all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-2(如果你有至少2个线索，改为-4)。
[tablet]：-2。如果你所在地点有隐匿迷你卡牌，再揭示一个混乱标记。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你检定失败，你必须花费1个线索，或在阴影中的一个敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.name: 谜雨
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-1(如果你有至少2个线索，改为-3)。
[tablet]：-1。如果你所在地点有隐匿迷你卡牌，再揭示一个混乱标记。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，你必须花费1个线索，或在阴影中的一个敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you have 2 or more clues).
[tablet]: -2. If there is a concealed mini-card at your location, reveal another chaos token.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, you must either spend 1 clue or place 1 doom on an enemy in the shadows.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you have 2 or more clues).
[tablet]: -1. If there is a concealed mini-card at your location, reveal another chaos token.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, you must either spend 1 clue or place 1 doom on an enemy in the shadows.

all_card.back_flavor: 结果你发现有人跟踪。你注意到身后的雨街中有身影尾随，对方还装作手头另有急切的事情。你一度以为是自己的妄想症发作。要想确认，只有一个法子。你检验自己的判断——加快脚步，在街巷里漫无目的地穿行，再三检查对方在干什么。结果对方无时不在，一直盯着你。果然是被盯上了。你改变计划，果断出击。如果这是戴红手套男子的手下，那你一定要查个明白。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员受到1点恐惧。将放在一边的肯辛顿花园、威斯敏斯特修道院和大本钟地点放置入场。 调查员队长抽取放在一边的戴红手套的男子敌人并结算其隐匿关键词。(将戴红手套的男子生成在阴影中。拿取其迷你卡牌和1[per_investigator]张诱饵，正面朝下混洗，放置入场，在离调查员队长最近的地点中，尽可能平均地分配。) 每位调查员失去其所有线索。将场景直接推进到场景2a(不结算场景1b)。
all_card.flavor: 你抵达伦敦，耐心地等候联络人…… 但谁也没有来。你坐在特拉法尔加广场外面一家隐蔽又狭窄的僻静茶馆。福林探员 —— 或者他的代表 —— 本该来此与你碰头。你不禁想问到底出了什么岔子，又担心最坏的情况可能已经发生，于是动身前往调查。
all_card.name: 偏逢大雨······
all_card.text: 强制 - 在本密谋推进时：将上面所有的毁灭标记移动到下一个密谋。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Eventually, you notice the tail. The figure stalks you through the rainy streets, pretending to have some other pressing task at hand. For once, you believe your paranoia may have paid off. But there is only one way to know for sure. So you test your theory - walking faster, moving aimlessly through the streets, and doubling back to see what they do. Every time, there they are. Watching you. It's a tail, all right. You flip the script and begin to give chase, instead. If they work for the man with the red gloves, you are going to find out.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator takes 1 horror. Put the set-aside Kensington Gardens, Westminster Abbey, and Big Ben locations into play. The lead investigator draws the set-aside The Red-Gloved Man enemy and resolves his concealed keyword. (Spawn The Red-Gloved Man in the shadows. Take his mini-card and 1 [per_investigator] decoys, shuffle them facedown, and put them into play divided as evenly as possible among the locations nearest to the lead investigator.) Each investigator loses each of their clues. Advance the act directly to act 2a (do not resolve act 1b).
all_card.real_flavor: Arriving in London, you patiently await your contact... but none arrives. Inspector Flint - or one of his proxies - was supposed to meet you at a quiet teahouse tucked away in a narrow storefront just outside Trafalgar Square. Wondering what could have gone wrong, and suspecting the worst, you set off to investigate.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 你穿越雨街和浓雾一路追逐，但怎么也抓不到那个男子。他屡屡逃脱，你只能瞧见一缕黯淡的红色。接着，视线里闪过一个不辨实状的身影，来去之疾，有如闪电。附近一座巨大的电话亭也随之而去。你大为惶恐，小心翼翼地接近电话亭还残余的部分。所剩的只是一团形体模糊的虚影，就像尚未冲洗的底片。你缓了一会儿才重新上路。你发现自己的猎物已经往东边逃去，那里的天际线上耸立着伦敦塔桥的高大身影。
all_card.back_text: 在剧本日志中记1时间。将戴红手套的男子敌人和每张隐匿迷你卡牌放在一边，位于场外。将放在一边的塔桥和伦敦塔地点放置入场。将遭遇弃牌堆和放在一边的猩红阴谋与域外来客遭遇组一同洗入遭遇牌库。每位调查员失去其所有线索。将场景直接推进到场景3a(不结算场景2b)。
all_card.flavor: 你肯定叫自己给耍了。雨只要一小，伦敦的浓雾中就会舞动着扭曲的身影。这些就是福林探员照片里出现的扭曲吗？还是你的猎物潜藏在阴暗的迷雾之中？
all_card.name: 雾中身影
all_card.text: 强制 - 在本密谋推进时：将上面所有的毁灭标记移动到下一个密谋。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Through the rainy streets and dense fog you give chase, but no matter what you do, the man you seek constantly eludes your grasp. All you catch is the barest hint of the color red as he slips out of view once more. Then, fast as a flash of lightning and gone just as swiftly, a formless shape ducks out of view. A chunk of a nearby telephone booth goes along with it. After a moment of trepidation, you inch forward and examine what remains of the booth. All that remains is an ectoplasmic substance, appearing like the negative of an undeveloped photo. It takes you a while to pick up the trail once more. When you do, you find that your quarry has fled to the east, where the Tower Bridge looms over the skyline.
all_card.real_back_text: Mark 1 time in your Campaign Log. Set The Red-Gloved Man enemy and each concealed mini-card aside, out of play. Put the set-aside Tower Bridge and Tower of London locations into play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside Crimson Conspiracy and Outsiders encounter sets into the encounter deck. Each investigator loses each of their clues. Advance the act directly to act 3a (do not resolve act 2b).
all_card.real_flavor: Your mind must be playing tricks on you. Misshapen figures dance through the dense London fog whenever the rain lets up. Are these distortions, like the one in the photograph Inspector Flint showed you? Or is it your quarry hiding in the mist and gloom?
all_card.real_text: Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.

all_card.back_flavor:
夜色愈发浓重，大雨变成了风暴。每一处阴影，每一声响动，每一个身形都吓得你不轻。你不禁怀疑此番调查是否明智。
或许还有更多潜藏的身影在注视着你，等待发起进攻的绝佳时机。
all_card.back_text:
调查员队长必须决定(选择一项)：
- 查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张同志会特工敌人并将其抽取。混洗遭遇牌库。
- 每位调查员受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.flavor: 显然福林探员的直觉非常准确。戴红手套的男子并非独自行动。无论他在干什么，都和最近的消失事件脱不了干系。你可以等待，报告自己所见的一切。但要是如此，这个男子和他同伙肯定已经实施了自己计划的密谋。不行——你只有一个选择。你必须不惜一切代价找到戴红手套的男子。
all_card.name: 其中关联
all_card.real_back_flavor:
As the night grows deeper and the rain becomes a torrent, you flinch at every moving shadow, every sound, every shape. You wonder if perhaps this investigation is getting the best of you.
Or maybe there are more of them than you thought, watching you. Lying in wait for the perfect opportunity to strike.
all_card.real_back_text:
The lead investigator must decide (choose one):
- Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Coterie Agent enemy and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
- Each investigator takes 1 damage and 1 horror.
all_card.real_flavor: It is clear now that Inspector Flint's hunches were correct. The man in the red gloves is not operating alone, and whatever he is up to, it has something to do with the recent vanishings. You could wait to report what you have seen, but by then the man and his cohorts may have already put into motion whatever scheme the planning. No - you have only one choice. You must find the man with the red gloves, at all costs.

all_card.back_text:
如果是场景1、2或3：
你用尽全力，但还是跟丢了人。你找不到戴红手套的男子一伙的任何踪迹。更糟的是，你甚至不知道他们在伦敦究竟有什么目的。你别无选择，只能将自己所知的一点点可怜情报给福林探员汇报。
(→结局4)(第8页)
如果是场景4：
你一路追寻戴红手套的男子，最终来到了塔楼牢房里的隐蔽角落。你在石质拱门下匍匐，蹑手蹑脚地穿过世人遗忘的潮湿长廊，终于找到了他。他正掀开石窖的顶盖，在研究里面的尸体。一看到你进来，他就夺过这个可怜人眼眶里小小的红石头，又溜进了阴影之中。
(→结局3)(第8页)
all_card.flavor: 浓雾遮蔽了月光，整座城市一片黑暗。屋檐上的渡鸦望着你前行，似乎带有非人的智慧。每一处阴影的扰动都吓得你心惊肉跳。要是你没能找到戴红手套的男子，阻止他的计划，谁知道会发生什么？
all_card.name: 阴谋阴郁
all_card.real_back_text:
If it is act 1, 2, or 3:
Despite your best efforts, the trail has gone cold. You cannot find any sign of the man with the red gloves or his cohorts. What's worse, you have no idea what their goal was in London to begin with. You have no choice but to report back to Inspector Flint with what little you have learned.
(→R4) (page 8) If it is act 4:
Your search for the man with the red gloves has led you into a hidden section of the tower prison. You duck under stone archways and sneak through dank, forgotten halls until finally, you find him: the man with the red gloves. He has lifted the lid from a stone crypt and is studying the corpse inside. The moment he sees you enter, he pulls a small ruby marble from the eyesocket of the unfortunate soul, then slips back into the shadows.
(→R3) (page 8)
all_card.real_flavor: Deep fog blots out the moonlight, bathing the city in utter darkness. From the rooftops, ravens watch your progress with inhuman intelligence. Every moving shadow sets your mind racing. If you don't find the man with the red gloves and stop his plans, who knows what he will do next?

all_card.back_flavor:
一辆亮红色的巴士开过，就在此时，你发现了街对面的身影。你确信对方正望着你。巴士在雾街中划过一道红色的长线。开过的时候，那个身影不见了。
兴许是你的妄想症在作祟，但这也太巧合了。这肯定是你的联络人，要不就是你的敌人，甚至可能是他们消失的原因。你做足准备，追了上去。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的肯辛顿花园、威斯敏斯特修道院和大本钟地点放置入场。 调查员队长抽取放在一边的戴红手套的男子敌人并结算其隐匿关键词。(将戴红手套的男子生成在阴影中。拿取其迷你卡牌和1[per_investigator]张诱饵，正面朝下混洗，放置入场，在离调查员队长最近的地点中，尽可能平均地分配。) 将密谋直接推进到密谋2a(不结算密谋1b)。
all_card.flavor: 你将雨伞拉近，遮住自己。你路上遇到的每个人都可能是联络人……或者来除掉你的人。
all_card.name: 纵横之谜
all_card.text: 目标 - 在密谋推进前，共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You spot the figure on the other side of the street just as a bright red bus approaches. You are certain whoever was there was staring directly at you. The bus cuts a swath through the foggy street, and when it has passed, the figure is gone.
Perhaps it is just your paranoia at work, but it cannot be a coincidence. It must have either been your contact, or one of their foes. Perhaps even the reason they are missing. Steeling yourself for any possibility, you set off in chase.
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Kensington Gardens, Westminster Abbey, and Big Ben locations into play. The lead investigator draws the set-aside The Red-Gloved Man enemy and resolves his concealed keyword. (Spawn The Red-Gloved Man in the shadows. Take his mini-card and 1 [per_investigator] decoys, shuffle them facedown, and put them into play divided as evenly as possible among the locations nearest to the lead investigator.) Advance the agenda directly to agenda 2a (do not resolve agenda 1b).
all_card.real_flavor: You draw your umbrella closer, using it to obscure your identity. Each person you pass on the street could be your contact... or be out to get you.
all_card.real_text: Objective - As a group, spend the requisite number of clues to advance before the agenda advances.

all_card.back_flavor: 你费尽千辛万苦，终于追上去了。你认出对方戴的红手套，顿知自己绝非臆想。你追逐的不是幻影，就是你一直要找的人。连绵的大雨和浓雾掩护你前进，你已经将他逼入狭窄的小巷。他周围还有几个身影——兴许是一次碰头？他朝你的方向投来面无表情的一瞥，惊着你了。接着，视线里闪过一个不辨实状的身影，来去之疾，有如闪电。附近的建筑也随之而去。你正要质问猎物发生了什么，他们却都往东逃去了。你小心翼翼地接近残余的半堵墙，却发现上面笼罩着一团形体模糊的虚影，就像尚未冲洗的底片。
all_card.back_text: 将戴红手套的男子放在一边，位于场外。将放在一边的塔桥和伦敦塔地点放置入场。将放在一边的猩红阴谋与域外来客遭遇组和遭遇弃牌堆一同洗入遭遇牌库。将密谋直接推进到密谋3a(不结算密谋2b)。
all_card.flavor: 你在夜幕的笼罩下追寻一道阴影，这无异于大海捞针。但你还是奋勇向前，希望能找到证据，将你引向真相……
all_card.name: 游戏开始！
all_card.text: 目标 - 在密谋推进前追上神秘的身影。如果调查员与戴红手套的男子交战，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: After much toil and pursuit, you finally catch up to the figure you've been chasing. A feeling of vindication washes over you as you spot the red gloves the man wears. It was no phantom you chased; this is the one you have sought all along. You corner him in a narrow alleyway, sheets of rain and fog masking your approach. Several more figures flank the man - a meeting, perhaps? To your surprise, he casts an expressionless glance in your direction. Then, fast as a flash of lightning and gone just as swiftly, a formless shape ducks out of view. A chunk of a nearby building goes along with it. When you turn to question your quarry about what happened, they have all fled east. You inch forward and examine the partially-excised wall, covered in an ectoplasmic substance, like the negative of an undeveloped photo.
all_card.real_back_text: Set The Red-Gloved Man aside, out of play. Put the set-aside Tower Bridge and Tower of London locations into play. Shuffle the set-aside Crimson Conspiracy and Outsiders encounter sets into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 3a (do not resolve agenda 2b).
all_card.real_flavor: You chase a shadow shrouded by night. It might as well be a needle in a haystack. But still you search, hoping for any clue that may lead you to the truth...
all_card.real_text: Objective - Chase down the mysterious figure before the agenda advances. If an investigator engages The Red-Gloved Man, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
你小心翼翼，悄然无声，远远地跟在那个身影后面。他迅速迈进了那座阴森的塔楼，是要寻找什么。
你从阴影中窥探，发现戴红手套的男子终于在烛光点燃的大厅里找到了自己想要的东西：在众多立柱中，有一块松动的砖头。他漫不经心地将砖头转回应有的位置，仿佛手上不过是一件放错位置的脏衣。惊人的是，附近的墙壁居然也转开了一个口子，露出一条秘密通道。他遁入黑暗，而你也秘密跟上。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的塔楼牢房地点放置入场。将放在一边的渡鸦之眼钥匙附属到塔楼牢房，不由任何人控制。
将场上所有的隐匿迷你卡牌移动到塔楼牢房。
抽取放在一边的戴红手套的男子敌人并结算其隐匿关键词，将所有这些隐匿迷你卡牌都放置入场，放到塔楼牢房。
all_card.flavor: 你最后瞧见那个男人往东逃了。越过塔桥，就是闻名遐迩的伦敦塔。你赶过去的时候，更多的眼睛正盯着你。那是一大团漆黑的渡鸦，徘徊不去。他为什么要到那儿去呢……？
all_card.name: 塔上黑眼
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有伦敦塔的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Quietly and cautiously, you follow the figure from a distance. With measured haste, he darts to and fro inside the ominous tower. Searching for something.
Finally, while you watch from the shadows, the man with the red gloves finds what he is looking for: a loose brick along one of the candlelit hall's many columns. He casually rotates the stone back into place with the kind of nonchalance as if he were dealing with a piece of misplaced laundry. To your surprise, a section of the nearby wall rotates in turn, revealing a secret passageway. He ascends into darkness, and you follow in secret.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put the set-aside Tower Prison location into play. Attach the set-aside The Eye of Ravens key to the Tower Prison, not controlled by anyone.
Move all concealed mini-cards in play to the Tower Prison.
Draw the set-aside The Red-Gloved Man enemy and resolve his concealed keyword, putting all of those concealed mini-cards into play at the Tower Prison.
all_card.real_flavor: Your gaze turns eastward, in the direction you last saw the man heading. Over the Tower Bridge lies the famed Tower of London, where even more eyes watch your approach, these belonging to a conspiracy of dark and brooding ravens. For what reason could he be heading there...?
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators at the Tower of London may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果你击败了戴红手套的男子：
他捂住胸口踉跄退后。小小的物件在地上咔哒作响。男子什么都没有说——只是从黑暗中注视着你。他的手套波动着，仿佛猩红的深池上泛起涟漪。片刻之后，他挺直身子，遁入阴影，压低帽子，消失了。
将戴红手套的男子加入胜利区。(→结局1)(第7页)。
如果戴红手套的男子上面有1[per_investigator]资源：
男子停了下来，面对着你，仿佛被你一连串的问题激起了兴趣。但他身处黑暗，你无法琢磨他的表情。“……有趣，”他低语道，“非常有趣。”他的嗓音起伏反常，仿佛正在检查每个词语的腔调，又仿佛他根本不习惯说话。
将戴红手套的男子加入胜利区。(→结局2)(第7页)。
all_card.flavor: 在世人遗忘的地窖深处，戴红手套的男子正在寻找什么……但是为什么呢？
all_card.name: 当场抓获
all_card.text: 戴红手套的男子获得：“[action]：谈判。检定[willpower]或[intellect](5)以盘问戴红手套的男子。如果你检定成功，在他上面放置1资源。” 目标 - 阻止戴红手套的男子窃取渡鸦之眼。如果他被击败，或他上面有1[per_investigator]资源，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If you defeated The Red-Gloved Man:
The figure reels backward, grasping at his wound. Something small clatters to the ground. The man says nothing - only glares at you from the darkness. His gloves seem to ripple around his hands, like the disturbed surface of a deep crimson pool, and after a moment, he straightens himself. Then, blending into the shadows, he tips his hat and is gone.
Add The Red-Gloved Man to the victory display. (→R1) (page 7) If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on The Red-Gloved Man:
The man stops and faces you, seemingly intrigued by your line of questioning, although in the darkness you cannot study his expression. "... interesting," he whispers. "Very interesting." His voice has a strange, uneven quality, like he is testing the tone of each word. Like one unaccustomed to speaking.
Add The Red-Gloved Man to the victory display. (→R2) (page 7)
all_card.real_flavor: Somewhere in these forgotten crypts, the man with the red gloves is searching for something... but for what purpose?
all_card.real_text: The Red-Gloved Man gains: "[action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (5) to interrogate The Red-Gloved Man. If you succeed, place 1 resource on him." Objective - Stop The Red-Gloved Man from stealing The Eye of Ravens. If he is defeated, or if there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on him, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 冷雨噼里啪啦地落在沉闷的街上，颇有些节奏。尽管为时已晚，广场上汽车、马车和行人还是熙熙攘攘。你要找的人就藏在拥挤的城市某处……但你还来得及吗？
all_card.name: 伦敦雨街
all_card.text: 伦敦雨街得到+X隐藏值。X为当前场景编号。 强制 - 如果伦敦雨街没有线索：在上面增加线索，直到其有1[per_investigator]个线索。 [action]：撤退。“我们应该等等福林探员……”
all_card.real_back_flavor: Cold rain pelts the dreary streets in a rhythmic pitter-patter. Despite the hour, the square is bustling with automobiles, carriages, and pedestrians. Somewhere in this crowded city is the man you seek... or are you already too late?
all_card.real_text: Rainy London Streets gets +X shroud. X is the current act number. Forced - If there are no clues on Rainy London Streets: Add clues to it until it has 1 [per_investigator] clues on it. [action]: Resign. "We should wait for Inspector Flint..."

all_card.back_flavor: 威斯敏斯特宫北段的钟楼俯瞰全城，是伦敦天际线上一道不容错过的风景，仿佛一位警惕的守望者瞪大的眼睛。
all_card.name: 大本钟
all_card.text: [free]：选择大本钟或一个连接地点的一张隐匿迷你卡牌并检定[agility](2)。如果你检定成功，查看该隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧。(每回合仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: A fixture of the London skyline, the clock tower at the north end of the Palace of Westminster looms over the city, its face like the eye of a watchful guardian.
all_card.real_text: [fast]: Choose a concealed mini-card at Big Ben or a connecting location and test [agility] (2). If you succeed, look at the revealed side of that concealed mini-card (without exposing it). If you fail, take 1 horror. (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.back_flavor: 宫殿旁哥特式的修道院既有着十足的宗教意义，也是英国王室传统的长眠之所。绵绵细雨惹人不安地飘泼起来。修道院的窗里闪着灯光。在这样的圣所寻求指引理所当然，但你也想知道古老的墙壁后是否还藏了其他东西。
all_card.name: 威斯敏斯特修道院
all_card.text: [action]：谈判。选择一个地点并检定[willpower](1)以在修道院周围打听。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，查看所选地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Gothic abbey near the palace is both a place of religious significance and a traditional burial site for English royals. Lights flicker in the windows as the gentle rain turns to an ominous downpour. You would not be the first to seek guidance on such hallowed ground, but you wonder what else may be at work within its aged walls.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Parley. Choose a location and test [willpower] (1) to ask around the abbey. For each point you succeed by, look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at the chosen location (without exposing it). (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor:
这一夜非常致郁，连御园的美丽也于事无补。
大雨如注，再这样下去圆池都要泛滥成灾。
人们常常来此会面——兴许戴红手套的男子和他的同伙就在这儿？
all_card.name: 肯辛顿花园
all_card.text: [reaction]你揭露在肯辛顿花园的诱饵后：治愈1点恐惧。 强制 - 你揭露在肯辛顿花园的敌人后：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The night's unusually somber mood is enough to drown out even the beauty of the royal park. The Round Pond threatens to flood as the downpour continues. This place has been a popular meeting ground for many years - perhaps the man with the red gloves and his cohorts are here?
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you expose a decoy at Kensington Gardens: Heal 1 horror. Forced - After you expose an enemy at Kensington Gardens: Take 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 横跨泰晤士河的塔桥虽然年轻，但也迅速成为一处文化地标，连接了伦敦中心和近年发展迅速的东区。越过塔桥，北边的乌云环绕着伦敦塔。
all_card.flavor: 传说囚徒都是坐驳船沿着泰晤士河送往伦敦塔。也许你也该遵循这可怕的旧例。
all_card.name: 塔桥
all_card.text: [action]：“兴许还有另一条路……”检定[willpower]或[intellect](5)。如果你检定成功，将放在一边的叛徒之门地点放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Spanning the River Thames, the newly built Tower Bridge has quickly become a cultural icon, connecting Central London with the East End, which has seen much growth in recent years. To the north, just over the bridge, a dark cloud encircles the Tower of London.
all_card.real_flavor: Stories have been told of the prisoners who were brought to the Tower of London by barge along the River Thames. Perhaps you could follow their morbid example.
all_card.real_text: [action]: "Maybe there is another way in..." Test [willpower] or [intellect] (5). If you succeed, put the set-aside Traitors' Gate location into play.

all_card.back_flavor: 尽管原本的水门早就用砖封上了，但你还是霸占了一艘小船沿河而行。也许这里还有潜入伦敦塔的秘密路线。
all_card.flavor: 从这里找一条路可能没那么简单。但要是你所料不虚，还是可以由此偷偷溜进去，不被任何人发现。你已经准备好要来一趟水下之旅，希望这门还没完全封死……
all_card.name: 叛徒之门
all_card.text: [action]：检定[combat]或[agility](5)。如果你检定成功，揭示伦敦塔。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Although the original entrance to the water gate has long since been bricked up, you commandeer a small vessel and make your way along the river anyway. Perhaps there is still a secret route one might take from here to infiltrate the Tower of London.
all_card.real_flavor: Finding a way in through here will be tricky, but if your hunch is right, you might be able to slip in without anyone suspecting your approach. You prepare yourself for an underwater excursion, hoping the gate wasn't fully blocked off...
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [combat] or [agility] (5). If you succeed, reveal the Tower of London. If you fail, take 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor:
一团乌鸦在城墙上环绕，颇为不祥。
数量之众，绝非巧合。
all_card.back_text:
通往塔楼的主门锁上了，还有卫兵把守。
作为进入伦敦塔的额外费用，塔桥的调查员必须共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.name: 伦敦塔
all_card.text: 强制 - 你在伦敦塔结束自己回合后：你必须失去2资源，或阴影中的每个敌人攻击你。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A conspiracy of ravens circle ominously over the castle walls. Far too many to be a coincidence.
all_card.real_back_text: The main gate into the Tower is locked and securely guarded. As an additional cost to enter the Tower of London, investigators at The Tower Bridge must spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you end your turn at the Tower of London: You must either lose 2 resources, or each enemy in the shadows attacks you.

all_card.back_flavor: 戴红手套的男子到底在这儿想获得什么？
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 隐匿迷你卡牌将要在非塔楼牢房地点入场时：改为将其放在塔楼牢房入场。
all_card.name: 塔楼牢房
all_card.text: [free]塔楼牢房的调查员执行技能检定时，花费1个线索：该调查员本次检定得到技能值+2。 强制 - 隐匿迷你卡牌将要在非塔楼牢房地点入场时：改为将其放在塔楼牢房入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor: What could the man with the red gloves possibly want in this place?
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - When a concealed mini-card would enter play anywhere other than Tower Prison: Put it into play at Tower Prison, instead.
all_card.real_text: [fast] While an investigator at Tower Prison is performing a skill test, spend 1 clue: That investigator gets +2 skill value for this test. Forced - When a concealed mini-card would enter play anywhere other than Tower Prison: Put it into play at Tower Prison, instead.

all_card.flavor: “我能记得的唯一细节就是他的手套：鲜红如血。”
all_card.name: 戴红手套的男子
all_card.text: 隐匿1[per_investigator]。反击。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同志会. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "The only detail I could remember was his gloves; red, red as blood."
all_card.real_text: Concealed 1 [per_investigator]. Retaliate.

all_card.flavor: 档案#5 - A19/客体等级：黄色/钥匙是一块小小的红石头，发现于同志会已故成员的眼眶。超维能力未知。
all_card.name: 渡鸦之眼
all_card.text: 变换 - 在你地点的技能检定期间，执行检定的调查员将其本次检定的基础技能值设为6。将本钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: File #5-A19 / Subject Class: Yellow / Key appears as small red marble found lodged in eyesocket of deceased Coterie operative. Paradimensional capabilities unknown.
all_card.real_text: Shift - During a skill test at your location, the performing investigator sets their base skill value for this test to 6. Flip this key to its [[Unstable]] side.

all_card.flavor: ……无论如何穿刺挤压，都完好如初。里面究竟是什么？ 这是一件仪器？ 抑或根本不是这个世界的产物？
all_card.name: 渡鸦之眼
all_card.text: 变换 - 抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。然后，如果是调查员变换了本钥匙，将其翻至[[稳定]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: ...completely impregnable despite all piercing and crushing attempts. What could possibly be inside? A device? Or another world entirely?
all_card.real_text: Shift - Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, if an investigator shifted this key, flip it to its [[Stable]] side.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：每有1[per_investigator]个平民遭到杀害，-2。
[cultist]：-6。选择你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。该敌人重整并攻击你。
[tablet]：-2。受到1点伤害。你所在地点的一个平民遭到杀害。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你检定失败，随机弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.name: 死亡酷暑
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：每有1[per_investigator]个平民遭到杀害，-1。
[cultist]：-4。如果你检定失败，选择你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。该敌人重整并攻击你。
[tablet]：-1。你可以受到1点伤害。如果你不这么做，你所在地点的一个平民遭到杀害。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，选择并弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 for every 1 [per_investigator] civilians slain.
[cultist]: -6. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. That enemy readies and attacks you.
[tablet]: -2. Take 1 damage. A civilian at your location is slain.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, discard 1 card from your hand at random.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 for every 1 [per_investigator] civilians slain.
[cultist]: -4. If you fail, choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. That enemy readies and attacks you.
[tablet]: -1. You may take 1 damage. If you do not, a civilian at your location is slain.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, choose and discard 1 card from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 夜幕愈深，你也愈发感到有什么东西在跟着自己。你转过身，看到三个高瘦的身影缓缓向前。他们的面容被阴影掩藏，看不真切，但鲜红潮湿的下颚和空洞的眼睛还是反射出了一点微光。你加快脚步，他们也提速跟上。就在他们要扑上来的时候，你迅速闪进附近的街巷，逃开了。你跑了几分钟，听到背后传来一阵堵在咽喉里的噪音，颇为刺耳，接着是衣服撕裂的声音。
all_card.back_text: 每有1[per_investigator]个平民遭到杀害，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个[[苏生]]或[[食尸鬼]]敌人，将其生成在一个随机地点。将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。(FAQ v2.2) 每位调查员决定(选择一项)： - 治愈场上每个[[精英]]敌人的2点伤害。 - 你所在地的1个平民遭到杀害。
all_card.flavor: 无论到了哪里，你都明显感觉自己被跟踪了，仿佛影子也在移动一般。你听到附近的街巷和小路里传来了磨牙吮血的声音。夜幕降临，这种不安的感觉随之剧增。
all_card.name: 咬牙切齿
all_card.text: 每个[[苏生]]敌人和每个[[食尸鬼]]敌人获得“生成 - 随机地点。”
all_card.real_back_flavor: As night falls, your sense of being followed only grows. Turning around, you see a trio of tall, lanky figures moving slowly. The shadows obscure their features, but a glint of light reflects on wet, red jaws and hollow eyes. When you quicken your pace, they quicken theirs. As the group bears down on you, you duck into a nearby alleyway and sprint away from them. After several minutes of running, you hear a rasping, gutteral howl followed by a sound like ripping cloth behind you.
all_card.real_back_text:
For every 1 [per_investigator] civilians slain, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Risen]] or [[Ghoul]] enemy and spawn it at a random location. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Each investigator decides (choose one):
- Heal 2 damage from each [[Elite]] enemy in play.
- 1 civilian at your location is slain.
all_card.real_flavor: Everywhere you go, you have the distinct feeling of being followed, as though the shadows themselves move of their own accord. In nearby alleyways and backroads, you hear the gnashing of teeth and the tearing of meat. The palpable sense of unease only grows stronger as night falls.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Risen]] enemy and each [[Ghoul]] enemy gains "Spawn - Random location."

all_card.back_flavor:
猩红的阳光洒在城市的废墟上，映照出一片可怕的光景：车辆倾倒，商店遭劫，卵石路上洒满了粘稠的血液。只剩寥寥无几的平民还躲在封死的窗后，惊恐万分地祈求活命。无论苋在此处的意图为何，她都得逞了。城中毁灭的惨状无情地证明了她有着多么强大的力量。
你心情沉重地穿越眼前的破败，如此惨重的损失压得你抬不起头。一群饥饿的死者闻到了你的味道，无休无止地追你直到城市的尽头。他们饥渴尖利的利爪伤你不浅，你仅以身免。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员承受1点肉体创伤。 检查场上的敌人。 - 如果拉辛·法瑞在场，进入(→结局1)(第13页)。 - 否则，进入(→结局2)(第13页)。
all_card.flavor: 每一晚都有更多的平民失踪，城市变得越来越寂静。到了暑热逼人的白天，街道上只有越来越多眼神空洞的身影。马拉喀什曾是生机盎然的文化绿洲，现在却只是先前繁荣的空洞倒影。
all_card.name: 空荡荡的街道
all_card.text: 每个[[苏生]]敌人和每个[[食尸鬼]]敌人获得猎手和“生成 - 随机地点。”
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A crimson sunrise casts the ruined city in an awful glow: cars overturned, stalls razed, cobblestones covered in blood smears. What few civilians remain cower behind boarded up windows, fearfully praying for their lives. Whatever terrible thing Amaranth aimed to do here, she has succeeded. The city's ruin is a grim testament to her awful power.
Heart heavy with the weight of such great loss, you make a path through the devastation. A pack of the hungering dead catch wind of your scent and pursue you relentlessly to the city limits, picking at you with sharp, hungry claws. You barely escape with your life.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator suffers 1 physical trauma. Check which enemies are in play. - If Razin Farhi is in play, proceed to (→R1) (page 13). - Otherwise, proceed to (→R2) (page 13).
all_card.real_flavor: The city grows quieter as more and more civilians disappear each night. The soul-deadening heat of the day sees more hollow-eyed figures walk the streets. Once a thriving oasis of life and culture, Marrakesh now feels like an empty echo of its former self.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Risen]] enemy and each [[Ghoul]] enemy gains hunter and "Spawn - Random location."

all_card.back_flavor:
你把苋的照片给几个当地人看了，他们指引你到郁郁葱葱的巴希尔宫花园去。你悄悄接近，发现戴着红花的女子正站在仪式法阵的边缘，法阵的角上都点着蜡烛，烛光照映着祭品，祭品中央的祭坛上有一具尸体。而在尸体的另一侧，是两个穿着古代华服的亡灵战士。
“马上，亲爱的。”苋敲过尸体的脸颊，她头发上系着的花朵展开了，黑暗的藤蔓向法阵外伸出，穿过了花园。草木触之尽枯。黑藤上闪过可怕的绿光，吸取了周围的生命。“看来我们有客人了。”苋狞笑道。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的苋敌人生成在巴希尔宫花园，(腐败潜伏)面朝上，并将放在一边的末绽之花钥匙附属在她上面。将放在一边的拯救平民剧情卡牌放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 将放在一边的哈立德敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 反常的现象不断发生：一位古代哲学家的坟墓遭劫；流言说街上徘徊着死者；更不用提这一连串的失踪案。要是你能收集苋的下落消息，兴许就能知道这些事情的真相。
all_card.name: 找到苋
all_card.text: 目标 - 当一轮结束时，在[[仪式地]]的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Showing the photograph of Amaranth to several locals, they direct you to the verdant Bahia Palace Gardens. Approaching carefully, you find the woman with the red flower standing at the edge of a ritual circle, candles lit at each point, with gleaming offerings gathered around a corpse laid on an altar in the center. On either side of the corpse, two dead warriors are laid on the ground, bedecked in ancient finery.
"Soon, my love," Amaranth strokes the cheek of the corpse as the blossom in her hair unfurls. Tenebrous vines radiate out from the circle and creep across the garden. The grass and greenery shrivel under their touch, and eerie green light shimmers up the black vines, drinking the life around it. "It appears we have guests," Amaranth smirks.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Amaranth enemy at Bahia Palace Gardens, (Lurking Corruption) side faceup, and attach the set-aside The Last Blossom key to her. Put the set-aside Save the Civilians story card into play next to the agenda deck. Shuffle the set-aside Khalid enemy into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: Strange happenings are afoot. A tomb robbery of an ancient philosopher. Rumors of the dead walking the streets. A string of disappearances. If you can gather information on Amaranth's whereabouts, you may be able to get to the bottom of things.
all_card.real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators at a [[Ritual Site]] location may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果本场景因其强制能力推进：
“拉辛，亲爱的！”苋喊道。仪式法阵中的尸体站了起来，一旁新复活的战士也随之而起。苋抱住了古代的哲学家，两人交织在黑色的藤蔓之中。她轻轻说道：“让我把这地方变成你的天堂，亲爱的。真正的天堂。”
将放在一边的拉辛·法瑞敌人生成在巴希尔宫花园。将放在一边的全部两张古代劫掠者敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
如果本场景因苋将要被击败推进：
你最后一击将苋打退，她在踉跄之中掀翻了古代火盆。火焰如饥似渴地吞没了仪式的残骸和尸体，苋痛苦地尖叫起来：“你知道自己都干了什么吗？拉辛，亲爱的……”
将苋翻至(腐败彰显)面，保留她所有的标记和附属，将她移动到一个没有调查员的随机地点。将放在一边的全部两张古代劫掠者敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 苋身上长出的枯萎藤蔓遍及全城。这个戴红花的女子偷来一具尸体，用它在巴希尔宫花园举行古怪的仪式。你必须不惜一切代价阻止她。
all_card.name: 生与死的仪式
all_card.text: 强制 - 在平民遭到杀害后，如果已有至少4 [per_investigator]个平民遭到杀害：推进本场景。 目标 - 如果苋将要被击败，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If this act advanced because of its forced ability:
"Razin, my love!" exclaims Amaranth. The body in the ritual circle rises to stand, along with two newly-resurrected warriors. Amaranth embraces the ancient philosopher, the two of them entwined with awful black tendrils. She speaks softly: "Let me make this place a paradise for you, my love. A true paradise."
Spawn the set-aside Razin Farhi enemy at Bahia Palace Gardens. Shuffle both copies of the set-aside Ancient Raider enemy into the encounter deck.
If this act advanced because Amaranth would be defeated:
Your final blow knocks Amaranth back, toppling an ancient brazier. As hungry flames consume the remnants of the ritual and the corpses, she screeches in anguish. "Do you have any idea what you have done? Razin, my love..."
Flip Amaranth to her (Corruption Revealed) side, keeping all tokens and attachments on her, and move her to a random location with no investigators. Shuffle both copies of the set-aside Ancient Raider enemy into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: A network of necrous vines has grown through the city, spurred on by Amaranth. The woman with the red flower is conducting strange rites upon a stolen corpse in the Bahia Palace Gardens. You must stop her at any cost.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After a civilian is slain, if 4[per_investigator] or more civilians have been slain: Advance this act. Objective - If Amaranth would be defeated, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
苋倒下了，街巷里回荡着她受难的尖叫。疾风将街上的沙尘吹起，在头顶的烈日下飘扬，仿佛是苦行僧的祭舞。黑色的液体洒满苋的四周，连结的藤蔓在你身旁枯萎干瘪。苏生的死者停了下来，仿佛在等你先动。你看到马拉喀什残存的平民逃出了城市。
你站在这个美丽又可怕的女子面前，心中不禁涌起一阵悲悯。你将她翻过身来，发现她耳边丰盈的花朵在暑气中已然枯萎。你从她耳边将花摘下，她发出一声压抑已久的悲鸣：花朵的茎杆比你想的还要长上几寸，上面黏糊糊地沾满了血液。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 - 如果特别小组知道了苋的真名，进入(→结局3)(第13页)。 - 否则，进入(→结局4) (第13页)。
all_card.flavor: 苋朝你步步逼近，可怕的藤蔓为她汲满了力量，封锁了街道。她残忍地狞笑，头发上的大花宛若血盆大口一样地绽放。
all_card.name: 虚无的女王
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果苋和拉辛·法瑞都不在场上，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Amaranth's tortured cry resounds through the streets as she collapses. A heady wind picks up, whipping the dust in the street into a frantic dervish as the hot sun beats down overhead. Black ichor pools around Amaranth's body as the nexus of vines begins to wither and dessicate around you. The hordes of risen dead stop in their tracks, as if waiting for your move. You can see the remaining civilians of Marrakesh flee the city beyond them.
Standing over the beautiful, terrible woman, you feel a pang of pity. As you turn her over, you notice the voluptuous flower behind her ear has wilted in the heat. She lets out a primal scream as you pull the blossom from her ear: the stem is several inches longer than you expected, and sticky with blood.
all_card.real_back_text: Check your Campaign Log. - If the cell knows Amaranth's real name, proceed to (→R3) (page 13). - Otherwise, proceed to (→R4) (page 13).
all_card.real_flavor: Unnatural vines choke the city streets as Amaranth pursues you, drunk with power. The blossom in her hair stretches wide like a garnet maw as she laughs cruelly.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If neither Amaranth nor Razin Farhi are in play, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你对马拉喀什的初见印象还算不错。暖风干爽和煦，摩尔式的建筑和彩色瓷砖也很迷人。不过，你还是体会到周围传来一阵难以言喻的恐惧。
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 如果马拉喀什火车站上没有平民：将其与放在一边的[[废弃]]版本交换。
all_card.name: 马拉喀什火车站
all_card.text: [free]：移动(到一个连接地点)。(团队每回合仅限一次。) [action]：撤退。你逃出了这座城。(注意：如果场上没有调查员，那么场上剩余的所有平民都会遭到杀害。) 强制 - 如果马拉喀什火车站上没有平民：将其与放在一边的[[废弃]]版本交换。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your initial impression of Marrakesh seems pleasant, from the gentle, dry heat to the striking Moorish architecture and colorful tilework. However, you also sense an unspoken fear among those around you.
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - If Marrakesh Railway Station has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.
all_card.real_text: [fast]: Move (to a connecting location). (Group limit once per turn.) [action]: Resign. You flee the city. (Note: If there are no investigators in play, all remaining civilians in play will be slain.) Forced - If Marrakesh Railway Station has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.

all_card.back_flavor: 这个庞大的露天广场是马拉喀什的商业中心。无论是想大快朵颐，还是获取补给，都可以到这儿来。空气中传来了杂耍艺人的乐声，还有香料和烤肉的气味。
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 如果德吉玛广场上没有平民：将其与放在一边的[[废弃]]版本交换。
all_card.name: 德吉玛广场
all_card.text: [action]如果本地点有平民：揭示你牌库顶的6张卡牌。你可以打出这些卡牌中的一张支援(支付其费用)。将其余卡牌洗入你的牌库。(每场游戏仅限一次) 强制 - 如果德吉玛广场上没有平民：将其与放在一边的[[废弃]]版本交换。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The center of commerce in Marrakesh, this huge open-air market is the go-to place for acquiring food and supplies. The air is thick with the music of buskers and the smell of spices and roasted meats.
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - If Jemaa el-Fnaa Square has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.
all_card.real_text: [action] If 1 or more civilians are on this location: Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. You may play an asset from among those cards (paying its cost). Shuffle the rest into your deck. (Limit once per game.) Forced - If Jemaa el-Fnaa Square has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.

all_card.back_flavor: 萨阿德王朝的陵墓是摩洛哥16世纪众王的长眠之所。一些精美的瓷砖已在最近的盗窃案中遭劫。
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 如果萨阿德王陵上没有平民：将其与放在一边的[[废弃]]版本交换。
all_card.name: 萨阿德王陵
all_card.text: 萨阿德王陵上每有一个平民，得到+1隐藏值。 强制 - 在非[[精英]]敌人进入或生成在萨阿德王陵时，与任意调查员交战前：将其横置。 强制 - 如果萨阿德王陵上没有平民：将其与放在一边的[[废弃]]版本交换。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The royal necropolis of the Saadian dynasty, this is the final resting place for much of Morocco's 16th-century royalty. Some of its beautiful tilework was destroyed with the recent theft.
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - If Saadian's Tombs has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.
all_card.real_text: Saadian's Tombs gets +1 shroud for each civilian on it. Forced - When a non-[[Elite]] enemy enters or spawns at Saadian's Tombs, before it engages any investigators: Exhaust it. Forced - If Saadian's Tombs has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.

all_card.back_flavor: 你听闻神秘的失踪案就发生在鞣革场附近。那里用大罐盛装刺激的化学药剂和染料处理皮革。
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 如果鞣革厂上没有平民：将其与放在一边的[[废弃]]版本交换。
all_card.name: 鞣革厂
all_card.text: [free]从遭遇弃牌堆选择一个[[苏生]]敌人，将其生成并与你交战：(从供应堆)放置线索在鞣革场上，数量等于该敌人的生命值。 强制 - 如果鞣革厂上没有平民：将其与放在一边的[[废弃]]版本交换。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You have heard reports of strange disappearances near the tanneries, where leather is processed in large vats of pungent chemicals and dyes.
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - If Tanneries has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Choose a [[Risen]] enemy from the encounter discard pile and spawn it engaged with you: Place clues on Tanneries (from the token pool) equal to that enemy's health. Forced - If Tanneries has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.

all_card.back_flavor: 植被繁盛的宫殿吸引了许多慕名而来的旅客。在环境严酷的沙漠中，御花园这样一片茂密的绿洲自然就成了王宫的明珠。
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 如果巴希尔宫花园上没有平民：将其与放在一边的[[废弃]]版本交换。
all_card.name: 巴希尔宫花园
all_card.text: [reaction]你在巴希尔宫花园解救了平民后：治愈1点伤害或1点恐惧。 强制 - 如果巴希尔宫花园上没有平民：将其与放在一边的[[废弃]]版本交换。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The sprawling and opulent palace draws many admirers. The jewel of the palace is its courtyard garden: an oasis of lush vegetation amidst a harsh desert.
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - If Bahia Palace Gardens has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you rescue a civilian on Bahia Palace Gardens: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror. Forced - If Bahia Palace Gardens has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.

all_card.back_flavor: 一度熙熙攘攘的火车站现在寂静荒凉。负责的工作人员将所有的班车都推迟到了明日。马拉喀什发生的事情看来已经传远。
all_card.name: 马拉喀什火车站
all_card.text: 作为移动离开马拉喀什火车站的额外费用，你必须花费1资源。 [action]：撤退。你慌忙逃命。(注意：如果场上没有调查员，那么场上剩余的所有平民都会遭到杀害。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The once-bustling station is now quiet and lonely. The attendants in charge have delayed the train until tomorrow; news of what is happening in Marrakesh seems to have spread quickly.
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost for you to move out of Marrakesh Railway Station, you must spend 1 resource. [action]: Resign. You run for your life. (Note: If there are no investigators in play, all remaining civilians in play will be slain.)

all_card.back_flavor: 微风吹过空荡荡的广场，与之同来的还有苏生的死者缓慢的脚步声和低沉的吼叫。
all_card.flavor: 摊子桌子全都倾覆，商品都毁了。整座广场再见不到客人和商贩。你在这儿再也买不到东西了。
all_card.name: 德吉玛广场
all_card.text: 你位于德吉玛广场时，你打出每张支援的费用提升2点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Wind whistles through the empty square, accompanied by the sound of slow footsteps and low groans of the risen.
all_card.real_flavor: Stalls and tables are tipped over and merchandize is ruined. The entire square is devoid of both patrons and merchants. You won't be buying anything here anytime soon.
all_card.real_text: While you are at Jemaa el-Fnaa Square, increase the cost of each asset you play by 2.

all_card.back_flavor: 曾经的圣所已遭亵渎，布满了鲜血和散发着死亡气味的身影。
all_card.flavor: 苏生的死者大军还会害怕坟墓吗？抑或他们只是厌恶死亡？
all_card.name: 萨阿德王陵
all_card.text: 强制 - 在非[[精英]]敌人进入萨阿德王陵时，与任意调查员交战前：治愈其全部伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: This once-holy place is now desecrated and overrun with figures that reek of death and fresh blood.
all_card.real_flavor: Do the risen throngs still fear the tombs? Or do they merely resent death?
all_card.real_text: Forced - When a non-[[Elite]] enemy enters Saadian's Tombs, before it engages any investigators: Heal all damage from it.

all_card.back_flavor: 不知怎的，旧鞣革场周围苏生的死者格外活跃。为什么会聚集在这儿？
all_card.flavor: 你看到苏生的死者纷纷栽进化学药剂池中，大口吞下臭味熏人的液体。苋的法术无法让这些尸体维系多久，也许是靠这种古怪的仪式才能继续支撑住他们腐化的身体。
all_card.name: 鞣革厂
all_card.text: 位于鞣革场的每个[[苏生]]敌人得到+1攻击与+1躲避。
all_card.real_back_flavor: For some reason, the risen dead have been especially active near the old tanneries. Why congregate here?
all_card.real_flavor: You watch the risen intentionally submerge themselves into pools of chemicals and swallow great mouthfuls of the foul liquid. Amaranth's power can only stave off decomposition so long. Perhaps this strange ritual preserves their rotting tissue.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Risen]] enemy at Tanneries gets +1 fight and +1 evade.

all_card.back_flavor: 一度生机盎然的花园现在已被黑色的荆藤占据。剩余的树木十分脆弱，你一碰就碎裂了。喷泉也已干涸。
all_card.flavor: “人择其所利，天择其所顾。”<cite>查尔斯·达尔文《物种起源》</cite>
all_card.name: 巴希尔宫花园
all_card.text: 强制 - 你在巴希尔宫花园结束自己回合时：受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。
all_card.traits: 马拉喀什. 仪式地. 废弃
all_card.real_back_flavor: The once-vibrant gardens are choked with black, thorned vines. The remaining trees are frail and flake under your touch, and the fountains run dry.
all_card.real_flavor: "Man selects only for his own good: Nature only for that of the being which she tends." - Charles Darwin, The Origin of Species
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you end your turn at Bahia Palace Gardens: Take 1 damage or 1 horror.

all_card.flavor: 尘土飞扬的街道上传来一声刺耳的尖叫，接着是一阵进食的声音。你在城市中穿行，一旁的路人纷纷逃离饥饿的死者。身边全是腐肉和鲜血的味道。只有你才能拯救这座城市免遭可怕的命运。
all_card.name: 拯救平民
all_card.text: 马拉喀什的平民遭到攻击！将他们救出险境，或许你可以避免一场屠杀。(注意：留在地点上的平民既未被解救，也未遭到杀害。) [action]花费1个线索：解救你所在地点的一个平民(将其放在本卡牌上)。 强制 - 在游戏结束时，将本卡牌翻面(保留其所有的标记)。
all_card.real_flavor: A piercing howl resounds through the dusty streets, accompanied by the sound of feeding. Bystanders flee packs of the hungry dead as you traverse the city. All around you is the scent of rot and blood. Only you can save the people of this city from a terrible fate.
all_card.real_text: The civilians of Marrakesh are under attack! By getting them out of harm's way, you may be able to avert a massacre. (Note: Civilians still on locations are neither rescued nor slain.) [action] Spend 1 clue: Rescue a civilian from your location (place it on this card). Forced - When the game ends: flip this card (keep all tokens on it).

all_card.flavor: 天已破晓，马拉喀什的幸存者现身，开始清点遭劫的人数。
all_card.name: 后果
all_card.text: 比较后果上被解救的平民数量和冒险参考卡牌上遭到杀害的平民数量。(注意：留在地点上的平民既未被解救，也未遭到杀害。) - 如果被解救的平民数量大于遭到杀害的平民，每位调查员取得2点奖励经验值。如果被解救的平民数量大于遭到杀害的平民的两倍，每位调查员取得额外2点奖励经验值。 - 如果遭到杀害的平民数量大于被解救的平民，每位调查员承受1点精神创伤。如果遭到杀害的平民数量大于被解救的平民的两倍，每位调查员承受额外1点精神创伤。 - 如果两者相等，无事发生。
all_card.real_flavor: As day breaks, the remaining survivors in Marrakesh emerge and the morbid arithmetic of counting survivors begins.
all_card.real_text: Compare the number of rescued civilians on Aftermath with the number of slain civilians on the Scenario Reference card. (Note: Civilians still on locations are neither rescued nor slain.) - If the number of rescued civilians is more than the number of slain civilians, each investigator earns 2 bonus experience. If the number of rescued civilians is more than twice the number of slain civilians, each investigator earns 2 additional bonus experience. - If the number of slain civilians is more than the number of rescued civilians, each investigator suffers 1 mental trauma. If the number of is more than twice the number of rescued civilians, each investigator suffers 1 additional mental trauma. - If it is a tie, nothing happens.

all_card.flavor: “许多人都说愿意为爱献出一切。而我真的这么做了。”
all_card.name: 苋
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在苋攻击的伤害或恐惧分配到支援时：击败该支援，且苋变换她身上附属的每个钥匙。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同志会. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "Many say they would do anything for love. But I actually mean it."
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When damage or horror from Amaranth's attack is assigned to an asset: Defeat that asset and Amaranth shifts each of her attached keys.

all_card.flavor: “你们不过是我花园里的杂草。”
all_card.name: 苋
all_card.text: 猎手。反击。 强制 - 在苋攻击时：她变换身上附属的每个钥匙。如果该次攻击的伤害和/或恐惧分配到支援，击败该支援。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同志会. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "All of you are just weeds in my garden."
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - When Amaranth attacks: She shifts each of her attached keys. If damage and/or horror from this attack is assigned to an asset, defeat that asset.

all_card.flavor: “我跨越数百年的时光，可不会被你击败！”
all_card.name: 拉辛·法瑞
all_card.text: 警戒。猎手。反击。 强制 - 在任意钥匙变换后：如果拉辛·法瑞已橫置，将其重整。否则，他立即对已交战的调查员进行一次攻击。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同志会. 苏生. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "I have not crossed vast oceans of time only to be defeated by the likes of you!"
all_card.real_text: Alert. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After any key is shifted: If Razin Farhi is exhausted, ready him. Otherwise, he makes an immediate attack against the engaged investigator.

all_card.flavor: 在昏暗的灯光和厚重的衣服下，他们可以笨拙地在活人中穿行。可要是到了白天，他们身上反常的苍白、呆滞的眼睛和可怕的伤口就一览无余。
all_card.name: 奴仆
all_card.text:
每轮抽取的第一张奴仆获得涌动。
[free]在你回合期间：尝试躲避奴仆。它本次躲避尝试获得警戒。(每回合仅限一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: With dim light and thick clothing they can clumsily pass for living, but by daylight their unnatural pallor, glassy eyes, and gruesome wounds are impossible to hide.
all_card.real_text:
The first copy of Thrall drawn each round gains surge.
[fast] During your turn: Attempt to evade Thrall. It gains alert for this evasion attempt. (Limit once per turn).

all_card.flavor: 这些战士生前是拉辛·法瑞的卫士，现在又带着诡异的斗志侍奉苋。
all_card.name: 古代劫掠者
all_card.text: 猎手。反击。 强制 - 在古代劫掠者攻击你后：你所在地点的1个平民遭到杀害。
all_card.real_flavor: The former vanguard of Razin Farhi, these soldiers now serve Amaranth with an unnatural fervor.
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After Ancient Raider attacks you: 1 civilian at your location is slain.

all_card.flavor: “他们都说猫有九条命，而这已经是我亲爱的哈立德第十条命了。”
all_card.name: 哈立德
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在哈立德入场后：将其所在地点的其他每个非[[精英]]敌人和平民移动到一个连接地点(尽可能平均分配)。
all_card.real_flavor: "They say cats have nine lives, but my sweet Khalid is already on his tenth."
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - After Khalid enters play: Move each other non-[[Elite]] enemy and civilian from its location to a connecting location (distributed as evenly as possible).

all_card.flavor: 那些吃枯萎谷物的人比挨饿的还死得早。
all_card.name: 饥荒
all_card.text: 显现 - 将饥荒放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 你打出每张卡牌的费用提升1点。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从场上弃掉饥荒。
all_card.real_flavor: Those that ate the blighted crop died even faster than those who chose to starve.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Famine into play next to the agenda deck. Increase the cost of each card you play by 1. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Famine from play.

all_card.flavor: 尽管苏生的死者移动缓慢，却会像狼群一样，先包围，再扑食。
all_card.name: 围困！
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[combat](3)。如果你检定失败，选择一项： - 你所在地点的1个平民遭到杀害。 - 你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: Although the risen move slowly, they hunt like wolves, surrounding their prey before they pounce.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [combat] (3). If you fail, either (choose one): - 1 civilian at your location is slain. - Take 1 damage for each point you fail by.

all_card.flavor: 档案#11 - B31/客体等级：红色/钥匙貌似一株外星植物，黑色的长茎杆缠绕蜷曲，已附在宿主的静脉内。
all_card.name: 末绽之花
all_card.text: 变换 - 治愈你所在地点每位调查员1点伤害和1点恐惧。将本钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: File #11-B31 / Subject Class: Red / Key appears as flora of extraterrestrial origin, with long, black prehnsile vines that attach intravenously with host.
all_card.real_text: Shift - Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from each investigator at your location. Flip this key to its [[Unstable]] side.

all_card.flavor: ……与宿主建立了神经联系，极度类似于寄生关系，已占据宿主的思维和记忆。
all_card.name: 末绽之花
all_card.text: 变换 - 治愈场上每个敌人1点伤害。然后，如果是调查员变换了本钥匙，将其翻至[[稳定]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: ...forming a neural link with host, much like the symbiotic relationship of a parasite, with access to host's thoughts and memories.
all_card.real_text: Shift - Heal 1 damage from each enemy in play. Then, if an investigator shifted this key, flip it to its [[Stable]] side.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]：-X。X为本卡牌上的标的数量+1。 [cultist]：-7。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少2点，将你所在地点和每个连接地点的所有隐匿迷你卡牌正面朝下混洗，然后随机放置到其刚才位置。 [tablet]：-2。取消投入本次技能检定的每张卡牌上的效果和图标。 [elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，你必须在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记，或最近的[[同志会]]敌人攻击你(即便其在阴影中)。
all_card.name: 血色阴影
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]：-X。X为本卡牌上的标的数量。 [cultist]：-5。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少2点，将你所在地点和每个连接地点的所有隐匿迷你卡牌正面朝下混洗，然后随机放置到其刚才位置。 [tablet]：-1。取消投入本次技能检定的每张卡牌上的效果和图标。 [elder_thing]：-2。如果你检定失败，你必须在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记，或最近的[[同志会]]敌人攻击你(即便其在阴影中)。
all_card.real_back_text: Hard / Expert [skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the number of targets on this card. [cultist]: -7. If you fail by 2 or more, shuffle each concealed mini-card at your location and at each connecting location facedown, then place them at random in the positions they were in. [tablet]: -2. Cancel the effects and icons of each card committed to this skill test. [elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, you must either place 1 doom on the current agenda, or the nearest [[Coterie]] enemy attacks you (even if it is in the shadows).
all_card.real_text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -X. X is the number of targets on this card. [cultist]: -5. If you fail by 2 or more, shuffle each concealed mini-card at your location and at each connecting location facedown, then place them at random in the positions they were in. [tablet]: -1. Cancel the effects and icons of each card committed to this skill test. [elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, you must either place 1 doom on the current agenda, or the nearest [[Coterie]] enemy attacks you (even if it is in the shadows).

all_card.back_flavor: 你紧追不舍，跟着窃贼冲进了大门，里面就是她的下一个目标，却发现她已经拿着一块碎片溜了。她从附近一扇窗逃了，临了还给你留下一个调皮的坏笑。
all_card.back_text: 揭示场上每张隐匿迷你卡牌，将每张诱饵放在一边，位于场外。 找到离红衣女郎(或其迷你卡牌)最近的有标的的地点。红衣女郎获得此标的(放在她上面)。如果红衣女郎上有3个标的，进入(→结局3)。(FAQ v2.1) 否则，结算红衣女郎的隐匿关键词，在每个有标的的地点中，尽可能平均地分发其隐匿迷你卡牌。将场景和密谋牌库重置为场景1和密谋1。 在每个地点上增加线索，直到其线索数量等于其线索值。
all_card.flavor: 红衣女郎意图窃取一件古代艺术珍藏分散的碎片，你相信这些东西组合起来就是一把古代的钥匙。
all_card.name: 她在哪儿……？
all_card.text: 强制 - 当游戏开始时，或密谋牌库重置后：将本密谋上的毁灭标记数量设为1[per_investigator]。 强制 - 你揭露诱饵后：红衣女郎攻击你。 (提示：在本密谋推进时，红衣女郎会得到其中一块碎片！)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Hot on the thief's heels, you bust through the door leading to her current target, only to find her already leaving with a piece of the statuette. She gives you a mischievous smirk before escaping through a nearby window.
all_card.real_back_text: Reveal each concealed mini-card in play and set each decoy aside, out of play. Find the location with a target on it nearest to La Chica Roja (or her mini-card). La Chica Roja collects that target (place it on her). If there are 3 targets on La Chica Roja, proceed to (→R3). Otherwise, resolve La Chica Roja's concealed keyword, distributing each of those concealed mini-cards as evenly as possible among each location with a target. Reset the act and agenda decks to agenda 1 and act 1. Add clues to each location until it has clues equal to its clue value.
all_card.real_flavor: La Chica Roja is stealing pieces divided up from an old art collection, which you believe are parts of an ancient Key.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the start of the game, or after the agenda deck resets: Set the amount of doom on this agenda to 1 [per_investigator]. Forced - After you expose a decoy: La Chica Roja attacks you. (Hint - when this agenda advances, La Chica Roja will collect one of the pieces she seeks!)

all_card.back_text:
如果这是第一次推进本场景：
你一路追踪，成功赶在红衣女郎抢夺标的之前埋伏了下来。你刚准备好，她就到了，并且很快就察觉出了不对劲。她即兴哼出一支爵士小调，在房中徘徊查找。“出来吧。”她最后笑着说道。你现了身，告诉她就此停手。“否则呢？”她咧开嘴笑道，“你要用武力逼我就范吗？”
否则：
你又一次赶在了她前面，这次她立刻就发现了你。 “又是你？”她轻蔑地说道，“你就没什么事好做了吗？看不出我很忙吗？”
all_card.flavor: 多亏玻利瓦尔警长，你觉得自己应该知道红衣女郎想要的标的在哪里了。现在剩下的就是抓她个现行。
all_card.name: 猩红阴影
all_card.text: 目标 - 揭露窃贼所在。如果调查员与红衣女郎交战，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If this is the first time this act has been advanced:
Following all of your leads, you manage to beat La Chica Roja to her target and lie in ambush. She arrives soon after and sets to work, but it's not long before she realizes something is wrong. She hums a jazzy improvisation and saunters around the room, scanning for something. "Come on out," she says at last, a smirk on her lips. You reveal yourself and tell her to stop what she is doing. "Or what?" she grins. "You gonna make me?"
Otherwise:
Once again, you beat your rival to the punch, and she spots you immediately. "You again?" she says dismissively. "Don't you have anything better to do? I'm quite busy, as you can see."
all_card.real_flavor: Thanks to Officer Bolívar, you believe you know which buildings might hold the pieces La Chica Roja is after. All that is left is to catch her in the act.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Expose the thief's whereabouts. If an investigator engages La Chica Roja, advance.

all_card.back_text:
找到离红衣女郎最近的有标的的地点。将该标的放在冒险参考卡牌上。然后，如果冒险参考卡牌上有3个标的，跳过本场景的剩余部分，改为进入冒险幕间故事：云开见日。否则，继续阅读如下部分。
“好吧，这次就算让你得手了。”神秘窃贼逃跑的时候说道，“但别的地方就轮不到你了！”你还没抓住她，她深红的大衣就卷起一阵旋风，整个人都消失在了阴影中，不留一丝踪迹。
治愈红衣女郎的所有伤害，将她返回阴影中，并结算她的隐匿关键词，在每个有标的的地点中，尽可能平均地分发其隐匿迷你卡牌。将场景和密谋牌库重置为场景1和密谋1。 每位调查员失去其所有线索。在每个地点上增加线索，直到其线索数量等于其线索值。
all_card.flavor: 你终于要逮住她了！
all_card.name: 一路追踪
all_card.text: 红衣女郎获得：“[action]：谈判。检定[intellect]或[agility](6)来胜过窃贼一筹。你可以花费1个线索以将本次检定难度降低2点。如果你检定失败，红衣女郎攻击你。” 目标 - 如果红衣女郎将要被击败，改为推进。 目标 - 如果有调查员与红衣女郎谈判，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
Find the location with a target on it nearest to La Chica Roja. Place that target on the scenario reference card. Then, if there are 3 targets on the scenario reference card, skip the rest of this act and instead proceed to Scenario Interlude: Cast a Light. Otherwise, continue reading the following.
"Fine, you can have this one," the mysterious thief calls to you as she makes her escape. "There's more where that came from, anyway!" Before you can catch her, with a twirl of her stark red coat, she vanishes into the shadows without a trace.
Heal all damage from La Chica Roja, return her to the shadows, and resolve her concealed keyword, distributing each of those concealed mini-cards as evenly as possible among each location with a target. Reset the act and agenda decks to agenda 1 and act 1. Each investigator loses each of their clues. Add clues to each location until it has clues equal to its clue value.
all_card.real_flavor: You finally have her in your sights!
all_card.real_text: La Chica Roja gains: "[action] Parley. Test [intellect] or [agility] (6) to outsmart the thief. You may spend 1 clue to reduce this test's difficulty by 2. If you fail, La Chica Roja attacks you." Objective - If La Chica Roja would be defeated, instead advance. Objective - If an investigator successfully parleys with La Chica Roja, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你走过宽广的大道，眼神扫过每一条街巷，每一座屋顶。玻利瓦尔警长给你标出了好几个地方，都可能是红衣女郎的目标。五月大道就是连接它们和五月广场的中轴，是开始搜寻的好地方。
all_card.name: 五月大道
all_card.text: 如果你的难度等级为…… - ……简单，X为2。 - ……普通，X为3。 - ……困难，X为4。 - ……专家，X为5。 [action]：撤退。看来这次是红衣女郎赢了。
all_card.traits: 布宜诺斯艾利斯. 中心
all_card.real_back_flavor: You step out onto the broad avenue, eyes darting to every alleyway and rooftop. This street connects with the Plaza de Mayo and many of the buildings which Officer Bolívar marked as potential targets for La Chica Roja's campaign of thievery. It's as good a place as any to start your search.
all_card.real_text: If your difficulty level is... - ...Easy, X is 2. - ...Standard, X is 3. - ...Hard, X is 4. - ...Expert, X is 5. [action]: Resign. Looks like La Chica Roja wins this game.

all_card.back_flavor: 玫瑰宫是阿根廷的总统府，里面寄存着过去数任留下的奇珍异宝。也许这里就有一片钥匙吸引了你的猎物。
all_card.name: 玫瑰宫
all_card.text: [action]花费1个线索：检定[intellect](4)来观察这里的员工。你可以花费额外1个线索以将此次检定的难度降低2点。如果你检定成功，查看本地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。你检定成功且每超过难度2点，额外查看本地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Serving as the office of the President of Argentina, the Rose House is also home to several antiques and curios inherited from past leaders. One might be a piece of the Key your quarry seeks.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Test [intellect] (4) to observe the staff. You may spend 1 additional clue to reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. If you succeed, look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at this location (without exposing it). For every 2 points you succeed by, look at an additional mini-card at this location.

all_card.back_flavor: 主教座堂的宏伟立面俯瞰整个五月广场。玻利瓦尔告诉你，这里仿佛一座宏伟的陵墓，除了有教会的华美陈设，更保存了许多艺术珍品，可能是红衣女郎的目标。
all_card.name: 主教座堂
all_card.text: [action]花费1个线索：检定[agility](4)以查看教堂天顶。你可以花费额外1个线索以将此次检定的难度降低2点。如果你检定成功，查看本地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。你检定成功且每超过难度2点，额外查看本地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Overlooking the Plaza de Mayo looms the impressive façade of the Metropolitan Cathedral. In addition to the usual trappings of the church, Bolívar has informed you that it houses many magnificent pieces of art, as well as a mausoleum. It seems a likely target for La Chica Roja.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Test [agility] (4) to watch the rooftops of the cathedral. You may spend 1 additional clue to reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. If you succeed, look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at this location (without exposing it). For every 2 points you succeed by, look at an additional mini-card at this location.

all_card.back_flavor: 只有最奸恶的窃贼才会对死者下手，玻利瓦尔警长自然觉得雷科莱塔公墓也会沦为目标。谁知道数不胜数的大理石坟茔中埋藏了多少宝藏？
all_card.name: 雷科莱塔公墓
all_card.text: [action]花费X个线索并受到X点恐惧：查看本地点X张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Robbing the dead has long been a crime reserved for only the foulest of thieves, so naturally, Officer Bolívar believes Recoleta Cemetery is on the list of potential targets. Who knows what valuables may be locked with the dead in the cemetery's countless marble vaults and mausoleums?
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend X clues and take X horror: Look at the revealed side of X concealed mini-cards at this location (without exposing them).

all_card.back_flavor: 这座私人宅邸藏有许多艺术品，和过去遭窃的地方如出一辙。看这华美的建筑，屋主肯定是上层人士。想必你没法进去探看。要在这儿守株待兔的话，你就得学着红衣女郎的手段了。
all_card.name: 伊拉祖里兹宫
all_card.text: [action]花费1个线索：检定[combat](4)以闯入庄园。你可以花费额外1个线索以将此次检定的难度降低2点。如果你检定成功，查看本地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。你检定成功且每超过难度2点，额外查看本地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: This privately-owned mansion contains many pieces of art that fit the profile of your mark's past robberies. Judging from the ornate architecture, its owners must be important high society types. You're unlikely to be allowed to patrol the area, so you'll have to resort to La Chica Roja's own methods if you plan on watching for her here.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Test [combat] (4) to break into the mansion. You may spend 1 additional clue to reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. If you succeed, look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at this location (without exposing it). For every 2 points you succeed by, look at an additional mini-card at this location.

all_card.back_flavor: 这座市政建筑也被玻利瓦尔警长标作是红衣女郎的目标。回顾历史，布宜诺斯艾利斯市议会可能珍藏了许多殖民地时期的文物。她要组装的钥匙，也许就有一片收在这里？
all_card.name: 市议会
all_card.text: [free]：查看本地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。然后，抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。你可以花费2个线索以取消该卡牌的效果并将其弃掉。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Officer Bolívar has marked this public administrative building as a potential target for La Chica Roja. Steeped in history, the Cabildo de Buenos Aires likely houses artifacts from the city's colonial era. Perhaps one is a piece of the Key she is assembling?
all_card.real_text: [fast]: Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at this location (without exposing it). Then, draw the top card of the encounter deck. You may spend 2 clues to cancel this card's effects and discard it.

all_card.back_flavor: 你知道红衣女郎不是为了钱，但玻利瓦尔警长还是坚持市里最大的银行可能成为其首要目标。
all_card.name: 省立银行
all_card.text: [action]花费X个线索与三倍数量的资源：查看本地点X张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: While you know La Chica Roja isn't after money, Officer Bolívar insists that the largest bank in the city is a prime target.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend X clues and thrice as many resources: Look at the revealed side of X concealed mini-cards at this location (without exposing them).

all_card.back_flavor: 众多歌剧界的名角——包括大名鼎鼎的阿尔图罗·托斯卡尼尼，都在这座华美的歌剧院留下了自己的印记。要说这里是世界一流，那也不差。玻利瓦尔能给你搞到最近《阿依达》的票，但你肯定会显得格格不入。
all_card.name: 哥伦布剧院
all_card.text: [action]花费1个线索：检定[willpower](4)以留心歌剧院的梁柱。你可以花费额外1个线索以将此次检定的难度降低2点。如果你检定成功，查看本地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。你检定成功且每超过难度2点，额外查看本地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Many prolific figures of opera, including the famed Arturo Toscanini, have laid their mark on this gorgeous opera house - easily one of the best in the world. Bolívar can provide you with tickets to the current showing of Aida, but you're probably going to stand out like a sore thumb.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Test [willpower] (4) to stake out the rafters of the opera house. You may spend 1 additional clue to reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. If you succeed, look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at this location (without exposing it). For every 2 points you succeed by, look at an additional mini-card at this location.

all_card.flavor: “思时应果决，行时应思量。”
all_card.name: 红衣女郎
all_card.text: 隐匿5。 强制 - 与红衣女郎交战的调查员在移动时：她与该调查员解除交战。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同志会. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "Think out your plan like a woman of action. Then act out your plan like a woman of thought."
all_card.real_subname: The Girl in the Carmine Coat
all_card.real_text: Concealed 5. Forced - When an investigator engaged with La Chica Roja moves: Disengage her from that investigator.

all_card.name: 红衣女郎
all_card.text: [reaction]在你回合结束时，横置红衣女郎：将你的调查员迷你卡牌放入阴影中。你在阴影中时，你不在任何地点。将要生成与你交战的敌人，改为生成在你先前地点。当你回合开始时，将你移动回你的先前地点(如果不能，则移动到任意已揭示地点)。
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When your turn ends, exhaust La Chica Roja: Place your investigator mini-card in the shadows. While you are in the shadows, you are not at any location. Enemies that would spawn engaged with you instead spawn at your previous location. At the start of your turn, move back to your previous location (or any revealed location if you cannot).

all_card.flavor: “他知道这些生物有庄严的誓约束缚……”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 履约夜魇
all_card.text:
猎手。
攻击履约夜魔时，揭示的每个混乱标记的负值修正翻倍。
all_card.real_flavor: "He had learned that they are bound by solemn treaties..." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath
all_card.real_text:
Hunter.
While attacking Bound Nightgaunt, double the negative modifier of each revealed chaos token.

all_card.name: 猫抓老鼠
all_card.text: 险境。涌动。 显现 - 如果你所在地点有隐匿迷你卡牌，你可以将其揭露。如果此效果揭露了敌人迷你卡牌，改为将其翻回，与你所在地点的隐匿迷你卡牌一同正面朝下混洗。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Surge. Revelation - If there is a concealed mini-card at your location, you may expose it. If an enemy's mini-card would be exposed by this effect, instead flip it back over and shuffle it facedown with the concealed mini-cards at your location.

all_card.name: 来访名片
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到没有标的且没有附属来访名片的地点。 来访名片在场上时，不能(在任何地点)花费线索。 [reaction]在你成功调查所附属地点且超过难度至少2点后：弃掉来访名片。查看任意地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to a location without a target, and without a copy of Calling Card attached. While Calling Card is in play, clues cannot be spent (at any location). [reaction] After you successfully investigate attached location by 2 or more: Discard Calling Card. Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at any location (without exposing it).

all_card.flavor: “祝你下次好运！”
all_card.name: 技高一筹
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](4)。如果你检定失败，你必须决定(选择一项)： - 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致密谋推进。 - 最近的[[同志会]]敌人攻击你。
all_card.real_flavor: "Better luck next time!"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (4). If you fail, you must decide (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the agenda to advance. - The nearest [[Coterie]] enemy attacks you.

all_card.back_flavor: 你和新的盟友费尽心思调查，其中艰难更是不计其数，终于击溃了名为血色监视者的同志会长老。保护他身体的法术已经瓦解，他已是你的板上鱼肉。他空洞的眼神从深红色的眼镜后面望向了你。“我就知道不该让你入伙。”他斥骂红衣女子，“你乳臭未干，粗野无礼。不过是个扮作女王的小丑。在我们的宏大圈子里就是个笑柄。”“你才给我们带来了恶名。”她吼了回去，“我们应该保护人类，而你却在折磨他们。要是我能说了算，就该把你赶出去。”“等着瞧吧。”他摘下自己的红眼镜，本该是眸子的地方却只有漆黑空洞的眼窝。鼻尖上可怖的镜片闪出了猩红的光芒。“小心着点儿，小丫头。你这点把戏救不了你。”夜魇漆黑的双翅突然扑扇而过，将他一把抓入了夜空。
all_card.flavor: 红光笼罩了全城。红衣女郎的对手就藏在某处，等着夺取最后一片钥匙。
all_card.name: 见红
all_card.text: 强制 - 揭露诱饵后：在本密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。 强制 - 如果本密谋将要因为毁灭达到阈值而推进：每位调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。(FAQ v2.1) 目标 - 如果血色监视者被击败，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
It has taken much investigative work and even more toil, but you and your new ally have finally managed to confront the Coterie elder known only as The Sanguine Watcher. The spell protecting his body has faltered, and he is at your mercy. Heartless, empty eyes gaze back at you from behind his ruby spectacles. "I knew we never should have let you into our fold," he scolds the girl in red. "You are young and insolent. A jester who dons the clothes of a queen. A mockery of our great circle."
"You are the one who gives us a bad name," she barks back. "We are supposed to protect humanity, not torment it. If it were up to me, you would be driven out."
"We shall see." He pulls his ruby glasses down, revealing dark, empty sockets where his eyes should be. Scarlet light bounces off the ominous rims resting on the tip of his nose. "Watch your step, girl. Not even your tricks can save you from me." Then, with a thrashing of dark, nightmarish wings, he is snatched from above and carried into the night.
all_card.real_flavor: Scarlet light drowns the city. Somewhere, La Chica Roja's rival lies in wait, hoping to claim the final pieces of the Key for himself.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After a decoy is exposed: Place 1 doom on this agenda. Forced - When this agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. Objective - If the Sanguine Watcher is defeated, advance.

all_card.flavor: “你胆敢挡我的路，小丫头？”
all_card.name: 血色监视者
all_card.text: 反击。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果血色监视者处于重整状态：每位调查员必须受到2点伤害或2点恐惧。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同志会. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "You dare get in my way, girl?"
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if The Sanguine Watcher is ready: Each investigator must either take 2 damage or 2 horror.

all_card.name: 分裂精魂
all_card.text: 隐匿4。 强制 - 在分裂精魂被揭露后：对血色监视者造成5点伤害。将分裂精魂返回阴影中，并结算其隐匿关键词，在每个没有标的的非[[中心]]地点中，尽可能平均地分发其隐匿迷你卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Concealed 4. Forced - After Apportioned Ka is exposed: Deal 5 damage to the Sanguine Watcher. Return Apportioned Ka to the shadows and resolve its concealed keyword, distributing those concealed mini-cards as evenly as possible among each non-[[Central]] location without a target.

all_card.flavor: 档案#16-D25 /客体等级：绿色/组装完成后，钥匙形为一具不明身份的女性雕像。流出不知来源的跨维红色液体(“眼泪？”)。
all_card.name: 恸哭女士
all_card.text: 变换 - 发现你所在地点或连接地点的1个线索。将本钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: File #16-D25 / Subject Class: Green / Once assembled, Key appears as small statuette of unidentified woman, weeping trandimensional, red fluid ("tears?") of unknown origin.
all_card.real_text: Shift - Discover 1 clue at your location or a connecting location. Flip this key to its [[Unstable]] side.

all_card.flavor: ……呈某种未知物质，在外界影响下也未停止。液体PH值为11。不含任何杂质或已知的细菌。
all_card.name: 恸哭女士
all_card.text: 变换 - 如可能，每位调查员必须弃掉自己控制的一个支援。然后，如果是调查员变换了本钥匙，将其翻至[[稳定]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: ...emergence of unknown substance does not cease despite external manipulation. Fluid pH 11. Contains no impurities or known bacteria of any kind.
all_card.real_text: Shift - Each investigator must discard an asset they control, if able. Then, if an investigator shifted this key, flip it to its [[Stable]] side.

all_card.back_flavor: 日光黯淡，你眯起眼睛想看看是为什么。诡异的黑影缓缓吞没了太阳的轮廓。是日食？无论教派意欲为何，你最好还是快点阻止他们……
all_card.back_text: 按玩家顺序，每位调查员必须选择：将1个线索(从供应堆拿取)放到彰显的线索上；或者查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个[[异教徒]]敌人并将其抽取，其获得隐匿1。(如果没有找到[[异教徒]]敌人，则改为在彰显的线索上放置1个线索)。如果查找过遭遇牌库，将其混洗。(FAQ v2.1) 本密谋在推进时上面每有一个日食，必须有一位调查员额外结算上述效果一次。 将本密谋翻回，在上面增加1资源，作为一个日食。(它也保留上面每个其他日食。)
all_card.flavor: 伊斯坦布尔活动的教派隐秘又危险，城市每个黑暗的角落都有他们的耳目。
all_card.name: 黑暗使徒
all_card.text: 每个非弱点[[异教徒]]敌人获得隐匿1。 强制 - 你躲避[[异教徒]]敌人后，将其返回阴影中并结算其隐匿关键词：控制它的1个线索。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The daylight dims, and you strain your eyes to examine why. A strange, black shape has begun to crawl its way over the outline of the sun. An eclipse? Whatever the cult is up to, you better stop it soon...
all_card.real_back_text: In player order, each investigator must choose: Either place 1 clue (from the token pool) on Clues Unveiled, or search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it; it gains concealed 1 (if no [[Cultist]] enemy is found, place 1 clue on Clues Unveiled, instead). Shuffle the encounter deck if it is searched. For each eclipse that was on this agenda when it advanced, an investigator must resolve the above effect an additional time. Flip this agenda back over, adding 1 resource to it, as an eclipse. (It keeps each other eclipse it had, as well.)
all_card.real_flavor: The cult operating in Istanbul is secretive and deadly, with eyes everywhere and ears in every dark corner of the city.
all_card.real_text: Each non-weakness [[Cultist]] enemy gains concealed 1. Forced - After you evade a [[Cultist]] enemy, return it to the shadows and resolve its concealed keyword: Take control of 1 of its clues.

all_card.back_text:
如果调查员先达成线索阈值：
你觉得自己发现了护身符的所在之处，赶在敌人追上之前搜检一番。但你惊讶地发现里面只是一件古代的手稿。
如果教派先达成线索阈值：
你觉得自己发现了护身符的所在之处，却发现里面已是一片狼藉。你在地上发现了一份撕裂的手稿，赶紧上前修复。
无论是上述何种情况： 结算已经不在阴影中的每个非弱点[[异教徒]]敌人(由密谋1a获得的)隐匿关键词。 将遭遇弃牌堆和放在一边的幽影预示者与犹格斯星的密使敌人洗入遭遇牌库。 进入剧本手册的场景2冒险设置。
all_card.flavor: 萨辛女士说护身符已经在城中某处藏了数百年之久。你可不能让它落入教派手中！
all_card.name: 寻找手稿
all_card.text: 目标 - 抢在教派之前找到护身符！如果教派或在任何地点的调查员共同拥有了所需数量的线索，推进。(你在推进时不花费任何线索。)
all_card.real_back_text:
If the investigators reached the clue threshold first:
You discover what you believe to be the talisman's resting place and scramble to find the Key before your adversaries find you. But to your surprise, inside is only an ancient manuscript.
If the cult reached the clue threshold first:
You discover what you believe to be the talisman's resting place and find it already torn apart. Resting on the ground nearby is a torn-up manuscript, which you hastily begin to restore.
In either case: Resolve the concealed keyword on each non-weakness [[Cultist]] enemy not already in the shadows (as granted by agenda 1a). Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside Umbral Harbinger and Emissary from Yuggoth enemies into the encounter deck. Proceed to Act 2 Setup in the Campaign Guide.
all_card.real_flavor: According to Ms. Şahin, the talisman has been hidden somewhere in the city for many hundreds of years. You must not let it fall into the cult's hands!
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find the talisman before the cult does! If either the cult, or investigators at any location(s), possess the requisite number of clues as a group, advance. (Do not spend any clues when you advance.)

all_card.back_text: 如果调查员先达成线索阈值，将扭曲反棱镜钥匙附属到东门的任意一位调查员。 如果教派先达成线索阈值，将扭曲反棱镜钥匙附属到线索最多的[[异教徒]]敌人。 揭示场上每张隐匿迷你卡牌。每揭示一张敌人的迷你卡牌，就将该敌人从阴影中移动到该地点。将每张隐匿迷你卡牌放在一旁，位于场外。(FAQ v2.1) 将先前放在一边的场景1的地点放回场上，圣索菲亚放在大巴扎入口左侧。这两个地点在本场冒险剩余时间内彼此连接。将加拉塔码头放置入场。 如果教派先达成线索阈值，他们比调查员每多1[per_investigator]个线索，就将附属了扭曲反棱镜的[[异教徒]]敌人朝加拉塔码头移动一次。 每位调查员和每个[[异教徒]]敌人失去其所有线索。将彰显剧情卡牌翻至另一面，移除上面的所有线索。将场景和密谋牌库直接推进到“追逐”。它既是当前场景也是当前密谋。
all_card.flavor: 手稿上说最近已另有其人发现了护身符，带到大巴扎里准备出售。这可不能让那人得逞！
all_card.name: 寻找护身符
all_card.text: 目标 - 抢在教派之前找到护身符！如果教派或在指定为东门的地点的调查员共同拥有了所需数量的线索，推进。(你在推进时不花费任何线索。)
all_card.real_back_text:
If the investigators reached the clue threshold first, attach The Twisted Antiprism key to any investigator at the east gate.
If the cult reached the clue threshold first, attach The Twisted Antiprism key to the [[Cultist]] enemy with the most clues.
Reveal each concealed mini-card in play. For each enemy's mini-card, move that enemy from the shadows to that location. Set each concealed mini-card aside, out of play.
Put the locations from act 1 that were previously set aside back into play, with Hagia Sophia to the left of the entrance to the Grand Bazaar. These two locations are connected to one another for the rest of the scenario. Put Galata Docks into play.
If the cult reached the clue threshold first, for every 1 [per_investigator] more clues they had than the investigators, move the [[Cultist]] enemy with The Twisted Antiprism once toward Galata Docks.
Each investigator and [[Cultist]] enemy loses each of their clues. Flip The Unveiling story card over to its other side, removing all clues from it. Advance the act and agenda deck directly to "The Chase." It is both the current act and the current agenda.
all_card.real_flavor: According to the manuscript, the talisman was discovered somewhat recently by a third party, and brought to the Grand Bazaar as a valuable item to be sold. You can't let that happen!
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find the talisman before the cult does! If either the cult, or investigators at the location designated as the east gate, possess the requisite number of clues as a group, advance. (Do not spend any clues when you advance.)

all_card.back_flavor: 在一片诡异的黑色月光下，你的敌人不知疲倦地想带着护身符逃走。
all_card.back_text: 场上每个敌人移动并攻击，如同此刻是敌军阶段(不要横置)。 如果场上的敌人数量少于调查员，按玩家顺序从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌，直到弃掉一张[[异教徒]]敌人，并将其抽取。(如有必要，混洗遭遇弃牌堆以组成新的遭遇牌库)。重复此步骤，直到场上敌人的数量等于调查员。 将本卡牌翻回。
all_card.name: 追逐
all_card.text: 目标 - “拿上东西快走！”如果附属了扭曲反棱镜的调查员在加拉塔码头，你可以进入(→结局1)(第25页)。 目标 - “别让他们带着钥匙跑了！”如果附属了扭曲反棱镜的敌人在加拉塔码头，或附属了扭曲反棱镜的调查员被击败，进入(→结局6)(第25页)。(FAQ v2.1)
all_card.real_back_flavor: In the dark light of an alien moon, your enemies work tirelessly to escape with the talisman in their possession.
all_card.real_back_text: Each enemy in play moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase (without exhausting). If there are fewer enemies in play than the number of investigators, in player order, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Cultist]] enemy is discarded, and draw it (shuffling the encounter discard pile to form a new encounter deck if necessary). Repeat this until there are enemies in play equal to the number of investigators. Flip this card back over.
all_card.real_text: Objective - "Get this thing out of here!" If an investigator with The Twisted Antiprism is at Galata Docks, you may proceed to (→R1) (page 25). Objective - "Don't let them get away with the Key!" If an enemy with The Twisted Antiprism is at Galata Docks, or if the investigator with The Twisted Antiprism is defeated, proceed to (→R6) (page 25).

all_card.name: 彰显
all_card.text: 强制 - 在毁灭标记放置到[[异教徒]]敌人后：将其翻至线索面。 如果一个敌人上有超过3个线索，将超出的线索移动到彰显的线索上，见下。 教派拥有的线索数量等于场上[[异教徒]]敌人的线索总数，加上彰显的线索(见下)上的线索数量。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on a [[Cultist]] enemy: Flip them to their clue side. If an enemy has more than 3 clues on it, move the clues in excess of 3 to Clues Unveiled, below. The number of clues possessed by the cult is equal to the total number of clues on [[Cultist]] enemies in play plus the number of clues on Clues Unveiled, below.

all_card.name: 解封
all_card.text: 每个非弱点敌人获得：“猎手。猎物 - 拥有扭曲反棱镜的调查员。”如果扭曲反棱镜附属到该敌人，它改为获得“巡逻(加拉塔码头)。” 强制 - 在毁灭标记将要放置到敌人时：改为该敌人移动并攻击，如同此刻是敌军阶段(不要横置)。 强制 - 在非弱点敌人攻击有扭曲反棱镜的调查员后：将扭曲反棱镜附属到该敌人，[[动荡]]面朝上。然后，该敌人变换它。 [reaction]你躲避或击败有扭曲反棱镜的敌人后：控制扭曲反棱镜，将其附属到你的调查员。
all_card.real_text: Each non-weakness enemy gains: "Hunter. Prey - Investigator with The Twisted Antiprism." If The Twisted Antiprism is attached to that enemy, it instead gains "Patrol (Galata Docks)." Forced - When 1 or more doom would be placed on an enemy: It instead moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase (without exhausting). Forced - After a non-weakness enemy attacks the investigator with The Twisted Antiprism: Attach The Twisted Antiprism to that enemy, [[Unstable]] side faceup. Then, that enemy shifts it. [reaction] After you evade or defeat the enemy with The Twisted Antiprism: Take control of The Twisted Antiprism, attaching it to your investigator.

all_card.back_flavor: 加拉塔大桥横跨金角湾，将码头和城区隔开。
all_card.back_text: 你只能从加拉塔进入加拉塔码头。作为这么做的额外费用，你必须从自己游戏区域的支援和手牌中弃掉卡牌，被弃掉的卡牌总计有至少3个相同的技能图标。
all_card.flavor: 有了基金会的旅行文件，搞一条船出城应该不是难事。
all_card.name: 加拉塔码头
all_card.text: 你只能从加拉塔进入加拉塔码头。作为这么做的额外费用，你必须从自己游戏区域的支援和手牌中弃掉卡牌，被弃掉的卡牌总计有至少3个相同的技能图标。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Galata Bridge spans over the Golden Horn, separating the piers from the rest of the city.
all_card.real_back_text: You can only enter Galata Docks from Galata. As an additional cost for you to do so, you must discard any combination of cards from your hand or assets from your play area with at least 3 matching skill icons.
all_card.real_flavor: With the Foundation's travel documents, you should be able to charter a ship out of the city with ease.
all_card.real_text: You can only enter Galata Docks from Galata. As an additional cost for you to do so, you must discard any combination of cards from your hand or assets from your play area with at least 3 matching skill icons.

all_card.back_flavor: 石塔耸立的加拉塔游人如织，和居民交融在一起。你经过使馆、仓库和贩卖国内外货物的商栈。这一片古老的建筑里可能就存放过护身符。也许就是著名的石塔？
all_card.name: 加拉塔
all_card.text: [free]花费3资源：谈判。揭露任意地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The ancient Galata Tower looms over this well-traveled district, where tourists and residents intermingle. You pass several embassies, warehouses, and commercial buildings for businesses both local and foreign. One of the district's older buildings may have once hid the talisman. Perhaps even the famed Galata Tower itself?
all_card.real_text: [fast] Spend 3 resources: Parley. Expose a concealed mini-card at any location. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 这座方尖碑原本是埃及人所造，被罗马人运到此城，阴森地耸立在苏丹艾哈迈德广场上。上面的铭文记录了征服胜利的历史。
all_card.name: 狄奥多西方尖碑
all_card.text: 强制 - 你调查狄奥多西方尖碑时技能检定失败后：将你的1个线索移动到最近的[[异教徒]]敌人上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Originally brought to the city from Egypt by the Romans, the Obelisk looms ominously over Sultanahmet Square. Its inscription commemorates the triumphs of conquerors past.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating the Obelisk of Theodosius: Move 1 of your clues to the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy.

all_card.back_flavor: 新近重组的大学闻名遐迩，校园也是美丽宜人。这里除了神学、艺术、数学和科学，还有许多新近设立的院系。要是城里还有什么地方能让你找到过去遗物的信息，那就是这儿了。
all_card.name: 伊斯坦布尔大学
all_card.text: [action]：检定[willpower]或[intellect](6)。如果你检定成功，控制彰显的线索的1个线索。(每场游戏最多一次成功。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Housing faculties of theology, arts, mathematics, and science, as well as other recent additions, the newly reconstituted university is as prestigious as its campus is beautiful. If there's anywhere in the city you'll be able to find information regarding relics from its past, it's here.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (6). If you succeed, take control of 1 clue on Clues Unveiled. (Max one success per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 圣索菲亚清真寺建立之初原本是一座基督大教堂。它是全世界最为著名的地标之一，也是拜占庭建筑的集大成者。沧海桑田，城市几度易手，圣地屹立不倒，可能藏着大量与你调查有关的讯息，但你得知道从哪入手。
all_card.name: 圣索菲亚
all_card.text: 圣索菲亚上每有一个研究标记，得到+3隐藏值。 [action]：(从供应堆)将1[per_investigator]个线索放到圣索菲亚上。将1资源(也从供应堆拿取)放到圣索菲亚上，作为一个研究标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Originally built as a cathedral, the Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque is one of the most iconic buildings in the entire world and the epitome of Byzantine architecture. Having survived the city's numerous transformations throughout the ages, this holy place may contain a wealth of information pertinent to your investigation, if you know where to look.
all_card.real_text: Hagia Sophia gets +3 shroud for each study token on it. [action]: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues on Hagia Sophia (from the token pool). Place 1 resource on Hagia Sophia (also from the token pool), as a study token.

all_card.name: 大巴扎

all_card.real_flavor: "Why do you suppose the keys have not been erased?"

all_card.flavor: “记忆有误。我看见了之前从未知晓之物。其他世界、其他星系……黑暗……看似暗的光、看似光的暗……”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《夜魔》</cite>

all_card.real_flavor:
"Trouble with memory. I see things I never knew before. Other worlds and other galaxies... Dark... The lightning seems dark and the darkness seems light..."
- H. P. Lovecraft, "The Haunter of the Dark"
