all_card.back_flavor: 一道闪电吸引你抬头看向空中。或者说，那是闪电吗？云朵和扭曲的空间在幽暗的夜色中翻滚。是闪光，是模糊，是污点。旋转的云朵有一片就这么消失了。也许这只是你的想象。但事情有点……奇怪？有没有可能你在伦敦发现的生物甚至可以吞噬这片天空？
all_card.back_text: 调查员队长必须决定(选择一项)： - 查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个带有隐匿关键词的敌人并将其抽取(结算其隐匿关键词)。混洗遭遇牌库。 - 揭示每位调查员牌库顶的卡牌。每位调查员抽取以此方式揭示的所有弱点。将揭示的所有其他卡牌放在一边，位于场外，作为空洞。
all_card.flavor: 这一夜没有月亮，只有细雨，一片阴郁。风中除了细雨，还传来了远处的乐声和话音。
all_card.name: 沉默之声
all_card.text: 强制 - 如果有至少5[per_investigator]个空洞放在一边：选择其中3[per_investigator]个并将它们从游戏中移除，在本密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果可以导致本密谋推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A flash of lightning draws your attention to the sky. Or, is it even lightning at all? Clouds and distorted space roll through the gloom of night. A shimmer. A blur. A blemish. And then one of the roiling clouds simply vanishes. Perhaps it was just your imagination. But something feels... strange. Is it possible the creatures you spotted in London could devour even the sky itself?
all_card.real_back_text: The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - Search the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy with the concealed keyword and draw it (resolving its concealed keyword). Shuffle the encounter deck. - Reveal the top card of each investigator's deck. Each investigator draws each weakness they revealed in this way. Set each other revealed card aside, out of play, as a hollow.
all_card.real_flavor: A gentle patter of rain gives the moonless night a somber, moody ambience. Distant music and conversation drift on the wind, accompanied by a light drizzle.
all_card.real_text: Forced - If there are 5 [per_investigator] or more set-aside hollows: Choose and remove 3 [per_investigator] of them from the game and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect may cause this agenda to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你的眼睛仿佛被一阵奇怪的冲动支配，止不住地看向遮蔽了无星黑夜的云层。有一朵云不时在你的视线中萦绕不去。每次都是同一朵，它的形状都刻在了你的视网膜里。你疯了吗？你的目光追踪着云朵的轮廓。不可能是同一朵。你见过有道光让它消失了，不是吗？
all_card.back_text: 调查员队长必须决定(选择一项)： - 查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个带有隐匿关键词的敌人并将其抽取(结算其隐匿关键词)。混洗遭遇牌库。 - 揭示每位调查员牌库顶的卡牌。每位调查员抽取以此方式揭示的所有弱点。将揭示的所有其他卡牌放在一边，位于场外，作为空洞。
all_card.flavor: 同志会在身后追猎已经够糟，而你还得担心路边街上的每一件东西，甚至是天空。它们都有可能将你整个吞没，再也不见，销声匿迹。
all_card.name: 笼中鸟
all_card.text: 强制 - 如果有至少4[per_investigator]个空洞放在一边：选择其中2[per_investigator]个并将它们从游戏中移除，在本密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果可以导致本密谋推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As if possessed by a strange compulsion, your eyes continuously drift to the clouds obscuring the starless night sky. Every now and again, one cloud haunts your sight. The same cloud, every time. Its shape burns into your retina. Are you going mad? Your eyes trace around its outline. It cannot be the same. You saw the flash that caused that cloud to vanish. Didn't you?
all_card.real_back_text: The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - Search the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy with the concealed keyword and draw it (resolving its concealed keyword). Shuffle the encounter deck. - Reveal the top card of each investigator's deck. Each investigator draws each weakness they revealed in this way. Set each other revealed card aside, out of play, as a hollow.
all_card.real_flavor: Being hunted by the Coterie was bad enough; now you worry any random object you pass on the street, or even the sky itself, could simply swallow you whole, never to be seen or heard from again.
all_card.real_text: Forced - If there are 4 [per_investigator] or more set-aside hollows: Choose and remove 2 [per_investigator] of them from the game and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect may cause this agenda to advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
你停下脚步，环顾四周。哈瓦那欢乐的喧嚣又回来了。整座城市突然静止了。再没有阴影中的眼睛。再没有看着熟悉的云。天上闪亮的星星还是那么迷人，仿佛是在嘲笑你的疑神疑鬼。德西和他的手下也都不见了。而更糟的是……
你的记忆中突然有了空白。
all_card.back_text: 将所有空洞从游戏中移除。 收齐本冒险中从游戏移除的所有空洞。每位调查员找出自己印刷经验值费用最高的空洞，将其放逐。 在剧本日志中，记录“存在抹除：”并在旁边记录下以此方式放逐的每张独特卡牌的名称。本剧本剩余时间内，玩家不能将这些卡牌的任意张数(以名称辨别)加入自己牌库(如果每位调查员牌库内有这些卡牌的同名卡牌，立即将其移除)。 (→结局2) (第31页)
all_card.flavor: 这座城活了。不是那种一般所说的“活了”——音乐、狂欢、迷人的魅力——而是真的活了，实在吓人。街道在你脚下变换，墙壁起伏似在呼吸，远处的窗户对你怒目而视。你额上流下了汗水。这是真的吗？抑或只是你的妄想症？
all_card.name: 眼见为虚
all_card.text: 强制 - 如果有至少3[per_investigator]个空洞放在一边：选择其中1[per_investigator]个并将它们从游戏中移除，在本密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果可以导致本密谋推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You stop in your tracks, taking stock of your surroundings. The joyous noise of Havana has returned. A stillness has settled over the city. No more eyes in the shadows. No more familiar clouds. Stars twinkle above, mocking your suspicion with their charming beauty. Desi and his crew are nowhere to be found. And, worse...
There are sudden gaps in your memory.
all_card.real_back_text: Remove each hollow from the game. Gather each hollow that was removed from the game throughout this scenario. Each investigator finds their hollow with the highest experience cost and exiles it. In the Campaign Log, record erased from existence: and next to this, record the names of each unique card exiled in this way. For the rest of the campaign, players cannot include any copies of those cards (by title) in their decks (immediately remove any copies from each investigator's deck). (→R2) (page 31)
all_card.real_flavor: The city is alive. Not alive in its usual sense - music and revelry and glamor - but truly, disturbingly alive. The streets shift under your feet, walls undulating as though breathing, windows glaring at you from afar. Sweat beads on your forehead. Is this all real? Or just paranoia?
all_card.real_text: Forced - If there are 3 [per_investigator] or more set-aside hollows: Choose and remove 1 [per_investigator] of them from the game and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect may cause this agenda to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: “这些事有点不对劲……”你们正在哈瓦那的雨街上巡逻，德西突然说道。“我发誓，一直有东西跟着我们，但每次我回头看的时候……”命运可真爱开玩笑，德西刚一回头，现实扭曲般的无形身影就张开巨口，将他整个吞没。你吓破了胆，大叫他的名字……但意外的是，扭曲重塑成了他的样子。赝品留给你一个邪恶的狞笑，就消失在阴影之中，带走了真的德西。
all_card.back_text: 如果德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹剧情支援在场，将他放在一边，位于场外(移除他身上的所有标记和附属)。 找出放在一边的遭遇卡牌牌背的德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹敌人。调查员队长抽取该敌人，结算其隐匿关键词。按玩家顺序，其他每位调查员依次选择一张放在一边的不同的[[同志会]]敌人，将其抽取并结算其隐匿关键词。 将遭遇弃牌堆和剩下的猩红阴谋与扫荡团伙遭遇组一同洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你和德西一起调查哈瓦那发生的失踪事件。这肯定是你在伦敦追查的生物犯下的罪行。但他们还没有被完全遗忘——兴许还有将他们带回来的方法？
all_card.name: 一失足(版本一)
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。“交易结束了！”你任凭德西和他的手下自生自灭。 强制 - 如果德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹离场：将他放在一边，位于场外。每位调查员受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "There's something off about all of this..." Desi remarks as you patrol the rainy streets of Havana. "I swear, I keep seeing something following us, but when I look-" Fate must have a sense of cosmic irony, as the moment Desi turns around, a formless shape not unlike a distortion in reality opens its gaping maw and swallows him whole. You shout his name in terror... but to your surprise, the distortion reshapes itself in his image. The imposter gives you a sinister grin before vanishing into the shadows, taking the real Desi with him.
all_card.real_back_text: If the Desiderio Delgado Álvarez story asset is in play, set him aside, out of play (removing all tokens and attachments from him). Find the set-aside Desiderio Delgado Álvarez enemy with the encounter card back. The lead investigator draws that enemy, resolving his concealed keyword. One at a time, in player order, each other investigator chooses a different set-aside [[Coterie]] enemy and draws it, resolving its concealed keyword. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the remainder of the Crimson Conspiracy and Cleanup Crew encounter sets into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: You and Desi are looking into the disappearances taking place in Havana. It has to be the work of the creatures you were investigating back in London. But they haven't been forgotten yet - maybe there is a way to bring them back?
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. "The deal's off!" You leave Desi and his crew to their fate. Forced - If Desiderio Delgado Álvarez leaves play: Set him aside, out of play. Each investigator takes 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor:
你终于清楚德西的手下发生了什么。他们被你和福林一路调查的实体掠走，代以一模一样的赝品。但他们的真实目的似乎是要抹除原品存在的证据。他们是要从内部彻底取代同志会吗？这些生物真的这么聪明，能筹划这样的密谋？
无论真实情况为何，你都得追踪这些赝品到底。德西的存在可能都要被抹除，甚至更糟。你并不确定自己是否能相信他，但你还是得施以援手。
all_card.back_text: 重整德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹敌人，移除他的所有标记，弃掉他的所有附属。找出之前放在一边的德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹剧情支援，将他翻至敌人面，生成在同一地点，将两个敌人混洗至无法分辨。
all_card.flavor: 等等——刚刚究竟发生了什么？那实体触碰了德西，模拟了他的形态。德西的手下也遭遇了一样的事情？你得在赝品得逞前找到他！
all_card.name: 一失色(版本一)
all_card.text: [reaction]在调查员将要结算敌人的隐匿X关键词时，共同花费X个线索：改为生成该敌人，与结算其关键词的调查员交战。 [action]：撤退。你任凭德西和他的手下自生自灭。 目标 - 如果阴影中没有敌人，调查员可以花费所需的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
It's clear now what has been happening to Desi's crew. They are being snatched by the very same entities you and Flint had been investigating and replaced by deadly imposters. But their true objective seems to be eliminating the evidence of their mimicry. Are they trying to infiltrate the Coterie from within? Are these creatures truly intelligent enough for such a scheme?
Whatever the case may be, you've tracked down the imposter. Desi is in danger of being erased from existence, or worse. You're not sure you can trust him, but you have to do something to help.
all_card.real_back_text: Ready the Desiderio Delgado Álvarez enemy, remove all tokens from him, and discard all attachments from him. Find the previously set-aside Desiderio Delgado Álvarez story asset, flip him to his enemy side, and spawn him at the same location as the one in play, randomizing them so you do not know which is which.
all_card.real_flavor: Wait - what in the world just happened? That entity touched Desi and assumed his form. Is that what has been happening to Desi's crew? You have to find him before it finishes the job!
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When an investigator would resolve an enemy's concealed X keyword, spend X clues, as a group: Spawn it engaged with that investigator instead. [action]: Resign. You leave Desi and his crew to their fate. Objective - If there are no enemies in the shadows, investigators may spend the requisite clues to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你凭着一点隐秘、一点速度和一点运气，成功从店后门逃向了哈瓦那的街道。枪声又响了几秒，随即停了。他们已经发现你不在里面。你按捺住胸膛里跳跃不止的心脏，仔细聆听，听到建筑另一侧传来了德西不甚流利的声音：“找到他们——一旦找到——就干掉。”他下令了，这声音让你烦躁。“不能让他们——溜了。”他们分头找你，人行道上又响起了脚步声。
all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆和放在一边的每张[[域外]]敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
如果德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹不在阴影中，将他返回阴影中，并结算他的隐匿关键词。
将放在一边的每张[[哈瓦那]]地点放置入场。
拿取场上每张隐匿迷你卡牌并混洗，在除月下餐厅的地点中，尽可能平均地分发。
all_card.flavor: 看来谈判终究没什么用。
all_card.name: 一失足(版本二)
all_card.text: 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：对月下餐厅的调查员造成总计X点伤害，自由分配。X为阴影中敌人的数量。 [reaction]在[[同志会]]敌人受到任意数量的伤害后：在月下餐厅发现该数量一半的线索(向下取整)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: With a bit of stealth, a bit of speed, and a lot of luck, you manage to make your way out the club's back entrance and into the streets of Havana. The gunfire continues for a few seconds, then ceases once your attackers realize you're no longer inside. Over the pounding of your heart in your chest, you listen closely for voices and hear Desi's, broken and uneven, on the other side of the building. "Find them - and when you do - end them," he orders. The sound of his voice grates against your mind. "They must not be allowed - to escape." Footsteps pound on the pavement as they split up in search of you.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each set-aside [[Outsider]] enemy into the encounter deck.
If Desiderio Delgado Álvarez is not in the shadows, return him to the shadows and resolve his concealed keyword.
Put each set-aside [[Havana]] location into play.
Take each concealed mini-card in play, shuffle them, and randomly distribute them as evenly as possible among each location other than Café Luna.
all_card.real_flavor: Negotiations didn't go so well after all.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Deal X total damage to investigators at Café Luna, divided as they wish. X is the number of enemies in the shadows. [reaction] After a [[Coterie]] enemy takes any amount of damage: Discover half that many clues at Café Luna (rounded down).

all_card.back_flavor: 你觉得自己在遭遇德西手下的过程中有了惊人的发现。他们的习性十分古怪，他们的敌意也十分野性、异样。他们身上不时出现的细微扭曲让你意识过来。这群攻击你的人根本不是德西和他的手下。他们已经被你和福林一路调查的实体掠走，代以一模一样的赝品。但也许真正的德西还在某处？要真是这样，那他危在旦夕！
all_card.back_text: 揭示场上每张隐匿迷你卡牌。每揭示一张敌人的迷你卡牌，就将该敌人从阴影中移动到此地点。然后，将每张隐匿迷你卡牌放在一边，位于场外。(FAQ v2.1) 重整德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹敌人，移除他的所有标记，弃掉他的所有附属。将放在一边的另一张德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹敌人生成在同一地点，将两个敌人混洗至无法分辨。 移除场上每个敌人的所有线索。以此方式从敌人上每移除一个线索，治愈该敌人的1点伤害。
all_card.flavor: 无论你到哪里，德西和手下都紧追不舍，发起攻击！但这是为什么？
all_card.name: 一失色(版本二)
all_card.text: [action]你所在地点的调查员共同将自己控制的线索放在此地点的一个[[同志会]]敌人上，放置的数量等于该敌人的剩余生命值：谈判。你洞察了些许当前的情况。移除该敌人所有的毁灭标记并自动躲避它。 [action]：撤退。“我们不是有过交易吗？！”你趁着为时未晚溜出了这座城市。 目标 - 查明这些人为什么要追杀你。如果场上的敌人上总计有4[per_investigator]个线索，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: From your encounters with Desi's crew, you believe you've made a startling discovery. Their mannerisms don't appear to be their own, and their hostility is feral, alien. But it is the very slight distortion that occasionally follows in their wake that leads to your realization. The people who attacked you weren't Desi and his crew at all. They were taken by the entities you and Flint had been investigating and replaced by deadly imposters. But perhaps the real Desi is still out there, somewhere. If so, he's definitely in danger!
all_card.real_back_text:
Reveal each concealed mini-card in play. For each enemy's mini-card, move that enemy from the shadows to that location. Then, set each concealed mini-card aside, out of play.
Ready the Desiderio Delgado Álvarez enemy, remove all tokens from him, and discard all attachments from him. Spawn the other set-aside Desiderio Delgado Álvarez enemy at the same location as the one in play, randomizing them so you do not know which is which.
Remove all clues from each enemy in play. For each clue removed from an enemy in this way, heal 1 damage from that enemy.
all_card.real_flavor: Desi and his crew are pursuing and attacking you everywhere you go! But why?
all_card.real_text: [action] As a group, investigators at your location place clues they control on a [[Coterie]] enemy at your location equal to that enemy's remaining health: Parley. You gain some insight into the situation. Remove all doom from that enemy and automatically evade it. [action]: Resign. "I thought we had a deal!" You get out of the city while you still can. Objective - Discover why your contacts are after you. If there are 4 [per_investigator] total clues among enemies in play, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你介入战局，帮了你认为是真身的德西一把，给了他足够的时间占据上风。你留了一手，但德西就没有这样的顾虑了。他把枪抵在复制品的肚子上，扣动了扳机。另一个德西倒下，死了。枪伤涌出血泊，将他染得鲜红。德西啐了一口自己仿态的尸体。“他妈的下地狱去吧。”他咬出一句咒骂。他随即拍了拍你的肩膀笑了。“谢了，我欠你一笔。”在你看来，他的举止非常自然。你松了口气。
all_card.back_text: 本剧本的剩余时间内，除非受到指示，否则请勿查看德西德柔・戴佳多・欧瓦瑞兹的另一面。 找出场上的德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹(如果两张都在胜利区，则将一张返回场上)。将这张德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹放在安全位置，你在剧本中之后时间可能用到。 (→结局1) (第31页)
all_card.flavor: 你及时赶到，却看到两个一模一样的德西德柔正在死斗，要争出谁才是真正的他。一片混乱中，根本分不清彼此。没时间研究他们的举止风貌了。你必须采取行动！
all_card.name: 一失真相
all_card.text: 每张德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹失去隐匿X，失去猎手，获得冷漠，并获得如下能力：“[action]：谈判。检查剧本日志。如果特别小组知道了德西的过往，你问了一个只有他才能回答的问题。查看该敌人的另一面。” 目标 - 如果任意一张德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹被击败，推进。 (不要查看该卡牌的另一面。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your intervention gives the Desi you suspect is real just enough time to gain the advantage. While you had been pulling your punches, Desi has no such qualms. He shoves his firearm in his imposter's stomach and pulls the trigger. The other Desi collapses, lifeless, to the floor. Blood pools from his bullet wound and soaks his body crimson. Desi spits on the corpse of the mimic. "Púdrete en el infierno," he mutters under his breath. Then he clasps your shoulder and gives you a grin. "Thanks. I really owe you one." From what you can tell, his mannerisms seem perfectly natural. You breathe a sigh of relief.
all_card.real_back_text: For the remainder of the campaign, do not look at the other sides of either copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez until you are instructed to do so. Find the copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez that is in play (if both copies are in the victory display, return one to play). Store this copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez in a safe place where you may refer to it later in the campaign. (→R1) (page 31)
all_card.real_flavor: You arrive just in time to see two exact replicas of Desiderio embroiled in a deadly battle for the fate of his identity. In the midst of this chaos, it's impossible to tell which is which. There is no time to study their mannerisms. You have to act!
all_card.real_text: Each copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez loses concealed X, loses hunter, gains aloof, and gains the following ability: "[action]: Parley. Check the Campaign Log. If the cell knows Desi's past, you ask a question only he can answer. Look at the other side of this enemy." Objective - If either copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez is defeated, advance. (Do not look at its other side.)

all_card.flavor: 德西的店里各种酒都有，夜生活也是琳琅满目，不仅让当地人尽兴，也欢迎那些厌烦禁酒令铁律的美国游客……或者说，至少在他那伙人把这里用枪打得稀巴烂之前，这里还是迷人的。这究竟发生了什么？
all_card.name: 月下餐厅
all_card.real_flavor: Desi's bar offers a variety of drinks and a rich, wild nightlife for both locals and tourists from the States looking to escape the tight grip of Prohibition... or, at least, it used to, before he and his guns shot the place to hell. What in the world is going on here?

all_card.flavor: 德西的店里各种酒都有，夜生活也是琳琅满目，不仅让当地人尽兴，也欢迎那些厌烦禁酒令铁律的美国游客。
all_card.name: 月下餐厅
all_card.text: 场上每有一个[[域外]]敌人，月下餐厅得到隐藏值-1。 强制 - 如果月下餐厅没有线索：在上面增加线索，直到其有1[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.real_flavor: Desi's bar offers a variety of drinks and a rich, wild nightlife for both locals and tourists from the States looking to escape the tight grip of Prohibition.
all_card.real_text: Café Luna gets -1 shroud for each [[Outsider]] enemy in play. Forced - If there are no clues on Café Luna: Add clues to it until it has 1 [per_investigator] clues on it.

all_card.back_flavor: 这条宽阔的大道沿着哈瓦那北部的防波堤，非常适合公众集会，也是私下碰头的好地方。同志会在这儿安排了特工吗？
all_card.flavor: 你沿着马赛奥大道找寻德西手下的踪迹，毛毛细雨嘀哩嘀哩地打在路上，带来一股阴郁的气息。
all_card.name: 马赛奥大道
all_card.text: [reaction]你在马赛奥大道揭露诱饵后：揭露马赛奥大道的另一张隐匿迷你卡牌。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The broad roadway along Havana's northern seawall is a perfect place for both public gatherings and clandestine meetings. Could the Coterie have agents posted there?
all_card.real_flavor: A patter of drizzling rain sets a somber mood as you scour the Malecón for any trace of Desi's crew.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you expose a decoy at El Malecón: Expose another concealed mini-card at El Malecón. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 要说到哈瓦那的上流社会，那就不能不提这片室外的桃源。但要是德西的手下在此游荡，那肯定又有些别的花样。
all_card.name: 热带花园
all_card.text: [reaction]在你成功调查热带花园且超过难度至少3点后：选择一个放在一边的空洞。其所有者将其抽取。 强制 - 你调查热带花园时检定失败且低于难度至少3点后：选择你手中一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When it comes to high society in Havana, nothing is more iconic than this outdoor venue. But if this is one of Desi's haunts, there has to be something else at work here.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate Jardines de la Tropical by 3 or more: Choose a set-aside hollow. Its owner draws it. Forced - After you fail by 3 or more while investigating Jardines de la Tropical: Choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.

all_card.back_flavor: 似乎没人注意到国家剧院上面旋转的存在，但你之前见过，就在伦敦。只要这东西出现，同志会肯定也在附近。兴许你应该买张票自己进去看看。
all_card.name: 哈瓦那大剧院
all_card.text: [free]在你回合期间，花费2资源：哈瓦那大剧院的隐藏值降低2点，直到你的回合结束。(每回合仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Nobody else seems to notice the presence swirling above the Teatro Nacional, but you've seen it before, in London. And where such creatures roost, the Coterie is sure to be present, as well. Perhaps you should get tickets and see for yourself.
all_card.real_text: [fast] During your turn, spend 2 resources: Reduce Gran Teatro de La Habana's shroud by 2 until the end of your turn. (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.back_flavor: 德西很有可能是这个俱乐部的一员。不论他和手下出现在哪里，这些东西都紧随其后。抑或是反过来的？只有一个办法可以确认。
all_card.flavor: 德西的手下肯定知道在这儿怎么潇洒。
all_card.name: 海景游艇俱乐部
all_card.text: [action]：调查。不发现线索，改为查看海景游艇俱乐部一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面。你检定成功且每超过难度2点，额外查看海景游艇俱乐部一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面。
all_card.real_back_flavor: If Desi is a member of the Club, chances are, it's no coincidence. Wherever he and his crew show up, those things are sure to follow. Or is it the other way around? Only one way to find out for sure.
all_card.real_flavor: Desi's crew sure know how to live it up.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Investigate. Instead of discovering clues, look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at Miramar Yacht Club. For every 2 points you succeed by, look at the revealed side of an additional concealed mini-card at Miramar Yacht Club.

all_card.back_flavor: 大名鼎鼎的广场酒店最近刚刚翻新，各类现代设施一应俱全。众多名流在此下榻。不过近来又有传言，说有活动的阴影和异界的身影在走廊里徘徊，让你不得不怀疑黑暗之后还有暗流涌动。
all_card.name: 广场酒店
all_card.text: [free]受到1点恐惧：查看广场酒店或连接地点一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Recently renovated, the famed Plaza Hotel offers all of the modern amenities, and has hosted a variety of famous guests. But recent gossip of living shadows and otherworldly figures prowling its halls at night have you thinking there's more at play here after dark.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Take 1 horror: Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at Plaza Hotel or at a connecting location (without exposing it). (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.name: 德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹
all_card.text: 警戒。隐匿1[per_investigator]。猎手。反击。 德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 场景1或2期间，在德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹受到伤害时：改为自动躲避他。 [reaction]在躲避德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹且超过难度至少2点后，如果你所在地点有另一张他，则那一张他对这一张他造成2点伤害。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同志会. 精英
all_card.real_subname: The Man in the Blood-Soaked Suit
all_card.real_text: Alert. Concealed 1 [per_investigator]. Hunter. Retaliate. Desiderio Delgado Álvarez gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When Desiderio Delgado Álvarez takes damage during act 1 or 2: Instead, automatically evade him. [reaction] After Desiderio Delgado Álvarez is evaded by 2 or more and there is another copy of him at your location, that copy deals this one 2 damage.

all_card.name: 德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹
all_card.text: 警戒。隐匿1[per_investigator]。猎手。反击。 德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 场景1或2期间，在德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹受到伤害时：改为自动躲避他。 [reaction]在躲避德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹且超过难度至少2点后，如果你所在地点有另一张他，则那一张他对这一张他造成2点伤害。

all_card.real_subname: The Man in the Blood-Soaked Suit
all_card.real_text: Alert. Concealed 1 [per_investigator]. Hunter. Retaliate. Desiderio Delgado Álvarez gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When Desiderio Delgado Álvarez takes damage during act 1 or 2: Instead, automatically evade him. [reaction] After Desiderio Delgado Álvarez is evaded by 2 or more and there is another copy of him at your location, that copy deals this one 2 damage.

all_card.name: 德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹
all_card.text: [reaction]在[[怪物]]敌人的攻击对德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹造成伤害时，横置他：取消该伤害的1点，对攻击的敌人造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_subname: In Your Debt, Despite it All
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When an attack from a [[Monster]] enemy deals damage to Desiderio Delgado Álvarez, exhaust him: Cancel 1 of that damage and deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.

all_card.flavor: 是虚假的复制？还是超维的阴谋？
all_card.name: 惨遭夺舍
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定失败，选择一个你控制的[[盟友]]或[[道具]]支援，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞(如果你不能，改为受到2点恐惧)。
all_card.real_flavor: A false facsimile? Or a paradimensional plot?
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, choose an [[Ally]] or [[Item]] asset you control and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow (if you cannot, take 2 horror instead).

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为场上[[危险]]诡计的数量+1。
[cultist]：-5。选择你手中一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
[tablet]：-3。如果虚空奇美拉在你的地点，改为你自动失败。
[elder_thing]：-4。查看你牌库顶的卡牌。如果不是弱点，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
all_card.name: 如履薄冰
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为场上[[危险]]诡计的数量。
[cultist]：-4。如果你检定失败，选择你手中一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
[tablet]：-2 (如果虚空奇美拉在你的地点，改为-5)。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，查看你牌库顶的卡牌。如果不是弱点，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert

[cultist]: -5. Choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[tablet]: -3. If Void Chimera is at your location, you automatically fail, instead.
[elder_thing]: -4. Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of [[Hazard]] treacheries in play.
[cultist]: -4. If you fail, choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[tablet]: -2 (-5 instead if Void Chimera is at your location).

all_card.back_flavor: 严寒冻得你麻木。一开始你只以为这是身体在寒冷之下的反应，打算不予理会。等到停下来的时候，你才发现这股感觉是某种奇怪的力量强加于你的。你开始忘掉一些琐碎的时刻，忘掉周围的区域。就好像有什么东西追猎、吃掉了你的思维。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员选择自己手中或游戏区域内的一个[[盟友]]或[[道具]]支援，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
all_card.flavor: 勘探员的日志描绘了一个可怕的掠食者。这怪物在树林中逡巡，有人说是野兽，有人说是灵体，也有人说是变形者。每个目击者描述这个怪物时，都伴随着最原始的、无以名状的恐惧。
all_card.name: 失落与遗忘
all_card.real_back_flavor: The frigid landscape fills you with a kind of numbness. At first, you dismiss the feeling as purely physical, a side effect of the cold. It is only when you stop and consider the feeling itself that it dawns on you: the numbness is a result of some strange influence. You are forgetting small moments. Memories of the surrounding area. It is as though your mind itself is being hunted and fed upon.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator chooses an [[Ally]] or [[Item]] asset in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
all_card.real_flavor: The prospector's journal described a horrifying predator. Some call the thing stalking the woods a beast, some call it a spirit, and others know it as a shapeshifter. Describing the thing seems to fill each witness with a primal, unspeakable terror.

all_card.back_flavor:
你在探索中驻足查看附近山脉的壮丽奇景。其中一峰看起来有奇怪的缺口，仿佛有一只巨拳在山侧打出一个洞来。尽管盖了一层雪，岩石边挖出的深洞看上去还是让人觉得不祥。你不禁想问，从山脉的心脏中到底会涌出什么可怕的东西。
就在你凝视周围不可思议的毁灭景象的时候，脑海深处突然传来一阵模糊的嗡嗡声，让你紧张起来。你害怕自己是不是已经忘了什么，忘了谁……
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员选择自己手中或游戏区域内的一个[[盟友]]或[[道具]]支援，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
all_card.flavor: 你探索这片区域的时候，总觉得自己被监视了。仿佛有一千只眼睛直直盯着你……甚至可能看穿了你。周围的森林里，寂静震耳欲聋。
all_card.name: 虚空之眼
all_card.real_back_flavor:
During your exploration, you stop and look up at the majestic vista of a nearby mountain range. One of the mountains appears strangely damaged, as though a great fist has punched a hole in the mountainside. Although it is covered in a layer of snow, there is something ominous about the deep, empty pit gouged into the side of the rock. You wonder what horrible thing burst out of the heart of the mountain.
As you stare at the impossible destruction around you, a faint buzzing in the back of your mind sets you on edge. You have a creeping feeling that you have forgotten something, or someone...
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator chooses an [[Ally]] or [[Item]] asset in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
all_card.real_flavor: As you explore the region, you cannot shake the feeling that you are being watched. It as though a thousand eyes are staring directly at you... or perhaps through you. The surrounding forest is filled with a deafening silence.

all_card.back_flavor: 你身边突然有一群虚影汇合。突如其来的麻木占据了你的感官。你视线模糊，知觉分裂。你臣服于改变此地的可怕力量，麻木也变得心悦。尽管你还想再抓住现实一把，但意识已经涣散，你陷入了深沉、健忘的长眠。
all_card.back_text: 将所有空洞从游戏中移除。 收齐本冒险中从游戏移除的所有空洞。每位调查员找出自己印刷经验值费用最高的空洞，将其放逐。 在剧本日志中，记录“存在抹除：”并在旁边记录下以此方式放逐的每张独特卡牌的名称。本剧本剩余时间内，玩家不能将这些卡牌的任意张数(以名称辨别)加入自己牌库(如果每位调查员牌库内有这些卡牌的同名卡牌，立即将其移除)。 (→结局4) (第35页)
all_card.flavor: 你附近的地貌都被吞噬，从存在和记忆中被偷走了。你望着周围渐渐消散的荒野，麻木的感觉传遍四肢百骸。你突然惊骇地意识到自己已经无法维系对现实的掌控了。
all_card.name: 灭绝
all_card.real_back_flavor: Suddenly, a horde of blurred figures coalesces around you. An obscene numbness overtakes your senses as sight blurs and sense splinters. The numbness gives way to bliss as you slip under whatever awful influence has been changing this place. You struggle to hold onto reality, but your awareness drifts to unconsciousness, and you are dragged into a deep, forgetful slumber.
all_card.real_back_text: Remove each hollow from the game. Gather each hollow that was removed from the game throughout this scenario. Each investigator finds their hollow with the highest experience cost and exiles it. In the Campaign Log, record erased from existence: and next to this, record the names of each unique card exiled in this way. For the rest of the campaign, players cannot include any copies of those cards (by title) in their decks (immediately remove any copies from each investigator's deck). (→R4) (page 35)
all_card.real_flavor: The landscape around you is being actively devoured, stolen from existence and memory. A feeling of numbness spreads through you as you stare at the fading wilderness. An uncanny sense that you are losing your grip on reality nags at the edge of your mind.

all_card.back_text:
如果是密谋1：
金矿旁立着警告标志，声明这里已经废弃，十分危险。但你不管不顾，沿着兰道里日志所写，走进其中的分岔，找到了岩石间的玄丧之镜。但你出来的时候，却发现自己并非孤身一人。
如果是密谋2或3：
你走进废弃的金矿，却发现了路障已被打破，雪中留着足迹。索恩和同志会已经到了。你刚想原路返回，阴影中就钻出来两个手持霰弹枪的保镖，其中一个说道：“别动。”
无论是上述何种情况：
阅读剧本手册中的冒险幕间故事：强买强卖。
all_card.flavor: 索恩可能在寻找玄丧之镜时赶在了你前头，但你可有一样独有的法宝：瑞特·兰道里的日志。要是你能赶在同志会前面抵达勘探员的金矿，就能保护钥匙不落入他们的手中。
all_card.name: 寻找玄丧之镜
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有废弃金矿的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If it is agenda 1:
Ignoring signs warning that the mine is condemned and dangerous, you trace a path to the branch Landry wrote about in his journal and find the Sable Glass buried in the rock. When you emerge, however, you are not alone.
If it is agenda 2 or 3:
As you approach the condemned mine, you see from the broken barricades and tracks in the snow that Thorne and the Coterie have already arrived. Before you can backtrack, two guards emerge from the shadows brandishing shotguns. "Don't move," one of them says.
In either case: Read Scenario Interlude: Raw Deal in the Campaign Guide.
all_card.real_flavor: Thorne may have a head start in their search for the Sable Glass, but you have something they don't: Rhett Landry's journal. If you can reach the prospector's gold mine before the Coterie, you may be able to keep the Key out of their hands.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators at the Condemned Gold Mine may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你做好准备，在营火旁等待。你在这里，就是树林间游荡的捕食者的首要目标。很快，你就听到枝桠扭断的声音，看到树林间众多荧荧闪光的眼睛正望着你。
all_card.back_text: 将虚空奇美拉(真实形态)生成在阴影中，结算它的隐匿关键词，在场上每个[[荒地]]地点中，尽可能平均地分发其隐匿迷你卡牌。 对于每个有勘察报告的地点，你可以查看刚刚放置到该地点的隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面。
all_card.flavor: 索恩说自己正在追踪林间的捕食者。尽管这怪物不留踪迹，但你还是可以勘察周边区域，再引它出来。
all_card.name: 如果它会流血……
all_card.text: [action]如果你所在地点有[[荒地]]特性，你所在地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将1资源放在你的地点，作为勘察报告。(每个[[荒地]]地点仅限1个勘察报告。) 目标 - 当任意轮结束时，你可以推进。(提示：在你推进时，捕食者将被引出。在你确信自己已经准备完全时再推进。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: After making what preparations you can, you wait around a campfire. Your very presence in this territory makes you a prime lure for whatever awful predator stalks these woods. Soon enough, you hear a twig snap and see a multitude of glowing eyes watching you from the trees.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn Void Chimera (True Form) in the shadows and resolve its concealed keyword, distributing each of those concealed mini-cards as evenly as possible among each [[Wilderness]] location in play. For each location with a scouting report on it, you may look at the revealed side of the concealed mini-card just placed at that location.
all_card.real_flavor: Thorne said they were trying to track the predator in these woods. Although the beast leaves no trace, you can surely scout the surrounding area before luring it out.
all_card.real_text: [action] If your location has the [[Wilderness]] trait and investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource on your location, as a scouting report. (Limit 1 scouting report per [[Wilderness]] location.) Objective - You may advance at the end of any round. (Hint: You will lure out the predator when you advance. Advance when you believe you are prepared.)

all_card.flavor: 超维野兽的奇美拉形态变换万千，在视线里忽隐忽现。它正在戏弄你，就像猫玩耗子。要是你能揭露它的真形，兴许就能一转局势，将它永远驱逐。
all_card.name: 夜魇游荡
all_card.text: 目标 - 在揭露虚空奇美拉(真实形态)后，推进场景。
all_card.real_flavor: The shifting, chimeric form of the paradimensional beast flits in and out of view. It is playing games with you, much like a cat plays with a mouse. If you can expose its true form, perhaps you can turn the game on its head and banish it once and for all.
all_card.real_text: Objective - After Void Chimera (True Form) is exposed, advance the act.

all_card.name: 域外来客之巢
all_card.text: 显现 - 将域外来客之巢放置入场，将虚空奇美拉(真实形态)和它所在地点的每位调查员移动到域外来客之巢。 域外来客之巢没有线索时，虚空奇美拉(真实形态)得到-1攻击和-1躲避。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Outsiders' Lair into play and move Void Chimera (True Form) and each investigator at its location to Outsiders' Lair. While Outsiders' Lair has no clues on it, Void Chimera (True Form) gets -1 fight and -1 evade.

all_card.back_flavor: 你打出最后一击，变换无穷的残暴怪物就此倒下，伴有恶臭和刺耳的噪音，吸走了附近的空气。它的身形崩坏，你周围奇异的异界景象也瓦解了。你发现自己混在一团静电和臭氧中给甩回了现实。
all_card.back_text: 检查场上的索恩是哪个版本： - 如果场上的索恩是剧情支援，(→结局1) (第35页)。 - 如果场上的索恩是敌人，(→结局2) (第35页)。 - 如果索恩不在场上，(→结局3) (第35页)。
all_card.flavor: 追捕你的猎手将你困在了它的巢穴里。这异星的野兽完全展现了自己此界无有的壮阔，万千种无形的化身朝你逼近。
all_card.name: 最后一刻
all_card.text: 揭露虚空奇美拉(真实形态)的地点与域外来客之巢连接(但域外来客之巢不与该地点连接)。 目标 - 如果虚空奇美拉(真实形态)被击败，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you land a final blow, the shifting, violent thing collapses into itself with a noisome cacophony and a sudden suction of air. As its form crumbles, the strange otherworld around you also begins to disintegrate, and you find yourself drawn back to reality in a rush of static and ozone.
all_card.real_back_text: Check which version of Thorne is in play: - If the Thorne story asset is in play, (→R1) (page 35). - If the Thorne enemy is in play, (→R2) (page 35). - If Thorne is not in play, (→R3) (page 35).
all_card.real_flavor: Your prey has trapped you in its own lair. The alien beast unveils itself in all its otherworldly grandeur, looming over you in myriad, amorphous forms.
all_card.real_text: The location where Void Chimera (True Form) was exposed is connected to Outsiders' Lair (but not vice versa.) Objective - If Void Chimera (True Form) is defeated, advance the act.

all_card.back_flavor: 淘金潮让安克雷奇变得热火朝天。差不多你经过的每条街都在大兴土木。街上走着无数的拓荒者，个个破衣烂衫。而你穿着日常衣服，显得格格不入。
all_card.name: 安克雷奇
all_card.text: [action]：选择一个放在一边的空洞。其所有者将其抽取。(每轮仅限一次。) [action]：撤退。“我还以为每年这时候阿拉斯加的天气能好点儿呢！”
all_card.real_back_flavor: Anchorage bustles with excitement brought on by the gold rush. Almost every street you walk down has a new façade under construction. The sheer number of rugged pioneer folk walking the streets makes you feel out of place in your everyday clothes.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Choose a set-aside hollow. Its owner draws it. (Limit once per round.) [action]: Resign. "I thought Alaska was supposed to be nice this time of year!"

all_card.back_flavor: 要想补充补给，研究去金矿的线路，那费尔班克斯是绝佳的地点。
all_card.flavor: 在我友邻的举止下，我感到周围袭来一阵奇异的严寒。<cite>维吉尔·格雷，《身临域外之廷》</cite>
all_card.name: 费尔班克斯
all_card.text: [reaction]在位于费尔班克斯的调查员抽取[[危险]]诡计时：花费2资源以取消该诡计的效果并将其弃掉。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Fairbanks is the perfect place to replenish your supplies and research routes to the gold mine.
all_card.real_flavor:
All around me I sensed a queer coldness in the demeanor of my neighbors, my friends.
 - Virgil Gray, "In the Court of the Outsiders"
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When an investigator at Fairbanks draws a [[Hazard]] treachery: Spend 2 resources to cancel that treachery's effects and discard it.

all_card.back_flavor: 这些森林遥远孤寂，荒芜又壮观，让他体会到了自己的渺小，这份感觉将他吞没。<cite>阿尔杰农·布莱克伍德，《温迪戈》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 这里的冰面吱嘎作响，要想跨越危险万分，但你没有别的选择。
all_card.name: 山间溪流
all_card.text: 强制 - 你进入山间溪流后：检定[intellect]或[agility](1)。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害。 强制 - 在山间溪流上最后的线索被发现后：将3张放在一边的界外荒地地点放置入场，与其相邻。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The bleak splendours of these remote and lonely forests rather overwhelmed him with the sense of his own littleness. - Algernon Blackwood, The Wendigo
all_card.real_flavor: Crossing the cracking ice is incredibly dangerous, but you have little other choice.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Mountain Stream: Test [intellect] or [agility] (1). If you fail, take 1 damage. Forced - After the last clue is discovered from Mountain Stream: Put the 3 set-aside Outer Wilderness locations into play adjacent to it.

all_card.name: 冰封湖面

all_card.flavor: 广袤的森林似在倾听，一片寂静，缓缓向前，将他们包围。<cite>阿尔杰农·布莱克伍德，《温迪戈》</cite>
all_card.name: 偏远小路
all_card.text: 本地点调查员每轮揭示的第一张[[危险]]诡计获得涌动。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The bleak splendours of these remote and lonely forests rather overwhelmed him with the sense of his own littleness. - Algernon Blackwood, The Wendigo
all_card.real_flavor: The silence of the vast listening forest stole forward and enveloped them. - Algernon Blackwood, The Wendigo
all_card.real_text: The first [[Hazard]] treachery revealed by an investigator at this location each round gains surge.

all_card.back_flavor: 夜风带来了森林深处汹涌的沉默，还有消息来自遥远的山脊和刚刚结冰的湖面。这些都是严冬将至之时淡薄的阴冷气息。<cite>阿尔杰农·布莱克伍德，《温迪戈》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 虽然远远比不上城镇，但在荒野里辛劳几日之后，这个小小的定居点也成了舒适的堡垒。
all_card.name: 被遗忘的哨站
all_card.text: [action]：抽取3张卡牌。(每场游戏仅限一次)
all_card.real_back_flavor: In the draughts of night that poured their silent tide from the depths of the forest, with messages from distant ridges and from lakes just beginning to freeze, there lay already the faint, bleak odors of coming winter. - Algernon Blackwood, The Wendigo
all_card.real_flavor: While hardly large enough to qualify as a town, this small settlement feels like a bastion of comfort after days on end of trying wilderness.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Draw 3 cards. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 夜风带来了森林深处汹涌的沉默，还有消息来自遥远的山脊和刚刚结冰的湖面。这些都是严冬将至之时淡薄的阴冷气息。<cite>阿尔杰农·布莱克伍德，《温迪戈》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 你本以为域外来客才是这里危险的生物。
all_card.name: 猎人小屋
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你揭示猎人小屋时：检定[willpower]或[intellect](3)以说服猎人冷静下来。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害。 强制 - 在[[怪物]]敌人进入本地点时：对它造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: In the draughts of night that poured their silent tide from the depths of the forest, with messages from distant ridges and from lakes just beginning to freeze, there lay already the faint, bleak odors of coming winter. - Algernon Blackwood, The Wendigo
all_card.real_flavor: And here you thought the Outsiders were the dangerous ones.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you reveal Hunter's Lodge: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3) to talk the hunter down. If you fail, take 1 damage. Forced - When a [[Monster]] enemy enters this location: Deal 1 damage to it.

all_card.back_flavor: 夜风带来了森林深处汹涌的沉默，还有消息来自遥远的山脊和刚刚结冰的湖面。这些都是严冬将至之时淡薄的阴冷气息。<cite>阿尔杰农·布莱克伍德，《温迪戈》</cite>
all_card.name: 废弃金矿
all_card.text: [action]：从混乱袋中随机揭示1个混乱标记，且废弃金矿上每有一个枯竭标记，额外揭示1个混乱标记。如果你没有以此方式揭示任何[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号，获得4资源并将1资源 (从供应堆拿取) 放到废弃金矿，作为一个枯竭标记。

all_card.real_text: [action]: Reveal 1 random chaos token from the chaos bag plus 1 additional token for each depletion token on Condemned Gold Mine. If you did not reveal any [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbols in this way, gain 4 resources and place 1 resource (from the token pool) on Condemned Gold Mine, as a depletion token.

all_card.name: 索恩
all_card.text: 猎手。反击。 索恩得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 在抽取[[危险]]诡计后：索恩变换身上附属的每个钥匙。 强制 - 在索恩被击败时：如果玄丧之镜附属到索恩，将其附属到任意一位调查员，由该调查员控制。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同志会. 精英
all_card.real_subname: The One with the Red Cravat
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Thorne gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After a [[Hazard]] treachery is drawn: Thorne shifts each of their attached keys. Forced - When Thorne is defeated: If The Sable Glass is attached to Thorne, attach it to any investigator, under that investigator's control.

all_card.flavor: “承认吧，我在这一点上比你强。”
all_card.name: 索恩
all_card.text: [reaction]你所在地点的调查员将卡牌放在一边，作为空洞后，横置索恩：该调查员可以立即进行一次行动，如同是自己回合。
all_card.real_flavor: "Just admit it. I'm better at this than you."
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After an investigator at your location sets a card aside as a hollow, exhaust Thorne: That investigator may take an immediate action as if it were their turn.

all_card.name: 虛空奇美拉
all_card.text: 隐匿4。庞大。 虚空奇美拉的其他形态在场时，你不能揭露任何隐匿迷你卡牌。 强制 - 你揭露虚空奇美拉的诱饵后：在放在一边的虚空奇美拉中，找出副标题与其对应的版本，生成在你的地点。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 域外. 精英
all_card.real_text: Concealed 4. Massive. You cannot expose any concealed mini-cards while one of Void Chimera's other forms is in play. Forced - After you expose one of Void Chimera's decoys: Find the set-aside version of Void Chimera with the matching subtitle and spawn it at your location.

all_card.flavor: 这头野兽全身精致的羽毛真是叫人震惊。
all_card.name: 虛空奇美拉
all_card.text: 巡逻(有最多调查员的[[荒地]]地点)。反击。 虚空奇美拉(凶残巨喙)得到+1[per_investigator]生命值。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 域外. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: The beast's exquisite plumage is quite literally stunning.
all_card.real_text: Patrol ([[Wilderness]] location with the most investigators). Retaliate. Void Chimera (Fellbeak) gets +1 [per_investigator] health.

all_card.flavor: 这怪物的甲壳震动着响起惊悚的声音。尽管大部分声音都不在你听觉的频率范围之内，但诡异的共振还是让你心神俱骇。
all_card.name: 虛空奇美拉
all_card.text: 警戒。猎手。 虛空奇美拉(震耳欲聋)得到+1[per_investigator]生命值。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 域外. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: The beast's carapace rattles with an unsettling hiss. While much of the sound lies beyond the scope of your hearing, its eerie resonance shakes you to your core.
all_card.real_text: Alert. Hunter. Void Chimera (Earsplitter) gets +1 [per_investigator] health.

all_card.name: 虛空奇美拉
all_card.text: 猎手。 虛空奇美拉(尤嗜鲜血)得到+1[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 虛空奇美拉(尤嗜鲜血)攻击你后：查看你牌库顶的卡牌。如果不是弱点，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞，并治愈虚空奇美拉(尤嗜鲜血)等于该空洞印刷费用的伤害。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 域外. 精英

If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow, and heal damage from Void Chimera (Gorefeaster) equal to that hollow's printed cost.

all_card.name: 虛空奇美拉
all_card.text: 猎手。 虚空奇美拉(凶狠猎犬)得到+1[per_investigator]生命值。 你攻击或尝试躲避虚空奇美拉(凶狠猎犬)时，如果有任何放在一边的空洞归你所有，它获得警戒和反击。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 域外. 精英
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Void Chimera (Fellhound) gets +1 [per_investigator] health. While you are attacking or attempting to evade Void Chimera (Fellhound), if you own any set-aside hollows, it gains alert and retaliate.

all_card.name: 饥饿的灰熊
all_card.text: 猎手。反击。 生成 - 最近的[[荒地]]地点。 饥饿的灰熊不能进入非[[荒地]]地点。 饥饿的灰熊移动时，跳过连接的非[[荒地]]地点。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Spawn - Nearest [[Wilderness]] location. Ravenous Grizzly cannot enter non-[[Wilderness]] locations. While Ravenous Grizzly is moving, it skips over connecting non-[[Wilderness]] locations.

all_card.name: 冰层破裂
all_card.text: 显现 - 将冰层破裂放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。然后，如果密谋牌库旁有至少3张冰层破裂，将其全部弃掉，每位在[[荒地]]地点的调查员检定[agility](4)。每位检定失败的调查员每低于难度1点，必须受到1点伤害，受到1点恐惧，或失去1个行动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Cracking Ice into play next to the agenda deck. Then, if there are 3 or more copies of Cracking Ice next to the agenda deck, discard them all and each investigator at a [[Wilderness]] location tests [agility] (4). Each investigator who fails must take 1 damage, take 1 horror, or lose 1 action for each point they failed by.

all_card.flavor: 要是你听到轰隆声悄悄逼近，就已经太晚了。
all_card.name: 积雪崩坍
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，你和你控制的每个有生命值的支援受到1点直接伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: If you hear that soft roar approaching, it's already too late.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you and each asset with health you control takes 1 direct damage.

all_card.flavor: 档案#33-K31/客体等级：绿色/客体为扭曲的棱镜，由不透明材料组成。透过棱镜能看到其他位面的景象。

all_card.real_flavor: File #33-K31 / Subject Class: Green / Subject is a warped lens of indeterminate translucent material. Layer appears as window to other layers when viewed through lens.

all_card.flavor: ……小心过度暴露在超维视角下/另一端也能看见你。
all_card.name: 玄丧之镜

all_card.real_flavor: ...beware of prolonged exposure to paradimensional viewpoint / other side can see you, too...
all_card.real_text: Shift - Each investigator sets the non-weakness card in their hand with the highest printed cost aside, out of play, as a hollow. Then, if an investigator shifted this key, flip it to its [[Stable]] side.
