all_card.back_text:
如果本密谋因达到毁灭阈值而推进：
风暴咆哮。门砸坏了，地基摇晃。钥匙节点光芒黯淡。你尽力坚持，但精疲力尽，心惊胆战，因为自己所选的任务根本不可能完成。同志会原本不会是你的盟友，但此刻你们还是一同退向最后一道防线，也就是暗红骑士的办公室。情绪万分紧张，四下无人出声。你怀疑恶兽及其信徒任何时候都可能破门而入，血染此屋……
推进场景。
如果暗红骑士被击败：
风暴咆哮。门砸坏了，地基摇晃。钥匙节点完全失效了。你尽力坚持，但精疲力尽，心惊胆战，因为自己所选的任务根本不可能完成。你不得不蛰伏，处理自己的伤口。恶兽已在此时袭来……
(→结局3) (第42页)
all_card.flavor: 恶兽将来夺取猎物……
all_card.name: 酝酿灾祸(版本一)
all_card.text: 每个敌人失去猎手并获得巡逻(有钥匙节点的最近地点)。 场上没有其他钥匙节点时，卡牌能力会将暗红骑士算作钥匙节点。 在检查毁灭阈值时，改为从场上毁灭标记总数中减去本密谋以外其他卡牌上的毁灭标记数，而不是加上。 目标 - 保卫骑士！如果暗红骑士被击败，推进本密谋。
all_card.real_back_text:
If this agenda advanced by reaching its doom threshold:
The storm rages on. Doors batter and foundations shake. The Key Locuses dim. You've stood your ground for as long as you can. Weary and terrified that you have chosen an impossible course, you and your unlikely Coterie allies retreat to the Claret Knight's office as a last line of defense. The mood is tense and quiet. Any moment you suspect the Beast or its devotees will tear down the door and turn this chamber into a bloodbath...
Advance the act.
If The Claret Knight was defeated:
The storm rages on. Doors batter and foundations shake. The Key Locuses have failed. You've stood your ground for as long as you could. Weary and terrified that you have chosen an impossible course, you are forced to lay low for a moment to lick your wounds. That is when the Beast strikes...
(→R3) (page 42)
all_card.real_flavor: The Beast is coming to claim its due...
all_card.real_text: Each enemy loses hunter and gains patrol (nearest location with a Key Locus). While there are no other Key Locuses in play, The Claret Knight counts as a Key Locus for the purposes of card abilities. When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it. Objective - Defend the Knight! If The Claret Knight is defeated, advance this agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 风暴咆哮。门砸坏了，地基摇晃。你把自己所有的力气都他妈的用尽了，但暗红骑士——还有剩下的钥匙节点——还在阻止你夺取猎物。反常的风暴愈演愈烈，同志会的人正倾巢而出，不留余力。你觉得自己不可能再有这样的机会了。现在是否应该撤退休整？
all_card.back_text:
调查员必须决定(选择一项)：
- 每位幸存的调查员立即受到1点直接伤害并承受1点肉体创伤。将本密谋翻回，并在上面放置10个毁灭标记。
- 每位幸存的调查员立即撤退。
all_card.flavor: 你拒绝了同志会特工的提议，而对方看上去已经控制了整个亚历山大。你转而和当地一名基金会成员哈桑·西里合作，他希望将同志会彻底赶出这座城市。要是走运，你或许能夺走钥匙，一石二鸟。
all_card.name: 酝酿灾祸(版本二)
all_card.text: 场上没有其他钥匙节点时，卡牌能力会将证券交易所算作钥匙节点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The storm rages on. Doors batter and foundations shake. You have tried your damnedest, but the Claret Knight - and thus the last of the Key Locuses preventing you from acquiring your prize - still stands. With the supernatural storm growing more and more potent, and the rest of the Coterie mobilizing for all-out war with one another, you don't think you'll get another chance like this. Perhaps it would be better to retreat and lay low.
all_card.real_back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
- Each surviving investigator immediately takes 1 direct damage and suffers 1 physical trauma. Flip this agenda back over and place 10 doom on it.
- Each surviving investigator immediately resigns.
all_card.real_flavor: You've refused the offer of the Coterie agent who appears to control things in Alexandria, and instead teamed up with a local Foundation operative, Hossam Sirry, who hopes to see the Coterie ousted from the city. With any luck, you can claim the Key here for yourself as well, killing two birds with one stone.
all_card.real_text: While there are no other Key Locuses in play, The Bourse counts as a Key Locus for the purposes of card abilities.

all_card.back_flavor: 风暴咆哮。门砸坏了，地基摇晃。你把自己所有的力气都他妈的用尽了，但还是拦不住危险又敏捷的深红斗篷的恶兽。只要它的巢穴不受侵扰——剩下的钥匙节点依然有效——你就无法夺回它手中的钥匙。反常的风暴愈演愈烈，每过一刻，恶兽的信徒胆子都越来越大，力量也越来越强。你觉得自己不可能再有这样的机会了。现在是否应该撤退休整？
all_card.back_text:
调查员必须决定(选择一项)：
- 每位幸存的调查员立即受到1点直接伤害并承受1点肉体创伤。将本密谋翻回，并在上面放置10个毁灭标记。
- 每位幸存的调查员立即撤退。
all_card.flavor: 你寻找亚历山大的钥匙，一路追踪深红斗篷的恶兽。它万分危险，蔑视秩序，即便是同志会的其他成员也忌惮它的怒火。它血腥狂暴的行为已经让全城陷入一片恐慌。
all_card.name: 酝酿灾祸(版本三)
all_card.text: 场上没有其他钥匙节点时，卡牌能力会将亚历山大地下陵墓算作钥匙节点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The storm rages on. Doors batter and foundations shake. You have tried your damnedest, but the Beast in a Cowl of Crimson is too dangerous and too agile to pin down. So long as its lair remains undisturbed - and thus the last of the Key Locuses still standing - you cannot reclaim the creature's Key. With the supernatural storm growing more and more potent and the Beast's devotees growing bolder and stronger by the hour, you don't think you'll get another chance like this. Perhaps it would be better to retreat and lay low.
all_card.real_back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
- Each surviving investigator immediately takes 1 direct damage and suffers 1 physical trauma. Flip this agenda back over and place 10 doom on it.
- Each surviving investigator immediately resigns.
all_card.real_flavor: In your pursuit of Alexandria's Key, you are on the trail of the Beast in a Cowl of Crimson, a Coterie member so dangerous and chaotic, even the rest of the Coterie fears its wrath. Its bloody rampage has sent the entire city into a state of terror.
all_card.real_text: While there are no other Key Locuses in play, Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa counts as a Key Locus for the purposes of card abilities.

all_card.back_flavor: ……等到风暴过去，你依然屹立，而法罗斯之光安全了。你的东道主命令手下几个特工去找寻恶兽的所在。意外的是，它已经逃出城去了。“我们安全了。”有个特工松了一直悬着的一口气，“我们终于安全了。”
all_card.back_text: 将深红斗篷的恶兽加入胜利区。 将场上每个钥匙节点加入胜利区。 (→结局1) (第42页)
all_card.flavor: 你同意帮助暗红骑士和他的手下守护钥匙，不让它落入同志会另一位成员——深红斗篷的恶兽的魔爪。
all_card.name: 惊弓之鸟(版本一)
all_card.text: 在敌军阶段的“敌人攻击”步骤期间，除标准攻击外，每个重整的敌人还会攻击其所在地点的钥匙节点，如同其是已交战的调查员。这些攻击造成的恐惧改为造成伤害。 目标 - 保卫钥匙，尽可能坚持下来。(密谋代表了你必须坚持多久。要推进场景时，你会收到指示。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: ...But when the storm passes, you still stand, and the Light of Pharos is safe. Your host orders several of his agents to track down the Beast's whereabouts, and you are surprised to find that it has fled the city. "We're safe," one of them says, letting out a held breath. "We're finally safe."
all_card.real_back_text: Add The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson to the victory display. Add each Key Locus in play to the victory display. (→R1) (page 42)
all_card.real_flavor: You've agreed to help The Claret Knight and his enforcers defend his Key from another member of the Coterie - the Beast in a Cowl of Crimson.
all_card.real_text: During the "enemies attack" step of the enemy phase, in addition to their standard attacks, each ready enemy attacks each Key Locus at its location as if it were an engaged investigator. Horror dealt by these attacks is dealt as damage, instead. Objective - Defend the Key and hold out for as long as you can. (The agenda represents how long you must defend it. You will be instructed when to advance.)

all_card.back_text:
如果调查员控制了法罗斯之光：
你安安全全地踏进了之前与同志会碰面的办公室，撬开了藏宝柜。里面闪耀的一缕微光未受侵扰。你将钥匙从安放之处一把拿起，趁着骑士的手下还没追来，赶紧溜了。
(→结局2) (第42页)。
如果调查员击败了暗红骑士：
“蠢货。”骑士按住自己一侧说道，“你不明白吗？我们是人类最后的依靠了。没有我们……”他几个护卫突然闯了进来，打断了你们，但也已经来不及阻止你了。他们没有与你对抗，而是将自己的头目带到安全的地方。“你会为这付出代价的。”老人给护送出了屋子，一路上咳嗽不停。“我们都会付出代价的。”
(→结局2) (第42页)。
all_card.flavor:
“证券交易所就是他们的行动基地。”西里特工在你们动手前总结道，“要想对付同志会，就先得摧毁散落全城的钥匙节点。不然，我们是没机会的。”
你点点头，回想起暗红骑士之前告诉你的事情。要是你能找到并摧毁这些节点，就能再次进入证券交易所。
all_card.name: 惊弓之鸟(版本二)
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果暗红骑士被击败，或如果调查员控制了法罗斯之光，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If the investigators took control of the Light of Pharos:
You safely enter the office where you met with the Coterie earlier and crack open the vault. The light inside shines on undisturbed. You snatch the Key from its resting place and abscond before the rest of the knight's enforcers catch up to you.
(→R2) (page 42) If the investigators defeated The Claret Knight:
"Fools," the knight utters, clutching his side. "Do you not understand? We are the last guardians of humanity. Without us..." Cutting him off, several of his bodyguards suddenly rush into the chamber, but they are too late to stop you. Rather than confront you, they pull their leader to safety. "You will pay for this," the elderly man shouts through a barrage of coughs as he is escorted off the premises. "We will all pay for this."
(→R2) (page 42)
all_card.real_flavor:
"The Bourse is their base of operations," Agent Sirry summarizes what you know before you put your plan into action. "If we're going to confront the Coterie, we have to first destroy the Key Locuses scattered around the city. Otherwise, we don't stand a chance."
You nod, recalling what the Claret Knight told you earlier. If you can find and destroy these locuses, you can enter The Bourse once more.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If The Claret Knight is defeated, or if an investigator controls The Light of Pharos, advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果调查员控制了法罗斯之光：
你在墓穴间小心前行，寻找恶兽将法罗斯之光藏在何处。最终，你找到一条隐秘的通道，通往城市底下更深处的坟墓。里面有座精美的石棺，裂隙间发出幽幽蓝光，预示了里面藏着什么。你推开棺盖，夺回了里面的钥匙，赶在恶兽发现你的所做作为之前溜走了。
如果调查员击败了深红斗篷的恶兽：
恶兽的哀嚎颇为可怕。它逃走了，留下一阵难闻的血迹。你可以继续追击，但你要找的东西还藏在墓穴深处。此外，你也担心这样的困兽可能十分危险……
无论是上述何种情况： 检查剧本日志。 - 如果特别小组与暗红骑士达成交易，(→结局5) (第43页)。 - 如果特别小组帮助西里特工，(→结局6) (第43页)。
all_card.flavor: 恶兽躲在城中某处的巢穴里，派出信徒血染街道，绑架受害者以作美餐。要是你想阻止这场屠杀，就得先摧毁散落全城的钥匙节点，这些节点保护着恶兽的巢穴。只有这样，你才能夺回遭窃的钥匙，将恶兽赶出亚历山大。
all_card.name: 惊弓之鸟(版本三)
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果深红斗篷的恶兽被击败，或如果调查员控制了法罗斯之光，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If the investigators took control of the Light of Pharos:
You sneak carefully through the catacombs, searching for the place where the Beast has hidden the Light of Pharos. Eventually, you find a hidden passage leading to a tomb much deeper beneath the city. Inside, a telltale glow emanates from the cracks of an ancient sarcophagus. You push off the stone lid and claim the Key from within, fleeing before the Beast realizes what you have done.
If the investigators defeated the Beast in a Cowl of Crimson:
The Beast lets out a sinister growl and retreats, leaving a trail of ichorous blood in its wake. You could pursue it, but your prize lies deeper in the catacombs, and besides, you worry how dangerous such a creature might become when cornered...
In either case: Check the Campaign Log: - If the cell made a deal with the Claret Knight, (→R5) (page 43) - If the cell is assisting Agent Sirry, (→R6) (page 43)
all_card.real_flavor: Somewhere in the city, the Beast dwells in its lair, sending its devotees to the streets to spill blood and kidnap victims to feast upon. If you are to stop this bloodbath, you'll have to first destroy the Key Locuses scattered around the city which protect the Beast's lair. Only then can you retrieve the Key it has stolen and drive the Beast from Alexandria.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson is defeated, or if an investigator controls The Light of Pharos, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 看来亚历山大的证券交易所可不仅仅是做生意的地方——它其实就是暗红骑士为钥匙选择的安放之所，那把你要找到的钥匙。
all_card.back_text: 通往办公室的门看守严密。除非暗红骑士是场上唯一的钥匙节点，否则敌人不能进入证券交易所(如果敌人将要生成在此处，改为生成在一个连接地点)。
all_card.name: 证券交易所
all_card.text:
除非暗红骑士是场上唯一的钥匙节点，否则敌人不能进入证券交易所(如果敌人将要生成在此处，改为生成在一个连接地点)。
[action]在证券交易所的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：从任意地点或你控制的支援上移除1个毁灭标记。任意玩家均可以触发本能力。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The stock exchange building in Alexandria is more than just a place of business, it seems - it is also the Claret Knight's chosen hiding place for the Key you are searching for.
all_card.real_back_text: The entrance to the offices is secure. Unless The Claret Knight is the only Key Locus in play, enemies cannot enter The Bourse (if an enemy would spawn here, spawn it at a connecting location instead).
all_card.real_text:
Unless The Claret Knight is the only Key Locus in play, enemies cannot enter The Bourse (if an enemy would spawn here, spawn it at a connecting location instead).
[action] Investigators at The Bourse spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remove 1 doom from any location or from an asset you control. Any player may trigger this ability.

all_card.back_flavor: 看来同志会已在亚历山大的证券交易安营扎寨。众目睽睽之下，还有哪能比这里更适合避人耳目？
all_card.back_text: 通往办公室的门重兵把守。你不能进入证券交易所，除非它是场上唯一的钥匙节点。
all_card.name: 证券交易所
all_card.text: [action]：检定[willpower]或[agility](4)。如果你检定成功，本地点的调查员可以共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索，以在法罗斯之光上放置1资源。然后，如果法罗斯之光上有3资源，选择一位本地点的调查员控制它。
all_card.real_back_flavor: It seems the Coterie has set up shop in Alexandria's stock exchange building. What better place to hide than in plain sight?
all_card.real_back_text: The entrance to the offices is guarded. You cannot enter The Bourse unless it is the only Key Locus in play.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to place 1 resource on the Light of Pharos. Then, if there are 3 resources on the Light of Pharos, choose an investigator at this location to take control of it.

all_card.back_flavor: 亚历山大的证券交易所巩固了此城埃及经济中心的地位。白天这里熙熙攘攘，无数马车汽车停在附近，众人进进出出。
all_card.name: 证券交易所
all_card.text: [action]：调查。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为获得4资源。你可以将此次检定的难度降低2点。如果你这么做，如果检定成功你少获得2资源。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Bourse is the site of Alexandria's stock exchange, cementing the city as a major economic center for Egypt. It is a bustling place during the day, with many carriages and automobiles parked nearby at all hours, and dozens of people entering and exiting.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, gain 4 resources. You may reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. If you do, gain 2 fewer resources if you succeed. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 建在海边的温莎宫是城里顶尖的酒店，服务精英阶层。要是哪里还能供同志会的特使藏身，那就是这儿了。根据你的情报，这里也是暗红骑士藏匿所谓“节点”的地方。
all_card.name: 溫莎宮酒店
all_card.text:
你在温莎宫酒店时……
-……如果此处有钥匙节点，你打出的每张[[道具]]和[[盟友]]支援的费用提升1点。
-……如果此处没有钥匙节点，你打出的每张[[道具]]和[[盟友]]支援的费用降低1点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Established along the coast, the Windsor Palace is one of the finest hotels in the city, serving its elite. If there is anywhere Coterie envoys might be hiding, this is it. According to your intel, it's also the hiding place of one of the Claret Knight's supposed "loci."
all_card.real_text:
While you are at Windsor Palace Hotel...
- ...if there is a Key Locus here, increase the cost of each [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you play by 1.
- ...if there is no Key Locus here, reduce the cost of each [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you play by 1.

all_card.back_flavor: 这所学院成立已有两秩，培育了许多达官显贵。你的情报显示，暗红骑士近来移动过一个节点——要是他选了这里，那真是毫不意外。
all_card.name: 维多利亚学院
all_card.text: [reaction]你位于维多利亚学院时，在你将要从自己牌库抽取正好1张卡牌时：改为查看你牌库顶的2张卡牌，选择1张抽取，并将另一张洗回你的牌库。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Founded just two decades ago, the college is home to many important and well-to-do students. Your intel indicates that one of the Claret Knight's loci might have moved recently - it wouldn't be a surprise to you if this was the chosen site.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you would draw exactly 1 card from your deck while you are at Victoria College: Instead, look at the top 2 cards of your deck, choose 1 to draw, and shuffle the other back into your deck. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 这座城堡名列地中海岸最重要的历史要塞之林。这块地方原本屹立着亚历山大名声卓著的古代灯塔。
all_card.name: 奎贝堡
all_card.text: 强制 - 你调查奎贝堡时技能检定失败后：直到本轮结束，你不能发现奎贝堡的线索，不能揭露奎贝堡的隐匿迷你卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: One of the most important historical strongholds along the Mediterranean, the Citadel was built on the site of the ancient and famed Lighthouse of Alexandria.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Qaitbay Citadel: You cannot discover clues or expose concealed mini-cards at Qaitbay Citadel for the remainder of the round.

all_card.back_flavor: 海浪冲击着亚历山大沿海的道路，海水都溅到了街上。滨海大道奇长无比，与许多街道都有交汇，是活动的中心——兴许这里是钥匙节点绝佳的藏匿地点？
all_card.name: 滨海大道
all_card.text: 强制 - 滨海大道被成功调查后：本轮在滨海大道执行的其他每次检定难度提升2点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Waves crash against the road that runs along Alexandria's coast, spilling water into the streets. A hub of activity, many streets intersect with the Corniche along its lengthy route - perhaps the perfect hiding place for a Key Locus?
all_card.real_text: Forced - After The Corniche is successfully investigated: Increase the difficulty of each other test performed at The Corniche this round by 2.

all_card.back_flavor: 这座拥挤繁忙的市集可谓鼎鼎大名，因为它有着弯曲的街巷、繁忙的店铺和可怕的过往。你寻找这里藏匿的钥匙节点，眼睛不住地瞥过狭窄街道间数不清的小巷和藏匿地。
all_card.name: 妇女市集
all_card.text: 强制 - 你位于妇女市集时，在你攻击敌人时：你必须花费1个行动，或本次攻击中该敌人的攻击值提升2点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: This busy, crowded marketplace is known for its twisting streets, bustling shops, and grisly past. You can't help but dart your eyes between the many alleys and hiding places along these narrow streets as you search for the Key Locus tucked away here.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you fight an enemy while at Zan'et el Settat: You must either spend 1 action or increase that enemy's fight by 2 for this attack.

all_card.back_flavor: 大墓地中是许多著名古人的长眠之地，也有更为可怕的存在以此为巢。
all_card.back_text: 通往地下陵墓的道路尚未发现。你不能进入亚历山大地下陵墓，除非它是场上唯一的钥匙节点。
all_card.name: 亚历山大地下陵墓
all_card.text: [action]：检定[willpower]或[agility](4)。如果你检定成功，本地点的调查员可以共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索，以在法罗斯之光上放置1资源。然后，如果法罗斯之光上有3资源，选择一位本地点的调查员控制它。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The necropolis is home to several prominent dead, but is also the lair of something far more terrifying.
all_card.real_back_text: The way into the catacombs is hidden. You cannot enter the Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa unless it is the only Key Locus in play.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to place 1 resource on the Light of Pharos. Then, if there are 3 resources on the Light of Pharos, choose an investigator at this location to take control of it.

all_card.back_text: 通往地下陵墓的道路尚未打开。你不能进入亚历山大地下陵墓。深红斗篷的恶兽不能离开亚历山大地下陵墓。 强制 - 如果当前密谋上有至少6个毁灭标记：揭示亚历山大地下陵墓。
all_card.flavor: 大墓地里面到处都是烧痕和干掉的血迹。这里到底发生了什么啊……？
all_card.name: 亚历山大地下陵墓
all_card.text: [action]：检定[willpower](6)。如果你检定成功，自动躲避深红斗篷的恶兽(无论其当前地点)。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_text: The way into the catacombs is blocked. You cannot enter the Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa. The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson cannot leave Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa. Forced - If there is 6 or more doom on the current agenda: Reveal Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa.
all_card.real_flavor: The interior of the necropolis is covered in scorch marks and lined with streaks of dried blood. What in the hell happened here...?
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] (6). If you succeed, automatically evade The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson (regardless of its current location). (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 此地本名碎片冢，汇集了埃及、罗马和希腊时代的众多坟墓、雕塑和古代遗物。现在已经半沉入水下，对公众关闭。谁知道里面还埋藏着什么样的秘密？
all_card.name: 亚历山大地下陵墓
all_card.text: [action]：调查。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为抽取3张卡牌。你可以将此次检定的难度降低2点。如果你这么做，如果检定成功你少抽取1张卡牌。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Kom el Shoqafa - meaning Mound of Shards - is the site of many tombs, statues and other ancient relics, a conflux of Egyptian, Roman, and Greek influences. It is now partially underwater and closed to the public. Who knows what other secrets lie buried within?
all_card.real_text: [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, draw 3 cards. You may reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. If you do, draw 1 fewer card if you succeed. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.name: 钥匙节点
all_card.text: 你可以攻击钥匙节点，如同它是攻击值为4的敌人。 [action]花费1个线索：对钥匙节点造成2点伤害。 强制 - 如果钥匙节点被击败：将其加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text: You may attack Key Locus as if it were an enemy with 4 fight. [action] Spend 1 clue: Deal 2 damage to Key Locus. Forced - If Key Locus is defeated: Add it to the victory display.

all_card.name: 钥匙节点
all_card.text: [action]花费1个线索：检定[willpower](2)。治愈钥匙节点的1点伤害；你检定成功且每高于难度1点，额外治愈1点伤害。 强制 - 如果钥匙节点被击败：将其从游戏中移除(不加入胜利区)。
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Test [willpower] (2). Heal 1 damage from Key Locus, plus 1 additional damage for each point you succeed by. Forced - If Key Locus is defeated: Remove it from the game (do not add it to the victory display).

all_card.flavor: “此等鼠辈不用我亲自动手。”
all_card.name: 暗红骑士
all_card.text: 强制 - 你在暗红骑士所在地点时，技能检定失败后，如果他处于重整状态：他变换身上附属的每个钥匙。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同志会. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "I do not involve myself in the matters of mice."
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while at The Claret Knight's location, if he is ready: He shifts each of his attached keys.

all_card.flavor: “只要还有需求，我必一直效命。”
all_card.name: 暗红骑士
all_card.text:
[free]横置暗红骑士：将你资源池的最多3资源移动到暗红骑士。
[free]横置暗红骑士：将暗红骑士的最多3资源移动到你的资源池；或移动到你控制的一个支援，作为充能、子弹、补给或秘密。
all_card.real_flavor: "I will serve, until such time as I am no longer needed."
all_card.real_text:
[fast] Exhaust The Claret Knight: Move up to 3 resources from your resource pool to The Claret Knight.
[fast] Exhaust The Claret Knight: Move up to 3 resources from The Claret Knight to your resource pool, or to an asset you control as charges, ammo, supplies, or secrets.

all_card.name: 深红斗篷的恶兽
all_card.text: 巡逻(有钥匙节点的最近地点)。反击。 强制 - 在深红斗篷的恶兽将要被击败时：改为治愈其全部伤害，将其横置并移动到亚历山大地下陵墓，不与调查员交战。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同志会. 精英
all_card.real_name: The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson
all_card.real_text: Patrol (nearest location with a Key Locus). Retaliate. Forced - When The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson would be defeated: Instead, heal all damage from it, exhaust it, and move it to Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa, unengaged.

all_card.flavor: 斗篷下的怪物喉咙里发出一阵低沉的吼声。它真的是人类吗？
all_card.name: 深红斗篷的恶兽
all_card.text: 强制 - 你在深红斗篷的恶兽所在地点时，技能检定失败后，如果它处于重整状态：它变换身上附属的每个钥匙。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同志会. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: The thing in the cowl growls, its voice low and gutteral. Is it even human?
all_card.real_name: The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while at The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson's location, if it is ready: It shifts each of its attached keys.

all_card.flavor: 一头鲜血和本能驱使的深红野兽。它一阵狂吠，盯着你，仿佛你就是一顿美餐。
all_card.name: 猩红野兽
all_card.text:
警戒。猎手。反击。
猩红野兽位于[[节点地]]地点时得到+2攻击值和-2躲避值。
all_card.real_flavor: A creature of crimson, fueled by blood and instinct. It snarls and eyes you as one might a delicious meal.
all_card.real_text:
Alert. Hunter. Retaliate.
Scarlet Beast gets +2 fight and -2 evade while it is at a [[Locus Site]] location.

all_card.name: 同志会煽动者
all_card.text: 冷漠。巡逻(有钥匙节点的最近地点)。 生成 - 有钥匙节点的最近地点。 同志会煽动者处于重整状态时，其地点的调查员不能攻击名称非同志会煽动者的任何游戏元素。
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest location with a Key Locus). Spawn - Nearest location with a Key Locus. While Coterie Provocateur is ready, investigators at its location cannot attack anything with a title other than Coterie Provocateur.

all_card.name: 节点脉冲
all_card.text: 显现 - 将节点脉冲附属到有钥匙节点的最近地点。该地点的每位调查员受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。 强制 - 如果附属的地点没有钥匙节点：弃掉节点脉冲。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Locus Pulse to the nearest location with a Key Locus. Each investigator at that location takes 1 damage and 1 horror. Forced - If there is no Key Locus at attached location: Discard Locus Pulse.

all_card.flavor: 档案#38 - N31/客体等级：黄色/客体为一透明容器，内有不明来源的振荡液体。钥匙散发出天蓝色的光芒，触感温暖。
all_card.name: 法罗斯之光
all_card.text: 变换 - 打出你的1张手牌，其费用-3。将本钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: File #38-N31 / Subject Class: Yellow / Subject is a crystalline container filled with rippling liquid of unknown origin. Key emits sapphire light and is warm to the touch.
all_card.real_text: Shift - Play a card from your hand, at -3 cost. Flip this key to its [[Unstable]] side.

all_card.flavor: ……液体不能从容器中漏出。如发生灾难性的泄漏事件，立即警告基金会人员。
all_card.name: 法罗斯之光
all_card.text: 变换 - 每位调查员必须随机弃掉自己2张非弱点手牌。然后，如果是调查员变换了本钥匙，将其翻至[[稳定]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: ...liquid cannot be allowed to leak from container. In event of catastrophic containment failure, alert Foundation operatives at once.
all_card.real_text: Shift - Each investigator must discard 2 random non-weakness cards from their hand. Then, if an investigator shifted this key, flip it to its [[Stable]] side.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为影穑上充能数。
[cultist]：-5。在影穑上放置1充能。
[tablet]：-3。如果你所在地点有[[灵怪]]敌人，你自动失败。
[elder_thing]：-6。你可以在影穑上放置1充能，以将本标记的修正值改为视作-3。
all_card.name: 苦痛之影
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为影穑上充能数的一半，向上取整(X不能大于6)。
[cultist]：-4。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少2点，在影穑上放置1充能。
[tablet]：-1。如果你所在地点有[[灵怪]]敌人，揭示额外一个混乱标记。
[elder_thing]：-4。你可以在影穑上放置1充能，以将本标记的修正值改为视作0。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of charges on The Shade Reaper.
[cultist]: -5. Place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper.
[tablet]: -3. If you are at a location with a [[Geist]] enemy, you automatically fail.
[elder_thing]: -6. You may place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper to treat this token's modifier as -3 instead.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of charges on The Shade Reaper, rounded up (X cannot be greater than 6).
[cultist]: -4. If you fail by 2 or more, place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper.
[tablet]: -1. If you are at a location with a [[Geist]] enemy, reveal an additional chaos token.
[elder_thing]: -4. You may place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper to treat this token's modifier as 0 instead.

all_card.back_flavor: 你在拥挤的街道中瞧见打着红伞的女子掠过卖食物的小摊，走进狭窄的后巷。你跟了进去，踏入小巷，里面一阵朦胧的银光。你被一阵奇怪的感觉包围，脑子里回荡起异界的低语。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员失去其所有线索。 调查员队长必须决定(选择一项)： - 弃掉场上印刷费用最高的[[盟友]]支援。检定[willpower](X)，其中X等于该支援的印刷费用。如果你检定失败，在影穑上放置充能，数量等于弃掉的支援的印刷费用。 - 在朱三娘上放置1个毁灭标记。 如果是场景1，推进场景(至场景1b)。
all_card.flavor: 魂灵在全城游荡。空荡荡的走道回响着脚步声、亡魂的敲击和沉默的低语。这座城市深埋的痛苦渴望有人知晓。寂静中每时每刻都有无言的惊骇在徘徊。
all_card.name: 苦难历史
all_card.real_back_flavor: Amidst the throng of a busy street, you see the woman with the red parasol flit past a food stall down a narrow back alley. Following her, you step into an alley filled with a hazy, silvery light. A strange feeling comes over you, and your head swims with alien whispers.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator loses all of their clues. The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - Discard the [[Ally]] asset in play with the highest printed cost. Test [willpower] (X), where X is that asset's printed cost. If you fail, place charges on The Shade Reaper equal to the discarded asset's printed cost. - Place 1 doom on Tzu San Niang. If it is act 1, advance the act (to act 1b).
all_card.real_flavor: The city buzzes with spiritual activity. Empty halls resound with footsteps, phantom knocks, voiceless whispers. Some deep pain in this city longs to be known. A wordless dread fills the silence and pervades every moment.

all_card.back_text:
如果朱三娘在场上任意地点： 朱三娘攻击她所在地点的每位调查员。将她返回阴影中，结算她的隐匿关键词，在每个有非弱点[[灵怪]]敌人的地点中，尽可能平均地分发其隐匿迷你卡牌。将本卡牌翻回密谋2a。
如果朱三娘在阴影中： 揭示场上每张隐匿迷你卡牌，将每张诱饵放在一边，位于场外。将朱三娘敌人与她的隐匿迷你卡牌交换位置。将她所在地点的每个非弱点[[灵怪]]敌人正面朝下放在她底下，然后在影穑上放置4充能。 如果场上没有非弱点[[灵怪]]敌人，将场景推进至场景2b。否则，将朱三娘返回阴影中，结算她的隐匿关键词，在每个有非弱点[[灵怪]]敌人的地点中，尽可能平均地分发其隐匿迷你卡牌。将本卡牌翻回密谋2a。
all_card.flavor: 你愈发觉得自己并非孤身一人，魂灵无言的尖叫充斥着你的脑海。吉隆坡的街道上一片油腻的浓雾，气氛幽森，使人窒息。
all_card.name: 亡灵未眠
all_card.text: 如果游戏中只有一位调查员，本密谋得到毁灭阈值+1。 强制 - 在你与朱三娘交战时：你所在地的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。如果不能，改为抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。 (提示：在本密谋推进时，如果未发现朱三娘所在地点，她会收割附近的魂灵！)
all_card.real_back_text:
If Tzu San Niang is in play at any location: Tzu San Niang attacks each investigator at her location. Return her to the shadows and resolve her concealed keyword, distributing each of those concealed mini-cards as evenly as possible among each location with a non-weakness [[Geist]] enemy. Flip this card back to agenda 2a.
If Tzu San Niang is in the shadows: Reveal all concealed mini-cards in play and set each decoy aside, out of play. Swap the Tzu San Niang enemy with her concealed mini-card. Place each non-weakness [[Geist]] enemy at her location facedown beneath her, then place 4 charges on The Shade Reaper. If there are no non-weakness [[Geist]] enemies in play, advance the act to act 2b. Otherwise, return Tzu San Niang to the shadows and resolve her concealed keyword, distributing each of those concealed mini-cards as evenly as possible among each location with a non-weakness [[Geist]] enemy. Flip this card back to agenda 2a.
all_card.real_flavor: The sense that you are not alone grows, and the spirits' wordless screams fill your mind. An oily fog rolls in to choke the streets of Kuala Lumpur in a ghostly aura.
all_card.real_text: If there is only one investigator in the game, this agenda gets +1 doom threshold. Forced - When you engage Tzu San Niang: Investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. If they cannot, draw the top card of the encounter deck instead. (Hint: When this agenda advances, Tzu San Niang will harvest a nearby spirit if her location is unknown!)

all_card.back_flavor:
朱三娘将你逼至狭窄的巷角，浓重的夜光给她的脸蒙上了厚厚的阴影。“别怕。”她的声音钻进了你的脑海，“我不想伤害你。恰恰相反，我觉得咱们应该能做朋友。”她狞笑着收起伞，用它直直指着你。
“唔，‘朋友’好像太客气了点。你会是我的新宠物。”伞尖跃动着噼啪的银光，一道能量的漩涡穿透空气奔你而来。痛苦席卷了你，你跪在地上，不堪折磨。朱三娘哈哈大笑，你失去了意识。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。 (→结局3)
all_card.flavor: 朱三娘向你走来，笑得很甜。她身后有个巨大的阴影自行移动，在墙上愤怒地扭动着。“马上就结束了。”她轻声说道。
all_card.name: 畏惧收割者
all_card.text: 每个[[灵怪]]敌人获得猎手和反击，且不能被翻面。 强制 - 在毁灭标记放到本密谋时：移除朱三娘底下的1个[[灵怪]]敌人，将其正面朝上生成在她的地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Tzu San Niang corners you in a narrow alley, her face heavily shadowed in the harsh evening light. "Don't be afraid," her voice worms its way into your mind. "I do not wish you harm. Quite the opposite, I think we should be friends." She grins and snaps her parasol shut, pointing it directly at you. "Well, 'friend' is a little too kind. You're my new pet." The tip dances with crackling, silvery light, and a torrent of energy tears through the air toward you. As waves of pain wash over you, you fall to your knees, wracked with agony. Tzu San Niang laughs as you lose consciousness.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. (→R3)
all_card.real_flavor: Tzu San Niang smiles sweetly as she bears down on you. Behind her, a massive shadow moves of its own accord, writhing in fulminant patterns on the wall. "This will be quick," she coos.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Geist]] enemy gain hunter and retaliate and cannot be flipped over. Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda: Remove 1 [[Geist]] enemy from beneath Tzu San Niang and spawn it faceup at her location.

all_card.back_flavor: 你花了几个小时搜寻，终于找到红伞夫人的踪迹。你跟她走进一条狭窄的侧巷，来到一家老店门前，店面看上去饱经风吹雨打。她进去了。你不确定她准备了什么等你，没有踏进可能的陷阱，而是在外面等她出现。但是过了一会儿，你焦躁起来，于是进店去了。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的美拉提的商店地点放置入场，并将其揭示。每位调查员与自己交战的所有敌人解除交战，并将每位调查员移动到美拉提的商店。 阅读冒险幕间故事：降头师(第47页)。
all_card.flavor: 打着红伞的身影融入了熙熙攘攘的城市之中，她意识到你的存在了吗？要是你能追踪到她的目的地，兴许就能了解她在吉隆坡的目的。
all_card.name: 红伞夫人
all_card.text: 目标 - 在密谋推进前找到朱三娘。 在你与朱三娘交战时，调查员必须共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。如果不能，将她放回阴影中，并结算她的隐匿关键词。
all_card.real_back_flavor: After what feels like hours of searching, you catch the trail of the Lady with the Red Parasol. You follow her down a narrow side-street to the worn façade of an old shop, which she steps inside. Uncertain of the risk she might pose, you wait for her to emerge rather than follow her into a potential trap. However, after some time passes, you grow impatient and step into the shop.
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Melati's Shop location into play and reveal it. Disengage each investigator from each enemy engaged with them and move each investigator to Melati's Shop. Read Scenario Interlude: The Bomoh (page 47).
all_card.real_flavor: The figure holding a red parasol melts into the bustle of the city, but is she aware of your presence? If you can track her to her destination, you may better understand her aims in Kuala Lumpur.
all_card.real_name: The Lady with the Red Parasol
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find Tzu San Niang before the agenda advances. When you engage Tzu San Niang, investigators must spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. If they cannot, return her to the shadows and resolve her concealed keyword.

all_card.back_text:
如果朱三娘底下没有正面朝下的敌人：
黄色的烟雾中涌现出一个小小的身影。朱三娘指着你斥责道：“你竟敢！你无权干扰我的事业。”她激动起来，手上的伞迸发出奇异的能量。
揭示所有的隐匿迷你卡牌并将其全部从游戏中移除。将朱三娘翻至(血债血偿)面，并生成在她的迷你卡牌所在地点。将密谋直接推进到密谋3a(不结算密谋2b)。
如果朱三娘底下有正面朝下的敌人：
黄色的烟雾中涌现出一个小小的身影。朱三娘狞笑着将伞转过头顶。“怎么了，你还渴吗？”她对你看不见的某物轻声说道，“他们准备好收割了。”她手上的伞迸发出奇异的能量。
调查员队长揭露所有的隐匿迷你卡牌。将朱三娘翻至(血债血偿)面，并治愈她的所有伤害。她与调查员队长交战。将密谋直接推进到密谋3a(不结算密谋2b)。
all_card.flavor: 美拉提说到了朱三娘给这座城市带来的巨大痛苦。要是能求求魂灵，让他们安息，你或许可以阻止朱三娘收割她种下的痛苦。
all_card.name: 鬼灵之光
all_card.text: [[灵怪]]敌人不能离开[[闹鬼]]地点。 目标 - 赶在朱三娘吞食魂灵之前，使他们安息！当一轮结束时，如果场上没有非弱点[[灵怪]]敌人，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If there are no enemies facedown beneath Tzu San Niang:
A petite figure emerges from the yellow haze. Tzu San Niang points at you accusingly. "How dare you! You have no right to interfere with my work," she seethes. The parasol in her hand glows with strange energy.
Reveal all concealed mini-cards and remove them from the game. Flip Tzu San Niang to her (Out for Blood) side and spawn her at the location where her mini-card was. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 3a (do not resolve agenda 2b).
If there is at least 1 enemy facedown beneath Tzu San Niang:
A petite figure emerges from the yellow haze. Tzu San Niang smirks as she twirls her parasol overhead. "What is it? You're still thirsty?" she coos, speaking to something you can't see. "They're ready to harvest." The parasol in her hand glows with strange energy.
The lead investigator exposes all concealed mini-cards. Flip Tzu San Niang to her (Out for Blood) side and heal all damage from her. She engages the lead investigator. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 3a (do not resolve agenda 2b).
all_card.real_flavor: Melati spoke of the great suffering Tzu San Niang has brought to this city. Perhaps by entreating the spirits and laying them to rest, you can stop her from reaping the pain she has sown.
all_card.real_text: [[Geist]] enemies cannot leave [[Haunted]] locations. Objective - Quell the restless spirits before they are consumed by Tzu San Niang! At the end of the round, if there are no non-weakness [[Geist]] enemies in play, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
朱三娘正准备再给你一招骇人的光线，你直接冲上前去，不顾疼痛，从她手里拧下了伞。她挣扎退后，怒如困兽。无数受钥匙磨难的亡魂一起发出尖叫。三娘失去了伞，也发出刺耳的哀嚎。你挥舞着她的武器退后。
“毫无意义的胜利。”她笑得很是狂妄，“你没有胆子用我的阴影来对付我。”她转身就走了。
all_card.back_text: 调查员必须决定(选择一项)： - 用伞对付她。(→结局1) - 让她走。(→结局2)
all_card.flavor: 红伞夫人将注意力转向了你。她穿过街道向你走来，唱起的歌萦绕在你心头。要是换了其他情况，你兴许还会觉得这旋律悠扬动听。
all_card.name: 收割苦难
all_card.text: [reaction]在朱三娘的强制效果对你造成伤害和/或恐惧时，你所在地点的调查员可以共同花费任意数量的线索：取消同等数量的伤害/恐惧。 目标 - 如果朱三娘被击败，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
As Tzu San Niang fires another eldritch beam of crackling light at you, you charge forward, ignoring the pain, and wrest the parasol from her grip. She fights back with all the fury of a cornered animal. Countless souls, all bound in torment to the Key, cry out at once. The woman lets out an ear-piercing scream as the red parasol is wrenched away from her. You step back, brandishing her own weapon.
"A hollow victory," she says haughtily. "I know you don't have the nerve to use my shade against me." She turns to walk away.
all_card.real_back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - Use the parasol against her. (→R1) - Let her go. (→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: The Lady with the Red Parasol has shifted her attention to you. She sings a haunting song as she stalks through the streets. Under any other circumstance, you might find the melody beautiful.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you are dealt damage and/or horror from Tzu San Niang's forced effect, investigators at your location may spend any number of clues: Cancel that much damage/horror. Objective - If Tzu San Niang is defeated, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 世界各地不分遐迩的旅客齐聚这座繁忙的车站。最新完工的月台将吉隆坡、新加坡和暹罗都联系在了一起。
all_card.name: 吉隆坡火车站
all_card.text: [free]在你回合期间，支付2资源：移动(到一个连接地点)。(每回合仅限一次。) [action]弃掉场上一个你控制的支援：获得等同于弃掉支援印刷费用一半(向下取整)数量的资源，并记住你“换到了一只小猫”。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: This busy railway stop brings in travelers from all over the world, near and far. The recently completed platform now connects Kuala Lumpur to Singapore and Siam.
all_card.real_text: [fast] During your turn, pay 2 resources: Move (to a connecting location). (Limit once per turn.) [action] Discard an asset you control from play: Gain resources equal to half the discarded asset's printed cost, rounded down, and remember that you "traded for a kitten." (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 火车站西翼弥漫着浓雾。朦胧中闪亮的身影来回穿梭。
all_card.name: 吉隆坡火车站
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。“我们在这儿做不了什么了。”你匆忙订了离开城市的车票。 [action]本地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：治愈2点恐惧。记住你“找到了一件便宜的纪念品”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The western wing of the station is veiled in a heavy fog. Glimmering shapes flit to and fro in the haze.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. "There's nothing more we can do here." You hastily book passage out of the city. [action] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Heal 2 horror. Remember that you "found a cheap memento."

all_card.back_flavor: 雪兰莪俱乐部吸引了全城所有的豪富，但做出口贸易的英帝国主义者尤其喜欢这里。
all_card.name: 雪兰莪俱乐部
all_card.text: 补给阶段期间，位于雪兰莪俱乐部的每位调查员不获得资源。 [action]花费2资源：谈判。你享用了珍馐佳酿。治愈你所在地点的一位调查员或一个[[盟友]]支援1点伤害和1点恐惧。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Selangor Club attracts all the city's wealthiest clientele, but especially caters to the British imperialists that run much of the export business.
all_card.real_text: Each investigator at Selangor Club does not collect resources during the upkeep phase. [action] Spend 2 resources: Parley. You enjoy a pleasant meal and drinks. Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 这片宽大的草坪堪称广场，养护完好，用于举办各种体育活动，从板球到橄榄球，不一而足。广场两侧和俱乐部屋子里都有观众观看比赛。
all_card.flavor: 侨民本就守口如瓶，你为他们的队伍取胜，他们对你的信任又多了几分。
all_card.name: 雪兰莪俱乐部草坪
all_card.text: [action]：谈判。检定[combat](4)以加入游戏。如果你检定失败，记住你“让领事蒙羞”。如果你检定成功，获得3资源。(每轮最多一次成功)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The large padang, or square, is a well-manicured lawn used for all sorts of sporting events, from cricket to rugby. Spectators watch the games from either side of the square or from inside the clubhouse.
all_card.real_flavor: The tight-lipped expatriates become much more trusting once you help their team achieve victory.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Parley. Test [combat] (4) to join the games. If you fail, remember that you "embarrassed the consulate." If you succeed, gain 3 resources. (Max one success per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 降头师的商店看上去就像家药铺，层层架子上堆满了一捆捆脱水的草药和花朵，另有一些磨碎了放在小罐里，泡在药酒里。还有一些降头师的材料放在柜台后面的书架上：石灰、松香，还有带木鞘的匕首。
all_card.flavor: “我宁静心神，就听他们听得更清。”
all_card.name: 美拉提的商店
all_card.text: [action]在美拉提的商店的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：记住你“眺望彼端”。查看场上任意一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面或[[灵怪]]敌人的另一面。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The bomoh's shop is primarily an apothecary, with shelf after shelf filled with dried bundles of herbs and flowers, some ground up in little jars or in alcohol tinctures. Other supplies for the bomoh's practice rest on a bookshelf behind the counter: lime, resin, and a dagger in a wooden sheath.
all_card.real_flavor: "When I quiet my mind, I can hear them clearly."
all_card.real_text: [action] Investigators at Melati's Shop spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that you "peered beyond." Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card or the other side of a [[Geist]] enemy in play.

all_card.back_flavor: 这座剧场会上演精巧的皮影偶戏，吸引了不少游客。特征鲜明的傀偶在幕布上投下虚影。这种效果给人留下一种印象，仿佛幕布就是现实和阴影彼端之间的帷幕。
all_card.name: 哇扬皮影偶戏剧场
all_card.text:
X为影穑上充能数的一半，向上取整(最大为8)。
[action]在哇扬皮影偶戏剧场的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：治愈2点伤害。记住你“分担了深沉的痛苦”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The elaborate shadow puppet shows that take place on stage make this theater a popular attraction. The distinctive puppets are made to cast stylized silhouettes on a backlit screen. The effect gives the impression that the screen is a veil between reality and some shadowy other world.
all_card.real_text:
X is equal to half the charges on The Shade Reaper, rounded up (to a max of 8).
[action] Investigators at Wayang Kulit Theater spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Heal 2 damage. Remember that you "shared a deep pain."

all_card.back_flavor: 地上的大坑就像张开的巨口：有的盛满了雨水，有的在暗光中像眨眼一样闪烁着。支撑着坑洞的脚手架摇摇晃晃，看来最多也不过是草草搭就的临时货。
all_card.name: 锡矿
all_card.text: [action]：检定[agility](6)。位于锡矿的调查员可以共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索，以自动成功。如果你检定成功，抽取2张卡牌，并记住你“找到了掩埋的遗骨”。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。) 强制 - 你在锡矿时技能检定失败后：受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Large pits yawn like open mouths in the earth: some are filled with rainwater, some flicker like shuttering eyes in the low light. The supports that hold up the rickety scaffolding that spans the pits are temporary, at best.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [agility] (6). Investigators at Tin Mine may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to automatically succeed. If you succeed, draw 2 cards and remember that you "found hidden bones." (Group limit once per game.) Forced - After you fail a skill test while at Tin Mine: Take 1 damage.

all_card.name: 诡怪的阴影
all_card.text: 诡怪的阴影得到+1[per_investigator]生命值。 [action]从你手中随机弃掉1-3张卡牌：谈判。检定[willpower](6)。你作为此行动的费用每弃掉一张卡牌，本次检定的难度降低1点。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面并结算另一面的文本。 强制 - 在诡怪的阴影将要被击败时：将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 灵怪. 精英
all_card.real_text: Uncanny Shadow gets +1 [per_investigator] health. [action] Discard 1-3 cards from your hand at random: Parley. Test [willpower] (6). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each card you discarded as part of this action's cost. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When Uncanny Shadow would be defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 陰影在紙質布幕上舞動，戲院中充滿了笑聲。梅拉蒂輕笑著看向你說："別擔心，這個靈魂雖然很活躍，但祂沒有惡意。"她看著紙幕上的影子，用馬來語低聲誦唸一段禱文。
all_card.name: 顽皮的阴影
all_card.text:
纸幕上皮影舞动，剧场里回荡着叽叽喳喳的笑声。美拉提咯咯笑着看向你。“不用担心。”她说，“这个魂灵是很闹，但它并无恶意。”她抬头望向纸幕，用马来语低吟着。
如果有调查员“让领事蒙羞”，阅读下列文本(否则，将本卡牌翻回敌人面，治愈其全部伤害，横置并与所有调查员解除交战)：
笑声变成了呜咽，随即又变回笑声。“是个男孩的魂灵。”美拉提告诉你。一个圆球从黑暗中滚到你脚下，你抬头看看那颤抖的影子。“他曾经玩耍的草地现在却成了朱夫人的舞台。你的小动作逗乐了他。我想他现在可以安息了。”
将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: The theater fills with the sound of chittering laughter as wavering shapes dance against a papery backdrop. Melati chuckles as she looks at you. "No need to worry," she says. "This spirit is restless, but it does not bear us ill will." Looking up at the papery shadows, she intones a low chant in Malay.
all_card.real_text:
If an investigator has "embarrassed the consulate," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):
The sound of laughter turns to weeping, then turns back to laughter. "It is the spirit of a boy," Melati tells you. A round ball rolls out from the darkness to your feet as you look up at the trembling forms. "The padang where he once played is now the ground of one of Ms. Tzu's endeavors. Your small gesture amused him. I think he will be at peace now."
Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.name: 诡怪的阴影
all_card.text: 诡怪的阴影得到+1[per_investigator]生命值。 [action]从你手中随机弃掉1-3张卡牌：谈判。检定[willpower](6)。你作为此行动的费用每弃掉一张卡牌，本次检定的难度降低1点。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面并结算另一面的文本。 强制 - 在诡怪的阴影将要被击败时：将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 灵怪. 精英
all_card.real_text: Uncanny Shadow gets +1 [per_investigator] health. [action] Discard 1-3 cards from your hand at random: Parley. Test [willpower] (6). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each card you discarded as part of this action's cost. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When Uncanny Shadow would be defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 戲院中充滿了笑聲，你們靠近時，紙幕上一道纖細的身影對你們張牙舞爪。梅拉蒂走向前，堅定地說："我知道你們無法安息，但不需要害怕我們。"她用馬來語低聲誦唸一段禱文。
all_card.name: 羞怯的阴影
all_card.text:
剧场里响起了刺耳的笑声，纸幕上细长的身影变得骇人。美拉提大步上前，声音中气十足：“我知道你不得安宁，但你无需害怕我们。”她用马来语低吟着。
如果有调查员“眺望彼端”，阅读下列文本(否则，将本卡牌翻回敌人面，治愈其全部伤害，横置并与所有调查员解除交战)：
“是个女孩的魂灵。她在这个剧场里看过许多故事。”美拉提告诉你。纸幕上的影子先是露出一个饥饿的笑容，满口尖牙，随即又皱起眉头，十分可怕。“她讨厌离开这里，因为她不知道自己的故事是否还能继续。”你借由美拉提翻译，向这个魂灵保证自己见过帷幕彼端，她可以离开此界。旧影消散，你意识到自己在彼端看见了——与没看见什么，不禁一阵恶寒。给她这样的保证，真的没错吗？
将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: The theater fills with cacophonous laughter as a spindly shape on the paper screen grows menacing. Melati strides forward, her voice firm. "I know that you are restless," she says. "But you have nothing to fear from us." She intones a low chant in Malay.
all_card.real_text:
If an investigator has "peered beyond," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):
"It is the spirit of a girl. She watched many stories unfold in this very theater," says Melati. The shadow on the screen forms a hungry smile filled with sharp teeth that turns to a fearful frown. "She is loathe to let go of this place, for she does not know if her story will continue." As Melati translates, you assure the spirit that you have looked beyond the veil and she can leave this plane of existence. As the hoary shadows dissipate, you feel a coldness as you reflect on what you saw - and didn't see - in the beyond. Was it wrong to reassure her?
Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.name: 被掩埋的矿工
all_card.text: 被掩埋的矿工得到+1[per_investigator]生命。 [action]受到1-3点恐惧：谈判。检定[combat](6)。你作为此行动的费用每受到1点恐惧，本次检定的难度降低1点。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面并结算另一面的文本。 强制 - 在被掩埋的矿工将要被击败时：将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 灵怪. 精英
all_card.real_text: Buried Miner gets +1 [per_investigator] health. [action] Take 1-3 horror: Parley. Test [combat] (6). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each horror you took as part of this action's cost. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When Buried Miner would be defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 溫暖的雨滴落在泥濘的道路上。昏暗中迴盪著呻吟聲，梅拉蒂將一隻手放在額頭上，另一隻放在被開鑿的岩石上。
all_card.name: 发掘遗骨
all_card.text:
矿区的深坑里都盛满了雨水，看上去一片黑亮。你走过这片危险的区域，水中突然伸出幽魂之手抓住了你。美拉提握住一只手，举到耳边，仿佛在聆听对方的低语。
如果有调查员“找到了掩埋的遗骨”，阅读下列文本(否则，将本卡牌翻回敌人面，治愈其全部伤害，横置并与所有调查员解除交战)：
“这些魂灵是死去的矿工。”美拉提指着油污的黑水说道，“由于朱三娘的无尽贪欲，这片矿区的工头将他们……活活剥削至死。他们的遗骨就在这些深坑中，未得安葬。” 你在她的帮助下开始挖掘这些矿工的遗骨。这项工作阴森骇人。但你辛劳之际，一股感激之情荡涤全身。你最后完成的时候，周边涌起一阵最终解脱的情绪。
将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: Warm, heavy rain begins to fall as you traverse the treacherous walkways. The moans of the departed echo in the dim. Melati holds one hand to her forehead and puts the other to the chiseled rock.
all_card.real_text:
If an investigator has "found a cheap memento," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):
"These are the spirits of fallen miners," says Melati, holding onto the flimsy tin figurine you found. "This belonged to one of them. It is sculpted from tin from this very mine. Tzu San Niang's heartless business separated the workers from their families. And now, they will never be reunited, except in death." She holds the tin figurine over the surface of the water and lets go of it. You think you can see the outline of wispy, spectral hands grasping at it as it sinks to the bottom of the pit.
Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.name: 被掩埋的矿工
all_card.text: 被掩埋的矿工得到+1[per_investigator]生命。 [action]受到1-3点恐惧：谈判。检定[combat](6)。你作为此行动的费用每受到1点恐惧，本次检定的难度降低1点。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面并结算另一面的文本。 强制 - 在被掩埋的矿工将要被击败时：将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 灵怪. 精英
all_card.real_text: Buried Miner gets +1 [per_investigator] health. [action] Take 1-3 horror: Parley. Test [combat] (6). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each horror you took as part of this action's cost. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When Buried Miner would be defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 礦坑裡到處都是裝滿黑色雨水的深坑。你們走在泥濘的路上，鬼影般的手從水中伸出，試著想抓住你。梅拉蒂握住其中一隻手，歪著頭像是在聽著什麼。
all_card.name: 遗失的纪念品
all_card.text:
你在倾盆的暖雨中沿着危险的矿区前行。一片昏暗中回响着死者的哀嚎。美拉提一手扶住前额，一手摸着参差的岩石。
如果有调查员“找到了一件便宜的纪念品”，阅读下列文本(否则，将本卡牌翻回敌人面，治愈其全部伤害，横置并与所有调查员解除交战)：
“这些魂灵是死去的矿工。”美拉提拿出你找到的薄皮锡像说道。“这是他们的，锡皮就产自这里。朱三娘的黑心生意让这些工人骨肉分离。他们只有死后才能重聚。” 她将锡像放在水上，松了手。你看到水中伸出一只纤弱的手，抓住锡像，沉了下去。
将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: The mines are pocked with deep pits brimming with dark, black rainwater. As you traverse the treacherous paths, spectral hands dart out of the water, grasping at you. Melati holds up one hand and turns her ear, as if listening for a whisper.
all_card.real_text:
If an investigator has "found hidden bones," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):
"These are the spirits of fallen miners," says Melati, gesturing to the oily dark water. "Compelled by Tzu San Niang's relentless greed, the foreman of the mine has worked them... well, literally to the bone. Their bodies lie, unburied, in these deep pits." With her help, you begin exhuming the bones of the fallen miners. It is gruesome, awful work, but as you do it, you can feel a sense of gratitude wash over you. Only when you are finished can you feel a final wave of relief emanate from your surroundings.
Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.name: 被杀害的工头
all_card.text: 被杀害的工头得到+1[per_investigator]生命。 [action]弃掉一个你控制的支援：谈判。检定[intellect](6)。降低本次检定的难度，降低的数量为你作为此行动费用弃掉的支援的印刷费用。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面并结算另一面的文本。 强制 - 在被杀害的工头将要被击败时：将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。

Reduce the difficulty of this test by the printed cost of the asset discarded as part of this action's cost. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When Slain Foreman would be defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 一聲痛苦的哀嚎迴盪在車站中，一道形影痛苦的按住身側，流著無形的鮮血走向你們。梅拉蒂伸出手阻止你。"這個靈魂生前遭受過巨大的傷害，只有同感祂的痛苦才能跟祂溝通。"
all_card.name: 家庭分离之痛
all_card.text:
美拉提对魂灵好言相劝。你发现它转过头，就像听到了什么你听不见的东西。降头师把你拉到一边，露出浅浅的微笑。“它是要寻找什么。”她解释道，“寻找能让它想起家庭的东西。”
如果有调查员“换到了一只小猫”，阅读下列文本(否则，将本卡牌翻回敌人面，治愈其全部伤害，横置并与所有调查员解除交战)：
美拉提示意你将小猫交给魂灵。“这位有两个女儿，养了很多只猫。”降头师说道，“它想知道自己所爱之人过得好不好。”魂灵伸出闪亮的幽魂之手，摸了摸小猫的皮毛。 她快速地讲了一串马来语后，看向了你。“把这个小东西带给死者的家人，能安慰他们几分。我已经告诉魂灵，会把它当作礼物带上。”你再回头看去，魂灵已经消失了。
将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: A pained howl echoes through the station as the shade bears down on you, bleeding ethereal blood and clutching its side. Melati holds up one hand to stop you. "This spirit is in great distress for a loss," she says. "It will only respond to one who has shared in its anguish."
all_card.real_text:
If an investigator has "shared a deep pain," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):
Melati prepares a ritual of banishment as you stare into the spirit's eyes. While the bomoh chants, you feel a ripple of pain resonate in your own mind, and for a moment you glimpse a memory from the rail worker's life: them, holding a sledgehammer, as a shadowy figure stood above them, smiling cruelly. A sudden blur of motion, followed by an awful screech. As the memory fades, so too does the spirit.
Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 當梅拉蒂與鬼魂溝通時，祂轉過頭，似乎聽到什麼你聽不見的聲音。薩滿將你拉到一邊，臉上帶著溫柔的笑容解釋道："祂在找某個東西，某個能讓祂想起家的東西。"
all_card.name: 怜悯同情之痛
all_card.text:
整个车站都回荡着痛苦的哀嚎，阴影向你逼近，它扶住自己一侧，滴下了幽魂之血。美拉提伸出手拦住了你。“这个魂灵丧生之际陷入了极大的痛苦。”她说道，“只有与其分担，方能与之回应。”
如果有调查员“分担了深沉的痛苦”，阅读下列文本(否则，将本卡牌翻回敌人面，治愈其全部伤害，横置并与所有调查员解除交战)：
你直视魂灵的双眼，美拉提则在准备放逐仪式。降头师吟唱起来，你感到脑海中回荡着痛苦的涟漪。你瞥见了铁路工人一生的记忆：自己握着长柄大锤，而有个阴影中的人站在自己上方残忍地狞笑。突然一切变得模糊，随之是痛苦的尖叫。记忆消散，魂灵也不见了。
将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: As Melati entreats the spirit, it turns its head, as if it hears something you can't. The bomoh pulls you aside, a gentle smile upon her face. "It's searching for something," she explains. "Something that reminds it of home."
all_card.real_text:
If an investigator has "traded for a kitten," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):
Melati gestures for you to hold the kitten out to the spirit. "This one had two daughters and many cats," the bomoh says. "They simply want to know their loved ones are cared for." The spirit reaches out and strokes the kitten's fur with a glimmering, spectral hand. After speaking rapidly in Malay, Melati looks to you. "Bringing this animal to the family of the departed would comfort them. I have told the spirit I will bring it as a gift soon." When you look, the spirit has vanished.
Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: “彼之痛苦，吾之食粮。”

all_card.back_flavor: 异星的天空中刮过洪荒星尘的漩涡。星光辐射条条成线，石砾风暴违背了重力的法则。这一切都在变换、搅动、重组。这里每寸地方都是刻意的疯狂，预谋要操纵你的思想，让你失去自己的感知。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的天启噩兆和原生质重组者敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
调查员必须共同选择两项：
- 每位调查员受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
- 每位调查员选择自己手中或游戏区域内控制的一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
- 混洗场上所有隐匿迷你卡牌，然后将其正面朝下随机放到先前位置。
all_card.flavor: 在我们的现实之外，只有遗忘失落之物所知的维度，是荒谬的残骸之城——也就是域外来客的本界。
all_card.name: 异界恐惧
all_card.text: 作为进入未揭示地点的额外费用，你所在地的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。 [reaction]你揭露地点后：(从相邻地点)移动到该地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Whirlwinds of cosmic dust swirl throughout the alien sky, threads of radiant starlight and tempests of gravity-defying rubble shifting, churning, rearranging. Every inch of this place is a deliberate act of insanity, a premeditated manipulation of your mind, designed to make you lose your sense of self.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the set-aside Apocalyptic Presage and Protoplasmic Reassembler enemies into the encounter deck.
The investigators must choose two options, as a group:
- Each investigator takes 1 damage and 1 horror.
- Each investigator chooses a non-weakness card they control in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
- Shuffle all concealed mini-cards facedown, then place them at random in the positions they were in.
all_card.real_flavor: Beyond our reality, in the dimension known only to the forgotten and the forsaken, lies the preposterous City of Remnants - the home world of the Outsiders themselves.
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost to enter an unrevealed location, investigators at your location must spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group. [reaction] After you expose a location: Move to that location (from an adjacent location).

all_card.back_flavor: 无维无尽的宇宙之重，压得你跪下。你想到泰勒的“多层蛋糕”，一层上面还有一层，世界上面还有世界，而你的却是最薄一层。你穿行于人类绝不该跨越的边界。要是你再待一会儿，甚至都不会记得自己从何而来。
all_card.back_text:
调查员必须共同选择两项：
- 每位调查员受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
- 每位调查员选择自己手中或游戏区域内控制的一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
- 混洗场上所有隐匿迷你卡牌，然后将其正面朝下随机放到先前位置。
all_card.flavor: 你在这里待得越久，就越觉得原本的世界正从记忆中溜走。面庞、名字、地方，从你记忆的空隙中落走了。你惊恐地意识到异界之力是一面双刃剑。哪怕你仍有自己的意志，待在这里也会让你迷失自己。
all_card.name: 异界的羔羊
all_card.text: 作为进入未揭示地点的额外费用，你所在地的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。 [reaction]你揭露地点后：(从相邻地点)移动到该地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The weight of an infinite, dimensionless universe forces you to your knees. You imagine Taylor's "layer cake," layer upon layer upon layer, worlds upon worlds upon wolrds, and yours is the thinnest of all. You are hurtling through barriers humanity was never meant to cross, and if you remain here any longer, you won't even remember where you came from.
all_card.real_back_text:
The investigators must choose two options, as a group:
- Each investigator takes 1 damage and 1 horror.
- Each investigator chooses a non-weakness card they control in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
- Shuffle all concealed mini-cards facedown, then place them at random in the positions they were in.
all_card.real_flavor: The longer you stay in this realm, the more your grip on the world you came from begins to slip. Faces, names, and places all fall through the gaps in your memory. You realize with horror that the power of the Outside goes both ways. Simply being in this realm, even of your own volition, is enough to lose yourself.
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost to enter an unrevealed location, investigators at your location must spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group. [reaction] After you expose a location: Move to that location (from an adjacent location).

all_card.back_text:
每位没有撤退的调查员发疯，从此音讯全无。有关这些调查员的所有记忆都从现实中清除。
如果有调查员撤退，那些调查员可以立即推进到场景3b。
all_card.name: 异界的屠杀
all_card.text: 作为进入未揭示地点的额外费用，你所在地点的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。 [reaction]你揭露地点后：(从相邻地点)移动到该地点。 [free]受到1点直接伤害或1点直接恐惧：查看任意一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: You are nothing; timeless, forgotten, a figment, a shard of a fractured memory; but here, so much more; a promise, a signatory, a blood-inked curse in a covenant of teardrops ever swimming ever falling ever drowning in thoughts in memory in time; and it, it is the final err, it is the final terror that shall reign; and your thoughts, your memories, they are its and it is you; coin-sides, both and all and nothing at once, all at once, all at once.
all_card.real_back_text:
Each investigator who has not resigned is driven insane, and is never seen or heard from again. All memory of their existence is purged from reality.
If any investigators resigned, those investigators may immediately advance to act 3b.
all_card.real_flavor: come you did what do to here ?again
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost to enter an unrevealed location, investigators at your location must spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group. [reaction] After you expose a location: Move to that location (from an adjacent location). [fast] Take 1 direct damage or 1 direct horror: Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card (without exposing it). (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 在残骸之城跃动的黑暗中枢，是纠结在一起的巨大构造物，全由黑色的缟玛瑙和犬牙参差、扭曲歪斜的玻璃组成。恐怖的巢穴正中悬着一张由异界的锁链、丝线和绳索纠缠在一起的巨网。漂浮在空间正中的是扭曲空间形成的巨大球体，伸出的两根触手散发着原生质的光芒。触手伸向一个衣衫褴褛、失去意识的人形生物，抽走了什么。你靠近一步，惊恐地意识到自己认识祭坛上这个被重重包裹的身影——或者说，你至少认出了红色的手套。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的拟态克星敌人以横置状态生成在域外来客之巢。 每位调查员选择自己弃牌堆2张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。 找出放在一边的戴红手套的男子剧情支援，将其与放在一边的空洞放在一起，也作为一个空洞。他视为归所有调查员所有。如果他拥有任何钥匙，不要将这些钥匙附属到他。
all_card.flavor: 这片诡异的域外之地潜藏着至关重要的秘密。红色同志会一位资深成员与你独自联络，想让你帮她找到这个地方——所有记忆中遭窃的事物都藏在那个世界。如果还有哪里能找到真相，就是那儿了。
all_card.name: 穿越域外之地
all_card.text: 目标 - 找到域外来客领域的中心。 在域外来客之巢被揭示时，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As the dark, beating heart of the City of Remnants is a mess of a structure, all black onyx stone and jagged, twisting glass. Hanging throughout the horrid lair is a jumbled nest of chains, fencewire, and alien cables. One of the entities floats in the center of the chamber: a ball of twisted, distorted space with two tendrils of shimmering plasmic light. The tendrils reach down to a humanoid figure in tattered cloth, touching its unconscious mind and pumping something out of it. You step closer and realize with horror that you recognize the covered figure upon the altar - or, at least, you recognize its stark red gloves.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Mimetic Nemesis enemy at Outsiders' Lair, exhausted. Each investigator chooses 2 non-weakness cards in their discard pile and sets them aside, out of play, as hollows. Find the set-aside The Red-Gloved Man story asset and place him with the other set-aside hollows, as a hollow. He is considered to be owned by all of the investigators. If he is the bearer of any keys, do not attach those keys to him.
all_card.real_flavor: Somewhere in this strange otherworld lies a secret so vital, an ages-old member of the Red Coterie was willing to reach out to you personally to have you help her find this place - the world where all things stolen from memory end up. If the truth is anywhere, it must be here.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find the heart of the Outsiders' domain. When the Outsiders' Lair is revealed, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
你终于将戴红手套的男子从怪物发光的触手中扯下，将他拖离祭坛。你将他拖离这怪物的老巢，他一路上都身软无力，失去意识，只会用一种异界的语言吐出几个没有意义的词。他终于睁眼看了域外的诡异天空，痛苦地颤抖着醒来，气喘吁吁，惨不忍睹，捂住自己头上被怪物抓住的位置。
你让他恢复了一会儿，才问起他是怎么来的，又到底发生了什么。他没花多久就恢复了自己原本镇定的样子，也是令人佩服。他理理西装的袖口，压低帽沿，遮住自己前额滴下的汗水。“这儿不行。”他说。恰巧就在这时候，玻璃和玛瑙的构造体在废墟中颤抖跃出，触手围拢扭曲在一起，形成一团巨大诡异的发光物质。“我想你应该知道怎么出去吧？”男人问道。
all_card.flavor: 你不知道这里究竟发生了什么，但肯定不是好事。你必须阻止此处发生的一切——只有这样你才能从戴红手套的男子那里得到真相。
all_card.name: 红色废墟
all_card.text: 戴红手套的男子不能被弃掉或抽取。 [action]如果拟态克星在你的地点，花费1个线索：对它造成2点伤害。本行动不会触发拟态克星的趁乱攻击。 目标 - 在戴红手套的男子入场时，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You finally manage to pry the body of the Red-Gloved Man away from the creature's flashing tendrils and drag him off of the altar. He drifts in and out of consciousness as you carry him out of the entity's lair, speaking only nonsense words in an unearthly language. The moment his eyelids open before the alien skies of the Outside, he shudders awake in agony, letting out gasping, pained breaths and clutching the very spot on his forehead where the creature had latched onto him.
You give him a moment to recover before asking him how he got here and what it was doing to him. To his credit, the man does not take long to return to his usual stoic demeanor, adjusting the cuffs of his suit and lowering the brim of his hat to obscure the sweat dripping down his forehead. "Not here," he says. As if on cue, the structure of glass and onyx shudders into ruin and the entity emerges, its tendrils unfolding into a massive, eldritch shape of luminous distortion. "I don't suppose you know a way out of here?" the man asks.
all_card.real_flavor: You don't truly know what's going on, but you know it can't be good. You have to stop whatever process is happening here - only then can you learn the truth from the man in the red gloves.
all_card.real_text: The Red-Gloved Man cannot be discarded or drawn. [action] If Mimetic Nemesis is at your location, spend 1 clue: Deal 2 damage to it. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity from Mimetic Nemesis. Objective - When The Red-Gloved man enters play, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你站在刚到这片领域时抵达的平面边缘，还是不知道该怎么返回自己的世界。掉进下方坑洞的船只去了哪里，毫无迹象。也许它已经回头。又或者还在继续下落。你并不确定，但也没什么选择。你屏息不看无底的深渊，纵身信仰之跃……
all_card.back_text: 检查胜利区有什么[[同谋]]支援。 - 如果戴红手套的男子和艾里奇·佐尼·奥佩勒曲亚都在胜利区，进入(→结局1)(第57页)。 - 如果只有戴红手套的男子在胜利区，进入(→结局2)(第58页)。 - 如果只有艾里奇·佐尼·奥佩勒曲亚在胜利区，进入(→结局3)(第58页)。 - 如果戴红手套的男子和艾里奇·佐尼·奥佩勒曲亚都不在胜利区，进入(→结局4)(第58页)。
all_card.flavor: 戴红手套的男子目前在你一边，最终的答案已经近在咫尺。但你首先要找到回家的路……不然，这里可能就会成为你的新家。
all_card.name: 逃出异界
all_card.text: 每个[[域外]]敌人失去冷漠。 强制 - 如果戴红手套的男子被击败：将他从游戏中移除。 目标 - 逃出这个鬼地方！如果所有幸存的调查员都撤退，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You stand at the edge of the platform upon which you arrived in this realm, wondering how to return to your own. There is no sign whatsoever of the ship that fell into the pit below. Perhaps it made its way back. Or perhaps it is still falling. You have no way to know for sure, but very few alternatives. Holding your breath, you look away from the bottomless pit, and take a leap of faith...
all_card.real_back_text: Check which [[Conspirator]] assets are in the victory display. - If both The Red-Gloved Man and Aliki Zoni Uperetria are in the victory display, proceed to (→R1) (page 57). - If The Red-Gloved Man is in the victory display, proceed to (→R2) (page 58). - If Aliki Zoni Uperetria is in the victory display, proceed to (→R3) (page 58). - If neither The Red-Gloved Man nor Aliki Zoni Uperetria are in the victory display, proceed to (→R4) (page 58).
all_card.real_flavor: The Red-Gloved Man is on your side and answers are finally within reach. But first you must find a way back home... because if you can't, this might become your new home.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Outsider]] enemy loses aloof. Forced - If The Red-Gloved Man is defeated: Remove him from the game. Objective - Time to get the hell out of here! If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你眼前的异界景象前所未见——扭曲纠缠的构造、外星植物和奇异的仿体，这一切都是在古今熟见的建筑和器物基础上模仿而来的。载你来此的船只在这个骇人平面的边缘摇晃片刻，就在震耳欲聋的混乱中摔下了无尽的虚空。
all_card.name: 域外来客之廷
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。检定[willpower]或[agility](4)。如果你检定成功，你撤退，将你控制的每个[[同谋]]支援加入胜利区。如果你检定失败，你依然困在此处，此检定得到-1难度值，直到你回合结束。如果每位存活的调查员均撤退，立即推进到场景3b。(FAQ v2.1)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Before you lies an otherworldly landscape unlike anything you have ever seen - the twisting, jumbled structures, the alien flora and strange effigies, all of it against a backdrop of familiar architecture and gadgetry both modern and ancient. The ship that led you here teeters on the brink of this eldritch platform for a moment, and then, with a deafening ruckus, plunges into the endless oblivion below.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. Test [willpower] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, you resign, adding each [[Conspirator]] asset you control to the victory display. If you fail, you remain trapped here, and this test gets -1 difficulty until the end of your turn. If each surviving investigator has resigned, immediately advance to act 3b.

all_card.back_text:
隐匿1。
强制 - 在你揭露此地点时：
- 如果它在阴影左边，受到1点伤害。
- 如果它在阴影中间，选择你手中一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
- 如果它在阴影右边，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.name: 域外来客之巢
all_card.text:
本地点的每个[[域外]]敌人失去冷漠并得到+1攻击值和+1躲避值。
[free]如果戴红手套的男子是唯一放在一边的空洞：将他放置入场，置于域外来客之巢的任意调查员控制下。
all_card.real_back_text: Concealed 1. Forced - When you expose this location: - If it is in the left position in the shadows, take 1 damage. - If it is in the middle position in the shadows, choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. - If it is on the right position in the shadows, take 1 horror.
all_card.real_text:
Each [[Outsider]] enemy at this location loses aloof and gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
[fast] If The Red-Gloved Man is the only set-aside hollow: Put him into play under the control of any investigator at Outsiders' Lair.

all_card.name: 拟态克星
all_card.text: 警戒。猎手。庞大。反击。 强制 - 在你将要对本敌人造成伤害时，改为选择并弃掉相同数量的放在一边的空洞。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：本敌人所在地点的每位调查员必须选择自己手中一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，作为一个空洞；或本敌人攻击自己。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 域外. 精英
all_card.real_text: Alert. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Forced - When you would deal damage to this enemy: Instead, choose and discard that many set-aside hollows. Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator at this enemy's location must either choose a non-weakness card in their hand and set it aside, as a hollow, or this enemy attacks them.

all_card.name: 原生质重组者
all_card.text: 庞大。 生成 - 离所有调查员最远的地点。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果本敌人处于重整状态：将最近的调查员牌库顶的卡牌正面朝下生成在本敌人的地点，作为一个魔像敌人。魔像拥有：“[[怪物]]，[[域外]] 猎手。1攻击值、1生命值、1躲避值、1伤害值。如果魔像被击败，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。”
all_card.real_text: Massive. Spawn - Location farthest from all investigators. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if this enemy is ready: Spawn the top card of the nearest investigator's deck facedown at its location as a Golem enemy. Golems have: "[[Monster. Outsider.]] Hunter. 1 fight, 1 health, 1 evade, 1 damage value. If Golem is defeated, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow."

all_card.flavor: “最后的变换——它告诉你这意味着什么了吗？”
all_card.name: 戴红手套的男子
all_card.text: [reaction]在你成功攻击或躲避[[域外]]敌人且超过难度至少2点后，横置戴红手套的男子：对该敌人造成1点伤害并发现你所在地点的1个线索。
all_card.real_flavor: "The final shift - has it told you what it means?"
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully fight or evade an [[Outsider]] enemy by 2 or more, exhaust The Red-Gloved Man: Deal 1 damage to that enemy and discover 1 clue at your location.

all_card.name: 艾里奇·佐尼·奥佩勒曲亚
all_card.text: [reaction]在隐匿迷你卡牌揭露后，横置艾里奇·佐尼·奥佩勒曲亚：选择一个放在一边的空洞。其所有者将其抽取。
all_card.real_subname: The Maid with the Scarlet Sash
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After a concealed mini-card is exposed, exhaust Aliki Zoni Uperetria: Choose a set-aside hollow. Its owner draws it.

困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为当前场景编号+1。

[tablet]：-2。如果你所在地点有重整的[[域外]]敌人，改为你自动失败。
[elder_thing]：-4。取消投入本次检定的每张卡牌上的效果和图标，将它们放到一边，位于场外，作为空洞。
all_card.name: 钥匙议会
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为当前场景编号。
[cultist]：-5。你可以将你控制的一个[[稳定]]钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面，以改为将本标记的修正值视为-2。
[tablet]：-2。如果这是对重整的[[域外]]敌人的攻击，改为你自动失败。
[elder_thing]：-3。取消投入本次检定的每张卡牌上的效果和图标，将它们放到一边，位于场外，作为空洞。

Hard / Expert

all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
