[elder_thing]: -3. Cancel the effects and icons of each card committed to this test and set each of them aside, out of play, as hollows.

all_card.back_text:
如果当前场景是秘密与谎言(版本一)：
超维能量的脉络包围了你，似要将你撕成碎片。
每个敌人变换身上附属的每个钥匙。立即结算额外一个敌军阶段(然后继续当前阶段)。
如果当前场景是秘密与谎言(版本二)：
戴红手套的男子打开的次元门就要关上了！你没时间准备了，纵身跃了进去。
在密谋2a上放置4个毁灭标记。推进场景。
如果当前场景是秘密与谎言(版本三)：
异次元的实体围绕着你，似要将你的存在抹除。
将1[per_investigator]个钥匙从其[[稳定]]面翻至[[动荡]]面。立即结算额外一个敌军阶段(然后继续当前阶段)。
all_card.flavor: 一段加密的信息……
all_card.name: 因果汇流
all_card.text: 强制 - 在本密谋推进时，如果是场景2、3或4：跳过本密谋的“b”面，直接推进到密谋2a。
all_card.real_back_text:
If the current act is Secrets and Lies (v. I):
Leylines of paradimensional energy surround you, threatening to tear you apart.
Each enemy shifts each of their attached keys. Immediately resolve an additional enemy phase (then resume the current phase).
If the current act is Secrets and Lies (v. II):
The portal the red-gloved man opened is almost shut! With no time left to prepare, you leap inside just before it closes.
Place 4 doom on agenda 2a. Advance the act.
If the current act is Secrets and Lies (v. III):
Extradimensional entities surround you, threatening to erase your very existence.
Flip 1 [per_investigator] keys from their [[Stable]] side to their [[Unstable]] side. Immediately resolve an additional enemy phase (then resume with the current phase).
all_card.real_flavor: You have come here to find us, but we found you long, long ago. You will be just another set piece in the monument that is our ultimate prayer to the Elder Ones. See our Grand Temple and hear our Call, O Great Ones beyond the beyond!
all_card.real_text: Forced - When this agenda advances, if it is act 2, 3, or 4: Skip the "b" side of this agenda and proceed directly to agenda 2a.

all_card.back_flavor: 维度之间雷声隆隆。无数被遗忘的世界重压累积，在你脑海深处冲击着你的每一寸感官。你手中的钥匙吱嘎嗡响，涌现着超维能量。要是没有它们，你在这片领域的重压下可没法存活。
all_card.back_text:
将每张诱饵翻回。混洗场上所有隐匿迷你卡牌，然后将其随机放到先前位置。
每位调查员受到2点伤害和2点恐惧但可以选择(选择一项或都不选)：
- 变换一个其控制的[[动荡]]钥匙而不翻至[[稳定]]面，以取消上述效果造成的所有伤害和恐惧。
- 将其控制的任意数量的[[稳定]]钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面，以取消相同数量的上述效果造成的伤害/恐惧。
all_card.flavor: 一段加密的信息……
all_card.name: 不速之界
all_card.real_back_flavor: A peal of thunder resounds across dimensions. In the deep recesses of your mind, the building pressure of infinite forgotten worlds crushes your every sense. Your keys, surging with paradimensional energy, rattle and hum in your hands. Without them, you could scarcely withstand the strain of this realm.
all_card.real_back_text:
Flip each decoy over. Shuffle all concealed mini-cards in play, then place them at random in the positions they were in.
Each investigator takes 2 damage and 2 horror but may either (choose one, or neither):
- Shift an [[Unstable]] key they control without flipping it to its [[Stable]] side to cancel all of the damage and horror just dealt to them by the above effect.
- Flip any number of [[Stable]] keys they control to their [[Unstable]] side to cancel that much damage/horror just dealt to them by the above effect.
all_card.real_flavor: So you deign to scale our monument? Our relic to the many worlds we have devoured? Oh yes; yours is not the first. Very well then. Climb to the vertex, if you can, and behold your ruin.

all_card.back_flavor: 一段加密的信息……
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员被击败。
all_card.flavor: 一段加密的信息……
all_card.name: 万物尽红
all_card.real_back_flavor: This is the forgotten end-that-is-not-an-end; not an erasure but a turning of the moons; the great twist of irony in the cosmic joke that is existence; consciousness and memory and being together at once and at last; and when the great work of the beyond is complete, your thoughts and dreams will be just a drop of water in an endless ocean of sentience; mine but yours and ours together; and this place will be our home, from now until eternity, and you shall never again hope nor despair, for we will be one and the same.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator is defeated.
all_card.real_flavor: Hark! You approach your own ruin. Its scarlet robes are the skin of foes long since vanquished. Its embroidery woven with the arteries of Kings long devoured. Its crown forged from the obelisks of once-great civilizations. You are just another meal. You, too, will be forgotten. And in the end only we shall reign.

all_card.back_flavor: 你终于找到了戴红手套的男子，他迅速溜进了一个闪闪发光的次元门。没有时间可以浪费了——机不可失，时不再来！你赶在次元门关闭时快速跟了上去……
all_card.back_text: 将所有地点从游戏中移除。(调查员在此过程期间没有被击败。这些地点的其他敌人和附属都被弃掉，隐匿迷你卡牌则放到一边。) 将万千纠结之塔、悖逆重力之阶、睥睨众生之巅地点放置入场，成一竖列，其中睥睨众生之巅在顶部，而万千纠结之塔在底部。拿取异界牌库顶的3张卡牌，放入阴影中，从左到右排成一行。拿取3张残骸之城迷你卡牌，正面朝下混洗，环绕万千纠结之塔左、右、下摆放。 将每位调查员放到万千纠结之塔，将戴红手套的男子敌人放到睥睨众生之巅。将遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆从游戏中移除，替换为第二个遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你得找到戴红手套的男子，搞清他真正的计划。但红色同志会的其他人还在挡你的路。他们难道意识不到真正的威胁吗？
all_card.name: 秘密与谎言(版本一)
all_card.text: 戴红手套的男子获得隐匿1[per_investigator]且不能受到伤害。 目标 - 当一轮结束时，如果所有调查员都与戴红手套的男子在同一地点，则可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Finally, you spot the man with the red gloves just before he ducks into a shimmering, extradimensional portal. There is no time to lose - it's now or never! You follow swiftly as the portal closes...
all_card.real_back_text: Remove each location from the game. (Investigators are not defeated during this process. Other enemies and attachments at those locations are discarded, and concealed mini-cards are set aside.) Put The Knotted Tower, Gravity-Defying Climb, and The Towering Vertex locations into play in a straight vertical line, with The Towering Vertex at the top and The Knotted Tower at the bottom. Take the top 3 locations in the Otherworld deck and place them in the shadows, arranged in a line from left to right. Take the 3 City of Remnants mini-cards, shuffle them facedown, and arrange them around The Knotted Tower as follows: One to its left, one to its right, and one below. Place each investigator at The Knotted Tower and The Red-Gloved Man enemy at the Towering Vertex. Remove the encounter deck and encounter discard pile from the game, replacing them with the second encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: You have to find the man with the red gloves and discover what his plan is, but the remainder of the Red Coterie stands in your way. Don't they realize the true threat here?
all_card.real_text: The Red-Gloved Man gains concealed 1 [per_investigator] and cannot be damaged. Objective - At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same location as The Red-Gloved Man, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你踏入次元门，不确定自己是否还能回来……
all_card.back_text: 将密谋1a从游戏中移除，将上面所有的毁灭标记移动到密谋2a上。将所有地点从游戏中移除。(调查员在此过程期间没有被击败。这些地点的其他敌人和附属都被弃掉，隐匿迷你卡牌则放到一边。) 将万千纠结之塔、悖逆重力之阶、睥睨众生之巅地点放置入场，成一竖列，其中睥睨众生之巅在顶部，而万千纠结之塔在底部。拿取异界牌库顶的3张卡牌，放入阴影中，从左到右排成一行。拿取3张残骸之城迷你卡牌和X张诱饵，其中X等于密谋2a上的毁灭标记数。正面朝下混洗，环绕万千纠结之塔左、右、下，尽可能平均地分发。 将每位调查员放到万千纠结之塔，将戴红手套的男子敌人放到睥睨众生之巅。将放一边的其他每张[[同志会]]敌人洗入遭遇牌库。(注意：从现在起，神话阶段期间如常从遭遇牌库抽取卡牌。)
all_card.flavor: 你在离开前，还有最后一次机会探索红色同志会的藏身处。但时间不等人！
all_card.name: 秘密与谎言(版本二)
all_card.text: 神话阶段期间，不从遭遇牌库抽取卡牌。 目标 - 等你准备好域外之行的时候就出发。当任意一轮结束时，如果所有调查员都在同一地点，则可以推进。越快越好。(提示——在密谋推进时，你会被强制自动推进。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: You step through the portal, uncertain if you will ever return...
all_card.real_back_text: Remove agenda 1a from the game, moving all of its doom to agenda 2a. Remove each location from the game. (Investigators are not defeated during this process. Other enemies and attachments at those locations are discarded, and concealed mini-cards are set aside.) Put The Knotted Tower, Gravity-Defying Climb, and The Towering Vertex locations into play in a straight vertical line, with The Towering Vertex at the top and The Knotted Tower at the bottom. Take the top 3 locations in the Otherworld deck and place them in the shadows, arranged in a line from left to right. Take the 3 City of Remnants mini-cards and X decoys, where X is the amount of doom on agenda 2a, shuffle them facedown, and distribute them as evenly as possible around The Knotted Tower to its left, right, and below. Place each investigator at The Knotted Tower and The Red-Gloved Man enemy at the Towering Vertex. Shuffle each other set-aside [[Coterie]] enemy into the encounter deck. (Note: From now on, draw cards from the encounter deck during each mythos phase, as normal.)
all_card.real_flavor: You have one last chance to explore the Red Coterie's hideout before you depart. But time is of the essence!
all_card.real_text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - Prepare for your journey into the Outside, and proceed when you are ready. At the end of any round, if each investigator is at the same location, they may advance. The sooner, the better. (Hint - You will also be forced to advance automatically when the agenda advances.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你终于找到了戴红手套的男子，他迅速溜进了一个闪闪发光的次元门。没有时间可以浪费了——机不可失，时不再来！你赶在次元门关闭时快速跟了上去……
all_card.back_text: 将所有地点从游戏中移除。(调查员在此过程期间没有被击败。这些地点的其他敌人和附属都被弃掉，隐匿迷你卡牌则放到一边。) 将万千纠结之塔、悖逆重力之阶、睥睨众生之巅地点放置入场，成一竖列，其中睥睨众生之巅在顶部，而万千纠结之塔在底部。 拿取异界牌库顶的3张卡牌，放入阴影中，从左到右排成一行。 拿取3张残骸之城迷你卡牌，正面朝下混洗，环绕万千纠结之塔左、右、下摆放。 将每位调查员放到万千纠结之塔，将戴红手套的男子敌人放到睥睨众生之巅。
all_card.flavor: 域外来客攻击了红色同志会的老巢！只有一人能告诉你答案。你必须找到“戴红手套的男子”——或者他皮下的实体——跟回他来的世界。
all_card.name: 秘密与谎言(版本三)
all_card.text: 戴红手套的男子获得隐匿1[per_investigator]且不能受到伤害。 目标 - 当一轮结束时，如果所有调查员都与戴红手套的男子在同一地点，则可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Finally, you spot the man with the red gloves just before he ducks into a shimmering, extradimensional portal. There is no time to lose - it's now or never! You follow swiftly as the portal closes...
all_card.real_back_text: Remove each location from the game. (Investigators are not defeated during this process. Other enemies and attachments at those locations are discarded, and concealed mini-cards are set aside.) Put The Knotted Tower, Gravity-Defying Climb, and The Towering Vertex locations into play in a straight vertical line, with The Towering Vertex at the top and The Knotted Tower at the bottom. Take the top 3 locations in the Otherworld deck and place them in the shadows, arranged in a line from left to right. Take the 3 City of Remnants mini-cards, shuffle them facedown, and arrange them around The Knotted Tower as follows: One to its left, one to its right, and one below. Place each investigator at The Knotted Tower and The Red-Gloved Man enemy at the Towering Vertex.
all_card.real_flavor: Outsiders have attacked the Red Coterie's hideout! Only one among them has the answers you seek. You must find the "Red-Gloved Man" - or the entity that wears his face - and follow it back to the world whence it came.
all_card.real_text: The Red-Gloved Man gains concealed 1 [per_investigator] and cannot be damaged. Objective - At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same location as The Red-Gloved Man, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 塔的入口处有七把遗忘之锁，每一把都是一段属于久遭遗忘国度的历史。门打开的时刻，你已经忘了它们存在过。另一端旋转阶梯的长度叫人望而生怯。它是个扭曲了无数次的难解之结，盘旋向上，通往塔顶，似乎无尽，令人茫然，将整个世界包裹起来，不可思议。即便你能上到顶端，你都怀疑自己能不能找到路回来。
all_card.back_text:
将每张隐匿迷你卡牌放在一边，位于场外。将阴影中的每张残骸之城和剩余的异界牌库从游戏中移除。
拿取3张残骸之城的隐匿迷你卡牌和1[per_investigator]张诱饵，正面朝下混洗，以随机顺序环绕悖逆重力之阶摆放。
all_card.flavor: 在一切已知的现实之外，只有遗忘失落之物所知的维度，是荒谬的残骸之城——也就是域外来客的本界。你眼前赫然出现了一座惊骇扭曲的高塔，异星天空中翻滚的云雾在塔顶交汇。
all_card.name: 登塔
all_card.text: 地点和隐匿迷你卡牌不能放置与[[高塔]]地点相邻。 目标 - 找到方法进入渗透者静候的高塔。如果有调查员进入了悖逆重力之阶，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Seven forgotten locks grant entry to the tower, each one a piece of history from a realm long since erased from time. You forget they exist the moment the gates open. On the other side, steps course their way up the spire's baffling length. Winding, perplexing, and seemingly infinite, the ascent to the apex of the tower that binds this world together is paradoxical, a Gordian knot twisted far too many times. Even if you make it to the top, you doubt you will ever find a way back.
all_card.real_back_text:
Set each concealed mini-card aside, out of play. Remove each City of Remnants in the shadows and the remainder of the Otherworld deck from the game.
Take the 3 City of Remnants concealed mini-cards and 1 [per_investigator] decoys, shuffle them facedown, and arrange them around Gravity-Defying Climb in a random order.
all_card.real_flavor: Beyond all of known reality, in the dimension known only to the forgotten and the forsaken, lies the preposterous City of Remnants - the home world of the Outsiders themselves. Looming before you, a terrifying, twisted tower of jumbled architecture is a nexus of roiling mist and clouds across an alien sky.
all_card.real_text: Locations and concealed mini-cards cannot be placed adjacent to [[Tower]] locations. Objective - Find a way into the tower where the infiltrator lies in wait. If an investigator enters the Gravity-Defying Climb, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你费尽千辛万苦，终于从最后一阶切实爬上了高塔顶端。多维的天空中猩红的云层扭曲出紫色的裂口，是通往无穷世界的无穷门扉。个个痴愚、个个盲目，个个任凭宰割。你带着敬畏和怜悯仰望着域外来客的世界，看着它们敛集的无数世界的遗迹，都已被遗弃、遗忘，失落于永恒。这里就是宇宙万物的垃圾堆。你的敌人，主宰人类消失的罪魁祸首，就在正中央。它的身形已经一点都不像那个戴红手套的男子了。它已经没有人类的面庞，眼神空洞，表情未知。
all_card.back_text:
将每张隐匿迷你卡牌放在一边，位于场外。
将放在一边的拟态克星敌人与睥睨众生之巅的戴红手套的男子敌人交换。
拿取拟态克星的隐匿迷你卡牌和2[per_investigator]张诱饵，正面朝下混洗，以随机顺序环绕睥睨众生之巅摆放。
all_card.flavor:
你面前的无穷阶梯仿佛埃舍尔笔下的虚幻场景。你向上攀爬，只感到一阵骇人的头晕目眩。

只有一条路可走。
all_card.name: 登顶
all_card.text: 目标 - 向上爬。如果有调查员进入睥睨众生之巅，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: With herculean effort, you practically crawl from the final step to the tower's pinnacle. Twisting clouds of crimson and violet clash in a multidimensional sky, infinite gateways to infinite worlds, all of them oblivious, all of them blind, all of them theirs for the taking. You look out upon the world of the Outsiders with both awe and pity, upon the countless worlds' worth of ruin they have collected, discarded, forsaken, lost to all time. It is a garbage heap of cosmic proportions. At the very center lies your foe who has orchestrated humanity's erasure. Its body only scarcely resembles that of the Red-Gloved Man now. With no human face to wear, its gaze is empty, its expression unknowable.
all_card.real_back_text:
Set each concealed mini-card aside, out of play.
Swap the set-aside Mimetic Nemesis enemy with The Red-Gloved Man enemy at The Towering Vertex.
Take the Mimetic Nemesis's mini-card and 2 [per_investigator] decoys, shuffle them facedown, and arrange them around The Towering Vertex in a random order.
all_card.real_flavor:
A terrible feeling of vertigo washes over you as you begin to scale the cyclopean, Escheresque steps.
Only one way to go now.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Ascend. If an investigator enters The Towering Vertex, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
实体倒下了，它无言的尖叫在世界和彼端回荡，在你的脑中回响，要将你撕成一个个原子。你还能留存至今，完全是因为钥匙的能量。你身边的一切早已爆裂。你脑后突然一阵拖拽的感觉，就好像你在这片凌乱的水域中上了钩。
然后，一片黑暗。
all_card.flavor: 你亮出自己一路收集的钥匙，做好准备。要是你不能expel这个实体，collapse这个dimension，你就将end of you all——永远地消失不见。胜败在此一举。这是你last chance before there is nothing of you left. nothing of you left nothing
all_card.name: 最后的疏忽
all_card.text: [action]将你控制的一个[[稳定]]钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面：将一个已揭露的诱饵从游戏中移除。 目标 - 如果拟态克星被击败，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The entity collapses upon itself, its wordless screech washing over the world and worlds beyond, reverberating through your skull, tearing you apart molecule by molecule. You remain tethered to reality only by the energy of your keys, which endure even as all else implodes around you. There is a sensation of tugging at the back of your skull, a feeling of being yanked by a fishhook out of ravaged waters.
Then, darkness.
all_card.real_flavor: You brandish the keys you have collected and brace yourself. If you cannot expel this entity and collapse this dimension, it will be the end of you all - and none will ever be the wiser. This is it. Your last chance before there is nothing of you left. nothing of you left nothing
all_card.real_text: [action] Flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side: Remove an exposed decoy from the game. Objective - If Mimetic Nemesis is defeated, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 红色同志会秘密窝点的长廊大大方方地陈列了他们干涉人类的历史，墙上装饰着过去文明的古代遗物、猩红的织毯，还有不计其数的肖像，上面画的人看上去都举足轻重，个个穿着红衣。
all_card.flavor: 要是有人引导，这迷宫般的长廊可能就没那么绕。
all_card.name: 猩红走廊
all_card.text: [free]横置一个你控制的[[同谋]]支援：移动(到一个连接地点)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The halls of the Red Coterie's secret hideout celebrate its long history of meddling with humanity, its walls adorned with ancient relics from past civilizations, scarlet-red tapestries, and numerous portraits of important-looking people, all clad in red.
all_card.real_flavor: Perhaps if you had a guide, these labyrinthine halls would not be so perplexing.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset you control: Move (to a connecting location).

all_card.back_flavor: 红色同志会秘密窝点的长廊大大方方地陈列了他们干涉人类的历史，墙上装饰着过去文明的古代遗物、猩红的织毯，还有不计其数的肖像，上面画的人看上去都举足轻重，个个穿着红衣。
all_card.name: 猩红走廊
all_card.text: 强制 - 你进入猩红走廊后：你回合剩余时间内，作为你从猩红走廊移动到连接地点的额外费用，你必须横置一个你控制的[[同谋]]支援，或花费额外一个行动。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The halls of the Red Coterie's secret hideout celebrate its long history of meddling with humanity, its walls adorned with ancient relics from past civilizations, scarlet-red tapestries, and numerous portraits of important-looking people, all clad in red.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Scarlet Halls: For the remainder of your turn, as an additional cost for you to move from Scarlet Halls to a connecting location, you must either exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset you control or spend an additional action.

all_card.back_flavor: 红色同志会的内部圣堂浸淫了古代的传统和仪式，既引人入胜，又邪恶无比。
all_card.flavor: 审判你的仪式室中间有一张巨桌，上面点着蜡烛。墙上豪奢的装饰个个是深红的颜色。
all_card.name: 议会室
all_card.text: [action]横置一个你控制的[[同谋]]支援：查找你牌库顶6张卡牌，找出一张支援，将其抽取，将其余卡牌洗入你的牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Red Coterie's inner sanctum is steeped in ancient tradition and ceremony, welcoming and sinister all at once.
all_card.real_flavor: The ceremonial chamber where your trial took place is dominated by an enormous table and lit by candlelight. Extravagant decorations adorn the walls, crimson in color.
all_card.real_text: [action] Exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset you control: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for an asset, draw it, and shuffle the rest into your deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 红色同志会的内部圣堂浸淫了古代的传统和仪式，既引人入胜，又邪恶无比。
all_card.flavor: 审判你的仪式室中间有一张巨桌，上面点着蜡烛。墙上豪奢的装饰个个是深红的颜色。
all_card.name: 议会室
all_card.text: 议会室有重整的[[同志会]]敌人时，议会室的每位调查员打出的每张支援费用提升2点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Red Coterie's inner sanctum is steeped in ancient tradition and ceremony, welcoming and sinister all at once.
all_card.real_flavor: The ceremonial chamber where your trial took place is dominated by an enormous table and lit by candlelight. Extravagant decorations adorn the walls, crimson in color.
all_card.real_text: While there is a ready [[Coterie]] enemy at Congress Chamber, increase the cost of each asset played by each investigator at Congress Chamber by 2.

all_card.back_flavor: 红色同志会的内部圣堂浸淫了古代的传统和仪式，既引人入胜，又邪恶无比。
all_card.flavor: 这间古老的厅堂里藏着大量古代书本、保存完好的卷轴和落满灰尘的典籍。世世代代的知识隐匿起来，只有同志会的人才能知晓。
all_card.name: 同志会藏书室
all_card.text: [action]：你本轮打出的下一张支援费用减少2点。你可以横置一个[[同谋]]支援，以使本次能力激活改为[free]能力，而非[action]能力。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Red Coterie's inner sanctum is steeped in ancient tradition and ceremony, welcoming and sinister all at once.
all_card.real_flavor: A treasure trove of aged books, preserved scrolls and dusty tomes fills this ancient hall, centuries of knowledge hidden away for only the Coterie to see.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Reduce the cost of the next asset you play this round by 2. You may exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset to treat this ability as a [fast] ability instead of an [action] ability for this activation.

all_card.back_flavor: 红色同志会的内部圣堂浸淫了古代的传统和仪式，既引人入胜，又邪恶无比。

all_card.name: 同志会藏书室
all_card.text: 强制 - 你调查同志会藏书室时技能检定失败后：最近的有钥匙附属的[[同志会]]敌人变换身上附属的每个钥匙。

all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Coterie Library: The nearest [[Coterie]] enemy with an attached key shifts each of their attached keys.

all_card.back_flavor: 红色同志会的内部圣堂浸淫了古代的传统和仪式，既引人入胜，又邪恶无比。
all_card.name: 藏钥馆
all_card.text: [reaction]你成功调查藏钥馆后：不发现线索，改为选择附属到你所在地点调查员的一个未注能的钥匙。将一个资源(从供应堆拿取)放到该钥匙上，作为注能，该钥匙即被注能(如果要变换该钥匙，其控制者可以不将其翻至[[动荡]]面，改为花费该注能)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Red Coterie's inner sanctum is steeped in ancient tradition and ceremony, welcoming and sinister all at once.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate The Key Reliquary: Instead of discovering clues, choose an unempowered key attached to an investigator at your location. Place a resource (from the token pool) on that key, as an empowerment; that key is empowered (if it is shifted, its controller may spend the empowerment instead of flipping it to its [[Unstable]] side).

all_card.back_flavor: 红色同志会的内部圣堂浸淫了古代的传统和仪式，既引人入胜，又邪恶无比。
all_card.flavor: 有多少钥匙藏于此处，经年累月，不见天日？又有多少用作了压迫的工具？
all_card.name: 藏钥馆
all_card.text: 场上每有一个[[动荡]]钥匙，藏钥馆得到+2隐藏值。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Red Coterie's inner sanctum is steeped in ancient tradition and ceremony, welcoming and sinister all at once.
all_card.real_flavor: How many Keys have been tucked away here for years, lost to history? How many more were used as tools of oppression?
all_card.real_text: The Key Reliquary gets +2 shroud for each [[Unstable]] key in play.

all_card.back_flavor: 在这个纠结世界的核心升起了一座巨塔：扭曲的材料在错综之城上盘旋成一幢不祥的高楼，你面前仿佛竖立起一座失落的摩天大楼，有无数层。一旁围绕着参差的不毛诸峰，中间异界的迷雾盘绕向上。
all_card.flavor: 这座亵渎的巨像，证明被征服的世界遭到了毁灭。<cite>维吉尔·格雷，《身临域外之廷》</cite>
all_card.name: 万千纠结之塔
all_card.text: [reaction]在有地点放置与万千纠结之塔相邻后：移动到该地点(从万千纠结之塔)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: In the nexus of this jumbled otherworld rises the tower: a sinister structure of assorted materials climbing out of the tangled city, looming countless stories over you like a skyscraper of forgotten architecture. An otherworldly mist snakes around the tower's length, flanked on all sides by barren, jagged peaks.
all_card.real_flavor:
And o'er it all loomed the blasphemous effigy,
a ruinous testament to conquered worlds.
 - Virgil Gray, "In the Court of the Outsiders"
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After a location is placed adjacent to The Knotted Tower: Move to that location (from The Knotted Tower).

all_card.back_text: 前往藐視重力之坡的大門被封印且遺忘。作為進入藐視重力之坡的額外費用，在百結之塔的調查員必須作為團隊花費4[per_investigator]個線索。
all_card.name: 悖逆重力之阶
all_card.text: 强制 - 在环绕悖逆重力之阶的隐匿迷你卡牌被揭露时：如果它是…… - ……睥睨众生之巅上所列顺序的下一位，则它留在场上，保持揭露，且你可以揭露另一张隐匿迷你卡牌。 - ……其他任意迷你卡牌，将其与其他每张隐匿迷你卡牌翻至正面朝下(不要混洗)。
all_card.back_flavor: 通往悖逆重力之阶的大门已经封印、失落。作为进入悖逆重力之阶的额外费用，万千纠结之塔的调查员必须共同花费4[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.real_back_text: The gate to Gravity-Defying Climb is sealed and forgotten. As an additional cost to enter Gravity-Defying Climb, investigators at The Knotted Tower must spend 4 [per_investigator] clues.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When a concealed mini-card around Gravity-Defying Climb is exposed: If it is... - ...the next in the sequence listed on The Towering Vertex, it remains in play and exposed, and you may expose another concealed mini-card. - ...any other mini-card, flip it and each other concealed mini-card facedown (without shuffling them).

all_card.back_text: 戴红手套的男子不能被击败。 通往睥睨众生之巅的道路错综复杂，不可思议。调查员要想进入睥睨众生之巅，必须按如下顺序揭露环绕悖逆重力之阶的隐匿迷你卡牌：首先，残骸之城(左)；其次，残骸之城(中)；最后，残骸之城(右)。
all_card.name: 睥睨众生之巅
all_card.text: 强制 - 在环绕睥睨众生之巅的隐匿迷你卡牌被揭露时：如果它是…… ……拟态克星的迷你卡牌，对拟态克星造成3点伤害，然后将所有隐匿迷你卡牌翻至正面朝下并混洗。 ……诱饵，则它留在场上，保持揭露。
all_card.real_back_text: The Red-Gloved Man cannot be defeated. The way to The Towering Vertex is impossibly perplexing. In order for an investigator to enter The Towering Vertex, concealed mini-cards around Gravity-Defying Climb must be exposed in the following sequence: First, City of Remnants (L); second, City of Remnants (M); third, City of Remnants (R).
all_card.real_text: Forced - When a concealed mini-card around The Towering Vertex is exposed: If it is... - ...the Mimetic Nemesis's mini-card, deal the Mimetic Nemesis 3 damage, then flip all concealed mini-cards facedown and shuffle them facedown. - ...a decoy, it remains in play and exposed.

all_card.name: 拟态克星
all_card.text: 庞大。不能进行趁乱攻击。 拟态克星得到+3[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 在拟态克星将要从攻击或玩家卡牌受到伤害时：选择并揭示一张隐匿迷你卡牌。如果是诱饵，取消刚才造成的所有伤害(诱饵依然留在场上，正面朝上)。否则，如常造成伤害，然后将所有已揭示的迷你卡牌翻至正面朝下并混洗。
all_card.traits: 古神. 域外. 精英
all_card.real_text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Mimetic Nemesis gets +3 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When Mimetic Nemesis would take 1 or more damage from an attack or player card: Choose and reveal a concealed mini-card. If it is a decoy, cancel all damage just dealt (the decoy remains in play and faceup). Otherwise, the damage is dealt as normal, then flip all revealed mini-cards facedown and shuffle them.

all_card.flavor: 一抹红色，一闪而过的身影。
all_card.name: 同志会特工(A)
all_card.text: 隐匿2。 强制 - 在同志会特工进入阴影后：在上面放置1个毁灭标记。 [reaction]在同志会特工揭露时：将其弃掉。
all_card.real_flavor: A flash of red and a fleeting shadow.
all_card.real_text: Concealed 2. Forced - After Coterie Agent enters the shadows: Place 1 doom on it. [reaction] When Coterie Agent is exposed: Discard it.

all_card.text: 隐匿2。 强制 - 在同志会特工进入阴影后：在上面放置1个毁灭标记。 [reaction]在同志会特工揭露时：将其弃掉。

all_card.flavor: 就在她描述对方穿着的时候，通话断线了。
all_card.name: 红色阴谋
all_card.text: 显现 - 在阴影中的一个敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。如果阴影中没有敌人，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个带有隐匿关键词的敌人，将其抽取。混洗遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_flavor: The moment she described his outfit, the line went dead.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on an enemy in the shadows. If there are no enemies in the shadows, search the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy with the concealed keyword and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: “福林，你瞧见我看到的东西了吗？”
all_card.name: 现实塌缩
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须(选择一项)：花费1个线索，或选择并弃掉你一半的非弱点手牌(向上取整)。
all_card.real_flavor: "Flint, are you seeing what I am seeing?"
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): Spend 1 clue or choose and discard half of the non-weakness cards in your hand (rounded up).

all_card.flavor: 他们大多在下雨时现身。大多。
all_card.name: 瓢泼大雨
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须受到1点恐惧，或将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。
all_card.real_flavor: They mostly come out when it rains. Mostly.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either take 1 horror, or place 1 of your clues on your location.

all_card.name: 同志会代表
all_card.text: 冷漠。巡逻(有隐匿迷你卡牌，而无同志会代表的最近地点)。 同志会代表处于重整状态时，其所在地点的隐匿迷你卡牌不能通过玩家卡牌效果揭露。(FAQ v2.3) [reaction]你击败同志会代表后：查看场上任意一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面。
all_card.real_text:
Aloof. Patrol (nearest location with a concealed mini-card and no Coterie Envoy)
While Coterie Envoy is ready, concealed mini-cards at its location cannot be exposed via player card effects.
[reaction] After you defeat Coterie Envoy: Look at the revealed side of any concealed mini-card in play.

all_card.name: 就在眼前
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到阴影中一个没有附属就在眼前的敌人上。如果你不能，就在眼前获得涌动。 强制 - 在你揭露附属的敌人后：该敌人攻击你，且直到本轮结束得到+2攻击。弃掉就在眼前。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to an enemy in the shadows without a copy of In Plain Sight attached. If you cannot, In Plain Sight gains surge. Forced - After you expose attached enemy: That enemy attacks you and gets +2 fight until the end of the round. Discard In Plain Sight.

all_card.name: 暗中一刀
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果你的威胁区域没有暗中一刀，将暗中一刀放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。否则，本卡牌获得涌动。 强制 - 你揭露诱饵后：受到2点伤害。(每轮仅限一次。) 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：检定[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉暗中一刀。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Knives in the Dark into play in your threat area if there is no copy of it in your threat area. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Forced - After you expose a decoy: Take 2 damage. (Limit once per round.) Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Knives in the Dark.

all_card.name: 乔装卧底
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果阴影中没有敌人，乔装卧底获得涌动。否则，检定[intellect]或[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，将一张诱饵放到隐匿迷你卡牌最多的地点，将其翻至正面朝下，并混洗该地点的每张隐匿迷你卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no enemies in the shadows, Undercover gains surge. Otherwise, test [intellect] or [agility] (4). If you fail, place a decoy at the location with the most concealed mini-cards, flip it facedown, and shuffle each concealed mini-card at that location.

all_card.name: 误见阴影
all_card.text: 显现 - 将误见阴影放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你在有隐匿迷你卡牌的地点时，技能检定失败后：受到1点恐惧。 [action][action]：弃掉误见阴影。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Seeing Shadows into play in your threat area. Forced - After you fail a skill test while at a location with a concealed mini-card: Take 1 horror. [action][action]: Discard Seeing Shadows.

all_card.name: 黑暗中的身影
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 － 如果阴影中没有敌人，黑暗中的身影获得涌动。否则，你必须决定(选择一项)： - 阴影中的每个敌人攻击你。 - 每位调查员失去一个行动。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - If there are no enemies in the shadows, Figures in the Dark gains surge. Otherwise, you must decide (choose one): - Each enemy in the shadows attacks you. - Each investigator loses an action.

all_card.flavor: “你知道该干什么。”
all_card.name: 同志会打手(A)
all_card.text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 你揭露阴影中其他名称的敌人后，如果同志会打手在阴影中：其攻击你。
all_card.real_flavor: "You know what to do."
all_card.real_text: Concealed 1. Forced - After you expose an enemy in the shadows not named Coterie Enforcer, if Coterie Enforcer is in the shadows: It attacks you.

all_card.flavor: “你知道该干什么。”
all_card.name: 同志会打手(B)
all_card.text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 你揭露阴影中其他名称的敌人后，如果同志会打手在阴影中：其攻击你。
all_card.real_flavor: "You know what to do."
all_card.real_text: Concealed 1. Forced - After you expose an enemy in the shadows not named Coterie Enforcer, if Coterie Enforcer is in the shadows: It attacks you.

all_card.flavor: 不惜一切手段。
all_card.name: 同志会刺客(A)
all_card.text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果同志会刺客在阴影中：其攻击每位所在地点有隐匿迷你卡牌的调查员。
all_card.real_flavor: By any means necessary.
all_card.real_text: Concealed 1. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Coterie Assassin is in the shadows: It attacks each investigator at each location with 1 or more concealed mini-cards.

all_card.flavor: 不惜一切手段。
all_card.name: 同志会刺客(B)
all_card.text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果同志会刺客在阴影中：其攻击每位所在地点有隐匿迷你卡牌的调查员。
all_card.real_flavor: By any means necessary.
all_card.real_text: Concealed 1. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Coterie Assassin is in the shadows: It attacks each investigator at each location with 1 or more concealed mini-cards.

all_card.name: 溜之大吉
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果场上没有[[同志会]]敌人，溜之大吉获得涌动。否则，找到最近的[[同志会]]敌人并检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，该敌人攻击你。如果你检定失败且该敌人不在阴影中，结算其隐匿关键词(如可能)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Coterie]] enemies in play, Swift Retreat gains surge. Otherwise, find the nearest [[Coterie]] enemy and test [agility] (3). If you fail, that enemy attacks you. If you fail and that enemy is not in the shadows, resolve its concealed keyword (if able).

all_card.name: 身染猩红
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果场上没有[[同志会]]敌人，身染猩红获得涌动。否则，将其附属到印刷生命值最高的[[同志会]]敌人。 附属的敌人得到+1攻击、+1躲避、+1伤害和+1恐惧。 [action]：将你控制的一个[[稳定]]钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面。然后，弃掉身染猩红。任意地点的调查员均可以触发此能力。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Coterie]] enemies in play, Bound in Red gains surge. Otherwise, attach it to the [[Coterie]] enemy with the highest printed health. Attached enemy gets +1 fight, +1 evade, +1 damage, and +1 horror. [action]: Flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side. Then, discard Bound in Red. An investigator at any location may trigger this ability.

all_card.flavor: 他们带着魔鬼的恶意操纵那个工具，我的视线已经模糊……<cite>维吉尔·格雷，《身临域外之廷》</cite>
all_card.name: 钥匙充能
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 - 每个[[同志会]]敌人变换附属到自己的钥匙。
all_card.real_flavor:
My vision blurred as they manipulated the tool with some daemonic purpose...
- Virgil Gray, "In the Court of the Outsiders"
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Each [[Coterie]] enemy shifts each key attached to it.

all_card.flavor: 档案#AT - 151/客体表现为一种非物质的超自然扭曲。可使接触的物质变得“空洞”(见档案#AV - 245)。无法收容。
all_card.name: 无端存在
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在无端存在与你交战时：查看你牌库顶的卡牌。如果不是弱点，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
all_card.real_flavor: File #AT-151 / Subject appears as hyperphysical distortion devoid of mass. Capable of "hollowing" contacted matter (see file #AV-245). Containment impossible.
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When Paracausal Entity engages you: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.

all_card.name: 天启噩兆
all_card.text: 强制 - 在天启噩兆入场时：每位调查员选择自己手中或游戏区域内控制的一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。 [reaction]在天启噩兆被击败时：不将其加入胜利区，改为将其弃掉并选择至多3张放在一边的空洞，将这些空洞加入所有者手牌。
all_card.real_text: Forced - When Apocalyptic Presage enters play: Each investigator chooses a non-weakness card they control in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow. [reaction] When Apocalyptic Presage is defeated: Instead of adding it to the victory display, discard it and choose up to 3 set-aside hollows. Add them to their owners' hands.

all_card.flavor: 档案#AV-245，补充/未观测到能量转换。变为空洞的物质究竟发生了什么？
all_card.name: 物质伪饰
all_card.text: 显现 - 每有一个放在一边的空洞归你所有，如果你的游戏区域和/或手牌中有其同名卡牌，弃掉这些卡牌并受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。如果没有因本效果弃掉的卡牌，选择你手中或游戏区域内控制的一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
all_card.real_flavor: File #AV-245, supplemental / No energy conversion observed. What happens to hollowed matter?
all_card.real_text: Revelation - For each set-aside hollow you own, if there are 1 or more copies of that hollow in your play area and/or hand, discard those copies and take 1 damage and 1 horror. If no cards are discarded by this effect, choose a non-weakness card you control in your hand or play area and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.

all_card.flavor: 档案#AV-261，补充/客体似乎回到了正常的物质状态。
all_card.name: 异界仿体
all_card.text: 冷漠。猎手。 强制 - 如果异界仿体处于重整状态，其所在地点的调查员在将放在一边的空洞的同名卡牌打出、投入，或触发其能力时：它攻击该调查员。
all_card.real_flavor: File #AV-261, supplemental / Subject appears to have returned to normal state of matter.
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Hunter. Forced - If Otherworldly Mimic is ready, when an investigator at its location plays, commits, or triggers an ability on a copy of a set-aside hollow: It attacks that investigator.

all_card.name: 记忆变体
all_card.text: 显现 - 将记忆变体放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 强制 - 事件被打出后：不将其弃掉，改为放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。 [action]：检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定成功，弃掉记忆变体。任意调查员均可以触发本能力。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Memory Variant into play next to the agenda deck. Forced - After an event is played: Instead of discarding it, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. [action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, discard Memory Variant. Any investigator may trigger this ability.

all_card.name: 失落的秘密
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，选择自己手中一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，你可以受到1点恐惧，以选择一个放在一边的空洞，将其加入所有者手牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may take 1 horror to choose a set-aside hollow and add it to its owner's hand.

all_card.name: 常态颠扑者
all_card.text: 冷漠。猎手。 强制 - 你在常态颠扑者的地点结束回合后：查看你牌库顶的卡牌。如果不是弱点，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。然后，如果有至少3张放在一边的空洞归你所有，常态颠扑者攻击你。
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Hunter. Forced - After you end your turn at Paradigm Effacer's location: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. Then, if you own 3 or more set-aside hollows, Paradigm Effacer attacks you.

all_card.name: 物质颠倒
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到一个没有附属物质颠倒的[[域外]]敌人上。如果你不能，物质颠倒获得涌动。 附属的敌人失去冷漠，获得反击，得到+1攻击和+1躲避。 强制 - 成功躲避附属的敌人后：弃掉物质颠倒，并抽取1张你放在一边的空洞。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to an [[Outsider]] enemy without a copy of Matter Inversion attached. If you cannot, Matter Inversion gains surge. Attached enemy loses aloof, gains retaliate, and gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Forced - After attached enemy is successfully evaded: Discard Matter Inversion and draw 1 of your set-aside hollows.

all_card.name: 犹格斯星的密使

While there is a concealed mini-card at your location, you get +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you expose a card in the shadows, exhaust Agent Ari Quinn: Draw 1 card.

all_card.name: 戴维·伊拉万博士
all_card.text:
你得到+1[willpower]。
[free]横置戴维·伊拉万博士：揭示你一张手牌，以将该卡牌放在一边作为空洞的所有同名卡牌混洗入其所有者牌库；或弃掉你一张手牌，以将任意一个放在一边的空洞混洗入其所有者牌库。无论选择哪一项，每以此方式混洗入一张卡牌，获得1资源。

all_card.name: 快捷旅票
all_card.text: 永久。 启程前往地图上新的目的地时，你可以放逐快捷旅票并在剧本日志中记1时间，以旅行到地图上任意一处。
all_card.real_text: Permanent. While embarking to a new destination on the map, you may exile Expedited Ticket and mark 1 time in your Campaign Log to travel anywhere on the map.

all_card.flavor: 这份密档记载了重要的信息，却和你当前的处境一点边都挨不上。只要方便，你就该尽快将它丢在泰勒指示的圣堂里。
all_card.name: 基金会情报
all_card.text: 基金会情报不能离开你手中。
all_card.real_flavor: This dossier, while filled with important findings, isn't related to your situation in the slightest. You should probably drop it off at the sanctum Taylor indicated at your earliest convenience.
all_card.real_text: Foundation Intel cannot leave your hand.

all_card.name: 超维认识
all_card.text: 显现 - 你必须(选择一项)： - 立即变换你控制的一个[[动荡]]钥匙。 - 将你控制的每个[[稳定]]钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Immediately shift an [[Unstable]] key you control. - Flip each [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side.

all_card.flavor: 档案#52 - U13/客体等级：红色/客体是一块玻璃样的碎片，长约26cm，最薄处不过3mm，锋利无比，足以穿透任何已知材料。
all_card.name: 镜刃
all_card.text: 变换 - 对你所在地点的一个敌人造成2点伤害，或对你所在地点的每个敌人造成1点伤害。将本钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: File #52-U13 / Subject Class: Red / Subject is glasslike shard 26 cm in length and less than 3 mm at thinnest edge, sharp enough to cut through any known material.
all_card.real_text: Shift - Deal 2 damage to an enemy at your location, or 1 damage to all enemies at your location. Flip this key to its [[Unstable]] side.

all_card.flavor: ……每个人从中所见到的镜像都不相同。此种差异尚无解释。
all_card.name: 镜刃
all_card.text: 变换 - 每位调查员受到1点直接伤害。然后，如果是调查员变换了本钥匙，将其翻至[[稳定]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: ...different for each individual who perceives reflection. No known explanation for this discrepancy.
all_card.real_text: Shift - Each investigator takes 1 direct damage. Then, if an investigator shifted this key, flip it to its [[Stable]] side.

all_card.flavor: 档案#54 - W14/客体等级：绿色/客体貌似某种未知原理的机械器具。其工程原理不属于任何已知科学领域。
all_card.name: 灾祸引擎

all_card.real_flavor: File #54-W14 / Subject Class: Green / Subject appears to be mechanical apparatus of unknown design. Engineering purpose eludes any known school of science.
all_card.real_text: Shift - Add 1 ammo, charge, secret, supply, or evidence to an asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Flip this key to its [[Unstable]] side.

all_card.flavor: ……鉴于无法理解潜在后果，不建议激活设备。
all_card.name: 灾祸引擎
all_card.text: 变换 - 每位调查员失去3资源。然后，如果是调查员变换了本钥匙，将其翻至[[稳定]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: ...currently does not recommend activation of device, without understanding of indirect consequences.
all_card.real_text: Shift - Each investigator loses 3 resources. Then, if an investigator shifted this key, flip it to its [[Stable]] side.

all_card.flavor: 档案#45 - P15/客体等级：黄色/客体貌似一枚小钟，由黑色金属物质制成。尽管没有钟舌，客体在振动时会产生超维音学效果。
all_card.name: 灾毁之钟
all_card.text: 变换 - 自动躲避你所在地点的所有敌人。将本钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: File #45-P15 / Subject Class: Yellow / Subject appears as small bell made of black metallic substance. Despite lack of clapper, subject resounds with paradimensional acoustics when disturbed.
all_card.real_text: Shift - Automatically evade all enemies at your location. Flip this key to its [[Unstable]] side.

all_card.flavor: ……尚不明确是在何种能力下可以听到或经受住客体的频率。小心使用。
all_card.name: 灾毁之钟
all_card.text: 变换 - 每位调查员受到1点直接恐惧。然后，如果是调查员变换了本钥匙，将其翻至[[稳定]]面。
all_card.real_flavor: ...unclear what parameters establish capability to hear or endure subject frequency. Use with caution.
all_card.real_text: Shift - Each investigator takes 1 direct horror. Then, if an investigator shifted this key, flip it to its [[Stable]] side.

all_card.back_flavor: 卡森·辛克莱已经在阿卡姆服务了韦伯家族的三代人。卡森的举止向来合宜，但最新一任家主的所为叫他无法认同一一赫丘勒·韦伯在商业伙伴杜普斯的帮助下，将奇怪的神器和渎神的典籍带到家中。韦伯先生最终被维度之间的裂隙吞没了，但卡森讲述的恐怖事件却没人相信。卡森决心要证明杜普斯有罪，让韦伯家的孩子继承应得的家产。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30 选择次级职阶：当构建牌库时，选择探求者([seeker])、潜修者([mystic])或求生者([survivor])。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多10张等级0-1你选择次级职阶的事件和/或技能。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：2张“如您所愿”、无私成疾、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.name: 卡森·辛克莱
all_card.text:
在你回合期间，你可以进行额外一次行动，该行动只能用于下方的[action]能力。
[action]：选择你所在地点的另一位调查员。该调查员立即进行一次行动，如同是自己回合。(每位调查员每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+0。抽取1张卡牌。每次你所在地点的另一位调查员结算其[elder_sign]效果时，你可以结算此效果。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Carson Sinclair has served three generations of the Webb family in Arkham. Always proper, Carson watched with disapproval as his most recent employer, Hercule Webb, began bringing bizarre artifacts and profane tomes into the house, aided in these endeavors by Webb's business manager, Dupuis. When Mr. Webb was swallowed by a dimensional rift, no one believed Carson's description of the harrowing event. Carson has devoted himself to proving Dupuis's guilt, and to restoring the children as the rightful heirs to the Webb fortune.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Secondary Class Choice: At deck creation, choose Seeker ([seeker]), Mystic ([mystic]), or Survivor ([survivor]). Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 level 0-1 events and/or skills of your chosen secondary class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 2 copies of "As you wish", Selfless to a Fault, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used on the below [action] ability.
[action]: Choose another investigator at your location. They immediately take an action as if it were their turn. (Limit once per round for each investigator.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. Draw 1 card. You may resolve this effect anytime another investigator at your location resolves their [elder_sign] effect.

all_card.name: “如您所愿”
all_card.text:
卡森·辛克莱牌库专用。
只能投入到其他调查员执行的技能检定。
如果本次检定成功，执行检定的调查员抽取1张卡牌。如果本次检定失败，你抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
Carson Sinclair deck only.
Commit only to a skill test being performed by another investigator.
If this test succeeds, the performing investigator draws 1 card. If this test fails, you draw 1 card.

all_card.name: 无私成疾
all_card.text: 显现 - 将无私成疾放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时，如果你本回合未投入卡牌到其他调查员执行的技能检定：受到1点恐惧并将无私成疾洗入你的牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Selfless to a Fault into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you did not commit at least 1 card to a skill test performed by another investigator this turn: Take 1 horror and shuffle Selfless to a Fault into your deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 文森特·李在阿卡姆的圣玛丽医院已经见到三四具严重损毁的尸体，他不禁怀疑这并非单纯的野生动物袭击。后来有一位青年在睡梦中尖叫着死于心脏爆裂。文森特知道，黑暗时光已至。混乱愈演愈烈。他在医院停了职，去找那些饱受折磨的人，为他们减缓痛苦，并希望尸体上的痕迹能引导他找到自己渴望的真相。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5，带有“治愈……伤害”字样的卡牌等级0-5，其他等级0-1的守卫者和/或求生者卡牌([guardian]和/或[survivor])最多15张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：骨锯、1[per_investigator]张术后恢复、受伤路人、1张随机基础弱点。 额外冒险设置：你每场游戏开始将1[per_investigator]张术后恢复放在一边，位于场外。
all_card.flavor: “哪怕这答案会要了我的命，我也要把它找出来。”
all_card.name: 文森特·李
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你的卡牌效果治愈调查员或调查员的[[盟友]]支援的伤害后：将你的一张放在一边的术后恢复技能加入该调查员手牌。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。你可以治愈你所在地点的一位调查员或一个[[盟友]]支援的1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: After the third or fourth mutilated body showed up during his time at St. Mary’s Hospital in Arkham, Vincent Lee began to suspect that these were not mere wild animal attacks. When a young man died screaming in his sleep from a burst heart, Vincent knew for a fact that dark times were ahead. Taking a leave of absence from his position at the hospital, he has set out to ease the suffering of those afflicted by the spreading chaos, hoping that the trail of bodies will lead him to the answers he craves.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards that "heal damage" level 0-5, up to 15 other Guardian and/or Survivor cards level 0-1 ([guardian] and/or [survivor]). Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Bonesaw, 1 [per_investigator] copies of On the Mend, Wounded Bystander, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Setup: You begin each game with 1 [per_investigator] copies of On the Mend set aside, out of play.
all_card.real_flavor: "I will find the answers, even if it kills me."
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] After one of your card effects heals damage from an investigator or an investigator's [[Ally]] asset: Add one of your set-aside On the Mend skills to that investigator's hand.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may heal 1 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.

all_card.name: 骨锯
all_card.text: 文森特·李牌库专用。 [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果本次攻击成功，你可以受到1点伤害，以使本次攻击造成+1伤害。 [action]：治愈你所在地点一位调查员5点伤害。检定[intellect](4)。如果你检定失败，该调查员承受1点肉体创伤。(每场游戏最多一次。)
all_card.traits: 道具. 工具. 近战
all_card.real_text: Vincent Lee deck only. [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If this attack is successful, you may take 1 damage to deal +1 damage for this attack. [action]: Heal 5 damage from an investigator at your location. Test [intellect] (4). If you fail, that investigator suffers 1 physical trauma. (Max once per game.)

all_card.name: 术后恢复
all_card.text: 你手牌中仅限1张术后恢复。 只能投入你正在执行的检定。 强制 - 在术后恢复将从任何地方弃掉时：改为将其放在一边，位于场外。
all_card.real_text: Limit 1 On the Mend in your hand. Commit only to a test you are performing. Forced - When On the Mend would be discarded from anywhere: Set it aside, out of play, instead.

all_card.name: 受伤路人
all_card.text: 显现 - 将受伤路人放置入场，放到你的游戏区域，带有3点伤害。它有伤害时不能离场(除非被击败)。如果它没有伤害，将他弃掉。 强制 - 在你受到非直接伤害时，如可能，其中至少1点必须分配到受伤路人。 强制 - 如果受伤路人被击败：你承受1点精神创伤。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Wounded Bystander into play in your play area with 3 damage on it. It cannot leave play while it has damage (unless it is defeated). If it has no damage, discard it. Forced - When you take non-direct damage: At least 1 of it must be assigned to Wounded Bystander, if able. Forced - If Wounded Bystander is defeated: You suffer 1 mental trauma.

all_card.back_flavor: 正巧基玛尼在受雇评定米斯卡塔尼克博物馆的安全指数的时候，馆内的泰诺族神器失踪了。基玛尼当然知道是谁干的——向来都是家贼难防。但基玛尼可不是为了卖掉这些遗物。其实基玛尼并不觉得自己真的偷了这些东西。不是的，基玛尼只是把这些神器带回家里，送到真正该在的地方。在博物馆和保险公司的眼中，基玛尼是要捉拿归案的反派。但基玛尼向来更快、更机灵、干得更好。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，[[工具]]卡牌等级0-4，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：抓钩、特工弗莱彻、1张随机基础弱点。 额外经验值：剧本开始时你有额外5点经验值(这不影响你在单场冒险模式必须拿取的弱点数量)。
all_card.flavor: “这不是你的。”
all_card.name: 基玛尼·琼斯
all_card.text:
[free]：与你所在地点的一个已横置敌人交战。
[reaction]在你尝试躲避一个已横置的非[[精英]]敌人时：本次尝试将你的[intellect]加入你的技能值。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少X点，弃掉该敌人。X为该敌人剩余的生命值。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。如果你所在地点有已横置敌人，改为你自动成功。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When the Taíno artifacts went missing from the Miskatonic Museum, Kymani was hired to assess the museum's liability. Of course, Kymani already knew who the thief was - it has been their own heist, all along. But Kymani had no interest in selling the relics. As far as Kymani was concerned, they weren't the one who really stole them. No; Kymani had sent the historical artifacts back home, where they truly belonged. The museum and the insurance company see only a villain to catch, but Kymani is faster, smarter, and better.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, [[Tool]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Grappling Hook, Agent Fletcher, 1 random basic weakness. Bonus Experience: You begin the campaign with 5 additional experience (does not affect the number of weaknesses you must take in Standalone Mode).
all_card.real_flavor: "This doesn't belong to you."
all_card.real_text:
[fast]: Engage an exhausted enemy at your location.
[reaction] When you attempt to evade an exhausted non-[[Elite]] enemy: Add your [intellect] to your skill value for this attempt. If you succeed by at least X, discard that enemy. X is that enemy's remaining health.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If there is an exhausted enemy at your location, you automatically succeed instead.

all_card.name: 抓钩

基玛尼·琼斯牌库专用。
使用抓钩执行的行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
[action][action]横置抓钩：以任意顺序进行最多3个不同的下列基础行动(交战、躲避、调查或移动)。如果你调查，不使用[intellect]，改为使用[agility]。
all_card.real_text:
Kymani Jones deck only.
Actions performed using Grappling Hook do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[action][action] Exhaust Grappling Hook: Take up to 3 different basic actions from the following list, in any order (engage, evade, investigate, or move). If you investigate, use your [agility] instead of your [intellect].

all_card.flavor: “我知道你究竟是谁，琼斯。”
all_card.name: 特工弗莱彻
all_card.text: 警戒。猎手。 猎物 - 仅对基玛尼·琼斯。 基玛尼·琼斯躲避特工弗莱彻时，将其[intellect]降为0。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同志会. 侦探
all_card.real_flavor: "I know who you really are, Jones."
all_card.real_text: Alert. Hunter. Prey - Kymani Jones only. While Kymani Jones is evading Agent Fletcher, reduce their [intellect] value to 0.

all_card.back_flavor: 阿米娜是从法属阿尔及利亚逃出来的难民，她到阿卡姆的时候身无长物。六年后，阿米娜凭借自己的灵敏头脑和专业技术，在米斯卡塔尼克谷电话公司找到了接线员的活。不久，她在工作中捕捉到了一些奇怪的片段——一种未知语言的扭曲话语，不合常理的噪音，阵阵呼唤不知通往何处，又在一瞬间断线。怪声越来越频繁，阿米娜决定要寻求答案。她连上正确的分线，开始倾听。尽管她并不明白另一端的异星语言到底在说什么，但依然能感受到其中蕴含着真正的力量。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，[[守护]]卡牌等级0-4。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：受难真言、蒙福真言、骤然无声、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “它要告诉我什么？”
all_card.name: 阿米娜·齐达内
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你打出支援时：该支援资源费用降低3点。其带有1个毁灭标记入场。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以将你所在地点一张卡牌的所有的毁灭标记移动到你所在地点的另一张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A refugee from French-occupied Algeria, Amina arrived in Arkham with nothing more than she could carry. Six years later, Amina's sharp mind and technical skill placed her at the switchboard for the Miskatonic Valley Telephone Company. Soon after, she began to catch snippets of something strange while at work - distorted words in an unrecognizable language, out-of-place noises, calls that connected to nowhere at all and dropped almost immediately. As the phantom calls grew in frequency, Amina sought answers. She found the right extension, connected to the line, and listened in. Despite not understanding a word of the alien language on the other side, she could tell the eldritch words held real power.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Charm]] cards level 0-4. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Word of Woe, Word of Weal, Deafening Silence, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "What is it trying to tell me?"
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] When you play an asset: Reduce its resource cost by 3. It enters play with 1 doom on it. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may move all doom from a card at your location to another card at your location.

all_card.name: 受难真言
all_card.text: 阿米娜·齐达内牌库专用。 快速。只能在你回合期间打出。 在你控制的一个支援上放置1个毁灭标记，以结算该支援的一个[action]能力，忽略所有费用(包括其[action]费用)。然后，如果蒙福真言在你的弃牌堆，你可以将其洗入你的牌库。
all_card.real_text: Amina Zidane deck only. Fast. Play only during your turn. Place 1 doom on an asset you control to resolve an [action] ability on it, ignoring all costs (including its [action] cost). Then, if Word of Weal is in your discard pile, you may shuffle it into your deck.

all_card.flavor: "UNINTELLIGIBLE SQUIGGLES"
all_card.name: 骤然无声

all_card.real_flavor: I can hear you too, Amina.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Move 1 doom from an asset you control to the current agenda. This may cause the current agenda to advance. If no doom is moved in this way, shuffle Deafening Silence back into your deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 即便达雷尔在阿卡姆长大，他还是知道这座诡镇有什么不对劲。自打高中毕业，达雷尔就在阿卡姆报社工作。这么多年的摄影师当下来，他已经翻遍了城里的每一寸地方。在宿命般的一夜，他看到的东西确实无可名状——这份恐惧让他的世界天翻地覆。编辑说他只是看到了幻象，但达雷尔知道真相。达雷尔带着自己信任的相机，一定要拍下实据，证明恐怖寄居于自己家乡和彼端的阴影之中，在此之前他绝不停歇。他只要按对一次快门。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：达雷尔的柯达相机、胶卷损坏、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “真相比我们所知的更黑暗。”
all_card.name: 达雷尔·西蒙斯
all_card.text:
你以达雷尔的柯达相机在场上开始游戏。
[free]在你地点的技能检定期间，从你控制的支援上花费1证据：此次检定的难度降低2点。(每次检定仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。在你控制的一张支援上放置1证据。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Even while growing up in Arkham, Darrell always knew that there was something not quite right about the strange little town. After graduating from high school, he went to work for the Arkham Advertiser as a photographer, and in the years since, he's scoured every inch of the city. But on one fateful night, he saw something truly indescribable - a horror that shook his world to the core. His editor says he was just seeing things, but he knows the truth. With his trusty camera in tow, he will not rest until he has captured photographic evidence of the horrors that dwell in the shadows of his hometown and beyond. Just one good shot is all he needs.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Darrell's Kodak, Ruined Film, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "The truth is darker than any of us know."
all_card.real_text:
You begin the game with Darrell's Kodak in play.
[fast] During a skill test at your location, spend 1 evidence from an asset you control: Reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. (Limit once per test.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Place 1 evidence on an asset you control.

all_card.name: 达雷尔的柯达相机
all_card.text: 达雷尔·西蒙斯牌库专用。 [reaction]在敌人或诡计入场后，横置达雷尔的柯达相机：在该敌人或诡计上放置1个资源(从供应堆拿取)，作为证据。 [reaction]在你发现任意数量的线索后：在发现线索的地点(或不在任何地点)的敌人或诡计上，将相同数量的证据移动到达雷尔的柯达相机上。
all_card.real_text: Darrell Simmons deck only. [reaction] After an enemy or treachery enters play, exhaust Darrell's Kodak: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on that enemy or treachery, as evidence. [reaction] After you discover any number of clues: Move that many evidence on enemies or treacheries at that location (or not at any location) to Darrell's Kodak.

all_card.flavor: 无可辩驳的证据，一见阳光就化为无物。
all_card.name: 胶卷损坏
all_card.text: 显现 - 从你控制的所有卡牌上移除总计4证据。每有一个证据你不能以此方式移除，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: Irrefutable proof, reduced to nothing by the light of day.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Remove 4 evidence from cards you control. For each evidence you cannot remove in this way, take 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 查理·凯恩向阿卡姆的人民允诺一个更为安全的未来。他作出了不少承诺——减低税收、兴办学校、打击犯罪。总之，这是工作。虽然有些时候做的事情他并不骄傲，但查理总是为了崇高利益。他听到报告时，总把人民放在第一位。当然，他不会告诉别人。撒播恐慌对公众利益没有好处。再说，有谁会信呢？查理在镇里总有人脉。他只要打几个电话，组织起一支队伍，然后就去干活。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30 选择职阶：当构建牌库时，选择2个职阶([guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic]或[survivor])。 牌库构建选项：[[盟友]]卡牌等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，你所选职阶的卡牌等级0-2。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：邦妮·沃尔什、领袖重担、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “这事可以办。具体看条件。”
all_card.name: 查理·凯恩
all_card.text:
你拥有额外3个盟友槽位。
[free]在你执行的技能检定期间，横置一个你控制的[[盟友]]支援：本次检定，你得到+1技能值，且该[[盟友]]支援每有一个与此次检定类型相符的技能图标，额外+1技能值。
[elder_sign]效果：+3。重整一个你所在地点的[[盟友]]支援。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Charlie Kane promised the people of Arkham a safer future. He made a lot of promises - lower taxes, better schools, less crime. It was part of the job, after all. And although he sometimes had to do things he wasn't proud of, Charlie always did work for the greater good. So when he started hearing the reports, he put the people first. Of course, he couldn't tell anyone. Widespread panic would not serve the public good. Besides, who'd believe him? Still, Charlie has always had connections in town. So he made a few calls, put a task force together, and went to work.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Class Choices: At deck creation, choose 2 classes ([guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], or [survivor]). Deckbuilding Options: [[Ally]] cards level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards from your chosen classes level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Bonnie Walsh, Burden of Leadership, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "It can be arranged. It's just a matter of acceptable terms."
all_card.real_text:
You have 3 additional ally slots.
[fast] During a skill test you are performing, exhaust an [[Ally]] asset you control: For this test, you get +1 skill value, plus an additional +1 for each skill icon that [[Ally]] asset has that matches this test's type.
[elder_sign] effect: +3. Ready an [[Ally]] asset at your location.

all_card.flavor: “别忘了您晚上9点约了桑福德先生。需要为您预定月下美人的老位子吗？还有，您居然送了我手表作生日礼物。实在是太感谢了。”

all_card.real_flavor: "Don't forget you have a 9 p.m. appointment with Mr. Sanford. Shall I book your usual table at La Bella Luna? Also, you bought me a wristwatch for my birthday. Thank you very much."
all_card.real_text:
Charlie Kane deck only.

all_card.flavor: “我对自己说这是为了崇高利益。对吧，邦妮？”

all_card.real_text: Evade. Attempt to evade using [combat] instead of [agility]. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], attach Bolas to it. Attached enemy gets -1 evade value. Forced - After attached enemy moves: Exhaust it.

all_card.flavor: “举起手来！”
all_card.name: 强势破门
all_card.text:
检定[combat](1)。如果你检定成功，将强势破门附属到你的地点。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，在强势破门上放置1资源，作为迹象。
强势破门上每有1迹象，所附属地点的隐藏值降低1点。
all_card.traits: 洞察. 策略. 警察
all_card.real_flavor: "Let's see those hands!"
all_card.real_text:
Test [combat] (1). If you succeed, attach Breach the Door to your location with 1 resource on it for each point you succeeded by, as leads.
Reduce attached location's shroud by 1 for each lead on Breach the Door.

all_card.flavor: “会很疼的。”
all_card.name: 深度伤痛
all_card.text: 快速。在你使用[[近战]]支援成功攻击非[[精英]]敌人后打出。 将深度伤痛附属到被攻击敌人。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：对附属的敌人造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: This is gonna hurt.
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play after you successfully attack a non-[[Elite]] enemy using a [[Melee]] asset. Attach Grievous Wound to the attacked enemy. Forced - At the end of the round: Deal 1 damage to attached enemy.

all_card.flavor: “他们会买账吗？”“他们肯定会相信世界末日就要来了，凯恩先生。”
all_card.name: 励志演讲
all_card.text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员可以从手牌打出一张[[盟友]]支援，其费用-3。
all_card.real_flavor:
"Think they bought it?"
"They certainly do not suspect the world is ending, Mr. Kane."
all_card.real_text: Parley. Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator may play an [[Ally]] asset from their hand, reducing its cost by 3.

all_card.name: 还剩一枪
all_card.text:
快速。当花费你控制的[[枪械]]支援上最后子弹的攻击或效果结束时打出。
在该支援上增加1子弹。本轮你下次使用该支援攻击得到+3技能值。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play at the end of an attack or effect that spends the last ammo from a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
Add 1 ammo to that asset. You get +3 skill value for your next attack with that asset this round.

all_card.flavor: “先瞄准，再按下他妈的扳机。这一点都不难，孩子”
all_card.name: 战斗课程
all_card.text:
只能投入到攻击或躲避尝试期间的技能检定。
你能将本技能投入到任意地点调查员的检定。
all_card.real_flavor: "Aim and pull the damned trigger. It ain't hard, kid."
all_card.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test during an attack or evasion attempt.
You can commit this skill to an investigator's test at any location.

all_card.name: 援助之手
all_card.text:
你可以将援助之手投入任意类型的检定。每次检定最多投入1张。
援助之手投入到技能检定时，投入该检定的其他每张卡牌技能图标翻倍。
all_card.real_text:
You may commit Helping Hand to any type of test. Max 1 committed per test.
While Helping Hand is committed to a skill test, double the skill icons of each other card committed to that test.

all_card.name: 鼓舞决心
all_card.text:
使用(4充能)。
[free]你所在地点或连接地点的调查员执行的技能检定期间，花费1充能：从你手牌将一张非弱点卡牌投入该次技能检定，将其所有技能图标视为[wild]。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (4 charges).
[fast] During a skill test performed by an investigator at your location or a connecting location, spend 1 charge: Commit a non-weakness card from your hand to that skill test, treating all of its skill icons as [wild].

all_card.flavor: 第15天。那群东西看起来在进食。他们吃的是什么，我不敢想象。我也不敢再靠近了。
all_card.name: 外勤特工
all_card.text:
你得到+1[intellect]。
[free]横置外勤特工并对其造成1点恐惧：发现你所在地点的1个线索。
all_card.real_flavor: Day 15. The entities appear to be feeding. On what, I cannot imagine. I dare not approach further.
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[fast] Exhaust Field Agent and deal 1 horror to it: Discover 1 clue at your location.

all_card.name: 看门狗
all_card.text:
[free]横置看门狗：与你所在地点的一个敌人交战。该敌人攻击你。
[reaction]在敌人的攻击对看门狗造成伤害和/或恐惧时：对攻击的敌人造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: [fast] Exhaust Guard Dog: Engage an enemy at your location. That enemy attacks you. [reaction] When an enemy attack deals damage and/or horror to Guard Dog: Deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy. Card design by the Council-in-Exile at Arkham Nights 2020.

all_card.name: 手铐
all_card.text: 快速。 [action]如果手铐没有附属到敌人：躲避。只用于[[类人]]敌人。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[combat]。如果你检定成功，移除刚刚躲避的敌人所有的毁灭标记，并将手铐附属到该敌人。 如果附属的敌人非[[精英]]，其不能重整，也不能在其上放置毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Fast. [action] If Handcuffs is not attached to an enemy: Evade. Use only on a [[Humanoid]] enemy. This evasion attempt uses [combat] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, remove all doom from the just-evaded enemy and attach Handcuffs to it. If the attached enemy is non-[[Elite]], it cannot ready and doom cannot be placed on it.

all_card.name: 最坏的打算
all_card.text: 选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员查找其牌库顶9张卡牌，找出一张[[武器]]支援，将其加入自己手牌或打出(支付其资源费用)，并混洗其牌库。
all_card.real_text: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator search the top 9 cards of their deck for a [[Weapon]] asset, adds it to their hand or plays it (paying its resource cost), and shuffles their deck.

all_card.name: 殉道者护臂
all_card.text:
你结算遭遇卡牌的显现能力时得到+1技能值。
[reaction]你所在地点的其他调查员抽取非险境遭遇卡牌后，结算该卡牌的效果前，横置殉道者护臂：改为视为你抽取了该遭遇卡牌。
all_card.traits: 道具. 守护. 护甲
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 skill value while resolving revelation abilities on encounter cards.
[reaction] After another investigator at your location draws a non-peril encounter card, before resolving that card's effects, exhaust Martyr's Vambrace: You are considered to have drawn that encounter card, instead.

all_card.name: 吉里什·卡达贾
all_card.text:
你所在地点其他调查员受到的伤害和/或恐惧，可以分配给吉里什·卡达贾。
[free]你所在地点的调查员执行的技能检定期间，横置吉里什·卡达贾：该调查员本次检定得到技能值+2。如果本次检定成功，治愈吉里什·卡达贾的1点伤害或恐惧。
all_card.real_text:
Girish Kadakia may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
[fast] During a skill test being performed by an investigator at your location, exhaust Girish Kadakia: That investigator gets +2 skill value for this test. If this test is successful, heal 1 damage or horror from Girish Kadakia.

all_card.flavor: 不得不说，洛根这家伙对世界末日真的留了一手。
all_card.name: 时刻警惕
all_card.text: 你所在地点的调查员可以依次共同从自己手牌打出总计最多4张支援，每张资源费用减少1点。
all_card.real_flavor:
He had to give Logan credit:
the man knew how to gear up for Armageddon.
all_card.real_text: One at a time, investigators at your location, as a group, may play up to 4 assets in total from their hands, reducing the resource cost of each by 1.

"Don't you realize what this means?"
"Why don't you calm down and tell me very slowly?"

all_card.flavor: 可以瞧不着，不能想不到。
all_card.name: 逃生通道
all_card.text: 快速。在敌人攻击你时打出。 躲避。尝试躲避攻击的敌人。如果你检定成功，取消该敌人的攻击。
all_card.real_flavor: It's out of sight, but never out of mind.
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play when an enemy attacks you. Evade. Attempt to evade the attacking enemy. If you succeed, cancel that enemy's attack.

all_card.name: 风险精算
all_card.text: 每次技能检定最多投入1张。 只能在你的回合，投入你正在执行的任意类型的检定。 你本回合每执行一个行动(包括本行动)，风险精算获得1[wild]。 本次检定结束后，结束你的回合。
all_card.real_text: Max 1 committed per skill test. Commit only to a test you are performing of any type, and only if it is your turn. Calculated Risk gains [wild] for each action you performed this turn (including this one). After this test ends, end your turn.

all_card.flavor: “你说要时刻整装待发，才能达成目标。可万一我的目标是把你整下去呢？”
all_card.name: 时髦大衣
all_card.text: [reaction]你在自己回合期间通过另一张玩家卡牌的效果获得资源时，横置时髦大衣：获得额外1资源。
all_card.real_flavor: "Dress for the job you want, you say. What if the job I want is yours?"
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you gain 1 or more resources during your turn via another player card effect, exhaust Stylish Coat: Gain 1 additional resource.

all_card.name: 查克·费格斯
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你打出一张[[策略]]或[[技巧]]事件时，横置查克·费格斯：选择一项——
- 该事件获得快速。
- 该事件打出的资源费用减少2点。
- 你在该事件的结算期间执行技能检定时，得到技能值+2。
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] When you play a [[Tactic]] or [[Trick]] event, exhaust Chuck Fergus: Choose one -
- That event gains fast.
- That event costs 2 fewer resources to play.
- You get +2 skill value while performing a skill test during the resolution of that event.

all_card.name: 痛下黑手
all_card.text:
每位调查员仅限1张。
在攻击、谈判，或尝试躲避已横置的敌人时，你得到+2技能值。
[reaction]在你躲避一个敌人后，横置痛下黑手：对该敌人进行一次攻击行动。本次攻击忽略冷漠关键词。
all_card.traits: 才能. 技巧. 违法
all_card.real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
While attacking, parleying, or attempting to evade an exhausted enemy, you get +2 skill value.
[reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Dirty Fighting: Take a fight action against that enemy. Ignore the aloof keyword for this attack.

all_card.flavor: 要是你小心点，这就只是一次“进入”。
all_card.name: 破门而入
all_card.text: 调查。本次调查将你的[agility]值加入你的技能值。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少1点，你可以自动躲避本地点的一个敌人。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少3点，当你回合结束时将破门而入返回你的手牌。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
all_card.real_flavor: If you're careful, it's just "entering."
all_card.real_text: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you succeed by 1 or more, you may automatically evade an enemy at this location. If you succeed by 3 or more, return Breaking and Entering to your hand at the end of your turn. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

all_card.flavor: “……噢，好了，是我的了。”
all_card.name: 扒手行窃工具
all_card.text: 使用(6补给)。 [action]花费1补给：调查。本次调查你可以不使用[intellect]，改为使用[agility]，且你得到+1技能值。如果你检定成功，获得1资源(如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，改为2资源)。
all_card.traits: 道具. 工具. 违法
all_card.real_flavor: "...okay, fine, they're mine."
all_card.real_text: Uses (6 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Investigate. For this investigation, you may use [agility] instead of [intellect], and you get +1 skill value. If you succeed, gain 1 resource (2 resources instead if you succeed by 2 or more).

all_card.name: 职业枪手
all_card.text: [reaction]在职业枪手入场后：将你手牌中一张[[违法]]支援附属到职业枪手(其视为在场，由你控制)。 [free]横置职业枪手并花费1资源：结算附属支援上的一个[action]能力，不支付其[action]费用。以基础技能值为4结算该能力。
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After Trigger Man enters play: Attach an [[Illicit]] asset from your hand to Trigger Man (it is considered to be in play and under your control). [fast] Exhaust Trigger Man and spend 1 resource: Resolve an [action] ability on attached asset, without paying its [action] cost. Resolve that ability with a base skill value of 4.

all_card.name: 地下市场
all_card.text:
永久。卓越。你得到牌库卡牌张数+10。
[reaction]你在抽取起始手牌前，选择自己牌库里的10张[[违法]]卡牌：将其混洗，放在地下市场旁，作为你的市场牌库。
[reaction]当你回合开始时：揭示你市场牌库顶的2张卡牌。你可以花费1资源以抽取其中1张。将其余卡牌以任意顺序放回市场牌库底。
all_card.real_text:
Permanent. Exceptional. You get +10 deck size.
[reaction] Before drawing your opening hand, choose 10 [[Illicit]] cards from your deck: Shuffle them together and place them next to Underworld Market, as your market deck.
[reaction] At the start of your turn: Reveal the top 2 cards of your market deck. You may spend 1 resource to draw 1 of them. Place the rest on the bottom, in any order.

all_card.name: 全身而退
all_card.text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
你所在地点每有一个横置的非蜂拥敌人，选择一个不同的选项：
- 获得2资源。
- 对该敌人造成2点伤害。
- 发现你所在地点的1个线索。
- 抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
For each exhausted non-swarm enemy at your location, choose a different option:
- Gain 2 resources.
- Deal 2 damage to that enemy.
- Discover 1 clue at your location.
- Draw 1 card.

all_card.real_text:

all_card.flavor: 你出港的时候，印斯茅斯码头的水手狐疑地望着你。你深入重重迷雾，唯有附近悬崖顶的灯塔还有一丝光亮。
all_card.name: 大海的秘密(版本一)
all_card.text: 你不在载具上时，作为在[[海洋]]地点间移动的额外费用，你必须花费2行动。 强制 - 在你回合开始时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过载具、未淹没或部分淹没的地点，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: The sailors along the docks of Innsmouth eye you with suspicion as you depart. The lighthouse beacon at the top of the nearby cliffside provides your only illumination as you head deeper into the fog.
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost for you to move from one [[Ocean]] location to another while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded location, partially flooded location, or a vehicle during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.flavor: “它抓住我们了！但它也动不了了！你该上了！”
all_card.name: 魔鬼礁石的骇物
all_card.text: 生成 - 渔船所在地点。 猎手。庞大。反击。 魔鬼礁石的骇物不能进入[[洞穴]]地点。 魔鬼礁石的骇物得到+3[per_investigator]生命值。
all_card.real_flavor: "It's got us in its grip! It ain't goin' nowhere. Now's your chance!"
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Fishing Vessel's location. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. The Terror of Devil Reef cannot enter [[Cave]] locations. The Terror of Devil Reef gets +3 [per_investigator] health.

all_card.back_flavor:
“咱们得撤了！”摩尔船长的叫喊盖过了浪涛的怒吼，“浪太大了！这潮每分钟都越来越猛！再多待会儿，咱们肯定要翻船了！”
你表示抗议，但船长是对的。天气这么坏，摩尔船长就要控制不住船了。更糟的是，要不了几个小时，潮水就会吞没整个沿海一带，你也没什么好调查的了。你沮丧地朝船长点了点头。现在只能如此。
all_card.back_text: 在剧本日志中，记录浪潮愈烈。 (→结局1)
all_card.flavor: 现在你知道为什么没人敢靠近这片黑色的礁石了。不仅是因为岛礁上的奇怪景象——在浪涛之下，潜居着更为古老、更为可怕的东西……
all_card.name: 深海的魔鬼
all_card.text: 你不在载具上时，作为在[[海洋]]地点间移动的额外费用，你必须花费2行动。 强制 - 在你回合开始时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过载具、未淹没或部分淹没的地点，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"We've gotta pull back!" Mr. Moore shouts over the roar of the waves. "The sea's too rough, and the tide's gettin' worse by the minute! Stay out here any longer an' we'll capsize fer sure!"
You protest, but the captain is right. The weather has gotten so bad Mr. Moore can barely control the ship. Worse yet, in just a matter of hours the tide has begun to swallow the coastal islands, leaving little for you to investigate. You nod to the captain, frustrated. This will have to do for now.
all_card.real_back_text: Record in your Campaign Log the tide has grown stronger. (→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: Now you know why none dare venture near the black reefs. It's not just the strange sightings on the islands - there is something far older and more horrifying that dwells under the waves...
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost for you to move from one [[Ocean]] location to another while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded location, partially flooded location, or a vehicle during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 你觉得自己已经找到足够多的密教活动的证据，回到了海岸上。你还是宁可在干燥的地面调查。
all_card.flavor: 在这片受诅的礁石某处，达贡密教想要隐藏什么大事……但究竟是什么呢？
all_card.name: 谜之礁石
all_card.text: [[伊哈·恩斯雷]]地点的钥匙只能通过其地点的[free]能力获取。 目标 - 尽可能多地从[[伊哈·恩斯雷]]地点找到并获取下列钥匙(紫色、白色和黑色)。如果你控制全部3把这些钥匙，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Confident that you've found enough evidence of the Order's activities, you head back to the coast. You'd much rather continue your investigation on dry land.
all_card.real_flavor: Somewhere in these accursed reefs, the Esoteric Order of Dagon is hiding something big... but what?
all_card.real_text: Keys can only be claimed from [[Y'ha-nthlei]] locations using the [fast] ability on those locations. Objective - Find and claim as many of the following keys as you can from [[Y'ha-nthlei]] locations (purple, white, and black). If you control all 3 of these keys, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: “尽管此时正值涨潮，我却还是能在沓远的海面上瞥见一条黑色长线，只略高过水面，潜藏着一种怪异的危险气息。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 急涡水域以完全淹没入场(即使其未揭示)。
all_card.name: 急涡水域
all_card.text: [action]如果你在渔船上：撤退。渔船上的每位调查员撤退。将渔船从游戏中移除。每位撤退的调查员将其每个紫色、黑色或白色钥匙放在当前场景上。其他每位调查员被抛下，自力更生。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "And far out at sea, despite a high tide, I glimpsed a long, black line scarcely rising above the water yet carrying a suggestion of odd latent malignancy." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth

Each resigning investigator places each of their purple, black, or white keys on the current act. All other investigators are left to fend for themselves.

all_card.name: 渔船
all_card.text:
载具。
你在本载具时，将你的地点视为如同未淹没。
[action]：将渔船移动到一个连接的[[海洋]]地点。
all_card.real_text:
Vehicle.
While you are in this vehicle, treat your location as if it were unflooded.
[action]: Move Fishing Vessel to a connecting [[Ocean]] location.

all_card.name: 浪蚀偶像
all_card.text: [reaction]你所在地点的淹没等级变化后，或有[[深潜者]]敌人生成在你所在地点后，横置浪蚀偶像：立即进行一个行动，如同在你的回合(该行动不计入你每回合可以进行的行动数)。
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After your location's flood level changes, or after a [[Deep One]] enemy spawns at your location, exhaust Waveworn Idol: Immediately take an action as if it were your turn (this action does not count toward the number of actions you can take each turn).

all_card.name: 觉醒斗篷
all_card.text: [free] 如果你位于淹没地点，横置觉醒斗篷：移动到一个淹没的连接地点。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 服装
all_card.real_text: [fast] If your location is flooded, exhaust Awakened Mantle: Move to a connecting location that is also flooded.

all_card.name: 伊哈·恩斯雷的头冠
all_card.text: 你调查淹没地点时，以及攻击或躲避位于淹没地点的敌人时，得到能力值+1。
all_card.real_text: You get +1 skill value while investigating a flooded location or while attacking or evading an enemy at a flooded location.

all_card.name: 掠食的深潜者
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 掠食的深潜者与你交战后：将你的1个线索或钥匙移动到掠食的深潜者上。 强制 - 在你击败或躲避掠食的深潜者时：控制其所有的线索和钥匙。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 深潜者
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - After Deep One Predator engages you: Move 1 of your clues or keys to Deep One Predator. Forced - When you defeat or evade Deep One Predator: Take control of all of its clues and keys.

all_card.name: 追猎的深潜者
all_card.text: 猎手。 追猎的深潜者与你交战时，你不能进入载具或获得资源。 强制 - 追猎的深潜者与你交战后：如果你不在载具上，失去2资源。如果你在载具上，离开你的载具。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 深潜者
all_card.real_text: Hunter. While Hunting Deep One is engaged with you, you cannot enter vehicles or gain resources. Forced - After Hunting Deep One engages you: If you are not in a vehicle, lose 2 resources. If you are in a vehicle, leave your vehicle.

all_card.flavor: “你看见那个了吗？”
all_card.name: 水中身影
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。如果你所在地点已淹没，本次检定难度+1(如果你所在地点完全淹没，改为难度+2)。
all_card.real_flavor: "Did you see that?"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, take 2 horror. This test gets +1 difficulty if your location is flooded (+2 difficulty instead if it is fully flooded).

all_card.name: 伏兵出水
all_card.text: 显现 - 将伏兵出水放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 强制 - 在你攻击淹没地点的敌人时，揭示混乱标记时：再揭示一个混乱标记。(每次检定最多一次。) 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从场上弃掉1张伏兵出水。(每轮最多一次。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Aquatic Ambush into play next to the agenda deck. Forced - When you reveal a chaos token while attacking an enemy at a flooded location: Reveal an additional chaos token. (Max once per test.) Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Aquatic Ambush from play. (Max once per round.)

all_card.name: 深海恐惧
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](2)。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。如果你所在地点已淹没，本次检定难度+1(如果你所在地点完全淹没，改为难度+2)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). If you fail, take 2 damage. This test gets +1 difficulty if your location is flooded (+2 difficulty instead if it is fully flooded).

all_card.name: 偷偷上船
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果没有调查员在载具上，偷偷上船获得涌动。否则，每位载具上的调查员必须受到1点伤害和1点恐惧，或离开该载具。每位离开载具的调查员不能再进入该载具，直到本轮结束。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If no investigators are in a vehicle, Stowaway gains surge. Otherwise, each investigator in a vehicle must either take 1 damage and 1 horror or leave that vehicle. Each investigator who left a vehicle cannot enter that vehicle for the remainder of the round.

all_card.name: 拖入水底
all_card.text: 显现 - 将拖入水底放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。如果你在载具上，离开该载具。 你不能进入载具。 [action]：检定[combat](3)或[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉拖入水底。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Dragged Under into play in your threat area. If you are in a vehicle, leave it. You cannot enter vehicles. [action]: Test [combat] (3) or [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Dragged Under.

all_card.name: 附魔护甲
all_card.text: 打出附魔护甲，置于你所在地点任意一位调查员控制之下。 强制 - 伤害和/或恐惧放置到附魔护甲后：附魔护甲的所有者检定[willpower](X)，其中X为附魔护甲上的伤害与恐惧总值。如果检定失败，弃掉附魔护甲并将刚刚放置在上面的伤害和/或恐惧分配到别处。
all_card.real_text: Play Enchanted Armor under the control of any investigator at your location. Forced - After damage and/or horror is placed on Enchanted Armor: The owner of Enchanted Armor tests [willpower] (X), where X is the total amount of damage and horror on it. If the test fails, discard Enchanted Armor and assign the damage and/or horror just placed on it elsewhere.

all_card.name: 伊西斯的祝福
all_card.text: [reaction]在你所在地点进行的单次技能检定期间，揭示第二个[bless]标记时，横置伊西斯的祝福：取消该标记，改为视作如同[elder_sign]标记。本次检定结束后，将这两个[bless]标记都返回混乱袋。
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When a second [bless] token is revealed during a single skill test at your location, exhaust Blessing of Isis: Cancel that token and treat it as if it were a [elder_sign] token instead. Return both of those tokens to the chaos bag after this test ends.

all_card.text:
研究完成。
[reaction]你在技能检定期间结算了1个或多个[curse]标记后：将同等数量的秘密放置在神秘魔法书上。
[reaction]你在自己回合期间打出[[洞察]]事件时，花费2秘密：该事件获得快速。其费用减少1。
all_card.traits: 道具. 书籍. 诅咒萦绕
all_card.real_text:
Researched.
[reaction] After you resolve 1 or more [curse] tokens during a skill test: Place that many secrets on Cryptic Grimoire.
[reaction] When you play an [[Insight]] event during your turn, spend 2 secrets: That event gains fast. Reduce its cost by 1.

all_card.name: 神秘魔法书
all_card.text:
研究完成。
[reaction]你在技能检定期间结算了1个或多个[curse]标记后：将同等数量的秘密放置在神秘魔法书上。
[reaction]在你将要抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌时，花费5秘密：改为从你的牌库抽取一张卡牌。
all_card.traits: 道具. 书籍. 祝福
all_card.real_text:
Researched.
[reaction] After you resolve 1 or more [curse] tokens during a skill test: Place that many secrets on Cryptic Grimoire.
[reaction] When you would draw the top card of the encounter deck, spend 5 secrets: Draw a card from your deck instead.

all_card.name: 狂怒畸变
all_card.text: 攻击。在你发动本次攻击时，在混乱袋中加入最多3个[curse]标记。每以此方式在混乱袋中加入一个[curse]标记，你本次攻击得到+1[combat]并造成+1伤害。
all_card.traits: 法术. 勇气. 诅咒萦绕
all_card.real_text: Fight. When you initiate this attack, add up to 3 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag. For each [curse] token added to the chaos bag in this way, you get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

all_card.flavor: “万事不同了，维托。”
all_card.name: 崔斯丹·波特雷
all_card.text:
[reaction]你的回合开始后：选择两项技能。直到你下个回合开始，这些技能你得到每项+1。
[reaction]任意揭示了总计至少3个[curse]或[bless]标记的技能检定结束后：从你的手牌中免费打出崔斯丹·波特雷。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 罪犯. 诅咒萦绕
all_card.real_flavor: "Nothin's ever gonna be the same, Vito."
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] After your turn begins: Choose two skills. Until the start of your next turn, you get +1 to each of those skills.
[reaction] After any skill test ends in which a total of 3 or more [curse] or [bless] tokens were revealed: Play Tristan Botley from your hand, at no cost.

all_card.name: 万古诅咒
all_card.text: [reaction]在你所在地点进行的单次技能检定期间，揭示第二个[curse]标记时，横置万古诅咒：取消该标记，改为视作如同[skull]标记。本次检定结束后，你可以选择将这两个[curse]标记都从混乱袋移除。
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When a second [curse] token is revealed during a single skill test at your location, exhaust Curse of Aeons: Cancel that token and treat it as if it were a [skull] token instead. You may choose to remove both of those tokens from the chaos bag after the test ends.

all_card.name: 不屈不挠
all_card.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你将不屈不挠投入到技能检定后，查找混乱袋，找出你选择的最多3个非[auto_fail]混乱标记，将其封印在不屈不挠上。如果不屈不挠上封印的全部3个标记都是“+1”、“0”、[bless]和/或[elder_sign]标记，抽取2张卡牌。本次检定结束后，释放此处封印的所有标记。
all_card.real_text:
Max 1 committed per test.
After you commit Unrelenting to a skill test, search the chaos bag for up to 3 non-[auto_fail] chaos tokens of your choice, and seal them on Unrelenting. If all 3 tokens sealed on Unrelenting are "+1,", "0," [bless], and/or [elder_sign] tokens, draw 2 cards. Release all tokens sealed here after this test ends.

all_card.name: 十字圣号
all_card.text:
只能投入你正在执行，且难度高于你基础技能值的技能检定。
你投入十字圣号到技能检定后，在混乱袋中加入X个[bless]标记。X为本次检定难度和你基础技能值的差距。
all_card.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing, and only if the difficulty of that test is higher than your base skill value.
After you commit Signum Crucis to a skill test, add X [bless] tokens to the chaos bag. X is the difference between the test's difficulty and your base skill value.
