all_card.flavor: 在你前往猎鹰岬的路上，密教的使徒伏击了你！
all_card.name: 追逐开始！(版本一)
all_card.text: 你不在载具上时，作为移动的额外费用，你必须花费2行动。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从最后方的地点开始，将每个没有载具、敌人和调查员的地点放在一边，位于场外(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其放入胜利区)。在到达有载具、敌人或调查员的地点时；或在最后方的调查员后方一个地点停下。
all_card.real_flavor: On your way to Falcon Point, you are ambushed by agents of the Order!
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost for you to move while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - At the end of the round: Starting with the rearmost location, set each location with no vehicles, enemies, or investigators aside, out of play (or add it to the victory display if it has Victory X and has no clues on it). Stop when you reach a location with at least 1 vehicle, enemy, or investigator; or the location behind the rearmost investigator.

all_card.name: 魔鬼礁石的骇物
all_card.text: 生成 - 最后方的地点。 猎手。庞大。反击。 强制 - 在魔鬼礁石的骇物将要被击败时：改为移除其所有伤害并将其横置。它本轮剩余时间内不能重整。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Rearmost location. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Forced - When The Terror of Devil Reef would be defeated: Instead, remove all damage from it and exhaust it. It cannot ready for the remainder of the round.

all_card.back_flavor: 你还在想自己是不是能毫发未损地逃脱，就在这时，你听见了引擎不堪重负的噼啪声，大事不妙。你骂了一句，赶在车彻底抛锚前停了下来。异教徒紧追其后，你只有几秒钟的时间来重新启动引擎！
all_card.back_text:
将每个正在运行的载具翻面，使其停止。
将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。如果游戏中有3或4位调查员，从遭遇牌库顶弃牌，直到弃掉一张[[载具]]敌人或机械故障诡计。调查员队长抽取该卡牌。
all_card.flavor: 在你前往猎鹰岬的路上，密教的使徒伏击了你！
all_card.name: 追逐开始！(版本二)
all_card.text: 你不在载具上时，作为移动的额外费用，你必须花费2行动。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从最后方的地点开始，将每个没有载具、敌人和调查员的地点放在一边，位于场外(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其放入胜利区)。在到达有载具、敌人或调查员的地点时；或在最后方的调查员后方一个地点停下。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Just as you think you might be able to escape unscathed, you hear the telltale sputtering of your engine struggling to keep up with your demands. You curse and briefly stop your car before it stalls. You have only seconds to get it started again before the cultists catch up to you!
all_card.real_back_text:
Flip over each vehicle that is running, so that it is stopped.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. If there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Vehicle]] enemy or Malfunction treachery is discarded. The lead investigator draws that card.
all_card.real_flavor: On your way to Falcon Point, you are ambushed by agents of the Order!
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost for you to move while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - At the end of the round: Starting with the rearmost location, set each location with no vehicles, enemies, or investigators aside, out of play (or add it to the victory display if it has Victory X and has no clues on it). Stop when you reach a location with at least 1 vehicle, enemy, or investigator; or the location behind the rearmost investigator.

all_card.back_flavor:
东方的树林开始破晓，然而在背后无情追兵的重重阻扰之下，你这会儿还没到猎鹰岬。但你的车已经开始晃动卡顿了。你知道再有几分钟燃料就要用完，但你别无选择。他们就要抓住你了。你又踩下油门——
一个急弯让你措手不及。你试着剎车，但为时已晚。车轮飘离地面，一阵失重感传来。时间都变缓了。接着就是一阵混沌向你袭来。
你再有意识的时候，正从废车中爬出。你鲜血淋漓，浑身淤伤，但还活着。塞翁失马的是，追兵径直开过了你出事故的地方。“下次还是我来开吧。”哈珀特工在咳嗽间还开着玩笑。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 密教杀红了眼！
all_card.name: 热力追踪
all_card.text: 你不在载具上时，作为移动的额外费用，你必须花费2行动。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从最后方的地点开始，将每个没有载具、敌人和调查员的地点放在一边，位于场外(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其放入胜利区)。在到达有载具、敌人或调查员的地点时；或在最后方的调查员后方一个地点停下。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Day is starting to break through the trees to the east, and thanks to the interference of your relentless pursuers, you still haven't made it to Falcon Point. Your car has begun to shake and stutter. You know it is only a matter of minutes before it runs out of fuel, but you have no choice. They've almost caught up to you. You force the accelerator down - 
The turn catches you by surprise. You try to skid to a halt, but it's too late. There is a brief feeling of weightlessness as the wheels leave the ground. Time slows to a crawl. Then, a whirlwind of chaos erupts around you.
The next thing you know, you are crawling out of the wreckage. You are bloody and bruised, but alive. And by some twist of fortune, your pursuers have driven past the spot of your accident. "Next time, I'm driving," Agent Harper jokes between fits of coughing.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: The Order is out for blood!
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost for you to move while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - At the end of the round: Starting with the rearmost location, set each location with no vehicles, enemies, or investigators aside, out of play (or add it to the victory display if it has Victory X and has no clues on it). Stop when you reach a location with at least 1 vehicle, enemy, or investigator; or the location behind the rearmost investigator.

all_card.back_flavor:
“我觉得我们终于把他们甩掉了！”哈珀特工把头伸出车窗外叫道。你望着后视镜，确信再也看不到追兵闪亮的车灯。一阵温暖的惬意鼓动你的全身。终于结束了。
目前如此。
all_card.flavor: 你必须赶在被追兵抓住之前到达猎鹰岬，这是你唯一的机会。
all_card.name: 油门踩死
all_card.text: 每个敌人获得猎手。 强制 - 当每个调查阶段结束时：每个运行的载具必须在其司机的选择下移动到一个连接的[[道路]]地点。 目标 - 尽快开到猎鹰岬！(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"I think we've lost them!" Agent Harper shouts, peeking her head out of your car's window. You glance at your rearview mirror and confirm that you no longer see the glaring headlights of your pursuers. Warm relief flutters through you. It's finally over.
For now.
all_card.real_flavor: Your only chance is to reach Falcon Point before your pursuers catch up to you.
all_card.real_text: Each enemy gains hunter. Forced - At the end of each investigation phase: Each vehicle that is running must move to a connecting [[Road]] location of the driver's choice. Objective - Drive to Falcon Point as fast as you can! (You will be instructed when to advance.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你穿行在衰败的街道，潮水也渐渐涨起。你听到前面有人传来痛苦的尖叫，血液为之凝固。这时你看见了那群怪物在十字路口游荡，你躲进一座废墟破损的门廊。它们反常的步履，咕呱的叫喊都吓得你不住颤抖。尽管它们蹼足拍地的声音已经远去消逝，你还是觉得它们肯定会找到你的。
all_card.back_text:
提升每个[[海岸]]地点的淹没等级。
将每张放在一边的深海劫掠者、年幼的深潜者敌人，和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: “那一刻我的计划全变了——要是我面前通往南边的公路已封锁，那我肯定就要另找一条路离开印斯茅斯。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 路障重重
all_card.text: 每个[[嫌犯]]敌人失去冷漠，并且不能与之谈判。 强制 - 在你回合结束时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点：受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The tide creeps in as you make your way through the decrepit streets. You hear the blood-curdling cries of someone in agony up ahead. The moment you see the creatures patrolling the intersection, you hide in the broken-down doorway of a ruined building. Their unusual gait and croaking voices send shivers through your body. Even as the slapping of their webbed feet against the road fades into the distance, you cannot escape the feeling that, inevitably, they will find you.
all_card.real_back_text:
Increase the flood level of each [[Coastal]] location.
Shuffle each set-aside Ravager from the Deep and Young Deep One enemy into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: "In a second all my plans were utterly changed - for if the southward highway were blocked ahead of me, I must clearly find another egress from Innsmouth." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy loses aloof and cannot be parleyed with. Forced - When your turn ends, if you are at a fully flooded location: Take 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor:
村镇广场上挤满了人。起初你还松了口气，因为这帮人脸上没有长出丑陋的怪物样子：异常鼓胀的眼睛；长满参差尖牙的宽嘴；鱼鳃、鱼鳍和手上的膜——这一切都是鱼类的特征，绝非人类。但你随即听到一个声音盖过喧嚣，把你的心冻成了冰。
“时候已到！达贡密教下了命令！干掉外来者和挡路的，你们都会得到奖赏！你们都将再造，共享深海的财富！”一个披着长袍的人叫道。这群乌合之众陷入了恣意的狂欢。
all_card.back_text:
提升每个[[城中]]地点的淹没等级。
将放在一边的愤怒暴民生成在印斯茅斯广场。
从放在一边正面朝下的钥匙中随机选择1个，放到愤怒暴民上，不要查看。
all_card.flavor: “它并未发现我，只是遵照着一个泛泛的计划想要切断我逃跑的道路。但这也意味着所有离开印斯茅斯的道路都会有类似的巡逻路线……”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 无情浪潮
all_card.text: 每个[[嫌犯]]敌人失去冷漠，并且不能与之谈判。 强制 - 在你回合结束时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点：受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A crowd gathers in the town square. At first you are relieved to see faces not bearing hideous, monstrous features: the prodigious, bulging eyes; wide jaws filled with sharp, jagged teeth; the gills, fins and webbings that suggest something fish-like and inhuman. Then you hear one voice rise above the din, and your heart turns to ice.
"The time is nigh! The Order of Dagon commands you! Slay the outsiders and any who stand in our way, and you shall be rewarded! You shall be remade and share in the riches of the deep!" a robed man shouts. The crowd rejoices in jubilant madness.
all_card.real_back_text:
Increase the flood level of each [[Midtown]] location.
Spawn the set-aside Angry Mob at Innsmouth Square. Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on Angry Mob without looking at it.
all_card.real_flavor: "It had not seen me, but was simply obeying a general plan of cutting off my escape. This, however, implied that all roads leading out of Innsmouth were similarly patrolled..." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy loses aloof and cannot be parleyed with. Forced - When your turn ends, if you are at a fully flooded location: Take 1 damage and 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 马奴赛特河破溢而出，浪潮越涨越高。很快街道就都被淹没了。洪水席卷了路上的一切，撞翻了车辆，冲毁了摇摇欲坠的房屋，也切断了求生之路。要是这种情况继续下去，印斯茅斯很快就什么都不剩了。
all_card.back_text:
提升每个地点的淹没等级。
按玩家顺序，每位调查员抽取1张遭遇卡牌。
all_card.flavor: “在我查看的时候——鱼腥味在减弱之后又陡然浓厚了起来，令人窒息——我看到一群笨拙匍匐的身影朝着同一个方向大步蹒跚……”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 水漫街道
all_card.text: 每个[[嫌犯]]敌人失去冷漠，并且不能与之谈判。 强制 - 在你回合结束时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点：受到1点伤害和1点恐惧，并随机弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Manuxet River spills over as the tide rolls in higher and higher. Soon the streets are overflowing. The waves engulf anything and everything in their way, turning over vehicles, smashing through ramshackle houses, and cutting off escape routes. If this goes on much longer, there will be nothing left of the town of Innsmouth.
all_card.real_back_text:
Increase the flood level of each location.
In player order, each investigator draws 1 encounter card.
all_card.real_flavor: "As I watched - choked by a sudden rise in the fishy odour after a short abatement - I saw a band of uncouth, crouching shapes loping and shambling in the same direction..." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy loses aloof and cannot be parleyed with. Forced - When your turn ends, if you are at a fully flooded location: Take 1 damage, 1 horror, and discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 水流冲毁了整个城镇。建筑垮塌，街道淹没，每座桥梁都被摧毁。就连精炼厂也在涌现的水流下毁为石砾。很快，印斯茅斯已不复存在。你九死一生，从狂怒的海水中逃脱。
all_card.back_text: 在剧本日志中，记录印斯茅斯被怒潮吞没。 每位没有撤退的调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: “我所能想象的一切——一切，哪怕我从最字面的意思去总结理解老扎多克所说的疯狂故事——都不能和我所看到的——或者我以为自己看到的——邪恶亵渎的现实相比。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 深海之怒
all_card.text: 每个[[嫌犯]]敌人失去冷漠，并且不能与之谈判。 强制 - 在你回合结束时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点：受到1点伤害和1点恐惧，并随机弃掉你2张手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Water rushes through the town. The waves crash through dilapidated buildings, consume the streets, and destroy every standing bridge. Even the refinery is turned to rubble by the surging waters. Soon, Innsmouth is gone. You barely escape the raging sea.
all_card.real_back_text: In your Campaign Log, record Innsmouth was consumed by the rising tide. Each investigator that has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: "Nothing that I could have imagined - nothing, even, that I could have gathered had I credited old Zadok's crazy tale in the most literal way - would be in any way comparable to the demoniac, blasphemous reality that I saw - or believe I saw." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy loses aloof and cannot be parleyed with. Forced - When your turn ends, if you are at a fully flooded location: Take 1 damage, 1 horror, and discard 2 cards at random from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 在几个小时的逃跑、匿踪和躲藏之后，你终于赶到了印斯茅斯村西头废弃的火车站。你看到铁轨旁停着的两辆汽车，狂奔起来。能把这倒霉地方抛在身后，你真是高兴极了。
all_card.back_text: 在剧本日志中，记录下调查员安全爬上载具。 (→结局1)
all_card.flavor: 非人怪物在街上巡逻，狩猎你和更多你这样的人。你必须找到路前往村子另一头逃走……但要是你深入探索印斯茅斯，兴许你能找回自己更多的记忆？
all_card.name: 穿越迷宫
all_card.text: [free]共同花费1[per_investigator]+1个线索：移除你所在地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。 目标 - 到达火车站！如果所有幸存的调查员都撤退，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: After hours of fleeing, sneaking, and hiding, you finally reach the abandoned railway station on the western edge of Innsmouth. The moment you see the two automobiles parked by the tracks, you break into a run. You're more than happy to leave this awful place behind.
all_card.real_back_text: In your Campaign Log, record the investigators made it safely to their vehicles. (→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: Inhuman creatures patrol the streets of Innsmouth, hunting for you and more of your kind. You must make your way to the other end of town and escape... but perhaps more of your memories can be recovered if you explore the town of Innsmouth further?
all_card.real_text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] +1 clues, as a group: Remove 1 barrier between your location and a connecting location. Objective - Get to the Railroad Station! If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 几个村民聚集在村北边达贡密教老旧的圣堂门前。他们疯狂的叫喊响彻街巷。基于哈珀特工告诉你的信息，你知道密教和这些怪事有关……但究竟是什么关系呢？
all_card.name: 达贡密教
all_card.text: 强制 - 本地点揭示后：从放在一边正面朝下的钥匙中随机选择1个，放到本地点上，不要查看。 [action][action]：谈判。检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，移除本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Some of the townsfolk are gathered in front of the old Order of Dagon hall on the north side of town. Their crazed shouts echo through the streets. Based on what Agent Harper has told you, you know that the Order has something to do with these strange happenings... but what?
all_card.real_text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on this location without looking at it. [action][action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.

all_card.back_flavor: 心脏脆弱就别到锯骨巷去。不过你若是知道了村子的秘密，要记得幸运总是眷顾胆大的。
all_card.name: 锯骨巷
all_card.text: [action]：谈判。检定[willpower](1[per_investigator])。如果你检定成功，移除本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。 [free]如果调查员共同控制了7个钥匙：谈判。阅读剧本手册的记忆闪回VII。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Sawbone Alley is not for the faint of heart, but if you think you know the town's secrets, fortune favors the bold.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (1 [per_investigator]). If you succeed, remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location. [fast] If the investigators control 7 keys, as a group: Parley. Read Flashback VII in the Campaign Guide.

all_card.back_flavor: 贫民窟里挤满了人，他们都在这待了一辈子。此处是打听村里关键信息的绝佳之地。
all_card.name: 朝岸贫民窟
all_card.text: 强制 - 本地点揭示后：从放在一边正面朝下的钥匙中随机选择1个，放到本地点上，不要查看。 [free]受到1点伤害：谈判。移除本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。
all_card.traits: 印斯茅斯. 海岸. 城中
all_card.real_back_flavor: Full of lifelong inhabitants, the slums could be a good place to glean key information about the state of the town.
all_card.back_traits: 印斯茅斯. 海岸. 城中
all_card.real_text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on this location without looking at it. [fast] Take 1 damage: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.

all_card.back_flavor: 这座破旧的老屋显然已经荒废，没有上锁，有一种奇怪的吸引力。
all_card.name: 水街老屋
all_card.text: 强制 - 本地点揭示后：从放在一边正面朝下的钥匙中随机选择1个，放到本地点上，不要查看。 [free]选择并弃掉你1张手牌：谈判。移除本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Decrepit and apparently abandoned, the house is unlocked and oddly inviting.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on this location without looking at it. [fast] Choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.

all_card.back_flavor: 警察肯定知道发生了什么，和牢犯谈谈也可能有用。
all_card.name: 印斯茅斯监狱
all_card.text: [action]花费3资源：谈判。移除本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。 [free]如果你控制黑色钥匙：谈判。阅读剧本手册的记忆闪回VIII。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The police must have an idea of what's going on, and it may be worth talking to one of the inmates.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 3 resources: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location. [fast] If you control the black key: Parley. Read Flashback VIII in the Campaign Guide.

all_card.back_flavor: 你不禁开始怀疑印斯茅斯还有没有人值得信任……
all_card.name: 新格林教堂
all_card.text: 强制 - 本地点揭示后：从放在一边正面朝下的钥匙中随机选择1个，放到本地点上，不要查看。 [action]如果本地点没有线索：谈判。移除本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You're beginning to wonder if anyone from Innsmouth can be trusted...
all_card.real_text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on this location without looking at it. [action] If there are no clues on this location: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.

all_card.back_flavor: 和名字不一样的是，小利透书店的书籍收藏其实非常宏大。仔细勘察一番书架，你或许能找到有用的典籍。
all_card.name: 小利透书店
all_card.text: [action][action]抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌：谈判。移除本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。 [free]如果调查员共同控制了至少5个钥匙：谈判。阅读剧本手册的记忆闪回VI。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Contrary to its name, the Little Bookshop has a vast collection of books. You might find a valuable tome by perusing its shelves.
all_card.real_text: [action][action] Draw the top card of the encounter deck: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location. [fast] If the investigators control 5 or more keys, as a group: Parley. Read Flashback VI in the Campaign Guide.

all_card.back_flavor: 尽管这座桥已经摇摇欲坠，但无论如何它还是为你溜出村子提供了掩护。
all_card.name: 鱼街旧桥
all_card.text: 鱼街旧桥与任意连接地点之间每有一个屏障，其隐藏值+1。 [action]在混乱袋里加入2个[curse]标记：谈判。移除本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。
all_card.traits: 印斯茅斯. 海岸. 城中
all_card.real_back_flavor: A crumbling ruin, the bridge nonetheless provides decent cover for your flight through the town.
all_card.back_traits: 印斯茅斯. 海岸. 城中
all_card.real_text: Fish Street Bridge gets +1 shroud for each barrier between it and any connecting location. [action] Add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.

all_card.back_flavor: 有人挡住了杂货铺的大门，希望这样能把街上游荡的怪物挡在外面。这丝毫无用。但想法倒是挺美的。
all_card.name: 国立第一杂货铺
all_card.text: 强制 - 你从连接地点进入本地点后：在该地点与你所在地点之间放置1个屏障。 [action]：谈判。检定你技能值最低的技能(2)。如果你检定成功，移除本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Someone has barricaded the entrance to the grocery store in the hopes that it might keep out the creatures prowling the streets. It won't. But it's a nice thought.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter this location from a connecting location: Place 1 barrier between both locations. [action]: Parley. Test your lowest skill (2). If you succeed, remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.

all_card.back_flavor: 一度熙攘的港口如今也已废弃。狂怒的潮水吞没了港口大半，几艘船在里面危如累卵。要是这继续下去，就再也没有什么港口了。
all_card.name: 印斯茅斯港口
all_card.text: [reaction]你进入本地点后：移动到水街老屋。 [action][action]：谈判。移除本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Even the town's once-bustling harbour is deserted. The angry tide has consumed much of the docks and toppled several ships into the ocean. If this continues much longer, there won't be much of a harbour left at all.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you enter this location: Move to The House on Water Street. [action][action]: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.

all_card.back_flavor: 你从高处看去，广场上停着一辆红色的巴士。要逃出这腐朽感染的城市，如果能搭上一程，那可真是帮了大忙。这时你听到广场上传来一声巨响——一声深沉的雷霆巨吼，吓得你纹丝不动。你不禁怀疑自己是否还要继续前进。
all_card.name: 印斯茅斯广场
all_card.text: 强制 - 本地点揭示后：将放在一边的印斯茅斯修格斯以横置状态生成在本地点。 [action]：谈判。将本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障，移动到本地点和另一个连接地点之间。 [free]如果调查员共同控制了至少2个钥匙：谈判。阅读剧本手册的记忆闪回V。
all_card.real_back_flavor: From your vantage point, you see a red bus parked in the square. Getting a ride would be a tremendous help in escaping this infested, decrepit town. Then you hear a petrifying sound emanating from the square - a thunderous, deep growl that gives you second thoughts about proceeding.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Spawn the set-aside Innsmouth Shoggoth at this location, exhausted. [action]: Parley. Move 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location so it is between this location and a different connecting location. [fast] If the investigators control 2 or more keys, as a group: Parley. Read Flashback V in the Campaign Guide.

all_card.back_flavor: 找到可信的人询问，或许能打开一扇门；而待在旅社的外乡人可能就会填上至关重要的一片拼图。
all_card.name: 吉尔曼旅社
all_card.text: 强制 - 本地点揭示后：从放在一边正面朝下的钥匙中随机选择1个，放到本地点上，不要查看。 [action]：谈判。检定[combat](2)或[agility](2)。如果你检定成功，移除本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Finding a trustworthy individual to query may open a door, and an out-of-town guest staying at the hotel could provide a vital piece of this puzzle.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on this location without looking at it. [action]: Parley. Test [combat] (2) or [agility] (2). If you succeed, remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.

all_card.back_flavor: “我过了桥，抵达下游的瀑布，紧贴着穿过了马什精炼厂——它异常安静，毫无工厂应有的噪声。这座建筑矗立在陡峭的河岸上，旁边就是桥梁，还有道路汇聚之地。我觉得那就是最早的村镇中心……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 马什精炼厂
all_card.text: [free]如果你控制钥匙：移动到一个连接地点。 [action]弃掉一个你控制的支援：谈判。移除本地点和连接地点之间的1个屏障。
all_card.traits: 印斯茅斯. 海岸. 城中
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Crossing the bridge and turning toward the roar of the lower falls, I passed close to the Marsh refinery, which seemed oddly free from the noise of industry. This building stood on the steep river bluff near a bridge and an open confluence of streets which I took to be the earliest civic centre..." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.back_traits: 印斯茅斯. 海岸. 城中
all_card.real_text: [fast] If you control 1 or more keys: Move to a connecting location. [action] Discard an asset you control: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.

all_card.back_flavor: “现在那边已经不通火车了——B.& M.线从来就没去过，从罗利延出去的支线几年前也停运了。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 火车站
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你进入本地点后，如果其已淹没：检定[agility](2)。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害。 [action]：撤退。你逃离了这座被淹没的村镇。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "No railroad now - B. & M. never went through, and the branch line from Rowley was given up years ago." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter this location, if it is flooded: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, take 1 damage. [action]: Resign. You escape the submerged town.

all_card.back_flavor: 你从这儿能看到自己一度囚身的潮水洞窟。潮水卷起，洞口逐渐消失。你打了个寒战，不禁想到自己要是没逃出来，事情会变成怎样。
all_card.name: 荒芜海岸
all_card.text: 卡牌效果不能在荒芜海岸与其连接地点之间放置屏障。
all_card.real_back_flavor: From here, you can still see the exit of the tidal cavern where you were trapped. The opening vanishes slowly as the tide rolls in. You shudder to think how things might have turned out if you hadn't escaped.
all_card.real_text: Card effects cannot place barriers between Desolate Coastline and connecting locations.

all_card.name: 印斯茅斯修格斯
all_card.text: 猎手。庞大。 印斯茅斯修格斯得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 在印斯茅斯修格斯通过其猎手关键词移动时，其忽略所有的屏障。 强制 - 印斯茅斯修格斯移动后：移除其移动通过的所有屏障。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 修格斯. 精英
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Massive. Innsmouth Shoggoth gets +2 [per_investigator] health. When Innsmouth Shoggoth moves via its hunter keyword, it ignores all barriers. Forced - After Innsmouth Shoggoth moves: Remove each barrier it moved through.

all_card.name: 深海劫掠者
all_card.text: 猎手。 深海劫掠者所在地点淹没时，其得到+1攻击和+1躲避(如果所在地点完全淹没，则改为+2攻击和+2躲避)。 强制 - 深海劫掠者与你交战后：检定[combat](2)。如果你检定失败，在你所在地点和西面的连接地点之间放置1个屏障。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 深潜者
all_card.real_text: Hunter. While its location is flooded, Ravager from the Deep gets +1 fight and +1 evade (+2 fight and +2 evade instead if its location is fully flooded). Forced - After Ravager from the Deep engages you: Test [combat] (2). If you fail, place 1 barrier between your location and the connecting location to the west.

all_card.name: 突现的深潜者
all_card.text: 猎手。 显现 - 突现的深潜者以横置状态入场且不与调查员交战，除非其地点完全淹没。 强制 - 在突现的深潜者与你交战后，如果你的地点已淹没：其攻击你。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 深潜者
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Revelation - Emerging Deep One enters play exhausted and unengaged unless its location is fully flooded. Forced - After Emerging Deep One engages you, if your location is flooded: It attacks you.

all_card.name: 深潜者入侵
all_card.text: 显现 - 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。你所在地点同一行东面每有一个地点，从遭遇牌库弃牌，直到弃掉一个带有猎手关键词的[[深潜者]]敌人，将该敌人生成在该地点。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. For each location to the east of your location (on the same row), discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Deep One]] enemy with the hunter keyword is discarded and spawn that enemy at that location.

all_card.name: 拽回原处
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，移动到你东面的连接地点，忽略所有屏障。然后将你控制的每个钥匙放在你所在地点。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, move to the connecting location to the east, ignoring all barriers. Then place each key you control on your location.

all_card.name: 泛滥
all_card.text: 显现 - 在本地点和每个连接地点之间放置1个屏障(已有屏障则不放置)。如果未因效果放置屏障，泛滥获得涌动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Place 1 barrier between this location and each connecting location with no barriers between them. If no barriers are placed by this effect, Inundated gains surge.

all_card.name: 乔·萨金特
all_card.text: 使用(3车票)。 强制 - 在乔·萨金特离场时：将其从游戏中移除。 [free]花费1车票：移动到一个未完全淹没的连接地点。
all_card.real_text: Uses (3 tickets). Forced - When Joe Sargent leaves play: Remove him from the game. [fast] Spend 1 ticket: Move to a connecting location that is not fully flooded.

all_card.name: 密教教义
all_card.text:
永久。
[free]横置密教教义并选择以下你未在本次剧本中选过的一项：
- 从混乱袋中移除所有[curse]标记。
- 移除一个非[[圣堂]]地点的淹没标记。
- 击败一个你所在地点的非[[精英]]敌人。

all_card.back_flavor: 不知怎的，水流彷彿活着一般，激荡着充溢的能量。大海每分每秒都愈加变幻莫测。然而更诡异的是黑水之中潜伏的可怕怪物——这些怪物有违一切自然法则……
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的洛依高尔敌人、放在一边的水生异怪敌人和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你的船在黑色礁石旁停下，你又一次深入了潮水洞穴之中。你越来越深，直到回归海面的想法已成泡影。
all_card.name: 海面之下
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你回合开始时，如果你在完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The waters continue to roil in ebullient energy, as if somehow alive. With each passing moment, the sea grows more and more volatile. Stranger still are the monstrous creatures that now prowl the dark waters - creatures that defy all laws of nature...
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Lloigor enemy and the set-aside Aquatic Abomination enemy into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: Your boat lands on the black reef, and you descend once more into the tidal caverns. Deeper and deeper still you travel, until all thoughts of returning to the surface seem like fantasy.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_text: 如果海德拉在场上，将她翻至(苏醒狂怒)面。 如果达贡在场上且在沉睡，将他翻至(苏醒狂怒)面。
all_card.flavor: 即便是在海底如此深处，你也能明白自己的时间所剩无几。你甚至能感到浪潮穿越水域的牵引之力。你从头到脚每块骨头都在震颤。你四周的墙壁竟然在呼吸，彷彿活过来一般。
all_card.name: 星潮合相
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你回合开始时，如果你在完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_text: If Hydra is in play, flip her to her (Awakened and Enraged) side. If Dagon is in play and slumbering, flip him to his (Awakened and Enraged) side.
all_card.real_flavor: Even this deep beneath the surface of the ocean, you can tell that your time is running short. You feel the pull of the tide as it courses through the water. Every bone in your body quakes. The walls breathe as though alive.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 深潜者的吟唱渐起渐强。你眼前伊哈·恩斯雷怪异的墙壁扭曲歪解，彷彿是不顾一切想要呼吸的肺。空气稀薄。墙中渗水。已经再没什么可以阻止浪潮的牵引了。再没什么可以阻止大洪水了。城中传来兴奋的叫喊，深海的住民一阵狂欢。你精疲力尽，选择放弃，轰然倒下。你完了。人类也快了。
all_card.flavor: 大洪水已至。仪式一旦完成，海水将震颤全地球。除了亘古的大洋和其中的住民，再也容不下别物。你是人类存续的最后一线生机。
all_card.name: 洪水
all_card.text: 如果有[[古神]]敌人沉睡，将其翻至(苏醒狂怒)面。 强制 - 在你回合开始时，如果你在完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The chanting of the Deep Ones rises to a crescendo. The alien walls of Y'ha-nthlei twist and contort before your eyes, like lungs desperately clawing for breath. The air becomes thin. Water seeps through the walls. Nothing can stop the pull of the tide now. Nothing can stop the great flood. A triumphant roar sounds throughout the city, and the citizens of the deep rise to meet the cry in their jubilance. You collapse in exhaustion and resignation. Your part is over, now. The part of humanity will soon follow.
all_card.real_flavor: The great flood has begun. With the ritual complete, the seas shall overtake the Earth, and there will be nothing left but the primordial ocean and its denizens. You are all that stands in the way of humanity's extinction.
all_card.real_text: If an [[Ancient One]] enemy is slumbering, flip it to its (Awakened and Enraged) side. Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 你穿越门扉的时候，激流的漩涡撕扯你的血肉。你到达彼端的时候，眼前不再是魔鬼礁石下普通的潮水通道，而是深海的一座大城：里面全是诡奇怪异的建筑，其中惊人的财富也远超你最狂野的想象。
all_card.back_text: 将除伊哈·恩斯雷门扉外的每个地点从游戏中移除(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其放入胜利区)。弃掉这些地点的所有卡牌。 按照剧本手册上“场景2设置”的指示，将放在一边的地点放置入场。(注意随着游戏中调查员人数的不同，会用到的伊哈·恩斯雷地点数量和其布局也会不同。) 将放在一边的海德拉敌人放置入场，放在海德拉巢穴，(深入沉睡)面朝上。 将放在一边的达贡敌人放置入场，放在达贡巢穴。检查剧本日志。如果达贡已苏醒，他以(苏醒狂怒)面入场。如果达贡仍沉睡，他以(深入沉睡)面入场。
all_card.flavor: 你终于来到了海底的门扉：这里诡异的激流旋转成涡，而深潜者之城，伊哈·恩斯雷正在等候。无论如何，你都得进去……
all_card.name: 回到深海
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果每位调查员都位于伊哈·恩斯雷门扉，且调查员控制了蓝色、红色、黄色和绿色钥匙，你可以选择推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A maelstrom of currents tugs at your flesh as you cross through the gateway. When you emerge on the other side, you are no longer in the simple tidal caverns beneath Devil Reef, but inside a vast city within the depths: a city of otherworldly, alien architecture and, surprisingly, riches beyond your wildest imagination.
all_card.real_back_text: Remove each location other than Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei from the game (or add them to the victory display if they have Victory X and no clues remaining). Discard each card at those locations. Put set-aside locations into play as shown in the Campaign Guide, following the "Act 2 Setup" instructions. (Note that the number of Y'ha-nthlei locations used and the arrangement of the locations varies depending on the number of investigators in the game.) Put the set-aside Hydra enemy into play in the Lair of Hydra, (Deep in Slumber) side faceup. Put the set-aside Dagon enemy into play in the Lair of Dagon. Check Campaign Log. If Dagon has awakened, he enters play (Awakened and Enraged) side faceup. If Dagon still slumbers, he enters play (Deep in Slumber) side faceup.
all_card.real_flavor: Finally you reach the gateway to the final depths: a swirling vortex of otherworldly currents beyond which Y'ha-nthlei, the city of the Deep Ones, waits. Somehow, you must gain entrance...
all_card.real_text: Objective - If each investigator is at Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei and the investigators possess each of the following keys (blue, red, yellow, and green), you may choose to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 漩涡怒吼，大海分流。伊哈·恩斯雷从海底升起，凛冽的寒风吹遍了其中的廊道。星光俯洒到异诡翠绿的厅堂，空气中有什么已然不一样。空气穿越真空，传来一阵怪声，像是啪哒，又像嘶鸣。日月仿佛重新启动的引擎开始移转。
all_card.back_text: 将本卡牌加入胜利区。 - 如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，你可以选择继续游戏，以完成该场景卡牌上的目标；或者不完成该目标，立即进入(→结局1)。 - 如果场上没有其他场景卡牌，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 在伊哈·恩斯雷深处，深潜者举行的仪式会将大地拖入海底。唯一能反制仪式的方法就是揭露深海，让城市暴露在蓝天之下。
all_card.name: 深海之城(版本一)
all_card.text: [free]从你所在地点的一个[[古神]]敌人上移除1[per_investigator]点伤害，或在一个[[巢穴]]地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：降低场上任意一个非[[圣堂]]地点的淹没等级。 目标 - 要阻止深潜者的仪式，你得抽干整座城市。如果场上每个地点都未淹没，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The seas part with a roaring torrent. Chill air flows through the corridors of Y'ha-nthlei as it rises. When the stars look down upon its alien, emerald halls, something in the air changes. There is a sound like a snap and the hissing of air being pulled through the vacuum of space. Then, like automobiles lurching to life, the Earth and the Moon begin to move once more.
all_card.real_back_text: Add this card to the victory display. - If there is another act card in play, you may choose to either continue playing in order to accomplish the objective on that act card, or proceed immediately to (→R1) without fulfilling that objective. - If there are no other act cards in play, proceed to (→R1). Victory 2.
all_card.real_flavor: Deep within the city of Y'ha-nthlei, the Deep Ones are performing a ritual that will drown the Earth under the seas. The only way to counteract this ritual is to unveil the depths and expose the city to the sky.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Either remove 1 [per_investigator] damage from an [[Ancient One]] enemy at your location, or investigators at a [[Lair]] location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Decrease the flood level of any non-[[Sanctum]] location in play Objective - Stop the Deep Ones' ritual by draining the city. If each location in play is unflooded, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 深潜者的宝库已囤积的金银财宝不可胜数。你疑窦顿消：这群生物——还有它们的代理达贡密教——就是靠了这些财富操控了印斯茅斯人，将更多的人容为己族。这里的财富哪怕只取一抔，也足以让人舒舒服服地安度余生。你和哈珀特工拿起所能找到最珍贵的财宝，把其余都留在了城市中。“我们沿着海岸部署了潜水艇。等我们完成任务，他们就会把这儿炸烂。”她解释道。
all_card.back_text: 将本卡牌加入胜利区。 - 如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，你可以选择继续游戏，以完成该场景卡上牌的目标；或者不完成该目标，立即进入(→结局1)。 - 如果场上没有其他场景卡牌，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 你同意帮助哈珀特工完成任务，找到并带回伊哈·恩斯雷的无穷宝藏。鬼知道政府要这些宝藏干什么……
all_card.name: 深海之城(版本二)
all_card.text: 目标 - 重获深潜者的宝藏。如果达贡巢穴、海德拉巢穴和放置了紫色钥匙的财富宝库上都没有线索，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The gold and jewels hoarded in the vaults of the Deep Ones are too plentiful to count. There is no doubt in your mind: This is how the creatures - and by proxy, the Esoteric Order of Dagon - were able to manipulate the people of Innsmouth and bring more into their fold. Even a few handfuls of such riches would be enough for one to live comfortably for the rest of their life. You and Agent Harper grab only the most valuable relics you can find, leaving the rest to sink with the remainder of the city. "We have submarines stationed off the coast. When we're done here, they'll blow this place apart," she explains.
all_card.real_back_text: Add this card to the victory display. - If there is another act card in play, you may choose to either continue playing in order to accomplish the objective on that act card, or proceed immediately to (→R1) without fulfilling that objective. - If there are no other act cards in play, proceed to (→R1). Victory 2.
all_card.real_flavor: You've agreed to help Agent Harper complete her mission to find and bring back the vast wealth of Y'ha-nthlei. Who knows what the government will do with such riches...
all_card.real_text: Objective - Recover the riches of the Deep Ones. If the Lair of Dagon, the Lair of Hydra, and the Vault of Riches with the purple key have no clues on them, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 深潜者的神灵痛苦地厮打嚎叫，你周围的城市也开始瓦解。你希望能以此为良机，引诱怪物靠近存放财富的宝库。这群生物——还有它们的代理达贡密教——毫无疑问就是靠了这里贮藏的金银财宝操控了印斯茅斯人，将更多的人容为己族。你不能让这样的事情再次发生。最后一击，怪物跌跌撞撞地摔在了墙上。天顶坍塌，海水涌入。千钧一发之际，你逃了出来，没被埋在里面。
all_card.back_text: 将本卡牌加入胜利区。 - 如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，你可以选择继续游戏，以完成该场景卡上牌的目标；或者不完成该目标，立即进入(→结局1)。 - 如果场上没有其他场景卡牌，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 你拒绝成为政府阴谋的棋子。但你也不想哈珀特工受伤。你告诉她趁着还能的时候快跑，她咒骂着溜了。现在你有了全新的目标——将伊哈·恩斯雷的财富沉入深海，使其再也不能用于为害人类。
all_card.name: 深海之城(版本三)
all_card.text: 目标 - 摧毁容纳深潜者财富的宝库。如果达贡和海德拉上各有至少4[per_investigator]伤害，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: With the deities of the Deep Ones thrashing and howling in pain, sections of the city begin to collapse all around you. Hoping to use this to your advantage, you lure the creatures closer and closer to the vaults where their riches are held. The vast hoards of gold and jewels are no doubt how the creatures - and by proxy, the Esoteric Order of Dagon - were able to manipulate the people of Innsmouth and bring more into their fold. You cannot let that ever happen again. One final blow sends one of the creatures staggering through the wall. The ceiling collapses, and a torrent of seawater follows. You escape just before you are caught inside.
all_card.real_back_text: Add this card to the victory display. - If there is another act card in play, you may choose to either continue playing in order to accomplish the objective on that act card, or proceed immediately to (→R1) without fulfilling that objective. - If there are no other act cards in play, proceed to (→R1). Victory 2.
all_card.real_flavor: You refuse to be a pawn in the government's schemes. Even so, you don't wish Agent Harper to come to any harm. You tell her to escape while she can, and she slips away, cursing under her breath. Now you have a new goal - send the riches of Y'ha-nthlei into the depths so they can never again be used against humanity.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Collapse the vault containing the Deep Ones' riches. If Dagon and Hydra each have at least 4 [per_investigator] damage on them, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 这里的空气寒冷刺骨，除了水滴在粗糙石面上的轻声之外，万籁俱寂。你打了个寒战，继续向前……
all_card.name: 黑暗深渊
all_card.text: 强制 - 黑暗深渊揭示后：从放在一边正面朝下的钥匙中随机选择1个，放到黑暗深渊上，不要查看。 强制 - 黑暗深渊上最后的线索被发现后：黑暗深渊完全淹没。提升与黑暗深渊连接的每个地点的淹没等级。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The air is frigid here, and there is no sound but the faint plinking of water dripping onto the rough stone ground. You shudder and proceed onward...
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Dark Abyss is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on Dark Abyss without looking at it. Forced - After the last clue is discovered from Dark Abyss: Dark Abyss becomes fully flooded. Increase the flood level of each location connected to Dark Abyss.

all_card.back_flavor: “前所未有的伟大荣光正在底下等候着我，而我很快就能寻到了。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 伊哈·恩斯雷门扉以部分淹没入场(即使其未揭示)。
all_card.flavor: 深海城市的大门是激荡的漩涡——这急流的漩涡彼端就是你最终的目的地，伊哈·恩斯雷。
all_card.name: 伊哈·恩斯雷门扉
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Stupendous and unheard-of splendours await me below, and I shall seek them soon." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_back_text: Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei enters play partially flooded (even while it is unrevealed).
all_card.real_flavor: The gateway to the city of the deep is a roiling vortex of seawater - a portal of currents beyond which lies Y'ha-nthlei, your final destination.

all_card.back_flavor: 你深入熟悉的台阶，记忆中有什么正在拉扯。你之前来过这儿，不是吗?
all_card.name: 达贡巢穴
all_card.text: 每有一个[[圣堂]]地点上有钥匙，达贡巢穴隐藏值-1。 [free]检查剧本日志。如果所有7个钥匙都在地点上，且密教的仪式被破坏：你深挖记忆，回想自己上次在此时发生了什么。阅读剧本手册的记忆闪回XIV
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you descend the familiar steps, something tugs at your memories. You've been here before, haven't you?
all_card.real_text: Lair of Dagon gets -1 shroud for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it. [fast] Check Campaign Log. If all 7 keys are on locations and the Order's ritual was disrupted: You dig deep into your memories to recall what happened the last time you were here. Read Flashback XIV in the Campaign Guide.

all_card.back_flavor: 瀑布倾泻的巨响中，浮现出深处某种巨物扰动的深沉隆隆声。巨物的每一次吐息都响彻全城，震慑壁墙，让你满心恐惧——而它却还在呼唤着你。
all_card.name: 海德拉巢穴
all_card.subname: 母神海德拉的高阶神庙
all_card.text:
每有一个[[圣堂]]地点上有钥匙，海德拉巢穴隐藏值-1。
[action]将黑色、紫色或白色钥匙放在本地点上：对一个未沉睡的[[古神]]敌人造成3点伤害。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Amidst the sound of cascading waterfalls, the deep rumbling of something enormous stirring emanates from below. Each of the thing's breaths resounds throughout the city, shaking the walls, filling your heart with fear, and yet, calling to you.
all_card.real_text:
Lair of Hydra gets -1 shroud for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it.
[action] Place the black, purple, or white key on this location: Deal 3 damage to an [[Ancient One]] enemy that is not slumbering. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 达贡
all_card.text: 达贡正在沉睡。他不能攻击，不能与调查员交战，免疫调查员行动和玩家卡牌效果。 强制 - 当调查阶段结束时，如果有调查员在达贡巢穴，且达贡处于重整状态：在达贡上放置1个毁灭标记。 [action]：检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定成功，横置达贡或移除他的1个毁灭标记。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，在达贡上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Dagon is slumbering. He cannot attack or engage, and is immune to investigator actions and player card effects. Forced - At the end of the investigation phase, if an investigator is in Lair of Dagon and Dagon is ready: Place 1 doom on him. [action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, either exhaust Dagon or remove 1 doom from him. If you fail by 3 or more, place 1 doom on him.

all_card.back_flavor:
等你发现敌人来袭，为时已晚。你转过拐弯的时候，头上吃了一记重击，打得你踉踉跄跄。伏击者将你抵在墙上，露出狞笑，嘴里全是参差的尖牙。你从记忆中认出了这张可恶的脸。
“又是你。”奥赛罗思咕呱的嗓音中带着一丝惊讶，“就是你在这四周乱转刺探。无妨。你再捣乱也就只能到这儿了。”
all_card.back_text: 生成放在一边的奥赛罗思·马什敌人，与调查员队长交战。将放在一边的蓝色钥匙放在奥赛罗思·马什上。 将每张放在一边的尽腥尽力混洗入遭遇牌库。 每位调查员失去其所有线索。 将放在一边的灯塔地下室地点放置入场，放在灯塔梯井正下方。 将场景直接推进到场景2a(不结算场景1b)。
all_card.flavor: 灯塔旁围绕的迷雾如同一道异界的帷幕。海浪如饕餮湿润的巨舌舔拭着岸边的岩石。头顶上的月亮在空中异常明亮。你有一种奇怪的感觉，你并非独自一人……
all_card.name: 海湾浓雾
all_card.text: 同一行的地点互相连接。 强制 - 在本密谋推进时：将上面所有的毁灭标记移动到下一个密谋。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You don't see the attack coming until it is too late. Just as you round a corner, you are struck across the head and sent reeling. Your ambusher pins you against the wall, his grin full of sharp, jagged teeth. You recognize the repulsive face from your memories.
"It's you again," Oceiros says with a hint of surprise in his croaking voice. "So you're the ones who've been snooping around. No matter. Your meddling ends now."
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Oceiros Marsh enemy engaged with the lead investigator. Place the set-aside blue key on Oceiros Marsh. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Worth His Salt into the encounter deck. Each investigator loses each of their clues. Put the set-aside Lighthouse Basement location into play directly below Lighthouse Stairwell. Advance the act directly to act 2a (do not resolve act 1b).
all_card.real_flavor: A curl of mist wraps the lighthouse in an otherworldy veil. The waves lap at the rocks on the shoreline like hungry, wet tongues. Overhead, the moon gleams unnaturally bright in the sky. You have a curious feeling you are not alone...
all_card.real_text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another. Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 更多可憎的混血生物突然冲出来伏击了你，叫你无法抵御。冰冷带鳞的手掌抓住你的臂膀，别到你背后。麻袋套到了你的头上，挡住了你的视线。你徒劳无功地挣扎，但它们数量太多，力气也胜过你。“带下去。”一个咕呱的声音命令道，“他们必须知道闯入我们的圣地是什么代价。”
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员被俘。将其所有钥匙放在拘禁室。如果奥赛罗思·马什在场上，将其放在一边，位于场外。将每张放在一边的惨遭俘虏混洗入遭遇牌库。 揭示灯塔地下室。将沉没岩洞(深层)放置入场，放在沉没岩洞(浅层)正下方；将沉没岩洞(底层)放置入场，放在沉没岩洞(深层)正下方。然后，将放在一边的潮水通道地点随机放置入场，直到每一行都有正好4个地点(除灯光室的一行外)。(见剧本手册上的图示。) 直接推进到场景3a(不结算场景2b)。
all_card.flavor: 密教知道你在这儿。你没多少时间了——你得赶在他们动身抓住你之前，找到他们的巢穴！
all_card.name: 不变如海
all_card.text: 同一行的地点互相连接。 强制 - 在有调查员被俘时：推进本密谋。 强制 - 在本密谋推进时：将上面所有的毁灭标记移动到下一个密谋。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Suddenly, you are ambushed by more of the repulsive hybrid creatures than you can possibly fend off. Cold, scaled hands grab your arms and pin them behind your back. The next thing you know, a sack is thrown over your head, obscuring your vision. You struggle in vain against your captors, but you are outnumbered and outmatched. "Take them below," a croaking voice commands. "They must learn the consequences of trespassing on sacred ground."
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator is captured. Place each of their keys on Holding Cells. If Oceiros Marsh is in play, set him aside, out of play. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Taken Captive into the encounter deck. Reveal the Lighthouse Basement. Put Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths) and Sunken Grotto (Final Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths). Then, put random set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations into play until there are exactly 4 locations on each row, except for the row with the Lantern Room. (See Campaign Guide for diagram.) Advance the act directly to act 3a (do not resolve act 2b).
all_card.real_flavor: The Order knows you're here. You have little time to spare - you have to find the way into their lair before they mobilize to capture you!
all_card.real_text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another. Forced - When an investigator is captured: Advance this agenda. Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 在黏滑的岩洞和灯塔的石墙中传来了熟悉的沉重呼吸。你蹲藏在一边，听到脚步声接近。接着传来沉重铁门的吱嘎和砰的一声，锁头的喀哒一声昭示了如今的情况，你的心脏都停跳了一拍。有人封住了灯塔上面出去的路……
all_card.back_text: 查找所有场外区域，找出奥赛罗思·马什，将其生成在沉没岩洞(浅层)。 将每个[[猎鹰岬]]地点从游戏中移除(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其加入胜利区)。将这些地点的所有敌人和调查员移动到沉没岩洞(浅层)。弃掉这些地点的所有其他卡牌。 在可以提升淹没等级的地点中，找到最底下4张。提升这些地点的淹没等级。
all_card.flavor: 潮水通道里的水平面越来越高，一种熟悉的冰冷随之袭来。浪潮奔涌。要是你不利索点儿，这儿很快就没有什么可调查的了。万幸的是，要是潮水涨得太快，你还有另一条路可以逃出去……
all_card.name: 浪潮汹涌
all_card.text: 同一行的地点互相连接。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Familiar, heavy breathing echoes across the slick rocks of the caverns and the stone walls of the lighthouse. You duck behind some cover as you hear footsteps approaching. Then comes the loud creaking and slamming of a heavy metal door, followed by a telltale click that stops your heart dead. Someone has sealed the exit to the lighthouse above...
all_card.real_back_text: Search all out-of-play areas for Oceiros Marsh and spawn him in the Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths). Remove each [[Falcon Point]] location from the game (or add them to the victory display if they have Victory X and no clues on them). Move each enemy and investigator at those locations to Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths). Each other card at those locations is discarded. Find the 4 bottommost locations that can have their flood levels increased. Increase each of their flood levels.
all_card.real_flavor: A wave of cold familiarity washes over you as you see the water level starting to rise throughout the tunnels. The tide is rolling in. If you aren't quick, there won't be much left here to investigate. Luckily, you still have a way out should the tide rise too quickly...
all_card.real_text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another.

all_card.back_flavor: 潮水还在不断上涨……
all_card.back_text: 在可以提升淹没等级的地点中，找到最底下4张。提升这些地点的淹没等级。如果你不能这么做，进入(→结局3)。否则，将本密谋翻面，继续游戏。
all_card.flavor: 海水冲击海岸的声音透过气孔在灯塔下的隧道里回响。你在水中挣扎向前，耳畔的脉搏撞痛了鼓膜。
all_card.name: 猎鹰岬的恐怖
all_card.text: 奥赛罗思·马什得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 同一行的地点互相连接。 (注意——在本密谋推进时，本场冒险可能不会结束，但浪潮将起……)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The tide continues to rise...
all_card.real_back_text: Find the 4 bottommost locations that can have their flood levels increased. Increase each of their flood levels. If you cannot, proceed to (→R3). Otherwise, flip this agenda back over and continue playing.
all_card.real_flavor: The crash of waves on the shoreline echoes through the porous tunnels underneath the lighthouse. Your pulse pounds in your ears as you struggle to stay ahead of the water.
all_card.real_text: Oceiros Marsh gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Locations on the same row are connected to one another. (Beware - the scenario may not end when this agenda advances, but the tide will continue to rise...)

all_card.back_flavor:
你在老旧风蚀的建筑里蹑手蹑脚的时候，听见灯塔附近的小屋里传来了压低的对话声。你把耳朵抵在附近的墙上，站得笔直，心跳不已。
“找到他们。”一个低沉的咕呱嗓音下令道，“不能让他们到岩洞去。吾教的秘密必须保护。”
“遵命，奥赛罗思。”几个安静的声音一起答道。你等到脚步声远去，才又继续调查。看来你的直觉没错。奥赛罗思就在这儿！
all_card.back_text: 生成放在一边的奥赛罗思·马什敌人以横置状态生成在灯塔看门人小屋。将放在一边的蓝色钥匙放在其上。 将每张放在一边的尽腥尽力混洗入遭遇牌库。 将放在一边的灯塔地下室地点放置入场，放在灯塔梯井正下方。 将密谋直接推进到密谋2a(不结算密谋1b)。
all_card.flavor: 所有的迹象都表明，灯塔是达贡密教的一处行动基地。印斯茅斯已没什么好调查的了，所以这里就是你找到答案的绝佳机会。密教到底要干什么？你必须赶在他们发现你在这儿前找到答案……
all_card.name: 灯塔
all_card.text: 目标 - 在密谋推进前花费所需数量的线索。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
As you tiptoe through the old, timeworn structure, you hear muffled conversation from within the small cottage attached to the lighthouse. You press your ear upon a nearby wall and stand perfectly still, your heart racing.
"Find them," a deep, croaking voice orders. "Do not let them reach the grotto. The Order's secrets must be preserved."
"Yes, Oceiros," a few quiet voices reply in unison. You wait until the sound of footsteps has faded before you resume your investigation. It looks like your hunch was right. Oceiros is here!
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Oceiros Marsh enemy in Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage, exhausted. Place the set-aside blue key on him. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Worth His Salt into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Lighthouse Basement location into play directly below Lighthouse Stairwell. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 2a (do not resolve agenda 1b).
all_card.real_flavor: All signs point to this lighthouse being a base of operations for the Esoteric Order of Dagon. There's not much left of Innsmouth to investigate, so this is your best chance to find answers. What exactly is the Order up to? You must find out before they realize you're here...
all_card.real_text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues before the agenda advances.

all_card.back_flavor: 你用奥赛罗思的钥匙打开灯塔地下室的门，本以为会瞧见一个小小的石头地窖。但眼前出现的却是一整片淹没的洞穴网络，延伸到猎鹰岬崖壁的深处，甚至一直到海平面以下。你来对地方了——谁知道密教在远离窥探目光的此处，到底隐藏了什么秘密？
all_card.back_text: 如果奥赛罗思·马什在场上，将他加入胜利区。 将沉没岩洞(深层)放置入场，放在沉没岩洞(浅层)正下方；将沉没岩洞(底层)放置入场，放在沉没岩洞(深层)正下方。然后，将放在一边的潮水通道地点随机放置入场，直到每一行都有正好4个地点(除灯光室的一行外)。(见剧本手册上的图示。) 将每张放在一边的惨遭俘虏混洗入遭遇牌库。 将密谋直接推进到密谋3a(不结算密谋2b)。
all_card.flavor: 猎鹰岬里有许多密教意图隐藏的秘密。兴许解决奥赛罗思就能打开一条路来。
all_card.name: 寻找前路
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果在密谋推进前，有调查员进入了灯塔地下室，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You use Oceiros's key to open the basement door of the lighthouse, expecting to find a small stone cellar. What you find instead is a network of flooded caverns extending deep into the cliffside of Falcon Point, perhaps even below sea level. You were right to come here - who knows what secrets the Order keeps here, away from prying eyes?
all_card.real_back_text: If Oceiros Marsh is in play, add him to the victory display. Put Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths) and Sunken Grotto (Final Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths). Then, put random set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations into play until there are exactly 4 locations on each row, except for the row with the Lantern Room. (See Campaign Guide for diagram.) Shuffle each set-aside copy of Taken Captive into the encounter deck. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 3a (do not resolve agenda 2b).
all_card.real_flavor: Falcon Point contains many secrets the Order does not wish you to know. Perhaps dealing with Oceiros will open the way.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If an investigator enters Lighthouse Basement before the agenda advances, advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果有调查员从月之室撤退：
水下的隧道似入永恒，直通往黑暗沉沉的涡流。暗黑的咸水打在你头盔的玻璃上。彷彿是永恒之后，你终于冲出水面，闯入寒冷的夜空中，浑身冻得骨头发凉。你来到海岸上后，一件件将沉重的潜水服脱下。
(→结局1)
如果每位调查员都从猎鹰岬门房撤退：
你逃进孤寂的树林，停下来喘口气。不知怎的，你又一次从深渊住民的手中逃脱了。
(→结局2)
all_card.flavor: 灯塔底的隧道网络里满是密教活动有关的信息。你在逃跑前必须尽力搜寻。
all_card.name: 深海信徒
all_card.text: 强制 - 当调查阶段结束时：每位在完全淹没地点的调查员必须受到3点伤害，或移动到其正下方的地点。 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退，推进。(提示——在离开之前，你可能会想要先找到自己来到此处的目的。黑色和红色钥匙是你最需要的东西。)
all_card.real_back_text:
If at least 1 investigator resigned from the Moon Room:
The underwater tunnels seem to go on forever, stretching into murk-ridden eddies. Dark salt water crashes against the glass helmet of your suit. After what feels like an eternity, you burst into the cold evening air, chilled to the bone. You pull the heavy suit off, piece by piece, the moment you reach the shore.
(→R1) If each investigator who resigned did so from the Falcon Point Gatehouse:
You flee into the lonely woods, panting for air. Somehow, you've escaped the denizens of the deep once more.
(→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: Deep below the lighthouse is a web of tunnels filled with information pertaining to the Order's activities. You must learn what you can before escaping.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the investigation phase: Each investigator at a fully flooded location must either take 3 damage or move to the location directly below their location. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance. (Hint - You may wish to find what you came for before you leave this place. The black and red keys represent the objects you need the most.)

all_card.back_flavor: 浓雾阻挡了你爬上猎鹰岬的路。要是运气好，灯塔此时应当无人……但运气近来一直不在你这边。
all_card.back_text: 猎鹰岬门房不能被完全淹没。
all_card.name: 猎鹰岬门房
all_card.text: 猎鹰岬门房不能被完全淹没。 [action]：撤退。你退回树林，把灯塔和它的秘密都抛在身后。如果你控制黑色或红色钥匙，将你控制的这些钥匙都放在当前场景上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Thick fog obscures your approach as you climb the trail leading to Falcon Point. With any luck, the lighthouse will be abandoned... but luck hasn't been on your side as of late.
all_card.real_back_text: Falcon Point Gatehouse cannot be fully flooded.
all_card.real_text: Falcon Point Gatehouse cannot be fully flooded. [action]: Resign. You head back into the woods, leaving the lighthouse and its mysteries behind. If you control the black or red keys, place each one you control on the current act.

all_card.back_flavor: 通往灯塔沉重的大门已经半开。最近肯定有人来过……
all_card.back_text: 灯塔梯井不能被完全淹没。
all_card.name: 灯塔梯井
all_card.text:
灯塔梯井不能被完全淹没。
[free]如果当前有任意[[遗物]]剧情支援放在一边：将其中1张加入你的手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The heavy door leading into the lighthouse is already ajar. Somebody has been here recently...
all_card.real_back_text: Lighthouse Stairwell cannot be fully flooded.
all_card.real_text:
Lighthouse Stairwell cannot be fully flooded.
[fast] If there are any [[Relic]] story assets currently set aside: Add 1 of them to your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 在梯井顶端，风雨侵蚀中一扇窄木门挡住你通往灯塔顶上灯光室的路。
all_card.back_text: 灯光室不能被淹没。
all_card.name: 灯光室
all_card.text: 灯光室不能被淹没。 强制 - 灯光室揭示后：将放在一边的白色钥匙放在其上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: At the very top of the stairwell, a narrow wooden door warped by rain damage blocks your way to the lantern room atop the lighthouse.
all_card.real_back_text: Lantern Room cannot be flooded.
all_card.real_text: Lantern Room cannot be flooded. Forced - After Lantern Room is revealed: Place the set-aside white key on it.

all_card.back_flavor: 陡峭的崖壁耸立在印斯茅斯海边。漆黑的浪潮冲刷着犬牙交错的岩石。从这儿掉下去必然无法生还。
all_card.back_text: 猎鹰岬崖边不能被完全淹没。
all_card.name: 猎鹰岬崖边
all_card.text: 猎鹰岬崖边不能被完全淹没。 [free] 如果你控制了白色钥匙：你使用白色钥匙窥探风暴肆虐的漆黑地平线，记忆中闪过什么事情。阅读剧本手册的记忆闪回XII。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The sharp cliffside juts over the Innsmouth coast. Dark waves crash against the jagged rocks. A fall from here would certainly be deadly.
all_card.real_back_text: Falcon Point Cliffside cannot be fully flooded.
all_card.real_text: Falcon Point Cliffside cannot be fully flooded. [fast] If you control the white key: Using the white key, you peer out into the dark, stormy horizon, and something sparks in your memories. Read Flashback XII in the Campaign Guide.

all_card.back_flavor: 灯塔边的小木屋一片狼藉。门居然还没脱链可真是个奇迹。屋子里传来了鱼腥味和发霉味。
all_card.back_text: 灯塔看门人小屋不能被完全淹没。
all_card.name: 灯塔看门人小屋
all_card.text: 灯塔看门人小屋不能被完全淹没。 强制 - 灯塔看门人小屋揭示后：将放在一边的黄色钥匙放在其上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The cottage next to the lighthouse is in shambles. It's a wonder the door hasn't already fallen off its hinges. Beyond, the building's interior smells of fish and mold.
all_card.real_back_text: Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage cannot be fully flooded.
all_card.real_text: Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage cannot be fully flooded. Forced - After Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage is revealed: Place the set-aside yellow key on it.

all_card.back_flavor: 厚实的大锁挡住了你的前路，你怀疑灯塔下面还有个小小的地窖。
all_card.back_text: 通向灯塔地下室的门锁住了。你不能进入本地点，除非你控制了蓝色钥匙。
all_card.flavor: 好吧，这肯定不是个地窖。
all_card.name: 沉没岩洞
all_card.text: [free]本地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：查看所在行的一个潮水通道地点的已揭示面。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A thick padlock bars your way into what you suspect is a small cellar below the lighthouse.
all_card.real_back_text: The door leading into the basement of the lighthouse is locked tight. You cannot enter this location unless you control the blue key.
all_card.real_flavor: Well, that's certainly not a cellar.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the revealed side of a Tidal Tunnel location on this row.

all_card.back_flavor: 摇摇晃晃的木楼梯穿过崖壁表面，通往更深的地下。
all_card.name: 沉没岩洞
all_card.text: [free]本地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：查看所在行的一个潮水通道地点的已揭示面。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Rickety wooden stairways cut through the crust of the cliffside, leading deeper underground.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the revealed side of a Tidal Tunnel location on this row.

all_card.back_flavor: 摇摇晃晃的木楼梯穿过崖壁表面，通往更深的地下。
all_card.name: 沉没岩洞
all_card.text: [free]本地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：查看所在行的一个潮水通道地点的已揭示面。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Rickety wooden stairways cut through the crust of the cliffside, leading deeper underground.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the revealed side of a Tidal Tunnel location on this row.

all_card.back_flavor: 这里的空气寒冷刺骨，除了水滴在粗糙石面上的轻声之外，万籁俱寂。你打了个寒战，继续向前……
all_card.name: 海德拉祭坛
all_card.text: 除调查外，不能从海德拉祭坛发现线索。 海德拉祭坛的调查员控制绿色钥匙时，海德拉祭坛隐藏值-3。 强制 - 海德拉祭坛揭示后：将放在一边的红色钥匙放在其上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The air is frigid here, and there is no sound but the faint plinking of water dripping onto the rough stone ground. You shudder and proceed onward...
all_card.real_text: Clues cannot be discovered from Shrine to Hydra except by investigating. While an investigator at Shrine to Hydra controls the green key, Shrine to Hydra gets -3 shroud. Forced - After Shrine to Hydra is revealed: Place the set-aside red key on it.

all_card.back_flavor: 这里的空气寒冷刺骨，除了水滴在粗糙石面上的轻声之外，万籁俱寂。你打了个寒战，继续向前……
all_card.name: 深潜者温床
all_card.text: [free]如果你控制紫色钥匙：你将紫色钥匙和这个溢水的洞室里大到夸张的卵进行了一番比较，回想起了什么。阅读剧本手册的记忆闪回XIII。 强制 - 深潜者温床揭示后：提升其淹没等级。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The air is frigid here, and there is no sound but the faint plinking of water dripping onto the rough stone ground. You shudder and proceed onward...
all_card.real_text: [fast] If you control the purple key: You compare the purple key to the oversized eggs littering the flooded chamber and recall something. Read Flashback XIII in the Campaign Guide. Forced - After Deep One Nursery is revealed: Increase its flood level.

all_card.back_flavor: 这里的空气寒冷刺骨，除了水滴在粗糙石面上的轻声之外，万籁俱寂。你打了个寒战，继续向前……
all_card.name: 月之室
all_card.text: [action] 如果月之室未淹没：撤退。你穿上一件闲置的潜水服，一头扎进了反射月光的池中。如果你控制黑色或红色钥匙，将你控制的这些钥匙都放在当前场景上。 强制 - 月之室揭示后：提升其淹没等级。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The air is frigid here, and there is no sound but the faint plinking of water dripping onto the rough stone ground. You shudder and proceed onward...
all_card.real_text: [action] If The Moon Room is unflooded: Resign. You don one of the empty diving suits and dive into the reflecting pool. If you control the black or red keys, place each one you control on the current act. Forced - After The Moon Room is revealed: Increase its flood level.

all_card.back_flavor: 这里的空气寒冷刺骨，除了水滴在粗糙石面上的轻声之外，万籁俱寂。你打了个寒战，继续向前……
all_card.name: 沉没档案库
all_card.text: 沉没档案库淹没时，不能发现其上的线索。 强制 - 沉没档案库揭示后：其完全淹没。将放在一边的黑色钥匙放在其上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The air is frigid here, and there is no sound but the faint plinking of water dripping onto the rough stone ground. You shudder and proceed onward...
all_card.real_text: Clues cannot be discovered at Sunken Archives while it is flooded. Forced - After Sunken Archives is revealed: It becomes fully flooded. Place the set-aside black key on it.

all_card.back_flavor: 这里的空气寒冷刺骨，除了水滴在粗糙石面上的轻声之外，万籁俱寂。你打了个寒战，继续向前……
all_card.name: 水泵室
all_card.text: [action]：检定[intellect](2)或[agility](2)。如果你检定成功，选择两个地点。降低其中一个地点的淹没等级，提升其中另一个地点的淹没等级(如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，你可以改为只选择一个地点，降低其淹没等级)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The air is frigid here, and there is no sound but the faint plinking of water dripping onto the rough stone ground. You shudder and proceed onward...
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (2) or [agility] (2). If you succeed, choose two locations. Decrease the flood level of one location and increase the flood level of the other (if you succeed by 2 or more, you may instead choose just one location and decrease its flood level).

all_card.name: 惨遭俘获！
all_card.text:
当第一次有调查员被俘，阅读下列文本：
你被五花大绑，拖行在深深的地下，然后扔进一间紧锁的囚室，周围全是滴水的石墙。抓住你的人脚步声渐渐远去，对你的叫喊全都充耳不闻。
将被俘的调查员从其地点移除，将该调查员每个占手部槽位的支援返回其手牌。 将该调查员的迷你卡牌侧放，以示其被俘。被俘的调查员不能移动、攻击，也不能与敌人交战。 将本剧情卡牌翻到“拘禁室”面并放置入场。它不存在于任何已有的行或列，只通过连接图标与沉没岩洞地点连接。将被俘的调查员放在拘禁室。 从现在起，每当有调查员被俘，结算相同的效果(将其每个占手部槽位的支援返回手中；侧放其迷你卡牌；将其放到拘禁室)。
all_card.real_text:
The first time an investigator is captured, read the following:
You are bound and dragged deep underground, then thrown into a sealed prison cell, surrounded on all sides by dripping stone walls. Your cries fall on deaf ears as your captor's footsteps fade into the distance.
Remove the captured investigator from their location and return each asset in that investigator's hand slots to their hand. Turn that investigator's mini-card sideways to indicate that they have been captured. Captured investigators cannot move, fight, or be engaged. Flip this story card over to its "Holding Cells" side and put it into play. It is not on any existing row or column, and is only connected to Sunken Grotto locations through its connection icons. Place the captured investigator in Holding Cells. From now on, whenever an investigator is captured, resolve this same effect (return each asset in their hand slots to their hand, turn their mini-card sideways, and place them in Holding Cells).

all_card.name: 拘禁室
all_card.text:
拘禁室不能被淹没。
敌人不能进入或生成在拘禁室(如果将有敌人生成在此，改为将其生成在任意沉没岩洞)。
[action]：检定[combat](3)以扭断铁条或[agility](3)以撬锁开门。如果你控制黄色钥匙，本次检定自动成功。如果你检定成功，解救此处一位被俘的调查员。
all_card.real_text:
Holding Cells cannot be flooded. 
Enemies cannot enter or spawn at Holding Cells (if one would spawn here, spawn it at any Sunken Grotto instead).
[action]: Test [combat] (3) to break the bars or [agility] (3) to pick the locks. If you control the yellow key, this test automatically succeeds. If you succeed, free an investigator who is captured here.

all_card.name: 奥赛罗思·马什
all_card.text: 猎手。反击。 奥赛罗思·马什的地点淹没时，其得到+2躲避。 强制 - 成功躲避奥赛罗思·马什后：你检定成功且每超过难度1点，控制他的1个钥匙。 强制 - 奥赛罗思·马什在敌军阶段期间攻击你后：你被俘虏了。将你的所有钥匙放在奥赛罗思·马什上。
all_card.traits: 类人. 深潜者. 混血. 精英
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Oceiros Marsh gets +2 evade while his location is flooded. Forced - After Oceiros Marsh is successfully evaded: For each point you succeeded by, take control of 1 key on him. Forced - After Oceiros Marsh attacks you during the enemy phase: You are captured. Place each of your keys on Oceiros Marsh.

all_card.name: 深潜者保姆
all_card.text: 冷漠。反击。 深潜者保姆未与调查员交战时，其地点和连接地点的每个其他[[深潜者]]敌人得到+1攻击和+1躲避。 强制 - 深潜者保姆与你交战后：抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。该卡牌失去涌动。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 深潜者
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Retaliate. While Deep One Nursemaid is unengaged, each other [[Deep One]] enemy at its location or connecting locations gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Forced - After Deep One Nursemaid engages you: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. That card loses surge.

all_card.name: 深潜者幼体
all_card.text: 涌动。 强制 - 深潜者幼体与你交战后：你必须失去一个行动，或它攻击你。 强制 - 在你击败深潜者幼体后：最近的未与调查员交战的重整[[深潜者]]敌人朝你所在地点移动一次。该敌人本次移动期间失去冷漠。
all_card.real_text: Surge. Forced - After you engage Deep One Hatchling: Either lose 1 action or it attacks you. Forced - After you defeat Deep One Hatchling: Move the nearest ready, unengaged [[Deep One]] enemy once toward your location. That enemy loses aloof during this movement.

all_card.name: 丑恶摇篮曲
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果场上没有[[深潜者]]敌人，丑恶摇篮曲获得涌动。否则，找到攻击值最高的[[深潜者]]敌人。检定[willpower](X)，其中X等于该敌人的攻击值。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Deep One]] enemies in play, Hideous Lullaby gains surge. Otherwise, find the [[Deep One]] enemy with the highest fight value. Test [willpower] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you fail, take 2 horror.

all_card.name: 咸海之吻
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[combat](2)。如果你位于淹没的地点，本次检定的难度提高2点。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害并将咸海之吻放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你不能获得资源或抽取卡牌。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：弃掉咸海之吻。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [combat] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 2 if you are at a flooded location. If you fail, take 1 damage and put Kiss of Brine into play in your threat area. You cannot gain resources or draw cards. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Discard Kiss of Brine.

all_card.name: 全蚀

all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, put Totality into play in your threat area. Forced - After you enter a flooded location: Take 1 horror. Forced - At the end of your turn: Discard Totality.

all_card.back_flavor: 在密教一处淹没的大厅里，你和一尊缟玛瑙雕像不期而遇。它描绘的生物和你在魔鬼礁石所见的非常相像。就在你思考这种存在的本性之时，你听到前方传来一声微弱的吟唱：“伊哈·恩斯雷！伊哈·恩斯雷！”你还没能解读这些奇怪的音节，背后就传来了一阵水花泼溅的声音。你躲藏起来，摒住呼吸，几个人影渐渐走近。他们经过的时候，一阵溅水声，渐渐行远消逝了。你尾随上去，跟着他们前往仪式地点……
all_card.back_text: 在混乱袋中加入2个[curse]标记。检查剧本日志。 - 如果剧本日志中，“恢复记忆”下方，列出了一次越狱，将放在一边的[[嫌犯]]敌人生成在一个[[三楼]]地点，或者如果场上没有[[三楼]]地点，则生成在宏伟入口(忽略该敌人的显现能力)。将放在一边的蓝色钥匙放在该敌人上。 - 否则，调查员队长查找遭遇牌库，找出一张[[异教徒]]敌人并将其生成在连接地点。混洗遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 老旧的共济会大厅内部寂静得诡异，除了杳远的水滴叮铃和你踩在地板上的吱嘎之外，再无声响。你不禁觉得早有人料到你会来。
all_card.name: 入教(版本一)
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你回合开始时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: In a flooded hall of the Order, you come across an onyx statue depicting a creature similar to the ones you saw in Devil Reef. Just as you are pondering the nature of its existence, you hear faint chanting up ahead: "Y'ha-nthlei! Y'ha-nthlei!" Before you can interpret the strange syllables, there is a splash behind you. You hide and hold your breath as the figures approach. The gentle sloshing of their steps passes and fades into the distance. You shadow the figures, following them to the site of their ritual...
all_card.real_back_text: Add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag. Check Campaign Log. - If a jailbreak is listed under "Memories Recovered" in your Campaign Log, spawn the set-aside [[Suspect]] enemy at a [[Third Floor]] location, or at the Grand Entryway if a [[Third Floor]] location is not in play (ignoring that enemy's revelation ability). Place the set-aside blue key on that enemy. - Otherwise, the lead investigator searches the encounter deck for a [[Cultist]] enemy and spawns it in a connecting location. Shuffle the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: The interior of the old masonic hall is eerily quiet, aside from the distant plink of dripping water and the creaking of the building under the weight of your feet. You get the feeling that your arrival may have been expected.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.real_back_flavor: The silence that pervades the building retreats as sinister chanting rises from the depths, each uncanny syllable a reminder of the Order's inhuman origins. What was once the rhythmic drip, drip, drip of trickling water is now a distant, resounding roar of rushing floodwater. But there is also something else. The rumbling of something enormous, something that stirs under the bedrock...

all_card.real_flavor: "Glancing up at the window I had left, I observed it was still dark, though far across the crumbling chimneys to the north I could see lights ominously blazing in the Order of Dagon Hall..." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth

你听到前面传来了脚步声，将身子抵在墙上，担心最坏的事情已经发生。你和可能的伏击者同时蹿了出来，双方亮出武器……然后你们认出了彼此，同时退下。
“哦，是你啊。”道森说着把手枪塞进了皮套里，“那边我都查过了。”他说着指向自己过来的走廊，“找到了这个，但没什么别的。”他给你一把钥匙，然后抽出手电筒，走在了前面。“从现在起我们应该一起行动了。”

Hearing footsteps up ahead, you press yourself against a nearby wall, fearing the worst. You and your would-be ambusher leap out at the same time, brandishing your weapons... then immediately withdraw once you recognize one another.
"Oh, it's you," Dawson says, holstering his handgun. "I've searched that entire wing," he says, motioning to the hall he came from. "Found this, but not much else." He offers the key in his possession, then pulls out his flashlight and takes the lead. "Might as well stick together from here on out."
