Remove 4 [curse] tokens from the chaos bag.
Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Thomas Dawson story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, Thomas Dawson does not take up an ally slot. That investigator may also take control of 1 spent key on the scenario reference card.
all_card.real_flavor: "Glancing up at the window I had left, I observed it was still dark, though far across the crumbling chimneys to the north I could see lights ominously blazing in the Order of Dagon Hall..." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 突然一声巨响在楼里炸开，彷彿剧烈的爆炸和回响的轰鸣同时骤起。起先你觉得这房子要塌了。你找寻掩护，举手挡住头免受落石的损害，但并无残骸击中你。取而代之的是回荡的巨吼，吓得你跪倒在地，把你肺里的空气都挤了出来。声音越来越大，你的鼓膜就要碎裂。黑暗潜入了你的视线，逐渐将你的记忆完全吞没
all_card.back_text: 每位没有撤退的调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。 在剧本日志中，记录达贡已苏醒。 (→结局1)
all_card.flavor: 整座楼都开始摇晃。在密教大堂的深处有什么邪恶的事情正在发生。要是你不加以阻止，谁知道会放出什么东西来？
all_card.name: 仪式推进
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你回合开始时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Suddenly, a tremendous sound thunders through the building, like a furious explosion and the resonance of a booming voice all at once. At first you think the building must be collapsing. You take cover and lift your arms above your head to shield yourself from falling rubble, but no debris strikes you. Instead, it is an echoing roar that brings you to your knees and forces the air out of your lungs. Your eardrums threaten to shatter as the sound grows louder and louder. Darkness creeps into your vision until it swallows your memories whole.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. In your Campaign Log, record Dagon has awakened. (→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: The building rumbles to its foundations. Something sinister is happening deep below the halls of the Order of Dagon. If you don't stop it, who knows what may be unleashed?
all_card.real_text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 密教里面每个房间都是他们宏大阴谋的一部分——那根植于密教之基的秘密，那印斯茅斯根源的毒药——但无论这秘密是什么，都已经超出了你的认知。但至少此刻你发现了这栋建筑背后的秘密：它不过是密教真正总部的掩护。你打开通往楼下巨穴深处的门，想知道这下面还会栖身着什么样的秘密……
all_card.back_text: 如果有[[嫌犯]]敌人在场上，将其从游戏中移除。 将除宏伟入口外的每个地点从游戏中移除(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其加入胜利区)，弃掉这些地点的所有卡牌。 混洗放在一边的潮水通道地点，将其全部放置入场。 提升每个地点的淹没等级。 将放在一边的朔望和星潮合相卡牌，和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: “咱们都和达贡立下了第一道誓约，后来还有第二道和第三道，有的人也立了。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 第一誓约
all_card.text: 每个[[嫌犯]]敌人得到+1[per_investigator]生命值，失去冷漠，并且不能与之谈判。 [free]花费蓝色、红色、白色或黄色钥匙：弃掉每张附属到你所在地点的[[屏障]]卡牌。 目标 - 如果所有幸存的调查员都在宏伟入口且调查员“解锁了洞穴的入口”，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Each of the Order's chambers are devoted to an aspect of their grand scheme - the secret that lies at the foundation of the Order, the poison that dwells in the roots of Innsmouth - but whatever that secret is, it is just beyond your grasp. At least, until the moment you discover the truth behind the building itself: It is nothing but a cover for the Order's true headquarters. As you unlock the pathway that leads into the cavernous depths beneath the building, you wonder what secrets could possibly dwell below...
all_card.real_back_text: If a [[Suspect]] enemy is in play, remove it from the game. Remove each location other than Grand Entryway from the game (or add them to the victory display if they have Victory X and no clues on them), discarding each card at those locations. Shuffle the set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations and put each of them into play. Increase the flood level of each location. Shuffle each set-aside Syzygy and Tidal Alignment card into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: "We all hed to take the Oath o' Dagon, an' later on they was secon' an' third Oaths that some of us took." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy gets +1 [per_investigator] health, loses aloof, and cannot be parleyed with. [fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Discard each [[Obstacle]] card attached to your location. Objective - If each surviving investigator is at Grand Entryway and the investigators have "unlocked the entrance to the caves," advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
你在洞穴中探索得越深，里面的构造就越奇异，非人。很快，你就觉得自己彷彿已经穿越门扉，完全到了另一个世界。这让你想到魔鬼礁石下的废墟，但彼处深渊应该离这里有数英里远……不是吗？还是这片网络如此广大，以至于延伸遍布整个印斯茅斯？
很快，你就在鎏金走廊组成的网络中央遇上了一大串门。从这厅堂延伸出许多通路，但这门——还有墙中嗡嗡传来的沉重呼吸，还有这地面——都在呼唤着你……
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的达贡巢穴地点放置入场，完全淹没。 将放在一边的达贡敌人放置入场，放在达贡巢穴，(深入沉睡)面朝上。 检查当前密谋。 - 如果是密谋1a，在混乱袋中加入10个[curse]标记。 - 如果是密谋2a，在混乱袋中加入5个[curse]标记。
all_card.flavor: 你深入密教总部底下的洞穴，不知道前方深处有什么可怕的命运在等着你。
all_card.name: 第二誓约
all_card.text: 每个[[嫌犯]]敌人得到+1[per_investigator]生命值，失去冷漠，并且不能与之谈判。 [free]花费蓝色、红色、白色或黄色钥匙：弃掉每张附属到你所在地点的[[屏障]]卡牌。 目标 - 如果有调查员“解锁了最终深渊”，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The more you explore the caverns, the more alien and inhuman the architecture becomes. Soon, it feels like you have crossed the threshold of another world entirely. It is reminiscent of the ruins you saw beneath Devil Reef, but those depths are miles from here... right? Or is this network of caves so vast, it spans the entirety of Innsmouth?
Soon you come upon a grand set of doors in the center of the web of gilded corridors. Many other paths stem from this hall, but it is this door - and the strange, heavy breathing that thrums throughout the walls and the floor - that calls to you...
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Lair of Dagon location into play, fully flooded. Put the set-aside Dagon enemy into play at Lair of Dagon, (Deep in Slumber) side faceup. Check the current agenda. - If it is agenda 1a, add 10 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag. - If it is agenda 2a, add 5 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.
all_card.real_flavor: You descend into the caverns beneath the Order of Dagon's headquarters, unaware of the horrific fate that awaits you in the depths.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy gets +1 [per_investigator] health, loses aloof, and cannot be parleyed with. [fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Discard each [[Obstacle]] card attached to your location. Objective - If an investigator has "unlocked the final depths," advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
洞穴里突然一阵寂静。唯一的声响就是密教隐藏洞穴中倒影池里的水滴轻语，还有你自己的猛烈心跳——因为你正极力理解自己究竟看到了什么。密教执行的仪式已由你亲手破坏，但道森特工看上去并未放松。“好了。好了。这样。”他在咳嗽间挤出几个字来，他摆摆手，放低了武器。“来吧，快点。我们还有别的任务。”
别的任务？你可不知道道森在说什么。他注意到你的困惑，摇了摇头。“没时间解释了。跟我来。”然后一阵模糊的黑暗占据了你的记忆…
all_card.back_text: 在剧本日志中，记录密教的仪式被破坏。 - 如果达贡(深入沉睡)在场上，在剧本日志中，记录达贡仍沉睡。 - 如果达贡(苏醒狂怒)在场上或胜利区，在剧本日志中，记录达贡已苏醒。 (→结局1)
all_card.flavor: 密教最终的秘密就藏在这扇门后。密教宣誓效忠的存在就在这里。这个生物已将他们攥在手心。此乃暗潮之源。
all_card.name: 第三誓约
all_card.text: 每个[[嫌犯]]敌人得到+1[per_investigator]生命值，失去冷漠，并且不能与之谈判。 [free]花费蓝色、红色、白色或黄色钥匙：弃掉每张附属到你所在地点的[[屏障]]卡牌。 目标 - 在本场景上放置线索，以此破坏密教的仪式。如果本场景上有3[per_investigator]个线索，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A sudden stillness permeates the chamber. The only sound you hear is the gentle rippling of the reflecting pool inside the cult's hidden lair, and the pounding of your own heart in your chest as you struggle to understand what you have seen. Whatever ritual the Order was performing has been disrupted by your hand, but Agent Dawson does not look relieved. "Okay. Okay. Right," he says through choked breaths. His hands shake as he lowers his weapon. "Come on, quickly. We have another task to perform." Another task? You have no idea what Dawson is talking about. He notices your confusion and shakes his head. "No time to explain. Follow me." Then a fuzzy darkness overtakes your memories...
all_card.real_back_text: In your Campaign Log, record the Order's ritual was disrupted. - If Dagon (Deep in Slumber) is in play, in your Campaign Log, record Dagon still slumbers. - If Dagon (Awakened and Enraged) is in play or in the victory display, in your Campaign Log, record Dagon has awakened. (→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: The Order's final secret lies just beyond this door. The entity to which the Order's service is pledged. The creature that holds them in its clutches. The conspiracy's beating heart.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy gets +1 [per_investigator] health, loses aloof, and cannot be parleyed with. [fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Discard each [[Obstacle]] card attached to your location. Objective - Disrupt the Order's ritual by placing clues on this act. If there are 3 [per_investigator] clues on this act, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 在荒废的表面之下，这座厅堂里塞满了古代的财富。两尊破裂的塑像拱卫着入口，后面深处两道木楼梯通往二楼。楼梯下你的左右藏着另外两扇门，厅堂另一头也有一扇锁着的门。
all_card.name: 宏伟入口
all_card.text: 宏伟入口与每个[[洞穴]]地点相连接，反之亦然。 [action]：撤退。你受够了这个地方。 [action]在宏伟入口的调查员共同花费紫色钥匙和3[per_investigator]个线索：记住你“解锁了洞穴的入口”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The lobby is full of old wealth hidden under layers of decrepitude. Two cracked statues flank the entrance, behind which loom two sets of wooden stairs leading up to the second floor. Two more doors hide under the stairways to your left and right, and a final locked door stands at the end of the hall.
all_card.real_text: Grand Entryway is connected to each [[Cave]] location, and vice versa. [action] Resign. You've had enough of this place. [action] Investigators at the Grand Entryway spend the purple key and 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that you have "unlocked the entrance to the caves".

all_card.back_flavor: 楼梯下这扇歪扭的门后面散发出一股恶臭。
all_card.name: 鲜血厅堂
all_card.text: 强制 - 鲜血厅堂揭示后：将放在一边的红色钥匙放在其上。 强制 - 你调查鲜血厅堂时，技能检定失败后：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A foul stench emanates from behind the crooked door beneath the staircase.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Hall of Blood is revealed: Place the set-aside red key on it. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Hall of Blood: Take 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 楼梯下这扇歪扭的门后面散发出一股恶臭。
all_card.name: 深海厅堂
all_card.text: [action]花费红色钥匙：血之纹章在石头祭坛上完美契合，发出一声清晰的喀哒。将放在一边的伊哈·恩斯雷雕塑剧情支援放置入场，由你控制，[[诅咒萦绕]]面朝上。 强制 - 深海厅堂揭示后：提升其淹没等级。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A foul stench emanates from behind the crooked door beneath the staircase.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend the red key: There is an audible click as the crest of blood fits into the stone altar. Put the set-aside Y'ha-nthlei Statue story asset into play under your control, [[Cursed]] side faceup. Forced - After Hall of the Deep is revealed: Increase its flood level.

all_card.back_flavor: 通往厅室的门后，模糊的脚步声渐行渐远渐消逝。那里是有人吗？
all_card.flavor: 这里或许曾是富丽堂皇之地。但现在空余发霉腐坏的臭味。
all_card.name: 邪秽走廊
all_card.text: [action]花费黑色钥匙：记住你“解锁了三楼”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Behind the door to the hall, muffled footsteps fade into the distance. Is there someone here?
all_card.real_flavor: This might have been an opulent hall, once. Now it reeks of mold and decay.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend the black key: Remember that you have "unlocked the third floor."

all_card.back_flavor: 二楼有两扇门，其中一扇后面的厅室里传来了压抑的吟唱声。声音在厅堂中回荡混响，很难分清究竟说了什么。
all_card.name: 笃忠厅堂
all_card.text:
[free]花费蓝色、红色、白色或黄色钥匙：选择以下其中3项——
- 治愈1点伤害。
- 抽取2张卡牌。
- 获得3资源。
- 在混乱袋中加入4个[bless]标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Muffled chanting fills the corridor from behind one of the two doors on the second floor. The reverberation of sound throughout the hall makes it difficult to determine which.
all_card.real_text:
[fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Choose 3 of the following - 
- Heal 1 damage.
- Draw 2 cards.
- Gain 3 resources.
- Add 4 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag.

all_card.back_flavor: 二楼有两扇门，其中一扇后面的厅室里传来了压抑的吟唱声。声音在厅堂中回荡混响，很难分清究竟说了什么。
all_card.flavor: “将汝献给母神海德拉，将汝献给父神达贡，以获新生！”那个低语如此提议。
all_card.name: 重生厅堂
all_card.text: 强制 - 你揭示重生厅堂后：抽取放在一边的达贡宣教士敌人。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Muffled chanting fills the corridor from behind one of the two doors on the second floor. The reverberation of sound throughout the hall makes it difficult to determine which.
all_card.real_flavor: "Offer yourself to Mother Hydra and Father Dagon and be born anew!" the whispers propose.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Hall of Rebirth: Draw the set-aside Apostle of Dagon enemy.

all_card.back_flavor: 楼梯顶部的门上有着环状的刻印，预示着得把什么放在这儿，才能打开前行的门。
all_card.back_text: 调查员不能移动到三楼厅室，除非有调查员已经“解锁了三楼”。
all_card.name: 寂静厅堂
all_card.text: 强制 - 寂静厅堂揭示后：将放在一边的紫色钥匙放在其上。 强制 - 本地点的调查员技能检定失败后：在混乱袋中加入1个[curse]标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A circular indentation on the door at the top of the staircase suggests that something must be placed here in order to open the way forward.
all_card.real_back_text: Investigators cannot move to Third Floor Hall unless an investigator has "unlocked the third floor."
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Hall of Silence is revealed: Place the set-aside purple key on it. Forced - After an investigator at this location fails a skill test: Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag.

all_card.back_flavor: 这里的空气寒冷刺骨，除了水滴在粗糙石面上的轻声之外，万籁俱寂。你打了个寒战，继续向前……
all_card.name: 深渊门扉
all_card.text: 强制 - 深渊门扉揭示后：将放在一边的绿色钥匙放在线索最多的地点上。 [action]在深渊门扉的调查员共同花费绿色钥匙和3个[per_investigator]线索：记住你“解锁了最终深渊”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The air is frigid here, and there is no sound but the faint plinking of water dripping onto the rough stone ground. You shudder and proceed onward...
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Doorway to the Depths is revealed: Place the set-aside green key on the location with the most clues. [action] Investigators at the Doorway to the Depths spend the green key and 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that you have "unlocked the final depths."

all_card.back_flavor: 门扉彼端陡峭扭曲的阶梯将你引入建筑底下更深更深的远处。这片领域满是诡异的构造和奇谲的财富，你深入其中，两边水生怪物的塑像凝视着你。
all_card.name: 达贡巢穴
all_card.text: 强制 - 你进入达贡巢穴后：检定你技能值最低的技能(3)。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)或[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，将你的1个线索放到当前场景上。你可以花费1个钥匙以再将你的1个线索放到当前场景上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The steep, twisting stairway beyond the doorway leads you deeper and deeper into the caverns below the building. Effigies depicting aquatic monstrosities watch you from both sides as you descend into a realm of alien architecture and otherworldly riches.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Lair of Dagon: Test your lowest skill (3). If you fail, take 1 horror. [action]: Test [willpower] (3) or [agility] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on the current act. You may spend 1 key to place 1 more of your clues on the current act.

all_card.name: 达贡
all_card.text: 达贡正在沉睡。他不能攻击，不能与调查员交战，免疫调查员行动和玩家卡牌效果。 强制 - 本地点的调查员技能检定失败后：在达贡上放置1资源。然后，如果达贡上有至少1[per_investigator]+2资源，将他翻面。 [action]花费1钥匙：从达贡上移除1资源。
all_card.real_text: Dagon is slumbering. He cannot attack or engage, and is immune to investigator actions and player card effects. Forced - After an investigator at this location fails a skill test: Place 1 resource on Dagon. Then, if there are at least 1 [per_investigator] +2 resources on Dagon, flip him. [action] Spend 1 key: Remove 1 resource from Dagon.

all_card.name: 达贡
all_card.text: 庞大。 达贡得到+6[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 本地点的调查员技能检定失败后：重整达贡。达贡攻击该调查员。
all_card.real_text: Massive. Dagon gets +6 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After an investigator at this location fails a skill test: Ready Dagon. Dagon attacks that investigator.

all_card.name: 达贡宣教士
all_card.text: 达贡宣教士得到+1[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 达贡宣教士入场后：将放在一边的黑色钥匙放在其上。 强制 - 在调查员对达贡宣教士造成至少1点伤害时：在混乱袋中加入1个[curse]标记。
all_card.traits: 类人. 混血. 异教徒
all_card.real_text: Apostle of Dagon gets +1 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After Apostle of Dagon enters play: Place the set-aside black key on it. Forced - When an investigator deals 1 or more damage to Apostle of Dagon: Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag.

all_card.name: 瑟瑞尼连海深潜者
all_card.text: 猎物 - [willpower]最低。 猎手。 强制 - 瑟瑞尼连海深潜者与你交战后：在混乱袋中加入2个[curse]标记。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 深潜者
all_card.real_text: Prey - Lowest [willpower]. Hunter. Forced - After Cerenerian Deep One engages you: Add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.

all_card.name: 践行誓约

all_card.back_flavor: 玛丽修女坚信，越是有诡奇奥义的力量在世上作怪，自己就越要在这条道路上抵御那些力量，只要有可能，无论有多远，都要保护无辜之人。尽管除了教会的罩袍和坚定的信仰之外别无他物，但玛丽修女只要一从同侪那里听闻超自然的威胁作祟，必然挺身前往一探究竟。教会中其他成员对此不屑一顾，以为这些都是中世纪的无知妄言。但玛丽修女知道，这些阴影中潜藏着真实的邪恶——她还知道这些邪恶如果听之任之，会给主创造的一切都带来毁灭和恐怖。
all_card.back_text: 牌组卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-2。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：守护天使、信仰危机、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor:
“主看护我的道路。
我以信为胄。”
all_card.name: 玛丽修女

冒险设置期间，在混乱袋中加入2个[bless]标记。

[elder_sign]效果：+1。如果你检定成功，在混乱袋中加入一个[bless]标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The more Sister Mary learns of the strange and arcane forces that sometimes manifest in this world, the more certain she is that she has been set upon a path to ward off these forces and protect the innocent wherever possible. Armed only with the trappings of her church and an unshakable faith, Sister Mary seeks out every supernatural threat she hears of through her fellow priests and nuns. Other members of her church may dismiss such things as medieval nonsense, but Sister Mary knows the real evils that exist in the shadows - and she knows that if such evils are left unchecked, they will bring ruin and horror to all of creation.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Guardian Angel, Crisis of Faith, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "The Lord watches over my path. I am armored in faith."
all_card.real_text:
During setup, add 2 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag.
[reaction] When the round ends: Add 1 [bless] token to the chaos bag.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If you succeed, add 1 [bless] token to the chaos bag.

all_card.back_flavor: 阿曼达·夏普眼看就要成为米大最杰出的毕业生。但自从她看见一幅诡奇的绘画之后，课业就受到了影响。画上是一个庞然巨物从深海涌起。她的梦境中全是一座巨大的沉没之城，还有不明言语的低语。她继续埋头研究，但目标已不是以尖子生的身份毕业，而是她定要找到现实之间潜藏的异教秘密究竟有何含义。
all_card.back_text: 牌组卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，[[精通]]技能卡牌等级0-3。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：晦涩研究、深海低语、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.name: 阿曼达·夏普

all_card.real_back_flavor: Amanda Sharpe was on track to become one of Miskatonic University's most accomplished graduates. However, ever since she saw a strange painting of an enormous creature's emergence from the depths of the ocean, her classwork has suffered. Her dreams are overwhelmed by images of a vast submerged city and whispers in a language she does not understand. She remains dedicated to her studies, but her goal is no longer to graduate at the top of her class; rather, she seeks to discover the meaning behind the occult secrets concealed between the lines of reality.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Practiced]] skills level 0-3. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Obscure Studies, Whispers from the Deep, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the start of the investigation phase: Draw 1 card. Discard the card beneath Amanda Sharpe. Choose a card from your hand and place it beneath her. Forced - At the start of a skill test you are performing: Commit the card beneath Amanda Sharpe, if able. Do not discard it when the test ends. [elder_sign] effect: +0. For this test, you may double the number of skill icons on the card beneath Amanda Sharpe.

all_card.back_flavor: 特里希向来文武双全，她坚定不移，追求卓越，无所畏惧，敢打敢拼，让她屡屡马到成功。鉴于她智体皆优的毕业记录，人人都指望她再干一番大事业。但特里希却去了一家商业密码公司。她的工作实在平平，旁人最初的惊讶也都消磨，一度被寄予重望的特里希·斯卡波罗已经泯然众人。但这却很适合特里希，也让旁人更难发现真相：她日常的工作不过是一种伪装，真实身份却是黑室这一官方译码特工组织的间谍。

[elder_sign]效果：+2。如果是调查检定，你可以选择任意已揭示地点：改为你如同在该地点调查。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Trish had always excelled in both body and mind, her unwavering focus on excellence and her fearless disposition a winning combination. Given her stellar academic and athletic records, everyone expected to see her become something great. Instead, Trish took a job at a commercial code company. The initial shock of her humble work eventually wore off, and the exceptional Trish Scarborough faded into obscurity. This suited Trish just fine, as it made it harder for anyone to realize the truth: her job was a cover for her true work as a spy with the Black Chamber, the Bureau's code-breaking agency.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): In the Shadows, Shadow Agents, 1 random basic weakness.

[elder_sign] effect: +2. If this is an investigation, you may choose any revealed location; you are now investigating as if you were at that location instead.

all_card.back_flavor: 戴克斯特·德雷克从大战退役后成了一名优秀的魔术师，总能用精巧的幻象和别出心裁的舞台技巧迷惑观众。尽管他声名鹊起，戴克斯特还是想发现真正的魔法。他为自己在战争中找到的密教文本着了魔，尽管这是一截火烧过的断章，但它也却是臭名昭著的《死灵之书》中的一节。戴克斯特用自己的财富寻找古代典籍之后的真相，但他的发现却叫人毛骨悚然。他知道，除了自己，可能再没人能阻止邪恶吞噬整个世界。
all_card.back_text: 牌组卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：精湛手法、密教残页、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “想看看真正的魔法吗？”
all_card.name: 戴克斯特·德雷克
all_card.text:

[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以将你游戏区域的一张支援返回你的手牌。然后，抽取一张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Dexter Drake returned from the Great War to become a successful magician, enthralling audiences with his elaborate illusions and cunning stage tricks. Despite his meteoric success, Dexter longed to discover true magic. He was intrigued by the burnt and torn scraps of occult writing he had found during the war - fragments of the infamous Necronomicon. Dexter used his wealth to search for the truth about this ancient lore, and what he found horrified him. He knows that he may well be the only person with the ability to stop evil from swallowing the entire world.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Showmanship, Occult Scraps, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "Do you want to see true magic?"

[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may return an asset from your play area to your hand. Then, draw 1 card.

all_card.back_flavor: 自打在海岸滩涂上蹒跚学步，塞拉斯·马什就深深爱上了大海。他不假思索就决定要做一名水手。他体格健壮、对天气有着超凡的感知，这让他名声在外，出海的每条船都认得。只有一件事困扰着塞拉斯：他一次次地梦到浪涛之下恼人的城市，还有栖息其中的古怪生物。这些梦境在召唤他，扰动他内心深处的一些东西，那些他以为已经留在家乡印斯茅斯的东西。
all_card.back_text: 牌组卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，[[天性]]技能卡牌等级0-2。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：骇变鱼叉、塞拉斯的渔网、海妖之唤、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “出海了就别怕，小子。”
all_card.name: 塞拉斯·马什

all_card.real_back_flavor: Silas Marsh has loved the sea ever since he was old enough to toddle through its briny shallows. Becoming a sailor was the easiest decision he ever made, and his sturdy frame and excellent sense for the weather have given him a good reputation aboard any vessel. There is only one thing troubling Silas: over and over again, he dreams of unsettling cities hidden beneath the waves and inhabited by bizarre creatures. These dreams call to him, stirring something deep within him that he thought he had left behind in his hometown of Innsmouth.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Innate]] skills level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Sea Change Harpoon, Silas's Net, Siren Call, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "Leave your fears on the docks, lads."

all_card.back_flavor: 你最担心的事情业已成真。刚刚还不到你脚踝的水塘漫了上来，水流汇集。你赶忙爬上高处，但这份努力无济于事。几分钟的工夫，水位已经漫过了你的膝盖，毫无减缓的迹象。

all_card.flavor: 附近的地上躺着一条死掉的三文鱼，带鳞的血肉已经开始腐败。你从水藻和湿漉漉的岩壁看出，这个洞穴不久前还在水下。距离涨潮还有多少时间？
all_card.name: 惊醒
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你回合开始时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your worst fears are coming true. Puddles of water that had barely reached your ankles are rising and joining one another. You scramble to find higher ground, but your efforts are for naught. In a matter of minutes, the water level has risen to your knees and shows no sign of slowing.
all_card.real_back_text:
Increase the flood level of each revealed location.
Until the end of the game, each time a location is revealed, increase its flood level.
Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to agenda 2a.
all_card.real_flavor: A salmon lays dead on the ground nearby, its scaly flesh just starting to rot. You can tell from the kelp and the dripping-wet walls that this cavern was underwater not too long ago. How much time do you have before high tide?
all_card.real_text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 洞窟内的水位持续上涨，你的恐惧指数也不断上升。没要多久，你就无法在洞内行走，不得不游泳。许多隧道已完全淹没。要是你不快点出去，很快就会无处呼吸。
all_card.back_text:
每个已揭示地点变为完全淹没。
直到游戏结束，每当地点揭示时，其变为完全淹没。
将本卡牌放在场景牌库旁作为提示(取代密谋1b)，并推进到密谋3a。
all_card.flavor: 你每一步都溅起周围的水流，水声洪亮。要是潮水继续上涨，几个小时就会把整个洞窟完全淹没。
all_card.name: 水位涌起
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你回合开始时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You panic as the water level continues to rise within the cavern. Before long, you are swimming instead of walking on the flooded cavern floor. Many of the tunnels are fully submerged. If you don't get out of here quickly, there will be nowhere safe to catch your breath.
all_card.real_back_text:
Each revealed location becomes fully flooded.
Until the end of the game, each time a location is revealed, it becomes fully flooded.
Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder (replacing agenda 1b), and advance to agenda 3a.
all_card.real_flavor: Your every movement is coupled with the loud swashing of rippling water all around you. If the tide continues to rise, the cavern will be completely submerged in a matter of hours.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 你肺部抽紧。胸膛里心脏剧烈跳动。潮水以万钧之力涌来，激流将你拖至冰冷水面的深处。你挣扎着求取空气，但世界已是一片漆黑。
all_card.back_text: 幸存的每位调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 整个洞窟都已淹没水下，只剩下几块突出的岩石还可栖身。你必须找到出去的路，并且要快……
all_card.name: 献于深海
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你回合开始时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your lungs constrict. Your heart hammers in your chest. As the tide rolls in, the current tugs you deeper under the surface of the ice-cold water. Everything goes dark as you struggle to find air.
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and takes 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: Save for a few rocky perches, the entire cavern system is submerged in seawater. You have to find a way out of here, and soon...
all_card.real_text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 你找到一条路通往这奇怪洞穴的更深处。但就在你迈步看看它通向何处之前，背后席卷的水声让你心脏狂跳不止。你转头面对声音的来源，但看到的东西几乎把你吓晕过去。这个庞大的混合生物有着万千面容和身形——有的是人类，有的是水生生物——所有的一切都变形和溶解了。那东西越来越近，你望见它身上一张脸传来冰冷的视线，你意识到自己竟然认识。
all_card.back_text: 生成放在一边的混生畸物敌人，与调查员队长交战。 将每张放在一边的有眼无珠和来自深渊，和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。 混洗每张放在一边的潮水通道地点，组成潮水通道牌库(包括放在一边的达贡祭坛、偶像洞室、封印出口地点)。从潮水通道牌库顶将地点放置入场，放在每个已揭示地点的下方、左方和右方。 阅读剧本手册的记忆闪回I
all_card.flavor: 你在湿漉漉的洞窟里惊醒，意识从记忆里抽离……但此处还有他物。无论洞窟里有什么活物，都势必与你为敌。你得逃出这里，回到文明世界。
all_card.name: 深坑
all_card.real_back_flavor: You find a path that leads deeper into this strange cave system, but before you can follow it to see where it leads, the sound of water sloshing behind you sets your heart racing. When you turn to face the sound, what you see next nearly causes you to faint. It is an enormous hybrid of many faces and shapes - some human, some aquatic - all of them misshapen and revolting. As the thing draws closer, you meet the frozen gaze of one of the faces upon its body, and you realize that you recognize it.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside The Amalgam enemy engaged with the lead investigator. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Blindsense and From the Depths into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Shuffle each of the set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations together to form the Tidal Tunnel deck (including the set-aside Altar to Dagon, Idol Chamber, and Sealed Exit locations). Put locations from the top of the Tidal Tunnel deck into play below, to the left, and to the right of each revealed location. Read Flashback I in the Campaign Guide.
all_card.real_flavor: You have awakened in a waterlogged cavern, your mind robbed of its memories... and you are not alone. Whatever else lives in this cavern, it can't possibly be friendly. You have to get out of this place and back to civilization.

all_card.back_flavor:
隧道往前没有尽头。你的肺已经开始抽痛。你已经屏息太久，远超自己以为的极限。有那么一刻，你想过回头。但现在整个洞窟肯定都已完全淹没。即便还有地方幸免，你也不想再回去面对深居其中已久的怪物。不，并无回头一说。你唯一的希望就是坚持向前。
又过了一会儿。隧道变窄，水流愈强。你的胸膛感觉就要炸开。最后，你终于突破冰冷的海水，滚出了洞窟，瘫倒在岩石嶙峋的海岸上。
all_card.flavor: 这究竟是什么鬼地方，你又怎么会困在这儿？你得找到一条路出去，但你肯定还有更多记忆藏在深坑某处……
all_card.name: 逃离此处
all_card.text: 强制 - 地点揭示后：从潮水通道牌库顶将地点放置入场，放在该地点的下方、左方和右方。 目标 - 这儿一定有路能出去。如果所有幸存的调查员都撤退，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The tunnel continues onward with no end in sight. Your lungs heave with pain. You have held your breath far longer than you ever thought possible. For a moment you wonder if you should turn back, but by now the entire cavern must be completely submerged. Even if it weren't, you couldn't hope to outlast the creatures that dwell inside for very long. No, there is no going back. Your only hope is to press forward.
Another minute passes. The current seems to grow stronger as the tunnel narrows ahead. Your chest feels as though it is about to burst. Finally, you emerge from ice-cold seawater and tumble out of the cavern, landing hard on a rocky shore.
all_card.real_flavor: What in the hell is this place, and why have you been trapped here? You have to find a way out, but more of your memories might be tucked away in this pit...
all_card.real_text: Forced - After a location is revealed: Put locations from the top of the Tidal Tunnel deck into play below, to the left, and to the right of that location. Objective - There must be a way out of here somewhere. If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.

如果在剧本日志中，“恢复记忆”下方列出了一起行动的决定：
调查数日之后，你和道森特工碰头，核对情况。他掏出一件绿宝石雕像，看着是某种水生怪物，中央嵌着一块心型的琥魄。你调查研究这腐烂之地已有数日，看到这东西竟觉得莫名得熟悉。“我很庆幸把你卷进来了。”道森说道，“这事情越看越不像是黑帮干的。我们接下来还是一起行动吧。”
选择一位调查员控制放在一边的托马斯·道森剧情支援。在本场冒险的剩余时间内，他不占用盟友槽位。
all_card.flavor: “在这座充斥着死亡和异像的城市里，神神秘秘、鬼鬼祟祟的事情随处可见。我总觉得自己被监视了，四面八方都是永不闭合的诡诈之眼，一直盯着我。” <cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 腐朽衰败
all_card.text: 强制 - 如果你击败了非绑架犯的[[嫌犯]]敌人：控制该敌人的每个线索。在剧本日志中，记录(该敌人名字)要你血债血偿。
all_card.back_flavor: 印斯茅斯的敌意与日俱增。村民们已经知晓了你的存在，兴许还明白你为何而来。
all_card.real_back_text:
The town of Innsmouth grows more and more hostile with each day that passes. The townsfolk have caught on to your presence, and perhaps even the reason for your visit.
Shuffle the set-aside Winged One and both Hunting Nightgaunts into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
If a decision to stick together is listed under "Memories Recovered" in your Campaign Log:
After several days of investigation, you meet up with Agent Dawson to check in with him. He shows you a figurine of emerald stone depicting some sort of aquatic monstrosity, a piece of heart-shaped amber embedded in its center. After the days you have spent investigating and researching this foul place, the creature is oddly familiar to you. "I'm glad I roped you in on this case," Dawson says. "It's looking less and less like mob work with each passing hour. Let's stick together from here on out."
Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Thomas Dawson story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, he does not take up an ally slot.
all_card.real_flavor: "Furtiveness and secretiveness seemed universal in this hushed city of alienage and death, and I could not escape the sensation of being watched from ambush on every hand by sly, staring eyes that never shut." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: Forced - If you defeat a [[Suspect]] enemy other than the kidnapper: Take control of each clue on that enemy. Record in your Campaign Log (name of enemy) is out for blood.

闯入者溺毙深海
也许你该蛰伏一段时间……
all_card.flavor: “这场追捕的组织有多严密——甚至他们是为了什么——老实说，我都一无所知。” <cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 愈发起疑

all_card.real_back_flavor:
As night falls once more on the town of Innsmouth, you return to your hotel room to find that it has been completely ransacked. Your luggage is ravaged, its contents strewn about. Much of your gear has been stolen. Scrawled on the wall in black paint is a warning:
INTERLOPERS DROWN IN THE DEEP
Perhaps you should lay low for a while...
all_card.real_flavor: "Just how fully the pursuit was organised - and indeed, just what its purpose might be - I could form no idea." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth

all_card.back_flavor: 是时候摊牌了。你竭力追踪哈珀特工的脚步，关于印斯茅斯及其村民，你已知晓不少。也许依靠手头的信息，你可以缩小范围，找出哈珀在哪儿。但你必须动作迅速，杀伐决断，不然绑架者肯定就会知道你追上来了。你只有一次机会抓住真凶。只有一次机会找到哈珀在哪，打绑架犯一个措手不及。要是你错了，就得回到原点……甚至更糟。
all_card.back_text: 阅读剧本手册中的冒险幕间故事：指控。
all_card.flavor: 翌日清晨，你和道森特工分头行动，去寻找他失踪的特工……
all_card.name: 寻找哈珀特工
all_card.text: [free]调查员共同花费X[per_investigator]个线索：谈判。揭示迹象牌堆顶的X张卡牌(最多为3)并抽取其中1张。将其余卡牌和遭遇牌库顶的卡牌一起混洗入迹象牌堆。(团队每轮仅限一次。) 目标 - 当任意一轮结束时，你可以推进。(提示：你将在推进时发起指控。在你确信自己已经缩小了范围，足够找到哈珀特工的绑架者和藏身处时推进。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The time has come for you to reveal your hand. You've retraced Agent Harper's steps as best you can and learned a lot about Innsmouth and its citizenry. Perhaps with this information, you can narrow down where Harper is now. But if you aren't swift and decisive, the kidnapper will surely discover you are onto them. You have only one chance to get this right. One chance to locate Harper and surprise her kidnapper. If you're wrong, it's back to square one... or worse.
all_card.real_back_text: Read Scenario Interlude: The Accusation in the Campaign Guide.
all_card.real_flavor: The next morning, you and Agent Dawson split up and search for his missing agent...
all_card.real_text: [fast] The investigators spend X [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Parley. Reveal the top X cards of the Leads deck (to a maximum of 3) and draw 1 of them. Shuffle the rest back into the Leads deck, along with the top card of the encounter deck. (Group limit once per round.) Objective - You may advance at the end of any round. (Hint: You will have to make an accusation when you advance. Advance when you believe you have narrowed down Agent Harper's kidnapper and whereabouts.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你解开哈珀特工的束缚，帮她站了起来，她朝你露出解脱的温暖微笑。“我不知道你是谁，但多谢了。不过在官方记录中，这些事情还都是我搞定的。”她被自己的玩笑逗乐了。尽管刚刚还危在旦夕，但特工现在已是自信满满。你自我介绍了一番，告诉他自己是受雇来帮忙找她的。“很好，我很高兴你在这儿。你来的正是时候。现在，要是你不介意的话，我和这家伙还有账没算。”她的声音尖利起来，带着一股愤慨，“要和我一起吗？”

all_card.flavor: 所有的线索都指向此处。你必须不惜任何代价营救哈珀特工！
all_card.name: 营救

all_card.real_back_flavor: Agent Harper gives you a warm smile of relief as you untie her bindings and help her to her feet. "I don't know who you are, but thank you. I did have things handled, though, for the record." She chuckles at her own joke. Despite her situation, the agent carries herself with the confidence of one who has been in deadly circumstances before. You introduce yourself and tell her you were hired to help find her. "Well then, I'm very glad you're here. You came in the nick of time. Now, if you don't mind, I have some unfinished business with this associate of mine," she says, her voice sharp with indignation. "Care to join me?"
all_card.real_back_text: - If Brian Burnham was the kidnapper, proceed to (→R2). - If Othera Gilman was the kidnapper, proceed to (→R3). - If Joyce Little was the kidnapper, proceed to (→R4). - If Barnabas Marsh was the kidnapper, proceed to (→R5). - If Zadok Allen was the kidnapper, proceed to (→R6). - If Robert Friendly was the kidnapper, proceed to (→R7).
all_card.real_flavor: All of your evidence leads here. You must rescue Agent Harper at all costs!

Objective - If either the kidnapper is in the victory display, or there are no clues on Elina Harper's location, advance (if there are 2 or more investigators in the game, both conditions must be fulfilled, instead).

all_card.back_flavor: “他发现马什精炼厂有些奇怪——这是一座位于马奴赛特河下游瀑布旁的老厂子。他所说的大体和我听到的差不多。账本残破不全，一笔清楚的明细都没有。你得知道，马什到底是从哪搞来精炼的金子，可一直都是个未解之谜。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.flavor: “不过，那家精炼厂倒是笔买卖。那里的老板，老马什，肯定富甲一方。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 马什精炼厂
all_card.text: [action][action]：抽取4张卡牌。(每场游戏仅限一次)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "He found the Marsh refinery a queer place - it's in an old mill on the lower falls of the Manuxet. What he said tallied up with what I'd heard. Books in bad shape, and no clear account of any kind of dealings. You know it's always ben a kind of mystery where the Marshes get the gold they refine." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_flavor: "That refinery, though, used to be a big thing, and Old Man Marsh, who owns it, must be richer'n Croesus." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Draw 4 cards. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: “没错，印斯茅斯是有家旅店——叫吉尔曼旅社——但我不觉得会好到哪里去。我可不会推荐你去那儿住。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.flavor: “吉尔曼旅社边上有几扇窗子闪着微光，我觉得自己听到里面有混乱的声音。” <cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 吉尔曼旅社
all_card.text: [action]：治愈2点伤害，或2点恐惧，或1点伤害和1点恐惧。(每场游戏仅限一次)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Yes, there's a hotel in Innsmouth - called the Gilman House - but I don't believe it can amount to much. I wouldn't advise you to try it." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_flavor: "Some of the windows on the Gilman House side were faintly glowing, and I thought I heard confused sounds within." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: [action]: Heal 2 damage or 2 horror (or any combination thereof). (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: “鹅卵石广场的一侧是笔直的河道，另一端则是斜顶砖房围成的半圆，这些房子大约都是十九世纪的。几条街道通往东南、南方和西南。路灯又少又小，都是低功率的白炽灯，简直致郁……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.flavor: “不消说，这就是印斯茅斯村中心。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 印斯茅斯广场
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你决定蛰伏一段时间。 [free]花费2资源：移动。移动到一个连接的[[印斯茅斯]]地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: One side of the cobblestoned open space was the straight line of the river; the other was a semicircle of slant-roofed brick buildings of about the 1800 period, from which several streets radiated away to the southeast, south, and southwest. Lamps were depressingly few and small - all low-powered incandescents..." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_flavor: "I did not need to be told that this was the civic centre of Innsmouth." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You decide to lay low for a while. [fast] Spend 2 resources: Move. Move to a connecting [[Innsmouth]] location.

all_card.back_flavor: “海港早就堆满了淤沙，外面堵着一段旧时的防波堤。我能辨认出堤上有几个小小的身影，是几个坐着的渔民。堤的尽头则是一座古时灯塔的地基。堤坝内部伸出一段沙地，我看见其上有几间破旧的小屋，停靠的渔船，还有七零八落的虾笼。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.flavor: “……你要是上那儿捕鱼，就能瞧瞧他们是怎么赶跑你的！”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 印斯茅斯港口
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你成功调查印斯茅斯港口且超过难度至少3点后：查看迹象牌库顶的卡牌。然后，混洗迹象牌库。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: "The harbour, long clogged with sand, was enclosed by an ancient stone breakwater; on which I could begin to discern the minute forms of a few seated fishermen, and at whose end were what looked like the foundations of a bygone lighthouse. A sandy tongue had formed inside this barrier, and upon it I saw a few decrepit cabins, moored dories, and scattered lobster-pots." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_flavor: "...just try to fish there yourself and see how the folks chase you off!" - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you successfully investigate Innsmouth Harbour by 3 or more: Look at the top card of the Leads deck. Then, shuffle the Leads deck. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: “出于某些原因，我选择第一站先去连锁杂货店打听消息。那里的员工不太可能是印斯茅斯本地人。” <cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 国立第一杂货铺
all_card.text: [action]：查找你牌库顶的6张卡牌，找出1张[[道具]]卡牌并将其加入你的手牌。混洗你的牌库。(每场游戏仅限一次)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "For some reason or other I chose to make my first inquiries at the chain grocery, whose personnel was not likely to be native to Innsmouth." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: [action]: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for an [[Item]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: “鱼街就和主街一样荒废，但不同的是这里有许多外形完好的砖石仓库。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.flavor: “根据村子的草图来看，鱼街旧桥已经塌了。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 鱼街旧桥
all_card.text: [action][action]：获得4资源。(每场游戏仅限一次)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Fish Street was as deserted as Main, though it differed in having many brick and stone warehouses still in excellent shape." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_flavor: "The Fish Street bridge, according to the sketch, was in ruins." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Gain 4 resources. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 小利透书店的温暖在沉闷的村子里别处都寻不着，这里是一片书架的迷宫，每一层的书都多到溢出来。
all_card.name: 小利透书店
all_card.text: 强制 - 你调查小利透书店时，在你技能检定失败后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌混洗入迹象牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A rare bit of warmth in an otherwise dreary town, The Little Bookshop is a narrow maze of shelves, each one spilling over with books.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating The Little Bookshop: Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the Leads deck.

all_card.flavor: “这里先前是共济会礼堂，而今却交给了一个堕落的教派。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>

all_card.real_flavor: "This, then, was the former Masonic Hall now given over to a degraded cult." - H. P. Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth

all_card.flavor: “在这附近走动时最好别太显眼……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《印斯茅斯之影》</cite>

all_card.name: 魂牵梦绕
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果你没有手牌，魂牵梦绕获得涌动。否则，随机弃掉你1张手牌。然后，检定[willpower](X)，其中X等于被弃掉卡牌的印刷费用。如果你检定失败，失去1个行动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If you have no cards in your hand, Psychic Pull gains surge. Otherwise, discard 1 random card from your hand. Then, test [willpower] (X), where X is the printed cost of the discarded card. If you fail, lose 1 action.

all_card.name: 深潜者巨怪
all_card.text: 强制 - 深潜者巨怪与你交战后：选择并弃掉你1张手牌。 强制 - 任意地点的调查员击败另一个[[深潜者]]敌人后：重整深潜者巨怪并且其朝该调查员的地点移动一次。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 深潜者
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Deep One Bull engages you: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. Forced - After an investigator defeats another [[Deep One]] enemy at any location: Ready Deep One Bull and move it once toward that investigator's location.

all_card.name: 潜伏的深潜者
all_card.text: 猎物 - [agility]最低。 强制 - 潜伏的深潜者与你交战后：受到1点伤害。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 深潜者
all_card.real_text: Prey - Lowest [agility]. Forced - After Lurking Deep One engages you: Take 1 damage.

all_card.name: 深潜者来袭
all_card.text: 显现 - 与你所在地点的每个[[深潜者]]敌人解除交战。你所在地点和连接地点的每个[[深潜者]]敌人与你交战。如果没有敌人因此效果与你交战，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个[[深潜者]]敌人，将其生成，与你交战，并混洗遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Disengage from each [[Deep One]] enemy at your location. Each [[Deep One]] enemy at your location and each connecting location engages you. If no enemies engage you from this effect, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Deep One]] enemy, spawn it engaged with you, and shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 暗流涌动
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果你所在地点未淹没，暗流涌动获得涌动。否则，将暗流涌动放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你移动后：受到2点伤害和2点恐惧。弃掉暗流涌动。 [free]弃掉你1的张手牌：检定[combat](3)或[agility](3)以在潮水中挣扎。如果你检定成功，弃掉暗流涌动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If your location is unflooded, Undertow gains surge. Otherwise, put Undertow into play in your threat area. Forced - After you move: Take 2 damage and 2 horror. Discard Undertow. [fast] Discard 1 card from your hand: Test [combat] (3) or [agility] (3) to fight the pull of the tides. If you succeed, discard Undertow.

all_card.name: 潮起
all_card.text: 显现 - 在能提升淹没等级的地点中，提升最近的地点的淹没等级。如果没有地点的淹没等级因此效果提升，潮起获得涌动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Increase the flood level of the nearest location that can have its flood level increased. If no location's flood level is increased by this effect, Rising Tides gains surge.

all_card.name: 激流
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果你所在地点未淹没，激流获得涌动。否则，检定[agility](3)(如果你所在地点完全淹没，则难度改为4)。如果你检定失败，选择并弃掉1个你控制的支援。如果你不能弃掉支援，改为你检定失败且每低于难度1点，失去1资源。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If your location is unflooded, Riptide gains surge. Otherwise, test [agility] (3) (4 instead if your location is fully flooded). If you fail, choose and discard 1 asset you control. If you cannot, lose 1 resource for each point you fail by instead.

all_card.name: 长翼者
all_card.text:
猎手。
X为长翼者所在地点的隐藏值。
除[[远程]]、[[枪械]]、[[法术]]卡牌外，长翼者每次从攻击受到的伤害减少1点(最低减至1点)。
all_card.real_text:
Hunter.
X is the shroud value of Winged One's location.
Winged One takes 1 fewer damage from attacks except by [[Ranged]], [[Firearm]], or [[Spell]] cards (to a minimum of 1 damage).

all_card.name: 印斯茅斯之雾
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，受到1点恐惧，或将印斯茅斯之雾放置入场，放到密谋牌库旁。如果你检定失败，执行两者。 每个地点的隐藏值+1。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从场上弃掉1张印斯茅斯之雾。(每轮最多一次。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, either take 1 horror or put Fog over Innsmouth into play next to the agenda deck. If you fail, do both. Each location gets +1 shroud. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Fog over Innsmouth from play. (Max once per round.)

all_card.name: 死亡纪念
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果你本次技能检定期间揭示了[cultist]标记，你自动失败。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you reveal a [cultist] token during this test, you automatically fail. If you fail, take 2 horror.

all_card.name: 崩裂意识
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](3)。如果你本次技能检定期间揭示了[tablet]标记，你自动失败。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). If you reveal a [tablet] token during this test, you automatically fail. If you fail, take 2 damage.

all_card.name: 湮灭记忆
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](4)或[intellect](4)。如果你本次技能检定期间揭示了[elder_thing]标记，你自动失败。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，选择并弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4) or [intellect] (4). If you reveal a [elder_thing] token during this test, you automatically fail. For each point you fail by, choose and discard 1 card from your hand.

all_card.flavor: “把这混蛋玩意儿再发动起来，不然我们哪儿也去不了！”
all_card.name: 机械故障
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到最近的[[载具]]剧情支援。 附属支援上的“[action]”能力不能触发。 [action]：检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉机械故障。
all_card.real_flavor: "Get this damned thing working again, or we ain't going anywhere!"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest [[Vehicle]] story asset. "[action]" abilities on attached asset cannot be triggered. [action]: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, discard Malfunction.

all_card.name: 星潮合相
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 选择一个有调查员的地点。提升该地点的淹没等级。位于所选地点的每位调查员受到1点伤害。如果所选地点的淹没等级未因此效果提升，星潮合相获得涌动。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Choose a location where there is at least 1 investigator. Increase that location's flood level. Each investigator at the chosen location takes 1 damage. If the chosen location's flood level is not increased by this effect, Tidal Alignment gains surge.

all_card.name: 朔望
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 每位调查员失去3资源。 - 每位调查员受到2点恐惧。 - 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记(本效果能导致当前密谋推进)。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Each investigator loses 3 resources. - Each investigator takes 2 horror. - Place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect can cause the current agenda to advance).

all_card.back_flavor: 这里的空气寒冷刺骨，除了水滴在粗糙石面上的轻声之外，万籁俱寂。你打了个寒战，继续向前……
all_card.name: 水下洞窟
all_card.text: [action]：移动。从水下洞窟移动到任意淹没的[[洞穴]]地点。 强制 - 水下洞窟揭示后：其完全淹没。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The air is frigid here, and there is no sound but the faint plinking of water dripping onto the rough stone ground. You shudder and proceed onward...
all_card.real_text: [action]: Move. Move from Underwater Cavern to any flooded [[Cave]] location. Forced - After Underwater Cavern is revealed: It becomes fully flooded.

all_card.back_flavor: 这里的空气寒冷刺骨，除了水滴在粗糙石面上的轻声之外，万籁俱寂。你打了个寒战，继续向前……
all_card.name: 潮池
all_card.text: 潮池部分淹没时隐藏值+1，潮池完全淹没时隐藏值+2。 强制 - 潮池揭示后：从放在一边正面朝下的钥匙中随机选择1个，放到潮池上，不要查看。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The air is frigid here, and there is no sound but the faint plinking of water dripping onto the rough stone ground. You shudder and proceed onward...
all_card.real_text: Tidal Pool gets +1 shroud while it is partially flooded and +2 shroud while it is fully flooded. Forced - After Tidal Pool is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on Tidal Pool without looking at it.

all_card.back_flavor: 这里的空气寒冷刺骨，除了水滴在粗糙石面上的轻声之外，万籁俱寂。你打了个寒战，继续向前……
all_card.name: 地下暗河
all_card.text: 地下暗河不能被完全淹没。 强制 - 地下暗河揭示后：提升其淹没等级。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The air is frigid here, and there is no sound but the faint plinking of water dripping onto the rough stone ground. You shudder and proceed onward...
all_card.real_text: Underground River cannot be fully flooded. Forced - After Underground River is revealed: Increase its flood level.

all_card.name: 印斯茅斯闹事者
all_card.text: 生成 - 线索最多的地点。 猎手。 [action]将你的1个线索放到你所在地点：谈判。横置印斯茅斯闹事者。其在下一个补给阶段期间不重整。本能力可以由连接地点的调查员触发。
all_card.traits: 类人. 混血. 罪犯
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Location with the most clues. Hunter. [action] Place 1 of your clues on your location: Parley. Exhaust Innsmouth Troublemaker. It does not ready during the next upkeep phase. This ability may be triggered by an investigator at a connecting location.

all_card.name: 印斯茅斯面容
all_card.text: 显现 - 将印斯茅斯面容放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你得到-1[intellect]、-1神智，并且你获得[[深潜者]]特性。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉印斯茅斯面容。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Innsmouth Look into play in your threat area. You get -1 [intellect] and -1 sanity, and you gain the [[Deep One]] trait. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Innsmouth Look.

all_card.name: 鬼祟的当地人
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，受到1点伤害，或将鬼祟的当地人放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。如果你检定失败，执行两者。 调查员不能谈判。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从场上弃掉1张鬼祟的当地人。(每轮最多一次。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, either take 1 damage or put Furtive Locals into play next to the agenda deck. If you fail, do both. Investigators cannot parley. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Furtive Locals from play. (Max once per round.)

all_card.name: 英勇无畏
all_card.text: 如果本次技能检定成功，将英勇无畏加入你的游戏区域，作为一张带有以下文字的支援卡牌：“你得到+1[intellect]、+1[combat]和+1[agility]。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：弃掉英勇无畏。”
all_card.real_text: If this skill test is successful, add Intrepid to your play area as an asset with the text: "You get +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility]. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Intrepid."

all_card.flavor: “你让我求福？给什么求福？”
all_card.name: 特制弹药
all_card.text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
附属到你所在地点的一位调查员控制的[[枪械]]支援上。在该支援上放置2子弹。每个支援仅限1张。
附属的支援对[[怪物]]敌人执行攻击时造成+1伤害。
all_card.traits: 升级. 供给. 祝福
all_card.real_flavor: "You want me to bless - what?"
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Place 2 ammo on that asset. Limit 1 per asset.
Attacks performed by attached asset deal +1 damage against [[Monster]] enemies.

all_card.flavor: 它总是指向你不愿去的地方。
all_card.name: 异界罗盘
all_card.text: [action]横置异界罗盘：调查。本次调查你所在地点的隐藏值-X。X为与你所在地点相互连接、且已揭示的地点数量。
all_card.real_flavor: It always points where you don't want to go.
all_card.real_text: [action] Exhaust Otherworldly Compass: Investigate. Your location gets -X shroud for this investigation. X is the number of revealed locations connected to your location.

all_card.name: 暴露弱点
all_card.text:
快速。在任意[free]玩家时间段期间打出。
选择你所在地点的一个敌人。检定[intellect](X)，其中X等于该敌人的攻击值。如果你检定成功，本阶段下次对该敌人执行的攻击中，将该敌人的攻击值视为0。抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Choose an enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you succeed, treat that enemy's fight value as if it were 0 for the next attack performed against it this phase. Draw 1 card.

all_card.flavor: “我从事的行业会碰上许多所谓的‘诅咒’。我不想讨论这个话题。”
all_card.name: 萝拉·桑提亚哥
all_card.text:
你得到+1[intellect]和+1[agility]。
[free]横置萝拉·桑提亚哥并花费X资源：发现你所在地点的1个线索。X为你所在地点的隐藏值。
all_card.real_flavor:
"My line of work encounters a lot of so-called 'curses.'
It is a topic I would rather not discuss."
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [agility].
[fast] Exhaust Lola Santiago and spend X resources: Discover 1 clue at your location. X is the shroud value of your location.

all_card.flavor: 你必须对每种法术全情投入。有时就是字面的意思。
all_card.name: 奥利芙·麦克布莱德
all_card.text: [reaction]在你将要揭示一个混乱标记时，横置奥利芙·麦克布莱德：改为揭示3个混乱标记，而非1个。选择其中2个标记结算，并忽略其余标记。
all_card.real_flavor: You must invest yourself in every spell. Sometimes literally.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, exhaust Olive McBride: Reveal 3 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 2 of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the other.

all_card.name: 逆反
all_card.text: 忽略本次技能检定期间所有[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]和[elder_thing]符号的效果(包括其修正值)。
all_card.real_flavor: "No."
all_card.real_text: Ignore the effects of all [skull], [cultist], [tablet], and [elder_thing] symbols during this test (including their modifiers).

all_card.name: 危险预感
all_card.text: 快速。在任意[free]玩家时间段期间打出。 将危险预感放置入场，从混乱袋中随机揭示一个混乱标记，并将其封印在危险预感上。 强制 - 在将要从混乱袋中揭示一个混乱标记时：改为结算封印在此的标记，如同刚刚从混乱袋中揭示该标记。然后，弃掉危险预感。
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play during any [fast] player window. Put Premonition into play, reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag, and seal it on Premonition. Forced - When a chaos token would be revealed from the chaos bag: Resolve the token sealed here as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag, instead. Then, discard Premonition.

all_card.name: 学无止境
all_card.text: 快速。在你技能检定失败且完毕后(结算该次技能检定的所有效果后)打出。 再次尝试该次检定。你本次检定得到+2技能值。
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play after a skill test you failed ends (after resolving all effects from the failed test). Attempt that test again. You get +2 skill value for this test.

all_card.name: 重拾信念
all_card.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你可以将重拾信念投入任意类型的检定。
如果本次检定失败，执行检定的调查员抽取2张卡牌并获得2资源。
all_card.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Take Heart to any type of test.
If this test fails, the performing investigator draws 2 cards and gains 2 resources.

all_card.name: 勇斗异劫
all_card.text:
快速。在你执行一次技能检定，且检定难度高于你的基础技能值时打出。
本次技能检定额外揭示X个混乱标记。选择其中一个结算并忽略其余标记。X为本次检定难度和你基础技能值的差值。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when you perform a skill test with a difficulty higher than your base skill value.
Reveal X additional chaos tokens for this skill test. Choose one to resolve and ignore the rest. X is the difference between the test's difficulty and your base skill value.

all_card.flavor:
罗兰松开了他的领带，帽子弄得歪斜，翻起大衣的领子，将自己的模样弄得邋里邋遢才去开门。
——格里姆·戴维斯，《理性的挽歌》
all_card.name: 战壕大衣
all_card.text: 你在躲避尝试期间得到+1[agility]。
all_card.real_flavor:
Roland loosened his tie, tilted his hat, and turned up his coat collar, and when he was sure he looked respectably disreputable, he approached the door.
- Graeme Davis, <u>The Dirge of Reason</u>
all_card.real_text: You get +1 [agility] during evasion attempts.

all_card.name: 华饰弓
all_card.text: 使用(1子弹)。华饰弓仅限1子弹。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[agility]。你本次攻击得到+2[agility]并造成+2伤害。 [action]：你重新搭上一支箭。在华饰弓上放置1子弹。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 武器. 远程
all_card.real_text: Uses (1 ammo). Limit 1 ammo on Ornate Bow. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [agility] and deal +2 damage for this attack. [action]: You nock another arrow. Place 1 ammo on Ornate Bow.

all_card.text:

[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 昆扬之口
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。“我们搭帐篷吧，明天再解开这个谜团。” [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有指南针，查看探索牌库顶的3张卡牌。按任意顺序将其中1张放在牌库底，其余2张放在牌库顶。
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. "Let's make camp and solve this puzzle tomorrow." [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a compass, look at the top 3 cards of the exploration deck. Place 1 on the bottom and the other 2 on top, in any order.

all_card.flavor: 儘管洞穴入口已碩大無朋，它跟下方廣無邊際的深淵相比，還是小巫見大巫。
all_card.name: 昆扬之口
all_card.text: [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有地图，查看探索牌库顶的2张卡牌。弃掉每张以此效果查看到的诡计卡牌。混洗探索牌库。
all_card.real_flavor: Even the enormous size of the cavern entrance pales in comparison with the vastness of the depths below.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a map, look at the top 2 cards of the exploration deck. Discard each treachery looked at by this effect. Shuffle the exploration deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 在丛林中探索数小时过后，你来到了一处陡峭的山脊上，在这儿能够更好地观察附近的区域。长着翅膀的怪异生物冲着你怪叫，在洞穴入口上方盘旋，就像等待着一顿饱餐的秃鹰一样。从这个有利位置看去，你能看到灌木丛下方有威胁向你逼近。要是有东西能让你看到更远的地方就好了……
all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
调查员队长选择一位调查员来担任瞭望员。该调查员检查自己的补给品。
如果瞭望员带有双筒望远镜，就能够看见有生物逼近并避开它。瞭望员不承受负面效果。
如果瞭望员没有双筒望远镜，从遭遇牌库顶弃牌，直到弃掉一个敌人。将该敌人生成在瞭望员所在地点。
all_card.flavor: 你深入丛林，四周都是未知的荒野。丛林在你周围歌唱，这支歌的歌词就藏在每一只昆虫的唧唧喳喳、每一根树枝的劈啪作响、还有每一条蛇的嘶嘶声之中。
all_card.name: 丛林之心
all_card.text: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: After exploring the rainforest for hours, you reach the top of a steep ridge, from which you can see much of the surrounding area. Uncanny winged creatures caw at you from above, circling over the cavern entrance like vultures waiting for their meal. From this vantage point, you may be able to see approaching threats as they traverse the brush below. If only you had something to help you see farther…
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
The lead investigator chooses one investigator to be the group's lookout. That investigator checks his or her supplies. 
If the lookout has binoculars, he or she is able to see the creature approaching and avoid it. The lookout suffers no ill effects.
If the lookout does not have binoculars, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy at the lookout's location.
all_card.real_flavor: You are deep in the jungle now, surrounded on all sides by the uncharted wilderness. All around you, the rainforest sings, its lyrics found in every chirping insect, every serpent’s hiss, every snapping tree branch.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

all_card.back_flavor:
转瞬便进入了黑夜，黯淡的月光洒落 在整个丛林。夜行生物开始出没，丛林的声音变得迥异。很快，空气中便充斥着奇怪的虫群发出的嗡嗡声和叽喳声，这其中还有更怪异的野兽，你根本无法辨别它们究竟是什么。
夜晚期间的危机不容小觑，而你必须研究象形文字和图案才能正确地移动石柱，但夜晚的黑暗使你研究的难度倍增。你别无选择，只好搭起帐篷，等到早上再继续探索。
all_card.back_text: 每位幸存的调查员立即撤退。
all_card.flavor: 白天很快就过去了。透过茂密笼罩的森林，你感觉到太阳开始落下，靠近地平线。在东边，天色已开始变暗。很快整个丛林都笼罩在黑暗之中，你必须停下脚步并搭建营地，好度过夜晚。
all_card.name: 夕阳
all_card.text: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Night comes swiftly, blanketing the rainforest in dim moonlight. The sounds of the jungle change as nocturnal creatures start to emerge. Soon, the air is filled with the buzzing and chirping of strange insects and even stranger beasts, the identity of which you are unable to determine.
The dangers of nighttime are too great to ignore, and the darkness makes it difficult for you to study the glyphs and patterns necessary to shift the pillars correctly. You have no choice but to set up camp and continue your exploration in the morning.
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator immediately resigns.
all_card.real_flavor: The day advances quickly. Through the thick canopy of trees, you can tell that the sun is starting to sink closer to the horizon. To the east, the sky grows dim. Soon the jungle will be covered in darkness, and you will have to stop and make camp for the night.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

all_card.flavor: 六根石柱围绕着洞穴入口，每根石柱都刻着许多异常的凹槽和象形文字，形成了错综复杂的图案。触摸石柱的时候凹槽上的光芒会变得明亮，而转动石柱时则会使得图案转动并改变。或许这些图案与在丛林其他地方找到的象形文字是对应的？
all_card.name: 研究图案
all_card.real_flavor: Six stone pillars surround the entrance to the cavern, each carved with a series of uncanny grooves and hieroglyphs that form an intricate pattern. Touching them causes the grooves to glow brightly, and twisting them causes the patterns to shift and change. Perhaps these patterns match the glyphs found in other regions of the jungle?

all_card.name: 羽翼蛇族
all_card.text: 生成 - 昆扬之口。 警戒。猎手。庞大。 不能被击败。不能进行趁乱攻击。 强制 - 在一个石柱标记被放置在昆扬之口上后：横置羽翼蛇族。其在本轮补给阶段期间不重整。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 蛇族. 精英
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Mouth of K'n-yan. Alert. Hunter. Massive. Cannot be defeated. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Forced - After a pillar token is placed on the Mouth of K'n-yan: Exhaust The Winged Serpent. It does not ready during the upkeep phase this round.

all_card.back_flavor: 伴随着深沉的隆隆声，外部的地面开始震动，洞穴内部的某些事物发生了变动。六块方尖碑以各不相同的方向旋转扭曲着，缓缓地沉入地面。把守洞穴的蛇族生物发出一声充满愤怒和怨恨的尖叫，随即飞走并从这片森林里消失。石柱一根接一根没入泥土之中，消失不见，而地面的震动也随之停止。
all_card.flavor: 你在丛林中的各座遗迹都找到了不同的象形文字图案，与六根石柱上找到的图案一致。当你转动石柱来对应这些图案的时候，一个蛇形生物从云层落下……
all_card.name: 张开巨口
all_card.text: [action]位于昆扬之口的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：你解开了其中一个谜题。在昆扬之口上放置1资源，作为一个石柱标记。 目标 - 为了进入昆扬，必须解开六根石柱的谜题。如果昆扬之口上有6个石柱标记，推进到场景2b。
all_card.real_back_flavor: With a deep rumbling that shakes the ground outside, something inside the cavern shifts. In a distinct sequence, the six obelisks slowly descend into the ground, twisting and turning. The serpent creature that guarded the cavern lets out a shriek of anger and hate before flying off and vanishing behind the treeline. One by one, the stone pillars disappear into the dirt, and the Earth stops shaking.
all_card.real_flavor: You have discovered that the ruins within the jungle each bear a distinct pattern of glyphs, which match those found on the six pillars. As you turn the pillars to match these patterns, a serpentine creature descends from the clouds…
all_card.real_text: [action] Investigators at the Mouth of K'n-yan spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You solve one piece of the puzzle. Add 1 resource to the Mouth of K'n-yan, as a pillar token. Objective - Solve the puzzle of the six pillars in order to enter K'n-yan. If there are 6 pillar tokens on the Mouth of K'n-yan, advance to act 2b.

all_card.back_text:
检查剧本日志。如果预示者还活着：
洞穴入口已落在你身后远处，从那儿传来一声可怕的嘶嘶声，伴随着一阵再熟悉不过的隆隆声，令你万分惊恐，动弹不得。你抓起你所能找到的最近的武器，害怕地拐进转角，双手瑟瑟发抖。这么远，它是怎么跟着你的？这可怕的追捕什么时候才结束？
查找收藏，找出瓦卢西亚的预示者并将它生成在距离所有调查员最远的地点(如果你剧本日志里的“伊格之怒”下方有至少8次记录，改为将它生成在调查员队长所在地点)。按照剧本日志括号内记录的伤害总数，瓦卢西亚的预示者在入场时带有对应数量的伤害。
all_card.flavor: 尽管这些洞穴系统大多是自然形成，未经人类之手，但你惊讶地发现了古代文明曾在这片地区居住的迹象。
all_card.name: 孤独的洞穴群
all_card.text: [action]如果你所在地点没有线索：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。 强制 - 在本密谋推进时：不要从场上任何地点移除毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_text:
Check Campaign Log. If the Harbinger is still alive:
From the entrance far behind you, a threatening hiss and an all-too-familiar rattling causes you to freeze in terror. You grip the nearest weapon you can find and turn in fright, hands trembling. How has it followed you this far? When will this awful hunt end?
Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia and spawn it at the location farthest from all investigators (if there are 8 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play at the lead investigator's location, instead). It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log.
all_card.real_flavor: Though much of this cavern system is natural and untouched by humans, you are stunned to find signs of an ancient civilization that once inhabited the area.
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from each location in play.

all_card.back_flavor: 毫无预警，一阵震耳欲聋的倒塌声回荡在整个洞穴中，而你脚下的地面剧烈地震动。钟乳石和破碎的石块开始从洞顶掉落下来，砸在你周围的地面上，而石块表面都出现了裂痕。“我们得离开这儿！”你对伊塔卡喊道，但当你意识到即将来临的是什么，这时已经太晚了。你脚下的地面爆裂开来，你猝不及防地坠落，直直落入下方的深渊……
all_card.back_text: 幸存的每位调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 当你继续深入洞穴的时候，一双双明亮的黄色眼睛从四面八方盯着你。当光线照射过去的时候，这些发光的球体就消失不见，但当光线消失，它们又马上在黑暗中重现。
all_card.name: 黑暗中的眼睛
all_card.text: [action]如果你所在地点没有线索：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。 *本密谋得到+1[per_investigator]毁灭阈值。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Without warning, a deafening crash echoes throughout the cave, and the ground under your feet rumbles with tremendous force. Stalactites and pieces of crumbling rock begin to fall from the ceiling of the cavern, striking the ground all around you and causing cracks to appear in the stone. "We have to get out of here!" you shout to Ichtaca, but by the time you realize what is coming, it is too late. The ground beneath your feet gives way, and suddenly you are falling, plummeting into the depths below…
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: Bright-yellow eyes peer at you from all sides as you continue delving deeper into the cavern. The glowing orbs vanish as light is cast on them, reappearing as soon as the darkness returns.
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold.

all_card.back_flavor: 这些隧道漆黑而偏僻，沿途能找到的路标少得可怜。你只能寄望于自己的才智和导航技能，希望它们能够让你避免迷路，找到前进的方向。要是你没有办法能够轻松地标记你走过的地点……
all_card.back_text: 将深入幽嘶洗入探索牌库。 调查员队长选择一位调查员来担任队伍的侦查员。该调查员检查自己的补给品。 如果侦查员带有粉笔，你们得以避免原地绕圈。侦查员不承受负面效果。 如果侦查员没有粉笔，在场上每个地点上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。然后，如果该侦查员在一个单面地点上，将该地点洗回探索牌库。将位于该地点的每个敌人和每位调查员移动到一个距离昆扬之口最近的连接地点。
all_card.flavor: 昆扬之中广阔的地下洞穴群寒冷且过于寂静。你前往恩凯联结点的路上，有着许多七零八落的被遗弃的废墟。这个古老的被遗忘的地方发生了什么？这些遗迹曾被人类所占据吗？还是说由某个远古种族所占据？
all_card.name: 失落时代的洞穴
all_card.real_back_flavor: With very few landmarks to spot along the dark and lonely tunnels, you must rely on your wits and navigation skills to make your way forward without getting lost. If only you had an easy way to mark the places you have already visited…
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle Descent to Yoth into the exploration deck. The lead investigator chooses one investigator to be the group's scout. That investigator checks his or her supplies. If the scout has chalk, you are able to avoid traveling in circles. The scout suffers no ill effects. If the scout does not have chalk, place 1 clue on each location in play (from the token pool). Then, if the scout is on a single-sided location, shuffle that location back into the exploration deck. Move each enemy and investigator that was at that location to a connecting location nearest to the Mouth of K'n-yan.
all_card.real_flavor: The vast underground caverns of K’n-yan are cold and all too quiet. Scattered, forsaken ruins lie undisturbed along your path to the Nexus of N’kai. What happened in this ancient and forgotten place? Were these ruins once occupied by humans? Or by a species far, far older?

all_card.back_flavor: 你面前是一扇华丽而精致的大门，石盘滚到了一旁，开启了另一头如炼狱般的领域。另一边的洞穴沐浴在红光之中。各面墙壁上有着以蛇为主题的雕像和雕刻，由此你知道你调查的方向是正确的。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 - 如果调查员解救了亚历山卓：(→结局1) - 如果亚历山卓已失踪：(→结局2)
all_card.flavor: 随着你在寒冷刺骨的黑暗之中更向下深入，你愈发感觉到自己上方世界的重压，以及更深层的下方世界令人目眩的景象。你突然渴望回到地面，不知自己还能否重见蓝天。
all_card.name: 降入黑暗
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果每位幸存的调查员均位于深入幽嘶，且该地点上没有毁灭标记，你可以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Before you lies an ornate and elaborately decorated doorway, a stone disc that has been rolled aside to unveil the hellish realm beyond. The caverns on the other side are bathed in a red glow. The serpent-themed statues and carvings along the walls inform you that you are on the right track.
all_card.real_back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If the investigators rescued Alejandro: (→R1). - If Alejandro is missing: (→R2).
all_card.real_flavor: The deeper you descend into the cold darkness, the more you feel the crushing weight of the world above, and the dizzying reality of the world further below. You suddenly long for the surface and wonder if you will ever see the sky again.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If each surviving investigator is at the Descent to Yoth and there is no doom on it, you may advance.

all_card.name: 落入陷阱
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须(选择以下一项)： - 检定[agility](3)来尝试跳过这条裂隙。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害。 - 将落入陷阱洗入探索牌库。落入陷阱如果是从探索牌库抽出的，你不能选择这个选项。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Test [agility] (3) to attempt to jump the gap. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage. - Shuffle Pitfall into the exploration deck. You cannot choose this option if Pitfall was drawn from the exploration deck.

all_card.name: 有毒孢子
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：附属地点的每位中毒的调查员受到2点恐惧。附属地点的每位未中毒的调查员改为必须将放在一边的一张中毒弱点卡牌放置入场，放到其威胁区域。弃掉有毒孢子。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator at the attached location who is poisoned takes 2 horror. Each investigator at the attached location who is not poisoned must put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in his or her threat area, instead. Discard Poisonous Spores.

all_card.flavor: 沿途的植物野蛮生长，姿态扭曲。这些植物对你来说都很陌生，有的花朵已经凋零，而有的却仍然蓬勃怒放。
all_card.name: 错时林地
all_card.text: [action][action]：从胜利区选择一张带有复仇点数的非[[精英]]卡牌。将该卡牌放到遭遇弃牌堆。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: The flora along this path are wildly distorted. Some of the flowers are withered and some are vibrant, but all are alien to you.
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Choose a non-[[Elite]] card worth vengeance points in the victory display. Place that card in the encounter discard pile. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor: 这里曾经是个仪式场所，而今杂草丛生，被人遗忘。
all_card.name: 石板祭坛
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你进入石板祭坛后：从混乱袋中随机揭示一个混乱标记。如果你揭示了[elder_sign]、[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，失去1个行动。如果你不能这么做，改为受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: Once a ceremonial site, now overgrown and forgotten.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Stone Altar: Reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [elder_sign], [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, lose 1 action. If you cannot, take 1 horror instead.

all_card.name: 绝命噬藤
all_card.text: 警戒。反击。 强制 - 在绝命噬藤对你进行趁乱攻击后：检查你的补给品。如果你没有折叠小刀，失去所有剩余行动并结束你的回合。
all_card.real_text: Alert. Retaliate. Forced - After Apex Strangleweed makes an attack of opportunity against you: Check your supplies. If you do not have a pocket knife, lose all remaining actions and end your turn.

all_card.name: 蛇怪
all_card.text: 猎物 - 距离昆扬之口最近的调查员。 猎手。 强制 - 在一个石柱标记被放置在昆扬之口上后：将一张蛇怪洗入遭遇牌库。(每轮最多一次。)
all_card.real_text: Prey - Nearest to the Mouth of K'n-yan. Hunter. Forced - After a pillar token is placed on the Mouth of K'n-yan: Shuffle one copy of Basilisk into the encounter deck. (Max once per round.) Vengeance 2.

all_card.flavor: 一只蚂蚁只是烦人。一支蚂蚁大军就不止是烦人了。
all_card.name: 蚁群缠身
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](4)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，随机弃掉一张手牌，或者选择并弃掉你游戏区域的一张卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: One ant is a nuisance. A colony is another matter.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). For each point you fail by, discard a random card from your hand or choose and discard a card from your play area.

all_card.flavor: 这些洞穴的规模令人眼花缭乱。自成一方天地。
all_card.name: 宽阔步道
all_card.text: 作为你在宽阔步道探索时的额外费用，检查你们的补给品。如果本地点没有调查员带有双筒望远镜，你必须花费额外1个行动。
all_card.real_flavor:
The scale of these caverns is dizzying.
It is truly a world of its own.
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost for you to explore while at Vast Passages, check your supplies. If no investigator at this location has binoculars, you must spend 1 additional action.

all_card.name: 崇拜礼堂

all_card.real_text: Forced - After you put Hall of Idolatry into play by successfully exploring: Check Campaign Log. If there are 5 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury", draw the top card of the encounter deck (top 2 cards instead if there are 10 or more tally marks).

all_card.flavor: 这座洞窟的窄道足有好几英里，你不由得感觉自己正在深入一头巨兽的腹部。
all_card.name: 漆黑洞窟
all_card.text: 强制 - 在漆黑洞窟入场后，检查你们的补给品。如果没有调查员带有地图：在漆黑洞窟上放置额外1[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.real_flavor: The throat of the cavern extends for miles, and you cannot help but feel as though you are descending into the belly of a great beast.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Dark Hollow enters play, check your supplies. If no investigator has a map: Place 1 [per_investigator] additional clues on Dark Hollow.

all_card.flavor: 沿漆黑的鸿沟前进，沿途的路径蜿蜒而曲折。诸多蛇形雕像抬起头颅，在你经过时作势要攻击你。
all_card.name: 危险峡谷
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你调查危险峡谷时，技能检定失败后：检查你的补给品。如果本地点没有调查员带有绳索，在危险峡谷上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_flavor: Along a dark chasm, the path winds and twists. Serpent statues with rearing heads are poised to strike as you pass.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Perilous Gulch: Check your supplies. If no investigator at this location has rope, place 1 doom on Perilous Gulch.

all_card.flavor: 巨大的白色晶体穿过隧道，光线透过晶体，反射到洞壁和洞顶上。
all_card.name: 晶体柱群
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你进入晶体柱群后：检定[willpower](1)。胜利区每有一点复仇点数，本次检定难度+1。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: Enormous white crystals pierce through the tunnel, sending reflections of light across the walls and ceiling.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Crystal Pillars: Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +1 difficulty for each vengeance point in the victory display. If you fail, take 1 damage and 1 horror.

all_card.name: 深入幽嘶
all_card.text: 强制 - 在深入幽嘶入场后：每位调查员必须在深入幽嘶上放置1个毁灭标记，或者抽取遭遇牌库顶2张卡牌。 [reaction]在你成功调查深入幽嘶后：你可以不发现线索，改为将深入幽嘶上的1个毁灭标记翻至线索面。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Descent to Yoth enters play: Each investigator must either place 1 doom on Descent to Yoth or draw the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. [reaction] After you successfully investigate Descent to Yoth: Instead of discovering clues, you may flip 1 doom on Descent to Yoth to its clue side. Vengeance 2.

all_card.name: 无路可退
all_card.text: 显现 - 将无路可退附属到你所在地点或一个连接地点。每个地点仅限1张。 调查员不能进入或离开被附属地点。 [action]：检定[combat](3)或检查你的补给品。如果你检定成功，或你带有鹤嘴锄，弃掉无路可退。位于连接地点的任何调查员均可以激活此能力。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach No Turning Back to your location or a connecting location. Limit 1 per location. Investigators cannot enter or leave attached location. [action]: Test [combat] (3) or check your supplies. If you succeed, or if you have a pickaxe, discard No Turning Back. Any investigator at a connecting location may activate this ability.

all_card.text:
使用(3补给)。如果煤油没有补给，将其弃掉。
[action]如果本轮一个敌人在本地点被击败，横置煤油并花费1补给：治愈你所在地点的调查员和[[盟友]]支援总计最多2点恐惧。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (3 supplies). If Kerosene has no supplies, discard it.

all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械

If this attack is successful, instead of its standard damage, you may assign up to 4 damage among enemies engaged with you (any additional damage adds to this total).

all_card.name: 有利位置

直到当前调查员的回合结束，该地点隐藏值-1。你可以将其他任何地点上的1个线索移动到该地点上。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play after a location enters play or is revealed during an investigator's turn.
Until the end of the active investigator's turn, that location gets -1 shroud. You may move 1 clue to that location from any other location.

all_card.name: 纳克特手稿

使用(3秘密)。

[action]花费1秘密：选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员在本轮下次执行技能检定时不揭示混乱标记。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 书籍

Uses (3 secrets).
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would perform a skill test during a revelation effect, spend 1 secret: Do not reveal chaos tokens for that test.
[action] Spend 1 secret: Choose an investigator at your location. Do not reveal chaos tokens for the next skill test that investigator performs this round.

all_card.name: 时间借取
all_card.text: 卓越。 [action]：在时间借取上放置1资源，视作一声滴答(时间借取上最多3声滴答)。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。 强制 - 在你的回合开始时：移除时间借取上所有的滴答。你本回合可以进行额外等量次的行动。
all_card.real_text: Exceptional. [action]: Place 1 resource on Borrowed Time, as a click (to a maximum of 3 clicks on Borrowed Time). Does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Forced - When your turn begins: Remove all clicks from Borrowed Time. You may take that many additional actions this turn.

all_card.name: 孤注一掷

每次技能检定最多投入1张。

all_card.real_text:

You get +2 [willpower] for this attack for each "0" token sealed on Shards of the Void. For each "0" token revealed during this attack, seal that token on Shards of the Void and this attack deals 1 additional damage.

all_card.name: 第七印记的封印
all_card.text: 封印([auto_fail])。使用(7充能)。如果第七印记的封印没有充能，或者其离场，将其从游戏中移除。 强制 - 在任何技能检定期间揭示[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]标记后：从第七印记的封印上移除1充能。
all_card.real_text: Seal ([auto_fail]). Uses (7 charges). If Seal of the Seventh Sign has no charges, or if it leaves play, remove it from the game. Forced - After a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] token is revealed during any skill test: Remove 1 charge from Seal of the Seventh Sign.

all_card.name: 临时路障

all_card.real_text: You may play Impromptu Barrier from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after resolving its effects. Evade. The chosen enemy gets -1 evade for this evasion attempt. (If you played Impromptu Barrier from your discard pile, you may evade an additional enemy at the same location with evade X or lower. X is the amount you succeed by.)

all_card.flavor: 我们的命运由自己书写。
all_card.name: 改变命运
all_card.text:

all_card.real_flavor: We make our own fate.
