all_card.back_flavor:
你并非第一个闯入这个深坑的人。曾经有人警告你不要破坏封印，但你还是进来了。现在你得承担你愚蠢之举所带来的后果。
某物从联结点另一端的无光虚空里出现。那是一团形态多变的黑色脓液，像是充满生机的粘稠软泥，用不成形的附肢在地面上爬行，它所路过之处的石面瓦解，留下一条光滑的足迹。
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。 将放在一边的无形之子生成在恩凯联结点上。 将本卡牌放到胜利区。本卡牌获得复仇1。
all_card.flavor: 随着你踏入门廊另一头的巨大石室，联结点开始扰动。你脚下的地面开始震动，而墙壁逐渐剥离，摇摇欲坠。碎石漂浮在联结点上空。你的时间马上结束了：你周围的现实世界开始撕裂。
all_card.name: 时间之线
all_card.text: 强制 - 如果一位手牌、牌库、弃牌堆或游戏区域内有古代遗物的调查员退场：立即推进到密谋3b。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You are not the first to intrude in this abyssal pit. You were warned not to break the seal, and yet here you are. Now you face the consequences for your foolish transgression. The thing emerges from the lightless void beyond the Nexus. It is a being of black polymorphic ichor, an animated viscous ooze that crawls along the ground with shapeless limbs and leaves a trail of smooth, dissolved stone in its wake.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Spawn the set-aside Formless Spawn in the Nexus of N'kai. Place this card in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 1.
all_card.real_flavor: As you enter the grand chamber beyond the doorway, the Nexus stirs. The Earth quakes below you, and the wall chips and crumbles. Shards of stone float in midair above the Nexus. You are running out of time: Reality is starting to shatter all around you.
all_card.real_text: Forced - If an investigator with the Relic of Ages in his or her hand, deck, discard pile, or play area is eliminated: Immediately advance to agenda 3b.

all_card.back_flavor: 联结点机械内的电流开始出现故障，迸发出一束火花，射向空中。门的环体过热了。门内由缥缈的光芒交织而成的线开始断裂。
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。 如果无形之子在场，在恩凯联结点上放置2个毁灭标记。如果无形之子在胜利区，将它洗入遭遇牌库。 将本卡牌放到胜利区。本卡牌获得复仇1。
all_card.flavor:
在联结点以内，
那由缥缈的光芒交织而成的丝线
开始解开，
而现实也由此解开。
all_card.name: 垂下的丝线
all_card.text: 强制 - 如果一位手牌、牌库、弃牌堆或游戏区域内有古代遗物的调查员退场：立即推进到密谋3b。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The electrical currents coursing through the machinery of the Nexus begin to malfunction, sending a shower of sparks into the air. The portal ring overheats. Threads of ethereal light within the portal begin to snap.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. If Formless Spawn is in play, place 2 doom on the Nexus of N'kai. If Formless Spawn is in the victory display, shuffle it into the encounter deck. Place this card in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 1.
all_card.real_flavor:
Inside the Nexus, the interwoven
threads of ethereal light
begin to unravel, and reality
unravels with it.
all_card.real_text: Forced - If an investigator with the Relic of Ages in his or her hand, deck, discard pile, or play area is eliminated: Immediately advance to agenda 3b.

all_card.back_flavor:
时间线崩溃了。
现实就在你眼前分崩离析。最先消去的是你周围的环境：万物变得模糊而稀薄，成为一缕缕光芒，消散在虚空之中。
接下来轮到你的身体：缓缓变得粉碎，毫无痛感地碎成数以百万计的亚原子微粒，随即在广阔的虚空之中散去踪迹。
最后，是你的意识：你对于一切事件的记忆，不论是真实的还是虚幻的。你的希望与梦想。在宇宙广无止境的布局之中，思想从来不具有任何意义。
all_card.flavor: 。尽殆失消里这在都物事切一的道知所你而，犹炼怕可的境止无是佛仿间时的裂撕被这。怕可，误错。同不得变却但，现重一一都来未和在现、去过的你。变改生发会又形情的来下接，候时的眼眨你当每。生发序顺的反相着照按都动一举一的你，间期这在。的来儿这到么怎是你起想回法无你但，生发未还事件那得记你。动变始开流间时
all_card.name: 断了的线
all_card.text: 强制 - 如果一位手牌、牌库、弃牌堆或游戏区域内有古代遗物的调查员退场：立即推进到密谋3b。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The timeline collapses.
Reality dissolves before your very eyes. First to vanish is the environment around you: the matter blurs and thins into strings of light that fade into an empty void.
Next comes your body: it disintegrates slowly and painlessly into hundreds of millions of subatomic particles, which diffuse throughout the vast emptiness.
Finally, your cognition: your memories of events both real and unreal. Your hopes and dreams. Thoughts that never held any significance in the infinite scheme of the cosmos.

all_card.back_flavor: 你在联结点每迈出一步，离最终目的地也就更近一步——那个存在于时间和空间的界限以外的地方……
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的时间之窗地点洗入探索牌库。
all_card.flavor: 联结点的能量在你下方的地面旋转，引诱着你进入其中。不论那是科学还是魔法，你都不得而知。你只能判断出，那是一种门……但那是通往哪里的门呢？
all_card.name: 彼端的世界
all_card.text: 强制 - 在敌人将要生成在一个无人地点，且场上没有无人地点时：从探索牌库揭示卡牌，直到揭示一个地点。将该地点放置入场，并将该敌人生成在该地点。混洗探索牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Each time you step through the Nexus, you get one step closer to your ultimate destination - a place that exists outside the boundaries of time and space...
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the set-aside A Pocket in Time location into the exploration deck.
all_card.real_flavor: The energies of the Nexus swirl in the ground below you, beckoning you to enter. Whether it is a thing of science or magic, you do not know. It is a gateway of sorts, that much you can tell... but a gateway to where?
all_card.real_text: Forced - When an enemy would spawn at an empty location and there are no empty locations in play: Reveal cards from the exploration deck until a location is revealed. Put that location into play and spawn that enemy there. Shuffle the exploration deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 你眼前的景象实在叫人震惊。在这些大厅里，布满了数以百计的窗户，通向古代和未来风格的各个地方：在最早的历史记录之前便已存在的、曾经辉煌的诸多文明，还有许多现今未被发现的文明。这一发现给精神层面带来重荷，远超你意识所能承受的范围。人类并非地球的主人，也不是暂时的看守人。人类不过是漫长历史的区区一行脚注罢了，而这历史将被改写。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的[[破碎]]地点洗入探索牌库。每位调查员将遭遇弃牌堆顶的第一张[[巫术]]诡计卡牌洗入探索牌库。检查剧本日志。 - 如果遗物已丢失，将放在一边的古代遗物(时光涌流)附属到时间之窗，不受调查员控制。推进到场景3a——“伊斯人的遗物”。 - 如果调查员找回了丢失的遗物，推进到场景3a——“伊斯人的遗物”。
all_card.flavor: 这是多个世界的联结点，你的目的地是时间线的交汇之地，就在联结点内部深处的某个地方。它从世外的景象之中闪现，被你的视线捕获。还有着许多窗户，连通不同的时间线。那是一个由时间与空间构筑而成的地方，毫无疑问兄弟会就栖居在那儿。
all_card.name: 搜寻兄弟会
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果有调查员进入时间之窗，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: What you see before you is truly staggering. Throughout these halls are hundreds of windows into places both ancient and futuristic: once-grand civilizations that came before even the earliest records of known history, and more still that have yet to be realized. The psychological weight of this discovery is almost more than your mind can bear. Humans are not the masters or caretakers of the Earth. They are merely a footnote in a much longer history - a history which is about to be revised.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the set-aside [[Shattered]] locations into the exploration deck. Each investigator shuffles the topmost [[Hex]] treachery in the encounter discard pile into the exploration deck. Check Campaign Log. - If the relic is missing, attach the set-aside Relic of Ages (Unleash the Timestream) to A Pocket in Time, under no investigator's control. Advance to Act 3a - "The Yithian Relic." - If the investigators found the missing relic, advance to Act 3a - "The Yithian Relic."
all_card.real_flavor: Somewhere deep within this nexus of worlds lies your objective: a place where timelines converge. You can see it in flashes of insight from beyond this reality. Windows into other timelines. A place carved out of time and space, where the Brotherhood no doubt resides.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If an investigator enters A Pocket in Time, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你手中就握着解决这一切事端的关键。它发出阵阵低鸣，伴随着巨大的能量而震动不已——你查看其他时间线的时候，它的能量似乎还在增长勃发。
all_card.back_text:
在本场冒险接下来的时间里，如果古代遗物因任何原因离场，将附属到它的每个地点洗入探索牌库，并将场景牌库重置到场景3a。
检查剧本日志。如果伊塔卡与你为敌：
某物从黑暗中滑行着身躯，口中嘶嘶有声，它曾经是你的同伴。“伊格将会找到办法！瓦卢西亚即将再临于我族！”
将放在一边的伊塔卡(伊格的后裔)生成在恩凯联结点。
如果亚历山卓与你为敌：
“蠢货！你没长眼睛吗？”亚历山卓指着他面前的各个世界，“你的种族是没法敌过时间的蹂躏的。”
将放在一边的亚历山卓(或许不是他？)生成在时间之窗。
all_card.flavor: 如果你想要修补破碎的时间线，你必须找到古代遗物并且学会运用它的力量。
all_card.name: 伊斯人的遗物
all_card.text: [action]：查找你的牌库和弃牌堆，找出古代遗物并将它加入你的手牌。混洗你的牌库。 [action]如果古代遗物附属到你所在地，且该地点上没有线索：控制古代遗物。 目标 - 如果有调查员控制古代遗物，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: In your hands, you hold the key to fixing all of this. It hums and vibrates with immense power - power that seems to grow and flourish as you visit other timelines.
all_card.real_back_text:
For the remainder of the scenario, if the Relic of Ages leaves play for any reason, shuffle each location attached to it into the exploration deck and reset the act deck to act 3a.
Check Campaign Log. If Ichtaca is set against you:
The thing that was once your companion slithers out of the darkness, hissing. "Yig will have his way! Valusia will be returned to us!"
Spawn the set-aside Ichtaca (Scion of Yig) in the Nexus of N'kai.
If Alejandro is set against you:
"Fools! Are you blind?" Alejandro motions to the worlds before him. "Your kind stands no chance against the ravages of time."
Spawn the set-aside Alejandro (Or, Is He?) in A Pocket in Time.
all_card.real_flavor: If you intend to mend the shattered timelines, you will need to find the Relic of Ages and learn to harness its power.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Search your deck or discard pile for the Relic of Ages and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. [action] If the Relic of Ages is attached to your location and there are no clues on that location: Take control of the Relic of Ages. Objective - If an investigator controls the Relic of Ages, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你运用知识与技术操纵着手中嗡嗡作响的设备，就像是这件遗物的制造者一样。仿佛你的脑海中突然涌入了前人的智慧。能量从这设备的每个孔洞涌出。刺眼夺目的光线从它表面的裂缝之间喷薄而出。你只有一次机会来重整这破碎的现世——只有一次机会来让一切回到正轨。
all_card.back_text: - 如果调查员控制的古代遗物版本是古代遗物(重拾往昔)，进入(→结局5)。 - 如果调查员控制的是古代遗物的其他任何版本，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 你步入的每扇窗户都仿佛使遗物的能量增强。一旦这件遗物充能完成，你就能用它来修补时间线的裂痕，并阻止灾难发生。
all_card.name: 修补裂痕
all_card.text: [action]如果你位于[[破碎]]地点，且该地点没有线索：检定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，将你所在地点正面朝下附属到古代遗物。该地点的每位调查员和每个敌人均被移动到时间之窗。 目标 - 如果附属到古代遗物的地点数为游戏开始时的调查员人数+1，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You manipulate the thrumming device in your hands with the skill and knowledge of one of the relic's ingenious inventors. It is as though your mind has suddenly become flooded with the knowledge of the ancients that came before you. Power seeps from the device's every aperture. Rays of blinding light shoot forth from cracks appearing on its surface. You only have one chance to restore these shattered realities - only one chance to make things right.
all_card.real_back_text: - If Relic of Ages (Repossess the Past) is the version of the Relic of Ages that the investigators control, proceed to (→R5). - If the investigators control any other version of the Relic of Ages, proceed to (→R1).
all_card.real_flavor: Each window you step through seems to empower the relic. Once the artifact is fully powered, you can use it to mend the shattered timelines and prevent catastrophe.
all_card.real_text: [action] If you are at a [[Shattered]] location with no clues: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, attach your location facedown to the Relic of Ages. Each investigator and enemy at that location is moved to A Pocket in Time. Objective - If the number of locations attached to the Relic of Ages is equal to 1 plus the number of investigators who started the game, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
在你操纵手中那嗡嗡作响的设备时，伊塔卡眯着她那黄色的眼瞳观察着你。能量从这设备的每个孔洞涌出。刺眼夺目的光线从它表面的裂缝之间喷薄而出。你看着时间线之间的界限开始修补，随后眼前的窗户关闭，将你困在了你所选择的地点和时间里。修补工作甫一告终，遗物的光芒也随之消失。它那嗡嗡声也停了下来，再也听不到了。
一轮美丽的黄色太阳从繁盛国度瓦卢西亚冉冉升起，而你对自己的新生满怀好奇。
all_card.flavor: 你步入的每扇窗户都仿佛使遗物的能量增强。一旦这件遗物充能完成，你会用它来使瓦卢西亚的蛇族文明恢复往日的荣光吗？
all_card.name: 失乐园
all_card.text: [action]如果你位于[[破碎]]地点，且该地点没有线索：检定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，将你所在地点正面朝下附属到古代遗物。该地点的每位调查员和每个敌人均被移动到时间之窗。 目标 - 如果瓦卢西亚附属到古代遗物，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Ichtaca observes you with narrow yellow eyes as you manipulate the thrumming device in your hands. Power seeps from the device's every aperture. Rays of blinding light shoot forth from the cracks appearing on its surface. You watch as the boundary between timelines begins to mend, and the window closes, trapping you within the time and place you have chosen. Once the deed is done, the light fades from the artifact. Its humming ceases, and it never sounds again.
A beautiful yellow sun rises over the lush kingdom of Valusia, and you wonder what to make of your new life.
all_card.real_flavor: Each window you step through seems to empower the relic. Once the artifact is fully powered, will you use it to restore the serpent civilization of Valusia to its former glory?
all_card.real_text: [action] If you are at a [[Shattered]] location with no clues: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, attach your location facedown to the Relic of Ages. Each investigator and enemy at that location is moved to A Pocket in Time. Objective - If Valusia is attached to the Relic of Ages, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
就在你操纵手中那嗡嗡作响的设备时，亚历山卓观察着你的每一步操作。能量从这设备的每个孔洞涌出。刺眼夺目的光线从它表面的裂缝之间喷薄而出。你看着时间线之间的界限开始修补，随后眼前的窗户关闭，将你困在了你所选择的地点和时间里。修补工作甫一告终，遗物的光芒也随之消失。它那嗡嗡声也停了下来，再也听不到了。
“来吧，我的朋友，”亚历山卓坚定地说道，同时向着这天机之城内最高的黑岩高塔移动，“现在可以真正开始我们的研究了。”
all_card.flavor: 你步入的每扇窗户都仿佛使遗物的能量增强。一旦这件遗物充能完成，你会用它来阻止纳克特和伊斯帝国的覆灭吗？
all_card.name: 锁定时间
all_card.text: [action]如果你位于[[破碎]]地点，且该地点没有线索：检定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，将你所在地点正面朝下附属到古代遗物。该地点的每位调查员和每个敌人均被移动到时间之窗。 目标 - 如果纳克特附属到古代遗物，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Alejandro studies your every move as you manipulate the thrumming device in your hands. Power seeps from the device's every aperture. Rays of blinding light shoot forth from the cracks appearing on its surface. You watch as the boundary between timelines begins to mend, and the window closes, trapping you within the time and place you have chosen. Once the deed is done, the light fades from the artifact. Its humming ceases, and it never sounds again.
"Come, my friend," Alejandro says stoically, motioning toward the tallest basalt tower of the city of endless archives. "Now our work can truly begin."
all_card.real_flavor: Each window you step through seems to empower the relic. Once the artifact is fully powered, will you use it to prevent the destruction of Pnakotus and the Yithians?
all_card.real_text: [action] If you are at a [[Shattered]] location with no clues: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, attach your location facedown to the Relic of Ages. Each investigator and enemy at that location is moved to A Pocket in Time. Objective - If Pnakotus is attached to the Relic of Ages, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 在联结点——地球的一个无底深坑——中央有着一个石室，其中有着充满未来风格的机器正发出响动，无疑这台机器是由早于人类的种族所建造的。这个深坑内部是无比骇人的能量，像一锅浓汤一般涡旋着：闪烁着的一缕缕缥缈的光芒，波动、折叠，相互交织。就在你伸手触碰时，它边缘的一部分碎石落入门中，消失了踪迹。
all_card.name: 恩凯联结点
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你从恩凯联结点移动到一个[[异界]]地点，或从一个[[异界]]地点移动到恩凯联结点后：该[[异界]]地点上每有一个线索，受到1点恐惧。 [action]：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。在通过此效果移动时，不从上述强制能力受到恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: At the center of the chamber lies the Nexus: a bottomless pit in the Earth, ringed by futuristic machinery no doubt built by those who came before humanity. Inside this pit is a swirling soup of eldritch energy; glowing strands of ethereal light that ripple, fold, and weave among one another. As you approach, a fragment of stone chips from the brim and falls into the portal, vanishing from existence.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you move from Nexus of N'kai to an [[Otherworld]] location, or vice versa: Take 1 horror for each clue on that [[Otherworld]] location. [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Do not take horror from the above Forced ability when moving via this effect.

all_card.name: 伊塔卡
all_card.text: 猎手。反击。 [action]：谈判。检定[intellect](5)来求她饶你一命。如果本次检定期间揭示了[cultist]符号，你自动成功。如果你检定失败，伊塔卡攻击你。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面并结算其文本。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 蛇族. 精英
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (5) to plead for your life. If a [cultist] symbol is revealed during this test, you automatically succeed. If you fail, Ichtaca attacks you. If you succeed, flip this card over and resolve its text.

all_card.name: 伊格的宽恕
all_card.text:
检查剧本日志。如果在“伊格之怒”下方的记录次数大于等于16： 伊塔卡拒绝了。将本卡牌翻面。 如果在“伊格之怒”下方的记录次数小于等于15：
伊塔卡停下了攻击，倾听你的话语。“瓦卢西亚必须重获荣光。必须这么做。”她坚定地说，“帮我们达成这个目标，而后你就可以加入我们。伊格将会把你重塑成他的模样，我们将一同生活在永恒的天堂，瓦卢西亚。”
调查员必须决定(选择一项)： - “我永远都不会背叛人类！”将本卡牌翻面，处于横置状态和未交战状态。在本场冒险接下来的时间里，你不能与伊塔卡谈判。 - “我答应你。”将本卡牌和场景1a——“修补裂痕”从游戏中移除，并推进到放在一边的场景4a——“失乐园”。在本场冒险接下来的时间里，你不能与亚历山卓·维拉谈判，并且[[蛇族]]敌人不与你交战，也不攻击你。
all_card.real_text:
Check Campaign Log. If there are 16 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury": Ichtaca refuses your plea. Flip this card back over. If there are 15 or fewer tally marks:
Ichtaca ceases her assault and listens to your words. "Valusia must be returned to glory. There is no other way," she decrees with bitter certainty. "Help us to achieve this goal, and you can join with us. Yig will remake you in his image, and we shall live together in our timeless paradise of Valusia."
The investigators must decide (choose one): - "I could never turn my back on humanity!" Flip this card back over, exhausted and unengaged. For the remainder of the scenario, you cannot parley with Ichtaca. - "I accept." Remove this card and Act 4a - "Mend the Shatter" from the game and advance to the set-aside Act 4a - "Paradise Lost". For the remainder of the scenario, you cannot parley with Alejandro Vela, and [[Serpent]] enemies do not engage or attack you.

all_card.name: 亚历山卓·维拉
all_card.text: 警戒。猎手。 [action]：谈判。检定[intellect](5)来求他饶你一命。如果本次检定期间揭示了[tablet]符号，你自动成功。如果你检定失败，亚历山卓·维拉攻击你。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面并结算其文本。
all_card.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 精英
all_card.real_text: Alert. Hunter. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (5) to plead for your life. If a [tablet] symbol is revealed during this test, you automatically succeed. If you fail, Alejandro Vela attacks you. If you succeed, flip this card over and resolve its text.

all_card.flavor: 亚历山卓正在细细思量你所说的话，不知道人形伪装之下的到底是不是他。“很好。只要你不再与兄弟会为敌，我们便会饶你一死。”他在你周围的门廊处踱步，“你的种族并不是最先在地球出现的。根据你经历过的几趟旅程，现在你已经明白这一点了。我们曾试图让你理解，但以你冥顽不灵的性子，你是听不进去的。现在听我说。曾摧毁我族的那群生物将会卷土重来。他们会把人类从这颗星球上抹消，到时唯一能够证明你们存在的证据将留在纳克特。但我们携手合作，定能阻止他们。加入我们，你或许还能拯救地球——还有你自己。”
all_card.name: 另有他法
all_card.text: 调查员必须决定(选择一项)： - “我永远都不会背叛人类！”将本卡牌翻面，处于横置状态和未交战状态。在本场冒险接下来的时间里，你不能与亚历山卓·维拉谈判。 - “我答应你。”将本卡牌和场景4a——“修补裂痕”从游戏中移除，并推进到放在一边的场景4a——“锁定时间”。在本场冒险接下来的时间里，你不能与伊塔卡谈判，并且[[异教徒]]敌人不与你交战，也不攻击你。
all_card.real_flavor: Alejandro - if it is really him beneath that guise of humanity - contemplates your words. "Very well. We will spare you, but only if you assist the Brotherhood." He motions to the gateways all around you. "Your kind was not the first to inherit the Earth. You know this, now, from your travels. We tried to get you to understand, but in your stubbornness, you would not listen. Hear me now. The creatures that drove us to ruin will return. They will wipe humanity off this planet, and the only evidence of your existence will live on in Pnakotus. But together we can stop them. Join us, and you may yet save the Earth - and yourselves.
all_card.real_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - "I could never turn my back on humanity!" Flip this card back over, exhausted and unengaged. For the remainder of the scenario, you cannot parley with Alejandro Vela. - "I accept." Remove this card and Act 4 - "Mend the Shatter" from the game and advance to the set-aside Act 4a - "Timelock". For the remainder of the scenario, you cannot parley with Ichtaca, and [[Cultist]] enemies do not engage or attack you.

all_card.flavor: 那是一个奇怪的漆黑天体，位于太阳系边缘——对地球上的天文学家来说还是未知的。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《暗夜低语者》</cite>
all_card.name: 犹格斯星
all_card.text: [action]：将犹格斯星上的一个线索翻至毁灭标记面。抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: It is a strange dark orb at the very rim of our solar system - unknown to earthly astronomers as yet. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Whisperer in Darkness</u>
all_card.real_text: [action]: Flip a clue on Yuggoth to its doom side. Draw 1 card.

all_card.flavor: 名为“拉莱耶”的巨石城，与它的巨石和坟墓一同沉入滔滔海浪之下……<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《克苏鲁的呼唤》</cite>
all_card.name: 拉莱耶海岸
all_card.text: 拉莱耶海岸的每张卡牌(包括本卡牌)上每有一个毁灭标记，隐藏值+1。 强制 - 在拉莱耶海岸入场后：在其上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_flavor: The great stone city R’lyeh, with its monoliths and sepulchres, had sunk beneath the waves... - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Call of Cthulhu</u>
all_card.real_text: Shores of R'lyeh gets +1 shroud for each doom on each card in Shores of R'lyeh (including itself). Forced - After Shores of R'lyeh enters play: Place 1 doom on it.

all_card.flavor: 这宇宙中存在一些谜团，还是不被了解为好。但是一旦你的“眼睛”睁开，你便会真正地看到它们的存在。
all_card.name: 隐匿之城
all_card.text: 强制 -在1个或多个毁灭标记被放置到位于隐匿之城的[[异教徒]]敌人后：在该敌人上放置额外1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_flavor:
There are secrets in the cosmos better left unknown.
But once your Eyes are open, you will truly See.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on a [[Cultist]] enemy at City of the Unseen: Place 1 additional doom on that enemy.

all_card.name: 时间之窗
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你从时间之窗移动到一个[[破碎]]地点，或从一个[[破碎]]地点移动到时间之窗后：该[[破碎]]地点上每有一个线索，受到1点伤害。 [action]：探索。抽取探索牌顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。在通过此效果移动时，不从上述强制能力受到伤害。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you move from A Pocket in Time to a [[Shattered]] location, or vice versa: Take 1 damage for each clue on that [[Shattered]] location. [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Do not take damage from the above Forced ability when moving via this effect.

all_card.name: 纽约遗址
all_card.text: 强制 - 在纽约遗址入场后：将调查员队长牌库顶的一张卡牌放置入场，正面朝下放在本地点上(如果游戏中有3或4位调查员，改为放置2张卡牌)。将这些卡牌视为飞天水螅敌人，带有2攻击值、2生命值、2躲避值、1伤害值，具有[[怪物]]特性。
all_card.traits: 破碎. 未來. 遗迹
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Ruins of New York enters play: Put the top card of the lead investigator's deck into play at this location, facedown (2 cards instead if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game). Treat each of those cards as Flying Polyp enemies with 2 fight, 2 health, 2 evade, 1 damage, and the [[Monster]] trait.

all_card.flavor: ……在一个可怕的日子里，风雨大作、雷电交加、轰鸣震耳、巨浪滔天，整片姆大陆最终永远地沉入了海中。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特和哈泽尔·赫尔德，《超越万古》</cite>
all_card.name: 姆大陆
all_card.text: 你位于姆大陆时，你每次技能检定期间揭示的第一个[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号获得：“揭示另一个标记。”
all_card.real_flavor: ...till at last on a hideous day of storm and thunder, terrific rumbling, and mountain-high waves, all the land of Mu sank into the sea forever. - H. P. Lovecraft and Hazel Heald, <u>Out of the Aeons</u>
all_card.real_text: While you are at Mu, the first [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol you reveal during each skill test gains: "Reveal another token."

all_card.name: 亚特兰蒂斯
all_card.text: 强制 - 你在任何地点执行技能检定期间，在揭示[auto_fail]符号后：在亚特兰蒂斯上放置1个毁灭标记。然后，如果亚特兰蒂斯上有至少3个毁灭标记，将其从游戏中移除。位于亚特兰蒂斯的每个敌人和每位调查员均被击败。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After an [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during a skill test at any location: Place 1 doom on Atlantis. Then, if there are 3 or more doom on Atlantis, remove it from the game. Each enemy and investigator that was at Atlantis is defeated.

all_card.name: 纳克特
all_card.text: [action]如果有至少3个[tablet]标记在混乱袋中，或被封印在场上的卡牌上：发现纳克特所有的线索并抽取等量的卡牌。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are at least 3 [tablet] tokens in the chaos bag or sealed on cards in play: Discover all of the clues on Pnakotus and draw that many cards. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 瓦卢西亚
all_card.text: [action]如果有至少3个[cultist]标记在混乱袋中，或被封印在场上的卡牌上：治愈2点伤害和2点恐惧。直到本局游戏结束，将瓦卢西亚的隐藏值设为0。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are at least 3 [cultist] tokens in the chaos bag or sealed on cards in play: Heal 2 damage and 2 horror. Set Valusia's shroud to 0 for the remainder of the game. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor: ……我们愈发强烈地感觉到，这个可怕的高地肯定是传说中的噩梦；冷原，即使是《死灵之书》的疯狂作者也不愿谈及。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.name: 冷原
all_card.text: 强制 - 如果你在冷原上执行技能检定期间揭示[elder_thing]符号：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: …the conviction grew upon us that this hideous upland must indeed be the fabled nightmare plateau of Leng which even the mad author of the <u>Necronomicon</u> was reluctant to discuss. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>At the Mountains of Madness</u>
all_card.real_text: Forced - If you reveal an [elder_thing] symbol during a skill test at Plateau of Leng: Take 1 horror.

all_card.flavor: ……他们找到了一些活物——它们沿着石渠流出，信奉着玛瑙和玄武岩制成的撒托古亚像。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《丘》</cite>
all_card.name: 无形之子
all_card.text: 生成 - 恩凯联结点。 庞大。无形之子不能移动，也不能被移动。 在恩凯联结点的每张卡牌上(包括恩凯联结点)每有一个毁灭标记，无形之子得到+1攻击值和+1躲避值。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 异形. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: ...they found living things - living things that oozed along stone channels and worshipped onyx and basalt images of Tsathoggua. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Mound</u>
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Nexus of N'kai. Massive. Formless Spawn cannot move or be moved. Formless Spawn gets +1 fight and +1 evade for each doom on each card in Nexus of N'kai (including Nexus of N'Kai).

all_card.name: 时间吞噬者
all_card.text: 生成 - 最远的[[破碎]]或[[异次元]]地点。如果场上没有此类地点，时间吞噬者获得涌动。 猎手。 强制 - 在时间吞噬者进入[[破碎]]或[[异次元]]地点后：在该地点放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Farthest [[Shattered]] or [[Extradimensional]] location. If there are no such locations in play, Temporal Devourer gains surge. Hunter. Forced - After Temporal Devourer enters a [[Shattered]] or [[Extradimensional]] location: Place 1 clue on that location (from the token pool).

all_card.flavor: 要是你没有修补破碎的时间线，我们所在的世界除了这几个时空之外就什么都不剩了。
all_card.name: 破碎的时代
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定失败，在除恩凯联结点以外的每个地点上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。
all_card.real_flavor: If you do not mend the shattered boundaries of time, this may be all that is left of our world.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, place 1 clue (from the token pool) on each location other than Nexus of N'kai.

all_card.name: 异界之间
all_card.text: 显现 - 将异界之间放置入场，作为一个[[异界]]地点，有3隐藏值和1个线索，并移动到该地点。该地点与恩凯联结点相互连接。(如果从探索牌库抽出本卡牌，本次探索仍视为失败。) 强制 - 当一轮结束时：位于本地点的每位调查员受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。如果本地点上没有调查员，将本地点弃掉并将本地点上的所有敌人移动到恩凯联结点。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Between Worlds into play as an [[Otherworld]] location with 3 shroud and 1 clue, and move to it. It is connected to the Nexus of N'kai. (If drawn from the exploration deck, this exploration is still considered unsuccessful.) Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator here takes 1 damage and 1 horror. If there are no investigators in this location, discard it and move each enemy here to Nexus of N'kai.

all_card.name: 时空撕裂
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。在[[破碎]]地点上的每位调查员都必须执行本技能检定。每位检定失败的调查员受到2点伤害。支援如被分配本效果产生的伤害，且未被击败，则将该支援洗入其所有者的牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). Each investigator at a [[Shattered]] location must also perform this skill test. Each investigator who fails takes 2 damage. Each asset assigned damage by this effect that is not defeated is shuffled into its owner's deck.

all_card.name: 黑暗隐伏
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到恩凯联结点。在黑暗隐伏上放置1个毁灭标记。 无形之子得到+1[per_investigator]生命值。 [action][action]：检定[willpower](3)或检查你的补给品。如果你检定成功，或你带有火把，弃掉黑暗隐伏。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to Nexus of N'kai. Place 1 doom on Creeping Darkness. Formless Spawn gets +1 [per_investigator] health. [action][action]: Test [willpower] (3) or check your supplies. If you succeed, or if you have torches, Discard Creeping Shadows.

all_card.flavor: 这个设备在你手中阵阵波动，其中的能量溢出，不受控制。你周围的景象开始扭曲，仿佛你周围的时间和空间都在扭转、变形一般……
all_card.name: 古代遗物
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你探索时结算诡计后：不弃掉该诡计，改为将其洗回探索牌库。
all_card.real_flavor: The device undulates in your hands, its power overflowing, uncontrolled. The air around you is warped, as though time and space around you is twisting, distorting...
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you resolve a treachery while exploring: Shuffle that treachery back into the exploration deck instead of discarding it.

all_card.back_text:
困难 /专家
[skull]：-X。X为所有地点上的毁灭标记总数。
[elder_thing]：-6。在你所在地点放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.name: 时间倒流
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为带有毁灭标记的地点数量。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你检定失败，在你所在地点放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X . X is the total amount of doom on locations.
[elder_thing]: -6. Place 1 doom on your location.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X . X is the number of locations with doom on them.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, place 1 doom on your location.

all_card.back_flavor: 你经过墙壁上雕刻的纹饰，还有刻在石台上的象形文字。这个存放着遗物的秘库位置，早已封存在你记忆的深处。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的时间石室地点洗入探索牌库。 将本场景放到胜利区。本场景获得复仇2。
all_card.flavor: 尽管在你上次到这儿来后，发生了许多事情，但埃兹特里神庙仍然与你第一次到此探索时别无二致，它在时间的回声之中留存下来，完好无损。你凭借自己的记忆作向导，再一次向遗迹的深处进发。
all_card.name: 再次进入遗迹
all_card.text: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You pass by carvings in the walls and hieroglyphs etched into stone altars. The location of the relic's vault is already locked deep in your memory.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Chamber of Time location into the exploration deck. Place this act in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 2.
all_card.real_flavor: Despite everything that has occurred since you were last here, the Eztli temple remains the same as it was when you first explored it, preserved in an echo of time. You use your memories to guide you, heading deeper into the ruins once more.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

all_card.back_flavor: 这件遗物在你的手中搏动着，它内部的能量发出嗡嗡的低鸣。从这件设备中漏出的能量流进了遗迹内的廊道中，神庙的构造骤然生变。但是，这并未影响你。你的目标不再是带着遗物逃出此地。你再次熟练地操作这件设备的隐藏配件，操纵着周围环境中的时间构成。你决心要阻止这一切的发生，于是你再次让时光倒流。
all_card.back_text: 选择位于时间石室的一位调查员控制古代遗物。 查找收藏，找出伊格(失落的时代#296)。将它生成在时间石室。 将本场景放到胜利区。本场景获得复仇2。
all_card.flavor: 在遗迹群核心地带深处，遗物就在中央石室里静静等候着。
all_card.name: 留存的石室
all_card.text: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。 目标 - 只有在时间石室的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The relic hums with power and throbs in your hands. Energy from the device seeps into the corridors of the ruins, and the structure of the temple shifts. However, this does not matter to you. Escaping with the relic is no longer your goal. You skillfully work the hidden components of the device once more, manipulating the very fabric of time in the environment around you. Determined to stop all of this from having ever occurred, you turn the clock back once more.
all_card.real_back_text: Choose an investigator in the Chamber of Time to take control of the Relic of Ages. Search the collection for Yig (The Forgotten Age card #296). Spawn it in the Chamber of Time. Place this act in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 2.
all_card.real_flavor: In the central chamber deep within the core of the ruins, the relic awaits.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Only investigators in the Chamber of Time may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 这头生物吃痛嚎叫。他的尾巴猛烈地抽击，将几根柱子撞碎，把你摔飞在地。他发出一阵满腹仇恨、低沉的嘶嘶声，随即离去。你把自己的注意力转回到遗物身上，还有这座用来保卫遗物的石室。是时候结束这一切，一劳永逸。必须给这一切画上句号。
all_card.flavor: 你站在遗物的秘库之中，周围满是阵亡的埃兹特里战士。万蛇之父就站在你面前，他嘶嘶的叫声让你从骨子里开始颤抖。这是埃兹特里文明最后的阵地。现在，只有你能阻挡在这头生物的前方。
all_card.name: 毁灭之时
all_card.text: 古代遗物获得：“[action]：检定[willpower]或[intellect](4)。如果你检定成功，将你所在地点的一位调查员控制的一个线索翻至毁灭标记面，并将它放在你所在地点。然后，对伊格造成3点伤害。” 目标 - 如果伊格被击败，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The creature roars in pain. His tail thrashes violently, crushing several pillars and sending you flying to the ground. He retreats with a hateful, rumbling hiss. You turn your attention back to the relic and the chamber that was built to preserve it. It is time to end this, once and for all. It is time to do what must be done.
all_card.real_flavor: You stand in the center of the relic’s vault, surrounded on all sides by slain Eztli warriors. The Father of Serpents stands before you, his hiss shaking you to your bones. This is where the Eztli made their last stand. Now, only you stand in the creature’s way.
all_card.real_text: Relic of Ages gains: "[action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, flip a clue controlled by an investigator at your location to its doom side, and place it on your location. Then, deal 3 damage to Yig." Objective - If Yig is defeated, advance.

all_card.name: 恢复元气
all_card.text:
只能作为你的第一个行动打出。
治愈1点伤害(如果你本轮抽取了一张诡计卡牌，改为治愈2点伤害)。然后，抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
Play only as your first action.
Heal 1 damage (2 instead if you drew a treachery this round). Then, draw 1 card.

all_card.name: 占据先机
all_card.text:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。
任意调查员在本阶段每完成一个行动，占据先机失去[wild]。
all_card.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
Take the Initiative loses [wild] for each action that has been completed by any investigator this phase.

all_card.name: 准备万全
all_card.text: [free]横置准备万全：选择你控制的一张支援卡牌。你本次技能检定得到+X技能值，X为所选支援上对应的技能图标数量。
all_card.real_text: [fast] Exhaust Well Prepared: Choose an asset you control. You get +X skill value for this skill test, where X is the number of matching skill icons on the chosen asset.

all_card.flavor:
“你怎么知道我是疯的？”爱丽丝说。“你肯定疯了。”柴郡猫说，“不然你不会到这儿来。”
——路易斯·卡罗尔，《爱丽丝梦游仙境》
all_card.name: 去伪存真
all_card.text:
你所在地点有线索才能打出。
在你控制的一张支援卡牌上放置2秘密。
all_card.real_flavor:
“How do you know I’m mad?” said Alice.
“You must be,” said the Cat, “or you wouldn’t have come here.”
- Lewis Carroll, Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland
all_card.real_text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Place 2 secrets on an asset you control.

all_card.name: 参透真谛
all_card.text:
只能投入冒险卡牌上印刷能力中的技能检定。
如果本次技能检定成功，你发现你所在地点的1个线索。
all_card.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test from an ability printed on a scenario card.
If this skill test is successful, discover 1 clue at your location.

all_card.name: 一目十行
all_card.text: [free]将你的1个线索放到你所在地点并横置一目十行：你本次技能检定得到+3技能值。
all_card.real_text: [fast] Place 1 of your clues on your location and exhaust Quick Study: You get +3 skill value for this skill test.

all_card.flavor: 喝多了的人才会主动找欧巴尼恩的茬。
all_card.name: 职业杀手
all_card.text: 如果在躲避尝试期间进行本技能检定，且检定成功，则在本回合中，成功躲避的该敌人下次受到伤害时，对其造成额外1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: Only someone who is half seas over would lather up the O’Bannions.
all_card.real_text: If this skill test is successful during an evasion attempt, the next time the evaded enemy takes damage this turn, deal it 1 additional damage.

all_card.flavor: 赌得越大，运势越旺
all_card.name: 挥金如土
all_card.text: [free]花费3资源并横置挥金如土：你本次技能检定得到+2技能值。如果你检定成功，获得3资源。
all_card.real_flavor: The higher the stakes, the better his luck.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Spend 3 resources and exhaust High Roller: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. If you succeed, gain 3 resources.

all_card.flavor: 远远地驶离我们那名为无知的平静小岛。
all_card.name: 如痴如醉
all_card.text: 如果调查期间本次技能检定成功，在你控制的一张支援卡牌上放置1充能或秘密。
all_card.real_flavor: Voyaging far from our placid island of ignorance.
all_card.real_text: If this skill test is successful during an investigation, place 1 charge or secret on an asset you control.

all_card.name: 追忆未来
all_card.text: [reaction]在你正在执行的技能检定开始时，如果追忆未来处于重整状态，指定一个混乱标记：如果本次技能检定期间揭示了指定的混乱标记，横置追忆未来。然后，你本次技能检定得到+2技能值。
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When a skill test you are performing begins, if Recall the Future is ready, name a chaos token: If the named chaos token is revealed during this skill test, exhaust Recall the Future. Then, you get +2 skill value for this skill test.

all_card.name: 反复尝试
all_card.text:
使用(3次数)。如果反复尝试沒有次数，弃掉本卡牌。
[reaction]在技能检定失败后，如果有投入到该检定的技能卡牌归你所有，横置反复尝试并花费1次数：将这些技能卡牌中的一张返回你的手牌。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (3 tries). If Try and Try Again has no tries, discard it.
[reaction] After a skill test is failed, if a skill card you own is committed to that test, exhaust Try and Try Again and spend 1 try: Return that skill card to your hand.

all_card.flavor: 面临绝境之时，勇气油然而生。
all_card.name: 围困
all_card.text: [free]弃掉你1张手牌：你本次技能检定得到+2技能值。(每次检定仅限一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: Bravery is born when there is no other choice.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Discard 1 card from your hand: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

all_card.back_text: 困难 /专家 [skull]：-2 (如果你位于[[古代]]地点，改为-4)。 [cultist]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，在每个[[异教徒]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。 [tablet]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，你所在地的每个[[蛇族]]敌人攻击你。 [elder_thing]：-4。在最近的[[古代]]地点上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。
all_card.name: 界限彼端
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]：-1 (如果你位于[[古代]]地点，改为-3)。 [cultist]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，在一个[[异教徒]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。 [tablet]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败且你所在地点有[[蛇族]]敌人，其中一个[[蛇族]]敌人攻击你。 [elder_thing]：-4。如果你检定失败，在最近的[[古代]]地点上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。
all_card.real_back_text: Hard / Expert [skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you are at an [[Ancient]] location). [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on each [[Cultist]] enemy. [tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail, each [[Serpent]] enemy at your location attacks you. [elder_thing]: -4. Place 1 clue (from the token pool) on the nearest [[Ancient]] location.
all_card.real_text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are at an [[Ancient]] location). [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on a [[Cultist]] enemy. [tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail and there is a [[Serpent]] enemy at your location, it attacks you. [elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, place 1 clue (from the token pool) on the nearest [[Ancient]] location.

all_card.back_text:
检查剧本日志。如果预示者还活着：
没有任何闪光的征兆，突然一道惊雷划破天穹，把你吓了一跳。一道银色闪电仿佛伴随着这声巨响出现，从云间落下，将你面前的世界撕开一条裂缝。在这条裂缝中，出现了一个熟悉的生物。它愤怒地发出嘶嘶声，举起镀金长矛向你攻来。
查找收藏，找出瓦卢西亚的预示者并将它生成在距离所有调查员最远的地点(如果你剧本日志里的“伊格之怒”下方有至少6次记录，改为将它生成在调查员队长所在地点)。按照剧本日志括号内记录的伤害总数，瓦卢西亚的预示者在入场时带有对应数量的伤害。
all_card.flavor:
当你醒来的时候，看见早已起床的伊塔卡在你不远处，穿着她那传统的护甲，把弓背在身后，身边还有一把长刀。
“有点不对劲。”她含糊地对你说明，“我只是想‘窥视’界限的另一头……”
她的双眼通红，脸色苍白得像个幽灵。你猜想她昨晚彻夜未眠。“但这些都不重要。要是我们失败，你将会见证降临于人类的是何种命运。”
all_card.name: 界限崩坏
all_card.real_back_text:
Check Campaign Log. If the Harbinger is still alive:
Following no telltale flash of light, a sudden explosion of thunder blasts across the sky, causing you to jump in shock. As though drawn from the sound, a streak of silver lightning crashes down from the clouds, ripping a tear in the world before you. Through this tear, a familiar creature emerges. It hisses in anger and raises its gilded spear to attack.
Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia and spawn it at the location farthest from all investigators (if there are 6 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play at the lead investigator's location, instead). It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log.
all_card.real_flavor:
Ichtaca is already up and about when you awaken, donning her traditional armor, her bow on her back and a long blade at her side. "Something is wrong," she states cryptically. "I only meant to peer through the boundary…"
Her eyes are bloodshot, her face pale as a ghost. You suspect she hasn’t slept all night. "It matters not. It is time you witnessed the fate that will befall humanity if we fail."

all_card.back_flavor: 一道道银色闪电愈发频繁地落下，天空开始撕裂开来。远方的雷声轰隆而鸣，你看着这两座城市——这座现代城市和它古老的前身——的天际线被吞噬，陷入广阔的岩土巨口之中。环绕在洞穴入口的六根石柱闪烁着鲜亮的光芒。门口中央迸发出一抹赤红，地面因地震的巨力而剧烈震动。“看够了吧。再不走就来不及了，我们得赶紧离开这儿！”伊塔卡吼道。这是你第一次听见她话语声带着颤抖。
all_card.back_text:
找出场上所有没有线索的[[特诺奇蒂特兰]]地点。将这些地点加入胜利区。然后，对场上每个[[现代]]地点分别执行以下流程：查找探索牌库，找出一张左上角带有对应地点符号的地点卡牌，将找出的地点卡牌放置在该地点上并替代该地点。
每位调查员失去其所有线索。
将放在一边的帕德玛·阿姆丽塔敌人生成在大神庙。
将当前场景牌库从游戏中移除。将放在一边的场景3a和密谋3a放置入场，作为当前场景和密谋。
all_card.flavor: 当你穿过这怪异的光景时，伊塔卡的力量不断减弱。你从未见过她这副焦头烂额的模样。她常常心烦意乱，不时四下张望，仿佛答案会出现在她眼前一般。她不住地喃喃自语，嘟囔着古怪的语句：“……这怎么可能发生？……谁是那些老东西……我知道，这儿有别人……”
all_card.name: 屏障薄弱
all_card.real_back_flavor: The silver flashes of lightning become more frequent, and the sky starts to split open. Thunder rumbles in the distance, and you watch as the skylines of both cities - the Present-Day city and its ancient predecessor - are consumed in a giant stone maw. Six pillars surround the cavernous opening, each glowing vibrantly. A red hue erupts from the center of the opening, and the ground shakes with the force of an earthquake. "We've seen enough. We must get out of here while we still can!" Ichtaca shouts. For the first time since meeting her, you hear a telltale trembling in her voice.
all_card.real_back_text:
Find each [[Tenochtitlán]] location in play with no clues on it. Add those locations to the victory display. Then, for each [[Present-Day]] location in play, search the exploration deck for a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner and place it on top of that location, taking its place.
Each investigator loses each of his or her clues.
Spawn the set-aside Padma Amrita enemy in Templo Mayor.
Remove the current act deck from the game. Put the set-aside act 3a and agenda 3a into play as the current act and agenda.
all_card.real_flavor: Ichtaca’s strength continues to wane as you journey through the strange vision. You’ve never seen her this troubled. She is often distracted, peering about as though any moment the answer will appear before her. From time to time, she mutters strange phrases to herself: "…How could this have happened?…The answer will be with the ancients…Someone else is here, I know it…"

all_card.back_flavor: “或许你到下辈子或下下辈子才能放下对追寻真相的愚蠢执着。”帕德玛步入神庙上方的裂缝时，她的嘲笑声在天空中回荡，“这并不重要。你等族类不会在地球上继续存在了……”她说完便消失得无影无踪。你问伊塔卡下一步该做什么，但她也不见了。风暴突然平息，只剩你一个人在这振聋发聩的寂静中孑立。
all_card.flavor: 这个女人此前对亚历山卓颇有微词，现在她就站在主神庙的台阶上，以真实的身份出现在你面前。银色的闪电从她张开的双臂间划过。一群眼镜蛇盘绕在她脚边，发出嘶嘶声。“只有被选中的人才能找到联结点！只有我才有此资格！”
all_card.name: 时间坍塌
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Perhaps an eternity or two will quell your foolish desire to find the truth." Padma's laugh echoes across the sky as she steps through the rift atop the temple. "Not that it matters much. Your kind will not be on this Earth much longer…" She vanishes without a trace. You ask Ichtaca what your next course of action should be, but she too is gone. The storm suddenly quiets, and you are left in deafening silence.
all_card.real_flavor: Alejandro’s former critic stands atop the steps of the main temple, her true self revealed to you. Silver streaks of lightning wind through her open arms. Coiled about her feet is an army of hissing cobras. "Only the chosen can find the Nexus! Only I am worthy!"

all_card.back_flavor: 在远方，地面一道颇宽的裂缝中漏出光芒。你到达那儿的时候，发现这个裂口根本就不是自然形成的。在裂口下方，你看见了天空，仿佛你正盯着上方云朵的倒影。裂口中冒出一缕缕灰烟，发出一阵熟悉的半苦半甜的气味。整个世界天旋地转，你步入裂口，同时压抑着想要呕吐的冲动。当你再次睁开双眼，你发现自己身在陌生的地方，地点不变，但时代变了。
all_card.back_text: 刚刚探索成功并将一个[[特诺奇蒂特兰]]地点放置入场的调查员必须检定[willpower](4)。如果检定失败，该调查员必须查找收藏，找出一张随机的基础[[疯狂]]或[[损伤]]弱点卡牌，并将它洗入自己的牌库。 (注意：[[特诺奇蒂特兰]]地点的连接规则与其他地点不同。)
all_card.flavor:
当你离开旅馆时，你发现这座城市风云变色。上方天空悬挂着银色的闪电，正噼啪作响，而从你脚底传来地底深处的震动。巨大的多足生物浮现在云层上方。“发生了什么？”你在呼啸的风中向伊塔卡大声喊道，“这是什么地方？”
“一个未来。”她的答案令你捉摸不透。
all_card.name: 穿越界限
all_card.text: 目标 - 在通过成功探索第一次将[[特诺奇蒂特兰]]地点放置入场后，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: In the distance, light seeps through a wide crack in the ground. As you approach it, you realize the chasm is not natural at all. Below, you see the sky, as if you were peering into a reflection of the clouds above. Wisps of grey smoke emerge from the chasm, giving off a familiar bittersweet scent. You step through and resist the urge to vomit as the world spins upside-down. When you open your eyes again, you are in another place. Not somewhere, but some<u>when</u>.
all_card.real_back_text: The investigator who just put a [[Tenochtitlán]] location into play by exploring successfully must test [willpower] (4). If he or she fails, he or she must search the collection for a random basic [[Madness]] or [[Injury]] weakness and shuffle it into his or her deck. (Note: Be aware that location connections are different on [[Tenochtitlán]] locations.)
all_card.real_flavor:
As you depart the hotel, you realize that the landscape of the city has been altered. Silver lightning crackles in the sky overhead, and the earth rumbles deep below your feet. Monstrous, polypous entities float just below the clouds. "What is going on?" you yell to Ichtaca over the whistling wind. "What is this place?"
"One future," she replies enigmatically.
all_card.real_text: Objective - After the first [[Tenochtitlán]] location enters play by exploring successfully, advance.

将放在一边的帕德玛·阿姆丽塔敌人生成在大神庙。
将当前密谋牌库从游戏中移除。将放在一边的场景3a和密谋3a放置入场，作为当前场景和密谋。
all_card.flavor: 这是真实，还是幻象？不管怎样，古代的秘密或许正是找到恩凯联结点的关键……
all_card.name: 过去与现在
all_card.text: 目标 - 在时间耗尽之前，尽可能多地发现不同的[[特诺奇蒂特兰]]地点的所有线索，从而找到通往联结点的道路。如果场上有6个[[特诺奇蒂特兰]]地点上没有线索，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The silver flashes of lightning become more frequent, and the sky starts to split open. Thunder rumbles in the distance, and you watch as the skylines of both cities - the present-day city and its ancient predecessor - are consumed in a giant stone maw. Six pillars surround the cavernous opening, each glowing vibrantly. A red hue erupts from the center of the opening, and the ground shakes with the force of an earthquake. "We've seen enough. We must get out of here while we still can!" Ichtaca shouts. For the first time since meeting her, you hear trembling in her voice.

all_card.real_flavor: Is this real, or a vision? Either way, the secrets of the ancients may hold the key to finding the Nexus of N’kai…
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find paths to the Nexus by discovering all of the clues from as many different [[Tenochtitlán]] locations as you can before time runs out. If there are 6 [[Tenochtitlán]] locations in play with no clues on them, advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果帕德玛·阿姆丽塔被击败：
“不！你们这些蠢货！”帕德玛双膝跪地，身上各处伤口淌着鲜血。她仰头看向伊塔卡的双眼，字字恳切：“你怎么能——？”她正想继续说下去，伊塔卡一箭射穿了她的肺部，让她再也说不出话。“走吧。”伊塔卡说道，“我会跟在你后面。”你挥去心中的恐惧，迈进裂缝。
(→结局1)
如果调查员花费线索以推进：
“不！回到这儿来！”帕德玛知道你的计划后尖叫道，“你不能把我留在这儿！我是被选中的人！”伊塔卡回头看了她一眼，向她投以怜悯的目光。在短暂的片刻中，她们二人交换了眼色，然后你听见帕德玛哭喊：“你怎么能这样？”伊塔卡不理会她，转身面向你。“走吧。我会跟在你后面。”你挥去心中的恐惧，迈进裂缝。
(→结局1)
all_card.flavor: 伊塔卡指着远处的​​神庙，在狂风暴雨中大声喊道：“是她！是她把我们困在这儿的；她一直都知道！”无论如何，要是你想回家，就得从帕德玛进入的那道裂缝中溜进去。
all_card.name: 归家之旅
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果帕德玛·阿姆丽塔被击败，推进场景。 目标 - 如果位于大神庙的调查员共同花费所需数量的线索，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If Padma Amrita was defeated:
"No! You fools!" Padma drops to her knees, bleeding out from her wounds. She looks up into Ichtaca's eyes, pleading with her. "How could you - ?" She is about to say something else when Ichtaca silences her with an arrow fired into her lung. "Go," says Ichtaca. "I'll be right behind you." You shake off your fear and step through the rift.
(→R1)
If the investigators spent clues to advance:
"No! Come back here!" Padma screams as soon as she figures out your plan. "You can't leave me here! I have been chosen!" Ichtaca looks back at her with a pitying glance. The two of them share a knowing look for a short moment, and you hear Padma cry, "How could you?" Ichtaca pays her no heed, turning back to face you. "Go. I'll be right behind you." You shake off your fear and step through the rift.
(→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: Ichtaca points to the temple in the distance, shouting over the raging storm. "It was her! She is the one trapping us here; she’s known all along!" One way or another, if you want to get back home, you’ll have to slip through the rift Padma entered from.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If Padma Amrita is defeated, advance. Objective - If investigators in Templo Mayor spend the requisite number of clues, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 尽管特诺奇蒂特兰主神庙的确切位置仍未得知，但挖掘工作已经开展，以搜寻这片区域曾经存在的多座神庙的遗迹。
all_card.name: 神庙遗迹
all_card.text: [action][action]：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Though the exact location of the main temple of Tenochtitlán is not yet known, excavation has begun in search of the ruins of the many temples that once covered this area.
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

all_card.back_flavor: 大都会教堂坐落在索卡洛广场北边，西班牙征服者们在攻陷阿兹特克王朝后建造了这座建筑。在这座教堂的每个钟塔上方，有一缕缕云彩在诡异地打旋。
all_card.name: 大都会教堂
all_card.text: [action]受到1点恐惧：抽取2张卡牌。 [action]如果你有至少6张手牌：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Catedral Metropolitana, situated on the northern side of the Plaza de la Constitución, was built by conquistadors after the conquest of the Aztec Empire. Cloud wisps swirl eerily over each of the cathedral’s bell towers.
all_card.real_text: [action] Take 1 horror: Draw 2 cards. [action] If you have 6 or more cards in your hand: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

all_card.back_flavor: 查普尔特佩克公园这个美丽的生态地标是西方最大的城市公园之一。在这里能将全城美景尽收眼底，其建造地在几个世纪之前曾是一处丛林。
all_card.name: 查普尔特佩克公园
all_card.text: 强制 - 你位于查普尔特佩克公园时，[willpower]技能检定失败后：受到1点恐惧。 [action]：探索。检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点在左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: One of the largest city parks in the west, the Bosque de Chapultepec is a beautiful ecological landmark overlooking the city, built in what was once a sacred forest many centuries ago.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a [willpower] test while at Chapultepec Park: Take 1 horror. [action]: Explore. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

all_card.back_flavor: 墨西哥城中央的主广场就在你眼前，这里曾是特诺奇蒂特兰的仪式中心。银色的闪电出现在上空的重重乌云之中，而你震惊地发现一股鲜血洪潮在广场上漫延。整座城市异常地毫无生机，死气沉沉。
all_card.name: 索卡洛广场
all_card.text: [action]弃掉费用总计至少为5的手牌：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The main square in central Mexico City, once the ceremonial center of Tenochtitlán, stretches before you. Silver lightning flashes in the storm clouds overhead, and you are shocked to find a tide of blood swelling over the plaza. The entire city is bizarrely devoid of any life.
all_card.real_text: [action] Discard cards with a total combined cost of at least 5 from your hand: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

all_card.back_flavor: 一艘小木船撞在运河边上，在潺潺流动的河水上荡漾起水波。旁边的浅水滩头上有一株醒目的松树，在微风中轻轻摇曳。
all_card.name: 霍奇米尔科
all_card.text: 你位于霍奇米尔科时，你不能获得资源。 [action]花费3资源：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A small wooden boat bumps up against the side of the canal, swaying gently in the rippling water. A juniper tree sticks out of the shallow water nearby, bending in the mild breeze.
all_card.real_text: While you are at Xochimilco, you cannot gain resources. [action] Spend 3 resources: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

all_card.back_flavor: 尽管科约阿坎区曾经不属于墨西哥城，但它始终是一块历史悠久的地区，其特征是有着诸多狭窄的鹅卵石街道和广场。当你走在这个村落的狭窄小道上时，地面伴有震动，你怀疑还有着更多的未知生命居于地下……
all_card.name: 科约阿坎区
all_card.text: [action]受到1点伤害或1点恐惧：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Although not always a part of Mexico City, Coyoacán has always been a historic area, marked by narrow cobblestone streets and plazas. The ground shakes as you walk down one of the village’s many confined paths, and you suspect there is more that lives below the surface…
all_card.real_text: [action] Take 1 damage or 1 horror: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

all_card.name: 大神庙

all_card.back_flavor: 就在你穿过这一间间奇异的房间时，你来到了一间之前未曾发觉的房间，里面满是来自各种文明的饰品及用具，林林总总，五花八门。其中的许多物品，与你之前对这座城市的住所供述的内容相符——你曾描述你在初次遭遇这些生物时的个人装备。它们是以某种方式复制了你携带的物品吗？你将找到的东西带走，随后继续探索。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员查找自己牌库顶9张卡牌，找出最多2张[[道具]]支援卡牌并将其抽取。混洗每个查找过的牌库。(注意：调查员现在能将[[道具]]支援放置入场。) 将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。 如果看管人在场，并且不受调查员控制，将它移动到线索最多的地点。
all_card.flavor: 不知怎地，你醒来时身处一座未来风格的城市，这里居住着你无法理解的怪异生物。要想找到出路，你必须探索这个诡异的地方，但适应你的新身体不是一件易事。
all_card.name: 伟大种族之城
all_card.text: 调查员不能将[[道具]]支援放置入场(包括[[道具]]弱点)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you traverse these strange halls, you come across a chamber you hadn't noticed before. It is filled with trinkets and items of all kinds from various civilizations. Many of them match the descriptions you have given to the city's inhabitants - descriptions of the equipment you had on your person when you first encountered the creatures. Have they somehow replicated the objects you had with you? You take what you can find and continue exploring.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator searches the top 9 cards of his or her deck for up to 2 [[Item]] assets and draws them. Shuffle each searched deck. (Note: Investigators are now able to put [[Item]] assets into play.) Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. If The Custodian is in play and not controlled by an investigator, move it to the location with the most clues on it.
all_card.real_flavor: Somehow you have awoken in a futuristic city, inhabited by odd alien creatures beyond your imagining. You must explore this strange place if you are to find a way out, but your new body is difficult to get used to.
all_card.real_text: Investigators cannot put [[Item]] assets into play (including [[Item]] weaknesses).

all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。 如果看管人在场，并且不受调查员控制，将它移动到线索最多的地点。
检查你们的补给品。如果有调查员带有挂坠，该调查员阅读以下文本：
随着你在这座古怪的城市逗留的时间越久，你对于过去的记忆就越模糊。随即一丝希望的火花回到你脑海，你回想起你曾携带的一件物品，在你困难的时间里给你带来慰藉。你仔细查看伊斯根据你的描述复制的物品，在其中找到了那件物品：一个银质链子的挂坠。就当你握紧这挂坠的时候，你真正的身份如潮水一般涌入脑海。
每位带有挂坠的调查员抽取2张卡牌。在本场冒险接下来的时间里，每位带有挂坠的调查员忽略将会减少手牌上限的任何效果。
all_card.flavor: 你进入新身体之前的记忆开始逐渐地消失。最先忘记的是最近发生的一些事情，但过了不久，你离自己的人类身份越来越远。
all_card.name: 失去的记忆
all_card.text: 每位调查员的手牌上限减少2张。
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. If The Custodian is in play and not controlled by an investigator, move it to the location with the most clues on it.
Check your supplies. If an investigator has a pendant, that investigator reads the following:
As you spend more and more time in the alien city, your memories of the past continue to fade. Then, a spark of hope returns to you, and you recall an object you once carried with you, one that brought you comfort when times were tough. You sift through the objects the Yithians replicated from your descriptions, and there you find it: a pendant on a silver chain. As you hold it, your real identity comes flooding back.
Each investigator with a pendant draws 2 cards. For the remainder of the scenario, each investigator with a pendant ignores any effect that would reduce his or her maximum hand size.
all_card.real_flavor: Little by little, the memories of your former life are starting to fade. The most recent events are the first to disappear, but soon you begin to lose your grip on your human identity.
all_card.real_text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 2.

all_card.back_flavor: 你彻底忘了自己曾经是谁。你的名字，你的人类身份，都忘光了。然而，纳克特的失落之城在召唤着你，它宁静的各个房间中蕴藏着知识的宝藏，你到达此地后，就会发现这座知识宝库比你所理解的任何事物都要广阔。你在迷雾之中失去了自己的方向，与伟大的种族伊斯共度时光，直到有一天……
all_card.back_text: 幸存的每位调查员被击败。
all_card.flavor:
过了多久了？几天？几个星期？
……几年？
all_card.name: 遗忘人类身份
all_card.text: 每位调查员的手牌上限减少4张。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You forget all that you once were. Your name, and your humanity, are lost. However, the lost city of Pnakotus calls to you, its peaceful halls a treasure trove of knowledge more vast than anything your mind could have comprehended before your arrival here. Your purpose lost in the haze, you live out your days with the Great Race of Yith, until one day...
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated.
all_card.real_flavor:
How long has it been? Days? Weeks?

…Years?
all_card.real_text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 4.

all_card.back_flavor: 你探索会谈间周围的区域，花了一些时间，了解了更多有关这座城市和其住民的信息。这是蕴藏知识，进行研究的地方，这里的居民自称“伟大种族伊斯”。对于这座城市的大多区域，伊斯人允许你自由探索，不加以阻挠，但是仍有某些伊斯人跟着你，带着强烈的兴趣观察你的举动。在你经过这座城市的一段曲折步道时，你发现墙上有着一块面板。这是一种科技设备，你真希望你能懂。当你目瞪口呆地站在这面板前方时，观察着你的一个伊斯人谨慎地走上前来。它伸长了自己的一根附肢，用钳子转动面板。令你惊奇的是，你面前的墙壁滑开，映入眼帘的是另一系列房间。这个生物站到了一旁，给你让出道路。
all_card.back_text: 将所有放在一边的地点放置入场(大图书馆、伟大种族的实验室、伊斯的太阳系仪、解构室、纳克特之塔)。 从上述地点中随机选择一个地点。将放在一边的看管人支援放置入场，放到所选地点。(注意：每个伊斯观测者不再具有冷漠关键词。)
all_card.flavor: 逃离这座怪异城市远比你预想的要难。它有着数之不尽的房间，房间里布满各式各样未来风格的复杂仪器。
all_card.name: 探索纳克特
all_card.text: 每个伊斯观测者获得冷漠。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You explore the area near your interview chamber for some time, learning more of this city and its dwellers. It is a place of knowledge and research, inhabited by beings who call themselves the Great Race of Yith. For the most part, the Yithians allow you to explore the city without troubling you, though some of them follow you about and observe you with keen interest. As you pass through one of the city's meandering halls, you find a panel attached to the wall. It is a technological device you cannot hope to understand. As you stand in front of it, dumbfounded, one of your observers approaches cautiously. It extends one of its claw-appendages and manipulates the panel in a convoluted manner. To your surprise, the wall in front of you slides open to reveal another series of halls. The creature steps aside to let you pass.
all_card.real_back_text: Put each set-aside location into play (Great Library, Laboratory of the Great Race, Yithian Orrery, Deconstuction Room, and Towers of Pnakotus). Choose one of those locations at random. Put the set-aside The Custodian asset into play at the randomly chosen location. (Note: Each copy of Yithian Observer is no longer aloof.)
all_card.real_flavor: Getting out of this strange city might be harder than you thought. Its halls are endless and filled with all manner of complex, futuristic machinery.
all_card.real_text: Each copy of Yithian Observer gains aloof.

all_card.back_flavor: 你深信你已找到了伊斯人将你传送到这里的程式。但事实令人难以接受。你的身体从未被带到这里来。你的意识已被转移到这具身体中，属于这群生物的其中一个同胞。在其他的某个地方——在某个时空——这群该死的生物中的一员就居住在你的身体中。
all_card.back_text: 你再也不必执行以下任何任务。但是，你在本场冒险结束之前执行的任务越多，就越容易能转移到你的人类身体中，这项程式失败或产生反作用的几率也更低。但要当心…… 将本场景放到胜利区，本面朝上，作为提醒。 - 有调查员“找到了归位程式”。 - 有调查员“解剖了一个器官”。 - 有调查员“进行了一次会谈”。 - 有调查员“发现了现在的年份”。 - 有调查员“启动了设备”。 - 有调查员控制了看管人。
all_card.flavor: 你必须找到回去的路。既然伊斯人能够带你来到这里，那肯定也有回去的办法……
all_card.name: 禁止通行
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果以下情况中，有三种情况已发生，你必须推进场景： - 有调查员“找到了归位程式”。 - 有调查员“解剖了一个器官”。 - 有调查员“进行了一次会谈”。 - 有调查员“发现了现在的年份”。 - 有调查员“启动了设备”。 - 有调查员控制了看管人。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You believe you have discovered the process used by the Yithians to transport you here. But the truth is hard to accept. Your body was never brought to this place. Your mind has been transferred into the body of one of these creatures. Somewhere, in another place - in another time - one of the reviled creatures dwells in your body.
all_card.real_back_text: You no longer have to perform any of the following tasks. However, the more you have performed by the time the scenario ends, the easier the transition to your human body will be, and the less likely the process is to fail or backfire. Be careful... Place this act in the victory display with this side faceup, as a reminder. - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian.
all_card.real_flavor: You have to find a way back home. Surely if the Yithians can bring you to this place, there must be a way to return…
all_card.real_text: Objective - If three of the following are true, you must advance: - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian.

all_card.back_flavor:
机器呼呼作响，发出剧烈的震动。你不得不秘密进行，结合你在这座城市的各个地区收集到的知识，花了几个小时才建造了这台机器。这是一台古怪的机器，由焊条、轮子、玻璃构成，大小与小型文件柜相仿。在正中央的一面圆形镜子映出你的异形倒影，镜中生物正盯着你看。
你启动了这台机器，你感到你的灵魂受到牵动，你的意识被撕扯拉伸，横跨空间与时间的虚空。记忆如潮水一般涌入脑海。
all_card.flavor: 你已经收集了夺回身体掌控权所需的所有信息，但在你启动程式之前，你必须先扩展自己的思维。
all_card.name: 回归自我
all_card.text: 每个伊斯观测者获得猎手。 [action]花费1个线索：抽取。不抽取1张卡牌，改为抽取2张。如果你的手牌超出上限，抽取额外1张卡牌。 目标 - 如果幸存的每位调查员有至少10张手牌，立即推进场景。(注意——记住要尽可能多地完成场景2b上列出的任务。)
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The machine whirs with intense vibration. It has taken many hours to construct, and you have had to build it in secret, using the knowledge you have gathered from the various areas within the city. It is a strange device of rods, wheels, and glass, about the size of a small filing cabinet. A circular mirror in the center sends your alien reflection staring back at you.
You activate the device, and you feel a tugging on your psyche, stretching your consciousness across the aether of space and time. The memories come flooding back.
all_card.real_flavor: You have gathered the knowledge necessary to repossess your body, but before you can initiate the process, you must expand your mind.
all_card.real_text: Each Yithian Observer gains hunter. [action] Spend 1 clue: Draw. Draw 2 cards instead of 1. If your hand exceeds your maximum hand size, draw 1 additional card. Objective - If each surviving investigator has 10 or more cards in his or her hand, immediately advance. (Beware - remember to complete as many of the tasks listed on act 2b as you can.)

all_card.back_flavor: 向下望望自己的身体，整夜我都没能抑制住这种冲动。尽管我第一次向下看的时候，什么都没有发现。下一秒我意识到，那是因为我的脑袋在一条灵活的、长得惊人的脖子上。缩回脖子并飞快地向下瞥了一眼，我看见的是一个虹色的庞大锥体，高十英尺、底部宽十英尺，全身布满了鳞片和皱纹。就在那时，我从熟睡的深渊中发疯似的跳了起来，尖叫声惊醒了半个阿卡姆城。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：与曾是人类时的卡牌张数一样。 牌库构建选项：伊斯人不能构建牌库。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：你还记得吗……？
all_card.name: 伊斯人身体
all_card.text:
你的每个[[盟友]]支援获得[[伊斯]]特性。
[reaction]在你将卡牌投入你正在执行的技能检定后：该卡牌上的技能图标数量翻倍。(每次检定仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: And then the morbid temptation to look down at myself became greater and greater, till one night I could not resist it. At first my downward glance revealed nothing whatsoever. A moment later I perceived that this was because my head lay at the end of a flexible neck of enormous length. Retracting this neck and gazing down very sharply, I saw the scale, rugose, iridescent bulk of a vast cone ten feet tall and ten feet wide at the base. THat was when I waked half of Arkham with my screaming as I plunged madly up from the abyss of sleep. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: What it used to be, when you were human. Deckbuilding Options: Yithians can't build decks. Deckbuilding Requirements: (do not count toward deck size): Do you remember...?
all_card.real_text:
Each of your [[Ally]] assets gains the [[Yithian]] trait.
[reaction] After you commit a card to a skill test you are performing: Double the skill icons on that card. (Limit once per test.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Draw 1 card.

all_card.back_flavor: 与此同时，被转移的意识将被送往转移者的时代和身体中，得到妥善的保护。阻止它伤害自己占有的身体，并且将由训练有素的提问者来榨干它的所有知识。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 这里有着巨大的圆窗、高高的拱门，还有高度与一般房间同高的基座和桌子。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 会谈间
all_card.text: [reaction]在你本地点开始自己的回合后，如果本地点有[[伊斯]]敌人：抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Meanwhile the displaced mind, thrown back to the displacer’s age and body, would be carefully guarded. It would be kept from harming the body it occupied, and would be drained of all its knowledge by trained questioners. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_flavor: There were colossal round windows and high arched doors, and pedestals or tables each as tall as the height of an ordinary room. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you begin your turn in this location, if there is a [[Yithian]] enemy in this location: Draw 1 card.

all_card.back_flavor: 与此同时，被转移的意识将被送往转移者的时代和身体中，得到妥善的保护。阻止它伤害自己占有的身体，并且将由训练有素的提问者来榨干它的所有知识。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 会谈间
all_card.text: [action]：谈判。检定[intellect](4)或[combat](4)来讯问被拘留在此的意识。如果你检定成功，记住你“进行了一次会谈”。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Meanwhile the displaced mind, thrown back to the displacer’s age and body, would be carefully guarded. It would be kept from harming the body it occupied, and would be drained of all its knowledge by trained questioners. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4) or [combat] (4) to interrogate the captive mind restrained here. If you succeed, remember that you "interviewed a subject." If you fail, take 2 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 与此同时，被转移的意识将被送往转移者的时代和身体中，得到妥善的保护。阻止它伤害自己占有的身体，并且将由训练有素的提问者来榨干它的所有知识。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 一种无法辨认的淤泥覆盖着房间中央的大桌。这是一次失败的试验留下的吗？或者是某些更糟的东西？
all_card.name: 会谈间
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你进入本地点后：检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Meanwhile the displaced mind, thrown back to the displacer’s age and body, would be carefully guarded. It would be kept from harming the body it occupied, and would be drained of all its knowledge by trained questioners. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_flavor: An unidentifiable ooze covers the large table near the center of the chamber. The remains of a failed experiment? Or something far worse?
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter this location: Test [willpower] (3). Take 1 horror for each point you fail by.

all_card.back_flavor: 由此显示，黄沙之下正好覆盖着地球初期某种巨大建筑的一层——历经了千万年的地质剧变，这建筑是如何留存至今的？无论是那时还是现在，我都无法猜测其中的缘由。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 然后我看见几幕景象，景象里我正穿过石砌的巨大走廊，在同样巨大的砖石结构的斜面上下走动。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 纳克特廊道
all_card.text: [free]在你回合期间，选择并弃掉一张手牌：移动到另一个纳克特廊道。(每回合仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: At this point, it appeared, the desert’s sands lay directly upon a floor of some titan structure of earth’s youth - how preserved through aeons of geologic convulsion I could not then and cannot now even attempt to guess. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_flavor: Later I had visions of sweeping through Cyclopean corridors of stone, and up and down gigantic inclined planes of the same monstrous masonry. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_text: [fast] During your turn, choose and discard a card from your hand: Move to another copy of Halls of Pnakotus. (Limit once per turn.)
