all_card.back_flavor: 在伊斯人宏大的图书馆里，存放着大量的文本和图画，有着地球万事万物的记录——记载着历史、所有曾经存在或将会诞生的物种，以及这些物种的艺术、成就、语言、心理的完整记录。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 大图书馆
all_card.text: [action]花费1[per_investigator]个线索：检定[intellect](3)来破译你找到的信息。如果你检定成功，记住你“找到了归位程式”。 强制 - 当一轮结束时，如果大图书馆上的线索数量不足4个：在大图书馆上放置线索，直至其上有4个线索。
all_card.real_back_flavor: In its vast libraries were volumes of texts and pictures holding the whole of earth’s annals - histories and descriptions of every species that had ever been or that ever would be, with full records of their arts, their achievements, their languages, and their psychologies. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Test [intellect] (3) to decipher the information you've found. If you succeed, remember that you have "found the process." Forced - At the end of the round, if there are fewer than 4 clues on Great Library: Add clues to Great Library until there are 4 clues on it.

all_card.back_flavor: 我似乎在使用钳子敲击声构成的某种奇怪的语言，来与太阳系各个角落被放逐的智慧对话。那里有一个意识体来自我们认知中的金星，源自遥不可及的未来，还有一个意识体来自六百万年前木星的一颗外围卫星。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 伊斯的太阳系仪
all_card.text:
[action][action]如果伊斯的太阳系仪上没有线索：记住你“发现了现在的年份”。
你位于伊斯的太阳系仪时，你手牌上限提高2张。
all_card.real_back_flavor: I seemed to talk, in some odd language of claw-clickings, with exiled intellects from every corner of the solar system. There was a mind from the planet we know as Venus, which would live incalculable epochs to come, and one from an outer moon of Jupiter six million years in the past. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_text:
[action][action] If there are no clues on Yithian Orrery: Remember that you "realized what year it is."
While you are in the Yithian Orrery, increase your maximum hand size by 2.

all_card.back_flavor: 它们运用自己敏捷的思维，将自身投射到过去与未来，了解地球上已知的和未知的一切事物，甚至跨越了数百万年的鸿沟，去研究每一个时代的知识。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 伟大种族的实验室
all_card.text: [action]如果伟大种族的实验室上没有线索：检定[agility](3)来操纵附近的先进设备。如果你检定成功，记住你“启动了设备”。如果你检定失败，在伟大种族的实验室上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: It had learned all things that ever were known or ever would be known on the earth, through the power of its keener minds to project themselves into the past and future, even through gulfs of millions of years, and study the lore of every age. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Laboratory of the Great Race: Test [agility] (3) to manipulate the controls on the technological device nearby. If you succeed, remember that you "activated the device." If you fail, place 1 clue on Laboratory of the Great Race (from the token pool).

all_card.back_flavor: 在我们的理解中，它们并非完全是物质的，它们的意识类型和感知媒介与陆生生物全然不同。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 解构室
all_card.text: [action]：检定[combat](4)来尝试从其中一具怪物尸体中取出宝贵的器官。解构室上每有一个线索，本次检定难度+1。如果你检定成功，记住你“解剖了一个器官”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: They were only partly material - as we understand matter - and their type of consciousness and media of perception differed wholly from those of terrestrial organisms. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [combat] (4) to attempt to retrieve a valuable organ from one of the alien cadavers. This test gets +1 difficulty for each clue on Deconstruction Room. If you succeed, remember that you "dissected an organ."

all_card.back_flavor: 在某些地方，我曾看见巨大的黑色高塔，形似圆柱，远远高于其他建筑物。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 你无法逃避自己面前的广阔沙漠，但如果就此放弃，你永远都无法夺回自己的身体。
all_card.name: 纳克特之塔
all_card.text: [action]：弃掉你任意数量的手牌。将你的弃牌堆洗入你的牌库并抽取卡牌，抽取的张数等于你弃掉的手牌数+1。(每回合仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: In certain places I beheld enormous dark cylindrical towers which climbed far above any of the other structures. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_flavor: The great sandy desert beyond is no escape for you. If you leave, you will never repossess your body.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Discard any number of cards from your hand. Shuffle your discard pile into your deck and draw cards equal to 1 more than the number of cards you discarded. (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.name: 看管人
all_card.text: [reaction]在调查阶段开始时，如果你控制着看管人：位于其所在地点的每位调查员抽取1张卡牌。 [action]如果没有任何玩家控制看管人：谈判。检定[intellect](3)来与图书馆看管人交涉。如果你检定成功，你对它的某些怪异行径感到熟悉；在本卡牌上放置你的1个线索。然后，如果本卡牌上有1[per_investigator]线索，控制看管人。
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When the investigation phase begins, if you control The Custodian: Each investigator at its location draws 1 card. [action] If The Custodian is not controlled by a player: Parley. Test [intellect] (3) to converse with the library custodian. If you succeed, something about its mannerisms seems familiar to you; place 1 of your clues on it. Then, if there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on it, take control of The Custodian.

all_card.name: 大图书馆的监守人
all_card.text: 生成 - 大图书馆。 警戒。冷漠。 如果有调查员“找到了归位程式”或“发现了现在的年份”，大图书馆的监守人失去冷漠并获得猎手。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Great Library. Alert. Aloof. If an investigator has "found the process" or "realized what year it is," Keeper of the Great Library loses aloof and gains hunter.

all_card.name: 伊斯科学家
all_card.text: 生成 - 伟大种族的实验室。 冷漠。 如果有调查员“启动了设备”或“解剖了一个器官”，伊斯科学家失去冷漠并获得猎手。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Laboratory of the Great Race. Aloof. If an investigator has "activated the device" or "dissected an organ," Scientist of Yith loses aloof and gains hunter.

all_card.name: 伊斯学者
all_card.text: 猎物 - 手牌最多。 强制 - 在伊斯学者攻击你时：随机弃掉你2张手牌。 [action]如果伊斯学者处于重整状态且与你交战：谈判。检定[intellect](3)来尝试扮作伟大种族的一员。如果你检定成功，抽取1张卡牌并躲避伊斯学者。如果你检定失败，伊斯学者攻击你。
all_card.real_text: Prey - Most cards in hand. Forced - When Scholar from Yith attacks you: Discard 2 random cards from your hand. [action] If Scholar from Yith is ready and engaged with you: Parley. Test [intellect] (3) to attempt to pass as a member of the creature's race. If you succeed, draw 1 card and evade Scholar from Yith. If you fail, Scholar from Yith attacks you.

all_card.name: 伊斯人登场
all_card.text: 显现 - 将伊斯人登场放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 如果你所在地点有[[伊斯]]敌人，你不能调查该地点或触发遭遇卡牌上的[action]能力(包括本卡牌)。 [action]选择并弃掉2张手牌：弃掉伊斯人登场。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Yithian Presence into play in your threat area. If there is a [[Yithian]] enemy at your location, you cannot investigate that location or trigger [action] abilities on encounter cards (including this card). [action] Choose and discard 2 cards from your hand: Discard Yithian Presence.

all_card.name: 残酷拷问
all_card.text: 显现 - 将残酷拷问放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。如果有调查员“进行了一次会谈”，受到1点恐惧，并且残酷拷问获得涌动。 你不能进行抽取行动。 [action]：检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定成功，弃掉残酷拷问。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Cruel Interrogations into play in your threat area. If any investigator has "interviewed a subject," take 1 horror and Cruel Interrogations gains surge. You cannot take draw actions. [action]: Test [willpower] (2). If you succeed, discard Cruel Interrogations.

all_card.flavor: 能被消除的所有记忆都被消除了，所以在大多数情况下，记忆都只剩一片空白，停留在最初互换时。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 丧失人性
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](5)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，将你牌库顶的一张卡牌从游戏中移除。如果你手牌、牌库和弃牌堆的卡牌总数少于10张，则你发疯。
all_card.real_flavor: All memories that could be eradicated were eradicated, so that in most cases only a dream-shadowed blank stretched back to the time of the first exchange. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, remove the top card of your deck from the game. If there are less than 10 total cards in your hand, deck and discard pile, you are driven insane.

all_card.flavor: 那不是一场绑架，只是一次交换。
all_card.name: 被监禁的意识
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](0)。不管本次技能检定是成功还是失败，选择并将你的手牌弃至X张。X为你本次检定经过修正后的技能值。
all_card.real_flavor: It was not a kidnapping, but an exchange.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (0). Regardless of whether this skill test succeeds or fails, choose and discard all but X cards from your hand. X is your modified skill value for this test.

all_card.flavor: 我的脑袋发痛，有种从未经历的怪异感觉——有人在试图占据我的脑海。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 离体体验
all_card.text: 显现 - 将你所有手牌洗入你的牌库并抽取等量的卡牌。将离体体验洗入你的牌库。
all_card.real_flavor: My head was aching, and I had a singular feeling - altogether new to me - that someone else was trying to get possession of my thoughts. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow Out of Time</u>
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Shuffle each card from your hand into your deck and draw an equal number of cards. Shuffle Out of Body Experience into your deck.

all_card.name: 手铐
all_card.text: [action]如果手铐没有附属到敌人：躲避。只能对[[类人]]敌人使用。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[combat]。如果你检定成功，将手铐附属到刚刚躲避的敌人。 如果附属的敌人非[[精英]]，其不能重整，也不能在其上放置毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: [action] If Handcuffs is not attached to an enemy: Evade. Use only on a [[Humanoid]] enemy. This evasion attempt uses [combat] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, attach Handcuffs to the just-evaded enemy. If the attached enemy is non-[[Elite]], it cannot ready and doom cannot be placed on it.

all_card.name: 鲜血失色
all_card.text: 作为打出鲜血失色的额外费用，受到最多3点伤害。 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。支付本卡牌费用时你每受到一点伤害，本次攻击得到+1[willpower]并造成+1伤害。
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost to play Blood Eclipse, take up to 3 damage. Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +1 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack for each damage taken as part of this card's cost.

all_card.name: 养神术
all_card.text:
使用(3秘密)。
[action]横置养神术并花费1秘密：检定[intellect](0)。你检定成功且每超过难度一点，抽取1张卡牌。然后，你手牌每超出上限一张，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Feed the Mind and spend 1 secret: Test [intellect] (0). For each point you succeed by, draw 1 card. Then, take 1 horror for each card in your hand in excess of your maximum hand size.

all_card.name: 柯尔特袖珍手枪
all_card.text: 使用(5子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：弃掉柯尔特袖珍手枪。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法
all_card.real_text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Colt Vest Pocket.

all_card.flavor: 两发子弹击穿了这个生物的头颅。然后又是一发，砰。继续，砰。再来，砰。
all_card.name: 最后的枪击
all_card.text: 对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。如果本效果击败该敌人，抽取1张卡牌。如果现在是你的回合，结束你的回合。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
all_card.real_flavor:
Two bullets cracked open the creature’s skull.
Then another. Then another. Then another.
all_card.real_text: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. If this effect defeats that enemy, draw 1 card. If it is your turn, end your turn. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

all_card.name: 骷髅钥匙
all_card.text:
卓越。快速。
[action]：如果骷髅钥匙在你的游戏区域，将其附属到你所在地点。如果骷髅钥匙已经附属到你所在地点，改为将其解除附属并放回你的游戏区域。
将所附属地点的隐藏值设为1。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕
all_card.real_text:
Exceptional. Fast.
[action]: If the Skeleton Key is in your play area, attach it to your location. If it is already attached to your location, detach it and return it to your play area instead.
Set the attached location's shroud value to 1.

all_card.name: 拉莱耶迷雾
all_card.text: 使用(5充能)。 [action]花费1充能：躲避。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次躲避尝试得到+3[willpower]。如果你检定成功，在躲避所选敌人后，你可以移动到一个连接地点。如果本次躲避尝试期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，从你手牌中选择并弃掉一张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Uses (5 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. You get +3 [willpower] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, after evading the chosen enemy, you may move to a connecting location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, choose and discard a card from your hand.

all_card.name: 将就一下
all_card.text: 你可以从你的弃牌堆中打出将就一下。如果你这么做，结算效果后将其洗入你的牌库。 调查。本次调查你所在地点隐藏值-1。(如果你从弃牌堆中打出了将就一下，并且调查成功，发现额外1个线索。)
all_card.real_text: You may play Winging It from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after resolving its effects. Investigate. Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation. (If you played Winging It from your discard pile, discover 1 additional clue if you succeed.)

all_card.name: 陈旧猎枪
all_card.text: 使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+3[combat]并造成+2伤害。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]或[auto_fail]符号，猎枪卡膛了。(本次攻击自动失败。你再次激活本攻击能力之前，你必须执行以下能力：“[action]：你解决了卡膛情况。”)
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械
all_card.real_text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +3 [combat] and deal +2 damage for this attack. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, the rifle jams. (This attack automatically fails. Before you can activate this ability again, you must perform the following ability: "[action]: You clear the jam.")

all_card.name: 暖水瓶
all_card.text:
使用(3补给)。
[action]花费1补给，横置暖水瓶：治愈你所在地点一位调查员1点伤害(如果该调查员有至少2点肉体创伤，改为治愈2伤害)。
[action]花费1补给，横置暖水瓶：治愈你所在地点一位调查员1点恐惧(如果该调查员有至少2点精神创伤，改为治愈2恐惧)。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply, exhaust Thermos: Heal 1 damage from an investigator at your location (2 damage instead if he or she has 2 or more physical trauma).
[action] Spend 1 supply, exhaust Thermos: Heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location (2 horror instead if he or she has 2 or more mental trauma).

all_card.name: 半球地图
all_card.text:
你当前所在地点与至少2个其他地点相互连接时，你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
你当前所在地点与至少4个其他地点相互连接时，你得到额外+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
all_card.real_text:
While your current location is connected to at least 2 other locations, you get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
While your current location is connected to at least 4 other locations, you get an additional +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].

all_card.name: 古旧锈剑
all_card.text: [action]如果古旧锈剑处于重整状态：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。 [action]横置古旧锈剑：攻击。本次攻击将你的[willpower]加入你的技能值。本次攻击造成+3伤害。如果本次攻击击败了[[精英]]敌人，抽取3张卡牌。(每场游戏最多一次。)
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 武器. 近战
all_card.real_text: [action] If Timeworn Brand is ready: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [action] Exhaust Timeworn Brand: Fight. Add your [willpower] to your skill value for this attack. This attack deals +3 damage. If this attack defeats an [[Elite]] enemy, draw 3 cards. (Max once per game.)

all_card.back_text: 困难 /专家 [skull]：-X。X为当前深度等级。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧。 [cultist]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，治愈你所在地点和连接地点的每个[[蛇族]]敌人2点伤害。 [tablet]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，在你所在地点上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。 [elder_thing]：-4。如果胜利区内有至少3点复仇点数，改为你本次检定自动失败。
all_card.name: 幽嘶深渊
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]：-X。X为当前深度等级。 [cultist]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，治愈你所在地点和连接地点的每个[[蛇族]]敌人2点伤害。 [tablet]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，在你所在地点上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。 [elder_thing]：-2。如果胜利区内有至少3点复仇点数，改为你本次检定自动失败。
all_card.real_back_text: Hard / Expert [skull]: -X. X is the current depth level. If you fail, take 1 horror. [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, each [[Serpent]] enemy at your location or a connecting location heals 2 damage. [tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 clue on your location (from the token pool). [elder_thing]: -4. If there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, you automatically fail this test, instead.
all_card.real_text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -X. X is the current depth level. [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, each [[Serpent]] enemy at your location or a connecting location heals 2 damage. [tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 clue on your location (from the token pool). [elder_thing]: -2. If there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, you automatically fail this test, instead.

all_card.back_flavor: 蛇族的遗迹陈旧破败，全无生机。这里所有的建筑几乎都倒塌了，只剩它们最大的几座城市连同雕像和它们的神像留存下来。这个领域定是在很久之前就遭到遗弃。
all_card.back_text: 找出躲避值最高且处于追击中的敌人，将它生成在本深度等级开始时调查员所在的地点。
all_card.flavor: 你缓缓而谨慎地开始下降，进入名为幽嘶的闪着红光的洞穴。洞穴里很安静，在你周围的隧道里，只听得见石块剥落和你回荡着的脚步声。
all_card.name: 开始下降
all_card.real_back_flavor: The serpents' ruins are ancient, decrepit, and devoid of life. Nearly all of their structures have collapsed, but evidence of their great cities remains, along with statues and idols of their gods. This realm must have been abandoned long ago.
all_card.real_back_text: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it in the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
all_card.real_flavor: Slowly and cautiously, you begin your descent into the red-litten caverns of Yoth. It is quiet, and only the crumbling of stone and your echoing footfalls can be heard in the tunnels surrounding you.

all_card.back_flavor: 你经过一片带有裂缝的泥地，这里曾经可能是个广场。在这广场中央，伫立着坍塌了一半的石制喷泉，如今已干涸得只剩骨架。在喷泉池最底部是一团糖浆似的黑色液体。
all_card.back_text: 找出躲避值最高且处于追击中的敌人，将它生成在本深度等级开始时调查员所在的地点。 检查你们的补给品。如果有调查员带有水壶，该调查员必须决定： - 这可能有用。记住你“收集了一种奇怪的液体”。 - 我不会靠近它半步。你不承受负面效果。
all_card.flavor: 你周围的各条隧道内渗出嘶嘶的叫声。你试图避开这片领域留存的怪物时，一双双蛇目从黑暗中紧盯着你。你在一条条狭窄的隧道里来回穿行，借助垮塌的墙壁和剥落破败的石柱藏匿行踪。
all_card.name: 恐惧渐生
all_card.real_back_flavor: You pass through a cracked earthen clearing that once might have been a plaza. Standing half-collapsed in the center of the plaza are the remains of a stone fountain, dry as a bone. At the very bottom of the fountain's basin is a glob of black syrupy ooze.
all_card.real_back_text: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level. Check your supplies. If an investigator has a canteen, that investigator must decide: - This could be useful. Remember that you have "collected a strange liquid." - I'm not going anywhere near that.You suffer no ill effects.
all_card.real_flavor: Hisses begin to emanate from the tunnels all around you. Snake eyes glare at you from the dark as you attempt to avoid encountering the creatures that remain in this realm. You weave in and out of narrow tunnels and hide behind broken‑down walls and crumbling pillars.

all_card.back_flavor: 面前的道路被陡峭的石崖所阻挡。你们开始在四周寻找出路，就在此时，你们身后突然传来嘶嘶声和惊恐的叫声，整片地区沐浴在橙色的火光中。蛇族紧随其后——你们之中的一人必须安全爬上石崖，再把其他人拉上去！
all_card.back_text:
找出躲避值最高且处于追击中的敌人，将它生成在本深度等级开始时调查员所在的地点。
调查员队长选择一位调查员来担任队伍的侦查员。该调查员检查自己的补给品。
如果侦查员有绳索，则其可以轻松爬上石崖，调查员不承受负面效果。
如果侦查员没有绳索，其必须检定[combat]或[agility](5)。如果执行检定的调查员检定失败，其成功爬上石崖，但在攀爬过程中耗尽气力，其承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 你们现在确定了一点：这些洞穴是走不到头的。它们准是横跨了整个地球的地下层。你们还能到达联结点吗？还能回家吗？
all_card.name: 无尽洞窟
all_card.real_back_flavor: The path ahead is blocked by a sheer rock cliff. You start to search for a way around when suddenly, hisses and shrieks emerge from behind you, and the area is bathed in orange fire-light. The serpents are coming - one of you must climb to safety and pull the others up!
all_card.real_back_text:
Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
The lead investigator chooses one investigator to be the group's scout. That investigator checks his or her supplies.
If the scout has rope, he or she is able to climb up with ease, and the investigators suffer no ill effects. 
If the scout does not have rope, he or she must test [combat] or [agility] (5). If the performing investigator fails, he or she makes it to the top but suffers 1 physical trauma from the exhaustion of the climb.
all_card.real_flavor: You are convinced of it now: these caverns are without end. They must span the entirety of the subterranean layer of the Earth. Will you ever reach the Nexus? Will you ever make it home?

all_card.back_flavor: 突然间数百条蛇发出了刺耳响声，响彻整个洞穴。你们已经进入了人类从来无意进入的领域。震耳欲聋的警报声穿刺着你们的耳膜，使你们耳朵流出鲜血。你们的一切感官都被淹没，徒劳地捂住耳朵。你们听不见自己的所思所想。警报声终于结束，你们不由自主地想要逃离此地。但是，你们知道如果现在离开，你们的举动会使全人类陷入险境。你们勇敢地，或者说愚蠢地继续前行。
all_card.back_text:
如果瓦卢西亚的预示者被放在一边，将它移动到追击区域。
找出躲避值最高且处于追击中的敌人，将它生成在本深度等级开始时调查员所在的地点。
all_card.flavor: 洞穴不再寂静无声。蛇人愤怒的叫声和响动近在咫尺，催促你赶紧往前逃。洞穴那异常的红光变得愈发强烈。在红光之中，幽暗的古城披上了另一种伪装——不再扮作隐藏着知识的宝库，而是化身憎恶之地，憎恨你存在于此。
all_card.name: 血色城市
all_card.real_back_flavor: The shrill noise of hundreds of snake rattles suddenly erupts throughout the cavern. You have crossed into territory that humanity was never meant to enter. The earsplitting alarm pierces your eardrums and causes your ears to bleed. Your senses are overwhelmed, and you cover your ears in vain. You cannot hear your own thoughts. Finally the warning ends, and you are left with the uncontrollable urge to flee. However, you know that if you fled now, your actions would endanger all of humanity. Bravely - or perhaps foolishly - you press onward.
all_card.real_back_text:
If the Harbinger of Valusia is set aside, move it to the pursuit area.
Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
all_card.real_flavor: The caverns are no longer quiet. The angry cries and rattling of serpent creatures is all around you now, urging you onward. The cavern’s unnatural red glow becomes more intense. In this red light, the cities of Yoth take on another guise - no longer a source of hidden knowledge, but a place of animosity that resents your mere presence.

all_card.back_text:
找出躲避值最高且处于追击中的敌人，将它生成在本深度等级开始时调查员所在的地点。
如果伊格被放在一边：
地面伴随着这头庞大生物的每一个脚步而震动摇晃。他有力的脚掌踩裂脚下每方石块，用长满鳞片、带有指甲的双手撕开墙壁。他对你投来憎恨的目光，残忍地露出饥饿的神情，下颌大张。
将伊格生成在本深度等级开始时调查员所在地点。
all_card.flavor: 蛇族已经在酝酿更为庞大、危险的阴谋，远远超过你本次旅程所面对的一切。你脸色惨白、汗流浃背、惊恐莫名，急忙想要从出口离开，随便哪个出口都行。
all_card.name: 撼地之怒
all_card.text: 强制 - 在第三个毁灭标记被放置到本密谋上后：找出躲避值最高且处于追击中的敌人，将它生成在本深度等级开始时调查员所在的地点。
all_card.real_back_text:
Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
If Yig is set aside:
The ground shakes with each of the massive creature's steps. He crushes the stone beneath his mighty feet, tearing through walls with his clawed, scaly hands. He sets his hateful eyes on you, unhinging his jaw in a cruel display of hunger.
Spawn Yig in the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
all_card.real_flavor: The serpents have stirred up something much larger and more deadly than anything you have faced on this journey. Pale, sweaty, and terrified, you scurry for an exit - any exit.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After the third doom is placed on this agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.

all_card.back_flavor: 没人能阻止嘶嘶的住民。它们从你四面八方的隐秘处现身，嘶嘶地发出粗鄙的诅咒。随着蛇群逼近，洞穴内陷入混乱。
all_card.back_text: 找出躲避值最高且处于追击中的敌人，将它生成在本深度等级开始时调查员所在的地点。 在本场冒险结束之前，当前密谋获得：“强制 - 在有毁灭标记被放置到当前密谋上后：找出躲避值最高且处于追击中的敌人，将它生成在本深度等级开始时调查员所在的地点。” 将本卡牌放到追击区域，本面朝上，作为提醒。
all_card.flavor: 随着你们下降得愈发深入，洞穴的那抹红光也变得更加明亮、照耀的范围也更大。如果不是有所了解，你们会以为自己将要落到地狱的最深处。
all_card.name: 赤红深渊
all_card.text: 强制 - 在有毁灭标记被放置到本密谋上后：找出躲避值最高且处于追击中的敌人，将它生成在本深度等级开始时调查员所在的地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Nothing can stop the denizens of Yoth. They emerge from hidden places all around you, hissing their foul curses. The caves are plunged into chaos as the serpents close in.
all_card.real_back_text: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it in the location where the investigators began at this depth level. Until the end of the scenario, the current agenda gains: "Forced - After any amount of doom is placed on the current agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it in the location where the investigators began at this depth level." Place this card in the pursuit area with this side faceup, as a reminder.
all_card.real_flavor: The deeper your descent, the brighter and more pervasive the red glow of the caverns becomes. If you didn’t know any better, you would think you were descending into the very depths of hell itself.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After any amount of doom is placed on this agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.

all_card.back_flavor: 蛇群穿过隧道和被摧毁的幽嘶城市，无情地追赶着你们，使你们无处容身，无暇歇息，没有机会逃脱。你们不能指望躲过它们特异的感官，也不能一直逃下去。你们渴望着找到办法躲开它们——什么办法都行，于是你们逃向一个最近的裂口。这个裂口里面有着一座孤零零的狭窄小桥。在桥下方是漆黑的无底深渊，吞噬了幽嘶的红光。
all_card.flavor: 你们不该来到这里。
all_card.name: 复仇
all_card.text: 强制 - 当神话阶段的“检查毁灭阈值”步骤结束时：场上每有一个毁灭标记，调查员按照玩家顺序抽取额外1张遭遇卡牌。 目标 - 如果每位调查员被击败，推进本密谋。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The serpents chase you relentlessly through the tunnels and ruined cities of Yoth, giving you no quarter, no rest, no chance of escape. You cannot hope to hide from their uncanny senses, nor can you run for much longer. Desperate for any way to elude them - any way at all - you run to a nearby chasm. A lone narrow bridge spans the pit. Underneath is a bottomless black abyss that devours the red light of Yoth.
all_card.real_flavor: You never should have come here.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the 'check doom threshold' step of the mythos phase: The investigators must draw 1 additional encounter card for each doom in play, in player order. Objective - If each investigator is defeated, advance this agenda.

all_card.back_text: 增加1资源到当前深度等级。如果当前深度等级为5+，并且你以剧本模式进行游戏，进入(→结局2)。 否则，按照以下步骤执行： - 不位于幽嘶的阶梯的每位调查员被抛弃并且被击败。幸存的每位调查员失去其所有线索。 - 将场上所有敌人移动到追击区域。 - 移除场上地点上的所有毁灭标记。将场上和探索牌库的每个地点放在一边，位于场外。调查员在此过程期间不被击败。 - 随机抽取一张放在一边的、除幽嘶的阶梯以外的地点，将其放置入场，将幸存的每位调查员放置在该地点。 - 从放在一边的地点中拿出幽嘶的阶梯，再从中随机抽取4个地点，以此5张地点卡牌创建一个新的探索牌库。混洗探索牌库。 - 将本场景翻面。尽你所能，向更深处探险……
all_card.flavor: 在我将要继续走下这条似乎看不到尽头的楼梯时，困惑与恐惧萦绕在我心中。这是否会没有尽头？<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特和泽利亚·毕晓普，《丘》</cite>
all_card.name: 前往联结点
all_card.text: [action]如果你所在地点没有线索：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。 目标 - 当一轮结束时，如果位于幽嘶的阶梯的调查员共同拥有所需数量的线索，可以推进场景。(注意——不位于幽嘶的阶梯的所有调查员将被击败。)
all_card.real_back_text: Add 1 resource to the current depth level. If the current depth level is 5+ and you are playing in Campaign Mode, go to (→R2). Otherwise, perform the following: - Each investigator who is not at Steps of Yoth is left behind and is defeated. Each surviving investigator loses each of his or her clues. - Move each enemy in play to the pursuit area. - Remove all doom from locations in play. Set each location in play and in the exploration deck aside, out of play. Investigators are not defeated during this process. - Draw a random set-aside location other than Steps of Yoth, put it into play, and place each surviving investigator at that location. - Create a new exploration deck consisting of Steps of Yoth and 4 other random set-aside locations. Shuffle the exploration deck. - Flip this act back over. Journey as deep as you can…
all_card.real_flavor: Doubt and horror grew upon me as I wound still farther down the seemingly endless staircase. Would the thing never stop?- H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - At the end of the round, if investigators at Steps of Yoth possess the requisite number of clues, they may advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not at Steps of Yoth will be defeated.)

all_card.flavor: 裂口上方有着一条弯曲的通道，通向一层层狭窄而陡峭的台阶，台阶沐浴在遥远下方发出的红色光芒之中。
all_card.name: 幽嘶的阶梯
all_card.text: [reaction]在增加当前深度等级时，如果位于幽嘶的阶梯的调查员共同拥有5[per_investigator]个线索，幽嘶的阶梯的一位调查员从自己补给品中划掉绳索：增加额外1资源到当前深度等级。(每场游戏最多一次。)
all_card.traits: 古代. 失落. 幽嘶
all_card.real_flavor: A twisting passage over the chasm leads to a set of narrow, steep steps bathed in the red glow of the depths farther below.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When adding to the current depth level, if investigators at Steps of Yoth possess 5 [per_investigator] clues as a group, an investigator at Steps of Yoth crosses rope off from his or her supplies: Add 1 additional resource to the current depth level. (Max once per game.)

all_card.flavor: 辛之墓群能够找到的手稿和雕刻少之又少，根据它们记载的信息，我们知道辛之墓群位于幽暗最大一座被摧毁的城市下方。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特和泽利亚·毕晓普，《丘》</cite>
all_card.name: 万蛇之城
all_card.text: 万蛇之城上没有线索时，该地点被视为在胜利区中(以计入复仇点数)。
all_card.traits: 古代. 洞穴. 幽嘶
all_card.real_flavor: This much was known from the very few manuscripts and carvings found in the vaults of Zin, beneath the largest ruined city of Yoth.- H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>
all_card.real_text: While City of the Serpents has no clues on it, it is considered to be in the victory display (for the purposes of counting vengeance).

all_card.flavor: 此处是仿造辛之墓群中所描绘的某种寺庙而建成的，用来供奉一尊极端可怖的黑色蟾蜍神像……<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特和泽利亚·毕晓普，《丘》</cite>
all_card.name: 异端教堂
all_card.text: 有调查员位于异端教堂时，该地点被视为在胜利区中(以计入复仇点数)。
all_card.traits: 古代. 洞穴. 幽嘶
all_card.real_flavor: It had been built in imitation of certain temples depicted in the vaults of Zin, to house a very terrible black toad-idol… - H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>
all_card.real_text: While an investigator is in Hall of Heresy, it is considered to be in the victory display (for the purposes of counting vengeance).

all_card.flavor: 走错一步……
all_card.name: 岌岌可危的悬崖
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你位于岌岌可危的悬崖并尝试探索时：检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定失败，检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，检定[combat](2)。如果你检定失败，你坠入深渊，阵亡。(如果你在以上任一检定中成功，你如常探索。)
all_card.traits: 古代. 洞穴. 幽嘶
all_card.real_flavor: One false step…
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you attempt to explore while at Crumbling Precipice: Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, test [agility] (3). If you fail, test [combat] (2). If you fail, you fall to your death and are killed. (If you succeed at any of these tests, you explore as usual.)

all_card.flavor: 它们——或者它们的先祖最早是以野生形态发现于一处巨大遗迹，遗迹位于名为幽嘶的被遗弃的世界，闪耀着红光，而在其上方的是名为昆扬的世界，闪耀着蓝光。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特和泽利亚·毕晓普，《丘》</cite>
all_card.name: 幽嘶洞群
all_card.text: 强制 - 在幽嘶洞群入场后：在该地点上放置线索，数量等于当前深度等级。
all_card.traits: 古代. 洞穴. 幽嘶
all_card.real_flavor: They - or their principal ancestral element - had first been found in a wild state amidst the Cyclopean ruins of the deserted red-litten world of Yoth which lay below the blue-litten world of K’n-yan. - H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Caverns of Yoth enters play: Place clues on it equal to the current depth level.

all_card.name: 分岔路
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你位于分岔路并尝试探索时，检查你的补给品。如果你带有地图：继续从探索牌库抽牌，直到你抽出2个连接地点(如可能)。将这两个地点放置入场，选择并移动到其中1个地点。
all_card.traits: 古代. 洞穴. 幽嘶
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you explore while at Forked Path, check your supplies. If you have a map: Continue drawing cards from the exploration deck until you have drawn 2 connecting locations, if able. Put both of those locations into play and choose 1 to move to.

all_card.flavor: 而使萨马科纳在萨托城陷入危险境地的另一个原因，则是他对恩凯一直以来的好奇心，那是一个无尽深渊，位于闪耀着红光的幽嘶下方……<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特和泽利亚·毕晓普，《丘》</cite>
all_card.name: 横跨恩凯之桥
all_card.text: 胜利区每有一点复仇点数，横跨恩凯之桥隐藏值+1。
all_card.traits: 古代. 洞穴. 幽嘶
all_card.real_flavor: One other thing which endangered Zamacona’s status in Tsath was his persistent curiosity regarding the ultimate abyss of N’kai, beneath red-litten Yoth… - H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>
all_card.real_text: Bridge over N'kai gets +1 shroud for each vengeance point in the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 通往昆扬的各条地下通道，或者说曾是通向那里的通道，不是被堵住就是受到严密的看守；所有靠近那里的人都被视作危险的探子和敌人。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特和泽利亚·毕晓普，《丘》</cite>
all_card.name: 坍塌的通道
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你位于坍塌的通道并尝试探索时，检查你的补给品。如果你没有鹤嘴锄：在坍塌的通道上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.traits: 古代. 洞穴. 幽嘶
all_card.real_flavor: The subterraneous approaches to K’n-yan, or such as could be remembered, were either blocked up or carefully guarded; and all encroachers were treated as dangerous spies and enemies. - H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you explore while at Broken Passage, check your supplies. If you do not have a pickaxe: Place 1 doom on Broken Passage.

all_card.flavor: 他们较早的几支部族曾居住在这整个地下世界，这个地方向下延伸是深不可测的深渊，包括闪耀着蓝色光芒的区域和称作幽暗的红光区域，在那儿考古学家们发现了更为古老的遗物和非人种族。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特和泽利亚·毕晓普，《丘》</cite>
all_card.name: 被遗弃的仪式场所
all_card.text: X为当前深度等级。
all_card.traits: 古代. 洞穴. 幽嘶
all_card.real_flavor: Formerly several races of them had inhabited the entire underground world, which stretched down to unfathomable abysses and which included besides the blue-litten region a red-litten region called Yoth, where relics of a still older and non-human race were found by archaeologists. - H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>
all_card.real_text: X is the current depth level.

all_card.name: 光耀峡谷
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你进入光耀峡谷后，如果你已中毒：受到1点伤害。 [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有双筒望远镜，发现光耀峡谷的2个线索。(团队每深度等级仅限一次。)
all_card.traits: 古代. 洞穴. 幽嘶
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Bright Canyon, if you are poisoned: Take 1 damage. [action]: Check your supplies. If you have binoculars, discover 2 clues on Bright Canyon. (Group limit once each depth level.)

all_card.name: 伊格
all_card.text:
猎手。庞大。
伊格得到+6[per_investigator]生命值。
伊格所在地点上有另一个处于重整状态的[[蛇族]]敌人时，伊格不能受到伤害。
伊格所在地点上的其他每个[[蛇族]]敌人获得警戒和反击。
all_card.traits: 古神. 蛇族. 精英
all_card.real_text:
Hunter. Massive.
Yig gets +6 [per_investigator] health.
Yig cannot be damaged while there is another ready [[Serpent]] enemy at its location.
Each other [[Serpent]] enemy at Yig's location gains alert and retaliate.

all_card.name: 深坑守卫
all_card.text: 生成 - 如果伊格在场，将深坑守卫生成在伊格所在地点。否则，将深坑守卫放置在追击区域。 猎手。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 蛇族
all_card.real_text: Spawn - If Yig is in play, spawn Pit Warden at Yig's location. Otherwise, place Pit Warden in the pursuit area. Hunter.

all_card.name: 深渊吞噬者
all_card.text: 生成 - 将随机一个放在一边的地点放置入场，并在该地点生成深渊吞噬者。 猎手。庞大。 X为当前深度等级。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Put a random set-aside location into play and spawn Eater of the Depths there. Hunter. Massive. X is the current depth level.

all_card.name: 瓦卢西亚之子
all_card.text: 显现 - 将瓦卢西亚之子放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 每个[[蛇族]]敌人得到+1攻击值和+1躲避值。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从场上弃掉1张瓦卢西亚之子。(每轮最多一次。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Children of Valusia into play next to the agenda deck. Each [[Serpent]] enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Children of Valusia from play. (Max once per round.)

all_card.flavor: 此物来自于下方的幽暗地域。这是一种被封印之物。它比你迄今见过的一切事物都要叫人生怖，即便是蛇人也会感到万分畏惧。
all_card.name: 无光之影
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](1)。本次检定难度+X，X等于当前深度等级。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: There is something in the black realm below. Something sealed away. Something worse than everything you have seen thus far, something that fills even the serpent creatures with unbridled terror.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (1). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the current depth level. If you fail, take 2 damage.

all_card.flavor:
对于地球，我们仍然知之甚少。
对此我们应该感到庆幸。
all_card.name: 深渊恐惧症
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](1)。本次检定难度+X，X等于当前深度等级。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: There is still much of the Earth we do not understand. For that, we can be thankful.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the current depth level. If you fail, take 2 horror.

all_card.name: 蛇族的愤怒
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果没有[[蛇族]]敌人处于追击中，蛇族的愤怒获得涌动。否则，找出攻击值最高且处于追击中的[[蛇族]]敌人，它生成并与你交战。如果有敌人以此效果生成，检定[agility](X)，X为该敌人的攻击值。如果你检定失败，该敌人立即攻击你。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Serpent]] enemies in pursuit, Serpent's Ire gains surge. Otherwise, find the [[Serpent]] enemy in pursuit with the highest fight value and spawn it engaged with you. If an enemy is spawned by this effect, test [agility] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you fail, that enemy immediately attacks you.

all_card.flavor: 你在这件遗物身上耗费了大量时间，研究到其创造者的身份，现在你知道了他们为什么要把它制造出来。伟大种族伊斯的覆灭时间已定……但这件遗物能够避免伊斯的倾覆。
all_card.name: 古代遗物
all_card.text: [free]横置古代遗物：检定[willpower]或[intellect](4)。如果你检定成功，移除场上任一卡牌上的1个毁灭标记。(每场游戏最多一次成功。)
all_card.real_flavor: After spending so much time with the relic and learning about its creators, you understand now why it was made. The doom of the Great Race of Yith was set in time… but it could be circumvented.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Exhaust Relic of Ages: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, remove 1 doom from any card in play. (Max one success per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 里奥·安德森穷其一生，出入于地球上最为凶险、隐蔽之地。在这一路上，他曾失去伙伴。他常常质疑自己，这样的学术追求是否值得付出生命的代价。他最近一次探险是前往南马都尔寻找奥卢索尔历书，那是一场不幸的探险，结局简直是场灾难。他的探险小队只有米奇活了下来，或者换句话说，只有他仍保有人性。里奥再也不愿理葬伙伴的尸身，他们生前是那么信任里奥。但现在他知道探险并不仅是出于学术目的一一在完成使命之前，他绝不却步。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：米奇·布朗、血的代价、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: 继续前进。要死你就自己死去，别误了大伙。
all_card.name: 里奥·安德森
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你的回合开始后：打出一张[[盟友]]支援卡牌，其费用减1。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。查找你牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张[[盟友]]支援卡牌并将其抽取。混洗你的牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Leo Anderson has spent his whole life getting into the deadliest and most obscure corners of the globe. Along the way, he's lost good people. He often questions whether such academic pursuits have been worth the lives lost. His most recent expedition, an ill-fated voyage to Nan Madol to recover <u>Olosopha's Almanac</u>, ended in complete disaster. Mitch was the only one of his people to survive, or at the very least, to remain human. Leo is sick of burying people who trusted him. But now he knows these expeditions aren't purely academic in nature - and he won't quit until the job is done.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Mitch Brown, Bought in Blood, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "Keep moving. You can die on your own time."
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] After your turn begins: Play an [[Ally]] asset, reducing its cost by 1.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Search the top 3 cards of your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 没多少人能说自己攀登过每一块大陆的高山，能说自己曾从食人族部落里偷走黄金神像的人就更少了。在男性占主导地位的社会中，厄休拉是唯一能够发出如此豪言的女性。当她还是个小女孩的时候，厄休拉就已打破了规限自己的条条框框，她爬树、在泥地里玩要、到森林里探索，做许多“年轻女孩不该做”的事情。在波士顿取得考古学学位后，她一直在世界各地找寻失落的文明。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，[[遗物]]卡牌等级0-4，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建(不计入卡牌张数)：杰克·威廉斯、未知的呼唤、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “发现易，领悟难。”
all_card.name: 厄休拉·唐斯
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你移动到一个地点后：进行一次调查行动。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。在本次检定结束后，你可以移动到一个连接地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Not many people can say that they've climbed a mountain on every continent. Fewer still can say they've stolen a golden idol from a tribe of cannibals. Among women in a male-dominated society, Ursula is unique in being able to make these sorts of claims. Ever since she was a small girl, Ursula has broken the rules set down for her, climbing trees, playing in the mud, exploring the woods, and doing plenty of other things that a "proper young lady shouldn't be doing." Since getting a degree in archaeology in Boston, she has been traveling the world searching for forgotten civilizations.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, [[Relic]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Jake Williams, Call of the Unknown, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "Discovery is easy. Understanding is the hard part."
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] After you move to a location: Take an investigate action. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. After this test ends, you may move to a connecting location.

deck_options.error: You cannot have more than 5 Seeker and/or Survivor cards

all_card.back_flavor: 对于芬思·爱德华兹而言，禁酒令简直就是天赐良机。在实施禁酒之前，他的生活漂泊无定，到处打些零工。但在那以后，人们对酒精的渴望臻至狂热，他便通过规避法律来满足人们的需求，赖以为生。他崭新的活法恰恰与他的个性不谋而合，在刀尖上过活，赚得盆满钵满。他从来不会被抓，也不会弄丢一趟货。现在他被卷入了某种超自然的阴谋之中，但最终他还是坚守着一贯的原则：安全走货，免遭逮捕。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：[[违法]]卡牌等级0-5，流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5，其它的探求者和/或求生者卡牌([seeker]和/或[survivor])等级0最多5张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：走私货物、芬恩可靠的.38手枪、当场抓获、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “别忘了给自己留条后路，也别把货给忘了”
all_card.name: 芬恩·爱德华兹
all_card.text:
你可以在自己回合期间进行额外一个行动，该行动只能用于躲避。
[elder_sign]效果：场上每有一个处于横置状态的敌人，+1。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，你可以发现你所在地点的1个线索。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Prohibition was the best thing that ever happened to Finn Edwards. Until they banned alcohol, he was just drifting through life, doing odd jobs here and there. But afterward, the demand for alcohol rose to such a fever pitch that he was able to make a living evading the law and giving people what they wanted. His new lifestyle particularly suited his personality, providing him with a taste of danger and plenty of cash. He never got caught and never lost a delivery. Now he's wrapped up in some kind of supernatural conspiracy, but in the end, he adheres to the same principles: Deliver the goods. Don't get caught.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: [[Illicit]] cards level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 Seeker and/or Survivor cards ([seeker] and/or [survivor]). Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Smuggled Goods, Finn's Trusty .38, Caught Red-handed, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "Never lose track of the exit. Or the merchandise."
all_card.real_text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to evade.
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each exhausted enemy in play. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may discover 1 clue at your location.

all_card.back_flavor: 马泰奥·卡斯提尔自从成为神父后，日子一直不好过。近十年来，墨西哥深受动乱与冲突之苦。马泰奥神父一面希望守住自己的信仰，一面为了布道，有时不得不忽视法律，但这并不是马泰奥信仰动摇的主要原因。如他所料，周围发生的凶杀案和绑架案，其动机与政治因素无关。在这场精心酝酿的纷争背后，一个可怕而恐怖的邪教逐渐壮大。马泰奥想知道，仁慈而可亲的上帝怎能容许他那晚所见的事情发生呢？
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，[[祝福]]卡牌等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：古代抄本、伊格蛇族、1张随机基础弱点。 额外经验值：剧本开始时你有额外5点经验值(这不影响你在单场冒险模式必须拿取的弱点数量)。
all_card.name: 马泰奥神父
all_card.text:
[reaction]在一位调查员揭示[auto_fail]混乱标记时：取消该标记并改为将其视作[elder_sign]标记。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：你检定自动成功。在本次检定结束后，选择一项：
- 抽取1张卡牌并获得1资源。
- 如果此时是你的回合，你本回合可以进行额外一次行动。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Mateo Castile's life has not been easy since he became a priest. Recent decades in Mexico have been wracked with instability and conflict. Father Mateo struggled to balance his faith with the pragmatic concerns of preaching when the law told him he must not. But this is not what has assaulted Mateo's faith at its core. The nearby murders and kidnappings were not politically motivated, as he had suspected. A gruesome and horrid cult thrives at the heart of the brewing war. How, Mateo wonders, could a kind and loving God allow what he saw that night to exist?
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, [[Blessed]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Codex of Ages, Serpents of Yig, 1 random basic weakness. Bonus Experience: You begin the campaign with 5 additional experience (does not affect the number of weaknesses you must take in Standalone Mode).
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] When an investigator reveals an [auto_fail] chaos token: Cancel that token and treat it as an [elder_sign] token, instead. (Limit once per game.)
[elder_sign] effect: You automatically succeed. After this test ends, either (choose one):
 - Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
 - If it is your turn, you may take an additional action this turn.

all_card.back_flavor: 有的时候，生活会让你做选择：接受被安排的命运，或者为自我和信仰而坚持。加尔文选择后者。当他倒在泥路边上，血流不止，濒临死亡时，他看见了幻象一一地球变得四分五裂，令人胆颤，而他的毕生挚爱一一乔亚在熊熊烈火的旋涡之中化为灰烬。随后，加尔文做了另一个决定。他伸手触及黑暗，将其引入自己体内。他不会死，至少今天不会。世界需要他，乔亚也是。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，[[勇气]]卡牌等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：时间尽头、信使之声、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “你要是伤了他，我就杀了你。”
all_card.name: 加尔文·怀特
all_card.text:
你身上每有一点恐惧，你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
你身上每有一点伤害，你得到+1[combat]和+1[agility]。
[elder_sign]效果：+0。你可以治愈1点伤害或恐惧，或受到1点直接伤害或直接恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Sometimes, life gives you a choice: accept the lot that is given to you or stand up for who you are and what you believe. Calvin chose the latter. On the edge of death, bleeding out on the side of a dirt road, he received a vision - a terrifying vision of the Earth, sundered, and João, the love of his life, turning to ash in the vortex of a blazing inferno. Then, Calvin made another choice. He reached out to the darkness and pulled it within him. He would not die, not today. The world needed him. João needed him.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, [[Spirit]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Until the End of Time, Voice of the Messenger, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "If you hurt him, I'll kill you."
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect] for each horror on you.
You get +1 [combat] and +1 [agility] for each damage on you.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. You may either heal 1 damage or horror, or take 1 direct damage or direct horror.

all_card.flavor: “你得带上我，里奥，所以不妨跟我说说发生了什么事。”
all_card.name: 米奇·布朗
all_card.text:
里奥·安德森牌库专用。
你拥有额外2个盟友槽位，只可以用来携带非独特盟友。
all_card.real_flavor:
"You ain't going nowhere without me, Leo.
So you might as well tell me what's going on."
all_card.real_text:
Leo Anderson deck only.
You have 2 additional ally slots, which can only be used to hold non-unique allies.

all_card.flavor: 我们为自己获得的知识付出了惨痛的代价。那值得吗？
all_card.name: 血的代价
all_card.text: 显现 - 你必须从场上弃掉你控制的一张[[盟友]]支援卡牌，或弃掉手牌中的所有[[盟友]]支援。如果没有因本效果弃掉的支援，将血的代价洗回你的牌库。
all_card.real_flavor: We paid a terrible price for the knowledge we sought. Was it worth it?
all_card.real_text: Revelation - You must either discard an [[Ally]] asset you control from play, or discard each [[Ally]] asset from your hand. If no assets are discarded by this effect, shuffle Bought in Blood back into your deck.

all_card.name: 杰克·威廉斯
all_card.text:
厄休拉·唐斯牌库专用。
你每回合执行的第一个移动或调查行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
[reaction]在你揭示一个地点或放置一个新的地点入场后，横置杰克·威廉斯：抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
Ursula Downs deck only.
The first move or investigate action you perform each turn does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[reaction] After you reveal a location or put a new location into play, exhaust Jake Williams: Draw 1 card.

all_card.name: 未知的呼唤
all_card.text: 显现 - 将未知的呼唤放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 当你的回合开始时：选择你所在地点以外的一个地点。在你的回合结束时，如果本回合你没能成功调查所选地点，受到2点恐惧并将未知的呼唤洗回你的牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Call of the Unknown into play in your threat area. Forced - At the beginning of your turn: Choose a location other than your location. When your turn ends, if you did not successfully investigate the chosen location this turn, take 2 horror and shuffle Call of the Unknown back into your deck.

all_card.name: 走私货物
all_card.text:
芬恩·爱德华兹牌库专用。
你所在地点没有处于重整状态的敌人才能打出。
查找你的弃牌堆或你牌库顶9张卡牌，找出一张[[违法]]卡牌并将其抽取。如果你查找了你的牌库，将走私货物洗入你的牌库。
all_card.real_text:
Finn Edwards deck only.
Play only if there are no ready enemies at your location.
Search either your discard pile or the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Illicit]] card and draw it. If you searched your deck, shuffle Smuggled Goods into your deck.

all_card.flavor: 这是一把旧枪——有磨损与划痕，用了好一阵子——但这杆枪从来没让他失望。
all_card.name: 芬恩可靠的.38手枪
all_card.text: 芬恩·爱德华兹牌库专用。快速。使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果被攻击敌人未与你交战，你本次攻击造成+1伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法
all_card.real_flavor: It was an old gun - battered, scraped, and well used - but it had never let him down.
all_card.real_text: Finn Edwards deck only. Fast. Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If the attacked enemy is not engaged with you, you deal +1 damage for this attack.

all_card.name: 当场抓获
all_card.text: 显现 - 重整你所在地点或一个连接地点的所有敌人。连接地点上的每个猎手敌人向你移动1个地点。如果没有敌人以此效果移动，将当场抓获洗回你的牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Ready each enemy at your location or a connecting location. Each hunter enemy at a connecting location moves 1 location toward you. If no enemies move as a result of this effect, shuffle Caught Red-Handed back into your deck.

all_card.name: 古代抄本
all_card.text: 马泰奥神父牌库专用。封印([elder_sign])。 有标记被封印在此时，你得到+1[willpower]。 [reaction]在你将要从混乱袋中揭示一个混乱标记时，弃掉古代抄本：结算封印在此的[elder_sign]标记，如同刚刚从混乱袋中揭示该标记(而不是从混乱袋中揭示一个标记)。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 书籍. 祝福
all_card.real_text: Father Mateo deck only. Seal ([elder_sign]). You get +1 [willpower] while there is a token sealed here. [reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag, discard The Codex of Ages: Resolve the [elder_sign] token that was sealed here as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag (instead of revealing a token from the chaos bag).

all_card.flavor: “我不知道伊格是什么，但我知道我伤了它的子嗣。”<cite>马泰奥神父，《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》</cite>
all_card.name: 伊格蛇族
all_card.text: 猎物 - 仅限马泰奥神父。 猎手。 显现 - 从混乱袋中查找[elder_sign]混乱标记并将其封印在伊格蛇族上。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 蛇族
