all_card.back_flavor: 你花了几个小时想摸清地形，但最终徒劳无功，你相信有某些东西在盯着你，步步紧跟。庞大的蛇形生物在你周围的灌木丛中蜿蜓而行。你试图后退，但它们将你团团围住，朝你嘶嘶作声。突然出现了几个身影：全是足有一人高的蛇身人，挥舞着长矛和齿刃刀，粗暴野蛮，朝你猛攻。不知何故你竟成功逃脱，但你仍觉得自己受到监视。尽管你这次性命无虞，但残酷的事实摆在你面前：此地就是那群怪物的家园。
all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆和放在一边的伊格的使徒遭遇组洗入遭遇牌库。
每位调查员检定[willpower](3)。每位检定失败的调查员依次执行以下流程：
- 如果你已中毒，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
- 如果你未中毒，将放在一边的一个中毒弱点放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
all_card.flavor: 为了找寻失落的阿兹特克城邦，你的探险队进入墨西哥南部丛林深处。随着你愈发深入这片野性的丛林，你将发现什么呢？
all_card.name: 荒野探险
all_card.text: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: After hours of exploration and futile attempts to map out the wilds, you're convinced something is watching your progress, stalking your every move. The shapes of large serpentine creatures slither in the brush all around you. You try to back away, but the creatures have you completely surrounded, hissing at you from all sides. Suddenly, several shapes emerge from the brush: human-sized creatures with the bodies of serpents and arms wielding spears and jagged knives. The creatures are savage, attacking you fiercely. Somehow, you manage to flee to safety, though the sensation that you are being watched remains. Although you survive the encounter, you are confronted with a stark reality: this place is home to creatures beyond your understanding.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside Agents of Yig encounter set into the encounter deck.
Each investigator tests [willpower] (3). Each investigator who fails performs the following, in order:
- If you are poisoned, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
- If you are not poisoned, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.
all_card.real_flavor: Your expedition has ventured far into the rainforests of southern Mexico in search of a forgotten Aztec city-state. What will you find when you head deeper into the untamed jungle?
all_card.real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

all_card.back_flavor: 你发现自己陷入了无尽的循环之中，一遍又一遍，不断重复地走到丛林中的同一条道路上。不管你朝着哪个方向走，结果都一样。你已经走了不知道多少个小时，甚至可能已经走了好几天。与此同时，你能听到树木之间有蛇形的生物在发出嘶嘶声，从远处嘲笑你。你的干粮早已吃完，而且由于缺少睡眠而筋疲力竭，坐倒在地，靠着一棵半身腐烂的树。你的眼前逐渐模糊。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员被击败。每位未中毒的调查员将放在一边的一个中毒弱点加入自己的牌库。
all_card.flavor: 曾经使你兴奋的事物，现在令人生畏。这个地方远比你想象的更致命。仿佛丛林要你离开一般。
all_card.name: 入侵者
all_card.text: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You find yourself in an endless loop, traversing the same path through the jungle over and over again. No matter which direction you walk, the result is the same. It has been hours, perhaps even days. Meanwhile, you can hear the serpent creatures hissing in the trees, mocking you from afar. Out of food and exhausted from lack of sleep, you collapse against a half-rotted tree. Your vision becomes hazy.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator is defeated. Each investigator who is not poisoned adds a set-aside Poisoned weakness to his or her deck.
all_card.real_flavor: What was once excitement has turned to dread. This place is far deadlier than you could have imagined. It is as though the jungle itself wants you out.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

all_card.back_flavor:
在你探索这片茂密的丛林时，你面前突然出现几个土著居民。第一眼看上去，他们像是某个阿兹特克城邦的战士：可能正是你所寻找的那个城邦。但他们怎能存活这么久，且不被发现？
即便是对照着亚历山卓的笔记，你也很难翻译出这些战士们所说的话，只听懂了他们将你叫作“入侵者”，请你马上离开丛林。你试图解释你在寻找“埃兹特里”，他们一听这话窃窃私语，纷纷议论。最后，他们之中的一人以基础的西班牙语对你说道：“伊塔卡知道怎么处置你，入侵者。”他吹响一支纹样精致的黏土陶笛，发出一声尖锐的响声，回声在整个丛林中回荡。战士突然退去，与他们到来时一样突然。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的伊塔卡敌人放置入场，位于调查员队长所在地点。
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 这天，你为了找到亚历山卓找寻的遗迹而离开了营地。前提是那些遗迹曾经存在过……
all_card.name: 探索丛林
all_card.text: 目标 - 在一轮结束时，位于任何非[[营地]]地点的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
As you explore the dense jungle, you are suddenly confronted by several natives. At first glance, they appear to be warriors of an Aztec city-state: perhaps even the one you seek. But how could they have survived undiscovered for this long?
Even with Alejandro's notes, you are barely able to translate what the warriors say, only that they call you "intruder" and implore you to leave the jungle at once. You try to explain that you are searching for the "Eztli," which causes them to murmur and debate among themselves. Finally, one of them speaks to you in rudimentary Spanish. "Ichtaca will know what to do with you, intruder." He blows on a decorated clay ocarina, producing a shrill note that echoes throughout the jungle. The warriors depart as suddenly as they arrived.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put the set-aside Ichtaca enemy into play at the lead investigator's location.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: Today, you depart from your camp in order to find the ruins Alejandro seeks. That is, if they even exist…
all_card.real_text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators at any non-[[Campsite]] locations may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果伊塔卡上有1[per_investigator]线索：
“有趣。你不是为了流血来的。”伊塔卡语气略带惊讶，她完美的英语发音把你惊呆了。
记住“伊塔卡在带路”。在混乱袋里加入1个[cultist]标记，直到剧本结束。 将放在一边的3个[[遗迹]]地点洗入探索牌库，并推进到场景3a——“搜索遗迹”。
如果你击败了伊塔卡：
“蠢货！”伊塔卡痛苦地朝你吼道，“你不知道自己干涉的是何方势力。如果真的想找死，神庙就在河流南边，走吧。”
记住“你与伊塔卡发生了冲突”。选择一位调查员控制放在一边的亚历山卓·维拉支援。在混乱袋里加入1个[tablet]标记，直到剧本结束。 将放在一边的3个[[遗迹]]地点洗入探索牌库，并推进到场景3a——“守备森严的遗迹”。
all_card.flavor: “我不相信他们，”亚历山卓在土著居民们走开后立即说道，“他们是想置咱们于死地，而不是帮咱们。如果你觉得这位‘伊塔卡’会帮咱们找到遗迹，悉随尊便。但我是不会跟着她走的。”听得出他的不安与困惑。你可以试着与伊塔卡交谈，或者听亚历山卓的，自行寻找遗迹。
all_card.name: 埃兹特里的女猎手
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果伊塔卡被击败，推进场景。 目标 - 如果伊塔卡上有1[per_investigator]线索，将她放到胜利区并推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If Ichtaca has 1 [per_investigator] clues on her:
"Interesting. You are not simply here to shed blood," Ichtaca says with a spark of wonder in her voice, and you are stunned to hear her speaking in perfect English.
Remember that "Ichtaca is leading the way." Add 1 [cultist] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign. Shuffle the 3 set-aside [[Ruins]] locations into the exploration deck and advance to Act 3 - "Search for the Ruins."
If you defeated Ichtaca:
"Fools!" Ichtaca shouts to you with a pained voice. "You do not understand the forces you are meddling with. If you truly wish to die, you will find the temple over the river to the south."
Remember that "you fought with Ichtaca." Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Alejandro Vela asset. Add 1 [tablet] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign. Shuffle the 3 set-aside [[Ruins]] locations into the exploration deck and advance to Act 3a - "The Guarded Ruins."
all_card.real_flavor: "I don't trust them," Alejandro says as soon as the natives are out of earshot. "They mean to kill us, not aid us. If you think this 'Ichtaca' is going to help us find the ruins, be my guest. But I refuse to follow where she leads." You can feel the discomfort and confusion in Alejandro's voice. You can attempt to speak with Ichtaca, or you can take Alejandro's advice and fight your way to the ruins you seek.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If Ichtaca is defeated, advance. Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Ichtaca, place her in the victory display and advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你的发现超乎你最大胆的猜想。不论这些遗迹被认为存在于哪个时代，它们看起来保存得不错。建筑风格的多个方面体现出古怪的未来主义。你立即着手调查。
all_card.flavor: “既然我没法劝服你，那就走吧。跟着我，我会带你到你要找的地方去。但我丑话说在前面：惊扰遗迹，后果自负。那些遗迹至今没有被人发现，自有它的原因。”在伊塔卡为你引路时，亚历山卓小心翼翼地与她保持安全距离。
all_card.name: 搜索遗迹
all_card.text: 每个埃兹特里的守卫者敌人不能攻击，也不能被攻击。忽略每个林中暗箭诡计的效果。 目标 - 只有在埃兹特里的遗迹的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: What you have found is beyond your wildest expectations. Despite their supposed age, the ruins appear preserved in time. Several aspects of the architecture are strangely futuristic. You set out to investigate at once.
all_card.real_flavor: "If I cannot dissuade you, so be it. Follow me, and I will lead you to the place you seek. But heed my warning: Disturb the ruins at your own risk. They have remained hidden for a reason." Alejandro warily keeps a safe distance from Ichtaca as she shows you the way.
all_card.real_text: Each Eztli Guardian enemy cannot attack or be attacked. Ignore the effects of each Arrows from the Trees treachery. Objective - Only investigators at the Ruins of Eztli can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你的发现超乎你最大胆的猜想。不论这些遗迹被认为存在于哪个时代，它们看起来保存得不错。建筑风格的多个方面体现出古怪的未来主义。你立即着手调查。
all_card.flavor: 伊塔卡迅速撤退，亚历山卓将一双手搭在你的肩上。“谢谢你听从了我的建议。”他松了口气说道，“现在她走了，从现在开始我来带路。我知道她说的那条河。来吧，跟上我！”
all_card.name: 守备森严的遗迹
all_card.text: 每个埃兹特里的守卫者敌人得到+1攻击值和+1躲避值。每个林中暗箭诡计获得涌动。 目标 - 只有在埃兹特里的遗迹的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: What you have found is beyond your wildest expectations. Despite their supposed age, the ruins appear preserved in time. Several aspects of the architecture are strangely futuristic. You set out to investigate at once.
all_card.real_flavor: Ichtaca swiftly retreats, and Alejandro places a hand on your shoulder. "Thank you for taking my advice," he says, relieved. "Now that she's gone, I'll take point from now on. I know the river she speaks of. Come, follow me!"
all_card.real_text: Each Eztli Guardian enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Each Arrows from the Trees treachery gains surge. Objective - Only investigators at the Ruins of Eztli can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 营地里议论着惊险与可怖的话题。探险队的一些成员多搭了几个帆布帐篷来存放补给品，而其他人则挤成一团，围在一张描绘森林北边的未完成的地图旁。
all_card.flavor: 探险队占下了这片丛林，但是丛林似乎对此并不乐意。
all_card.name: 探险营地
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。荒野实在太危险了！ [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有地图，查看探索牌库顶的3张卡牌。按任意顺序将其中1张放在牌库底，其余2张放在牌库顶。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The camp is abuzz with both excitement and dread. Some members of the expedition are setting up additional canvas tents for supplies, while others are huddled around an incomplete map of the northern edge of the rainforest.
all_card.real_flavor: The expedition has staked its claim on the jungle, and the jungle doesn't seem too happy about it.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. The wilds are too dangerous! [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a map, look at the top 3 cards of the exploration deck. Place 1 on the bottom and the other 2 on top, in any order.

all_card.name: 亚历山卓·维拉
all_card.text:
你调查[[古代]]地点时得到+1技能值。
[action]如果你位于[[古代]]地点，横置亚历山卓·维拉：抽取2张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 skill value while investigating an [[Ancient]] location.
[action] If you are at an [[Ancient]] location, exhaust Alejandro Vela: Draw 2 cards.

all_card.name: 伊塔卡
all_card.text: 警戒。反击。 [action]：谈判。检定[intellect](4)来说服伊塔卡，你不是她的敌人。如果你检定成功，在伊塔卡上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。如果你检定失败，且伊塔卡处于重整状态，她攻击你。
all_card.traits: 类人. 埃茲特里. 精英
all_card.real_text: Alert. Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4) to convince Ichtaca you are not her enemy. If you succeed, place 1 clue on her. If you fail and Ichtaca is ready, she attacks you.

all_card.flavor: 环绕着中央庙宇的石灰岩上雕有蛇形雕像，远远地向你投来恶毒的视线。
all_card.name: 埃兹特里的遗迹
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你调查埃兹特里的遗迹时，技能检定失败后：抽取遭遇牌库顶一张卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: Serpent statues carved from limestone surround the central temple, glaring at you ominously from afar.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Ruins of Eztli: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-2(如果你所在地点有毁灭标记，改为-4)。
[cultist] [tablet]：-X。X为场上所有地点上的毁灭标记总数。
[elder_thing]：揭示另一个混乱标记。在你所在地点放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.name: 埃兹特里的覆灭
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-1(如果你所在地点有毁灭标记，改为-3)。
[cultist] [tablet]：-X。X为带有毁灭标记的地点数量。
[elder_thing]：揭示另一个混乱标记。如果你检定失败，在你所在地点放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if there is doom on your location).
[cultist] [tablet]: -X. X is the total amount of doom on locations in play.
[elder_thing]: Reveal another chaos token. Place 1 doom on your location.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if there is doom on your location).
[cultist] [tablet]: -X. X is the number of locations with doom on them.
[elder_thing]: Reveal another chaos token. If you fail, place 1 doom on your location.

all_card.back_flavor: 就在那时，一阵声音在神庙的墙上击打回荡，像是发电机一般的沉闷嗡嗡声。墙壁和天花板上的凹槽一闪一闪，开始发光。神庙仿佛有着生命，能够感知你的存在。你眼前的古怪雕像和雕刻，加上暗淡的光芒和墙壁流通的能量，都清楚地显示出这座神庙的起源不是阿兹特克。实际上，它似乎源自更遥远、更古老的文明。你感觉自己就像是闯入了一个无法理解的世界中。你最坏的预想应验了，一声响亮的嘶嘶声响起，在整座神庙激起了咯咯作响的回声。不管你吵醒的是何方神圣，它并不乐于见到你。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的瓦卢西亚的预示者生成在场上毁灭标记最多的地点。
all_card.flavor: 你不顾伊塔卡的警告，进入神庙遗迹寻求古代知识和遗物。
all_card.name: 暗起波澜
all_card.text: *本密谋得到+1[per_investigator]毁灭阀值。 强制 - 在本密谋推进时：不要从场上任何地点移除毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Just then, a sound thrums in the walls of the temple, a dull humming similar to that of a generator. Grooves in the walls and the ceiling flicker and start to glow. It is as though the temple is alive, and it senses your presence. The strange statues and carvings you've seen, coupled with the dim glow and the power coursing through the walls, makes it clear that this temple isn't Aztec in origin. In fact, it appears to be from an even older, more ancient civilization altogether. You feel as though you are an intruder in a world you cannot begin to understand. Confirming your worst fears, a loud hiss and rattling echoes throughout the temple. Whatever you just woke up, it's not happy to see you.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Harbinger of Valusia at the location with the most doom.
all_card.real_flavor: Despite Ichtaca's warnings, you've entered the ruins of the temple in search of ancient knowledge and artifacts.
all_card.real_text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from each location in play.

all_card.back_flavor: 这座造迹饱合着怒火呻吟、晃动。你在这儿不受欢迎。墙壁和天花板无规律地变换，将通道紧紧封锁，想要阻止你逃跑。石块上的凹槽现在发出了振动的红光。一阵恶毒的嗽嘶声在神庙里紧跟着你。你逐渐意识到，你没法活着逃出这个地方……
all_card.back_text: 每位没有撤退的调查员被击败。
all_card.flavor: 蛇形生物以惊人的高速从阴影中蹿出，向你袭来。它身上带有镀金羽毛的装饰，装备着一根金制长矛，锋利的刀尖并未被时间所磨损。当它在遗迹里追捕你时，它的尾巴引起了巨大的噪声。
all_card.name: 神庙看守者
all_card.text: *本密谋得到+1[per_investigator]毁灭阀值。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The ruins groan and shake with anger. You are not wanted here. The walls and ceiling shift erratically, blocking off corridors and attempting to prevent your escape. Grooves in the stone are now glowing a vibrant red hue. A sinister hiss follows you throughout the temple. The realization dawns on you that you are not making it out of this place alive…
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated.
all_card.real_flavor: The serpent creature emerges from the shadows with terrifying speed. It is bedecked in ornate gold feathers, and it wields a golden spear, the blade tip unravaged by time. The rattle at the end of the creature's tail produces a tremendous noise as the creature hunts you throughout the ruins.
all_card.real_text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold.

all_card.back_flavor: 遗迹远比亚历山卓预想的更为宽阔。墙壁上的纹饰和刻在石台上的象形文字显示，地下存在一个中央石室。可能有秘密通道能够到那个石室去——这座神庙遗迹的中心地带。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的时间石室地点洗入探索牌库。
当你经过带有古代雕文的墙壁时，遗迹发出嘎吱嘎吱的声音，以示反抗，雕刻也开始发光，预示不吉。这些雕文在多年的侵蚀之下图形已渐渐消退，周围的石块渗出了浓稠的粘液。如果你有某些方法能够保存这些雕文………
检查你们的补给品。如果有任何调查员带有粉笔，将本场景从游戏中移除。否则，将本场景放到胜利区。本场景获得复仇1。
all_card.flavor: 当你在丛林里经历了地狱般的旅程后，神庙遗迹的寂静与隔绝在你心里埋下了妄想症的种子。蛇群的眼睛从黑暗中紧盯着你。每一滴水和每一颗掉落的鹅卵石都会扰乱你的思绪，让你四下回望，寻找是不是哪里会有危险……但真正危险的还在后头。
all_card.name: 进入遗迹
all_card.text: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The ruins are far more vast than even Alejandro had anticipated. Carvings in the walls and hieroglyphs etched into stone altars suggest the existence of a central chamber underground. Perhaps a hidden passageway will show you the way to this chamber - the very heart of the temple ruins.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the set-aside Chamber of Time location into the exploration deck.
As you pass the strange glyphs in the walls, the ruins groan and creak in protest, and the carvings glow ominously. Years of deterioration have faded the pattern of these glyphs, and the surrounding stones seep with a venomous pus. If only you had some way to restore these glyphs…
Check your supplies. If any investigator has chalk, remove this act from the game. Otherwise, place this act in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 1.
all_card.real_flavor: After your hellish journey through the jungle, the quiet solitude of the temple ruins sows paranoia in your mind. Serpent eyes glare at you from the darkness. Every drop of water and fallen pebble causes you to whirl about in search of danger… But the real danger is yet to come.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

all_card.back_flavor: 这件遗物在你的手中搏动着，它内部的能量发出嗡嗡的低鸣。从这件设备中漏出的能量流进了遗迹内的廊道中，神庙的构造骤然生变。
all_card.back_text: 选择位于时间石室的一位调查员控制古代遗物。 移动所有地点的摆放位置，摆成一条直线，时间石室在左端，遗迹入口在右端。其他所有地点从左到右摆放在这两个地点之间，按照每个地点上的毁灭标记数从低到高进行排序(如有多个地点的毁灭标记数相等，可以自行决定顺序)。 直到冒险结束，忽略所有地点之间的连接，改为每个地点与其左边和右边的地点互相连接.
all_card.flavor: 不论中央石室里有些什么，那必定至关重要；它的所在被人精心掩盖。
all_card.name: 科学与魔法
all_card.text: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。 目标 - 只有在时间石室的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The relic hums with power and throbs in your hands. Energy from the device seeps into the corridors of the ruins, and the structure of the temple shifts.
all_card.real_back_text: Choose an investigator in the Chamber of Time to take control of the Relic of Ages. Move the placement of each location to form a straight line, with the Chamber of Time on the left and the Entryway on the right. Each other location is placed from left to right in between these two locations, in order of how much doom is on them, from lowest to highest (in the event of a tie, you may decide the order). Until the end of the scenario, ignore all location connections. Instead, each location is connected to each location to its left and right.
all_card.real_flavor: Whatever is inside this central chamber must be very important; much care was taken to obscure its location.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Only investigators in the Chamber of Time may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 当你跨过遗迹入口的门槛时，在神庙里的某些事物开始改变……
all_card.back_text:
如果控制古代遗物的调查员撤退：
神庙的地面停止震动，墙壁沉闷的嗡嗡声也停了下来。遗物离开原来的石室后，遗迹似乎再次陷入了沉睡。你还是不知道这到底是什么东西，也不知道它的用途可能是什么，但你不敢继续在此逗留，没工夫搞明白这一切。
(→结局1)
否则：
片刻后，神庙继续剧烈地晃动，建筑的结构开始异常地旋转、扭曲。令人心安的是，神庙的整个结构再次组合在一起，然后再次陷入沉睡。
(→结局3)
all_card.flavor: 这座遗迹伴随着猛烈的力量震动不已。你害怕要是继续震动下去，建筑的结构会塌落。你得带着遗物逃出这座遗迹！
all_card.name: 逃出遗迹
all_card.text: 胜利区内有至少3点复仇点数时，每个[[蛇族]]敌人得到+1躲避值。 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As soon as you cross the threshold of the entryway, something inside the temple begins to change…
all_card.real_back_text:
If an investigator resigned with the Relic of Ages under his or her control:
The floor of the temple stops shaking, and the dull humming in the walls goes quiet. Without the relic in its chamber, the ruins appear to be sleeping once more. You still have no idea what the object is or what its purpose may be, but you dare not tarry any longer to find out.
(→R1)
Otherwise:
For a moment, the temple continues to shudder, the architecture twisting and contorting strangely. Pleased that it is once again whole, the temple then returns to its dormant state.
(→R3)
all_card.real_flavor: The ruins are shuddering with a tremendous power. You fear that the structure may collapse if this keeps up. You have to escape with the relic!
all_card.real_text: While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, each [[Serpent]] enemy gets +1 evade. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 日落余晖洒在神庙遗迹，所有石块都沐浴在温暖的光辉下。当你踏入漆有颜色的遗迹入口时，丛林的种种声音离你远去。在遗迹入口里，诸多厅室淹没在漆黑之中。
all_card.flavor: 数百年之前，这座神庙或许就是一座美丽而受人敬畏的精神圣殿，坐落在这片危机四伏的丛林中。
all_card.name: 遗迹入口
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你暂时……逃出来了。 [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有火把，查看探索牌库顶的2张卡牌。弃掉每张以此效果查看到的诡计卡牌。混洗探索牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The sun sets over the temple ruins, bathing the stone in warm light. The sounds of the rainforest are distant by the time you cross underneath the painted entryway. Inside, the halls are plunged into darkness.
all_card.real_flavor: Many hundreds of years ago, this temple might have been a bastion of beauty and reverence in this perilous jungle.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You've escaped… for now. [action]: Check your supplies. If you have torches, look at the top 2 cards of the exploration deck. Discard each treachery looked at by this effect. Shuffle the exploration deck.

all_card.flavor: 你不知道它是什么，也不知道它从前作什么用途。但或许随着时间推移，你就能发现它真正的用途。
all_card.name: 古代遗物
all_card.real_flavor: You have no idea what it is or what it might have been used for. But perhaps with time, you could discover its true purpose.

all_card.name: 瓦卢西亚的预示者
all_card.text: 警戒。猎手。反击。 瓦卢西亚的预示者处于横置状态时能反击。 强制 - 成功攻击或躲避瓦卢西亚的预示者后：在该卡牌上放置1资源。然后，如果该卡牌上有2[per_investigator]资源，瓦卢西亚的预示者发出奸险的嘶嘶声并遁去身影。(将该卡牌放在一边，位于场外。该卡牌保留所有伤害标记。)
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 蛇族. 精英
all_card.real_text: Alert. Hunter. Retaliate. Harbinger of Valusia can retaliate while exhausted. Forced - After Harbinger of Valusia is successfully attacked or evaded: Place 1 resource on it. Then, if there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on it, it vanishes with a sinister hiss. (Set it aside, out of play. It keeps all damage tokens.)

all_card.flavor: 一座厅堂出现在你面前，砌筑这座厅堂的石块已摇摇欲坠，你是否还有勇气进入遗迹深处探险？
all_card.name: 古代石厅
all_card.text: 强制 - 当一轮结束时：将古代石厅上的1个线索翻至毁灭标记面。位于古代石厅的任何一位调查员可以花费3资源来取消此效果。
all_card.real_flavor: A hall of crumbling stone looms before you, daring you to venture deeper into the ruins.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the round: Flip 1 of the clues on Ancient Hall to its doom side. Any investigator at Ancient Hall may spend 3 resources to cancel this effect.

all_card.flavor: 在这个石室中央躺着一座华丽的高台，上面布满手工雕环的精细的象形文字。这或许是一处古代的集会或仪式场所？
all_card.name: 华美石室
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你调查华美石室时，如果你检定失败，或成功但没有超过难度至少2点：在结算本次技能检定的其他任何效果之前，将华美石室的1个线索翻至毁灭标记面。
all_card.real_flavor: The ornate dais in the center of this chamber is covered in detailed hand-carved hieroglyphs. A site for ancient gatherings or rituals, perhaps?
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you investigate Grand Chamber and do not succeed by at least 2: Before resolving any other effects from this skill test, flip 1 of the clues on Grand Chamber to its doom side.

all_card.flavor: 骨灰瓮和破碎的尸骨躺在灰尘和沙土上，布满整个墓坑。腐烂的恶臭早已消散，此处只有渗着陈腐气味的灰尘，令人室息。
all_card.name: 坑葬墓室
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你探索成功并将坑葬墓室放置入场后：你必须从遭遇牌库顶抽取2张卡牌，或者在坑葬墓室上放置2个毁灭标记，或以任何方式组合上述两项，总数为2。
all_card.real_flavor: Urns and broken bones fill this pit of ash and sand. The stench of rot has long since dissipated, leaving behind only stale‑smelling air saturated with choking dust.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you put Burial Pit into play by exploring successfully: You must either draw 2 cards from the top of the encounter deck or place 2 doom on Burial Pit, or any combination thereof.

all_card.name: 地下遗迹
all_card.text: 有敌人在地下遗迹中时，将地下遗迹视为在胜利区中(以计入复仇点数)。 强制 - 在地下遗迹中的敌人离场后：在地下遗迹上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: While there is an enemy in Underground Ruins, Underground Ruins is considered to be in the victory display (for the purposes of counting vengeance). Forced - After an enemy in Underground Ruins leaves play: Place 1 doom on Underground Ruins.

all_card.flavor: 在这条漆黑的通道上，一块巨石挡住前路。当你迈过通道入口时，这条通道通向下方一个开阔的地下坑室……
all_card.name: 秘密通道
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你进入秘密通道后：你必须受到1点恐惧和1点伤害，或在秘密通道上放置1个毁灭标记。检查你们的补给品。如果你或一位在秘密通道的调查员带有绳索，忽略此效果。
all_card.real_flavor: A boulder obscured the route to this dark passageway. As soon as you step through the doorway, it opens into a vast underground pit below…
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Secret Passage: You must either take 1 horror and 1 damage, or place 1 doom on Secret Passage. Check your supplies. If you or an investigator at Secret Passage has a rope, ignore this effect.

all_card.flavor: 这个石室中央的地面雕刻着精细纹路，发出诡异的光芒……
all_card.name: 时间石室
all_card.text: 强制 - 在时间石室入场后：将放在一边的古代遗物支援附属到时间石室上。在时间石室上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_flavor: The floor of this central chamber is intricately carved and glows strangely…
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Chamber of Time enters play: Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages asset to the Chamber of Time. Place 1 doom on Chamber of Time.

all_card.name: 荆棘之路
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你调查荆棘之路时，技能检定失败后：受到1点伤害。 强制 - 在你在荆棘之路探索失败后：受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Path of Thorns: Take 1 damage. Forced - After you explore while at Path of Thorns, if the exploration was not successful: Take 1 damage.

all_card.flavor: 河水远比看起来的要深。水面上的涟漪掩盖了藏身在水下的生物。水从瀑布上方流入河中，形成一股强劲而稳定的水流。
all_card.name: 河流峡谷
all_card.text: [action]：治愈河流峡谷一位调查员1点伤害。检查你的补给品。如果你带有水壶，治愈额外2点伤害。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: The river is deeper than it appears. Ripples along its surface obscure the creatures that lie within. Water cascades into the river from above, causing a strong, steady current.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Heal 1 damage from an investigator at River Canyon. Check your supplies. If you have a canteen, heal 2 additional damage. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 索桥
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你位于索桥并尝试探索时：检定[agility](2)。如果你检定失败，取消本次探索，受到2点伤害，失去所有剩余行动并结束你的回合。将你的调查员放在河流峡谷(如果该地点不在场上，先查找探索牌库，找出河流峡谷并将它放置入场；混洗探索牌库)。
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you attempt to explore while at Rope Bridge: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, cancel the exploration, take 2 damage, lose all remaining actions, and end your turn. Place your investigator in the River Canyon (if it is not in play, search the exploration deck for River Canyon and put it into play first; shuffle the exploration deck).

all_card.name: 万蛇据点
all_card.text: 万蛇据点的每个[[蛇族]]敌人得到+1攻击值。 强制 - 在你在万蛇据点调查或探索后，如果你已中毒：受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Each [[Serpent]] enemy at Serpent's Haven gets +1 fight. Forced - After you investigate or explore while at Serpent's Haven, if you are poisoned: Take 1 damage.

all_card.flavor: 你之前不是到过这儿吗？
all_card.name: 曲折小道
all_card.text: 作为你在曲折小道调查或探索的额外费用，检查你们的补给品。如果你所在地点没有调查员带有指南针，你必须花费3资源。
all_card.real_flavor: Haven't you been here before?
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost for you to investigate or explore while at Circuitous Trail, check your supplies. If no investigator at your location has a compass, you must spend 3 resources.

all_card.flavor: 林冠之上矗立着苍白的石块筑成的、年代久远的阶梯式金字塔。一阵嘶嘶的声音像暴雨般落在你周围。
all_card.name: 毒牙神庙
all_card.text: 胜利区每有一点复仇点数，毒牙神庙隐藏值+1。
all_card.real_flavor: Rising just over the tree canopy is a timeworn step pyramid of pale stone. A storm of hisses surrounds you from the trees.
all_card.real_text: Temple of the Fang gets +1 shroud for each vengeance point in the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 繁茂成簇的植物遮挡了前往这个遗迹的道路。藤蔓的触须像是拼命要活下来一般，紧紧抓住金字塔的阶梯。
all_card.name: 杂草丛生的遗迹
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你进入杂草丛生的遗迹后，如果你已中毒：失去所有剩余行动并结束你的回合。
all_card.real_flavor: A dense thicket of flora obscures the route to these ruins. Tendrils of vine grip the pyramid steps as though holding on for dear life.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter this location, if you are poisoned: Lose all remaining actions and end your turn.

all_card.name: 疯狂生长
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限1张。 你不能在本卡牌附属的地点探索。 [action]：检定[combat](4)来从灌木丛中辟出道路，或检定[intellect](4)来另寻出路。如果你检定成功，弃掉疯狂生长。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. You cannot explore at attached location. [action]: Test [combat] (4) to hack through the brush or [intellect] (4) to find another route. If you succeed, discard Overgrowth.

all_card.name: 丛林之声
all_card.text: 显现 - 将丛林之声放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时，如果你本回合未探索成功：受到1点恐惧。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉丛林之声。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Voice of the Jungle into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you did not successfully explore this turn: Take 1 horror. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Voice of the Jungle.

all_card.flavor: 比它的外表更致命。
all_card.name: 蝮蛇
all_card.text: 强制 - 在蝮蛇的攻击对你造成伤害后：如果你未中毒，将放在一边的一张中毒弱点卡牌放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
all_card.real_flavor: Deadlier than it seems.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Pit Viper deals you damage from its attack: If you are not poisoned, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.

all_card.flavor: 遍布鳞片，十四英尺长的饿兽。
all_card.name: 蟒蛇
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在蟒蛇攻击你后：在下一个补给阶段期间，你处于横置状态的卡牌不能重整。
all_card.real_flavor: Fourteen feet of scaled hunger.
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - After Boa Constrictor attacks you: During the next upkeep phase, your exhausted cards cannot ready.

all_card.name: 毒蛇噬咬
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，你必须 (选择一项)： - 对你控制的一个[[盟友]]支援造成5点伤害。 - 受到1点直接伤害。如果你未中毒，将放在一边的一张中毒弱点卡牌放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you must either (choose one): - Deal 5 damage to an [[Ally]] asset you control. - Take 1 direct damage. If you are not poisoned, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.

all_card.name: 迷失荒野
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧，并将迷失荒野加入你的威胁区域。 你不能移动或探索。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：弃掉迷失荒野。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror for each point you fail by and add Lost in the Wilds to your threat area. You cannot move or explore. Forced - At the end of your turn: Discard Lost in the Wilds.

all_card.name: 补给短缺
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 每位调查员失去2资源。 - 每位调查员受到1点伤害。 - 每位调查员选择并弃掉自己控制的一个支援。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Each investigator loses 2 resources. - Each investigator takes 1 damage. - Each investigator chooses and discards an asset he or she controls.

all_card.flavor: 一种蛇形生物，双臂有鳞，携带着远古的护甲和武器。
all_card.name: 伊格之子
all_card.text:
猎手。
胜利区每有一点复仇点数，伊格之子得到+1攻击值。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 蛇族
all_card.real_flavor: A serpentine creature with scaled arms, bearing primitive armor and weaponry.
all_card.real_text:
Hunter.
Brood of Yig gets +1 fight for each vengeance point in the victory display.

all_card.name: 幽嘶蛇人
all_card.text:
胜利区内有至少1点复仇点数时，幽嘶蛇人获得反击。
胜利区内有至少2点复仇点数时，幽嘶蛇人获得猎手。
胜利区内有至少3点复仇点数时，幽嘶蛇人每次受到攻击时少受到1点伤害。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 蛇族
all_card.real_text:
While there are 1 or more vengeance points in the victory display, Serpent from Yoth gains retaliate.
While there are 2 or more vengeance points in the victory display, Serpent from Yoth gains hunter.
While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, Serpent from Yoth takes 1 less damage from each attack made against it.

all_card.name: 伊格的诅咒
all_card.text: 显现 - 将伊格的诅咒放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你得到-1[combat]，-1生命值，并获得[[蛇族]]特性。 [action]：检定[willpower](2)。胜利区每有一点复仇点数，本次检定难度+1。如果你检定成功，弃掉伊格的诅咒。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Curse of Yig into play in your threat area. You get -1 [combat], -1 health, and gain the [[Serpent]] trait. [action]: Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each vengeance point in the victory display. If you succeed, discard Curse of Yig.

all_card.flavor: 必须保守住这个秘密。
all_card.name: 埃兹特里的守卫者
all_card.text: 生成 - 任意无人地点(如可能，生成在[[古代]]地点)。 警戒。冷漠。 强制 - 在敌军阶段期间，敌人攻击时，如果埃兹特里的守卫者处于重整状态且未处于交战状态：其攻击每个连接地点的每位调查员。
all_card.real_flavor: The secret must be kept.
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Any empty location ([[Ancient]], if able). Alert. Aloof. Forced - When enemies attack during the enemy phase, if Eztli Guardian is ready and unengaged: It attacks each investigator in each connecting location.

all_card.flavor: 看不见的行凶者齐齐射出黑曜石箭尖的箭枝，弓箭射中了你，这是一个可怕的警告，要让你们马上离开此地。
all_card.name: 林中暗箭
all_card.text: 显现 -受到1点伤害，你每控制一个盟友支援，受到额外1点伤害。在[[古代]]地点上的其他每位调查员也必须结算此效果。
all_card.real_flavor: You are caught in a volley of obsidian-tipped arrows fired by unseen assailants, a dire warning to leave this place at once.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Take 1 damage, plus 1 additional damage for each [[Ally]] asset you control. Each other investigator at an [[Ancient]] location must also resolve that effect.

all_card.flavor: 我们有勇气追随他的足迹吗？
all_card.name: 致命错误
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](2)。你所在地点每有一个毁灭标记，本次检定难度+1。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: Do we dare follow in his footsteps?
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each doom on your location. If you fail, take 2 damage.

all_card.name: 半身入土
all_card.text: 显现 - 将半身入土放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你不能与敌人解除交战，也不能移动。 [action]：检定[agility](4)来逃出墓穴，或者检定[combat](4)来挣脱束缚。如果你检定成功，弃掉半身入土。如果你检定失败，本次检定的难度降低1点，直到一轮结束。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Entombed into play in your threat area. You cannot disengage from enemies or move. [action]: Test [agility] (4) to escape the tomb or [combat] (4) to break out. If you succeed, discard Entombed. If you fail, reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 until the end of the round.

all_card.flavor: “我们曾将时间设想成一条直线，在点到点之间流动。实际与设想的相差甚远。”
all_card.name: 时间裂缝
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你失败且每低于难度1点，必须失去1个行动或受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: "We've been conceptualizing time as if it were a straight line, moving forward from one point to the next. The truth is quite different."
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 action or take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 困于时间
all_card.text: 显现 - 将一张你控制的非剧情的支援卡牌洗回你的牌库，将该支援卡牌上的所有伤害和恐惧移动到你的调查员上。如果没有支援卡牌通过本效果洗入牌库，则选择并弃掉你3张手牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Shuffle a non-story asset you control into your deck, moving all damage and horror from that asset to your investigator. If no asset is shuffled into your deck by this effect, choose and discard 3 cards from your hand.

all_card.flavor: 那不是自然死亡。
all_card.name: 不祥之兆
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 选择一个至少有1位调查员的地点。在该地点上放置1个毁灭标记。所选地点的每位调查员受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: It was not a natural death.
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Choose a location where there is at least 1 investigator. Place 1 doom on that location. Each investigator at the chosen location takes 1 horror.

all_card.name: 先祖恐惧
all_card.text: 险境。涌动。 显现 - 你必须 (选择以下一项)： - 在你所在地点放置1个毁灭标记并弃掉先祖恐惧 (而不是将它放到胜利区)。 - 将先祖恐惧放到胜利区。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Surge. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Place 1 doom on your location and discard Ancestral Fear (instead of placing it in the victory display). - Place Ancestral Fear in the victory display.

all_card.name: 一片漆黑
all_card.text: 显现 - 将一片漆黑放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 每位调查员每轮不能从单个地点发现超过1个线索。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从场上弃掉1张一片漆黑。(每轮最多一次。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Deep Dark into play next to the agenda deck. No more than 1 clue may be discovered from each location by each investigator each round. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Deep Dark from play. (Max once per round.)

all_card.name: 兄弟会异教徒
all_card.text: 猎手。 兄弟会异教徒上每有一个毁灭标记，其得到+1攻击值和+1躲避值。 强制 - 在你对兄弟会异教徒发动一次攻击时：在兄弟会异教徒上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Brotherhood Cultist gets +1 fight and +1 evade for each doom on it. Forced - When you initiate an attack against Brotherhood Cultist: Place 1 doom on Brotherhood Cultist.

all_card.name: 阴影笼罩
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果场上没有[[异教徒]]敌人，受到1点恐惧，且阴影笼罩获得涌动。否则，找到离你最近的[[异教徒]]敌人。在该敌人上放置1个毁灭标记并检定[willpower](X)，其中X等于该敌人的攻击值。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, take 1 horror and Shadowed gains surge. Otherwise, find the [[Cultist]] enemy nearest to you. Place 1 doom on that enemy and test [willpower] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you fail, take 2 horror.

all_card.name: 力量真言
all_card.text: 显现 - 将力量真言放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 如果你所在地点有1个或更多带有毁灭标记的敌人，你不能对这些敌人造成伤害或发现你所在地的线索。 [action][action]：弃掉力量真言。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Words of Power into play in your threat area. If there are 1 or more enemies at your location with doom on them, you cannot damage those enemies or discover clues at your location. [action][action]: Discard Words of Power.

all_card.name: 伊格的獠牙
all_card.text: 猎物 - 中毒的调查员。 反击。 伊格的獠牙与中毒的调查员交战时，该调查员不能打出卡牌，也不能在技能检定中投入卡牌。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 蛇族
all_card.real_text: Prey - Poisoned investigator. Retaliate. While Fang of Yig is engaged with a poisoned investigator, that investigator cannot play cards or commit cards to skill tests.

all_card.name: 毒蛇灾厄
all_card.text: 显现 - 将毒蛇灾厄放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。如果你已中毒，毒蛇灾厄获得涌动。 将你的每个非弱点[[道具]]支援的文本框(除[[特性]]外)视为空白。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：弃掉毒蛇灾厄。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Snakescourge into play in your threat area. If you are poisoned, Snakescourge gains surge. Treat each of your non-weakness [[Item]] assets as if its text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]). Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Snakescourge.

all_card.name: 毒蛇召来
all_card.text: 显现 - 你必须(选择以下一项)：将放在一边的一张中毒弱点卡牌放置入场，放到你的威胁区域，或抽取遭遇牌库顶2张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - You must either (choose one): Put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area, or draw the top 2 cards of the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: 乌黑的血管在她的皮肤之下，伴随着心跳搏动着。她的时间不多了。
all_card.name: 毒性蔓延
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 - 中毒的每位调查员受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: Black veins crawled underneath her skin, pulsating with every heartbeat. It would not be long now.
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Each investigator who is poisoned takes 1 damage.

all_card.name: 中毒
all_card.text: 每位调查员仅限1张。每套牌库仅限1张。 永久。 你中毒了。(这张卡牌本身没有效果。你已中毒时，其他卡牌效果可能改变或增强。)
all_card.real_text: Limit 1 per investigator. Limit 1 per deck. Permanent. You are poisoned. (This has no game effect on its own. Other card effects may change or become stronger while you are poisoned.)

all_card.name: 犯罪现场
all_card.text:
只能作为你的第一个行动打出。
发现你所在地点的1个线索(如果该地点有敌人，改为发现2个线索)。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
all_card.real_text:
Play only as your first action.
Discover 1 clue at your location (2 clues instead if there is an enemy at that location). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

all_card.name: 枪法如神
all_card.text: 快速。在你激活[[枪械]]或[[远程]]支援上的攻击能力时打出。 本次攻击可以选择一个连接地点上的一个敌人作为目标。本次攻击忽略冷漠和反击关键词。如果本次攻击的敌人未与你交战，且你攻击成功，本次攻击造成+1伤害。
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play when you activate the Fight ability on a [[Firearm]] or [[Ranged]] asset. This attack can target an enemy at a connecting location. Ignore the aloof and retaliate keywords for this attack. If this attack succeeds against an enemy not engaged with you, the attack deals +1 damage.

all_card.name: 劝服
all_card.text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个非弱点[[类人]]敌人并检定[intellect](3)。本次检定得到+X难度，X等于该敌人的恐惧值。如果你检定成功，将所选敌人洗入遭遇牌库。如果所选敌人为[[精英]]，改为自动躲避它。
all_card.real_text: Parley. Choose a non-weakness [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location and test [intellect] (3). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is that enemy's horror value. If you succeed, shuffle the chosen enemy into the encounter deck. If the chosen enemy is [[Elite]], automatically evade it instead.

all_card.name: 老练分析
all_card.text: 永久。每套牌库仅限1张。 每当你升级带有(未鉴定)或(未翻译)副标题的卡牌时，你可以多升级一张同名卡牌，无需花费经验值。如果你这么做，从符合条件的选项中随机选择该卡牌的两张升级版本。(你仍需满足所有的牌库构建限制。)
all_card.real_text: Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Anytime you upgrade a card with the (Unidentified) or (Untranslated) subtitle, you may upgrade a second copy of that card at no experience cost. If you do, the two upgraded versions are chosen at random from among the eligible options. (You must still meet all deckbuilding restrictions.)

all_card.flavor: “其实没那么幸运，只是想抽根烟。”
all_card.name: 幸运烟盒
all_card.text: [reaction]你在一次技能检定中成功且超过难度2点或更多后，横置幸运烟盒：抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: "It’s not really all that lucky. Just in the mood for a smoke."
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more, exhaust Lucky Cigarette Case: Draw 1 card.

all_card.flavor: “别担心，我认识一个人。”<cite>——里奥·德·卢卡</cite>
all_card.name: 销赃贩子
all_card.text: [reaction]你在你的回合期间打出[[违法]]卡牌时，横置销赃贩子：该[[违法]]卡牌获得快速。如果该卡牌已有快速，改为降低其费用1点。
all_card.real_flavor: "Don’t worry. I know a guy." - Leo De Luca
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you play an [[Illicit]] card during your turn, exhaust Fence: The [[Illicit]] card gains fast. If it was already fast, reduce its cost by 1 instead.

all_card.name: 奥术研究
all_card.text:
永久。
在你购买奥术研究时，承受1点精神创伤。
在一个剧本的每个冒险结束后，在下一场冒险之前，你升级的第一张[[法术]]卡牌经验值费用减1。
all_card.real_text:
Permanent.
When you purchase Arcane Research, suffer 1 mental trauma.
After each scenario of a campaign, reduce the experience cost of the first [[Spell]] card you upgrade before the next scenario by 1.

all_card.flavor: “有我在，不用担心。”
all_card.name: 反击法术
all_card.text: 快速。在你所在地点的技能检定期间揭示[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]混乱标记时打出。 取消该混乱标记。(不揭示新的混乱标记以替换。)
all_card.real_flavor: "Not on my watch."
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play when a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] chaos token is revealed during a skill test at your location. Cancel that chaos token. (Do not reveal a new chaos token to replace it.)

all_card.flavor: 她只需要一双长满茧子的手，还有一颗坚定的心。
all_card.name: 坚韧不拔
all_card.text:
快速。在你将被分配伤害和/或恐惧，且其数值足够击败你时打出。
取消该伤害和/或恐惧中的最多4点。
all_card.real_flavor: Calloused hands and a determined heart were all she needed.
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when you are assigned damage and/or horror that would defeat you.
Cancel up to 4 of that damage and/or horror.

all_card.flavor: 砰。
all_card.name: 晕眩重击
all_card.text: 如果攻击期间本次技能检定成功，自动躲避被攻击敌人。
all_card.real_flavor: Thud.
all_card.real_text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, automatically evade the attacked enemy.

all_card.back_text:
困难 /专家
[skull]：-X。X为场上的毁灭标记总数。
[cultist]：-2。如果你检定失败，或成功但没有超过难度至少2点，受到1点直接伤害。
[tablet]：-2。如果你检定失败，或成功但没有超过难度至少2点，在每个[[异教徒]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，失去1个线索。
all_card.name: 命运之线
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为毁灭标记最多的[[异教徒]]敌人上的毁灭标记数。
[cultist]：-2。如果你检定失败，或成功但没有超过难度至少1点，受到1点伤害。
[tablet]：-2。如果你检定失败，或成功但没有超过难度至少1点，在最近的[[异教徒]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你检定失败，失去1个线索。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull] : -X. X is the total number of doom in play.
[cultist]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 2, take 1 direct damage.
[tablet]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 2, place 1 doom on each [[cultist]] enemy.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, lose 1 of your clues.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] : -X. X is the highest number of doom on a [[cultist]] enemy.
[cultist]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 1, take 1 damage.
[tablet]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 1, place 1 doom on the nearest [[cultist]] enemy.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, lose 1 of your clues.

all_card.back_flavor: 中午的小城熙熙攘攘，热闹非凡。大学生们步行上课，上班族从办公室的繁忙工作中抽身片刻，而在东城区，维尔玛小餐馆在午餐高峰时间忙碌非凡。尽管表面一切正常，但帷幕已经升起。你看清了这座城市究竟是什么：充满疑团的无底深潭。
all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
如果场上只有2个场景牌库，在揭示密谋2a时，在其上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.flavor: 在有限的时间里，赶在线索消失之前，你需要完成三件任务。你会先搜索哪里？
all_card.name: 三种命运
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你不想花费过多时间来冒险，因此你带着搜集到的信息安全返回。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The town is bustling as noon comes and goes. University students travel from class to class, businesspeople take breaks from their busy office lives, and in Easttown, Velma's Diner is abuzz with the lunch rush. Despite this veil of normality, the curtain has been lifted. You see this town for what it really is: an endless mire of secrets.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If there are only 2 act decks in play, place 1 doom on agenda 2a as it is revealed.
all_card.real_flavor: You have three tasks before you and a limited amount of time before the trail goes cold. Where do you search first?
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.

all_card.back_flavor: 夜色将至，街上行人渐少。当一幢幢写字楼都关上了大门时，不论公开还是隐秘的各个俱乐部则开门纳客。在阿卡姆的商业区，沃德剧院灯火通明，座无虚席。但在周围的街道上，则静得离奇。只有附近小巷传来的轻柔的脚步声，能够证明此处有生命存在，一阵寒风从空中呼啸而过。工作时间可能已经结束，但你的工作还远远没有结束。走在街道上的一个个身影没能使你安心，反而让你的内心充满了恐惧。
all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
如果场上只有2个场景牌库，在揭示密谋3a时，在其上放置1个毁灭标记。
如果场上只有1个场景牌库，在揭示密谋3a时，在其上放置2个毁灭标记。
all_card.flavor: 这个阴谋远比你想象的要更加深远。你花费越多时间来调查这些谜团，你愈发认识到它们之间环环相扣。在这些谜团的中央，是一个在幕后操纵各起事件的神秘组织……
all_card.name: 幕后
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你不想花费过多时间来冒险，因此你带着搜集到的信息安全返回。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The streets begin to empty as evening approaches. When the office buildings shut their doors, the clubs open theirs, in places both public and hidden from view. In downtown Arkham, the Ward Theatre is well lit and filled to capacity. The surrounding streets, however, are eerily quiet. Only soft footsteps from nearby alleyways hint at any sign of life, and a cold wind whistles through the air. The workday might have ended, but your work is far from over. The figures walking down the street start to fill you with a sense of dread instead of comfort.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If there are only 2 act decks in play, place 1 doom on agenda 3a as it is revealed.
If there is only 1 act deck in play, place 2 doom on agenda 3a as it is revealed.
all_card.real_flavor: This conspiracy runs much deeper than you had imagined. The more time you spend investigating these mysteries, the more you come to realize they are linked to one another. At the center of these secrets is an enigmatic organization, manipulating events behind the scenes...
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.

all_card.back_flavor: 午夜已至，但你的工作还没结束。你在阿卡姆的街道上晃悠了几个小时，随着时间的推移，你追寻的线索逐渐消失，使你倍感沮丧。太阳升起的时候，你身心俱疲。
all_card.back_text: 幸存的每位调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。
all_card.flavor: 在这座满是谎言的城市里，你能相信谁呢？在阿卡姆不会受到丛林的危险，但你在这里并不安全。在这漆黑的夜里，来往的每个陌生人都可能是绑架犯、小偷、或者杀手。他们向你投来的每一个眼神，都可能是你最后见到的东西。
all_card.name: 暗藏纠葛
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你不想花费过多时间来冒险，因此你带着搜集到的信息安全返回。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Midnight arrives, but your work is not done. You wander the streets of Arkham for hours, frustrated as the trails you have pursued grow cold over time. When the sun rises, fatigue has wreaked havoc on your body and mind.
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: Who can you trust in this city of lies? Arkham may be safe from the perils of the jungle, but you are far from safe here. Each passing stranger in the dark of night could be a kidnapper, a thief, or a killer. Each glance they send your way could be the last thing you ever see.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.

all_card.flavor: 埃兹特里遗物最后一次出现，是在米斯卡塔尼克博物馆的埃兹特里展览上，就在它的展示柜中。伊塔卡担心如果遗物落入坏人手中，可能用来达成某些可怕的目的。你必须将它找回来！
all_card.name: 遗物不见了！
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在米斯卡塔尼克大学的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_flavor: The Eztli relic was last seen in its display case in the Eztli exhibit at the Miskatonic Museum. Ichtaca fears that the relic could be used for terrible purposes if left in the wrong hands. You must recover it!
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in Miskatonic University can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.name: 埃兹特里展厅
all_card.text: 显现 - 将埃兹特里展厅放置入场。 强制 - 在你调查埃兹特里展厅时揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号后：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.traits: 米斯卡塔尼克. 展览
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put the Eztli Exhibit into play. Forced - After you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol while investigating the Eztli Exhibit: Take 1 horror.

all_card.flavor: 哈伦保管着那件遗物，但他确信有人在跟着他。你最后一次听到他的消息是他在大学的办公室里。
all_card.name: 哈伦遇险！
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在米斯卡塔尼克大学的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_flavor: Harlan has custody of the relic, but he believes he is being followed. The last time you heard from him, he was in his office at the university.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in Miskatonic University can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.flavor: 当你找到哈伦时，他语无伦次地说着胡话，不管你说什么他都不理睬。
all_card.name: 哈伦·恩斯通
all_card.text: 显现 - 将哈伦·恩斯通放置入场，放在东城区。 [action]弃掉你牌库顶3张卡牌：谈判。你试图让恩斯通恢复清醒。检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定成功，在其上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。
all_card.traits: 旁人. 米斯卡塔尼克
all_card.real_flavor: When you find him, Harlan is babbling incoherently and won't respond to anything you say.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Harlan Earnstone into play in Easttown. [action] Discard the top 3 cards of your deck: Parley. You try to snap Earnstone out of his daze. Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, place 1 clue on him (from the token pool).

all_card.back_flavor: 你到遗物之前展出的展厅内搜寻一番，看是否有线索表明它被带到哪里去了。尽管你没找到什么实质证据，但在展厅入口旁的地面上，你发现了几条最近出现的痕迹，是男性的鞋子在地上拖拽而成。你询问德鲁，在亚历山卓离开后，谁还进过这个展厅。“几个穿西装的，像是政府来的。”他回答说，“他们从馆长维尔斯特那儿获得了许可，可以进这个展厅。”尽管这还不能证明遗物现在的下落，但至少是条线索——希望能指引你往正确的方向前进。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的市政厅地点放置入场。如果市政厅已在场上，在其上增加1[per_investigator]个线索。将放在一边的古代遗物附属到市政厅。
如果场上有2个或更多的场景牌库，在市政厅上放置额外1[per_investigator]个线索。
推进到场景3a——“寻找遗物”。
all_card.flavor: 博物馆的其中一位名叫德鲁·沃克的保安，记得你先前和亚历山卓·霍洛维兹博士共事，认出了你。“听着，我不该让任何人进展厅的……但我会想点法子瞒过去，警察不会知道这事的。”他往边上走了一步，让你进入展厅，“要是有人问起，你就说你是趁着我上厕所的时候溜进来的，懂吗？别被人套话了。”
all_card.name: 来到展厅
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在埃及特里展厅的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You search the exhibit where the relic was to be on display, looking for signs of where it may have been taken. Though you find no concrete evidence, on the ground near the exhibit entrance, you do notice several recent scuff marks made by men's shoes. You ask Drew who was last to see the exhibit after Alejandro left. "Some suits. Government types," he replies. "They had clearing to see the exhibit from Mr. Walsted, the curator." It's far from proof of the relic's location, but it's a lead - hopefully one that will point you in the right direction.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put the set-aside Town Hall location into play. If it was already in play, add add 1 [per_investigator] clues to it. Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages to the Town Hall.
If there are 2 or fewer act decks in play, add an additional 1 [per_investigator] clues to the Town Hall.
Advance to Act 3a - "Find the Relic."
all_card.real_flavor: One of the museum security guards, a man named Drew Walker, recognizes you from your prior work with Alejandro and Dr. Horowitz. "Look, I ain’t supposed to be letting anybody into the exhibit... But the coppers don’t know from nothing when it comes to this hokum." He steps aside and lets you pass. "If anybody asks, you slipped in while I was using the john, all right? Don’t take any wooden nickels."
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in the Eztli Exhibit can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
你到遗物之前展出的展厅内搜寻一番，看是否有线索表明它被带到哪里去了。在你搜寻的时候，你察觉到一个阴影在墙上爬行。它很快就消失在你的视线以外，随后一阵沉重的脚步声回荡在画廊另一头的展厅之间。难道罪魁祸首还在这里？
你追了上去，只见一个戴着兜帽的人影飞快地逃出了博物馆。至少现在你有一条线索可以跟了——在遗物重新回到你手上之前，你都不会停下脚步。
all_card.back_text:
查找遭遇牌库、遭遇弃牌堆、胜利区，找出一张兄弟会异教徒并将其生成在距离所有调查员最远的地点。
治愈场上所有兄弟会异教徒的全部伤害。
将放在一边的古代遗物附属到距离所有调查员最远的兄弟会异教徒。
如果场上有2个或更少的场景牌库，在附属古代遗物的兄弟会异教徒上放置1个毁灭标记。
推进到场景3a——“夺回遗物”。
all_card.flavor: 博物館的其中一位名叫德魯·沃克的保安，記得你先前和亞歷山卓、霍洛維茲博士共事，認出了你。“聽著，我不該讓任何人進展廳的……但我會想點法子瞞過去，警察不會知道這事的。”他往邊上走了一步，讓你進入展廳，“要是有人問起，你就說你是趁著我上廁所的時候溜進來的，懂嗎？別被人套話了。”
all_card.name: 来到展厅
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在埃及特里展厅的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You search the exhibit where the relic was to be on display, looking for signs of where it may have been taken. As you search, you notice a shadow crawling along the wall. It quickly flits out of sight, and heavy footsteps echo through the halls beyond the gallery. Could it be that the culprit is still here?
You give chase, but the hooded figure has a lead on you and quickly escapes from the museum. At least now you have a trail to follow - and you won't stop until the relic is yours again.
all_card.real_back_text:
Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and victory display for a Brotherhood Cultist and spawn it in the location farthest from all investigators. Heal all damage from each Brotherhood Cultist in play.
Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages to the Brotherhood Cultist farthest from all investigators.
If there are 2 or fewer act decks in play, add 1 doom to the Brotherhood Cultist with the attached Relic of Ages.
Advance to Act 3a - "Recover the Relic."
all_card.real_flavor: One of the museum security guards, a man named Drew Walker, recognizes you from your prior work with Alejandro and Dr. Horowitz. "Look, I ain’t supposed to be letting anybody into the exhibit... But the coppers don’t know from nothing when it comes to this hokum." He steps aside and lets you pass. "If anybody asks, you slipped in while I was using the john, all right? Don’t take any wooden nickels."
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in the Eztli Exhibit can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 哈伦终于从呆滞中恢复过来，变得同平常一样。他告诉你，他被几个身穿棕色长袍的人拦住问话，问他把遗物藏在哪里了。他们用了某种催眠术，企图强行让哈伦把所知道的事情和盘托出。他别无选择，只能说出实话——他将遗物带到了珍品店，交给他的一位助手。要是你抓紧点，或许你能赶在身穿棕色长袍的人之前取回遗物！
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的古代遗物附属到珍品店。
如果场上有2个或更少的场景牌库，查找遭遇牌库，找出1张祭司(如果游戏中有3或4位调查员，改为找出2张祭司)。将刚刚找出的每个祭司生成在珍品店。
推进到场景3a——“寻找遗物”。
all_card.flavor: 在哈伦的办公室里没找到他的踪迹，但一位楼宇管理员告诉你，哈伦请了一天假，回他东城区的家里去了。
all_card.name: 哈伦的诅咒
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果哈伦·恩斯通上有1[per_investigator]线索：你必须移除这些线索并立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Harlan finally snaps out of his daze, returning to his normal self. He tells you that he was accosted by several figures in brown robes, who asked him where he'd hidden the relic. They used some kind of hypnotism to pry the knowledge from him by force. He had no choice but to tell them the truth - that he'd brought the relic to the Curiositie Shoppe and gave it to one of his associates. If you make haste, perhaps you can reach the relic before the brown-robed figures do!
all_card.real_back_text:
Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages to the Curiositie Shoppe.
If there are 2 or fewer act decks in play, search the encounter deck for 1 Acolyte (2 Acolytes instead if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game). Spawn each searched-for Acolyte in the Curiositie Shoppe.
Advance to Act 3a - "Find the Relic."
all_card.real_flavor: There is no sign of Harlan in his office, but one of the assistants in the administration building informs you that he took the day off and went to his home in Easttown.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Harlan Earnstone: You must remove them and immediately advance.

all_card.flavor: 在哈伦的办公室里没找到他的踪迹，但一位楼宇管理员告诉你，哈伦请了一天假，回他东城区的家里去了。
all_card.name: 哈伦的诅咒
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果哈伦·恩斯通上有1[per_investigator]线索：你必须移除这些线索并立即推进。
all_card.real_flavor: There is no sign of Harlan in his office, but one of the assistants in the administration building informs you that he took the day off and went to his home in Easttown.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Harlan Earnstone: You must remove them and immediately advance.

all_card.flavor: 哈伦饱受一种古怪诅咒的折磨，突然对你发起了攻击！
all_card.name: 哈伦·恩斯通
all_card.text: 显现 - 将本卡牌与带有[[旁人]]特性的哈伦·恩斯通切换，将被切换版本从游戏中移除。将放在一边的古代遗物附属到哈伦·恩斯通。推进到场景3a——“夺回遗物”。 强制 - 在你成功躲避哈伦·恩斯通，且超过难度至少3点后：将他加入胜利区。
all_card.traits: 类人. 诅咒萦绕. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: Afflicted by a strange curse, Harlan suddenly attacks!
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Switch this card with the [[Bystander]] version of Harlan Earnstone, removing that version from the game. Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages to Harlan Earnstone. Advance to Act 3a - "Recover the Relic." Forced - After you successfully evade Harlan Earnstone by 3 or more: Add him to the victory display.

all_card.back_text:
如果古代遗物附属到市政厅
在花费了一个小时来调查阿卡姆市政厅后，你注意到有一道微弱的蓝光从一扇门底下透出，那是城市规划师的办公室。你闯进了这间办公室，没被任何人察觉。这件遗物就在他的桌子上，旁边是一张本市的地图，上面画满了古怪的标志和图形。它为什么会在这儿？
距离市政厅最近的调查员控制古代遗物。将剩余的“a/b”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有一另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
如果古代遗物附属到珍品店：
果然，这件遗物就藏在珍品店储物室的角落里，避开了人们的视线。
距离珍品店最近的调查员控制古代遗物。将剩余的“a/b”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有一另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 你深信自己发现了遗物的所在之处。为了找到遗物，现在你得将这个地方找个底朝天。
all_card.name: 寻找遗物
all_card.text: 古代遗物附属到一个地点时，该地点隐藏值+2。 目标 - 如果古代遗物附属到的地点上没有剩余线索，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If the Relic of Ages is attached to the Town Hall:
After an hour of searching Arkham's Town Hall, you notice a faint blue glow emanating from underneath the door to the city planner's office. You break into the office without being noticed. The relic is lying on his desk, along with a map of the city that is covered in strange markings and iconography. Why is it here?
The investigator nearest to the Town Hall takes control of the Relic of Ages. Remove the remainder of the "a/b" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If the Relic of Ages is attached to the Curiositie Shoppe:
Sure enough, the relic is tucked away in a corner of the shop's storage room, hidden from sight.
The investigator nearest to the Curiositie Shoppe takes control of the Relic of Ages. Remove the remainder of the "a/b" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
all_card.real_flavor: You believe you have discovered the relic’s whereabouts. Now, you must scour this place from bottom to top in order to find it.
all_card.real_text: While Relic of Ages is attached to a location, that location gets +2 shroud. Objective - If Relic of Ages is attached to a location with no remaining clues, advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果古代遗物附属到兄弟会异教徒：
随着那个身着长袍的人影倒下，遗物从他的披风里掉了出来，骨碌碌地掉到了地上，滚动了一小段距离就停下了。它一边发出诡异的光芒一边跳动着，仿佛它知道有人在寻找自己一般。
距离该兄弟会异教徒所在地点最近的调查员控制古代遗物。将剩余的“a/b”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
如果古代遗物附属到哈伦·恩斯通：
哈伦从呆滞中恢复过来，瘫倒在地，抱着他那头痛欲裂的脑袋。“我这是怎——？”意识到自己干了什么后，他睁大了双眼，从他的外套里拿出遗物，将它交给你。“拿、拿着它！”他说，“你比我更能保护它的安全。”
距离哈伦·恩斯通所在地点最近的调查员控制古代遗物。将剩余的“a/b”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 你知道将遗物带走的是什么人了。现在，你必须从他们手中取回遗物，不惜任何代价！
all_card.name: 夺回遗物
all_card.text: 古代遗物附属到一个敌人时，该敌人得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 目标 - 如果古代遗物附属到的敌人离场，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If the Relic of Ages was attached to a Brotherhood Cultist:
As the robed figure collapses, the relic falls out of his cloak, clattering to the ground and rolling to a stop nearby. It is pulsing with an odd glow, as though aware it is being searched for.
The investigator nearest to the Brotherhood Cultist's location takes control of the Relic of Ages. Remove the remainder of the "a/b" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If the Relic of Ages was attached to Harlan Earnstone:
Harlan snaps out of his daze and collapses, holding his head in pain. "What was I - ?" His eyes widen as he realizes what he has done, and he pulls the relic out of his coat, offering it to you. "T-take it!" He says. "You can keep it safer than I can."
The investigator nearest to Harlan Earnstone's location takes control of the Relic of Ages. Remove the remainder of the "a/b" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
all_card.real_flavor: You’ve discovered who is carrying the relic. Now, you must secure it from them, whatever the cost!
all_card.real_text: While Relic of Ages is attached to an enemy, that enemy gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Objective - If the enemy the Relic of Ages is attached to leaves play, advance.

all_card.flavor: 你决定自己寻找亚历山卓，相信在不牵涉警方势力的情况下，你找到他的机会更大。他下榻的旅店就在东城区，因此你在那儿展开调查。
all_card.name: 寻找亚历山卓
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在东城区的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_flavor: You’ve decided to search for Alejandro on your own, believing you will have a better shot at finding him without involving the police. His hotel is in Easttown, so you begin your search there.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in Easttown can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.flavor: 亨利坐在吧台旁边，小口啜饮着一杯黑咖啡。
all_card.name: 亨利·德沃
all_card.text: 显现 - 将亨利·德沃放置入场，放到维尔玛小餐馆上。 [action] 选择并弃掉你一张手牌：谈判。你跟他讨论亚历山卓的下落。检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，在本卡牌上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。
all_card.real_flavor: Henry sits at the counter, sipping at a cup of black coffee.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Henry Deveau into play in Velma's Diner. [action] Choose and discard a card from your hand: Parley. You discuss Alejandro's whereabouts. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, place 1 clue on this card (from the token pool).

all_card.flavor: 你怀疑亚历山卓已遭毒手，决定到警察局寻求帮助，请他们帮忙寻找亚历山卓。
all_card.name: 失踪人口
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在东城区的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_flavor: Suspecting foul play, you’ve decided to go to the police to enlist their help in searching for Alejandro.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in Easttown can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.name: 阿卡姆警察局
all_card.text: 显现 - 将阿卡姆警察局放置入场。 东城区与阿卡姆警察局相互连接。 [action]：查找你牌库顶的6张卡牌，找出一张[[武器]]卡牌并将其加入你的手牌。混洗你的牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put the Arkham Police Station into play. Easttown is connected to Arkham Police Station. [action]: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a [[weapon]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 没有任何一个警员见过亚历山卓，而且他们似乎对帮你找人这件事并不上心。“这才过了几天呢。他会出现的。”他们这么说道，找了个借口，想要借此少写一份报告。最后，正当你背负着挫败感离开的时候，一个因行为不检被捕的流浪汉抓住了你的胳膊。“吾见着伊啦！”他慢吞吞地说道，“你说的那个男人，吾见着伊飞在天上，被一头怪物抓着……”他描述了一只没有面容，长着翅膀的生物，这时一旁的警员们翻了翻白眼，咯咯地笑着。很明显这个男人喝醉了……但他说的难道是真的？
all_card.back_text: 查找所有场上和场外地区(FAQ v2.1)找出一个狩猎中的夜魇并将其生成在距离所有调查员最远的地点。治愈场上所有狩猎中的夜魇的全部伤害。 将放在一边的亚历山卓·维拉附属到距离所有调查员最远的狩猎中的夜魇。 推进到场景3c——“亚历山卓遇险”。
all_card.flavor: 警察局理论上是向公众开放的，但要让有关部门听到你的陈述，需要动用的手段比你想象的要多。
all_card.name: 来到警局
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在阿卡姆警察局的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: None of the police officers have seen Alejandro, and they don't seem interested in helping you find him. "It's only been a couple days. He'll turn up," they say. They give excuses, trying to avoid filling out a report. Finally, just as you are about to leave in frustration, a homeless man being held for disorderly conduct grabs your elbow. "I saw 'im!" he drawls. "The man you describe, I saw 'im in the sky, carried in its clutches..." He describes a faceless winged creature while the officers nearby chuckle and roll their eyes. The man is clearly drunk... but could it be he's telling the truth?
all_card.real_back_text:
Search all in- and out-of-play areas for a Hunting Nightgaunt and spawn it in the location farthest from all investigators. Heal all damage from each Hunting Nightgaunt in play.
Attach the set-aside Alejandro Vela to the Hunting Nightgaunt farthest from all investigators.
Advance to Act 3c - "Alejandro's Plight."
all_card.real_flavor: The police station might be open to the public in theory, but getting your story heard by the proper authorities requires a bit more finesse than you imagined.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in the Arkham Police Station can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.flavor: 警察局理论上是向公众开放的，但要让有关部门听到你的陈述，需要动用的手段比你想象的要多。
all_card.name: 来到警局
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在阿卡姆警察局的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_flavor: The police station might be open to the public in theory, but getting your story heard by the proper authorities requires a bit more finesse than you imagined.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in the Arkham Police Station can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.flavor: 其中一个警员宣称在火车铁轨边上看到了亚历山卓，身旁站着几个身着长袍的人……
all_card.name: 火车轨道
all_card.text: 显现 - 将火车轨道放置入场。将放在一边的亚历山卓·维拉附属到火车轨道。推进到场景3c——“亚历山卓被关押”。 北区与火车轨道相互连接。 [action]花费1个线索：抽取4张卡牌。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: One of the police officers claims to have seen Alejandro down by the train tracks, flanked by several robed figures...
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Train Tracks into play. Attach the set-aside Alejandro Vela to Train Tracks. Advance to Act 3c - "Alejandro's Prison." Northside is connected to Train Tracks. [action] Spend 1 clue: Draw 4 cards. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 亨利焦急地四下张望，然后身体前倾，压低声音说道：“好吧，听着。我在商业区上班，是城市规划师的助手之一。我的上司是个怪人，他性格安静，想法大胆，喜欢连着几个小时窝在他的办公室里。”他紧张地搓着自己的双手，“我不知道他为什么会跟亚历山卓出现在同一个地方，而且还是在我毫不知情的情况下——上一次我见到亚历山卓时：他跟我的上司走在大厅里，有两个穿着黑西装的家伙站在他们身旁，看着可怕极了。”他站起来并穿上自己的外套，在桌上留下2枚25美分的硬币。“这话你不是从我这儿听来的。”在离开之前他强调道。
all_card.back_text:
如果市政厅地点不在场上，将放在一边的市政厅地点放置入场。
将放在一边的亚历山卓·维拉附属到市政厅。
推进到场景3c——“亚历山卓被关押”。
all_card.flavor: 你没法进入亚历山卓在旅店的房间，因此你决定问问隔壁几个房间的住客。他们之中的一个人告诉你，亚历山卓时常与一个朋友见面，那人名叫亨利·德沃，是政府官员。他们常常约在夜间见面，就在维尔玛小餐馆。或许你该去见亨利一面？
all_card.name: 上头有人
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果亨利·德沃上有1[per_investigator]个线索：你必须移除这些线索并立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Henry looks about anxiously, then leans forward and speaks in a hushed tone. "All right, listen. I work downtown, as assistant to the city planner. He's a bit of a funny bird. Quiet type, big ideas, likes to hole up in his office for hours at a time." He rubs his hands together nervously. "Don't know why he and Alejandro would ever be in the same room without my knowing - but last time I saw Alejandro, that's right where he was: walking down the hall with my boss, flanked by a couple of intimidating fellas in black suits." He gets up and puts on his coat, leaving two quarters on the table. "You didn't hear this from me," he insists before departing.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put the set-aside Town Hall location into play, if it is not already in play.
Attach the set-aside Alejandro Vela to the Town Hall.
Advance to Act 3c - "Alejandro's Prison."
all_card.real_flavor: You can’t get into Alejandro’s hotel room, so you decide to question several of the occupants in the neighboring rooms. One of them informs you that Alejandro has been meeting often with an acquaintance of his, a government official named Henry Deveau. They tend to meet nightly at Velma’s Diner. Perhaps you should pay Henry a visit?
all_card.real_text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Henry Deveau: You must remove them and immediately advance.

One of them informs you that Alejandro has been meeting often with an acquaintance of his, a government official named Henry Deveau. They tend to meet nightly at Velma’s Diner. all_card.real_text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Henry Deveau: You must remove them and immediately advance.

all_card.flavor: 亨利宣称知道亚历山卓的下落，领你离开了餐馆。就在你跟着他来到附近的一条小巷时，他拔出了一把小刀向你捅来！
all_card.name: 亨利·德沃
all_card.text: 显现 - 将本卡牌与带有[[旁人]]特性的亨利·德沃切换，将被切换版本从游戏中移除。将放在一边的亚历山卓·维拉附属到亨利·德沃。推进到场景3c——“亚历山卓遇险”。 反击。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同谋. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: Henry claims to know where Alejandro is and leads you out of the diner. As you follow him down a nearby alley, he pulls out a knife and attacks you!
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Switch this card with the [[Bystander]] version of Henry Deveau, removing that version from the game. Attach the set-aside Alejandro Vela to Henry Deveau. Advance to Act 3c - "Alejandro's Plight." Retaliate.

all_card.back_text:
如果亚历山卓·维拉被附属到火车轨道：
你四处寻找，花了快一个小时，你听见从其中一辆货运车的车厢传来响声。被锁在里面的正是喃喃自语的亚历山卓。“谢天谢地！”在你走进车厢时他惊呼道，“我正想搞明白他们为什么把我带到这里来呢……”
距离火车轨道最近的调查员控制亚历山卓·维拉。将剩余的“c/d”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
如果亚历山卓·维拉被附属到市政厅：
你成功地潜入了市政厅的地下层，没被任何人发现。你在地下层的一个办公室里找到了亚历山卓。他没被限制自由，但他见了你便欣喜若狂：“谢天谢地！他们强行把我带到这里来。但我不知道这是为什么……”
距离市政厅最近的调查员控制亚历山卓·维拉。将剩余的“c/d”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 你确信亚历山卓被关在此处的某个地方。你必须解救他！
all_card.name: 亚历山卓被关押
all_card.text: 亚历山卓·维拉附属到一个地点时，该地点隐藏值+2。 目标 - 如果亚历山卓·维拉附属到的地点上没有剩余线索，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If Alejandro Vela is attached to the Train Tracks:
After searching up and down for nearly an hour, you hear a voice coming from one of the storage cars. Sealed inside is Alejandro, murmuring to himself. "Thank goodness!" he exclaims as you enter. "I was just trying to figure out why they brought me here..."
The investigator nearest to the Train Tracks takes control of Alejandro Vela. Remove the remainder of the "c/d" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If Alejandro Vela is attached to the Town Hall:
You manage to slip into the basement of the town hall without being spotted. You find Alejandro in one of the basement offices. He isn't restrained, but he is overjoyed to see you. "Thank goodness! They brought me here by force. Though I don't know why..."
The investigator nearest to the Town Hall takes control of Alejandro Vela. Remove the remainder of the "c/d" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
all_card.real_flavor: You believe that Alejandro is held captive somewhere in this location. You must rescue him!
all_card.real_text: While Alejandro Vela is attached to a location, that location gets +2 shroud. Objective - If Alejandro Vela is attached to a location with no remaining clues, advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果亚历山卓·维拉被附属到一个狩猎中的夜魇：
亚历山卓和长着翅膀的生物的尸体一同落在地上。他咳嗽着，颤颤巍巍地站了起来。“那头野兽！它用它的爪子抓着我……天知道它把我带到哪里去了！”
距离该狩猎中的夜魔最近的调查员控制亚历山卓·维拉。将剩余的“c/d”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
如果亚历山卓·维拉被附属到亨利·德沃：
亨利瘫倒在地，耗尽气力，浑身是血。“慢着！我……我来告诉你上哪儿去找亚历山卓！”他给了你一个在河岸城的地址，随后你跟着他的指引，找到了那里。就在一栋废弃的办公楼里，你找到了亚历山卓，他没被限制自由，但他见了你便欣喜若狂：“谢天谢地！你得带我离开这儿！”
距离亨利·德沃最近的调查员控制亚历山卓·维拉。将剩余的“c/d”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 你相信自己已经料到，将亚历山卓绑架起来的人是谁。现在你必须通过战斗来解救自己的同伴！
all_card.name: 亚历山卓遇险
all_card.text: 亚历山卓·维拉附属到一个敌人时，该敌人得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 目标 - 如果亚历山卓·维拉附属到的敌人离场，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If Alejandro Vela was attached to a Hunting Nightgaunt:
Alejandro collapses to the ground along with the winged creature's body. He coughs and rises to his feet, shaking. "Th-that beast! It had me in its clutches...Who knows where it was taking me?"
The investigator nearest to the Hunting Nightgaunt takes control of Alejandro Vela. Remove the remainder of the "c/d" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If Alejandro Vela was attached to Henry Deveau:
Henry collapses to the ground, exhausted and bloodied. "Wait! I... I'll tell you where to find Alejandro!" He gives you an address in Rivertown, and you follow his directions. Inside the abandoned office building is Alejandro, not restrained but overjoyed to see you. "Thank goodness! You have to get me out of here!"
The investigator nearest to Henry Deveau takes control of Alejandro Vela. Remove the remainder of the "c/d" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
all_card.real_flavor: You believe you have discovered the identity of Alejandro’s kidnapper. Now you must fight to rescue your companion!
all_card.real_text: While Alejandro Vela is attached to an enemy, that enemy gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Objective - If the enemy Alejandro Vela is attached to leaves play, advance.

all_card.flavor: 伊塔卡跟你说了不要跟着她，但你按捺不住自己的好奇心，想要知道她要干什么。于是你跟着她，沿着河畔走……
all_card.name: 女猎手的苦旅
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在河岸城的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_flavor: Ichtaca told you not to follow her, though you can’t help but wonder what she is up to. You decide to pursue her as she heads down toward the riverside…
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in Rivertown can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.name: 幽暗洞穴
all_card.text: 显现 - 将幽暗洞穴放置入场。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时，如果你位于幽暗洞穴：你必须受到1点恐惧，或选择并弃掉2张手牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Black Cave into play. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are in the Black Cave: You must either take 1 horror or choose and discard 2 cards from your hand.

all_card.flavor: 伊塔卡告诉你，她看见在这座城市的西北角，有一间古怪的商店正在售卖多件埃兹特里遗物。她打算到那儿去深入调查。
all_card.name: 守卫者追根究底
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在北区的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_flavor: Ichtaca tells you that she saw several Eztli artifacts on sale in the strange shop near the northwestern edge of the city. She wants to head in that direction to investigate further.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in Northside can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.flavor: “精巧极了，不是吗？”
all_card.name: 玛利亚·德西瓦
all_card.text: 显现 - 将玛利亚·德西瓦放置入场，放在珍品店。 [action] 花费1资源：谈判。你跟玛利亚聊聊关于在售物品的事情。检定[intellect](3)如果你检定成功，在其上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。
all_card.real_flavor: "Exquisite, aren't they?"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Maria DeSilva into play in the Curiositie Shoppe. [action] Spend 1 resource: Parley. You chat with Maria about the artifacts on sale. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, place 1 clue on her (from the token pool).

all_card.back_flavor: 正当你寻找自己的同伴时，一声尖锐的号叫回荡在整个洞穴中，鞭策你前进。你深入洞穴深处，发现伊塔卡正和几个身着长袍的人战斗。她拉弓射出一支箭，刺进了其中一人的胸膛，她一见你进来便立即在凸起的石头后面蹲了下来。一波恐怖至极的能量轰击了她刚刚所站的位置，烧焦了地面。“你在这儿干什么？”她愤怒地吼道。
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。从遭遇牌库顶弃牌，直到弃掉一个[[异教徒]]敌人(如果场上有2个或更少的场景牌库，则改为2个[[异教徒]]敌人)。 将这些敌人生成在幽暗洞穴(而不是其通常的生成地点)。直到冒险结束，记住这些敌人是“伊塔卡的猎物”。 推进到场景3e——“兄弟会暴露”。
all_card.flavor: 你看见伊塔卡一个人走进了这个荒废的洞穴。她会在这个奇怪的地方干什么呢？
all_card.name: 漆黑的洞穴
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在幽暗洞穴的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。必须在幽暗洞穴没有线索时才能推进本场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you search for your companion, a piercing cry echoes throughout the cave, spurring you onward. Deep within the cave, you find Ichtaca in the midst of a battle with several robed figures. She fires an arrow from her bow, striking one of the figures in its chest, then ducks behind an outcropping of rock as she sees you enter. A wave of eldritch energy strikes the place she had been standing moments prior, charring the ground. "What are you doing here?" she yells angrily.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Cultist]] enemy is discarded (2 [[Cultist]] enemies instead if there are 2 or fewer act decks remaining). Spawn those enemies in Black Cave (instead of their normal spawn location). Until the end of the scenario, remember that those enemies are "Ichtaca's prey." Advance to Act 3e - "The Brotherhood Is Revealed."
all_card.real_flavor: You watched Ichtaca enter this abandoned cave on her own. What is she doing in such a strange place?
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in the Black Cave can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. There must be no clues remaining on the Black Cave in order to advance this act.

all_card.back_flavor: 你跟着伊塔卡穿过洞穴，步步紧跟而又不暴露行踪。她凭借着自然探险家的专业知识，穿过了洞穴，你一开始没能发现的道路也被她一一洞察。让你惊讶的是，这条昏暗的隧道向上倾斜，你离地面越来越近。你听见伊塔卡在前方将某种金属打开又合上。你追上去发现上方是一道沉重的铁门，通往洞穴入口北面一座建筑的地下层。
all_card.back_text:
如果市政厅地点不在场上，将放在一边的市政厅地点放置入场。记住市政厅是“伊塔卡的目的地”。直到游戏结束，幽暗洞穴和市政厅相互连接。
按玩家顺序，每位调查员依次从遭遇牌库顶弃掉一张卡牌。每位弃掉诡计卡牌的调查员必须抽取该卡牌。
推进到场景3e——“怪事丛生”。
all_card.flavor: 你看见伊塔卡一个人走进了这个荒废的洞穴。她会在这个奇怪的地方干什么呢？
all_card.name: 漆黑的洞穴
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在幽暗洞穴的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。必须在幽暗洞穴没有线索时才能推进本场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You track Ichtaca throughout the cave, echoing her movements closely while remaining hidden. She traverses the cavern with the expertise of a natural explorer, discovering paths you hadn't noticed at first. To your surprise, the dark tunnels ramp upwards, taking you closer to the surface. You hear Ichtaca open and close something metallic up ahead. When you catch up, you find a heavy iron grate above you leading into the basement of a building north of the cave's entrance.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put the set-aside Town Hall location into play, if it is not already in play. Remember that the Town Hall is "Ichtaca's destination." For the remainder of the game, Black Cave and Town Hall are connected to one another.
One at a time, in player order, each investigator discards the top card of the encounter deck. Each investigator who discards a treachery card must draw that card.
Advance to Act 3e - "Strange Occurrences."
all_card.real_flavor: You watched Ichtaca enter this abandoned cave on her own. What is she doing in such a strange place?
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in the Black Cave can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. There must be no clues remaining on the Black Cave in order to advance this act.

all_card.flavor: 在这间商店里，一位衣着入时的中年妇女正在仔细查看展出的埃兹特里遗物，赞不绝口。这些遗物是怎么出现在这里的？这个女人对这一切又有何了解呢？
all_card.name: 古怪遗物
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果玛利亚·德西瓦上有1[per_investigator]个线索：你必须移除这些线索并立即推进。
all_card.real_flavor: Inside the shop, an middle-aged woman wearing the height of fashion inspects the Eztli relics on display with admiration. How did those relics get here? And what does this woman know about all of this?
all_card.real_text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Maria DeSilva: You must remove them and immediately advance.

all_card.flavor: “你不知道你在干涉的是什么事情！”
all_card.name: 玛利亚·德西瓦
all_card.text: 显现 - 将本卡牌与带有[[旁人]]特性的玛利亚·德西瓦切换，将被切换版本从游戏中移除。记住她是“伊塔卡的猎物”。推进到场景3e——“兄弟会暴露”。 反击。
all_card.traits: 类人. 同谋. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "You don't understand what you are meddling in!"
all_card.real_subname: Knows More Than She Lets On
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Switch this card with the [[Bystander]] version of Maria DeSilva, removing that version from the game. Remember that she is "Ichtaca's prey." Advance to Act 3e - "The Brotherhood is Revealed." Retaliate.

all_card.back_flavor: 玛利亚抽了一口香烟才回答你的问题。她告诉你，她无意中从几位富裕的客人那儿听说，埃兹特里遗物在好几次竞价中拍出了惊人的高价。“我完全不知道这些遗物是从哪来的，但这些人似乎很清楚自己的目标是什么。”她这么说道。要是你追踪这些资金的去向，或许你能进一步得知，在阿卡姆的阴影下运作的神秘组织究竟是什么……
all_card.back_text:
记住商业区和河岸城都是“伊塔卡的目的地”。
按玩家顺序，每位调查员依次从遭遇牌库顶弃掉一张卡牌。每位弃掉诡计卡牌的调查员必须抽取该卡牌。
推进到场景3e——“怪事丛生”。
all_card.flavor: 在这间商店里，一位衣着入时的中年妇女正在仔细查看展出的埃兹特里遗物，赞不绝口。这些遗物是怎么出现在这里的？这个女人对这一切又有何了解呢？
all_card.name: 古怪遗物
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果玛利亚·德西瓦上有1[per_investigator]个线索：你必须移除这些线索并立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Maria takes a puff from her cigarette before responding to your questions. She tells you that she overheard some well-to-do patrons putting down several outrageously pricey bids on the Eztli artifacts. "I don't even know where these artifacts came from, but those people seemed to know <u>exactly</u> what they were looking for," she claims. Perhaps if you follow this trail of money, you'll uncover more about this mysterious group that operates in Arkham's shadows…
all_card.real_back_text:
Remember that both Downtown and Rivertown are "Ichtaca's destinations."
One at a time, in player order, each investigator discards the top card of the encounter deck. Each investigator who discards a treachery card must draw that card.
Advance to Act 3e - "Strange Occurrences."
all_card.real_flavor: Inside the shop, an middle-aged woman wearing the height of fashion inspects the Eztli relics on display with admiration. How did those relics get here? And what does this woman know about all of this?
all_card.real_text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Maria DeSilva: You must remove them and immediately advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果市政厅是“伊塔卡的目的地”：
由于某些原因，这些隧道连通到阿卡姆市政厅地下一层的一条密道。你在一个黑暗的房间里找到了伊塔卡，她正在浏览这座城市的几张地图。“你在这儿干什么？”她用责难的语气问道，“算了。你都到这儿来了，就帮我读读这些文件，搞明白这儿发生了什么。”
距离市政厅最近的调查员控制放在一边的伊塔卡(失落的守卫者)。将剩余的“e/f”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
如果商业区和河岸城是“伊塔卡的目的地”：
凭借着从银行取得的信息，你追踪拍卖者来到了河岸城的一个仓库。在这幢建筑里，你找到了更多的信息，关于埃兹特里遗物和亚历山卓的探险队。
距离河岸城最近的调查员控制放在一边的伊塔卡(失落的守卫者)。将剩余的“e/f”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 伊塔卡找到了她要调查的目标，而你沿着神秘异教的线索追查到此。给这片区域来个彻底搜查，会发现更多信息……
all_card.name: 怪事丛生
all_card.text: 你位于“伊塔卡的目的地”时，你每轮从遭遇牌库抽出的第一张诡计卡牌获得涌动。 目标 - 如果所有“伊塔卡的目的地”上均无线索，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If "Ichtaca's destination" was the Town Hall:
For some reason, the tunnels connect to a hidden passage in the basement of Arkham's town hall. You find Ichtaca in a dark room, browsing through several maps of the city. "What are you doing here?" she asks accusingly. "No matter. You're here now. Help me read these documents and figure out what is going on here."
The investigator nearest to the Town Hall takes control of the set-aside Ichtaca (The Forgotten Guardian). Remove the remainder of the "e/f" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If "Ichtaca's destinations" were Downtown and Rivertown:
Using information from the bank, you track the bidders to a warehouse in Rivertown. Inside, you find a bounty of information about the Eztli relics and Alejandro's expedition.
The investigator nearest to Rivertown takes control of the set-aside Ichtaca (The Forgotten Guardian). Remove the remainder of the "e/f" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
