all_card.real_flavor: Ichtaca has found the target of her investigation. The trail of the mysterious cult leads here. A thorough search of the area may reveal more...
all_card.real_text: While you are at any of "Ichtaca's destinations," the first treachery you draw from the encounter deck each round gains surge. Objective - If there are no clues remaining on each of "Ichtaca's destinations," advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果“伊塔卡的猎物”是至少1个[[异教徒]]敌人：
最后一个身着长袍的人摔倒在地，你放心地舒了一口气。伊塔卡取回了她的箭枝，然后搜查这些尸体，寻找线索。“你为什么跟着我？”她用责难的语气问道，“算了。都过去了。现在来看看这些疯子都知道些什么。”
距离幽暗洞穴最近的调查员控制放在一边的伊塔卡(失落的守卫者)。将剩余的“e/f”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
如果“伊塔卡的猎物”是玛利亚·德西瓦：
你质问玛利亚的同时，愤怒的埃兹特里战士也向她逼近。“你替谁办事？你的目的又是什么？”玛利亚双唇紧闭，然后目光看向远方，“我会把你想要知道的都告诉你，关于兄弟会的一切。”
距离玛利亚·德西瓦最近的调查员控制放在一边的伊塔卡(失落的守卫者)。将剩余的“e/f”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 伊塔卡找到了她的猎物，揭露了这个神秘的异教——但他们的最终目的是什么呢？
all_card.name: 兄弟会暴露
all_card.text: 每个“伊塔卡的猎物”所在地点上没有线索时，得到+1攻击值，+1[per_investigator]生命值，+1躲避值。 目标 - 如果所有“伊塔卡的猎物”均不在场上，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If "Ichtaca's prey" were 1 or more [[cultist]] enemies:
The final robed figure drops to the ground, and you breathe a sigh of relief. Ichtaca recovers her arrows and searches the bodies for clues. "Why did you follow me?" she asks accusingly. "No matter. What's done is done. Now to uncover what these cretins knew."
The investigator nearest to the Black Cave takes control of the set-aside Ichtaca (The Forgotten Guardian). Remove the remainder of the "e/f" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If "Ichtaca's prey" was Maria DeSilva:
You interrogate Maria while the angry Eztli warrior looms over her. "Who do you work for? What is your purpose?" Maria purses her lips tightly, then looks away, into the distance. "I'll tell you what you need to know. I'll tell you about the Brotherhood."
The investigator nearest to Maria DeSilva takes control of the set-aside Ichtaca (The Forgotten Guardian). Remove the remainder of the "e/f" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
all_card.real_flavor: Ichtaca has found target of her hunt. The mysterious cult has been revealed - but what is their ultimate purpose?
all_card.real_text: "Ichtaca's prey" each get +1 fight, +1 [per_investigator] health, and +1 evade while at a location with no clues on it. Objective - If each of "Ichtaca's prey" is no longer in play, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 维尔玛小餐馆是东城区的主要食肆——来这找点东西吃，喝上一杯浓咖啡，或是收集一些有趣的流言都再合适不过。
all_card.back_text: 东城区与维尔玛小餐馆相互连接。
all_card.flavor: 这个地方给这座无聊透顶的城市带来了一丝温暖。
all_card.name: 维尔玛小餐馆
all_card.text:
东城区与维尔玛小餐馆相互连接
[action][action][action]：你在小餐馆打发了些时间，听着周围顾客的交谈。从供应堆获得2个线索。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Velma’s is a staple of Easttown - the perfect place to find a bite to eat, a strong cup of joe, or some interesting gossip.
all_card.real_back_text: Easttown is connected to Velma's Diner.
all_card.real_flavor: A bit of warmth in an otherwise dreary town.
all_card.real_text:
Easttown is connected to Velma's Diner.
[action][action][action]: You kill some time at the diner and listen to the conversations of the patrons around you. Gain 2 clues from the token pool. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 奥利弗·托马斯名下的这间自称“珍品店”的商店坐落在北区，是一间与众不同的商店。在橱窗里展示的是一系列古怪的小饰品：例如一个铜制煤斗、一辆摇篮车、一个古董地球仪，还有一艘沉船模型。
all_card.back_text: 北区与珍品店相互连接。
all_card.flavor: 你推开商店前门时，一个铜制的铃铛叮铃铃地响了。店里尘土飞扬，杂乱无章。你查看着橱窗里非同一般的商品，胳膊上的汗毛都竖了起来。
all_card.name: 珍品店
all_card.text:
北区与珍品店相互连接。
你位于珍品店时，你打出每个[[遗物]]支援的费用减2。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Owned by Oliver Thomas, the self-styled "Curiositie Shoppe" in Northside is an unusual store. On display in the front window is a collection of odd trinkets: a brass coal scuttle, a perambulator, an antique globe, and a model sailing ship, to name just a few.
all_card.real_back_text: Northside is connected to Curiositie Shoppe.
all_card.real_flavor: A brass bell clangs as you push open the front door. Inside, the shop is dusty and disorganized. Inspecting the unusual wares on display causes the hair on your arms to stand on end.
all_card.real_text:
Northside is connected to Curiositie Shoppe.
While you are in the Curiositie Shoppe, reduce the cost of each [[relic]] asset you play by 2.

all_card.back_flavor: 阿卡姆的市政厅坐落在独立广场旁边，是一座静谧而不起眼的建筑。一座小小的钟楼从倾斜的屋顶上探出头来，由于年久失修，钟面的数字都消失了。
all_card.back_text: 商业区与市政厅相互连接。
all_card.name: 市政厅
all_card.text: 商业区与市政厅相互连接。 强制 - 在你进入市政厅后，如果你有至少4张手牌：选择并弃掉手牌，直到你只有3张手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Arkham’s town hall is a quiet, unassuming building near Independence Square. A small clock tower protrudes from the sloped rooftop, the numbers faded from years of disrepair.
all_card.real_back_text: Downtown is connected to Town Hall.
all_card.real_text: Downtown is connected to Town Hall. Forced - After you enter Town Hall, if you have 4 or more cards in your hand: Choose and discard cards from your hand until you have 3 cards in your hand.

all_card.name: 密不可泄
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。调查员每完成一个场景牌库，本次技能检定难度+1，且检定失败造成的伤害和恐惧各+1。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage and 1 horror. For each act deck the investigators have completed, this skill test gets +1 difficulty and deals +1 damage and +1 horror if it is failed.

all_card.name: 屋中无人
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。如果你所在地点没有线索，屋中无人获得涌动。 你必须花费额外1个行动来调查所附属地点。 强制 - 如果所附属地点没有线索：弃掉屋中无人。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. If there are no clues on your location, Nobody's Home gains surge. You must spend 1 additional action to investigate attached location. Forced - If there are no clues on attached location: Discard Nobody's Home.

all_card.name: 鲜血阴谋
all_card.text: 显现 - 将鲜血阴谋附属到当前密谋。 被附属的密谋得到-1毁灭阈值。 每个[[异教徒]]敌人获得：“[action]：谈判。检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定成功，从场上弃掉1张鲜血阴谋。如果你检定失败，在本敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。”
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Conspiracy of Blood to the current agenda. Attached agenda gets -1 doom threshold. Each [[cultist]] enemy gains: "[action] Parley. Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, discard 1 copy of Conspiracy of Blood from play. If you fail, place 1 doom on this enemy."

all_card.name: 伊塔卡
all_card.text: 你得到+1[combat](攻击带有胜利X的敌人时，改为+2[combat])。 你得到+1[agility](尝试躲避带有复仇X的敌人时，改为+2[agility])。 [reaction]在你将一个敌人加入胜利区后，横置伊塔卡：治愈你和伊塔卡各1点恐惧。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 埃兹特里. 旅人
all_card.real_text: You get +1 [combat] (+2 [combat] instead while attacking an enemy with Victory X). You get +1 [agility] (+2 [agility] instead while attempting to evade an enemy with Vengeance X). [reaction] After you add an enemy to the victory display, exhaust Ichtaca: You and Ichtaca each heal 1 horror.

all_card.flavor:
1925年7月12日，星期天
……我们都干了什么？
all_card.name: 探险日志
all_card.text: 在你回合期间，你可以进行额外一次行动，该行动只能用于探索。
all_card.real_flavor:
Sunday, July 12th, 1925
…What have we done?
all_card.real_text: You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to explore.

all_card.name: .35温彻斯特步枪
all_card.text: 使用(5子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。(FAQ v1.7)你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果本次攻击期间揭示了+1、0或[elder_sign]混乱标记，本次攻击造成+2伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械
all_card.real_text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If a +1, 0, or [elder_sign] chaos token is revealed during this attack, this attack deals +2 damage.

all_card.flavor: 她告诉我，当心别碰上麻烦。我翻了个白眼。麻烦事可从没消停过。
all_card.name: 安全护卫
all_card.text: [reaction]在其他调查员的回合期间，横置安全护卫：在该调查员的回合结束前，当该调查员从你所在地点移动到连接地点时，你也可以移动到该地点。
all_card.real_flavor:
Keep an eye out for any trouble, she told me.
I rolled my eyes. There was always trouble.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] During another investigator's turn, exhaust Safeguard: For the remainder of that investigator's turn, as they move from your location to a connecting location, you may move to that location as well.

all_card.name: 熟能生巧
all_card.text:
快速。在你所在地点的技能检定期间打出。
查找你牌库顶的9张卡牌，找出一张[[精通]]技能并将其投入本次技能检定(如可能)。将其余卡牌混洗回你的牌库。本次检定结束后，如果检定成功，不将该技能弃掉，改为将该技能加入你的手牌中。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play during a skill test at your location.
Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Practiced]] skill and commit it to this skill test, if able. Shuffle the remaining cards back into your deck. After this test ends, if it was successful, add that skill to your hand instead of discarding it.

all_card.flavor:
“这儿也没发现。我们还差多少没查？”
“……瞧瞧你背后这面墙？”
all_card.name: 海量研究
all_card.text:
你每有一张其它手牌，海量研究的打出费用减少1点。
发现你所在地点的2个线索。
all_card.real_flavor:
"Nothing in here, either. How many do we have left?"
"... See the wall behind you?"
all_card.real_text:
Reduce the cost to play Extensive Research by 1 for each other card in your hand.
Discover 2 clues at your location.

all_card.name: 三条A
all_card.text: 多重。 如果你将3张三条A投入到一次技能检定中，该检定自动成功(不要从混乱袋抽取混乱标记)。然后，抽取3张卡牌并获得3资源(本效果每次检定最多1次)。
all_card.real_text: Myriad. If you commit 3 copies of Three Aces to a skill test, that test automatically succeeds (do not reveal chaos tokens from the chaos bag). Then draw 3 cards and gain 3 resources (max once per test).

all_card.name: 夜盗
all_card.text: [action]横置夜盗：调查。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为获得2资源，你检定成功且每超过难度1点，额外+1资源(最多+3)。
all_card.real_text: [action] Exhaust Burglary: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, gain 2 resources, +1 additional resource for each point you succeed by (to a maximum of +3 resources).

all_card.name: 幽灵利刃
all_card.text: 攻击。本次攻击将你的[willpower]值加入你的技能值。本次攻击前，你可以立即与被攻击敌人交战。本次攻击造成+1伤害(如果该敌人非[[精英]]，改为造成+2伤害)。
all_card.real_text: Fight. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this attack. Immediately before this attack, you may engage the attacked enemy. This attack deals +1 damage (+2 damage instead if the enemy is non-[[Elite]]).

all_card.flavor: 为明视野，要有光。为暖体肤，要有热。为救灵魂，要有火。
all_card.name: 命令真言
all_card.text: 指定一张[[法术]]卡牌。查找你的牌库，找出并抽取1张指定的卡牌。混洗你的牌库。
all_card.real_flavor:
Light for the saving of our eyes.
Heat for the saving of our skin.
A spark for the saving of our souls.
all_card.real_text: Name a [[Spell]] card. Search your deck for 1 copy of the named card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

all_card.name: 月石
all_card.text: 你得到+1[willpower]和+1[agility]。 你不能从手牌中打出月石，也不能将其从手牌中投入检定。 [reaction]你从手牌中弃掉月石后：将其打出(支付其费用)。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 幻梦境
all_card.real_text: You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [agility]. You cannot play or commit Moonstone from your hand. [reaction] After you discard Moonstone from your hand: Play it (paying its cost).

all_card.name: 目力敏锐
all_card.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
将目力敏锐在基础调查行动期间投入时，其获得[intellect][intellect]和以下文本：“如果这次检定成功且超过难度至少2点，发现本地点的额外1个线索。”
all_card.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
While Sharp Vision is committed during a basic investigate action, it gains [intellect] [intellect] and the text: "If this test is successful by 2 or more, discover 1 additional clue at this location."

all_card.flavor:
“……所有生命都仅仅只是大脑中的一串图像，这些图像不管是来自真实，还是来自内在梦境，它们之间并无区别……”
——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特《银钥匙》
all_card.name: 清醒梦
all_card.text: 选择你游戏区域的一张卡牌，或揭示你的一张手牌。查找你的牌库，找出并抽取另一张该卡牌的同名卡牌。混洗你的牌库。
all_card.real_flavor: "... all life is only a set of pictures in the brain, among which there is no difference betwixt those born of real things and those born of inward dreamings..." - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Silver Key"
all_card.real_text: Choose a card in your play area or reveal a card in your hand. Search your deck for another copy of that card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X，X为你的警报等级。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败，并且你的警报等级高于你修正后的技能值，本次技能检定结束后，抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
[tablet]：-2。如果你检定失败，你的警报等级提高1级。
[elder_thing]：0。黑猫召唤了几只猫来帮你。如果在尝试躲避期间揭示本标记，并且你检定成功，对躲避的敌人造成2点伤害。
all_card.name: 月之暗面
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X，X为你警报等级的一半(向上取整)。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败，并且你的警报等级高于你修正后的技能值，本次技能检定结束后，抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
[tablet]：-1。如果你检定失败，你的警报等级提高1级。
[elder_thing]：+1。黑猫召唤了几只猫来帮你。如果在尝试躲避期间揭示本标记，并且你检定成功，对躲避的敌人造成2点伤害。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is your alarm level.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and your alarm level is higher than your modified skill value, after this skill test ends, draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1.
[elder_thing]: 0. The black cat summons several other cats to help. If this token is revealed during an evasion attempt and you succeed, deal 2 damage to the evaded enemy.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half your alarm level (rounded up).
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and your alarm level is higher than your modified skill value, after this skill test ends, draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -1. If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1.
[elder_thing]: +1. The black cat summons several other cats to help. If this token is revealed during an evasion attempt and you succeed, deal 2 damage to the evaded enemy.

all_card.back_flavor:
一声尖叫打破了这寂静，你本能地躲了起来。你之前见过它们：飞在海盗的黑色帆船旁边的，可怕的无眼怪物。它们有着恐怖的骨骼，还有像皮革一样的膜状皮肤。
它们成群盘旋在你头顶上，发出尖叫。你被发现了吗？不管如何，你都得离开这里。
all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。
每位调查员的警报等级提高1级。
all_card.flavor: 这里的寂静振聋发聩。空气中没有一丝风的呼啸，没有鸟儿的啾鸣，没有任何声音。这是没有生命的世界。你听不见把这里当作家园的野兽和海盗的声音，但你知道危险无处不在。你必须更加安静，才能不被发现。
all_card.name: 无声暗涌
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A single screech pierces the silence, and you instinctively duck for cover. You have seen these creatures before: horrid, eyeless monstrosities that fly alongside the Corsairs' black galleys. Terrible things of bone and leathery membranous skin.
A flock circles and screeches overhead. Have you been spotted? It doesn't matter. You cannot stay here any longer.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1.
all_card.real_flavor: The silence of this place is deafening. There is no wind whistling through the air, no chirping of birds, no idle sound of any kind. This is a dead world. Though you know danger lurks around every corner, you hear no sign of the beasts or the Corsairs who call this place home. You must remain even quieter in order to stay hidden.

all_card.back_flavor: 一群体态轻盈的生物包围了你，堵住了你的逃跑路线。第一眼看去，你以为它们是猫，但它们的形态只是略微像猫。你误以为它们身上带有皮毛，细看发现更像是一种古怪的丝线图案。你无声地祈求救援……
all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。 每位调查员的警报等级提高1级。
检查剧本日志。如果[[调查员强行进入神庙]]，阅读以下内容：
……但没人来救你。
调查员队长查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出1张土星猫并将其抽取。
否则，阅读以下内容：
……突然，一大群猫咪从虚空跃出，落在你身前，让你惊讶不已。你认出为首的猫咪正是你在数月之前见过的伤疤老灰猫。“快走，人类！”它大喊，“我们来对付它们！”
all_card.flavor: 时间一分一秒地过去，你脚下的步伐也越来越快，而怪物也更加疯狂地追赶着你。之前被你咒骂的寂静已被不时传来的刺耳尖叫打破，情况变得更糟了。
all_card.name: 警报响起
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your escape route is cut off as a pack of lithe creatures surrounds you. At first glance, you believe them to be cats, but they are only vaguely catlike in shape. What you mistook for fur is more akin to a series of patterns, like strange filigrees. You silently pray for aid...
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1.
Check Campaign Log. If the investigators forced their way into the temple, read the following:
...but nobody comes.
 The lead investigator searches the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Cats from Saturn and draws it.
Otherwise, read the following:
...and to your surprise, an army of cats lands in front of you, having leaped through the void of space itself. You recognize the cat at the head of the formation as the grey old cat with the scar you met months ago. "Go, human!" he yells. "We will hold them off!"
all_card.real_flavor: Your pace quickens as the creatures’ pursuit grows more frenzied with each passing minute. The silence you once cursed is broken; the awful piercing screeches that punctuate the night are even worse.

all_card.back_flavor: 你已无处可逃。
all_card.back_text:
每位调查员的警报等级提高1级。
每位调查员受到等于其警报等级一半的恐惧(向上取整)。
将密谋牌库重置到密谋3a。然后，在该密谋上放置2个毁灭标记。
all_card.flavor: 所有的月球住民倾巢而出向你袭来。不管走到哪里，不是一群海盗在等着你，就是潜伏起来的猫群，要把你赶到它们邪恶的主人面前。上方的天空满是长有翅膀的怪兽和黑色的帆船。要是找不到返回地球的方法，你必然会被它们抓走。
all_card.name: 它们是冲着你来的！
all_card.text: (提示：本密谋推进时本场游戏不会结束……但奈亚拉托提普的使徒们会收紧它们的圈套。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: There is nowhere left to run.
all_card.real_back_text:
Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1.
Each investigator takes horror equal to half their alarm level (rounded up).
Reset the agenda deck to agenda 3a. Then, place 2 doom on that agenda.
all_card.real_flavor: The entirety of the Moon’s denizens are raised against you now. Behind every corner, a group of Corsairs lies in wait, or a pack of hunting cats lurks to herd you toward its vicious masters. The skies above swarm with winged beasts and black galleys. If you cannot find a way back to Earth, you will surely be captured.
all_card.real_text: (Hint - The game will not end when this agenda advances... but the agents of Nyarlathotep will tighten their noose.)

all_card.back_flavor: 经过几小时在布满鳞片的石塔周围到处寻找，你终于在码头上看到一群戴着镣铐的俘虏，他们排成一队，不知道要被带到什么地方去。还好，只有两个邪恶的海盗负责看守。你利用声响引开他们的注意力，然后偷偷溜过去解救俘虏。
all_card.back_text: 选择位于月兽之城的一位调查员控制放在一边的维吉尔·格雷(文思泉涌))剧情支援。 检查剧本日志。如果伦道夫被俘，该卡牌的所有者将放在一边的伦道夫·卡特(梦境专家)剧情支援放入手牌。
all_card.flavor: 在这座怪异而庞大的月兽之城，维吉尔·格雷就被关在其中的某个地方。如果你想不引人注目地找到他并逃走，那么你必须保持安静，多留心眼。
all_card.name: 月兽腹地
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有位于月兽之城的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: After hours of weaving around leprous stone towers and searching high and low, you finally spot a group of shackled captives being led single file from the docks to who knows where. Luckily, they are guarded by only two of the foul Corsairs. You create a distraction loud enough to separate the pair, then sneak by in order to free the captives.
all_card.real_back_text: Choose an investigator at the City of the Moon-Beasts to take control of the set-aside Virgil Gray (Truly Inspired) story asset. Check Campaign Log: If Randolph was captured, that card's owner puts the set-aside Randolph Carter (Expert Dreamer) story asset into their hand.
all_card.real_flavor: Virgil Gray is held captive somewhere in the vast, strange city of the moon-beasts. You must be quiet and cunning if you are to find him and escape unnoticed.
all_card.real_name: In the Belly of the Moon-Beast
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators at the City of the Moon-Beasts may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
这座神庙大部分都供奉着一种被称为“月蜥”的月球生物的雕像，你还发现有文字指向月球地下，距离表面不远的地方有着某种原始的黑色粘液形成的湖泊，其连接着月球的核心。“这些文字暗示着，整个月球表面都是透过这一‘核心’连接到不同世界的。或许我们可以利用它，去到月球的另一面。”伦道夫提议道，
“或者去到死后的世界。”维吉尔补充。
“是的，只有这两种结果。”伦道夫没好气地说道，“我们也没别的选择了。”
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的月下洞穴(暗面)和黑暗月核地点放置入场。 将放在一边的月蜥以横置状态生成在黑暗月核。 将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你们已经重聚，该离开这座石塔了。伦道夫告诉你，月兽只住在这一面，所以月球的亮面应该是安全的，不受月兽的威胁。但是，距离那里实在太过遥远，无法徒步到达。你们需要寻找别的办法逃离。
all_card.name: 月上探索
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有位于月蜥神庙的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
While the majority of this temple is dedicated to an idol the moon-dwelling creatures refer to as the "Moon Lizard," you also find several references to some kind of lake of primordial black ooze not far beneath the surface, that binds together the core of the Moon. "These texts imply that the whole of the Moon's surface is connected by this 'core' across multiple dimensions. Perhaps we can use it to cross over to the Moon's other side," Randolph suggests.
"Or to the afterlife," Virgil adds.
"Yes, one or the other," Randolph replies nonchalantly. "It is still our only option."
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Caverns Beneath the Moon (Dark Side) and The Black Core locations into play. Spawn the set-aside Moon Lizard at The Black Core, exhausted. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: Now that you are reunited, it is time to get off this rock. Randolph informs you that the light side of the Moon should be safe from the reach of the moon-beasts, who dwell only on this side. However, it is much too far for you to walk on foot. You’ll have to find another way to escape.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators at the Temple of the Moon Lizard may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 月球表面以下的黑水湖有几英里宽，里面充满了温热的有毒气体。绝大部分的湖床完全都是固态，有那么一瞬间，你觉得伦道夫的计划走进了死胡同。随后，你踏下一步，接着你的脚接触到的是……虚无。你还没反应过来，就被猛地拉到了湖面下方。你试图大喊，提醒你的同伴，但你的声音彷佛和你的身体一起，被这黑暗月核吞没。你肺部的空气几乎被完全挤出。一股猛烈的底流把你卷走，你拼命忍着不发出尖叫。当你终于浮出水面，你发现自己所在的地方和你来时的一样，除了能看到一束光刺穿上方的地壳。过了一会，你的其他同伴也出来了。“我们成功了吗？”维吉尔问，“啊？我还以为一切都结束了呢。这一段写出来肯定十分刺激！”
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的月下洞穴(亮面)、月之亮面、白船地点放置入场。
all_card.flavor: 你打消内心的疑虑，来到月球的地壳之下。为了到月球的另一面去，你必须穿过月球的黑暗月核，那里的液体跨越维度，孕育着噩梦。
all_card.name: 月之核心
all_card.text: 黑暗月核的线索只能通过调查成功来发现，其他方式均不能发现。 目标 - 如果每位幸存的调查员都位于黑暗月核，且黑暗月核没有线索，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The lake of black ichor below the surface of the Moon is miles wide and bubbles with warm, noxious pockets of gas. Most of the lake bed is completely solid, and it seems for a moment that Randolph's plan is a dead end after all. Then, you take a final step, and your foot is caught by... nothing. Before you can react, you are yanked under the surface. You try to shout a warning to your companions, but your words are swallowed by the black core, along with the rest of your body. Your lungs barely have air. You struggle not to scream as you are carried by a fierce undertow. When you finally emerge, you are in another chamber just like the one you came from, only you can see a shaft of light piercing through the grey crust above you. Moments later, the rest of your party emerges. "Did we make it?" Virgil asks. "Why, I thought that was the end, for sure. This will make for an exciting chapter!"
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Caverns Beneath the Moon (Light Side), Light Side of the Moon, and The White Ship locations into play.
all_card.real_flavor: You suspend your disbelief and descend beneath the Moon’s crust. In order to reach the other side of the Moon, you must make your way though its black core, a transdimensional fluid from which nightmares are born.
all_card.real_text: Clues cannot be discovered from The Black Core except as a result of a successful investigation. Objective - If each surviving investigator is at The Black Core and it has no clues on it, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你们一行人顺利登上了白船后，你恳求白船的船长马上驶离月球。如果可以，你一秒也不想再待在这个充满危险的地方。“现在还不行。”船长亲切地笑着说道。你一再苦苦哀求，但他举手示意你安静，同时眺望远方。你眯着眼睛迎着阳光望去，太阳就静静地悬挂在漆黑的天穹上。就在几英里以外，你看到是什么东西吸引了船长的目光：那是一只有着许多翅膀、色彩丰富的鸟，它身上的羽毛十分鲜亮。它停在一处残破的石质建筑上，整理着自己的羽毛。然后，就在你快要失去耐心的时候，它直直冲上了太空，船长也随之拉起了船锚。
all_card.flavor: 在月球的亮面，许多船只在无风的空中航行，巡逻表面情况。但是，其中一艘船和其他船只不一样。它的船身光秃秃的，闪闪发亮，在黑夜里发出一道白光。“白船！”伦道夫惊叹道。
all_card.name: 意外救援
all_card.text: 目标 - 设法离开月球。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: With your party safely aboard the White Ship, you beseech its captain to leave the Moon at once. You have no desire to stay in this perilous place any longer than you have to. "Not yet," the captain replies with an amiable smile. You plead with him, but he raises a hand in a gesture of silence, peering out into the distance. You squint against the light from the sun, which hangs static in the dark sky. There, miles away, you spot the thing that drew the captain's eye: a bird with many wings and even more colors, its feathers bright and vivid. It perches on a ruined stone structure and preens itself. Then, just as your patience is beginning to wear thin, it launches itself into space, and the captain pulls up the ship's anchor.
all_card.real_flavor: The surface of the light side of the Moon is patrolled by ships that sail through the windless sky. One, however, looks different from the rest. Its hull is stark and shining, casting a white glow into the night. "The White Ship!" breathes Randolph.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find a way off the Moon. (You will be instructed when to advance.)

all_card.name: 月兽帆船
all_card.text: 调查员不能通过玩家卡牌的效果进入或离开月兽帆船。 [free]如果月兽帆船上没有线索：将其翻面。 强制 - 当一轮结束时，如果场上有至少3个毁灭标记：将月兽帆船翻面。
all_card.real_text: Investigators cannot enter or leave Moon-Beast Galley via player card effects. [fast] If there are no clues remaining on Moon-Beast Galley: Flip it over. Forced - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more doom in play: Flip Moon-Beast Galley over.

all_card.name: 下船
all_card.text:
如果本卡牌翻面时已没有线索，阅读以下内容：
你尽量轻声走动，找到拴在船侧的一艘小艇，艇里还留了两把船桨。如果帆船能够靠桨穿越太空，那么这艘救生艇也一定可以。你确保不发出声响，轻轻地跳进救生艇里逃走。
弃掉位于本地点的所有敌人。将本地点的每位调查员移动到月之森林。 将本卡牌从游戏中移除，弃掉位于本地点的所有敌人。
如果本卡牌翻面时有至少1个线索，阅读以下内容：
这艘船在一座由无数石塔形成的巨大城市靠岸，你趁着守卫还在搜寻你的时候溜走了。
本地点的每位调查员的警报等级提高1级。 将本地点的每位调查员和每个敌人移动到月兽之城。 将本卡牌从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_text:
If there were no clues on this card when it was flipped, read the following:
Moving as stealthily as you can, you find a dinghy tied to the side of the ship, two oars left inside. If this galley can move through space using oars, surely this lifeboat can, too. Making sure to stay as quiet as possible, you hop inside the small boat and make your escape.
 Discard each enemy here. Move each investigator here to the Moon-Forest. Remove this card from the game.
If there were 1 or more clues on this card when it was flipped, read the following:
The ship docks at a great city of stone towers, and you slip away as the guards search for you.
Each investigator here raises their alarm level by 1. Move each investigator here to the City of the Moon-Beasts, along with each enemy here. Remove this card from the game.

all_card.back_flavor: “前方逐渐升起了一片嶙峋的海岸，上面有着高低参差的群山，卡特看到了一座城市，那里有着令人不安的灰色高塔。它们倾斜而弯曲，林立丛聚，每座塔上都没有窗户，这让即将被关押的囚徒感到十分不安……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 月兽之城
all_card.text: X为所有调查员之中最高的警报等级。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：位于月兽之城的每位调查员检定[agility](2)。检定失败的每位调查员必须将自己的警报等级提高1级。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "There presently rose ahead the jagged hills of a leprous-looking coast, and Carter saw the thick unpleasant grey towers of a city. The way they leaned and bent, the manner in which they were clustered, and the fact that they had no windows at all, was very disturbing to the prisoner..." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: X is the highest alarm level among all investigators. Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator at the City of the Moon-Beasts tests [agility] (2). Each investigator who fails must raise their alarm level by 1.

all_card.back_flavor: “船逐渐向月球的边缘驶去，卡特很快就明白目的地正是月球总是背向地球的那一面，它无比神秘，除了入梦者斯尼瑞斯·寇，从来没有人类见过。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 漆黑深坑
all_card.text: [action]：检定[intellect](5)以躲在坑里。如果你检定成功，你的警报等级下降1级。(每场游戏仅限1次成功。) 强制 - 当你的回合结束时，如果你位于漆黑深坑，并且你在本回合发现了其上的至少1个线索：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，你的警报等级提高1级。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "The ship made for the edge, and it soon became clear that its destination was that secret and mysterious side which is always turned away from the earth, and which no fully human person, save perhaps the dreamer Snireth-Ko, has ever beheld." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (5) to hide within the crater. If you succeed, reduce your alarm level by 1. (Limit 1 success per game.) Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are at The Dark Crater and have discovered 1 or more of its clues this turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1.

all_card.back_flavor: “群山之上的神庙遗迹矗立在特定的位置，使得它们只能用来供奉邪神，或者德不配位之神，而在那些破碎立柱呈现的对称性中，似乎也隐含着某些不希望被人解明的深层黑暗含义。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 月蜥神庙
all_card.text: [action]：检定[willpower](5)以躲在禁闭的神庙里。如果你检定成功，你的警报等级下降1级。(每场游戏仅限1次成功。) 强制 - 你发现月蜥神庙的任意数量的线索后：你必须受到相同数量的恐惧，或弃掉相同数量的手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "The dead temples on the mountains were so placed that they could have glorified no wholesome or suitable gods, and in the symmetries of the broken columns there seemed to lurk some dark and inner meaning which did not invite solution." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] (5) to hide inside the forbidden temple. If you succeed, reduce your alarm level by 1. (Limit 1 success per game.) Forced - After you discover any number of clues at the Temple of the Moon Lizard: You must either take that much horror or discard that many cards from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: “当靠近海岸线时，那座城市散发出的可怕恶臭变得愈发强烈。同时，他还看到高低参差的群山上的大片森林，其中一些树木与地球上的魔幻森林里孤零零的月树显然有着相同的渊源，棕色的小祖格鼠正是用这种树木的汁液来酿造它们那奇特的美酒。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 月之森林
all_card.text: [action]：检定[agility](5)以藏身在怪异的森林中。如果你检定成功，你的警报等级下降1级。(每场游戏仅限1次成功。) [free]在你回合期间(行动外)：躲避。如果你检定失败，你的警报等级提高1级。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: "As the coast drew nearer, and the hideous stench of that city grew stronger, he saw upon the jagged hills many forests, some of whose trees he recognised as akin to that solitary moon-tree in the enchanted wood of earth, from whose sap the small brown zoogs ferment their peculiar wine." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [agility] (5) to hide among the strange trees. If you succeed, reduce your alarm level by 1. (Limit 1 success per game.) [fast] During your turn, except during another action: Evade. If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: “……而在月球山脉上遥远的某座不洁的尖峰之上，蠕行混沌奈亚拉托提普正在那里的洞穴徒劳地等待着。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 月下洞穴
all_card.text: 强制 - 你调查月下洞穴时技能检定失败后：其隐藏值-2，直到你回合结束。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "...while in a black cave on a far unhallowed summit of the moon-mountains still vainly waited the crawling chaos Nyarlathotep." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Caverns Beneath the Moon: Until the end of your turn, reduce its shroud by 2.

all_card.back_flavor: 当你越来越接近月球的黑暗核心，厚厚的黑色淤泥开始阻碍你前进……
all_card.back_text: 通往月球核心的道路漫长而曲折。月下洞穴 (暗面)上有线索时，你不能进入黑暗月核。
all_card.name: 黑暗月核
all_card.text: X为黑暗月核上的深度标记数量。 强制 - 黑暗月核揭示后：在其上放置3资源作为深度标记，再加上额外3[per_investigator]个深度标记。 [action]：检定[willpower](2)或[combat](2)来游过月核的黑水湖。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，移除黑暗月核的1个深度标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A thick black sludge begins to impede your progress as you draw nearer and nearer to the Moon’s dark core...
all_card.real_back_text: The path to the Moon's core is long and winding. You cannot enter The Black Core while Caverns Beneath the Moon (Dark Side) has clues on it.
all_card.real_text: X is the number of depth tokens on The Black Core. Forced - After The Black Core is revealed: Place 3 resources on it, as depth tokens, plus an additional 3 [per_investigator] depth tokens. [action]: Test [willpower] (2) or [combat] (2) to swim through the dark lake at the Moon's core. For each point you succeed by, remove 1 depth token from The Black Core.

all_card.back_flavor: “群山之上的神庙遗迹矗立在特定的位置，使得它们只能用来供奉邪神，或者德不配位之神……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 月下洞穴
all_card.text: 强制 - 你调查月下洞穴时技能检定失败后：其隐藏值-2，直到你回合结束。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "The dead temples on the mountains were so placed that they could have glorified no wholesome or suitable gods..." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Caverns Beneath the Moon: Until the end of your turn, reduce its shroud by 2.

all_card.back_text: 通往月球表面的道路漫长而曲折。月下洞穴(亮面)上有线索时，你不能进入月之亮面。
all_card.flavor: “……而在那些破碎立柱呈现的对称性中，似乎也隐含着某些不希望被人解明的深层黑暗含义。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 月之亮面
all_card.text: [action]：检定[intellect](1)或[agility](1)以藏身在废墟之中。你检定成功且每超过难度3点，你的警报等级下降1级。(每轮仅限1次成功。)
all_card.real_back_text: The path to the Moon's surface is long and winding. You cannot enter Light Side of the Moon while Caverns Beneath the Moon (Light Side) has clues on it.
all_card.real_flavor: "...in the symmetries of the broken columns there seemed to lurk some dark and inner meaning which did not invite solution." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (1) or [agility] (1) to attempt to hide among the ruins. For every 3 points you succeed by, reduce your alarm level by 1. (Limit one success per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: “……它总是平稳而无声地滑行着，远远就能看到它的船帆，还有那规律地摆动着的奇怪长桨。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《白船》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 这艘神秘帆船的船长不允许你登船，除非追赶你的月兽均已撤退。你的警报等级至少为5时，你不能进入白船。
all_card.name: 白船
all_card.text: 你的警报等级至少为5时，你不能进入白船。 强制 - 白船揭示后：将放在一边的船长剧情支援放置入场，位于白船。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "...it would always glide smoothly and silently, its sails distant and its long strange tiers of oars moving rhythmically." - H. P. Lovecraft, "The White Ship"
all_card.real_back_text: The mysterious ship's captain cannot let you board until the pursuing moon-beasts have retreated. You cannot enter The White Ship while your alarm level is 5 or higher.
all_card.real_text: You cannot enter The White Ship while your alarm level is 5 or higher. Forced - After The White Ship is revealed: Put the set-aside The Captain story asset into play at The White Ship.

all_card.name: 维吉尔·格雷
all_card.text: [reaction]你的警报等级提高后：抽取1张卡牌，获得1资源，或治愈维吉尔·格雷的1点恐惧。如果游戏中有超过1位调查员，将维吉尔·格雷的控制权交给另一位调查员。 强制 - 如果维吉尔·格雷离场：将他从游戏中移除。(FAQ v2.0)
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After your alarm level is raised: Either draw 1 card, gain 1 resource, or heal 1 horror from Virgil Gray. If there is more than 1 investigator in the game, give control of Virgil Gray to another investigator. Forced - If Virgil Gray leaves play: Remove him from the game.

all_card.name: 船长
all_card.text: [action]如果每位未被击败的调查员都位于白船：谈判。检定[willpower](X)或[intellect](X)以说服船长启航。X为所有调查员之中最高的警报等级。如果你检定成功，推进场景。位于白船的任意调查员都可以激活此能力。
all_card.real_text: [action] If each undefeated investigator is at The White Ship: Parley. Test [willpower] (X) or [intellect] (X) to convince the captain to set sail. X is the highest alarm level among the investigators. If you succeed, advance the act. Any investigator at The White Ship may activate this ability.

all_card.name: 月蜥
all_card.text:
猎手。
月蜥只能进入[[洞穴]]地点。
月蜥与调查员交战时，X为该调查员的警报等级。否则，X为5。
all_card.real_text:
Hunter.
Moon Lizard can only enter [[Cave]] locations.
While Moon Lizard is engaged with an investigator, X is that investigator's alarm level. Otherwise, X is 5.

all_card.name: 月之拜亚基
all_card.text: 生成 - 最近的[[月面]]地点。 猎物 - 警报等级最高(并且至少为3)。 警戒。猎手。 月之拜亚基移动或交战时，其忽略警报等级小于等于2的调查员。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Nearest [[Surface]] location. Prey - Highest alarm level (3 or more only). Alert. Hunter. While moving or engaging, Moonbound Byakhee ignores investigators with an alarm level of 2 or less.

all_card.name: 土星猫
all_card.text: 猎手。蜂拥X。 X为你的警报等级(如果此时非调查阶段，则X为所有调查员之中最高的警报等级)。 强制 - 土星猫的头领移动或被躲避后：弃掉其1张蜂拥卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Swarming X. X is your alarm level (or the highest alarm level among investigators if there is no active investigator). Forced - After the host Cats from Saturn moves or is evaded: Discard 1 of its swarm cards.

all_card.name: 月兽
all_card.text: 反击。 强制 - 月兽入场后：每位调查员的警报等级提高1级。 强制 - 你击败月兽后：每位调查员的警报等级下降1级。
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. Forced - After Moon-Beast enters play: Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1. Forced - After you defeat Moon-Beast: Reduce each investigator's alarm level by 1.

all_card.flavor: 你的心脏在胸口里砰砰直跳。你摒住呼吸，一动不动，祈祷自已不被人发现。
all_card.name: 严密监视
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，你必须弃掉你控制的印刷费用最高的支援，或将你的警报等级提高1级。
all_card.real_flavor: Your heart pounds in your chest. You hold your breath, keep perfectly still, and pray they cannot see you.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, you must either discard the asset you control with the highest printed cost, or raise your alarm level by 1.

all_card.name: 被迫藏身
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](X)，其中X为你的警报等级。 - 如果你检定失败，失去1个行动。 - 如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，改为失去2个行动。 - 如果你检定失败且低于难度至少5点，改为失去3个行动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is your alarm level. - If you fail, lose 1 action. - If you fail by 3 or more, lose 2 actions instead. - If you fail by 5 or more, lose 3 actions instead.

all_card.name: 月球巡逻
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 [action]：检定[agility](3)以避开巡逻。如果你检定成功，弃掉月球巡逻。 强制 - 在一位调查员离开附属地点时：该调查员的警报等级提高1级。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. [action]: Test [agility] (3) to lose the patrol. If you succeed, discard Lunar Patrol. Forced - When an investigator leaves attached location: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.

all_card.name: 梦中苏醒
all_card.text:
每场游戏开始时，将梦中苏醒放在密谋牌库旁边，并在其上放置1个毁灭标记。
[action]：检定任意技能(2)。本次检定难度+1[per_investigator]。如果你检定成功，将梦中苏醒从游戏中移除。任意调查员均可以触发本能力。
all_card.real_text:
False Awakening begins each game next to the agenda deck, with 1 doom on it.
[action]: Test any skill (2). This test gets +1 [per_investigator] difficulty. If you succeed, remove False Awakening from the game. Any investigator may trigger this ability.

all_card.name: 英勇救援
all_card.text:
快速。在一个非[[精英]]敌人将要攻击你所在地点或连接地点的另一位调查员时打出。
如果你此时不在该地点，你移动到该地点。改为你与该敌人交战并对你结算它的攻击。然后，对其造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when a non-[[Elite]] enemy would attack another investigator at your location or a connecting location.
Move to that location if you are not already there. Engage that enemy and resolve its attack against you instead. Then, deal it 1 damage.

all_card.name: 领导力
all_card.text:
领导力投入到另一位调查员执行的技能检定中时，领导力获得[willpower][wild]。
如果本次检定成功，获得2资源。如果领导力投入到另一位调查员执行的技能检定，该调查员也获得2资源。
all_card.real_text:
While Leadership is committed to a skill test being performed by another investigator, Leadership gains [willpower] [wild].
If this test is successful, gain 2 resources. If Leadership is committed to a skill test being performed by another investigator, that investigator also gains 2 resources.

all_card.name: 梦境日记
all_card.text: 研究完成。(FAQ v2.0) 你在隐藏值至少为4的地点时，你的梦的本质获得[wild][wild]。 [reaction]在你回合开始时：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出梦的本质，将其加入你的手牌。
all_card.traits: 道具. 书籍. 守护
all_card.real_text:
Researched.
While you are at a location with at least 4 shroud, your Essence of the Dream gains [wild][wild].
[reaction] When your turn begins: Search your bonded cards for Essence of the Dream and add it to your hand.

all_card.name: 梦境日记
all_card.text: 研究完成。(FAQ v2.0) 你与敌人交战时，你的梦的本质获得[wild][wild]。 [reaction]在你回合开始时：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出梦的本质，将其加入你的手牌。
all_card.traits: 道具. 书籍. 守护
all_card.real_text:
Researched.
While you are engaged with an enemy, your Essence of the Dream gains [wild][wild].
[reaction] When your turn begins: Search your bonded cards for Essence of the Dream and add it to your hand.

all_card.name: 梦境日记
all_card.text: 研究完成。(FAQ v2.0) 你有至少8张手牌时，你的梦的本质获得[wild][wild]。 [reaction]在你回合开始时：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出梦的本质，将其加入你的手牌。
all_card.traits: 道具. 书籍. 守护
all_card.real_text:
Researched.
While you have at least 8 cards in hand, your Essence of the Dream gains [wild][wild].
[reaction] When your turn begins: Search your bonded cards for Essence of the Dream and add it to your hand.

all_card.name: 快手
all_card.text: 每位调查员仅限1张。 [reaction]你连续执行同一种行动两次后，横置快手：再执行一次该种行动(行动种类包括激活、交战、躲避、攻击、调查、移动、打出、资源和抽取)。
all_card.real_text: Limit 1 per investigator. [reaction] After you perform the same type of action twice in a row, exhaust Haste: Take another action of that type again (types include activate, engage, evade, fight, investigate, move, play, resource, and draw).

all_card.flavor: “你是个疯子，温妮！”“我知道！这难道不是件好事吗？”
all_card.name: 虎口拔牙
all_card.text: 你将虎口拔牙投入到一次技能检定后，从你牌库顶揭示卡牌，直到揭示一张能够投入本次检定的[rogue]技能卡牌。将其投入。将其他每张已揭示的卡牌混洗回你的牌库。
all_card.real_flavor:
"You're a maniac, Wini!"
"I know! Isn't it wonderful?"
all_card.real_text: After you commit Daredevil to a skill test, reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a [rogue] skill you can commit to this test. Commit it. Shuffle each other revealed card back into your deck.

all_card.name: 增强自我
all_card.text: 多重。每套牌库仅限1张增强自我(毅力)。 最多3张增强自我卡牌共占1个法术槽位。 每当有卡牌效果要求你不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]，你可以忽略这类效果。 [free]横置增强自我：你本次检定得到+2[combat]。
all_card.real_text: Myriad. Limit 1 Empower Self (Stamina) per deck. Up to 3 Empower Self cards take up a single arcane slot. Anytime a card effect requires you to use [willpower] instead of [combat], you may ignore that aspect of the effect. [fast] Exhaust Empower Self: You get +2 [combat] for this test.

all_card.name: 增强自我
all_card.text: 多重。每套牌库仅限1张增强自我(迅捷)。 最多3张增强自我卡牌共占1个法术槽位。 每当有卡牌效果要求你不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]，你可以忽略这类效果。 [free]横置增强自我：你本次检定得到+2[agility]。
all_card.real_text: Myriad. Limit 1 Empower Self (Alacrity) per deck. Up to 3 Empower Self cards take up a single arcane slot. Anytime a card effect requires you to use [willpower] instead of [agility], you may ignore that aspect of the effect. [fast] Exhaust Empower Self: You get +2 [agility] for this test.

all_card.name: 增强自我
all_card.text: 多重。每套牌库仅限1张增强自我(敏锐)。 最多3张增强自我卡牌共占1个法术槽位。 每当有卡牌效果要求你不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]，你可以忽略这类效果。 [free]横置增强自我：你本次检定得到+2[intellect]。
all_card.real_text: Myriad. Limit 1 Empower Self (Acuity) per deck. Up to 3 Empower Self cards take up a single arcane slot. Anytime a card effect requires you to use [willpower] instead of [intellect], you may ignore that aspect of the effect. [fast] Exhaust Empower Self: You get +2 [intellect] for this test.

all_card.flavor: “有时……我会希望我永远都不要回到这个世界来。”
all_card.name: 特薇拉·凯瑟琳·普莱斯
all_card.text: [reaction]你花费[[法术]]支援的至少1充能后，横置特薇拉·凯瑟琳·普莱斯：在该支援上放置1充能。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 艺术家. 入梦者
all_card.real_flavor: "Sometimes, this world... I wish I never came back."
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you spend 1 or more charges from a [[Spell]] asset, exhaust Twila Katherine Price: Place 1 charge on that asset.

all_card.name: 希望微光
all_card.text: 多重。 希望微光只能从你的弃牌堆打出。 将你弃牌堆中的所有希望微光加入你的手牌(包括本卡牌)。
all_card.real_text: Myriad. A Glimmer of Hope can only be played from your discard pile. Add all copies of A Glimmer of Hope in your discard pile to your hand (including this copy).

all_card.name: 迅速撤退
all_card.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
将迅速撤退在基础躲避行动期间投入时，其获得[agility][agility]和以下文本：“如果本次检定成功且超过难度至少2点，你可以自动躲避你所在地点的另一个敌人。”
all_card.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
While Expeditious Retreat is committed during a basic evade action, it gains [agility][agility] and the text: "If this test is successful by 2 or more, you may automatically evade another enemy at your location."

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为本卡牌上的伤害数量+1。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败，本次技能检定结束后，抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
[tablet]：0。黑猫带你走出了死亡之火。如果调查期间揭示本标记且你检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少2点，选择你所在地点或连接地点的一个重整状态的敌人。该敌人移动到你的地点，与你交战并立即进行一次攻击。
all_card.name: 无归之地
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为本卡牌上的伤害数量。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败，本次技能检定结束后，抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
[tablet]：+1。黑猫带你走出了死亡之火。如果调查期间揭示本标记且你检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少2点，选择你所在地点或连接地点的一个重整状态的敌人。该敌人移动到你的地点，与你交战并立即进行一次攻击。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the amount of damage on this card.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, after this skill test ends, draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: 0. The black cat helps you navigate through the death-fire. If this token is revealed during an investigation and you succeed, draw 1 card.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail by 2 or more, choose a ready enemy at your location or a connecting location. That enemy moves to your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the amount of damage on this card.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, after this skill test ends, draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: +1. The black cat helps you navigate through the death-fire. If this token is revealed during an investigation and you succeed, draw 1 card.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail by 2 or more, choose a ready enemy at your location or a connecting location. That enemy moves to your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.

all_card.back_flavor: 你突然感到一阵疼痛和反胃，在那一瞬间，彷佛现实的结构分崩离析。这感觉很快消失，但显然有些不对劲。
all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。
在冒险参考卡牌上放置1个伤害标记。
all_card.flavor: 地下世界是个如同洞穴般的国度，和地上的世界相比截然不同。这里的顶部是那么的遥远，像是乌云密布的天空。每个洞穴的墙壁被看不到光源的灰色闪光朦朦胧胧地照亮。你漫步在扭曲的地下墓穴中，寻找着前进的方向，但也一直觉得有什么东西正在跟踪自己。
all_card.name: 邪恶国度
all_card.real_back_flavor: A sudden wave of pain and nausea passes over you, and for a brief moment, it seems the very fabric of reality is tearing apart. The feeling passes quickly, but it's obvious that something is not quite right.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Place 1 damage on the scenario reference card.
all_card.real_flavor: The Underworld is a cavernous realm, almost another world unto itself. Its ceiling is so far in the distance that it might as well be a somber, overcast sky. The walls of the caverns are dimly lit by a flickering grey light with no apparent source. You wander through the twisting catacombs in search of the way forward, but you can't shake the feeling that you're being followed.

all_card.back_flavor: 当你周围的一切都在移动和扭曲，你再次被一股不安的感觉所动摇。这次的能量比之前的更为强烈，似乎是从地下世界至深处的漆黑之海传来的。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员必须随机弃掉其1张手牌，或失去2资源。 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。 在冒险参考卡牌上放置1个伤害标记。然后： - 如果冒险参考卡牌上的伤害数大于等于5，进入(→结局2)。 - 否则，将本密谋翻面。
all_card.flavor: 随着你继续探索，地下世界的生物彷佛受到某些无形力量的驱使，它们变得不安，开始追猎你。
all_card.name: 怪物围困
all_card.text: (提示：本密谋推进时本场游戏不会结束……但现实的结构会进一步崩解。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Again you are shaken by a sudden feeling of instability as reality shifts and bends around you. The wave is more intense than before, and it seems to originate from the Sea of Pitch in the depths of the Underworld.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator must either discard 1 card at random from their hand or lose 2 resources. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Place 1 damage on the scenario reference card. Then: - If there are 5 or more damage tokens on the scenario reference card, proceed to (→R2). - Otherwise, flip this agenda back over.
all_card.real_flavor: As you continue to explore, the creatures of the Underworld grow agitated and begin to pursue you, as if compelled by some unseen force.
all_card.real_text: (Hint - The game will not necessarily end when this agenda advances... but the stability of reality will continue to unravel.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你惊慌失措地向食尸鬼讲述你们的遭遇。它一听到“伦道夫·卡特”的名字，态度便发生了变化。它连忙问伦道夫发生了什么事，你便把这位朋友的凄惨命运说与它听。听后，它陷入了悲伤的情绪。它说自己名叫理查德·皮克曼，从前与伦道夫是朋友。它答应放你过去，但在那之前它提醒你：地下世界正发生许多异象。它说，有黑暗力量正通过食尸鬼平原下方的山谷扩散，阴险的织网者正沿着洞穴墙壁爬行，还有可怕的嚎叫声穿透这整个地下世界。它语无伦次地解释着，所有这些异象都源于一个地方：地下世界最深处的漆黑之海。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的每张[[山谷]]地点放置入场。 找出食尸鬼遭遇组和恐惧打击遭遇组的每张卡牌(即便它们位于场外)。将其从游戏中移除。 将放在一边的恐怖谷与夜魇遭遇组和遭遇弃牌堆一同混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你已经顺利来到幻梦境，但眼前的情景却和你预想的完全不同。你处在地下世界，你需要花些功夫，弄明白自己在这险境之中所处的方位。
all_card.name: 进入地下世界(版本一)
all_card.text: 强制 - 击败带有线索的敌人后：控制该敌人的所有线索。 目标 - 探索这片区域。 (要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You launch into a panicked explanation of everything that's happened to you. When the ghoul hears the name "Randolph Carter," his demeanor changes. He asks what has become of Randolph, and you tell him of his friend's fate. Sadness overcomes the creature. He introduces himself as Richard Pickman, and tells you that Randolph was once his friend. He agrees to let you pass in peace, but not before giving you a warning: strange happenings have been occurring within the Underworld. He tells of dark forces spreading throughout the vale below the Plain of the Ghouls, of vile weavers that crawl along the cavern walls, and of a terrible howling cry that penetrates throughout the realm. All of it, he explains in gibbering speech, emanates from one place: an ocean of pitch in the realm's deepest layer.
all_card.real_back_text: Put each set-aside [[Vale]] location into play. Find each card from the Ghouls encounter set and the Striking Fear encounter set (even if they are out of play). Remove them from the game. Shuffle the set-aside Terror of the Vale and Nightgaunts encounter sets into the encounter deck, along with the discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: You have succeeded in reaching the Dreamlands, but this is not quite what you expected. You are in the Underworld, and it will take some work to find your bearings in this sinister place.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After an enemy with 1 or more clues on it is defeated: Take control of each of those clues. Objective - Explore this region. (You will be instructed when to advance.)

all_card.back_flavor: 那食尸鬼走近时，伦道夫认出了它，叫了一声。他和那食尸鬼握了握手，聊了一会儿，然后把它介绍给你：“这是我之前跟你说过的食尸鬼。它是我的老朋友，它答应做我们在地下世界的向导了。但它带来了一些可怕的消息……”伦道夫继续说明：地下世界里发生了许多异象。它说，有黑暗力量正通过食尸鬼平原下方的山谷扩散，阴险的织网者正沿着洞穴墙壁爬行，还有可怕的嚎叫声穿透这整个地下世界。他说，所有这些异象都源于一个地方：地下世界最深处的漆黑之海。
all_card.back_text: 选择一位调查员控制放在一边的理查德·厄普顿·皮克曼剧情支援。本场冒险剩余时间内，如果理查德·厄普顿·皮克曼离场，将其从游戏中移除。 将放在一边的每张[[山谷]]地点放置入场。 找出恐惧打击遭遇组的每张卡牌(即便它们位于场外)。将其从游戏中移除。 将放在一边的恐怖谷与夜魇遭遇组和遭遇弃牌堆一同混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你已经顺利来到幻梦境，但眼前的情景却和你预想的完全不同。你处在地下世界，你需要花些功夫，弄明白自己在这险境之中所处的方位。
all_card.name: 进入地下世界(版本二)
all_card.text: 强制 - 击败带有线索的敌人后：控制该敌人的所有线索。 目标 - 找到理查德·厄普顿·皮克曼。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Randolph gives a shout of recognition as the ghoul approaches. He and the creature shake hands and converse for a short while, after which he introduces you. "This is the ghoul I spoke to you about. He is an old friend of mine, and he has offered to guide us through the Underworld. He has some dire news, however..." Randolph goes on to explain: strange happenings have been occurring within the Underworld. He tells of dark forces spreading throughout the vale below the Plain of the Ghouls, of vile weavers that crawl along the cavern walls, and of a terrible howling cry that penetrates throughout the realm. All of it, he says, emanates from one place: an ocean of pitch in the realm's deepest layer.
all_card.real_back_text: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Richard Upton Pickman story asset. For the remainder of the scenario, if Richard Upton Pickman leaves play, remove him from the game. Put each set-aside [[Vale]] location into play. Find each card from the Striking Fear encounter set (even if they are out of play). Remove them from the game. Shuffle the set-aside Terror of the Vale and Nightgaunts encounter sets into the encounter deck, along with the discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: You have succeeded in reaching the Dreamlands, but this is not quite what you expected. You are in the Underworld, and it will take some work to find your bearings in this sinister place.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After an enemy with 1 or more clues on it is defeated: Take control of each of those clues. Objective - Find Richard Upton Pickman. (You will be instructed when to advance.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你走到石墙的另一边的过程中，洞变得越来越窄。当你终于从洞口出来时，你发现自己来到了海岸上，前方是柏油般漆黑的宽广大海。发光的紫色能量网在海面蔓延，让你心中充满恐惧，忐忑不安。这和你在圣玛丽医院里目睹的恐怖景象有关吗？正当你思考下一步该怎么做的时候，你发现有几艘黑色的小木艇停泊在附近的一处小湾。每艘小艇的船身上都刻着一个怪异的标志。这些小艇的出现是上天的旨意，还是巧合？不管是前者还是后者，你都决定要越过这片大海，追寻这疯狂的来源。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的每张[[深海]]地点放置入场。 将放在一边的深入漆黑之海与阿特拉克·纳克亚的使徒遭遇组和遭遇弃牌堆一同混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 前往山谷下方的道路充满了危险。你需要从皮克曼口中的“食尸鬼峭壁”往下爬，那里是食尸鬼丢弃它们骇人的食物残渣的地方。你只能想象那里有多深。
all_card.name: 深入
all_card.text: 强制 - 击败带有线索的敌人后：控制该敌人的所有线索。 目标 - 找到前往漆黑之海的道路。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The hole becomes narrower and narrower as you make your way through to the other side of the stone wall. When you finally emerge, you find yourself at the shores of an enormous ocean of pitch-black tar. Webs of glowing, violet energy spread across its surface, filling you with an uneasy dread. Could this be related to the horrors you witnessed in St. Mary's Hospital? Just as you are beginning to wonder what to do next, you discover several rowboats of black wood moored in a nearby cove. The hull of each is carved with a strange insignia. Is this luck, or providence? Either way, you are determined to set off across the sea and trace this madness to its source.
all_card.real_back_text: Put each set-aside [[Depths]] location into play. Shuffle the set-aside Descent into the Pitch and Agents of Atlach-Nacha encounter sets into the encounter deck, along with the discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: The way to the vale below is treacherous. You will have to climb down from a place Pickman calls "the Crag of the Ghouls," where the creatures cast the discarded remains of their macabre meals. You can only imagine what the depths might be like.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After an enemy with 1 or more clues on it is defeated: Take control of each of those clues. Objective - Find the way to the Sea of Pitch. (You will be instructed when to advance.)

all_card.back_flavor: 当你凝视这片浓稠而黑暗的水域，你心中泛起一股恐惧。这里就是扭曲的根源。不管海面下究竟有些什么，在这里一定能找到答案，解释至今为止现实世界所发生的一切。或许你还能找到拯救伙伴的办法。又或者这片海会直接活生生地把你吞噬。你无法得知等待你的命运究竟是什么。你站起身来，握紧拳头，吸进最后一口气。然后，你面朝大海，来了一次信仰之跃。
all_card.flavor: 当你穿越这柏油般的漆黑之海，你开始隐约看清海面底下，那发光的神秘之网的图案。
all_card.name: 无边黑暗
all_card.text: 强制 - 击败带有线索的敌人后：控制该敌人的所有线索。(FAQ v1.9) 目标 - 找到地下世界扭曲的根源。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A pit of fear grows in your chest as you gaze into the thick, dark water. This is the source. Whatever is below the surface of this sea, it holds the answer to everything that has transpired thus far in the waking world. Perhaps you can even find a way to save your friends. Or perhaps the ocean will simply swallow you alive. You have no way of knowing for certain. You stand and take a final breath, clenching your fists tightly. Then, you take a leap of faith.
all_card.real_flavor: As you traverse the tar-like Sea of Pitch, you begin to discern patterns in the unearthly web that glows below its surface.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After an enemy with 1 or more clues on it is defeated: Take control of each of those clues. Objective - Find the source of the distortion. (You will be instructed when to advance.)

all_card.flavor: “……因为这里是辛之墓穴的入口，意图复仇的恶鬼总会在此凶狠地盯着上方深渊的住民，那些曾经猎杀它们的仇敌。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 辛之墓穴
all_card.text: 掩藏。
all_card.real_flavor:
"...for this is the mouth of the vaults of Zin, and the vindictive ghasts are always on watch there murderously for those denizens of the upper abyss who hunt and prey on them."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Veiled.

all_card.flavor: 在这错综复杂、漆黑的隧道网络中，低吼和可怕的声音追赶着你。你相信在这个巨大的洞穴网络之中，这无数的通路或许会通向幻梦境的地面。你已无可能返回这迷宫起点。然而，当你走出这迷宫时，一起出来的还有……
all_card.name: 阴森隧道
all_card.text:
查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张[[噩妖]]敌人并将其以横置状态生成在此，并带有1个线索。混洗遭遇牌库。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: Hisses and uncanny voices pursue you throughout this web of darkened, intersecting tunnels. You believe the myriad paths might lead all the way to the surface of the Dreamlands, considering the vastness of this network of caverns. It is a wonder you can even find your way back to where you started. However, you are not alone when you emerge...
all_card.real_text:
Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Ghast]] enemy and spawn it here exhausted and with 1 clue on it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: “……卡特跟着那三只食尸鬼大步走出林立的巨石丛，来到这座被高耸石塔所包围的可怕城市，走在黑暗而散发着恶臭的街道上。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 古革巨人之城
all_card.text: 强制 - 你进入古革巨人之城后：将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。
all_card.real_flavor:
"...Carter followed the loping three out of the forest of monoliths and into the dark noisome streets of that awful city whose rounded towers of Cyclopean stone soared up beyond the sight."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter City of Gugs: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 古革巨人的国境被高大的围墙所包围。高墙之内，柱状的塔群高耸入云，每座塔都以灰色石材建成，没有窗户，塔底部隐约有着一道大门。其中一座黑塔最为高耸，彷佛刺入了地下世界的顶部。你走了没几步，就发现有哨兵在守卫城墙外围：那怪物身形庞大，硕大的手臂布满茸毛，长满牙齿的肮脏大嘴竖着长在头上。
all_card.name: 岗哨
all_card.text:
将放在一边的古革哨兵敌人生成在本地点，其带有1[per_investigator]个线索。检定[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，古革哨兵以横置状态入场，不与调查员交战。否则，其入场并与你交战。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: The kingdom of the Gugs is surrounded by a colossal wall. Inside, cylindrical towers rise high into the mist, each one windowless and made of grey stone, with large looming doorways at the bottom. One black tower stands paramount among the others, rising into the very ceiling of the Underworld. You do not make it very far before you spot the sentry standing guard outside the city's walls: a tremendous creature with huge furry arms and an obscene toothy maw extending vertically through its head.
all_card.real_text:
Spawn the set-aside Gug Sentinel enemy at this location, with 1 [per_investigator] clues on it. Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, Gug Sentinel enters play exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it enters play engaged with you.
Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: 你惊讶地发现，这座位于城市中心的巨大建筑里竟没有生物居住。这座塔空荡荡的，除了塔门上的奇怪标志之外再无任何装饰，也看不出任何用途。
all_card.name: 卡斯之塔
all_card.text: [action]：检定[combat](5)以移开塔顶沉重的石板暗门。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面并结算另一面的文本。
all_card.real_flavor: You are surprised to find that none of the creatures that dwell within in the city seem to reside within this vast structure at the heart of the city. Aside from the strange sign upon the tower's doorway, it is barren and devoid of any decoration or purpose.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [combat] (5) to lift the heavy stone trapdoor at the top of the tower. If you succeed, flip this card over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 你一步一步地爬上塔顶，来到塔顶的一扇沉重的石板暗门前。你把石板推开到一边后，一道明亮的光柱照进塔内，让你睁不开眼。是地面！你爬出这道门，来到了一片笼罩着神秘迷雾的树林。一阵凉爽的微风吹来，在地下度过如此漫长的数小时后，这风简直沁人心脾。周围的树木之间有许多双好奇的眼睛在盯着你。虽然你还想在此停留，探索这片荒林，但是你知道，你真正的目标还在地下的洞穴。
all_card.name: 另一条路
all_card.text: 将放在一边的魔幻森林(石板暗门)放置入场，呈已揭示状态。 在剧本日志中，记录调查员找到了离开地下世界的路。 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: Step after step, you scale the tower until you reach the heavy trapdoor at the top. When you push the stone aside, a column of bright light pierces through the shaft, blinding you. The surface! You emerge in an area thick with trees and mystical fog. After so many hours spent underground, the cool breeze feels wonderful. Many curious eyes watch you from the surrounding woods. Though you long to stay and explore more of these wilds, you know your true goal lies back down in the caverns below the surface.
all_card.real_text: Put the set-aside Enchanted Woods (Stone Trapdoor) into play, revealed. Record in your Campaign Log the investigators found a way out of the Underworld. Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: “尽管有几只食尸鬼若有所思地盯着他瘦弱的身躯，还有一只食尸鬼试着捏了他一把，但食尸鬼总的来说还算礼貌。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 食尸鬼平原
all_card.text:
掩藏。
[[古革巨人]]敌人不能进入食尸鬼平原。如果[[古革巨人]]敌人将要生成在食尸鬼平原，改为将其生成在古革巨人之城。
all_card.real_flavor:
"The ghouls were in general respectful, even if one did attempt to pinch him while several others eyed his leanness speculatively."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text:
Veiled.
[[Gug]] enemies cannot enter the Plain of the Ghouls. If a [[Gug]] enemy would spawn at the Plain of the Ghouls, spawn it at the City of Gugs instead.

all_card.name: 诡异食尸鬼
all_card.text:
如果调查员拥有少于3[per_investigator]个线索：
不管如何尝试，你都无法从这里居住的生物取得任何进展。
将本卡牌翻面。等你更好地了解了这片区域，再回到此处。在你准备好时可以将本卡牌再次翻面。
如果调查员拥有至少3[per_investigator]个线索：
在花了大把时间来探索上层之后，你稍微明白了食尸鬼的本性。它们比从前的同胞更加热情好客，一字一句地说着含糊不清的英语与你交流。当你仍在思考该作何选择时，有一只穿着人类装束的食尸鬼接近你。不同于其他的食尸鬼，它能够和你顺畅地沟通。它要求你说出来意，言辞中透露出权威与智慧。
调查员必须以共同花费3[per_investigator]个线索。 推进当前场景。 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_text:
If the investigators possess fewer than 3 [per_investigator] clues:
Try as you might, you cannot make any headway with the creatures that dwell i this region.
Flip this card back over. Come back when you have a greater understanding of this region. This card may be flipped over again when you are ready.
If the investigators possess at least 3 [per_investigator] clues:
Having spent considerable time exploring the upper layer, you understand the ghouls' nature a bit more. They are more welcoming than their kin have been in the past, speaking to you in grunting, monosyllabic English. As you consider your options, you are approached by one of their kind who still wears human clothing. Unlike the rest, he is able to communicate with you perfectly. With an air of authority and wisdom about him, he demands to know why you have come to this place.
The investigators must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. Advance the current act. Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: “最后，他隐约看见了上方食尸鬼巨岩突出的边缘，在这之前他从未见过这块巨岩的顶面……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 食尸鬼峭壁
all_card.text:
掩藏。
本地点的调查员在神话阶段期间抽取的第一张诡计卡牌获得涌动。
all_card.real_flavor:
"At last he discerned above him the projecting edge of the great crag of the ghouls, whose vertical side he could not glimpse..."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text:
Veiled.
The first treachery drawn during the mythos phase by an investigator at this location gains surge.

all_card.flavor: 你望着荒芜的山谷，感觉到下方的威胁。在你脚下的平原底下，连绵数英里的是一片可憎的苍白真菌。在那之外是堆成山的骸骨，就像朝四面八方涌流的大海一般。你发誓自己看到了那些骸骨的表面爬着某些东西，但或许这只是你的想象。远处陡峭的石峰屹立在山谷之上。长有翅膀的黑色生物在峰顶周围飞翔，寻找着猎物。你并没有看到皮克曼口中的“漆黑之海”，但你发现在下方山谷右边的石壁上有着巨大的洞穴……
all_card.name: 探查山谷
all_card.text:
查看遭遇牌库顶的2[per_investigator]张卡牌。你可以最多弃掉这些卡牌的一半。将其余卡牌以任意顺序放回遭遇牌库顶。
直到本场游戏结束，忽略食尸鬼峭壁的文本。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: Looking out over the barren vale, you get a sense for the threats that dwell below. Underneath the plateau upon which you stand, a forest of obscene, pale fungi extends for miles. Beyond that is a great heap of bones, like an ocean pouring forth in all directions. You swear you can see something crawling or worming its way along the surface of the bones, but perhaps it's just your imagination. In the distance, great sharp peaks of stone loom over the vale. Black, winged creatures fly around the summits, searching for prey. You see no sign of this "ocean of pitch" Pickman described, though you do notice a wide cavern opening along a wall of stone to the right of the vale below...
all_card.real_text:
Look at the top 2 [per_investigator] cards of the encounter deck. You may discard up to half of those cards. Return the rest to the top of the encounter deck, in any order.
For the remainder of the game, ignore the text on Crag of the Ghouls.
Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: “除了黑暗、恐怖、寂静和无数的骸骨之外，这里什么都没有。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 骸骨之海
all_card.text: 强制 - 你发现骸骨之海的线索后：将其翻面。
all_card.real_flavor:
"There was nothing anywhere but blackness and horror and silence and bones."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at Sea of Bones: Flip it over.

all_card.flavor: 光是穿越这片满是尸体和怪物遗骸的山谷已非易事，但你对这个可怕地方的憎恨来自于地面以下的搅动与挖掘。什么样的怪物能跨越这片骸骨之海呢？当你看到峡谷中的一个巨坑时，你心中有了答案。它就像漩涡一样吞噬骸骨和带有腐肉的骨头。当你到达隧道底部，意识到它的真实用意时，一股颤栗传遍你的全身。这是由居住在骸骨之海底下的一种巨大生物引起的。
all_card.name: 下方之物
all_card.text:
如果本地点没有巨噬蠕虫隧道，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张巨噬蠕虫隧道并将其附属到本地点(如可能)。混洗遭遇牌库。
如果滑行的巨噬蠕虫在场上，将其移动到本地点，在其上放置2个线索。否则，查找遭遇牌库、遭遇弃牌堆和胜利区，找出滑行的巨噬蠕虫，将其以横置状态生成在本地点，并带有2个线索。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: Traversing this canyon of cadavers and monstrous remains is laborious enough, but it is the churning and digging below the surface that causes you to hate this awful place. What sort of monstrosity could span the entirety of this ocean of bones? Your answer presents itself as you come across a great pit in the ravine. It is swallowing the bones and scraps of rotten meat like a whirlpool. When you reach the base of the tunnel and realize its true purpose, a shudder courses through you. It was made by an enormous creature: the thing that dwells below the sea of bones.
all_card.real_text:
If there is no Dhole Tunnel at this location, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Dhole Tunnel and attach it to this location, if able. Shuffle the encounter deck.
If Slithering Dhole is in play, move it to this location and add 2 clues to it. Otherwise, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and victory display for Slithering Dhole, and spawn it at this location, exhausted and with 2 clues on it.
Flip this card back over.

all_card.name: 撒克山峰
all_card.text: [action]：检定[agility](5)以尝试攀登危险的山峰。如果你检定成功，将将本卡牌翻面并结算另一面的文本。 强制 - 在你离开撒克山峰时：你必须检定[agility](2)以安全地爬下山峰。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [agility] (5) to attempt to scale the treacherous peaks. If you succeed, flip this card over and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When you leave Peaks of Thok: You must test [agility] (2) to climb down safely. If you fail, take 1 damage.

all_card.flavor: 你爬上危险的峰顶，观察下方。从这个位置，山谷里居住的各种生物的一举一动都被你看在眼内。黑色的有翼生物在山峰周围翱翔，它们没有表情的空白面庞对你怒目而视。在山谷上方的悬崖之上，食尸鬼们的一双双眼睛带着病态的好奇心，注视着你的进展。悬崖底下的一堆骸骨和碎石正是地下搅动和挖掘的巨大生物居住的地方。在你的左手边，雾蒙蒙的山谷绵延数英里，一直延伸到一堵巨大的石墙前。墙壁另一面的遥远处，你只能勉强看到黑暗中一座城市的轮廓。难以理解的低语声和嘲笑声钻进你的耳朵。你不敢细想。
all_card.name: 山谷住民
all_card.text:
查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张狩猎中的夜魇并将其以横置状态生成在潘斯山谷。
位于撒克山峰的每位调查员可以抽取2张卡牌。
选择场上任意一个敌人，在其上放置2个线索。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: You climb to the top of the hazardous peaks to survey the lands below. From this vantage point, you are able to see the movements of the various creatures that live in the vale. Soaring all around the peaks are black, winged things that somehow scowl at you with empty, expressionless faces. Upon the cliff that hangs over the vale, ghoul eyes watch your progress with morbid curiosity. The mound of bones and detritus below the precipice is home to nothing but the churning and dredging of something massive under the surface. To your left, the misty vale extends for miles until it reaches an enormous stone wall. Opposite the wall, far in the distance, you barely make out the shape of a city in the darkness. Incomprehensible whispers and mocking laughter seep into your ears. You dare no further study.
all_card.real_text:
Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Hunting Nightgaunt and spawn it at Vale of Pnath, exhausted.
Each investigator at Peaks of Thok may draw 2 cards.
Choose any enemy in play and place 2 clues on it.
Flip this card back over.

all_card.name: 潘斯山谷
all_card.text:
掩藏。
潘斯山谷上有线索时，位于潘斯山谷的调查员不能打出卡牌，也不能投入卡牌到技能检定。
all_card.real_text:
Veiled.
While there are clues remaining on Vale of Pnath, investigators at Vale of Pnath cannot play cards or commit cards to skill tests.

all_card.name: 逃生之路
all_card.text:
如果调查员拥有少于3[per_investigator]个线索：
不管如何努力，你都无法离开这座黑暗而荒凉的山谷。
将本卡牌翻面。等你更好地了解了这片区域，再回到此处。在你准备好时可以将本卡牌再次翻面。
如果调查员拥有至少3[per_investigator]个线索：
你冒险进入这片黑暗的山谷，试图摸清周围的地形。根据至今为止取得的所有信息，你知道扰乱地下世界的根源不会在这片地区。一定有别的道路——或许是洞穴或隧道——从山谷通向幻梦境地下更深处的地点。当你走近山谷尽头的巨石壁时，你闻到了一股难闻的气味，像是硫磺与柏油。你循着这股恶臭，找到了石壁上的一个大洞。
调查员必须共同花费3[per_investigator]个线索。 推进当前场景。 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_text:
If the investigators possess fewer than 3 [per_investigator] clues:
Try as you might, you cannot find any way out of the dark, barren vale.
Flip this card back over. Come back when you have a greater understanding of this region. This card may be flipped over again when you are ready.
If the investigators possess at least 3 [per_investigator] clues:
You venture out into the dark vale and attempt to map out your surroundings. With the knowledge you have accumulated, you know that the source of the disturbances within the Underworld cannot be in this region. There must be another pathway - perhaps a cavern or tunnel - that leads from the vale to a place even deeper beneath the surface of the Dreamlands. As you approach the great stone wall at the far end of the vale, you pick up a foul scent, like sulfur and tar. You follow the stench until it leads you to a wide hole in the wall.
The investigators must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. Advance the current act. Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor:
在这空虚的广阔空间深处，有着另一个世界。
你是否会一跃而入？
all_card.name: 漆黑之海
all_card.text:
掩藏。
X为冒险参考卡牌上的伤害标记数。
all_card.real_flavor:
Deep in the vacuous expanse lies another dimension.
Will you take the plunge?
all_card.real_text:
Veiled.
X is the number of damage tokens on the scenario reference card.

all_card.flavor: 突然，一群怪物从沥青一样漆黑的海洋深处出现。它们的外形与蜘蛛相近，但只有这一点相似。它们的身体像是沥青般的物质形成，和海洋本身一样。在笼罩海洋的黑雾之中，可以看到它们眼睛发出的深红色光芒。蛛群围绕在你的船只周围，试图把船只——还有你——拽入深海。
all_card.name: 蛛群之海
all_card.text:
将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库，并从遭遇牌库顶弃牌，直到弃掉一张[[蜘蛛]]敌人。将该敌人生成在此，并且其带有1[per_investigator]个线索(如果其为蜂拥敌人，将这些线索放在其头领敌人上)。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: From the depths of the pitch-black ocean, the creatures suddenly emerge. They are similar to spiders in shape, but that is where the similarities end. Their bodies appear to be made from the same tarry substance as the ocean itself, and their eyes glow crimson red in the dark fog over the sea. The spiders surround your vessel and attempt to pull it - and you - into the depths.
all_card.real_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until a [[Spider]] enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy here with 1 [per_investigator] clues on it (if it is swarming, place those clues on the host enemy).
Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor:
在这空虚的广阔空间深处，有着另一个世界。
你是否会一跃而入？
all_card.name: 漆黑之海
all_card.text:
掩藏。
X为冒险参考卡牌上的伤害标记数。
all_card.real_flavor:
Deep in the vacuous expanse lies another dimension.
Will you take the plunge?
all_card.real_text:
Veiled.
X is the number of damage tokens on the scenario reference card.

all_card.flavor: 海面的波浪持续地缓慢流动，就像无数个搅动的泥坑，但最后你发现，海面上有一处地方停止不动，令人恐惧，寂静无声。你从船上探头往外看，望进深处。你要去的地方就在这片广阔的漆黑之海底下……
all_card.name: 平静海面
all_card.text:
查看另一张漆黑之海的另一面。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: The ocean's waves are steady and slow, like rolling pits of sludge, but eventually you find a spot where the ocean is eerily still, and all is silent. You peer over the edge of your boat and gaze into the depths. Somewhere in the black vastness below is your destination...
all_card.real_text:
Look at the other side of another copy of Sea of Pitch.
Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor:
在这空虚的广阔空间深处，有着另一个世界。
你是否会一跃而入？
all_card.name: 漆黑之海
all_card.text:
掩藏。
X为冒险参考卡牌上的伤害标记数。
all_card.real_flavor:
Deep in the vacuous expanse lies another dimension.
Will you take the plunge?
all_card.real_text:
Veiled.
X is the number of damage tokens on the scenario reference card.

all_card.flavor: 虽然地下世界的黑暗洞穴里一丝风也没有，但漆黑之海上许多巨大的漩涡正从四面八方袭击你的船只。漩涡正要把你的船只卷到不知何处，你拼命控制，避免船只失控。
all_card.name: 起伏的漩涡
all_card.text:
将每张漆黑之海上的所有线索放在一边。
弃掉每张漆黑之海上的其他所有标记和附属。
将本卡牌翻面，并混洗每张漆黑之海以打乱其位置，使你无法分辨每张漆黑之海(调查员和敌人仍位于各自当前位置)。
将刚刚放在一边的线索尽可能地平分到每张漆黑之海上。
每张漆黑之海都可以通过其掩藏关键词翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: Though there is no wind in the dark caverns of the Underworld, enormous maelstroms of pitch attack your vessel from all sides. You struggle to remain in control of your boat as the whirlpools hurl you into pandemonium.
all_card.real_text:
Set all of the clues from each Sea of Pitch aside.
Discard all other tokens and attachments from each Sea of Pitch.
Flip this card back over and shuffle the positions of each copy of Sea of Pitch so you do not know which is which (investigators and enemies remain at their current position).
Distribute the previously set-aside clues among each copy of Sea of Pitch, as evenly as possible.
Each Sea of Pitch may be flipped over again using their veiled keyword.

all_card.flavor:
在这空虚的广阔空间深处，有着另一个世界。
你是否会一跃而入？
all_card.name: 漆黑之海
all_card.text:
掩藏。
X为冒险辅助卡上的伤害标记数。
all_card.real_flavor:
Deep in the vacuous expanse lies another dimension.
Will you take the plunge?
all_card.real_text:
Veiled.
X is the number of damage tokens on the scenario reference card.

all_card.name: 大海中央
all_card.text:
如果调查员拥有少于3[per_investigator]个线索：
你想尽一切办法，也不知道如何去往这片漆黑之海的另一边。
将本卡牌翻面。等你更好地了解了这片区域，再回到此处。在你准备好时可以将本卡牌再次翻面。
如果调查员拥有至少3[per_investigator]个线索：
你将船只驶向更遥远的地方，进入了更为黑暗也更深的水域，但是仍然看不到其他海岸。在这如同柏油的黑海之下，你看到一串发光的星星，如同一个未知的星座，呼唤你靠近。你可能会以为那是天空的倒影，但你知道在这个黑暗的区域里根本没有天空。你趴在船边，眩晕的感觉让你几乎要吐出来。那一定是数百英里深的地方，充满了无法想象的恐怖。然而，你知道你必须要做的是什么……
调查员必须共同花费3[per_investigator]个线索。 将本卡牌翻面并推进当前场景。
all_card.real_text:
If the investigators possess fewer than 3 [per_investigator] clues:
Try as you might, you cannot find the way to the other side of this ocean of tar.
Flip this card back over. Come back when you have a greater understanding of this region. This card may be flipped over again when you are ready.
If the investigators possess at least 3 [per_investigator] clues:
You row farther out, into deeper, darker waters, but there is still no sign of any other shore. Under the surface of the black, tarry liquid, you can see a series of glittering stars, like an unknown constellation beckoning you forward. If you didn't know any better, you would think it was a reflection of the sky above, but there is no sky in this dark realm. You lean over the edge of your boat and nearly vomit from the sensation of vertigo that assaults you. It must be hundreds of miles deep, and filled with horrors beyond your imagining. And yet, you know what you must do...
The investigators must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. Flip this card back over and advance the current act.

all_card.name: 理查德·厄普顿·皮克曼
all_card.text: [free]横置理查德·厄普顿·皮克曼：选择你所在地点的一个[[食尸鬼]]敌人并将其正面朝下附属到理查德·厄普顿·皮克曼。 [action]横置理查德·厄普顿·皮克曼：攻击。你以基础值为5的[combat]攻击。本次攻击不造成标准伤害，改为造成等于附属到理查德·厄普顿·皮克曼的正面朝下的遭遇卡牌数量的伤害。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 食尸鬼. 艺术家
all_card.real_text: [fast] Exhaust Richard Upton Pickman: Choose a [[Ghoul]] enemy at your location and attach it to him, facedown. [action] Exhaust Richard Upton Pickman: Fight. You attack with a base [combat] of 5. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals damage equal to the number of facedown encounter cards attached to Richard Upton Pickman.

all_card.flavor: “接着亮起了一双粉红色的眼睛，再是苏醒的古革哨兵那硕如木桶一般的巨大头颅摇晃着出现在视野中。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 古革哨兵
all_card.text: 古革哨兵得到生命值+2[per_investigator]。 强制 - 古革哨兵重整后：对其所在地点的每位调查员造成1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: "Then two pink eyes shone, and the head of the awakened gug sentry, large as a barrel, wobbled into view."- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Gug Sentinel gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After Gug Sentinel readies: Deal 1 horror to each investigator at its location.

all_card.flavor: “卡特一看到那怪物污秽而丑陋的模样就感到恶心……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 鲜血的滋味
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须(选择一项)：将你的1个线索放到你所在地点或最近的敌人上，或受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor:
"Carter turned sick at the aspect of that scabrous and unwholesome beast..."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must (choose one): Place 1 of your clues on your location, place 1 of your clues on the nearest enemy, or take 1 damage.

all_card.name: 夺命猛火
all_card.text: 显现 - 每位调查员失去1资源。位于[[山谷]]或[[深海]]地点的每位调查员选择并弃掉其1张手牌。位于[[深海]]地点的每位调查员失去1个行动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Each investigator loses 1 resource. Each investigator at a [[Vale]] or [[Depths]] location chooses and discards 1 card from their hand. Each investigator at a [[Depths]] location loses 1 action.

all_card.name: 意外伏击
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果场上没有敌人，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。否则，检定[intellect](4)或[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，最近的敌人重整并移动(每次一个地点)，直到它到达你所在地点并与你交战。然后，如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，其立即进行一次攻击。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no enemies in play, take 1 damage and 1 horror. Otherwise, test [intellect] (4) or [agility] (4). If you fail, the nearest enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, and engages you. Then, if you failed by 3 or more, it makes an immediate attack.

all_card.name: 滑行的巨噬蠕虫

all_card.traits: 怪物. 蠕虫. 精英
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Nearest location with an attached Dhole Tunnel. (Otherwise, shuffle Slithering Dhole back into the encounter deck, and it gains surge.) Hunter. Massive. While Slithering Dhole is moving, all locations with an attached Dhole Tunnel are considered to be connected to one another.

all_card.name: 巨噬蠕虫隧道

Then, if Slithering Dhole is in the victory display, spawn it at attached location, exhausted.

all_card.real_flavor: Ripples of violet light shimmer under the surface of the dark, rolling ocean. What is the reason for this disturbance?

all_card.flavor: 可怕的未来就在你眼前。你是要转头就跑，还是对它敞开胸怀？

A grisly future is laid before you.
Do you turn away? Or do you embrace it?

all_card.flavor: “我警告过你离我远一点。现在我们都被困在这里了。”
