all_card.back_flavor:
距离你第一次从乌撒之城出发，已经过了好几个月。一路上，你见到了许多惊人的地方，遇上许多有趣的怪人。一些人帮助了你，给了你一些明智的建议，或是指引你正确的方向。但绝大多数人只是怀疑而警惕地盯着你。或许这是因为你是来自外界的入梦者，又或许是因为你愚蠢又该死，竟想去寻找幻梦境的禁忌之地。
但真正使你担惊受怕的是那些海盗。在你旅程的每时每刻，你都能发现它们在紧追着你，一次又一次。船上的生物被幻梦境的住民称为“冷原人”，他们貌如萨蒂尔，双脚为蹄，巨大而卷曲的角从前额伸出。他们驶着长长的、带有黑帆的黑船。你不知道他们为什么不停地追猎着你，你此时也不想深究。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的2张冷原海盗敌人和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你和你的同伴们不顾幻梦境住民的劝告，打算寻找未知的神居之所——卡达斯。
all_card.name: 穿过幻梦境的旅程
all_card.text: [action]如果你位于[[港口]]地点：撤退。进入未知领域冒险一事变得过于危险，所以你带着目前搜集到的一切返回安全的地方。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Months have passed since you first set forth from Ulthar. Along the way, you have seen many fabulous places and met many strange and interesting people. Some have been helpful, giving you sage advice or pointing you in the right direction. Most, however, have regarded you with suspicion and wariness. Perhaps it is because you are a dreamer from the outside world, or perhaps it is because you are foolish and accursed enough to seek the forbidden places of the Dreamlands.
But it is the Corsairs who truly frighten you. Throughout your travels, you spot them pursuing you time and time again. "Men of Leng," the inhabitants of the Dreamlands call them: satyr-like creatures with hooves instead of feet and great curved horns protruding from their foreheads. They sail on long, black galleys with black sails. You know not why they hunt for you relentlessly, and you are not keen to find out.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle both set-aside Corsair of Leng enemies into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: Despite the advice of the Dreamlands' inhabitants, you and your companions seek unknown Kadath, where the gods dwell.
all_card.real_text: [action] If you are at a [[Port]] location: Resign. Venturing into the unknown has become too dangerous, so you return to safety with the information you've gathered.

all_card.back_flavor:
从几周之前开始，你便一直在躲避海盗的追捕。每当他们出现，你总能从他们手中逃脱，但随着你每次逃脱，他们的包围圈都更加地收紧。尽管如此，你还是祈望自己能在运气用尽之前找到卡达斯。
但是，即使你掌握了这么多信息，你依然无法找到卡达斯，而海盗依然对你究追不舍。你试图逃到安全的地方去，但你没想到，那群海盗为了抓住你竟然追到这么远。他们封锁了你所有的出路，使你无法到达海港寻求庇护。你已无处可逃。他们就像集体狩猎的动物一样，将你包围……
all_card.back_text: 每位幸存的调查员被击败。
all_card.flavor: 或许，寻找卡达斯就是一趟被诅咒的危险之旅。即便如此，好奇心依然侵蚀着你的头脑。众神歇息之所能让你得到什么样的证据呢？
all_card.name: 外神的使徒
all_card.text: [action]如果你位于[[港口]]地点：撤退。进入未知领域冒险一事变得过于危险，所以你带着目前搜集到的一切返回安全的地方。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You have evaded the Corsairs for weeks since their pursuit began. Each time they appear, you are able to slip through their grasp, but the noose grows tighter and tighter with each escape. Even so, you persist in the hope you can find Kadath before your luck runs out.
However, even with all of the information you have uncovered, Kadath eludes you still, and the Corsairs are hot on your trail. You try to make your way to safety, but you have underestimated the lengths these creatures will go to in order to capture you. They have cut off all of your escape routes and have taken away all of your safe havens. There is nowhere left for you to run. Like pack hunters, they surround you...
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated.
all_card.real_flavor: Perhaps seeking Kadath is an accursed venture after all. Even so, curiosity gnaws at your mind. What proof could the resting place of the gods hold for you?
all_card.real_text: [action] If you are at a [[Port]] location: Resign. Venturing into the unknown has become too dangerous, so you return to safety with the information you've gathered.

all_card.back_flavor: 你找到一位船长愿意带你前往幻梦境的偏远地带，你或许能因此找到一些神迹，来指引你卡达斯所在的方位。
all_card.back_text: 查找遭遇牌库、遭遇弃牌堆和所有游戏区域，找出乌撒之猫、每张一群乌尼斯和祖格鼠遭遇组的每张卡牌，将其从游戏中移除。 将每张放在一边的千面祭司和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。 调查员必须决定(选择一项)： - 前往南边的奥瑞巴岛。结算剧本手册的奥瑞巴岛冒险设置。 - 前往西边的古老的米纳尔。结算剧本手册的米纳尔冒险设置。 - 前往北边的禁闭之地。结算剧本手册的禁闭之地冒险设置。 - 前往东边的永恒王国。结算剧本手册的永恒王国冒险设置。
all_card.flavor: “在绵延至斯凯的肥沃平原上，他看到了农舍的炊烟，周围有着树篱，耕开的田地和茅草屋顶，呈现出一派宁静安逸的景象。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 斯凯王国
all_card.text: 目标 - 当一轮结束时，位于[[港口]]地点的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You find a captain willing to grant you passage to the remote regions of the Dreamlands, wherein you may find signs from the gods to point you in the direction of Kadath.
all_card.real_back_text: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and all play areas for Cats of Ulthar, each Pack of Vooniths, and each card from the Zoogs encounter set, and remove them from the game. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Priest of a Thousand Masks into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. The investigators must decide (choose one): - Visit the isle of Oriab to the south. Resolve Oriab Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the ancient land of Mnar to the west. Resolve Mnar Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the Forbidden Lands to the north. Resolve Forbidden Lands Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the kingdom of the Timeless Realm to the east. Resolve Timeless Realm Setup in the Campaign Guide.
all_card.real_flavor:
"Over fertile plains rolling down to the Skai he saw the smoke of cottage chimneys, and on every hand were the hedges and ploughed fields and thatched roofs of a peaceful land."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators at a [[Port]] location may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你再次登上了你的船只，发现船员正在搬运装着货物的木桶上船，里面装有毛皮、矿石、异国香料等等。“等我们回到大陆就能大赚一笔。”船长拍着你的肩膀这么说道，“但愿你也能找到你要的东西。接下来，你要去哪儿？”
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。 调查员必须决定(选择一项)。你不能选择已经到过的地方。如果列出的每个地方你均已到过，进入(→结局1)。 - 前往西边的古老的米纳尔。结算剧本手册的米纳尔冒险设置。 - 前往北边的禁闭之地。结算剧本手册的禁闭之地冒险设置。 - 前往东边的永恒王国。结算剧本手册的永恒王国冒险设置。
all_card.flavor: 南边坐落着面积不大但植物丰茂的火山岛——奥瑞巴岛，名为恩格拉尼克的休眠火山俯瞰整座小岛。巴哈那海湾有着标志性的两座灯塔，它们名为索恩和索尔，眺望着南部海域。
all_card.name: 奥瑞巴岛
all_card.text: 目标 - 在这个区域发现尽可能多的神迹。当一轮结束时，如果每位调查员都位于同一个[[港口]]地点，你可以通过推进本场景来移动到下一个区域。 目标 - 如果调查员发现了10个神迹，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you board your ship once again, you find the crew loading barrels of trade goods: furs, ore, exotic spices, and the like. "We'll make a killing with these back on the mainland," the captain says, clapping your shoulder. "Hope you found what you were looking for, too. Where do you want to head next?"
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. The investigators must decide (choose one). You cannot choose a place you have already visited. If you have already visited each of the listed areas, proceed to (→R1). - Visit the ancient land of Mnar to the west. Resolve Mnar Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the Forbidden Lands to the north. Resolve Forbidden Lands Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the kingdom of the Timeless Realm to the east. Resolve Timeless Realm Setup in the Campaign Guide.
all_card.real_flavor: To the south lies the small but thriving volcanic island of Oriab, dominated by the dormant volcano called Ngranek. The Bay of Baharna, marked by twin lighthouses, Thon and Thal, overlooks the Southern Sea.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find and uncover as many Signs of the Gods in this region as you can. At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same [[Port]] location, you may move to another region by advancing this act. Objective - If the investigators have uncovered 10 Signs of the Gods, proceed to (→R1).

all_card.back_flavor: 你在这个地方能做的事都尝试过了，于是你回到船上。船长命令船员准备离港。“之前还不知道你能不能准时回来，你终于来了。”船长咧嘴一笑，“那么，你要去哪儿？”
all_card.back_text: 查找遭遇牌库、遭遇弃牌堆和所有游戏区域，找出每张伊伯生物敌人，将其从游戏中移除。 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。 调查员必须决定(选择一项)。你不能选择已经到过的地方。如果列出的每个地方你均已到过，进入(→结局1)。 - 前往南边的奥瑞巴岛。结算剧本手册的奥瑞巴岛冒险设置。 - 前往北边的禁闭之地。结算剧本手册的禁闭之地冒险设置。 - 前往东边的永恒王国。结算剧本手册的永恒王国冒险设置。
all_card.flavor: 传说中久远的米纳尔是幻梦境中最古老的地方之一，游牧民族在那定居并建立城邦，在无数年间，城邦日益壮大，拓宽疆域，发展成了屹立至今的大都会。
all_card.name: 昔日厄运
all_card.text: 目标 - 在这个区域发现尽可能多的神迹。当一轮结束时，如果每位调查员都位于同一个[[港口]]地点，你可以通过推进本场景来移动到下一个区域。 目标 - 如果调查员发现了10个神迹，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your options in this region exhausted, you make your way back to your ship. The captain orders the crew to get ready to leave port. "Wasn't sure if you'd be back in time, but here you are," the captain says with a grin. "Well? Where to?"
all_card.real_back_text: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and all play areas for the Beings of Ib enemy and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. The investigators must decide (choose one). You cannot choose a place you have already visited. If you have already visited each of the listed areas, proceed to (→R1). - Visit the isle of Oriab to the south. Resolve Oriab Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the Forbidden Lands to the north. Resolve Forbidden Lands Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the kingdom of the Timeless Realm to the east. Resolve Timeless Realm Setup in the Campaign Guide.
all_card.real_flavor: The ancient, fabled land of Mnar is one of the oldest regions in the Dreamlands, where wandering nomadic tribes settled city-states that grew in size and power over untold ages, until they became the metropolises that stand today.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find and uncover as many Signs of the Gods in this region as you can. At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same [[Port]] location, you may move to another region by advancing this act. Objective - If the investigators have uncovered 10 Signs of the Gods, proceed to (→R1).

all_card.back_flavor: 你终于回到了船上，离开这片被诅咒的土地。“别在这个倒霉地方待着了。”船长对船员发号施令道，“伊莱克-瓦达或许是个好地方，但更远的地方充满了危险。挑个方向开船吧，任何方向都可以，只要能赶紧离开这儿。”
all_card.back_text: 查找遭遇牌库、遭遇弃牌堆和所有游戏区域，找出每张夜色怪群和跟踪的蝎狮敌人，将其从游戏中移除。 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。 调查员必须决定(选择一项)。你不能选择已经到过的地方。如果列出的每个地方你均已到过，进入(→结局1)。 - 前往南边的奥瑞巴岛。结算剧本手册的奥瑞巴岛冒险设置。 - 前往西边的古老的米纳尔。结算剧本手册的米纳尔冒险设置。 - 前往东边的永恒王国。结算剧本手册的永恒王国冒险设置。
all_card.flavor: 从传说中的城市伊莱克-瓦达，你可以离开这片相对安全的地方进入禁闭之地，那里的景象匪夷所思、令人毛骨悚然。在这片荒芜贫瘠的陆地以东，是被夜色怪群践踏的土地。
all_card.name: 找寻黑夜
all_card.text: 目标 - 在这个区域发现尽可能多的神迹。当一轮结束时，如果每位调查员都位于同一个[[港口]]地点，你可以通过推进本场景来移动到下一个区域。 目标 - 如果调查员发现了10个神迹，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You finally return to your ship, ready to leave this accursed land behind. "Let's not tarry in this godsforsaken place any longer," the captain says, barking orders to his crew. "Ilek-Vad may be a jewel, but the lands beyond are frought with danger. Pick a heading. Any heading. Just so long as it is far away from here."
all_card.real_back_text: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and all play areas for the Horde of Night and Stalking Manticore enemies and remove each of them from the game. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. The investigators must decide (choose one). You cannot choose a place you have already visited. If you have already visited each of the listed areas, proceed to (→R1). - Visit the isle of Oriab to the south. Resolve Oriab Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the ancient land of Mnar to the west. Resolve Mnar Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the kingdom of the Timeless Realm to the east. Resolve Timeless Realm Setup in the Campaign Guide.
all_card.real_flavor: From the relative safety of the fabulous city of Ilek-Vad, you may cross into the hellish and bizarre landscape of the Forbidden Lands. East of this barren and blasted landscape lie the lands which have been ravaged by the hordes of Night.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find and uncover as many Signs of the Gods in this region as you can. At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same [[Port]] location, you may move to another region by advancing this act. Objective - If the investigators have uncovered 10 Signs of the Gods, proceed to (→R1).

all_card.back_flavor: 当你说要离开这里时，船员们都在嘟囔着表示不愿离开。“这你怪不了他们。”船员准备出航时，船长侧身靠近你，轻声说道。“要是可以，他们愿意永远留在这个港口。唉，但是大海在召唤。那我们下一站去哪？”
all_card.back_text: 查找遭遇牌库、遭遇弃牌堆和所有游戏区域，找出蠕行之雾敌人，将其从游戏中移除。 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。 调查员必须决定(选择一项)。你不能选择已经到过的地方。如果列出的每个地方你均已到过，进入(→结局1)。 - 前往南边的奥瑞巴岛。结算剧本手册的奥瑞巴岛冒险设置。 - 前往西边的古老的米纳尔。结算剧本手册的米纳尔冒险设置。 - 前往北边的禁闭之地。结算剧本手册的禁闭之地冒险设置。
all_card.flavor: 在入梦者库拉尼斯的统治之下，欧斯-纳尔盖山谷的大部分地区都逃过了时间的魔爪。那里的一切既不会风化，也不会垮塌。这是一个充满奇迹的国度——在你来到这里之前，这个国度究竟存在了多少年呢？
all_card.name: 王之判决
all_card.text: 目标 - 在这个区域发现尽可能多的神迹。当一轮结束时，如果每位调查员都位于同一个[[港口]]地点，你可以通过推进本场景来移动到下一个区域。 目标 - 如果调查员发现了10个神迹，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your ship's crew grumbles in protest when you announce your intention to leave. "Can you blame them?" the captain leans in and says quietly as the crew prepares for the voyage. "They would stay in port here forever if they could. But alas, the sea calls. So, where are we headed next?"
all_card.real_back_text: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and all play areas for The Crawling Mist enemy and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. The investigators must decide (choose one). You cannot choose a place you have already visited. If you have already visited each of the listed areas, proceed to (→R1). - Visit the isle of Oriab to the south. Resolve Oriab Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the ancient land of Mnar to the west. Resolve Mnar Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the Forbidden Lands to the north. Resolve Forbidden Lands Setup in the Campaign Guide.
all_card.real_flavor: Much of the valley realm of Ooth-Nargai, ruled by the dreamer Kuranes, eludes the grasp of time. Nothing here ages or falls into disrepair. It is a realm of wonders and marvels - how many years might pass here before you even noticed?
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find and uncover as many Signs of the Gods in this region as you can. At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same [[Port]] location, you may move to another region by advancing this act. Objective - If the investigators have uncovered 10 Signs of the Gods, proceed to (→R1).

all_card.flavor: “乌撒之城的郊外景色分外宜人，有绿色的小农舍和围着篱色的整齐的农场；更令人赏心悦目的是这座古朴的小城本身……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 乌撒
all_card.text: 掩藏。
all_card.real_flavor:
"Very pleasant were the suburbs of Ulthar, with their little green cottages and neatly fenced farms; and still pleasanter was the quaint town itself..."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Veiled.

all_card.flavor: 当你走在小城的街道上，一群猫咪慢慢地在你周围聚集起来，你到哪它们都跟着。
all_card.name: 神秘生物
all_card.text:
检查剧本日志。如果猫群收到了祖格鼠的贡品，阅读以下内容：
一只接一只的猫咪要求你爱抚它们的身体，以此作为你给它们的贡品。尽管你任务紧迫，它们依然蹭着你的双腿，跳到你的大腿上，没有得到充足的爱抚它们是不会离开的。
失去你所有剩余的行动并结束你的回合。
如果调查员强行进入神庙，阅读以下内容：
接下来，猫群将你彻底包围。它们低声咆哮，从四面八方靠近你。
将乌撒之猫敌人生成并与你交战。
无论结果如何： 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: As you walk the streets of the town, a horde of cats slowly congregates around you, following you everywhere you go.
all_card.real_text:
Check Campaign Log. If the cats collected their tribute from the Zoogs, read the following:
One by one, the cats demand a tribute in the form of physical affection. Despite the urgency of your task, they rub against your legs, leap onto your lap, and do not leave until they are thoroughly adored.
Lose all of your remaining actions and end your turn.
If the investigators forced their way into the temple, read the following:
The next thing you know, the cats have you completely surrounded. They hiss and growl, closing in from all sides.
Spawn the Cats of Ulthar enemy engaged with you.
Regardless: Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: “……不久后他来到横跨斯凯河的巨大石桥，修桥的人曾在中央桥墩封入了一个活人贡品……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 斯凯河
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你尝试离开斯凯河时，如果该地点未被翻面过：检定[willpower](2)或[agility](2)。如果你检定失败，将本卡牌翻面并结算另一面的文本。
all_card.real_flavor:
"...soon afterward he came to the great stone bridge across the Skai, into whose central pier the masons had sealed a living human sacrifice..."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you attempt to leave Skai River, if it has not yet been flipped over: Test [willpower] (2) or [agility] (2). If you fail, flip this card over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 斯凯河流域的荒野看似平静，但并不安全。你不得不放慢前进的脚步，享受这里的宁静与优美，但闲逛会使你成为以湿地为居的邪恶生物的目标。
all_card.name: 如梦恐惧
all_card.text:
取消该移动的效果。
如果没有[[生物]]敌人位于斯凯河，从遭遇牌库顶弃牌，直到弃掉1个[[生物]]敌人，将其生成并与你交战。
否则，增加1张蜂拥卡牌到斯凯河的1个[[生物]]敌人。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: The wilds of the Skai region may appear peaceful, but they are far from safe. You are compelled to travel slowly and take in the beauty and tranquility of this realm, but your dawdling makes you a target for the vicious creatures that call the wetlands home.
all_card.real_text:
Cancel the effects of the move.
If there are no [[Creature]] enemies at Skai River, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Creature]] enemy is discarded, and spawn that enemy engaged with you.
Otherwise, add 1 swarm card to a [[Creature]] enemy at Skai River.
Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: “狄拉斯-利恩有着细长而棱角分明的高塔，远远看去像是‘巨人之路’，那里的街道昏暗，让人不想进入。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 狄拉斯-利恩
all_card.text:
掩藏。
[action]花费1资源：查找你牌库顶6张卡牌，找出一张[[道具]]支援并将其抽取。混洗你的牌库。
all_card.traits: 斯凯. 城市. 港口
all_card.real_flavor:
"Dylath-Leen with its thin angular towers looks in the distance like a bit of the Giants' Causeway, and its streets are dark and uninviting."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text:
Veiled.
[action] Spend 1 resource: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for an [[Item]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

all_card.flavor: 在港口城市狄拉斯-利恩，你向城中的几位长者请教卡达斯的所在。他们认为卡达斯的真相之所以隐藏起来是有原因的，他们说你是傻瓜，竟想寻找卡达斯。即使如此，他们把自己知道的、关于那座被遗忘的山峰的信息告诉了你，尽管他们知之甚少。凭借现有的信息，远远无法找到卡达斯，但你能明确的是，它不在这片区域。“我们得找个船长。”伦道夫沉思地说，“这趟旅程还有很长的路要走。奥瑞巴岛坐落在南边，我曾听说那里有一座大山。西边是古老的米纳尔，那里藏着许多秘密。东边是睿智的库拉尼斯王所统治的永恒王国。北边则是无人胆敢踏足的禁闭之地……”
all_card.name: 无穷秘密
all_card.text: 你发现了一个神迹(在冒险参考卡牌上放置1资源作为表示)。本场冒险剩余时间内，冒险参考卡牌上的资源表示调查员已发现的神迹。你要做的就是发现尽可能多的神迹，从而找到卡达斯的位置。 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: In the port city of Dylath-Leen, you consult with the elders of the city. They believe that the truth of Kadath was hidden for a reason, and they call you a fool for searching for it. Even so, they tell you what little they know of the forsaken peak. Though you are far from finding Kadath, it is clear now that it cannot be in this region. "We'll need to find a ship captain," Randolph muses. "This journey will be much longer still. The isle of Oriab lies to the south, and I have heard of a great mountain there. To the west lies the ancient land of Mnar, where many secrets lie hidden. To the east is the Timeless Realm ruled by the wise King Kuranes. North of there is a forbidden land where none dare tread..."
all_card.real_text: You have uncovered a Sign of the Gods (place 1 resource on the scenario reference card to indicate this). For the remainder of the scenario, resources on the scenario reference card represent Signs of the Gods the investigators have uncovered. Your quest is to uncover as many of these signs as you can in order to discern the location of Kadath. Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: 据说这里的历史都被写在了古城中著名的圆柱上：巨大的砖砌柱子直插云霄，曾有许多贤者、法师和学者都对其进行过研究。或许你能在这儿找到答案。
all_card.name: 卡达瑟隆
all_card.text:
掩藏。
[action][action][action]：抽取5张卡牌。
all_card.traits: 米纳尔. 古代. 城市. 港口
all_card.real_flavor: It is said that the history of this land is written upon the famed cylinders of this ancient city: great brick pillars that rise into the sky, studied by sages, sorcerers, and scholars alike. Perhaps here you can find answers.
all_card.real_text:
Veiled.
[action][action][action]: Draw 5 cards.

all_card.flavor: 你对卡达瑟隆的柱子研究了好几个小时，沉醉在幻梦境这传奇而宏大的历史中。最初你专注于调查众神城堡的下落，但很快你便沉迷于柱子上记载的一切事物。数小时、数天、数个星期；谁知道你浪费了多少时间在调查上。尽管你收获颇丰，但你在这儿耗费的时间，对于你的追猎者来说却是一种恩惠。当你感觉到恶徒那不详的目光远远注视着你，你才从柱子面前抽身……
all_card.name: 卡达瑟隆之柱
all_card.text: 你发现了一个神迹(在冒险参考卡牌上放置1资源)。 将1张放在一边的黑暗夜魇混洗入遭遇牌库(如可能)。 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: You study the pillars within Kadatheron for many hours, losing yourself in the vast, storied histories of the Dreamlands. What was first a focused search for the whereabouts of the castle of the gods soon becomes an obsession with all things inscribed upon the cylinders. Hours, days, weeks; who knows how much time you lose to your research. Though you learn much, the time you spend here is a boon to those who pursue you. You are only able to pry yourself free from the cylinders when you feel the ominous gaze of something sinister watching you from afar...
all_card.real_text: You have uncovered a Sign of the Gods (place 1 resource on the scenario reference card). Shuffle 1 set-aside copy of Tenebrous Nightgaunt into the encounter deck, if able. Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: “一个贵金属的矿源都没有幸免。萨尔纳斯迎来灭亡。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《降临在萨尔纳斯的灾殃》</cite>
all_card.name: 萨尔纳斯
all_card.text: 掩藏。萨尔纳斯不能被翻面，除非调查员“知道伊伯发生的事情”。 强制 - 你成功调查萨尔纳斯且至多超过难度1点后：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.traits: 米纳尔. 古代. 遗迹
all_card.real_flavor:
"Not even the mines of precious metal remained. DOOM had come to Sarnath."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Doom That Came to Sarnath"
all_card.real_text: Veiled. Sarnath cannot be flipped over unless the investigators "know what happened to Ib." Forced - After you successfully investigate Sarnath by 1 or less: Take 1 horror.

all_card.flavor: 虽然这座城邦建于很久以前，存在过千年之久，但现在已经不复存在。传说萨尔纳斯在一夜间覆灭。如今它已几乎什么都不剩了：这座高耸壮观的城邦曾经仁立的地方已经变成了一片巨大的沼泽。废墟中找不到任何一座依然屹立的建筑，只有大理石、砖块和玉髓的碎片。但当你接近这些残骸时，数道闪电划破天空。闪光使你睁不开眼。就在你眨眼的瞬间，一切都变了。那里从前没有城市，现在却隐约出现了萨尔纳斯曾经的景象，如同幽灵一般。在闪电击中的湖边，你发现了一尊古老神奇的绿石雕像。它周身覆盖着海草，貌似一只巨大的水蜥蜴。或许，它是这个地方的神明之一？
all_card.name: 萨尔纳斯的覆灭
all_card.text: 你发现了一个神迹(在冒险参考卡牌上放置1资源)。 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: Although this city-state was founded ages ago and stood for over a thousand years, it is no more. The tales tell of a single night in which Sarnath fell. Now very little of it remains: only a vast marsh where the city once stood tall and proud. Among the ruins you find no standing buildings, but rubble of marble, brick, and chalcedony. But as you approach the remains, lightning splits the sky. There is a blinding flash. As you blink your eyes, everything changes. Where before no city stood, now there looms a ghostly image of Sarnath as it once was. Near the lake, where the lightning struck, you find a curious and ancient idol of green stone. It is coated with seaweed and chiseled in the likeness of a great water lizard. One of the gods of this realm, perhaps?
all_card.real_text: You have uncovered a Sign of the Gods (place 1 resource on the scenario reference card). Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: “在离灰城伊伯不远的地方，这些游牧民族开始兴建萨尔纳斯……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《降临在萨尔纳斯的灾殃》</cite>
all_card.name: 伊伯遗迹
all_card.text: 掩藏。 强制 - 你调查伊伯遗迹时，揭示[skull]或[cultist]标记后：弃掉一个你控制的支援。
all_card.traits: 米纳尔. 古代. 遗迹
all_card.back_text: 掩藏。 強制 - 在你調查伊伯遺跡時抽出了[skull]或[cultist]標記後：棄掉你控制的1張支援卡。
all_card.real_flavor:
"Not far from the gray city of Ib did the wandering tribes lay the first stones of Sarnath..."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Doom That Came to Sarnath"
all_card.real_text: Veiled. Forced - After you reveal a [skull] or [cultist] token while investigating Ruins of Ib: Discard an asset you control.

all_card.flavor: 据说，萨尔纳斯曾在数千年之前摧毁了伊伯的城邦。根据你所搜集到的信息，伊伯住民并没有为非作歹，只是外表令人生厌，并且在它们城市里的灰色巨石上雕刻些怪异的雕塑。然而，萨尔纳斯人面临的报应却远远超过了他们犯下的罪孽。即便是距离伊伯覆灭十分遥远的现在，无名湖畔依然有像是伊伯住民的生物出没，它们会追猎入侵者——比如摧毁了它们文明的萨尔纳斯武士，比如你自己。
all_card.name: 亡者之魂
all_card.text:
记住调查员“知道伊伯发生的事情”。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: It is said that the people of Sarnath were the ones who destroyed the city of Ib thousands of years ago. From what you can gather, the inhabitants of Ib had committed no crime other than possessing a disturbing appearance and carving strange sculptures upon the grey monoliths within their city. However, the retribution Sarnath faced was far greater than their own sin. Even now, long after the destruction of Ib, creatures resembling the city's inhabitants still haunt the Nameless Lake, hunting down intruders like the warriors of Sarnath who destroyed their civilization so long ago. Intruders such as yourself.
all_card.real_text:
Remember that the investigators "know what happened to Ib."
Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: 在禁闭之地的远方，富强的城邦伊莱克-瓦达就坐落在中空的玻璃悬崖上。
all_card.name: 伊莱克-瓦达
all_card.text:
掩藏。
你位于伊莱克-瓦达时，你每轮打出的第一张[[法术]]、[[仪式]]或[[遗物]]卡牌的费用减少1点。
all_card.traits: 禁闭. 城市. 港口
all_card.real_flavor: Beyond the Forbidden Lands, perched atop hollow cliffs of glass, is the rich and powerful city-state of Ilek-Vad.
all_card.real_text:
Veiled.
While you are at Ilek-Vad, reduce the cost of the first [[Spell]], [[Ritual]], or [[Relic]] card you play each round by 1.

all_card.flavor: 伊莱克-瓦达的高墙之上矗立着一座令人惊异的彩虹宫殿，其塔顶由许多刻面形成，所以每当清晨的阳光照耀宫殿，都会形成明亮的彩虹。你会惊讶地发现，伊莱克一瓦达的子民一一形形色色的人们，甚至包括像你一样的外乡人——都可以自由参观宫殿，漫步在光滑的玻璃道路上，两旁是散发着芳香的花园。你可以见到伊莱克-瓦达的王，据说他通晓月亮的音律，他很乐意把他知道的关于幻梦境的一切告诉你。你再也不想离开这里。
all_card.name: 彩虹宫殿
all_card.text:
位于伊莱克-瓦达的每位调查员治愈2点恐惧并抽取2张卡牌。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: High above the walls of Ilek-Vad stands the marvelous Palace of Rainbows, its towers faceted so the sunlight forms bright rainbows when it strikes the palace each dawn. You are surprised to learn that the citizenry of Ilek-Vad - people of all stations and, indeed, even outsiders such as yourself - are free to visit the palace grounds and walk its smooth glass streets lined with fragrant gardens. You are able to meet with the king of Ilek-Vad, who is said to know the music of the Moon, and he is happy to share with you his knowledge of the Dreamlands. You never, ever want to leave.
all_card.real_text:
Each investigator at Ilek-Vad heals 2 horror and draws 2 cards.
Flip this card back over.

all_card.name: 禁闭之地
all_card.text: [action]：检定[combat](1)。如果你检定成功，检定[agility](2)。如果你检定成功，检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面。如果你在上述任何检定中检定失败，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [combat] (1). If you succeed, test [agility] (2). If you succeed, test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, flip this card over. If you fail any of these tests, take 1 damage.

all_card.flavor: 在这危机四伏的可怕地方，你被无名野兽、危险地形和难以描述的怪异生物所包围。即便如此，你依然继续前进，希望能在这个被遗弃的地方知道一些关于神明的信息。你在这里度过第三个夜晚时，你发现火焰湖畔旁边有一座庙宇。它隐藏在火山群之中，带有一座雕刻在火山岩表面的雕像，它的存在早已被古代的入梦者和异乡人所忘却。或许这是幻梦境神明的迹象？你在日志里画下这雕像的模样，希望它有所意义。
all_card.name: 诸神庙宇
all_card.text: 你发现了一个神迹(在冒险参考卡牌上放置1资源)。 将1张放在一边的黑暗夜魇混洗入遭遇牌库(如可能)。 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: Throughout these perilous and hellish lands, you are beset by nameless beasts, hazardous terrain, and creatures too bizarre to describe. Even so, you press onward in the hope that you might learn something of the gods in this forsaken place. On the third evening you spend here, you find a shrine beside a lake of fire. Tucked away among a range of volcanoes, the shrine bears a statue carved in the face of the volcanic rock, long forgotten by ancient dreamers and outsiders alike. A mark of the Dreamlands' gods, perhaps? You draw the statue's likeness in your journal and hope that it might hold some significance.
all_card.real_text: You have uncovered a Sign of the Gods (place 1 resource on the scenario reference card). Shuffle 1 set-aside copy of Tenebrous Nightgaunt into the encounter deck, if able. Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: 据说祖兰-提克曾是显赫一时的城邦，畏惧灭亡与黑夜。它们最终摧毁了这座城邦。
all_card.name: 祖兰-提克
all_card.text: 掩藏。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：每有一位调查员位于祖兰-提克，增加1张蜂拥卡牌到夜色怪群。
all_card.real_flavor: It is said that Zulan-Thek, once a mighty city, feared their dead and the Night alike. It was both which rose up to destroy the city in the end.
all_card.real_text: Veiled. Forced - At the end of the round: Add 1 swarm card to Horde of Night for each investigator in Zulan-Thek.

all_card.flavor: 这座被摧毁的城市如今剩余的最大建筑就是它的地穴。在地穴巨大的石门后面，是无数没有光亮的通道所形成的迷宫，死去的祖兰-提克人就在那里沉眠；从普通的农民和劳工，到因施展魔法而被处刑的法师、女巫和死灵法师，不论高低贵贱，他们的尸骨都在此腐坏。当你穿过阴森的廊道时，你能找到的生命迹象只有不知是谁发出的哭泣声，以及你不敢打开的封印石门背后的抓挠声。你迫不及待想离开这个不详的坑洞，但你知道里面可能藏着许多秘密。
all_card.name: 祖兰-提克的地穴
all_card.text: 你发现了一个神迹(在冒险参考卡牌上放置1资源)。 将夜色怪群加入胜利牌区。 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: The greatest structure within the ruined city is its crypt. Beyond its massive stone door lies a labyrinth of lightless passages wherein sleep the dead of Zulan-Thek: decaying bones of those both important and inconsequential, from simple farmers and laborers to wizards, witches, and necromancers executed for practicing their magical arts. As you traverse the shrouded halls, the only signs of life you come across are a sobbing voice whose owner you cannot ever seem to find, and the scraping of claws along the inside of a sealed stone door that you dare not open. You cannot wait to leave this ominous pit, and yet you know there may be many secrets hidden within.
all_card.real_text: You have uncovered a Sign of the Gods (place 1 resource on the scenario reference card). Add Horde of Night to the victory display. Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: “巴哈那码头以斑岩构成，后面是通向城邦的巨大石阶……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 巴哈那港
all_card.text: 掩藏。
all_card.traits: 奥瑞巴. 城市. 港口
all_card.real_flavor:
"The wharves of Baharna are of porphyry, and the city rises in great stone terraces behind them..."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Veiled.

all_card.flavor: 巴哈那港是一个繁忙的港口，在这里你能找到各种货物、补给品和其他东西。你可以从集市找到可供你到达南边更远处的补给品，还有用来驮行李的动物。这些动物中最常见的是斑马——这你本该料到，但亲眼所见，还是让你惊呆了。你可以花上好几天逛逛集市，还能找到许多激发你想象力的奇怪物什。这确实是个充满奇迹的地方。
all_card.name: 巴哈那港的货物
all_card.text:
位于巴哈那港的每位调查员可以将自己弃牌堆中的一张[[道具]]或[[供给]]卡牌返回自己手牌。
记住调查员“在巴哈那港口获取补给”。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: The city of Baharna is a thriving and bustling harbor where you can find all manner of trade goods, provisions, and other wares. In the marketplace, you find supplies that may aid you in your expedition to lands farther south, as well as beasts of burden to carry your belongings. It should not surprise you that the most common of these creatures are zebras, and yet you are stunned nonetheless. You could spend days perusing the bazaar and still find oddities to spark your imagination. Truly this is a land of wonders.
all_card.real_text:
Each investigator at Baharna may return an [[Item]] or [[Supply]] card from their discard pile to their hand.
Remember that the investigators have "obtained supplies from Baharna."
Flip this card back over.

all_card.name: 恩格拉尼克山脉
all_card.text: 掩藏。 强制 - 你进入恩格拉尼克山脉或发现恩格拉尼克山脉的至少1个线索后，如果调查员未“在巴哈那港口获取补给”：检定[combat](3)或[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，失去你所有剩余的行动并立即结束你的回合。
all_card.real_text: Veiled. Forced - After you enter Mt. Ngranek or discover 1 or more clues at Mt. Ngranek, if the investigators have not "obtained supplies from Baharna": Test [combat] (3) or [agility] (3). If you fail, lose your remaining actions and immediately end your turn.

all_card.flavor:
随着你开始危险的攀登，你意识到自己是唯一一个敢于攀登这座山的人。尽管伐木工和采集熔岩的人会探索较低的部分，但鲜少有人敢爬上北面更高的悬崖，当然也没有人敢到这座山南面去，毕竟从下方的城市看不到那里。
你终于来到由坚如磐石的、静止的熔岩形成的山谷。在遥远的尽头，一条蜿蜒的窄道沿着南面的山坡向上延伸。在你到达山路顶端时，你发现自己来到了一直找寻的地方：山的一侧雕着一张脸，有几百英尺高：这是梦境诸神之一的面容，至少传闻是这么说的。
all_card.name: 远古诸神的面容
all_card.text: 你发现了一个神迹(在冒险参考卡牌上放置1资源)。 将1张放在一边的黑暗夜魇混洗入遭遇牌库(如可能)。 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor:
As you begin your perilous climb, you realize that you are the only ones who dare to scale the mountain. Although woodsmen and lava gatherers explore its lower slopes, few brave the cliffs higher up on the northern face, and certainly none along the southern face of the mountain, which cannot be seen from the city below.
You eventually reach a valley of still lava, solid as rock. At the far end, a twisting, narrow path ascends the southern slope. When you reach the top, you find what you have been searching for: a face carved into the side of the mountain, hundreds of feet tall: the face of one of the Great Ones, or so it is told.
all_card.real_text: You have uncovered a Sign of the Gods (place 1 resource on the scenario reference card). Shuffle 1 set-aside copy of Tenebrous Nightgaunt into the encounter deck, if able. Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: “傍晚时分，他接近了亚斯湖更远的湖畔，远古的无名遗迹……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 无名遗迹
all_card.text: 掩藏。 强制 - 你在无名遗迹结束回合后：对你控制的一个[[盟友]]支援造成1点直接伤害。
all_card.traits: 奥瑞巴. 古代. 遗迹
all_card.real_flavor:
"By evening he was near the nameless ancient ruins on Yath's farther shore..."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Veiled. Forced - After you end your turn at Nameless Ruins: Deal 1 direct damage to an [[Ally]] asset you control.

all_card.flavor: 这个聚落的废墟十分庞大，但其地下的洞穴吸引了你的注意力。你深入地下，在一个错综复杂的禁闭迷宫中迷失了方向，无法确定自己的位置。数日来你在迷宫中搜寻，却找不到通往迷宫中央的道路。最后，你注意到一个黑色身影在角落里盯着你，仿佛是个朦胧的影子。你追着它，直到它引导你来到了巨大洞穴中央的一个墓坑，周围是古老的挂毯，上面描绘了昔日辉煌的特尔菲亚王国。你想知道那个影子为何带你来到这里。它是在帮你，还是想利用你呢？你记下特尔菲亚覆灭的故事之后便逃回了地面。你不想继续待在这里。
all_card.name: 特尔菲亚的废墟
all_card.text: 你发现了一个神迹(在冒险参考卡牌上放置1资源)。 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: The ruins of this settlement are vast, but it is the caverns that lie beneath that draw your interest. Deep underground, you become lost in a forbidden maze of wildly complex corridors, impossible to map. For days you scour the maze, unable to find the path to its core. Finally, you notice a dark shape, like a hazy shadow, watching you from around a corner. You pursue it until it leads you to a tomb in the center of the gargantuan cavern, surrounded by ancient tapestries depicting the once great kingdom of Tyrrhia. You wonder about the intentions of the shadow that led you here. Was it aiding you, or manipulating you? You record the story of Tyrrhia's fall before fleeing to the surface. You have no wish to stay any longer.
all_card.real_text: You have uncovered a Sign of the Gods (place 1 resource on the scenario reference card). Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: “……卡特知道他们来到了欧斯-纳尔盖山谷，以及坐落其中的不可思议的城邦塞勒菲斯。迅速映入眼帘的是那座美丽城邦的亮闪闪的尖塔，还有无瑕的大理石墙壁及其上方矗立的铜像，再就是横跨汇入海洋的纳拉克萨河的巨大石桥。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 塞勒菲斯
all_card.text: 掩藏。
all_card.traits: 欧斯-纳尔盖. 城市. 港口
all_card.real_flavor:
"...Carter knew that they were come to the land of Ooth-Nargai and the marvellous city of Celephaïs. Swiftly there came into sight the glittering minarets of that fabulous town, and the untarnished marble walls with their bronze statues, and the great stone bridge where Naraxa joins the sea."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Veiled.

all_card.flavor: 伦道夫停在塞勒菲斯的一条街道上，与统领全城猫咪的老首领会面，你想起你的同伴曾经告诉过你，在幻梦境，这种谜一样的生物可不止住在乌撒之城。为首的猫咪告诉伦道夫他到哪能找到“他的老朋友”，随后伦道夫带你去到城市中央的玫瑰水晶宫殿，你对此大为惊诧。你在这见到了统治这个国度的库拉尼斯王。你把你的任务告诉库拉尼斯后，他提示你要找的可能就在大神庙，它位于哈祖斯-克列格城中央，距离永恒王国十分遥远。但他同时也警告你：一旦你进入了无以达愿之庙，你可能再也无法离开。
all_card.name: 王之良言
all_card.text:
记住你“向王祈求帮助”了。
将1张放在一边的黑暗夜魇混洗入遭遇牌库(如可能)。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: Randolph stops in one of the streets of Celephaïs to meet with the old chief of the city's cats, and you recall that your companion once told you that Ulthar is not the only city of the Dreamlands in which these curious creatures dwell. The cat informs Randolph where he can find "his old friend," and you are surprised when your companion leads you to a rose-crystal palace in the center of the city. Here you meet with King Kuranes, who rules this region. When you tell Kuranes of your quest, he indicates that you may find what you are looking for in the great temple that lies in the center of Hazuth-Kleg, a city beyond his Timeless Realm. But this advice comes with a warning: Once you enter the Temple of Unattainable Desires, you might never leave.
all_card.real_text:
Remember that you have "beseeched the King."
Shuffle 1 set-aside copy of Tenebrous Nightgaunt into the encounter deck, if able.
Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: “……在海天相接的飘渺空间里，坐落着名为塞拉尼安的大理石云中城……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 塞拉尼安
all_card.text:
掩藏。
作为你进入或离开塞拉尼安的额外费用，你必须选择并弃掉你的一张手牌。
all_card.traits: 欧斯-纳尔盖. 城市. 港口
all_card.real_flavor:
"...the marble cloud-city of Serannian, that lies in ethereal space beyond where the sea meets the sky..."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text:
Veiled.
As an additional cost for you to enter or leave Serannian, you must choose and discard a card from your hand.

all_card.flavor: 美丽的塞拉尼安城是远离世间一切灾厄的避难所。在天空之上高悬的这些带有塔楼的云中城堡中，时间停滞不前。这座城市的魅力永恒不变。你可能在这里的大理石街道和完美的花园中迷失上千个日夜，而察觉不到时间的流动。这里的一切是如此平静，使你几乎忘记了自己的任务，也忘记了自己的肉体还在现实世界里沉睡着。即便如此，你依然忍不住想知道：即使你的肉体在衰老、萎缩，留在这个平静的地方，让内心得到安宁会不会更好？
all_card.name: 永恒美景
all_card.text: 位于塞拉尼安的每位调查员治愈2点伤害并获得2资源。 你发现了一个神迹(在冒险参考卡牌上放置1资源)。 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: The beautiful city of Serannian is a refuge from all the world's ills. In these turreted cloud-castles that hang in a heavenly sky, time slows to a halt. The allure of this city is ageless. You could lose yourself for years within its marbled streets and perfect gardens and never notice the difference. It is so peaceful that you nearly forget your quest, as well as the fact that your physical body still sleeps in the real world. Even so, you cannot help but wonder: Would it be better to simply stay in this tranquil realm and let your mind remain at peace, even while your body ages and withers away?
all_card.real_text: Each investigator at Serannian heals 2 damage and gains 2 resources. You have uncovered a Sign of the Gods (place 1 resource on the scenario reference card). Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: 哈祖斯-克列格与永恒王国其他地方的显著差异在于，这是一座破败的城市，不受塞勒菲斯之王管辖，有着肮脏的蜿蜒小道和玄武岩筑成的高塔。这里的一切似乎都不符合建筑学的基本定律，尽管这座城市的许多寺庙都供奉着神明，但它们都不是你要找的受人敬仰的那些。
all_card.name: 哈祖斯-克列格
all_card.text: 掩藏。
all_card.real_flavor: In stark contrast to the rest of the Timeless Realm, Hazuth-Kleg is a decaying city of dingy, twisting streets and basalt towers that lies outside the reach of the king of Celephaïs. Even simple rules of architecture do not seem to apply here, and though there are gods venerated within the city's many temples, none of them are the reputable sort that you seek.
all_card.real_text: Veiled.

all_card.flavor: 在破败的哈祖斯-克列格城中，沿着万神街道前行，就到了无以达愿之庙。这座宏伟的神庙以缟玛瑙筑成，它的铁门看起来就像扭曲盘结的蛇群，蛇目如同紫水晶一般。入口处的灯笼发出不详的红光。你一想到这里不洁的殿堂里可能会发生渎神的仪式，你就感到不寒而栗。然而，直觉告诉你，你要找的答案可能就在这里。
all_card.name: 无以达愿
all_card.text:
将放在一边的无以达愿之庙地点放置入场。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: Deep within the run-down city of Hazuth-Kleg, along the street of the pantheon, lies the Temple of Unattainable Desires. It is a grand temple of onyx, its iron gate fashioned to look like a mass of twisted and intermingled serpents with amethyst eyes. Lanterns cast a baleful red glow at the entrance. You shudder at the thought of what profane rituals might transpire within its unhallowed halls, and yet, your gut tells you this awful place may hold the answers you seek.
all_card.real_text:
Put the set-aside Temple of Unattainable Desires location into play.
Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor: 神庙内部比其所在的这座城市更加昏暗，更加蜿蜒。蒙着的灯笼发出深红色的光芒，将整座殿堂笼罩其中，你也没有受到任何形式的友善欢迎。
all_card.name: 无以达愿之庙
all_card.text:
掩藏。
进入神庙的道路已被堵住。你不能进入无以达愿之庙，除非调查员“向王祈求帮助”了。
all_card.real_flavor: The interior of the temple is even darker and more twisted than the city in which it dwells. Hooded lanterns bathe its halls in dim crimson light, and no friendly faces greet you within.
all_card.real_text:
Veiled.
The way into the temple is barred shut. You cannot enter the Temple of Unattainable Desires unless an investigator has "beseeched the king."

all_card.flavor: 神庙最深处有着最大的殿堂，也有着最可怕的诅咒。当你穿过低矮狭窄的门道，你发现自己来到了另一个迥异的地方：眼前是这座城市外部，但景象变得扭曲，令人毛骨悚然。街道两旁是摇摇欲坠的房屋，它们挨在一起，几乎形成了一条隧道，遮蔽了这个噩梦般的世界里的天空。在永恒的暮色之中，只有一颗凶星在倾斜的玄武岩塔楼和蜿蜒的街道之间闪烁。
all_card.name: 城中之城
all_card.text:
将放在一边的地图未见之城地点放置入场。
将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: In the deepest section of the temple lies its greatest hall and its greatest curse. The moment you pass under its low, narrow doorway, you find yourself in another realm altogether: a twisted, hellish version of the city outside. The streets are lined with tottering houses that lean together so that they almost form tunnels, blotting out what passes for the sky in this nightmare realm. Only a single baleful star shines in the perpetual twilight, visible between the leaning basalt towers and twisted streets.
all_card.real_text:
Put the set-aside City-Which-Appears-On-No-Map location into play.
Flip this card back over.

all_card.name: 地图未见之城
all_card.text: 掩藏。 每有一个千面祭司位于地图未见之城，其隐藏值-1。 强制 - 你调查地图未见之城时，技能检定失败后：查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张千面祭司并将其生成在此。混洗遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_text: Veiled. For each Priest of a Thousand Masks at the City-Which-Appears-On-No-Map, reduce its shroud by 1. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating the City-Which-Appears-On-No-Map: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Priest of a Thousand Masks and spawn it here. Shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: 你在这个黑暗的、被遗弃的地方穿行了数个小时。你不知道过了多久，因为高悬在你上方的星星从未移动，而此外天上什么都没有，也没有一星半点的光亮。最后你走到了城市中心的广场，正在那颗凶星下方。它的红光照耀在一尊外形异常可憎的雕像上。雕像前的石头上刻满了占星学的符号和奇怪的名字，除此之外就没有别的了。当你读到其中一个名字的那一刻，这座城市就开始崩塌，一股不可思议的力量将你拂去。几个小时之后你醒了过来，感觉头脑天旋地转。你的双手双脚都布满了狭长的、血淋淋的伤口。
all_card.name: 凶星
all_card.text: 你发现了两个神迹(在冒险参考卡牌上放置2资源)。 弃掉本地点的每个敌人。将本地点的每位调查员移动到无以达愿之庙(不能取消)。将本卡牌翻面并加入胜利牌区。
all_card.real_flavor: You traverse the tangled streets of this dark, abandoned realm for what seems like many hours. You cannot tell the passage of time, for the star that hangs above you never moves, and the rest of the sky is empty and devoid of all light. Finally you reach the square in the center of town, directly below the baleful star. Its red glare shines down on a statue depicting an otherworldly abomination. The inscription in the stone before the statue is riddled with astrological symbols and strange names, but nothing more. The moment you read one of the names, the city begins to collapse, and you are whisked away by an incomprehensible force. You awaken several hours later, your head spinning. Your arms and legs are covered in thin, bloody incisions.
all_card.real_text: You have uncovered two Signs of the Gods (place 2 resources on the scenario reference card). Discard each enemy here. Move each investigator here to the Temple of Unattainable Desires (cannot be canceled). Flip this card back over and add it to the victory display.

all_card.name: 维吉尔·格雷
all_card.text: [reaction]发现至少1个神迹后：抽取1张卡牌，获得1资源，或治愈维吉尔·格雷的1点恐惧。如果游戏中有超过1位调查员，将维吉尔·格雷的控制权交给另一位调查员。 强制 - 如果维吉尔·格雷离场：将他从游戏中移除。(FAQ v2.0)
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After 1 or more Signs of the Gods are uncovered: Either draw 1 card, gain 1 resource, or heal 1 horror from Virgil Gray. If there is more than 1 investigator in the game, give control of Virgil Gray to another investigator. Forced - If Virgil Gray leaves play: Remove him from the game.

all_card.name: 乌撒之猫
all_card.text: 蜂拥2。 在你尝试躲避本敌人，揭示混乱标记时，揭示额外一个混乱标记。(每次检定仅限一次。) 强制 - 调查员第一次击败乌撒之猫(或击败其1张蜂拥卡牌)时：增加3张蜂拥卡牌到其头领卡牌，并在你的剧本日志中记录(你的调查员姓名)已打破乌撒的法则。
all_card.real_text: Swarming 2. When you reveal chaos tokens while attempting to evade this enemy, reveal an additional token. (Limit once per test.) Forced - The first time an investigator defeats Cats of Ulthar (or one of its swarm cards): Add 3 swarm cards to the host and record in your Campaign Log (your investigator name) has broken the law of Ulthar.

all_card.name: 跟踪的蝎狮
all_card.text: 强制 - 如果你成功躲避跟踪的蝎狮：与其解除交战，但不要横置它。其不能与你交战，直到本阶段结束。
all_card.traits: 生物. 怪物. 精英
all_card.real_text: Forced - If you successfully evade Stalking Manticore: Disengage from it, but do not exhaust it. Until the end of the phase, it cannot engage you.

all_card.name: 夜色怪群
all_card.text:
庞大。蜂拥1[per_investigator]。
夜色怪群的蜂拥卡牌不能攻击。
夜色怪群的头领卡牌不能被击败。如果其将被击败，改为横置夜色怪群。
all_card.real_text:
Massive. Swarming 1 [per_investigator].
Horde of Night's swarm cards cannot attack.
Horde of Night's host card cannot be defeated. If it would be defeated, exhaust Horde of Night, instead.

all_card.name: 伊伯生物
all_card.text: 猎物 - 仅限位于[[遗迹]]地点的调查员。 冷漠。猎手。蜂拥1[per_investigator]。 敌军阶段的“敌人攻击”步骤期间，伊伯生物不攻击与其交战的调查员，改为攻击位于其地点的每位调查员(即便未与其交战)。
all_card.real_text: Prey - Investigator at a [[Ruins]] location only. Aloof. Hunter. Swarming 1 [per_investigator]. During the "enemy attacks" step of the enemy phase, instead of attacking its engaged investigator, Beings of Ib attacks each investigator at its location (even if it is unengaged).

all_card.name: 千面祭司
all_card.text:
调查员已经发现了…………2个或更多的神迹时，千面祭司得到攻击值+1与躲避值+1。
……4个或更多的神迹时，千面祭司得到生命值+2。
……6个或更多的神迹时，千面祭司得到伤害值+1，并获得反击。
all_card.real_text:
While the investigators have uncovered...
...2 or more Signs of the Gods, Priest of a Thousand Masks gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
...4 or more Signs of the Gods, Priest of a Thousand Masks gets +2 health.
...6 or more Signs of the Gods, Priest of a Thousand Masks gets +1 damage and gains retaliate.

all_card.name: 黑暗夜魇
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在黑暗夜魇因场景的设置而离场时：将其放在一边(保留其所有的标记和附属)。结算场景的设置后，将其放回场上任意一个[[城市]]地点。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When Tenebrous Nightgaunt leaves play as a result of an act's setup: Set it aside (it keeps all tokens and attachments). After resolving the act's setup, put it back into play at any [[City]] location.

all_card.name: 一群乌尼斯
all_card.text:
蜂拥1。
一群乌尼斯的头领卡牌没有附属蜂拥卡牌时，其得到攻击值+2和躲避值+2。
all_card.real_text:
Swarming 1.
While the host Pack of Vooniths has no attached swarm cards, it gets +2 fight and +2 evade.

all_card.name: 夜骑
all_card.text: 蜂拥1。 夜骑的头领卡牌没有附属蜂拥卡牌时，其得到躲避值-3。 强制 - 你躲避夜骑后：将其弃掉。
all_card.real_text: Swarming 1. While the host Nightriders has no attached swarm cards, it gets -3 evade. Forced - After you evade Nightriders: Discard it.

all_card.name: 麦格鸟之歌
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 强制 - 你移动离开其附属的地点后：受到1点恐惧，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记，并弃掉麦格鸟之歌。本效果能导致当前密谋推进。 [action]：检定[willpower](4)来抵御呼唤，或者检定[combat](4)来赶走鸟群。如果你检定成功，弃掉麦格鸟之歌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - After you move out of attached location: Take 1 horror, place 1 doom on the current agenda, and discard Song of the Magah Bird. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. [action]: Test [willpower] (4) to resist the call or [combat] (4) to drive away the birds. If you succeed, discard Song of the Magah Bird.

all_card.name: 奇妙平原
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果你所在地点没有线索，弃掉奇妙平原，其获得涌动。否则，将奇妙平原附属到你所在地点。附属地点的隐藏值-2。 强制 - 你成功调查附属的地点后：受到1点恐惧，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记，并弃掉奇妙平原。本效果能导致当前密谋推进。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no clues on your location, discard Wondrous Lands, and it gains surge. Otherwise, attach Wondrous Lands to your location. Attached location gets -2 shroud. Forced - After you successfully investigate attached location: Take 1 horror, place 1 doom on the current agenda, and discard Wondrous Lands. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 马尔登家族里的大多数人都或多或少于波士顿警署任职。不久之前，马尔登家族最小的弟弟托米也得到了自己的警徽。托米有着敏锐的洞察力、过人的胆识，还有一把可靠的步枪“贝基”，他愿献身于执法事业······但当他被借调到阿卡姆的警察局之后，他发现自己对这座诡异小城里层出不穷的怪事一点心理准备都没有。即便如此，不管罪案现场是烟雾缭绕的地下酒吧，还是血迹斑驳的圣坛，托米都不会停下追查的步子，直到将罪犯绳之以法。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，求生者卡牌([survivor])等級0-2。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：贝基、低级错误、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “保持警惕，托米。”
all_card.name: 托米·马尔登
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你控制的一个支援被击败时：获得X资源，其中X等于该支援上的伤害和恐惧总和。將该支援混洗回你的牌库。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以将托米·马尔登上的总计最多2点伤害和/或恐惧移动到你控制的一个支援上，或者将你控制的一个支援上的总计最多2点伤害和/或恐惧移动到托米·马尔登上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Most members of the Muldoon family are part of the Boston police force in some way or another. Not long ago, the youngest Muldoon brother, Tommy, got his badge. Armed with an eye for detail, fierce courage, and his trusty rifle, Becky, Tommy is dedicated to law enforcement... but when he was loaned out to the Sheriff's Department in Arkham, he found that he was not prepared for the bizarre crimes cropping up in this strange town. Even so, whether the crime scene is a smoky speakeasy or a bloodstained altar, Tommy will not rest until he can bring the culprit to justice.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Becky, Rookie Mistake, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "Eyes up, Tommy."
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] When an asset you control is defeated: Gain X resources, where X is the total amount of damage and horror on that asset. Shuffle that asset into your deck.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may move up to 2 damage and/or horror from Tommy Muldoon to an asset you control, or vice versa.

all_card.back_flavor: 曼蒂打从小时候开始，睡不着就会看书。许多夜晚都是如此度过的。她过目不忘，擅长联系事物找出真相，因此她得到了米斯卡塔尼克大学的一份宝贵工作——研究员。她曾花上数小时翻阅那些古老的禁书，细细阅读书中的亵渎内容。在阅读过程中，她发现字里行间在有规律地暗示着一场大乱即将来临。她是不是得了妄想症？还是说真有一场灾难或是动乱将要发生？
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：当构建牌库时，选择牌库卡牌张数为30、40或50。 选择次级职阶：当构建牌库时，选择潜修者([mystic])、流浪者([rogue])或求生者([survivor])。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多10张等级0-1你选择次级职阶的事件和/或技能。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：1张神秘证据(如果你的卡牌张数为40，改为2张；如果为50，则改为3张)、惊人的发现、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.name: 曼蒂·汤普森
all_card.text:
[reaction] 在你所在地点的一位调查员将要查找自己的牌库或遭遇牌库，找出卡牌并结算某一效果时：该调查员可以查找额外3张卡牌，或者该次查找多结算1个目标。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+0。查找你牌库顶的3张卡牌，找出其中一张，抽取该卡牌或者将其投入本次检定(如可能)。混洗你的牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Ever since she was a child, Mandy would read whenever she could not sleep. Such has been the case on many nights. Her remarkable memory and ability to correlate facts have landed her a highly valued job as a researcher for Miskatonic University. She has spent hours poring over the profane pages of ancient, forbidden texts. In doing so, she has discovered a pattern indicating an impending catacylsm. Has paranoia finally caught up to her? Or is a disaster of truly epic proportions on the horizon?
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: At deck creation, choose 30, 40, or 50. Secondary Class Choice: At deck creation, choose Mystic ([mystic]), Rogue ([rogue]), or Survivor ([survivor]). Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 level 0-1 events and/or skills of your chosen secondary class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 1 copy of Occult Evidence (2 copies instead if your deck size is 40; 3 copies instead if your deck size is 50), Shocking Discovery, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would search their deck or the encounter deck: They may either search 3 additional cards or resolve 1 additional target of the search. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a card and either draw it or commit it to this test, if able. Shuffle your deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 托尼能把卑鄙的人渣从世上任何一个肮脏的角落里揪出来，但他却从来没想到，自己会在印斯茅斯杀死那样的家伙。那家伙的长相与人类有几分相似，但全身都布满了惹人生厌的鳞片和粘液，像是某种恐怖的深海生物。它的气味混杂着海水、烂鱼和血液的味道。托尼本该在它跳下水后就放手不管，但他从未让赏金打过水漂，这次自然也不会善罢甘休。在那之后，他的赏金猎物又多了一种——可能是普通匪徒，也可能是异界的怪物。只要有人付钱······他定会把目标解决。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 选择次级职阶：当构建牌库时，选择守卫者([guardian])、探求者([seeker])或求生者([survivor])。 牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多10张等级0-1你选择次级职阶的事件和/或技能。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：赏金合约、2张托尼的.38柯尔特长管手枪、托尼的猎物、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “等我找到那个怪物，我就把它彻底干掉。”
all_card.name: 托尼·摩尔根
all_card.text:
在你回合期间，你可以进行额外一次行动，该行动只能用于与带有赏金的敌人交战，或攻击带有赏金的敌人。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。在赏金合约上放置1点赏金。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Tony's tracked down low-life scum in every lousy corner of the world, but nothing could have prepared him for the thing he killed in Innsmouth. It had the form of a man, more or less, but it was covered in loathsome scales and slime, like some horrid creature of the deep. It stank of salt water, rotten fish, and blood. He should've let it go when it dove into the river, but he'd never let a bounty escape before, and he wasn't about to start then. Ever since, he's found a new kind of dirtbag to hunt. Ordinary mobster or otherworldly monster, Tony will take it down... if someone is willing to pay him for it.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Secondary Class Choice: At deck creation, choose Guardian ([guardian]), Seeker ([seeker]), or Survivor ([survivor]). Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 level 0-1 events and/or skills of your chosen secondary class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Bounty Contracts, 2 copies of Tony's .38 Long Colt, Tony's Quarry, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "When I find that beast, I'll put it down for good."
all_card.real_text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to engage or fight an enemy with 1 or more bounties on it.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Place 1 bounty on Bounty Contracts.

all_card.back_flavor: 在许多年之前，卢克发现了幻梦境的入口。从他叔叔留给他的礼物——不同寻常的盒子中，他掌握了进出梦境之门的方法。从那以后，他大部分时候都在梦境里徘徊，寻历奇遇。从塞勒菲斯的街道到充满无穷谜团的魔幻森林，他信步徘徊，揭开梦境和居住在此的入梦者背后的秘密。如今，古老的混沌不仅威胁着要毁灭现实世界，还要毁灭他的梦中世界。卢克绝不允许此事发生。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：门之匣、脱离现实，1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “通往幻梦境的钥匙就在我们每个人心中。”

all_card.real_back_flavor: It was many years ago when Luke discovered the entrance to the Dreamlands. Through the gift of an unusual box his uncle had left him, he learned of a way to travel to and from the Gates of Sleep. He has since spent the majority of his days wandering the land of dreams in search of adventure. From the streets of Celephaïs to the Enchanted Wood with its endless mysteries he wanders, unraveling the secrets of the land and of the myriad dreamers who reside there. Now an ancient chaos threatens to annihilate not only the waking world but the world of his dreams as well. This is something Luke cannot allow.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Gate Box, Detached from Reality, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "The key to the Dreamlands lies within us all."

all_card.back_flavor: 派翠丝毕生都在为音乐而活。悠扬的奏鸣曲、曼妙的咏叹调、低沉洪亮的进行曲，永远是她最亲密的伙伴。但有的时候，当派翠丝拉起小提琴，她能感觉到有个超出认知的怪异存在正监视且等待着她，心急如焚。在过去的一个月里，它出现得愈发频繁，派翠丝的情绪也日渐紧绷，已开始影响她拉琴的表现。她再也无法忍受。她在阿卡姆沃德剧院举办最后一场演奏会之后，终于决定要采取行动。

all_card.real_back_flavor: All her life, Patrice has lived for music. The soaring sonatas, the graceful arias, and the booming marches have always been her closest companions. But sometimes when she plays, she can sense some alien intelligence at the edge of her awareness. Something that watches her and waits. Something that hungers. The presence has been growing over the last month and her increasing nervousness is starting to spoil her ability to play the violin. That's not something she can tolerate. After her last concert at the Ward Theatre in Arkham, she finally decided to take action.

all_card.real_text: Myriad. X is the number of other copies of Fortuitous Discovery in your discard pile. Investigate. You get +X [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, discover X additional clues at your location.

all_card.name: 自私自利

all_card.real_text: Multiplayer only. Revelation - Put Self-Centered into play in your threat area. You cannot commit cards to other investigators' skill tests or affect other investigators with player card effects (except aspects that cause damage or horror). [action][action]: Discard Self-Centered.

all_card.name: 偷窃癖

all_card.real_text: Multiplayer only. Revelation - Put Kleptomania into play in your play area. [action]: Take control of an [[Item]] asset or 2 resources from another investigator at your location. Then, shuffle Kleptomania into your deck. Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 1 horror.

all_card.real_text: Multiplayer only. Revelation - Put Narcolepsy into play in your threat area. You cannot take actions, trigger abilities, or play cards. [action]: "Wake up!" Discard Narcolepsy. Forced - After you take damage or horror: Discard Narcolepsy.

all_card.real_text: Multiplayer only. Hunter. Prey - Bearer only. The bearer of Your Worst Nightmare cannot attack, damage, or defeat it.

all_card.back_text:
如果是场景1、2或3，阅读以下内容：
台阶开始扭曲，像是一条从睡眠中苏醒的蛇。你想要保持平衡，但楼梯开始倾斜、翻转，这儿没有任何东西能让你攀扶站稳
幸存的每位调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。这些调查员在被击败之前，每人可以检定[willpower](3)来记住这一切都是一场梦。检定成功的调查员改为被击败并承受1点精神创伤。
如果是场景4，阅读以下内容：
“救命！帮帮我！有人吗！”远离道路的树林里传来一声呼喊。正常来说，这种把戏骗不了你，但这道声音实在太过耳熟，熟悉到你无法置若罔闻。也许是你爱的人，或者是曾在需要你的时候被你辜负的人。是谁都没关系，现在已经晚了。你转身寻找道路，但怎么也找不到。
在剧本日志中，记录入梦者偏离了道路。每位幸存的调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。
all_card.flavor: 你从最初的梦中被拉入另一个熟悉的梦境：正如维吉尔·格雷在《传奇故事》中所写的自己经历的梦境。这是真的梦吗？抑或这只是你的大脑想象出来的、你期待看到的画面？
all_card.name: 穿越门扉之旅
all_card.text: 强制 - 神话阶段期间，在毁灭标记放置到本密谋时，如果有调查员位于[[台阶]]地点：在本密谋上放置额外1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_text:
If it is act 1, 2, or 3, read the following:
The steps begin to twist like a snake uncoiling from its sleep. You try to keep your balance, but there is nothing for you to cling to for safety as the stairs tilt and flip.
Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. Each of those investigators may test [willpower] (3) before being defeated to remember that this is all a dream. Each investigator who succeeds is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma, instead.
If it is act 4, read the following:
"Help! Please! Anyone!" The voice called out from the trees, far from the path. Normally, this sort of trick would not have fooled you, but the voice was too familiar to ignore. A loved one, perhaps, or someone you once failed in a time of need. It doesn't matter. It's too late now. You spin and look for the path, but it is nowhere to be found.
 Record in your Campaign Log the dreamers strayed from the path. Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: From your initial dream, you have been drawn into a familiar dreamscape: the same one that Virgil Gray traversed in his story in <u>Tales from Nevermore</u>. Is this real? Or is your mind simply conjuring what it expects to see?
all_card.real_text: Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda during the mythos phase, if any investigator is at a [[Steps]] location: Place 1 additional doom on this agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 洞穴中央是一根火柱，两名头戴兜帽，面覆须髯的男子分立两侧。你认出眼前此景也出自维吉尔·格雷笔下。这两名牧师，这个洞穴：一切都与他所写的—样。要么是你们进入了同一个梦境探险，要么是你进入了他的幻觉。“你必须经受考验。”其中一名牧师神秘兮兮地说道，“你的磨难将无比沉重，因此你的试炼也将无比艰难。”
all_card.back_text:
每位调查员失去其所有线索。
将放在一边的纳什特和卡曼塔敌人放置入场，放到火焰洞穴。
你越睡越沉。在混乱袋里加入1个[skull]标记，直到剧本结束。
all_card.flavor: 你从离开最初梦境的那扇门走出，来到一条石质阶梯。成千上万条楼梯在此相互连接，台阶匪夷所思地联结起来，各个世界与人们口中的故事都在此交汇。所有楼梯交汇之处形成了一条螺旋通道，向下深入幻梦境。
all_card.name: 进入幻梦境
all_card.text: 神话阶段期间，不从遭遇牌库抽取卡牌。 目标 -  如果有调查员进入火焰洞穴，立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: At the center of the cavern is a pillar of flame flanked by two robed, bearded men. You recognize this scene from the writings of Virgil Gray. The priests, the cavern: it is all just as he described. Either you have ventured into the same dreamscape, or you are sharing in his delusions. "You must be tested," one of the priests says enigmatically. "Your ordeal will be great, and thus, so too will be your trial."
all_card.real_back_text:
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Put the set-aside Nasht and Kaman-Thah enemies into play in The Cavern of Flame.
Your slumber grows deeper. Add 1 [skull] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
all_card.real_flavor: The door leading out of your initial dream takes you to a stone staircase. Thousands of different stairways join together here, forming an incomprehensible nexus of steps where worlds and stories join together. Where the stairs meet, they form a single spiraling pathway descending deeper into the land of dreams.
all_card.real_text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - If an investigator enters The Cavern of Flame, immediately advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 牧师对你的表现感到满意，认为你有资格进入幻梦境，他们站到一旁，放你通行，另一头的门扉也为你敞开。就在你走进这道门之前，其中一名牧师伸手拉住你，给你最后一次警告：“你此行将越过众神之地。混沌之眼从今注视着你。循着道路走，你便会平安。但千万当心！”他紧紧抓着你，“不要偏离道路！”
all_card.back_text:
每位调查员失去其所有线索。
将放在一边的七百级台阶、楼梯底部和魔幻小路地点放置入场。
你越睡越沉。在混乱袋里加入1个[skull]标记，直到剧本结束。
all_card.flavor: 另一头的金色门扉受人阻隔，不会为你而开。只有那两名牧师可以裁决你是否有资格通过那扇门，踏进下方的阶梯。他们把武器——一把钢戟和一把银镰——交叉在门前。
all_card.name: 纳什特和卡曼塔的考验
all_card.text: 神话阶段期间，不从遭遇牌库抽取卡牌。 目标 -  如果纳什特和卡曼塔都不在场上，立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Satisfied that you are worthy to enter the Dreamlands, the priests step aside to let you pass, and the gate beyond opens. Before you step through, one of them grabs you by the wrist and gives you a final warning: "Your journey shall take you beyond the lands of the gods. The eye of chaos is upon you now. Follow the path, and you shall be safe. But beware!" He tightens his grip. "Stray not from the path!"
all_card.real_back_text:
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Put the set-aside Seven Hundred Steps, Base of the Steps, and The Enchanted Path locations into play.
Your slumber grows deeper. Add 1 [skull] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
all_card.real_flavor: The barred golden gates beyond will not open for you. Only the priests can judge whether you are worthy to pass through to the steps below. They cross their weapons - a steel halberd and a silver scythe - in front of the gates.
all_card.real_name: The Trial of Nasht and Kaman-Thah
all_card.real_text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - If neither Nasht nor Kaman-Thah are in play, immediately advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你到达楼梯底部，发现自己正在一片异于尘世的橡树林中。森林的地面上铺满了厚厚的落叶，像是经过无数岁月迭积而成，还有各种各样的发光真菌包围着你。树木被藤蔓侵袭扼杀，粗糙的树根穿刺在泥土之外。一条婉蜓的土路通向树林深处。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员失去其所有线索。 你越睡越沉。在混乱袋里加入1个[skull]标记，直到剧本结束。 将每个[[台阶]]地点从游戏中移除。 随机从放在一边的魔幻森林地点中选择6张，并将其放置入场。将剩余的魔幻森林从游戏中移除。 将剩余的放在一边的冒险卡牌混洗并组成遭遇牌库，除了辛劳的古革巨人和伦道夫·卡特(梦境专家)。(从现在起，神话阶段期间调查员如常从遭遇牌库抽取卡牌。)
all_card.flavor: 螺旋楼梯向下延伸，似乎无穷无尽。
all_card.name: 最后一阶
all_card.text: 神话阶段期间，不从遭遇牌库抽取卡牌。 目标 - 如果每位调查员都在魔幻小路，立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When you reach the base of the stairway, you find yourself in an otherworldly oak forest. The forest floor is thick with countless years of fallen leaves, and you are surrounded by glowing fungi of all shapes and sorts. The soil is pierced with gnarled roots, and the trees are strangled by invasive vines. A winding dirt path leads deeper into the woods.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator loses all of their clues. Your slumber grows deeper. Add 1 [skull] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign. Remove each [[Steps]] location from the game. Randomly choose 6 of the set-aside Enchanted Woods locations to put into play. Remove the other copy from the game. Shuffle all of the remaining set-aside scenario cards, except for Laboring Gug and Randolph Carter (Expert Dreamer), to form the encounter deck. (From now on, investigators draw cards from the encounter deck during each mythos phase, as normal.)
all_card.real_flavor: Spiraling stairs descend below for what seems like an infinity.
all_card.real_text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - If each investigator is at The Enchanted Path, immediately advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 当你接近这片森林的边缘，这里出现了更多像是老鼠的生物，它们从洞穴和多孔的树木中蜂涌而出。很快，它们遍布整片森林。它们包围了你，用一种你不知道为何竟能听懂的语言叽叽喳喳地叫着：“是入侵者。”“他们和猫是一伙的。”“新的入梦者。”“不，他们是跟着那只黑猫来的。”“但那只黑猫不在这儿。”“我们鼠多，他们人少。”其中几只生物开始接近你，并且发出低吼。就在这时，你听见一个人大声喊道：“你们这是要干什么？”这声音的主人是个金发的年轻男子，他脸上带着毫不畏惧的表情。一群愤怒的猫保护着他，每只猫都齐步跟在他身边，为首的是一只伤痕累累的老猫。你意识到这个人不是在对你说话，而是在对你周围的生物说话，它们受了训斥便往后退缩。然后，让你更惊讶的是，那只带有伤疤的猫开口了：“你们的贡品迟了！”
all_card.back_text: 调查员必须决定(选择一项)： - 后退并观察这离奇的一幕。(→结局1) - 打断那只猫的发言，自己来处理此事。(→结局2)
all_card.flavor: 你唯一要做的，就是不偏离这条道路。
all_card.name: 通路
all_card.text: 强制 - 任意调查员初次进入魔幻森林地点后：在剧本日志中，记录入梦者偏离了道路。 目标 - 只有在魔幻小路的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you near the edge of the wood, more of the rodent-like creatures emerge, swarming out of burrows and honeycombed trees. Soon, the whole forest is alive with them. They surround you and chitter in a language you somehow understand: "Intruders." "They are with the cats." "New dreamers." "No, they followed the black cat." "But the black cat is not here." "We are many; they are few." Several of them emit low growls as they begin to close in. ust then, you hear a human voice call out, "What is the meaning of all this?" The owner of the voice is a blond young man with an unfazed expression. He is flanked by a pack of angry cats, each of whom falls into step beside him, save for one scarred old cat who takes the lead. You realize that the man speaks not to you, but to the creatures all around you, who slink backward as they are scolded. Then, to your ever-growing surprise, the scarred cat speaks: "Your tribute is late!"
all_card.real_back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - Step back and watch this surreal scene play out. (→R1) - Interrupt the scarred cat and handle this yourself. (→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: All you have to do is stay on the path.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After the first time any investigator enters an Enchanted Woods location: Record in your Campaign Log the dreamers strayed from the path. Objective - Only investigators at The Enchanted Path may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
你已不在自己的世界里。
ff扭曲的石质螺旋楼梯悬浮在虚空之中，看不到任何支撑。楼梯底部是一座同样悬浮着的岛状平台，那里有一道金色大门，通向一个明亮的洞穴。
all_card.name: 七十级台阶
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你离开七十级台阶时：你手牌超出5张的部分，每有一张卡牌，受到1点恐惧。 [free]：选择并弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You are no longer in your own world.
A spiral of twisting stone steps hang suspended in the aether with no visible means of support. At the bottom of the steps, there is an island landing, also floating in the void, where a tall, golden gateway leads into a brightly lit cavern.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you leave the Seventy Steps: Take 1 horror for each card in your hand in excess of 5. [fast]: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: “在这个平台上，有着一道巨大的门扉，宽度横跨这整个岩石平面。这道门呈现金青铜色，熠熠生辉，朝着天空延伸开去，似乎永无尽头，消失在上方的、让我联想到暴雨云的混沌黑暗中。”<cite>珍妮弗·布罗泽克，《对抗黑风》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 你不能进入火焰洞穴，除非七十级台阶的所有线索都已发现。
all_card.flavor: “在浅眠中他走下了七十级台阶，来到火焰洞穴，向长着胡子的牧师纳什特和卡曼塔道出自己的计划。两位牧师摇着他们戴着双重冠的脑袋，发誓说这将是他灵魂的末日。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 火焰洞穴
all_card.text: 强制 - 当神话阶段结束时：位于火焰洞穴的每位调查员受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "On this landing, there was a huge gate that spanned the width of the rocky platform. Gold-bronze and glimmering, the gate reached skyward and appeared to go on forever, disappearing into a roiling darkness above that reminded me of storm clouds." - Jennifer Brozek, <u>To Fight the Black Wind</u>
all_card.real_back_text: You cannot enter The Cavern of Flame unless all of the clues on the Seventy Steps have been discovered.
all_card.real_flavor: "In light slumber he descended the seventy steps to the cavern of flame and talked of this design to the bearded priests Nasht and Kaman-Thah. And the priests shook their pshent-bearing heads and vowed it would be the death of his soul." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>

all_card.back_flavor: “于是，在向两位牧师祈求道别的祝福之后，卡特麻利地规划好自己的路线，勇敢地走下七百级台阶，来到沉眠之门。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>

all_card.real_back_flavor: "So asking a farewell blessing of the priests and thinking shrewdly on his course, he boldly descended the seven hundred steps to the Gate of Deeper Slumber." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>

all_card.back_flavor: 最后，台阶为沃土所代替。最后几级台阶盘伏着菌床，上面长满了发光的蘑菇，它们的形状与自然界常见的蘑菇不同。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Eventually, the steps give way to loamy soil. Coiling up the bottom few steps is a bed of glowing fungi whose shapes defy natural convention.

all_card.real_back_flavor: From the base of the steps, a peaceful dirt path winds through the dense forest. Many dozens of eyes watch you with curiosity from the tangled woods surrounding the path.

all_card.name: 卡曼塔的考验
all_card.text:
如果你与卡曼塔谈判，阅读以下内容：
“你的精神很强大。”你得到那位守卫者的承认，“但你准备好抛却自己对于现实世界的真实概念了吗？如果你准备好了，改变你衣服的样子。”你满心困惑地抗议。“在这里，意志主宰一切。”牧师继续说道，“如果你的决心当真够坚定，那就证明给我看。”你合上双眼，想象着另一套衣服，努力回想它的质地、颜色、气味。想象出织物的每一根线。你睁开双眼时，发现自己正穿着那套衣服。“很好。”卡曼塔说着站到一旁。
将本卡牌加入胜利区。
如果你击败了卡曼塔，阅读以下内容：
你愚蠢的反抗意图在那位牧师看来不过是个笑话，片刻后他的双目变得火红。他完全没有受伤。“你很凶猛，但猛劲只能帮你这么多。你可以过去，但听我的劝告：暴力解决不了一切问题。”
将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text:
If you parleyed with Kaman-Thah, read the following:
"Your mind is strong," the guardian admits, " but are you ready to shed your concept of truth? Of reality? If so, alter your clothing." You protest out of confusion. "This is a land of wills," the priest continues. "If your resolve is truly strong enough, prove it to me." You close your eyes and imagine a different outfit, straining to recall its texture, its color, its smell. Each and every thread of fabric. When you open your eyes, you are wearing it. "Good," Kaman-Thah says, stepping aside.
Add this card to the victory display.
If you defeated Kaman-Thah, read the following:
The priest entertains your silly notion of resistance for a few moments before his eyes turn fiery. He is completely unharmed. "You are fierce. But ferocity will only get you so far. You may pass, but heed me: Not all problems can be solved with violence."
Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.name: 纳什特的考验
all_card.text:
如果你与纳什特谈判，阅读以下内容：
“你的任务将招致死亡。”牧师预言道，“证明你能活着渡过接下来的难关，我就会让你过去。亮出你的武器吧。”你打开手掌，第一个出现在你脑海中的武器就在你手中。纳什特将它打落。“那不是武器。给我看你真正的武器。”你思索片刻。这位守卫者指的会是什么武器呢？什么武器能让你在这样的地方活命呢？然后，你脑海里浮现出答案，显而易见。你指向自己的太阳穴，纳什特点点头：“很好。
将本卡牌加入胜利区。
如果你击败了纳什特，阅读以下内容：
那位守护者轻轻一挥手便把你推飞，你猛烈地撞上洞穴的墙壁。“你的双眼错将我看成是一个体弱老者。这是给你上了一堂课：别相信自己的眼睛，它们会欺骗你。”他站到一旁，让你通过。
将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text:
If you parleyed with Nasht, read the following:
"Your quest will lead to death," the priest foretells. "Prove that you can survive what is to come, and I shall let you pass. Show me your weapon." You open your hand and reveal the first weapon that comes to your mind. Nasht slaps it out of your hand. "That is not a weapon. Show me your true weapon." You think for a moment. What weapon could the guardian possibly be referring to? What weapon could help you survive a place like this? Then the answer hits you, plain as day. You point to your temple, and Nasht nods. "Very well."
Add this card to the victory display.
If you defeated Nasht, read the following:
The guardian dismisses you with a gentle wave of his hand, and you are sent hurtling into the wall of the cavern. "Your eyes mistake me for a feeble old man. This is your lesson: Do not trust your eyes, for they will lie to you." He steps aside to let you pass.
Add this card to the victory display.
