all_card.back_flavor: 随着你继续探索这座医院，你发现怪事发生得越来越频繁。如今厚重而黑暗的蛛网遍布每个病房的角落。无数蜘蛛在墙壁和天花板上爬行，不知从何处冒出，转瞬又消失不见。这不是你的假想一一这所医院里有蛛群在蔓延。那不是一般的蜘蛛：它们比寻常蜘蛛更大，腿上带有长长的锯齿和尖刺，腹部还有许多毛。或许更令人担心的是，病房里一个医护人员都没有。除了几个战战兢兢的护工，你见不到别的医院员工，更别说护士和医生了。他们都到哪去了？
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的蜘蛛遭遇组和每张爆发，和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。 抽取放在一边的蛛群入侵剧情卡牌并结算其文本。
all_card.flavor: 当你探索圣玛丽医院时，一种沉重的不详感觉索绕着你。大厅里黑得可怕，空无一物，只有偶尔出现的护工在深夜巡视。灯光闪烁，阴影就像在角落之间飞快地移动。医院迷宫般的走廊开始变得朦胧，像梦境一般。你注意到又有一只蜘蛛正爬上你的腿，你挥手把它赶开，真想知道它们究竞为什么频频出现。
all_card.name: 圣玛丽医院的走廊
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you continue to explore the hospital, the oddities you have observed become more and more frequent. Thick, dark cobwebs now cover the corners of every room. Spiders crawl along the walls and the ceilings, emerging from seemingly nowhere and vanishing just as quickly. It's not just your imagination - an infestation of spiders has taken root within the hospital. And not just any spiders: they are larger than average, with long, jagged, barbed legs and great hairy abdomens. Perhaps even more worrying is the complete lack of hospital staff roaming the halls. Aside from several wary and frightened orderlies, you see no other staff members, not even any nurses or doctors. Where has everyone gone?
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Spiders encounter set and each set-aside copy of Outbreak into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Draw the set-aside The Infestation Begins story card and resolve its text.
all_card.real_flavor: A heavy, ominous feeling haunts you as you explore St. Mary’s Hospital. Its halls are eerily dark and empty of everything but the occasional orderly making the late-night rounds. Lights flicker, and shadows seem to dart from corner to corner. The hospital’s maze of corridors has begun to take on an almost dreamlike haziness. You notice yet another spider crawling up your leg and brush it away, wondering what is causing them to appear so often.

all_card.back_flavor: 突然，医院陷入了混乱。墙壁里传出了嘈杂声和撞击声。眼前一片黑暗，你只能勉强看到像是蜘蛛的怪物轮廓，它们正在远处疾速爬行。你转过拐角，看到一个护工在光亮的地面上痛苦翻滚，他剧烈地抽搐，仿佛被一种邪恶的力量所控制。你冲到他身边，将他身体翻过来面朝着你……然后发现他的脸上几乎完全被厚重的蛛网覆盖着，双目圆睁，目光呆滞。任凭你怎么摇晃，他都没有反应。
all_card.back_text: 找出场上的每张可疑的护工敌人，将其分别替换为一张放在一边的堕落的护工敌人(其游戏状态，所有标记和附属卡牌保持不变)。 查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出每张可疑的护工，将其从游戏中移除。 将遭遇弃牌堆、放在一边的阿特拉克·纳克亚的使徒遭遇组和剩余的堕落的护工敌人一起混洗入遭遇牌库。 在蛛群滋生袋里加入1个[skull]标记和1个[cultist]标记。
all_card.flavor: 圣玛丽医院里蛛巢四处蔓延，出现了大批怪物。它们躲在墙里，从四面八方监视着你。短短几分钟里，你就看到每个病房都布满了黏糊糊的厚重蛛网。整个医院里的灯不是熄灭了，就是在闪烁，而一些先进的医疗设备已经故障，被蛛网所笼罩。
all_card.name: 蛛巢蔓延
all_card.text: 强制 - 当神话阶段结束时：进行一次蛛群滋生检定。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Suddenly, chaos breaks out in the hospital. THe sound of chittering and crashing emerges from the walls. In the darkness, you can barely make out the shapes of bizarre spiderlike creatures scurrying in the distance. As you round a corner, you spot an orderly writhing on the polished floor, convulsing violently as though possessed by an insidious force. You rush to his side and flip him onto his back... and find that nearly all of his face is covered in thick webbing, and his eyes are wide and glazed over. He does not react as you shake him.
all_card.real_back_text: Find each Suspicious Orderly enemy in play and replace it with a set-aside Corrupted Orderly enemy (it keeps its game state, all tokens, and all attachments). Search the encounter deck and discard pile for each copy of Suspicious Orderly and remove them from the game. Shuffle the set-aside Agents of Atlach-Nacha encounter set, each remaining set-aside Corrupted Orderly enemy, and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Add 1 [skull] token and 1 [cultist] token to the infestation bag.
all_card.real_flavor: A monstrous presence has infested St. Mary’s. It lies inside the walls and watches you from all sides. In mere minutes, it has spun thick, sticky webbing throughout each of the rooms you visit. The lights are either flickering or out across the hospital, and some of the more advanced medical machinery is broken and covered in cobwebs.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Make an infestation test.

all_card.back_flavor: 蛛群占领了整个医院。没有一间病房幸免于难。你跑遍了医院的各个房间，拼命寻找出路，却只发现了布满蛛网的墙壁、裹在丝茧里的人们，以及挂在天花板上的医护人员户体。
all_card.back_text: 在剧本日志中“桥梁进度”旁作8次记录。 (→结局4)
all_card.flavor: 整幢建筑都被邪魔——那些违反自然规律的怪物——入侵。你必须设法阻止它或者逃走，免得自己也遭到吞噬。
all_card.name: 恐怖医院
all_card.text: 强制 - 当神话阶段结束时：进行一次蛛群滋生检定。 位于蛛巢地点的每个[[蜘蛛]]敌人得到+1攻击与+1躲避。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The infestation has claimed the hospital in its entirety. Not a single room has been left untouched. You race through its halls, searching desperately for a way out, and find only web-covered walls, victims wrapped in silken cocoons, and dead hospital staff hanging from the ceiling.
all_card.real_back_text: In your Campaign Log, record 8 tally marks next to "Steps of the Bridge." (→R4)
all_card.real_flavor: The entire building has become infested with a sinister evil - something that does not follow the laws of nature. You need to find some way to either stop it or to escape before it consumes you, too.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Make an infestation test. Each [[Spider]] enemy at an infested location gets +1 fight and +1 evade.

all_card.back_flavor: 你翻查医院记录并私下打探，得知最近医院中有一位病人的情况与你朋友们相似。他昏睡了几个星期之后，今早突然莫名醒了过来。医生也感到困惑，将他隔离在医院东区病房地下室的某处。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的梯井和地下室的门地点放置入场。
检查当前密谋。
- 如果是密谋2或3，进行一次蛛群滋生检定。
- 如果是密谋1，立即推进到密谋2。
all_card.flavor: 你的同伴们有些不对劲，虽然医学昌明，也无法解释他们出了些什么问题。你已决定自行调查真相，拨乱反正。
all_card.name: 寻求答案
all_card.real_back_flavor: From hospital records and snippets of hushed conversation, you are able to glean that there was recently another patient in the hospital whose condition closely mirrored that of your friends. After being comatose for weeks, the patient abruptly and inexplicably awakened just this morning. Baffled, the doctors have quarantined the patient somewhere in the basement of the hospital, below the eastern ward.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put the set-aside Stairwell and Basement Door locations into play.
Check the current agenda.
- If it is agenda 2 or 3, make an infestation test.
- If it is agenda 1, immediately advance to agenda 2.
all_card.real_flavor: Something is wrong with your companions, and while medical science has come far, it can’t account for what is happening to them. You’ve decided to take it upon yourself to figure out what is wrong and set things right.

all_card.back_flavor: 经过一番劝说，你终于说服那名金发男子倾听你的故事。你跟他说明你同伴的情况时，他神情严肃地摇头：“我早就知道维吉尔老兄会闹出事情。要是当初我能说服他不写那篇故事……”你问他说的是什么意思，他长叹一声，继续解释：“那都是真的。他写的一切。幻梦境是真实存在的。我认为有某些原因，使它与现实世界相融。所有这一切都来自这里。”他指着病房角落里的蛛网说道，“有了你的帮助，我或许能暂时阻止蛛群蔓延。然后我们再进一步调查此事。”他从病床坐起，握着你的手说道，“顺带一提，我的名字是伦道夫。伦道夫·卡特。”
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你必须找到那名神秘的病人被关在何处。如果你能找到他，跟他谈谈，也许他知道你的朋友们出的是什么问题。
all_card.name: 寻找病人
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果有调查员控制伦道夫·卡特，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: After some persuading, you manage to convince the blond-haired man to listen to your story. Once you explain to him what has happened to your companions, he shakes his head in solemn understanding. "I knew this Virgil fellow would cause trouble. If only I had convinced him not to write that story..." You ask him what he means, and he lets out a long sigh before elaborating: "It's all true. All of it. The Dreamlands is real. And I believe that something is causing it to merge with the waking world. That's where all of this is coming from," he explains, motioning to the spiderwebs in the corners of the room. "With your help, I may be able to temporarily stop the infestation from spreading. Then we can investigate this matter further." He rises from his cot and shakes your hand. "My name is Randolph, by the way. Randolph Carter."
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: You need to learn where this mysterious patient is being kept. If you can find them and speak with them, perhaps they can provide some answers about what is happening to your friends.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If an investigator controls Randolph Carter, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 封上最后的裂缝之后，蛛群消散，医院也恢复了正常。“干得好。”伦道夫说，“不过，我认为这件事值得进一步调查。目前我们还不知道是什么导致了这一切的发生。”你提醒他，你同伴仍未苏醒的问题也待解决，“嗯，当然——那件事也得调查。来吧，我们找个僻静的地方讨论接下来该怎么做。遗憾的是，我想我们在这儿已经没什么能帮你这几位朋友了。”你不知道伦道夫所说的“这儿”是指“这所医院”还是“清醒世界”，但不管是什么，这对你的同伴们都不是好兆头。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 - 如果马斯沃伦医生与你一同调查，并且本场冒险结束时她在场上，(→结局1)。 - 如果马斯沃伦医生与你一同调查，并且本场冒险结束时她不在场上，(→结局2)。 - 如果马斯沃伦医生留在病人身边，(→结局3)。
all_card.flavor: 你必须在伦道夫·卡特的帮助之下尝试弥合幻梦境和清醒世界之间的裂痕。
all_card.name: 阻止爆发
all_card.text: 每个蛛巢地点获得： “[action]：检定[willpower](X)以尝试弥合裂痕。X为本地点的隐藏值。位于本地点的调查员可以共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索，以自动成功。如果你检定成功，将本地点上的伤害标记替换为恐惧标记。直到本场游戏结束，本地点不能变成蛛巢。” 目标 - 如果场上没有蛛巢地点，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: With the final rift sealed, the infestation ceases, and the hospital returns to normal. "Good work," Randolph says. "Still, I believe this matter warrants further investigation. We do not know what caused this to happen." You remind him that there is also the matter of your companions, who still refuse to wake. "Yes, of course— that too. Come, let us go somewhere private where we can discuss what our next step should be. Sadly, I do not believe there is anything more we can do to aid your friends here." You don't know if Randolph means "here" as in "the hospital" or "here" as in "the waking world," but either way, it does not bode well for your companions.
all_card.real_back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If Dr. Maheswaran joined the investigation and she was in play when the scenario ended, (→R1). - If Dr. Maheswaran joined the investigation and she was not in play when the scenario ended, (→R2). - If Dr. Maheswaran stayed with her patients , (→R3).
all_card.real_flavor: With the aid of Randolph Carter, you must attempt to close the rifts that have opened between the Dreamlands and the waking world.
all_card.real_text: Each infested location gains: "[action]: Test [willpower] (X) to attempt to seal the rift. X is this location's shroud. Investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to automatically succeed. If you succeed, replace the damage token on this location with a horror token. For the remainder of the game, this location cannot become infested." Objective - If there are no infested locations in play, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 医院的候诊室里有着几排椅子和长凳，在这儿等待很舒适，但也很乏味。旁边有一个小书架，摆满了各种可供阅读的书本，但大多数都让你觉得枯燥得要命。
all_card.flavor: 在窗户的角落里，丝网爬上了玻璃，几乎是一根根丝在自行纺织成网。你刚来的时候有蛛网吗……？
all_card.name: 候诊室
all_card.text: 候诊室没有变成蛛巢时，其获得：“[action]：撤退。你逃出了这所医院，把同伴留在里面。”
all_card.real_back_flavor: The hospital’s waiting room is pleasant but boring, with several rows of benches and chairs. Nearby, a short bookshelf is filled with a variety of reading material, most of which you find dreadfully monotonous.
all_card.real_flavor: In the corner of the windows, silken webbing creeps along the glass, spun almost of its own accord. Was that there when you first arrived...?
all_card.real_text: While Waiting Room is not infested, it gains: "[action]: Resign. You flee the hospital, leaving your companions behind."

all_card.back_flavor: 你偷偷看向急救病房里面，发现除了你同伴所在的病房之外还有其他几个病房。
all_card.flavor: 这间病房一定有人接受了残酷的手术。房间中央的床褥上溅满了干燥的血迹，地上散落着绷带、纱布、注射器等等医疗物品。
all_card.name: 急救病房
all_card.text: 你位于急救病房时，每有一张卡牌投入到你进行的技能检定，其检定难度+1。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You peek into the emergency ward and find several other rooms besides the one where your companions are being kept.
all_card.real_flavor: This room contains the aftermath of what must have been a gruesome admission. Splatters of dried blood cover the mattress in the center of the room, and medical supplies - bandages, gauze, and syringes - litter the floor.
all_card.real_text: While you are in the Emergency Room, each of your skill tests gets +1 difficulty for each card committed to it.

all_card.back_flavor: 走廊上挂着标识“实验疗法”。你不知道圣玛丽医院里的人实验的是什么疗法，你也不想知道。
all_card.flavor: 这个病房里摆满了病床，每张病床都拉了隔帘。一台台高科技的机器放在各张病床旁边，用来实施各种激进疗法。
all_card.name: 实验疗法病房
all_card.text: [reaction]在你调查实验疗法病房时，受到1点恐惧：本次调查中实验疗法病房得到隐藏值-2。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A sign over this hallway reads "Experimental Therapies." You’re not sure what sorts of remedies the staff at St. Mary’s experiment with, and you’re not sure you want to know.
all_card.real_flavor: This room is filled with beds, each one surrounded by a partition curtain. High-tech machines sit next to each bed, ready to administer all sorts of radical treatments.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you investigate Experimental Therapies Ward, take 1 horror: Experimental Therapies Ward gets -2 shroud for this investigation.

all_card.back_flavor:
房门旁边的牌子写着：“档案。”
下面还写着一行：“仅供医院职工使用。”
all_card.flavor: 许多摆满了文件夹的架子靠墙摆放，它们离奇地被水完全浸湿。你注意到天花板由于发霉和腐烂已局部坍塌，水从天花板滴到地面。你每走一步，鞋子都被蛛网粘住。
all_card.name: 档案室
all_card.text: [action][action][action]如果你未与任何敌人交战：依次进行4个基础调查行动。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A plaque next to the door of this room reads: "RECORDS."
Underneath that, another sign warns: "STAFF ONLY."
all_card.real_flavor: Shelves of folders line the walls of this room, and for some strange reason, they are completely waterlogged. You notice that the ceiling has partially collapsed due to mold and rot, and water drips from the ceiling onto the floor. Webs stick to your shoes with every step you take.
all_card.real_text: [action][action][action] If you are not engaged with any enemies: One at a time, take 4 basic investigate actions.

all_card.back_flavor: 实验疗法病房后面有一扇不带标记的门，门后是一条黑暗的楼梯，通向医院深处。
all_card.name: 梯井
all_card.text: [reaction]你从非[[地下室]]地点进入梯井后：移动到一个[[地下室]]地点。然后，检定[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。 强制 - 梯井变成蛛巢后：进行一次蛛群滋生检定。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Through an unmarked door in the hall behind the experimental therapies ward, a dark staircase leads deeper into the hospital.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you enter Stairwell from a non-[[Basement]] location: Move to a [[Basement]] location. Then, test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 2 damage. Forced - After Stairwell becomes infested: Make an infestation test.

all_card.back_flavor: 圣玛丽医院发霉冰冷的地下室的其中一扇门。
all_card.flavor: 这看起来不像人类。
all_card.name: 太平间
all_card.text: [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，发现本地点的1个线索。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧。 强制 - 太平间上最后的线索被发现后：进行一次蛛群滋生检定。
all_card.traits: 圣玛丽医院. 地下室
all_card.real_back_flavor: One of several unmarked wooden doors in the cold, musty basement of St. Mary’s Hospital.
all_card.real_flavor: That doesn't look human.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discover 1 clue at this location. If you fail, take 1 horror. Forced - After the last remaining clue is discovered from Morgue: Make an infestation test.

all_card.back_flavor: 圣玛丽医院发霉冰冷的地下室的其中一扇门。
all_card.flavor: 之前在这间病房的人们像是在手术过程中落荒而逃了。手术台上躺着一具病人尸体，从头到脚都盖着一层薄薄的白布……除了从尸体里面冒出的一些纤细的蜘蛛腿一样的东西。
all_card.name: 手术室
all_card.text: [action][action]：选择你所在地点的一位调查员并检定[intellect](4)。如果你检定成功，治愈该调查员3点伤害。如果你检定失败，对该调查员造成1点伤害。
all_card.traits: 圣玛丽医院. 地下室
all_card.real_back_flavor: One of several unmarked wooden doors in the cold, musty basement of St. Mary’s Hospital.
all_card.real_flavor: This room seems to have been abandoned midsurgery. On the operating table lies a deceased patient completely covered in a thin sheet... save for the spindly, spiderlike legs emerging from the patient's body.
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Choose an investigator at your location and test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, heal 3 damage from that investigator. If you fail, deal 1 damage to that investigator.

all_card.back_flavor: 圣玛丽医院发霉冰冷的地下室的其中一扇门。
all_card.flavor: 你一直寻找的病人就在这间黑暗的病房里，坐在房间中央的病床上。你询问他的状况，但他只回你一句：“我为什么要告诉你？反正说了你也不会相信我。”
all_card.name: 私人病房
all_card.text: [action]：谈判。检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定成功，检定[intellect](2)。如果你检定成功，本地点的调查员可以共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索，以将放在一边的伦道夫·卡特支援置于本地点的一位调查员控制之下。
all_card.traits: 圣玛丽医院. 地下室
all_card.real_back_flavor: One of several unmarked wooden doors in the cold, musty basement of St. Mary’s Hospital.
all_card.real_flavor: The patient you've been looking for sits on a bed in the middle of this dark room. You ask him about his condition, but he merely replies, "Why should I help you? You'd never believe me, anyway."
all_card.real_text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (2). If you succeed, test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues as a group to give control of the set-aside Randolph Carter asset to an investigator at this location.

all_card.back_text: 只有在从蛛群滋生袋揭示蛛群滋生标记时，才使用这些结果。 [skull]：将本标记放在一边。查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张[[蜘蛛]]敌人并将其生成在距离任意一位调查员最近的蛛巢地点。 [tablet]：将本标记放在一边。 [cultist]：将本标记放在一边。选择一个与蛛巢地点连接的地点。该地点变成蛛巢(在该地点上放置1个伤害标记作为表示)。然后，如果有至少2个[cultist]标记被放在一边，将所有放在一边的蛛群滋生标记放回蛛群滋生袋。
all_card.name: 蛛群入侵
all_card.text:
在线索最多的地点上放置1个伤害标记(如果游戏中有3或4位调查员，改为在线索最多的2个地点上放置)。本场冒险剩余时间内，地点上的伤害标记表示蛛群的蔓延路线。带有伤害标记的每个地点视为“蛛巢”地点。
用下列标记单独创建一个袋子：[skull]、[tablet]、[tablet]、[tablet]、[tablet]、[cultist]、[cultist]。(如果你没有第二个袋子，你可以用杯子、碗，或其他不透明容器代替。)这个袋子就是蛛群滋生袋，这些标记就是蛛群滋生标记，而不是混乱标记。
有的能力会指示玩家进行蛛群滋生检定。蛛群滋生检定可能导致蛛群蔓延到其他地点，或者使位于蛛巢地点的调查员陷入危险。要结算一次蛛群滋生检定，调查员必须从蛛群滋生袋中随机揭示一个蛛群滋生标记，结算该标记在本卡牌另一面上所指示的效果。
将本卡牌翻面，放在冒险参考卡牌旁。
all_card.real_back_text: Use these results only when revealing infestation tokens from the infestation bag. [skull]: Set this token aside. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Spider]] enemy and spawn it at the infested location nearest to any investigator. [tablet]: Set this token aside. [cultist]: Set this token aside. Choose a location connected to an infested location. That location becomes infested (place a damage token on it to mark this.). Then, if there are 2 or more [cultist] tokens set aside, return all set-aside infestation tokens to the infestation bag.
all_card.real_text:
Place 1 damage token on the location with the most clues (the 2 locations with the most clues if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game). For the remainder of the scenario, damage tokens on locations represent the spreading infestation. Each location with a damage token on it is an "infested" location.
Create a separate bag consisting of the following tokens: [skull], [tablet], [tablet], [tablet], [tablet], [cultist], [cultist]. (If you do not have a second bag, use a cup, bowl, or other opaque container.) This is the infestation bag, and these are infestation tokens. They are not chaos tokens.
Some abilities will instruct the players to make an infestation test. An infestation test may cause the infestation to spread to other locations or endanger investigators at infested locations. To resolve an infestation test, an investigator must reveal a random infestation token from the infestation bag, and resolve the effects for that token as indicated on the other side of this card.
Flip this card over and place it next to the scenario reference card.

all_card.name: 伦道夫·卡特
all_card.text:
你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
[reaction]你所在地点的技能检定期间揭示[elder_thing]符号后，横置伦道夫·卡特：抽取2张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After an [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during a skill test at your location, exhaust Randolph Carter: Draw 2 cards.

all_card.name: 席瓦妮·马斯沃伦医生
all_card.text:
[free]横置席瓦妮·马斯沃伦医生：自动躲避一个交战的可疑的护工。
[reaction]在有调查员揭示[skull]或[cultist]符号作为蛛群滋生标记时，将席瓦妮·马斯沃伦医生从游戏中移除：取消该标记并将其放回蛛群滋生袋。
all_card.real_text:
[fast] Exhaust Dr. Shivani Maheswaran: Automatically evade an engaged Suspicious Orderly.
[reaction] When an investigator reveals a [skull] or [cultist] symbol on an infestation token, remove Dr. Shivani Maheswaran from the game: Cancel that token and return it to the infestation bag.

all_card.name: 可疑的护工
all_card.text:
猎手。
可疑的护工不能攻击，不能被攻击，也不能受到伤害。
可疑的护工与你交战时，你不能调查。
all_card.real_text:
Hunter.
Suspicious Orderly cannot attack, be attacked, or be dealt damage.
While Suspicious Orderly is engaged with you, you cannot investigate.

all_card.name: 堕落的护工
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 位于蛛巢地点的堕落的护工受到至少1点伤害时：取消该伤害中的1点。
all_card.traits: 类人. 职工. 蜘蛛
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When Corrupted Orderly is dealt 1 or more damage while at an infested location: Cancel 1 of that damage.

all_card.name: 爆发
all_card.text: 显现 - 执行一次蛛群滋生检定。如果你位于蛛巢地点，你揭示的每个[tablet]标记改为视作[skull]标记。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Perform an infestation test. If you are at an infested location, treat each [tablet] token you reveal as a [skull] token instead.

all_card.name: 灰织蛛
all_card.text: 猎物 - [agility]最低。 猎手。 灰织蛛处于重整状态时，位于其地点的每位调查员不能进行移动行动。
all_card.real_text: Prey - Lowest [agility]. Hunter. While Grey Weaver is ready, each investigator at its location cannot take move actions.

all_card.name: 蛛后的意志
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果你所在地点有[[蜘蛛]]敌人，你不能投入卡牌到本次技能检定。如果你检定失败，你不能攻击也不能调查，直到本轮结束。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If there is a [[Spider]] enemy at your location, you cannot commit cards to this skill test. If you fail, you cannot attack or investigate until the end of the round.

all_card.name: 蠕行之雾
all_card.text: 猎物 - 手牌最多。 猎手。庞大。 你手牌中每有一张卡牌牌背为遭遇卡牌，你攻击或尝试躲避蠕行之雾的难度提高1点。
all_card.real_text: Prey - Most cards in hand. Hunter. Massive. Increase the difficulty for you to attack or attempt to evade The Crawling Mist by 1 for each card in your hand with an encounter card back.

all_card.name: 伊吉若斯之理(混沌)
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 秘密地将本卡牌加入你的手牌。 你不能打出印刷资源费用为奇数的卡牌，也不能触发印刷资源费用为奇数的玩家卡牌上的能力。 [action]弃掉你手牌中的一张印刷资源费用为偶数的玩家卡牌：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. You cannot play cards or trigger abilities on player cards with an odd printed resource cost. [action] Discard a player card with an even printed resource cost from your hand: Discard this card from your hand.

all_card.name: 伊吉若斯之理
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 秘密地将本卡牌加入你的手牌。 你不能对技能检定投入技能图标总数为奇数的卡牌。 [action]弃掉你手牌中的一张技能图标总数为偶数的玩家卡牌：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. You cannot commit cards to skill tests with an odd number of total skill icons on them. [action] Discard a player card with an even number of total skill icons from your hand: Discard this card from your hand.

all_card.name: 伊吉若斯之理(喧嚣)
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 秘密地将本卡牌加入你的手牌。 你不能打出右下角编号为奇数的卡牌，也不能将右下角编号为奇数的卡牌投入技能检定。 [action]弃掉你手牌中的一张右下角编号为偶数的玩家卡牌：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. You cannot play cards or commit cards to skill tests with an odd number of words in their title. (A word is any text separated by spaces.) [action] Discard a player card with an even number of words in its title from your hand: Discard this card from your hand.

all_card.flavor: “……就算是神或恶魔，也不曾渴望过我们所低声计划的发现与征服。”——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《修普诺斯》
all_card.name: 修普诺斯的低语
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 选择一项技能([willpower]、[intellect]、[combat]或[agility])。直到本轮结束，每位调查员所选技能-2。你不能选择本轮已被相同卡牌效果选择的技能。
all_card.real_flavor: "...no god or daemon could have aspired to discoveries and conquests like those which we planned in whispers." - H. P. Lovecraft, "Hypnos"
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Choose a skill ([willpower], [intellect], [combat], or [agility]). For the remainder of the round, each investigator gets -2 to the chosen skill. You cannot choose a skill that has already been chosen by a copy of this effect this round.

all_card.name: 追猎噩妖
all_card.text: 猎手。 猎物 - 伤害最多。 强制 - 追猎噩妖进入[[古革巨人]]敌人所在地点后：重整该地点的每个[[古革巨人]]敌人，并对追猎噩妖造成1点伤害。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 噩妖
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Prey - Most damage. Forced - After Hunting Ghast enters a location with a [[Gug]] enemy: Ready each [[Gug]] enemy at its location and deal 1 damage to Hunting Ghast.

all_card.name: 笨拙的古革巨人
all_card.text: 强制 - 笨拙的古革巨人横置后：其在下一个补给阶段期间不重整。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Lumbering Gug exhausts: It does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

all_card.name: 入梦者的诅咒
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](5)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害，最多受到3点伤害。统计投入本技能检定的图标时，[intellect]、[combat]和[agility]图标计为1个匹配图标，[willpower]和[wild]图标计为2个匹配图标。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, take 1 damage, to a maximum of 3 damage. For the purposes of counting icons committed to this skill test, [intellect], [combat], and [agility] icons count as matching icons, and [willpower] and [wild] icons count as 2 matching icons.

all_card.name: 睡眠恐惧症
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](5)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧，最多受到3点恐惧。统计投入本技能检定的图标时，[intellect]、[combat]和[agility]图标计为1个匹配图标，[willpower]和[wild]图标计为2个匹配图标。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror, to a maximum of 3 horror. For the purposes of counting icons committed to this skill test, [intellect], [combat], and [agility] icons count as matching icons, and [willpower] and [wild] icons count as 2 matching icons.

all_card.name: 沉眠
all_card.text: 显现 - 将沉眠放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你的手牌上限减少3张，并且你每次抽取(1张或多张)卡牌后检查上限。 [action][action]：弃掉沉眠。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Deeper Slumber into play in your threat area. Your maximum hand size is reduced by 3 and is checked after each time you draw 1 or more cards. [action][action]: Discard Deeper Slumber.

all_card.name: 幻梦境月食
all_card.text: 显现 - 将幻梦境月食放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 强制 - 在你发动一次调查时：你必须受到1点恐惧，或本次调查你所在地点的隐藏值+2。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：弃掉幻梦境月食。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Dreamlands Eclipse into play next to the agenda deck. Forced - When you initiate an investigation: You must either take 1 horror, or your location gets +2 shroud for this investigation. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Dreamlands Eclipse.

all_card.name: 棱镜光华
all_card.text: 显现 - 将棱镜光华放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你每轮第一次执行以下行动(抽取、资源、打出)之一，须支付额外1个行动。 强制 - 你成功调查一个地点后：不发现线索，改为弃掉棱镜光华。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Prismatic Phenomenon into play in your threat area. The first time you perform one of the following actions (draw, resource, or play) each round, it costs 1 additional action. Forced - After you successfully investigate a location: Instead of discovering clues, discard Prismatic Phenomenon.

all_card.name: 黑夜恐怖
all_card.text: 显现 - 将黑夜恐怖放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你技能检定失败后：揭示你牌库顶的3张卡牌。抽取以此方式揭示的每张弱点卡牌，将其他卡牌从游戏中移除。 [action]如果黑夜恐怖在你的威胁区域：检定[willpower](4)。本次检定结束后，弃掉黑夜恐怖(即便你检定失败)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Night Terrors into play in your threat area. Forced - After you fail a skill test: Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Draw each weakness revealed this way and remove the other cards from the game. [action] If Night Terrors is in your threat area: Test [willpower] (4). After this test ends, discard Night Terrors (even if you fail).

all_card.name: 窥看地下世界
all_card.text: 显现 - 将窥看地下世界放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 在你将要受到伤害和/或恐惧时：受到额外1点伤害或恐惧。 [free]：弃掉窥看地下世界。然后，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Glimpse of the Underworld into play in your threat area. Forced - When you would take damage and/or horror: Take 1 additional damage or horror. [fast]: Discard Glimpse of the Underworld. Then, take 1 damage and 1 horror.

all_card.name: 现实之线
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你控制的印刷资源费用最高的非永久且非弱点的支援。否则，现实之线获得涌动。 将所附属支援的印刷文本框视为空白(除[[特性]]和强制能力外)。 [action]弃掉一个你控制的支援：弃掉现实之线。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the non-permanent, non-weakness asset you control with the highest printed cost. Otherwise, Threads of Reality gains surge. Treat attached asset as if its printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]] and forced abilities). [action] Discard an asset you control: Discard Threads of Reality.

all_card.name: 冷原蜘蛛
all_card.text: 强制 - 在敌军阶段结束时：增加1张蜂拥卡牌到场上的每张蛛群敌人。如果场上没有蛛群敌人，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张蛛群敌人，将其生成(不带蜂拥卡牌)在冷原蜘蛛所在地点。
all_card.real_text: Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Add 1 swarm card to each Swarm of Spiders enemy in play. If there are no Swarm of Spiders enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Spiders enemy and spawn it at Spider of Leng's location with no swarm cards.

all_card.name: 蛛群
all_card.text: 蜂拥2。 X等于本地点的蛛群敌人数量(包括蜂拥卡牌)。
all_card.real_text: Swarming 2. X equals the number of Swarm of Spiders enemies at this location (including swarm cards).

all_card.name: 恶心蛛网
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 位于附属地点的每个[[蜘蛛]]敌人获得反击和警戒。调查员不能移动离开附属地点。 [action]：检定[combat](3)或[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉恶心蛛网。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Each [[Spider]] enemy at attached location gains retaliate and alert. Investigators cannot move out of attached location. [action]: Test [combat] (3) or [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Sickening Webs.

all_card.name: 海盗追猎
all_card.text: 显现 - 将海盗追猎附属到当前场景。 强制 - 在场景推进时：每位调查员受到2点伤害。 附属的场景获得：“[action]：检定[intellect](4)智胜海盗，或检定[agility](4)偷偷溜走。如果你检定成功，弃掉海盗追猎。”
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Hunted by Corsairs to the current act. Forced - When the act advances: Each investigator takes 2 damage. Attached act gains: "[action]: Test [intellect] (4) to outwit the Corsairs or [agility] (4) to sneak past them. If you succeed, discard Hunted by Corsairs."

all_card.name: 冷原海盗
all_card.text: 生成 - 最近的[[城市]]或[[月面]]地点。 警戒。 强制 - 冷原海盗通过其警戒关键词攻击后：直到本阶段结束，其躲避值-3。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Nearest [[City]] or [[Surface]] location. Alert. Forced - After Corsair of Leng attacks via its alert keyword: It gets -3 evade for the remainder of the phase.

all_card.flavor: “……虽然它们大多时候以蕈类为食，但也有传闻称它们对肉类亦有些兴趣……”——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》
all_card.name: 鬼祟的祖格鼠

all_card.real_flavor: "...although they live mostly on fungi it is muttered that they have also a slight taste for meat..." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Engaged with the investigator at your location with the lowest [combat]. Prey - Lowest [combat]. Retaliate. Swarming 1.

all_card.flavor: “……看到它们怪异的眼晴后，人们往往还要花上很长时间才能看清它们细小且有着光滑皮毛的轮廓。”——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》
all_card.name: 潜行的祖格鼠
all_card.text: 生成 - 与你所在地点[agility]最低的调查员交战。 猎物 - [agility]最低。 警戒。蜂拥1。
all_card.real_flavor: "...one sees their weird eyes long before one can discern their small, slippery brown outlines." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Engaged with the investigator at your location with the lowest [agility]. Prey - Lowest [agility]. Alert. Swarming 1.

all_card.flavor: “它们中的大多数都住在洞穴里，但也有一些住在巨大树木的枝干上……”——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》
all_card.name: 隐蔽的祖格鼠
all_card.text: 生成 - 任意一个连接地点。 猎手。蜂拥2。 强制 - 在隐蔽的祖格鼠被击败时：取消所有超出的伤害，并将其余的蜂拥/头领卡牌移动到一个连接地点，呈横置状态。
all_card.real_flavor: "Most of them live in burrows, but some inhabit the trunks of the great trees..." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Any connecting location. Hunter. Swarming 2. Forced - When Inconspicuous Zoog is defeated: Cancel all excess damage and move any of its remaining swarm/host cards to a connecting location, exhausted.

all_card.name: 祖格鼠的地穴
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，增加1张蜂拥卡牌到最近的带有蜂拥关键词的[[祖格鼠]]敌人。如果你检定失败且场上没有这类敌人，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出并抽取一张[[祖格鼠]]敌人，混洗遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, add 1 swarm card to the nearest swarming [[Zoog]] enemy. If you fail and there are no such enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Zoog]] enemy, draw it, and shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 森哲夫
all_card.text:
对你所在地点其他调查员造成的伤害和/或恐惧，可以分配给森哲夫。
[reaction]在森哲夫被击败时：选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员查找自己牌库顶的9张卡牌或弃牌堆，找出一张[[道具]]支援，将其加入自己的手牌。如果查找过牌库，将其混洗。
all_card.real_subname: Too Noble for His Own Good
all_card.real_text:
Tetsuo Mori may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
[reaction] When Tetsuo Mori is defeated: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches either their discard pile or the top 9 cards of their deck for an [[Item]] asset and adds it to their hand. Shuffle their deck if it is searched.

all_card.name: “吃一堑……”
all_card.text:
快速。在你结算一张诡计卡牌的任何效果后，将要弃掉该卡牌时打出。
将“吃一堑……”放置入场，放到你的游戏区域，附属该诡计卡牌到“吃一堑……”上。
[reaction]在任意一位调查员抽取与附属的诡计卡牌同名的卡牌时，弃掉“吃一堑……”：取消该卡牌的显现效果。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when you would discard a treachery card after resolving any of its effects.
Put "Fool me once..." into play in your play area and attach that treachery to it.
[reaction] When any investigator draws a copy of the attached treachery card, discard "Fool me once...": Cancel that card's revelation effect.

all_card.name: 自我牺牲
all_card.text:
只能投入到你所在地点的另一位调查员执行的技能检定(任意类型)中。
如果本次检定失败，检定失败的所有效果不由执行检定的调查员结算，改为必须由你结算。然后，你抽取2张卡牌，或者执行检定的调查员抽取2张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test (of any type) being performed by another investigator at your location.
If this test fails, you must resolve all effects from the failed test, instead of the performing investigator. Then, either you draw 2 cards, or the performing investigator draws 2 cards.

all_card.name: 异界手稿
all_card.text:
使用(3秘密)。
[action]横置异界手稿并花费1秘密：查找遭遇牌库顶的9张卡牌，并从中选择一张非[[精英]]卡牌。弃掉场上一张与该所选卡牌同名的卡牌。将查找的所有卡牌混洗回遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Otherworld Codex and spend 1 secret: Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck and choose a non-[[Elite]] card among them. Discard a copy of the chosen card from play. Shuffle all of the searched cards back into the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 强梦血清
all_card.text:
如果你手中有多张同名手牌，检查手牌上限时其只计作一张。
[reaction]你抽取与你手牌同名的卡牌后，揭示这两张卡牌并横置强梦血清：抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
Only the first copy of each card in your hand counts toward your maximum hand size.
[reaction] After you draw a copy of a card that is already in your hand, reveal both copies and exhaust Dream-Enhancing Serum: Draw 1 card.

all_card.name: “让上帝分辨去吧……”
all_card.text:
你在自己的一个回合期间，击败总计生命值至少为6点的敌人方可打出。
将“让上帝分辨去吧……”加入胜利区，立即结束你的回合。在本场冒险结局期间调查员取得经验值时，你取得额外1点经验值。
all_card.real_text:
Play only during one of your turns in which you defeated enemies with a total of 6 or more health.
Add "Let God sort them out..." to the victory display and immediately end your turn. When earning experience during the resolution of this scenario, you earn 1 additional experience.

all_card.name: 快速装填
all_card.text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
选择你控制的一个[[枪械]]支援(其子弹标记数量少于其“使用(X)”中的X)。在该支援上放置子弹，直到子弹数量等于其“使用(X)”中的X。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose a [[Firearm]] asset you control with fewer ammo tokens than its uses (X) value. Place ammo on that asset until it has ammo equal to its uses (X) value.

all_card.flavor: 这小子在拿到自己的第一张手牌之前，只靠打量就能猜出对方下注的理由。
all_card.name: 格雷戈里·葛利
all_card.text:
使用(9资源)。
[reaction]在你发动一次技能检定时，花费格雷戈里·葛利的最多3资源：如果本次检定成功且至少超过该资源数量，获得相同数量的资源。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 罪犯. 入梦者
all_card.real_flavor: Long before he was ever dealt his first hand, the boy was able to stare a man down and discern the meaning behind his bets.
all_card.real_text:
Uses (9 resources).
[reaction] When you initiate a skill test, spend up to 3 resources from Gregory Gry: If this test succeeds by at least that amount, gain that many resources.

all_card.flavor: 你也不是非要相信这些咒语，只是你别无选择。
all_card.name: 治愈真言
all_card.text:
使用(3充能)。
[action]花费1充能：治愈你所在地点一位调查员1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: You don't necessarily trust the occult words, but you have no other choice.
all_card.real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Heal 1 damage from an investigator at your location.

all_card.name: 缥缈灵体
all_card.text: 躲避。本次躲避尝试将你的[willpower]值加入你的技能值。如果你检定成功，和其他每个与你交战的敌人解除交战，且你视为无形(敌人不能与你交战，你不能攻击敌人也不能对敌人造成伤害)，直到本轮结束。
all_card.real_text: Evade. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, disengage from each other enemy engaged with you, and for the remainder of the round, you are ethereal (enemies cannot engage or be engaged with you, and you cannot attack or deal damage to enemies).

all_card.flavor: 你掰开尸体的手把东西拿了下来。反正他也不会发牢骚。
all_card.name: 搜刮补给
all_card.text: 选择你弃牌堆中一张等级0的卡牌。将所选卡牌加入你的手牌。
all_card.real_flavor:
You pry it out of the corpse's hand.
It's not like he's going to complain.
all_card.real_text: Choose a level 0 card in your discard pile. Add the chosen card to your hand.

all_card.name: 蛮力
all_card.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
将蛮力在基础攻击行动期间投入时，其获得[combat][combat]和以下文本：“如果本次检定成功且超过难度至少2点，本次攻击造成+2伤害。”
all_card.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
While Brute Force is committed during a basic fight action, it gains [combat][combat] and the text: "If this test is successful by 2 or more, this attack deals +2 damage."

deck_options.name: Versatile
deck_options.error: Too many off-class cards for Versatile.

all_card.flavor: 不抢风头，不代表你没做好准备。
all_card.name: 多才多艺
all_card.text:
永久。
你的牌库卡牌张数+5。
你调查员的牌库构建选项获得：“一张任意职阶([guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic]或[survivor])的其它等级0卡牌。”
all_card.real_flavor: "Unassuming" doesn't mean you're unprepared.
all_card.real_text:
Permanent.
You get +5 Deck Size.
Your investigator's Deckbuilding Options gain: "one other level 0 card from any class ([guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], or [survivor])."

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-2(如果你位于[[墓地]]地点，改为-4)。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败并且不可名状之物在场上，其攻击你(无论其当前地点)。
[tablet]：+1。黑猫掩护你。如果本次检定成功，选择并躲避任意地点的一个攻击值不超过X的敌人，其中X为你超过难度的点数。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，你必须将你的1个线索放到你所在地点，或者受到1点伤害。
all_card.name: 万千骇形
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-1(如果你位于[[墓地]]地点，改为-3)。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败并且不可名状之物在场上，其攻击你(无论其当前地点)。
[tablet]：+2。黑猫掩护你。如果本次检定成功，选择并躲避任意地点的一个攻击值不超过X的敌人，其中X为你超过难度的点数。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你检定失败，你必须将你的1个线索放到你所在地点，或者受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you are at a [[Graveyard]] location).
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and The Unnamable is in play, it attacks you (regardless of its current location).
[tablet]: +1. The black cat causes a distraction. If this test is successful, choose and evade an enemy at any location with a fight value of X or lower, where X is the amount you succeeded by.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, you must either place 1 of your clues on your location or take 1 damage.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are at a [[Graveyard]] location).
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and The Unnamable is in play, it attacks you (regardless of its current location).
[tablet]: +2. The black cat causes a distraction. If this test is successful, choose and evade an enemy at any location with a fight value of X or lower, where X is the amount you succeeded by.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, you must either place 1 of your clues on your location or take 1 damage.

all_card.flavor: 伦道夫口中“不可提及”的那座房屋并不起眼。这幢十七世纪的破败建筑已经荒废了数十年，年久失修。大门上布满了划痕，坑坑洼洼，大部分玻璃窗都破了，老鼠在裸露的地基上爬来爬去。
all_card.name: 无名之屋
all_card.real_flavor: The house that Randolph calls "The Unnamable" is not much to look at. The run-down seventeenth-century building has been abandoned for decades and has fallen into disrepair. Its door is scratched and pitted, most of the windowpanes are shattered, and rats crawl around the foundations.

all_card.name: 不可名状之物
all_card.text: 生成 - 阁楼或楼上的走廊。 冷漠。猎手。不能被击败。 以下每有一种情况属实，不可名状之物得到攻击值-1和躲避值-1(调查员“找到了破碎的镜子”，“研究了一幅亵渎的肖像画”，“发现了缺失的骨头”)。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 异形. 精英
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Attic or Upstairs Hallway. Aloof. Hunter. Cannot be defeated. For each of the following which are true, The Unnamable gets -1 fight and -1 evade (the investigators "found a cracked mirror," "studied a desecrated portrait," or "noticed the missing bones").

all_card.back_flavor: 时间所剩无几。这个实体之前似乎只是在不时出没，并且远远地观察你，但它现在凶残异常，无情地追赶着你。它身躯扭曲，猛烈摆动，似乎每个地方都会同时出现它的踪影。你必须加快速度并面对自己的恐惧，否则你永远也找不到进入幻梦境的道路。
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你刚一来到，就感觉到有邪恶之物在此潜伏。任何言辞都无法描述这个实体。有时它似乎是无形的：而其他时候，它又表现出各种形态和特征。你不时能认出一些部位——一只眼晴、一只角、一道疤痕——但是，一旦你盯着那个部位，它就会迅速消失。
all_card.name: 无名之物
all_card.text: 每张鼠群获得蜂拥1。 强制 - 当你的回合开始时，如果不可名状之物处于重整状态并且位于你所在地点：检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定失败，其攻击你(无论其是否交战)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Time is running short. The entity, which before had seemed content to loom and observe you from afar, now swells with power and pursues you with relentless ferocity. It writhes and thrashes, seemingly everywhere at once. You have to hurry and confront your fears, or you will never find your way into the Dreamlands.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: You’ve felt an evil presence lurking here ever since you arrived. The entity defies all description. At times it appears formless; at others, it embodies myriad shapes and features. You can sometimes pick out a particular aspect - an eye, a horn, a blemish - but it disappears as soon as you focus on it.
all_card.real_text: Each Swarm of Rats gains swarming 1. Forced - At the start of your turn, if The Unnamable is ready and at your location: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, it attacks you (even if it is not engaged).

all_card.back_flavor: 让你感到惊讶的是，最可怕的声音——会永远刻在你那晚的记忆里——不是不可名状之物沮丧哭喊的回响，也不是墓地里干尸被吞噬时发出的像纸张一样嘎吱嘎吱的声音。而是一扇花格窗发出的嘎吱声。伦道夫脸色苍白，僵在原地。就在他记起这道声音之后，你明白了这意味着什么。这幢房子里的所有窗框早已脱落——唯有一扇窗例外。那就是阁楼的窗户，无名之物就藏在阁楼那被诅咒的邪恶黑暗之中。它来找你了。
all_card.flavor: “一阵冰冷的刺骨寒风呼啸而来，接着是砖块与水泥剥落的咔嗒咔嗒声；幸好，我还没明白这意味着什么就昏厥过去。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《不可名状之物》</cite>
all_card.name: 无名之死
all_card.text: 每张鼠群获得蜂拥2。 不可名状之物失去冷漠并获得庞大。 强制 - 当你的回合开始时，如果不可名状之物处于重整状态并且位于你所在地点：检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定失败，其攻击你(无论其是否交战)。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
To your surprise, the most dreadful sound - the one that will forever burn in your memory of the night's events - is not the echoing, despondent cries of the unnamable monstrosity or the papery crunch of dry corpses being devoured in the graveyard. It is the simple creaking of a lattice window.
Randolph turns rigid and pale. You realize the implication just after he recalls the sound. All of the window frames in the house had fallen long ago - all save for one. It was the attic window that kept hidden the accursed demonic darkness: the thing with no name. It reaches out for you.
all_card.real_flavor:
"There was a vortex of withering, ice-cold wind, and then the rattle of loose bricks and plaster; but I had mercifully fainted before I could learn what it meant."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Unnamable"
all_card.real_text: Each Swarm of Rats gains swarming 2. The Unnamable loses aloof and gains massive. Forced - At the start of your turn, if The Unnamable is ready and at your location: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, it attacks you (even if it is not engaged).

all_card.back_flavor: 墓穴通向一条楼梯，一直延伸到地下深处，尽头消失在黑暗中。
all_card.back_text: 将不可名状之物放在一边。其保留所有标记和附属。 将所有地点从游戏中移除(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其放入胜利区)。调查员在此过程期间没有被击败。(这些地点的其他敌人和附属都被弃掉。)将放在一边的神秘阶梯地点混洗，并将其中5张放置入场，排成一条纵列。将剩余的神秘阶梯地点从游戏中移除。 将每位调查员和放在一边的不可名状之物敌人放在最上方的神秘阶梯地点，揭示该地点。 查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出两张上锁的门和两张阁楼的秘密，将其从游戏中移除。 将每张放在一边的无尽深入和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你仍然不知道你要在这幢老房子里找些什么，但伦道夫坚持说你必须找到“钥匙”。看来你别无选择，只得搜寻这幢房子，看看能找到什么。
all_card.name: 搜寻不可名状之物
all_card.text: 目标 - 探索这幢房子，以找到进入幻梦境的方法。 (找到并完成另一张冒险卡牌上的目标以推进。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The tomb opens into a staircase that stretches deep underground before disappearing into darkness.
all_card.real_back_text: Set The Unnamable aside. It keeps all tokens and attachments. Remove each location from the game (or place it in the victory display if it has Victory X and no clues on it). Investigators are not defeated during this process. (Other enemies and attachments at those locations are discarded.) Shuffle the set-aside Mysterious Stairs locations and put 5 of them into play in a vertical line. Remove the remaining Mysterious Stairs location from the game. Place each investigator and the set-aside The Unnamable enemy at the topmost Mysterious Stairs location, revealing it. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for both copies of Locked Door and both copies of Secrets in the Attic, and remove them from the game. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Endless Descent into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: You're still not sure exactly what you're meant to find inside the old house, but Randolph insists that you need to locate the "key." Seems like you have no choice but to search the house and see what you can turn up.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Explore the house to find a way into the Dreamlands. (Find and complete an objective on another scenario card to advance.)

all_card.back_flavor:
那个无名生物——无论它是什么，或者它曾经是什么——它孤独的叫声从上方远远传来，回荡在这个诡异的洞穴里。“它没法下到这里来。”伦道夫说着，松了一口气。下降的过程十分痛苦，但你们终于逃离了那无法名状的怪物。但是，你们的安全感转瞬即逝。脚下盘旋的楼梯看不到尽头。这座尖塔的石墙上，一道道窗户俯瞰着无尽的岩石峭壁和光秃秃的山峰，朦胧地罩着昏暗的光芒。你距离这个地下世界的地面还有好几英里，到那儿的时候会遇上什么样的恐怖，又有谁会知道呢？
“这只是开始。”伦道夫提醒你，“现在已经没有回头路了。你准备好继续往前走了吗？”
all_card.flavor: 这条楼梯似乎一直往下延伸，没有尽头。每当你以为自己接近了尽头，拐过弯后，你又会看到上百级台阶。
all_card.name: 无尽阶梯
all_card.text: 最下方的神秘阶梯地点被揭示时，其获得：“[action]：撤退。” 目标 - 到达阶梯底部。如果所有未被击败的调查员都已撤退，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The forlorn cries of the unnamable creature - whatever it is or once was - echo throughout the unnatural cavern from far above you. "It cannot reach us down here," Randolph says, letting out a sigh of relief. It was a harrowing descent, but you are finally safe from the indescribable thing. Even so, your safety is fleeting. The stairway coils below you with no end in sight. Windows in the spire's stone wall overlook an endless landscape of rocky crags and barren peaks, dimly lit by a grey phosphorous light. You are still many miles above the floor of this subterranean world, and who knows what horrors you may find once you arrive?
"This is only the beginning," Randolph warns you. "There is no turning back now. Are you ready to proceed?"
all_card.real_flavor: The steps seem to descend forever. Every time you think you're nearing the end, you round another corner and see hundreds more.
all_card.real_text: While the bottommost Mysterious Stairs location is revealed, it gains: "[action]: Resign." Objective - Reach the bottom of the stairs. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: “我望着墓地中央的一棵巨大的柳树，它的树干几乎陷在一块古老的、字迹模糊的石板上，我曾经说过一句荒唐的话，说那巨大的树根一定是在这片久远的、安葬死者的土地上，吸收幽灵的、难以言说的养分……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《不可名状之物》</cite>
all_card.name: 坟地
all_card.text:
抽取到的每个[[食尸鬼]]敌人不生成在在其通常的生成地点，改为生成在坟地。
[free]位于坟地的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：记住调查员“发现了缺失的骨头”。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"Looking toward the giant willow in the centre of the cemetery, whose trunk has nearly engulfed an ancient, illegible slab, I had made a fantastic remark about the spectral and unmentionable nourishment which the colossal roots must be sucking in from that hoary, charnel earth...”
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Unnamable"
all_card.real_text:
Each [[Ghoul]] enemy drawn spawns at Burial Ground instead of at its normal location.
[fast] Investigators in the Burial Ground spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "noticed the missing bones."

all_card.back_flavor: “我想看看那幢房子，卡特。它在哪里？不管那里有没有玻璃，我都想进去调查一下。还有你安放骸骨的墓穴，以及另一个没有碑文的坟墓——这整件事有点可怕。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《不可名状之物》</cite>
all_card.name: 入口
all_card.text:
[free]位于入口的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：揭示楼上的走廊。
[free]如果不可名状之物上有至少1[per_investigator]点伤害：那只怪物拖着一道烟雾，烟雾的尽头指向外头墓地中央的一座墓穴。将放在一边的无名坟墓地点放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"I'd like to see that house, Carter. Where is it? Glass or no glass, I must explore it a little. And the tomb where you put those bones, and the other grave without an inscription - the whole thing must be a bit terrible.”
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Unnamable"
all_card.real_text:
[fast] Investigators in the Entryway spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Reveal the Upstairs Hallway.
[fast] If The Unnamable has 1 [per_investigator] or more damage on it: Smoke trails off of the creature, leading to a tomb near the center of the cemetery outside. Put the set-aside Unmarked Tomb location into play.

all_card.back_flavor: 这道门之前从未打开。你只是回头看了一眼，但你认为自己看到了些什么。但你究竟看到了什么呢？是个模糊的影子？还是看到了一个人影？
all_card.name: 休息间
all_card.text:
[reaction]你成功调查休息间后，弃掉你的1张手牌：发现本地点的额外一个线索。
[free]位于休息间的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：记住调查员“研究了一幅亵渎的肖像画”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: This doorway was not open before. You only turned for a moment, but you thought you saw something. But what, exactly? A blur? A figure?
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] After you successfully investigate the Den, discard 1 card from your hand: Discover an additional clue at this location.
[fast] Investigators in the Den spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "studied a desecrated portrait."

all_card.back_flavor: 这道门之前从未打开。你只是回头看了一眼，但你认为自己看到了些什么。但你究竟看到了什么呢？是个模糊的影子？还是看到了一个人影？
all_card.name: 客厅
all_card.text:
每有一位调查员位于客厅，其得到隐藏值+1。
[free]如果不可名状之物上有至少2[per_investigator]点伤害：镜子不自然地闪着光芒，露出一抹银光。记住调查员“发现了一把奇怪的钥匙”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: This doorway was not open before. You only turned for a moment, but you thought you saw something. But what, exactly? A blur? A figure?
all_card.real_text:
For each investigator at the Parlor, it gets +1 shroud.
[fast] If The Unnamable has 2 [per_investigator] or more damage on it: The mirror gleams unnaturally, revealing a glint of silver. Remember that the investigators "recovered a strange key."

all_card.back_flavor: “快过来！我刚刚正要记录我的进度，你来看这个。这些小小的光芒是一只只眼睛。一定是的！有什么东西在盯着我。”<cite>——安妮·范德米尔·米特索达，《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 恶臭让你不敢上楼。你不能进入楼上的走廊。
all_card.name: 楼上的走廊
all_card.text: [free]位于楼上的走廊的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将放在一边的阁楼地点放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "There! I was just trying to track my progress, and you can see it. Those little glints are eyes! They have to be! Something was watching me." - Annie VanderMeer Mitsoda, <u>The Investigators of Arkham Horror</u>
all_card.real_back_text: A malodorous presence prevents you from venturing upstairs. You cannot enter the Upstairs Hallway.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Investigators in the Upstairs Hallway spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Put the set-aside Attic location into play.

all_card.back_flavor: 有什么东西在另一边刮着木板。老鼠？还是说只是你的想象？不，一定是某些东西。某些怪异的东西。
all_card.name: 藏书室
all_card.text:
作为调查藏书室的额外费用，你必须失去1个行动或受到1点恐惧。
[free]位于藏书室的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：你翻阅了一篇古怪的日志，提到外面墓地里的一座坟墓。将放在一边的无名坟墓地点放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Something scratches at the wood on the other side. Rats? Your imagination? No, something else. Something unnatural.
all_card.real_text:
As an additional cost to investigate the Library, you must either lose 1 action or take 1 horror.
[fast] Investigators in the Library spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You read a strange journal entry regarding one of the graves in the burial ground outside. Put the set-aside Unmarked Tomb location into play.

all_card.back_flavor: 有什么东西在另一边刮着木板。老鼠？还是说只是你的想象？不，一定是某些东西。某些怪异的东西。
all_card.name: 卧室
all_card.text:
[action][action]：弃掉你威胁区域的所有非弱点诡计卡牌。
[free]位于卧室的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：记住调查员“找到了破碎的镜子”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Something scratches at the wood on the other side. Rats? Your imagination? No, something else. Something unnatural.
all_card.real_text:
[action][action]: Discard all non-weakness treachery cards from your threat area.
[fast] Investigators in the Bedroom spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "found a cracked mirror."

all_card.back_flavor: “他们从不打开阁楼的门，让这整幢房子像原来一样，令人害怕，无人居住。当这里传出噪声，他们压低声音，浑身发抖；希望阁楼的门锁够结实。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《不可名状之物》</cite>
all_card.name: 阁楼
all_card.text: [free]位于阁楼的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：在一堆怪异的骨头底下，你看到了一抹银光。记住调查员“发现了一把奇怪的钥匙”。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"They never unlocked that attic door, but left the whole house as it was, dreaded and deserted. When noises came from it, they whispered and shivered; and hoped that the lock on that attic door was strong."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Unnamable"
all_card.real_text: [fast] Investigators in the Attic spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Deep within a pile of monstrous bones, you see a glint of silver. Remember that the investigators "recovered a strange key."

all_card.back_flavor: “……墓穴里传出一些声响，其中有沉闷的喘息声，飕飕的风声，令我不禁想象，米尔顿笔下那群畸形的坠入地狱的灵魂就居住在这无光的昏暗中。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《不可名状之物》</cite>
all_card.name: 无名坟墓
all_card.text: 目标 - 当一轮结束时，如果每位未被击败的调查员都位于无名坟墓，并且调查员“发现了把奇怪的钥匙”，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"...from the tomb came such a stifled uproar of gasping and whirring that my fancy peopled the rayless gloom with Miltonic legions of the misshapen damned."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Unnamable"
all_card.real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, if each undefeated investigator is at Unmarked Tomb and the investigators "recovered a strange key," advance the act.

all_card.back_flavor: “这些台阶破旧而狭窄，还因为地里渗出的液体而变得油滑，导致走在楼梯上的人根本不知道自己何时会突然摔倒，跌入无底的深坑……”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。

"So worn and narrow were the steps, and so greasy with the ooze of inner earth, that the climber never quite knew when to expect a breathless fall and hurtling down to the ultimate pits..."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>

all_card.flavor: “里面有一把失去了光泽的巨大钥匙，裹在一卷褪色的羊皮纸当中，钥匙上刻着神秘的阿拉伯式图案；却没有任何清晰可辨的文字说明。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《银钥匙》</cite>
all_card.name: 银钥匙
all_card.text: [reaction]在你将要受到恐惧时，横置银钥匙：取消该恐惧中的1点。
all_card.traits: 道具. 守护. 遗物
all_card.real_flavor:
"Inside, wrapped in a discoloured parchment, was a huge key of tarnished silver covered with cryptical arabesques; but of any legible explanation there was none."
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Silver Key"
all_card.real_subname: Key to the Gate of Dreams
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you would take horror, exhaust The Silver Key: Cancel 1 of that horror.

all_card.name: 无尽深入
all_card.text: 显现 - 将位于最上方地点的所有调查员和敌人移动到其连接的下方地点。将最上方的地点翻至其未揭示面，弃掉其所有标记和附属，将其放到最下方的地点下方。将所有未揭示的地点混洗以打乱位置，使你无法辨认。将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Move each investigator and enemy at the topmost location to the location below it. Flip the topmost location to its unrevealed side, discard all tokens and attachments from it, and place it below the bottommost location. Shuffle the positions of each unrevealed location so you cannot tell which is which. Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.name: 难以描述的鬼魅
all_card.text: 显现 - 将难以描述的鬼魅放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 不可名状之物位于你所在地点时，你得到每项技能值-1。 [action][action]：弃掉难以描述的鬼魅。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Indescribable Apparition into play in your threat area. You get -1 to each of your skills while The Unnamable is at your location. [action][action]: Discard Indescribable Apparition.

all_card.name: 发光的眼睛
all_card.text: 显现 - 将发光的眼睛放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：你的威胁区域每有一张卡牌，受到1点恐惧，最多受到3点恐惧。弃掉发光的眼睛。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Glowing Eyes into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of the round: Take 1 horror for each card in your threat area, to a maximum of 3 horror. Discard Glowing Eyes.

all_card.name: 欺骗性记忆
all_card.text: 显现 - 将欺骗性记忆放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 另一张卡牌进入你的威胁区域后：选择并弃掉你1张手牌。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉欺骗性记忆。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Deceptive Memories into play in your threat area. Forced - After another card enters your threat area: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Deceptive Memories.

all_card.name: 阁楼的秘密
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧并将阁楼的秘密放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 地点上的[free]能力不能触发。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从场上弃掉1张阁楼的秘密。(每轮最多一次。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror and put Secrets in the Attic into play next to the agenda deck. [fast] abilities on locations cannot be triggered. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Secrets in the Attic from play. (Max once per round.)

all_card.name: 空虚项链
all_card.text:
每套牌库仅限1张。使用(0充能)。
[reaction]你击败一个敌人后：在空虚项链上放置1充能。
[free]如果空虚项链上有至少3充能：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出食愿项链，将其与空虚项链交换，将空虚项链上的所有充能移动到食愿项链上。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 祝福
all_card.real_text:
Limit 1 per deck. Uses (0 charges).
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Place 1 charge on Empty Vessel.
[fast] If there are at least 3 charges on Empty Vessel: Search your bonded cards for Wish Eater and swap it with Empty Vessel, moving all charges from Empty Vessel to Wish Eater.

all_card.name: 食愿项链
all_card.text: 绑定(空虚项链)。 [reaction]在你进行技能检定期间揭示[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]混乱标记时，花费1充能：取消该混乱标记。治愈1点伤害和1点恐惧。 强制 - 如果食愿项链没有充能：查找你的绑定卡牌。找出空虚项链，将其与食愿项链交换。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 祝福
all_card.real_text: Bonded (Empty Vessel). [reaction] When you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] chaos token during a skill test, spend 1 charge: Cancel that token. Heal 1 damage and 1 horror. Forced - If Wish Eater has no charges: Search your bonded cards for Empty Vessel and swap it with Wish Eater.

all_card.name: 惊喜的发现
all_card.text:
多重。
[reaction]在你查找牌库，并且查找过的卡牌中有惊喜的发现时：将其放置入场，放到你的游戏区域。在你执行的能够投入该卡牌的下一次技能检定中，你必须投入该卡牌。如果该技能检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。(每次查找最多使用1次[[研究]]能力。)
all_card.real_text:
Myriad.
[reaction] When you search your deck and Surprising Find is among the searched cards: Put it into play in your play area. You must commit it to the next eligible skill test you perform. If that test is successful, draw 1 card. (Max one [[Research]] ability per search.)

all_card.name: 智慧古书
all_card.text:
使用(2秘密)。
[action]横置智慧古书：选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员查找其牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张将其抽取，并将剩余卡牌混洗入自己牌库。然后，你可以花费1秘密，使该调查员立即打出该卡牌，其费用-2。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (2 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Old Book of Lore: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches the top 3 cards of their deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles their deck. Then, you may spend 1 secret to have that investigator immediately play that card, reducing its cost by 2.

all_card.name: 绞喉索
all_card.text: [free]在你回合期间，横置绞喉索：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。只能对剩余生命值为正好1点的敌人进行本次攻击。
all_card.real_text: [fast] During your turn, exhaust Garrote Wire: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. Use only on an enemy with exactly 1 remaining health.

all_card.flavor: “谢尔顿？欧巴尼恩？我才不管他们是谁。只要能拿到报酬就行。”
all_card.name: 黛利拉·欧鲁尔克
all_card.text:
你得到+1[combat]和+1[agility]。
[free]横置黛利拉·欧鲁尔克并花费X资源：选择你所在地点的一个敌人。对所选敌人造成1点伤害(如果该敌人已被横置，改为造成2点伤害)。X为所选敌人的躲避值。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 罪犯. 犯罪团伙
all_card.real_flavor: "Sheldon? O'Bannion? Don't care. Just as long as I get paid."
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [combat] and +1 [agility].
[fast] Exhaust Delilah O'Rourke and spend X resources: Choose an enemy at your location. Deal 1 damage to the chosen enemy (2 damage instead if that enemy is exhausted). X is the chosen enemy's evade value.

all_card.name: 受召猎犬
all_card.text: 作为打出受召猎犬的额外费用，你必须查找你的绑定卡牌，找出1张脱缰野兽并将其混洗入你的牌库。 [free]在你回合期间(行动外)，横置受召猎犬： 攻击/调查。以基础值为5的[combat]攻击，或以基础值为5的[intellect]调查。
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost to play Summoned Hound, you must search your bonded cards for 1 copy of Unbound Beast and shuffle it into your deck. [fast] During your turn, except during an action, exhaust Summoned Hound: Fight/Investigate. Either attack with a base [combat] skill of 5, or investigate with a base [intellect] skill of 5.

all_card.name: 脱缰野兽
all_card.text: 绑定(受召猎犬)。 猎物 - 承受者。 猎手。反击。 显现 - 如果场上没有受召猎犬，将脱缰野兽放在一边，位于场外。否则，将一位调查员的受召猎犬放在一边，位于场外，且脱缰野兽生成并与该调查员交战。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 异次元. 廷达洛斯
all_card.real_text: Bonded (Summoned Hound). Prey - Bearer. Hunter. Retaliate. Revelation - If there is no copy of Summoned Hound in play, set Unbound Beast aside, out of play. Otherwise, set an investigator's Summoned Hound aside, out of play, and spawn Unbound Beast engaged with the same investigator.

all_card.name: 背水一战
all_card.text:
如果你的资源数量少于5，获得资源，直到你的资源数量等于5。
如果你的手牌数量少于5，抽取卡牌，直到你的手牌数量等于5。

If you have fewer than 5 resources, gain resources until you have 5 resources.
If you have fewer than 5 cards in your hand, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.
Remove Nothing Left to Lose from the game.

all_card.name: 黑猫
all_card.text:
每当你在技能检定期间揭示[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[elder_sign]符号，你可以不使用该符号的效果，改为选择使用以下效果：
[tablet]:-1。黑猫受到1点直接伤害。
[elder_thing]:-1。黑猫受到1点直接恐惧。
[elder_sign]:+5。治愈黑猫的全部伤害和恐惧。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 化身. 幻梦境
all_card.real_subname: A Liar, or a Prophet, or Both
all_card.real_text:
Anytime you reveal a [tablet], [elder_thing], or [elder_sign] symbol during a skill test, you may choose to use the following effects instead of that symbol's normal effects:
[tablet]: -1. The Black Cat takes 1 direct damage.
[elder_thing]: -1. The Black Cat takes 1 direct horror.
[elder_sign]: +5. Heal all damage and horror from The Black Cat.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为当前场景编号加上当前密谋编号。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致当前密谋推进。
[tablet]：-6。如果你检定失败，选择并揭示你手中的一张奈亚拉托提普。其攻击你，将其混洗入遭遇牌库。
[elder_thing]：-1。黑猫提醒你这一切都是一场梦。
all_card.name: 神居之所
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为当前场景编号。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。

[elder_thing]：0。黑猫提醒你这一切都是一场梦。

Hard / Expert

[tablet]: -6. If you fail, choose and reveal a copy of Nyarlathotep in your hand. It attacks you and is shuffled into the encounter deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 别想逃。你归我了。你永永远远都不会再醒来。
all_card.back_text: 如果是场景4，阅读以下内容：在每个被遗忘的高塔地点上放置线索，直到其线索数量等于其线索值。 每位调查员揭示自己手牌中的每张奈亚拉托提普。没有揭示奈亚拉托提普的每位调查员必须受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。 调查员每揭示一张奈亚拉托提普，其必须选择： - 奈亚拉托提普立即攻击该调查员，并将其混洗入遭遇牌库。 - 奈亚拉托提普立即攻击该调查员三次，并回到该调查员的手牌。
all_card.flavor:
我看到你了。
在那把命运视作儿戏。
你真以为能逃出我的掌心？
你那份胸有成竹的底气从何而来？
all_card.name: 混沌之眼
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Do not try to run now. You are mine.
You will never, ever, ever wake up.
all_card.real_back_text: If it is act 4, read the following: Place clues on each Forsaken Tower location until it has clues equal to its clue value. Reveal each copy of Nyarlathotep in each investigator's hand. Each investigator who did not reveal a copy of Nyarlathotep must take either 1 damage or 1 horror. For each copy of Nyarlathotep revealed by an investigator, that investigator must choose: - Nyarlathotep immediately attacks that investigator and is shuffled into the encounter deck. - Nyarlathotep immediately attacks that investigator three times and is returned to that investigator's hand.
all_card.real_flavor:
I see you there.

Playing with fate like it is
all some sort of game.

Did you really think you
could escape my grasp?

What makes you
think you are
the one
in
control?

all_card.back_flavor: 对，继续读吧，我的提线木偶。这将是你最后的一场梦。这是你死刑延缓的最后一刻，接下来，你将归我所有。
all_card.back_text: 如果是场景4，阅读以下内容：在每个被遗忘的高塔地点上放置线索，直到其线索数量等于其线索值。 每位调查员揭示自己手牌中的每张奈亚拉托提普。没有揭示奈亚拉托提普的每位调查员必须受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。 调查员每揭示一张奈亚拉托提普，其必须选择： - 奈亚拉托提普立即攻击该调查员，并将其混洗入遭遇牌库。 - 奈亚拉托提普立即攻击该调查员三次，并回到该调查员的手牌。
all_card.flavor:
你为何抗争？
为何想逃？
我是你的未来，
你的命运。
你的面孔将是我收藏的面具。
你的尸体将是我穿着的新衣。
all_card.name: 混沌之形
all_card.real_back_flavor: Yes, read on, my puppet. This will be your last dream. Your final reprieve. Then I shall take the rest for myself.
all_card.real_back_text: If it is act 4, read the following: Place clues on each Forsaken Tower location until it has clues equal to its clue value. Reveal each copy of Nyarlathotep in each investigator's hand. Each investigator who did not reveal a copy of Nyarlathotep must take either 1 damage or 1 horror. For each copy of Nyarlathotep revealed by an investigator, that investigator must choose: - Nyarlathotep immediately attacks that investigator and is shuffled into the encounter deck. - Nyarlathotep immediately attacks that investigator three times and is returned to that investigator's hand.
all_card.real_flavor:
Why do you fight?
Why do you flee?

I am your future.
I am your fate.

Another mask for my collection.

Another corpse
for me
to
wear.

all_card.back_flavor: 我跟你玩够了。我会拿走属于我的东西。你以为你能轻易走进幻梦境，而不用承受任何后果吗？不受惩罚？毫发无损？你凭什么抱有这样的幻想？以为自己能像寄生虫一样侵入别人的梦境，能把这些梦境当作是自己的一样，将它们吞噬？滚出去！我会撕开你的脑壳，掏出你的脑子，就像剥下一只猫的皮一样。看好了，我正要破开你的脑壳，把“你”抽出来，然后，把“我”放到里面去。你将不复存在。你真的以为结果会不一样吗？现在就给我滚出去。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员被击败，并且发疯。
all_card.flavor: Hei！Aa-shanta’ nygh！/我是混沌的真形/不要注视我的外表，因为它千变万化/我命令你继续读下去/不要凝望我的面容，其形亦无形/我说过让你别再逃跑/不要听进真相，真相即谎言/我警告过你别再作梦/一切皆属于我，只属于我/不属于其他任何人/我认定你不会反抗/跑呀，接着跑/你没有救星，也没有最后一根稻草/我很享受这场追逐/皆为虚无/皆为虚无
all_card.name: 混沌化身
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Enough playing with you. I will have what is owed to me.
You think you can simply venture into this land of dreams with no consequence? With impunity? With no spilt blood?
Who are you to partake of such fantasy? To intrude on the dreams of others like a parasite? To devour these dreams like they are yours to enjoy? Out with you! I shall rend your mind from your skull as one skins a cat. Look, see: I am cracking open your skull, and pouring out your <u>you</u>. And now, I am filling it with <u>me</u>. You are no longer. Did you really think there would be any other result? Out with you, now. Begone.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator is defeated and driven insane.
all_card.real_flavor: Hei! Aa-shanta 'nygh! / I am true Chaos / look not upon my shape for it is ever-changing / I commanded you to keep reading / look not upon my face for it is no face at all / I told you to stop running / listen not for the truth for the truth is a lie / I warned you not to dream / Mine and mine alone / Nobody else can have it / I dared you not to fight / Run then, rabbit, run / there is nothing more / I cherish the chase / nothing / nothing

all_card.back_flavor: 穿越这片荒土绝非易事。寒冷噬咬着你的皮肤，刺骨的寒风抽打着你的脸庞。就算没有出现无名的怪物，这片荒土也依旧能够夺走你的生命。你拼命地想要寻找避难所来保持身体的温度，但在这冰封的荒土却找不到那样的所在。你筋疲力竭，倒在旁边的一座雪堆里。让你惊讶的是，你感到有坚硬的岩石撞上了你的胸膛。这股疼痛使萎靡不振的你一下惊醒，你扒开雪堆，查看里面藏了些什么。终于，你发现了一块古怪的石像，其外形像是一头长角的怪物，正散发着光芒，并且伴随着微弱的能量搏动着。你听到雪中远远传来石板移动的声音。
all_card.back_text:
揭示冷原隐修院。
将放在一边的不可描述的高阶祭司敌人生成在冷原隐修院。
all_card.flavor: 你来到了冷原，一片冰封雪裹的不毛之地，你认为未知的卡达斯就在这个地方。与此同时，某个存在正嘲笑着你，侵蚀着你的内心。你无法听见，但在你意识内却能感觉到它无言的嘲弄。
all_card.name: 穿越冰封荒土
all_card.real_back_flavor: Traversing the wastes of Leng is no easy task. The cold bites at your skin, and the bitter winds lash against your face. Even if you encounter no nameless monsters, the land itself may still yet claim your life. You try desperately to stay warm, but there is no refuge in the icy desolation. Exhausted, you collapse into a nearby snowdrift. To your surprise, you feel hard stone thrust into your ribcage. The pain shocks you out of your enervation, and you brush aside the snow to examine what it hides. Eventually, you uncover a curious stone idol in the shape of a horned creature, which glows and vibrates with faint energy. In the distance, you hear a stone slab shifting in the snow.
all_card.real_back_text:
Reveal the Monastery of Leng.
Spawn the set-aside High Priest Not to Be Described enemy in the Monastery of Leng.
all_card.real_flavor: You have come to the land of Leng, a barren, icy wasteland where you believe the peak of unknown Kadath resides. All the while, you are taunted by a presence which gnaws at your insides, a wordless, derisive voice which you cannot hear but feel within the confines of your mind.

all_card.back_text:
如果你通过伤害击败了不可描述的高阶祭司，阅读以下内容：
你打倒这头怪物时，它以一种难以描述的语言诅咒你。它咽下了满怀仇恨的最后一口气。
如果你通过使用场景2a的能力击败了不可描述的高阶祭司，阅读以下内容：
尽管你内心恐惧——或者说，正是因为你的恐惧——你找到了逃离这头怪物魔掌的方法。你趁着它不注意的时候全力一推，把它推进了房间中央敞开的井口，接着它发出了一声可怕的尖叫。
不论以何方式把它击败，都阅读以下内容：
解决了那头怪物之后，你得以稍为轻松地探索那头怪物的隐修之处。这幢石砌建筑残破的墙壁上挂着许多挂毯，上面讲述着这片土地的历史，这段历史写的尽是鲜血与苦痛，你连一个字也不想记进心里。目之所及，到处都是白雪覆盖的巨大山峰。其中一座山峰上坐落着以黑线织就的一幢城堡。
all_card.flavor: 这座圆顶建筑内部是一个凸起的讲坛。上面坐着一个丑陋的身影，其身着黄色丝质长袍，戴有面具。“我的主人已料到你的到来。”它慢吞吞地说道，“现在，上前接收我的赠礼吧。”你摇头拒绝——这位“祭司”的伪装你在这之前就见过，所以你很清楚它究竟是什么怪物。
all_card.name: 袍下之人
all_card.text: [action]如果调查员“靠近了祭司”，并且调查员“打晕了祭司”：击败不可描述的高阶祭司。 目标 -如果不可描述的高阶祭司被击败，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If you defeated the High Priest Not to Be Described with damage, read the following:
As you strike it down, the creature spits foul curses at you in tongues that can scarcely be described. Its last breath is filled with hate.
If you defeated the High Priest Not to Be Described using the ability on act 2a, read the following:
Despite your fear - or perhaps as a result - you discover a means to escape the creature's grasp. With the creature distracted, you shove with all of your might, and it topples into the gaping well in the center of the room, letting out a hideous screech in its wake.
No matter how it was defeated, also read the following:
With the monster dispatched, you can explore its monastery in relative peace. Along the ruined walls of the stone building, tapestries depict the history of this land, a history of blood and suffering that you have no desire to remember when this is all said and done. Great snowcapped peaks loom over each of these scenes. In just one of them, a castle is woven in black thread.
all_card.real_flavor: Inside the domed structure is a raised dais. Upon it sits a lumpish figure robed in yellow silk, a mask covering its face. "My master has plans for you," it drawls. "Now, step forward and receive my gift." You shake your head - you have seen this sort of disguise before. You know what sort of creature this "priest" truly is.
all_card.real_text: [action] If an investigator "maneuvered the priest closer," and an investigator "stunned the priest": Defeat the High Priest Not to Be Described. Objective - If the High Priest Not to Be Described is defeated, advance.

all_card.back_text: 每位调查员失去其所有线索。 阅读剧本手册中的冒险幕间故事：一盘大棋。 然后，推进到场景4a—“真实与谎言”。
all_card.flavor: 你相信卡达斯就是遥远北方的最高山峰，但要想打开通向那片失落之地的门扉，你需要先证明它的存在。
all_card.name: 梦境之外
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果每位调查员都位于缟玛瑙大门，且该地点上没有线索，推进。
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator loses all of their clues. Read Scenario Interlude: Grand Design in the Campaign Guide. Then, advance to Act 4a - "Truth and Lies."
all_card.real_flavor: You believe that Kadath is the highest peak far to the north, but in order to open the gates leading to that forsaken land, you must prove that it exists.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If each investigator is at the Onyx Gates, and no clues are on it, advance.

all_card.back_text:
检查剧本日志。如果[[黑猫得知真相]]，并且[[调查员持有银钥匙]]︰
黑影消散时，黑猫出现在你的肩膀上。“就是现在！”它大喊道。你掏出银钥匙时它发出了灿烂的光芒。“只有这样才能揭露它的真形！”
每位调查员失去其所有线索。胜利区的每张奈亚拉托提普组成了一个敌人，并且： - 其攻击值/躲避值，等于胜利区中奈亚拉托提普最高的对应值。 - 其生命值/伤害值/恐惧值/胜利点数，等于胜利区中所有奈亚拉托提普的对应值总和。 - 其具有胜利区中所有奈亚拉托提普的关键词。 将这可憎的异形生成在大礼堂。这就是奈亚拉托提普的真形。在每个被遗忘的高塔地点上放置线索，直到其线索数量等于其线索值。
否则，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 好好看着吧！我已将你困于此处，永远不会让你离开。你的梦将永远属于我！
all_card.name: 真实与谎言
all_card.text: [action]花费1个线索：查看遭遇牌库顶的3张卡牌。抽取这些卡牌中带有隐私关键词的每张卡牌，弃掉其余卡牌。 目标 - 将奈亚拉托提普放入胜利区，以找出并揭露它的真形。如果胜利区有1[per_investigator]+1张奈亚拉托提普，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
Check Campaign Log. If the black cat knows the truth and the investigators possess the Silver Key:
As the shadows disperse, the black cat appears on your shoulder. "Now!" it cries. The silver key shimmers with radiant light as you draw it out. "This is the only way to expose its true shape!"
Each investigator loses each of their clues. Each copy of Nyarlathotep in the victory display combines to form a single enemy with: - Fight/evade values equal to the highest fight/evade value among combined copies of itself. - Health/damage/horror/victory values equal to the total combined health/damage/horror/victory values of all combined copies of itself. - All keywords from all combined copies of itself. Spawn this monstrosity in The Great Hall. It is Nyarlathotep's True Shape. Place clues on each Forsaken Tower location until it has clues equal to its clue value.
Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
all_card.real_flavor: Beware! For I am the one who has trapped you here, and you shall never leave. Your dreams are forever mine!
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Draw each of those cards with the hidden keyword and discard the rest. Objective - Find and expose Nyarlathotep's true form by adding copies of Nyarlathotep to the victory display. If 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] copies are in the victory display, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
这令人憎恶的怪物自我塌缩，在现实中撕开一个窟窿，然后逃到了世界的另一边去。它逃离了幻梦境，而且可能永远不会再回来。
在一段令人不安的沉默后，黑猫说道：“结束了。这是我预见的最后一幕，我的故事也将在这里画上句号。”它的身影开始消散，像绳子的末端一样散开。“人类，这些梦境十分珍贵哦。”虽然它的身影已消失在虚空之中，它的声音却仍回荡在空气中，不断回响。“不要失去梦，它们就是你最重要的东西。对我们也是。而且，它们是属于你的——至少目前如此。”
你试图让它进一步说明，但为时已晚。黑猫已经不在了。
all_card.flavor:
什么？！
你以为自己在干什么？
这一切都是我的梦境。
你真的以为你能将幻梦境据为己有吗？
幻梦境绝对不能被你这样的家伙占有！
all_card.name: 食梦者
all_card.text: 调查员每共同拥有1个线索，奈亚拉托提普的真形生命值-1。 目标 - 如果奈亚拉托提普的真形被击败，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The abomination folds in on itself, tears a hole through reality, and escapes through the other side. It has fled the Dreamlands and may never return.
"It is done," the black cat says after a moment of unsteady silence. "The final scene in my vision, and the final chapter of my story." Its form begins to fray and unravel like the end of a rope. "These dreams are very precious, human." Its voice lingers and hums through the air even as the last vestiges of its shape disappear into the aether. "Do not lose them. They are the very heart of you. The heart of us all. And they're yours to keep - at least, for now."
You want to ask what all of this means, but it is too late. The black cat is gone.
all_card.real_flavor:
What?!

What do you think you are doing?

These are <u>my</u> dreams.

Do you really think you can
claim this realm for yourself?

It cannot be possessed
by one such as you!
all_card.real_text: Nyarlathotep's True Shape gets -1 health for each clue the investigators possess, as a group. Objective - If Nyarlathotep's True Shape is defeated, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: “……没有哪个正常人愿意到这片冰雪覆盖的荒原来，而到了夜晚，远远可以看到这里升起邪恶的火光。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 冷原
all_card.text: 强制 - 在敌人试图生成在无人地点，且场上没有无人地点时：改为将该敌人生成在此。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"...the icy desert plateau of Leng, which no healthy folk visit and whose evil fires are seen at night from afar."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Forced - When an enemy attempts to spawn at an empty location, and there are no empty locations in play: Spawn that enemy here, instead.

all_card.back_flavor: “接着，山岭上出现了一道宽阔的豁口，群山另一边的可怕冷原通过一道被黯淡星光照亮的低矮隘口，连接到下方的冰封荒土。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 冰封荒土
all_card.text: 强制 - 你调查冰封荒土时揭示[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]混乱标记后：你必须受到1点伤害或失去1个行动。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"Then came a wide gap in the range, where the hideous reaches of transmontane Leng were joined to the cold waste on this side by a low pass through which the stars shone wanly."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] chaos token while investigating Cold Wastes: You must either take 1 damage or lose 1 action.

all_card.back_flavor: 你终于顶着风雪来到圆顶神庙前，却烦躁地发现大门被封锁了起来，而且门上并没有锁头。或许有别的方法能进去。
all_card.back_text: 隐修院的门被封起来了。你不能进入冷原隐修院。
all_card.flavor: “……一个带有巨大穹顶的房间，四面墙壁雕刻着令人震惊的浮雕，中央有着一个圆形的深坑，其周围是一圈六座沾染邪秽的石头祭坛。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 冷原隐修院
all_card.text: [free]位于冷原隐修院的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：记住调查员“靠近了祭司”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When you finally reach the domed temple in the snow, you are distraught to find its doors sealed shut, with no lock to speak of. Perhaps there is another way inside.
all_card.real_back_text: The door to the Monastery of Leng is sealed shut. You cannot enter the Monastery of Leng.
all_card.real_flavor:
"...a great domed space whose walls were carved in shocking bas-reliefs, and whose centre held a gaping circular pit surrounded by six malignly stained stone altars in a ring."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: [fast] Investigators at Monastery of Leng spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "maneuvered the priest closer."

all_card.back_flavor: “它们所居住的地方一定就在冰封荒土不远处，而未知的卡达斯和诸神的缟玛瑙城堡也都在那里。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 你走近缟玛瑙大门时，注意到门上有着一行铭文：“别再寻找那遥远的地方，因其并不存在。此门永不会开，只因门后一无所有。”
all_card.name: 缟玛瑙大门
all_card.text: 缟玛瑙大门隐藏值+1[per_investigator]。 强制 - 缟玛瑙大门揭示后：检查剧本日志。 “卡达斯的证据”旁边每有一次记录，移除缟玛瑙大门上的1个线索。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"Where they dwelt, there must the cold waste lie close, and within it unknown Kadath and its onyx castle for the Great Ones."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_flavor: As you approach the gates, you notice an inscription in the onyx stone: "Do not seek the lands beyond, for they do not exist. These gates shall never open, for there is nothing beyond."
all_card.real_text: Onyx Gates gets +1 [per_investigator] shroud. Forced - After Onyx Gates is revealed: Check Campaign Log. Remove 1 clue from Onyx Gates for each tally mark recorded next to "Evidence of Kadath."

all_card.back_flavor: “过去从未有人找到卡达斯，而且将来也不会有。有关缟玛瑙城堡的传说每一则都令人不安。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 前往缟玛瑙城堡的道路隐藏了起来。你不能进入缟玛瑙城堡。
all_card.flavor: “除了高塔上的那间房间，卡达斯顶上的缟玛瑙城堡一片漆黑，这里的主人也不在。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 大礼堂
all_card.text: [action]：选择你所在地点的另一位调查员。将你手牌中的一张隐私卡牌加入所选调查员的手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"No man had ever found Kadath in the past, and it might be just as well if none ever found it in the future. Such rumours as were told about that onyx castle of the Great Ones were not by any means reassuring."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_back_text: The way to The Onyx Castle is hidden. You cannot enter The Onyx Castle.
all_card.real_flavor:
"Save for that one tower room the onyx castle atop Kadath was dark, and the masters were not there."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: [action]: Choose another investigator at your location. Add a hidden card in your hand to the chosen investigator's hand.

all_card.back_flavor: “宽广的墙壁拔地而起，隐约瞥见它们从一道大门内掠过。黑夜笼罩了这片巨大的庭院，然后则是内部更为深邃的黑暗，就像一个巨大的拱形入口将整支军队尽数吞入。”<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 被遗忘的高塔
all_card.text: 你不能使用本地点的[action]能力，除非另一张卡牌明确允许你这么做。 [action]：调查。选择并揭示你手中的一张奈亚拉托提普。本次调查中，本地点的隐藏值等于奈亚拉托提普的印刷生命值。如果你检定成功，将该奈亚拉托提普加入胜利区。如果你检定失败，奈亚拉托提普攻击你，并将其混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"Vast walls shot up, and there was a glimpse of a great gate through which the voyagers were swept. All was night in the titan courtyard, and then came the deeper blackness of inmost things as a huge arched portal engulfed the column."
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: You cannot use this location's [action] ability unless another card explicitly allows you to do so. [action]: Investigate. Choose and reveal a copy of Nyarlathotep from your hand. For this investigation, this location's shroud is equal to Nyarlathotep's printed health. If you succeed, add that copy of Nyarlathotep to the victory display. If you fail, Nyarlathotep attacks you and is shuffled into the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: 一想到这个令人厌恶的“祭司”长袍下会是什么样子，你便不寒而栗。
all_card.name: 不可描述的高阶祭司
all_card.text:
警戒。庞大。反击。
本敌人不能进行趁乱攻击。
[free]如果本敌人横置，花费1[per_investigator]个线索：记住你“打晕了祭司”。直到本场冒险结束，本敌人攻击值-3。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 异教徒. 化身. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: You shudder to think just what this abhorrent "priest" might be beneath its robes.
all_card.real_name: High Priest Not to Be Described
all_card.real_text:
Alert. Massive. Retaliate.
This enemy cannot make attacks of opportunity.
[fast] If this enemy is exhausted, spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Remember that you "stunned the priest." Until the end of the scenario, this enemy gets -3 fight.

all_card.name: 荒土蠕虫
all_card.text: 生成 - 冰封荒土或大礼堂。 猎物 - [agility]最低。 猎手。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Cold Wastes or The Great Hall. Prey - Lowest [agility]. Hunter.

all_card.name: 无面欺诈者
all_card.text: 猎物 - 手牌最多。 猎手。 强制 - 在无面欺诈者攻击你时，如果混沌低语在你手牌中：将其揭示。无面欺诈者本次攻击造成+2伤害。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 异教徒. 仆从
all_card.real_text: Prey - Most cards in hand. Hunter. Forced - When Liar with No Face attacks you, if Whispering Chaos is in your hand: Reveal it. Liar with No Face deals +2 damage for this attack.

all_card.name: 混沌低语(北)
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 秘密地将本卡牌加入你的手牌。 本卡牌在你手牌中时，如果你将本卡牌揭示，你可以激活北塔上的能力。如果北塔上的能力结算成功，弃掉本卡牌。如果结算失败，将本卡牌混洗回遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. While this card is in your hand, you may activate the ability on the Northern Tower if you reveal this card from your hand. If the ability on the Northern Tower resolves successfully, discard this card. If it fails, shuffle this card back into the encounter deck.
