all_card.back_flavor:
这个跨次元的空间里没有任何空气。即便是在地下世界那荒凉的坑洞里，你也能感觉到深渊处盘旋的冷风，或是漆黑之海升腾的暖热毒气。但在这里，这里什么都没有：没有一丝空气，除了你和那些即将完成桥梁的蜘蛛之外，没有任何生命。
正当你思考事物究竟是如何在诸界之中的可怕此间存在之时，你听到了一道声音，像是织物被拉扯和撕裂的声音。然后从你周围涌来了一股气流，空气就像被吸入真空中的灰尘一样，充满了这个宽阔的空间。这风一定是从什么地方吹来的，这意味着：两个世界正开始融合。
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 这片广袤无边的空间是幻梦境与现实世界之间的桥梁，编织这道桥梁的是一个可怕的蜘蛛怪物，也是它导致了此前你们所经历的扭曲异象。要是无法阻止它，这道桥梁一旦建成，这些恐怖的异象就会进入清醒世界。
all_card.name: 蛛网桥梁
all_card.text: *本密谋的毁灭阈值+2[per_investigator]。 强制 - 在本密谋推进时：不要从场上地点移除毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
There is no air in this interdimensional space. Even in the bleak pits of the Underworld, you sensed cold wind coiling through the depths or warm, noxious gas rising from the Sea of Pitch. But here, there is nothing: no air, no atmosphere, no life whatsoever, save for you and the spiders whose work nears completion.
Just as you are contemplating how anything can exist at all in this awful world between worlds, you hear a sound like the stretching and tearing of fabric. Then a rush of billowing air erupts all around you, filling the vastness of the realm like dust in a vacuum. This wind must be coming from somewhere, and that can only mean one thing: Worlds are starting to merge.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: This vast expanse of space is a bridge between the Dreamlands and reality, woven by a terrible spider creature that is the cause of all of the distortions you have experienced thus far. If you don’t find a way to stop it from completing the bridge, it will open the way for these horrors to enter the waking world.
all_card.real_text: *This agenda gets +2 [per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from locations in play.

all_card.back_flavor: 在蛛丝织成的飘渺丝带以外遥远的地方，闪过一道光芒：那是数千光年以外发生的一场爆炸。整条蛛网桥梁上闪动着光芒。丝线折射着那破碎星云的光辉。那耀眼的光芒烧灼你的双眼。等到光芒终于变暗一些，桥梁因宇宙的能量而变得光彩灿烂。桥梁快要建成了。很快这道桥梁就会连接两个世界，到时除了阿特拉克·纳克亚和它的蜘蛛大军，一切都不复存在。
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 这现实世界以外的虚空之中，希望与欢欣都不可能存在。这里只有蜘蛛在无休止地编织，完成它们那伟大的作品，随着时间的流逝，它们的作品也即将完成。
all_card.name: 曲折道路
all_card.text: *本密谋的毁灭阈值+2[per_investigator]。 强制 - 在本密谋推进时：不要从场上地点移除毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A light flashes in the distance, beyond strands of ethereal webbing: an explosion thousands of light-years away. Radiant light ripples throughout the web-bridge. The silken threads reflect the luminescence of a shattered nebula. A brilliant shine burns your pupils. When the glow finally dims, the bridge is resplendent with cosmic energy. It is almost over now. Soon the bridge will connect the two worlds, and there will be nothing left but Atlach-Nacha and its horde.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: In this void between realities, there can be no hope or joy. Just the ceaseless toiling of spiders performing their great work, closer and closer to completion with each passing moment.
all_card.real_text: *This agenda gets +2 [per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from locations in play.

all_card.back_flavor: 突然，空气急速流动，接着是噼啪声响起，如同成千上万根骨头同时组合归位。你周围的蛛网闪烁着无穷的力量，气流伴随着闪烁的节奏，稳定地来回穿梭着。在这虚空的遥远尽头，射来太阳的光线——光线所能照到的隧道尽头，是阿特拉克·纳克亚的王国。你惊恐地看着无数蜘蛛快步飞跑，一只接一只地朝着那道光奔去。
all_card.flavor: 在遥远的一条条地平线以外，群星闪烁，与无数异界的力量一同燃烧。你周围蛛网的丝线也都闪烁着相同的光芒。
all_card.name: 现实交织
all_card.text: *本密谋的毁灭阈值+2[per_investigator]。
all_card.real_back_flavor: There is a sudden rush of air and a snapping sound, like a thousand bones popping into place at once. The webs surrounding you all flicker with untold power, the air currents shifting back and forth to the same steady rhythm. At the far end of the void, the sun's light shines through - a literal light at the end of the tunnel that is Atlach-Nacha's realm. You watch with dread as the spiders infesting this place scurry, one by one, toward the light.
all_card.real_flavor: In the distance, untold horizons away, stars glimmer and burn with the power of countless other worlds. The shimmering strands of web all around you pulse with the same light.
all_card.real_text: *This agenda gets +2 [per_investigator] doom threshold.

all_card.back_text: 阅读剧本手册中的冒险幕间故事：蛛后。 然后，推进到场景2a—“编织宇宙”。
all_card.flavor: 你意识到自己不在幻梦境，也不在清醒世界，而是处在幽暗的虚空之中，这里就是宇宙织网者所在的地方。这不仅关系到你的世界，还与幻梦境息息相关。
all_card.name: 穿过桥梁
all_card.text: 每个地点与其上方和下方的地点连接。 目标 - 如果每位调查员都位于最下方的地点，则可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_text: Read Scenario Interlude: The Spider Queen in the Campaign Guide. Then, advance to Act 2a - "The Weaver of the Cosmos."
all_card.real_flavor: You realize now that you are no longer in the Dreamlands or the waking world, but somewhere else entirely: a stygian void wherein dwells the Weaver of the Cosmos. It is not just your world at stake, but the Dreamlands as well.
all_card.real_text: Each location is connected to each location above and below it. Objective - If each investigator is at the bottommost location, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你弄断了这只可恨蜘蛛的腿，并且破坏了它身下的蛛网，希望能让它栽进下方无尽的虚空。但当它下坠时，它腹部下方伸出了几根更为纤细的带有锯齿的腿，抓住了旁边的平台，勉强没有掉下去。它张开了可怕的下颌，一直延伸到与它那蠕虫般的头颅等长的位置。它厉声长鸣，就像千千万万根指甲在黑板上抓挠一般令人难受。
all_card.back_text:
将阿特拉克·纳克亚的中央卡牌翻面，翻至敌人面。
将其放在毁灭标记最多的地点上。
all_card.flavor: 阿特拉克·纳克亚专注在它的编织活计上。现在就是你的机会！
all_card.name: 编织宇宙
all_card.text: [action]花费1个线索：对你所在地点的一个[[古神]]敌人造成3点伤害。 强制 - 在神话阶段开始时：从混乱袋中随机揭示一个标记。如果该标记修正值为负值，将阿特拉克·纳克亚顺时针旋转X次。X为该负值修正值。 目标 - 如果胜利区有4张阿特拉克·纳克亚之腿，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Having severed the wretched spider's legs and unraveled the webs it stood on, you hoped that this would send the thing careening into the endless void below. But as it falls, more thin, jagged legs erupt from below its abdomen, and it grips onto a nearby platform, just barely catching itself. The horrible maw, which extends down the length of its worm-like head, wrenches open. From it emerges a screech like a thousand nails on a chalkboard.
all_card.real_back_text: Flip Atlach-Nacha's center card over, to its enemy side. Place it at the location with the most doom in it.
all_card.real_flavor: Atlach-Nacha is distracted by its mindless task. Now is your chance!

If its modifier is negative, spin Atlach-Nacha clockwise X times. X is the token's negative modifier. Objective - If 4 Legs of Atlach-Nacha are in the victory display, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
当这头怪物编织的网被撕碎时，它猛烈地扭动着身躯。桥梁的丝线渐渐失去了光芒。远处，宇宙中群星的光点也一点点地熄灭。蜘蛛痛苦的尖叫声震耳欲聋。你不知道这样的怪物究竟能否被杀死，但你摧毁它的毕生心血，所造成的伤害无疑更甚于你给它留下的弹孔和刀伤。
随着蛛丝纺成的丝线解开，这里悬浮的岩石平台也开始破碎，掉入下方无尽的虚空。你拼命寻找支撑点。没有了蛛网桥梁，你周围的这整个次元都会坍塌。
随着这异界之间的空间里响起阿特拉克·纳克亚最后一声绝望的尖叫，它坠向下方永恒的黑暗之中。你很快就会随它而去。
all_card.flavor: 你们是阻止这些怪物吞噬世界的最后一道防线。
all_card.name: 阴谋破灭
all_card.text: [action]花费1个线索：对你所在地点的一个[[古神]]敌人造成3点伤害。 强制 - 在神话阶段开始时：从混乱袋中随机揭示一个标记。如果该标记修正值为负值，将阿特拉克·纳克亚朝顺时针方向移动X次。X为该负值修正值。 目标 -如果阿特拉克·纳克亚被击败，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The creature thrashes about violently as its webbing is ripped apart. The shimmer fades from the bridge's threads. In the distance, the cosmic array of lights winks out of existence, star by star. The spider's pained screech is deafening. You're not sure if it would be possible to kill a creature such as this, but you have done more harm to it in destroying its life's work than you could have ever done with bullets and blades.
As the woven threads of spider silk unravel, this realm's many suspended platforms of rock crumble and collapse into the endless aether below. You struggle to find something to stand on or grab hold of. Without the support of the web-bridge, the entire dimension collapses all around you.
With a final desperate screech that echoes throughout this world between worlds, Atlach-Nacha plunges into the eternal darkness below. You are quick to follow.
all_card.real_flavor: You are the last line of defense against the creatures that scheme to devour your world.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Deal 3 damage to an [[Ancient One]] enemy at your location. Forced - When the mythos phase begins: Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If its modifier is negative, move Atlach-Nacha clockwise X times. X is the token's negative modifier. Objective - If Atlach-Nacha is defeated, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你一路奔向下一个目的地，这时候看到一个形态可疑的长大衣女子从旁边的巷子里走了出来。你转向旁边一条路，只想避开她，却又差点撞上一个右边脸上一道怪疤的男人。他吸了口烟，把烟头扔了，瞪着你。你后退一步，却碰上了之前看到的那个女人。她笑了：“你往哪儿去呢，朋友？我们只想聊聊。”
all_card.back_text: 生成1个放在一边的帮派打手敌人，与线索最多的调查员交战。将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 月亮投下长长的阴影，在大地上仿佛一双摸索的手。你一直把这座城市视为家，但今夜的阿卡姆感觉完全变了个地方。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆夜生活
all_card.text: [reaction][[阿卡姆]]地点最后的线索被发现后：弃掉遭遇牌库顶3张牌。将以此方式弃掉的每个[[罪犯]]敌人依次生成在最近的无人地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Moving quickly down the avenue to your next destination, you see a suspicious-looking woman in a long coat step out from a nearby alley. You turn down a side street to avoid her and nearly run into a man with a wicked scar running down his right cheek. He takes a drag from his cigarette, tosses it to the sidewalk, and glowers at you. You step back only to bump into the woman you saw before. She smiles.
"Where you goin', pal? We just wanna talk."
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn 1 set-aside Gang Enforcer enemy engaged with the investigator with the most clues. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor:
The moon casts long shadows that reach across the ground like searching fingers.
You've always seen this city as home, but tonight Arkham feels like another place entirely.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After the last clue is discovered from an [[Arkham]] location: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. One at a time, spawn each [[Criminal]] enemy discarded this way at the nearest empty location.

all_card.back_flavor:
无论你到哪儿，好像帮派分子都在：每条后巷都有人等着，街角也有人随意杵着，商店的窗户和公园的长椅上也有窥视的眼睛。继续搜查实在危险，所以你扭头回蒂林哈斯特的店里。你在只差一个路口的地方被一伙暴徒拦住了。中间块头最大的那个叼着烟，不怀好意地来了，而他手下的喽啰已经按住了你。
    “没人告诉你好奇心杀死猫吗？”他俯身向前，把烟蒂吐在了你脸上，朝手下点了点头。这群恶棍用黄铜指虎、拳头或者砖头往你身上招呼，很快把你打倒在地。帮派的消息确实传达到位了。
all_card.back_text: 幸存的每位调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 你每一步都有谢尔顿帮和欧巴尼恩帮的人尾随。看来这俩开战的帮派已经暂时搁置了争端，打算一起终结你的调查。
all_card.name: 漫漫长夜
all_card.text: [reaction][[阿卡姆]]地点最后的线索被发现后：弃掉遭遇牌库顶3张牌。将以此方式弃掉的每个[[罪犯]]敌人依次生成在最近的无人地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
No matter where you go, there seems to be a mobster waiting in every back alley, standing casually on the street corner, or watching from shop windows and park benches. It's too dangerous to continue your search, so you head back to Tillinghast's shop. A mob of gangsters intercepts you just a block away. The largest among them steps toward you menacingly, a lit cigarette clenched in his teeth, as his mooks restrain you.
"Didn't anyone ever tell you that curiosity killed the cat?" He leans down and puts his cigarette out on your cheek, then nods to his lackeys, who swiftly beat you down with brass knuckles, bare fists, and bricks.
Message received.
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: Your every step is dogged by both the Sheldons and the O'Bannions. It seems like the two warring gangs have put aside their beef to end your investigation.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After the last clue is discovered from an [[Arkham]] location: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. One at a time, spawn each [[Criminal]] enemy discarded this way at the nearest empty location.

all_card.flavor: 你得弄清蒂林哈斯特的货究竟去哪儿了。河岸城的帮派活动愈发频繁，你觉得先跟谢尔顿帮和欧巴尼恩帮谈谈最为合适。

all_card.name: 盘问黑帮
all_card.text: *本场景的线索阈值+1[per_investigator]。 [free]花费X个线索：谈判。弃掉你所在地点的一个与调查员交战，且剩余生命值为X的[[罪犯]]敌人。将1个线索(从供应堆)放到本场景。 目标 – 当一轮结束时，如果本场景上线索的数量等于或超过其线索阈值，推进。
all_card.real_flavor: You need to find out what happened to Tillinghast's shipment. With the increased gang activity all over Rivertown, you think that checking in with the Sheldons and the O'Bannions is the best place to start.
all_card.real_text: *This act gets +1 [per_investigator] clue threshold. [fast] Spend X clues: Parley. Discard an engaged [[Criminal]] enemy with X remaining health at your location. Place 1 clue (from the token pool) on this act. Objective - At the end of the round, if the number of clues on this act equals or exceeds its clue threshold, advance.

all_card.name: 月下美人
all_card.text: 商业区与月下美人连接。 显现 – 将月下美人放置入场。将放在一边的内奥米·欧巴尼恩敌人生成在月下美人。将放在一边的场景2a——“欧巴尼恩帮”和场景3a——“面对现实”加入场景牌库，然后推进到场景2a。
all_card.real_text: Downtown is connected to La Bella Luna. Revelation - Put La Bella Luna into play. Spawn the set-aside Naomi O'Bannion enemy at La Bella Luna. Add the set-aside act 2a - "The O'Bannion Gang" and act 3a - "Face the Music" to the act deck, then advance to act 2a.

all_card.back_flavor:
内奥米·欧巴尼恩带着一对暴徒大步迈进了希伯特路边酒馆，打断了你的谈判。
    “那批货是我的，萨迪。”她冷酷地说道。她手下的暴徒掏出来复枪，朝墙上和家具倾泄着枪林弹雨，而你赶紧低头躲避。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的内奥米·欧巴尼恩和帮派打手敌人生成在希伯特路边酒馆。查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出1张帮派战士，并将其生成在希伯特路边酒馆。 如果萨迪·谢尔顿上至少有1个线索，在内奥米·欧巴尼恩上放置2点伤害。将萨迪·谢尔顿上的至多2个线索移动到希伯特路边酒馆的任意非[[精英]]的[[罪犯]]敌人上。 每个有线索的敌人与每位调查员解除交战并(在其上有线索时)获得冷漠。
all_card.flavor: 谢尔顿帮最终搞定了货。现在你要么跟萨迪谈谈，达成交易；要么“说服”她犯不着惹麻烦。
all_card.name: 谢尔顿帮
all_card.text: 萨迪·谢尔顿获得：“[action]花费最多4资源：谈判 。检定[willpower]或[combat](5)。每有1资源作为本次行动的费用花费，本次检定难度–1。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，将你的1个线索放在萨迪·谢尔顿上。” 目标 – 在伤害放置到萨迪·谢尔顿上时，推进。 目标 – 如果萨迪·谢尔顿上有3个线索，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Your negotiations are cut short as Naomi O'Bannion strides into Hibb's Roadhouse, accompanied by a pair of mobsters.
"That shipment is mine, Sadie" she says coldly. You duck down as her goons pull out their rifles and spray the walls and furniture with a hail of bullets.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Naomi O'Bannion and Gang Enforcer enemies at Hibb's Roadhouse. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Gang Soldier and spawn it at Hibb's Roadhouse. If there is at least 1 clue on Sadie Sheldon, place 2 damage on Naomi O'Bannion. Move up to 2 clues from Sadie Sheldon to any non-[[Elite]], [[Criminal]] enemies at Hibb's Roadhouse. Each enemy with clues on it disengages from each investigator and gains aloof (while there are clues on it).
all_card.real_flavor: The Sheldons wound up with the shipment. It's up to you to either talk Sadie into a deal, or "convince" her it's not worth the trouble.
all_card.real_text: Sadie Sheldon gains: "[action] Spend up to 4 resources: Parley. Test [willpower] or [combat] (5). This test gets -1 difficulty for each resource spent as part of this action's cost. For each point you succeed by, place 1 of your clues on Sadie Sheldon." Objective - When damage is placed on Sadie Sheldon, advance. Objective - If there are 3 clues on Sadie Sheldon, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 这家时髦的酒吧门口传来了打斗的声音，随即是沉闷的叫嚷。萨迪·谢尔顿冲进了月下美人，旁边是几个刚刚打过一架的暴徒。他们一看到你，就把指节扭得啪啪响，等谢尔顿一声令下就冲了过来。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的萨迪·谢尔顿和帮派打手敌人生成在月下美人。查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出1张帮派战士，并将其生成在月下美人。 如果内奥米·欧巴尼恩上至少有1个线索，在萨迪·谢尔顿上放置2点伤害。将内奥米·欧巴尼恩上的至多2个线索移动到月下美人的任意非[[精英]]的[[罪犯]]敌人上。 每个有线索的敌人与每位调查员解除交战并(在其上有线索时)获得冷漠。
all_card.flavor: 欧巴尼恩帮偷走了蒂林哈斯特的货。现在你要么跟内奥米谈谈，达成交易；要么“说服”她犯不着惹麻烦。
all_card.name: 欧巴尼恩帮
all_card.text: 内奥米·欧巴尼恩获得：“[action]花费最多4资源：谈判 。检定[intellect]或[agility](5)。每有1资源作为本次行动的费用花费，本次检定难度–1。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，将你的1个线索放在内奥米·欧巴尼恩上。” 目标 – 在伤害放置到内奥米·欧巴尼恩上时，推进。 目标 – 如果内奥米·欧巴尼恩上有3个线索，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: There is a sound of a struggle at the entrance to the swanky lounge, followed by a muffled scream. Sadie Sheldon bursts into La Bella Luna accompanied by several rough-and-tumble mooks. They crack their knuckles when they see you, and advance at Sheldon's signal.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Sadie Sheldon and Gang Enforcer enemies at La Bella Luna. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Gang Soldier and spawn it at La Bella Luna. If there is at least 1 clue on Naomi O'Bannion, place 2 damage on Sadie Sheldon. Move up to 2 clues from Naomi O'Bannion to any non-[[Elite]], [[Criminal]] enemies at La Bella Luna. Each enemy with clues on it disengages from each investigator and gains aloof (while there are clues on it).
all_card.real_flavor: The O'Bannions nicked Tillinghast's shipment. It's up to you to either talk Naomi into a deal, or "convince" her it's not worth the trouble.
all_card.real_text: Naomi O'Bannion gains: "[action] Spend up to 4 resources: Parley. Test [intellect] or [agility] (5). This test gets -1 difficulty for each resource spent as part of this action's cost. For each point you succeed by, place 1 of your clues on Naomi O'Bannion." Objective - When damage is placed on Naomi O'Bannion, advance. Objective - If there are 3 clues on Naomi O'Bannion, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
原先的争执升级成了公开的流血冲突，你却在这时发现后面房间里有个小箱子上标着“蒂林哈斯特产业”。你伏低身子，仓皇逃离战斗，回到了冰冷的夜空下。你背后的建筑里传来玻璃碎裂和重重的击打声。
    “啊，恭喜了。”头顶突然传来了一个声音，一个身着黑衣的结实身影荡着绳索滑了下来，摘掉了面具。“我本来有一整个盗窃计划，你懂的，有线人，甚至还有张名片。”露比说着把一朵黄玫瑰扔到了路上，“我没想到你就这么大摇大摆地走进去，礼貌地问他们要。但是，好吧，我想你赢得公正漂亮。”
all_card.flavor: 你发现自己正好身处一场帮派战争的最中心！
all_card.name: 面对现实
all_card.text: 每个有线索的[[罪犯]]敌人获得冷漠。 [action]从你所在地点的一个[[罪犯]]敌人上移除1个线索：谈判 。该敌人对你所在地点的另一个敌人造成其伤害。 目标 – 在一轮结束时，如果胜利区中有[[精英]]敌人，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As the conflict erupts into outright bloodshed, you locate a small crate labeled "Tillinghast Endeavors" in a back room. Keeping low to the ground, you scamper through the fight and back out to the cold evening air. The sound of shattering glass and heavy blows emanates from the building behind you. "Aw, applesauce," says a voice above you. A compact figure clad in black slides down a rappelling line and removes their mask. "I had a whole heist planned, you know. An informant. A calling card, even," Ruby says, tossing a yellow rose on the pavement. "I didn't think you could just walk in and ask politely, but, well, I guess you won fair and square."
all_card.real_flavor: You've found yourself squarely in the center of a gang war!
all_card.real_text: Each [[Criminal]] enemy with clues on it gains aloof. [action] Remove 1 clue from a [[Criminal]] enemy at your location: Parley. That enemy deals its damage to another enemy at your location. Objective - When the round ends, if there is at least 1 [[Elite]] enemy in the victory display, advance.

all_card.back_text:
蒂林哈斯特密所与其右边的地点相互连接。
    [action]本地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：在剧本日志中，记录<cite>调查员发现了一种异星语言</cite>。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.name: 蒂林哈斯特密所
all_card.text: 蒂林哈斯特密所与其右边的地点相互连接。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Tillinghast Esoterica - purveyor of sundry delights, exotic treasures, wondrous baubles, and innumerable secrets." - Recent ad in the Arkham Advertiser
all_card.real_back_text: Tillinghast Esoterica is connected to the location to the right of it, and vice versa.
all_card.flavor:
“蒂林哈斯特密所——供应万千乐事、异国珍宝、奇妙饰物与无尽秘密。”
    <cite>阿卡姆报社最近刊登的广告</cite>
all_card.real_text: Tillinghast Esoterica is connected to the location to the right of it, and vice versa. [action] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: In your Campaign Log, record the investigators discovered an alien language. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 萨迪·谢尔顿
all_card.text:
反击。
    萨迪·谢尔顿不能移动且得到+1[per_investigator]生命值。
    萨迪·谢尔顿上每有1点伤害，她得到+1攻击值(最多+3攻击值)。
all_card.traits: 类人.罪犯.犯罪团伙.精英
all_card.real_text:
Retaliate.
Sadie Sheldon cannot move and gets +1 [per_investigator] health.
Sadie Sheldon gets +1 fight for each damage on her (to a maximum of +3 fight).

all_card.name: 内奥米·欧巴尼恩
all_card.text: 警戒。 内奥米·欧巴尼恩不能移动且得到+1[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 – 每轮第一次内奥米·欧巴尼恩被躲避时：将她重整。她所在地点的任意调查员可以受到1点伤害以防止她这么做。
all_card.traits: 类人.罪犯.犯罪团伙.精英
all_card.real_text: Alert. Naomi O'Bannion cannot move and gets +1 [per_investigator] health. Forced - The first time Naomi O'Bannion is evaded each round: Ready her. Any investigator at her location may take 1 damage to prevent this.

all_card.flavor: “别多管与你无关的闲事，朋友！”
all_card.name: 帮派战士
all_card.real_flavor: "Don't go stickin' your nose where it don't belong, pal!"

all_card.name: 帮派打手
all_card.text: 猎手。 猎物 – 线索最多。 强制 – 每轮第一次本敌人所在地点的调查员攻击另一个[[罪犯]]敌人：帮派打手重整并攻击该调查员。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Prey - Most clues. Forced - The first time each round an investigator at this enemy's location attacks another [[Criminal]] enemy: Gang Enforcer readies and attacks that investigator.

all_card.name: 帮派线人
all_card.text: 冷漠。 生成 – 最近的有线索的[[阿卡姆]]地点。 强制 – 帮派线人为重整状态时，本敌人所在地点的调查员发现线索后：该调查员必须花费3资源或在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Spawn - Nearest [[Arkham]] location with clues. Forced - After an investigator at Gang Informant's location discovers 1 or more clues while this enemy is ready: That investigator must either spend 3 resources or place 1 doom on the current agenda.

all_card.name: 身陷火线
all_card.text: 显现 – 将身陷火线放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。 强制 – 在你所在地点的[[罪犯]]敌人受到伤害时：检定[intellect]或[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，该敌人受到的伤害减少1点，且你受到1点直接伤害。弃掉身陷火线。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Caught in the Crossfire into play in your threat area. Forced - When damage is dealt to a [[Criminal]] enemy at your location: Test [intellect] or [agility] (3). If you fail, reduce the damage dealt to that enemy by 1 and take 1 direct damage. Discard Caught in the Crossfire.

all_card.name: 谈判结束
all_card.text: 显现 – 将谈判结束附属到最近的[[罪犯]]敌人。每个敌人仅限1张。如果你不能这么做，谈判结束获得涌动。 强制 – 本地点的调查员谈判后：所附属的敌人攻击该调查员。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉本卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach End of Negotiations to the nearest [[Criminal]] enemy. Limit 1 per enemy. If you cannot, End of Negotiations gains surge. Forced - After an investigator parleys at this location: Attached enemy attacks that investigator. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard this card.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
    [skull]：–X。X为你所在地点的深度+2。
    [cultist]：–5。如果你所在地点完全淹没，受到1点伤害。
    [tablet]：–5。如可能，提升你所在地点的淹没等级。
    [elder_thing]：–5(如果你的地点完全淹没，改为你自动失败)。
all_card.name: 西墙
all_card.text:
简单/普通
    [skull]：–X。X为你所在地点的深度。
    [cultist]：–3。如果你检定失败且你所在地点完全淹没，受到1点伤害。
    [tablet]：–3。如果你检定失败，提升你所在地点的淹没等级。
    [elder_thing]：–3(如果你的地点完全淹没，改为–5)。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 2 more than your location's level.
[cultist]: -5. If your location is fully flooded, take 1 damage.
[tablet]: -5. Increase the flood level of your location, if able.
[elder_thing]: -5 (If your location is fully flooded, you automatically fail instead).
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is your location's level.
[cultist]: -3. If you fail and your location is fully flooded, take 1 damage.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, increase the flood level of your location.
[elder_thing]: -3 (-5 instead if your location is fully flooded).

all_card.back_flavor: 踏错一步让你偏离了城墙废墟。你望向深海的黑暗深渊，感觉自己仿佛漂浮在无垠的宇宙中，是绝然的宁静。突然一阵猛烈的拖拽将你的注意力拉回，是你潜水服的管线被基座上掉下来的碎块挂住了。又是一阵拽力，你被拖回了安全的地方，但身体和自尊都受到了创伤。
all_card.back_text: 每位幸存的调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。
all_card.flavor: 崩塌的废墟中有些狭小的空间可以呼吸空气，你可以从中找出一条路来。
all_card.name: 泛滥道路
all_card.text: 每个地点都与其上一行及下一行的其他每个地点相互连接。 强制 – 在你回合开始时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，也没有降低过你所在地点的淹没等级，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: One wrong step sends you careening away from the ruined wall. As you look out into the abyssal darkness of the ocean depths, you have the illusion of drifting in the vastness of space. It is utterly serene. A sharp tug pulls your attention away: your line is caught on a falling chunk of foundation. Another sharp tug follows. You are drawn back to safety, but not without a heavy bruise and some wounded pride.
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: You can navigate a path through the crumbling ruins via small pockets of air.
all_card.real_text: Each location is connected to each other location on the rows above and below it. Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location or decrease the flood level of your current location, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 安迪·范·诺特维克最后一个跌在了城市底部的环形黑柱区域。他一脸敬畏地望着海底广场中央闪亮的能量场。能量场泛过立柱，像一个连绵的泡泡，里面是可以呼吸的空间。蜿蜒的长隧道从你所属的位置绕向水下发光穹顶的入口。你终于抵达了海床。
all_card.flavor: 远古的基座传来幽光，唤你到海床去。你必须小心前进。
all_card.name: 深入深渊
all_card.text: [free]共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：降低你所在地点的淹没等级。 目标 – 到海床去！如果每位幸存的调查员都在黑曜石基层，你可以推进。(FAQ v2.4)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Andy Van Nortwick is the last to tumble into the ring of black columns at the base of the city. He looks out in awe at a shimmering energy field in the center of the underwater plaza. The field ripples around the columns like a persistent bubble, creating a pocket of breathable air. A long meandering tunnel winds from your position to the entrance of the underwater dome. You have reached the sea floor at last.
all_card.real_flavor: A softly pulsing light at the base of the ancient foundations beckons you to the sea floor. You must proceed carefully.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Decrease your location's flood level. Objective – Make your way to the sea floor! If each surviving investigator is at Obsidian Foundations, you may advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 露比帮你爬上了光滑的黑色岩石，站在了远古步道的边缘。拉莱耶较你抵达之时升起得十分明显：沉没的西墙塔楼摇摇晃晃地睥睨着汹涌的水流，像一座大教堂。你们之前扎营的海湾也已退潮。不远处你还能看到卡珊德拉号在黑浪上摇曳。要想回登陆点并不远。
all_card.flavor: 崩塌的城墙十分陡峭，但要是你小心攀爬，应该还是可以安全地到达海面。
all_card.name: 浮出城墙
all_card.text: [free]共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：降低你所在地点的淹没等级。 目标 – 到海面去！如果每位幸存的调查员都在西墙，你可以推进。(FAQ v2.4)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Ruby helps you up the slick black rocks to stand on the edge of what was once an ancient walkway. R'lyeh has risen noticeably since you arrived: the sunken western wall tower precariously over the turgid waters like an ancient citadel. The bay where you first made camp has receded as well. Not far off, you can see the Cassandra bob on the black waves. It won't be a long trek back to where you made landfall.
all_card.real_flavor: It is a steep climb up the crumbling wall, but if you step carefully, you should reach the surface in one piece.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Decrease your location's flood level. Objective – Make your way to the surface! If each surviving investigator is at Western Wall, you may advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 这条路既危险重重，又令人惊叹。底下传来绿色的荧光，照出一群群鱼和深海的生物。
all_card.back_text: 如果你所在地点有线索，你不能进入危险道路。
all_card.name: 危险道路
all_card.text: X为本地点的深度。 强制 – 你从上方的地点进入危险道路后：受到1点伤害。 强制 – 你从下方的地点进入危险道路后：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The path is both perilous and breathtaking in equal measure. A brilliant green glow emanates from below, illuminating schools of fish and deep sea creatures.
all_card.real_back_text: You cannot enter Treacherous Path if there are clues on your location.

all_card.name: 海床壁缘[tdc_rune_w]
all_card.text:
壁缘下方是三幅不同的场景。第一块描绘了彗星从天空坠落。中间的部分相当抽象，上面展示着夜魇般的异星形体大军从坠落的岩石中倾巢而出。它们脸上盖着厚厚一层触手样的附肢。壁缘上描绘的异星生物践踏了一片森林，森林里长着浓密的、方方的开花的树。最后一幅则是蠕虫般遒劲的生物从外星陨石上像洪水一样席卷而来。
你发现了该字符： [tdc_rune_w] 在剧本日志中，字符表部分的[tdc_rune_w]下方记录“寄生”。该字符已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text:
Below the frieze is a triptych of three distinct scenes. The first panel depicts a comet falling from the sky. The center panel, while highly abstract, shows legions of nightmarish alien shapes pouring out of fallen rocks. Their faces are covered in thick, ropy appendages. The frieze depicts the alien creatures trampling a forest of what looks like thick, boxy flowering trees. The final frieze depicts a wave of sinewy, wormlike creatures spilling out from the celestial rocks like a flood.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_w] In your Campaign Log, record "Parasite" under [tdc_rune_w] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.name: 海底秘库[tdc_rune_z]
all_card.text:
你按下秘库大门上三个隐藏的节点，伴随着一阵令人满意的嘶嘶声，门滑开了。里面是一具已经干燥的异星生物的尸体，章鱼脸和皮革翼已经化为尘土。它嶙峋的爪子里握着一块黑曜石板，你认出来那是一张城市地图，可能就是拉莱耶的。
你发现了该字符： [tdc_rune_z] 在剧本日志中，字符表部分的[tdc_rune_z]下方记录“城市”。该字符已被翻译。 将本卡牌翻回地点面。它不能再次翻面。
all_card.real_text:
You press three small hidden nodes inset into the vault door and it slides open with a satisfying hiss. Inside is a desiccated corpse of an alien creature, its octopoid face and leathery wings reduced to dust. It holds an obsidian slate in one bony hand; you identify it as a kind of city map, likely of R'lyeh itself.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_z] In your Campaign Log, record "City" under [tdc_rune_z] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Flip this card back to its location side. It cannot be flipped over again.

[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, take 1 damage or 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 隧道分分合合，就像诡异的巨大食道里的血管。每个表面都长着有机的血肉增生。你原本以为的震颤，其实是隧道自己在动：就像一根巨大的气管，肌肉在伸缩。你刚转过拐角，就看到了梦魇中的生物，它长着肿胀盲目的眼睛，正滑出你的视线。
all_card.back_text: 在每个没有胜利X的地点上放置线索，直至其线索等于其线索值。 将放在一边的奇丑混种敌人和遭遇弃牌堆混洗，放置在遭遇牌库底。
all_card.flavor: 你听到黑暗中传来蜿蜒爬行和咬牙切齿的声音。拉莱耶深处有什么可怕的东西在骚动。你觉得还是别等着看到底是什么了······
all_card.name: 暗中骚动
all_card.real_back_flavor: The tunnels branch and merge like blood vessels in a vast alien gullet. Every surface is covered in fleshy organic growths. What you first thought were tremors were the tunnels themselves: tightening and expanding like the muscles of a large trachea. As you round a corner, you see a nightmarish creature with sightless, buggy eyes slither out of sight.
all_card.real_back_text: Place clues on each location without victory X up to its clue value. Shuffle the set-aside Grotesque Amalgam enemy with the encounter discard pile and place those cards on the bottom of the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: You can hear the sound of slithering and gnashing teeth in the darkness. Something awful stirs in the bowels of R'lyeh. You would rather not stick around to find out what it actually is...

all_card.back_flavor: 一大群腥臭的脓疱生物将你追赶进黑暗的涵洞。你藏在血肉之墙中，祈祷好运。仿佛好几小时之后，长廊终于宁静下来。你松了口气，想要推开肉壁，却发现它已经用黏糊糊的胶状物质锁住了你的手。你试着挣脱，却发现手上臂上的皮肤脱落下来，几无痛感。你惊恐地望着自己已经变样的手掌。一根橙色的触手从耳边略过，绕着你的脖子。你被活活吞吃了。
all_card.back_text: 每位没有撤退的调查员被击败。
all_card.flavor: 每个隐蔽的地方和裂缝都钻出了可憎的生物。要是你跑得不够快，你感觉自己肯定会成为永恒的宿主。
all_card.name: 可憎的寄生虫
all_card.text: 强制 – 在毁灭标记放置到本密谋时，如果场上没有非[[精英]]敌人：从遭遇牌库顶揭示卡牌，直到揭示了一个敌人，将其生成(如可能，生成在无人地点)。混洗其他每张揭示的卡牌，并将它们放回遭遇牌库顶。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A horde of stinking pustulous creatures chases you into a dark culvert. You hide within a fleshy fold of wall and hope for the best. After what feels like hours, the halls grow silent. Breathing a sigh of relief, you try to push the fold back only to find it has latched onto your arm with a sticky, gluey substance. As you try to pull away from it, the skin on your hand and arm sloughs off loosely, and with little pain. You stare in horror at your degloved palm. An orange tendril snakes past your ear to encircle your neck. You are being digested alive.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated.
all_card.real_flavor: Loathsome creatures emerge from every nook and cranny. If you don't escape soon, you have a feeling you'll become a permanent resident.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if there are no non-[[Elite]] enemies in play: Reveal cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is revealed and spawn it (at an empty location, if able). Shuffle each other revealed card and place them on top of the encounter deck.

all_card.back_text:
如果每位调查员都在迷失营地：
你搜寻了营地，却发现自己被一群长袍人包围了，他们举着火炬，没有武器。人群中走出来一个穿着补丁长袍的女子，她面色柔和地说：“请别吓着了。我们一点也不想伤害你。”
每位调查员失去其所有线索。 进入幕间故事：失落的朝圣者(第21页)。
如果每位调查员都在酸性腔体：
你听到了嘶嘶声，后背随即传来一阵锐利地刺痛。你失去意识的那一刹，回头看到了卷曲的肢体埋入了你的脊背。
每位调查员失去其所有线索。 进入幕间故事：蜂巢思维(第22页)。
all_card.flavor: 血肉隧道分泌出一种腐臭的蜡状物质，灼烧着你的皮肤。你的目的地藏在恶心迷宫的更深处。
all_card.name: 不安的兆象
all_card.text: [action]共同花费1个或更多线索：每花费1个线索，弃掉遭遇牌库顶5张卡牌(如果只有1位调查员则改为10张)并抽取以此效果弃掉的每个地点。 目标 – 如果所有幸存的调查员都在一个[[圣堂]]地点，则可以共同花费所需的线索以推进。(提示：在你推进后，可能无法再进一步探索。)
all_card.real_back_text:
If each investigator is at Lost Campsite:
After searching the campsite, you find yourselves surrounded by robed figures holding torches, but no weapons. A soft-faced woman in a patchwork cloak emerges from the crowd. "Please, don't be alarmed. We have no intention of harming you."
Each investigator loses all of their clues. Proceed to Interlude: Lost Pilgrims (page 21).
If each investigator is at Acidic Coelom:
You hear a hiss, then feel sharp, stinging pain in your back. As you lose consciousness, look around and see a prehensile limb buried in your spine.
Each investigator loses all of their clues. Proceed to Interlude: The Hive Mind (page 22).
all_card.real_flavor: The fleshy tunnels excrete a foul, waxy substance that burns the skin. Your destination lies deeper within the disgusting labyrinth.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 or more clues, as a group: For each clue spent, discard the top 5 cards (10 cards instead if there is 1 investigator) of the encounter deck and draw each location discarded by this effect. Objective - If each surviving investigator is at a [[Sanctum]] location, investigators may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.(Hint: you may not be able to explore further after you advance.)

all_card.back_text:
如果本场景下有3张或更多[[异教徒]]卡牌：
你逃离养育场的时候，隧道弯曲开裂了。你带着幸存的朝圣者逃了出去，而身后异星的寄生虫还在发出狂怒的尖叫。你安全了······至少现在是的。
(→结局1)(第23页)。
否则：
你逃离养育场的时候，隧道弯曲裂开了。你听到身后传来朝圣者痛苦的尖叫。尖叫戛然而止，取而代之的是大吃大嚼和血肉撕裂的声音。幸存者无几，但其中有你。
(→结局2)(第23页)。
all_card.flavor: 这个营地被异星寄生虫攻击了！
all_card.name: 失落的朝圣者
all_card.text: 每个[[异教徒]]敌人获得胜利0和冷漠。 [action]：谈判。检定[intellect](2)或[combat](2)。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，将你所在地点一个不同的[[异教徒]]敌人朝任意方向移动一次。 强制 – 在敌军阶段结束时：每个[[异教徒]]敌人所在地点每有一个[[偷渡虫]]敌人，则该[[异教徒]]敌人受到1点伤害。 目标 – 在一轮结束时，如果胜利区中和/或本场景下面有总计5个或更多[[异教徒]]敌人，你必须推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If there are 3 or more Cultist cards under this act:
The tunnels buckle and spasm as you flee the apiary. You usher the last of the surviving pilgrims out as the alien parasites screech in primal rage behind you. You are safe... for now.
(→R1) (page 23).
Otherwise:
The tunnels buckle and spasm as you flee the apiary. You hear the pilgrims' agonized screams behind you. Suddenly the screams stop, replaced by the sound of gnashing mouths and tearing flesh. You were one of the fortunate ones.
(→R2) (page 23).
all_card.real_flavor: The campsite is under attack by alien parasites!
all_card.real_text: Each [[Cultist]] enemy gains victory 0 and aloof. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2) or [combat] (2). For each point you succeed by, move a different [[Cultist]] enemy at your location once in any direction. Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Each [[Cultist]] enemy takes 1 damage for each [[Stowaway]] enemy at its location. Objective - When the round ends, if there is a combined total of 5 or more [[Cultist]] cards in the victory display and/or under this act, you must advance.

all_card.back_flavor: “嘿！丑东西！尝尝这个！”露比叫着将手枪的子弹全部打进主母松垂的肉体。寄生虫女王痛苦地尖叫。你周围其它的偷渡虫一起叽喳尖叫，主母死后它们也僵直了。露比一脸凶相，一个个踩过寄生虫，确保它们真的死了。你检查这些怪物的尸体。没有主母的控制，寄生虫都一动不动。
all_card.flavor: 它不是活在墙里！它就是墙！
all_card.name: 蜂巢思维
all_card.text: [free]在你的回合期间，将X个线索放到你的地点：对你地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人造成X点伤害。 强制 – 在一轮结束时：抛一枚硬币。正面向上，则顺时针旋转中央腔室一次。背面向上，则逆时针旋转中央腔室一次。 目标 – 如果主母被击败，立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Hey, ugly! Eat this!" Ruby shouts as she empties her pistol into the Mother's sagging flesh. The queen parasite screams in pain. Around you, the other stowaways chitter and squeal in tandem, then go limp as their mother expires. Ruby's face is wild as she stomps each of the parasites in turn, just to make sure they're dead. You examine the creatures' remains. Without the Mother to control them, the parasites are inert.
all_card.real_flavor: It doesn't live in the walls! It is the walls!
all_card.real_text: [fast] During your turn, place X clues on your location: Deal X damage to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. Forced - When the round ends: Flip a coin. On heads, rotate Central Chamber once clockwise. On tails, rotate Central Chamber once counter-clockwise. Objective - If Mother is defeated, immediately advance.

all_card.name: 养育场入口
all_card.text: [action]共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将遭遇弃牌堆的所有地点混洗入遭遇牌库底的10张卡牌。 [free]：先择离养育场入口最远的地点。在所选地点放置线索，直至其线索等于其线索值。(每轮仅限一次。) [action]：撤退。你离开了。
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Shuffle each location in the encounter discard pile into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck. [fast]: Choose the farthest location from Apiary Entrance. Place clues on the chosen location up to its clue value. (Limit once per round.) [action]: Resign. You make your exit.

all_card.name: 养育场入口
all_card.text: 在抽取[[偷渡虫]]敌人时，不将其生成在通常的生成地点，改为生成在养育场入口。 [action]共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将本地点的一个[[异教徒]]支援或敌人放到场景卡牌下面。 [action]：撤退。你离开了。
all_card.real_text: When a [[Stowaway]] enemy is drawn, spawn it at Apiary Entrance instead of its normal spawn location. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place a [[Cultist]] asset or enemy at this location underneath the act. [action]: Resign. You make your exit.

all_card.name: 血肉道路
all_card.text: 显现 – 将血肉道路放置入场。 [action]：检定[intellect](2)以搜寻血肉一样的墙壁。如果你检定成功，将放在一边的古代遗物[tdc_rune_s]支援放置入场，位于你的控制之下。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Fleshy Paths into play. [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to search the flesh-like walls. If you succeed, put the set-aside Ancient Relic [tdc_rune_s] asset into play under your control.

all_card.name: 血肉道路[tdc_rune_r]
all_card.text: 显现 – 将血肉道路[tdc_rune_r]放置入场。 [action]你发现了该字符： [tdc_rune_r] 在剧本日志中，字符表部分的[tdc_rune_r]下方记录“时间”。该字符已被翻译。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Fleshy Paths [tdc_rune_r] into play. [action] You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_r] In your Campaign Log, record "Time" under [tdc_rune_r] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

all_card.name: 增生原野
all_card.text: 显现 – 将增生原野和放在一边的隐藏秘库[tdc_rune_u]地点一起放置入场。 [action]：检定[willpower](8)。投入本次技能检定的每张卡牌上的技能图标翻倍。如果你检定成功，控制放在一边的骇人“面具”剧情支援。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Growing Fields into play along with the set-aside Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u] location. [action]: Test [willpower] (8). Double the skill icons of each card committed to this test. If you succeed, take control of the set-aside Grisly "Mask" story asset.

all_card.name: 翻腾裂口
all_card.text: 显现 – 将翻腾裂口放置入场，并将放在一边的带鳞寄生虫[tdc_rune_t]敌人生成在该地点。 [reaction]在你于翻腾裂口开始自己的回合时：移动到任意已揭示的地点。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Churning Chasm into play and spawn the set-aside Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t] enemy at it. [reaction] When you begin your turn in Churning Chasm: Move to any revealed location.

all_card.name: 腐化秘库[tdc_rune_q]
all_card.text: 显现 – 将腐化秘库[tdc_rune_q]放置入场。 [action][action]：你发现了该字符： [tdc_rune_q] 在剧本日志中，字符表部分的[tdc_rune_q]下方记录“手”。该字符已被翻译。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Corrupted Vault [tdc_rune_q] into play. [action][action]: You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_q] In your Campaign Log, record "Hand" under [tdc_rune_q] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

all_card.name: 荧光通道
all_card.text: 显现 – 将荧光通道放置入场。将放在一边的朝圣者遭遇组和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。找出放在一边的孽生温床和腐化秘库[tdc_rune_q]，将其混洗入遭遇牌库底的10张牌。 [action]受到1点伤害：在离养育场入口最远的地点放置线索，直至其线索等于其线索值。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Luminous Tunnels into play. Shuffle the set-aside Pilgrims encounter set into the encounter deck along with the encounter discard pile. Find the set-aside Spawning Grounds and Corrupted Vault [tdc_rune_q] and shuffle them into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck. [action] Take 1 damage: Place clues on the location farthest from Apiary Entrance up to its clue value.

all_card.name: 孽生温床
all_card.text: 显现 – 将孽生温床放置入场。将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。找出放在一边的迷失营地和翻腾裂口，将其混洗入遭遇牌库底的10张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Spawning Grounds into play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the set-aside Lost Campsite and Churning Chasm and shuffle them into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: 营地看来已被遗弃，到处散乱着餐具和撕碎的帐篷。也许还有幸存者藏在周围。
all_card.name: 迷失营地
all_card.text: 显现 – 将迷失营地放置入场。 [action]：抽取迷失营地底下顶部的卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: The camp is seemingly abandoned, strewn with dishware and tattered tents. Perhaps there are survivors hiding nearby.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Lost Campsite into play. [action]: Draw the topmost card beneath Lost Campsite.

all_card.name: 玛利亚·里维拉
all_card.text: 在伤害将要放置到你所在地点的[[异教徒]]敌人上时，改为放置在玛莉亚·里维拉上。 [reaction]在毁灭标记将要放置到[[异教徒]]敌人上时，横置玛莉亚·里维拉：改为放置在玛莉亚·里维拉上，作为伤害。 强制 – 如果玛莉亚·里维拉被击败：将她加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text: When damage would be placed on a [[Cultist]] enemy at your location, place it on Maria Rivera instead. [reaction] When doom would be placed on a [[Cultist]] enemy, exhaust Maria Rivera: Place it on Maria Rivera instead, as damage. Forced - If Maria Rivera is defeated: Add her to the victory display.

all_card.name: 攫噬长廊
all_card.text: 显现 – 将攫噬长廊放置入场。将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。找出放在一边的饥渴长廊和腐化秘库[tdc_rune_q]，将其混洗入遭遇牌库底的10张卡牌。 [action]受到1点恐惧：在离养育场入口最远的地点放置线索，直至其线索等于其线索值。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Grasping Corridor into play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the set-aside Starving Corridor and Corrupted Vault [tdc_rune_q] and shuffle them into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck. [action] Take 1 horror: Place clues on the location farthest from Apiary Entrance up to its clue value.

all_card.name: 饥渴长廊
all_card.text: 显现 – 将饥渴长廊放置入场。将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。找出放在一边的酸性体腔和翻腾裂口，将其混洗入遭遇牌库底的10张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Starving Corridor into play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the set-aside Acidic Coelom and Churning Chasm and shuffle them into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: 酸性的蒸汽消化了腔室里的一切，包括血肉和金属。
all_card.name: 酸性体腔
all_card.text: 显现 – 将酸性体腔放置入场。 作为从酸性腔体移动到养育场入口的额外费用，你必须受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: The acidic vapors digest anything inside the chamber, including flesh and metal.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Acidic Coelom into play. As an additional cost to move from Acidic Coelom to Apiary Entrance, you must take 1 damage.

all_card.name: 中央腔室
all_card.text: 中央腔室与其下方的地点(与其底边接触)相互连接。 强制 – 在你回合结束时，如果你位于本地点：检定[agility](1)。如果你检定失败，你必须移动到一个连接地点或主母攻击你。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A rhythmic thud reverberates through the walls of the chamber like a heartbeat.
all_card.real_back_text: Central Chamber is connected to the location below it (bordering its bottom edge) and vice versa.
all_card.real_text: Central Chamber is connected to the location below it (bordering its bottom edge) and vice versa. Forced - When your turn ends, if you are at this location: Test [agility] (1). If you fail, you must either move to a connecting location or Mother attacks you.
all_card.back_text: 中央腔室与其下方(紧邻其底边)的地点相连，反之亦然。

all_card.name: 主母
all_card.text: 庞大。无情。 强制 – 在另一个[[偷渡虫]]敌人被击败时：将该敌人上所有的伤害移动到主母。(如果该敌人上有毁灭标记，也将该敌人混洗入遭遇牌库。)
all_card.real_text: Massive. Relentless. Forced - When another [[Stowaway]] enemy is defeated: Move all damage on that enemy to Mother. (If that enemy had doom on it, shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck as well.)

all_card.name: 奇丑混种
all_card.text: 猎手。反击。 强制 – 你使用[[武器]]支援攻击本敌人后：在该支援上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After you fight this enemy using a [[Weapon]] asset: Place 1 doom on that asset.

all_card.name: 养育场看管者
all_card.text: 冷漠。猎手。 猎物 – [agility]最低。 强制 – 在毁灭标记放到本地点的卡牌时：重整养育场看管者。它失去冷漠，直到本轮结束。如果其与调查员交战，其立即进行一次攻击。
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Hunter. Prey - Lowest [agility]. Forced - When doom is placed on a card at this location: Ready Apiary Tender. It loses aloof until the end of the round. If it is engaged with an investigator, it makes an immediate attack.

all_card.name: 饥饿的墙
all_card.text: 显现 – 将本卡牌附属到你所在地点。 强制 – 在你离开所附属的地点时：检定[agility](4)或[combat](4)。如果你检定失败且你检定的是······ – ······[agility]，弃掉一个你控制的支援并受到1点伤害。弃掉饥饿的墙。 – ······[combat]，受到2点直接伤害。弃掉饥饿的墙。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach this card to your location. Forced - When you leave attached location: Test [agility] (4) or [combat] (4). If you fail and you tested... - ...[agility], discard an asset you control and take 1 damage. Discard Hungry Walls. - ...[combat], take 2 direct damage. Discard Hungry Walls.

all_card.name: 危险的好奇心
all_card.text: 显现 – 检定[willpower](X)，其中X为你所在地点的隐藏值。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害并从遭遇牌库顶弃牌，直到弃掉一个[[偷渡虫]]敌人并将其抽取。将以此效果弃掉的每个地点混洗回遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is your location's shroud value. If you fail, take 1 damage and discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Stowaway]] enemy is discarded and draw it. Shuffle each location discarded by this effect back into the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: 里面是什么在动？
all_card.name: 异星卵
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 – 在最近的没有毁灭标记的非[[精英]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_flavor: What is that moving inside?
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Place 1 doom on the nearest non-[[Elite]] enemy with no doom on it.

all_card.name: 隐藏秘库[tdc_rune_u]
all_card.text: 强制 – 在隐藏秘库[tdc_rune_u]入场后：查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个敌人并将其生成在本地点。 [reaction]你成功躲避在隐藏秘库[tdc_rune_u]的敌人且超过难度至少2点后：将本卡牌翻面并结算其文本。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u] enters play: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy and spawn it at this location. [reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy at Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u] by 2 or more: Flip this card and resolve its text.

all_card.name: 隐藏秘库[tdc_rune_u]
all_card.text:
你在血肉之墙的褶皱之后发现了一块隐藏的异星嵌板。你面露不快地按了下去，发现露出来一个圆形的壁龛，一点也没有异星增生的痕迹。壁龛中心，黑色的石板上，曲线连接起了鲜明的发光符号。你研究了一番，发现这是某种族谱。上面有成百上千的名字：亿万年前到底有多少生物存活于这座古城？
你发现了该字符： [tdc_rune_u] 在剧本日志中，字符表部分的[tdc_rune_u]下方记录“女儿”。该字符已被翻译。 将本卡牌翻面，它不能再翻回。
all_card.real_text:
You find an alien panel hidden behind a fold of fleshy wall. Grimacing, you press it and reveal a round alcove untouched by the alien growths. Sharp glowing symbols connected by curling lines appear on a black slate in the center of the alcove. After some study, you recognize it as some kind of ancestral tree. There are hundreds upon hundreds of names: how many creatures lived in this city aeons ago?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_u] In your Campaign Log, record "Daughters" under [tdc_rune_u] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Flip this card back to its location side. It cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.name: 带鳞寄生虫[tdc_rune_t]
all_card.text: 反击。 如果带鳞寄生虫[tdc_rune_t]将要离场，将其放在一边，位于场外。 强制 – 在你击败带鳞寄生虫[tdc_rune_t]时：将本敌人翻面并结算其文本。
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. If Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t] would leave play, set it aside, out of play. Forced - When you defeat Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t]: Flip this enemy and resolve its text.

all_card.name: 带鳞寄生虫[tdc_rune_t]
all_card.text:
这只异星生物坚硬的外壳碎裂了，露出一个闪亮的黑色印记。它肯定是吞吃了这件东西······或者是因其诞生的？按下印记后，投射出了一片多云金色天空的景象，肯定不属于这个世界。一连串的字符和下划线盖住了这片场景。终于，意思清晰了。
你发现了该字符： [tdc_rune_t] 在剧本日志中，字符表部分的[tdc_rune_t]下方记录“大气”。该字符已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text:
The alien creature's hard carapace crumbles to reveal a shining black sigil. It must have devoured this piece of technology... or was it assembled from it? Pressing the sigil projects an image of a cloudy golden sky. Somewhere not of this world. A series of glyphs and descending lines overlay the scene. Eventually, their meaning becomes clear.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_t] In your Campaign Log, record "Air" under [tdc_rune_t] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.name: 古代遗物
all_card.text: 如果古代遗物[tdc_rune_s]将要离场，将其放在一边，位于场外。 强制 – 你受到伤害后：对古代遗物[tdc_rune_s]造成1点伤害。 [reaction]在你控制着古代遗物[tdc_rune_s]结束游戏时：将本卡牌翻面并结算其文本。
all_card.real_text: If Ancient Relic [tdc_rune_s] would leave play, set it aside, out of play. Forced - After you take 1 or more damage: Deal 1 damage to Ancient Relic [tdc_rune_s]. [reaction] When you end the game with Ancient Relic [tdc_rune_s] under your control: Flip this card and resolve its text.

all_card.name: 古代遗物[tdc_rune_s]
all_card.text:
将遗物的一部分旋转之后，露出来一个小小的圆柱体，里面是一个更小号的相同遗物，再里面则是一块闪亮的宝石。你把宝石对着光，它映出了一串小点，组成了某种编码。有个探险队员认出这是某种蓝图：这些符号似乎是修复某种机械的说明。
你发现了该字符： [tdc_rune_s] 在剧本日志中，字符表部分的[tdc_rune_s]下方记录“机械”。该字符已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text:
Twisting portions of the relic unlocks a small cylinder in the center. Inside the cylinder is an even smaller version of the same relic, and within the smaller relic is a glittering gem. Holding it up to the light projects a series of small dots that form some kind of code. One of the expedition members identifies it as a blueprint of sorts: the symbols appear to be instructions for repairing some kind of machine.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_s] In your Campaign Log, record "Machine" under [tdc_rune_s] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.name: 骇人“面具”
all_card.text:
[free]横置骇人“面具”：与每个敌人解除交战。直到你下个回合开始，你不能移动，不能对敌人造成伤害，不能与敌人交战。
    [tdc_rune_j] · [tdc_rune_m] · [tdc_rune_s] · [tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_b]
    [free]受到1点直接恐惧并横置骇人“面具”：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成2点伤害。
all_card.real_text:
[fast] Exhaust Grisly "Mask": Disengage from each enemy. Until the beginning of your next turn, you cannot move and cannot damage enemies or engage them.
[tdc_rune_j] · [tdc_rune_m] · [tdc_rune_s] · [tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_b]
[fast] Take 1 direct horror and exhaust Grisly "Mask": Deal 2 damage to an enemy at your location.

all_card.name: 寄生变形
all_card.text: 显现 – 将寄生变形放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。 强制 – 敌人与你交战后：在寄生变形上放置1个毁灭标记。 [action][action]：弃掉寄生变形。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Parasitic Transformation into play in your threat area. Forced - After an enemy engages you: Place 1 doom on Parasitic Transformation. [action][action]: Discard Parasitic Transformation.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
    [skull]：–X。X为已激活地点的数量。
    [cultist]：–4。本次检定结算后，你必须关闭你所在地点，或受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
    [tablet]：–3(如果你所在地点部分淹没，改为–4；如果你所在地点完全淹没，改为–5)。
    [elder_thing]：–5。如果你检定失败，查找遭遇弃牌堆，找出1张还在身后诡计并将其抽取。
all_card.name: 大秘库
all_card.text:
简单/普通
    [skull]：–X。X为已激活地点数量的一半(向下取整)。
    [cultist]：–3。如果你检定失败，你必须关闭你所在地点，或受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。
    [tablet]：–2(如果你所在地点部分淹没，改为–3；如果你所在地点完全淹没，改为–4)。
    [elder_thing]：–4。如果你检定失败，查找遭遇弃牌堆，找出1张还在身后诡计并将其加入胜利区。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of activated locations.
[cultist]: -4. After this test resolves, you must either deactivate your location or take 1 damage and 1 horror.
[tablet]: -3 (-4 instead if your location is partially flooded; -5 instead if your location is fully flooded).
[elder_thing]: -5. If you fail, search the encounter discard pile for a copy of the Still Behind You treachery and draw it.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of activated locations (rounded down).
[cultist]: -3. If you fail, you must either deactivate your location or take 1 damage or 1 horror.
[tablet]: -2 (-3 instead if your location is partially flooded; -4 instead if your location is fully flooded).
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, search the encounter discard pile for a copy of the Still Behind You treachery and add it to the victory display.

all_card.back_flavor: 这个不断变换的建筑群由迷宫一样的长廊和穴室组成，就在你终于理解了一点此地布局的时候，一面墙裂开了。裂缝越来越大，两只巨爪推开了一扇暗门。一个熟悉的身影从黑暗中浮现，怒视着你。你那不知疲倦的追猎者又来了。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的穷途异魔敌人生成在调查员队长所在地点。选择一位该地点的调查员检定[agility](4)。如果检定成功，穷途异魔与每位调查员解除交战并横置。
    将每张放在一边的还在身后诡计和随机1张放在一边的[[星之眷族]]敌人，与遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 黑暗压得人喘不过气，其中满是机器吱嘎的挤压声。
all_card.name: 城市深处
all_card.text: 强制 – 在你回合开始时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，也没有降低过你所在地点的淹没等级，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you begin to make sense of the ever-shifting complex of maze-like corridors and chambers, a crack appears in one wall. The crack grows wider as two massive clawed hands push a hidden door open. A familiar imposing frame emerges from the darkness, glowering at you. Your tireless pursuer is here yet again.
all_card.real_back_text:
Spawn the set-aside The Inescapable enemy at the lead investigator's location. Choose an investigator at that location to test [agility] (4). If they succeed, disengage The Inescapable from each investigator and exhaust it.
Shuffle each copy of the set-aside Still Behind You treachery and 1 random set-aside [[Star Spawn]] enemy, along with the encounter deck and discard pile, into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: The oppressive darkness is filled with the sound of crushing, gnashing machinery.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When your turn begins, if your location is fully flooded, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter a partially flooded or unflooded location during your turn, or decrease your location's flood level, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 接连不断的刺耳噪声盖过了一切其他声音，甚至包括你的追击者的踏步声。他可能潜伏在任何一个角落，找到你只是时间问题。
all_card.back_text:
查找所有场上和场外区域，找出每张还在身后诡计。将这些卡牌、放在一边的[[星之眷族]]敌人和遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。
    将场上每个未与调查员交战的不懈构造物敌人移动到移动平台，呈横置状态，不与调查员交战。
    如果穷途异魔在场上，治愈其1[per_investigator]点伤害并将其朝最近的调查员移动一次。本次移动期间，相邻的地点视为彼此连接。
all_card.flavor: 要是你不找到一劳永逸的办法，这东西是永远不会停下来的。
all_card.name: 机械中的恶魔
all_card.text: 穷途异魔得到+1[per_investigator]生命值。 在穷途异魔通过其猎手关键词移动时，每个相邻的地点视为彼此连接。 强制 – 在你回合开始时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，也没有降低过你所在地点的淹没等级，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The incessant cacophony makes it difficult to hear anything, even the sound of your pursuer's footfalls. He could be lurking around any corner. It is only a matter of time before you are found.
all_card.real_back_text:
Search all in- and out-of-play areas for each copy of the Still Behind You treachery. Shuffle these cards, the set-aside [[Star Spawn]] enemy, and the encounter discard pile, into the encounter deck.
Move each unengaged Persistent Construct enemy in play to the Moving Platform, exhausted and unengaged.
If The Inescapable is in play, heal 1 [per_investigator] damage from it and move it once toward the nearest investigator. Each location is considered to be connected to each adjacent location during this movement.
all_card.real_flavor: This thing won't stop unless you find a way to put it down for good.
all_card.real_text: The Inescapable gets +1 [per_investigator] health. When The Inescapable moves via its hunter keyword, each location is considered to be connected to each adjacent location. Forced - When your turn begins, if your location is fully flooded, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter a partially flooded or unflooded location during your turn, or decrease your location's flood level, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 你发现自己被困在了小小的方室里。黑水从远古水闸涌出，漫过了你的腰、胸、颈。城市的心脏不断嗡响，你的每块骨头也随之震动。你抑制住恐惧，按向发光的节点和面板，徒劳地想抽干穴室里的水，但无济于事。你最后吞下几口气，潜入水中，想要找到出去的路。你勉强挤过巨大的闸门，使尽浑身力气对抗水流。终于，你跌进一个深深的蓄水池，里面全是冰冷刺骨的黑水。然后就在你身下，星之眷族的身影缓缓游来，不可阻挡。它们并不着急，因为它们知道不必：你已无路可逃。
all_card.back_text: 每位没有撤退的幸存调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 要是付出千百倍的努力配上足够多的运气，你或许还是可以逃脱的。
all_card.name: 变换不休的墙壁
all_card.text: 穷途异魔得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 在穷途异魔通过其猎手关键词移动时，每个相邻的地点视为彼此连接。 强制 – 在你回合开始时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，也没有降低过你所在地点的淹没等级，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You find yourself trapped in a small cubic room. Dark water pours out of ancient sluices, rising to your waist, then chest, then neck. Your very bones seem to vibrate with the unceasing thrum of the heart of the city. Pushing panic aside, you press glowing nodes and panels in a futile attempt to drain the chamber, but to no result. Gulping a few last breaths, you dive down, searching for any way out. You just barely squeeze through a massive sluice, struggling against the current. At long last, you tumble out into a deep reservoir filled with icy black water. Below you, the silhouettes of star spawn swim slowly, inexorably toward you. They move without haste, for they know that there is no rush: you have no escape.
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: With great effort and no small amount of luck, you may still be able to escape.
all_card.real_text: The Inescapable gets +2 [per_investigator] health. When The Inescapable moves via its hunter keyword, each location is considered to be connected to each adjacent location. Forced - When your turn begins, if your location is fully flooded, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter a partially flooded or unflooded location during your turn, or decrease your location's flood level, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor:
你对胜利确信无疑，从洞室中央撬下了尘封的碑匾。它随着机械的嗡鸣在你手中搏动，在你脚下的浅水中激起阵阵涟漪。细小的水流蜿蜒升起，围绕在你周围。你挥舞了一下碑匾，看到地上的水也随即升起，又撞向了穴室的右墙。
    你对自己的发现心满意足，准备离开。不过，你还是好奇，拉莱耶的心脏是否还有更多的秘密等你发现······
all_card.back_text: 提升每个能提升淹没等级的地点的淹没等级。 在每个没有胜利X的已揭示[[秘库]]地点上放置线索，直至其线索等于其线索值。
all_card.flavor: 充当拉莱耶跳动心脏的机械确实是异星设计，但并非无法理解。借由此前的研究，你或许可以找出方向。
all_card.name: 小心前行
all_card.text: [reaction]调查员翻译了任意3个下列字符([tdc_rune_l]，[tdc_rune_m]，[tdc_rune_n]，[tdc_rune_p]，[tdc_rune_o])后：揭示封印穴室地点。(提示：这些字符都可以在本场冒险内找到。) 目标 – 在一轮结束时，如果有调查员控制了潮汐碑匾剧情支援，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
With an undeniable sense of triumph, you pry the tablet from its resting place in the center of the chamber. It pulses in your hands in time to the thrumming machinery, sending ripples through the shallow water at your feet. Small tendrils of water snake upward to hang, suspended, around you. You wave the tablet once and watch the water on the floor rise and crash against the right wall of the chamber.
Satisfied with your find, you prepare to leave. However, you wonder if there are any other mysteries you have yet to uncover at the very heart of R'lyeh...
all_card.real_back_text: Increase the flood level of each location that can have its flood level increased. Place clues on each revealed [[Vault]] location without victory X up to its clue threshold.
all_card.real_flavor: The machinery that serves as the beating heart of R'lyeh is alien in design, but not inscrutable. Thanks to all you've learned up to this point, you may be able to find your way through.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After the investigators have translated any 3 of the following glyphs ([tdc_rune_l], [tdc_rune_m], [tdc_rune_n], [tdc_rune_p], [tdc_rune_o]): Reveal the Sealed Chamber location. (Hint: Each of these glyphs are found in this scenario.). Objective - When the round ends, if an investigator controls the Tidal Tablet story asset, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 终于，你抵达了出口。攀爬了一小段之后，你回到了先前俯瞰远古秘库的高耸峭壁。在那儿，你惊讶地发现另外一半探险队也扎了营，正在俯视底下轰响的装置和湍急的水流。你和其他人决定，相比继续前进，还是先休息一下，分享见闻。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 – 如果探险队向西进发，(→结局1)(第27页)。 – 如果探险队向东进发，(→结局2)(第27页)。
all_card.flavor: 古老的秘库进出只有一条路，但返回的原路危险重重。城市剩余部分的水利工程，还在将泛着白沫的水流倾泻进来。
all_card.name: 回穿机械
all_card.text: 目标 – 如果所有幸存的调查员都撤退，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: At long last, you reach the exit. After a short climb, you return to the towering precipice overlooking the ancient vault. There, you are surprised to find the other half of the expedition camped on the overlook, staring down at the churning machinery and turgid waters. Rather than press on, you and the others resolve to rest and share your findings as a group.
all_card.real_back_text: Check your Campaign log. - If the expedition headed west, (→R1) (page 27). - If the expedition headed east, (→R2) (page 27).
all_card.real_flavor: There is only one way in and one way out of the ancient vault, but your route back is fraught with danger. Frothing water continues to pour in, carried by the great waterworks from the rest of the city.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 石头阶梯看着像是通往城市更东端的主路，它隐没在黑暗中，但墙壁和台阶还是随着墙另一端庞大机械的持续运作而振动。
all_card.name: 宏伟台阶
all_card.text: 宏伟台阶不能被淹没。 [action]：撤退。你迈入黑暗，将轰鸣的装置抛在身后。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The stone stairwell appears to be the main way to access much of the eastern side of the city. It is engulfed in darkness, but the walls and steps vibrate with the constant movement of immense machines hidden just beyond the walls.
all_card.real_text: The Great Stair cannot be flooded. [action]: Resign. You venture into darkness, leaving the churning machinery behind.

In your Campaign Log, record the creature was defeated. [action][action] Spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You study the machine. Proceed to Scenario Interlude: The Vault Core (page 26).

all_card.name: 古代秘库[tdc_rune_o]
all_card.text:
墙基处的小开关打开了里面狭窄发霉的房间。你走了进去，地上小小的字符发出黯淡的绿光，光越来越亮，直至夺目，室内的空气也噼啪作响，充满能量。字符先是闪耀，随即黯淡，它的含义将永远在你记忆中烙印。
你发现了该字符： [tdc_rune_o] 在剧本日志中，字符表部分的[tdc_rune_o]下方记录“力量”。该字符已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text:
A small switch at the base of the wall opens into a cramped musty room. As you enter, a small glyph in the floor begins to glow a dim green. The light intensifies until it is blindingly bright, and the air in the room begins to crackle with energy. The glyph flares even brighter, then goes dark. The symbol's meaning will forever be burned into your memory.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_o] In your Campaign Log, record "Power" under [tdc_rune_o] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.name: 古代秘库[tdc_rune_n]
all_card.text: 显现 – 将古代秘库[tdc_rune_n]附属到你所在地点。不能取消。 [action]受到总计X点伤害和/或恐惧，其中X为所附属地点的隐藏值：将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_n] to your location. Cannot be canceled. [action] Take a combined total of X damage and/or horror, where X is attached location's shroud: Flip this card over.

all_card.name: 古代秘库[tdc_rune_n]
all_card.text:
这座古代秘库里有一个不小的八角形房间，像是某种实验室。中央控制台像是爪状的手，升出了两根“指”，控制台中央的节点映射出一个透明的发光字母。你好奇地伸出手，按下了中央的节点。幻象瞬间占据了你的脑海：狂潮怒涛、崩裂的山脉、烧灼的森林和大气。你收回手，不确定自己刚才体验的是什么。是记录？还是幻象？
你发现了该字符： [tdc_rune_n] 在剧本日志中，字符表部分的[tdc_rune_n]下方记录“毁灭”。该字符已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text:
Within the ancient vault is a large octagonal room that resembles a kind of laboratory. A central console resembles a clawed hand, with two of its "fingers" raised. Nodes in the console project a glowing translucent letter. Curious, you press one hand to a central node. A vision overwhelmes your mind: a torrential wave, a sundered mountain, burning forests and atmosphere. You pull one hand away, uncertain of what you just experienced. A record? A vision?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_n] In your Campaign Log, record "Doom" under [tdc_rune_n] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.name: 古代秘库[tdc_rune_p]
all_card.text: 显现 – 将古代秘库[tdc_rune_p]附属到你所在地点。不能取消。 [action]选择并弃掉你X张手牌，其中X为所附属地点的隐藏值：将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_p] to your location. Cannot be canceled. [action] Choose and discard X cards from your hand, where X is attached location's shroud: Flip this card over.

all_card.name: 古代秘库[tdc_rune_p]
all_card.text:
这个秘库里的房间黑暗又平常，只有中心悬着一个发光的烟状球体。你靠近观察，发现这是一颗外星的全貌模型。小小的风暴系统沿着表面加速移动，很快就旋转消解了。你触碰它，感官瞬间被无形的狂风、怒吼的暴雨和电闪雷鸣侵袭。球面出现了几行打旋的异星文字，记录了一场远古的风暴。
你发现了该字符： [tdc_rune_p] 在剧本日志中，字符表部分的[tdc_rune_p]下方记录“气候”。该字符已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text:
The room within the vault is dark and featureless, save for an incandescent, smoky orb suspended in the center. Inspecting it closer, you find a full-scale model of an alien planet. Small storm systems move along the surface at an accelerated rate, swirling and dissipating in seconds. When you touch it, your senses are assailed by invisible gales, torrential rain, and a crack of thunder. Lines of swirling alien writing appear on the globe, conveying a record of an ancient storm.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_p] In your Campaign Log, record "Weather" under [tdc_rune_p] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.back_flavor: 异常的狂风在外面呼啸，塔楼像历经风暴的古树一般哀嚎摇曳。你靠着柱子站直，希望能等震颤过去。突然，你觉得柱子也松动了。你跳开一步，看着精雕细琢的立柱倒塌，落入底下深处。
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆中每张[[征兆]]和[[字符]]卡牌混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你面前是高耸的巨塔，诱人的知识和禁忌的真相就在其中。然而，一大块黑曜石砸碎在附近，你一下子意识到在这座崩坏的建筑里探索有多么危险。尽管它宏伟壮丽，你在这儿却并不安全。
all_card.name: 毁坏的档案馆
all_card.real_back_flavor: As supernatural winds howl outside, the tower groans and sways like an ancient tree weathering a storm. You steady yourself against a pillar, hoping to wait out the tremor. Suddenly, you feel the pillar loosen. Stepping away, you watch the intricately carved pillar tumble down to the bottom far below.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle each [[Omen]] and [[Glyph]] card in the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: The massive tower rises above you, promising enticing knowledge and forbidden truths. However, the imminent peril of navigating the ancient, crumbling structure comes into sharp focus as a chunk of obsidian crashes down nearby. For all its grandeur, you are not safe here.

all_card.back_flavor: 异常的狂风在外面呼啸，塔楼像历经风暴的古树一般哀嚎摇曳。你靠着柱子站直，希望能等震颤过去。突然，你觉得柱子也松动了。你跳开一步，看着精雕细琢的立柱倒塌，落入底下深处。你等着，想听到落水的啪嗒声，但并未听见。底下的水已经退去了。这座城市还在升起，就像死去已久的尸体会从深海浮出一样。
all_card.back_text:
降低每个地点的淹没等级。
    将遭遇弃牌堆中每张[[征兆]]和[[字符]]卡牌混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你面前是高耸的巨塔，诱人的知识和禁忌的真相就在其中。然而，一大块黑曜石从你面前掉入被淹没的深渊，你一下子意识到在这座崩坏的建筑里探索有多么危险。尽管它宏伟壮丽，你在这儿却并不安全。
all_card.name: 淹没的档案馆
all_card.text: 强制 – 在你回合开始时，如果你位于完全淹没的地点，你奋力挣扎，求取空气：在你回合结束时，如果你在自己回合期间没有进入过未淹没或部分淹没的地点，受到5点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As supernatural winds howl outside, the tower groans and sways like an ancient tree weathering a storm. You steady yourself against a pillar, hoping to wait out the tremor. Suddenly, you feel the pillar loosen. Stepping away, you watch the intricately carved pillar tumble down to the bottom far below. You pause, waiting to hear a splash, but there is none. The water below has receded. The city continues to rise like a long-dead corpse from the sea depths.
all_card.real_back_text:
Decrease the flood level of each location.
Shuffle each [[Omen]] and [[Glyph]] card in the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: The massive tower promises enticing knowledge and forbidden truths. However, the imminent peril of navigating the ancient, crumbling structure comes into sharp focus as a chunk of obsidian crashes down to the flooded depths below. For all its grandeur, you are not safe here.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When your turn begins, if your location is fully flooded, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 整座拉莱耶都在升起，塔楼为之震颤。宫墙上的古代符号闪着刺眼的光。你暂时失了明，却隐约瞥见古代生物巨大亵渎的身形，它所在的地方就像你熟悉的黑沙滩。在遥远的异星海岸，翡翠色的太阳照射在油黑色的水面。塔楼中如此海量的历史一下子都涌入了你可怜的小小脑海，你的每一点神经都在尖叫着抗议。你不知不觉地已经倒在了石板地上，陷入了黑暗不休的沉睡······
all_card.back_text: 每位尚未撤退的幸存调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。
all_card.flavor: 拉莱耶缓缓从深海升起，塔楼随之痛苦地呻吟。
all_card.name: 动荡的地基
all_card.text: 敌军阶段期间，每个地点视为与其上方和下方的地点连接。 强制 – 大升降机移动后：每位在大升降机的调查员必须检定[agility](2)。每位检定失败的调查员受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The tower shudders as all of R'lyeh continues to ascend. Ancient symbols on the court walls flash with blinding bright intensity. In your momentary blindness, you catch glimpses of blasphemous, hulking shapes of ancient creatures on what looks like a familiar black-sanded beach. An emerald sun reflects on oily black water of a distant alien shore. Every fiber of your being screams in protest as the sheer volume of history within the tower surges into your pitifully small mind all at once. Before you know it, you collapse on the stone floor and slip into a dark and restless slumber...
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: The tower groans as R'lyeh continues its slow ascent from the depths of the ocean.
all_card.real_text: During the enemy phase, each location is considered to be connected to the location above and below it. Forced - After the Great Lift moves: Each investigator at the Great Lift must test [agility] (2). Each investigator who fails takes 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 千年未用的古代齿轮，发出令人胃痛的声音重新吱嘎运作了起来。升降梯无法稳定，颤动不止，因为有一头巨大的怪物从地面的破洞顽强地爬了出来。看来它一直安眠在升降梯底部，而你却唤醒了它！
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的巨型霸王敌人生成在大升降机。选择一位大升降机的调查员检定[agility](3)。如果该调查员检定成功，横置巨型霸王。
all_card.flavor: 厅堂和高高的天顶分成了几大块，仿佛是图书馆里的书架。你在这里能学到的太多了。
all_card.name: 巨人的阶梯
all_card.text: [action]花费1[per_investigator]个线索：弃掉遭遇牌库顶5张卡牌(如果只有1位调查员，则改为弃掉8张卡牌)。抽取1张以此效果弃掉的[[字符]]卡牌。然后，依次抽取每张以此效果弃掉的[[征兆]]卡牌。 目标 – 大升降机翻至其(开启)面后，立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Ancient gears, unused for millennia, grind to life with a gut-wrenching sound. The lift shudders erratically as a massive creature claws its way up through one of the holes in the floor. It would appear this monstrosity resided on the underside of the lift, and you have awakened it!
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Colossal Tyrant enemy at the Great Lift. Choose an investigator at the Great Lift to test [agility] (3). If they succeed, exhaust the Colossal Tyrant.
all_card.real_flavor: The halls and tall ceilings are divided into massive stacks, like the shelves of a library. There is so much you could learn here.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck (8 cards instead if there is only 1 investigator). Draw 1 [[Glyph]] card discarded by this effect. Then, one at a time, draw each [[Omen]] card discarded by this effect. Objective - After the Great Lift flips to its (Active) side, immediately advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你到了高塔的顶层，寻找有没有出口能让你逃离这座就要倒塌的建筑。往下的道路已经被碎石封死。天顶的开口似乎是你仅剩的希望······
all_card.flavor: 你唯一的希望就是找到遗物，如果真能的话，还得赶在整座塔在你周围倒塌前逃出去！
all_card.name: 逃离高塔(版本一)
all_card.text: [action]如果你位于扭曲窄道：撤退。 [action]花费1[per_investigator]个线索：弃掉遭遇牌库顶5张卡牌(如果只有1位调查员，则改为弃掉8张卡牌)。抽取1张以此效果弃掉的[[字符]]卡牌。然后，依次抽取每张以此效果弃掉的[[征兆]]卡牌。 目标 – 如果所有幸存的调查员都撤退，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You reach the topmost floor of the tower and search for any way to escape from the collapsing structure. The paths down are choked with rubble. The openings in the ceiling seem to be your only hope...
all_card.real_flavor: Your only hope is to find the relic, if you can, and get out before the entire tower crumbles around you!
all_card.real_text: [action] If you are at Twisting Catwalks: Resign. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck (8 cards instead if there is only 1 investigator). Draw 1 [[Glyph]] card discarded by this effect. Then, one at a time, draw each [[Omen]] card discarded by this effect. Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你到了高塔这侧的底部，这里有个圆台，仿佛是某种门。四周的建筑不断倾塌，探险队员疯狂地按压发光的节点和面板，希望能有一条路出去。
all_card.flavor: 你唯一的希望就是找到遗物，如果真能的话，还得赶在整座塔在你周围倒塌前逃出去！
all_card.name: 逃离高塔(版本二)
all_card.text: [action]如果你位于东前厅：撤退。 [action]花费1[per_investigator]个线索：弃掉遭遇牌库顶5张卡牌(如果只有1位调查员，则改为弃掉8张卡牌)。抽取1张以此效果弃掉的[[字符]]卡牌。然后，依次抽取每张以此效果弃掉的[[征兆]]卡牌。 目标 – 如果所有幸存的调查员都撤退，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You reach the bottom of this side of the tower and find a round dais that resembles some kind of door. As destruction rains down around you, the expedition members frantically press the glowing nodes and panels, hoping for a way out.
all_card.real_flavor: Your only hope is to find the relic, if you can, and get out before the entire tower crumbles around you!
all_card.real_text: [action] If you are at East Antechamber: Resign. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck (8 cards instead if there is only 1 investigator). Draw 1 [[Glyph]] card discarded by this effect. Then, one at a time, draw each [[Omen]] card discarded by this effect. Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 曾经宏伟的拱门一度通往拉莱耶的街道，现在却早已坍塌，从这里逃脱的所有希望都被碎石封堵住了。
all_card.name: 西前厅
all_card.text: [free]你的回合期间，本地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索(如果本地点已淹没，改为2[per_investigator]个线索)：将大升降机向下滑动一次。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The once grand archway that opened out onto the streets of R'lyeh has long since collapsed, any hope of exit dashed by the choking rubble.
all_card.real_text: [fast] During your turn, investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group (2 [per_investigator] clues instead if this location is flooded): Slide the Great Lift down once.

all_card.back_flavor: 这间厅室的地面盖着一块巨大的圆形石板，上面有精细的异星雕刻。走在上面，感觉与塔里的其他部分都截然不同。也许这块石板下面是通往城市更深处的道路······
all_card.name: 东前厅
all_card.text: [free]你的回合期间，本地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索(如果本地点已淹没，改为2[per_investigator]个线索)：将大升降机向下滑动一次。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The floor of this chamber is dominated by a large circular slab covered in intricate alien carvings. Walking on its surface feels distinctly different than the other parts of the tower. The slab may cover a passage leading deeper into the city...
all_card.real_text: [fast] During your turn, investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group (2 [per_investigator] clues instead if this location is flooded): Slide the Great Lift down once.

all_card.back_flavor: 透过天顶上的破洞，你能看见阴沉的天空，黯淡的光线和黑暗的阴影交织落在石头窄道上，构成了塔楼此侧的顶层。
all_card.name: 扭曲窄道
all_card.text: 强制 – 位于扭曲窄道的敌人对你造成伤害和/或恐惧后：选择并弃掉你1张手牌。 [reaction]你击败本地点的敌人后：弃掉遭遇牌库顶X张卡牌，其中X为该敌人的印刷生命值。抽取1张以此效果弃掉的[[字符]]卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The overcast sky can be seen through holes in the ceiling above, casting dim light and dark shadows on the interlacing stone catwalks that make up the highest floor of this side of the tower.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After an enemy at Twisting Catwalks deals damage and/or horror to you: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. [reaction] After you defeat an enemy at this location: Discard the top X cards of the encounter deck, where X is that enemy's printed health. Draw 1 [[Glyph]] card discarded by this effect.

all_card.name: 大升降机
all_card.text: 大升降机不能移动，且与其左边和右边的地点相互连接。 强制 – 在本地点最后的线索被发现时：将大升降机翻面(保留其所有的标记和附属)。
all_card.real_text: Great Lift cannot move and is connected to the locations to the right and left of it, and vice versa. Forced - When the last clue is discovered from this location: Flip Great Lift (keeping all tokens and attachments).

all_card.name: 大升降机
all_card.text:
大升降机与其左边和右边的地点相互连接。
    [reaction]在你成功调查本地点时，不发现线索：改为将大升降机向上或向下滑动一次。你可以花费1[per_investigator]个线索，以将大升降机额外向上或向下滑动一次。
all_card.real_text:
Great Lift is connected to the locations to the right and left of it, and vice versa.
[reaction]When you successfully investigate this location, instead of discovering clues: Slide Great Lift up or down once. You may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues to slide Great Lift up or down one additional time.

all_card.back_flavor: 围绕巨柱盘旋而上的阶梯被门挡住了，每扇门上都有一个发光的异星符号。
all_card.back_text:
你不能进入本地点，除非胜利区中有3张或更多[[字符]]卡牌。
作为进入古代祭坛的额外费用，东前厅地点的调查员必须共同花费4[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.name: 古代祭坛
all_card.text: [action]：检定[willpower]或[intellect](5)以打破封印。调查员每翻译5个字符，本次检定得到难度值–1(最多–4)。如果你检定成功，控制放在一边的伊库勒刻特碎片剧情支援。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The stairway winding up the column is obstructed by gates, each one featuring a glowing alien symbol.
all_card.real_back_text:
You cannot enter this location unless there are 3 or more [[Glyph]] cards in the victory display.
As an additional cost to enter Ancient Altar, investigators at East Antechamber must spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (5) to break the seal. This test gets -1 difficulty for every 5 glyphs the investigators have translated (to a max of -4). If you succeed, take control of the set-aside Shard of Y'ch'lecht story asset.

all_card.back_flavor: 通道扭曲又回旋，你几乎不可能在这座崩塌的建筑里找到方向。看来塔楼中央的升降机平台是唯一可以上下的方法。
all_card.name: 环形藏书室
all_card.text: [reaction]在你从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌时，选择并弃掉你1张手牌：从遭遇牌库顶额外弃掉2张卡牌。 [action]：移动。移动到一个已揭示的[[通道]]地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The pathways wind and twist, making it impossible to navigate the crumbling structure. It would appear that the lift platform in the tower's center is the only way up or down.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you discard 1 or more cards from the top of the encounter deck, choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Discard 2 additional cards from the top of the encounter deck. [action]: Move. Move to a revealed [[Passageway]] location.

all_card.back_flavor: 通道扭曲又回旋，你几乎不可能在这座崩塌的建筑里找到方向。看来塔楼中央的升降机平台是唯一可以上下的方法。
all_card.name: 环形藏书室
all_card.text: [reaction]在你从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌时，受到1点直接恐惧：从遭遇牌库顶额外弃掉3张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The pathways wind and twist, making it impossible to navigate the crumbling structure. It would appear that the lift platform in the tower's center is the only way up or down.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you discard 1 or more cards from the top of the encounter deck, take 1 direct horror: Discard 3 additional cards from the top of the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 崇高步道
all_card.text: 胜利区中每有一张[[字符]]卡牌，本地点得到隐藏值–1。 强制 – 在本地点揭示时：将放在一边的星之眷族观测者生成在本地点。 [action]：移动。移动到一个已揭示的[[通道]]地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The pathways wind and twist, making it impossible to navigate the crumbling structure. It would appear that the lift platform in the tower's center is the only way up or down.
all_card.real_text: This location gets -1 shroud for each [[Glyph]] card in the victory display. Forced - When this location is revealed: Spawn the set-aside Star Spawn Observer at this location. [action]: Move. Move to a revealed [[Passageway]] location.

all_card.back_flavor: 通道扭曲又回旋，你几乎不可能在这座崩塌的建筑里找到方向。看来塔楼中央的升降机平台是唯一可以上下的方法。
all_card.name: 崇高步道
all_card.text: 强制 – 你位于崇高步道时从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌后：最近的重整状态的非[[精英]]敌人与每位调查员解除交战并移动到本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The pathways wind and twist, making it impossible to navigate the crumbling structure. It would appear that the lift platform in the tower's center is the only way up or down.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discard 1 or more cards from the top of the encounter deck while at Lofty Walkway: The nearest ready, non-[[Elite]] enemy disengages from each investigator and moves to this location.

all_card.real_text: Forced - When the investigation phase ends, if there are clues on Luminous Archives: Shuffle each [[Glyph]] treachery attached to this location into the encounter deck. [action][action]: Search the encounter discard pile for a [[Glyph]] card and draw it.

all_card.name: 宫廷看守[tdc_rune_k]
all_card.text: 如果调查员翻译了10个或更多的字符，本敌人获得无情。 强制 – 在你击败本敌人时，发现该字符： [tdc_rune_k] 在剧本日志中，字符表部分的[tdc_rune_k]下方记录“梦境”。该字符已被翻译。
all_card.real_text: If the investigators have translated 10 or more glyphs, this enemy gains relentless. Forced - When you defeat this enemy, discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_k] In your Campaign Log, record "Dreams" under [tdc_rune_k] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

all_card.name: 宫廷看守[tdc_rune_j]
all_card.text: 如果调查员翻译了10个或更多的字符，本敌人获得警戒和反击。 强制 – 在你击败本敌人时，发现该字符： [tdc_rune_j] 在剧本日志中，字符表部分的[tdc_rune_j]下方记录“沉睡”。该字符已被翻译。
all_card.real_text: If the investigators have translated 10 or more glyphs, this enemy gains alert and retaliate. Forced - When you defeat this enemy, discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_j] In your Campaign Log, record "Sleep" under [tdc_rune_j] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

all_card.name: 古代秘库[tdc_rune_g]

Each enemy, token, and attachment at those locations/open sky are discarded. - Slide each open sky and [[Summit]] location in rows 2 and 4 once to the right. - Place the bottom card of the Summit deck in each gap created. - Flip this card.
