all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的穷途异魔敌人以横置状态生成在中心尖塔，不与调查员交战。将穷途异魔遭遇组的剩余卡牌和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。 将拉莱耶街道从游戏中移除，忽略其文本框。将场上除了中心尖塔之外的每张天空和[[顶端]]地点混洗入顶端牌库。弃掉这些地点的所有卡牌和标记。 按照剧本手册上的场景2地点摆放示意图(第36页)，将放在一边的5张天空卡牌放置入场。用顶端牌库底部的卡牌填满中心尖塔上方、下方、右方的剩余行列，直至共有3行5列。 将放在一边的古代穹顶、空中瀑布地点和剩余放在一边的每张天空卡牌一起混洗入顶端牌库顶部的5张卡牌。
all_card.flavor: 异星天际线呼唤着你，那里全是远古的秘密。
all_card.name: 搜寻尖塔
all_card.text: [action]花费X个线索：从顶端牌库底揭示X张卡牌。你可以将1个揭示的地点放置入场，位于相邻的天空，并移动到该地点。(将那张天空卡牌和揭示的其他每张卡牌以任意顺序放到顶端牌库顶。) 目标 – 如果每位幸存的调查员都位于中心尖塔，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you admire the skyline, you see the elephantine shape of a winged creature climbing up from below. You are being hunted.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside The Inescapable enemy at Central Spire, exhausted and unengaged. Shuffle the rest of The Inescapable encounter set into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Remove R'lyeh Streets from the game, ignoring its text box. Shuffle each open sky and [[Summit]] location in play except for Central Spire into the Summit deck. Each card and token at those locations is discarded. Put 5 of the set-aside open sky cards into play as shown in the Act 2 location placement diagram in the Campaign Guide (page 36). Fill each remaining row and column above, below, and to the right of Central Spire with the bottom card of the Summit deck until there are 3 rows and 5 columns. Shuffle the set-aside Ancient Dome and Aerial Waterfall locations, along with each remaining set-aside open sky card, into the top 5 cards of the Summit deck.
all_card.real_flavor: The alien skyline calls to you, brimming with ancient secrets.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend X clues: Reveal X cards from the bottom of the Summit deck. You may put 1 revealed location into play in an adjacent open sky and move to it. (Place that open sky card and each other revealed card on top of the Summit deck in any order.) Objective - If each surviving investigator is at Central Spire, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 异界的云层在不断变化的天际线上翻滚，中间掠过来自异星的身影。露比吊在参天大楼的边缘，邪恶地大笑：“别害怕！只有这样你才能感受到自己活着！”她叫道。她说的下一句话被隆隆的雷声和更加疾骤的狂风淹没。露比把绳索一端扔给你，爬上了塔顶。
all_card.flavor: 异星天际线呼唤着你，那里全是远古的秘密。
all_card.name: 前往古代穹顶！

all_card.real_back_flavor: The otherworldly clouds churn above the ever-shifting skyline, glimmering with alien shapes. Ruby hangs over the edge of a skyscraper, laughing devilishly. "Don't be scared! This is how you know you're alive!" she shouts. Whatever she says next is drowned out by the crack of thunder, and a quickening gale. Ruby throws the end of her line to you and pulls herself to the top.
all_card.real_flavor: The alien skyline calls to you, brimming with ancient secrets.

(Place that open sky card and each other revealed card on top of the Summit deck in any order.) Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你站在塔楼的顶端，得见拉莱耶全景。某种远古的灾变夷平了城市，冲击波如此之强，足以把尖塔扭曲得像青草的叶片。是什么能导致这样大的灾难？

你爬下险峻尖塔的时候，一阵震颤几乎将你掀翻下来。惊险的几分钟后，你可算是回到了街道上。安迪坐在闪光的岩石上，尽量显得平静。“好吧。又是半打胶卷报废了。”他沮丧地叹了口气，“至少我们安全回来了。唔，基本上是吧。”他笑着看了看自己打着绷带的手臂。
    等你们小队的其他人都聚齐之后，你们就上路返回登陆的海滩。

A tremor nearly knocks you loose as you descend the treacherous spires. After several tense minutes, you finally descend to the streets. Andy sits on a glistening boulder, doing his best not to look shaken. "Well. That's another half a dozen rolls of film gone," he sighs with a melancholy air. "At least we're back in one piece. Well, mostly," he laughs, favoring his bandaged arm.
After the rest of your group are gathered, you make your way back to the beach where you made landfall.

all_card.real_flavor: Parts of the frieze are worn smooth by the passage of time, but you eventually identify the shapes of mountains, clouds, mist. Within the mist, nightmarish shapes appear to be locked in some kind of struggle. Frightened creatures look up from below. Underneath it all, a cyclopean eye gazes intensely at an underground city deep below the surface. Heavy accenting depicts a roiling mist that fills the streets of the city. Each of the citizens reclines in a look of terrifying repose.

all_card.real_flavor: The downpour worsens. As the streets begin to flood, terrifying creatures emerge from the shadows: creatures that could only have come from R'lyeh.

一阵强烈的风卷起了克苏鲁松垂双腿旁的黑水。骇人的死神手上腿上闪亮起了绿色的咒印，他发出震耳欲聋的尖叫，震碎了玻璃，城市的地基都随之摇晃。安迪弓在一旁，喉咙里涌出一连串咒语，颤抖的手紧紧握着一件发光的神器。“起作用了！”露比叫道。
    又是一声怒吼。水面上传来开火的声音，是阿卡姆警方徒劳地想吸引他的注意力。你抬头发现古神正瞪着你，眼睛放出鲜亮的猩红色光芒。巨兽抬起了手，朝你头顶压来，要把你像虫子一样碾碎。

all_card.real_back_flavor:
A quickening gale stirs the black water at Cthulhu's sagging legs. As glowing green sigils alight on the awful dead god's arms and legs, he looses an ear-splitting roar that shatters windows and shakes the very foundations of the city. Hunched over nearby, Andy intones a string of guttural words, holding one shaking hand over a glowing artifact. "It's working!" Ruby shouts.
Another roar. The sound of gunfire echoes across the water as the Arkham police try in vain to draw his attention. You look up to see the ancient one himself staring down at you, his eyes glowing a vivid crimson. The behemoth raises one clawed hand overhead to crush you like an insect.

    [reaction]克苏鲁进入圣玛丽医院后：将你最多3个线索放到本地点。每以此方式放置一个线索，对本地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The raging fires threaten the hundreds of ailing patients in St. Mary's eastern ward. The few brave nurses and doctors who have not succumbed to the strange sleeping sickness work through the night to keep their patients safe.
all_card.real_back_text: St. Mary's Hospital cannot be fully flooded.
all_card.real_text:
St. Mary's Hospital cannot be fully flooded.
[reaction] After Cthulhu enters St. Mary's Hospital: Place up to 3 of your clues on this location. For each clue placed in this way, deal 1 damage to an enemy at this location. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 这个街区的众多基础设施很容易就成为了目标。燃烧的大楼在淹没的街道上投下跃动的影子。
all_card.flavor: 南区的祖宅已经化为齑粉。
all_card.name: 南区
all_card.text: [action]选择你弃牌堆的一张[[道具]]支援，将其加入你的手牌。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The neighborhood's dense infrastructure makes it an easy target. Burning buildings cast flickering shadows on the flooded streets.
all_card.real_flavor: The old family homes of Southside have been reduced to splinters.
all_card.real_text: [action] Choose an [[Item]] asset in your discard pile and add it to your hand. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_text:
作为进入西部屋顶的额外费用，你们必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。
    西部屋顶不能被淹没。
    北区、米斯卡塔尼克大学、圣玛丽医院与西部屋顶相互连接。
all_card.name: 西部屋顶
all_card.text:
西部屋顶不能被淹没，咒印不能放置在西部屋顶。
    北区、米斯卡塔尼克大学、圣玛丽医院与西部屋顶相互连接。
    你位于西部屋顶时，你可以攻击、躲避连接地点的敌人，如同你在其地点。
all_card.real_back_text:
As an additional cost to enter Western Rooftops, you must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
Western Rooftops cannot be flooded.
Northside, Miskatonic University, and St. Mary's Hospital are connected to Western Rooftops, and vice versa.
all_card.real_text:
Western Rooftops cannot be flooded and sigils cannot be placed on it.
Northside, Miskatonic University, and St. Mary's Hospital are connected to Western Rooftops, and vice versa.
While you are at Western Rooftops, you may fight and evade enemies at connecting locations as if you were at their location.

all_card.back_text:
作为进入东部屋顶的额外费用，你们必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。
    东部屋顶不能被淹没。
    东城区、河岸城、南区与东部屋顶相互连接。
all_card.name: 东部屋顶
all_card.text:
东部屋顶不能被淹没，咒印不能放置在东部屋顶。
    东城区、河岸城、南区与东部屋顶相互连接。
    你位于东部屋顶时，你可以攻击、躲避连接地点的敌人，如同你在其地点。
all_card.real_back_text:
As an additional cost to enter Eastern Rooftops, you must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
Eastern Rooftops cannot be flooded.
Easttown, Rivertown, and Southside are connected to Eastern Rooftops, and vice versa.
all_card.real_text:
Eastern Rooftops cannot be flooded and sigils cannot be placed on it.
Easttown, Rivertown, and Southside are connected to Eastern Rooftops, and vice versa.
While you are at Eastern Rooftops, you may fight and evade enemies at connecting locations as if you were at their location.

all_card.name: 克苏鲁
all_card.text:
克苏鲁版图上的每个[[克苏鲁]]敌人共享此敌人的[[特性]]、文本框和所在地点。
    庞大。巡逻(最近的可以被淹没的地点)。不能进行趁乱攻击。
all_card.real_text:
Each [[Cthulhu]] enemy on the Cthulhu Board shares this enemy's [[Traits]], text box, and location.
Massive. Patrol (nearest location that can be flooded). Cannot make attacks of opportunity.

all_card.name: 克苏鲁
all_card.text: 警戒。猎物 – [agility]最高。 X为克苏鲁之怒。不能受到伤害、不能被击败、不能被横置。 [reaction]你成功攻击或躲避本敌人后：将其翻至[[狂怒]]面。
all_card.real_text: Alert. Prey - Highest [agility]. X is Cthulhu's Rage. Cannot be damaged, defeated, or exhausted. [reaction] After you successfully fight or evade this enemy: Flip it to its [[Enraged]] side.

all_card.name: 克苏鲁
all_card.text: 警戒。猎物 – [agility]最高。 X为克苏鲁之怒。不能被横置。 强制 – 你将本敌人翻至本面后：抽取克苏鲁牌库顶的卡牌。 [reaction]你躲避本敌人后：对它造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Alert. Prey - Highest [agility]. X is Cthulhu's Rage. Cannot be exhausted. Forced - After you flip this enemy to this side: Draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck. [reaction] After you evade this enemy: Deal 1 damage to it.

all_card.name: 克苏鲁
all_card.text: 警戒。反击。猎物 – [willpower]最高。 X为克苏鲁之怒。不能受到伤害、不能被击败、不能被横置。 [reaction]你成功攻击或躲避本敌人后：将其翻至[[狂怒]]面。
all_card.real_text: Alert. Retaliate. Prey - Highest [willpower]. X is Cthulhu's Rage. Cannot be damaged, defeated, or exhausted. [reaction] After you successfully fight or evade this enemy: Flip it to its [[Enraged]] side.

all_card.name: 克苏鲁
all_card.text: 警戒。反击。猎物 – [willpower]最高。 X为克苏鲁之怒。不能被横置。 强制 – 你将本敌人翻至本面后：随机弃掉你1张手牌。 [reaction]你躲避本敌人后：对它造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Alert. Retaliate. Prey - Highest [willpower]. X is Cthulhu's Rage. Cannot be exhausted. Forced - After you flip this enemy to this side: Discard 1 card at random from your hand. [reaction] After you evade this enemy: Deal 1 damage to it.

all_card.name: 克苏鲁
all_card.text: 反击。猎物 – [combat]最高。 X为克苏鲁之怒。不能受到伤害、不能被击败、不能被横置。 [reaction]你成功攻击或躲避本敌人后：将其翻至[[狂怒]]面。
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. Prey - Highest [combat]. X is Cthulhu's Rage. Cannot be damaged, defeated, or exhausted. [reaction] After you successfully fight or evade this enemy: Flip it to its [[Enraged]] side.

all_card.name: 克苏鲁
all_card.text: 反击。猎物 – [combat]最高。 X为克苏鲁之怒。不能被横置。 强制 – 你将本敌人翻至本面后：在其上放置1个毁灭标记。 [reaction]你躲避本敌人后：对它造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. Prey - Highest [combat]. X is Cthulhu's Rage. Cannot be exhausted. Forced - After you flip this enemy to this side: Place 1 doom on it. [reaction] After you evade this enemy: Deal 1 damage to it.

all_card.name: 无情冲锋
all_card.text: 如果克苏鲁(陈腐之翼)在场上： 克苏鲁所在地点的每位调查员随机弃掉1张手牌。 如果克苏鲁(凶狠之面)在场上： 克苏鲁(凶狠之面)攻击克苏鲁所在地点[willpower]最高的调查员。如果未进行攻击，[willpower]最高的调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。该卡牌的效果不能被取消，且其失去涌动。 如果克苏鲁(邪恶之爪)在场上： 克苏鲁所在地点[combat]最高的调查员必须检定[combat](X)，其中X为克苏鲁之怒。如果该调查员检定失败，克苏鲁(邪恶之爪)攻击该调查员。
all_card.real_text: If Cthulhu (Hoary Wings) is in play: Each investigator at Cthulhu's location discards one card from hand at random. If Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) is in play: Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) attacks the investigator with the highest [willpower] at Chulhu's location. If no attack was made, the investigator with the highest [willpower] draws the top card of the encounter deck. That card's effects cannot be canceled and it loses surge. If Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) is in play: The investigator with the highest [combat] at Cthulhu's location must test [combat] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) attacks them.

all_card.name: 飓风之力
all_card.text: 如果克苏鲁(陈腐之翼)在场上： 额外结算克苏鲁的巡逻关键词一次。 如果克苏鲁(凶狠之面)在场上： 离克苏鲁最近的调查员必须检定[willpower](X)，其中X为克苏鲁之怒。如果该调查员检定失败，克苏鲁(凶狠之面)攻击该调查员。 如果克苏鲁(邪恶之爪)在场上： 选择一位克苏鲁所在地点的调查员检定[agility](X)，其中X为克苏鲁之怒。如果该调查员检定失败，则必须提升克苏鲁所在地点的淹没等级，或其受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: If Cthulhu (Hoary Wings) is in play: Resolve Cthulhu's patrol keyword an additional time. If Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) is in play: The nearest investigator to Cthulhu must test [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If that investigator fails, Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) attacks them. If Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) is in play: Choose an investigator at Cthulhu's location to test [agility] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If that investigator fails, they must either increase the flood level of Cthulhu's location, or take 1 damage or 1 horror.

all_card.name: 骇人狂风
all_card.text: 如果克苏鲁(陈腐之翼)在场上： 克苏鲁所在地点的每位调查员随机弃掉1张手牌。额外结算克苏鲁的巡逻关键词一次。 如果克苏鲁(凶狠之面)在场上： [willpower]最高的调查员检定[willpower](X)，其中X为克苏鲁之怒。如果该调查员检定失败，则其必须受到1点恐惧，或选择并弃掉其控制的一张非剧情支援。 如果克苏鲁(邪恶之爪)在场上： 如果克苏鲁本轮没有通过其巡逻关键词移动，克苏鲁(邪恶之爪)攻击其所在地点的每位调查员。
all_card.real_text: If Cthulhu (Hoary Wings) is in play: Each investigator at Cthulhu's location discards 1 card at random from hand. Resolve Cthulhu's patrol keyword an additional time. If Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) is in play: The investigator with the highest [willpower] tests [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, they must either take 1 horror, or choose and discard a non-story asset they control. If Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) is in play: If Cthulhu did not move via his patrol keyword this round, Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) attacks each investigator at its location.

all_card.name: 惊骇目光
all_card.text: 如果克苏鲁(陈腐之翼)在场上： [agility]最高的调查员检定[agility](X)，其中X为克苏鲁之怒。如果该调查员检定失败，其受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。 如果克苏鲁(凶狠之面)在场上： 克苏鲁所在地点的每位调查员失去2资源。 如果克苏鲁(邪恶之爪)在场上： 调查员必须共同决定： – 每位调查员在其下个回合期间失去1个行动。 – 克苏鲁(邪恶之爪)攻击其所在地点的每位调查员。 – 每位调查员受到1点直接恐惧。
all_card.real_text: If Cthulhu (Hoary Wings) is in play: The investigator with the highest [agility] tests [agility] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, they take 1 damage or 1 horror. If Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) is in play: Each investigator at Cthulhu's location loses 2 resources. If Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) is in play: The investigators must decide, as a group: - Each investigator loses 1 action during their next turn. - Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) attacks each investigator at its location. - Each investigator takes 1 direct horror.

all_card.name: 毁灭殆尽
all_card.text: 在离克苏鲁最近的[[屋顶]]地点放置1个伤害标记，作为毁坏标记。如果该地点上有至少2个毁坏标记，该地点的每位调查员阵亡，弃掉该地点的每个敌人。然后，将该地点和本卡牌从游戏中移除。 否则，将本卡牌和克苏鲁弃牌堆一起混洗回克苏鲁牌库。
all_card.real_text: Place 1 damage token on the [[Rooftop]] location nearest to Cthulhu, as a ruin token. If there are 2 or more ruin tokens on that location,each investigator is killed and each enemy at that location is discarded. Then, remove that location and this card from the game. Otherwise, shuffle this card into the Cthulhu deck along with the Cthulhu discard pile.

all_card.name: 第五只眼
all_card.text: 将本卡牌放置入场，位于密谋牌库旁。 强制 – 在调查阶段结束时：在克苏鲁版图上一个没有毁灭标记的敌人上放置1个毁灭标记，并弃掉本卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Put this card into play next to the agenda deck. Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Place 1 doom on an enemy on the Cthulhu Board with no doom on it and discard this card.

all_card.name: 地震践踏
all_card.text:
如果克苏鲁所在地点没有调查员，弃掉本卡牌并抽取克苏鲁牌库顶的卡牌。
    否则，克苏鲁所在地点的每位调查员检定[agility]或[willpower](X)，其中X为克苏鲁之怒。如果调查员检定失败，则该调查员必须受到1点伤害/恐惧，或随机弃掉其1张手牌。
all_card.real_text:
If there are no investigators at Cthulhu's location, discard this card and draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck.
Otherwise, each investigator at Cthulhu's location tests [agility] or [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, they must either take 1 damage/horror, or discard 1 card from their hand at random.

all_card.name: 惊悚呼唤
all_card.text:
如果克苏鲁所在地点没有调查员，弃掉本卡牌并抽取克苏鲁牌库顶的卡牌。
    否则，克苏鲁所在地点的每位调查员检定[willpower](X)，其中X为克苏鲁之怒。如果有调查员检定失败，从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌，直到弃掉一个敌人，将其生成在克苏鲁所在地点。
all_card.real_text:
If there are no investigators at Cthulhu's location, discard this card and draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck.
Otherwise, each investigator at Cthulhu's location tests [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If 1 or more investigators fail, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded and spawn it at Cthulhu's location.

all_card.name: 心灵呵斥
all_card.text:
如果胜利区中没有[[克苏鲁]]敌人，弃掉本卡牌并抽取克苏鲁牌库顶的卡牌。
    否则，选择一位调查员检定[willpower](X)，其中X为克苏鲁之怒。如果调查员检定失败，选择胜利区中一个[[克苏鲁]]敌人，将其返回克苏鲁版图，[[狂怒]]面朝上。
all_card.real_text:
If there are no [[Cthulhu]] enemies in the victory display, discard this card and draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck.
Otherwise, choose an investigator to test [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, choose a [[Cthulhu]] enemy in the victory display and return it to the Cthulhu board, [[Enraged]] side faceup.

all_card.name: 潮起
all_card.text:
降低克苏鲁所在地点的淹没等级，选择另一个能提升淹没等级的地点(如可能，选择有调查员的地点)。提升所选地点的淹没等级。
    位于完全淹没的地点的每位调查员检定[agility](X)，其中X为克苏鲁之怒。如果该调查员检定失败，则其必须受到1点伤害，或弃掉其控制的一张非剧情支援。
all_card.real_text:
Decrease the flood level of Cthulhu's location and choose another location (with an investigator, if able) that can have its flood level increased. Increase the flood level of the chosen location.
Each investigator at a fully flooded location tests [agility] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, they must either take 1 damage or discard a non-story asset they control.

all_card.name: 希望破灭
all_card.text: 将本卡牌放置入场，位于密谋牌库旁。查找混乱袋和所有场上和场外区域，找出[elder_sign]标记并将其封印在本卡牌上。(如果你不能这么做，改为查找混乱袋，找出最高正值的数字标记，并将其封印在本卡牌上) 强制 – 在场景推进时：弃掉本卡牌(释放此处封印的标记)。
all_card.real_text: Put this card into play next to the agenda deck. Search the chaos bag and all in- and out-of-play areas for the [elder_sign] token and seal it on this card. (If you cannot, search the chaos bag for the numbered token with the highest positive value and seal it on this card instead.) Forced - When the act advances: Discard this card (release the token sealed here).

all_card.flavor: 阿卡姆将永远不复以往。远古生物将树木、房屋和载具抛飞，仿佛它们都是纸糊的一样。
all_card.name: 损毁
all_card.text: 显现 – 检定[agility](X)，其中X为克苏鲁之怒。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: Arkham will never be the same. The ancient creature tosses trees, houses, and vehicles aside as if they were made of paper.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If you fail, take 2 damage.

all_card.name: 伊库勒刻特之眼
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 – 检定[willpower](X)，其中X为克苏鲁之怒。如果你检定失败，受到1点直接恐惧并随机弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_flavor: [tdc_rune_m] · [tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_k] · [tdc_rune_h][tdc_rune_x][tdc_rune_n] · [tdc_rune_g][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_b] · [tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_h] · [tdc_rune_z][tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_e] · [tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_h][tdc_rune_k]
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If you fail, take 1 direct horror and discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.name: 肥硕身躯
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 – 你必须决定(选择一项)： – 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致密谋推进。 – 提升你所在地点的淹没等级。 – 每位调查员受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the agenda to advance. - Increase the flood level of your location. - Each investigator takes 1 damage or 1 horror.

all_card.flavor: [tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_n][tdc_rune_j][tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_x] · [tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_h] · [tdc_rune_g][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_p][tdc_rune_p] · [tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_k] · [tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_l] · [tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_x] · [tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_u][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_q][tdc_rune_k]
all_card.name: 阿卡姆遇袭
all_card.text: 显现 – 每位调查员检定[willpower](X)，其中X为克苏鲁之怒。如果有调查员检定失败，抽取克苏鲁牌库顶的卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: [tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_n][tdc_rune_j][tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_x] · [tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_h] · [tdc_rune_g][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_p][tdc_rune_p] · [tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_k] · [tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_l] · [tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_x] · [tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_u][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_q][tdc_rune_k]
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Each investigator tests [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If 1 or more investigators fail, draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck.

all_card.name: 偷渡寄生虫
all_card.text: 冷漠。巡逻(其他没有毁灭标记的最近的敌人)。 强制 – 在敌军阶段结束时：在本地点的另一个非[[精英]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。然后，弃掉偷渡寄生虫。
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest other enemy with no doom on it ). Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Place 1 doom on another non-[[Elite]] enemy at this location. Then, discard Stowaway Drone.

all_card.name: 被感染了！
all_card.text: 显现 – 将“被感染了！”放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。每位调查员仅限1张。 强制 – 你在有另一位调查员或[[偷渡虫]]敌人的地点结束回合后：在“被感染了！”上放置1个毁灭标记。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害。如果你检定成功，弃掉“被感染了！”。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Infected! into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - After you end your turn at a location with another investigator or a [[Stowaway]] enemy: Place 1 doom on Infected! [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage. If you succeed, discard Infected!

all_card.flavor:
“······旧日支配者塑造了其中敏感之人的梦境，以此向他们言说。”
    <cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《克苏鲁的呼唤》</cite>
all_card.name: 朝圣者祭司
all_card.text: 强制 – 朝圣者祭司攻击后：在其上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_flavor: "…the Great Old Ones spoke to the sensitive among them by moulding their dreams." - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Call of Cthulhu"
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Pilgrim Acolyte attacks: Place 1 doom on it.

all_card.name: 朝圣者领袖
all_card.text: 冷漠。 生成 – 任意地点(如可能，生成在无人地点)。 朝圣者领袖为重整状态时，每个其他[[异教徒]]敌人得到+2攻击值，并获得猎手和无情。
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Spawn - Any location (empty, if able). While Pilgrim Leader is ready, each other [[Cultist]] enemy gets +2 fight and gains hunter and relentless.

all_card.name: 骇人的星之眷族
all_card.text: 猎手。庞大。无情。 猎物 – [combat]最高。 强制 – 你攻击或躲避本敌人时，在你揭示了[elder_thing]标记时：治愈其1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Massive. Relentless. Prey - Highest [combat]. Forced - When you reveal an [elder_thing] token while fighting or evading this enemy: Heal 1 damage from it.

all_card.name: 感染的星之眷族
all_card.text: 猎手。无情。猎物 – [agility]最高。 强制 – 本敌人第一次将要被击败：治愈其所有伤害并将其重整。 强制 – 你攻击或躲避感染的星之眷族时，在你揭示了[elder_thing]标记时：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Relentless. Prey - Highest [agility]. Forced - The first time this enemy would be defeated: Heal all damage from it and ready it. Forced - When you reveal an [elder_thing] token while fighting or evading Infected Star Spawn: Take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 珊瑚星之眷族
all_card.text: 猎手。无情。猎物 – [willpower]最高。 珊瑚星之眷族上有伤害时，它获得警戒和反击。 强制 – 你攻击或躲避本敌人时，在你揭示了[elder_thing]标记时：受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Relentless. Prey - Highest [willpower]. While Coral Star Spawn has damage on it, it gains alert and retaliate. Forced - When you reveal an [elder_thing] token while fighting or evading this enemy: Take 1 damage.

all_card.name: 星之眷族观测者
all_card.text: 冷漠。猎手。 猎物 – [intellect]最高。 强制 – 你调查星之眷族观测者所在地点时，在你揭示了[elder_thing]标记时：它与你交战并立即进行一次攻击。
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Hunter. Prey - Highest [intellect]. Forced - When you reveal an [elder_thing] token while investigating Star Spawn Observer's location: It engages you and makes an immediate attack.

all_card.name: 深海之眼
all_card.text: 显现 – 将深海之眼放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。每位调查员仅限1张。 技能检定期间你揭示的每个 [cultist]和[tablet]标记改为视为如同[elder_thing]标记。 [aciton]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉深海之眼。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Eye of the Deep into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Treat each [cultist] and [tablet] token you reveal during a skill test as if it were an [elder_thing] token, instead. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Eye of the Deep.

all_card.name: 阴险伪装
all_card.text: 显现 – 如果场上没有[[怪物]]敌人，阴险伪装获得涌动。否则，检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定失败，最近的[[怪物]]敌人攻击你(无论其当前地点是否是你的地点)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Monster]] enemies in play, Cunning Mimicry gains surge. Otherwise, test [intellect] (3). If you fail, the nearest [[Monster]] enemy attacks you (regardless of its current location).

all_card.name: 古老迷雾
all_card.text: 显现 – 将古老迷雾附属到最近且没有附属古老迷雾的地点。 位于附属地点的每位调查员得到–1[willpower]、–1[intellect]、–1[combat]、–1[agility]。 强制 – 所附属地点的调查员技能检定成功且超过难度至少2点后：弃掉古老迷雾。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Elder Mist to the nearest location without Elder Mist attached. Each investigator at attached location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect],-1 [combat], and -1 [agility]. Forced - After an investigator at attached location succeeds at a skill test by 2 or more: Discard Elder Mist.

all_card.name: 锈蚀之雾
all_card.text: 显现 – 检定[intellect]或[combat](4)。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，改为对你的调查员和你控制的每个有生命值的[[盟友]]及[[道具]]支援各造成1点直接伤害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] or [combat] (4). If you fail, take 1 damage. If you fail by 3 or more, instead deal 1 direct damage to your investigator and each [[Ally]] and [[Item]] asset you control with health.

all_card.name: 伏特鳗
all_card.text: 猎手。 猎物 – 线索最多。 伏特鳗在敌军阶段期间移动时，完全淹没的地点视作相互连接。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Prey - Most clues. While Voltaic Eel is moving during the enemy phase, each fully flooded location is considered to be connected to one another.

all_card.name: 梦境迁移
all_card.text: 显现 – 如果场上没有敌人，梦境迁移获得涌动。否则，检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，你必须选择一项： – 最近的敌人移动到你的地点并立即进行一次攻击。 – 抽取遭遇弃牌堆最顶部的敌人。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no enemies in play, Dreaming Migration gains surge. Otherwise, test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must choose one: - The nearest enemy moves to your location and makes an immediate attack. - Draw the topmost enemy in the encounter discard pile.

all_card.name: 海底追猎
all_card.text: 显现 – 检定[agility](3)。如果你所在地点完全淹没，本次检定难度+2。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害并提升最近的符合条件的地点的淹没等级。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). This test gets +2 difficulty if your location is fully flooded. If you fail, take 1 damage and increase the flood level of the nearest eligible location.

all_card.name: 致命洪流
all_card.text: 显现 – 如果你所在地点未淹没，致命洪流获得涌动。否则，你必须选择： – 检定[agility](4)以游到安全的地点。如果你检定成功，移动到一个连接地方。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。 – 检定[combat](4)以原地站稳。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害，并弃掉1个你控制的至少占用1个槽位的支援。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If your location is unflooded, Deadly Torrent gains surge. Otherwise, you must choose: - Test [agility] (4) to swim to safety. If you succeed, move to a connecting location. If you fail, take 1 damage and 1 horror. - Test [combat] (4) to stand your ground. If you fail, take 1 damage and discard 1 asset you control that takes up 1 or more slots.

all_card.flavor:
“我一想到深海就忍不住发抖，因为此时此刻可能就有无名之物在粘滑的海床上匍匐挣扎······”
    <cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《达贡》</cite>
all_card.name: 水中某物
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 – 提升最近的符合条件的地点的淹没等级。
all_card.real_flavor: "I cannot think of the deep sea without shuddering at the nameless things that may at this very moment be crawling and floundering on its slimy bed..." - H.P. Lovecraft, "Dagon"
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Increase the flood level of the nearest eligible location.

all_card.name: 不祥静寂
all_card.text: 显现 – 将不祥静寂放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。 作为打出卡牌的额外费用，你必须花费1资源或受到1点恐惧。 [action]：检定[agility](3)。如果你所在地点未淹没，本次检定自动成功。如果你检定成功，弃掉不祥静寂。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Ominous Silence into play in your threat area. As an additional cost to play a card, you must either spend 1 resource or take 1 horror. [action]: Test [agility] (3). If your location is not flooded, this test automatically succeeds. If you succeed, discard Ominous Silence.

all_card.flavor:
“在入睡之后，他做了一个从未做过的怪梦。他梦见了由雄伟巨石和顶天立柱组成的巍峨城市······”
    <cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《克苏鲁的呼唤》</cite>
all_card.name: 恢弘楼宇
all_card.text: 显现 – 检定[intellect](X)，其中X为你所在地点的印刷隐藏值。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，选择并弃掉你1张手牌(最多弃掉3张)。
all_card.real_flavor: "He had an unprecedented dream of great Cyclopean cities of titan blocks and sky-flung monoliths..." - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Call of Cthulhu"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (X), where X is your location's printed shroud. For each point you fail by, choose and discard 1 card from your hand (to a maximum of 3).

all_card.flavor:
“他说自己所见的梦中之地的几何构造全然反常，有违规律，令人厌恶地想到了另外的界域和维度。”
    <cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《克苏鲁的呼唤》</cite>
all_card.name: 石楼坍圮
all_card.text: 显现 – 检定[agility](X)，其中X为你所在地点的印刷隐藏值。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: "He said that the geometry of the dream-place he saw was abnormal, non-Euclidean, and loathsomely redolent of spheres and dimensions apart from ours." - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Call of Cthulhu"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (X), where X is your location's printed shroud. If you fail, take 2 damage.

all_card.name: “克苏鲁弗坦！”
all_card.text: 显现 – 检定[combat](3)。如果你检定失败，你必须受到2点恐惧，或对你所在地点的一位调查员造成1点直接伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: [tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_f] · [tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_l] · [tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_x][tdc_rune_n][tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_k] · [tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_p][tdc_rune_h][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_b] · [tdc_rune_z][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_z] · [tdc_rune_u][tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_n][tdc_rune_p][tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_n] · [tdc_rune_g][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_l] · [tdc_rune_z][tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_e]
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [combat] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 horror or deal 1 direct damage to an investigator at your location.

all_card.flavor:
“我已经看到了宇宙不得不隐藏的全部恐怖，从此之后春季的天空与夏季的花朵对我来说都成了毒药。”
    <cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《克苏鲁的呼唤》</cite>
all_card.name: 压迫影响
all_card.text: 显现 – 检定[willpower](X)，其中X为你所在地点的印刷隐藏值。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: "I have looked upon all the universe has to hold of horror, and even the skies of spring and flowers of summer must ever afterward be poison to me." - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Call of Cthulhu"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is your location's printed shroud. If you fail, take 2 horror.

all_card.name: 统御主宰
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 – 你必须决定(选择一项)： – 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致当前密谋推进。 – 每位调查员弃掉2张手牌。 – 每位调查员失去1个行动。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. - Each investigator discards 2 cards from their hand. - Each investigator loses 1 action.

all_card.name: 穷途异魔
all_card.text: 猎手。无情。 生成 – 任意连接地点(如可能，生成在无人地点)。 强制 – 每轮[elder_thing]标记第一次从混乱袋被揭示：重整穷途异魔并结算其猎手关键词(但它不攻击)。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Relentless. Spawn - Any connecting location (empty, if able). Forced - The first time each round an [elder_thing] token is revealed from the chaos bag: Ready The Inescapable and resolve its hunter keyword (it does not attack).

all_card.name: 还在身后
all_card.text: 显现 – 检定[agility](2)。胜利区中每有1张还在身后，本次检定难度+1。如果你检定失败且穷途异魔······ – ······在场上，它移动(每次一个地点)，直到它移动到你的地点并与你交战。 – ······不在场上，查找所有的场上和场外区域，找出穷途异魔并将其抽取。将还在身后加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each copy of Still Behind You in the victory display. If you fail and The Inescapable... - ...is in play, it moves, one location at a time, to your location and engages you. - ...is not in play, search all in- and out-of-play areas for The Inescapable and draw it. Add Still Behind You in the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 一个完美适应于漆黑深海的猎手。
all_card.name: 深潜者奴仆
all_card.text: 强制 – 深潜者奴仆与你交战后：随机弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_flavor: A hunter perfectly adapted to the lightless deep.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Deep One Thrall engages you: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.name: 古老深潜者
all_card.text: 猎手。反击。 每个其他[[深潜者]]敌人获得无情。 强制 – 古老深潜者与你交战后：治愈场上其他每个[[深潜者]]敌人1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Each other [[Deep One]] enemy gains relentless. Forced - After Elder Deep One engages you: Heal 1 damage from each other [[Deep One]] enemy in play.

all_card.flavor: “小心点。我们可不知道阴影里潜伏着什么。”
all_card.name: 深潜者埋伏
all_card.text: 显现 – 将深潜者埋伏放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。每位调查员仅限1张。 强制 – [[深潜者]]敌人与你交战后：它攻击你。然后，弃掉深潜者埋伏。
all_card.real_flavor: "Be careful out there. We have no idea what's lurking in the shadows."
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Deep One Ambush into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - After a [[Deep One]] enemy engages you: It attacks you. Then, discard Deep One Ambush.

all_card.flavor: [tdc_rune_g][tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_z][tdc_rune_x] · [tdc_rune_h][tdc_rune_x][tdc_rune_n] · [tdc_rune_z][tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_o] · [tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_f] · [tdc_rune_h][tdc_rune_x][tdc_rune_n][tdc_rune_s] · [tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_p][tdc_rune_p] · [tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_z]
all_card.name: 折磨幻象
all_card.text: 显现 – 检定[willpower](3)。如果你的手牌不多于3，本次检定难度+2。如果你检定失败，受到1点直接恐惧并随机弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_flavor: [tdc_rune_g][tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_z][tdc_rune_x] · [tdc_rune_h][tdc_rune_x][tdc_rune_n] · [tdc_rune_z][tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_o] · [tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_f] · [tdc_rune_h][tdc_rune_x][tdc_rune_n][tdc_rune_s] · [tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_p][tdc_rune_p] · [tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_z]
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). This test gets +2 difficulty if you have 3 or fewer cards in your hand. If you fail, take 1 direct horror and discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.name: 拖入黑暗
all_card.text: 显现 – 将拖入黑暗放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。每位调查员仅限1张。 你的手牌上限减少3张(最少减至1张)。 强制 – 在你的回合结束时，如果你没有手牌：弃掉拖入黑暗。

all_card.back_flavor: 父亲死后，玛利翁就从纳拉甘西特湾搬到了阿卡姆。她和朋友安娜丽丝·泰勒一同买了条船，两个人就在城里的渔业社区安下了新家。在一个海上的风暴之夜，安娜丽丝被奇怪的类鱼生物拖下了船。玛利翁跳进水里，把安娜丽丝拉出怪物的巨口——这也让玛利翁失去了右手。打那时起，她就时刻警惕大西洋的波涛，还有底下深处隐藏的古怪生物。

all_card.real_back_flavor: After her father died, Marion moved to Arkham from Narragansett Bay. She purchased a boat with her friend, Annalise Taylor, and the two found a new home among the city's fishing community. One stormy night at sea, Annalise was pulled overboard by a strange fish-like creature. Marion leapt into the water and pulled Annalise from the creature's jaws - costing Marion her right arm. Since then, she keeps a weather eye on the choppy waters of the Atlantic and the strange creatures that hide in its depths.

all_card.back_flavor: 身为南方移民的卢修斯在纽约长大，他笔下的诗句如梦如幻，在哈莱姆的知识分子、艺术家和音乐人中颇有名气。但同侪们不知道，卢修斯笔下朦胧的水底城市，并非取材于纽约，而是他失踪的伴侣鲁迪的梦魇。鲁迪失踪前，提到过阿卡姆还有一伙梦中人也见过同样不安的幻象。现在，卢修斯一边在米大担任客座讲师，一边寻找自己失去的爱人，或许还有他那些可怕梦境的源头……

all_card.real_back_flavor: A Southern transplant raised in New York, Lucius has made quite a name for himself writing dreamy poetry alongside the intellectuals, artists, and musicians of Harlem. What his contemporaries don't know is that the hazy underwater city Lucius describes is inspired not by New York, but by the nightmarish dreams of his missing partner, Rudi. Before he disappeared, Rudi spoke of a cabal of fellow dreamers in Arkham who shared these unsettling visions. Now, Lucius has taken on the role of guest lecturer at Miskatonic University as he searches for his lost lover, and perhaps the source of his own horrifying dreams...

all_card.back_flavor: 手捏数学和心理学两门学位的阿加莎·克雷恩，向来重视循证科学。她年轻的时候就不爱听鬼故事，但证据越来越多，让阿加莎得出结论：阿卡姆历史上比比皆是的怪物和魔法传说背后，一定藏着什么确凿无疑的真相。如果这些都是真的，那肯定也遵循着一样的法则。她把这片全新领域的研究解释给任何愿意听下去的人——她的丈夫威尔伯就听过很多次——她称之为“通灵学”。阿加莎期望通过实践出真知的科学方法，弥合神话与理性、玄学与科学之间的鸿沟。

all_card.real_back_flavor: With degrees in Mathematics and Psychology, Agatha Crane has always placed a premium on evidence-based science. In her youth, she cared little for ghost stories, but mounting evidence has led Agatha to conclude that there is an unmistakable truth to the tales of monsters and magic that permeate Arkham's history. If these things are real, then they must obey consistent rules. As she will explain to anyone who listens for long enough - and as her husband Wilbur has heard many times - this new field of study is called "parapsychology." With tried-and-true scientific methods, Agatha seeks to bridge the gap between the mystic and the rational, between occultism and science.

all_card.back_flavor: 手捏数学和心理学两门学位的阿加莎·克雷恩，向来重视循证科学。她年轻的时候就不爱听鬼故事，但证据越来越多，让阿加莎得出结论：阿卡姆历史上比比皆是的怪物和魔法传说背后，一定藏着什么确凿无疑的真相。如果这些都是真的，那肯定也遵循着一样的法则。她把这片全新领域的研究解释给任何愿意听下去的人——她的丈夫威尔伯就听过很多次——她称之为“通灵学”。阿加莎期望通过实践出真知的科学方法，弥合神话与理性、玄学与科学之间的鸿沟。

all_card.real_back_flavor: With degrees in Mathematics and Psychology, Agatha Crane has always placed a premium on evidence-based science. In her youth, she cared little for ghost stories, but mounting evidence has led Agatha to conclude that there is an unmistakable truth to the tales of monsters and magic that permeate Arkham's history. If these things are real, then they must obey consistent rules. As she will explain to anyone who listens for long enough - and as her husband Wilbur has heard many times - this new field of study is called "parapsychology." With tried-and-true scientific methods, Agatha seeks to bridge the gap between the mystic and the rational, between occultism and science.

all_card.back_flavor: 迈克尔·麦克格林话不多。他也不需要多说，“快手”路易更擅长说话。这俩人是欧巴尼恩最好的打手，确保帮派在整个阿卡姆都大名鼎鼎……直到那天晚上，河里的东西把路易拖了下去，在水下撕成了碎片。迈克尔本以为，要是他把事情告诉老板，他们肯定会觉得他是疯了。但事实更糟：他们不仅相信，还让他别声张。但迈克尔不会让自己的伙伴白死，也不会放过他那晚看到的东西。他还是话不多。现在他会让他的枪说话。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Michael McGlen was a man of few words. He didn't need to talk much; he had Fast Louis for that. The two of them were O'Bannion's best soldiers, making sure the gang was respected throughout Arkham... until the night the thing in the river dragged Louis off the dock to tear him to pieces beneath the water. Michael thought his bosses would call him crazy when he told them what happened, but the truth was worse: they told him they believed him and to let the matter lie. But Michael can't just let the death of his partner, or the things he saw that night, go unpunished. He's still a man of few words. Now he'll let his gun do the talking.

all_card.real_back_flavor: As a young girl, Gloria was haunted by terrible visions. After years of visiting doctors, she learned to exorcise these visions by writing stories. Her weird and disturbing fiction somehow spoke to the public and made her a bestselling writer. But while visiting Arkham, she had the most powerful vision she's ever experienced. The sky tore open, a monstrous form pouring out of the very air itself. Gloria knew, somehow, that this vision was real, and that it would come to pass unless she did something about it.

all_card.real_back_flavor: After spending a month in jail at the age of 19, George Barnaby felt compelled to become a lawyer. He found great success and notoriety in his career, and as retirement approached he made plans to sail around the world with his wife Maria. On the eve of his retirement, however, his home was attacked and Maria was murdered by cultists. Now, with a lifetime of wealth and contacts at his back, George has tracked the culprits to the city of Arkham, vowing to bring them to justice for their hideous crimes.

all_card.back_text:
每个[[异教徒]]敌人为仪式而自决。弃掉场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人，并将他们的所有毁灭标记移动到阿撒托斯。 调查员队长必须查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张魔鬼的笛声并将其抽取。

检查剧本日志。如果“遗留记忆”下方列有吉尔曼的日记，你可以找到出路。否则，你绝望地迷路了；每位调查员必须移动到其左方的地点，或将其地点向左移动一次(在其原来的位置放置一个虚空格子)。地点不能通过本效果移动超过一次。
all_card.flavor:

Azathoth! The end has come!"

Check Campaign Log. If Gilman's Journal is listed under "Mementos Discovered," you are able to find you way. Otherwise, you become hopelessly lost; each investigator must either move to the location to his or her left, or move the placement of his or her location once to the left (placing an empty space in the spot it previously occupied). A location cannot move more than once via this effect.
all_card.real_flavor:
ONE END IS ANOTHER BEGINNING.
CHANGE IS THE ONLY CONSTANT.
YOUR ULTIMATE FATE IS AT HAND.

每个[[异教徒]]敌人为仪式而自决。弃掉场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人，并将他们的所有毁灭标记移动到阿撒托斯。 调查员队长必须查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张魔鬼的笛声并将其抽取。
在这超越时间之外的遗忘之地，一切都不复原样。云雾在你周围飞舞翻腾。远处传来的笑声嘲笑着你，黑色星云里出现了一道熟悉的鬼魂——一个早已死去的人。
检查剧本日志。如果“遗留记忆”下方列有磨损的十字架，鬼魂认得你从沃尔特·吉尔曼房间偷来的十字架，缓缓后退，遁入彼端的黑暗之中。 否则，鬼魂攻击你；每位调查员必须检定[willpower](4)。每位检定失败的调查员受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.flavor: ……它就是无边无际的恶魔之王阿撒托斯，无人胆敢大声说出它的名讳。在超越时间之外、凡人无法想象的无光之室，它饥饿地啃噬着，周围伴着沉闷而令人癫狂的邪恶鼓声、尖细而单调的诅咒笛声……<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 它在等待
all_card.text:
每个地点与其相邻的每个地点相互连接。

Each [[Cultist]] enemy commits ritual suicide. Discard each [[Cultist]] enemy in play and move all doom from them to Azathoth. The lead investigator must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Daemonic Piping and draw it.
In this oblivion outside time, nothing is as it should be. The mist dances and churns around you. Laughter mocks you from beyond, and out from the dark nebulae emerges a familiar wraith, a being which should be long dead.
Check Campaign Log. If Worn Crucifix is listed under "Mementos Discovered," the wraith recognizes the crucifix you stole from Walter Gilman's room and backs away slowly, slinking into the darkness beyond. Otherwise, the wraith attacks you; each investigator must test [willpower] (4). Each investigator who fails takes 1 damage and 1 horror.
all_card.real_flavor:
...the boundless daemon-sultan Azathoth, whose name no lips dare speak aloud, and who gnaws hungrily in inconceivable, unlighted chambers beyond time amidst the muffled, maddening beating of vile drums and the thin, monotonous whine of accursed flutes...
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances.

all_card.back_text:
每个[[异教徒]]敌人为仪式而自决。弃掉场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人，并将他们的所有毁灭标记移动到阿撒托斯。 调查员队长必须查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张魔鬼的笛声并将其抽取。 密谋牌库不复存在，但本场冒险没有结束。直到本场冒险结束，将要放到当前密谋上的毁灭标记，改为放到阿撒托斯上，且场上所有毁灭标记视为在阿撒托斯上。
你遇到另一伙阿撒托斯的崇拜者，一个无形的兜帽者带领着他们，将一盏古老的提灯高举过头。提灯黯淡的灰色光芒根本无法照亮这个国度的黑暗。不知为何，你觉得那幽灵很是熟悉；某种说不清的亲切感驱使着你前进。
检查剧本日志。如果“遗留记忆”下方列有玉米皮娃娃，那幽灵也认出了你。它好奇地盯着你看，周围一圈信徒停止了祈祷；移除阿撒托斯的1个毁灭标记。否则，那幽灵几乎没有注意到你，周围一圈祈祷者继续咏唱。
all_card.flavor: ……斜睨、狞笑着的夏塔克鸟飞快而无情地前进，幸灾乐祸地扇动着它那巨大而光滑的翅膀，飞向梦境都无法抵达的不洁深处……<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 最后的倒计时
all_card.text: 每个地点与其相邻的每个地点相互连接。 在本密谋推进时，不要移除敌人的毁灭标记。 (注意——在本密谋推进时，本场冒险不会结束，但世界末日即将到来。)
all_card.real_back_text:
Each [[Cultist]] enemy commits ritual suicide. Discard each [[Cultist]] enemy in play and move all doom from them to Azathoth. The lead investigator must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Daemonic Piping and draw it. There is no longer an agenda deck, but the scenario is not over. Until the end of the scenario, doom that would be placed on the current agenda is instead placed on Azathoth, and all doom in play is considered to be on Azathoth.
You come across another circle of Azathoth's worshippers, led by a hooded, shapeless form which holds an ancient lantern high above its head. The lantern's dim grey light scarcely pierces the realm's darkness. Somehow, the phantom is familiar to you; some vague sense of kinship drives you onward.
Check Campaign Log. If Corn Husk Doll is listed under "Mementos Discovered," the creature recognizes you, as well. It peers at you curiously, and the circle of prayer is silenced; remove 1 doom from Azathoth. Otherwise, the creature barely notices you, and the circle resumes its chanting.
all_card.real_flavor:
...that leering, tittering shantak coursed on impetuous and relentless, flapping its great slippery wings in malignant joy, and headed for those unhallowed pits whither no dreams reach... 
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it. Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances. (Beware - the scenario will not end when this agenda advances, but the doom of the world will be close at hand.)

all_card.back_flavor: 坐骑载着你穿过这座梦魇般的宫殿入口，随后你惊讶地发现宫殿内的所有房间宽广而空旷，一如其周围的虚空。这个入口彷佛通向另一个宇宙，与之前一样荒凉、广渺无际。
all_card.back_text: 将宇宙入口从游戏中移除。将每个虚空格子的卡牌洗入其所有者牌库，将场上除憎恶宫殿以外的所有地点洗入“宇宙”。(FAQ v1.7)位于这些地点的所有调查员被抛弃并阵亡。将这些地点的每个敌人与遭遇牌库顶的5张卡牌一同混洗，放到遭遇牌库顶。 拿取放在一边的旧日支配者皇廷和“宇宙”顶上的2张卡牌，将其混洗至无法分辨。然后，将这3张卡牌与虚空格子一同放置入场，如剧本手册中“场景2的地点摆放位置”所示。 按玩家顺序，每位调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。
all_card.flavor: 你从进入空中那如同巨口一般的无边裂口以来，已经飞行了一段不可思议的距离，但你离阿撒托斯所在的黑色王座的路途仍然遥远。
all_card.name: 宇宙的呼唤
all_card.text: [action]花费X个线索：抽取“宇宙”顶上的X张卡牌。选择其中一张卡牌，按照其“宇宙 -”指示放置入场，并移动到其上。将其余卡牌洗回“宇宙”。 目标 - 只有憎恶宫殿的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。(注意——不位于该处的所有调查员将会阵亡。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your steed carries you through the entryway of the nightmarish palace, and you are surprised to find the halls inside to be as vast and cavernous as the empty space surrounding it. It is as though the doorway was but the threshold of another universe, as desolate and boundless as the last.
all_card.real_back_text:
Remove Cosmic Ingress from the game. Shuffle each empty space into its owner's deck and each location in play other than Hideous Palace into the Cosmos. Each investigator at those locations is left behind and is killed. Each enemy at those locations is shuffled into the top 5 cards of the encounter deck.
Take the set-aside Court of the Great Old Ones and the top 2 cards of the Cosmos, and shuffle them so you cannot tell which is which. Then, put them into play along with empty space, as depicted in "Location Placement for Act 2" in the Campaign Guide.
In player order, each investigator draws the top card of the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: From the horizonless breach in the gaping maw of the sky, you have traveled an impossible distance, and yet you are still many leagues from the nighted throne where Azathoth stirs.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos. Objective - Only investigators at Hideous Palace may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not there will be killed.)

all_card.back_flavor: 长有翅膀的生物落在一条黑石步道上，蜿蜒地向倾斜虚空的无尽边界延伸开去。你需要对自己的坐骑多加鞭策鼓励，它才会继续前进。似乎连最可怕的野兽，也会害怕这个地方。然而，你仍然能听到恶魔之王身边盲目痴愚的吟诵、令人发狂的呜咽笛声、在你脑海中不停回响的单调鼓声……
all_card.back_text: 将憎恶宫殿从游戏中移除。将每个虚空格子的卡牌洗入其所有者牌库，将场上除旧日支配者皇廷以外的所有地点洗入“宇宙”。(FAQ v1.7)位于这些地点的所有调查员被抛弃并阵亡。将这些地点的每个敌人与遭遇牌库顶的5张卡牌一同混洗，放到遭遇牌库顶。 拿取放在一边的黑色王座和“宇宙”顶上的3张卡牌，将其混洗至无法分辨。然后，将这4张卡牌与虚空格子一同放置入场，如剧本手册中“场景3的地点摆放位置”所示。 按玩家顺序，每位调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。
all_card.flavor: 在寂静而又寒冷的虚空，你浑身骨骼剧烈地颤抖。没有光能够照进这些漆黑的房间。没有微风吹拂你的皮肤，也没有温度传递到你身上。这就是死亡的感觉，你神思古怪地想到。
all_card.name: 阿撒托斯的领域
all_card.text: [action]花费X个线索：抽取“宇宙”顶上的X张卡牌。选择其中一张卡牌，按照其“宇宙 -”指示放置入场，并移动到其上。将其余卡牌洗回“宇宙”。 目标 - 只有旧日支配者皇廷的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。(注意——不位于该处的所有调查员将会阵亡。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The winged creature lands on a winding walkway of black stone, extending into a ceaseless horizon of pitched void. It takes some prodding and encouragement before your steed continues onward. Even the most dreadful of beasts are terrified of this place, it seems. Yet still, you can hear the mindless chanting of those who dwell closest to the daemon-sultan, the maddening whining of the pipers, the monotonous drum-beats which thrum endlessly in your mind...
all_card.real_back_text:
Remove Hideous Palace from the game. Shuffle each empty space into its owner's deck and each location in play other than Court of the Great Old Ones into the Cosmos. Each investigator at those locations is left behind and is killed. Each enemy at those locations is shuffled into the top 5 cards of the encounter deck.
Take the set-aside The Black Throne and the top 3 cards of the Cosmos, and shuffle them so you cannot tell which is which. Then, put them into play along with empty space, as depicted in "Location Placement for Act 3" in the Campaign Guide.
In player order, each investigator draws the top card of the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: Your bones shiver violently with the silent, still cold of this empty place. No light penetrates these black halls. No warmth reaches you, no breeze touches your skin. This must be what death feels like, you think morbidly.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos. Objective - Only investigators at Court of the Great Old Ones may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not there will be killed.)

all_card.back_flavor:
你站在黑色王座前的悬崖，抬头凝视那名叫阿撒托斯的盲目而沉默的怪物。光是看见它，你的视觉就开始模糊，身体不住地颤抖。单调的笛声如今变得洪亮，让你浑身骨骼颤抖，几乎从身体内部使你呕吐出来。鲜血从你的眼睛与耳朵滴落。
要是阿撒托斯苏醒，它将吞噬曾经存在的所有世界。趁着还有机会，你必须现在动手。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 - 如果达成下方至少2种情况，你可以前往(→结局2)：你接受了自己的命运、“遗留记忆”下方列有催眠长笛、“遗留记忆”下方列有仪式道具。 - 如果达成下方至少2种情况，你可以前往(→结局3)：你拒绝了自己的命运、“遗留记忆”下方列有残影碎片、“遗留记忆”下方列有一缕鬼灵迷雾。 - 否则，(→结局4)。
all_card.flavor: 你现在已经很接近了。在你周围的虚空之中，你能感觉到历史长河的翻腾扭曲。这是万事万物的中心——混沌其本身的中心——你的目标与你最终的命运就在面前。
all_card.name: 必竟之事
all_card.text: [action]花费X个线索：抽取“宇宙”顶上的X张卡牌。选择其中一张卡牌，按照其“宇宙 -”指示放置入场，并移动到其上。将其余卡牌洗回“宇宙”。 目标 - 如果调查员队长位于黑色王座，且该地点上没有线索，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You stand on a precipice before the Black Throne and gaze up at the blind, voiceless monstronsity that is Azathoth. The mere sight of it causes your vision to blur and your body to shake uncontrollably. The monotonous piping is so loud now, it rattles your bones and nearly causes you to vomit from the force upon your insides. Blood drips from your eyes and your ears.
Should Azathoth awaken, it will devour every world that ever was. You must act now, before it is too late.
all_card.real_back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If at least two of the following are true, you may proceed to (→R2): You accepted your fate, Mesmirizing Flute is listed under "Mementos Discovered," and Ritual Components is listed under "Mementos Discovered." - If at least two of the following are true, you may proceed to (→R3): You rejected your fate, Scrap of Torn Shadow is listed under "Mementos Discovered," and Wisp of Spectral Mist is listed under "Mementos Discovered." - Otherwise, (→R4).
all_card.real_flavor: You are close now. You can feel the churning and twisting of aeons in the emptiness around you. Here, in the nucleus of all things - the very center of chaos itself - your objective, and your ultimate fate, lie at hand.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos. Objective - If the lead investigator is at The Black Throne and there are no clues on it, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: ……那头布满鳞片的怪物让骑在它背上的人心烦意乱；它急飞猛冲，划破最外层的边界，跨越最遥远的深渊；将星辰与现实领域抛在身后，如流星一般穿过空无一物的无形空间，向着那时间之外凡人无法想象的无光之室飞去……<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 宇宙入口
all_card.text: 强制 - 当一轮结束时：在宇宙入口上增加线索，直到其有3个线索。 每个[[虚空]]地点获得：“[action]：将本地点洗入‘宇宙’，将位于本地点的每位调查员和每个敌人移动到宇宙入口。”
all_card.real_back_flavor:
...that eldritch scaly monster bore its helpless rider; hurtling and shooting, cleaving the uttermost rim and spanning the outermost abysses; leaving behind the stars and the realms of matter, and darting meteor-like through stark formlessness toward those inconceivable, unlighted chambers beyond Time...
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the round: Add clues to Cosmic Ingress until it has 3 clues on it. Each [[Void]] location gains: "[action]: Shuffle this location into the Cosmos, moving each investigator and enemy that was at this location to Cosmic Ingress."

all_card.back_flavor: 群星嘲讽般舞动着，几乎每时每刻都在变换位置，组成象征毁灭的苍白符号。从未见过这个符号也不曾畏惧它的人，可能还会对它感到惊奇；就连以太形成的风呼啸时，也带着来自宇宙之外的缥缈黑暗与孤独。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>

all_card.name: 盲目舞者
all_card.text: 生成 - 最远的虚空格子。 猎手。 盲目舞者可以进入虚空格子，如同其进入一个地点。 强制 - 在盲目舞者通过其猎手关键词移动到一个虚空格子后：再次结算其猎手关键词。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Farthest empty space. Hunter. Mindless Dancer can enter empty space as if it were a location. Forced - After Mindless Dancer moves to an empty space via its hunter keyword: Resolve its hunter keyword again. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.name: 究极混沌
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定失败，将究极混沌附属到阿撒托斯上。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少2点，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，究极混沌获得涌动。不能被取消。 如果阿撒托斯上附属了3张究极混沌，将其全部弃掉，并在阿撒托斯上放置1个毁灭标记或阿撒托斯按玩家顺序攻击每位调查员。不能被取消。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, attach Ultimate Chaos to Azathoth. If you fail by 2 or more, take 1 damage and 1 horror. If you fail by 3 or more, Ultimate Chaos gains surge. Cannot be canceled. If there are 3 copies of Ultimate Chaos attached to Azathoth, discard them and either place 1 doom on Azathoth, or Azathoth attacks each investigator in player order. Cannot be canceled.

all_card.flavor: 遥古至今，一直有人担任着这些隐秘而又恐怖的力量的代理者或是信使……<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《女巫屋中之梦》</cite>

all_card.name: 阿撒托斯
all_card.text: 阿撒托斯懵懂不察而又无所不能。其免疫所有玩家的卡牌效果和调查员行动，并且不能被任何方式击败。 强制 - 如果阿撒托斯上有至少10个毁灭标记：盲目愚痴之神从它究级混沌虚空的王座升起，吞食宇宙。(→结局1)
all_card.real_text: Azathoth is oblivious and omnipotent. It is immune to all player card effects and investigator actions, and cannot be defeated by any means. Forced - If there is 10 or more doom on Azathoth: The Blind Idiot God rises from its throne in the ultimate void of chaos and devours the universe. (→R1)

all_card.back_flavor:
当你在这幢建筑探索时，你险些被几名秘社成员撞见，他们正在旁边的门廊上激烈地争论。这是一个获取信息的好机会，于是你隐藏行迹，偷听他们谈话。“桑福德先生下的命令是，完成灵怪陷阱，不惜一切代价。”其中一人笃定地说道，“要是这意味着我们得活在刀尖上，那我们也得接受。多数人的利益高于少数人的利益；这道理你懂的。”
另一名女成员重重地捶打墙壁：“不！流血牺牲不是我们的第一选择。一定还有别的法子。”
另一个人回答：“已经没时间了。”其他人纷纷应和。“很明显，你不想继续下去。把她带走。我们会让她亲眼见证，为了崇高的利益必须作出牺牲。”
“不！你不能这么做！”那女人喊道。听着她的尖叫声在走廊里回荡，你蹙起眉头。他们想干什么？
all_card.back_text: 弃掉遭遇牌库顶5张卡牌。按玩家顺序，每位调查员必须抽取1张以此方式弃掉的[[异教徒]]敌人。
all_card.flavor:
调整你的信念，
接受新的真理。
理应循规蹈矩。
不要偏离正道。
all_card.name: 教皇•V
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你击败一个[[银暮秘社]]敌人时：你匆忙之中遗漏了一些证据。将位于该地点的每个敌人的1个毁灭标记移动到当前密谋。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
As you explore the building, you almost wander into a heated debate between several members of the Lodge in a nearby hallway. Seeing an opportunity to learn more, you hide and eavesdrop on the conversation. "Mr. Sanford's orders are to complete the geist-trap at any cost," one of them says firmly. "If that means we must put lives in danger, so be it. The good of the many outweigh the good of the few; you know this."
Another member, a woman, pounds her fist on the wall."No! Our first resort cannot be to spill blood. There must be another way."
"There is no time," the other responds, and there is a murmur of agreement among the rest. "It is clear you do not have the will to proceed. Take her away. We will make her see for herself the sacrifices that must be made for the greater good."
"No! You can't do this!" the woman yells. You wince as her screams echo down the corridor. What are they planning to do?
all_card.real_back_text: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. In player order, each investigator must draw a [[Cultist]] enemy discarded in this way.
all_card.real_flavor:
ADAPT YOUR BELIEFS AND BE OPEN TO NEW TRUTHS.
YOU ARE EXPECTED TO CONFORM.
DO NOT STRAY FROM THE PATH.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you defeat a [[Silver Twilight]] enemy: You leave behind some evidence of the scuffle. Move 1 doom from each enemy at that location to the current agenda.

all_card.back_text: 显现 - 以崇高的利益替代场景和密谋牌库。将放在一边的响应召唤的怪兽生成在机关盒所在地点(如果机关盒不在场，则生成在任意一个[[圣堂]]地点)，并将机关盒从游戏中移除。
all_card.flavor: 秘社为达到自己的目的，将采用严酷的手段。要是你不赶快行动，定会发生流血事件。
all_card.name: 目的与手段

all_card.real_back_text: Revelation - Replace the act and agenda decks with The Greater Good. Spawn the set-aside Summoned Beast at the Puzzle Box's location (or any [[Sanctum]] location if the Puzzle Box is not in play) and remove the Puzzle Box from the game.
all_card.real_flavor: The Lodge will resort to drastic measures in order to achieve their goals. If you don’t act quickly, blood will surely be shed.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in a [[Sanctum]] location loses aloof. Forced - When you defeat a [[Silver Twilight]] enemy: You leave behind some evidence of the scuffle. Move 1 doom from each enemy at that location to the current agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: “噢，是你啊。”一名秘社成员走近你，你认出这是你之前与秘社会长卡尔·桑福德见面时，他身边的一名保镖。“很抱歉通知你，桑福德先生和其他秘社成员正忙于一件重要事务。建议你晚些时候再来一趟。”你告诉这名男子你来这一趟的目的很重要，并且你想为组织贡献一份力量，在那之后你希望和桑福德谈谈。他考虑了片刻，点点头：“好吧。我们正试图把一件仪器打开，它能帮助我们对你早前遇见的亡灵施以咒缚。要是你想帮忙，去找南森·威克谈谈吧。他就在藏书室楼上。”你向他道谢并转身离开，但他拉住你的胳膊，最后警告道：“你该知道，我们为了打开那件仪器，不惜付出一切代价。要是你不能承受后果，我再说一遍，建议你还是走吧。”
all_card.back_text: 如果藏书室不在场上，将其放置入场。 将放在一边的南森·威克敌人生成在藏书室，(引导大师)面朝上。将放在一边的机关盒剧情支援附属到他身上。
all_card.flavor: 你来到了秘社位于法兰西山的庄园，看你所收集的证据是否能在这里拼凑完整。或许你还能跟秘社的会长再谈谈。但在到达这幢庄园后，你开始怀疑这是在考验你的忠诚。
all_card.name: 热烈欢迎
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Ah, it's you." You are approached by a member of the Lodge whom you recognize: one of Carl Sanford's bodyguards from your previous meeting with the president. "I regret to inform you that Mr. Sanford and the other members of the Lodge are busy with an important task at the moment. I would suggest you come back at a later time." You tell the man that your task is important, and offer to help in return for a meeting with Mr. Sanford. He considers you for a moment, then nods. "All right. We are attempting to open a device which we believe will help us bind the revenant you encountered earlier. You'll want to speak with Nathan Wick if you want to help. You can find him in the library upstairs." You thank him and turn to leave, but he grabs your arm and stops you, adding one final warning: "You should know that we intend to open this device at any cost. If you cannot stomach the consequences, once again, I suggest you leave."
all_card.real_back_text: If the Library is not in play, put it into play. Spawn the set-aside Nathan Wick enemy in the Library, (Master of Initiation) side faceup. Attach the set-aside Puzzle Box story asset to him.
all_card.real_flavor: You have arrived at the Lodge’s manor in French Hill to see if they can help you piece together the evidence you’ve collected. Perhaps you can even speak with the president of the Lodge again. But as you approach the manor, you begin to wonder if this was a test of your loyalty all along.

all_card.back_flavor:
一开始，你的调查几乎没有得出任何答案。今晚这幢庄园里确实要举行某种会议，尽管你不知道为什么。终于你抓住了机会。在附近的一张桌子上，一张手写的传令解释了今晚聚集于此的原因：
“我们的计划已经提前。我们必须在今晚午夜之前完成陷阱。我们找到的那件仪器将帮助我们对那亡灵施以咒缚，所以，我们必须在仪式开始之前找到开启它的方法。不能再因为谨慎或怯懦而浪费时间。马上到圣堂向南森·威克汇报。”
你心中并没有得到答案，反而更生疑窦。
all_card.back_text: 如果圣堂内室不在场上，将其放置入场。 将放在一边的南森·威克敌人生成在圣堂内室，(教化大师)面朝上放置。将放在一边的机关盒剧情支援附属到他身上。 直到游戏结束，当前场景获得：“[reaction]在你躲避一个敌人后：移除其所有毁灭标记。”将本卡牌放到场景牌库旁作为提醒，然后推进至场景2a。
all_card.flavor: 秘社另有目的——你十分肯定。你不确定他们的计划具体是什么，但目前为止，你所怀疑的都是真的。你打算溜进秘社位于法兰西山的庄园，查出他们到底有什么阴谋。
all_card.name: 渗透秘社
all_card.text: [reaction]在你躲避一个敌人后：移除其所有的毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
At first, your investigation yields few answers. There is indeed a meeting of some sort happening at the manor tonight, though you're not sure why. Finally, you catch a break. On a nearby table, a written summons explains the reason for tonight's gathering:
"Our timetable has moved forward. We must complete the trap by midnight tonight. The device we found will aid us in binding the revenant, so it is imperative that we find a way to open it before the ceremony begins. We have no time to waste with prudence or cowardice. Report to Nathan Wick in the sanctum at once."
You are left with more questions than answers.
all_card.real_back_text: If the Inner Sanctum is not in play, put it into play. Spawn the set-aside Nathan Wick enemy in the Inner Sanctum, (Master of Indoctrination) side faceup. Attach the set-aside Puzzle Box story asset to him. For the remainder of the game, the current act gains "[reaction] After you evade an enemy: Remove all doom from it." Place this card next to the act deck as a reminder, then advance to act 2a.
all_card.real_flavor: The Lodge is up to something - you’re sure of it. You’re not sure exactly what their plans entail, but your suspicions have proven correct so far. You have decided to sneak into the Lodge’s manor in French Hill to learn what they are plotting.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you evade an enemy: Remove all doom from it.

all_card.back_text:
如果你通过击败南森·威克推进场景：
你迅速从南森的手中撬走仪器，趁着无人发觉，逃离现场。
如果你通过躲避南森·威克推进场景：
你趁着南森不注意，从他身旁的桌上偷走了仪器。当他意识到仪器不见了的时候，你早已离开。
如果你通过与南森·威克谈判推进场景：
“好吧，听着。”南森安静地说道，“事实是，可能有另一种更安全的方法能打开仪器。这座建筑有着许多秘密；远比你能知道的要多。但是时间不多了，桑福德先生希望能在午夜之前把它打开。如果你能够在那之前打开，当然再好不过。不然的话，那……要是我是你，等到我们要强行打开它的时候，我可不会待在它边上。”他将仪器递给你，然后静静地离开。
all_card.flavor: 不管秘社的计划是什么，其中牵涉到一个“仪器”，秘社为了开启它会不惜一切代价。现在，似乎这个仪器在一位名叫南森·威克的秘社成员手上。不管如何，你都得亲手把这件仪器拿过来。
all_card.name: 取得仪器
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果南森·威克以任何方式加入到胜利牌区，选择一位调查员来控制附属的机关盒，并推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If you advanced by defeating Nathan Wick:
You quickly pry the device from Nathan's hands and flee before you are noticed.
If you advanced by evading Nathan Wick:
You wait until Nathan is not looking, then sweep in and steal the device from the table next to him. You are long gone by the time he realizes it is missing.
If you advanced by parleying with Nathan Wick:
"All right, listen," Nathan explains quietly. "Truth is, there probably is a safer way for us to open the device. This building holds many secrets; more than you could possible know. But time is running thin, and Mr. Sanford wants it open by midnight. If you can open it before then, great. If not, well... If I were you, I wouldn't be around it when we try to force it open." He hands you the device and walks away, leaving you in silence.
all_card.real_flavor: Whatever the Lodge is planning, it involves a "device" they will do anything to open. It seems a Lodge member by the name of Nathan Wick holds the device at the moment. One way or another, you have to get your hands on it.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If Nathan Wick is added to the victory display by any means, choose an investigator to take control of the attached Puzzle Box, and advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 尽管这个盒子彷佛每次都在与你较劲，但在得到全部四把钥匙后，你最终拼好了盒子的图案，打开这个精巧的盒子。首先，你旋转盒子上多处机械设置，直到盒盖的图案与你得到的图样完美契合([tablet])。接下来，你念出方才饰板上所写的拉丁咒语([cultist])。你反复尝试，让木盒表面图块移动、变化，终于你听见了一声咔搭声。盒侧出现了一个圆形凹痕，和你神秘的黑玛瑙硬币([elder_thing])大小吻合。你将硬币放入凹痕后，对侧的另一块木板立即敞开，露出一个钥匙孔。最后，你将白骨钥匙([skull])插进钥匙孔，转动钥匙。盒盖缓缓打开，突然整个房间都被一股奔腾的气流吞没，所有光线、色彩、声音、物质都被吸入盒中。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 - 如果调查员成为了秘社一员， (→结局1)。 - 否则，(→结局2)。
all_card.flavor: 那个“仪器”不过是个上了锁的机关盒，大小只够装下一双鞋子。它表面有着错乱的图形，图块可以无限扭转，而它表面没有任何的钥匙孔。
all_card.name: 四把钥匙
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果同在一个地点的调查员控制了机关盒、[skull]钥匙、[cultist]钥匙、[tablet]和[elder_thing]钥匙，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Though the box itself seems to fight you at every turn, with all four key components in your possession, you finally manage to piece together how to open the contraption. First, you twist and contort the box's many mechanical devices until the image on its lid lines up perfectly with the diagram in your possession ([tablet]). Next, you chant the Latin incantation inscribed on the small wooden plaque you found ([cultist]). It takes a few tries to get it right, but eventually you hear a click as the surface of the wooden container shifts and changes. A round indentation has appeared on the side of the box, matching the size of your mysterious block onyx coin ([elder_thing]). As soon as you place the coin inside, another wooden panel opens on the other side, revealing a keyhole. Finally, you insert the key of bone ([skull]) into the keyhole and turn it. The lid begins to open, and suddenly the entirety of the room is engulfed in a rush of air as all light, color, sound, and matter is sucked into the box.
all_card.real_back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If the investigators are members of the Lodge, (→R1). - Otherwise, (→R2).
all_card.real_flavor: The "device" is nothing more than a locked puzzle box, just about large enough to hold a pair of shoes. The diagram on its surface depicts a broken pattern which can be manipulated to no apparent end, and there does not appear to be a keyhole of any kind.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If investigators at the same location control the Puzzle Box, the [skull] key, the [cultist] key, the [tablet] key, and the [elder_thing] key, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 当你来到这座位于法兰西山的秘社庄园时，你惊讶地发现附近的街道上停着几辆汽车。庄园的几扇窗户里传出灯光。今晚这里会有什么聚会吗？
all_card.flavor: 银暮秘社的总部位于法兰西山，是一座宏伟的维多利亚式大宅，几乎能够俯瞰全城。大宅那扇醒目的彩色玻璃门里有灯光闪动。
all_card.name: 秘社大门
all_card.text: 敌人不能生成在秘社大门。 [action]：撤退。再想一下，可能来这儿不是一个好主意。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you approach the gates of the Lodge’s manor in French Hill, you are surprised to see several automobiles parked nearby, in the street. Light shines in several of the windows of the manor. Is there a gathering of some sort here tonight?
all_card.real_flavor: The headquarters of the Silver Twilight Lodge is a gorgeous Victorian mansion in French Hill, overlooking most of the city. Light flickers beyond its prominent stained-glass door.
all_card.real_text: Enemies cannot spawn at the Lodge Gates. [action]: Resign. On second thought, maybe coming here was a bad idea.

all_card.back_flavor: 当你来到这座位于法兰西山的秘社庄园时，你惊讶地发现附近的街道上停着几辆汽车。庄园的几扇窗户里传出灯光。今晚这里会有什么聚会吗？
all_card.flavor: 银暮秘社的总部位于法兰西山，是一座宏伟的维多利亚式大宅，几乎能够俯瞰全城。大宅那扇醒目的彩色玻璃门里有灯光闪动。
all_card.name: 秘社大门
all_card.text: 敌人不能生成在秘社大门。 [action]：撤退。再想一下，可能来这儿不是一个好主意。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you approach the gates of the Lodge’s manor in French Hill, you are surprised to see several automobiles parked nearby, in the street. Light shines in several of the windows of the manor. Is there a gathering of some sort here tonight?
all_card.real_flavor: The headquarters of the Silver Twilight Lodge is a gorgeous Victorian mansion in French Hill, overlooking most of the city. Light flickers beyond its prominent stained-glass door.
all_card.real_text: Enemies cannot spawn at the Lodge Gates. [action]: Resign. On second thought, maybe coming here was a bad idea.

all_card.back_flavor: 秘社的庄园前门有两名身着战壕大衣的男子把守着，你接近的时候，他们冲你点了点头。
all_card.back_text: 银暮秘社的入口有人把守。你不能进入前厅。 秘社大门获得：“[action]：谈判。看门人在梅吉尔庄园见过你，于是让你进门。揭示前厅。”
all_card.flavor: 守卫们让到一边，准你进入前厅。“桑福德先生已经等了你很久了。”其中一名守卫神秘兮兮地说道。大宅内部干净整洁、保养良好，与你预想中阿卡姆最著名的社交俱乐部别无二致。木墙上装饰着一些饰板、相片和其他饰品，暗示秘社有着悠久而传奇的历史。
all_card.name: 前厅
all_card.real_back_flavor: The front entrance to the Lodge’s manor is guarded by two men in trenchcoats, who nod to you as you approach.
all_card.real_back_text: The entrance to the Silver Twilight Lodge is guarded. You cannot enter the Lobby. Lodge Gates gains: "[action]: Parley. The guards recognize you from the Meiger estate and let you pass. Reveal the Lobby."
all_card.real_flavor: The guards step aside and allow you to enter the lobby. "Mr. Sanford has been expecting you," one of them says cryptically. The interior of the mansion is clean and well-kept, as you would expect from Arkham's most prestigious social club. Plaques, pictures, and other trinkets adorn the wooden walls, hinting at the Lodge's long and storied history.

all_card.back_flavor: 秘社的庄园前门有两名身着战壕大衣的男子把守着。或许还有别的办法能进去……
all_card.flavor: 大宅内部干净整洁、保养良好，与你预想中阿卡姆最著名的社交俱乐部别无二致。木墙上装饰着一些饰板、相片和其他饰品，暗示秘社有着悠久而传奇的历史。
all_card.name: 前厅
all_card.text: 强制 - 前厅揭示后：将随机1个放在一边的钥匙放在前厅上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The front entrance to the Lodge’s manor is guarded by two men in trenchcoats. Perhaps there is another way into the building...
all_card.real_flavor: The interior of the mansion is clean and well-kept, as you would expect from Arkham's most prestigious social club. Plaques, pictures, and other trinkets adorn the wooden walls, hinting at the Lodge's long and storied history.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After the Lobby is revealed: Place 1 random set-aside key on it.

all_card.back_flavor: 在秘社庄园的地下室，从几扇上锁的窗户里能够看到窗内漆黑的地窖。
all_card.flavor: 秘社地窖里只有一个大大的酒柜，还有几个没有标识的酒桶。一扇沉重的铁门挡在你面前，阻止你进入地下室。你差点就不想知道这扇门背后的是什么了。差点。
all_card.name: 秘社地窖
all_card.text: 强制 - 秘社地窖揭示后：将随机1个放在一边的钥匙放在前厅上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Several locked windows along the basement level of the manor reveal the dark cellar within.
all_card.real_flavor: The cellar of the Lodge contains only a large wine rack and several unmarked barrels. A heavy steel door bars your passage deeper into the basement. You almost don't want to know what lies beyond it. Almost.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After the Lodge Cellar is revealed: Place 1 random set-aside key on it.

all_card.back_flavor: 在秘社庄园的地下室，从几扇窗户里能够看到窗内漆黑的地窖。
all_card.back_text:
银暮秘社的后门是隐藏起来的。你不能进入秘社地窖。
秘社大门获得：“[action]位于秘社大门的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：揭示秘社地窖。”
all_card.flavor: 你从一扇没有上锁的窗户溜进了这幢建筑的地窖，里只有一个大大的酒柜，还有几个没有标识的酒桶。一扇沉重的铁门挡在你面前，阻止你进入地下室。你差点就不想知道这扇门背后的是什么了。差点。
all_card.name: 秘社地窖
all_card.real_back_flavor: Several windows along the basement level of the manor reveal the dark cellar within.
all_card.real_back_text:
The rear entrance to the Silver Twilight Lodge is hidden. You cannot enter the Lodge Cellar.
Lodge Gates gains: "[action] Investigators at the Lodge Gates spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Reveal the Lodge Cellar."
all_card.real_flavor: You slip through an unlocked window into the building's cellar. It contains only a large wine rack and several unmarked barrels. A heavy steel door bars your passage deeper into the basement. You almost don't want to know what lies beyond it. Almost.

all_card.back_flavor: 你登上通往大宅二楼的楼梯时，闻到了蜡烛燃烧的气味。安静得连纸张翻页的细小沙沙声也能听见。
all_card.flavor: 进入温暖的休息室，你看见一位衣着优雅的男子在火炉旁边看书。让你吃惊的是，他几乎完全没有注意你。
all_card.name: 休息室
all_card.text: 强制 - 休息室揭示后：将放在一边的机密室和藏书室地点放置入场。将放在一边的奥古斯特·林奎斯特支援放置入场，放到休息室。将随机1个放在一边的钥匙放在他身上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you approach the staircase leading to the second floor of the mansion, you smell burning candle wax. It is quiet enough that you can hear the gentle crinkling of a page being turned.
all_card.real_flavor: As you enter the warm lounge, you spot an elegantly dressed man reading by the fire. To your surprise, he pays you almost no heed whatsoever.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After the Lounge is revealed: Put the set-aside Vault and Library locations into play. Put the set-aside August Lindquist asset into play in the Lounge. Place 1 random set-aside key on him.

all_card.back_flavor: 带有铁栏小窗的一扇沉重木门似乎通往一个狭小的机密室。门窗紧闭，防止他人窥视。
all_card.back_text: 机密室的门锁上了。你不能进入机密室，除非你控制[elder_thing]钥匙。
all_card.flavor: 这个简朴的房间里有着许多书架和档案柜子，存放着秘社保存的重要文文件和记录。房间一角藏着一个小小的保险箱。你想知道，要是时间充足，你能在这发现些什么秘密。
all_card.name: 机密室
all_card.text: 强制 - 机密室被揭示后：将随机1个放在一边的钥匙放在机密室上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A heavy wooden door with an iron-barred window appears to lead into a small vault. It is sealed shut from prying eyes.
all_card.real_back_text: The door to the Vault is locked. You cannot enter the Vault unless you control the [elder_thing] key.
all_card.real_flavor: This simple unadorned room contains many shelves and filing cabinets, where important documents and records pertaining to the Lodge are kept. A small combination safe hides in a corner of the room. You wonder what secrets you could uncover here if you had more time.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After the Vault is revealed: Place 1 random set-aside key on it.

all_card.back_flavor: 一条狭窄无窗的走廊从休息室向上倾斜，通向一扇高大的木门。
all_card.flavor: 就连秘社的藏书室也被用来展示这个组织的财富与权力。里面有着许多又高又窄的书架，摆放着数百本书。
all_card.name: 藏书室
all_card.text: 你调查藏书室时，如果你控制[tablet]钥匙，藏书室得到隐藏值-3。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A narrow, windowless hallway slopes upward from the lounge, leading you to a tall, wooden door.
all_card.real_flavor: Even the Lodge's library is arranged to showcase the organization's wealth and power. There are hundreds of books among the room's tall, cramped shelves.
all_card.real_text: While you are investigating the Library, if you control the [tablet] key, the Library gets -3 shroud.

all_card.back_flavor: 一扇没有窗户的铁门阻止你前进探索未知。你感觉这个地下室比它看起来的要大许多。
all_card.back_text: 地下墓穴的门锁上了。你不能进入秘社地下墓穴，除非你控制至少1个([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing])钥匙。
all_card.flavor: 在铁门的另一头，火光照亮的走道通向更深的地底。与楼上擦得锃亮的木头比起来，这个地方肮脏而污浊。这到底是什么鬼地方？
all_card.name: 秘社地下墓穴
all_card.text: 强制 - 在秘社地下墓穴揭示时：将放在一边的圣堂内室和每个放在一边的圣堂门廊地点放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A windowless steel door blocks your way into paths unknown. You get the feeling this basement is much larger than it appears.
all_card.real_back_text: The door to the catacombs is locked. You cannot enter the Lodge Catacombs unless you control at least 1 ([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing]) key.
all_card.real_flavor: Beyond the steel door, torchlit stone halls lead deeper underground. Compared to the polished wood upstairs, this area feels grimy and unclean. What the hell is this place?
all_card.real_text: Forced - When Lodge Catacombs is revealed: Put the set-aside Inner Sanctum and each of the set-aside Sanctum Doorway locations into play.

all_card.back_flavor: 石拱门后面是一扇没有标识的铁门，以未曾透露的秘密和隐藏的真相嘲弄着你。
all_card.flavor: 房间中央有一块有着精细雕纹的石质祭坛。鲜血沿着嵌在石质地面上一条条的通道，从祭坛流下。
all_card.name: 典礼室
all_card.text: 强制 - 在一轮结束时：在典礼室的每位调查员和每个[[盟友]]支持卡受到1点直接恐惧。如果在典礼室的调查员控制了[skull]钥匙，取消本效果。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Beyond a stone archway lies an unmarked iron door, mocking you with untold secrets and hidden truths.
all_card.real_flavor: At the center of this room lies an ornately carved stone altar. Blood drains from the altar through a series of channels in the mosaic stone floor.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When the round ends: Each investigator and each [[Ally]] asset in the Ceremony Room takes 1 direct horror. Cancel this effect if an investigator in the Ceremony Room controls the [skull] key.

all_card.back_flavor: 石拱门后面是一扇没有标识的铁门，以未曾透露的秘密和隐藏的真相嘲弄着你。
all_card.name: 拘禁室
all_card.text: 强制 - 在拘禁室揭示后：查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张[[异教徒]]敌人，将其生成在拘禁室。混洗遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Beyond a stone archway lies an unmarked iron door, mocking you with untold secrets and hidden truths.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Holding Cells is revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and spawn it in the Holding Cells. Shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 地下墓穴的尽头有一排铁门，门上饰有银暮秘社的标志——尖朝上的三支箭。一如所料，这些铁门全都紧锁着。
all_card.back_text: 圣堂内室的门锁上了。你不能进入圣堂内室，除非你控制[cultist]钥匙。
all_card.flavor: 在房间的另一头，木平台上方伫立着一个讲台。几排豪华座椅面朝舞台。你从未听说在秘社里有这样一个会议室；这里一定是只有最忠心、最受信任的秘社成员才能进入的地方。
all_card.name: 圣堂内室
all_card.text: 强制 - 在圣堂内室揭示后：将随机1个放在一边的钥匙放在圣堂内室上。
all_card.real_back_flavor: At the end of the catacombs lies a set of iron doors adorned with the symbol of the Silver Twilight Lodge - three arrows pointed upwards. Unsurprisingly, the doors are locked tight.
all_card.real_back_text: The door to the Inner Sanctum is locked. You cannot enter the Inner Sanctum unless you control the [cultist] key.
all_card.real_flavor: At the far end of this room, a podium stands atop a wooden platform. Several rows of plush seats face the stage. You've never heard of a meeting room like this within the Lodge; this must be a place for only the most dedicated and trusted members.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After the Inner Sanctum is revealed: Place 1 random set-aside key on it.

all_card.name: 南森·威克
all_card.text: 反击。 [action]：谈判。检定[willpower](3)以说服南森再给你一次机会。如果你检定成功，在南森·威克上放置1资源。然后，如果其上有1[per_investigator]个资源，将其加入胜利牌区。如果你检定失败，南森·威克攻击你。
all_card.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 银暮秘社. 精英
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) to persuade Nathan to let you find another option. If you succeed, place 1 resource on Nathan Wick. Then, if there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. If you fail, Nathan Wick attacks you.

all_card.name: 南森·威克
all_card.text: 警戒。 强制 - 你躲避南森·威克成功并超过难度3点或更多后：你偷了机关盒。将南森·威克加入胜利牌区。
all_card.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 银暮秘社. 精英
all_card.real_text: Alert. Forced - After you evade Nathan Wick by 3 or more: You steal the puzzle box. Add Nathan Wick to the victory display.

all_card.name: 秘社狱卒
all_card.text: 生成 - 任意一个[[圣堂]]地点。 冷漠。 强制 - 在秘社狱卒入场后：在其上放置2个毁灭标记和随机1个放在一边的钥匙。 [action]：谈判。检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，移除秘社狱卒上的1个毁灭标记或控制其钥匙。
all_card.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 银暮秘社

all_card.back_flavor:
不知为何，尽管困难重重，你终于击败了那苏生的亡灵，让安妮特·梅森摆脱了它的折磨。她晕倒在地，但她体内的亡灵却强迫她睁开眼睛，并且操纵她的身体，如同木偶一般，情状可怖。“愚蠢！”从安妮特翕动的唇间发出了粗哑而空洞的嗓音，凯夏再次站起身来：“你们一文不值，不过是些微不足道的虫子，而我曾亲眼目睹真理。我已见过混沌是何模样，你很快就会融入其中。现在来吧；加入我，在黑色王座前屈膝下跪，与宇宙合而为一！”
话音传入你的耳中，让你为之颤抖。她说的话你一个字都听不懂，但你知道她在盘算着黑暗而邪恶的阴谋。“离开这个地方，”你振作起来，命令她，“回到你受到召唤之前所在的地方去，再也不要回来。”
all_card.flavor: 这个噩梦不会停止，除非你阻止了背后黑手：安妮特·梅森和附在她身上的鬼魂。你周遭的世界正分崩离析，而女巫集会只会将末日提前。
all_card.name: 坟墓彼端
all_card.text: [free]移除本场景的3个裂口：在一个随机地点上放置1个线索。 目标 - 如果安妮特·梅森被击败，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Somehow, despite all odds, you have managed to defeat the resurrected spirit which torments Anette Mason. She passes out and collapses to the ground, but the revenant inside forces her eyes open and puppeteers her body in a lurid display. "Fools!" the ragged, disembodied voice of Keziah declares through Anette's lips as she rises once more. "You are naught but insects. I have seen the truth. I have seen the face of Chaos itself, and you will soon be a part of it. Now, come; join me, kneel before the Black Throne, and be one with the universe!"
You shudder as the words reach your ears. Nothing she says makes sense to you, but you can tell her intent is dark and wicked. "Leave this place," you muster up the will to command, "Go back to the beyond from which you were summoned, and never return."
all_card.real_flavor: This nightmare will not end until you stop the one behind it: Anette Mason and the spirit which possesses her. The world is falling apart all around you, and the coven is only bringing the end closer.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Remove 3 breaches from this act: Place 1 clue on a random location. Objective - If Anette Mason is defeated, advance.

all_card.flavor: 城市的境况持续恶化。现世的裂缝将大地的脉络撕扯开来，大街小巷里都能听到微弱的不谐笛声。
all_card.name: 黑暗知识(版本二)
all_card.text: [free]移除本场景的3个裂口：在一个随机地点上放置1个线索。 目标 - 在调查员搜集的线索总计达到所需数量时，必须立即花费这些线索并推进场景。在本场景推进时，将上面所有的裂口移动到下一张场景。
all_card.real_flavor: The state of the city continues to decay. Breaches in reality begin to rip through the fabric of the Earth, and a faint melody of discordant pipes can be heard throughout the streets.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Remove 3 breaches from this act: Place 1 clue on a random location. Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance. When this act advances, move all of the breaches on it to the next act.

all_card.name: 卡尔·桑福德
all_card.text: 生成 - 银暮秘社。 猎手。反击。 调查员每控制1个线索，卡尔·桑福德生命值-2。 强制 - 在任意数量的裂口被从当前场景移除后：将其中1个放在卡尔·桑福德所在地点。
all_card.traits: 类人. 银暮秘社. 精英
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Silver Twilight Lodge. Hunter. Retaliate. Carl Sanford gets -2 health for each clue controlled by an investigator. Forced - After any number of breaches are removed from the current act: Place 1 of them on Carl Sanford's location.

all_card.back_flavor:
你运用武力和智计，在卡尔·桑福德自己的布局中成功击败了他。他抽取的力量痛苦地从他身上流逝。“你这个笨蛋。”他啐了ー口，“你以为自己干成了什么大事？我们本来可以永生不朽。你难道不懂吗？我们本来可以成神！”他挣扎着站起身，渐渐无法控制自己的力量，愈发虚弱。
“可是代价是什么呢？”你直视回去，回答他，“你不会让我们成神，而会让我们沦为奴隶，被你的贪欲和修道会的强权奴役的奴隶。我宁愿继续做个凡人，也不愿做你的奴隶。”
“那样我们都会死的。”卡尔痛苦地回答，“我本来能够让我们晋升天界，但现在，我们都会灭亡。这样的结果你满意了。”
all_card.flavor: 这个噩梦不会停止，除非你推翻了背后黑手：卡尔·桑福德和银暮修道会。即便你周围的世界正分崩离析，这个邪教仍想继续他们的阴谋，直到最后。
all_card.name: 世界新秩序
all_card.text: [free]移除本场景的3个裂口：在一个随机地点上放置1个线索。 目标 - 如果卡尔·桑福德被击败，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Using force and ingenuity, you have managed to defeat Carl Sanford at his own game. The power he was drawing from surges painfully through him. "You imbeciles," he spits, "what do you think you have accomplished? We could have been immortal. Don't you understand? We could have been gods!" he struggles to remain on his feet, his strength waning as he loses control of his power. "At what cost?" You reply, taking in the sight before you. "You would have made us slaves, not gods. Slaves to your greed and the Order's power. I'd rather stay mortal than be your thrall." "Then we will all perish," Carl responds bitterly. "I could have made us into celestials. Instead we will be extinct. I hope you are satisfied."
all_card.real_flavor: This nightmare will not end until you overthrow the one behind it: Carl Sanford and the Order of the Silver Twilight. Even with the world falling apart all around you, the cult seems intent on continuing their plot to the bitter end.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Remove 3 breaches from this act: Place 1 clue on a random location. Objective - If Carl Sanford is defeated, advance.

all_card.text: [free]：弃掉遭遇牌库顶的3张卡牌，并将南区的1个裂口移动到当前场景。如可能，选择以此效果弃掉的一张[[力量]]诡计并结算其显现能力。

all_card.flavor: 许多惊恐的市民坐在教堂的木质长椅上祈祷，互相窃窃私语。

all_card.real_flavor: Many fearful citizens are seated at the church's wooden pews, praying and whispering amongst themselves.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, move all breaches from South Church to the current act. [action]: Resign. You hide through the night.

all_card.real_back_flavor: As you approach the manor of the Lodge once more, you find it dark and empty. It seems that its members are still laying low, at least for the time being.

all_card.back_flavor: 当你再次接近绞刑者山丘，你发现这里没有任何痕迹——不论是活物还是别的什么。看来女巫集会已经离开了这个地方，至少目前如此。
all_card.name: 绞刑者山丘

all_card.flavor: 你看到的是真正的混沌。与它相比，你的所知，所爱——都是毫无意义的。

all_card.real_flavor: You look upon the face of true chaos. Everything you have ever known, everything you have ever loved - it is all meaningless by comparison.
