all_card.back_flavor: 卡洛琳·弗恩以他人心房为居。她使用一种特殊的疗法，通过患者的梦境来研究他们的心理。在此类疗法实践的过程中，她见过也听过许多令人不安的事物。一些患者曾声称自己在睡梦中会去到其他的领域，或告诉她有可怕的生物出没于自己的梦境。她的研究将她导向一桩又一桩离奇事件，然而对于周遭世界的恐惧，她似乎并没有更多地真正了解。即便如此，卡洛琳不会停下研究，除非自己发现了这一切疯狂的根源。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5，带有“治愈……恐惧”字样的卡牌等级0-5，其他等级0-1的探求者和/或潜修者卡牌([seeker]和/或[mystic])最多15张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：催眠疗法、理性思考、1张随机基础弱点。 额外限制：无等级1-5的[[武器]]卡牌。
all_card.flavor: “心灵本身是脆弱的，但是通过理解，我们就能对它加以保护。”
all_card.name: 卡洛琳·弗恩
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你的卡牌效果治愈调查员或[[盟友]]支援的恐惧后：被治愈卡牌的控制者获得1资源。
[elder_sign]效果：+1，你可以治愈你所在地点的一位调查员或一个[[盟友]]支援的1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Carolyn Fern dwells in the minds of others. Using a complex form of hypnosis, she studies the psychology of her patients through their dreams. Through this practice, she has seen and heard many disturbing things. Some patients have claimed to travel to other realms in their sleep, or tell her of terrible creatures that haunt their dreams. Her research has led her from one bizarre case to another, and yet, she seems no closer to truly understanding the horrors of the world around her. Even so, Carolyn will not give up until she can uncover the root of these madnesses.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards that "heal horror" level 0-5, up to 15 other Seeker and/or Mystic cards level 0-1 ([seeker] and/or [mystic]). Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Hypnotic Therapy, Rational Thought, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Restrictions: No [[Weapon]] cards level 1-5.
all_card.real_flavor: The mind is fragile, but through understanding, we can protect it.
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] After one of your card effects heals horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset: The healed card's controller gains 1 resource.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.

deck_options.error: Deck must have at least 11 Insights.

all_card.back_flavor: 乔·戴蒙德是一名私家侦探，因办理他人眼中的非自然案件而闻名。他全身心地投入到每次调查中去，而且他的能力不容小觑。他既接受过有钱人的委托，也为穷苦人家办过事。不论是大案小案、奇案险案，他都不会拒绝。凭乔的经验来说，人一旦尝试接近真相，事情就会变得棘手，但这正是他想要的。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：40 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：侦探的柯尔特1911式手枪、悬案、1张随机基础弱点。 附加需求：你的牌库必须包括至少11张[[洞察]]事件(包括悬案)。在每场冒险的冒险设置期间，你必须从你牌库中选择11张[[洞察]]事件(其中必须包括悬案)，将其混洗为一个单独的“直觉牌库”。
all_card.name: 乔·戴蒙德
all_card.text: 强制 - 在调查阶段开始时：揭示你直觉牌库顶1张卡牌。直到本阶段结束，你可以以-2费用打出该卡牌，如同它是你的手牌。如果当本阶段结束时该卡牌未被打出，将其洗回你的直觉牌库。 [elder_sign]效果：+1。你可以将你弃牌堆的一张[[洞察]]事件移动到你的直觉牌库底。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Joe Diamond is a private eye with a reputation for handling cases that everyone else regards as supernatural nonsense. He is thorough in his investigations and not one to be trifled with. His services have been employed by the wealthy as well as those down on their luck. No case is too large, too small, too strange, or too dangerous. In Joe's experience, things start getting nasty right when you start reaching the truth, and that is exactly where he likes to be.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 40. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Detective's Colt 1911s, Unsolved Case, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Requirements: Your deck must include at least 11 [[Insight]] events (including Unsolved Case). During the setup of each scenario, you must choose 11 [[Insight]] events from your deck (one of which must be Unsolved Case) and shuffle them into a separate "hunch deck".
all_card.real_text: Forced - When the investigation phase begins: Reveal the top card of your hunch deck. Until the end of the phase, you may play that card as if it were in your hand, at -2 cost. If it is still revealed at the end of the phase, shuffle it back into your hunch deck. [elder_sign] effect: +1. You may move an [[Insight]] event from your discard pile to the bottom of your hunch deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 普雷斯顿·费尔蒙特从没多想自己家族的钱是怎么来的。从前他只知道自己有大把的钱，只要花钱能解决问题他从不吝啬。他的父亲常常看起来很不安，曾试图向他解释他祖父经营的是什么生意、名叫“银暮秘社密会”的什么组织提出了哪些要求，但他从来没有把这放在心上。随后他父亲在一场离奇的车祸中丧生，自那以后打理家族财产的重任就落在了普雷斯顿的肩上。现在“银暮秘社”的社长卡尔·桑福德想要与普雷斯顿单独会面。这或许是普雷斯顿第一次真正开始思考他家族的财产是怎么得来的……
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：家族遗产、秘社“债务”、1张随机基础弱点。 牌库构建限制：无[[违法]]卡牌。
all_card.flavor: “不论是我的钱、我的遗产，还是我面临的问题，让我用自己的方式来解决吧。”
all_card.name: 普雷斯顿·费尔蒙特
all_card.text:
你每次从卡牌效果获得资源，不将其放在资源池，改为放在家族遗产上。
[elder_sign]效果：+0。你可以花费2资源以改为自动成功。
all_card.traits: 银暮秘社. 社会名流
all_card.real_back_flavor: Preston Fairmont never thought much about where his family's money came from. All he knew was that he had plenty, and he took great advantage of it whenever possible. His father seemed troubled at times, and tried to explain about his grandfather's business and the demands of something called the Hermetic Order of the Silver Twilight, but Preston never paid any mind. Then his father died in a mysterious car accident, and Preston's family fortune has since become his responsibility. Now Carl Sanford, president of the Silver Twilight Lodge, wants to meet with Preston personally. Perhaps for the first time, Preston has begun to really think about where his family's money came from...
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Family Inheritance, Lodge "Debts," 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Illicit]] cards.
all_card.real_flavor: "My money, my legacy, my problem. Let me handle it in my own way."
all_card.real_text:
Anytime you gain 1 or more resources from a card effect, place them on Family Inheritance instead of in your resource pool.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. You may spend 2 resources to automatically succeed, instead.

all_card.back_flavor: 作为刚刚在阿卡姆营商的生意人，黛安娜·史丹利骄傲地接受了征召，加入久负盛名的银暮秘社。在那之后，她的喜悦之情变为了恐惧。受邀加入这个组织对于她的生意来说本来是件美事，但每周的会议越来越令人不安。在目睹诡异的仪式和恐怖的秘密后，黛安娜对这个结社的本质产生了怀疑。现在她确信有诸多可怕的势力齐聚于阿卡姆，且银暮秘社不知何故也参与其中。黛安娜决心要从内部瓦解这个组织，不借任何代价。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：35。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：银暮匕首、黑暗洞察、可怕的秘密、1张随机基础弱点。 额外冒险设置：每场游戏开始时，你的起始手牌中额外有一张黑暗洞察。
all_card.name: 黛安娜·史丹利
all_card.text:
黛安娜·史丹利底下每有一张卡牌，其得到+1[willpower]。
[reaction]你拥有的一张卡牌取消或忽略卡牌效果或游戏效果后，如果黛安娜·史丹利底下的卡牌数量少于5张：将该卡牌正面朝下放在她底下。抽取1张卡牌并获得1资源。(每阶段仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以选择黛安娜·史丹利底下的一张卡牌加入手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As a new business owner in Arkham, Diana Stanley was proud to be inducted into the prestigious Silver Twilight Lodge. Her joy has since turned to dread. Her admittance into the organization was fantastic for business, but the weekly meetings have grown more and more disturbing. After witnessing strange rituals and terrible secrets, Diana has become suspicious of the Lodge's true nature. Now she is convinced that there are terrible forces converging on Arkham, and that the Lodge is somehow involved. Diana has resolved to take it down from the inside, regardless of the cost.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 35. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Twilight Blade, Dark Insight, Terrible Secret, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Setup: You begin each game with Dark Insight as an additional card in your opening hand.
all_card.real_text:
Diana Stanley gets +1 [willpower] for each card beneath her.
[reaction] After a card you own cancels or ignores a card effect or game effect, if there are fewer than 5 cards beneath Diana Stanley: Place that card facedown beneath her. Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may choose a card beneath Diana Stanley and add it to your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 时间是不会说谎的。在过去，有人曾对丽塔恶语相加。他们威胁她，认为她低人一等。但自从丽塔开始参加赛跑，她在意的只有时间。秒表读数显示，丽塔跑得比所有人都快。还看得出她比过去更加强壮，经受了更为刻苦的训练。现在，她或许要为自己的生命而战。有人在追着她。她对这一点十分确定。虽然她不知道追赶自己的是什么人，也不知道他们的来意，但有过好几个奇怪的人在她的宿舍周围徘徊。他们打算拿她杀一儆百，但前提是得先抓到她，而秒表读数显示，他们追不上丽塔。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，[[技巧]]卡牌等级0-3。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：“我不会再逃了！”、兜帽人、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “你有意见？我不介意。我把你甩在后头可不需要得到你的批准。”
all_card.name: 丽塔·杨
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你躲避一个敌人后：对该敌人造成1点伤害，或移动到一个连接地点。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。直到本轮结束，忽略以上[reaction]能力的限制。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Clocks do not lie. In the past, people have said hurtful things to Rita. They have threatened her, deemed her inferior. But ever since she started running competitively, Rita has only cared about the clock. The clock says that Rita is faster then the rest. It says she is stronger and has trained harder. Now, she may have to fight for her life. Someone is after her. That much she's sure of. She has no idea who it is or why they want her, but there have been several strange men hanging around her dorm. They plan to make an example of her. But they will have to catch her, and the clock says they cannot.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Trick]] cards level 0-3. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): "I'm done runnin'!," Hoods, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "You got a bone to pick? Fine by me. I don't need your permission to leave you in the dust."
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] After you evade an enemy: Either deal 1 damage to that enemy, or move to a connecting location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Until the end of the round, ignore the limit on the above [reaction] ability.

deck_options.error: You cannot have more than 5 Seeker and/or Survivor cards

all_card.back_flavor: 多少人渴望听玛丽·朗博唱上一曲。人们把她叫做“烟熏天鹅绒”，称她是为演唱爵士乐而生，唱功如同魔法一一他们说的也许是真的。毕竟自祖母去世后，玛丽在梦里会听到一些她从未听过的歌曲。歌声听起来不像地球上使用的任何一种语言，曲调弯弯绕绕。玛丽永远也不会知道，她的祖母当年为什么从新奥尔良搬到了阿卡姆。人们过去把她的祖母叫做女巫。或许流淌在玛丽血液里的不止是爵士乐，毕竟……
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：[[法术]]卡牌等级0-5，潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5，[[密教]]卡牌等级0，其他等级0的探求者和/或求生者卡牌([seeker]和/或[survivor])最多5张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：神秘乐曲、安息日男爵、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.name: 玛丽·朗博
all_card.text:
你控制的卡牌上有至少1个毁灭标记时，你可以在自己的回合期间进行一个额外行动，但该额外行动只能用于打出[[法术]]卡牌或激活[[法术]][action]能力。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。你可以在你控制的一张卡牌上增加或移除1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Marie Lambeau always had a voice to die for. People called her "the Smoky Velvet." They said she was born to sing jazz, that she had the magic touch - and maybe they were right. After all, the songs she heard in her dreams ever since her Grand-Mère passed away were like nothing she'd ever heard before. The vocals sounded like no language spoken on Earth, the notes twisted and warped. Why her Grand-Mère had moved from New Orleans to Arkham, Marie would never know. People used to call her Grand-Mère a witch. Maybe there's more than just jazz in Marie's blood, after all...
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: [[Spell]] cards level 0-5, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Occult]] cards level 0, up to five other level 0 Seeker and/or Survivor cards ([seeker] and/or [survivor]). Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Mystifying Song, Baron Samedi, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_text:
While you have 1 or more doom among cards you control, you may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to play [[Spell]] cards or activate [[Spell]] [action] abilities.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may add 1 doom to or remove 1 doom from a card you control.

all_card.name: 催眠疗法
all_card.text:
卡洛琳·弗恩牌库专用
[action]横置催眠疗法：检定[intellect](2)。如果你检定成功，治愈你所在地点一位调查员1点恐惧。然后，该调查员可以抽取1张卡牌。
[reaction]在你的其他卡牌效果治愈调查员的恐惧后，横置催眠疗法：该效果治愈额外1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text:
Carolyn Fern deck only.
[action] Exhaust Hypnotic Therapy: Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location. Then, that investigator may draw 1 card.
[reaction] After one of your other card effects heals horror from an investigator, exhaust Hypnotic Therapy: That effect heals 1 additional horror.

all_card.name: 理性思考
all_card.text: 显现 - 将理性思考放置入场，放到你的威胁区域，带有4点恐惧。理性思考上的恐惧可以被治愈，如同其在卡洛琳·弗恩上。如果理性思考上没有恐惧，将其弃掉。 你不能治愈理性思考以外卡牌上的恐惧。你不能从卡洛琳·弗恩的[reaction]能力获得资源。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Rational Thought into play in your threat area, with 4 horror on it. Horror on Rational Thought may be healed as if it were on Carolyn Fern. If there is no horror on Rational Thought, discard it. You cannot heal horror from cards other than Rational Thought. You cannot gain resources from Carolyn Fern's [reaction] ability.

all_card.name: 侦探的柯尔特1911式手枪
all_card.text: 乔·戴蒙德牌库专用。使用(4子弹)。 你控制的最多2张[[工具]]支援不占用手部槽位。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]并造成+1伤害。如果本次攻击击败了敌人，你可以将你弃牌堆的一张[[洞察]]事件移动到你的直觉牌库底。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械
all_card.real_text: Joe Diamond deck only. Uses (4 ammo). Up to 2 [[Tool]] assets you control do not take up hand slots. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If this attack defeats an enemy, you may move an [[Insight]] event from your discard pile to the bottom of your hunch deck.

all_card.name: 悬案
all_card.text: 将你的1个线索放在隐藏值最高的地点上。将悬案从游戏中移除。 强制 - 如果悬案将要洗入你的直觉牌库：改为将它加入你的威胁区域。直到游戏结束，它获得：“强制 - 在游戏结束时：乔·戴蒙德本场冒险少取得2点经验值。”
all_card.real_text: Place 1 of your clues on the location with the highest shroud. Remove Unsolved Case from the game. Forced - If Unsolved Case would be shuffled into your hunch deck: Add it to your threat area instead. For the remainder of the game, it gains: "Forced - When the game ends: Joe Diamond earns 2 fewer experience for this scenario."

all_card.name: 家族遗产
all_card.text: 永久。普雷斯顿·费尔蒙特牌库专用。 [action]：将本卡牌上的所有资源移动到你的资源池。 强制 - 在你的回合开始时：在本卡牌上放置4资源(从供应堆拿取)。本卡牌上的资源可以被花费，如同在你的资源池中。当你的回合结束时，弃掉本卡牌上的所有资源。
all_card.real_text: Permanent. Preston Fairmont deck only. [action]: Move all resources from this card to your resource pool. Forced - When your turn begins: Place 4 resources (from the token pool) on this card. Resources on this card may be spent as if they were in your resource pool. Discard all resources from this card at the end of your turn.

all_card.flavor: 他谈到了契约和他背负的债务，显然他要付出的不只是金钱。<cite>《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》</cite>
all_card.name: 秘社“债务”
all_card.text: 将秘社“债务”从游戏中移除。 强制 - 在游戏结束或你退场时，如果秘社“债务”仍在你手牌中：你承受1点精神创伤。
all_card.real_flavor: He spoke of bargains and of debts owned, yet they were clearly no mere monetary obligations. - <u>The Investigators of Arkham Horror</u>
all_card.real_text: Remove Lodge "Debts" from the game. Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if Lodge "Debts" is still in your hand: You suffer 1 mental trauma.

all_card.name: 银暮匕首
all_card.text: 黛安娜·史丹利牌库专用。 [action]：攻击。你本次攻击可以不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。你可以打出或投入黛安娜·史丹利底下的事件和技能，如同其在你的手牌中。作为以此方式打出或投入卡牌的额外费用，横置银暮匕首。以此方式打出或投入卡牌时，你不能触发黛安娜·史丹利的[reaction]能力。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 武器
all_card.real_text: Diana Stanley deck only. [action]: Fight. You may use [willpower] instead of [combat] for this attack. You may play or commit events and skills beneath Diana Stanley as if they were in your hand. As an additional cost to play or commit a card in this way, exhaust Twilight Blade. You cannot trigger Diana Stanley's [reaction] ability while playing or committing a card in this way.

all_card.name: 黑暗洞察
all_card.text: 黛安娜·史丹利牌库专用。 快速。在你所在地点的一位调查员抽取一张遭遇卡牌或弱点时打出。 取消该卡牌的全部效果并将其洗回其牌库。(不抽取一张新卡牌以替换。)
all_card.real_text: Diana Stanley deck only. Fast. Play when an investigator at your location draws an encounter card or a weakness. Cancel all of that card's effects and shuffle it back into its deck. (Do not draw a new card to replace it.)

all_card.name: 可怕的秘密
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果黛安娜·史丹利底下没有卡牌，将可怕的秘密洗回你的牌库。否则，黛安娜·史丹利底下每有一张卡牌，你必须弃掉该卡牌或受到1点恐惧。不能取消。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no card beneath Diana Stanley, shuffle Terrible Secret back into your deck. Otherwise, for each card beneath Diana Stanley, you must either discard that card or take 1 horror. Cannot be canceled.

all_card.name: “我不会再逃了！”
all_card.text: 丽塔·杨牌库专用。 快速。只能在你回合期间打出。 你所在地点的所有敌人重整并与你交战。你回合的剩余时间内，每当你躲避一个敌人，你可以不横置该敌人也不与其解除交战，而 是改为对其造成1点伤害。(成功躲避的其他所有效果仍然有效。)
all_card.real_text: Rita Young deck only. Fast. Play only during your turn. Ready and engage all enemies at your location. For the remainder of your turn, whenever you evade an enemy, instead of exhausting and disengaging from that enemy, you may deal it 1 damage. (All other effects of the successful evasion still apply.)

all_card.flavor: “你们这些该死的胆小鬼，总是蒙着脸。你们就像混账三K党一样，不敢让人们知道自己是谁……”<cite>格雷厄姆·麦克尼尔，《米斯卡塔尼克的食尸鬼》</cite>
all_card.name: 兜帽人
all_card.text: 猎物 - 仅对丽塔·杨。 警戒。猎手。 强制 - 在你躲避兜帽人后：其攻击你。
all_card.real_flavor:
"You damn cowards always cover your faces. You're just like the damn Klan, always too scared to let people see who you are…"
 - Graham McNeill, <u>Ghouls of the Miskatonic</u>
all_card.real_text: Prey - Rita Young only. Alert. Hunter. Forced - After you evade Hoods: It attacks you.

all_card.name: 神秘乐曲
all_card.text:
玛丽·朗博牌库专用。
快速。在密谋将要因为达到毁灭阈值而推进时打出。
直到本阶段结束，密谋不能因为达到毁灭阈值而推进。将神秘乐曲从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_text:
Marie Lambeau deck only.
Fast. Play when the agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold.
Until the end of the phase, the agenda cannot advance by reaching its doom threshold. Remove Mystifying Song from the game.

all_card.name: 安息日男爵
all_card.text: 显现 - 将安息日男爵放置入场。他身上有少于3个毁灭标记时，他不能离场。 强制 - 在任意数量的伤害被放置到安息日男爵所在地点的调查员上时：在该调查员上放置额外1点伤害。 [free]横置安息日男爵：在安息日男爵上放置1个毁灭标记。如果他身上有至少3个毁灭标记，将他弃掉。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Baron Samedi into play. He cannot leave play while he has less than 3 doom on him. Forced - When any amount of damage is placed on an investigator in Baron Samedi's location: Place 1 additional damage on that investigator. [fast] Exhaust Baron Samedi: Place 1 doom on Baron Samedi. If he has 3 or more doom on him, discard him.

all_card.flavor: 他在隐瞒着什么……但他为什么要隐瞒？
all_card.name: 拷问
all_card.text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个[[类人]]敌人并检定[combat](3)。本次检定得到+X难度，其中X为所选敌人的伤害值。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点的1个线索和其他任意一个地点的1个线索。
all_card.real_flavor: He was hiding something… but why?
all_card.real_text: Parley. Choose a [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location and test [combat] (3). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the chosen enemy's damage value. If you succeed, discover 1 clue at your location and 1 clue at any other location.

all_card.traits: 洞察. 勇气. 策略

[reaction] When you are dealt damage and/or horror: Discard Delay the Inevitable and cancel all damage and/or horror just dealt. Forced - When the mythos phase ends: You must either spend 2 resources or discard Delay the Inevitable.

all_card.flavor: 勇敢和愚蠢之间只有一线之隔。

all_card.real_flavor: There is a fine line between bravery and foolishness.
all_card.real_text: While you have 5 or more total remaining health and sanity, Steadfast gains [willpower] [combat] (while you have 10 or more total remaining health and sanity, Steadfast gains [willpower] [willpower] [combat] [combat], instead).

你得到+1[combat]。

all_card.real_flavor: Cut to the heart of the matter.

You get +1 [combat].

all_card.real_text: Uses (3 supplies). [action] Exhaust Fingerprint Kit and spend 1 supply: Investigate. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you discover 1 additional clue at your location.

all_card.flavor: 他们曾认为你变得不可理喻。偏执。妄想。但结果证明，你一直以来都是对的。

快速。你发现所在地点的最后一个线索后打出。
发现一个地点的2个线索，该地点的印刷隐藏值须低于你所在地点。
all_card.real_flavor: They thought you were being unreasonable. Paranoid. Delusional. Turns out you were right all along.
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play after you discover the last clue at your location.
Discover 2 clues at a location with a lower printed shroud value than your location.

all_card.flavor: 如果你就是被好奇心害死的那只猫呢？
all_card.name: 好奇心

all_card.real_flavor: What if <u>you</u> are the cat?
all_card.real_text: While you have 4 or more cards in hand, Curiosity gains [willpower] [intellect] (while you have 7 or more cards in hand, Curiosity gains [willpower] [willpower] [intellect] [intellect], instead).

all_card.flavor: 让往事如风，拥抱新生。

all_card.text:
你得到+1[intellect]。

all_card.real_flavor: Let go, and embrace a new truth.
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] When the game begins, if Death • XIII is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

all_card.flavor: 有的时候，有关系比有本事强。

每位调查员仅限1张。
[free]横置良好人脉：你每有5资源，你本次技能检定得到技能值+1。
all_card.real_flavor: Sometimes who you know is more important than how good you are.
all_card.real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] Exhaust Well Connected: You get +1 skill value for this skill test for every 5 resources you have.

all_card.flavor: 钱买不来幸福，但你可以买到除此之外的一切好东西。

all_card.text:
快速。在你发动技能检定时打出。
本次检定不是其标识的技能类型([willpower]、[intellect]、[combat]或[agility])，而是改为资源技能检定。本次检定你的基础技能值等于你资源池内资源数的一半(向下取整)。
all_card.real_flavor: You can't buy happiness, but you can buy pretty much everything else.
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when you initiate a skill test.
Instead of the skill type indicated for this test ([willpower], [intellect], [combat], or [agility]), this is a resource skill test. Your base skill value for this test is equal to half the number of resources in your resource pool (rounded down).

all_card.flavor: “别担心。”她坚持说，“我能搞定这事。”
all_card.name: 狡猾
all_card.text: 你拥有至少5资源时，狡猾获得[intellect][agility](你拥有至少10资源时，改为狡猾获得[intellect][intellect][agility][agility])。
all_card.real_flavor: "Don't worry," she insisted. "I can handle it."
all_card.real_text: While you have 5 or more resources, Cunning gains [intellect] [agility] (while you have 10 or more resources, Cunning gains [intellect] [intellect] [agility] [agility], instead).

all_card.flavor: 张开你的双眼，倾听你的影子。

你得到+1[agility]。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果月亮·XVIII在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
all_card.real_flavor: Open your eyes, and listen to your shadow.
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] When the game begins, if The Moon • XVIII is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

all_card.name: 否决存在
all_card.text: 快速。在遭遇卡牌或敌人攻击将要导致你执行以下一项(选择一项)时打出：弃掉手牌、失去资源、失去行动、受到伤害、受到恐惧。你忽略该效果的影响。(所有其他效果如常结算。)
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play when an encounter card or an enemy attack would cause you to do one of the following (choose one): Discard cards from hand, lose resources, lose actions, take damage, or take horror. You ignore that aspect of the effect. (Each other aspect resolves normally.)

all_card.name: 恐怖灵感
all_card.text:
快速。在你将要结算一张[mystic]卡牌上的效果，且该卡牌有以下触发条件时打出：在[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号揭示时；如果揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号；在[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号揭示后。
取消该效果，或额外结算一次该效果。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when you would resolve an effect on a [mystic] card that triggers "when," "if," or "after" a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed.
Either cancel that effect, or resolve it an additional time.

all_card.flavor: 末日将至。

all_card.real_flavor: The end approaches.
all_card.real_text: While there are 3 or more doom in play, Prophesy gains [wild] (while there are 6 or more doom in play, Prophesy gains [wild] [wild], instead).

all_card.flavor: 找寻你心灵与思绪的清明。
all_card.name: 圣杯四
all_card.text:
你得到+1[willpower]。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果圣杯四在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
all_card.real_flavor: Seek clarity in your heart and mind.
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] When the game begins, if Four of Cups is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

每位调查员仅限1张[[鞋子]]。
你得到+1[agility]。

all_card.real_text:
Limit 1 [[Footwear]] per investigator.
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you move, but before enemies at your new location engage you, exhaust Track Shoes: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, move to a connecting location.

all_card.name: 绝望之举

all_card.real_text: As an additional cost to play Act of Desperation, choose and discard an [[Item]] asset that takes up at least 1 hand slot from your hand or play area. Fight. You get +X [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack, where X is the chosen asset's printed resource cost. If you succeed and that asset was in your play area, gain X resources.

all_card.name: 体格强健

all_card.real_text: While you control 2 or fewer [[Item]] assets, Able Bodied gains [combat] [agility] (while you control 1 or fewer [[Item]] assets, Able Bodied gains [combat] [combat] [agility] [agility], instead).

all_card.flavor: 是时候重新站起来了。

all_card.text:
你得到+1生命值和+1神智值。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果星币五在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
all_card.real_flavor: It is time to rise up again.
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 health and +1 sanity.

all_card.real_flavor: The first twelve were false…
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put The 13th Vision into play in your threat area. Investigators at your location fail ties during skill tests. [action][action]: Discard The 13th Vision.

all_card.name: 高塔·XVI
all_card.text: 高塔·XVI在你手牌中时，你不能在技能检定投入卡牌。 如果冒险设置期间你抽取了高塔·XVI作为你起始手牌(不论在重调之前还是之后)，你不能将其替换。其必须留在你的起始手牌中。
all_card.real_text: You cannot commit cards to skill tests while The Tower • XVI is in your hand. If The Tower • XVI is drawn in your opening hand during setup (before or after taking a mulligan), you cannot replace it. It must stay in your opening hand.

简单/普通
[skull]：-3。如果你检定失败且本次检定为攻击或躲避尝试，结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。

all_card.back_text: 按照以下指示，在剧本日志的“失踪人口”部分，你角色旁记录该角色的命运。然后，将本密谋翻回另一面。 - 如果你因幽灵看守人的攻击而被击败，记录下(角色姓名)被看守人抓走。 - 如果你因[[怪物]]敌人的攻击而被击败，记录下(角色姓名)已被幽灵夺走性命。 - 如果在本密谋推进时，场上至少有7个毁灭标记，且你因密谋1a的强制能力造成的恐惧或伤害被击败，记录下(角色姓名)消失在迷雾之中。 - 如果你因其他任何效果而被击败，记录下(角色姓名)被拉入幽灵国度。
all_card.flavor:
命运无法逃避。
聆听召唤，迎来重生
all_card.name: 审判·XX
all_card.text: 强制 - 在任何卡牌上放置了毁灭标记后：每位调查员必须受到1点伤害或1点恐惧(如果场上有至少5个毁灭标记，改为受到2点伤害或2点恐惧)。 强制 - 在任何调查员被击败时，该调查员必须推进此密谋。在本密谋推进时，不要移除其上任何毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_text: In the "Missing Persons" section of your Campaign Log, next to your character's profile, make a record of that character's fate, as follows. Then flip this agenda back over. - If you were defeated by The Spectral Watcher's attack, record (character's name) was taken by the Watcher. - If you were defeated by a [[Monster]] enemy's attack, record (character's name) was claimed by specters. - If there was 7 or more doom in play when this agenda advanced, and you were defeated by horror or damage dealt by the Forced ability on agenda 1a, record (character's name) disappeared into the mist. - If you were defeated by any other effect, record(character's name) was pulled into the spectral realm.
all_card.real_flavor:
THERE IS NO ESCAPING FATE.
HEAR THE CALL AND BE REBORN.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After doom is placed on any card: Each investigator must either take 1 damage or 1 horror (2 damage or 2 horror instead if there is 5 or more doom in play). Forced - When any investigator is defeated, that investigator must advance this agenda. Do not remove any doom from this agenda when it advances.

all_card.real_back_flavor:
SHADOWS TWIST IN AETHER'S COIL
THE GATE HAS LED US ALL ASTRAY
DESPAIR LOATHES A BEATING HEART
DEAD OR LIVING, WE CANNOT SAY
BLACKEST THRONE IN THE VOID OF SPACE

all_card.real_back_text: Record in your Campaign Log you are being hunted. Flip back to Act 1a.
all_card.real_flavor: Something terrible has invaded the home of Josef Meiger. In the moments that follow, you scramble to survive.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When an investigator is eliminated: Place each of that investigator's clues on this act instead of his or her location. Objective - Discover as many clues as you can before your inevitable demise.

all_card.back_flavor: 加弗瑞拉·米兹拉克曾是军事组织哈加纳的成员，现在的工作是富人家的私人保安，约瑟夫·梅吉尔——一个高度重视保密性的人——为了确保今晚的盛会不出差错而雇佣了加弗瑞拉。但即便是加弗瑞拉，也无法应对即将发生的事情。
all_card.back_text: 冒险设置：你从维多利亚式宴会厅开始游戏。在幽灵看守人上放置1点伤害。查找收齐的卡牌，找出1张愚人的命运，将其放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。游戏开始时你不获得5资源，改为获得1资源。 起始游戏区域：带有2个子弹标记的.45自动手枪(基础16)、体能训练(基础17)。 起始手牌：急救(基础19)、看门狗(基础21)、证据！(基础22)、闪躲(基础23)、多余的弹药(等级1)(基础26)、2张劫数延后(万象无终21)。
all_card.name: 加弗瑞拉·米兹拉克
all_card.text:
[reaction]敌人攻击你后，即便该次攻击被取消：发现你所在地点的1个线索。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。治愈1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A former member of the Haganah, Gavriella Mizrah now works private security for wealthy homeowners. Josef Meiger - a man who takes confidentiality quite seriously - has retained Gavriella to make sure there are no problems during tonight's event. But even she is not prepared for what is to come.
all_card.real_back_text: Setup: You begin play in the Victorian Halls. Place 1 damage on The Spectral Watcher. Search the gathered cards for 1 copy of Fate of All Fools and put it into play in your threat area. You begin with 1 resource instead of 5. Starting Play Area: .45 Automatic (Core 16) with 2 ammo tokens remaining, Physical Training (Core 17). Opening Hand: First Aid (Core 19), Guard Dog (Core 21), Evidence! (Core 22), Dodge (Core 23), Extra Ammunition (level 1) (Core 26), 2 copies of Delay the Inevitable (TCU 21).
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] After an enemy attacks you, even if that attack was canceled: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Heal 1 damage and 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 杰罗姆是约瑟夫·梅吉尔的私人助理和秘书。他是约瑟夫的一位密友，同时也是银暮秘社的一名杰出成员。他帮梅吉尔打理庄园的巨额财产、管理时间，但最近梅吉尔的时间变得越来越宝贵了。
all_card.back_text: 冒险设置：你从办公室开始游戏。查找收齐的卡牌，找出1张冥府之雾和1张朦胧之雾。将冥府之雾生成在办公室，将朦胧之雾附属到办公室。游戏开始时你不获得5资源，改为获得3资源。 起始游戏区域：无卡牌。 起始手牌：超感知(基础34)、心胜于物(基础36)、专业的直觉(基础37)、屏障(基础38)、推理(基础39)、放大镜(等级1)(基础40)、指纹采集工具(万象无终24)、串联线索(万象无终25)、2张好奇心(万象无终26)。
all_card.name: 杰罗姆·戴维斯
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你地点的调查员从遭遇牌库抽出诡计时，弃掉你总计至少带有2个[intellect]图标的手牌：取消该卡片的显现效果。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。发现你所在地点的1个线索。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Jerome is Josef Meiger's personal assistant and secretary. He is a close friend of Josef's and is also an upstanding member of the Silver Twilight Lodge. He helps keep the Meiger estate's vast finances in order and manages Josef's time, which has become increasingly precious of late.
all_card.real_back_text: Setup: You begin play in the Office. Search the gathered cards for 1 copy of Nether Mist and 1 copy of Obscuring Fog. Spawn the Nether Mist in the Office and attach Obscuring Fog to the Office. You begin with 3 resources instead of 5. Starting Play Area: Nothing. Opening Hand: Hyperawareness (Core 34), Mind over Matter (Core 36), Working a Hunch (Core 37), Barricade (Core 38), Deduction (Core 39), Magnifying Glass (level 1) (Core 40), Fingerprint Kit (TCU 24), Connect the Dots (TCU 25), 2 copies of Curiosity (TCU 26).
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] When an investigator at your location draws a treachery from the encounter deck, discard cards from your hand with a total of at least 2 [intellect] icons: Cancel that card's revelation effect. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Discover 1 clue at your location.

all_card.back_flavor: “蒂诺”是一位富有的慈善家，也是今晚最受尊敬的宾客之一。瓦伦蒂诺得到了一笔可观的意外之财后，过着奢靡而逸乐的生活。他虽有万贯家财，但还是跟普罗大众保持着良好的关系，乐于将大笔金钱捐献给公益事业。
all_card.back_text: 冒险设置：你从台球室开始游戏。查找收齐的卡牌，找出1张暗影猎犬和1张恐怖夜色。将暗影猎犬生成并与你交战，将恐怖夜色放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。游戏开始时你不获得5资源，改为获得10资源。 起始游戏区域：良好人脉(万象无终28)。 起始手牌：.41短口手枪(基础47)、机会主义者(基础53)、老千手法(等级3)(基础56)、2张金钱万能(万象无终29)、2张狡猾(万象无终30)。
all_card.name: 瓦伦蒂诺·里瓦斯
all_card.text:
[free]在你执行的技能检定期间，花费2资源：本次检定难度降低1点。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。获得2资源。
all_card.traits: 银暮秘社. 社会名流
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Tino" is a wealthy philanthropist and one of tonight's most esteemed guests. The recipient of a fortuitous windfall, Valentino lives a life of luxury and recreation. Despite his wealth, he remains connected to his community, and he takes great joy in giving large sums of money to good causes.
all_card.real_back_text: Setup: You begin play in the Billiards Room. Search the gathered cards for 1 copy of Shadow Hound and 1 copy of Terror in the Night. Spawn the Shadow Hound engaged with you and put Terror in the Night into play next to the agenda deck. You begin with 10 resources instead of 5. Starting Play Area: Well Connected (TCU 28). Opening Hand: .41 Derringer (Core 47), Opportunist (Core 53), Sure Gamble (level 3) (Core 56), 2 copies of Money Talks (TCU 29), 2 copies of Cunning (TCU 30).
all_card.real_text:
[fast] During a skill test you are performing, spend 2 resources: Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Gain 2 resources.

all_card.back_flavor: 佩妮·怀特是梅吉尔庄园的管家领班。她在梅吉尔庄园工作了好几年。尽管她只和约瑟夫交谈过寥寥数次，但他过分挑剔的性格令佩妮总是忙得停不下来。今晚，她的任务是保持这座庄园一尘不染、饭菜温热、给客人的酒杯里斟上私酒。
all_card.back_text: 冒险设置：你从露台开始游戏。查找收齐的卡牌，找出1张怨灵和1张黑暗中的低语。将怨灵生成并与你交战，将黑暗中的低语放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。游戏开始时你不获得5资源，改为获得2资源。 起始游戏区域：深挖(基础77)、刀子(基础86)、带有2个补给标记的手电筒(基础87)。 起始手牌：野猫(基础76)、运气好！(基础80)、刀子(基础86)、手电筒(基础87)、2张绝望之举(万象无终37)、2张体格强健(万象无终38)。
all_card.name: 佩妮·怀特
all_card.text:
[reaction]你在显现效果期间的技能检定成功后：发现你所在地点的一个线索。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。如果本次技能检定在显现效果期间，则在你下个回合期间，你可以进行额外一次行动。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Penny White is the Meiger estate's head housekeeper. She has been working in the Meiger estate for several years. Though she has only spoken with Josef a few times, his overly fastidious nature has kept her quite busy. Tonight, she is tasked with keeping the manor spotless, the food hot, and the hooch flowing.
all_card.real_back_text: Setup: You begin play at the Balcony. Search the gathered cards for 1 copy of Wraith and 1 copy of Whispers in the Dark. Spawn the Wraith engaged with you and put Whispers in the Dark into play next to the agenda deck. You begin with 2 resources instead of 5. Starting Play Area: Dig Deep (Core 77), Knife (Core 86), Flashlight (Core 87) with 2 supply tokens remaining. Opening Hand: Stray Cat (Core 76), Lucky! (Core 80), Knife (Core 86), Flashlight (Core 87), 2 copies of Act of Desperation (TCU 37), 2 copies of Able Bodied (TCU 38).
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test during a revelation effect: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If this is a skill test during a revelation effect, you may take an additional action during your next turn.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-2。从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌，弃掉的张数等于本次检定的难度。
[tablet]：-2。如果你检定失败，在本次检定结算后，抽取遭遇弃牌堆最底部的1张诡计。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你检定失败，重整你所在地点和连接地点的每个[[女巫]]敌人。治愈这些敌人全部伤害。
all_card.name: 巫异时刻
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-1。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，弃掉遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。
[tablet]：-1。如果你检定失败，在本次检定结算后，抽取遭遇弃牌堆最底部的1张诡计。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，选择你所在地点或连接地点的一个已横置或已受到伤害的[[女巫]]敌人。重整该敌人并治愈其全部伤害。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck equal to this test's difficulty.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, after this test resolves, draw the bottommost treachery in the encounter discard pile.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, ready each [[Witch]] enemy at your location and at each connecting location. Heal all damage from each of those enemies.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1. For each point you fail by, discard the top card of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -1. If you fail, after this test resolves, draw the bottommost treachery in the encounter discard pile.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, choose an exhausted or damaged [[Witch]] enemy at your location or at a connecting location. Ready that enemy and heal all damage from it.

all_card.back_flavor:
夜空中的月亮上升到了最高处。树木在微风中摇摆，如水般温柔，如雾般轻盈。一群群鸟儿从每棵树的树顶上飞散开来。在远处，你能听见一阵微弱的旋律，微风让其音高变低。
一个身着长袍的身影从灌木丛另一头的黑暗里出现，她脚下汇聚了一个神奇的能量漩涡。“打扰我们的就是你吗？”她大声间道，从她厚厚的兜帽下向你投来怀疑的目光。“不论是不是你，这里不欢迎你。”她威胁道，“快滚，不然有你好看的。”
all_card.back_text: 从遭遇牌库弃掉卡牌，弃至剩下5张卡牌。游戏区域有最多卡牌的调查员必须抽取遭遇弃牌堆最顶上的一张[[女巫]]敌人。
all_card.flavor:
保持冷静，你会看到未定的未来。
宇宙的平衡已经倾斜。
你正是支点。
耐心等待，一切都将会显现。
all_card.name: 节制•XIV
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The moon reaches the height of its arc in the night sky. The trees begin to shift and twist in the breeze, as though made of something other than solid matter. Dozens of birds suddenly scatter from every treetop. In the distance, you can hear a faint melody, the pitch blending in the wind.
A cloaked figure emerges from the darkness beyond the brush, a vortex of magical energy coalescing at her feet. "Are you the ones who have been meddling with our works?" she wonders aloud, gazing at you suspiciously from underneath her thick hood. "It is no matter. You are not welcome here," she threatens. "Begone, or face the consequences."
all_card.real_back_text: Discard all but the last 5 cards from the encounter deck. The investigator with the most cards in his or her play area must draw the topmost [[Witch]] enemy in the encounter discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor:
REMAIN CALM AND YOU MAY PEER INTO AN UNCERTAIN FUTURE.
THE BALANCE OF THE UNIVERSE HAS TILTED.
YOU ARE THE FULCRUM.
BE PATIENT, AND ALL WILL BE REVEALED.

all_card.back_flavor: 空中一道闪电伴随着震耳欲聋的雷声劈落，这声音响彻整片森林。大地在颤抖，狂风在你周围呼号，其中夹杂着尖叫声，像是有人遭受了痛苦而凄惨的折磨。此时长笛乐声响起。
all_card.back_text: 每位存活的调查员被击败，且必须查找收藏，随机找出一张基础[[征兆]]或[[诅咒]]弱点，将它加入自己的牌库。每位不能这么做的调查员改为承受1点精神创伤。
all_card.flavor: 午夜渐近，森林开始显现出另一副样貌。一顶黑暗的天篷掩盖了星辰。风越吹越烈，呼啸声在树木之间回荡。一股危险的力量在森林深处凝聚，会被吸引前去的不是奸徒就是傻子。
all_card.name: 深夜号叫
all_card.text: 强制 - 当一轮结束时：女巫圆环每有一个[[女巫]]敌人，在本密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A column of lightning flashes in the sky, coupled with an earsplitting clap of thunder that resounds throughout the woods. The earth trembles, and the wind howls as it rushes all around you, intermingled with what sounds like the screaming and shrieking of somebody torn in anguish and misery. That is when the flutes begin to play.
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and must search the collection for a random basic [[Omen]] or [[Curse]] weakness and add it to his or her deck. Each investigator who cannot suffers 1 mental trauma instead.
all_card.real_flavor: As midnight draws nearer, the forest begins to take on another form. A canopy of darkness overtakes the stars. The wind picks up in intensity, its whistling echoing through the trees. A dangerous power gathers deep within the woods, drawing only the foul and the foolish.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 doom on this agenda for each [[Witch]] enemy at the Witches' Circle.

all_card.back_flavor: 雨停了之后，浓雾笼罩着这整片区域。很快，所有的树木都在这朦胧的雾中消失了。你大声呼叫自己的同伴，但无人应答。你在迷雾里盲目摸索，寻找能够依靠的东西，什么东西都可以。
all_card.back_text:
每位调查员必须随机选择1张放在一边的阿卡姆密林地点里，将其放置入场，放到自己面前，并且立即移动到该地点(不能取消)。
每位调查员将放在一边的一个黑山羊眷族生成到自己所在地点(如果是4人游戏，改为调查员队长将放在一边的一个坚韧的黑山羊幼崽生成，其他每位调查员将放在一边的一个黑山羊眷族生成)。然后每位调查员检定[willpower]或[agility](3)。检定成功的每位调查员横置与自己交战的该敌人并且解除交战。
将放在一边的1张魔鬼的笛声洗入遭遇牌库。将另外2张魔鬼的笛声放到遭遇弃牌堆。
all_card.flavor: 你在阿卡姆南部的森林里独自醒来。神秘的预言者已经消失了踪影。你从泥泞的小路上爬了起来，试图认清方向。一种沉重的压迫感悬在上空。
all_card.name: 森林迷途
all_card.text: 你面前的地点均相互连接。你不能进入其他调查员面前的地点。 目标 - 当一轮结束时，调查员可以以团队为单位，花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As the rain lets up, a dense fog rolls in throughout the area. Soon all of the woods have vanished within the hazy fog. You call out for your companions, but none answer. You grope blindly in the haze, searching for something, anything to which you can cling.
all_card.real_back_text:
Each investigator must randomly choose 1 of the set-aside Arkham Woods locations, put it into play in front of him or her, and immediately move to that location (cannot be canceled).
Each investigator spawns a set-aside Goat Spawn at his or her location (if there are 4 investigators in the game, the lead investigator spawns the set-aside Relentless Dark Young, and each other investigator spawns a set-aside Goat Spawn, instead). Each investigator then tests [willpower] or [agility] (3). Each investigator who succeeds exhausts that enemy and disengages from it.
Shuffle one of the set-aside copies of Daemonic Piping into the encounter deck. Place the other two copies in the encounter discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: You have awakened alone deep in the woods south of Arkham. The mysterious soothsayer is nowhere to be seen. You rise up from the muddy trail and try to find your bearings. An oppressive weight hangs in the air.
all_card.real_text: Locations in front of you are connected to one another. You cannot enter locations in front of other investigators. Objective - At the end of the round, investigators may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你在树林里搜寻答案——或者说是在找一条引领你回家的道路——这时你被迷人心神的清脆笛声所吸引，走到了一条足迹斑驳的小路上。你深入朦胧、潮湿的森林，找寻这怪异乐声是从何处传出的。终于，你来到了一块雾蒙蒙的空地上，中央有一根腐烂的树桩。树桩上躺着一根老旧但精心雕琢的木笛，无声地哀求着你靠近。你甫一碰到那乐器，吸引你来到这里的笛曲戛然而止，一阵突如其来的微风将你四周的浓雾吹散。
all_card.back_text: 在本场冒险接下来的时间里，调查员可以进入其他调查员面前的地点。
all_card.flavor: 不论在这片森林里进行的是什么神秘仪式，你前所未见的各式凶兽已被此处吸引了注意力。这就是占卜师向你示警的原因吗？
all_card.name: 女巫作祟
all_card.text: 你面前的地点均相互连接。你不能进入其他调查员面前的地点。 目标 - 如果有一位调查员花费所需数量的线索，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you scour the woods for answers - or a path that will lead you back home - you find yourself drawn off the beaten trail by a mesmerizing melody of silvery pipes. Deeper into the damp, hazy woodland you delve, searching for the source of the strange music. Finally, you come upon a foggy clearing, at the center of which lies a half-rotted tree stump. An old but delicately carved wooden flute lies atop the stump, silently beseeching you to approach. The moment you touch the instrument, the piping melody that lured you here is cut short, and the dense fog around you disperses with a sudden breeze.
all_card.real_back_text: For the remainder of the scenario, investigators may now enter locations in front of other investigators.
all_card.real_flavor: Whatever arcane rites are being practiced in these woods, they are attracting the attention of all manner of vile beasts, the likes of which you have never seen. Is this what the soothsayer was trying to warn you about?
all_card.real_text: Locations in front of you are connected to one another. You cannot enter locations in front of other investigators. Objective - If a single investigator spends the requisite number of clues, advance.

all_card.flavor: 伴随着奇怪的浓雾散去，你现在可以探索森林了。你找不到通往住宅区的主道，但这正是你了解女巫仪式的机会。
all_card.name: 通向曙光
all_card.text: 你面前的地点均相互连接。
all_card.real_flavor: With the strange fog dispersed, you are now able to explore the woods. You are unable to find the main path that leads back to Uptown, but this is your chance to discover more about the ritual the witches are conducting.
all_card.real_text: Locations in front of you are connected to one another.

all_card.name: 女巫圆环
all_card.text: 显现 - 将女巫圆环放置入场，位于游戏区域中央，不在任何调查员面前。调查员队长将放在一边的安妮特·梅森生成在女巫圆环。 强制 - 在敌军阶段开始后：所有处在重整状态且未交战的[[女巫]]敌人向女巫圆环移动一次。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put the Witches' Circle into play in the center of the play area, in front of none of the investigators. The lead investigator spawns the set-aside Anette Mason at the Witches' Circle. Forced - After the enemy phase begins: Move each ready, unengaged [[Witch]] enemy once toward the Witches' Circle.

all_card.back_text:
如果你通过击败安妮特·梅森推进场景：
“住手！”女巫集会的领导者以命令的语气喝道，表情因为你造成的伤口而痛苦扭曲。你不确定她是喝止你还是喝止包围你的那群兜帽女子，但无论如何，圆环四周突然陷入了寂静。
(→结局1)
如果你通过发现女巫圆环的所有线索推进场景：
一阵巨大的爆裂声响彻树林，你打破了女巫圆环并且逆转了女巫的巫术。“不！他们破坏了仪式！”一名遭到巫术力量反噬的女巫尖叫道。炙热的白色闪电击中了场地中央，尘土与残骸向各个方向飞散。你在掩体后躲了起来。
(→结局2)
all_card.flavor: 你来到了一片空地，上面搭有一个仪式圆环。几个戴着兜帽的人木然站在圆环周围，并未发现你。一个身材健壮的女人在检查仪式，她看见你来到，挥舞起一把长长的，波浪形的匕首。“马上离开这儿！”她命令道。
all_card.name: 未毁之环
all_card.text: 你面前的地点均相互连接。 目标 - 如果安妮特·梅森被击败，推进场景。 目标 - 如果女巫圆环上没有线索，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If you advanced by defeating Anette Mason:
"Stop!" the coven's leader yells in a commanding voice, grimacing from the wounds you've inflicted. You're not sure if she's speaking to you or to the hooded women surrounding you, but regardless, there is a sudden stillness in the clearing around the circle
(→R1)
If you advanced by discovering all of the clues in the Witches' Circle:
A loud crack echoes throughout the woods as you break the circle and reverse the witches' spell. "No! They have broken the ritual!" one of the witches screams as the spell's energy backfires. White-hot lightning strikes the center of the field, sending dirt and debris flying in every direction. You duck for cover.
(→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: You come across a clearing where a ritual circle has been constructed. Several hooded figures stand around it in a trance, unaware of your presence. Overlooking the ritual is a powerfully built woman who brandishes a long wavy dagger as she sees you approach. "Leave this place at once!" she commands.
all_card.real_text: Locations in front of you are connected to one another. Objective - If Anette Mason is defeated, advance. Objective - If there are no clues on the Witches' Circle, advance.

all_card.flavor: “过来吧，姐妹们。我们的时候到了。”
all_card.name: 安妮特·梅森
all_card.text: 反击。 强制 - 在敌军阶段开始后：弃掉遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。将因本效果弃掉的所有[[女巫]]敌人生成在安妮特·梅森所在的地点。如果没有因本效果弃掉的[[女巫]]敌人，重整安妮特·梅森。
all_card.traits: 类人. 女巫. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "Come, sisters. Our time is now."
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. Forced - After the enemy phase begins: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Spawn each [[Witch]] enemy discarded by this effect at Anette Mason's location. If no [[Witch]] enemies are discarded by this effect, ready her.

all_card.back_flavor: 你向着阿卡姆城外有女巫作祟的树林步步深入时，寒风在你身边呼啸。
all_card.name: 女巫作祟之林
all_card.text:
你拥有3到10点资源时不能调查本地点。
[free]：选择位于另一处女巫作祟之林的一位调查员。将你最多3点资源移动到该调查员的资源池；或者反过来将该调查员的最多3点资源移动到你的资源池。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The frigid wind howls around you as you venture deeper into the haunted woods beyond Arkham.

all_card.back_flavor: 你向着阿卡姆城外有女巫作祟的树林步步深入时，寒风在你身边呼啸。
all_card.flavor: 他们是标记了一处墓地吗？抑或是更邪恶的所在？
all_card.name: 女巫作祟之林
all_card.text: 强制 - 本地点任意数量的线索被发现后：位于本地点的每位调查员失去相等数量的资源。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The frigid wind howls around you as you venture deeper into the haunted woods beyond Arkham.
all_card.real_flavor: Do they mark a grave site? Or something more sinister?
all_card.real_text: Forced - After any number of clues are discovered from this location: Each investigator at this location loses an equal number of resources.

all_card.back_flavor: 你向着阿卡姆城外有女巫作祟的树林步步深入时，寒风在你身边呼啸。
all_card.flavor: 其瘤节遍生、瘦削的外形极为恐怖，树皮上彷佛长着一张张痛苦扭曲的人面。看着就难受。
all_card.name: 女巫作祟之林
all_card.text:
你拥有3到5张手牌时不能调查本地点。
[free]：你选择并弃掉1张手牌，然后在另一处女巫作祟之林的一位调查员抽取1张卡牌；或者该调查员选择并弃掉1张手牌，然后你抽取一张卡牌。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The frigid wind howls around you as you venture deeper into the haunted woods beyond Arkham.
all_card.real_flavor: The ghastly likenesses of tortured figures writhe within its bark, gnarled and emaciated. It is agonizing to look upon.
all_card.real_text:
You cannot investigate this location while you have between 3 and 5 cards in hand.
[fast]: You choose and discard 1 card from your hand, then an investigator at a different Witch-Haunted Woods draws 1 card, or vice versa. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你向着阿卡姆城外有女巫作祟的树林步步深入时，寒风在你身边呼啸。
all_card.name: 女巫作祟之林
all_card.text: 强制 - 在本地点的最后一个线索被发现时：将遭遇弃牌堆最顶部的敌人生成在本地点。(如果遭遇弃牌堆中没有敌人，改为从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌，直到弃掉一个敌人，并生成该敌人。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The frigid wind howls around you as you venture deeper into the haunted woods beyond Arkham.

(If there are no enemies in the encounter discard pile, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded, and spawn that enemy instead.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你向着阿卡姆城外有女巫作祟的树林步步深入时，寒风在你身边呼啸。
all_card.flavor: 这口老井周围的地面只剩几丛草还活着，其他的地方彷佛失去了颜色。
all_card.name: 女巫作祟之林
all_card.text: 位于其他女巫作祟之林地点的每位调查员能够对本地点执行的每次技能检定投入1张卡牌；或者反过来，位于本地点的调查员能够对其他女巫作祟之林地点的每次技能检定投入1张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The frigid wind howls around you as you venture deeper into the haunted woods beyond Arkham.
all_card.real_flavor: A few tufts of grass are all that cling to life around the base of this old well, the rest of the landscape sucked dry of color.
all_card.real_text: Investigators at other Witch-Haunted Woods locations can commit 1 card to each skill test performed at this location, and vice versa.

all_card.back_flavor: 你向着阿卡姆城外有女巫作祟的树林步步深入时，寒风在你身边呼啸。
all_card.flavor: 尽管这条小路数年前便再无人迹，附近一间破房子的阁楼还亮着灯。
all_card.name: 女巫作祟之林
all_card.text: 强制 - 本地点任意数量的线索被发现后：位于本地点的每位调查员必须随机弃掉相等数量的手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The frigid wind howls around you as you venture deeper into the haunted woods beyond Arkham.
all_card.real_flavor: Though this trail was abandoned many years ago, a light still shines in the attic of one of the decrepit houses nearby.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After any number of clues are discovered from this location: Each investigator at this location must discard an equal number of cards at random from his or her hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 你向着阿卡姆城外有女巫作祟的树林步步深入时，寒风在你身边呼啸。
all_card.flavor: 数十年来这座谷仓里什么都没有。至少，据你所知是这样的。
all_card.name: 女巫作祟之林
all_card.text: [reaction]在一个敌人将要生成在另一处女巫作祟之林时：改为将其生成在本地点。然后，该敌人立即对本地点的每位调查员进行一次攻击。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The frigid wind howls around you as you venture deeper into the haunted woods beyond Arkham.
all_card.real_flavor: Nothing has lived inside this barn for decades. At least, as far as you know.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When an enemy would spawn at a different Witch-Haunted Woods: Spawn it at this location instead. Then, it makes an immediate attack against each investigator at this location.

[elder_thing]：-4。如果你所在地点有[[幽灵]]敌人，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.name: 死亡门前
