all_card.back_flavor: 你发现了一些与失踪事件有关的证据，但真相尚不明朗。
all_card.back_text: 调查员团队如果未拥有3[per_investigator]个线索，则失去其所有线索。 调查员团队如果有至少3[per_investigator]个线索，则其必须花费3[per_investigator]个线索，并将放在一边的约瑟夫·梅吉尔敌人生成在除入口大厅以外离所有调查员最远的地点。 打开剧本日志，进入幕间故事I：失踪人口记录。 此幕间故事结束后，移除场上每个地点的所有线索，推进到场景1b。
all_card.flavor:
面对真实的自己，
发现真实的他人。
你必须一视同仁。
你得为自己的行动作出解释。
all_card.name: 正义·XI
all_card.text: [[银暮秘社]]敌人不能被伤害也不能被击败。 强制 - 在你抽取[[怪物]]敌人时：该敌人不生成，改为放在一边，位于场外，并在本密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致本密谋推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You have uncovered some of the evidence pertaining to the disappearances, but the truth has yet to be unveiled.
all_card.real_back_text: If the investigators do not possess 3 [per_investigator] clues as a group, they lose all of their clues. If the investigators possess at least 3 [per_investigator] clues as a group, they must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues and spawn the set-aside Josef Meiger enemy at the location other than the Entry Hall that is farthest from all investigators. Open the Campaign Guide and proceed to Interlude I: A Record of Those Lost. Once this interlude has been resolved, remove all clues from each location in play, and advance to act 1b.
all_card.real_flavor:
BE TRUE TO YOURSELF, AND SEEK THE TRUTH IN OTHERS.
BALANCE THE SCALES.
YOU SHALL BE CALLED TO ACCOUNT FOR YOUR ACTIONS.
all_card.real_text: [[Silver Twilight]] enemies cannot be damaged or defeated. Forced - When you draw a [[Monster]] enemy: Instead of spawning it, set it aside, out of play, and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect can cause this agenda to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 雾气一直从建筑的外墙与地基渗入，充斥了这座庄园的每条走廊。你无法无视雾气里那一张张尖叫的脸孔，许多灵魂被囚禁在雾里痛苦地扭曲着。他们饱受煎熬的声浪穿过了每条走廊，穿透你的心神。一阵疯狂袭上你的心头。你必须赶在你遭到囚禁——跟他们一样——之前逃离这里。你还没反应过来，自己已经奔向了出口。
all_card.back_text: - 调查员如果在场景2，其被囚禁在幽灵国度。(→结局3) - 调查员如果在场景3，其勉强捡回了小命。每位没有撒退的调查员被击败并承承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 这和那四个失踪的人有什么关联？如果有的话，这对你的生存有何意义？
all_card.name: 横跨界限
all_card.text: 每个[[银暮秘社]]敌人获得胜利0，且在敌军阶段如要决定猎手敌人的移动方向，将其视为调查员。 强制 - 在敌军阶段的“猎手敌人移动”步骤后：所有重整状态的[[幽灵]]敌人对同一地点的每个[[类人]]敌人造成等于自己伤害值的伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The mist continues to seep through the walls and the foundation of the building, filling the manor's halls. Inside the mist, you cannot unsee the screaming faces, the twisting torment of the spirits trapped within. Their agony ripples throughout the corridors and pierces your mind. A bout of madness overtakes you. You must escape before you, too, are lost forever. Before you know it, you are running for the exit.
all_card.real_back_text: - If the investigators are at act 2, they are trapped inside the spectral realm. (→R3) - If the investigators are at act 3, they barely escape with their lives. Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: Does this have something to do with the four missing persons? And if so, what does that mean for your survival?
all_card.real_text: Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy gains Victory 0, and counts as an investigator for the purpose of determining where hunter enemies move during the enemy phase. Forced - After the 'hunter enemies move' step of the enemy phase: Each ready [[Spectral]] enemy deals its damage value to each [[Humanoid]] enemy at its location.

all_card.back_flavor: 你还没来得及进一步调查，这座建筑突然陷入了冰冷的黑暗。所有的灯闪了一下就熄灭了。一股异世界的浓雾开始渗入走廊，它碰触到的一切事物都开始衰败腐朽。
all_card.back_text: 将位于入口大厅的每位调查员和每个敌人移动到维多利亚式宴会厅。 对于场上每个地点，从放在一边的卡牌中找出一张该地点的[[幽灵]]版本并替换(原地点上的所有标记和卡牌视为位于新版本地点)。如果该地点上有调查员，将其揭示。 按玩家顺序，每位调查员将1个放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人生成在自己地点，直到所有放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人都已生成。 将放在一边的幽灵看守人敌人生成在入口大厅。将放在一边的看守人遭遇组的剩余卡牌、和放在一边冥界遭遇组的剩余卡牌连同遭遇弃牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你走近梅吉尔庄园的庭院时，一名身着典雅西服的男子站在门边，检查你的邀请函。庭院里的客人们相互交谈，但大多数对话都尴尬又简短。一股沉默的紧张感笼罩着整座庄园，虽然你并不知道原因。
all_card.name: 秘密阴谋
all_card.text: 目标 - 通过发现尽可能多的线索，找到有关失踪事件的信息。(不要推进场景，直到你受到指示。) (提示：失踪人口最后所在的地点或许值得一查。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Before you can investigate further, the building is suddenly plunged into icy darkness. All of the lights flicker once and are snuffed out. A thick, otherworldly mist begins to seep into the corridors, causing everything it touches to decay.
all_card.real_back_text: Move each investigator and each enemy currently in the Entry Hall to the Victorian Halls. For each location in play, find the set-aside [[Spectral]] version of that location and swap them (all tokens and cards at the former location are now considered to be at the new location). If there is an investigator at that location, reveal it. In player order, each investigator spawns one of the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies at his or her location, until each of the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies has been spawned. Spawn the set-aside The Spectral Watcher enemy in the Entry Hall. Shuffle the remainder of the set-aside The Watcher encounter set and the set-aside Realm of Death encounter set into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: As you approach the patio of the Meiger estate, a man in an elegant suit checks your invitation at the door. Inside, guests mingle and chat with one another, but much of the conversation is awkward and terse. A silent tension has gripped the manor, and you are not sure why.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find information about the disappearances by discovering as many clues as you can. (Do not advance until you are instructed.) (Hint: it may be worthwhile to investigate the last known locations of the missing persons.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你找到了被困在这里的另一个人的尸体——你猜测他是银暮秘社的成员，虽然他的蓝色外套和银色兜帽暗示着更为深奥的事物。他干枯的双手里紧紧攥着一本小小的古籍，上面有着秘社的标志。你翻阅这本书，惊讶地发现有关黑雾，以及你遭遇到的所有生物的各种信息，书中还记载着一种能“解开死亡的枷锁”并逃离黑雾的法术。这名男子是什么时候到这儿来研究这个国度的？不管怎样，至少你找到了一个方法……
all_card.back_text:
阻挡你逃离的迷雾渐渐散去。揭示入口大厅。
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 一眨眼的工夫，一切都不一样了。突然，一种压抑的寂静充斥着约瑟夫·梅吉尔庄园的各个厅室。宴会厅里的闲聊声、酒杯相碰的脆响和客人们的笑声都消失了。除了你和其他几个人，这房子里的所有人都消失无踪了。剩下只有黑雾……还有栖身在雾中的生物。
all_card.name: 幽灵国度
all_card.real_back_flavor: You find the corpse of one of the others trapped here - a member of the Silver Twilight Lodge, you surmise, although his outfit of blue and silver robes suggests something more esoteric. Gripped tightly in his withered hands is a small tome bearing the insignia of the Lodge. Browsing through its pages, you are surprised to find all manner of information regarding the mist and the creatures you have encountered, including a spell to "release the bonds of death" and escape the mist. How long has this man been here, studying this realm? Regardless, at least you have a way out now…
all_card.real_back_text:
The mist blocking your escape recedes. Reveal the Entry Hall.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: In the blink of an eye, everything has changed. A sudden, oppressive silence fills the halls of Josef Meiger's manor. Gone is the din of idle chatter from the banquet hall, the clinking of glasses, the laughter of oblivious guests. Save for only you and several others, all of the people in the house have vanished without a trace. All that is left is the dark mist… and the beings that inhabit it.

all_card.back_flavor: 来到这个地方真是大错特错。你为的是发现与庄园的失踪事件有关的线索，而不是让自己沦为受害者。你大步穿过入口大厅，重重摔上庄园沉重的前门，发誓自己要离梅吉尔庄园越远越好。不幸的是，你的计划很快就偏离了轨道。
all_card.flavor: 现在雾已经散去，你可以带着自己的小命逃走……但要把约瑟夫·梅吉尔和其他秘社成员留在这里吗？你会留下来确保他们逃脱，还是自己趁机逃走？
all_card.name: 逃出牢笼
all_card.text: 强制 - 当一轮结束时：位于入口大厅的所有[[银暮秘社]]敌人逃走；将其放在入口大厅底下，位于场外。将所有处于重整状态且带有冷漠关键词的[[银暮秘社]]敌人向入口大厅移动一次。 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Coming to this place was a terrible mistake. You had hoped to uncover evidence pertaining to the disappearances at the estate, not become victims yourselves. As you tear through the entry hall and slam through the manor's heavy front doors, you vow to put as much distance between you and the Meiger estate as you possible can. Unfortunately, your plan is quickly derailed…
all_card.real_flavor: Now that the mist has receded, you might be able to escape with your lives… but what about Josef Meiger and the other Lodge members left behind? Should you stay to make sure they escape, or flee while you have the chance?
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the round: Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in the Entry Hall escapes; place them beneath the Entry Hall, out of play. Move each ready [[Silver Twilight]] enemy with the aloof keyword once toward the Entry Hall. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 不管约瑟夫·梅吉尔掌管的是什么生意，显而易见，他都经营得风生水起。一条柔软的红毯指引着你深入大厅，道路两旁是一些大理石和象牙的小雕像。在走廊上方，一盏大吊灯在抛过光的地板和木质楼梯上投下了璀璨的光芒。
all_card.flavor: 这座庄园的大多地方都禁止宾客进入，银暮秘社的成员除外。但你的调查是第一要务，所以你等着时机溜走……
all_card.name: 入口大厅
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。“我觉得在这儿查不到失踪事件的线索。”
all_card.real_back_flavor: Clearly, whatever business Josef Meiger has his hands in, it's doing well. A soft red carpet guides you deeper into the opulent hall, flanked by small statues of marble and ivory. Above, a glimmering chandelier casts a brilliant shine along the polished floor and wooden stairs.
all_card.real_flavor: Most of the manor is off-limits to guests who are not members of the Silver Twilight Lodge. But your investigation takes priority, so you wait for the right time to sneak away…
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. "I guess there is nothing to those disappearances after all."

all_card.back_flavor: 连这座庄园的每条走廊都极尽奢华，铺着厚厚的地毯，摆放着奇异的艺术品、废旧金属制成的神秘雕像。阿卡姆城外夕阳西下，夕照穿过了窗帘。
all_card.name: 维多利亚式宴会厅
all_card.text: [action]：你这是自找麻烦。从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌，直到弃掉一个[[银暮秘社]]敌人。将该敌人生成在维多利亚式宴会厅。然后，获得2个线索。(从供应堆。)(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Even the hallways of this manor are luxurious, decorated by thick rugs, bizarre artwork, and uncanny statues shaped from scrap metal. Rays of sunlight shine through the curtains as the sun sets over Arkham outside.
all_card.real_text: [action]: You go looking for trouble. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Silver Twilight]] enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy in the Victorian Halls. Then, gain 2 clues (from the token pool). (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 门左右两侧的墙壁上装有两个鹿头，就像在守着入口一般。
all_card.flavor: 这间房的幕墙上装饰有兽首，以及约瑟夫收藏的其他文物。房间中央是一张矮桌，桌上是盛在水晶酒瓶里的白兰地，周围摆着几张填料充实的沙发。
all_card.name: 纪念品陈列室
all_card.text: [action]：你跟其他客人谈了一会儿天。获得2资源，或花费2资源来获得1个线索(从供应堆拿取。)(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Flanking this door are two deer heads mounted along the wall, set almost as though they are guarding its entrance.
all_card.real_flavor: Mounted animal heads adorn this room's paneled walls, along with other artifacts from Josef's collection. Dominating the room are several overstuffed armchairs arranged around a low table bearing a crystal decanter of brandy.
all_card.real_text: [action]: You spend some time schmoozing with the other guests. Either gain 2 resources, or spend 2 resources to gain 1 clue (from the token pool). (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 从房间外面，你能听到人们的谈笑声和台球的碰撞声。
all_card.flavor: 房间正中坐落着一张豪华而闪亮的台球桌，香烟的烟雾在其四周缭绕，被两盏装饰华丽的灯所照亮。零星的几位宾客在台球桌周围放松自己，惬意地与他人谈天或玩台球。
all_card.name: 台球室
all_card.text: [action]：检定[agility](3)来与其他宾客来比一场。如果你检定成功，从供应堆获得1个线索。(从供应堆拿取。)(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: From outside this room, you can hear the telltale clacking of billiard balls clattering against one another, along with idle chatter and laughter.
all_card.real_flavor: A ritzy, polished billiard table lies at the center of this room, surrounded by cigarette smoke and illuminated by two ornate lamps. Several guests relax around the table, casually playing or chatting with one another.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [agility] (3) to compete with the other guests. If you succeed, gain 1 clue (from the token pool). (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 这扇大门上没有标记，擦得锃亮，坐落在楼上走廊的一角，远离宾客和他人的窥视。
all_card.flavor: 毫无疑问，这肯定是约瑟夫·梅吉尔的卧室。房间正中是一张巨大的四柱床，床柱有着精致的雕刻。你看不到梅吉尔夫人的踪影。
all_card.name: 主卧
all_card.text: 强制 - 在一轮结束时，如果主卧里有调查员：在最近的[[银暮秘社]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: This unmarked door is large and well polished, set in a corner of the upstairs hallway out of view of guests and other prying eyes.
all_card.real_flavor: No doubt about it: this must be Josef Meiger's bedroom. The centerpiece of the room is a massive canopy bed, the posts of which are ornately carved. You see no sign of a Mrs. Meiger.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When the round ends, if there is at least 1 investigator in the Master Bedroom: Place 1 doom on the nearest [[Silver Twilight]] enemy.

all_card.back_flavor: 一扇玻璃门敞开着，通往庄园主卧外的露台。
all_card.name: 露台
all_card.text: [action]弃掉你总计至少3个[intellect]图标的手牌：谈判。这里的宾客实际上对银暮秘社有更深的了解。获得2个线索(从供应堆拿取。)。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: An open glass door leads onto the balcony outside the estate's master bedroom.
all_card.real_text: [action] Discard cards from your hand with a total of at least 3 [intellect] icons: Parley. The guest here knows more about the Lodge than they let on. Gain 2 clues (from the token pool). (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 在通往庄园三楼的陡峭楼梯顶上，远离下方派对的喧嚣，一扇伶仃的橡木门在此处守卫着梅吉尔先生最为隐私的秘密。
all_card.back_text: 位于办公室的所有[[银暮秘社]]敌人失去冷漠关键词。
all_card.flavor: 约瑟夫的办公室既展示了他的富有与权力，又是他工作的地方。
all_card.name: 办公室
all_card.text: 位于办公室的每个[[银暮秘社]]敌人失去冷漠。 强制 - 调查办公室时，如果你揭示了一个[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号：在最近的[[银暮秘社]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Atop a steep staircase leading to the manor's third floor, far from the hustle and bustle of the party below, a solitary oak door stands sentry, guarding Mr. Meiger's closest secrets.
all_card.real_back_text: Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in the Office loses aloof.
all_card.real_flavor: Josef's office is as much a display of his wealth and power as it is a workplace
all_card.real_text: Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in the Office lose aloof. Forced - If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol while investigating the Office: Place 1 doom on the nearest [[Silver Twilight]] enemy.

all_card.back_flavor: 一道黑雾壁障封锁了你的出路，将其接触到的一切事物腐化。雾中伸出许多手臂，似幽灵一般向你攫来，拼命想将你拖入其中。你怀疑要是试图穿过这团雾，你没法活着出来。
all_card.back_text: 鬼灵迷雾形成的壁障封锁了入口大厅。你不能进入入口大厅。[[银暮秘社]]敌人不能生成在入口大厅。
all_card.flavor: 黑雾开始消退，而约瑟夫庄园的入口大厅也在雾散后慢慢恢复原样。
all_card.name: 入口大厅
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你从庄园的前门破门而出，逃出了幽灵国度，让其他人自生自灭。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A wall of dark mist blocks your escape, decaying everything it touches. Ghostly hands grasp at you from the mist, desperately trying to pull you in. You suspect that if you tried to cross through the mist, you wouldn't emerge alive.
all_card.real_back_text: The Entry Hall is blocked by a wall of spectral mist. You cannot enter the Entry Hall. [[Silver Twilight]] enemies cannot spawn in the Entry Hall.
all_card.real_flavor: The dark mist begins to recede, and the entry hall to Josef's manor is slowly restored to its original state as the mist dissipates.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You tear through the front doors of the manor, escaping the spectral realm and leaving the remainder of the survivors to their fate.

all_card.back_flavor: 照耀在这些房间里的曾是温暖的阳光，现在变成了冰冷、灰白的月光，穿过漂浮着的尘埃和缕缕黑雾洒落地面。
all_card.flavor: 寒冷、死气沉沉的大厅里萦绕着一股挥之不去的寂静。墙壁上装点的许多油画都已褪色，难以辨认原来的样子，走廊两侧的金属雕像已爬满锈迹。
all_card.name: 维多利亚式宴会厅
all_card.text: 闹鬼 - 失去1个行动。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The warm rays that once illuminated these halls have faded into beams of cold, grey moonlight that shine through floating motes of dust and wisps of dark mist.
all_card.real_flavor: A haunting stillness lingers through the frigid, dead halls. The many paintings that adorn the walls have faded and become unrecognizable, and the metal statuettes flanking the corridors have completed rusted over.
all_card.real_text: Haunted - Lose 1 action.

all_card.back_flavor: 门左右两侧的墙壁上装有两个腐坏的鹿头。它们用了无生气的空洞双眸注视着你。
all_card.flavor: 腐烂的兽首装点在房间的木质幕墙上，这里曾经用于彰显强权，现在展出的主题则已沦为死亡与衰败。你探索房间时，不由得感觉到兽首空洞的目光穿透了你。
all_card.name: 纪念品陈列室
all_card.text: 闹鬼 - 失去2资源。每有1个你不能从本效果失去的资源，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Flanking this door are two rotting deer heads mounted on the wall. They stare at you with hollow, dead eyes.
all_card.real_flavor: Rotting animal heads adorn this room's wood-paneled walls, once a display of power and sovereignty, now macabre displays of death and decay. You cannot help but feel their empty eyes drill through you as you explore the room.
all_card.real_text: Haunted - Lose 2 resources. For each resource you cannot lose from this effect, take 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 从房间外面，你能听到地板上传来旧木头发出的嘎吱嘎吱声和轻柔的脚步声。
all_card.flavor: 台球室的温馨与欢笑变成了一种恐怖的寂静。黑雾如同卷须一般在塌落的台球桌下方蠕动，以一种缥缈无形的舞态在地面上扭曲摇荡。
all_card.name: 台球室
all_card.text: 闹鬼 - 你必须弃掉一个你控制的支援，或受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: From outside this room, you can hear the creaking of old wood and the patter of soft footsteps along the ground.
all_card.real_flavor: The game room's warmth and laughter have been replaced with a sense of quiet dread. Tendrils of black mist slither from underneath the collapsed billiard table, twisting and swaying along the floor in a formless dance.
all_card.real_text: Haunted - You must either discard an asset you control or take 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 这扇老旧的门上没有标识，有部分已经腐烂，静静地坐落在楼上走廊的一角。一阵漆黑的浓雾从门的下方渗出，在你脚边飘动。
all_card.flavor: 黑雾的根须从敞开的露台侵入了这房间的每一个角落，房内的家具开始腐化、垮塌。每块木板和玻璃都已破碎、扭曲。无一幸免。
all_card.name: 主卧
all_card.text: 闹鬼 - 将你的1个线索放到主卧
all_card.real_back_flavor: This unmarked door is old and partially rotted, set in a quiet corner of the upstairs hallway. A thick, dark fog seeps beneath the door and wafts around your feet.
all_card.real_flavor: Tendrils of black mist have invaded every corner of this room from the open balcony doorway, causing the furniture to decay and collapse. Every piece of wood and glass is shattered and warped. Nothing is untouched.
all_card.real_text: Haunted - Place 1 of your clues on Master Bedroom.

all_card.back_flavor: 一扇破碎的玻璃门敞开着，通往庄园主卧外的露台。
all_card.flavor: 黑雾隐约笼罩在法兰西山上。幽灵的身影把露台团团围住，痛苦地扭曲、呻吟。
all_card.name: 露台
all_card.text: 闹鬼 - 你每张带有生命值的卡牌受到1点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A shattered glass door leads onto the balcony outside the estate's master bedroom.
all_card.real_flavor: Clouds of dark mist loom above French Hill. Spectral shapes surround the balcony, moaning and writhing in torment.
all_card.real_text: Haunted - Each of your cards with health takes 1 direct damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 二楼的楼梯顶上是一道门，门腐坏的样子像是经过了数百年。曾经擦得锃亮的橡木现在变得肮脏而扭曲。彷佛随时都会崩塌。
all_card.flavor: 曾经令人印象甚佳的办公室现在充满了难以忍受的浓雾。墙上嵌入的木板上下开裂，约瑟夫办公桌周围的书架不堪重负，被腐烂的书籍压塌。
all_card.name: 办公室
all_card.text: 闹鬼 - 选择并弃掉你一张手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The lone door atop the second-floor staircase has rotted and decayed as though hundreds of years have passed. The once‑polished oak is now stained and warped. It could collapse at any moment.
all_card.real_flavor: A thick, oppressive haze fills what was once an impressive office. Cracks fork up and down the wooden paneling of the walls, and the bookshelves surrounding Josef's desk sag with the weight of rotten, decayed books.
all_card.real_text: Haunted - Choose and discard a card from your hand.

all_card.flavor: “不要唤醒你无法理解的野兽。”
all_card.name: 约瑟夫·梅吉尔
all_card.text: 反击。 [action]如果其他[[银暮秘社]]敌人上没有毁灭标记：谈判。检定[intellect](4)来让约瑟夫相信这不是你干的。如果你检定失败，约瑟夫·梅吉尔攻击你。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面并结算其文本。
all_card.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 银暮秘社. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "Do not rouse the beast you do not comprehend."
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. [action] If no other [[Silver Twilight]] enemy has doom on it: Parley. Test [intellect] (4) to convince Josef that this is not your doing. If you fail, Josef Meiger attacks you. If you succeed, flip this card over and resolve its text.

all_card.flavor:
约瑟夫放下手里的武器，仔细思考你说的话。“或许你说的是真的。但这如果是真的……”他认真考虑这一情况，随后将自己的武器收回枪套，查看怀表，“无论如何，我们时间有限。如果我估算无误，这异象很快就会消失。我们必须赶在那之前离开庄园，否则就要被困在这儿了。”
你问他为什么知道这一切，但他只是摇摇头：“现在不是好时机。要是我们活着离开这儿你再问吧。”
all_card.name: 约瑟夫的计划
all_card.text:
移除本卡牌上的所有毁灭标记。
在本局游戏的剩余时间里，毁灭标记不能被放在[[银暮秘社]]敌人上，约瑟夫·梅吉尔获得冷漠。
将本卡牌翻回敌人面，并与所有调查员解除交战状态。
all_card.real_flavor:
Josef lowers his weapon and studies you for a moment. "Perhaps you are telling the truth. But if that is true…" He ponders the situation, then holsters his weapon and checks his pocket watch. "Regardless, we have little time. If my estimate is correct, the anomaly will recede soon. We must be out of the manor before that occurs, or we'll all be trapped here."
You ask how he knows all of this, but he merely shakes his head. "This is not the time. Ask again if we make it out of here alive."
all_card.real_text:
Remove all doom from this card.
For the remainder of the game, doom cannot be placed on [[Silver Twilight]] enemies, and Josef Meiger gains aloof.
Flip this card back to its enemy side and disengage it from all investigators.

all_card.flavor: 命运无法逃避。
all_card.name: 幽灵看守人
all_card.text: 警戒。猎手。 强制 - 在幽灵看守人被击败时：不将其弃掉，改为治愈其所有伤害，将其与所有调查员解除交战状态并将其横置。本轮补给阶段期间其不重整。
all_card.traits: 古神. 幽灵. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: There is no escaping fate.
all_card.real_text: Alert. Hunter. Forced - When The Spectral Watcher is defeated: Instead of discarding it, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it. It does not ready during the upkeep phase this round.

all_card.name: 看守人的攫噬
all_card.text: 显现 - 治愈幽灵看守人的3点伤害。重整幽灵看守人。其移动、交战并攻击，如同此刻是敌军阶段。结算本效果期间，幽灵看守人获得“猎物 - 你。”
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Heal 3 damage from The Spectral Watcher. Ready The Spectral Watcher. It moves, engages, and attacks as if it were the enemy phase. Throughout the resolution of this effect, The Spectral Watcher gains "Prey - You."

all_card.name: 阿撒托斯的吹笛手
all_card.text: 猎物 - 剩余神智值最低。 警戒。猎手。反击。 强制 - 在敌军阶段结束时：阿撒托斯的吹笛手攻击其所在地点未与其交战的每位调查员(不论其是处于重整状态还是横置状态)。
all_card.real_text: Prey - Least remaining sanity. Alert. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Piper of Azathoth attacks each investigator it is not engaged with at its location (regardless of whether it is ready or exhausted).

all_card.name: 魔鬼的笛声
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 - 如果阿撒托斯的吹笛手在场，对其所在地点和每个连接地点的每位调查员造成1点恐惧。否则，将魔鬼的笛声放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁边。 如果场上有3张魔鬼的笛声，弃掉这3张卡牌，阿撒托斯的吹笛手生成与其猎物交战(从场外的任意区域生成)。
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - If Piper of Azathoth is in play, deal 1 horror to each investigator at its location and at each connecting location. Otherwise, put Daemonic Piping into play next to the agenda deck. If there are 3 copies of Daemonic Piping in play, discard them and spawn the Piper of Azathoth engaged with its prey (from any out of play area).

all_card.flavor: 这群女巫所属的隐秘邪教往往守护着惊人的秘密，并且将这源于被遗忘的远古年代的秘密继续流传下去…… <cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《女巫屋中之梦》</cite>
all_card.name: 女巫集会学徒
all_card.text: 显现 - 弃掉遭遇牌库顶2张卡牌。如果本效果导致遭遇牌库的卡牌耗尽，抽取遭遇弃牌堆最顶部的[[巫术]]卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: The hidden cults to which these witches belonged often guarded and handed down surprising secrets from elder, forgotten aeons… - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dreams in the Witch House</u>
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. If this effect causes the encounter deck to run out of cards, draw the topmost [[Hex]] card in the encounter discard pile.

all_card.name: 女巫集会的女祭司
all_card.text: 反击。 遭遇弃牌堆每有1个[[女巫]]敌人，女巫集会的女祭司得到+1攻击和+1躲避(最多+3攻击和+3躲避)。 强制 - 在遭遇牌库的卡牌耗尽时：女巫集会的女祭司重整并攻击其所在地点的每位调查员。
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. Priestess of the Coven gets +1 fight and +1 evade for each [[Witch]] enemy in the encounter discard pile (to a maximum of +3 fight and +3 evade). Forced - When the encounter deck runs out of cards: Priestess of the Coven readies and attacks each investigator at its location.

all_card.flavor: 地狱般的恸哭和咯格的笑声在你脑海里不停响起。
all_card.name: 恶魔之音
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，随机弃掉一张手牌。你每有一张卡牌无法弃掉，受到1点恐惧或1点伤害。遭遇弃牌中每有1张恶魔之音，本次检定难度+1。
all_card.real_flavor: The infernal wailing and cackling rattle endlessly through your mind.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, discard 1 random card from your hand. For each card you cannot discard, take 1 horror or 1 damage. This test gets +1 difficulty for each copy of Diabolic Voices in the encounter discard pile.

all_card.name: 崩毁离析
all_card.text: 显现 - 将崩毁离析放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 每轮你执行的第一次技能检定期间，你得到每项技能值-1。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉崩毁离析。如果你所在地点有处于横置状态的[[女巫]]敌人，本次检定自动成功。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Wracked into play in your threat area. You get -1 to each of your skills during the first skill test you perform each round. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Wracked. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.

all_card.name: 苦痛折磨
all_card.text: 显现 - 将苦痛折磨放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你不能触发你控制的卡牌上的[action]能力。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉苦痛折磨。如果你所在地点有处于横置状态的[[女巫]]敌人，本次检定自动成功。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Bedeviled into play in your threat area. You cannot trigger [action] abilities on cards you control. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Bedeviled. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.

all_card.name: 秘社新信徒
all_card.text: 生成 - 任意无人地点。 冷漠。 强制 - 在秘社新信徒入场后：在上面放置1个毁灭标记。 [action]：谈判。检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定成功，移除秘社新信徒上的所有毁灭标记。
all_card.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 银暮秘社
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Any empty location. Aloof. Forced - After Lodge Neophyte enters play: Place 1 doom on it. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (2). If you succeed, remove all doom from Lodge Neophyte.

all_card.name: 守密人
all_card.text: 生成 - 任意无人地点。 冷漠。反击。 强制 - 在神话阶段结束时：在守密人上放置1个毁灭标记。 [action]：谈判。检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，移除守密人上的所有毁灭标记。
all_card.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 银暮秘社
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Any empty location. Aloof. Retaliate. Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Place 1 doom on Keeper of Secrets. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, remove all doom from Keeper of Secrets.

all_card.name: 秘社玄仪
all_card.text: 显现 - 在最近的一个[[异教徒]]敌人身上放置1个毁灭标记。然后，直到一轮结束，对该敌人攻击、躲避或与该敌人谈判的难度加2。如果未因本效果放置毁灭标记，秘社玄仪获得涌动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy. Then, until the end of the round, increase the difficulty to fight, evade, or parley with that enemy by 2. If no doom is placed by this effect, Mysteries of the Lodge gains surge.

all_card.name: 邪恶往昔
all_card.text: 显现 -  如果你的威胁区域里没有邪恶往昔，将邪恶往昔放置入场，位于你的威胁区域(如果已有邪恶往昔，改为将本卡牌弃掉并获得涌动)。 强制 - 在遭遇牌库的卡牌耗尽时：受到2点恐惧并检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉邪恶往昔。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Evil Past into play in your threat area if there is no copy of it in your threat area (if there is, discard Evil Past and it gains surge instead). Forced - When the encounter deck runs out of cards: Take 2 horror and test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Evil Past.

all_card.flavor: 或许这些疑团还是不让别人知道更好。
all_card.name: 百年秘事
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](5)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，弃掉遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。如果本效果弃掉了[[诅咒]]诡计，对你的调查员和你的每个[[盟友]]支援造成1点直接伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: Perhaps these mysteries are better left unknown.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If a [[Curse]] treachery is discarded by this effect, deal 1 direct damage to your investigator and to each of your [[Ally]] assets.

all_card.flavor: 我们为死者发愿，但我们真的想见到他们吗？
all_card.name: 冥府之雾
all_card.text: 猎物 - 所在地点线索最多的调查员。 冷漠。猎手。 冥府之雾所在地点获得：“闹鬼 - 冥府之雾攻击你。”
all_card.real_flavor: We beseech the dead, but do we really wish to see them?
all_card.real_text: Prey - Investigator at the location with the most clues. Aloof. Hunter. Nether Mist's location gains: "Haunted - Nether Mist attacks you."

all_card.flavor: 鬼灵迷雾融合成了一个犬形灵体。饥饿的双眼在黑暗中闪烁着。
all_card.name: 暗影猎犬
all_card.text: 猎物 - [agility]最低。 猎手。反击。 强制 - 在暗影猎犬攻击你后：结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
all_card.real_flavor: The spectral mist coalesces into an incorporeal canine form. Hungry eyes shine from the darkness.
all_card.real_text: Prey - Lowest [agility]. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After Shadow Hound attacks you: Resolve each haunted ability on your location.

all_card.flavor: 嘘，孩子。很快就会结束了。
all_card.name: 黑暗中的低语
all_card.text: 显现 - 将黑暗中的低语放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁边。 每个地点获得：“闹鬼 - 受到1点恐惧。” 强制 - 在一轮结束时：弃掉黑暗中的低语。
all_card.real_flavor: Hush, child. It will all be over soon.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Whispers in the Dark into play next to the agenda deck. Each location gains: "Haunted - Take 1 horror." Forced - When the round ends: Discard Whispers in the Dark.

all_card.name: 怨灵
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在怨灵因(除[[法术]]或[[遗物]]以外的)伤害而被击败时：不将其弃掉，改为将其附属到其所在地点。被附属的地点获得：“闹鬼 - 将怨灵生成在本地点。”
all_card.traits: 怪物. 灵怪. 幽灵
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When Wraith is defeated by damage (except from a [[Spell]] or [[Relic]]): Instead of discarding it, attach it to its location. Attached location gains: "Haunted - Spawn Wraith at this location."

all_card.name: 被困的灵魂
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害。如果你所在地点闹鬼，一位调查员如要在本次技能检定投入1张或多张卡牌，作为额外费用，该调查员必须结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 damage. If your location is haunted, as an additional cost for an investigator to commit 1 or more cards to this skill test, he or she must resolve each haunted ability on this location.

all_card.name: 苦痛之地
all_card.text: 显现 - 将苦痛之地放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 在你的回合开始时：结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。 强制 - 在你的回合结束时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉苦痛之地。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Realm of Torment into play in your threat area. Forced - When your turn begins: Resolve each haunted ability on your location. Forced - When your turn ends: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Realm of Torment.

all_card.flavor: 那是……不，不可能。这只是我的想象。没错。
all_card.name: 雾中身形
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 - 结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
all_card.real_flavor: Is that… no, it can't be. Just my imagination. Surely.
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Resolve each haunted ability on your location.

all_card.name: 恐怖夜色
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](4)。如果你失败，将恐怖夜色放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，恐怖夜色获得涌动。 如果密谋牌库旁有3张恐怖夜色，将其全部弃掉，每位调查员受到3点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, put Terror in the Night into play next to the agenda deck. If you fail by 3 or more, Terror in the Night gains surge. If there are 3 copies of Terror in the Night next to the agenda deck, discard them and each investigator takes 3 horror.

all_card.name: 愚人的命运
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 如果场上没有其他愚人的命运，将愚人的命运放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 - 威胁区域中有另一张愚人的命运的一位调查员受到2点直接伤害。 - 在另一张愚人的命运上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - If there is no other copy of Fate of All Fools in play, put Fate of All Fools into play in your threat area. - An investigator with another copy of Fate of All Fools in his or her threat area takes 2 direct damage. - Place 1 doom on another copy of Fate of All Fools.

all_card.flavor: 我不能死在这儿。现在不能，还不能。
all_card.name: 赴汤蹈火
all_card.text: 你所在地点的其他调查员受到的恐惧可以分配给赴汤蹈火。
all_card.real_flavor: I can't die here. Not now. Not yet.
all_card.real_text: Something Worth Fighting For may be assigned horror dealt to other investigators at your location.

all_card.flavor:
“……当你排除掉一切不可能的情况后，不论剩下的有多不可思议，都一定是真相。”
——阿瑟·柯南·道尔，《白化士兵》
all_card.name: 水落石出
all_card.text:
快速。一位调查员发现你所在地点的最后一个线索后打出。
位于该地点的调查员获得总计X资源，由你自行分配。X为该地点的隐藏值。
all_card.real_flavor: "…when you have eliminated all which is impossible, then whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth." <cite>Arthur Conan Doyle, "The Adventure of the Blanched Soldier"</cite>
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play after an investigator discovers the last remaining clue at your location.
Investigators at that location gain a total of X resources, distributed as you wish. X is that location's shroud value.

all_card.name: 情报报告
all_card.text:
发现你所在地点的1个线索。
[reaction]在你打出情报报告时，提升其费用2点：“发现……的1个线索”变为“发现……的2个线索”。
[reaction]在你打出情报报告时，提升其费用2点：“你所在地点”变为“与你所在地点之间连接次数不超过2的地点”
all_card.real_text:
Discover 1 clue at your location.
[reaction] When you play Intel Report, increase its cost by 2: Change "Discover 1 clue" to "Discover 2 clues."
[reaction] When you play Intel Report, increase its cost by 2: Change "at your location" to "at a location up to 2 connections away."

all_card.flavor: 皮囊不过是意识的延伸。
all_card.name: 魔法手势
all_card.text:
快速。
你拥有额外1个法术槽位，只能用来携带一张[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援。
all_card.real_flavor: The body is but an extension of the mind.
all_card.real_text:
Fast.
You have 1 additional arcane slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset.

all_card.name: 驱除
all_card.text: 躲避。只用于非[[精英]]敌人。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你检定成功，将刚才躲避的敌人移动到场上任意一个地点。如果你检定成功且本次躲避尝试期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号，该敌人在下一个补给阶段期间不重整。
all_card.real_text: Evade. Use only on a non-[[Elite]] enemy. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, move the enemy just evaded to any location in play. If you succeed and a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol was revealed during this evasion attempt, that enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

all_card.name: 切肉刀
all_card.text: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat](如果你剩余神智值不超过3，改为+2[combat])。如果本次攻击击败了敌人，你可以治愈1点恐惧。作为发动本能力的额外费用，你可以受到1点恐惧以使本次攻击造成+1伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 近战
all_card.real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack (+2 [combat] instead if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity). If this attack defeats an enemy, you may heal 1 horror. As an additional cost to initiate this ability, you may take 1 horror to have this attack deal +1 damage.

all_card.flavor: 这款全自动的汤姆逊冲锋枪因为其精确度与大火力，同时受到黑帮与警察的青睐。
all_card.name: .45汤姆逊冲锋枪
all_card.text: 使用(5子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法
all_card.real_flavor: Used by both gangsters and police officers, the fully automatic Thompson submachine gun was favored due to its accuracy and high volume of fire.
all_card.real_text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

all_card.name: 秘密卷轴
all_card.text:
使用(3秘密)。
[action]横置秘密卷轴并花费1秘密：查看任意一位调查员的牌库底或遭遇牌库底1张卡牌。然后，弃掉该卡牌、将其加入其所有者手牌，或将其放到该牌库底或者牌库顶。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Scroll of Secrets and spend 1 secret: Look at the bottom card of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. Then, either discard that card, add it to its owner's hand, place it on the bottom of its deck, or place it on the top of its deck.

all_card.name: 田纳西酸麦芽威士忌
all_card.text: 使用(2补给) [free]横置田纳西酸麦芽威士忌并花费1补给：你在诡计卡牌的一次技能检定中得到+2[willpower]。 [action]弃掉田纳西酸麦芽威士忌：攻击。你本次攻击得到+3[combat]。
all_card.real_text: Uses (2 supplies). [fast] Exhaust Tennessee Sour Mash and spend 1 supply: You get +2 [willpower] for a skill test on a treachery card. [action] Discard Tennessee Sour Mash: Fight. You get +3 [combat] for this attack.

all_card.name: 附魔剑
all_card.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]。作为发动本能力的额外费用，你可以花费1充能来为剑附魔。如果你这么做，本次攻击你得到+1[combat]并造成+1伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 武器. 近战
all_card.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. As an additional cost to initiate this ability, you may spend 1 charge to empower the blade. If you do, you get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

all_card.flavor: 当时应该马上把它丢掉的。但我们又怎么知道呢？
all_card.name: 恐怖图腾
all_card.text: [reaction]在你将卡牌投入技能检定后，横置恐怖图腾：你选择该卡牌已有的任意一个技能图标，该卡牌额外获得该图标。
all_card.real_flavor:
We should have thrown it back immediately.
But how could we have known?
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you commit a card to a skill test, exhaust Grisly Totem: That card gains another instance of one of its skill icons of your choice.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]：-2(如果你位于[[异次元]]地点，改为-4)。 [cultist]：再揭示一个混乱标记。如果你检定失败，弃掉遭遇牌库顶5张卡牌。 [tablet]：-3。如果你检定失败，且那赫卜在场，其攻击你。(无视她当前地点)。 [elder_thing]：-4。结算场上每个敌人的猎手关键词。
all_card.name: 隐秘之名
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-1(如果你位于[[异次元]]地点，改为-3)。
[cultist]：再揭示一个混乱标记。如果你检定失败，弃掉遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。
[tablet]：-2。如果你检定失败，且那赫卜在你的地点，其攻击你。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，结算场上每个敌人的猎手关键词。
all_card.real_back_text: Hard / Expert [skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you are at an [[Extradimensional]] location). [cultist]: Reveal another chaos token. If you fail, discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. [tablet]: -3. If you fail and Nahab is in play, she attacks you (regardless of her current location). [elder_thing]: -4. Resolve the hunter keyword on each enemy in play.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are at an [[Extradimensional]] location).
[cultist]: Reveal another chaos token. If you fail, discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail and Nahab is at your location, she attacks you.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, resolve the hunter keyword on each enemy in play.

all_card.back_flavor: 你在探索这幢又破又旧的老房子时，墙壁内不时的沙沙声和快步的爬行声愈发响亮、愈发频密。长有尖牙、毛茸茸的生物时不时窜过木地板，从墙上的老鼠洞跳进跳出。你感觉这幢房子与其说是木屋，不如说是老鼠屋。
all_card.back_text:
如果布朗·詹金在场，查找遭遇牌库和弃牌堆，找出一张鼠群，并将其生成在布朗·詹金所在地点。如果布朗·詹金不在场，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，将其找出，并将其生成在调查员队长所在地点。
除此之外，如果游戏中有3或4位调查员，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张鼠群，并将其生成在任意一个[[巫宅]]地点。
all_card.flavor:
找寻内因，而非外因。
道路纷纭，答案唯一。
真理崇高，宜加思量。
all_card.name: 隐士•IX
all_card.text:
每个非弱点敌人得到+1生命值。
[reaction]在你击败布朗·詹金或那赫卜后：从供应堆获得1个线索(如果游戏中有至少3位调查员，改为获得2个线索)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you explore the old, dilapidated house, the telltale scratching and scurrying in the walls become louder and more frequent. Every now and again a fanged, furry creature darts across the wooden floor, scampering in and out of ratholes in the walls. You wonder if this house is more rat than wood.
all_card.real_back_text:
If Brown Jenkin is in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Rats and spawn it in Brown Jenkin's location. If Brown Jenkin is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for him and spawn it in the lead investigator's location.
Additionally, if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Rats and spawn it in any [[Witch House]] location.
all_card.real_flavor:
LOOK FOR ANSWERS WITHIN AND NOT WITHOUT.
MANY PATHS LEAD TO THE SAME ANSWER.
CONTEMPLATE THE GREATER TRUTH.
all_card.real_text:
Each non-weakness enemy gets +1 health.
[reaction] After you defeat Brown Jenkin or Nahab: Gain 1 clue from the token bank (2 clues instead if there are 3 or more investigators in the game).

all_card.back_flavor: 这幢房子摇摇欲坠，令人目眩的紫光从各处空隙、木质幕墙和地板的裂缝后方射入，从各个角度笼罩了你。一道残忍的尖啸声嘲笑着你，一道人影从巫术光芒里应声出现。她歪曲破碎的鬼魂只剩一丝人形。这老大婆梦魇般的嗓音咯咯笑着，在彼端的国度回响。
all_card.back_text:
- 如果当前为场景1，将放在一边的那赫卜生成在沃尔特·吉尔曼的房间。
- 如果当前为场景2，将放在一边的那赫卜生成在凯夏的房间。
- 如果当前为场景3，在那赫卜上放置1个毁灭标记。
将放在一边的2张鬼影骤现洗入遭遇牌库。找出布朗·詹金(不论其是否位于场上)，将其放在那赫卜当前所在地点。
all_card.flavor: ……那只窜来窜去毛茸茸的小东西是她的魔宠，对于它的描述如此极尽真实，尽管细节令人难以置信。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《女巫屋中之梦》</cite>
all_card.name: 魔宠
all_card.text:
每个非弱点敌人得到+2生命值。
[reaction]在你击败布朗·詹金或那赫卜后：从供应堆获得1个线索(如果游戏中有至少3位调查员，改为获得2个线索)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A dizzying violet light emerges from the crevices of the ramshackle house, behind cracks in the wooden paneling and underneath the floor, bathing you from every angle. An inhuman squeal mocks you as a figure emerges from the witch light. Only a hint of humanity remains in her crooked and broken form. The crone cackles with a nightmarish timbre, her voice echoing and resounding from the realm beyond.
all_card.real_back_text:
- If it is act 1, spawn the set-aside Nahab in Walter Gilman's Room.
- If it is act 2, spawn the set-aside Nahab in Keziah's Room.
- If it is act 3, place 1 doom on Nahab.
Shuffle both set-aside copies of Ghostly Presence into the encounter deck.
Find Brown Jenkin (even if he is out of play) and place him in Nahab's current location.
all_card.real_flavor: …the descriptions of the darting little furry object which served as her familiar were so painfully realistic despite their incredible details. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dreams in the Witch House</u>
all_card.real_text:
Each non-weakness enemy gets +2 health.
[reaction] After you defeat Brown Jenkin or Nahab: Gain 1 clue from the token bank (2 clues instead if there are 3 or more investigators in the game).

all_card.back_flavor:
突然一道紫光闪过，让你向后打了个趔趄。老妇的鬼魂支离破碎，但你倒下时能看见她畸形的脸庞上露出了奸笑。你的脑袋撞上了墙壁，此时一阵疼痛涌上心头，你最后看见的景象就是那个老女巫可怕的狞笑，随后你两眼一黑失去了意识。
你醒来时，巫术光芒已经消失，但你目睹的景象却在灼烧着你的脑海——年迈的老妇在倾斜的地面上俯下身子，愉悦地斜眼望着一本腐旧书籍，弯曲的手指握着一柄形状怪异的小刀。在她身后，暮光深渊无止境地延伸，一张敞开的巨口开始闭合。
all_card.back_text:
- 如果当前为场景1或场景2，将那赫卜放在一边，位于场外，且密谋4a入场时在密谋4a上面放置4个毁灭标记。
- 如果当前为场景3，在那赫卜上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.flavor: 在梦境眩目的紫光照耀下，老妇和长有尖牙的长毛怪物再次出现，比以往更为清晰。这次他们真的抓住他了，他感觉得到老妇那双干枯的手钳住了自己。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《女巫屋中之梦》</cite>
all_card.name: 巫异光芒
all_card.text:
每个非弱点敌人得到+3生命值。
[reaction]在你击败布朗·詹金或那赫卜后：从供应堆获得1个线索(如果游戏中有至少3位调查员，改为获得2个线索)。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A sudden flash of violet light causes you to reel backwards. The spectral form of the crone is broken and shattered, but as you fall you can see a sinister grin play across her misshapen face. A jolt of pain surges through you as your head strikes the surface of the wall, and the witch's terrible grin is the last thing you see before everything goes black.
When you awaken, the witch light is gone, but a vision is burned in your mind - the ancient crone, bent over a slanted floor, leering gleefully at a rotting book, a misshapen knife in her crooked fingers. Behind her, the twilight abyss extends into oblivion, and a gaping maw begins to close.
all_card.real_back_text:
- If it is act 1 or 2, set Nahab aside, out of play, and place 4 doom on agenda 4a as it enters play.
- If it is act 3, place 1 doom on Nahab.
all_card.real_flavor: In the dazzling violet light of dream the old woman and the fanged, furry thing came again and with a greater distinctness than on any former occasion. This time they actually reached him, and he felt the crone’s withered claws clutching at him. -H.P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dreams in the Witch House</u>
all_card.real_text:
Each non-weakness enemy gets +3 health.
[reaction] After you defeat Brown Jenkin or Nahab: Gain 1 clue from the token bank (2 clues instead if there are 3 or more investigators in the game).

all_card.back_flavor: 你被拖行在肮脏的木质地板上，脑海里闪过一些画面。一场污秽的仪式——那幢房子——那赫卜——有节奏的咏唱——盘旋的黑色漩涡——黑暗狂欢——原初混沌——孩童的啼哭声——你五脏六腑拧作一团。
all_card.flavor: 要不是这幢房子真的闹鬼，就是你的脑子被诅咒搞得混混沌沌，被房子里诡异的角度和光线摆了一道。那些幽灵似的幻象是真的吗？还是说它们是这幢房子的恐怖过去留下的残响？
all_card.name: 献祭标志
all_card.text:
每个非弱点敌人得到+4生命值。
[reaction]在你击败布朗·詹金或那赫卜后：从供应堆获得1个线索(如果游戏中有至少3位调查员，改为获得2个线索)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Flashes of vision spark your memory as you are dragged along the dirty wooden floor. A foul ceremony - the house - Nahab - a rhythmic chant - the spiraling black vortex - a dark revelry - the Primal Chaos - a child's cries - a writhing tunnel inside your chest.
all_card.real_back_name: A Dream in the Witch House
all_card.real_flavor: Either this house is truly haunted, or its strange angles and eerie light are playing tricks on your curse-addled mind. Are these ghostly visions real? Or echoes of the house’s gruesome past?
all_card.real_text:
Each non-weakness enemy gets +4 health.
[reaction] After you defeat Brown Jenkin or Nahab: Gain 1 clue (2 clues instead if there are 3 or more investigators in the game).

all_card.back_flavor: 站在死人的房间里已经够令人不安，但你在这房间里找到的东西让你更加萌生退意，再也不要回来。沃尔特·吉尔曼的日记里记载的满是他的梦境和幻象，一个比一个更恐怖离奇。他不止一次提到自己看见了凯夏·梅森，一度还以另一个名字称呼她：“那赫卜。”你甫一念出这个名字，近处的窗户便应声而碎，一阵再熟悉不过的鬼灵迷雾钻进了这个狭小的房间。等到迷雾散去，房间里的一切都变了个样。一张书桌和一个陈旧的书架坐落在吉尔曼房间一角，那里原来摆放着吉尔曼的床。而你之前踏入这个房间的门已经消失不见。周围墙壁上用红色的黏稠物质画满了怪异的图形。
all_card.back_text: 用放在一边的凯夏的房间替换沃尔特·吉尔曼的房间(原地点上的所有标记和卡牌现在都在新地点上)。将场上的其他所有地点从游戏中移除。 选择一位调查员来控制放在一边的黑书支援。将放在一边的2张古怪图形洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你来到这幢古老的巫宅，发现这里比你想象中的要更凄凉。四周是弯弯扭扭的尖木椿栅栏，房子看起来彷佛下一秒就要垮塌。前门上了锁，但你扒开盖在破窗上的烂木板后，轻而易举地从窗户进了屋。
all_card.name: 探访巫宅
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都位于沃尔特·吉尔曼的房间，调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Standing in a dead man's room is disconcerting enough, but what you find within is enough to make you want to leave and never return. Walter Gilman's journal is filled with descriptions of his dreams and visions, each more terrifying and perplexing than the last. He mentions seeing the figure of Keziah Mason on more than one occasion, and at one point calls her by another name: "Nahab." As soon as you read the name aloud, the nearby window shatters, and an all-too-familiar spectral mist invades the cramped space. When it recedes, everything about the room has changed. A work desk and an aged bookshelf occupy the far corner of Gilman's room, where his bed should be. The door you entered from is gone. Strange geometrical markings, drawn with a sticky red substance, cover the walls.
all_card.real_back_text: Swap Walter Gilman's Room with the set-aside Keziah's Room, taking its place (all tokens and cards at the former location are now at the new location). Remove each other location in play from the game. Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside The Black Book asset. Shuffle both set-aside copies of Strange Geometry into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: When you arrive at the old Witch House, you find it in a sorrier state than you imagined. Surrounded by a crooked picket fence, the house looks as though it may fall apart at any minute. The front door is locked, but you are able to easily enter through one of the windows after pulling apart the rotting wooden boards covering the shattered glass.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is in Walter Gilman's Room, investigators may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你在废墟里搜索一番过后，在倾斜的天花板上发现了一个腐烂的窟窿，通往封闭的阁楼。废墟之中是一些破碎的骨头，其中一些属于人类，但另一些……不属于。此地有凯夏更多可怕的书籍，均已脱页散架，书里记载的全是黑暗仪式和黑魔法。地板上雕刻着一个圆环——或者说，是蚀刻在木地板上的。在阁楼正中是一块干涸的血迹，还有一把满是锯齿的小刀。在这个亵渎的地方到底发生了什么恐怖的仪式？你或许有一种方式能够确认。你拿起小刀，深深地刺入你手中，让你的掌中淌满鲜血。根据凯夏的公式，你在圆圈中央画下一个图形，切开一条时间的通路……
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的献祭场所地点放置入场。
- 如果当前为密谋1、密谋2或密谋3，找出那赫卜(不论其是否在场)，在其上放置2个毁灭标记，并将其放在献祭场所。
- 如果当前为密谋4，找出那赫卜(不论其是否在场)，并将其放在献祭场所。将密谋4a上的每个毁灭标记移动到那赫卜身上。
找出布朗·詹金(不论他是否位于场上)，将其放在那赫卜当前所在地点。
all_card.flavor: 在这间诡异房间的书籍之中，有着一本无名的黑书，上面刻着干涸的红色血迹。这与沃尔特·吉尔曼在日记中所说的“黑书”相吻合。两百多年前的凯夏·梅森定是住在这个房间。据传，凯夏发现了深奥的数学真理，能够穿梭时空。或许你能利用她的知识，找到离开此处的方法。
all_card.name: 巫宅之外
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在巫宅遗址的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Searching through the ruins, you find a rotting hole in the slanted ceiling, leading to a closed-off attic. Amidst the debris are crushed and splintered bones, some human and some... not. More of Keziah's awful tomes are scattered about, filled with pages of dark rituals and black spellcraft. On the floor, a circle has been carved - or perhaps gnawed - into the wood. At the center lies a spatter of dried blood and a jagged knife. What terrible rituals were performed in this profane space? Perhaps there is a way you can know for sure. You take the knife and prick your hand deep enough for blood to well in your palm. Using Keziah's formulae, you draw a pattern in the circle, and carve a path through time...
all_card.real_back_text:
Put the set-aside Site of the Sacrifice location into play.
- If it is agenda 1, 2, or 3, find Nahab (even if she is out of play), place 2 doom on her, and place her at the Site of the Sacrifice.
- If it is agenda 4, find Nahab (even if she is out of play) and place her at the Site of the Sacrifice. Move each doom from agenda 4a to Nahab.
Find Brown Jenkin (even if he is out of play) and place him in Nahab's current location.
all_card.real_flavor: Among the books in this strange room is a black, nameless tome inscribed with dried red blood. It matches a description from Walter Gilman’s journal of a tome he names "The Black Book." This room must be the haunt of Keziah Mason, from over 200 years ago. It is rumored that Keziah had discovered deep mathematical truths that allowed her to traverse space and time. Perhaps you can find a way out using this knowledge.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in the Witch House Ruins may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 就在你解除老妇的渎神仪式时，她发出一声女妖般的哀嚎。这个房间在时空中展开，狭窄而倾斜的四壁伸展开去，显现出彼端的深渊。曾经是凯夏·梅森的怪物扭曲的身体被拖入虚空，用嘶哑的嗓音恶毒地诅咒着。你脚下的木地板一点一点地分崩离析。然后你被扯落——群星的引力——泥泞的小巷——树林里的长笛——怒号的深渊——看守人的凝视——“高塔”——翠绿山坡——黑色漩涡——受刑者的尖叫——吹笛手——三根箭矢——献祭——铃声——飞升——然后你摆脱了这异象，痛苦地坠在地上。
all_card.flavor: 你分开了时空，到达了你的目的地。还是那个狭窄的阁楼，但是处在不同的时间。房间一片黑暗，被一圈紫色光芒所包围，光源来自于地面沉入深渊的远处。从深渊里，年迈的老妇和她的魔宠出现了……
all_card.name: 阻止仪式
all_card.text: 那赫卜不能离开献祭场所。 强制 - 在那赫卜被击败时：不将其弃掉，改为治愈其所有伤害，将其与所有调查员解除交战状态并将其横置。本轮补给阶段期间其不重整。 目标 - 如果那赫卜上没有毁灭标记，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The ancient crone lets out a banshee's wail as you dismantle her unholy ritual. The room unfurls through space-time, the cramped, slanted walls unfolding to reveal the oblivion beyond. The creature who was once Keziah Mason croaks a loathsome curse as her shapeless form is pulled into the void. Bit by bit, the wood-paneled flooring below your feet breaks apart. Then you are ripped - the pull from the stars - a muddy alleyway - the flute in the woods - the roaring abyss - the gaze of the watcher - The Tower - a green hillside - the black vortex - the screams of the accused - the piper - three arrows - a sacrifice - a ringing bell - an ascension - and you emerge from the anomaly, crashing painfully onto the floor.
all_card.real_flavor: You part the seams of space-time and arrive at your destination. It is the same cramped attic, but in a different time. The room is dark save for a violet glow emanating from the far edge, where the floor falls into oblivion. From out of the abyss, the ancient crone and her familiar emerge...
all_card.real_text: Nahab cannot leave the Site of the Sacrifice. Forced - When Nahab is defeated: Instead of discarding her, heal all damage from her, disengage her from all investigators, and exhaust her. She does not ready during the upkeep phase this round. Objective - If there is no doom on Nahab, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你踏进巫宅时，浑浊的发霉异味立刻扑面而来。木头闻起来像是腐烂发霉了。墙纸从墙上剥落。难怪这幢房子会被废弃。
all_card.flavor: 在古旧而破败的巫宅里，唯一的生命迹象就是墙壁窟窿里爬进爬出的鼠群。
all_card.name: 发霉的走道
all_card.text: 闹鬼 - 失去3资源。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you enter the Witch House, you are immediately struck by the musty, stale air. The timber smells of decay and mold. Paper peels off the walls. It is no wonder this house was condemned.
all_card.real_flavor: Within the aged, decrepit walls of the Witch House, the only signs of life are the rats which scurry in and out of holes in the walls.
all_card.real_text: Haunted - Lose 3 resources.

all_card.back_flavor: 没有迹象和线索能够证明这个房间曾经的主人是谁——只有发霉的恶臭和老鼠在另一边跑动的声音。
all_card.name: 屋主的住处
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你揭示屋主的住处后：查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张鼠群并将其生成在发霉的走道。混洗遭遇牌库。 闹鬼 - 查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张鼠群并将其生成在发霉的走道。混洗遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor: There are no markings or clues which would inform as to who this room once belonged to - only the stench of mold and the sound of rats scampering on the other side.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Landlord's Quarters: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Rats and spawn it in Moldy Halls. Shuffle the encounter deck. Haunted - Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Rats and spawn it in Moldy Halls. Shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 没有迹象和线索能够证明这个房间曾经的主人是谁——只有发霉的恶臭和老鼠在另一边跑动的声音。
all_card.flavor: 这个房间相当简陋。墙上挂着几个十字架，角落的桌上放着一台坏了的织布机。
all_card.name: 乔·马祖尔维奇的房间
all_card.text: [action]：查找你的牌组，找出一张[[祝福]]或[[道具]]支援，将其加入你手牌。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。) 闹鬼 - 你必须受到1点恐惧，或选择并弃掉1个你控制的支援。
all_card.real_back_flavor: There are no markings or clues which would inform as to who this room once belonged to - only the stench of mold and the sound of rats scampering on the other side.
all_card.real_flavor: This room is rather plain. Several crucifixes hang on the wall, and a broken loom sits on a table in the corner
all_card.real_text: [action]: Search your deck for a [[Blessed]] or [[Item]] asset and add it to your hand. (Group limit once per game.) Haunted - You must either take 1 horror, or choose and discard an asset you control.

all_card.back_flavor: 没有迹象和线索能够证明这个房间曾经的主人是谁——只有发霉的恶臭和老鼠在另一边跑动的声音。
all_card.flavor: 这个小房间的一面墙前方摆放着一张桌子，上面铺满了大学论文与书籍。曾经住在这里的可能是一名学生？
all_card.name: 弗兰克·埃尔伍德的房间
all_card.text: 闹鬼 - 你必须将你的1个线索放在弗兰克·埃尔伍德的房间上，或在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: There are no markings or clues which would inform as to who this room once belonged to - only the stench of mold and the sound of rats scampering on the other side.
all_card.real_flavor: A desk covered in university papers and books occupies one wall of the cramped room. Perhaps a student once lived here?
all_card.real_text: Haunted - You must either place 1 of your clues on Frank Elwood's Room, or place 1 doom on the current agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 不知道是出于什么原因，这个房间也一直被锁着，哪怕在建筑废弃后也是一样。你想知道钥匙会在哪儿。
all_card.back_text: 沃尔特·吉尔曼的房间锁上了。作为进入沃尔特·吉尔曼的房间的额外费用，位于发霉的走道的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.flavor: 吉尔曼的房间很宽敞，但形状很奇怪，不规整；北面的墙明显地由外向内倾斜，而低矮的天花板也同样地向下轻微倾斜。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《女巫屋中之梦》</cite>
all_card.name: 沃尔特·吉尔曼的房间
all_card.text: [action]：抽取3张卡牌并受到1点恐惧。(每场游戏仅限一次。) 闹鬼 -弃掉遭遇牌库顶的2张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: For whatever reason, this room was kept locked even after the building was condemned. You wonder where the key might be.
all_card.real_back_text: The door to Walter Gilman's room is locked. As an additional cost to enter Walter Gilman's room, investigators in the Moldy Halls must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_flavor: Gilman's room was of good size but queerly irregular shape; the north wall slanting perceptibly inward from the outer to the inner end, while the low ceiling slanted gently downward in the same direction. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dreams in the Witch House</u>
all_card.real_text: [action]: Draw 3 cards and take 1 horror. (Limit once per game.) Haunted - Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 吉尔曼自己也说不出他想要在这里找到些什么，他只知道自己想要住进这幢房子，这里曾经存在某种际遇，某种程度上能够令十七世纪一名普普通通的老妇人超越普朗克、海森堡、爱因斯坦和德西特所建立的当代研究极限，洞察数学的奥秘。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《女巫屋中之梦》</cite>
all_card.name: 凯夏的房间
all_card.text: [reaction]在你成功调查凯夏的房间后：不发现线索，改为将未知地点牌库顶的1张卡牌以未揭示面朝上放置入场。然后，你可以移动到该地点。 闹鬼 - 从遭遇牌库顶弃牌，直到弃到一张[[巫术]]卡牌。抽取该卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Gilman could not have told what he expected to find there, but he knew he wanted to be in the building where some circumstance had more or less suddenly given a mediocre old woman of the seventeenth century an insight into mathematical depths perhaps beyond the utmost modern delvings of Planck, Heisenberg, Einstein, and de Sitter.
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dreams in the Witch House</u>
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate Keziah's Room: Instead of discovering clues, put the top card of the Unknown Places deck into play, unrevealed. Then, you may move to that location. Haunted - Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Hex]] card is discarded. Draw that card.

all_card.back_flavor: ……他来到了一个简陋、无窗的狭小房间，头顶是粗糙的横梁和木板隆起的尖顶，脚下则是古怪的倾斜地板。支撑着这层阁楼的是一摞摞装满书籍的小箱子，其中的书籍破旧不堪，而阁楼中央是一张桌子和一把长椅，两者显然被固定在原位。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《女巫屋中之梦》</cite>
all_card.name: 献祭场所
all_card.text: [action]在本地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：移除那赫卜上的1个毁灭标记。本行动不会引起那赫卜的趁乱攻击。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：在本地点上增加线索，直到其上有3[per_investigator]个线索。 闹鬼 - 你必须在那赫卜上面放置1个毁灭标记，或那赫卜攻击你。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
…presently he was in a crude, windowless little space with rough beams and planks rising to a peak just above his head, and with a curious slanting floor underfoot. Propped level on that floor were low cases full of books of every degree of antiquity and disintegration, and in the centre were a table and bench, both apparently fastened in place.
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dreams in the Witch House</u>
all_card.real_text: [action] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remove 1 doom from Nahab. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity from Nahab. Forced - At the end of the round: Add clues to this location until it has 3 [per_investigator] clues on it. Haunted - You must either place 1 doom on Nahab, or Nahab attacks you.

all_card.name: 古怪图形
all_card.text: 显现 - 将古怪图形放置入场，并移动到其上。 强制 - 在调查阶段结束后：弃掉古怪图形，并将此处的每位调查员和每个敌人移动到最多线索的地点。被本效果移动的每位调查员受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。 [free]如果古怪图形上没有线索：移动到任意一个已揭示的地点。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Strange Geometry into play and move to it. Forced - After the investigation phase ends: Discard Strange Geometry and move each investigator and enemy here to the location with the most clues. Each investigator who moved by this effect takes 1 damage and 1 horror. [fast] If Strange Geometry has no clues on it: Move to any revealed location.

all_card.name: 好事魔宠
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果布朗·詹金不在场，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，将其找出，并将其生成在你所在地点，且你受到1点伤害。否则，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张鼠群并将其生成，与你交战，然后你受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If Brown Jenkin is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for him, spawn him at your location, and take 1 damage. Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Rats, spawn it engaged with you, then take 1 damage.

all_card.name: 鬼影骤现

all_card.real_text: Revelation - If Nahab is in play, ready her, resolve her hunter keyword, and she attacks each investigator at her location. If Nahab is at the Site of the Sacrifice, place 1 doom on her, as well. Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for Nahab and spawn her at your location.

all_card.flavor: 29日早晨，吉尔曼从恐惧的漩涡中醒来。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《女巫屋中之梦》</cite>
all_card.name: 异次元幻象

all_card.real_flavor: On the morning of the 29th Gilman awaked into a maelstrom of horror. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dreams in the Witch House</u>
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for every 10 cards in the encounter discard pile. If you fail, discard an asset you control.

all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Pulled by the Stars into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you did not move at least once during your turn: Take 2 horror. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Pulled by the Stars from play. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.

all_card.name: 不安的梦
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](5)。如果你检定失败，将不安的梦放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：弃掉遭遇牌库顶的1张卡牌。 强制 - 在遭遇牌库的卡牌耗尽时：弃掉不安的梦并揭示你牌堆顶10张卡牌。抽取每张揭示的弱点，并弃掉其他每张揭示的卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). If you fail, put Disquieting Dreams into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. Forced - When the encounter deck runs out of cards: Discard Disquieting Dreams and reveal the top 10 cards of your deck. Draw each weakness revealed and discard each other revealed card.

[reaction] When you perform a Fight action using attached asset, if you are engaged with no enemies, exhaust Telecopic Sight: This attack can target a non-[[Elite]] enemy at a connecting location. Ignore the aloof and retaliate keywords for this attack.

all_card.flavor: ……这股力量也会堕落。

Resolve an [action] or [fast] ability on that asset, ignoring all costs (including its [action] cost, if any). Then, if that asset was in your hand, you may discard it to draw 1 card.

all_card.real_text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[action] Spend 1 secret and exhaust Esoteric Atlas: Choose a revealed location that is exactly 2 connections away from your location. Move to that location.

all_card.name: 投资
all_card.text:
使用(0补给)。投资上仅限10补给。
[free]横置投资：在上面放置1补给。
[action]横置并弃掉投资：将本卡牌上所有补给移动到你的资源池，作为资源。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (0 supplies). Limit 10 supplies on Investments.
[fast] Exhaust Investments: Place 1 supply on it.
[action] Exhaust and discard Investments: Move all supplies from it to your resource pool, as resources.

all_card.name: 诱敌
all_card.text: 躲避。自动躲避你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。 [reaction]在你打出诱敌时，提升其费用2点：“一个非[[精英]]敌人”变为“最多2个非[[精英]]敌人”。 [reaction]在你打出诱敌时，提升其费用2点：“你所在地点”变为“与你所在地点之间连接次数不超过2的地点”。
all_card.real_text: Evade. Automatically evade a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. [reaction] When you play Decoy, increase its cost by 2: Change "a non-[[Elite]] enemy" to "up to 2 non-[[Elite]] enemies." [reaction] When you play Decoy, increase its cost by 2: Change "at your location" to "at a location up to 2 connections away."

all_card.flavor: 本书作者是路德维格·普林恩；他在巫术审判达到高潮时死于布鲁塞尔的审讯桩上。<cite>——罗伯特·布洛克，《来自星际的蹒跚者》</cite>
all_card.name: 蠕虫的秘密
all_card.text: [action]横置蠕虫的秘密并在其上放置1个毁灭标记：从你的弃牌堆打出一张[[法术]]或[[洞察]]事件，其资源费用减少1点。该事件结算后，将其从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_flavor: Ludwig Prinn was its author; he who had perished in the inquisitorial stake in Brussels when the witchcraft trials were at their height. - Robert Bloch, "The Shambler from the Stars"
all_card.real_text: [action] Exhaust De Vermis Mysteriis and place 1 doom on it: Play a [[Spell]] or [[Insight]] event from your discard pile, reducing its resource cost by 1. After that event resolves, remove it from the game.

all_card.name: 指路鬼魂
all_card.text: 你得到+1[intellect]。 非直接恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给指路鬼魂。 强制 - 在指路鬼魂因为恐惧而被击败时：将其放逐。
all_card.real_text: You get +1 [intellect]. Non-direct horror must be assigned to Guiding Spirit before it can be assigned to your investigator card. Forced - When Guiding Spirit is defeated by horror: Exile it.

all_card.name: 幸运或是注定
all_card.text:
快速。在毁灭标记将要放到任意冒险卡牌上时打出。
每场游戏最多1张。
取消将要放到该卡牌上的1个毁灭标记。放逐幸运或是注定。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when doom would be placed on any scenario card.
Max 1 per game.
Cancel 1 doom just placed on that card. Exile Fortune or Fate.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]：-3。如果本次技能检定在阵法行动期间，再抽一个标记。 [cultist]：-4。如果你身上没有伤害标记，受到1点伤害。如果你身上没有恐惧标记，受到1点恐惧。 [tablet]：-4。如果你检定失败，你所在地点的一个[[幽灵]]敌人攻击你(不论其是否处于横置状态)。 [elder_thing]：-4。如果本次技能检定在阵法行动期间且你检定失败，结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
all_card.name: 聚合幻灭
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]：-2。如果本次技能检定在阵法行动期间，再抽一个标记。 [cultist]：-3。如果你身上没有伤害标记，受到1点伤害。如果你身上没有恐惧标记，受到1点恐惧。 [tablet]：-3。如果你检定失败，你所在地点的一个[[幽灵]]敌人攻击你(不论其是否处于横置状态)。 [elder_thing]：-3。如果本次技能检定在阵法行动期间且你检定失败，结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
all_card.real_back_text: Hard / Expert [skull]: -3. If this is a skill test during a circle action, reveal another token. [cultist]: -4. If you have no damage on you, take 1 damage. If you have no horror on you, take 1 horror. [tablet]: -4. If you fail, a [[Spectral]] enemy at your location attacks you (even if it is exhausted). [elder_thing]: -4. If this is a skill test during a circle action and you fail, resolve each haunted ability on your location.
all_card.real_text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -2. If this is a skill test during a circle action, reveal another token. [cultist]: -3. If you have no damage on you, take 1 damage. If you have no horror on you, take 1 horror. [tablet]: -3. If you fail, a [[Spectral]] enemy at your location attacks you (even if it is exhausted). [elder_thing]: -3. If this is a skill test during a circle action and you fail, resolve each haunted ability on your location.

all_card.back_flavor: 月亮被浓雾所遮蔽，整片森林陷入黑暗。一群鸟儿突然从树顶四散飞走。
all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
检查剧本日志的“失踪人口”部分。如果至少1个角色“被看守人抓走”，阅读以下文本：
在鬼灵迷雾的另一头，一声恐怖的尖叫在树林里回响。那声音很遥远，像是隔着一面玻璃传来的，但又是那么的清晰，令你知道这声音是真实存在的。
每有一个角色被看守人抓走，在幽灵看守人身上放置1资源，作为1个被偷走的灵魂(不论幽灵看守人当前是否在场)。 直到冒险结束，幽灵看守人获得以下文本：“幽灵看守人上每有一个被偷走的灵魂，其得到+1攻击值，+1[per_investigator]生命值。”将本卡牌放在密谋牌库旁作为提示，并推进至密谋2a。
all_card.flavor:
身在岔路。
宜多思量。
进退两难。
all_card.name: 恋人•VI
all_card.real_back_flavor: The mist obscures the moon, plunging the woods into darkness. A flock of birds suddenly scatter from the treetops.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If at least 1 character was "taken by the watcher," read the following:
Beyond the spectral mist, an awful scream resounds through the woods. It is distant, as though heard through a pane of glass, but distinct enough for you to know it is real.
For each character who was taken by the watcher, place 1 resource on The Spectral Watcher, as a stolen soul (even if The Spectral Watcher is currently out of play). Until the end of the scenario, The Spectral Watcher gains the following text: "For each stolen soul on The Spectral Watcher, it gets +1 fight and +1 [per_investigator] health." Keep this card next to the agenda deck as a reminder, and advance to agenda 2a.
all_card.real_flavor:
YOU ARE AT A CROSSROADS.
REFLECT ON THE CHOICES YOU HAVE MADE.
YOU SHALL BE CONFRONTED WITH A TERRIBLE DILEMMA.

all_card.back_flavor:
一阵强风横扫岛屿中央，标示着秘社仪式场所的光柱突然向外爆裂。数十道鬼魂和幽灵般的人影飞越树冠，飘过树林。它们的尖叫你永生难忘，就像是数百人同时发出死亡的呐喊。
最后一波力量涌出，位于岛屿中央的方尖石塔轰然碎裂。这波力量将林子里的树木压弯，把你打倒在地。然后你眼前一黑。
all_card.back_text: 幸存的每位调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。 (→结局5)
all_card.flavor: 就在你继续穿过树林时，你发现岛上弥漫的黑雾从海岸线向岛中央飘来，在那儿光能形成的一柱灯塔升向天穹。
all_card.name: 命运的十字路口
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A powerful gale sweeps through the island from its center, and the spectral pillar marking the site of the Lodge's ritual suddenly bursts outward. Dozens of specters and phantasmal shapes fly across the treetops and weave through the woods. You will never forget their shrieks, like hundreds of deathcries sounding at once.
With a final surge of power, the stone obelisk at the center of the island shatters. Trees bend from the tremendous force that is unleashed, and you are pummeled to the ground. Everything goes black.
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. (→R5)
all_card.real_flavor: As you continue through the woods, you notice the dark mist which has permeated the island is starting to drift away from the shoreline, toward the center of the island where the beacon of spectral energy still rises into the sky.

all_card.back_flavor: 你在杂草丛生的森林里越走越深，内心深处有一把胆怯的声音在劝你逃离这片地方，再也别回来。黑雾愈发浓重，你几乎什么也看不见。你大声呼唤自己的同伴，但没有一个人响应——只有摇摇欲坠的树枝在风中摇曳，以及你心脏在胸口搏动的声音。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员必须随机选择1张放在一边的未访之岛地点，将其放置入场，放到自己面前，并且立即移动到该地点(不能取消)。如果调查员支持女巫集会，位于这些所选地点的火盆已点燃。在这些所选地点上放置1个资源标记以作表示。 混洗冒险参考卡牌底下的每张剧情卡牌，随机给每位调查员发放1张，直到这些卡牌发放完毕。按玩家顺序，结算发放的每张剧情卡牌。
all_card.flavor: 未访之岛雾茫茫的河畔既荒凉又贫瘠。你靠近岛屿时无人迎接，只有幽灵般的鸟儿停在树上，用目光打量着你。远处，一道光柱直插云霄，异界之雾在其周围盘旋成漩涡。
all_card.name: 未访之岛
all_card.real_back_flavor: You venture deeper and deeper into the overgrown woods, a timid voice in the back of your mind urging you to flee this place and never return. The dark mist becomes so dense you can hardly see anything. You shout for any of your companions, but there is no response - just the sway of dying tree branches in the wind and the thump of your heart pounding in your chest
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator must randomly choose 1 of the set-aside Unvisited Isle locations, put it into play in front of him or her, and immediately move to that location (cannot be canceled). If the investigators sided with the coven, the brazier at each of those locations is already lit. Place a resource token on each of those locations to signify this. Shuffle each of the story cards beneath the scenario reference card and deal 1 at random to each investigator until all of them have been dealt. In player order, resolve each of the dealt story cards.
all_card.real_flavor: The foggy shores of the Unvisited Isle are barren and unwelcoming. Not a soul greets you as you draw closer to the island, save for the judging gaze of ghostly birds that observe you from the trees. In the distance, the pillar of spectral energy is rising into the clouds, a vortex of otherworldly mist spiraling about it.

all_card.back_flavor:
不久后，那个亡灵也来到了这里。
它从米斯卡塔尼克河底升起，丝毫不受河水和迷雾的影响。它感应到恐惧与鲜血，张开手臂，缓缓飘向未访之岛。它的目光带来绝望。它的魔掌带来死亡。
all_card.back_text: 将幽灵看守人生成在米斯卡塔尼克河。 将遭遇弃牌堆、放在一边的每张看守人的攫噬和看守人的注视洗入遭遇牌库。 将每位调查员面前的地点放回游戏区域中央。(调查员不再受阻，可离开所在地点。) 将放在一边的灵怪陷阱地点放置入场。如果调查员支持女巫集会，灵怪陷阱的火盆已点燃。在其上放置1个资源标记，表示该地点火盆已点燃。
all_card.flavor: 银暮秘社设下的陷阱引起了灵界的注意，引来了灵界住民。不管怎样，被困在雾中的人最终都会来到这里。
all_card.name: 命数已定
all_card.text: 每位调查员不能离开自己面前的地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Before long, the revenant arrives.
It rises from the depths of the Miskatonic River, unfazed by the water or the mist. Sensing fear and blood, it glides slowly toward the island with its arm outstretched. Its gaze brings dismay. Its grasp brings death.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn The Spectral Watcher at the Miskatonic River. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Watcher's Grasp and Watcher's Gaze into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Return the location in front of each investigator to the center of the play area. (Investigators are no longer prevented from leaving their location.) Put the set-aside The Geist-Trap location into play. If the investigators sided with the coven, the brazier at The Geist-Trap is already lit. Place a resource token on it to signify this.
all_card.real_flavor: The trap set by the Silver Twilight Lodge has drawn the attention of the spectral realm and its inhabitants. One way or another, those who were trapped in the mist will end up here.
all_card.real_text: Each investigator cannot leave the location in front of him or her.

all_card.back_flavor:
在浓雾中搜索近一个小时过后，你终于抵达了秘社的仪式场所，但这儿已经一片混乱。银暮秘社的成员都披着蓝色和银色的长袍，与女巫战作一团。“完成仪式！”卡尔·桑福德从空地另一头命令你，“这是唯一的办法！”
安妮特注意到你，震怒不已：“又是你！我警告过你，要是我们再遇上绝对不会手下留情。”她呼唤女巫集会：“姐妹们！我们这次绝对不能让他们插手。别让他们完成阵法！”
all_card.back_text: 揭示灵怪陷阱地点。将位于未访之岛地点的每位调查员移动到灵怪陷阱。 检查剧本日志。如果女巫的法术成功施放，将放在一边的安妮特·梅森生成在灵怪陷阱。如果女巫的法术被破坏，将放在一边的1张女巫集会学徒生成在灵怪陷阱(如果游戏中有3到4位调查员，改为2张)。 将遭遇弃牌堆和放在一边的每张剩余[[女巫]]敌人一起洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你接近了封印仪式的场地。你得点燃火盆才能找到进入的方法。然后只要把看守人引到陷阱，对它施以咒缚。
all_card.name: 迷雾彼端(版本一)
all_card.text: [free]在一个阵法行动期间，花费1个线索：本次技能检定难度降低2点。 目标 - 如果场上每个未访之岛地点均已翻开，且每个此类地点的火盆均已点燃，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
After nearly an hour spent searching through the dense mist, you finally arrive at the site of the Lodge's ritual, only to find it in chaos. Members of the Silver Twilight Lodge, each wearing robes of blue and silver, are embroiled in battle with the witches. "Complete the ritual!" Carl Sanford commands you from across the clearing. "It is the only way!"
Anette turns her attention to you, shocked and angered. "You again! I warned you we would not show mercy if we met a second time." She calls to her coven: "Sisters! We must not let them interfere this time. Do not let their circle close!"
all_card.real_back_text: Reveal The Geist-Trap location. Move each investigator at an Unvisited Isle location to The Geist-Trap. Check Campaign Log. If the witches' spell was cast, spawn the set-aside Anette Mason at The Geist-Trap. If the witches' spell was broken, spawn 1 set-aside Coven Initiate at The Geist-Trap (2 instead if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game). Shuffle each remaining set-aside [[Witch]] enemy into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: You are close to the site of the binding ritual. You must light the braziers to find the way. Then, all that is left to do is bait the watcher to the trap and bind it there.
all_card.real_text: [fast] During a circle action, spend 1 clue: Reduce the difficulty of this skill test by 2. Objective - If each Unvisited Isle location in play is revealed and the brazier on each of them is lit, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
在浓雾中搜索近一个小时过后，你终于抵达了秘社的仪式场所，但这儿已经一片混乱。银暮秘社的成员都披着蓝色和银色的长袍，与女巫战作一团。“仪式马上就要完成了！”卡尔·桑福德从空地另一头朝你喊道，“把那亡灵带到这儿来，结束这一切！”
机不可失，时不再来。你盯着他，沿路将熄灭的火盆砸在地上，破坏火盆上的脆弱防护。黑雾立即袭来，雾中饥渴的身影袭向不幸的秘社成员。“叛徒！”一人喊道。你努力将他们痛苦的哭嚎声抛在脑后，进入空地中央。
all_card.back_text: 揭示灵怪陷阱地点。将位于未访之岛地点的每位调查员移动到灵怪陷阱。 将所有[cultist]标记从混乱袋中移除(不论是否被封印在场上的卡牌上)，直到剧本结束。
all_card.flavor: 你接近了封印仪式的场地。几个火盆早已点燃，启动了陷阱。为了击破包围圈，你得按顺序熄灭所有火盆。
all_card.name: 迷雾彼端(版本二)
all_card.text: [free]在一个阵法行动期间，花费1个线索：本次技能检定难度降低2点。 目标 - 如果场上每个未访之岛地点均已翻开，且每个此类地点的火盆均未点燃，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
After nearly an hour spent searching through the dense mist, you finally arrive at the site of the Lodge's ritual, only to find it in chaos. Members of the Silver Twilight Lodge, each wearing robes of blue and silver, are embroiled in battle with the witches. "The ritual has neared completion!" Carl Sanford yells to you from across the clearing. "Bring the revenant here and end this!"
It is now or never. Glaring at the man, you throw the unlit braziers you snuffed along the way onto the ground, breaking the delicate wards placed upon them. Immediately, the dark mist invades, and hungry shapes in the mist descend upon the unfortunate members of the Lodge. "Traitor!" one yells. You try to ignore their cries of agony as you proceed towards the center of the clearing.
all_card.real_back_text: Reveal The Geist-Trap location. Move each investigator at an Unvisited Isle location to The Geist-Trap. Remove all [cultist] tokens from the chaos bag (even if they are currently sealed on cards in play) for the remainder of the campaign.
all_card.real_flavor: You are close to the site of the binding ritual. The braziers have already been lit, enabling the trap. You will have to unlight each of them in order to break the circle.
all_card.real_text: [fast] During a circle action, spend 1 clue: Reduce the difficulty of this skill test by 2. Objective - If each Unvisited Isle location in play is revealed and the brazier on each of them is unlit, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 在浓雾中搜索近一个小时过后，你终于抵达了秘社的仪式场所，但这儿已经一片混乱。银暮秘社的成员都披着蓝色和银色的长袍，与女巫战作一团。“仪式马上就要完成了！”卡尔·桑福德从空地另一头朝你喊道，“把那亡灵带到这儿来，结束这一切！”你盯着那人，拒绝了他的要求。“你终于露出了真面目。想来也是如此。”秘社的打手毫不犹豫朝你开火。
all_card.back_text: 揭示灵怪陷阱地点。将位于未访之岛地点的每位调查员移动到灵怪陷阱。 将放在一边的1张秘社新信徒敌人生成在灵怪陷阱(如果游戏中有3到4位调查员，改为2张)。将放在一边的银暮秘社遭遇组的剩余卡牌和遭遇弃牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌库。 检查剧本日志。如果约瑟夫依然健在，将放在一边的约瑟夫·梅吉尔敌人生成在灵怪陷阱。在本局游戏剩余时间里，调查员不能与约瑟夫·梅吉尔谈判。
all_card.flavor: 你接近了封印仪式的场地。几个火盆早已点燃，启动了陷阱。为了击破包围圈，你得按顺序熄灭所有火盆。
all_card.name: 迷雾彼端(版本三)
all_card.text: [free]在一个阵法行动期间，花费1个线索：本次技能检定难度降低2点。 目标 - 如果场上每个未访之岛地点均已翻开，且每个此类地点的火盆均未点燃，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: After nearly an hour spent searching through the dense mist, you finally arrive at the site of the Lodge's ritual, only to find it in chaos. Members of the Silver Twilight Lodge, each wearing robes of blue and silver, are embroiled in battle with the witches. "The ritual has neared completion!" Carl Sanford yells to you from across the clearing. "Bring the revenant here and end this!" Glaring at the man, you refuse. "So, at last you show your true colors. I thought that might be the case." The Lodge's enforcers turn on you without hesitation.
all_card.real_back_text: Reveal The Geist-Trap location. Move each investigator at an Unvisited Isle location to The Geist-Trap. Spawn 1 set-aside Lodge Neophyte enemy at The Geist-Trap (2 instead if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game). Shuffle the remainder of the set-aside Silver Twilight Lodge encounter set into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Check Campaign Log. If Josef is alive and well, spawn the set-aside Josef Meiger enemy at The Geist-Trap. Investigators cannot parley with Josef Meiger for the remainder of the game.
all_card.real_flavor: You are close to the site of the binding ritual. The braziers have already been lit, enabling the trap. You will have to unlight each of them in order to break the circle.

all_card.back_flavor: 在浓雾中搜索近一个小时过后，你终于抵达了秘社的仪式场所，但这儿已经一片混乱。银暮秘社的成员都披着蓝色和银色的长袍，与女巫战作一团。“仪式马上就要完成了！”卡尔·桑福德从空地另一头朝你喊道，“把那亡灵带到这儿来，结束这一切！”你盯着那人，拒绝了他的要求。他神色惊讶，然后吼道：“原来你跟她们是一伙的。真叫人失望。”他向着自己的核心圈成员下命令：“杀了他们！别让他们插手！”
all_card.back_text: 揭示灵怪陷阱地点。将位于未访之岛地点的每位调查员移动到灵怪陷阱。 将放在一边的银暮秘社遭遇组和遭遇弃牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌库。 查看剧本日志。如果约瑟夫依然健在，将放在一边的约瑟夫·梅吉尔敌人生成在灵怪陷阱。在本局游戏剩余时间里，调查员不能与约瑟夫·梅吉尔谈判。
all_card.flavor: 你接近了封印仪式的场地。几个火盆早已点燃，启动了陷阱。为了击破包围圈，你得按顺序熄灭所有火盆。
all_card.name: 迷雾彼端(版本四)
all_card.text: [free]在一个阵法行动期间，花费1个线索：本次技能检定难度降低2点。 目标 - 如果场上每个未访之岛地点均已翻开，且每个此类地点的火盆均未点燃，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: After nearly an hour spent searching through the dense mist, you finally arrive at the site of the Lodge's ritual, only to find it in chaos. Members of the Silver Twilight Lodge, each wearing robes of blue and silver, are embroiled in battle with the witches. "The ritual has neared completion!" Carl Sanford yells to you from across the clearing. "Bring the revenant here and end this!" Glaring at the man, you refuse. He looks surprised for a moment, then growls, "So, you are on <u>their</u> side after all. How disappointing." He turns to his inner circle and commands, "Kill them! Do not let them interfere!"
all_card.real_back_text: Reveal The Geist-Trap location. Move each investigator at an Unvisited Isle location to The Geist-Trap. Shuffle the set-aside Silver Twilight Lodge encounter set into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Check Campaign Log. If Josef is alive and well, spawn the set-aside Josef Meiger enemy at The Geist-Trap. Investigators cannot parley with Josef Meiger for the remainder of the game.

all_card.back_flavor: 看守人痛苦地哀号，盘绕在它周围的暗影已被抽离，暴露出它的真身。你和秘社成员将这破碎的灵魂围住，以防它逃走。
all_card.flavor: 空地中央是鬼灵陷阱：灵能凝作一柱，围绕着一块石碑旋转。柱体内部有着数百张幽灵般的面庞、交缠作一团的腐烂肢体和血肉，呈现出死亡与绝望的景象，令人作呕。柱子前方立着一个未被点燃的银质火盆，待你采取行动。
all_card.name: 咒缚仪式
all_card.text: [free]在一个阵法行动期间，花费1个线索：本次技能检定的难度降低2点。 目标 - 如果幽灵看守人在灵怪陷阱被击败，且该地点的火盆已点燃，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The watcher wails in agony as the shadow-wreath around its form is pulled away, exposing its true form. You and the members of the Lodge surround the shattered soul to prevent it from escaping.
all_card.real_flavor: At the center of the clearing lies the spectral trap: a pillar of ghostly energy which swirls about a stone obelisk. Hundreds of phantasmal faces and a conglomeration of rotted limbs and flesh intertwine within, a revolting display of death and despair. An unlit silver brazier stands in front of the pillar, ready for you to act.
all_card.real_text: [fast] During a circle action, spend 1 clue: Reduce the difficulty of this skill test by 2. Objective - If The Spectral Watcher is defeated at The Geist-Trap while the brazier there is lit, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你的船只沿着潺潺的水流轻轻摇曳。漆黑的河水深不见底，你突然想到有多少具尸体躺在河床上，被人遗忘，消失踪影。
all_card.flavor: 尽管任务危急，但你在静静地划船，彷佛在避免打扰河流。
all_card.name: 米斯卡塔尼克河
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你划着自己的小船离开了这座神秘的岛屿，回到米斯卡塔尼克河边。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your boat sways gently along the current of the rippling water. The river is deep and dark, and you find yourself suddenly wondering how many bodies might lie forgotten along the riverbed, never to be seen again.
all_card.real_flavor: Despite the urgency of your task, you find yourself rowing quietly, as though trying to avoid disturbing the river.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You take your rowboat back to the shore of the Miskatonic River, leaving the mysterious island behind.

all_card.text:

加弗瑞拉从雾中跌出，眼睛血红，紧张地说：“我在哪？……你是谁？”
控制放在一边的加弗瑞拉·米兹拉克剧情支援卡。她不占用盟友槽，直到本场冒险结束。在“失踪人员”的加弗瑞拉·米兹拉克旁边记录加弗瑞拉还活着。

否则：
你发现加弗瑞拉的武器落在草丛里，已经腐坏、破烂。而她本人不见踪影。
all_card.real_text:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Gavriella disappeared into the mist and you are on Gavriella's trail:
Gavriella stumbles out of the mist, her eyes bloodshot and her voice strained. "Where am I?… Who are you?"
Take control of the set-aside Gavriella Mizrah story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, she does not take up an ally slot. Next to Gavriella Mizrah's profile, record Gavriella is alive.
If Gavriella was claimed by specters: Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Gavriella's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.
Otherwise:
You find Gavriella's weapon lying in the grass, decayed and broken. No other sign of her can be seen.

all_card.back_flavor:
亡者的哭声回荡在整片树林，伴随着喃喃的承诺与低声的威胁。但当鬼灵迷雾遮盖天穹，一切陷入了寂静无声。你汗毛竖起，浑身战栗。全身上下都想要赶紧逃走。
猎人已经闻到了猎物的血腥味，要来取你的性命了。
