all_card.back_flavor: 墙上挂着好似外太空的美林背景。角落里有一架涂了银漆的木头火箭飞船，穿着外星人装扮和宇航服的人正在彼此对台词。导演一直在喊戏中的女演员，但她已经没影儿了。
all_card.name: 太空布景
all_card.text: 强制 - 你发现本地点的线索后：检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定失败，失去1个行动。 [action]：从你手牌打出一张支援，其费用减少2点。（每场游戏仅限一次。）
all_card.real_back_flavor: A beautiful backdrop illustrated to look like outer space hangs on the wall. A wooden rocket ship coated in silver paint sits in the corner, and people in alien outfits and space suits go over their lines with one another. The director continues to call for an actress on set, but she is nowhere to be found.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, lose 1 action. [action]: Play an asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 2. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 这个布景如此逼真，要是你驻足够久，几乎能听到海浪拍打岸边的声音。然而周围的人却不多，因为群演和演员一直生病。
all_card.name: 丛林布景
all_card.text: 强制 - 你发现本地点的线索后：检定[agility](2)。如果你检定失败，你必须受到1点伤害或弃掉一个你控制的支援。 [action]：揭示你牌库顶的6张牌。选择一张揭示的[[道具]]支援，将其加入你的手牌。混洗你的牌库。（每场游戏仅限一次。）
all_card.real_back_flavor: The set is so realistic that if you pause for just long enough, you can almost hear the waves splashing against the shoreline. Not too many people are around, however, as extras and actors on set continue to get sick.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, you must either take 1 damage or discard an asset you control. [action]: Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. Choose a revealed [[Item]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 逼真的灯光和音效营造出了杳远、漆黑的风暴之夜。有报告称，在该布景上长时间拍摄的演员似乎会迷失在自己的角色中。
all_card.name: 哥特布景
all_card.text: 强制 - 你发现本地点的线索后：检定[combat](2)。如果你检定失败，重整最近的敌人。它朝最近的调查员移动，与其交战并进行一次攻击。 [reaction]你在哥特布景击败一个敌人后：治愈1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The realistic lighting and sound effects evoke a far-off place on a dark and stormy night. There have been reports that actors who spend extended time on the set seem to lose themselves in their role.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Test [combat] (2). If you fail, ready the nearest enemy. It moves towards, engages, and attacks the nearest investigator. [reaction] After you defeat an enemy at Gothic Set: Heal 1 horror.

all_card.name: 抛开剧本
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](0)。本次检定所投入的技能图标不加入你的技能值，改为减去。你检定成功且每高于难度1点，你必须受到1点恐惧，或将你的1个线索放到你所在地点（最多高于3点）。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (0). Each matching skill icon committed to this test subtracts from your skill value instead of adding to it. For each point you succeed by, you must either take 1 horror or place 1 of your clues on your location (to a maximum of 3).

all_card.name: 寻得胶片
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](X)，其中X为你所在地点的隐藏值。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is equal to your location's shroud value. If you fail, take 2 horror.

all_card.name: 开拍！
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定（选择一项）： - 失去2个行动。 - 你所在地点的每位调查员受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Lose 2 actions. - Each investigator at your location takes 1 damage and 1 horror.

all_card.name: “一路走好！”
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，你必须受到2点伤害，或选择弃掉一个你控制的非剧情[[道具]]支援。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 damage, or choose and discard a non-story [[Item]] asset you control.

all_card.name: 血腥现实
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](X)，其中X为当前场景编号+1.你鉴定失败且每低于难度1点，随机弃掉你1张手牌（最多弃掉3张）。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (X), where X is 1 more than the current act number. For each point you fail by, discard 1 card at random from your hand (to a maximum of 3).

all_card.name: 最终造型
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。如果你身上有至少3点伤害，本次检定难度+2。如果你检定失败，受到1点直接恐惧并随机弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +2 difficulty if there is 3 or more damage on you. If you fail, take 1 direct horror and discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.name: 生物特征
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect]+[combat](5)。如果你检定失败，抽取遭遇牌库最顶部的[[生物]]或[[怪物]]敌人。如果你检定失败且没有以此效果抽取敌人，受到1点恐惧且生物特征获得涌动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] + [combat] (5). If you fail, draw the topmost [[Creature]] or [[Monster]] enemy in the encounter discard pile. If you failed and no enemy was drawn by this effect, take 1 horror and Creature Feature gains surge.

all_card.flavor:
“只想一件事！那就是回到地球！”
    <cite>《月球上的女人》</cite>
all_card.name: 被附身的群演
all_card.real_flavor: "There is only one longing! Back to Earth!" -Woman in the Moon

all_card.flavor:
“你要是真能杀了这么大一头野兽，那说的话会更有分量——只要我们能回去！”
    <cite>《侏罗纪公园：迷失的世界》</cite>
all_card.name: 被附身的群演
all_card.real_flavor: "Your record as a hunter of big game will add weight to your testimony- if we return!" -The Lost World

all_card.flavor:
“睁大你的眼睛看看！我受到诅咒的丑陋要吃掉你的灵魂！”
    <cite>《歌剧魅影》</cite>
all_card.name: 被附身的群演
all_card.real_flavor: "Feast your eyes! Glut your soul on my accursed ugliness!" -The Phantom of the Opera

all_card.name: *艾卡丽·斯特兰德
all_card.text: 强制 - 在敌军阶段开始时，如果艾卡丽·斯特兰德为重整状态：从混乱袋中随机揭示一个标记。如果揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，重整其他每个[[附身]]敌人。这些敌人获得猎手并失去冷漠，直到本轮结束。
all_card.traits: 类人. 附身. 精英
all_card.real_text: Forced - When the enemy phase begins, if Erika Strand is ready: Reveal 1 random token from the chaos bag. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token is revealed, ready each other [[Possessed]] enemy. Those enemies gain hunter and lose aloof until the end of the round.

all_card.name: 鬼灵之光
all_card.text:
猎手。
除因[[法术]]、[[遗物]]、[[守护]]和遭遇卡外，不能受到伤害。
[reaction]成功躲避鬼灵之光后：对它造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_text:
Hunter.
Cannot be damaged except by [[Spell]], [[Relic]], [[Charm]], or encounter cards.
[reaction] After Ghost Light is successfully evaded: Deal 1 damage to it.

all_card.name: *安德烈·帕特尔
all_card.text:
你得到+1[agility]。
[reaction]你在一次至少投入2张卡牌的技能检定成功后，横置安德烈·帕特尔：立即进行一个行动，如同在你的回合（该行动不计入你每回合可以进行的行动数）。
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test in which 2 or more cards were committed, exhaust André Patel: Immediately take an action as if it were your turn (this action does not count toward the number of actions you can take each turn).

all_card.back_flavor: 你从太空中一路猛降，最终在C号片场着陆。望远镜是在手里，但来的不止有它。
all_card.back_text: 弃掉场上的所有敌人。将每位调查员移动到太空布景。每位调查员失去其所有线索。 将每个有胜利X且没有线索地点加入胜利区。将每张[[宇宙]]和[[仪式地]]卡牌从游戏中移除。将放在一边的每张[[布景]]地点放置入场，未揭示面朝上；将放在一边的中心片场放置入场，（一片模糊）面朝上。查找胜利区，找出土星君主，将其放置入场，位于中心片场，（身处异星）面朝上。 将胶卷牌库顶的2张卡牌和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。 在混乱袋中加入1和[cultist]、1个[tablet]和1个[elder_thing]。 将煦日望远镜剧情支援放置入场，位于任意调查员控制下。
all_card.flavor: 你们一起在太空中静静地漂浮，安德烈说肯定是望远镜引起了这通灾难。你眼前只有土星及其卫星，你别无选择，只能探索这些星体。
all_card.name: 宇宙之旅
all_card.text: 目标 - 重组望远镜。在一轮结束时，如果煦日望远镜上有3碎片，推进。（提示：探索宇宙以重组望远镜。）
all_card.real_back_flavor: You plummet through space until you land in Lot C. You have the telescope in hand, but you are not alone.
all_card.real_back_text: Discard each enemy in play. Move each investigator to Space Set. Each investigator loses all of their clues. Add each location with victory X and no clues on it to the victory display. Remove each [[Cosmos]] and [[Ritual Site]] card from the game. Put each set-aside [[Set]] location into play unrevealed, along with Central Lot, (Blurred) side faceup. Search the victory display for Saturnite Monarch and put it into play at Central Lot with its (In An Alien Land) side faceup. Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Reel deck into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Add 1 [cultist], 1 [tablet], and 1 [elder_thing] to the chaos bag. Put the Helios Telescope story asset into play under the control of any investigator.
all_card.real_flavor: As you float noiselessly through space, André mentions that the Telescope must have caused this madness. With nothing but Saturn and its moons in front of you, you have no other choice but to explore these celestial bodies.
all_card.real_text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 health. Objective - Rebuild the telescope. When the round ends, if there are 3 shards on Helios Telescope, advance. (Hint: Explore the cosmos to rebuild the telescope.)

all_card.back_text:
如果本场景因其强制效果推进：
君主轻而易举地将你寄到，从你手中夺走了望远镜。他朝着周围好斗的土星人发出咔咔一声。你不知道它打算用这强大的力量做些什么，但你知道大事不妙。
（结局1）
如果本场景因其目标推进：
你拿到煦日望远镜还没多久，就掌握了它的力量。君主倒在地上，失去了力气。你瞄准土星人，发射出一道强光。随着一声尖叫，君主和它的部下消失了，所残存的只有记忆。
将煦日望远镜降入胜利区。 （结局2）
all_card.flavor: 望远镜的传送射线或许能把土星人送回老家，但他们的君王也执意要夺取望远镜。
all_card.name: 哪来的回哪去
all_card.text: 每个被附身的群演得到+2生命值、+1攻击值和+1躲避值，并获得逃逸和[[土星人]]特性。 [action]共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：在煦日望远镜上放置1碎片。 强制 - 如果煦日望远镜上没有碎片，推进。 目标 - 推翻君主。如果土星君主被击败，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If this act advanced via its forced effect:
The Monarch easily knocks you aside and snatches the telescope from your arms. It clicks rapidly at the militant Saturnites surrounding you. You don't understand what it has planned with this immense power, but you know it isn't good.
(→R1).
If this act advanced via its objective:
After only a short time with the Helios Telescope, you have begun to master its power. The Monarch falls to the floor, exhausted. You take aim and fire a fantastical beam at the Saturnite. With a shriek, the monarch and its subjects vanish, leaving nothing but memories.
Add the Helios Telescope to the victory display. (→R2).
all_card.real_flavor: The telescope's transporting beam may be able to send the Saturnites home, but the monarch is hellbent upon taking it.
all_card.real_text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 health, +1 fight, +1 evade, and gains elusive and the [[Saturnite]] trait. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 shard on Helios Telescope. Forced - If Helios Telescope has no shards on it, advance. Objective - Dethrone the monarch. If the Saturnite Monarch is defeated, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 高大的墙壁从沙漠耸起，探向天空。一旁有漂浮的玻璃球体。仿佛警惕的眼睛。
all_card.name: 高阶领主的堡垒
all_card.text: 强制 - 当一轮结束时，如果高阶领主的堡垒上没有线索：在本地点上放置线索，直至其线索等于其线索值。 [free]如果土星君主在胜利区：在煦日望远镜上放置1碎片。（每场游戏最多一次。）
all_card.real_back_flavor: The looming walls spring forth from the desert, grasping for the heavens. They're accompanied by floating glass orbs resembling watchful eyes
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the round, if there are no clues on High Ruler's Bastion: Place clues on this location up to its clue value. [fast] If the Saturnite Monarch is in the victory display: Place 1 shard on Helios Telescope. (Max once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 巍峨的峭壁间蜿蜒着一条狭窄的小道。你确信有人——或是有什么东西——正在监视。
all_card.name: 提坦通道
all_card.text:
提坦通道得到-X隐藏值，其中X为提坦通道底下每张支援的费用之和。
[free]如果提坦通道上没有线索：在煦日望远镜上放置1碎片。（每场游戏最多一次。）
all_card.real_back_flavor: A narrow passage winds beneath two looming cliffs. You're convinced someone - or something - is watching.
all_card.real_text:
Teetawn Passage gets -X shroud, where X is the combined cost of each asset beneath Teetawn Passage.
[fast] If there are no clues on Teetawn Passage: Place 1 shard on Helios Telescope. (Max once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 仪式地早已风霜侵蚀，底下的岩浆翻滚冒泡，它渴望祭品。
all_card.name: 提坦仪式地
all_card.text: [action]：献上祭品。检定[willpower]+[agility](5)。如果你检定成功，你可以将至多两张非剧情支援从你的手牌或游戏区域放到提坦通道下。然后，弃掉遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。如果是敌人，将其抽取。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The lava beneath the timeworn ritual site bubbles and boils. It is calling for sacrifice.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Make a sacrifice. Test [willpower] + [agility] (5). If you succeed, you may place up to two non-story assets from your hand or play area under Teetawn Passage. Then, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If it is an enemy, draw it.

all_card.back_flavor: 目光所及之处尽是荒芜。无数敌人能轻易隐藏在浓重的阴影之中，等着扑向措手不及的来者。
all_card.name: 图斯荒地
all_card.text: 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果图斯荒地上有重整的敌人：弃掉图斯荒地的1碎片。 [action]如果图斯荒地没有线索：将1碎片从图斯荒地移动到煦日望远镜。（每场游戏最多一次。）
all_card.real_back_flavor: The barrens stretch as far as the eye can see. Heavy shadows could easily hide countless enemies, ready to pounce on unsuspecting visitors.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if there are any ready enemies at Tothis Barrens: Discard 1 shard on Tothis Barrens. [action] If there are no clues on Tothis Barrens: Move 1 shard on Tothis Barrens to Helios Telescope (Max once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 破败的废墟间，古老的仪式地底下翻滚着绿色的能量。这里到底进行了什么亵渎的仪式。
all_card.name: 图斯仪式地
all_card.text: [free]如果图斯荒地上没有碎片：干扰仪式地。弃掉遭遇牌库顶的1[per_investigator]张卡牌。将每个以此效果弃掉的敌人生成在图斯荒地。在图斯荒地上放置1资源从供应堆拿取，作为碎片。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Green energy churns below the ancient ritual site amidst the decaying ruins. What profane rituals were performed here?
all_card.real_text: [fast] If there is no shard on Tothis Barrens: Disturb the ritual site. Discard the top 1 [per_investigator] cards from the encounter deck. Spawn each enemy discarded by this effect at Tothis Barrens. Place 1 resource token (from the token pool) on Tothis Barrens, as a shard.

all_card.name: 土星君主
all_card.text: 冷漠。 [action]：谈判。检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定成功，将1资源（从供应堆拿取）放到土星君主上。如果土星君主上有1[per_investigator]资源，将其加入胜利区。
all_card.back_text: 警戒。猎手。庞大。 场上没有一个其他敌人，土星君主得到+1攻击值(最多+3)。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果土星君主与煦日望远镜位于同一地点：移除煦日望远镜的1碎片。
all_card.back_traits: 怪物. 土星人. 精英
all_card.real_text: Aloof. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, place 1 resource (from the token pool) on Saturnite Monarch. If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on Saturnite Monarch, add it to the victory display.

Alert. Hunter. Massive. Saturnite Monarch gets +1 fight for each other enemy in play (to a max of +3). Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Saturnite Monarch is at the same location as Helios Telescope, remove 1 shard from Helios Telescope.
all_card.name: 土星人君主
all_card.text: 警戒。猎手。巨型。 土星人君主每有一名其他场上敌人，得到+1战斗值(最多+3)。 强制 - 敌军阶段结束时，如果土星人君主与赫利俄斯望远镜位于同一地点：从赫利俄斯望远镜上移除1个碎片。

all_card.name: 土星人杂兵
all_card.text: 逃逸。反击。 [action]：谈判。检定[willpower](3)以发出噪音。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，对土星人杂兵造成1点伤害。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，将其横置。
all_card.real_text: Elusive. Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) to make loud noises. For each point you succeed by, deal 1 damage to Saturnite Drudge Militia. If you succeed by 2 or more, exhaust it.

all_card.name: 失落的小行星
all_card.text: 显现 - 与所有敌人解除交战，将失落的小行星放置入场，并移动到其上。 失落的小行星的每位调查员在神话阶段期间得到每项技能值-1。 [action]：检定[agility](4)。如果你检定成功，移动到一个已揭示地点并弃掉失落的小行星。（你可以花费3资源以自动成功。）
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Disengage from each enemy, put Lost Asteroid into play, and move to it. Investigators at Lost Asteroid get -1 to all skills during the mythos phase. [action]: Test [agility] (4). If you succeed, move to a revealed location and discard Lost Asteroid. (You may spend 4 resources to automatically succeed.)

all_card.name: 陨石雨
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect]+[agility](6)。如果你检定失败，你所在地点的调查员受到总计X点伤害，由你选择分配。X为你所在地点的调查员数量。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] + [agility] (6). If you fail, investigators at your location take a combined total of X damage, divided as you choose. X is the number of investigators at your location.

all_card.flavor: 里头看起来更大。
all_card.name: 火箭飞船
all_card.text:
载具。
[free]共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：发射！将火箭飞船移动到一个[[宇宙]]地点。从混乱袋中揭示一个标记。如果揭示了符号标记，所有调查员离开火箭飞船。然后，将本卡牌反面。
all_card.real_flavor: It seems bigger on the inside.
all_card.real_text:
Vehicle.
[fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Blast off! Move Rocket Ship to a [[Cosmos]] location. Reveal a token from the chaos bag. If a symbol token is revealed, each investigator leaves Rocket Ship. Then, flip this card over.

all_card.real_flavor: Your reckless flight has attracted unwanted attention. You can't risk flying until this pesky planetoid is dealt with.
all_card.real_text: Massive. Forced - If Curious Moon is successfully attacked or evaded, flip this card over.
all_card.name: 好奇之月
all_card.text: 巨型。 强制 - 好奇之月被成功攻击或躲避时：将本卡牌翻面。

all_card.back_text: 如果异特龙敌人在场，将其放在一边，位于场外（保留身上的所有标记和附属）。弃掉场上所有其他敌人。将每位调查员移动到丛林布景。每位调查员失去所有线索。 将每个有胜利X且没有线索的地点加入胜利区。将所有[[丛林]]地点从游戏中移除。将放在一边的每张[[布景]]地点放置入场，未揭示面朝上；将放在一边的中心片场放置入场，（一片模糊）面朝上。如果异特龙敌人放在一边，将其生成在中心片场，（狂暴捕食者）面朝上。 将胶卷牌库顶的2张卡牌和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。 在混乱袋中加入1个[cultist]、1个[tablet]和1个[elder_thing]。
all_card.flavor: 你发现自己真的来到了一片热带丛林。要是奇怪的事情都是因为权杖而起，那你就要尽快找到它。
all_card.name: 失落之岛
all_card.text: 每个被附身的群演得到+1生命值和+1躲避值，并获得警戒。 [free]在同一[[丛林]]地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将1封印从蛇王废墟移动到异特龙。 目标 - 在一轮结束时，如果每位幸存的调查员和蛇杖都在丛林布景，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Staff in hand, you rush headlong back up the hill and through the jungle where you first arrived, hoping to find your way back to Lot C.
all_card.real_back_text: If the Allosaurus enemy is in play, set it aside out of play (keeping all tokens and attachments). Discard each other enemy in play. Move each investigator to Jungle Set. Each investigator loses all of their clues. Add each location with victory X and no clues on it to the victory display. Remove each [[Jungle]] location from the game. Put each set-aside [[Set]] location into play, unrevealed, along with Central Lot, (Blurred) side faceup. If the Allosaurus enemy is set aside, spawn it at Central Lot, (Rampaging Predator) side faceup. Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Reel deck into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Add 1 [cultist], 1 [tablet], and 1 [elder_thing] to the chaos bag.
all_card.real_flavor: You have found yourself in an actual tropical jungle. If the staff is behind these strange events, you should find it immediately.
all_card.real_text: Each Possessed Extra gets +1 health, +1 evade, and gains alert. [fast] Investigators at the same [[Jungle]] location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Move 1 seal from Ruins of the Serpent King to Allosaurus. Objective - When the round ends, if each surviving investigator and the Staff of the Serpent are at Jungle Set, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
你拼命将权杖的力量引回自身，一边躲避着各种各样成真的可怕电影场景。金色的蛇头满怀恶意地瞪着你，蛇口中的绿宝石让你每块骨头都在颤抖。恐龙、异星昆虫和夜行生物的声音在你周围激烈地和声，沸反盈天。
然后宝石碎裂的声音在你脑中回响，像一道闪电。其他声音渐渐隐去，手杖在你手中化为尘埃，你并感受不到风，但它却消散了。
all_card.flavor: 史前的恐怖开始席卷C号片场。权杖的力量扭曲了现实。要终结这场面梦魇，你必须摧毁它！
all_card.name: 摧毁源头
all_card.text: 每个被附身的群演得到+2生命值和+2躲避值，并获得警戒和[[恐龙]]特性。 [free]共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：查找遭遇牌库顶的6张卡牌，找出一个敌人，将其生成在调查员最多的地点。 目标 - 打碎权杖。如果蛇杖被击败，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You struggle to channel the staff's power back in on itself while dodging all manner of cinematic horrors brought to life. The golden serpent head stares at you menacingly, the green jewel in its mouth making your very bones vibrate. The sounds of dinosaur and alien insects and stalking creatures of the night rage around you in a tumultuous cacophony.
And then the gem fractures, the sound of its crack echoes in your head like a thunderous crash. The other sounds fade away, and the staff dissolves into dust in your hands, blowing away on a wind you cannot feel.
all_card.real_flavor: Prehistoric terrors have begun to overrun Lot C. The staff's power is warping reality. To end this nightmare, you must destroy it!
all_card.real_text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 health, +2 evade, and gains alert and the [[Dinosaur]] trait. [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Search the top 6 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy and spawn it at the location with the most investigators. Objective - Shatter the staff. If the Staff of the Serpent is defeated, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 这片山脊的顶端可以俯瞰下方一大片丛林。东面有一条蜿蜒的小岛，通向绿色山丘顶上的废物。
all_card.name: 西山脊
all_card.text: [reaction]在你尝试躲避西山脊的敌人时，选择并弃掉你2张手牌：该敌人本次躲避尝试得到-2躲避值。（每轮仅限一次。）
all_card.real_back_flavor: The top of this ridge looks out over a vast jungle below. To the east, a path winds up a green hill to a ruin at its summit.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you attempt to evade an enemy at Western Ridge, choose and discard 2 cards from your hand: That enemy gets -2 evade for this evasion attempt. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 池子泛着滞重的油光。沥青中露出的骨头数不胜数，说明穿越池子肯定不安全。
all_card.name: 沥青坑
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你于本地点结束回合时：检定[combat](2)。如果你检定失败，你必须受到1点直接恐惧，或弃掉一个你控制的[[盟友]]或[[鞋子]]支援。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The surface of the pool is slick with an oily sheen. Numerous bones protruding from the tar indicate that traversing the pool will be dangerous.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you end your turn at this location: Test [combat] (2). If you fail, you must either take 1 direct horror or discard an [[Ally]] or [[Footwear]] asset you control.

all_card.back_flavor: 谷地远端的山脊锐利地伸向天空，在那里可以一览众小地俯瞰下方浓密的丛林。
all_card.name: 东山脊
all_card.text: [reaction]在你尝试攻击东山脊的敌人时，花费3资源：该敌人本次攻击得到-2攻击值。（每轮仅限一次。）
all_card.real_back_flavor: The ridge at the far end of the valley rises sharply into the air, providing a high perch from which to view the dense jungle below.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you attempt to fight an enemy at Eastern Ridge, spend 3 resources: That enemy gets -2 fight for this attack. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 河流穿越丛林奔腾而下，在巨石和扭曲的树根上激起白色浪沫。要不是树影之下潜藏的危险，这片景色堪称宁静。
all_card.name: 丛林河源
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你离开本地点时：检定[agility](2)。如果你检定失败，你必须受到1点直接伤害，或弃掉一个你控制的[[武器]]或[[服装]]支援。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The river rushes through the jungle, churning white water breaking on large black rocks and gnarled tree roots. The scene would feel tranquil were it not for the danger lurking in the shadow of the trees.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you leave this location: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, you must either take 1 direct damage or discard a [[Weapon]] or [[Clothing]] asset you control.

all_card.back_flavor: 绕着绿色山丘的蜿蜒道路通向了顶端的废墟。这里氤氲着超自然的能量，一道无形的屏障挡住了不受欢迎的访客。
all_card.back_text: 蛇王废墟上有封印时，调查员不能进入。
all_card.name: 蛇王废墟
all_card.text:
[action]选择一个位于蛇王废墟的敌人并花费X个线索，其中X为该敌人的攻击值：横置该敌人。
[action]：你试着夺下祭坛上的权杖。检定[willpower]+[combat](6)。如果你检定成功，控制蛇杖。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The spiraling path up the green hillside leads to the ruins at the very top. The site seems to hum with supernatural energy, an unseen barrier to turn back unwanted visitors.
all_card.real_back_text: Investigators cannot enter Ruins of the Serpent King while it has 1 or more seals on it.
all_card.real_text:
[action] Choose an enemy at Ruins of the Serpent King and spend X clues, where X is that enemy's fight value: Exhaust that enemy.
[action]: You attempt to wrest the staff from the altar. Test [willpower] + [combat] (6). If you succeed, take control of the Staff of the Serpent.

all_card.name: 异特龙
all_card.text: 警戒。猎手。庞大。反击。 异特龙不能受到伤害，也不能被击败。 强制 - 在封印放到异特龙后，如果它身上有4个封印：移除异特龙所有的封印并将其翻面。
all_card.traits: 生物. 恐龙. 精英
all_card.back_text: 警戒。猎手。庞大。反击。 异特龙得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 异特龙进入你的地点后：你必须受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧，或异特龙击败你的地点的一个[[盟友]]支援。
all_card.back_traits: 生物. 恐龙. 精英
all_card.real_text: Alert. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Allosaurus cannot be damaged or defeated. Forced - After a seal is placed on Allosaurus, if there are 4 seals on it: Remove each seal from Allosaurus and flip it over.

Alert. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Allosaurus gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After Allosaurus enters your location: You must either take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror, or Allosaurus defeats an [[Ally]] asset at your location.
all_card.name: 异特龙
all_card.text: 警戒。猎手。巨型。反击。 异特龙得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 异特龙进入你所在地点后：你必须受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧，或异特龙击败你所在地点的一张[[盟友]]支援。

all_card.flavor: 这东西来去迅速又静悄悄，它可不是电影里的皮套，是活生生的捕食者。
all_card.name: 驰龙
all_card.text: 逃逸。猎手。 强制 - 驰龙与你交战后：你必须选择并弃掉1张手牌，或驰龙攻击你。
all_card.real_flavor: The creature moves rapidly and without a sound. This is no puppet from a film. This is a real predator.
all_card.real_text: Elusive. Hunter. Forced - After Dromaeosaurus engages you: You must either choose or discard 1 card from your hand, or Dromaeosaurus attacks you.

all_card.name: 远古恐怖
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个[[恐龙]]敌人并将其生成，与你交战。如果查找了遭遇牌库，将其混洗。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. If you fail by 3 or more, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Dinosaur]] and spawn it engaged with you. If the encounter deck was searched, shuffle it.

all_card.name: 意外变形
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](X)，其中X为你控制的非剧情支援中，最高的资源费用。如果你检定失败，你必须决定（选择一项）： - 弃掉该支援。 - 该支援上每有一个[willpower]和[intellect]图标，就受到1点恐惧；没有1个[combat]和[agility]图标，就受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is the highest resource cost among non-story assets you control. If you fail, you must either discard that asset, or take 1 horror for each [willpower] and [intellect] skill icon on that asset and 1 damage for each [combat] and [agility] skill icon on that asset.

all_card.back_flavor: 女爵化作一团蝙蝠。你发现自己回到了C号片场，但事情变得奇怪起来了……
all_card.back_text: 如果女爵在场，治愈其全部伤害，将其放在一边，位于场外。弃掉场上的所有敌人。将每位调查员移动到哥特布景。每位调查员失去其所有线索。 将每个有胜利X且没有线索的地点加入胜利区。将所有[[城堡]]地点从游戏中移除。将放在一边的每张[[布景]]地点放置入场，未揭示面朝上；将放在一边的中心片场放置入场，（一片模糊）面朝上。 查找所有场外区域，找出女爵，将其生成在中心片场，（嗜血狂怒）面朝上。查找胜利区，找出受诅斗篷，将其附属到女爵。 将胶卷牌库顶的2张卡牌和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。 在混乱袋中加入1个[cultist]、1个[tablet]和1个[elder_thing]。
all_card.flavor: 你和安德烈发现自己被困在了恐怖电影里……而你们恰是受害者，你得找到女爵，夺走她该死的斗篷！
all_card.name: 骇恶女爵
all_card.text: 每个被附身的群演得到+1生命值和+1攻击值，并获得逃逸。 目标 - 在一轮结束时，如果受诅斗篷在胜利区，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Contessa vanishes into a cloud of bats. You find yourself back in Lot C, but things have grown stranger...
all_card.real_back_text: If The Contessa is in play, heal all damage from her and set her aside, out of play. Discard each enemy in play. Move each investigator to Gothic Set. Each investigator loses all of their clues. Add each location with victory X and no clues on it to the victory display. Remove each [[Castle]] location from the game. Put each set-aside [[Set]] location into play, unrevealed, along with the Central Lot, (Blurred) side faceup. Search all out-of-play areas for The Contessa and spawn her at the Central Lot, (Enraged) side faceup. Search the victory display for the Accursed Cape and attach it to her. Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Reel deck into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Add 1 [cultist], 1 [tablet], and 1 [elder_thing] to the chaos bag.
all_card.real_flavor: You and André have found yourselves trapped in a horror film... and you are the victims. You have to find the Contessa and wrest her cursed cape from her!
all_card.real_text: Each Possessed Extra gets +1 fight, +1 health, and gains elusive. Exhausted enemies cannot be damaged. Objective - When the round ends, if the Accursed Cape is in the victory display, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: “蠢货！吾即黑暗，吾即黑夜！”女爵惨叫道。可怕的吸血鬼将爪子伸向安德烈，而他竭尽全力要把受到诅咒的斗篷从她身上扯下来。你将她困住，直到最后一拉，安德烈把斗篷撕成了两半。阳光穿透了头顶的黑暗。女爵发出最后的尖叫，化为尘土。只剩下了血红色斗篷，也已经成了碎片。
all_card.flavor: 反常的黑暗席卷了C号片场。女爵夺回了斗篷！要是你还想活命，就得彻底击倒她。
all_card.name: 浴血
all_card.text: 每个被附身的群演得到+2生命值和+2攻击值，并获得巡逻(女爵)和[[怪物]]特性。 [free]花费1个线索：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。 目标 - 终结她！如果女爵被击败，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Fools! I am darkness. I AM THE NIGHT!" The Contessa bellows. The monstrous vampire claws at André as he struggles to pull the accursed cape off her. You hold her at bay until, with a final tug, André rips the cape in two. In a flash, sunlight cuts through the darkness overhead. The Contessa lets out one final scream, then explodes into a pile of grave dirt. All that is left of her is the blood red cape, torn to shreds.
all_card.real_flavor: An unnatural darkness overtakes Lot C. The Contessa has reclaimed her cape! If you hope to survive, you will need to defeat her once and for all.
all_card.real_text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 fight, +2 health, and gains patrol (The Contessa) and the [[Monster]] trait. [fast] Spend 1 clue: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. Objective - Finish her! If The Contessa is defeated, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 古堡寂静的长廊里蒙着经年的积尘和腐臭的气味。
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 在你揭示本地点时：检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定失败，重整女爵并将她移动到本地点。
all_card.name: 城堡走廊
all_card.text: 闹鬼 - 选择并弃掉你1张至少有1个[intellect]技能图标的手牌。如果你不能这么做，重整女爵 并将她移动到本地点。 [free]花费1资源：移动到任意已揭示的[[城堡]]地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The still halls of the ancient castle are choked with grave dirt and the scent of decay.
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - When you reveal this location: Test [intellect] (3). If you fail, ready The Contessa and move her to this location.
all_card.real_text: Haunted - Choose and discard 1 card with at least 1 [knowledge] skill icon from your hand. If you cannot, ready The Contessa and move her to this location. [fast] Spend 1 resource: Move to any revealed [[Castle]] location.

all_card.back_flavor: 底下传来了臭气。
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 在你揭示本地点时：检定[combat](3)。如果你检定失败，重整女爵并将她移动到本地点。
all_card.name: 地下墓穴
all_card.text: 闹鬼 - 重整最近的敌人。它移动并攻击。如同此刻是敌军阶段。 强制 - 在敌人将要于地下墓穴被击败时：改为治愈其所有伤害，将其与所有调查员解除交战并将其横置。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The scent of putrescence emanates from below.
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - When you reveal this location: Test [combat] (3). If you fail, ready The Contessa and move her to this location.
all_card.real_text: Haunted - Ready the nearest enemy. It moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase. Forced - When an enemy would be defeated in the Catacombs: Instead, heal all damage from it, disengage it from each investigator, and exhaust it.

all_card.back_flavor: 滴答声和齿轮的嗡嗡声不绝于耳，掩盖了翅膀扑动和遥远的尖叫。
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 在你揭示本地点时：检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，重整女爵并将她移动到本地点。
all_card.name: 钟楼
all_card.text: 闹鬼 - 选择并弃掉你1张至少有1个[agility]技能图标的手牌。如果你不能这么做，受到2点伤害。 在本地点调查改为使用[agility]，而非尝试调查原本指示的技能。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The endless sound of ticking and whirring gears masks the flutter of wings and distant screams.
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - When you reveal this location: Test [agility] (3). If you fail, ready The Contessa and move her to this location.
all_card.real_text: Haunted - Choose and discard 1 card with at least 1 [agility] skill icon from your hand. If you cannot, take 2 damage. This location is investigated using [agility] instead of the skill indicated by the investigation attempt.

all_card.back_flavor: 城堡这部分的植物总有些对方特别古怪。
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 在你揭示本地点时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，重整女爵并将她移动到本地点。
all_card.name: 月光花园
all_card.text: 闹鬼 - 治愈最近的敌人2点伤害。如果没有以此效果治愈的伤害，重整女爵并将她移动到本地点。 [reaction]你成功躲避月光花园的非[[精英]]敌人，且超过难度至少2点后：将该敌人移动到一个连接地点。（团队每轮仅限一次。）
all_card.real_back_flavor: There is something very strange about the foliage in this part of the castle...
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - When you reveal this location: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, ready The Contessa and move her to this location.
all_card.real_text: Haunted - Heal 2 damage from the nearest enemy. If no damage was healed by this effect, ready The Contessa and move her to this location. [reaction] After you successfully evade a non-[[Elite]] enemy at Moonlit Garden by 2 or more: Move that enemy to a connecting location. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 女爵的正殿里黑影重重，仿佛一根根欣长的手指。
all_card.back_text: 作为进入鲜血王座的额外费用，哥特布景的调查员必须共同花费4[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.name: 鲜血王座
all_card.text: 女爵不能离开鲜血王座。 强制 - 在你揭示本地点时：查找所有场上和场外区域，找出女爵，将她移动到鲜血王座。治愈女爵的所有伤害，并将放在一边的受诅斗篷剧情支援附属到她。 [free]花费1个线索：对鲜血王座的一个敌人造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Tenebrous shadows stretch like long fingers from the Contessa's throne room.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost to enter Throne of Blood, investigators at Gothic Set must spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_subname: Red as Blood, Black as Night
all_card.real_text: The Contessa cannot leave Throne of Blood. Forced - When you reveal this location: Search all in- and out-of-play areas for The Contessa and move her to Throne of Blood. Heal all damage from The Contessa and attach the set-aside Accursed Cape story asset to her. [fast] Spend 1 clue: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at Throne of Blood

all_card.name: 女爵
all_card.text: 逃逸。猎物 - 剩余生命值最高。 强制 - 你躲避女爵后：将她重整。她在本轮剩余时间里不能攻击你。 强制 - 在女爵通过其逃逸关键词移动时：改为将她移动到鲜血王座。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 精英
all_card.back_text:
逃逸。
受诅斗篷附属到女爵时，她得到+1伤害，并获得猎手和反击。
all_card.back_traits: 类人. 怪物. 精英
all_card.real_text: Elusive. Prey - Most remaining health. Forced - After you evade The Contessa: Ready her. She cannot attack you for the rest of the round. Forced - When The Contessa moves via her elusive keyword: Move her to the Throne of Blood instead.

Elusive.
While the Accursed Cape is attached to The Contessa, she gets +1 damage and gains hunter and retaliate.
all_card.name: 伯爵夫人
all_card.text:
逃逸。
受诅咒斗篷附属到伯爵夫人时，她得到+1伤害值，并获得猎手和反击。

all_card.flavor: “你的脖子真漂亮……”
all_card.name: 吸血鬼奴仆
all_card.text: 逃逸。猎手。 猎物 - 剩余生命值最低。 强制 - 吸血鬼奴仆攻击后：治愈其1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: "You have such a beautiful neck..."
all_card.real_text: Elusive. Hunter. Prey - Least remaining health. Forced - After Vampire Thrall attacks: Heal 1 damage from it.

all_card.flavor: 演员似乎有点太入戏了。
all_card.name: 狼人
all_card.text: 逃逸。猎手。反击。 猎物 - 剩余生命值最高。 本敌人通过其猎手关键词移动两次。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 生物
all_card.real_flavor: This actor seems to have gotten a little too into character.
all_card.real_text: Elusive. Hunter. Retaliate Prey - Most remaining health. This enemy moves twice via its hunter keyword.

all_card.flavor: “蠢货！你永远无法打败我！”
all_card.name: 地狱之火
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](1)三次。这些技能检定中你每失败一次，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: "Fools! You can never defeat me!"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (1) three times. For each of these skill tests you fail, take 1 damage.

all_card.flavor: 据说吸血鬼的啃咬是世界上最精致的痛苦。
all_card.name: 吸血鬼之吻
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果你身上的伤害不超过3点，本次检定难度+2。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，治愈最近的符合条件的敌人1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: They say that the bite of a vampire is the most exquisite kind of pain imaginable.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). This test gets +2 difficulty if you have 3 or fewer damage on you. If you fail, take 1 damage. For each point you fail by, heal 1 damage from the nearest eligible enemy.

all_card.back_text:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。X等同於你的警戒等級。
[cultist]：再抽出一個標記。如果你檢定失敗，將你的警戒等級提升1。
[tablet]：-4。最近的敵人朝你移動一次。
[elder_thing]：-6。你可以將你的警戒等級提升1，改為自動成功。
all_card.name: 時運與愚行
all_card.text:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。X等同於你的警戒等級的一半(向上取整)。
[cultist]：再抽出一個標記。如果你檢定失敗，將你的警戒等級提升1。
[tablet]：-3。如果你檢定失敗，最近的敵人朝你移動一次。
[elder_thing]：-5。你可以將你的警戒等級提升1，改為自動成功。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is your alarm level.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1.
[tablet]: -4. The nearest enemy moves once toward you.
[elder_thing]: -6. You may raise your alarm level by 1 to automatically succeed, instead.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half your alarm level (rounded up).
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, the nearest enemy moves once toward you.
[elder_thing]: -5. You may raise your alarm level by 1 to automatically succeed, instead.

all_card.back_flavor: 你越來越頻繁地感受到守衛跟發牌員投射而來的視線。在一個陰暗的角落，有一群便衣保全正在交頭接耳。當你與他們視線交錯，其中一人抬手指向你，接著他們就開始往你的方向走來……
all_card.back_text: 如果調查員作為團隊，持有10[per_investigator]或更多資源，請記住你"滿載而歸"。(→結局1)
all_card.flavor: 你走進輪盤挑戰的大門。如果你想帶走時運泉源，就必須多了解這座賭場，以及經營它的邪教。
all_card.name: 警覺的莊家
all_card.text: 強制 - 當敵軍階段開始時：每位與準備[[賭場]]敵人位於同一地點的調查員將自己的警戒等級提升1。 強制 - 在調查員擊敗一個[[賭場]]敵人後：該調查員的警戒等級提升1。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The stray glances that you have started attracting from the dealers and guards have become more frequent. In a shadowed corner, a group of uniformed security gathers together in conversation. As you watch them, one looks at you and points in your direction. They begin to head your way...
all_card.real_back_text: If the investigators, as a group, possess 10 [per_investigator] or more resources, remember that you "cleaned out the house." (→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: You have arrived at Défis de la Roulette. If you are to recover the Wellspring, you must learn all that you can about this casino and the cult that operates it.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.

all_card.back_flavor: 一道聲音從輪盤桌傳來，響徹整個大廳：“紅色19！”桌子附近的某人興奮地大喊著。片刻過後，同個聲音再次響起：“又是紅色19！”你周圍傳來竊竊私語，這種情況幾乎不可能發生。你一瞬間感覺到周圍的空氣彷彿破裂了，但你搖搖頭不予理會。接著，就在大廳中的氣氛快要恢復正常時，同樣的聲音不可置信地大喊：“紅色19！這是第三次了！”這次你無法再忽視碎裂的感覺，碎裂聲變得更密集，接著四周的一切在一瞬間突然變模糊。當你的視線恢復後，一隻超乎想像的恐怖生物出現在賭場中央，居高臨下地盯著周遭的人類。你的心情沉到谷底，想起伊薩瑪拉說過那個遺物可能帶來災難。如果這還不夠糟，你很清楚那個災難是衝著不被泉源擁有者歡迎的人來的。
all_card.back_text: 將放在一旁的異空間漫步者生成到輪盤賭桌。將遭遇棄牌堆與放在一旁的無序計劃遭遇組洗入遭遇牌堆。 將每位調查員的警戒等級提升1。
all_card.flavor: 今晚的賭場一片忙碌，對你跟你的團隊來說是最好的掩護。希望你計畫許久的行動能成功。
all_card.name: 掀開底牌
all_card.text: 強制 - 當敵軍階段開始時：每位與準備[[賭場]]敵人位於同一地點的調查員將其警戒等級提升1。 強制 - 在調查員擊敗一個[[賭場]]敵人後：該調查員的警戒等級提升1。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A voice from the roulette tables cuts clearly through the din of the entire casino: "Red 19!" Someone nearby shouts in excitement. A few moments later, the same voice calls out once more: "Red 19 hits again!" You hear murmurings around you. Such an event is highly improbable. For a moment, you feel a small crackling in the air, but you shrug it off. Then, just when normalcy seems to have reasserted itself, the voice calls out once more in disbelief: "Red 19 a third time!" The crackling is unmistakable this time and begins to intensify until everything seems to blur for a moment. When your vision clears, a terrible creature beyond all imagining stands in the middle of the crowded casino, towering above the humans surrounding it. With a sinking feeling, you remember Isamara's warning that the relic's presence might invite disaster. If that wasn't bad enough, said disaster will fall on those who are not favored by the bearer of the Wellspring.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Dimensional Shambler at the Roulette Wheel. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside Plan in Shambles encounter set into the encounter deck. Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1.
all_card.real_flavor: Défis de la Roulette is bustling on this busy night — the perfect cover for you and your crew. You hope that your long days of planning will pay off.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.

all_card.back_flavor: 就在你以為情況不可能更糟了的同時，賭場的氣氛突然改變，就像暴風雨前的寧靜。接著，如同窒息者奮力爭取最後一絲氣息，不幸的風暴在人群中爆發……
all_card.back_text:
混洗3張放在一旁的時運不濟劇情卡牌，並隨機選擇1張，結算其上的文字。
將每位調查員的警戒等級提升1。
all_card.flavor: 這場劫案的棘手程度，是你從未預料過的。恐怖的怪物在賭場大廳出現，但賭客們似乎毫無所覺；賭場員工們也依舊將注意力放在尋找可疑的活動上。難道他們都看不見自己身處危險之中嗎？
all_card.name: 轉捩點
all_card.text: 強制 - 當敵軍階段開始時：每位與準備[[賭場]]敵人位於同一地點的調查員將其警戒等級提升1。 強制 - 在調查員擊敗一個[[賭場]]敵人後：該調查員的警戒等級提升1。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Just when it seems like things couldn't get any worse, there is a strange transformation in the atmosphere of the casino, the calm before a storm. Then, like the last gasp before drowning, the storm of misfortune breaks...
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the 3 set-aside Fortune's Disfavor story cards and select 1 of them at random, resolving its text.
Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1.
all_card.real_flavor: The heist has become more complicated than you could have ever imagined. Terrifying monsters have appeared on the casino floor. The patrons, however, seem to be in a daze, while the staff continue to watch for suspicious activity. Can they not see the danger they are all in?
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.

all_card.back_flavor: 你絕望地想要逃脫，但你的運氣終究是用盡了。幾個配戴熟悉護身符的邪教徒擋在你面前。在你身後，可怕的生物在賭場中肆虐，四周一片混亂。群眾跟賭場保全們終於意識到有恐怖的存在在他們之中穿梭。你盡全力擊退邪教徒跟怪物，僥倖逃出生天。
all_card.back_text: 每位未撤退的調查員被擊敗，並受到1點肉體創傷。(→結局3)
all_card.flavor: 邪教與你為敵；超越時空而來的怪物與你為敵；現在連運氣本身都與你為敵。你早就知道這一切不會這麼容易。
all_card.name: 梭哈
all_card.text: 強制 - 當敵軍階段開始時：每位與準備[[賭場]]敵人位於同一地點的調查員將其警戒等級提升1。 強制 - 在調查員擊敗一個[[賭場]]敵人後：該調查員的警戒等級提升1。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You try desperately to escape, but your luck has run out at last. Several cultists wearing familiar coin medallions block your way out. Behind you, the horrifying creatures that were summoned by the Wellspring's power rampage through the casino. Chaos erupts around you. It is only then the crowds and the casino security seem to finally notice the horrible truth lurking within the casino. You try your best to fend off both the creatures and the cultists, and you barely escape with your life.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator who did not resign is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. (→R3)
all_card.real_flavor: The cult is against you. Creatures from beyond time and space are against you. Now fortune itself is against you. No one said this would be easy.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.

all_card.back_flavor: 你在離開賭場前回頭看了最後一眼。你很有自信發牌員跟保全都只看見你所扮演的角色：另一個滿懷希望的普通賭客。不管你今晚在牌桌上的輸贏如何，你真正的獎品是蒐集到的資訊。你希望這些足夠讓你為即將到來的驚世劫案做好準備。
all_card.back_text: 每位被擊敗的調查員將其警戒等級提升2。 如果調查員作為團隊，持有10[per_investigator]或更多資源，請記住你"滿載而歸"。(→結局2)
all_card.flavor: 你必須步步為營，引起不必要的注意可能會導致計畫胎死腹中。
all_card.name: 編織計畫
all_card.text: [reaction]在你觸發一個[[遊戲]]地點上的[action]能力後：移除時運泉源上的1個線索(如果你從[[遊戲]]地點的能力獲得資源，改為移除2個線索)。 目標 - 在你被注意到前盡可能完成最多的任務並離開！如果每位未被擊敗的調查員都撤退，推進。
all_card.real_back_flavor: With one last parting glance, you exit the casino. You're confident that none of the dealers or security suspected you for anything other than what you pretended to be: just another hopeful gambler. Regardless of any money that you made or lost tonight, your real winnings will be the information that you were able to gather. You hope that it will be enough to prepare you for the improbable scheme that you must now concoct and pull off.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator who was defeated raises their alarm level by 2. If the investigators, as a group, possess 10 [per_investigator] or more resources, remember that you “cleaned out the house.” (→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: You must tread carefully, as arousing suspicion may ruin your plans before they have even begun.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - Accomplish as many tasks as you can and get out before you are noticed! If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果阿巴蘭·阿里戈里亞加仍在場……
就在你準備慶祝勝利時，一個聲音從你身後傳來：“你跑進我的賭場，還想偷走我的東西？”阿巴蘭站在門邊，全身因憤怒而顫抖著。“你會毀了我的心血！我不會讓你得逞的！”他所有文明的偽裝都已被撕爛，露出了他危險的本質。
將阿巴蘭·阿里戈里亞加(失控的阿巴蘭)移動到遺物室。
如果阿巴蘭·阿里戈里亞加在勝利牌區……
一個憤怒的聲音嘶聲到：“我不會讓你帶走它！”阿巴蘭不知為何還能站著，他倚靠在你身後的門廊邊。即使他看起來搖搖欲墜，但眼中的恨意卻仍在沸騰。在你還來不及阻止他的時候，他的手捶上牆上某種機關，然後倒地不起。大塊大塊的鋼製天花板開始從你頭上砸落……
每位調查員必須檢定[agility](3)。每位檢定失敗的調查員受到2點傷害。
all_card.flavor: 行動開始。你必須開啟金庫的門，找出時運泉源的所在位置，通過它的祕法防護，然後設法打開存放它的容器。
all_card.name: 好戲上場
all_card.text: [reaction]在你觸發一個[[遊戲]]地點上的[action]能力後：移除時運泉源上的1個線索(如果你從[[遊戲]]地點的能力獲得資源，改為移除2個線索)。 目標 - 如果有調查員控制時運泉源，推進。
all_card.real_back_text:
If Abarran Arrigorriagakoa is still in play...
Just as you are ready to celebrate victory, a voice calls from the door behind you. "You come into my casino and steal from me?" Abarran stands there, shaking with fury. "You'll ruin everything I built. But I won't let you!" Any front of professionalism has been dropped. The true danger of the man has been revealed.
Move Abarran Arrigorriagakoa (Abarran Unleashed) to Relic Room.
If Abarran Arrigorriagakoa is in the victory display...
A ragged voice gasps from behind you. "I won't let you take it!" Abarran is somehow still on his feet in the doorway behind you. Although he looks ready to collapse, his eyes burn with hatred. Before you can stop him, he slams his fist against some kind of mechanism on the wall before slumping to the ground. Large sections of the solid steel ceiling begin to fall from above...
Each investigator must test [agility] (3). Each investigator who fails takes 2 damage.
all_card.real_flavor: The heist begins. You must open the vault door, locate the Wellspring, make it past the mystical defenses, and find a way to open the container that holds it.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - If an investigator controls The Wellspring of Fortune, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你曾一瞬間覺得自己不可能完好如初地逃出賭場，保有肉體跟靈魂的完整，但你做到了。感覺像是一場夢，但你還能清楚聽見賭場中的騷動聲。是時候離開，並消失的無影無蹤了。
all_card.back_text: 每位未撤退的調查員被擊敗，並受到1點肉體創傷。(→結局1)
all_card.flavor: 進來是一回事；出去又是另一回事了。你現在必須帶著你的戰利品逃離，感覺像是整座賭場都擋在你與自由之間。
all_card.name: 出口
all_card.text: 每個[[賭場]]敵人失去冷漠和巡邏。 每個[[賭場]]敵人獲得獵手和"獵物 - 控制時運泉源的調查員。" 目標 - 如果控制時運泉源的調查員撤退，推進。(小心，任何尚未撤退的調查員都會被留下！)
all_card.real_back_flavor: There were times when you weren't sure whether you would make it out of the casino with your skin and soul intact, but here you stand. It almost feels like a dream, but you can still hear a commotion inside. It's time to leave this place behind and make yourself scarce.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. (→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: Getting in was one thing, but now you must make it out with your prize. It feels as if the whole casino stands between you and the world outside.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Casino]] enemy loses aloof and patrol. Each [[Casino]] enemy gains hunter and "Prey - Investigator that controls The Wellspring of Fortune." Objective - If the investigator with The Wellspring of Fortune has resigned, advance. (Beware - any investigator who has not resigned will be left behind!)

all_card.flavor: 站在賭場大廳中央令人眼花撩亂，到處都是富麗堂皇的裝飾跟大呼小叫的熱情賭客。
all_card.name: 賭場大廳
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。是時候離開這裡了！ [action]：從你手牌或你的遊戲區域將一張支援面朝下放到賭場大廳的下方，作為你團夥"為了劫案而藏匿"的一部分。(每回合限制一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: Standing in the center of the casino floor is overwhelming, with its dazzling interior and the clamor of well-to-do patrons.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. It's time to get out of here! [action]: Place an asset from your hand or play area facedown beneath Casino Floor, as part of your crew's "stash for the heist." (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.name: 賭場大廳
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。是時候離開這裡了！ [action]如果調查員"扮演高額賭客"且你的警戒等級為6或更低，花費2資源：你準備好了送達金庫的包裹。查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出一張[[賭場]]敵人，將其生成在此，然後將放在一旁的包裹送達劇情卡牌疊加到其上。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. It's time to get out of here! [action] If an investigator "impersonated a high roller" and your alarm level is 6 or lower, spend 2 resources: You set up a delivery to the vault. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Casino]] enemy, spawn it here, and attach the set-aside Package Delivery story card to it. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 撲克一直都是熱門的遊戲，每張桌子都坐滿來自世界各地的賭客。籌碼相互碰撞的聲音，無論是出於快樂或不情願，每一聲都代表著對抗命運的賭注。空氣中煙霧縈繞，充滿了緊張的汗味，還有虛張聲勢的緊繃。
all_card.flavor: 奧瑪哈撲克，沒什麼好顧慮的，賭注比天高。
all_card.name: 撲克賭桌
all_card.text: [action]花費2資源：棄掉遭遇牌堆頂的5張卡牌，並檢查它們的遊戲圖標。你可以進行一次重調。如果5張卡牌的大小形成順子，或是至少有3張的卡牌是相同的大小，獲得5資源。
all_card.traits: 開放區域. 賭場. 遊戲
all_card.real_back_flavor: The poker tables are constantly in demand, each game filled with players from around the continent and the world. Clattering fills the air as piles of chips are relentlessly pushed and stacked, each one a bet against destiny. The air is thick with smoke, sweat, and the tension of a good bluff.
all_card.real_flavor: Omaha 8-or-better, nothing's wild, sky's the limit.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have a sequential rank, or if 3 or more of the cards have the same rank, gain 5 resources.

all_card.back_flavor: 輪盤遊戲是在賭客間最熱門的遊戲，似乎也是經營者的偏好。畢竟蒙特卡羅的這家賭場就是以此命名的。
all_card.flavor: 紅還是黑，哪個才是你的幸運色？
all_card.name: 輪盤賭桌
all_card.text: [action]花費1資源：聲明一個顏色和一個大小。然後，棄掉遭遇牌堆頂的卡牌，並檢查它的遊戲圖標。如果其顏色與大小都和你的聲明相符，獲得5資源。
all_card.traits: 開放區域. 賭場. 遊戲
all_card.real_back_flavor: Roulette seems to be a favorite of many patrons and of the establishment itself. The casino is named after this icon of Monte Carlo gambling, after all.
all_card.real_flavor: Red or black, what tickles your fancy?
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Name a color and a rank. Then, discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon. If it matches the named color and rank, gain 5 resources.

all_card.back_flavor: 百家樂近百年，甚至更長的時間中，都在法國的貴族與上流社會十分流行。即使在這座賭場中也是如此，衣著華麗、出手闊綽的客人們聚集在百家樂桌邊。
all_card.name: 百家樂
all_card.text: [action]花費2資源：聲明"玩家"、"莊家"或"平局"。棄掉遭遇牌堆頂的2張卡牌，並檢查它們的遊戲圖標。如果其大小的總和大於18，"玩家"獲勝。如果其大小的總和小於18，"莊家"獲勝。如果其大小的總和等於18，則為"平局"。如果結果與你的聲明相符，獲得4資源。
all_card.traits: 開放區域. 賭場. 遊戲
all_card.real_back_flavor: Baccarat has been popular among French nobility and aristocrats for over a century, perhaps longer. Even in this casino, this seems to remain true, with the most well-dressed and ostentatious sitting around the baccarat tables.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Name "player," "banker," or "tie." Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If the combined value of their ranks is higher than 18, the "player" wins. If the combined value is lower than 18, the "banker" wins. If the combined value is equal to 18, it is a "tie." If this result matches the result you named, gain 4 resources.

all_card.back_flavor: 牆邊放著一排機器，等著貪婪的靈魂上鉤，引誘他們沉浸在無盡的投幣與拉桿中。不需要任何技巧或知識，只要放手臣服於命運的操弄。
all_card.flavor: "中獎了！"
all_card.name: 拉霸機
all_card.text: [action]花費1資源：棄掉遭遇牌堆頂的3張卡牌，並檢查它們的遊戲圖標。如果3張卡牌的花色全部相同，或是大小全部相同，獲得3資源。
all_card.traits: 開放區域. 賭場. 遊戲
all_card.real_back_flavor: Several rows of machines stand to one side, hooking unwary souls into an endless cycle of spend and pull, spend and pull, spend and pull. No skill or finesse needed here - just raw submission to the whims of fortune.
all_card.real_flavor: "Jackpot!"
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If all 3 cards have the same suit or same rank, gain 3 resources.

all_card.name: 高注賭桌
all_card.text: [action]如果此處沒有線索，花費4資源：請記住你"扮演高額賭客"。棄掉遭遇牌堆頂的5張卡牌，並檢查它們的遊戲圖標。你可以進行一次重調。如果5張卡牌的大小形成順子，或是花色全部相同，或是其中4張卡牌是相同的大小，獲得8資源。
all_card.traits: 開放區域. 賭場. 遊戲
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues here, spend 4 resources: Remember that you "impersonated a high roller." Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have the same suit or a sequential rank, or if 4 of the cards have the same rank, gain 8 resources.

all_card.name: 高注賭桌
all_card.text: [action]花費4資源：棄掉遭遇牌堆頂的5張卡牌，並檢查它們的遊戲圖標。你可以進行一次重調。如果5張卡牌的大小形成順子，或是花色全部相同，或是其中4張卡牌是相同的大小，獲得8資源並且請記住你"贏得邪教的護身符"。
all_card.traits: 開放區域. 賭場. 遊戲
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 4 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have the same suit or a sequential rank, or if 4 cards have the same rank, gain 8 resources and remember that you "won a cultist medallion."

all_card.flavor: 這個奢華的區域提供美味的佳餚，寬敞的舞台能容納各種餘興節目，無數的桌椅提供討論生意的空間——無論合不合法。
all_card.name: 賭場交誼廳
all_card.text: [action]如果賭場交誼廳上沒有線索：檢定[agility](3)。如果你檢定成功，請記住你"找到通風口"。
all_card.real_flavor: The sumptuous lounge area boasts culinary delights, a stage suitable for all manner of entertainment, and countless tables for conducting business - both legal and illicit.
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Casino Lounge: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, remember that you "found a vent."

all_card.name: 賭場交誼廳
all_card.text: [action]如果你"找到通風口"，在賭場交誼廳的調查員作為團隊，共同花費2[per_investigator]個線索：移動。移動到守衛室。然後，如果員工通道還未被揭示，揭示員工通道。請記住"通風口開啟"。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。) 只要"通風口開啟"，調查員可以從賭場交誼廳移動到守衛室，就如同它們是連接的地點，反之亦然。
all_card.real_text: [action] If you "found a vent," investigators at Casino Lounge spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Move. Move to Guard Room. Then, reveal Staff Access Hallway if it has not already been revealed. Remember that "the vent is open." (Group limit once per game.) While "the vent is open," investigators may move from Casino Lounge to Guard Room as if they were connected, and vice versa.

all_card.back_flavor: 通往管制區域的門透著亮光……你必須找個辦法在沒人看守入口時偷偷溜進去。
all_card.back_text: 作為進入員工通道的額外費用，在連接地點的調查員必須作為團隊共同花費4[per_investigator]個線索。
all_card.flavor: "廁所是往這邊走嗎？"
all_card.name: 員工通道
all_card.text: 強制 - 在員工通道被翻開時：將阿巴蘭·阿里戈里亞加(失控的阿巴蘭)生成到老闆辦公室。將遭遇棄牌堆和放在一旁的時運之選遭遇組一同洗入遭遇牌堆。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The door to the restricted section of the casino beckons... but you must find a way through when no one is looking and the entrance is unguarded.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost to enter Staff Access Hallway, investigators at a connecting location must spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_flavor: "Is this the way to the bathroom?"
all_card.real_text: Forced - When Staff Access Hallway is revealed: Spawn Abarran Arrigorriagakoa (Abarran Unleashed) at Owner's Office. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside Fortune's Chosen encounter set into the encounter deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 門上的牌子寫著"監控室"。你聽說他們有某種辦法監視整個賭場，也許門後會有答案？
all_card.name: 監控室
all_card.text: [action]：選擇1、2或3張。從遭遇牌堆頂棄掉該數量的卡牌，並檢查它們的遊戲圖標。如果有圖示與在場上敵人上的大小相符，請記住你"監視員工們"。如果其大小的總和大於等於19，抽取遭遇棄牌堆頂的卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A sign on the door reads "Security." You've heard from your sources that the staff has some means of monitoring the casino at all times. Perhaps whatever is behind this door provides the answer.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Choose 1, 2, or 3. Discard that many cards from the top of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If an icon matches the rank of an enemy in play, remember that you "observed the staff." If the combined value of the discarded cards is 19 or higher, draw the top card in the encounter discard pile.

all_card.back_flavor: 透過門縫，你看見一個滿是保全制服與裝備的房間。
all_card.name: 守衛室
all_card.text:
[action]如果以下的所有情況都成立，請記住你"偽裝成守衛"：
- 守衛室沒有敵人。
- 守衛室上沒有剩餘的線索。
- 有調查員"取得員工制服"。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Through a crack in the door, you see a room filled with security uniforms and equipment.
all_card.real_text:
[action] If all of the following are true, remember that you "impersonated a guard:"
- There are no enemies at Guard Room.
- There are no clues remaining on Guard Room.
- An investigator "obtained an employee uniform."

all_card.back_flavor: 門上的名牌寫著"阿巴蘭·阿里戈里亞加"。裡面一定藏著重要的祕密或寶物，如果你能設法進去的話……
all_card.back_text: 老闆辦公室被上鎖了。作為進入老闆辦公室的額外費用，在連接地點的調查員必須作為團隊共同花費2[per_investigator]個線索。除非有調查員"盜取阿巴蘭的鑰匙"。
all_card.flavor: 阿巴蘭辦公室中的抽屜跟保險箱都上了鎖。辦公室另一端的牆上有個透過假牆窺視賭場大廳的孔洞。
all_card.name: 老闆辦公室
all_card.text:
X等同於位於老闆辦公室的調查員中最高的警戒等級。
[action]如果老闆辦公室上沒有剩餘的線索：請記住你"找到阿巴蘭的符咒"。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The placard next to the door reads "Abarran Arrigorriagakoa." It's likely that important secrets and materials might be kept here... if only you could get in.
all_card.real_back_text: The Owner's Office is locked. As an additional cost to enter Owner's Office, investigators at a connecting location must spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, unless an investigator "stole Abarran's keys."
all_card.real_flavor: Abarran's safe and desk drawers are locked. The far side of the office peers into the main hall of the casino through a false wall.
all_card.real_text:
X is equal to the highest alarm level among investigators at Owner's Office.
[action] If there are no clues on Owner's Office: Remember that you "found Abarran's sigil."

all_card.back_flavor: 籌碼跟錢幣的碰撞聲從門內傳來，你不是為了錢而來的，對吧……？
all_card.name: 會計室
all_card.text:
[action]在會計室的調查員作為團隊共同花費10[per_investigator]資源(如果你"找到通風口"，改為花費5[per_investigator]資源)：請記住你"取得藍圖"。
[reaction]在你成功調查會計室並超過難度2點或更多後：獲得2資源。(每回合限制一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The clinking of chips and coins emanates through the doorway of this room. You're not really here for money, though… right?
all_card.real_text:
[action] Investigators at Counting Room spend 10 [per_investigator] resources, as a group (5 [per_investigator] instead if you "found a vent"): Remember that you "obtained a schematic."
[reaction] After you successfully investigate Counting Room by 2 or more: Gain 2 resources. (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.back_flavor: 巨大的鋼門擋在你面前，細緻的溝紋由上至下雋刻在金庫門上，似乎是用來導引保持大門封閉的祕術能量。
all_card.back_text: 賭場的金庫大門鎖上了、被嚴密看守著，且還有魔法的保護。你不能進入金庫大門，除非你已經完成在劫案開始劇情卡牌上的至少4項任務。
all_card.name: 金庫大門
all_card.text: [action] 移動。棄掉遭遇牌堆頂的卡牌，並檢查它的遊戲圖標。(如果有調查員"取得藍圖"，你可以重調最多兩次)： - 如果其花色為♣或♠：移動到守衛室。 - 如果其花色為♥：移動到賭場交誼廳。 - 如果其花色為♦：移動到百家樂。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A massive steel door looms before you. Miniscule grooves run through it from top to bottom, seemingly acting as channels for the arcane energy that keeps it shut.
all_card.real_back_text: The door to the casino vault is locked, guarded, and warded with magic. You cannot enter Vault Door unless you have completed at least 4 of the tasks on The Heist story card.
all_card.real_text: [action] Move. Discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon (if an investigator "obtained a schematic," you may mulligan up to two times): - Ifits suit is ♣ or ♠: Move to Guard Room. - If its suit is ♥: Move to Casino Lounge. - If its suit is ♦: Move to Baccarat Table.

all_card.back_text:
你不能進入遺物室。
金庫大門獲得："[action]除非有調查員"找到阿巴蘭的符咒"，否則受到1點傷害和1點恐懼：檢定[willpower]或[agility](4)。如果你檢定成功，在金庫大門的調查員可以作為團隊共同花費4[per_investigator]個線索，來翻開遺物室。
all_card.name: 遺物室
all_card.text: 強制 - 在遺物室被翻開後：將時運泉源上的所有線索移動到遺物室。 [action]如果遺物室上沒有剩餘的線索：控制時運泉源，將其疊加到你的調查員卡牌。
all_card.real_back_text:
You cannot enter Relic Room.
Vault Door gains: "[action] Take 1 damage and 1 horror unless an investigator "found Abarran's sigil": Test [willpower] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, investigators at Vault Door may spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to reveal Relic Room.
all_card.flavor: 錢幣外型的遺物以令人不安的速度，伴隨著能量脈動著。希望你能找到辦法破解它的祕密。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Relic Room is revealed: Move all clues from The Wellspring of Fortune to Relic Room. [action] If there are no clues on Relic Room: Take control of The Wellspring of Fortune and attach it to your investigator card.

all_card.back_text: 以下是你可以在時運與愚行，第二部分中完成的任務： □調查員"贏得邪教的護身符"。 □調查員"監視員工們"。 □調查員"找到阿巴蘭的符咒"。 □調查員"取得藍圖"。 □調查員"偽裝成守衛"。 □調查員"成功隱匿"。 □調查員"運送誘餌包裹"。 □ "伊薩瑪拉用歌聲迷惑守衛"。 提示：你必須至少完成4項任務才能打開金庫大門。
all_card.name: 事前準備
all_card.text:
以下是你可以在時運與愚行，第一部分中完成的任務： □調查員"找到通風口"。 □調查員"扮演高額賭客"。 □調查員"說服伊薩瑪拉參與劫案"。 □調查員"取得員工制服"。 □調查員"盜取阿巴蘭的鑰匙"。 □調查員"滿載而歸"。
強制 - 在一位調查員退場(被擊敗或是撤退)時：將該調查員的所有線索放到本劇情卡牌上，而不是將它們放到其所在地點上。
all_card.real_back_text: Each of the following is a task that can be completed in Fortune and Folly, Part II: □ An investigator "won a cultist medallion." □ An investigator "observed the staff." □ An investigator "found Abarran's sigil." □ An investigator "obtained a schematic." □ An investigator "impersonated a guard." □ An investigator "stayed out of sight." □ An investigator "delivered a decoy package." □ "Isamara mesmerized the guards with her song." Hint: You must complete at least 4 of these tasks to unlock the vault door.
all_card.real_text:
Each of the following is a task that can be completed in Fortune and Folly, Part I: □ An investigator "found a vent." □ An investigator "impersonated a high roller." □ An investigator "convinced Isamara to participate in the heist." □ An investigator "obtained an employee uniform." □ An investigator "stole Abarran's keys." □ An investigator "cleaned out the house."
Forced - When an investigator is eliminated (by defeat or resignation): Place each of that investigator's clues on this story card, instead of placing them at their location.

all_card.back_text:
你將包裹交給員工。
被疊加敵人的巡邏地點改為金庫大門。被疊加的敵人失去其[[賭場]]屬性。 如果被疊加的敵人進入金庫大門，則包裹已送達(閱讀以下部分)。 如果被疊加的敵人離場，從遊戲中移除本劇情卡牌。
如果被包裹已送達： 選擇一位調查員，其查找自己的牌堆，找出一張[[盟友]]或[[道具]]支援，並將其面朝下放到金庫大門下方。請記住你"運送誘餌包裹"。 丟棄被疊加的敵人，並將本劇情卡牌疊加到金庫大門。 [action]：將面朝下放在金庫大門下方的支援放置入場，在你的控制之下。從遊戲中移除本劇情卡牌。
all_card.name: 制服合身的話……
all_card.text:
這名員工的制服大小看起來很適合你。
[action]：攻擊。這次攻擊只能對被疊加的敵人執行。檢定[combat](3)。如果你檢定成功，被疊加的敵人被擊倒(閱讀以下部分)。如果你檢定失敗，將你的警戒等級提升1。 如果被疊加的敵人離場，從遊戲中移除本劇情卡牌。
如果被疊加的敵人被擊倒： 請記住你"取得員工制服"。 如果有另一個敵人在你的所在地點或是一個連接地點上，將你的警戒等級提升1。 丟棄被疊加的敵人。從遊戲中移除本劇情卡牌。
all_card.real_back_text:
You pass the package to the employee.
The attached enemy's patrol location changes to Vault Door. Attached enemy loses the [[Casino]] trait. If attached enemy enters Vault Door, the package has been delivered (read the section below). If attached enemy leaves play, remove this story card from the game.
If the package has been delivered: Choose an investigator to search their deck for an [[Ally]] or [[Item]] asset and place it facedown beneath Vault Door. Remember that you "delivered a decoy package." Discard the attached enemy and attach this story card to Vault Door. [action]: Put the facedown asset beneath Vault Door into play under your control. Remove this story card from the game.
all_card.real_text:
This casino employee looks like they are wearing a uniform in your size.
[action]: Fight. Perform this attack only on the attached enemy. Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, attached enemy has been knocked out (read the section below). If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1. If attached enemy leaves play, remove this story card from the game.
If attached enemy is knocked out: Remember that you "obtained an employee uniform." Raise your alarm level by 1 if another enemy is at your location or a connecting location. Discard the attached enemy. Remove this story card from the game.

all_card.back_text:
就在要開始行動時，燈光閃爍幾下後完全熄滅，賭場陷入一片黑暗，周邊響起了恐慌的驚呼。這厄運的背後感覺像是某種力量在作祟。你現在必須摸黑行事了，除非你能找到辦法恢復電力。
將本卡牌放置入場，放到密謀牌堆旁。在每個地點上分別放置一個傷害標記。 每個有傷害標記的地點沒有照明並獲得："本地點得到+1隱藏值。作為你觸發本地點上能力的額外費用，你必須花費額外一次行動或受到1點恐懼。" 有調查員在監控室時，他可以執行以下行動： [action]：花費1[per_investigator]個線索。選擇一項 - - 將公共區域的電力恢復正常。從每個[[開放區域]]地點移除一個傷害標記。 - 將員工區域的電力恢復正常。從每個[[管制區域]]地點移除一個傷害標記。
all_card.name: 時運不濟
all_card.text:
伊薩瑪拉警告過你，你在追尋的遺物有呼喚不幸的力量，尤其是降臨在不合其擁有者心意的人身上。也許你應該將突發狀況考慮進計畫內，在劫案進行途中，所有事情都可能發生……
將本卡牌翻到背面，並結算另一面上的文字。
all_card.real_back_text:
Just as you are about to act, there is a sudden pop and a spark, and the casino plunges into total darkness. There are panicked whispers from all around. This seems like an unfortunately timed malfunction of some kind. Now you must find your way forward in the dark unless you can find a way to restore the power.
Put this card into play next to the agenda deck. Place a damage token on each location. Each location with a damage token has no lights and gains: "This location gets +1 shroud. As an additional cost to trigger an ability on this location, you must either spend an additional action or take 1 horror." While an investigator is at Security Office, they may perform the following action: [action]: Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues. Choose one - - Restore power to the main hall. Remove a damage token from each [[Public]] location. - Restore power to the staff area. Remove a damage token from each [[Restricted]] location.
all_card.real_text:

Perhaps, then, you should have factored a sudden turn of fortune into your plans. For, at this moment, in the midst of your high-stakes heist, everything is about to be turned upside-down...

all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Grip of the Beyond into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 2 damage. Reduce this damage by 1 for each time you moved this turn. Discard Grip of the Beyond. ♦4

all_card.name: 獵人的飢渴
all_card.text: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須決定(選擇一項)： - 丟棄你控制的一張[[盟友]]支援。每位其他調查員受到1點恐懼。 - 檢定[agility](3)。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點直接傷害和1點直接恐懼。 ♣4
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Discard an [[Ally]] asset you control. Each other investigator takes 1 horror. - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror. ♣4

all_card.name: 獵人的飢渴
all_card.text: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須決定(選擇一項)： - 丟棄你控制的一張[[盟友]]支援。每位其他調查員受到1點恐懼。 - 檢定[agility](3)。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點直接傷害和1點直接恐懼。 ♥4
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Discard an [[Ally]] asset you control. Each other investigator takes 1 horror. - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror. ♥4

all_card.back_text:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X為當前深淵之力的強度+1。
[cultist]：再抽取1個標記。如果你失敗，且深淵之力的強度為5或更低，深淵之力增強1點。
[tablet]：-2。本次技能檢定無視所有你的技能值正值修正。。
[elder_thing]：-6。你可以改為增強1點深淵之力，從而自動成功。
all_card.name: 永恆沉睡
all_card.text:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X為當前深淵之力的強度。
[cultist]：再抽取1個標記。如果你失敗，且深淵之力的強度為3或更低，深淵之力增強1點。
[tablet]：0。本次技能檢定無視所有你的技能值正值修正。。
[elder_thing]：-5。你可以改為增強1點深淵之力，從而自動成功。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the strength of the abyss.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and the strength of the abyss is 5 or lower, add 1 strength to the abyss.
[tablet]: -2. For this skill test, ignore all bonuses to your skill value.
[elder_thing]: -6. You may add 1 strength to the abyss to automatically succeed, instead.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the strength of the abyss.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and the strength of the abyss is 3 or lower, add 1 strength to the abyss.
[tablet]: 0. For this skill test, ignore all bonuses to your skill value.
[elder_thing]: -5. You may add 1 strength to the abyss to automatically succeed, instead.

all_card.back_flavor: 你找到了足夠的證據，確信在開羅地下存在著一個影子組織，也許就是他們帶來了瀰漫整座城市的詛咒。然而，儘管你竭盡全力，這個神秘團夥還是從城裡消失了，不留一絲蹤跡。要想治療這種怪病，你還需要更多信息。
all_card.back_text: 找出場上所有的[[兄弟會]]敵人(位於場上地點或在玩家的威脅區域)。將找出的每個敵人放在冒險輔助卡底下，位於場外。 將放在一邊的每張深淵亡魂和遭遇棄牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌堆。 深淵之力增強1點。 如果當前場景為場景1，推進場景。
all_card.flavor: 傑西·伯克，一位在埃及工作的政府人員，請求你來開羅幫她解決一個醫學難題。全開羅形形色色的人都神秘陷入了不會醒來的沉睡之中——這其中還有傑西的丈夫和拍檔約翰。要想一探這種神秘現象的究竟，就全看你了。
all_card.name: 傑西的請求
all_card.text: [action]調查員以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]線索：隨機生成1個冒險輔助卡底下的敵人。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You've found enough leads to confirm the existence of a shadowy organisation within Cairo, and perhaps the origin of the curse afflicting the city. However, despite your best efforts, the secret cabal has vanished from the city without a trace. You're going to need a lot more information if you are to cure this illness.
all_card.real_back_text: Find each [[Brotherhood]] enemy currently in play (at a location or in an investigator's threat area). Place each of those enemies beneath the scenario reference card, out of play. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Abyssal Revenant into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Add 1 strength to the abyss. If it is act 1, advance the current act.
all_card.real_flavor: Jessie Burke, a government agent who works in Egypt, has asked you to come to Cairo to help her solve a medical quandary. People all over Cairo, from all walks of life, are mysteriously falling into a wakeless slumber - including Jessie's husband and partner, John. It is up to you to get to the bottom of this strange phenomenon.
all_card.real_text: [action] Investigators spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Randomly spawn one of the enemies beneath the scenario reference card.

all_card.back_flavor: 詛咒感染了整個開羅，越來越多的人淪為受害者，一陣寂靜的恐怖攫住了整座城市。夜幕再臨之時，街道被突如其來的恐慌佔據。一開始是醫院外的騷動，人們想知道自己深愛的人身上究竟出了什麼事，醫生們又能做些什麼來治好他們。不久，整座城市都爆發了騷亂和劫掠。到了午夜，街頭已是一片混亂。
all_card.back_text:
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。
深淵之力增強1點。
all_card.flavor: 陽光照耀著開羅。這天早上，城裡多了許多沒有醒來的人。一個念頭閃過你的腦海：要是就此睡去，也許你永遠都不會醒來。儘管昨晚幾乎沒怎麼休息，你還是奮力保持清醒，繼續調查……
all_card.name: 深淵的詛咒
all_card.text: 強制 - 如果深淵之力的強度為0：將深淵之力的強度設為1。每位調查員抽取1張卡牌並治癒1點恐懼。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As more and more fall victim to the curse that has infected Cairo, a silent terror grips the city. When night falls again, the streets are filled with a sudden panic. It starts with turmoil outside the hospital, as people demand to know what has happened to their loved ones and what the doctors are doing to solve the problem. Before long, rioting and looting erupt throughout the city. By midnight, the streets have descended into utter chaos.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Add 1 strength to the abyss.
all_card.real_flavor: The sun rises over Cairo. Many more people within the city did not wake up this morning. A grim thought seizes your mind: Should you fall asleep, you too may never wake again. Having gotten little rest the previous night, you struggle to stay awake and continue your investigation…
all_card.real_text: Forced - If the strength of the abyss is 0: Set the strength of the abyss to 1. Each investigator draws 1 card and heals 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor:
你太累了，已無法繼續。你的精神催促著繼續前進，但你的肉體已經背叛了自己。你摔倒在地，像一袋沉重的磚。
你用盡全身力氣抗爭，但最後能動的不過是彎彎指頭。你感到好像身上壓迫著千斤重擔，深沉的黑暗蓋過了眼簾。
你確信自己要是就此睡去，一定不會再醒來。但不知怎的，內心深處，你已經果得顧不上這些了。
你打了個哈欠。
all_card.back_text: 深淵之力增強1點。 每位未撤退的調查員被擊敗，且"墮入深淵"。
all_card.flavor:
翌日清晨，城市裡又陷入一片寂靜。醫院裡擠滿了昨晚的受害者，街頭到處都是陷入沉睡的人。
你昨晚強行沒睡，但你知道自己堅持不了多久了。你身心俱疲。要是不快點行動，你就會成為詛咒的下一個受害者。
all_card.name: 影之園
all_card.text: 強制 - 如果深淵之力的強度為0或1：將深淵之力的強度設為2。每位調查員抽取1張卡牌或治癒1點恐懼。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You are too exhausted to go on. Your mind screams at your body to keep moving, but your muscles have betrayed you. You sink to the ground like a sack of bricks.
You resist with all your strength, but all it amounts to is a wiggling of your fingers. You feel as thought a heavy weight is pressed upon your head, and a dark cloak is thrown over your eyes.
If you fall asleep here, you are sure you'll never wake again. And yet, somehow, deep within your mind, you're too tired to care.
You yawn.
all_card.real_back_text: Add 1 strength to the abyss. Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated and is "taken by the abyss."
all_card.real_flavor: When morning comes, the city is silent once more. The hospital is overflowing with last night's victims, and many more comatose people fill the streets. You've evaded sleep for this long, but you can't go on much longer. Fatigue has inflicted its toll on your body and mind. If you don't act fast, you may be the spell's next victim.
all_card.real_text: Forced - If the strength of the abyss is 0 or 1: Set the strength of the abyss to 2. Each investigator either draws 1 card or heals 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 有一個秘密組織的成員正打算逃出城市，你在一條暗巷把他逼進了絕路。"太晚了，預言已無法阻止。"他面露驚恐之色，"請讓我走吧。"你看出這個男人心中的軟弱，告訴他你能阻止組織的密謀，只要他對你如實相告，把知道的一切都說出來。"惡獸兄弟會相信自己已經找到了容器。"他緊張地支支吾吾，"現在他們要給予'天選'無可名狀的力量，你是無法阻止他們的！"他掙扎著逃脫了你的控制，溜回了大街上。要是你跟上去，說不定他會把你帶到兄弟會的藏身處……
all_card.back_text:
混洗放在一邊的每張[[探險]]地點卡，以此構建探索牌堆。 查找遭遇牌堆和遭遇棄牌堆，找出以下詭計卡每種一張：金字塔下的恐怖、蝗蟲成群、深淵領域、日蝕、沙塵暴。將這些卡牌洗入探索牌堆，然後將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。
每位調查員失去自己的所有線索。
移除每個[[開羅]]地點的所有線索。
all_card.flavor: 就在你搜索開羅尋找答案的時候，你開始懷疑傑西的預感是正確的。陰暗的人影跟著你穿過整座城，有幾個你面談的人壓根兒不想跟你扯上關係。他們在隱藏什麼？
all_card.name: 長眠詛咒
all_card.text: 強制 - 在一個[[兄弟會]]兄弟會敵人進入勝利牌區後：將其翻面，結算其另一面的文本。 目標 - 在密謀推進前，找到儘可能多的[[證據]]卡牌，並將其加入勝利牌區。(如果勝利牌區中有6張[[證據]]卡牌，推進場景。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: You corner one of the organization's agents in a dark alleyway as he attempts to flee the city. "It is too late to stop the prophecy," he says with a frightened expression. "Please, just let me go." Seeing weakness in the man's heart, you tell him that he can help you stop what the organization is plotting, if he tells you everything he knows. "The Brotherhood of the Beast believes they have found their vessel," he explains, stuttering nervously. "Now they're giving their Chosen untold power. There's no way you can stop them!" He struggles and breaks free from your grasp, fleeing back toward the main street. If you follow that man, perhaps he will lead you to the brotherhood's hideout…
all_card.real_back_text:
Create the exploration deck by shuffling together each of the set-aside [[Expedition]] locations. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy each of the following treachery cards: Terror Under the Pyramids, Swarm of Locusts, Abyssal Reach, Eclipse, and Sandstorm. Shuffle those cards into the exploration deck, then shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Each investigator loses each of his or her clues.
Remove all clues from each [[Cairo]] location.
all_card.real_flavor: As you scour Cairo for answers, you begin to suspect that Jessie's hunch was right. You're being tailed by shadowy figures throughout the city, and several of the people you interview want nothing to do with you. What are they hiding?
all_card.real_text: Forced - After a [[Brotherhood]] enemy enters the victory display: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side. Objective - Find as many [[Evidence]] cards as you can and add them to the victory display before the agenda advances. (If there are 6 [[Evidence]] cards in the victory display, advance.)

all_card.back_flavor:
你無法找到兄弟會的藏身處，但你找到了自己在開羅遇到的那個兄弟會成員……或者說，你至少找到了他殘存下來的部分。一座古老的神廟供奉著一位久被遺忘的法老，這個男子的屍體就擺在神廟裡的石質祭壇上。他身上滿是新鮮的刀傷。你不禁想知道，他是不是——出於某種原因——因你而死。
在檢查屍體和這座半焚毀的神廟之後，所得的發現令人不安。如你所想，感染開羅的詛咒背後就是惡獸兄弟會。你找到了幾頁紙，上面詳細地描述了咒語的細節——儘管上面的描述和你親眼所見並不一樣。兄弟會的典籍描述了如何將受害者送往另一片領域，名為"深淵"的國度。在那片夢魘之中，沉夢者將永遠無法醒來。每有一人陷入永恆的長夢，兄弟會的"天選"就會更為強大……
all_card.back_text:
在每個[[開羅]]地點放置1[per_investigator]個傷害標記。地點上的傷害標記代表"沉夢者"——也就是慘遭詛咒，陷入永恆沉睡的人，直到本場冒險結束。
將放在一邊的奈斯敵人卡放置入場，放在開羅街道。
all_card.flavor: 兄弟會成員逃出了城市，你跟著他一路往西。要是你加入新近的考古探險隊，在沙漠裡追尋兄弟會的蹤跡就會容易得多。
all_card.name: 沙漠中的秘密
all_card.text: 線索無法放置在[[開羅]]地點。 [action]如果你位於一個[[探險]]地點：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，將它放置入場，並移動到該地點。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You are unable to find the Brotherhood's hideout, but you are able to find the agent you interrogated in Cairo… Or at least, what remains of him. Inside the halls of an ancient temple dedicated to a long-forgotten pharaoh, the man's corpse has been placed upon a stone altar. His body is riddled with fresh stab wounds. You can't help but wonder if this was - in a way - your doing.
Investigating the body and the remainder of the half-buried temple yields a troubling discovery. As you suspected, the Brotherhood of the Beast is behind the curse afflicting Cairo. You find several passages describing the spell in greater detail - though these descriptions do not match what you have seen with your own eyes. The Brotherhood's tomes describe how to transport their victims to another realm, a place called the Abyss. A nightmarescape from which the dreamers cannot awaken. With each dreamer, their "Chosen" grows in strength…
all_card.real_back_text:
Place 1 [per_investigator] damage tokens on each [[Cairo]] location. Until the end of the scenario, damage tokens on locations represent "dreamers" - victims who have been cursed with eternal slumber.
Put the set-aside Neith enemy into play in the Streets of Cairo.
all_card.real_flavor: You pursue the Brotherhood's agent west as he flees the city. Following his trail into the desert will be easier if you join the archaeological expedition currently underway.
all_card.real_text: Clues cannot be placed on [[Cairo]] locations. [action] If you are at an [[Expedition]] location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

all_card.back_flavor: 你每喚醒一個沉夢者，奈斯的神秘力量就減退一分。不多時，她便跪倒在地，身上的力量完全喪失了。然而，即便藉助你在兄弟會神廟裡發現的咒語和記錄，你還是無法喚醒全部的受害者，只有最近陷入沉睡的人才擺脫了咒語的束縛。至於其餘的受害者——包括約翰·伯克——他們的命運毫無疑問和奈斯緊緊相連。"如果你相信整件事就到此結束，那麼你真是活該掉入伊扎法拉的陷阱。"她警告你，"殺了我，你就會是下一個。"你猶豫了。但要是讓她活下去，那些被她誘入長眠的人就一定不會醒來。一個人的性命，怎麼能和那麼多無辜者的性命相比呢？
all_card.back_text: 調查員必須作出決定(請明智地選擇)： - 永遠消滅奈斯。 你相信只要選擇此項，那些陷入永恆沉睡詛咒的人將會醒來。(→結局1) - 饒過奈斯，聽聽她要說什麼。 你相信只要選擇此項，就能知道更多奈斯所提及有關伊扎法拉的事情。(→結局2)
all_card.flavor: 你找到的最後一則記錄描述了末日時刻，屆時將有一千個沉夢者被獻祭。你現在明曉了兄弟會的知識，你相信自己可以趕在他們殺死開羅所有的男女老少之前扭轉詛咒。
all_card.name: 審判之刻
all_card.text: [action]如果你所在地點有沉夢者：檢定[willpower]或[intellect](X)來試著叫醒沉夢者，其中X為當前深淵之力的強度。如果你成功，將一個沉夢者從你所在地點移動到奈斯上，作為傷害。 目標 - 如果奈斯沒有剩餘生命值，推進場景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: With each of the dreamers you set free, the arcane power wielded by Neith fades. Before long, she has collapsed to her knees, the power completely drained from her body. However, even with the spells and records you found in the Brotherhood's temple, you're unable to awaken all of the victims; only those most recently put under the spell's sway. As for the remainder of the victims - including John Burke - their fate is inextricably tied to Neith. "If you believe that this is the end, you deserve the fate Xzharah has in store for you," she warns you. "Slay me and you will be next in line to die." You waver. But if she is allowed to live, those she has ensnared in sleep will never awaken. What is one life, compared to the lives of so many innocents?
all_card.real_back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose wisely): -Destroy Neith once and for all.
By choosing this option, you believe those still under the curse of eternal slumber will be freed. (→R1) - Spare Neith and listen to what she has to say.
By choosing this option, you believe you can learn more about the one Neith refers to as Xzharah. (→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: The final record you find describes a time of reaping, wherein a thousand dreamers will be sacrificed. Armed with the Brotherhood's knowledge, you believe you can reverse their curse before they claim the waking lives of every last man, woman, and child in Cairo.
all_card.real_text: [action] If there is a dreamer at your location: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (X) to attempt to awaken a dreamer. X is the strength of the abyss. If you succeed, move a dreamer from your location to Neith, as damage. Objective - If Neith has no remaining health, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 這個月開羅出奇的乾燥。熾熱的太陽無情地烘烤著城裡彎彎繞繞的狹窄小巷。過路行人在蔭庇間穿行，以此躲避陽光……還是說，他們在躲著你？
all_card.name: 開羅街道
all_card.text: 強制 - 你在一個回合內於開羅街道發現2個或更多線索後：受到1點恐懼。 [action]如果開羅街道沒有線索：檢定[agility](4)。如果你成功，請記住你"找到了一扇用血標記的門"。
all_card.real_back_flavor: It is an unusually dry month in Cairo. The narrow, winding streets of the city are baked by the hot, unrelenting sun. Pedestrians travel from shadow to shadow to keep out of the sunlight… Or are they avoiding you?
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discover 2 or more clues at Streets of Cairo during a single turn: Take 1 horror. [action] If there are no clues on Streets of Cairo: Test [agility] (4). If you succeed, remember that you have "found a door marked with blood."

all_card.back_flavor: 大巴札繁忙的街道上擠滿了叫賣器物的小販，主顧沙啞的聲音也不絕於耳。在人群中找出一條路已經夠難了——要想找到你的目標則要麻煩得多。
all_card.name: 開羅巴扎
all_card.text:
你位於開羅巴扎時，你打出的每張[[道具]]支援卡費用減少1，你打出的其他支援卡的費用增加1。
[action]花費10資源：記住你"買到了一件古怪的飾品"。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The busy streets of the bazaar are packed with peddlers hawking their wares and a raucous throng of patrons. Navigating your way through the crowd is difficult enough - finding your mark will be even more troublesome.
all_card.real_text:
While you are at Cairo Bazaar, reduce the cost of each [[Item]] asset you play by 1 and increase the cost of each other asset you play by 1.
[action] Spend 10 resources: Remember that you "bought an odd trinket."

all_card.back_flavor: 在舊博物館被尼羅河的洪水淹沒後，解放廣場上豎立起了一座新博物館，這裡貯存著全世界最大的法老時代收藏，包括莎草紙、錢幣、雕像、碑銘、棺槨和木乃伊。
all_card.name: 埃及博物館
all_card.text: [action]：檢定[intellect](5)。如果你成功，請記住你"發現了一塊古代碑銘"。 強制 - 在你調查埃及博物館後，如果你沒有成功並超過至少2點：失去所有剩餘的行動，立即結束你的回合。
all_card.real_back_flavor: This new museum - built in Tahrir Square after the Nile flooded the previous building - houses the world's largest collection of Pharaonic antiquities, including papyrus, coins, statues, tablets, coffins, and even mummies.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (5). If you succeed, remember that you have "discovered an ancient tablet." Forced - After you investigate Museum of Egyptian Antiquities, if you did not succeed by at least 2: Lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.

all_card.back_flavor: 熾烈的艷陽照耀著整個開羅，天空沐浴在美麗的橙紅色光線裡。對將要到來的恐怖而言，這真是一幕盛大的序曲。
all_card.name: 開羅市郊
all_card.text: [action]選擇並丟棄你5張手牌：記住你"破壞了火車"。 [action]如果沒有調查員"破壞了火車"：撤退。你坐上火車離開了開羅，把沉夢者留在了他們無法醒來的夢魘之中。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As the hot sun sets over Cairo, the sky is bathed in beautiful rays of orange and red. It is a magnificent prelude to the horrors to come.
all_card.real_text: [action] Choose and discard 5 cards from your hand: Remember that you have "sabotaged the train." [action] If no investigator has "sabotaged the train": Resign. You take the train out of Cairo, leaving the dreamers to their unceasing nightmare.

all_card.back_flavor: 銀色的燈光輕柔地灑在庭院裡。儘管任務緊急，你還是在這兒感受到了平靜。你發誓要是這一切結束之後自己還醒著，一定會回來看看。
all_card.name: 神廟庭院
all_card.text:
