只要神廟庭院上沒有剩餘線索，每個謙恭教徒失去冷漠。
[action]：檢定[combat](5)。如果你成功，請記住你"闖入一間廢棄的神廟"。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Silvery rays of light gently bathe the courtyard in a soft glow. Despite the urgency of your task, you feel at peace here. You vow to return if you're still awake when this is over.
all_card.real_text:
While there are no clues remaining on Temple Courtyard, each copy of Humble Supplicant loses aloof.
[action]: Test [combat] (5). If you succeed, remember that you have "broken into a deserted temple."

all_card.name: 奈斯
all_card.text: 獵手。反擊。 強制 - 在奈斯的攻擊造成的恐懼擊敗一位調查員或[[盟友]]支援卡後：該卡"墮入深淵"。 強制 - 在奈斯從攻擊中受到任意數量的傷害時，如果其所在地點有至少1個沉夢者：從其所在地點移除1個沉夢者，取消1點奈斯將受到的傷害。
all_card.traits: 類人. 兄弟會. 精英
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate Forced - After horror from Neith's attack defeats an investigator or [[Ally]] asset: That card is "taken by the abyss." Forced - When Neith is dealt any amount of damage from an attack, if there is at least 1 dreamer at her location: Remove 1 dreamer from her location and cancel 1 damage just dealt to Neith.

all_card.name: 謙恭教徒
all_card.text: 生成 - 任意[[開羅]]地點(如果可能，生成在有[[兄弟會]]敵人所在的地點)。 冷漠。 每個謙恭教徒所在地點的[[兄弟會]]敵人無法被攻擊，也不會受到傷害。 強制 - 在敵軍階段結束時：如果可能，將每個謙恭教徒向最近的[[兄弟會]]敵人移動一次。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Any [[Cairo]] location (with a [[Brotherhood]] enemy, if able). Aloof. Each [[Brotherhood]] enemy at Humble Supplicant's location cannot be attacked or damaged. Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Move Humble Supplicant once toward the nearest [[Brotherhood]] enemy, if able.

all_card.name: 深淵造物
all_card.text: 反擊。 X為當前深淵之力的強度。 強制 - 在深淵造物入場後，如果深淵之力的強度為2或更低：深淵之力增強1點。 強制 - 在深淵造物被擊敗後，如果深淵之力的強度為5或更高：深淵之力減弱1點。
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. X is the strength of the abyss. Forced - After Creature from the Abyss enters play, if the strength of the abyss is 2 or lower: Add 1 strength to the abyss. Forced - After Creature from the Abyss is defeated, if the strength of the abyss is 5 or higher: Remove 1 strength from the abyss.

all_card.back_text:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X為當前深淵之力的強度+1。
[cultist]：再抽取1個標記。如果你失敗，且深淵之力的強度為5或更低，深淵之力增強1點。
[tablet]：-3。本次技能檢定無視所有你的技能值正值修正。
[elder_thing]：-5。如果你成功，且深淵之力的強度為4或更高，深淵之力減弱1點。
all_card.name: 夜之亂臣
all_card.text:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X為當前深淵之力的強度。
[cultist]：再抽取1個標記。如果你失敗，且深淵之力的強度為3或更低，深淵之力增強1點。
[tablet]：-1。本次技能檢定無視所有你的技能值正值修正。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你成功，且深淵之力的強度為4或更高，深淵之力減弱1點。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the strength of the abyss.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and the strength of the abyss is 5 or lower, add 1 strength to the abyss.
[tablet]: -3. For this skill test, ignore all bonuses to your skill value.
[elder_thing]: -5. If you succeed and the strength of the abyss is 4 or more, remove 1 strength from the abyss.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the strength of the abyss.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and the strength of the abyss is 3 or lower, add 1 strength to the abyss.
[tablet]: -1. For this skill test, ignore all bonuses to your skill value.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you succeed and the strength of the abyss is 4 or more, remove 1 strength from the abyss.

all_card.back_flavor:
兄弟會剩餘的成員找到了絕佳的出手機會，趁著夜色伏擊了你。"為了涅弗倫·卡，為了伊扎法拉！"他們狂喜地叫著，包圍了你的營地。
他們的眼睛赤若火燒，閃耀著反常的力量。他們的肌肉腫脹，血管搏動的樣子絕非常態。無論你說什麼，都無法阻止他們的攻擊，你懷疑他們內心是否還有任何人性可言。
all_card.back_text: 按玩家順序，每位調查員隨機拿取一張放在冒險輔助卡底下的[[兄弟會]]敵人，將其生成並與自己交戰，直到冒險輔助卡底下所有的敵人都已生成，或每名調查員都已按照此方式生成了一個敵人。將冒險輔助卡底下剩餘的每個敵人生成在距離探險營地最遠的無人地點，一次一個。(無視這些敵人上的所有"生成"指示。) 將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。 深淵之力增強1點。
all_card.flavor:
兄弟會的成員依然逍遙在外，你不得不秘密進行搜查，以防有人窺視。現在你已經暴露，你知道任何人都可能是祕密組織的密探——即便是溫洛克的探險隊員也一樣。
要想阻止他們的密謀，你必須以身犯險。
然而，知道他們隨時可能出擊，讓你時刻保持警惕，絕不鬆懈。他們遲早會出手，而你有備而來。
all_card.name: 兄弟會等候時機
all_card.real_back_flavor: Having found the perfect moment to strike, the remaining members of the Brotherhood ambush you in the night. "For Nephren-Ka! For Xzharah!" they cry out in exultation as they surround your camp. Their eyes are burning red with unnatural power, their muscles bulging and their veins pulsing with bizarre fluid. Nothing you say deters their attack, and you wonder if there is any humanity left in their minds at all.
all_card.real_back_text: In player order, each investigator takes a random [[Brotherhood]] enemy from under the scenario reference card and spawns it engaged with him or her, until either each of the enemies under the scenario reference card have been spawned, or each investigator has spawned an enemy in this way. Spawn each enemy still remaining under the scenario reference card, one at a time, at empty locations farthest from the Expedition Camp. (Ignore all "Spawn" instructions on those enemies.) Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Add 1 strength to the abyss.
all_card.real_flavor: With members of the Brotherhood still at large, your research had to be done in secret, away from prying eyes. Now that you are exposed, you know that anyone could be a spy for the secret cabal - even members of Winlock's expedition. It is a risk you must take in order to stop their plot. Regardless, knowing they could strike at any moment sets your nerves on edge. Sooner or later, they will show their hand, and you will have to be ready.

all_card.back_flavor:
"完成了。"伊扎法拉的彎刀捅進了最後一個沉夢者的身子。他繁星密佈的臉浸滿了猩紅的熱血，吞食了受害者的生命力，"再加上這一片靈魂，我就完整了。
深淵陷入一片可怕的寂靜。沒人敢質疑這片領域新王的權威和力量。粗鄙的黑暗怪物成群爬下，向自己的新主人獻上了祭品。伊扎法拉檢閱著自己的領地，他每跨出一步，足下都環繞著重重迷霧。他經過的時候，數不清的有翼怪物恭恭敬敬地以示效忠。
這個世界已屬於他。我們的世界將會是下一個。
all_card.back_text: 所有調查員被擊敗。 所有被擊敗的調查員"墮入深淵"。 (→結局1)
all_card.flavor: 這個邪惡的陰謀威脅的不僅是我們的世界，還有另一個世界。你只有一次機會阻止他們實現自己的野心。現在就是出手的時候。
all_card.name: 黑暗彼端的陰謀
all_card.text: 調查員不能和[[兄弟會]]敵人談判。 每個[[兄弟會]]敵人不能翻面。 強制 - 在本密謀上放置了第4個或第8個毀滅標記後：深淵之力增強1點。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"It is done." Xzharah plunges his blade into the last of the dreamers. Its starry surface, soaked in hot crimson blood, devours the victim's life force. "With this soul, I am complete."
The abyss is plunged into a dreadful silence. None can question the authority and power of the realm's new lord. Uncouth creatures of darkness crawl forth from their pits to pay tribute to their master. As Xzharah surveys his domain, the mist coils about his feet with each step he takes. Countless winged creatures bow in servitude as he passes.
This world is his. Ours is next.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator is defeated. Each defeated investigator is "taken by the abyss." (→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: This sinister plot threatens not only our own world, but another. You have only one chance to stop them from achieving their goal. Now is the time for action.
all_card.real_text: Investigators cannot Parley with [[Brotherhood]] enemies. Each [[Brotherhood]] enemy cannot be flipped over. Forced - After the 4th or 8th doom is placed on this agenda: Add 1 strength to the abyss.

all_card.back_flavor:
你離開開羅已有數週，令人沮喪的是，關於兄弟會可能逃走的異界入口，你沒發現任何跡象。正當你考慮返回開羅進行更多研究的時候，你被叫到了溫洛克的帳篷裡，疲憊的探險隊長正用他長滿老繭的雙手檢查著一幅埃及地圖。"啊，很好。你來了。"他說著從背包裡摸索出一本半是燒痕的古書，放在你面前，"我覺得你可能會想看看我們在南邊的古墓裡發現了什麼。"你翻開古書，在焦痕遍佈的書頁間細細研讀，最後終於發現了一幅沙漠地圖，上面標記著埃及的象形文字。這和溫洛克身前地圖所繪的位於同一地區。"看到了嗎，就在那兒？"他指著地圖西面的一個象形文字說道，"這個的意思是'門'。"他帶著一點自鳴得意的笑意，指向自己那幅更大的地圖上相同的地方，那裡標示了你的目的地。
"這就是你要找的地方嗎？"
all_card.back_text: 將放在一邊的驚悚入口洗入探索牌堆。
all_card.flavor: 在溫洛克的支持下，探險開展了起來。但是和其它的考古學家與研究者不一樣，你不是為了尋找古墓或者文物而來的。你尋找的，是更為古老，更加危險的東西：一個若非你提及，絕不會有人相信的地方。
all_card.name: 搜尋入口
all_card.text: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，將它放置入場，並移動到該地點。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
It has been several weeks since you set forth from Cairo, but to your dismay, you have found no sign of the otherworldly gate to which the Brotherhood supposedly retreated. Just as you are considering returning to Cairo to conduct more research, you are summoned into Winlock's tent, where the weary expedition leader is examining a map of Egypt with calloused hands. "Oh good, you're here," he says, fumbling through his pack for an old, half-burned tome, which he places on the table in front of you. "Thought you might want to see what we found in that crypt to the south." You turn over the book, sifting through its charred pages, until you come to a map of the desert marked by Egyptian hieroglyphs. It is the same region depicted on the map in front of Winlock. "See that, right there?" He points to one of the hieroglyphs on the western side of the map. "It means 'door'." With a hint of a smirk, he then points to the same spot on his larger map, marking your destination.
"That what you're looking for?"
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Eldritch Gate into the exploration deck.
all_card.real_flavor: With Winlock's support, the expedition is underway. But unlike the other archaeologists and researchers, you're not searching for ancient crypts or artifacts. You are after something older and far more dangerous: a place the others would not believe existed even if you told them.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

all_card.back_flavor: 你穿越入口的時候，現實瞬間消融。沙丘化為世界之基，蒼穹进裂，整個世界的顏色都被抽進了拱門之內。你再次掙開雙眼的時候，發現自己正身處不同的世界之間。在長廊的另一頭，一個穿著長袍的身影從彼端的門顯現，他沒有面龐，揮舞著一柄彎刀，上面躍動著黑暗的力量。"你將成為我的下一個祭品。"他的聲音聽上去怒火中燒。
all_card.back_text:
將放在一邊的夢境之間地點放置入場，已揭示面向上。將所有調查員移動到此處，將所有其它地點移出遊戲。將放在一邊的伊扎法拉敵人放在夢境之間，敵人面向上。將每張放在一邊的駭人的夏塔克鳥和遭遇棄牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌堆。
如果古代安可架支援卡位於場上：
你的安可架發出炫目的光芒，嚇得伊扎法拉趕忙後退。"這麼說，奈斯背棄了我們！"伊扎法拉嘶嘶道。
消耗伊扎法拉，將其與所有調查員解除交戰。
all_card.flavor: 在充分縮小入口可能所在的範圍之後，你和溫洛克及他的隊伍分道揚鑣。接下來要做的事，你不想再讓他們跟著……
all_card.name: 踏進入口
all_card.text: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，將它放置入場，並移動到該地點。 目標 - 當一輪結束時，如果每位未被擊敗的調查員都位於驚悚入口，花費所需數量的線索推進場景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Reality slips away as you cross the threshold of the gate. The sandy dunes fold into the foundation of the Earth, the firmament splits, and the colors of the world bleed into the archway. When next you open your eyes, you are in a place between worlds. At the opposite end of the corridor, a figure emerges from the doorway beyond, faceless and wielding a curved blade that pulses with dark power. "You shall be my next sacrifice," his voice seethes.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put the set-aside A Dream Betwixt location into play, revealed location side faceup. Move each investigator there and remove all other locations from the game. Spawn the set-aside Xzharah enemy in A Dream Betwixt, enemy side faceup. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Dreaded Shantak into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
If the Ancient Ankh asset is in play:
Your Ankh amulet glows with a blinding light, causing Xzharah to recoil. "So, Neith has abandoned us!" Xzharah hisses.
Exhaust Xzharah and disengage him from all investigators.
all_card.real_flavor: Having sufficiently narrowed down the location of the gateway, you part ways with Winlock and his team. You don't want them following where you're going…
all_card.real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - At the end of the round, if each undefeated investigator is at the Eldritch Gate and they spend the requisite number of clues, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 僅憑你一己之力，是無法擊敗伊扎法拉的。也許你可以在門扉彼岸的領域中找到終結這場邪惡儀式的方法。
all_card.back_text: 如果以下要求已至少滿足3項，你可以選擇推進(→結局2)。否則，將本場景翻回"a"面。 - 伊扎法拉已沒有剩餘生命值。 - 調查員必須以團隊為單位，至少擁有3[per_investigator]個線索。 - 深淵之力必須為4或更低。 - 調查員必須已經"解救了夜魘"、"警告了薩爾科曼德的居民"、"尋求了幫助"。
all_card.flavor: 伊扎法拉正在積聚力量，屠殺所有穿過這片領域和深淵之間的沉夢者。當最後的靈魂也被他吞沒之時，還有什麼能阻止他征服一切呢？
all_card.name: 夜之亂臣
all_card.text: 目標 - "我們必須找到方法阻止他！"如果伊扎法拉已消耗，一位其所在地點的調查員可以選擇推進場景。(每階段限制一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Xzharah cannot be stopped by means you alone possess. Perhaps if you learn more about the realm beyond the gateway, you can find a way to end this vile ritual.
all_card.real_back_text: If at least three of the following requirements are met, you may proceed to (→R2). Otherwise, flip this act back to its "a" side. - Xzharah must have no remaining health. - Investigators must possess 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. - The strength of the abyss must be 4 or lower. - The investigators must have "freed the nightgaunts," "warned the denizens of Sarkomand," and "pled for help."
all_card.real_flavor: Xzharah is gathering his strength, slaying each and every dreamer who crosses between this realm and the Abyss beyond. When the last soul is his, who will be left to prevent his conquest?
all_card.real_text: Objective - "We have to find a way to stop him!" If Xzharah is exhausted, an investigator at his location may choose to advance. (Limit once per phase.)

all_card.name: 夢境之間
all_card.text: 強制 - 如果深淵之力的強度為0：將深淵之力的強度設為1。 [reaction]在你成功調查夢境之間後：將其翻面，結算其另一面的文本。
all_card.real_text: Forced - If the strength of the abyss is 0: Set the strength of the abyss to 1. [reaction] After you successfully investigate A Dream Betwixt: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor:
長廊彼端的門所通往的地方，遠超現實所在。這裡是夢境和現實交匯的地方。
你堅定信念，凝視著深淵。深淵將你擁入懷中。
all_card.name: 前往幻夢境
all_card.text: 將所有其餘放在一邊的地點放置入場，已揭示面向上 - 大深淵、恩格拉內克山下的隧道、通往薩爾科曼德的階梯、充滿迷霧的洞穴。(在每個地點上放置等同於其線索值數目的線索。) 結算此文本的調查員和與其交戰的所有怪物解除交戰，並移動到大深淵。 將本卡牌翻面。直到本局遊戲結束，本卡牌都不能再被翻面。
all_card.real_flavor:
The gateway beyond this corridor leads to a place beyond the physical world. A place where dreams and reality converge.
You steady your thoughts and stare into the abyss. The abyss embraces you.
all_card.real_text: Put each of the remaining set-aside locations into play, revealed location side faceup - The Great Abyss, Tunnels under Ngranek, Stairway to Sarkomand, and Mist-Filled Caverns. (Place clues on each of those locations equal to their clue value.) The investigator resolving this text disengages from each engaged enemy and moves to The Great Abyss. Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.flavor:
……他已經抵達深淵的入口了，下方就是結著硬殼、散發著霉臭的石頭階梯，直通往充滿噩夢的地穴。
<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《夢尋秘境卡達斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 大深淵
all_card.text: [reaction]在你成功發現了大深淵最後的線索後：將其翻面，結算其另一面的文本。
all_card.real_flavor: …he had indeed reached the yawning gulf whose crusted and mouldy stone steps lead down to the crypts of nightmare. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you discover the last remaining clue from The Great Abyss: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 正當你穿過巨大的深淵之時，你驚奇地發現還有人像被催眠一樣，萬分困惑地逡巡在這洞穴般的迷霧。你認不出他們，這些人不是開羅事件中的病人。兄弟會一定是最近才又找到了這些最新的受害者。憑藉你已有的知識，你可以試著叫醒他們——或者把他們作為祭品帶到伊扎法拉那裡。
all_card.name: 沉夢者的命運
all_card.text:
你必須作出決定(選擇以下一項)：
- 深淵之力減弱2點。
- 深淵之力增強2點。
無論你選擇哪一項，都將本卡牌翻面。直到本局遊戲結束，本卡牌都不能再被翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: As you traverse the vast abyss, you are surprised to find others wandering through the cavernous mist, mesmerized and confused. You don't recognize them as patients from the incident in Cairo. The Brotherhood must have sent these victims here recently. With the knowledge you have now, you could try to awaken them - or guide them to Xzharah as sacrifices.
all_card.real_text:
You must decide (choose one):
- Remove 2 strength from the abyss.
- Add 2 strength to the abyss.
Regardless of your choice, flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.flavor:
……恩格拉內克山貧瘠險惡、極難攀援，還有傳聞說山頂附近的洞穴裡住著夜魘。
<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《夢尋秘境卡達斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 恩格拉內克山下的隧道
all_card.text: [action]：檢定[intellect](2)以在犬牙交錯的隧道中找出生命的跡象。如果你成功，將本卡牌翻面，結算其另一面的文本。
all_card.real_flavor: …Ngranek is very difficult and barren and sinister, and there are rumours of caves near the peak wherein dwell the night-gaunts. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to search for signs of life within these jagged tunnels. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 你在火山隧道中探索的時候，發現了許多受到殘忍對待的有翼生物的屍體：它們中有些通體黑色、沒有面龐、長著带膜的翅膀和黑色的角：其它的碩大無朋、長有鱗片、長著蝙蝠樣的翅膀和馬一樣的頭。繼續深入隧道，你發現更多的無面生物被粗粗的鐵鏈束縛著。你想這一定是伊扎法拉的囚徒。你靠近的時候，它們奇異的頭顱都轉向了你，沒有發出一點聲響。
all_card.name: 征服者的囚徒
all_card.text:
你必須作出決定(選擇以下一項)：
- 檢定[agility](4)以解救這些生物。如果你成功，其中一個生物給了你三隻黑哨，然後飛向了自己的主人。控制放在一邊的召來的夜魔支援並記住你 "解救了夜魘"。
- 檢定[combat](4)以殺死這些生物。如果你成功，請記住你"殺死了夜魘"。
無論你選擇哪一項，無論你通過檢定與否，都將本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: As you explore the volcanic tunnels, you find brutalized corpses of dozens of winged creatures: some black and faceless, with membranous wings and dark horns; others huge and scaly, with bat-like wings and heads like a horse's. Continuing deeper down the tunnels, you come across more of the faceless creatures restrained by thick iron chains. Prisoners of Xzharah, you imagine. They make no sound as you approach, their uncanny heads turning towards you.
all_card.real_text:
You must decide (choose one):
- Test [agility] (4) to free the creatures. If you succeed, one of them hands you 3 black whistles before they fly off toward their master; take control of the set-aside Summoned Nightgaunt asset and remember that you "freed the nightgaunts."
- Test [combat] (4) to slay the creatures. If you succeed, remember that you "executed the nightgaunts."
Regardless of your choice and whether you succeed or fail the indicated skill test, flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor:
這段下行之路相當可怕，數個鐘頭不知不覺地過去了，期間卡特一直摸黑在滑溜溜的陡峭階梯上行走，在旋轉的樓梯上繞了一圈又一圈。
<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《夢尋秘境卡達斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 通往薩爾科曼德的階梯
all_card.text: [action]：檢定[willpower](3)以通過不可思議的反重力階梯。如果你成功，將本卡牌翻面，結算其另一面的文本。
all_card.real_flavor: Terrible is the memory of that dark descent in which hours wore themselves away whilst Carter wound sightlessly round and round down a fathomless spiral of steep and slippery stairs. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] (3) to navigate the bewildering and gravity-defying staircase. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 彷彿是經過了永恆，你終於到了地下階梯的頂端，這裡有一扇活板門可以通向地面。你發現自己身處一座廢城宏大的中央廣場，這座廢城位於天藍色的美麗海洋之畔。一對巨大的有翼獅像拱衛著階梯的入口。
all_card.name: 薩爾科曼德的廢墟
all_card.text:
你必須作出決定(選擇以下一項)：
- 檢定[intellect](3)來和跟人類非常相像的廢墟居民對話。如果你成功，你警告他們下面爆發的戰爭，他們四散而逃，請記住你 "警告了薩爾科曼德的居民"。
- 檢定[combat](3)以鎖住活板門。如果你成功，你推倒了獅像，在你退回深處的時候封死了通往階梯的活板門，請記住你 "切斷了一切退路"。
無論你選擇哪一項，無論你通過檢定與否，都將本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: After what feels like an eternity, you finally reach the top of the subterranean stairs, where a trapdoor leads you to the surface. You find yourself in the large central plaza of a ruined city on the shoreline of a beautiful sky-blue ocean. A pair of colossal winged lion statues guards the entrance to the stairway.
all_card.real_text:
You must decide (choose one):
- Test [intellect] (3) to speak to the almost-humanoid creatures that dwell in these ruins. If you succeed, you warn them of the battle below and they flee; remember that you "warned the denizens of Sarkomand."
- Test [combat] (3) to block the trapdoor. If you succeed, you topple the lion statues and use them to block the entrance to the stairway as you descend back into the depths; remember that you "cut off all escape."
Regardless of your choice and whether you succeed or fail the indicated skill test, flip this card back over.

all_card.name: 充滿迷霧的洞穴
all_card.text: [action]：檢定[agility](4)以穿過這片迷霧。如果你成功，將本卡牌翻面，結算其另一面的文本。
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [agility] (4) to traverse through the mist. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 你越是深入深淵的深處，迷霧就越顯濃重。最終，你來到迷霧散去的地方，這裡是一間開闊的內室。你看到一尊高聳雕像，刻的是一位鬚髮濃密的長者。他駕著一輛巨大貝殼樣子的馬車，拉車的是驚異奇怪的野獸。
all_card.name: 諾登斯的雕像
all_card.text:
你必須作出決定(選擇以下一項)：
- 檢定[willpower](2)來向這尊雕像所繪的存在乞求幫助。如果你成功，記住你"尋求了幫助"。
- 檢定[combat](2)來推翻這尊雕像。如果你成功，雕像翻倒，在凹凸不平的岩穴地面上摔成碎片。記住你 "觸怒了這片領域的主人"。
無論你選擇哪一項，無論你通過檢定與否，都將本卡牌翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: The mist grows ever thicker as you make your way deeper into the depths of the abyss. Finally, you come across an open chamber where the mist has receded, and you are greeted by a tall statue of an elderly man with a great bear and a mane of long hair. He rides a chariot formed from a huge seashell, which is pulled by beasts both wondrous and strange.
all_card.real_text:
You must decide (choose one):
- Test [willpower] (2) to entreat the entity depicted in this statue for aid. If you succeed, remember that you "pled for help."
- Test [combat] (2) to overthrow the statue. If you succeed, it topples over and shatters into pieces on the jagged cavern floor; remember that you "affronted the ruler of this realm."
Regardless of your choice and whether you succeed or fail the indicated skill test, flip this card back over.

all_card.name: 伊札法拉
all_card.text: 獵手。反擊。 伊札法拉+5[per_investigator]生命值，且不會因傷害而被擊敗。 [action]：談判。檢定[willpower]或[intellect](X)，其中X為當前深淵之力的強度。如果你成功，將本敵人翻面，結算其另一面的文本。如果你失敗，伊札法拉攻擊你。
all_card.traits: 僕從. 幻夢境. 同謀. 精英
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate Xzharah gets +5 [per_investigator] health and cannot be defeated by damage. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (X), where X is the strength of the abyss. If you succeed, flip this enemy over and resolve the text on its other side. If you fail, Xzharah attacks you.

all_card.flavor: "天選"開了口，冷酷的話語鑽進了你的耳朵。"涅弗倫·卡之日就要到來，道路將灑滿鮮血。"他向你允諾道，"證明你的忠誠，你就將受到嘉獎。等那天到來，你可以活下去。倘若拒絕，那就去死。我就將獨自統治這裡。"
all_card.name: 逆亂暗夜
all_card.text: 如果以下要求都已滿足，你可以選擇前往(→結局3)。 - 深淵之力必須為5或更高。 - 調查員必須已經"殺死了夜魘"、"切斷了一切退路"、"觸怒了這片領域的主人"。 如果上述要求未都滿足，每位調查員可以分別選擇是否要接受伊扎法拉的仁慈並立刻撤退。如果仍有調查員進行遊戲，將這張卡牌翻回敵人面。
all_card.real_flavor: The Chosen One's words are grim whispers that worm their way into your ears. "The Day of Nephren-Ka shall come, and the road shall be paved with blood," he promises. "Prove your loyalty and you shall be rewarded. When the Day arrives, you alone shall be spared. Refuse, and be consumed. Then I alone shall rule this place."
all_card.real_text: If each of the following requirements are met, you may proceed to (→R3). - The strength of the abyss must be 5 or higher. - The investigators must have "executed the nightgaunts," "cut off all escape," and "affronted the ruler of this realm." If the above requirements are not met, each investigator may choose whether or not to accept Xzharah's mercy and immediately resign. If any investigators remain, flip this card back to its enemy side.

all_card.flavor: 巨大的拱門赫然聳立在你眼前，就像從故事裡出來的一樣。都不需要專業的考古學知識，也能看出這東西的源頭不是埃及。要是這道門真能通向什麼地方，那肯定有辦法能"啟動"它……
all_card.name: 驚悚入口
all_card.traits: 探險. 沙漠. 遺跡
all_card.real_flavor: The colossal archway looms before you, appearing like something out of fiction. It doesn't take an archaeologist to realize it isn't Egyptian in origin. If this gateway truly leads somewhere else, there must be a way to "activate" it…

all_card.flavor:
它們不是地球或幻夢境中人熟悉的任何一種鳥類或蝙蝠，因為他們的個頭超過了大象……
<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《夢尋秘境卡達斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 駭人的夏塔克鳥
all_card.text:
獵手。龐大。
駭人的夏塔克鳥準備時，其所在地點的[action]和[reaction]能力不能被觸發。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 幻夢境. 夏塔克鳥
all_card.real_flavor:
They were not any birds or bats known elsewhere on earth or in dreamland, for they were larger than elephants…
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text:
Hunter. Massive.
While Dreaded Shantak is ready, [action] and [reaction] abilities on its location cannot be triggered.

all_card.name: 黑法老的信使
all_card.text: 深淵之力小於或等於2時，黑法老的信使獲得獵手。 強制 - 在黑法老的信使被擊敗後，如果深淵之力為3或更高：其所在地點的每位調查員受到1點傷害。
all_card.real_text: While the strength of the abyss is 2 or lower, Speaker for the Dark Pharaoh gains hunter. Forced - After Speaker for the Dark Pharaoh is defeated, if the strength of the abyss is 3 or higher: Each investigator at its location takes 1 damage.

all_card.name: 萊拉·艾爾·馬斯瑞博士
all_card.text: 生成 - 探險營地。 [action]在萊拉·艾爾·馬斯瑞博士所在地點的調查員以團隊為單位，丟棄合計至少有4個[willpower]圖標的手牌：談判。將萊拉·艾爾·馬斯瑞博士加入勝利牌區。
all_card.traits: 類人. 異教徒. 兄弟會
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Expedition Camp. [action] As a group, investigators at Dr. Layla El Masri's location discard cards from hand with a total of at least 4 [willpower] icons among them: Parley. Add Dr. Layla El Masri to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: "我別無選擇！"萊拉叫道，"我讀到的東西……我翻譯的記錄……他們都指向一件事。"她宣稱，"毀滅、廢墟。我們無法阻止。我們能做的，就只有在殘磚碎瓦之間為自己愛的人築一片巢。"你告訴她你會盡自己所能阻止這次"毀滅"，但她搖了搖頭，涕淚交加。"這是愚蠢的使命。但……"萊拉深吸一口氣，她想到自己還有一條路可以選，"答應我，你會保護我的兒女安全，我就會盡我所能地幫助你。"
all_card.name: 譯者的證據
all_card.text:
在一位調查員"發現了一塊古代碑銘"後，閱讀以下本文(如果已完成，立刻閱讀以下文本)：
你把碑文帶給了艾爾·馬斯瑞博士，她盡自己最大的努力翻譯了出來。"當天選降世，他將從神聖之地的一千個祭品中獲得力量。"她眨了幾下眼睛，想要弄清這是什座意思，"現在已經有多少病人陷入沉睡了？"她瞪大眼晴問道。
深淵之力減弱1點。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: "I didn't have a choice!" Layla cries. "The things I've read… The records I've translated… They all point to one thing," she claims. "Destruction. Ruin. We can't stop it. All we can do is forge a place for our loved ones in the rubble." You tell her that you will do everything in your power to stop this 'destruction', but she shakes her head, tears in her eyes. "It's a fool's errand. But… " Layla takes a deep breath as she considers her options. "Promise you'll keep my daughter and my son safe, and I'll help you in any way I can."
all_card.real_text:
After an investigator has "discovered an ancient tablet," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
You bring the tablet to Dr. El Masri, and she translates it to the best of her ability. "When the Choice is made, He shall be empowered by a thousand sacrifices from the sacred land." She blinks a few times, trying to process what it means. "How many coma patients are there right now?" she asks, wide-eyed.
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 溫特沃斯·摩爾博士
all_card.text: 生成 - 埃及博物館。 溫特沃斯·摩爾博士所在地點有有準備狀態的[[怪物]]敵人時，他不會受到傷害。 強制 - 在溫特沃斯·摩爾博士入場後：查找遭遇牌堆和遭遇棄牌堆，找出1個[[怪物]]敵人，生成在他所在地點。混洗遭遇牌堆。
all_card.traits: 類人. 異教徒. 兄弟會
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Museum of Egyptian Antiquities. Dr. Wentworth Moore cannot be damaged while there is a ready [[Monster]] enemy at his location. Forced - After Dr. Wentworth Moore enters play: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Monster]] enemy, and spawn it at his location. Shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: 儘管你盡了最大的努力，摩爾博士還是趁著你對付他的"護衛"的時候溜走了。擊敗怪物後，你追上他的蹤跡，你懷疑他一有機會就會逃出這座城。
all_card.name: 教徒的證據
all_card.text:
在一位調查員"破壞了火車"後，閱讀以下本文(如果已完成，立刻閱讀以下文本)：
就在摩爾博士準備徒步逃出城市的時候，你成功將其逼入絕境。"非常聰明。"他承認道，"但你已經沒有時間了。抓住我並無關緊要。沉夢者將被獻祭，天選將帶領我們前往新紀元。"但在幾個小時後，他求著你放他離開城市。"求求你！末日時刻就要來了！奈斯會來殺了我們所有人。我們都會被獻祭，你不明白嗎？你和我都會！我們現在要做的，就是趁還能夠的時候逃出這座城！"
深淵之力減弱1點。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: Despite your best efforts, Dr. Moore slips away while you are occupied by his 'bodyguard'. With the creature defeated, and you hot on his trail, you suspect he will try to escape the city while he has the chance.
all_card.real_text:
After an investigator has "sabotaged the train," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
You manage to corner Dr. Moore as he tries to escape the city on foot. "Very clever," he admits. "But you're already out of time. Lock me up, it doesn't matter. The dreamers will be sacrificed, and our Chosen will lead us to a new age." But after several hours, he is begging to be let out of the city. "Please, the reaper is coming! Neith is coming for us all. We'll all be sacrificed, don't you understand? You and me both! All of us need to flee the city while we still can!"
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 納迪婭·尼姆爾
all_card.text: 生成 - 神廟庭院。 [action]：談判。檢定[willpower](7)。你可以受到最多3點恐懼，你每以此方式受到1點恐懼，本次檢定難度-2。如果你成功，將納迪婭·尼姆爾加入勝利牌區。如果你失敗，納迪婭·尼姆爾攻擊你。
all_card.traits: 類人. 異教徒. 兄弟會
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Temple Courtyard. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (7). You may take up to 3 horror to reduce the difficulty of this test by 2 for each horror taken in this way. If you succeed, add Nadia Nimr to the victory display. If you fail, Nadia Nimr attacks you.

all_card.flavor: 納迪婭的信仰動搖了。她驚慌失措、困惑不已，最終屈服了。"開羅城裡他們只讓我們放過了一個地方。"她解釋道，"我們沒人知道為什麼，也沒人知道他們和兄弟會的聯繫。我們只知道不能打擾他們。"她猶豫地交給你一把小小的黃銅鑰匙，"也許現在是時候打擾他們了。那個地方的門上有羔羊之血做的標記。"
all_card.name: 女祭司的證據
all_card.text:
在一位調查員"找到了一扇用血標記的門"後，閱讀以下本文(如果已完成，立刻閱讀以下文本)：
你用納迪婭給你的鑰匙進入了標記的地方。令你驚訝的是，這裡空無一人，只有淡淡的腐敗和舊皮革的味道。這裡的地下室散落著舊書和兄弟會及其成員留下的記錄。要想讀完這些東西可要花上些時候，但線索終歸是線索。
深淵之力減弱1點。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: Nadia's faith is shaken. Scared and confused, she finally gives in. "There is only one residence in Cairo they told us to spare," she explains. "None of us know why, or what their connection is to the Brotherhood. All we know is they were not to be disturbed." She hesitantly gives you a small brass key. "… So maybe it's time to disturb them. The building's door is marked with lamb's blood."
all_card.real_text:
After an investigator has "found a door marked with blood," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
Using the key Nadia gave you, you enter the marked residence. To your surprise, there is nobody inside - only the faint stench of rot and aged leather. The basement of the residence is littered with old books, records kept by the Brotherhood and its many agents. They will take some time to peruse, but a lead is a lead.
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 法利得
all_card.text: 生成 - 開羅巴扎。 [action]：談判。檢定[intellect](7)。你可以花費最多5資源來降低檢定難度，每花費1資源，檢定難度-1。如果你成功，將法利得加入勝利牌區。如果你失敗，法利得攻擊你。
all_card.traits: 類人. 異教徒. 兄弟會
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Cairo Bazaar. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (7). You may spend up to 5 resources to reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each resource spent in this way. If you succeed, add Farid to the victory display. If you fail, Farid attacks you.

all_card.flavor: "好吧，好吧。"法利得的態度溫和了起來，"我是個商人，不是個戰士。我們來做個交易，我就把自己知道的事情都告訴你。然後我就逃出這座城市，不再煩你。"你問他想要什麼。"東邊一座廢棄的神廟裡有個地穴。傳言說裡面有許許多多珍奇的古物。就是那種能在黑市賣不少錢的東西。"他列嘴一笑，露出兩排牙齒，"帶我進入神廟，我就都聽你的。成交嗎？"
all_card.name: 小販的證據
all_card.text:
在一位調查員"闖入了一間廢棄的神廟"後，閱讀以下本文(如果已完成，立刻閱讀以下文本)：
法利得把黃金雕像搜刮進自己的背包，笑得開心極了。你趁著他還沒激動到說不出話來，逼問他你想知道的情報。"你看，我本來也有自己的價碼，但他們給的錢實在是太多了。你明白嗎？"他舉起手，作投降狀，"我給你看看我的記錄。過去幾個月我做了不少'生意'。這其中應該有能正確指引你的。"
深淵之力減弱1點。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: "All right, all right," Farid relents, " I'm a businessman, not a soldier. Strike a deal with me, and I'll tell you what I know. Then I'll skip out of town and be out of your hair." You ask what he wants. "There's a vault in the abandoned temple to the east. Word is, there are a lot of old, valuable artifacts in there. The kind that would fetch a high price on the black market." He grins toothily. "Get me into that temple, and I'm all yours. Deal?"
all_card.real_text:
After an investigator has "broken into a deserted temple," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
Farid grins wide as he scoops golden idols into his rucksack. You press him for information before he gets too excited. "Look, they promised me wealth beyond my wildest dreams. Even I have my price, you know?" He throws up his hands, resigned. "Let me show you my records. I've done a lot of 'business' in the last few months. That'll point you in the right direction."
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 納賽爾
all_card.text: 生成 - 開羅街道。 反擊。 強制 - 在納賽爾攻擊時：深淵之力增強1點，或納賽爾這次攻擊造成+1傷害和+1恐懼(如果是敵軍階段，改為+2傷害和+2恐懼)。
all_card.traits: 類人. 異教徒. 兄弟會
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Streets of Cairo. Retaliate. Forced - When Nassor attacks: Either add 1 strength to the abyss, or Nassor deals +1 damage and +1 horror for this attack (+2 damage and +2 horror instead if it is the enemy phase).

all_card.flavor:
儘管受了致命傷，刺客還是邪笑了一聲。"時候就要到了。"他在一陣咳嗽中擠出一句話，"你以為殺了我就能阻止這一切？蠢貨！惡獸會吞噬你們所有人！"他呼出了最後一口氣，不再出聲了。
你趕在路人注意到屍體前快速翻找他隨身帶的東西。在他個人收藏的一堆奇怪古董裡面，你找到了一小本皮革封面的日誌，上面刻著晦澀難懂的話語：
深淵之刃，食我祭獻。
千魂匯聚，盡然長眠。
其勢將起，惡獸天選。
其日將至，末世吞天！
all_card.name: 刺客的證據
all_card.text: 深淵之力減弱1點。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_flavor:
Despite his mortal wounds, the assassin grins wickedly. "The Day is coming," he says between a fit of coughs. "You think killing me will stop it? Fools! The Beast will devour you all!" He cackles with his final breath, then falls silent.
You are quick to search his belongings before any bystanders spot the body. Among the many strange curios on his person, you find a small leather-bound journal with a cryptic inscription:
Our tribute soaks the abyssal blade
A thousand souls never to wake
With this our Chosen shall arise
And the day is ever nigh!
all_card.real_text: Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 納撒尼爾·泰勒教授
all_card.text: 生成 - 開羅市郊。 [action]在納撒尼爾·泰勒教授所在地點的調查員以團隊為單位，丟棄合計至少4個[intellect]圖標的手牌：談判。將納撒尼爾·泰勒教授加入勝利牌區。
all_card.traits: 類人. 異教徒. 兄弟會
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Outskirts of Cairo. [action] As a group, investigators at Professor Nathaniel Taylor's location discard cards from hand with a total of at least 4 [intellect] icons among them: Parley. Add Professor Nathaniel Taylor to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: "我已時日無多。"泰勒教授長嘆一口氣承認道，"就算沒有你和兄弟會，肺裡的腫瘤也會要了我的命。"他倒掉菸斗裡面的菸灰，把菸斗放在桌上，轉過來面對著你，"好吧。儘管我確信咱倆都已經被死神盯上了，我還是會幫你逃出去的。儘管我還不知道你到底想從我這兒得到什麼。要是你能找到一個兄弟會的古物，我還是能為你研究一下它的。"
all_card.name: 教授的證據
all_card.text:
在一位調查員"買到了一件古怪的飾品"後，閱讀以下本文(如果已完成，立刻閱讀以下文本)：
你把飾品放在教授的桌上。他戴上單片眼鏡，仔細檢查。"太有意思了！"教授叫道，"這只可能是從王室墓穴的某個墓中傳出來的。大多數學者都不相信它真的存在。"他站起來，和你握了握手，"再給我點時間深入研究。或許我們能活著一起把它搞清楚，這樣我還能重發一篇論文呢。"他說著露出了病態的笑容。
深淵之力減弱1點。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: "I'll be dead soon anyway," Professor Taylor admits with a deep sigh. "If it's not you, or the Brotherhood, it'll be the tumor in my lung." He dumps the ashes in his pipe and sets it on his table before turning back towards you. "Fine. I'm certain it'll be the death of both of us, but I'll help you out. Don't know what you expect of me, exactly. I suppose if you found one of the Brotherhood's artifacts, I could study it for you."
all_card.real_text:
After an investigator has "bought an odd trinket," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
You set the trinket down on the professor's desk. He puts on his monocle and examines it carefully. "Intriguing!" he exclaims. "This could only have come from a particular tomb in the royal crypts. Most scholars don't believe it exists." He rises to his feet and shakes your hand. "Give me some time to study this further. Perhaps if we both make it out of this alive, I can resubmit my thesis," he says with a morbid chuckle.
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 當代最偉大的考古學家們彙集在城外，帶著資金、資源和知識，誓要發現古埃及隱藏的所有秘密。也許他們的探險能揭露你正在追尋的真相。
all_card.name: 探險營地
all_card.text: [action]：談判。檢定[intellect](2)來和此地駐紮的研究者交談。如果你成功，查看探索牌堆或遭遇牌堆頂的X張卡牌，其中X為你成功且超出難度的點數。將最多2張查看的卡牌放到相應的牌堆底。將其餘卡牌以任意順序放在牌堆頂。(團隊每輪限制一次。)
all_card.traits: 探險. 開羅. 沙漠
all_card.real_back_flavor: Just outside of the city, the greatest archaeological minds of the age are gathered together with the funding, resources, and knowledge to discover all of the secrets ancient Egypt has to hide. Perhaps their expedition will reveal the truths you are searching for.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2) to speak to the researchers stationed here. If you succeed, look at the top X cards of either the exploration deck or the encounter deck, where X is the amount you succeeded by. Place up to 2 of those cards on the bottom of that deck. Place the rest on top in a random order. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.name: 尼羅河
all_card.text: 強制 - 在你進入尼羅河後：你必須受到1點恐懼或隨機丟棄1張手牌。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Nile River: You must either take 1 horror or discard 1 card from your hand at random.

all_card.name: 代赫舒爾沙漠
all_card.text: 作為你在代赫舒爾沙漠探索時的額外費用，你必須花費2個資源。
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost for you to explore while at Sands of Dashur, you must spend 2 resources.

all_card.name: 撒哈拉沙丘
all_card.text: 強制 - 在你進入撒哈拉沙丘後：你必須受到1點傷害或失去1次行動。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Dunes of the Sahara: You must either take 1 damage or lose 1 action.

all_card.name: 避世墓穴
all_card.text:
每個位於避世墓穴的[[怪物]]敵人+2攻擊且+1傷害。
[action]如果本輪有[[怪物]]敵人在此地點被擊敗：你凝視著怪物的死眼，而深淵也在凝視著你。深淵之力減弱1點。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_text:
Each [[Monster]] enemy at Untouched Vault gets +2 fight and +1 damage value.
[action] If a [[Monster]] enemy was defeated here this round: You stare into the creature's dead eyes, and the abyss stares back at you. Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 獅身無面像
all_card.text:
X為當前深淵之力的強度。
[action]如果你有至少2個線索：你凝視著斯芬克斯空洞的面龐，而深淵也在凝視著你。將你的2個線索放在獅身無面像上，深淵之力減弱1點。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.traits: 探險. 沙漠. 遺跡
all_card.real_text:
X is the strength of the abyss.
[action] If you have at least 2 clues: You stare into the sphinx's empty face, and the abyss stares back at you. Place 2 of your clues on Faceless Sphinx and remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 沙漠綠洲
all_card.text:
[action]：治癒1點傷害和1點恐懼。(每場遊戲限制1次。)
[action][action]如果你身上沒有恐懼：你凝視著水波的倒影，而深淵也在凝視著你。受到3點恐懼，深淵之力減弱1點。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_text:
[action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror. (Limit once per game.)
[action][action] If you have no horror on you: You stare into the reflection on the water, and the abyss stares back at you. Take 3 horror and remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 沙塵遺跡
all_card.text:
你調查沙塵遺跡時，如果你有5張或更多的手牌，該地點+3隱藏值。
[action][action]如果你有8張或更多的手牌：你凝視著旋轉的沙丘，而深淵也在凝視著你。隨機丟棄你3張手牌，深淵之力減弱1點。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.traits: 探險. 沙漠. 遺跡
all_card.real_text:
While you are investigating Sandswept Ruins, if you have 5 or more cards in your hand, it gets +3 shroud.
[action][action] If you have 8 or more cards in your hand: You stare into the swirling sands, and the abyss stares back at you. Discard 3 cards from your hand at random and remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 深淵亡魂
all_card.text: 生成 - 最遠的[[沙漠]]或[[異界]]地點。 獵手。 強制 - 在深淵亡魂在敵軍階段中攻擊時：深淵亡魂本次攻擊不造成標準傷害，改為造成X點傷害，其中X為當前深淵之力的強度。被這次攻擊擊敗的調查員和[[盟友]]支援"墮入深淵"。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Farthest [[Desert]] or [[Otherworld]] location. Hunter. Forced - When Abyssal Revenant attacks during the enemy phase: Instead of its standard damage, it deals X damage for this attack, where X is the strength of the abyss. If this attack defeats an investigator or [[Ally]] asset, that card is "taken by the abyss."

all_card.name: 棺中之物
all_card.text: 生成 - 線索最多的地點。 當前地點沒有線索時，棺中之物獲得獵手。 強制 - 棺中之物準備時，在你使用除了[[遠程]]、[[槍械]]或[[法術]]以外的卡牌攻擊它時：棺中之物立即攻擊你。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - The location with the most clues. While its location has no clues, Thing in the Sarcophagus gains hunter. Forced - While Thing in the Sarcophagus is ready, when you attack it by any means except a [[Ranged]], [[Firearm]], or [[Spell]] card: It immediately attacks you.

all_card.name: 日蝕
all_card.text: 你位於一個[[異界]]地點時，日蝕獲得禍害關鍵詞。 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你失敗，你必須受到2點恐懼或選擇你所在地點的1張[[盟友]]支援卡，該卡被擊敗且"墮入深淵"。
all_card.real_text: While you are at an [[Otherworld]] location, Eclipse gains peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 horror or choose an [[Ally]] asset at your location to be defeated and "taken by the abyss."

all_card.name: 沙塵暴
all_card.text: 你位於一個[[沙漠]]地點時，沙塵暴獲得禍害關鍵詞。 顯現 - 檢定[agility](3)。如果你失敗，你必須受到2點傷害，或丟棄1張你控制的支援卡。
all_card.real_text: While you are at an [[Desert]] location, Sandstorm gains peril. Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 damage or discard an asset you control.

all_card.name: 金字塔下的恐怖
all_card.text: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。你失敗且每低於難度1點，選擇並丟棄1張手牌。每有1張手牌無法丟棄，受到1點恐懼。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, choose and discard 1 card from your hand. For each card you cannot discard, take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 蝗蟲成群
all_card.text: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](3)。你失敗且每低於難度1點，失去1個資源。每有1個資源無法失去，受到1點傷害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, lose 1 resource. For each resource you cannot lose, take 1 damage.

all_card.name: 沉睡
all_card.text: 顯現 - 如果你的威脅區域沒有沉睡，將其放置入你的威脅區域(否則，丟棄沉睡且該卡獲得湧動)。 強制 - 在你回合開始時：檢定[willpower](2)。如果你失敗，失去1次行動。 [reaction]在深淵之力減弱後：丟棄沉睡。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Slumber into play in your threat area if there is no copy of it in your threat area (if there is, discard Slumber and it gains surge instead). Forced - When your turn begins: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, lose 1 action. [reaction] After strength is removed from the abyss: Discard Slumber.

all_card.name: 黑暗祭牲
all_card.text: 顯現 - 如果你的威脅區域沒有黑暗祭牲，將其放置入你的威脅區域(否則，丟棄黑暗祭牲且該卡獲得湧動)。 強制 - 在深淵之力增強後：受到1點傷害和1點恐懼。被此效果擊敗的調查員和[[盟友]]支援卡"墮入深淵"。 [reaction]在深淵之力減弱後：丟棄黑暗祭牲。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Dark Sacrifice into play in your threat area if there is no copy of it in your threat area (if there is, discard Dark Sacrifice and it gains surge instead). Forced - After strength is added to the abyss: Take 1 damage and 1 horror. If this effect defeats an [[Ally]] asset or investigator, that card is "taken by the abyss." [reaction] After strength is removed from the abyss: Discard Dark Sacrifice.

all_card.name: 黑風
all_card.text: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須選擇(以下一項)： - 深淵之力增強1點，並將黑風加入勝利牌區。 - 丟棄黑風，抽取遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。你本輪剩餘時間內所有技能值-1。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Add 1 strength to the abyss and add The Black Wind to the victory display. - Discard The Black Wind and draw the top card of the encounter deck to replace it. You get -1 to all skills for the remainder of this round.

all_card.name: 深淵領域
all_card.text: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](X)。X為當前深淵之力的強度。如果你失敗且低於難度： - 1點，在你所在地點放置1個你的線索。 - 2點，受到1點傷害和1點恐懼。 - 3點，你本輪不能打出卡牌。 - 4點或以上，在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記(本效果可能導致當前密謀推進)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X). X is the strength of the abyss. If you fail by: - exactly 1, place 1 of your clues on your location. - exactly 2, take 1 damage and 1 horror. - exactly 3, you cannot play cards this round. - 4 or more, place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect may cause the current agenda to advance).

all_card.flavor: 無論死活……但大多時後都是死了。
all_card.name: 约翰&杰西·伯克
all_card.text: [action]消耗約翰＆傑西·伯克並對其造成1點傷害：選擇連接地點的1個敵人。移動到該敵人所在地點。然後，與該敵人交戰並對其造成1點傷害。
all_card.real_flavor: Dead or alive… but mostly dead.
all_card.real_text: [action] Exhaust John & Jessie Burke and deal them 1 damage: Choose an enemy in a connecting location. Move to that enemy's location. Then, engage that enemy and deal it 1 damage.

all_card.name: 古代十字架
all_card.text:
使用(4充能)。
[reaction]在你所在地點一位調查員技能檢定將要失敗且低於難度至少2點時，花費1充能：改為該調查員失敗並低於難度1點(即便是自動失敗)。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (4 charges).
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would fail a test by more than 1, spend 1 charge: That investigator fails by 1, instead (even if he or she automatically failed).

all_card.name: 深渊镰形剑
all_card.text: [action]：攻擊。你這次攻擊+3[combat]並造成+1傷害。 [reaction]在你使用深淵鐮形劍擊敗1個敵人後，消耗深淵鐮形劍：選擇1個位於另一個已揭示地點的敵人。你和所有與你交戰的敵人解除交戰，並移動到所選敵人的地點。然後，與該敵人交戰。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 遺物. 近戰
all_card.real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +3 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [reaction] After you defeat an enemy using Khopesh of the Abyss, exhaust it: Choose an enemy at another revealed location. Disengage from each other enemy engaged with you and move to the chosen enemy's location. Then, engage that enemy.

all_card.name: 受召夜魇
all_card.text: 使用(3哨聲)。如果召來的夜魘沒有哨聲，或者離場，將其移出遊戲。 [action]花費1哨聲並受到1點恐懼：躲避。自動躲避所有與你交戰的非[[夜魘]]敵人，並移動到任意一個已揭示地點。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 夜魘. 力量
all_card.real_text: Uses (3 whistles). If Summoned Nightgaunt has no whistles, or if it leaves play, remove it from the game. [action] Spend 1 whistle and take 1 horror: Evade. Automatically evade all non-[[Nightgaunt]] enemies engaged with you and move to any revealed location.

all_card.back_text:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。X為場上的[[無辜]]敵人的數量。
[cultist]：-2。如果勝利牌區有[[無辜]]敵人，抽出另一個混亂標記。
[tablet]：-5。你可以在你所在地點放置1個你的線索，改為將此標記視為-2。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你失敗，勝利牌區每有1個[[無辜]]敵人，受到1點恐懼。
all_card.name: 艾肖希爾酒店謀殺案
all_card.text:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。X為場上的[[客人]]敵人的數量。
[cultist]：-1。如果勝利牌區有[[無辜]]敵人，抽出另一個混亂標記。
[tablet]：-3。你可以在你所在地點放置1個你的線索，改為將此標記視為-1。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你失敗且勝利牌區有[[無辜]]敵人，受到1點恐懼。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of [[Innocent]] enemies in play.
[cultist]: -2. If there is an [[Innocent]] enemy in the victory display, reveal another chaos token.
[tablet]: -5. You may place one of your clues on your location to treat this as a -2 instead.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, take 1 horror for each [[Innocent]] enemy in the victory display.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of [[Guest]] enemies in play.
[cultist]: -1. If there is an [[Innocent]] enemy in the victory display, reveal another chaos token.
[tablet]: -3. You may place one of your clues on your location to treat this as a -1 instead.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail and there is an [[Innocent]] enemy in the victory display, take 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 當你沿路返回想弄清情勢時，有人敲了房間的門。"警察！"傳來嚴厲的聲音，"我們接到舉報，這裡發生了騷亂。開門！"
all_card.back_text: 將放在一邊的門羅警司放置入場，位於門廳。 將放在一邊的1個阿卡姆警官敵人生成在二樓走廊(如果有3到4名調查員進行遊戲，將另一個放在一邊的阿卡姆警官敵人生成在門廳)。將每張其他的阿卡姆警官敵人和遭遇棄牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌堆。 調查員隊長抽取放在一邊的"你都做了什麼？"弱點。 以下情況每有一條屬實，在225房間上放置1個線索(從供應堆拿取)，並放置1個毀滅標記到1個阿卡姆警官上： - 調查員沒有"清理掉血跡"。 - 調查員沒有"掩藏了屍體"。 - 調查員沒有"整理好房間"。
all_card.flavor: 你甦醒時，發現自己站在那人的屍體前。這番景象讓你瞬間畏縮了。多處刺傷貫穿了他的胸膛，血濺了一地。這裡到底發生了什麼？為什麼你一點都不記得？
all_card.name: 謀殺
all_card.text: 如果只有一位調查員進行遊戲，本密謀的毀滅目標值+1。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you retrace your steps to make sense of the situation, there is a pounding on the door to the suite. "This is the police!" a stern voice calls out. "We've gotten reports of a disturbance. Open up!"
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Sergeant Monroe into play in the Foyer. Spawn 1 set-aside Arkham Officer enemy at the Second Floor Hall (if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game, spawn another set-aside Arkham Officer enemy at the Foyer). Then shuffle each other set-aside Arkham Officer enemy into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. The lead investigator draws the set-aside What Have You Done? weakness. For each of the following circumstances which is true, place 1 clue on Room 225 (from the token bank) and place 1 doom on an Arkham Officer: - The investigators have not "cleaned up the blood." - The investigators have not "hid the body." - The investigators have not "tidied up the room."
all_card.real_flavor: When you come to, you are standing over the man's body. You recoil immediately at the grisly sight. Multiple stab wounds perforate his chest. Blood spills onto the floor. What in the hell happened here? And why can't you remember a thing?
all_card.real_text: If there is only 1 investigator in the game, this agenda gets +1 doom threshold.

all_card.back_flavor:
你已經在酒店裡花了很長的時間，你確定有些事情不對勁，但你仍未能弄清事情的來龍去脈。你漫步至門廳，正試圖拼湊收集到的信息時，迎接你的是更多從街道進入的阿卡姆警察。他們一看到你，就紛紛掏出槍。
"不准動！"帶頭的警察命令道，"你被逮捕了！"
all_card.back_text: 調查員未能破案並證明自己的清白！(→結局3)
all_card.flavor: 你不是唯一一個對今晚艾肖希爾酒店奇異事件感興趣的人，而且警查盯上了你。你仍未弄清發生了什麼——或者是否會再次發生。
all_card.name: 特別調查
all_card.text: 強制 – 在調查員與準備狀態的[[警察]]敵人位於相同地點，並於該地點發現1個或更多的線索，或對1個[[類人]]敵人造成傷害後：每個位於該地點並處於準備狀態的[[警察]]敵人與該調查員交戰並立刻進行一次攻擊。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You've spent a lot of time in the hotel, and while you're certain that something is amiss, you haven't been able to get to the bottom of it all. As you wander into the foyer, trying to piece together the information you've gathered, you're greeted by more of Arkham's finest entering from the street. As soon as they spot you, guns are drawn.
"Hold it!" the lead officer commands. "You're under arrest!"
all_card.real_back_text: The investigators failed to solve the crime and clear their names! (→R3)
all_card.real_flavor: You're not the only ones interested in the strange events at the Excelsior tonight, and the police are on to you. You're still not sure what happened - or if it could happen again.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After an investigator at the same location as a ready [[Police]] enemy discovers 1 or more clues at that location or deals damage to a [[Humanoid]] enemy: Each ready [[Police]] enemy at that location engages that investigator and makes an immediate attack.

all_card.back_flavor: 雖然不多，但這已經是你瞭解的全部。你唯一的選項就是去探索酒店的其他地方，看看你能發現什麼。
all_card.back_text:
將所有放在一邊的地點放置入場。
將跡象牌堆剩餘的卡牌移出遊戲。
根據場上的[[跡象]]支援，將以下6張卡牌和遭遇棄牌堆一同洗入遭遇牌堆：
- 如果異星裝置在場上，將3張放在一邊的腦部信號洗入遭遇牌堆。
- 如果經理的鑰匙在場上，將3張放在一邊的酒店保安洗入遭遇牌堆。
- 如果儀式古書在場上，將3張放在一邊的昂科雷異教徒洗入遭遇牌堆。
- 如果不祥溶液在場上，將3張放在一邊的病態的意識洗入遭遇牌堆。
- 如果陳舊的掛墜盒在場上，將3張放在一邊的令人不寒而慄的存在洗入遭遇牌堆。
all_card.flavor: 你暈頭轉向，試圖弄清情況。房間裡散落著空瓶。你的雙手發麻，影子似乎在盤繞著你扭動。你被下了藥嗎？還是說這完全是另一回事？
all_card.name: 發生了什麼……？
all_card.text: [action]調查員以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：抽取跡象牌堆頂的1張卡牌。 目標 – 如果調查員總共控制了2個[[跡象]]支援，推進場景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: It isn't much, but it's all you've got. Your only real option now is to explore the rest of the hotel and see what you can learn.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put each of the set-aside locations into play.
Remove the remainder of the Leads deck from the game.
Depending on which [[Lead]] assets are in play, shuffle 6 cards into the encounter deck, as follows, along with the encounter discard pile:
- If Alien Device is in play, shuffle the 3 set-aside copies of Encephalon Signal into the encounter deck.
- If Manager's Key is in play, shuffle the 3 set-aside copies of Hotel Security into the encounter deck.
- If Tome of Rituals is in play, shuffle the 3 set-aside copies of Cultist of the Enclave into the encounter deck.
- If Sinister Solution is in play, shuffle the 3 set-aside copies of Morbid Awareness into the encounter deck.
- If Time-Worn Locket is in play, shuffle the 3 set-aside copies of Chilling Presence into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: Your head is spinning as you try to make sense of the situation. Empty bottles are scattered around the room. Your hands tingle. The shadows seem to coil and writhe around you. Were you drugged? Or is this something else entirely?
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues as a group: Draw the top card of the Leads deck. Objective - If the investigators control two [[Lead]] assets, advance.

all_card.back_text: 閱讀規則手冊第10頁的冒險幕間故事：真相。
all_card.flavor: 多虧了你在套房裡發現的線索，你十分確定陷害你的人仍在酒店裡。唯一的問題是如何找到這個人。看著你發現的跡象，你感覺答案其實就在你面前……
all_card.name: 追查跡象
all_card.text: 目標 – 在你發現的跡象上放置線索以瞭解更多信息(使用某些地點上的能力)。放置的線索越多越好。當一輪結束時，如果每個[[跡象]]支援上有至少1[per_investigator]個線索，你可以選擇推進場景。(提示：如果你希望將證據交給警方，每個[[跡象]]支援上最好至少有2[per_investigator]個線索。)
all_card.real_back_text: Read Scenario Interlude: The Truth on page 10 of the Rules Booklet.
all_card.real_flavor: Thanks to the leads you discovered in the suite, you're fairly sure whoever framed you is still in the hotel. The only real question is where to find this person. Looking at the leads you've found, you feel like the answers are right in front of you...
all_card.real_text: Objective - Learn more about your leads by placing clues on them (using abilities on some locations). The more clues, the better. At the end of the round, you may choose to advance if each [[Lead]] asset has at least 1 [per_investigator] clues on it. (Hint: If you wish to present this evidence to the police, you may wish to have at least 2 [per_investigator] clues on each [[Lead]] asset, instead.)

all_card.flavor: 你感到你的罪孽爬上了你的背脊。
all_card.name: 染血匕首
all_card.text: [action]：攻擊。你這次攻擊得到+2[combat]。 [action]消耗染血的匕首並受到1點恐懼：攻擊。你這次攻擊+2[combat]並造成+1傷害。如果這次攻擊擊敗了一個敵人，抽取1張卡牌。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 近戰. 詛咒縈繞?
all_card.real_flavor: You feel your sins crawling on your back.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. [action] Exhaust Bloodstained Dagger and take 1 horror: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If this attack defeats an enemy, draw 1 card.

all_card.name: 你都做了什麼？
all_card.text: 顯現 - 將"你都做了什麼？"放置入場，放道你的威脅區域。 作為你談判的額外費用，你必須隨機丟棄1張手牌。 [action]：將"你都做了什麼？"洗入你的牌堆。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put What Have You Done? into play in your threat area. As an additional cost for you to parley, you must discard a card at random from your hand. [action]: Shuffle What Have You Done? into your deck.

all_card.name: 门罗警长
all_card.text:
對門羅警司所在地點的任意調查員造成的傷害和/或恐懼可以分配到門羅警司上，即使其未受調查員控制。
[reaction]在門羅警司受到任意數量的傷害或恐懼時，將其消耗：對其所在地點的1個非[[無辜]]敵人造成等量的傷害。任何位於門羅警司所在地點的調查員可以觸發這個能力。
all_card.real_text:
Sergeant Monroe may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to any investigator at his location, even if he is uncontrolled.
[reaction] When Sergeant Monroe is dealt any amount of damage or horror, exhaust him: Deal that much damage to a non-[[Innocent]] enemy at his location. Any investigator at Sergeant Monroe's location may trigger this ability.

all_card.name: 阿卡姆警官
all_card.text: 冷漠。巡邏(最近的有線索的地點)。 強制 – 當敵軍階段結束時：將阿卡姆警官所在地點的1個線索翻到毀滅標記面，並移動到阿卡姆警官上。 [action]：談判。檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，自動躲避阿卡姆警官，或將其上的一個毀滅標記翻到線索面並控制該線索。
all_card.traits: 類人. 警察. 無辜
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest location with clues). Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move 1 clue to Arkham Officer from its location, flipping it to its doom side. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, either automatically evade Arkham Officer, or flip one of its doom to its clue side and take control of it.

all_card.back_flavor: 地上的地毯浸滿了鮮血。碎玻璃撒落在臥室的沙發和茶几上。窗是開著的，一陣寒風掠過長長的窗簾。
all_card.name: 225房間
all_card.text:
[action]：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，請記住調查員"清理掉血跡"。
[action]：檢定[combat](3)。如果你成功，請記住調查員"掩藏了屍體"。
[action]：檢定[intellect](3)。如果你成功，請記住調查員"整理好房間"。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The rug on the floor is soaked with blood. Broken glass litters the couch and coffee table in the living room. The window is open, a chill breeze flowing through the long curtains.
all_card.real_text:
[action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, remember that the investigators "cleaned up the blood."
[action]: Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, remember that the investigators "hid the body."
[action]: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, remember that the investigators "tidied up the room."

all_card.back_flavor: 在陽台這可以俯瞰整個阿卡姆。靠著欄杆，想到如果從這麼高的地方墜落，感到頭暈。
all_card.name: 套房陽台
all_card.text: [action]：選擇1個位於套房陽台的[[類人]]敵人並檢定[combat]或[agility](4)。如果你成功，受到1點直接恐懼並擊敗所選敵人(如果該敵人為[[精英]]，改為對其造成2點傷害)。此行動不會引起趁亂攻擊。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The balcony affords a high vantage point over the rest of Arkham. Leaning over the rail, your mind reels at the thought of falling from such a height.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Choose a [[Humanoid]] enemy at Suite Balcony and test [combat] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, take 1 direct horror and defeat the chosen enemy (if that enemy is [[Elite]], deal 2 damage to it instead). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

all_card.back_flavor: 沿路鋪著奢華的地毯，特別整潔的牆上穿插著血紅色的房門。
all_card.name: 二樓走廊
all_card.text: [reaction]在你進入本地點後：你可以立刻移動到一個連接地點。如果你這麼做，從混亂袋中隨機抽出一個標記。如果抽出[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]標記，抽取遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Extravagant carpeting runs along the floor, and meticulously clean walls are perforated by blood-red doors.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you enter this location: You may immediately move to a connecting location. If you do, reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed, draw the top card of the encounter deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 門廳是一個鋪著拋光磁磚，有著寬敞樓梯的豪華大廳。客人和員工在近乎夢遊的狀態下穿梭在寬敞的室內。或者這只是你的想像？
all_card.name: 門廳
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你逃離了作案現場。 強制 – 在你試圖移動離開門廳時，只要此處有至少1個[[客人]]敵人：檢定[agility](X)，其中X為位於門廳的[[客人]]敵人數量。如果你失敗，你必須額外花費一次行動來移動離開門廳。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The foyer is a grand hall of polished tile and sweeping stairs. Guests and staff move through the vast room in an almost dreamlike state. Or is that just your imagination?
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You flee the scene of the crime. Forced - When you attempt to move out of the Foyer while there is at least 1 [[Guest]] enemy here: Test [agility] (X), where X is the number of [[Guest]] enemies here. If you fail, you must spend 1 additional action to move out of the Foyer.

all_card.back_flavor: 白色的桌布看著有些過於乾淨了。你瀏覽菜單時，完全無法理解其中的文字。然而乍一看，一切又顯得正常……
all_card.name: 餐廳
all_card.text: [action]花費2資源：你忍受著全體服務員的冷眼，點了一些東西。當你回合結束時，如果你仍位於餐廳，你可以受到1點恐懼來治癒3點傷害。(每場遊戲限制1次。) [free]如果場上所有地點都已揭示，且場上地點都沒有線索：在餐廳上放置1[per_investigator]個線索(從供應堆拿取)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The white tablecloths seem almost too clean. As you glance through the menu, the words within are entirely unintelligible. Upon second glance, however, everything seems normal...
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 2 resources: You place an order while enduring the withering glares of the entire waitstaff. At the end of your turn, if you are still at the Restaurant, you may take 1 horror to heal 3 damage. (Limit once per game.) [fast] If each location in play is revealed and there are no clues on locations in play: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues on Restaurant (from the token bank.)

all_card.back_flavor: 烏雲在頭頂翻滾，一陣陣風刮過平坦寬敞的樓頂。
all_card.name: 酒店樓頂
all_card.text:
[action]：檢定[agility](4)或[combat](4)。如果你成功，移動到212房間、225房間或245房間。
[action]：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，將位於本地點的調查員控制的任意數量的線索移動到異星裝置上(如果異星裝置在場上)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Wind whips across the flat, open roof as clouds roll in overhead.
all_card.real_text:
[action]: Test [agility] (4) or [combat] (4). If you succeed, move to either Room 212, Room 225, or Room 245.
[action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, move any number of clues controlled by investigators at this location to Alien Device (if it is in play).

all_card.back_text:
212房間的門鎖上了。你不能從二樓走廊進入212房間。
二樓走廊獲得："[action]：檢定[agility](4)來嘗試撬鎖。如果你成功，翻開212房間並立刻移動到該地點。"
all_card.flavor: 桌子上有一個裝滿了怪異物質的玻璃容器，與各種奇怪的、超現代的實驗室設備連接著。旁邊的床看起來從未有人睡過。床墊上放著一箱小瓶子，各裝滿了綠色的粘稠液體。
all_card.name: 212房間
all_card.text: [action]：檢定[intellect](3)。如果你成功，將位於本地點的調查員控制的任意數量的線索移動到不祥溶液上(如果不祥溶液在場上)。
all_card.real_back_text:
The door to Room 212 is locked. You cannot enter Room 212 from the Second Floor Hall.
Second Floor Hall gains: "[action]: Test [agility] (4) to attempt to pick the lock. If you succeed, reveal Room 212 and immediately move to it."
all_card.real_flavor: A mass of inhuman matter sits in a glass tub on the desk, connected to all manner of strange and futuristic lab equipment. The bed nearly looks like it was never slept in. Sitting on the mattress is a case of vials, each filled with green, viscous liquid.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, move any number of clues controlled by investigators at this location to Sinister Solution (if it is in play).

all_card.back_flavor: 245房間的門縫下散發出一股致命的寒意。
all_card.flavor: 房間的另一邊一塵不染，似乎很久沒有使用了。
all_card.name: 245房間
all_card.text: [action]：檢定[intellect](3)。這次技能檢定只能投入你棄牌堆最頂的卡牌(在技能檢定結算後，將其放到你的牌堆底部)。如果你成功，將位於本地點的調查員控制的任意數量的線索移動到陳舊的掛墜盒上(如果陳舊的掛墜盒在場上)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A deathly chill emanates from beneath the door to Room 245
all_card.real_flavor: The room beyond is immaculate, seemingly untouched in quite some time.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (3). Only the top card of your discard pile may be committed to this skill test (place it on the bottom of your deck after this test resolves). If you succeed, move any number of clues controlled by investigators in Room 245 to Time-Worn Locket (if it is in play).

all_card.back_text:
辦公室的門鎖上了。你不能進入辦公室，除非你控制經理的鑰匙。
地下室獲得："[action]：檢定[agility](3)來嘗試撬鎖。如果你成功，翻開辦公室並立刻移動到該地點。"
all_card.flavor: 艾肖希爾的經理顯然是個大忙人——剪報、奇怪的文件和各種鑰匙散落了一地。
all_card.name: 辦公室
all_card.text: [action]：檢定[intellect](0)。你成功且每高於難度1點，你可以將位於本地點的一位調查員控制的1個線索移動到經理的鑰匙(如果經理的鑰匙在場上)。
all_card.real_back_text:
The door to the Office is locked. You cannot enter the Office unless you control the Manager's Key.
Basement gains: "[action]: Test [agility] (3) to attempt to pick the lock. If you succeed, reveal Office and immediately move to it."
all_card.real_flavor: The manager of the Excelsior is obviously a busy person - newspaper clippings, strange documents, and keys of all sorts are scattered about.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (0). For each point you succeed by, you may move 1 clue controlled by an investigator in the Office to Manager's key (if it is in play).

all_card.back_flavor: 機器的嗡嗡聲以及昏暗的燈光令你毛骨悚然。探索地下室將會十分困難。在嘈雜聲中，你認為你聽到了自己腳步聲的回音，僅距離你身後幾步。
all_card.name: 地下室
all_card.text:
[action]：檢定[intellect](1)。如果你成功，將任意地點的1個[[類人]]敵人向地下室移動一次。
[reaction]在你擊敗1個位於地下室的敵人後：將位於本地點的調查員控制的任意數量的線索移動到儀式古書上(如果儀式古書在場上)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The hum of machinery and the dim lighting make your hair stand on end. Exploring the basement will be difficult. Amidst the din, you think you hear footsteps echoing your own, just a few paces behind.
all_card.real_text:
[action]: Test [intellect] (1). If you succeed, move a [[Humanoid]] enemy at any location once toward the Basement.
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy in the Basement: Move any number of clues controlled by investigators at the Basement to Tome of Rituals (if it is in play).

all_card.flavor: 禮賓員帶著激動，狂亂的表情向你問候。"是你要求叫醒服務嗎？"
all_card.name: 特布雷先生
all_card.text: 生成 - 門廳。 獵手。 強制 – 在特布雷先生入場後：立刻結算場上每個其他[[職工]]敵人的獵手和巡邏關鍵詞。
all_card.real_flavor: The concierge regards you with a feverish, maddened expression. "Did you request a wake-up call?"
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Foyer. Hunter. Forced - After Mr. Trombly enters play: Immediately resolve the hunter and patrol keywords on each other [[Staff]] enemy in play.

all_card.flavor:
"你迷路了？這不是你該來的地方。"
他們的眼中閃著惡意，指關節攥得發白，揮舞著他們能找到最近的物體。
all_card.name: 顯眼的職工
all_card.text: 生成 – 最近的[[犯罪現場]]地點。 獵物 – 線索最多的目標。 獵手。
all_card.real_flavor:
"You lost? I don't think you should be here."
Their eyes gleam with malice, and their knuckles turn white as they brandish the closest object they can find.
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Nearest [[Crime Scene]] location. Prey - Most clues. Hunter.

all_card.name: 酒店客人
all_card.text: 生成 – 最近的[[廳堂]]地點。 冷漠。巡邏(最近的[[犯罪現場]]地點)。 強制 – 當敵軍階段結束時，如果酒店客人位於[[犯罪現場]]地點：在酒店客人上放置1個毀滅標記。 [action]：談判。檢定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你成功，丟棄酒店客人。
all_card.traits: 類人. 賓客. 無辜
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Nearest [[Hall]] location. Aloof. Patrol (nearest [[Crime Scene]] location). Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Hotel Guest is at a [[Crime Scene]] location: Add 1 doom to Hotel Guest. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, discard Hotel Guest.

all_card.name: 毒霧
all_card.text: 顯現 – 依玩家順序，你所在地點的每位調查員必須選擇： - 檢定[agility](3)以試圖在毒霧充滿房間前逃離。如果你成功，移動到一個連接地點。如果你失敗，受到2點傷害。 - 檢定[combat](3)以試圖屏住呼吸。你失敗且每低於難度1點，受到1點傷害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - In player order, each investigator at your location must choose: - Test [agility] (3) to attempt to flee before the gas fills the room. If you succeed, move to a connecting location. If you fail, take 2 damage. - Test [combat] (3) to attempt to hold your breath. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.

all_card.name: 陷入瘋狂
all_card.text: 顯現 - 如果場上沒有[[類人]]敵人，陷入瘋狂獲得湧動。 否則，將陷入瘋狂疊加到最近的[[類人]]敵人。 被疊加的敵人獲得+1攻擊、+1生命值和+1躲避。被疊加的敵人失去冷漠。調查員不能與被疊加的敵人談判。 強制 – 在被疊加的敵人被躲避後：丟棄陷入瘋狂。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Humanoid]] enemies in play, Driven to Madness gains surge. Otherwise, attach Driven to Madness to the nearest [[Humanoid]] enemy. Attached enemy gets +1 fight, +1 health, and +1 evade. Attached enemy loses aloof. Investigators cannot parley with attached enemy. Forced - After attached enemy is evaded: Discard Driven to Madness.

all_card.flavor: 血債血償。
all_card.name: 雙手染血
all_card.text: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](2)。勝利牌區每有1個[[無辜]]敵人，這次檢定難度提升1點。如果你失敗，受到2點恐懼(如果你在[[犯罪現場]]地點，你必須額外選擇並丟棄1張手牌)。
all_card.real_flavor: Blood will have blood.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 1 for each [[Innocent]] enemy in the victory display. If you fail, take 2 horror (if you are at a [[Crime Scene]] location, you must also choose and discard a card from your hand).

all_card.name: 定罪證據
all_card.text: 顯現 - 疊加到最近的非[[犯罪現場]]地點。 疊加的地點得到獲得[[犯罪現場]]屬性並得到+2隱藏值。 [reaction]在你成功調查被疊加的地點時：不發現線索，改為丟棄定罪證據。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest non-[[Crime Scene]] location. Attached location gains the [[Crime Scene]] trait and gets +2 shroud. [reaction] When you successfully investigate attached location: Instead of discovering clues, discard Incriminating Evidence.

all_card.name: 大發雷霆
all_card.text: 顯現 - 如果場上沒有[[類人]]敵人，查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆的1個[[類人]]敵人，抽取該卡牌並混洗遭遇牌堆。否則，最近的[[類人]]敵人準備、移動(一次一個地點)到你所在地點，與你交戰，並立即進行一次攻擊。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Humanoid]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Humanoid]] enemy, draw it, and shuffle the encounter deck. Otherwise, the nearest [[Humanoid]] enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.

all_card.flavor: 由怪異部件組成的裝置，持續發出你聽不到也感覺不到的信號。裝置散發著星空的味道，就像夜空中無處不在的虛無。
all_card.name: 異星裝置
all_card.text: 顯現 – 放置入場，放到你的遊戲區域。 強制 – 在你被擊敗時：將異星裝置的控制權交給另一位調查員。
all_card.real_flavor: A device constructed of strange parts, and emitting a signal you don't hear so much as feel. The contraption smells of the stars and feels like the inescapable emptiness of the night sky.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put into play in your play area. Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Alien Device to another investigator.

all_card.name: 異界干涉者
all_card.text: 反擊。 強制 – 在異界干涉者將要受到來自攻擊的傷害時：移除異界干涉者上的1個毀滅標記。然後，減少1點受到的傷害。(FAQ v1.7) 強制 – 在一位調查員被擊敗後：在異界干涉者上放置3個毀滅標記。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 米戈. 精英
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. Forced - When Otherworldly Meddler would take damage from an attack: Remove 1 doom from Otherworldly Meddler. Then, reduce the damage dealt by 1. Forced - After an investigator is defeated: Add 3 doom to Otherworldly Meddler.

all_card.name: 腦部信號
all_card.text: 禍害。顯現 - 在異界干涉者上放置1個毀滅標記(如果該敵人在場上)，並檢定[willpower](4)。如果你失敗，你必須選擇(以下一項)： - 受到2點恐懼。 - 對你所在地點的1位調查員或1個[[類人]]敵人造成2點傷害。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Place 1 doom on Otherworldly Meddler (if it is in play) and test [willpower] (4). If you fail, you must either (choose one): - Take 2 horror. - Deal 2 damage to an investigator or [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location.

all_card.flavor: 一把看起來並不起眼的鑰匙，一側刻著"辦公室"。受害者是酒店的一名員工嗎？艾肖希爾酒店裡到底進行著什麼邪惡的陰謀？
all_card.name: 經理的鑰匙
all_card.text: 顯現 – 放置入場，放到你的遊戲區域。 強制 – 在你被擊敗時：將經理的鑰匙的控制權交給另一位調查員。
all_card.real_flavor: A seemingly inconspicuous key, the word "Office" etched on one side. Was the victim a member of the hotel's staff? What diabolical scheme was in motion at the Excelsior?
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put into play in your play area. Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Manager's Key to another investigator.

all_card.name: 酒店經理
all_card.text: 龐大。反擊。 每個[[客人]]敵人失去巡邏並獲得湧動。 強制 – 當敵軍階段開始時：將酒店經理所在地點的1個[[客人]]敵人加入勝利牌區，然後在酒店經理上放置2個毀滅標記。將其他所有[[客人]]敵人向酒店經理移動一次。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 職工. 精英
all_card.real_text: Massive. Retaliate. Each [[Guest]] enemy loses patrol and gains surge. Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Add 1 [[Guest]] enemy at Hotel Manager's location to the victory display, then place 2 doom on Hotel Manager. Move each other [[Guest]] enemy one location toward Hotel Manager.

all_card.flavor: 不管是什麼，顯然它已不再是人類了。
all_card.name: 酒店保安
all_card.text: 生成 – 最近的無人地點。 獵手。反擊。 如果場上至少有1個[[客人]]敵人，酒店保安失去獵手並獲得"巡邏(有[[客人]]敵人的最近地點)。"
all_card.traits: 類人. 怪物. 職工
all_card.real_flavor: Whatever it is, it's clearly no longer human.
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Nearest empty location. Hunter. Retaliate. If there is at least 1 [[Guest]] enemy in play, Hotel Security loses hunter and gains "Patrol (nearest location with a [[Guest]] enemy)."

all_card.flavor: 一本厚重的書，書頁古老而脆弱。當你翻開時，一張紙片掉落出來。紙條上寫著一條簡單的訊息："昂科雷在潛伏等待。"
all_card.name: 儀式古書
all_card.text: 顯現 – 放置入場，放到你的遊戲區域。 強制 – 在你被擊敗時：將儀式古書的控制權交給另一位調查員。
all_card.real_flavor: A massive book, its pages ancient and weathered. As you page through, a leaflet falls out. Picking it up, you see it contains a simple message: "The Enclave awaits below."
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put into play in your play area. Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Tome of Rituals to another investigator.

all_card.name: 次元蹣跚者
all_card.text: 獵手。 強制 – 在次元蹣跚者攻擊並對你造成傷害後：從混亂袋隨機抽出1個標記。如果抽出[auto_fail]符號，它將你抓到它的次元；將次元蹣跚者移出遊戲，並且你被擊敗。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 異次元. 精英
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - After Dimensional Shambler deals you damage from its attack: Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If an [auto_fail] symbol is revealed, it snatches you from this dimension; remove Dimensional Shambler from the game and you are defeated.

all_card.name: 昂科雷異教徒
all_card.text: 生成 – 地下室。 獵手。 強制 – 在昂科雷異教徒攻擊後：從混亂袋隨機抽出一個混亂標記。如果抽出的是[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符號，在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Basement. Hunter. Forced - After Cultist of the Enclave attacks: Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed, place 1 doom on the current agenda.

all_card.flavor: 燒瓶是冰冷的，裡面噁心的綠色液體黏稠如糖漿。帶著一股魚腥味盒臭氧味。瓶頂掛著一個標籤："實驗品1號。"
all_card.name: 不祥溶液
all_card.text: 顯現 – 放置入場，放到你的遊戲區域。 強制 – 在你被擊敗時：將不祥溶液的控制權交給另一位調查員。
all_card.real_flavor: The flask is ice-cold, and the sickly green liquid within has the consistency of syrup. It smells vaguely of fish and ozone. Hanging from the top of the flask is a tag stamped: "Test 1."
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put into play in your play area. Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Sinister Solution to another investigator.

all_card.name: 採集的大腦
all_card.text: 強制 – 當調查階段結束時：每位位於疊加地點的調查員受到1點傷害和1點恐懼。每位其他調查員必須受到1點傷害或1點恐懼(自行選擇)。
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the investigation phase: Each investigator at attached location takes 1 damage and 1 horror. Each other investigator must either take 1 damage or 1 horror (their choice).

all_card.name: 病態的意識
all_card.text: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](6)。你和212房間每距離一個地點，這次檢定的難度降低1點。如果你失敗，你必須在你所在地點上放置你的1個線索，或受到2點恐懼。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (6). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each location away from Room 212 you are. If you fail, you must either place 1 of your clues on your location, or take 2 horror.

all_card.flavor: 裡面褪色的照片描繪的是一名過去的年輕美麗的女子。也許是酒店曾經的住客？
all_card.name: 陳舊的掛墜盒
all_card.text: 顯現 – 放置入場，放到你的遊戲區域。 強制 – 在你被擊敗時：將陳舊的掛墜盒的控制權交給另一位調查員。
all_card.real_flavor: The faded photograph within depicts a beautiful young woman from another time. A previous guest of the hotel, perhaps?
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put into play in your play area. Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Time-Worn Locket to another investigator.

all_card.name: 復仇幽魂
all_card.text: 巡邏(245房間)。反擊。 強制 – 在傷害將要被放置到復仇幽魂上時：除了由[[法術]]、[[遺物]]、[[守護]]或遭遇卡造成的傷害以外，將傷害減少至1點。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 靈怪. 精英
all_card.real_text: Patrol (Room 245). Retaliate. Forced - When damage would be placed on Vengeful Specter: Reduce that damage to 1 unless it was dealt by a [[Spell]], [[Relic]], [[Charm]], or encounter card.

all_card.name: 令人不寒而慄的存在
all_card.text: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。你失敗且每低於難度1點，受到1點恐懼。你成功且每高於難度1點，你可以對你所在地點的1個[[靈怪]]敵人造成1點傷害。如果這次檢定中抽出了[elder_sign]標記，你可以對任意地點的1個[[靈怪]]敵人造成2點傷害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. For each point you succeed by, you may deal 1 damage to a [[Geist]] enemy at your location. If an [elder_sign] symbol is revealed during this test, you may deal 2 damage to a [[Geist]] enemy at any location.

all_card.back_text:
如果本密謀因為達到毀滅目標值而推進：
悲痛的哀嚎如同死亡的浪潮向你襲來。這個幽靈——一個被謀殺許久的女人鬼影——來世也無法獲得安寧。她只尋求復仇，讓其他人也像她一樣受到煉獄般無休止的折磨。你已經幫她殺了人，而現在，在她的不朽凝視下——如無盡深淵般深遂——你準備再次動手。你手起刀落，客人和員工紛紛倒下，直到你也癱倒在地，滿身都是無辜者的鮮血。
(→結局2)
如果本密謀因為目標完成而推進：
你打量著手中闔上的掛墜盒，站在鴉雀無聲的酒店中。看起來世個很普通的東西，但這個黑暗世界的紀念品在艾肖希爾酒店的混亂中起到了舉足輕重的作用。你把它放進口袋，轉向門口，終於能稍微放鬆一些。意識到艾肖希爾的奇異事件已經平息，你從中找到了一絲慰藉，至少目前是這樣。
(→結局1)
all_card.name: 真兇(版本一)
all_card.text: 異星裝置獲得："[action]如果復仇幽魂處於消耗狀態且位於你所在地點，移除異星裝置上的2個線索：對復仇幽魂造成2點傷害。" 目標 – 如果復仇幽魂被擊敗，推進。
all_card.real_back_text:
If this agenda advanced by reaching its doom threshold:
The mournful wail cascades over you like a wave of death. The specter - a ghostly image of a woman long since murdered - is beyond any hope of a peaceful afterlife. She seeks only vengeance, so that others might join her in purgatorial restlessness. You've killed for her once before and now, facing the full power of her undying gaze - black as the endless abyss - you're ready to do it again. Guest and staff alike fall by your hand until you collapse on the floor, soaked in the blood of innocents.
(→R2)
If this agenda advanced because you completed its objective:
The locket rests in your open hand and you consider it now, standing in the sudden silence of the hotel. It seems such a simple thing, but this memento of dark events had a hand in the turmoils of the Excelsior, despite its unassuming appearance. You slide it into your pocket and turn toward the door, breathing a bit easier. You find some measure of comfort in knowing that the strange goings-on of the Excelsior have been put to rest, at least for now.
(→R1)
all_card.real_text: Alien Device gains: "[action] If Vengeful Specter is exhausted and at your location, remove 2 clues from Alien Device: Deal 2 damage to Vengeful Specter." Objective - If Vengeful Specter is defeated, advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果本密謀因為達到毀滅目標值而推進：
你將裝置握在手中時，它突然開始振動並發出嗡鳴聲。它的核心發出強烈的淡綠色光芒。你的頭開始陣痛，一滴血從你的鼻子滑落。一切都太遲了，在這個設備全速運轉之前，你沒有辦法可以阻止米戈的威脅了。現在，當你逐漸失去對現實的掌控時，你想知道異星干涉者會強迫你——以及酒店裡的其他人——接下來做什麼。你的意識現在已被它牢牢地掌控了。
(→結局2)
如果本密謀因為目標完成而推進：
這台異星裝置又嗡嗡作響了片刻，最終安靜了下來。它落在你手中，冰冷、平靜，似乎又變成了一件不起眼的小飾品。你終於能稍微放鬆一些，至少現在艾肖希爾的奇異事件已經平息，你從中找到了一絲慰藉，至少目前是這樣。
(→結局1)
all_card.name: 真兇(版本二)
all_card.text: 不祥溶液獲得："[action]如果你位於212房間：檢定[intellect](2)。如果你成功，你可以移除不祥溶液的2個線索來消耗異界干涉者，或對其造成2點傷害。" 目標 – 如果異界干涉者被擊敗，推進。
all_card.real_back_text:
If this agenda advanced by reaching its doom threshold:
You clutch the device in your hands when it suddenly begins to hum and vibrate, its core glowing with a searing, pale-green light. You feel your head throb, a drop of blood rolling down from your nose. You're too late. You were unable to stop the Mi-Go threat before the device reached full power. Now, as you feel your grasp on reality begin to fade, you wonder what the alien meddler will force you - and everyone else in the Excelsior - to do next. Your mind is now clutched firmly in its grasp.
(→R2)
If this agenda advanced because you completed its objective:
The alien device hums and pulses for a few more moments, before finally going silent. It rests in your hands, cold and still, seemingly an unassuming trinket once more. You breathe a bit easier and find some measure of comfort in knowing that the strange goings-on of the Excelsior have been put to rest, at least for now.
(→R1)
all_card.real_text: Sinister Solution gains: "[action] If you are in Room 212: Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, you may remove 2 clues from Sinister Solution to either exhaust Otherworldly Meddler or deal it 2 damage." Objective - If Otherworldly Meddler is defeated, advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果本密謀因為達到毀滅目標值而推進：
隨著怪物吞噬越來越多的人，它的力量就越強大。客人們失去意識，掠過你向它走去，像待宰的羔羊般蹣跚而行。它不規則的身體吞噬這些無辜者的聲音充斥著你的耳朵。你試著喚醒他們，但他們毫不理睬。你又試圖拉回他們，但那些酒店保安模樣的生物將你擊退。你倒在地上，所有的希望都破滅了……然後，你聽到了一個聲音在你的腦海裡低語。它在引誘你，呼喚著你。你慢慢地站起來，走向你的命運。
(→結局2)
如果本密謀因為目標完成而推進：
你站在酒店的大廳，建築內突然陷入寂靜，似乎空無一人。當你審視你所作所為時，你低頭看向了你手中的鑰匙。這是一個十分簡單的物件，但你感到背脊發涼，因為你知道曾經握著這把鑰匙的是誰。意識到艾肖希爾的奇異事件已經平息，你從中找到了一絲慰藉，至少目前是這樣。
(→結局1)
all_card.name: 真兇(版本三)
all_card.text: 異星裝置獲得："[action]消耗異星裝置並移除其2個線索：將你所在地點的1個[[職工]]敵人移至勝利牌堆(如果其是[[精英]]，改為對其造成2點傷害)。此效果不會引起趁亂攻擊。" 目標 – 如果酒店經理被擊敗，推進。
all_card.real_back_text:
If this agenda advanced by reaching its doom threshold:
With each person it consumes, the creature grows in power. Guests brush past you toward it, shambling along mindlessly like lambs to the slaughter. The sound of its amorphous form gorging itself on innocents fills your ears. You try reasoning with them, but they ignore you. You try holding them back, but the creatures posing as hotel security beat you back. You fall to the floor, all hope utterly lost... Then you hear it. A single voice, whispering in your head. It coaxes you, beckons you. You slowly stand, and march toward your fate.
(→R2)
If this agenda advanced because you completed its objective:
You stand in the lobby of the hotel, the building suddenly silent and seemingly empty. As you survey the results of your work, you glance down at the key in your hand. Such a simple object, yet you still feel a shiver of dread slide down your spine, knowing what once held this key. You are able to find some measure of comfort in knowing that the strange goings-on of the Excelsior have been put to rest, at least for now.
(→R1)
all_card.real_text: Alien Device gains: "[action] Exhaust Alien Device and remove 2 clues from it: Add a [[Staff]] enemy at your location to the victory display (or deal it 2 damage if it is [[Elite]]). Does not provoke attacks of opportunity." Objective - If Hotel Manager is defeated, advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果本密謀因為達到毀滅目標值而推進：
悲痛的哀嚎如同死亡的浪潮向你襲來。這個幽靈——一個被謀殺許久的女人鬼影——來世也無法獲得安寧。她只尋求復仇，讓其他人也像她一樣受到煉獄般無休止的折磨。你已經幫她殺了人，而現在，在她的不朽凝視下——如無盡深淵般深遂——你準備再次動手。你手起刀落，客人和員工紛紛倒下，直到你也癱倒在地，滿身都是無辜者的鮮血。
(→結局2)
如果本密謀因為目標完成而推進：
你打量著手中闔上的掛墜盒，站在鴉雀無聲的酒店中。看起來世個很普通的東西，但這個黑暗世界的紀念品在艾肖希爾酒店的混亂中起到了舉足輕重的作用。你把它放進口袋，轉向門口，終於能稍微放鬆一些。意識到艾肖希爾的奇異事件已經平息，你從中找到了一絲慰藉，至少目前是這樣。
(→結局1)

all_card.back_text:
如果本密謀因為達到毀滅目標值而推進：
他們無處不在，每個房間、每條走廊，始終圍繞著你，他們的聲音合而為一。他們的書在你手裡，但這已經無關緊要了。他們的儀式已持續了太久，獲得了太多的力量。這本書籍在你手中燃燒，它的皮革封面灼燒著你的皮膚，但你仍將其緊緊握住。你能感覺到它的脈博，就好像有一顆在書頁之間跳動的心臟。低頭看向它，你意識到這是你能從這場噩夢中存活下來的唯一途徑。你打開這本古書，翻到儀式的頁面，將自己的聲音加入到無盡的詠唱中。
(→結局2)
如果本密謀因為目標完成而推進：
這本書現在闔上了，你扣上栓並將其夾在胳膊下，你希望並祈禱你能保護它的安全，再也沒有人能將其打開。你親身體會到它風化的書頁中存留的只有瘋狂，而現在將由你來保護它，以免落入壞人之手。你些許鬆了一口氣，意識到艾肖希爾的奇異事件已經平息，你從中找到了一絲慰藉，至少目前是這樣。
(→結局1)
all_card.name: 真兇(版本七)
all_card.text: 每個[[客人]]敵人失去勝利0，失去[[無辜]]並獲得[[異教徒]]。 每個[[跡象]]支援獲得："[action]如果次元蹣跚者在你所在地點，從該支援卡上移除1個線索：躲避。自動躲避次元蹣跚者。 目標 – 如果場上沒有[[異教徒]]敵人，推進。
all_card.real_back_text:
If this agenda advanced by reaching its doom threshold:
They are all around you, in every room, in every hall, and their voices chant as one. You have their book, but it doesn't matter - not anymore. Their ritual has gone on too long, and gained too much power. The tome burns in your hands, its leather cover searing your skin, but you cling to it regardless. You feel it pulse, as if a heart were beating between its pages. Looking down to it, you realize it is the only way to survive this nightmare. You open the tome, find the page of the ritual, and add your voice to the endless chorus.
(→R2)
If this agenda advanced because you completed its objective:
The book is closed now, and as you fasten the latch and tuck it under your arm, you hope and pray that you can keen it safe and that it will never be opened again. You know firsthand that only madness lies within its weathered pages, and it is now up to you to protect it from falling into the wrong hands. You breathe a bit easier and find some measure of comfort in knowing that the strange goings-on of the Excelsior have been put to rest, at least for now.
(→R1)
all_card.real_text: Each [[Guest]] enemy loses Victory 0, loses [[Innocent]], and gains [[Cultist]]. Each [[Lead]] asset gains: "[action] If Dimensional Shambler is at your location, remove 1 clue from this asset: Evade. Automatically evade Dimensional Shambler. Objective - If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, advance.

(→結局2)

all_card.real_back_text:
If this agenda advanced by reaching its doom threshold:
Everywhere you go, you can feel its piercing awareness in your mind. It is too powerful for you to resist. You can feel it as it watches your every move, listens to your every thought, and tastes your every fear. It picks at your nerves, as if its cold, dark fingers were digging through your cerebrum. You look down to your own hands, and feel an unsettling thought growing in your mind. Your own body looks foreign to you, and with a grim finality your consciousness is thrust aside to make room for this new sentience.
(→R2)
If this agenda advanced because you completed its objective:
You stand in the lobby of the hotel, the building suddenly silent and seemingly empty. You hold the bottle of the strange liquid up to the light and consider its contents again. Your eye twitches as it traces the swirling, churning green solution within, and you shudder as you wonder what other effects this concoction may hold. You slide the bottle into your pocket, finding some measure of comfort in knowing that the strange goings-on of the Excelsior have been put to rest, at least for now.
(→R1)
