你站在酒店的大廳，建築內突然陷入寂靜，似乎空無一人。你將裝著奇怪液體的瓶子舉到燈光下，打量著裡面的溶液。你看著瓶中綠色的漩渦，眼睛開始抽搐，想到這混合物是否還有其他效果，你不禁哆嗦起來。你將瓶子放入口袋，意識到艾肖希爾的奇異事件已經平息，你從中找到了一絲慰藉，至少目前是這樣。
(→結局1)

all_card.real_back_text:
If this agenda advanced by reaching its doom threshold:
Everywhere you go, you can feel its piercing awareness in your mind. It is too powerful for you to resist. You can feel it as it watches your every move, listens to your every thought, and tastes your every fear. It picks at your nerves, as if its cold, dark fingers were digging through your cerebrum. You look down to your own hands, and feel an unsettling thought growing in your mind. Your own body looks foreign to you, and with a grim finality your consciousness is thrust aside to make room for this new sentience.
(→R2)
If this agenda advanced because you completed its objective:
You stand in the lobby of the hotel, the building suddenly silent and seemingly empty. You hold the bottle of the strange liquid up to the light and consider its contents again. Your eye twitches as it traces the swirling, churning green solution within, and you shudder as you wonder what other effects this concoction may hold. You slide the bottle into your pocket, finding some measure of comfort in knowing that the strange goings-on of the Excelsior have been put to rest, at least for now.
(→R1)
all_card.real_text: Room 212 gains: "[action] If Tome of Rituals is at this location: Test [willpower] (5) or [intellect] (5). If you succeed, move up to 1 [per_investigator] clues from Tome of Rituals to Harvested Brain. Objective - If Harvested Brain has 3 [per_investigator] clues on it, advance

all_card.back_text:
如果本密謀因為達到毀滅目標值而推進：
他們無處不在，每個房間、每條走廊，始終圍繞著你，他們的聲音合而為一。他們的書在你手裡，但這已經無關緊要了。他們的儀式已持續了太久，獲得了太多的力量。這本書籍在你手中燃燒，它的皮革封面灼燒著你的皮膚，但你仍將其緊緊握住。你能感覺到它的脈博，就好像有一顆在書頁之間跳動的心臟。低頭看向它，你意識到這是你能從這場噩夢中存活下來的唯一途徑。你打開這本古書，翻到儀式的頁面，將自己的聲音加入到無盡的詠唱中。
(→結局2)
如果本密謀因為目標完成而推進：
這本書現在闔上了，你扣上栓並將其夾在胳膊下，你希望並祈禱你能保護它的安全，再也沒有人能將其打開。你親身體會到它風化的書頁中存留的只有瘋狂，而現在將由你來保護它，以免落入壞人之手。你些許鬆了一口氣，意識到艾肖希爾的奇異事件已經平息，你從中找到了一絲慰藉，至少目前是這樣。
(→結局1)

all_card.text: 每個[[客人]]敵人失去勝利0，失去[[無辜]]，並獲得[[異教徒]]。 地下室獲得："[action]：檢定[willpower](4)或[agility](4)。你可以從地下室的1張[[跡象]]支援卡移除1線索，以降低這次檢定的難度2點。如果你成功，從當前密謀移除1個毀滅標記。 目標 - 如果本密謀上沒有毀滅標記，推進。
all_card.real_back_text:
If this agenda advanced by reaching its doom threshold:
They are all around you, in every room, in every hall, and their voices chant as one. You have their book, but it doesn't matter - not anymore. Their ritual has gone on too long, and gained too much power. The tome burns in your hands, its leather cover searing your skin, but you cling to it regardless. You feel it pulse, as if a heart were beating between its pages. Looking down to it, you realize it is the only way to survive this nightmare. You open the tome, find the page of the ritual, and add your voice to the endless chorus.
(→R2)
If this agenda advanced because you completed its objective:
The book is closed now, and as you fasten the latch and tuck it under your arm, you hope and pray that you can keen it safe and that it will never be opened again. You know firsthand that only madness lies within its weathered pages, and it is now up to you to protect it from falling into the wrong hands. You breathe a bit easier and find some measure of comfort in knowing that the strange goings-on of the Excelsior have been put to rest, at least for now.
(→R1)

如果密谋推进时场上至少有11个毁灭标记：
你将装置上的刻度盘转到最大值。肌肉紧绷、身体开始腐朽时，你奋力抓紧它。刻度盘咔哒一声停住，接着你慢慢得以继续朝同一方向转动。它缓慢地一圈又一圈转动，最终回到起点，你承受着剧烈痛苦。空气变得稀薄，时间恢复了原本的节奏。
结算场景3设置。
如果密谋推进时场上少于11个毁灭标记：
你的肌肉和皮肤紧缩，感觉身体的能量正被抽干。你想尖叫，却没有空气能穿过喉咙。器官干瘪腐朽。一个阴险的声音解释道：“这是我们所有人终将面对的命运。”几分钟内，你便化作尘土。
本组每位调查员被杀死。(→结局1)
all_card.flavor: Glowing words continue to appear on your note. “Time flows differently in the next chamber,” it reads. “If you do not act quickly, you will decay into ash.”
all_card.name: 时间扭曲（A组）
all_card.text: 限时 - 在收到指示前，不要推进本场景。密谋推进时，场上必须至少有11个毁灭标记。(注意：若密谋推进时不满足此条件，本组每位调查员将被杀死。)
all_card.real_back_text:
If there was at least 11 doom in play when the agenda advanced:
You spin the dial on the device to its maximum value, struggling to keep hold of it as your muscles tighten and you begin to decay. The dial stops with a click, then slowly you are able to continue turning it in the same direction. You are in intense pain as it slowly turns, round and round, finally making it way back where it began. The air thins, and time returns to its original pace.
Resolve Act 3 Setup.
If there was less than 11 doom in play when the agenda advanced:
Your muscles and skin tighten, and you feel your body draining of energy. You try to scream, but no air escapes your throat. Your organs shrivel and decay. "The fate that inevitably awaits us all," a sinister voice explains. Within minutes, you are naught but dust.
Each investigator in this group is killed. (→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: Glowing words continue to appear on your note. "Time flows differently in the next chamber," it reads. "If you do not act quickly, you will decay into ash."
all_card.real_text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. When the agenda advances, there must be at least 11 doom in play. (Beware - If the agenda advances and you do not meet this condition, each investigator in this group will be killed.)

all_card.back_text:
如果一位调查员发动了毒之密室上的[action]能力，该调查员阅读下列文字： - 如果你“已被注射”，这团淤泥令人作呕却无害。结算场景3设置。 - 如果你“未被注射”，毒液会渗入你的皮肤，从内到外吞噬你的器官。你被杀死。结算场景3设置。
如果没有调查员发动毒之密室上的[action]能力：
整个迷宫的地板和墙壁移动、翻转，你失去了平衡。重力扭曲时，你沿着地板滑行，被撞入毒坑。
将每位调查员移动到毒之密室。本组每位“未被注射”的调查员被杀死。结算场景3设置。
all_card.flavor: Glowing words continue to appear on your note. “The Chamber of Poison awaits,” it reads. “One of you must open the way,” your note reads. “A sacrifice, for the greater good.”
all_card.name: 渗透的死亡（B组）
all_card.text: 限时 - 在收到指示前，不要推进本场景。密谋推进前，一位调查员必须发动毒之密室上的[action]能力。
all_card.real_back_text:
If an investigator activated the [action] ability on the Chamber of Poison, that investigator reads the following: - If you have "been injected," the sludge is disgusting but harmless. Resolve Act 3 Setup. - If you have not "been injected," the poison seeps through your skin, devouring your organs from inside. You are killed. Resolve Act 3 Setup.
If no investigator activated the [action] ability on the Chamber of Poison:
The floors and walls of the entire labyrinth shift and turn, and you lose your balance. Sliding along the floor as gravity twists, you are knocked into the poisonous pit.
Move each investigator to the Chamber of Poison. Each investigator in this group who has not "been injected" is killed. Resolve Act 3 Setup.
all_card.real_flavor: Glowing words continue to appear on your note. "The Chamber of Poison awaits," it reads. "One of you must open the way," your note reads. "A sacrifice, for the greater good."
all_card.real_text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Before the agenda advances, one investigator must activate the [action] ability on the Chamber of Poison.

all_card.back_text:
如果你“已将艾克索多隆的宠物送往另一组”： 随机选择另一组。在本轮结束时，该组将其放在一边的艾克索多隆的宠物放置在其一个迷宫走廊，处于生成状态。结算场景3设置。
如果艾克索多隆的宠物在胜利区：
生物无力地瘫倒在地，你终于松了一口气。
结算场景3设置。
如果以上情况均不符合：
生物撞破饲养箱的玻璃，饥饿地猛扑向附近的人。
将艾克索多隆的宠物移动到饥饿密室。它依次攻击饥饿密室的每位调查员。结算场景3设置。
all_card.flavor: Glowing words continue to appear on your note. “In the chamber ahead lives my precious pet,” it reads. “He is very hungry. Perhaps you should open his gate and allow him to feed.”
all_card.name: 宠物（C组）
all_card.text: 限时 - 在收到指示前，不要推进本场景。密谋推进前，设法处理艾克索多隆的宠物。(注意：若密谋推进时该生物仍“被锁起来”，它将挣脱束缚。)
all_card.real_back_text:
If you "sent Eixodolon's Pet to another group": Choose another group, at random. At the end of the current round, that group spawns their set-aside copy of Eixodolon's Pet in one of their Labyrinthine Halls. Resolve Act 3 Setup.
If Eixodolon's Pet is in the victory display:
You breathe a sigh of relief as the creature crumples lifelessly to the ground.
Resolve Act 3 Setup.
If neither of the above are true:
The creature smashes through the glass of its terrarium and lashes out hungrily at anyone nearby.
Move Eixodolon's Pet to Chamber of Hunger. It attacks each investigator in the Chamber of Hunger, in player order. Resolve Act 3 Setup.
all_card.real_flavor: Glowing words continue to appear on your note. "In the chamber ahead lives my precious pet," it reads. "He is very hungry. Perhaps you should open his gate and allow him to feed."
all_card.real_text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Find a way to deal with Eixodolon's Pet before the agenda advances. (Beware - If the creature is still "locked away" when the agenda advances, it will break free.)

all_card.back_text:
如果任意幸存组游戏区域内的任意艾克索多隆仍有生命值：
那身影穿过时空扭曲、闪烁。
将本场景翻回正面。
如果其他每个幸存组的艾克索多隆均没有剩余生命值： - 如果你的组是唯一幸存的组，前往(→结局2)。 - 如果仅有两组幸存，这两组前往(→结局3)。 - 如果三组均幸存，三组均前往(→结局4)。
all_card.flavor: “You are close to freedom,” the figure’s distorted voice crackles. “Do you still have hope in your voice? Do you still have light in your eyes?”
all_card.name: 逃离
all_card.text: 目标 - 在本轮结束时，如果艾克索多隆没有剩余生命值，你可以将其身上超过其生命值的任意伤害移动到另一组的艾克索多隆上。然后，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If any copy of Eixodolon in any surviving group's play area has health remaining:
The figure distorts and shimmers through space-time.
Flip this act back over.
If each other surviving group's copy of Eixodolon has no health remaining: - If your group is the only surviving group, proceed to (→R2). - If only two groups survived, those groups proceed to (→R3). - If all three groups survived, all three groups proceed to (→R4).
all_card.real_flavor: "You are close to freedom," the figure's distorted voice crackles. "Do you still have hope in your voice? Do you still have light in your eyes?"
all_card.real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, if Eixodolon has no remaining health, you may move any damage on him in excess of his health to another group's copy of Eixodolon. Then, advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果你以独立模式进行游戏： 前往(→结局2)。
如果你以小型战役模式进行游戏，且这是第一个或第二个进行游戏的组： 以新的一组开始游戏，以确定最终达成的结局。
如果你以小型战役模式进行游戏，且这是第三个进行游戏的组： - 如果仅有一组幸存，前往(→结局2)。 - 如果有两组幸存，前往(→结局3)。 - 如果三组均幸存，前往(→结局4)。
all_card.flavor: “You are close to freedom,” the figure’s distorted voice crackles. “Do you still have hope in your voice? Do you still have light in your eyes?”
all_card.name: 逃离
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果艾克索多隆没有剩余生命值，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If you are playing in standalone mode: Proceed to (→R2).
If you are playing as a mini-campaign and this is the first or second group played: Begin as a new group to discover which resolution is reached.
If you are playing as a mini-campaign, and this is the third group played: - If only one group survived, proceed to (→R2). - If two groups survived, proceed to (→R3). - If all three groups survived, proceed to (→R4).
all_card.real_flavor: "You are close to freedom," the figure's distorted voice crackles. "Do you still have hope in your voice? Do you still have light in your eyes?"
all_card.real_text: Objective - If Eixodolon has no remaining health, advance.

Perhaps it is a clue… but for what?

all_card.name: 裂隙
all_card.text:
一道闪光之后，附近墙壁上开始裂开一道缝隙，能量慢慢凝聚成传送门的形状。它现在太小，无法进入，但很快就足以让人穿过……
显现 - 将裂隙附属到当前场景。如果是场景1，B组和C组将放在一边的奥秘之钥放置入场，放在一个[[扭曲]]地点。 强制 - 在本轮结束时，如果每组的密谋上均至少有3个毁灭标记：裂隙张开到足以让一位调查员穿过。选择任意地点的一位调查员进入裂隙。然后，该调查员将本卡牌翻面并遵循其背面的指示。
all_card.back_flavor: You find yourself in a hub, of sorts — a pathway within the aether. Other prisoners have found their way here. Perhaps you can collaborate with them to find a way to escape.
all_card.back_text: 每位进入裂隙的调查员拿走本剧情卡牌，远离各组私下会面。裂隙中的调查员可以自由交谈，并可以交换任意数量的线索、资源、手牌或其控制的剧情支援。调查员满意后，每位调查员回到其原本的组。将本卡牌翻回正面。
all_card.flavor: With a sudden flash of light, a rift begins to open in the wall nearby, energy slowly coalescing into the shape of a portal. It is too small to enter now, but soon it will be large enough for a person to step through…
all_card.real_text:
With a sudden flash of light, a rift begins to open in the wall nearby, energy slowly coalescing into the shape of a portal. It is too small to enter now, but soon it will be large enough for a person to step through...
Revelation - Attach The Rift to the current act. If it is act 1, Groups B and C put the set-aside Key of Mysteries into play at a [[Distortion]] location. Forced - At the end of the round, if there is at least 3 doom on each group's agenda: The rift opens wide enough for an investigator to step through. Choose an investigator at any location to enter the rift. Then, that investigator flips this card over and follows the instructions on its other side.

You find yourself in a hub, of sorts - a pathway within the aether. Other prisoners have found their way here. Perhaps you can collaborate with them to find a way to escape.
Each investigator that entered the rift takes this story card and meets in private, away from each group. Investigators within the rift can speak freely, and may exchange any number of clues, resources, cards in hand, or story assets controlled. Once the investigators are satisfied, each investigator returns to his or her original group. Flip this card back over.
all_card.name: 迷宫深处……
all_card.text:
你发现自己置身于某种枢纽——以太中的一条通道。其他囚徒也找到了这里。或许你们可以合作寻找逃脱的办法。
每位进入裂隙的调查员拿取本剧情卡牌，并远离各组私下会面。裂隙中的调查员可以自由交谈，也可以交换任意数量的线索、资源、手牌或其控制的剧情支援。调查员满意后，每位调查员回到原来的组别。将本卡牌翻回。

拿走本卡牌上或下方的卡牌、标记和便笺，将它们放在另一组的通风井副本上或下方。

all_card.name: 两难抉择
all_card.text:

all_card.back_flavor: 時空旅行可能會導致意料之外的後果……
all_card.back_text:
如果場上有時空異常劇情卡牌： 在一個(沒有異常的?)河濱碼頭地點放置1[per_investigator]點恐懼，作為異常。然後，在每個有異常的地點上各加上1個異常。
如果場上有黑幫糾纏劇情卡牌： 將其翻面。將3張放在一旁的謝爾頓幫派成員敵人洗入遭遇牌庫。如果場上有[[現在]]的滴答俱樂部，將放在一旁的老薩迪·謝爾頓敵人生成於此。
如果場上有不可名狀的異形劇情卡牌： 將其翻面。將放在一旁的提爾斯哈敵人生成在廷達洛斯。
如果場上有惡毒對弈劇情卡牌： 將其翻面。如果你處於過去時代，將放在一旁的艾德溫·貝內特敵人生成在調查員隊長所在地點。
all_card.flavor: 為了修復時間線，你必須穿過曲徑迷宮，解救被困在廷達洛斯的受害者，然後重現托馬斯和瑪麗人生歷程中的重大事件。
all_card.name: 進入虛空
all_card.text: 強制 - 在一個[[科學家]]支援將被擊敗時：改為被綁架(放在一旁，位於場外)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Traveling through time may cause unintended consequences...
all_card.real_back_text:
If the Anomalies in Spacetime story card is in play: Place 1 [per_investigator] horror on a River Docks location, as anomalies. Then, add 1 anomaly to each location with an anomaly.
If the Mob Troubles story card is in play: Flip it over. Shuffle all 3 set-aside Sheldon Gang enemies into the encounter deck. If the [[Present]] Tick-Tock Club is in play, spawn the set-aside Old Sadie Sheldon enemy at it.
If the Unspeakable Abomination story card is in play: Flip it over. Spawn the set aside Tyr'thrha enemy at Tindalos.
If the A Bitter Rivalry story card is in play: Flip it over. If you are playing the past era, spawn the set-aside Edwin Bennet enemy at the lead investigator's location.
all_card.real_flavor: In order to mend time, you must traverse the maze of winding pathways to rescue those trapped within Tindalos, then reconstruct the significant events of Thomas and Mary's journey.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When a [[Scientist]] asset would be defeated: It is abducted instead (set it aside, out of play).

all_card.back_flavor: 就算你用盡渾身解數、逃遍天涯海角，成群的獵犬還是會對你糾纏不斷、緊追不捨。牠們從角度空間中出現，把你抓住並拖進牠們的領域，承受地獄般的折磨。你再也進行不下去了。你修復時間線的努力失敗了。
all_card.back_text: 每位在任意時代剩下的調查員被擊敗並受到1點精神創傷。 如果艾德溫·貝內特支援在任意時代的場上，進入(→結局2)。 如果艾德溫·貝內特敵人在任意時代的場上，進入(→結局3)。 否則，進入(→結局4)。
all_card.flavor: 你越深入廷達洛斯，就越容易吸引其中的爪牙們注意並追捕你。如果你不抓緊時間完成任務，你可能就要永遠滯留在廷達洛斯了。
all_card.name: 時光荏苒
all_card.text: 強制 - 在一個[[科學家]]支援將被擊敗時：改為被綁架(放在一旁，位於場外)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: No matter what you do, no matter where you go, packs of Hounds harry and pursue you. They emerge from angular space to snatch you up and drag you to their realm of hellish torment. You can go on no further. You have failed to fix the broken timeline.
all_card.real_back_text: Each remaining investigator in all eras is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. If the Edwin Bennet asset is in play in any era, proceed to (→R2). If the Edwin Bennet enemy is in play in any era, proceed to (→R3). Otherwise, proceed to (→R4).
all_card.real_flavor: The more you travel through Tindalos, the more likely its minions are to take notice and pursue you. If you don't complete your mission in time, you might become permanent guests of Tindalos.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When a [[Scientist]] asset would be defeated: It is abducted instead (set it aside, out of play).

all_card.back_flavor:
你看著托馬斯和瑪麗榮獲他們應得的諾貝爾獎，長舒了一口氣。時間線看來已經被修補完整，一切都已恢復原樣。你收到了由衷的感謝。他們會為人類留下偉大的遺產，而你為這份遺產做出了至關重要的貢獻。
你謹慎地希望艾德溫的陰謀已經被完全瓦解了。廷達洛斯的勢力可能永遠不會收起獠牙。你只能繼續保持警惕。但願你對時間的干預不會造成新的悖論。
all_card.flavor: 你緊張地穿過前往廷達洛斯的次元門，踏入一個超脫時間的深層未知領域。
all_card.name: 時間穿越
all_card.text: [[科學家]]支援上的能力可以被該支援所在地點的任意調查員觸發。 [reaction]在你移動到一個地點時，如果你所在地點至少有1個[[科學家]]支援：將其中任意數量的支援和你一起移動至該地點。 目標 - 為了修復時間線，完成所有劇情卡牌上的目標。如果所有3個時代中，托馬斯·科里根和瑪麗·傑林斯基都位於非廷達洛斯地點，且每個時代中都沒有劇情卡牌在場上，推進。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You breathe a sigh of relief as you watch Thomas and Mary receive their well-earned award. The timeline appears to have been stitched back together, and things are as they should be. They thank you profusely, forever grateful for your integral contributions to their legacy. You wonder with cautious hope whether Edwin's machinations are truly over. The forces of Tindalos may never be defanged. You can only remain vigilant and hope that your meddling has caused no further paradox.
all_card.real_flavor: Nervously, you step through a portal and enter the realm of angular time and infinite depths.
all_card.real_text: Abilities on [[Scientist]] assets can be triggered by any investigator at that asset's location. [reaction] When you move to a location, if one or more [[Scientist]] assets are at your location: Move any number of them with you. Objective - Restore the timeline by completing the objective on each story card. If Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at non-Tindalos locations in all 3 eras, and each era has no story cards in play, advance.

all_card.flavor:
托馬斯與瑪麗相遇時，雙方都是就讀於米斯卡塔尼克大舉的優等生。讓這兩位聰明的學者相見並發展出永恆的友誼至關重要。
知名發明家尼古拉·特斯拉正在周遊美國，最近坐船來到了阿卡姆。你知道托馬斯和瑪麗參觀過特斯拉的發明展示，這場電閃雷鳴般的經歷極大地激勵了他們對科學的追求。
米斯卡塔尼克大學為了推動科學發展，正計劃升級或擴建校園。其中建造一座天文台的呼聲最高，但在資金緊缺的情況下，如此昂貴的設施幾乎無法建成。一筆可觀的捐款肯定能幫助這樣的重要項目逐漸走上正軌。
all_card.name: 偉大遺產(過去)

all_card.real_flavor:
Thomas and Mary met as promising undergraduate students attending Miskatonic University. It is paramount that these two gifted minds meet and form an everlasting friendship.
Famed inventor Nikola Tesla is touring America and has arrived in Arkham by sea. You know Thomas and Mary witnessed Tesla's electrifying demonstration and regarded it as highly inspirational in their pursuit of science.
In its devotion to the sciences, the Universtiy is looking to upgrade and expand its campus. High on the wish list is an observatory, but a lack of funding makes such an exorbitant facility unlikely. A sizable donation would surely get the momentum started on such a notable project.
all_card.real_text: Setup: Place the Nikola Tesla asset at the [[Past]] River Docks. Flip this story card over.

[action] If you, Thomas Corrigan, and Mary Zielinski are all at the [[Past]] Miskatonic University: Announce "Thomas and Mary have met." [action] If Thomas Corrigan, Mary Zielinski, and Nikola Tesla are all at the same location, spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Announce "Thomas and Mary are inspired by Nikola Tesla." [fast] If you are at the [[Past]] Miskatonic University, spend 2 [per_investigator] resources: Announce "funding for an observatory has begun." all_card.back_flavor: <u>阿卡姆公報</u>的歷史可追溯至美國獨立革命時代，當時報紙還只是發布本地通告和事務的手抄報紙。工業化讓<u>公報</u>有了第一家自動印刷機，報紙的影響很快蔓延到了阿卡姆以外。

Industrialization led to the <u>Gazette's</u> first automated printing press, and the newspaper's influence quickly spread beyond Arkham.

Look at the top 5 cards of the encounter deck, add 1 to the victory display, and put the rest on the top and/or bottom of that deck in any order.

all_card.name: 奧馬利鐘錶店
all_card.text: [action]移除此地點上的1個時間：從任意時代的密謀移除1個毀滅標記。如果托馬斯·科里根位於此地點，你可以消耗他來將1資源(從供應堆拿取)放到[[現在]]的滴答俱樂部上，作為時間。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Exquisitely crafted timepieces of all shapes, sizes, and styles adorn the walls of O'Malley's Watch Shop. Each clock is unique and displays a different time, causing the serence ringing of various bells and chimes every few minutes.

all_card.back_flavor: 米斯卡塔尼克沿岸的河濱碼頭是商人區的核心，時常因業務繁忙而車水馬龍。東部海域四處的許多貨物和旅客每天都會經過這座碼頭。
all_card.name: 河濱碼頭
all_card.text: [action]花費2資源或消耗此地點的一個[[科學家]]支援：將1資源(從供應堆拿取)放到[[現在]]或[[未來]]的河濱碼頭上，作為貨物。(每回合限制一次。)
all_card.traits: 阿卡姆. 次元門. 過去
all_card.real_back_flavor: Whirling with activity at all hours, the River Docks along the banks of the Miskatonic are the heart of the Merchant District. Numerous goods and travelers from across the Eastern Seaboard pass through the harbor every day.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 2 resources or exhaust a [[Scientist]] asset at this location: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on the [[Present]] or [[Future]] River Docks, as a shipment. (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.back_flavor: 成立於1690年，地位顯赫的米斯卡塔尼克大學是新英格蘭最為著名的高等學府。大學內廣受讚譽的學術風氣吸引了國內外眾多資質優異的學生。
all_card.flavor: 米斯卡塔尼克科學院學者們的傑出思想會互相激勵，達到更高的境界。
all_card.name: 米斯卡塔尼克大學
all_card.text: [action][action]移除此地點的1種子：宣告"已種下一棵樹。"每有1個[[科學家]]支援在此地點，獲得1資源。
all_card.traits: 阿卡姆. 次元門. 過去
all_card.real_back_flavor: Founded in 1690, the prestigious Miskatonic University is one of New England's most notable institutions of higher learning. The university's lauded academic disciplines attract promising students from across the country and abroad.
all_card.real_flavor: The brilliant minds of Miskatonic's College of Sciences motivate one another to ever-ascending heights.
all_card.real_text: [action][action] Remove 1 seed from this location: Announce "a tree seed has been planted." Gain 1 resource for each [[Scientist]] asset at this location.

all_card.back_flavor: 這座不大但溫馨的房子由托馬斯·科里根的父親於1858年搭建，托馬斯在這裡出生並成長。隨著新英格蘭四季更替，他對於科學的喜愛也與日俱增。
all_card.name: 童年之家
all_card.text: [action]如果"托馬斯和瑪麗見過面了"，且托馬斯·科里根和瑪麗·傑林斯基位於此地點：宣告"托馬斯和瑪麗結婚了。" [action][action]如果"科里根工業成立"：將1資源(從供應堆拿取)放到科里根工業上，作為時間膠囊。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Born and raised in a small yet cozy house built in 1858 by his father, Thomas Corrigan and his love for science grew rapidly as the ever changing seasons of New England passed.
all_card.real_text: [action] If "Thomas and Mary have met" and Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at this location: Announce "Thomas and Mary have married." [action][action] If "Corrigan Industries has been founded:" Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on Corrigan Industries, as a time capsule. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor: 自他蹣跚學步，探索家附近的樹林溪流起，托馬斯就是個求知欲和探求動力都取之不盡的人。
all_card.name: 托馬斯·科里根
all_card.text: [reaction]在你發動技能檢定時，消耗托馬斯·科里根：如果你檢定成功，抽取1張卡牌。
all_card.traits: 科學家. 盟友. 過去
all_card.real_flavor: Ever since he was a toddler exploring the woods and creek near his home, Thomas has had an abundance of curiosity and the drive to satiate it.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you initiate a skill test, exhaust Thomas Corrigan: If you succeed, draw 1 card.

all_card.flavor: 誕生於波蘭華沙，瑪麗對科學的熱情引導她遠渡重洋來到米斯卡塔尼克大學。
all_card.name: 瑪麗·傑林斯基

all_card.traits: 科學家. 盟友. 過去
all_card.real_flavor: Born in Warsaw, Poland, Mary's intense passion for the Sciences led her across the world to Miskatonic University.
all_card.real_text: [action] Exhaust Mary Zielinski: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering a clue at your location, gain 1 clue (from the token pool).

all_card.flavor: 特斯拉在歐美各地的高壓電展示，令參觀者讚嘆不已。
all_card.name: 尼古拉·特斯拉

all_card.traits: 科學家. 盟友. 過去
all_card.real_flavor: The high-voltage demonstrations performed by Tesla throughout America and Europe were truly awe-inspiring.

all_card.flavor:
當資金籌備達標，建造也已完成，米斯卡塔尼克大學最新的建築——杰拉爾德·沃倫天文觀測台，將會高高地坐落於鶴丘。這座設施內有最先進的儀器，比如一架能探索宇宙深處的高能望遠鏡。它提供的新型數據對於托馬斯和瑪麗的研究價值是難以計算的。
與研究法術的教授——愛茲拉·格雷弗絲的合作雖然短暫，但收穫頗豐，對於引導托馬斯和瑪麗走向正確的研究方向而言非常關鍵。你將需要確保他們能這抓住這份機遇。

all_card.real_flavor:
When funding is reached and construction is completed, Miskatonic University's newest building, the Gerald Warren Astronomical Observatory, will sit high atop Crane Hill. The facility will feature state-of-the-art equipment, such as a high-powered telescope, that will be able to explore the depths of the universe. The new data it provides could be invaluable to the research of Thomas and Mary.
While brief, the fortuitous collaboration with a professor of the arcane, Ezra Graves, was vital in steering Thomas and Mary down the right path. You'll have to ensure this chance encounter occurs.
all_card.real_text: Setup: Place the Ezra Graves asset at the [[Present]] Arkham Advertiser. Flip this story card over.

all_card.real_flavor: The new facilities on campus have attracted additional prominent researchers to Miskatonic University.
all_card.real_text: [action] If "a tree seed has been planted:" Gain 1 clue (from the token pool) for each [[Scientist]] asset at this location. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 米斯卡塔尼克大學以南的住宅區，米里亞姆·比徹的古玩店內擺滿了科學無法解釋的神秘珍品。在工作多年後，米里亞姆在考慮退休，或許還有店鋪的出售事宜。
all_card.name: 魔術古玩商店
all_card.text: [fast]如果愛茲拉·格雷弗絲位於此地點，消耗他並花費1個線索：擊敗任意時代的1個非[[精英]]敵人。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Just south of Miskatonic University in Uptown, Miriam Beecher's novelty shop is filled with various arcane oddities the likes of which science cannot explain. After many years of work, Miriam ponders retirement and perhaps the sale of her store.
all_card.real_text: [fast] If Ezra Graves is at this location, exhaust him and spend 1 clue: Defeat a non-[[Elite]] enemy in any era. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor:
一旦所有關鍵的碎片都已歸位，可能需要無數年的研究——如果真的能得出結果的話——才能對宇宙中最大的謎題之一獲得突破性進展：傳送——即在不進行實體空間移動的情況下，將物質從一個點移動到另一個點。
托馬斯和瑪麗相信他們就快破解如何讓人類在時空中穿梭了。
如此重大的發現本應已經發生——托馬斯和瑪麗贏得諾貝爾獎，他們在世界各地享受讚譽，他們在<u>阿卡姆報社</u>慶祝自己的成功——然而，現在卻找不到任何相關的跡象。除非你親自介入……
all_card.name: 偉大遺產(未來)
all_card.text: 冒險設置：將次元射線儀支援放在一旁，位於場外。將此劇情卡牌翻面。
all_card.back_text: [action]如果托馬斯·科里根和瑪麗·傑林斯基位於科里根工業：將放在一旁的次元射線儀支援放置入場，在你控制之下(如果你退場，將其放在一旁，位於場外)。 [action]如果"傳送研究已開始"，且托馬斯·科里根、瑪麗·傑林斯基和次元射線儀位於[[未來]]的米斯卡塔尼克大學：檢定[intellect](3)。如果你檢定成功，以團隊為單位花費2[per_investigator]個線索(如果你以多組史詩模式進行遊戲，改為以團隊為單位花費8[per_investigator]個線索)：宣告"托馬斯和瑪麗創造歷史性大發現。" [action]如果"托馬斯和瑪麗創造歷史性大發現"，且托馬斯·科里根和瑪麗·傑林斯基位於[[未來]]的阿卡姆報社：宣告"托馬斯和瑪麗榮獲諾貝爾獎。" 目標 - 如果本劇情卡牌上所有3個能力都已被觸發，將其加入勝利牌區(在每個能力被觸發時，在其上放置一個資源標記)。
all_card.real_flavor: Once all of the necessary pieces are in place, it could take countless years of researching - if it is possible at all - to make a significant breakthrough on one of the greatest mysteries of the universe: teleportation - the moving of matter from one point to another without traversing the physical space between them. Thomas and Mary believe they are on the verge of sending a human through spacetime. Such a momentous discovery should have occurred - Thomas and Mary's Nobel Prize, their worldwide acclaim, the event at the Arkham Advertiser, the two of them holding up the newspaper celebrating their accomplishments - and yet, there is no trace of such events happening. Unless you intervene...
all_card.real_text: Setup: Set the Dimensional Beam Machine asset aside, out of play. Flip this story card over.

[action] If Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at Corrigan Industries: Put the set-aside Dimensional Beam Machine asset into play under your control (if you are eliminated, set it aside, out of play). [action] If "teleportation research has begun" and Thomas Corrigan, Mary Zielinski, and the Dimensional Beam Machine are at the [[Future]] Miskatonic University: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group (8 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, instead if you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode) and announce "Thomas and Mary have made a historic discovery." [action] If "Thomas and Mary have made a historic discovery" and Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at the [[Future]] Arkham Advertiser: Announce "Thomas and Mary have won a Nobel Prize." Objective - If all 3 abilities on this story card have been triggered, add it to the victory display (place a resource token over each ability when it is triggered).
all_card.name: 伟大遗产(未来)
all_card.text: [action]如果托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基位于科里根工业：将放在一边的维度光束机器支援放置入场，由你控制(如果你被淘汰，将其放在一边，位于场外)。 [action]如果"传送研究开始了"，且托马斯·科里根、玛丽·杰林斯基和维度光束机器位于[[未来]]的米斯卡塔尼克大学：进行一次[intellect](3)检定。如果你成功，作为团队花费2[per_investigator]个线索(如果你在史诗多人模式中游戏，改为作为团队花费8[per_investigator]个线索)，并宣告"托马斯和玛丽取得了一项历史性发现。" [action]如果"托马斯和玛丽取得了一项历史性发现"，且托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基位于[[未来]]的阿卡姆广告报：宣告"托马斯和玛丽获得了诺贝尔奖。" 目标 - 如果本剧情卡牌上的全部3个能力均已触发，将其加入胜利牌区(每个能力触发时，在该能力上放置一个资源标记)。

all_card.back_flavor: 阿卡姆北區這幾年來建築和廠房都在擴建，但其中只有一棟樓在晚上也安靜不下來：<u>阿卡姆報社</u>。哪怕是半夜三更的時候，這裡也會傳出記者、編輯和操作員的喧鬧，夾雜著印刷機印出最新一期報紙的嘯嘯聲。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆報社
all_card.text: [action]：在阿卡姆公報或任意時代的阿卡姆報社上放置1資源(從供應堆拿取)，作為報紙。(團隊每場遊戲限制兩次。) [fast]移除此地點上的1個報紙：將1[per_investigator]個線索(從供應堆拿取)放到此地點上。從混亂帶移除1個[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]標記，直到遊戲結束。
all_card.traits: 阿卡姆. 次元門. 未來
all_card.real_back_flavor: As the buildings and factories of Arkham's Northside grow in size over the years, all but one is relatively silent by nightfall: the <u>Arkham Advertiser</u>. Even the witching hour is filled with the constant bustling of reporters, editors, and operators as the latest edition comes off the humming presses.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on the Arkham Gazette or on an Arkham Advertiser in any era, as a newspaper. (Group limit twice per game.) [fast] Remove 1 newspaper from this location: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues (from the token pool) on this location. Remove 1 [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] token from the chaos bag for the remainder of the game.

all_card.back_flavor: 滴答俱樂部藏於一條後巷中的老鐘錶店旁，是一間提供爵士樂、歡笑和酒水的地下酒吧。這裡的時間永遠是午夜。
all_card.name: 滴答俱樂部
all_card.text: [action]如果托馬斯·科里根位於此地點，消耗他並花費1[per_investigator]個線索：將1資源(從供應堆拿取)放到奧馬利鐘錶店上，作為時間。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。) [action]移除此地點上的1個時間：從任意時代的密謀移除1個毀滅標記。
all_card.traits: 阿卡姆. 次元門. 未來
all_card.real_back_flavor: Located in the Merchant District, the Tick-Tock Club is a popular nightclub where jazz, rock-n-roll, laughter, and drinks flow. It's always midnight at the Tick-Tock Club.
all_card.real_text: [action] If Thomas Corrigan is at this location, exhaust him and spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on O'Malley's Watch Shop, as time. (Group limit once per game.) [action] Remove 1 time from this location: Remove 1 doom from an agenda in any era.

all_card.back_flavor: 米斯卡塔尼克沿岸的河濱碼頭是商人區的核心，時常因業務繁忙而車水馬龍。世界各地的許多貨物和旅客每天都會經過這座碼頭。
all_card.name: 河濱碼頭
all_card.text: [fast]移除此地點上的1個貨物：獲得4資源或1個線索(從供應堆拿取)。 [fast]花費3資源或消耗此地點的2個[[科學家]]支援：將1資源(從供應堆拿取)放到[[現在]]的河濱碼頭上，作為貨物。(每輪限制一次。)
all_card.traits: 阿卡姆. 次元門. 未來
all_card.real_back_flavor: Whirling with activity at all hours, the River Docks along the banks of the Miskatonic are the heart of the Merchant District. Numerous goods and travelers from around the world pass through the harbor every day.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Remove 1 shipment from this location: Gain 4 resources or 1 clue (from the token pool). [fast] Spend 3 resources or exhaust 2 [[Scientist]] assets at this location: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on the [[Present]] River Docks, as a shipment. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 歲月流逝，不間斷的捐款和建設讓米斯卡塔尼克大學的校園持續擴張，入學人數也創下了新高。但到了黃昏時分，校園就會被滲人的影子籠罩，據說實驗室在深夜會進行禁忌的實驗。
all_card.name: 米斯卡塔尼克大學
all_card.text: [action]如果瑪麗·傑林斯基位於此地點：將1資源(從供應堆拿取)放到[[過去]]的米斯卡塔尼克大學上，作為種子。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。) [fast]：如果"已種下一棵樹"：本地點每有1個[[科學家]]支援，獲得1個線索(從供應堆拿取)。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.traits: 阿卡姆. 次元門. 未來
all_card.real_back_flavor: In time, continued donations and construction have led to a sprawling campus at Miskatonic University, with record-high enrollment. But by twilight, eerie shadows blanket the quiet campus, and rumors mount of late-night taboo experiments within the laboratories.
all_card.real_text: [action] If Mary Zielinski is at this location: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on the [[Past]] Miskatonic University, as a seed. (Group limit once per game.) [fast]: If "a tree seed has been planted:" Gain 1 clue (from the token pool) for each [[Scientist]] asset at this location. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 建於托馬斯·科里根童年之家的舊址，科里根工業是夢想成真的標誌。創新與發現是公司的特色，這裡透過科學推動著社會的發展。
all_card.name: 科里根工業
all_card.text:

all_card.real_back_flavor: Built on the site of Thomas Corrigan's childhood home, Corrigan Industries is a dream come to fruition. Innovation and discovery are the hallmarks of the company as it uses science to improve society.
all_card.real_text:
[action] Remove 1 time capsule from this location: Choose up to 4 cards in your discard pile and add them to your hand.
[action][action] If "Thomas and Mary have married:" Their children inherit Corrigan Industries. Gain 10 resources. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor: 這裡完全沒有艾德溫·貝內特的一點線索，但你知道他隨時可能會出現在任何地點。他現已精神錯亂、執迷不悟，發誓要向"背叛他"的人復仇。名望和榮譽都將只屬於他自己。沒有任何事物能改變他的想法。
all_card.name: 惡毒對弈
all_card.text:
冒險設置：遵循以下與你所對應的(一個或多個)時代的指示。
過去：將托馬斯·科里根放在一旁，位於場外；他被綁架了。將瑪麗·傑林斯基放在阿卡姆公報。將艾德溫·貝內特敵人放在一旁，位於場外。
現在和未來：將托馬斯·科里根和瑪麗·傑林斯基放在一旁，位於場外；他們被綁架了。如果你以多組史詩模式進行遊戲，將艾德溫·貝內特敵人放在一旁，位於場外。
all_card.back_text: [action][action]：準備艾德溫·貝內特並將其移動到你所在地點(即使他在另一個時代)。 [action]如果艾德溫·貝內特位於你所在地點：攻擊/躲避。攻擊或嘗試躲避艾德溫·貝內特。如果你檢定成功，以團隊為單位花費X個線索，其中X為所有玩家總數。然後，將1資源放到他身上，作為1獵殺。(團隊每輪限制一次。) 目標 - 如果艾德溫·貝內特上有3獵殺，且他位於廷達洛斯，廷達洛斯的勢力對他進行追捕。將艾德溫·貝內特從遊戲中移除，並將所有時代中的本劇情卡牌都加入勝利牌區。
all_card.real_flavor: There's no sign of Edwin Bennet but you know he could appear anywhere at any moment. Deranged and obsessed, he swears revenge on those who "betrayed" him. The fame and glory will be his alone. Nothing will convince him otherwise.
all_card.real_text:
Setup: Follow the instructions for your relevant era(s), below.
Past: Set Thoman Corrigan aside, out of play; he has been abducted. Place Mary Zielinski at Arkham Gazette. Set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.
Present and Future: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski aside, out of play; they have been abducted. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.

[action][action]: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your location (even if he is in another era). [action] If Edwin Bennet is at your location: Fight/Evade. Either attack or attempt to evade Edwin Bennet. If you succeed, spend X clues as a group, where X is the global number of players. Then, place 1 resource on him, as a target. (Group limit once per round.) Objective - If Edwin Bennet has 3 targets on him and he is at Tindalos, the forces of Tindalos seize him. Remove Edwin Bennet from the game and add all copies of this story card in each era to the victory display.
all_card.name: 苦涩的竞争
all_card.text: [action][action]：重整艾德温·贝内特，将其移动到你所在地点(即使他位于另一时代)。 [action]如果艾德温·贝内特位于你所在地点：攻击/躲避。攻击或尝试躲避艾德温·贝内特。如果你成功，作为团队花费X个线索，其中X为全局玩家人数。然后，在他身上放置1个资源，作为目标。(每轮团队限一次。) 目标 - 如果艾德温·贝内特上有3个目标，且其位于廷达洛斯，廷达洛斯的势力将他捕获。将艾德温·贝内特移出游戏，并将每个时代的本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。

all_card.flavor: 艾德溫·貝內特對前同事的怨恨已幾近失控，必須迅速制服他。你心無旁鶩，決心恢復他的理智並化解仇殺之恨。
all_card.name: 救贖前同事
all_card.text:
冒險設置：遵循以下與你所對應的(一個或多個)時代的指示。然後，將此劇情卡牌翻面。
過去：將瑪麗·傑林斯基放在一旁，位於場外；她被綁架了。將托馬斯·科里根放在童年之家。如果你以多組史詩模式進行遊戲，將艾德溫·貝內特敵人放在一旁，位於場外。
現在：將托馬斯·科里根和瑪麗·傑林斯基放在一旁，位於場外；他們被綁架了。將艾德溫·貝內特敵人生成在[[現在]]的米斯卡塔尼克大學。
未來：將托馬斯·科里根和瑪麗·傑林斯基放在一旁，位於場外；他們被綁架了。如果你以多組史詩模式進行遊戲，將艾德溫·貝內特敵人放在一旁，位於場外。
all_card.back_text: [action][action]：準備艾德溫·貝內特並將其移動到你所在地點(即使他在另一個時代)。 [action]如果艾德溫·貝內特位於你所在地點：談判。檢定[willpower](3)或[intellect](3)。如果你檢定成功，以團隊為單位花費X個線索，其中X為所有玩家總數。然後，將1資源放到他身上，作為1救贖。 目標 -如果艾德溫·貝內特上有至少3點救贖，且他和托馬斯·科里根、瑪麗·傑林斯基位於任意的米斯卡塔尼克大學，他得到了救贖。移除其上的所有救贖並將其翻面。將所有時代中的本劇情卡牌都加入勝利區。
all_card.real_flavor: Edwin Bennet's grudge for his former colleagues has spiraled out of control and he must be swiftly subdued. Undaunted, you're determined to restore his sanity and dissolve his vendetta.
all_card.real_text:
Setup: Follow the instructions for your relevant era(s), below. Then, flip this story card over.
Past: Set Mary Zielinski aside, out of play; she has been abducted. Place Thomas Corrigan at Childhood Home. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.
Present: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinsky aside, out of play: they have been abducted. Spawn the Edwin Bennet enemy at Miskatonic University.
Future: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski aside, out of play; they have been abducted. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.

[action][action]: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your location (even if he is in another era). [action] If Edwin Bennet is at your location: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, spend X clues, as a group where X is the global number of players. Then, place 1 resource on him, as a redemption. Objective - If Edwin Bennet has 3 or more redemption on him and he is at any Miskatonic University with Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski, he is redeemed. Remove all redemption from him and flip him over. Add all copies of this story card in each era to the victory display.
all_card.name: 救赎旧日同事
all_card.text: [action][action]：重整艾德温·贝内特，将其移动到你所在地点(即使他位于另一时代)。 [action]如果艾德温·贝内特位于你所在地点：谈判。进行一次[willpower](3)或[intellect](3)检定。如果你成功，作为团队花费X个线索，其中X为全局玩家人数。然后，在他身上放置1个资源，作为救赎。 目标 - 如果艾德温·贝内特上有3个或更多救赎，且他与托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基位于任意米斯卡塔尼克大学，他得到救赎。移除他身上的所有救赎并将他翻面。将每个时代的本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。

all_card.flavor: 過去的一切似乎都沒有異常。你不確定艾德溫·貝內特是否值得信任。他淵博的知識確實能替你帶來極大的幫助。你極不情願地說服自己回報值得冒險，但你需要費盡心思說服艾德溫，防止他背叛你。
all_card.name: 不安同盟
all_card.text:
冒險設置：遵循以下與你所對應的(一個或多個)時代的指示。然後，將此劇情卡牌翻面。
過去：將托馬斯·科里根放在童年之家。將瑪麗·傑林斯基放在奧馬利鐘錶店。將艾德溫·貝內特支援放在阿卡姆公報在其上放置12個線索，然後移除其上的3[per_investigator]個線索。
現在和未來：將托馬斯·科里根和瑪麗·傑林斯基放在一旁，位於場外；他們被綁架了。如果你以多組史詩模式進行遊戲，將艾德溫·貝內特支援放在一旁，位於場外。
all_card.back_text: [action]如果艾德溫·貝內特位於你所在地點且處於準備狀態：談判。將你的1個線索放在他身上。你可以檢定[intellect](4)。如果你檢定成功，再將你的1個線索放在他身上。如果你檢定失敗，將他消耗。 [action]：準備並將艾德溫·貝內特移動到你所在地點(即使他在另一個時代)。 強制 - 當一輪結束時：移除艾德溫·貝內特上的1個線索(如果你以多組史詩模式進行遊戲，改為移除2個線索)。如果你不能這麼做，在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。本效果能導致當前密謀推進。 強制 - 在艾德溫·貝內特將要被綁架時：改為移除其所有傷害和恐懼，並在當前密謀上放置2個毀滅標記。 目標 -如果"托馬斯和瑪麗榮獲諾貝爾獎"，且場上任意時代都沒有[[情節]]劇情卡牌，將本劇情卡牌加入勝利牌區。
all_card.real_flavor: Nothing in the past appears to be out of the ordinary. You wonder if Edwin Bennet is trustworthy. Surely his vast knowledge could prove extremely useful in aiding you. Reluctantly, you convince yourself the payoff is worth the risk, but it will take a great deal of persuasion to keep Edwin from betraying you.
all_card.real_text:
Setup: Follow the instructions for your relevant era(s), below. Then, flip this story card over.
Past: Place Thomas Corrigan at Childhood Home. Place Mary Zielinski at O'Malley's Watch Shop. Place the Edwin Bennet asset at Arkham Gazette with 12 clues on him, then remove 3 [per_investigator] clues from him.
Present and Future: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinsky aside, out of play: they have been abducted. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet asset aside, out of play.

[action] If Edwin Bennet is at your location and he is ready: Parley. Place 1 of your clues on him. You may test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, place 1 more of your clues on him. If you fail, exhaust him. [action]: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your loaction (even if he is in another era). Forced - At the end of the round: Remove 1 clue from Edwin Bennet (2 clues instead if you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode). If you cannot, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. Forced - When Edwin Bennet would be abducted: Remove all damage and horror from him and place 2 doom on the current agenda instead. Objective - If "Thomas and Mary have won a Nobel Prize" and there is no [[Plot]] story card in play in any era, add this story card to the victory display.
all_card.name: 不安的联盟
all_card.text: [action]如果艾德温·贝内特位于你所在地点且处于重整状态：谈判。将你的1个线索放在他身上。你可以进行一次[intellect](4)检定。如果你成功，再将你的1个线索放在他身上。如果你失败，将其横置。 [action]：重整并将艾德温·贝内特移动到你所在地点(即使他位于另一时代)。 强制 - 一轮结束时：移除艾德温·贝内特上的1个线索(如果你在史诗多人模式中游戏，改为移除2个线索)。如果你无法如此做，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果可以导致当前密谋推进。 强制 - 艾德温·贝内特将要被绑架时：改为移除其所有伤害和恐惧，并在当前密谋上放置2个毁灭标记。 目标 - 如果"托马斯和玛丽获得了诺贝尔奖。"，且任意时代的场上都没有[[情节]]剧情卡牌，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。

all_card.name: 艾德溫·貝內特
all_card.text: 巡邏(最近有[[科學家]]支援的地點)。 艾德溫·貝內特不會受到傷害。 不能發現艾德溫·貝內特所在地點的線索。 強制 - 當神秘階段結束時：對艾德溫·貝內特所在地點的1個[[科學家]]支援造成1點傷害。
all_card.real_text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Edwin Bennet cannot be damaged. Clues cannot be discovered from Edwin Bennet's location. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Deal 1 damage to a [[Scientist]] asset at Edwin Bennet's location.

all_card.flavor: 有著真才實學，卻也反覆無常的謀略者。
all_card.name: 埃德温·贝内特
all_card.text: [fast]如果現在是你的回合且你位於[[次元門]]地點，消耗艾德溫·貝內特並花費2資源：移動到廷達洛斯。
all_card.real_flavor: A truly brilliant, yet unstable, mastermind.
all_card.real_text: [fast] If it is your turn and you are at a [[Portal]] location, exhaust Edwin Bennet and spend 2 resources: Move to Tindalos.

all_card.name: 艾德溫·貝內特
all_card.text: 巡邏(最近有[[科學家]]支援的地點)。 艾德溫·貝內特不會受到傷害。 不能發現艾德溫·貝內特所在地點的線索。 強制 - 當神秘階段結束時：對艾德溫·貝內特所在地點每個[[科學家]]支援造成1點傷害。然後，選擇一位調查員抽取遭遇牌堆頂的卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Edwin Bennet cannot be damaged. Clues cannot be discovered from Edwin Bennet's location. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Deal 1 damage to each [[Scientist]] asset at Edwin Bennet's location. Then, choose an investigator to draw the top card of the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 埃德温·贝内特
all_card.text: 強制 - 在艾德溫·貝內特消耗後：選擇一位調查員抽取遭遇牌堆頂的卡牌。 [reaction]在你抽取1張遭遇卡牌時，消耗艾德溫·貝內特：取消該卡牌的所有效果並將其丟棄。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Edwin Bennet exhausts: Choose an investigator to draw the top card of the encounter deck. [reaction] When you draw an encounter card, exhaust Edwin Bennet: Cancel all of that card's effects and discard it.

all_card.flavor: 表面上似乎是隨機的奇怪現象正在影響時空。阿卡姆四處的怪異地點打亂了人們的日常生活，在居民之間散佈了恐慌。顯然這一切始於米斯卡塔尼克大學，有些人指責是科學大樓內進行的禁忌實驗所致。
all_card.name: 時空異常
all_card.text: 冒險設置：將1[per_investigator]點恐懼放到每個米斯卡塔尼克大學地點上，作為異常。如果你以多組史詩模式進行遊戲，將1[per_investigator]點恐懼放到以下地點，作為異常：阿卡姆公報、阿卡姆報社、奧馬利鐘錶店和滴答俱樂部。 將以下敵人從遊戲中移除：提爾斯哈、老薩迪·謝爾頓和所有3張謝爾頓幫派成員。將此劇情卡牌翻面。
all_card.back_text: 不能觸發有異常的地點的能力。 [action]花費任意數量的線索：檢定[willpower](3)或[agility](3)。每以此方式花費1個線索，這次檢定你得到+3技能值。如果你檢定成功，移除你所在地點的1異常(如果你成功且超過難度至少3點，改為移除2異常)。然後，如果你成功且超過難度至少4點，且"科里根工業成立"，移除任意時代和你所在地點名稱相同的地點上的1異常。 目標 -如果當前密謀為2a，且所有地點上都沒有異常，將本劇情卡牌加入勝利牌區。
all_card.real_flavor: Seemingly random peculiarities are affecting spacetime. Strange hotspots in Arkham disrupt day-to-day life and terrify residents. Apparently, these aberrations began at Miskatonic University, and some blame the distortions on taboo experiments in the Science Building's laboratories.
all_card.real_text: Setup: Place 1 [per_investigator] horror on each Miskatonic University location, as anomalies. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, also place 1 [per_investigator] horror on the following locations, as anomalies: Arkham Gazette, Arkham Advertiser, O'Malley's Watch Shop, and Tick-Tock Club. Remove the following enemies from the game: Tyr'thrha, Old Sadie Sheldon, and all 3 copies of Sheldon Gang. Flip this story card over.

Abilities on locations with an anomaly cannot be triggered. [action] Spend any number of clues: Test [willpower] (3) or [agility] (3). You get +3 skill value to this test for each clue spent this way. If you succeed, remove 1 anomaly from your location (2 anomalies instead if you succeed by 3 or more). Then, if you succeed by 4 or more and "Corrigan Industries has been founded," remove 1 anomaly from a location with the same title as your location, in any era. Objective - If it is agenda 2a and each location has no anomalies, add this story card to the victory display.
all_card.name: 时空异常
all_card.text: 有异常地点上的能力不能触发。 [action]花费任意数量的线索：进行一次[willpower](3)或[agility](3)检定。以此方式每花费1个线索，你本次检定得到+3技能值。如果你成功，移除你所在地点的1个异常(如果你成功超过难度至少3点，改为移除2个异常)。然后，如果你成功超过难度至少4点，且"科里根工业成立"，移除任意时代中一处与本地点同名地点上的1个异常。 目标 - 如果当前密谋为2a，且每个地点均没有异常，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。

all_card.flavor: 被選上絕路時往往只能鋌而走險。你別無他法，只能前去尋求惡名昭著的幫派頭目——老薩迪·謝爾頓的協助。謝爾頓以大批量非法販賣加拿大威士忌聞名，他和手下的幫派持有眾多資金儲備，以提供給那些急需借貸的人。只不過你要記得及時償還這位暴脾氣黑幫老大的債務……
all_card.name: 黑幫糾纏
all_card.text: 冒險設置：將老薩迪·謝爾頓敵人和所有3張謝爾頓幫派成員敵人放在一旁，位於場外。將提爾斯哈敵人從遊戲中移除。你和老薩迪·謝爾頓頓做了筆交易：每位在現在時代的調查員獲得2資源。
all_card.back_text: [action]如果"債務已償還"，以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：查找遊戲區域、遭遇牌堆或遭遇棄牌堆，找出一個謝爾頓幫派成員敵人並將其加入勝利牌區。如果你查找過遭遇牌堆，將其混洗。本行動不會觸發趁亂攻擊。 目標 - 如果所有3個謝爾頓幫派成員敵人都在勝利牌區，將本劇情卡牌加入勝利牌區。
all_card.real_flavor: Desperate times call for desperate measures. Out of options, you go to the infamous crime boss, Old Sadie Sheldon. Notorious for bottlegging large quantities of Canadian whiskey, Sheldon and his gang maintain a vast reserve of cash for those in need of an urgent loan. Just be sure you reimburse the short-tempered kingpin in a timely fashion...
all_card.real_text: Setup: Set the Old Sadie Sheldon enemy and all 3 copies of the Sheldon Gang enemy aside, out of play. Remove the Tyr'thrha enemy from the game. You make a deal with Old Sadie Sheldon: each investigator playing the present era gains 2 resources.

[action] If "the debt has been paid," spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Search the play area, encounter deck, or encounter discard pile for a Sheldon Gang enemy and add it to the victory display. If you searched the encounter deck, shuffle it. This action does not cause attacks of opportunity. Objective - If all 3 Sheldon Gang enemies are in the victory display, add this story card to the victory display.
all_card.name: 黑帮麻烦
all_card.text: [action]如果"债务已偿还"，作为团队花费1[per_investigator]个线索：查找游戏区域、遭遇牌库或遭遇弃牌堆，找出一名谢尔顿帮敌人，将其加入胜利牌区。如果查找遭遇牌库，将其混洗。本行动不会引发趁乱攻击。 目标 - 如果全部3名谢尔顿帮敌人均位于胜利牌区，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。

all_card.name: 老薩迪·謝爾頓
all_card.text: 冷漠。 每個謝爾頓幫派成員敵人得到+1攻擊和+1躲避。 [action]：談判。檢定[intellect](2)。如果你檢定成功，以團隊為單位花費3[per_investigator]資源，將老薩迪·謝爾頓加入勝利牌區並宣告"債務已償還。"
all_card.traits: 類人. 罪犯. 犯罪團夥
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Each Sheldon Gang enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, spend 3 [per_investigator] resources, as a group, to add Old Sadie Sheldon to the victory display and announce "the debt has been paid."

all_card.name: 謝爾頓幫派成員
all_card.text: 湧動。獵手。龐大。 謝爾頓幫派成員得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 強制 - 在謝爾頓幫派成員所在地點的調查員打出一張卡牌後：準備謝爾頓幫派成員，並棄掉遭遇牌堆頂的3張卡牌。將每個以此方式丟棄的[[罪犯]]敵人放置入場，位於該地點。
all_card.traits: 類人. 罪犯. 犯罪團夥. 精英
all_card.real_text: Surge. Hunter. Massive. Sheldon Gang gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After an investigator at Sheldon Gang's location plays a card: Ready Sheldon Gang and discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Put each [[Criminal]] enemy discarded this way into play at that location.

all_card.flavor:
廷達洛斯時空的極度扭曲影響了其中的一切。潛伏於角度時間之領域的生物不僅僅有薩蒂爾和廷達洛斯獵犬——有一個較它們指數般巨大、更為強大的存在，甚至能扭曲時空本身。
在這座巨大迷宮中游蕩的人，必定會招致居住於此之物的仇視，而廷達洛斯至高領主的怒火是無可比擬的。
all_card.name: 不可名狀的異形
all_card.text: 冒險設置：將提爾斯哈敵人放在一旁，位於場外。將老薩迪·謝爾頓敵人和所有3張謝爾頓幫派成員敵人從遊戲中移除。
all_card.back_text: [action]如果提爾斯哈位於你所在地點，花費1個線索：檢定[intellect](3)。如果你檢定成功，對提爾斯哈造成2點傷害(如果你成功並超過難度至少3點，改為3點傷害)。本行動不會觸發趁亂攻擊。 目標 - 如果提爾斯哈被擊敗，將本劇情卡牌加入勝利牌區。
all_card.real_flavor:
The extreme warping of spacetime in Tindalos has affected everything within. The satyrs and Hounds of Tindalos aren't the only beings to stalk about the realm of angular time - a being exponentially larger and more powerful twists spacetime itself.
Those who continually walk the paths of this vast maze are bound to draw the ire of those who call it home, andnothing compares to the wrath of the Arch-Lord of Tindalos.
all_card.real_text: Setup: Set the Tyr'thrha enemy aside, out of play. Remove the Old Sadie Sheldon enemy and all 3 copies of the Sheldon Gang enemy from the game.

[action] If Tyr'thrha is at your location, spend 1 clue: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, deal 2 damage to Tyr'thrha (3 damage instead if you succeed by 3 or more). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Objective - If Tyr'thrha is defeated, add this story card to the victory display.
all_card.name: 不可名状的怪物
all_card.text: [action]如果提尔斯哈位于你所在地点，花费1个线索：进行一次[intellect](3)检定。如果你成功，对提尔斯哈造成2点伤害(如果你成功超过难度至少3点，改为3点伤害)。本行动不会引发趁乱攻击。 目标 - 如果提尔斯哈被击败，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。

all_card.name: 提爾斯哈
all_card.text: 龐大。反擊。巡邏(最近有[[科學家]]支援的地點)。 *提爾斯哈的總生命值池為6[per_investigator]。 強制 - 在提爾斯哈進入一個地點時：每個位於該地點的[[科學家]]支援被綁架。
all_card.traits: 古神. 廷達洛斯. 精英
all_card.real_text: Massive. Retaliate. Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). *Tyr'thrha has a global health pool of 6 [per_investigator]. Forced - When Tyr'thrha enters a location: Each [[Scientist]] asset at that location is abducted.

all_card.name: 恐怖薩蒂爾

all_card.back_text:
如果无血者(无声潜伏者)在场：
你转身，看见无血者带着杀意大步朝你走来。还来不及反应，这个高大的身影便踉跄了一下，脸朝下倒在红地毯上。

片刻后，尖锐的裂帛声打破寂静。闪亮的附肢从无血者破裂的西装和四肢中钻出，绽放为由血肉和扭动触手组成的骇人混合体。那生物的骨白色面具从梦魇般的肢体和咬合的尖牙之口中俯视着你，令你胃中翻腾。
将无血者(无声潜伏者)翻至(释放)面。
否则：
你周围的喧嚣似乎暂时平息了。
每位调查员可以治愈其所在地点一位调查员或[[宾客]]支援的1点恐惧。
all_card.flavor: Commotion stirs deeper within the manor as various guests ask the attendants to be let out. Other guests shuffle through the manor with dead eyes and blank stares.
all_card.name: 不速之客
all_card.text: 每个[[灯笼会]]敌人的谈判能力不能发动。 卡牌效果不能从本密谋移除毁灭标记。 强制 - 一个单面[[宾客]]支援将要离场时：改为其被咒缚(将其翻至背面，失去对其的控制，并治愈其所有伤害和恐惧)。
all_card.real_back_text:
If The Bloodless Man (Silent Lurker) is in play:
You turn around to see the Bloodless Man striding toward you with murderous intent. Before you can react, the imposing figure staggers, then falls face first onto the red carpet.

Moments later, a sharp sound of ripping cloth breaks the silence. Glistening appendages erupt from the Bloodless Man's torn suit and limbs, blossoming into a grotesque amalgam of flesh and writhing tentacles. Your stomach churns as the creature's bone-white mask stares down at you, set in a maw of nightmarish limbs and gnashing fangs.
Flip The Bloodless Man (Silent Lurker) to his (Unleashed) side.
Otherwise:
The clamor around you seems to quiet for a moment.
Each investigator may heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Guest]] asset at their location.

all_card.back_flavor: A rank stench pervades the once-stately manor. As more and more nightmarish creatures overtake wounded or dazed guests, you dash out from a hiding place to make a beeline for the exit. A ravenous creature, the stuff of nightmares, catches wind of your scent and pursues you doggedly to the exit. You feel its claws on your throat as you throw yourself through the solid pane of glass, straight onto a gory pile of bodies covered in lightly falling snow.

all_card.back_flavor: You take a deep breath as you stagger out into the cold night air. Snow falls thickly on the once-pristine lawn, now stained red with blood. The manor is dead silent behind you. Was the gem worth all this devastation?

all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). For each point you fail by, you must choose one: - Choose and discard 1 card from your play area. - Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. - Take 1 damage.

If you succeed, move to a connecting location. If you fail, take 2 damage. - Test [combat] (3) to attempt to hold your breath. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 氣溫聚然下降20度、40度、60度——這股寒意不僅不合時節，還奇在它能夠進入你體內，像尖針扎刺你的皮膚一般。天空中雲團舒展，形成許多神秘的、長有翅膀的身影：張開大口、牙似鋸齒的野獸像禿鷲一樣盤旋著，等待著時機下來覓食。
all_card.back_text:
如果本場遊戲為冒險模式，將1個[tablet]標記加入混亂袋。
將放在一邊的2張縹緲存在敵人、3張宿命終結詭計和遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。
如果這是第一張推進至1b的密謀，將放在一邊的胡吝紉合兆使敵人生成在空天圖書館。
all_card.flavor: 在另一維度的宇宙深處，某些東西開始從世界之間的帷幕之下滲入……
all_card.name: 召喚西勒諾斯
all_card.text: *本密謀的總毀滅目標值=團隊數量x6。 強制 - 在本密謀推進時： - 如果本場遊戲為單組團隊模式，移除本密謀的6個毀滅標記，然後將所有超出的毀滅標記移動到下一張藍色密謀。 - 如果本場遊戲為多組史詩模式，將本密謀的所有毀滅標記和界護標記移動到下一張藍色密謀。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The temperature plummets by twenty, forty, sixty degrees - the cold is bizarre not only for this time of year but also for the way in which it digs into your body, like needles piercing your skin. In the sky, the clouds unfurl into uncanny winged shapes: beasts with gaping mouths and serrated teeth, all of them circling like vultures, waiting for the right moment to descend and feed.
all_card.real_back_text:
If you are playing in Standalone Mode, add 1 [tablet] token to the chaos bag.
Shuffle the 2 set-aside Ethereal Entity enemies, the 3 Inevitable End treacheries, and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If this is the first agenda to advance to 1b, spawn the set-aside Hune-Stitched Herald enemy at the Athenaeum of the Empty Sky.
all_card.real_flavor: Deep in the cosmos of another dimension, something begins to seep through the veil between worlds...
all_card.real_text: *This agenda has a global doom threshold of 6 per group. Forced - When this agenda advances: - If you are playing in Single Group Mode, remove 6 doom from it and move all excess doom to the next blue agenda. - If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, move all doom and wards from it to the next blue agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 隨著胡吝迷霧散去，虛空彼端有詭異的星群在閃爍。你心中充斥著一種奇怪的感覺，感覺有成千上萬雙看不見的眼睛在盯著你。在聯結點的另一頭，天文學家和虛無主義者所預言的事件將要發生。一切生靈的終結，甚至還是一切終結的終結。
all_card.back_text:
如果本場遊戲為冒險模式，將1個[tablet]標記加入混亂袋。
如果胡吝紉合兆使敵人被放在一邊，將其洗入遭遇牌堆。
如果這是第一張推進至2b的密謀，將放在一邊的難逃巨腭敵人生成在空天圖書館。
all_card.flavor: 空天教團早在數年前就預言了這些事件。如今他們將要迎來自己早已預知的末日了。
all_card.name: 召喚推進
all_card.text: *本密謀的總毀滅目標值=團隊數量x6。 強制 - 在本密謀推進時： - 如果本場遊戲為單組團隊模式，移除本密謀的6個毀滅標記，然後將所有超出的毀滅標記移動到下一張藍色密謀。 - 如果本場遊戲為多組史詩模式，將本密謀的所有毀滅標記和界護標記移動到下一張藍色密謀。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As the hune-mists disperse, strange constellations twinkle beyond the void of space. You are filled with the curious feeling that you are being watched by thousands upon thousands of eyes that you cannot see. On the other side of the nexus, the event predicted by astronomers and nihilists approaches. The end of all life. The end, even, of all endings.
all_card.real_back_text:
If you are playing in Standalone Mode, add 1 [tablet] token to the chaos bag.
If the Hune-Stitched Herald enemy is set-aside, shuffle it into the encounter deck.
If this is the first agenda to advance to 2b, spawn the set-aside The Inescapable Maw enemy at the Athenaeum of the Empty Sky.
all_card.real_flavor: The Cult of the Empty Sky predicted these events many years ago. Now they will live out the ending that they have long foreknown.
all_card.real_text: *This agenda has a global doom threshold of 6 per group. Forced - When this agenda advances: - If you are playing in Single Group Mode, remove 6 doom from it and move all excess doom to the next blue agenda. - If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, move all doom and wards from it to the next blue agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 迷霧充斥著聯結點，滲出到外面的大氣，凝聚成名為"西勒諾斯"的存在。那是一片旋轉著的龐大迷霧，虛無而又具有生命力。它那無形的身軀上綴飾著幾乎無法辨別的形狀：眼睛、翅膀、牙齒、爪子，它所有的飢餓、貪婪、無止境的食慾。一切生靈都會被它恐怖的陰影所吞噬。
all_card.back_text: 如果本場遊戲為冒險模式，將1個[tablet]標記加入混亂袋。 將次元樞紐翻至(通向毀滅)面。如果次元樞紐不在場上，將其放置入場，(通向毀滅)面朝上放置。 將放在一邊的西勒諾斯敵人生成在次元樞紐。 查找遭遇牌堆、遭遇棄牌堆和所有遊戲區域的所有綠色和紅色遭遇卡，並將其移出遊戲。混洗遭遇牌堆。將每張密謀和場景移出遊戲，把放在一邊的西勒諾斯降臨密謀放置入場。
all_card.flavor: 終結將至。
all_card.name: 召喚將成
all_card.text: *本密謀的總毀滅目標值=團隊數量x6。 強制 - 在本密謀推進時： - 如果本場遊戲為單組團隊模式，移除本密謀的6個毀滅標記，然後將所有超出的毀滅標記移動到放在一邊的西勒諾斯降臨密謀。 如果本場遊戲為多組史詩模式，將本密謀的所有毀滅標記和界護標記移動到放在一邊的西勒諾斯降臨密謀。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The mist fills the nexus and seeps out into the atmosphere, consolidating into the being known as Silenus. It is a vast, swirling mist, empty and alive all at once. Punctuating its otherwise formless mass are barely recognizable shapes: eyes, wings, teeth, claws, all of it starving, ravenous, insatiable. All life is inhaled by its horrible shadow as it descends.
all_card.real_back_text: If you are playing in Standalone Mode, add 1 [tablet] token to the chaos bag. Flip Hub Dimension to its (Gateway to Destruction) side. If Hub Dimension is not in play, put it into play, (Gateway to Destruction) side faceup. Spawn the set-aside Silenus enemy at Hub Dimension. Search the encounter deck, encounter discard pile, and each play area for all green and red encounter cards and remove them from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck. Remove each agenda and act from the game and put the set-aside Silenus Descends agenda into play.
all_card.real_flavor: The end is nigh.
all_card.real_text: *This agenda has a global doom threshold of 6 per group. Forced - When this agenda advances: - If you are playing in Single Group Mode, remove 6 doom from it and move all excess doom to the set-aside Silenus Descends agenda. - If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, move all doom and wards from it to the set-aside Silenus Descends agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 樂園的卵體在其聖地——阿卡特的高牆之內開始躁動。在地球歷史上，這還是第一次能看到長有鱗片的卵殼裡面的樣貌：那是一個胚胎，正隨著自己醜陋身形的發育而蠕動著。
all_card.back_text:
如果本場遊戲為冒險模式，將1個[cultist]標記加入混亂袋。
將放在一邊的2樂園引領者敵人、3張窮追猛打詭計和遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。
如果這是第一張推進至1b的密謀，將放在一邊的可怕的修格斯敵人生成在梅根-阿卡特聖地。
all_card.flavor: 在世外的褻漬之地，有個存在正從另一次元汲取異界的熱量。
all_card.name: 卵的孵化
all_card.text: *本密謀的總毀滅目標值=團隊數量x6。 強制 - 在本密謀推進時： - 如果本場遊戲為單組團隊模式，移除本密謀的6個毀滅標記，然後將所有超出的毀滅標記移動到下一張綠色密謀。 - 如果本場遊戲為多組史詩模式，將本密謀的所有毀滅標記和界護標記移動到下一張綠色密謀。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Deep within the walls of its sacred shrine, Ark'at, the Egg of Paradise, begins to stir. For the first time in the history of the Earth, a shape can be seen on the other side of the egg's scaled translucent surface: an embryo, moiling and writhing as its hideous alien body develops.
all_card.real_back_text:
If you are playing in Standalone Mode, add 1 [cultist] token to the chaos bag.
Shuffle the 2 set-aside Bringer of Paradise enemies, the 3 Hunt Down treacheries, and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If this is the first agenda to advance to 1b, spawn the set-aside Horrific Shoggoth enemy at the Shrine of Magh'an Ark'at.
all_card.real_flavor: In a profane place hidden from society, an entity siphons otherworldly heat from another dimension...
all_card.real_text: *This agenda has a global doom threshold of 6 per group. all_card.back_flavor: 阿卡特表面出現了一道裂痕。看護者對卵中孵化的存在頂禮膜拜、畢恭畢敬。裂痕繼續生長，在阿卡特帶有鱗片的表面盤繞。裂縫裡冒出帶有泡泡的綠色黏液，噴灑在聖地的祭壇。"梅根！梅根！梅根！"信眾歡欣鼓舞，"我們將會迎來樂園！"
all_card.back_text:
如果本場遊戲為冒險模式，將1個[cultist]標記加入混亂袋。
如果可怕的修格斯敵人被放在一邊，將其洗入遭遇牌堆。
如果這是第一張推進至2b的密謀，將放在一邊的卑鄙護卵者敵人生成在梅根-阿卡特聖地。
all_card.flavor: 從卵殼表面滾落的每一滴胎液，都孕育出恐怖的生物：樂園的使徒，至少阿卡特教團是這樣認為的。
all_card.name: 孵化推進
all_card.text: *本密謀的總毀滅目標值=團隊數量x6。 強制 - 在本密謀推進時： - 如果本場遊戲為單組團隊模式，移除本密謀的6個毀滅標記，然後將所有超出的毀滅標記移動到下一張綠色密謀。 - 如果本場遊戲為多組史詩模式，將本密謀的所有毀滅標記和界護標記移動到下一張綠色密謀。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A crack appears on the surface of Ark'at. The caretakers of the egg genuflect, submitting themselves in reverence to the entity hatching within. The crack grows, winding up and down Ark'at's scaled surface. Effervescent green slime bubbles from the fissure and spills onto the shrine's altar. "Magh'an! Magh'an! Magh'an!" the devotees rejoice. "Paradise is upon us!"
all_card.real_back_text:
If you are playing in Standalone Mode, add 1 [cultist] token to the chaos bag.
If the Horrific Shoggoth enemy is set-aside, shuffle it into the encounter deck.
If this is the first agenda to advance to 2b, spawn the set-aside Vile Broodmaster enemy at the Shrine of Magh'an Ark'at.
all_card.real_flavor: From each drop of embryonic liquid that rolls off of the egg's surface, horrible creatures gestate: agents of paradise, or so the Cult of Ark'at believes.

all_card.back_flavor: 阿卡特的卵以次元樞紐的能量為養分，業已孵化。但看護卵體的人錯了，大錯特錯。地球上不會出現樂園，因為阿卡特內孕育的並非是神聖的存在，它既沒有公平與正義的靈魂，也完全無法進行理智的思考——它是個只知道飢餓、死亡與毀滅的狂暴怪物。
all_card.back_text: 如果本場遊戲為冒險模式，將1個[cultist]標記加入混亂袋。 將次元樞紐翻至(通向毀滅)面。如果次元樞紐不在場上，將其放置入場，(通向毀滅)面朝上放置。 將放在一邊的梅根-阿卡特敵人生成在次元樞紐。 查找遭遇牌堆、遭遇棄牌堆和所有遊戲區域的所有藍色和紅色遭遇卡，並將其移出遊戲。混洗遭遇牌堆。將每張密謀和場景移出遊戲，把放在一邊的孵化密謀放置入場。
all_card.flavor: 終結將至。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Incubated by the energies of the hub dimension, the egg of Ark'at has hatched. But its caretakers were wrong. So very, very wrong. There will be no paradise on Earth, for the entity that stirred within Ark'at is no heavenly being, no spirit of justice or righteousness, nothing capable of intelligent thought at all - it is a rampaging monstrosity that knows only hunger, death, and destruction.

Search the encounter deck, encounter discard pile, and each play area for all blue and red encounter cards and remove them from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
