Forced - When this agenda advances: - If you are playing in Single Group Mode, remove 6 doom from it and move all excess doom to the set-aside The Egg Hatches agenda. - If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, move all doom and wards from it to the set-aside The Egg Hatches agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 地球上的各座城市突然出現黑雲。但那並非鳥雲，而是飛翔的諸多艾澤爾子民：成群的巨大昆蟲佈滿天空與街道，發出無休止的嗡鳴聲。這聲音時刻提醒著你，沒能阻止它們的話會是什麼後果。
all_card.back_text:
如果本場遊戲為冒險模式，將1個[elder_thing]標記加入混亂袋。
將放在一邊的4張三重蝗敵人中的3張、2張原形驚變詭計和遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。
如果這是第一張推進至1b的密謀，將放在一邊的三重蝗敵人生成。該敵人額外獲得"蜂擁2"。
all_card.flavor: 某種可怕的東西開始從深至地殼的坑洞裡出現……
all_card.name: 蟲群增殖
all_card.text: *本密謀的總毀滅目標值=團隊數量x6。 強制 - 在本密謀推進時： - 如果本場遊戲為單組團隊模式，移除本密謀的6個毀滅標記，然後將所有超出的毀滅標記移動到下一張紅色密謀。 - 如果本場遊戲為多組史詩模式，將本密謀的所有毀滅標記和界護標記移動到下一張紅色密謀。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Black clouds descend on the cities of Earth. But they are not storm clouds. They are the soaring masses of Ezel: swarms of monstrous insects that fill the sky and the streets with incessant buzzing. The droning of the hive is constant. An ever-present reminder of what might come if you fail to stop them.
all_card.real_back_text:
If you are playing in Standalone Mode, add 1 [elder_thing] token to the chaos bag.
Shuffle 3 of the 4 set-aside Trylogog enemies, the 2 Transmogrify treacheries, and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If this is the first agenda to advance to 1b, spawn the remaining set-aside Trylogog enemy. That enemy gains an additional swarming 2.
all_card.real_flavor: From a pit deep within the crust of the Earth, something horrid begins to emerge...
all_card.real_text: *This agenda has a global doom threshold of 6 per group. Forced - When this agenda advances: - If you are playing in Single Group Mode, remove 6 doom from it and move all excess doom to the next red agenda. - If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, move all doom and wards from it to the next red agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 艾澤爾的領袖蟲后從聯結點的火坑裡現身，加入蟲群。當蟲群領袖加入，黑雲變得愈發暗沉、厚重。很快，一切都會被蟲群同化。
all_card.back_text:
如果本場遊戲為冒險模式，將1個[elder_thing]標記加入混亂袋。
如果有三重蝗敵人被放在一邊，將其洗入遭遇牌堆。
如果這是第一張推進至2b的密謀，將放在一邊的嗡鳴蟲群敵人生成在火坑。
all_card.flavor: 對於同化教團來說，蟲群的出現是新時代的先兆。迎來某種意義上的重生，變為更高級的形態。高人一等。
all_card.name: 增殖推進
all_card.text: *本密謀的總毀滅目標值=團隊數量x6。 強制 - 在本密謀推進時： - 如果本場遊戲為單組團隊模式，移除本密謀的6個毀滅標記，然後將所有超出的毀滅標記移動到下一張紅色密謀。 - 如果本場遊戲為多組史詩模式，將本密謀的所有毀滅標記和界護標記移動到下一張紅色密謀。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Emerging from within the Burning Pit that joins with the nexus, the Matriarch of Ezel joins the hive. The clouds grow darker and denser as the form of the swarm's master begins to coalesce. Soon, all will be assimilated into the hive.
all_card.real_back_text:
If you are playing in Standalone Mode, add 1 [elder_thing] token to the chaos bag.
If a copy of Trylogog is set-aside, shuffle it into the encounter deck.
If this is the first agenda to advance to 2b, spawn the set-aside Droning Horde enemy at the Burning Pit.
all_card.real_flavor: For the Cult of Assimilation, the appearance of the swarm is the heralding of a new era. A rebirth, of sorts, into a higher form. An ascendance.
all_card.real_text: *This agenda has a global doom threshold of 6 per group. Forced - When this agenda advances: - If you are playing in Single Group Mode, remove 6 doom from it and move all excess doom to the next red agenda. - If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, move all doom and wards from it to the next red agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 火坑裡湧現出大批蟲子。它們充斥了城市地下的每條隧道，隨即飛上天穹與同胞會合，直至蟲群遮蔽了整片天空。蟲雲的嗡鳴聲是如此響亮，蓋過了一切聲音，哪怕是即將釋放的混沌喧囂也被其蓋過。蟲群凝聚之後，整個地球也開始被同化。
all_card.back_text: 如果本場遊戲為冒險模式，將1個[elder_thing]標記加入混亂袋。 將次元樞紐翻至(通向毀滅)面。如果次元樞紐不在場上，將其放置入場，(通向毀滅)面朝上放置。 將放在一邊的艾澤爾-贊-雷茲爾敵人生成在次元樞紐。 查找遭遇牌堆、遭遇棄牌堆和所有遊戲區域的所有藍色和綠色遭遇卡，並將其移出遊戲。混洗遭遇牌堆。將每張密謀和場景移出遊戲，把放在一邊的艾澤爾-贊-雷茲爾出現密謀放置入場。
all_card.flavor: 終結將至。
all_card.name: 增殖將成
all_card.text: *本密謀的總毀滅目標值=團隊數量x6。 強制 - 在本密謀推進時： - 如果本場遊戲為單組團隊模式，移除本密謀的6個毀滅標記，然後將所有超出的毀滅標記移動到放在一邊的艾澤爾-贊-雷茲爾出現密謀。 如果本場遊戲為多組史詩模式，將本密謀的所有毀滅標記和界護標記移動到放在一邊的艾澤爾-贊-雷茲爾出現密謀。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Burning Pit erupts with insects. They fill every tunnel beneath the city and spill out into the sky, joining with their brethren until the swarm has completely obscured the atmosphere. The droning of the clouds is so loud that it drowns out all other sound, even the din of the chaos that is soon to be unleashed. With the swarm united, the assimilation of Earth has begun.
all_card.real_back_text: If you are playing in Standalone Mode, add 1 [elder_thing] token to the chaos bag. Flip Hub Dimension to its (Gateway to Destruction) side. If Hub Dimension is not in play, put it into play, (Gateway to Destruction) side faceup. Spawn the set-aside Ezel-zen-rezl enemy at Hub Dimension. Search the encounter deck, encounter discard pile, and each play area for all blue and green encounter cards and remove them from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck. Remove each agenda and act from the game and put the set-aside Ezel-zen-rezl Emerges agenda into play.
all_card.real_flavor: The end is nigh.
all_card.real_text: *This agenda has a global doom threshold of 6 per group. Forced - When this agenda advances: - If you are playing in Single Group Mode, remove 6 doom from it and move all excess doom to the set-aside Ezel-zen-rezl Emerges agenda. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, move all doom and wards from it to the set-aside Ezel-zen-rezl Emerges agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 你疲憊的雙手握著那位天文學家沉甸甸的筆記。"一切科學與宗教都無法解釋這一現象，"筆記開頭是這麼寫的。這本筆記接著描述了一個虛空的孔洞——從中可以看到另一個世界。"我知道別人不會認可我的發現，覺得我說的是瘋話，但那是我親眼所見——這個世界與異界連接的聯結點。"這聽起來很瘋狂，但這項發現把你的調查全都連通了。你審問過的每個教團成員都曾經提到某個"樞紐"，在不同的審問對象口中，它的開啟意味著萬物無法避免的終結，地球上的樂園，或者被"蟲群"同化。這位天文學家所說的地方一定就是這個"樞紐"了。雖然你還是無法理解究竟發生了什麼，但是至少你知道自己要做什麼了。如果這場戰爭的目的就是開啟樞紐，那你們必須要將它封印，確保它永遠都不會開啟。
all_card.back_text: 將放在一邊的次元樞紐地點放置入場，(未封印)面朝上放置。
all_card.flavor: 狂熱的三個教團從陰影中現身，他們的陰謀正席捲全球，掀起一場全面戰爭。你必須找出他們為何爭鬥，並且阻止這場戰爭。
all_card.name: 外神之戰
all_card.text: 強制 - 在要放置任意數量的毀滅標記到一張玩家卡時：將該數量的毀滅標記同樣放到任意一張密謀卡上。 目標 - 如果場上沒有[[異教徒]]敵人，調查員才能花費所需數量的線索。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The astronomer's notes weigh heavily in your weary hands. "Nothing in any science, or any religion for that matter, can explain this phenomenon," the preface reads. The notes then go on to describe a pocket within the void of space itself - a hole inside which another world can be seen. "I know my observations will be dismissed as madness, but I have seen it with my own two eyes. A nexus linking this world with others." Crazy as it all sounds, this discovery connects all of the dots in your investigation. Each of the cultists you've interrogated mentioned some kind of "hub," the opening of which will spell the inevitable end of all things, paradise on Earth, or assimilation into "the hive," depending on whom you are interrogating. The place described by this astronomer must be this "hub." You still do not understand precisely what is going on, but at least now you know what you have to do. If opening this hub is the goal of this war, yours must be to seal the hub so that it may never be opened.
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Hub Dimension location into play, (Unsealed) side faceup.
all_card.real_flavor: Three zealous cults have emerged from the shadows and their schemes are engulfing Earth in all-out war. You must find out why the cults are fighting and put a stop to their battle.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When any amount of doom is placed on a player card: Place that amount of doom on any agenda as well. Objective - Investigators may only spend the requisite number of clues if no [[Cultist]] enemies are in play.

all_card.back_flavor: 你這輩子從沒試過執行這樣的儀式。為了萬無一失地完成，你需要匯聚全部的力量、決心、智慧。哪怕是一句咒語、一個材料、一個步驟，一旦出錯就會讓所有的努力付諸東流。
all_card.back_text:
如果以單組團隊模式進行遊戲：
儀式完成之後，你和自己的同伴躺倒在冰冷的地面，異界的電流仍然刺痛著你的皮膚。現在夜空重新佈滿星辰，不再有旋轉的黑暗存在，籠罩在神秘迷霧中的異次元也消失不見。
調查員成功完成了封印，讓地球遠離外神的災難級戰爭。(→結局1)
如果以多組史詩模式進行遊戲：
樞紐的這一入口已被關閉，但在戰爭真正結束之前，還得封印更多的入口……
在每個密謀上放置2個界護標記。推進到場景3a。
all_card.flavor: 趁早封印次元樞紐！
all_card.name: 關閉次元門
all_card.text: [action]如果你位於[[儀式地]]：：你試圖封印次元門。在次元樞紐周圍放置你的1個線索。然後你可以檢定[willpower](2)或[intellect](2)。如果你成功，在次元樞紐周圍放置你的1個線索。 強制 - 在要放置任意數量的毀滅標記到一張玩家卡時：將該數量的毀滅標記同樣放到任意一張密謀卡上。 目標 - 如果你的團隊"封印了次元樞紐"，推進場景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You have never in your life performed a rite such as this. It takes all of your strength, all of your resolve, and all of your ingenuity to complete it without faltering. One misspoken incantation, one false ingredient, one wrong step, and the entire endeavor will have been for naught.
all_card.real_back_text:
If you are playing in Single Group Mode:
When your work is done, you and your companions lie on the cold ground, your skin tingling with otherworldly currents. The night sky is filled with stars and no longer blotted out by swirling black entities or alternate dimensions swathed in uncanny mist.
The investigators have sealed Earth away from the cataclysmic war of the Outer Gods. (→R1)
If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode:
This entrance to the hub is sealed, but there are many more entrances that must be sealed before the war can truly end...
Place 2 wards on each agenda. Advance to act 3a.
all_card.real_flavor: Seal off the hub dimension before it is too late!
all_card.real_text: [action] If you are at a [[Ritual Site]]: You try to seal off the portal. Place 1 of your clues around Hub Dimension. Then you may test [willpower] (2) or [intellect] (2). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues around Hub Dimension. Forced - When any amount of doom is placed on a player card: Place that amount of doom on any agenda as well. Objective - If your group has "sealed off the Hub Dimension," advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 儀式完成之後，你和自己的同伴躺倒在冰冷的地面，異界的電流仍然刺痛著你的皮膚。現在夜空重新佈滿星辰，不再有旋轉的黑暗存在，籠罩在神秘迷霧中的異次元也消失不見。
all_card.back_text: 調查員成功完成了封印，讓地球遠離外神的災難級戰爭。 (→結局1)
all_card.flavor: 趕在有教團完成儀式之前，幫助你的同伴封印所有的次元樞紐。
all_card.name: 關閉所有次元門
all_card.text: [action]如果你位於[[儀式地]]：你試圖封印另個次元門。檢定[willpower](3)或[intellect](3)。如果你成功，在另一團隊的次元樞紐周圍放置你的1個線索。 強制 - 在要放置任意數量的毀滅標記到一張玩家卡時：將該數量的毀滅標記同樣放到任意一張密謀卡上。 目標 - 如果每個未被擊敗的團隊都"封印了次元樞紐"，推進場景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When your work is done, you and your companions lie on the cold ground, your skin tingling with otherworldly currents. The night sky is filled with stars and no longer blotted out by swirling black entities or alternate dimensions swathed in uncanny mist.
all_card.real_back_text: The investigators have sealed Earth away from the cataclysmic war of the Outer Gods. (→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: Help your companions seal off all the hub dimensions before a cult completes their ritual.
all_card.real_text: [action] If you are at a [[Ritual Site]]: You try to seal off another portal. Test [willpower] (3) or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues around another group's Hub Dimension. Forced - When any amount of doom is placed on a player card: Place that amount of doom on any agenda as well. Objective - If each group has "sealed off the Hub Dimension," advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
"我們都熱愛那些令人驚歎的、黑暗的事物，這無疑是因為我們生活在一座日漸衰敗、隱約令人感到恐懼的古老小鎮——曾受女巫詛咒、傳說不斷的阿卡姆。在這座鎮上，擁擠、垮塌的複折屋頂和搖搖欲墜的喬治亞式欄杆經歷數百年後，依然叢立在昏暗、汨汨流淌的米斯卡塔尼克河旁邊。"
<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《門外之物》</cite>
all_card.name: 阿卡姆
all_card.text:
阿卡姆不能被附屬。
[free]花費1[per_investigator]個資源：移動到一個連接地點。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"What lay behind our joint love of shadows and marvels was, no doubt, the ancient, mouldering, and sublty fearsome town in which we live - witch-cursed, legend-haunted Arkham, whose huddled, sagging gambrel roofs and crumbling Georgian balustrades brood out the centuries beside the darkly muttering Miskatonic."
-H. P. Lovecraft, "The Thing on the Doorstep"
all_card.real_text:
Arkham cannot have attachments.
[fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Move to a connecting location.

all_card.back_flavor:
"街道兩旁有著雕刻的門扉，落日餘暉灑進舊式扇形窗和玻璃小窗，還有頂部裝飾著金葉的喬治亞式尖塔——這就是我兒時夢中的景象。"
<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《猶格斯星真菌》</cite>
all_card.name: 普羅維登斯街道
all_card.text: [action][action]：對任意一個團隊的[[普羅維登斯]]上的一個非[[古神]]敵人造成3點傷害。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"Streets with carved doorways where the sunset beams
Flooded old fanlights and small window-panes,
And Georgian steeples topped with gilded vanes -
These are the sights that shaped my childhood dreams."
-H. P. Lovecraft, "Fungi from Yuggoth"
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Deal 3 damage to a non-[[Ancient One]] enemy at a [[Providence]] location in any group. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 西勒諾斯教團的望遠鏡和星盤顯示了他們對夜空的敬畏。浩瀚宇宙的黑暗與空虛反映了他們的信念：必須終結一切生命。
all_card.name: 空天圖書館
all_card.text: [free]抽取遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌：在藍色密謀上放置1個界護標記。(團隊每輪限制一次。)
all_card.traits: 儀式地. 普羅維登斯
all_card.real_back_flavor: The telescopes and astrolabes of the Cult of Silenus manifest their reverence of the night sky. The darkness and emptiness of the vast universe mirror their faith that all life must end.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Draw the top card of the encounter deck: Place 1 ward on the blue agenda. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 作為美國的第一個室內商場，普羅維登斯自1828年以來一直保留著優雅的拱廊，包括其中的希臘復興式柱子和花崗岩牆壁。
all_card.name: 拱廊
all_card.text: [action]：檢定[agility](4)。如果你成功，從供應堆獲得1個線索。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As the nation's first indoor mall, the elegant Arcade and its Greek Revival columns and granite walls have been a fixture of Providence since 1828.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [agility] (4). If you succeed, gain 1 clue (from the token pool).

all_card.back_flavor: 蒙特利爾建於1642年，當時名為"維爾-瑪麗"或"瑪麗城"，有著多樣的建築風格，比如蒙特利爾大學的藝術裝飾風格，以及歷史悠久的聖母大教堂的哥特復興式風格。
all_card.name: 蒙特利爾街道
all_card.text: [action][action]：對任意一個團隊的[[蒙特利爾]]上的一個非[[古神]]敵人造成3點傷害。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Founded in 1642 as Ville-Marie, or "City of Mary," Montréal has a multitude of architectural styles, such as the Art Deco of the Université of Montréal and the Gothic Revival of the historic Notre-Dame Basilica.
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Deal 3 damage to a non-[[Ancient One]] enemy at a [[Montréal]] location in any group. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 哈默介城堡建於1705年，當時是一座輝煌的宅邸，如今作為博物館收藏大批藝術品，是了解蒙特利爾歷史的入口。
all_card.name: 哈默介城堡
all_card.text: [action]：檢定[willpower](4)。如果你成功，從供應堆獲得1個線索。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Built in 1705 as an illustrious residence, Chateau Ramezay is a museum containing numerous works of art that are a portal to Montréal's past.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, gain 1 clue (from the token pool).

all_card.back_flavor: 梅根-阿卡特的追隨者即便在卵體長大到超出聖地範圍之後，也妥善地看顧著它。他們相信卵的孵化會帶來永恆的樂園，而半透明的卵殼之下藏著的東西卻與他們的想法相左。
all_card.name: 梅根-阿卡特聖地
all_card.text: [free]抽取遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌：在綠色密謀上放置1個界護標記。(團隊每輪限制一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The followers of Magh'an Ark'at have cradled the insidious egg even as it outgrew the shrine. They believe the hatching of the egg will bring eternal paradise, but its translucency betrays that delusion.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Draw the top card of the encounter deck: Place 1 ward on the green agenda. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 在咆哮的二十年代的空前繁榮推動之下，紐約城正處於興建高樓的熱潮。一座座摩天大樓拔地而起：伍爾沃斯大樓高度被克萊斯勒大廈超越，過了不久帝國大廈又超過了克萊斯勒大廈。
all_card.name: 紐約街道
all_card.text: [action][action]：對任意一個團隊的[[紐約城]]上的一個非[[古神]]敵人造成3點傷害。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Boosted by the unprecedented prosperity of the Roaring Twenties, New York City is in the midst of a building boom as towers grow ever taller. Skyscrapers are topping one another in rapid succession: the Woolworth Building was surpassed by the Chrysler Building, which will soon be eclipsed by the Empire State Building.
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Deal 3 damage to a non-[[Ancient One]] enemy at a [[New York City]] location in any group. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 在紐約城熙熙攘攘的街道下方深處，有一處破舊的地方供奉著外神艾澤爾-贊-雷茲爾。狂熱的教眾戴著附魔頭骨，心中只有一個信念：同化是永恆的唯一之道。
all_card.name: 火坑
all_card.text: [free]抽取遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌：在紅色密謀上放置1個界護標記。(團隊每輪限制一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Deep beneath the bustling streets of New York City lies a decrepit place of worship for the Outer God Ezel-zen-rezl. The fanatical cultists wear enchanted skulls and have but one belief: the only path to eternity is through assimilation.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Draw the top card of the encounter deck: Place 1 ward on the red agenda. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 這套豪華的頂層住宅配備了最先進的設備，而且景觀優美，能夠將紐約城的天際線盡收眼底。
all_card.name: 頂層公寓
all_card.text: [action]：檢定[combat](4)。如果你成功，從供應堆獲得1個線索。
all_card.real_back_flavor: This luxurious top-floor residence is furnished with state-of-the-art amenities and has an exquisite view of the New York City skyline.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [combat] (4). If you succeed, gain 1 clue (from the token pool).

all_card.back_flavor: 巨大的宇宙隧道網，這裡扭曲的引力形成了超乎現實的星網次元。
all_card.back_text: 只要次元樞紐周圍有6[per_investigator]或更多線索，你的團隊"封印了次元樞紐"。
all_card.name: 次元樞紐
all_card.text:
次元樞紐不能被附屬。
次元樞紐與每個[[儀式地]]連接，反之亦然。
[action]：檢定[willpower](2)或[intellect](2)。如果你成功，花費3個線索或者移除次元樞紐周圍2個線索，以對一個[[古神]]敵人造成2點傷害(如果你成功並超過難度至少3點，改為造成3點傷害)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A vast network of cosmic tunnels where gravity is warped in a surreal web of astral dimensions.
all_card.real_back_text: While there are 6 [per_investigator] or more clues around Hub Dimension, your group has "sealed off the Hub Dimension."
all_card.real_text:
Hub Dimension cannot have attachments.
Hub Dimension is connected to each [[Ritual Site]], and vice versa.
[action]: Test [willpower] (2) or [intellect] (2). If you succeed, spend 3 clues or remove 2 clues from around Hub Dimension to deal 2 damage to an [[Ancient One]] enemy (if you succeed by 3 or more, instead deal 3 damage).

all_card.flavor: "迅速且無痛的了斷是一種仁慈。"
all_card.name: 虛無主義占星師
all_card.text: 冷漠。交兵。 生成 - 空天圖書館。 強制 - 當一輪結束時，如果場上沒有綠色敵人也沒有紅色敵人：在藍色密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。
all_card.real_flavor: "A swift and painless end is a mercy."
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Warring. Spawn - Athenaeum of the Empty Sky. Forced - At the end of the round, if no green or red enemies are in play: Place 1 doom on the blue agenda.

all_card.name: 死亡凋零
all_card.text: 顯現 - 你必須決定(以下一項)： - 在藍色密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。 - 你和你控制的每張支援受到1點直接傷害。 - 選擇你控制的1個[[道具]]支援，將其移出遊戲。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the blue agenda. - You and each asset you control take 1 direct damage. - Choose an [[Item]] asset you control and remove it from the game.

all_card.flavor: "我們將迎來嶄新的樂園！"
all_card.name: 樂園狂信徒
all_card.text: 冷漠。交兵。 生成 - 梅根-阿卡特聖地。 強制 - 當一輪結束時，如果場上沒有藍色敵人也沒有紅色敵人：在綠色密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。
all_card.real_flavor: "We shall usher in a new paradise!"
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Warring. Spawn - Shrine of Magh'an Ark'at. Forced - At the end of the round, if no blue or red enemies are in play: Place 1 doom on the green agenda.

all_card.name: 掠食者的呼喚
all_card.text: 顯現 - 將掠食者的呼喚疊加到最近的綠色敵人。如果該敵人是[[突變]]敵人，在其上放置1個資源，作為一個突變標記。如果場上沒有綠色敵人，掠食者的呼喚獲得湧動。 被疊加的敵人+1攻擊、+1躲避、+1傷害並+1恐懼。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Predator's Call to the nearest green enemy. If that enemy is [[Mutated]], place 1 resource on it, as a mutation. If no green enemies are in play, Predator's Call gains surge. Attached enemy gets +1 fight, +1 evade, +1 damage, and +1 horror.

all_card.flavor: "同化是唯一之道！"
all_card.name: 蟲群信徒
all_card.text: 冷漠。交兵。 生成 - 火坑。 強制 - 當一輪結束時，如果場上沒有藍色敵人也沒有綠色敵人：在紅色密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。
all_card.real_flavor: "Assimilation is the only way."
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Warring. Spawn - The Burning Pit. Forced - At the end of the round, if no blue or green enemies are in play: Place 1 doom on the red agenda.

all_card.name: 蝗蟲大餐
all_card.text: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](2)。場上每有1張蜂擁卡牌，本次檢定難度提升1點。如果你失敗，受到2點恐懼(如果你失敗且低於難度至少4點，改為受到3點恐懼)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 1 for each swarm card in play. If you fail, take 2 horror (if you fail by 4 or more, instead take 3 horror).

all_card.name: 地獄之火
all_card.text: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](4)。如果你失敗，受到2點傷害或在你所在地點上放置你的2個線索(如果你失敗且擁有至少4個線索，改為執行上述2項)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, either take 2 damage or place 2 of your clues on your location (if you fail and have 4 or more clues, do both instead).

all_card.name: 戰後殘跡
all_card.text: 顯現 - 每個非[[精英]]敵人移動並攻擊，如同在敵軍階段。敵人以此方式攻擊後不被消耗。如果本效果未導致攻擊，戰後殘跡獲得湧動。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Each non-[[Elite]] enemy moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase. Enemies do not exhaust after attacking in this way. If no attacks were made as a result of this effect, Ravages of War gains surge.

all_card.name: 熟睡之時
all_card.text: 顯現 - 每個擁有最多敵人在場的陣營，在其密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。如果場上沒有敵人，不放置毀滅標記，熟睡之時獲得湧動。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - For each faction that has the most enemies in play, place 1 doom on that faction's agenda. If no enemies are in play, place no doom and While They Sleep gains surge.

all_card.back_flavor: 溫度不斷下降，直到熱度一絲一毫都不剩。絕對的黑暗取代了一切光亮。萌動的生命被無盡的空虛所抹消。你的意識被徹底地湮沒。
all_card.name: 西勒諾斯降臨
all_card.text: 每個藍色敵人失去冷漠、失去交兵，獲得獵手。 目標 - 如果西勒諾斯被擊敗，(→結局3)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The temperature plunges until there is no heat left. Absolute darkness displaces all light. Budding life is expunged by the endless void. Your consciousness fades into utter oblivion.
all_card.real_text: Each blue enemy loses aloof, loses warring, and gains hunter. Objective - If Silenus is defeated, (→R3).

all_card.name: 西勒諾斯
all_card.text: *西勒諾斯的總生命值為8[per_investigator]。 獵手。龐大。 強制 - 在神話階段結束時：位於西勒諾斯所在地點的每位調查員必須決定(以下一項)： - 在藍色密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。 - 將你的所有手牌移出遊戲。 - 受到3點恐懼。
all_card.real_text: *Silenus has a global health pool of 8[per_investigator]. Hunter. Massive. Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Each investigator at Silenus's location must decide (choose one) - - Place 1 doom on the blue agenda. - Remove each card in your hand from the game. - Take 3 horror.

all_card.name: 難逃巨腭
all_card.text:
獵手。
每當調查員在藍色遭遇卡的能力作用下"決定"，該調查員不選擇1項，而是改為選擇2項。
all_card.traits: 類人. 僕從. 精英
all_card.real_text:
Hunter.
Anytime an investigator is forced to "decide" by an ability on a blue encounter card, they must choose two options instead of one.

all_card.name: 胡吝紉合兆使
all_card.text: 交兵。 強制 - 在胡吝紉合兆使與你交戰後：你必須決定(以下一項)： - 在藍色密謀上放置放置1個毀滅標記。 - 從次元樞紐周圍移除2個線索。 - 胡吝紉合兆使攻擊你。
all_card.real_text: Warring. Forced - After Hune-Stitched Herald engages you: You must decide (choose one) - - Place 1 doom on the blue agenda. - Remove 2 clues from around Hub Dimension. - Hune-Stitched Herald attacks you.

Warring. Spawn - Athenaeum of the Empty Sky. Forced - After Ethereal Entity engages you: You must decide (choose one) - - Place 1 doom on the blue agenda. - Place 1 of your clues on your location. - Take 2 horror.
all_card.name: 缥缈存在
all_card.text: 交兵。 生成 - 空天图书馆。 强制 - 缥缈存在与你交战后：你必须决定(选择一项)： - 在蓝色密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。 - 将你的1个线索放在你所在地点。 - 受到2点恐惧。

all_card.name: 縹緲存在
all_card.text: 交兵。 生成 - 空天圖書館。 強制 - 在縹緲存在與你交戰後：你必須決定(以下一項)： - 在藍色密謀上放置放置1個毀滅標記。 - 在你所在地點上放置你的1個線索。 - 受到2點恐懼。
all_card.real_text: Warring. Spawn - Athenaeum of the Empty Sky. Forced - After Ethereal Entity engages you: You must decide (choose one) - - Place 1 doom on the blue agenda. - Place 1 of your clues on your location. - Take 2 horror.

all_card.name: 宿命終結
all_card.text: 顯現 - 你必須決定(以下一項)： - 在藍色密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。 - 選擇並將你的3張手牌移出遊戲。 - 將你牌堆頂的6張卡牌移出遊戲。將以此方式移除的每個弱點洗入你的牌堆。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the blue agenda. - Choose 3 cards in your hand and remove them from the game. - Remove the top 6 cards of your deck from the game. Shuffle each weakness removed this way into your deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 隨著時間推移，那個生物飛速壯大。它的鱗片能夠反彈子彈和法術。你唯一的希望就是在它的幼年期將它摧毀。在它的命令之下，你周圍亂象橫生。如今你在它面前不過是隻蟲子。
all_card.name: 孵化
all_card.text: 每個綠色敵人失去冷漠、失去交兵，獲得獵手。 目標 - 如果梅根-阿卡特被擊敗，(→結局4)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: With each minute that passes, the creature grows larger and larger. Its scales deflect bullet and spell alike. Your only hope was to destroy it while it was still an infant. Chaos erupts around you as it charges. You are nothing but an insect now.
all_card.real_text: Each green enemy loses aloof, loses warring, and gains hunter. Objective - If Magh'an Ark'at is defeated, (→R4).

all_card.name: 梅根-阿卡特
all_card.text: *梅根-阿卡特的總生命值為8[per_investigator]。 獵手。龐大。反擊。 強制 - 在神話階段結束時：在梅根-阿卡特所在地點的每個[[突變]]敵人上放置1個資源，作為1個突變標記。梅根-阿卡特上每有1個突變標記，對該地點的每個調查員造成1點傷害。
all_card.traits: 古神. 突變. 精英
all_card.real_text: *Magh'an Ark'at has a global health pool of 8[per_investigator]. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Place 1 resource on each [[Mutated]] enemy at Magh'an Ark'at's location, as a mutation. Deal 1 damage to each investigator at this location for each mutation on Magh'an Ark'at.

all_card.name: 卑鄙護卵者
all_card.text: 獵手。反擊。 卑鄙護卵者每有1個突變標記，獲得+1生命值。 強制 - 在至少1個突變標記將要放到一個敵人上時：在該敵人上放置1個額外的突變標記。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 僕從. 突變. 精英
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Vile Broodmaster gets +1 health for each mutation on it. Forced - When 1 or more mutations would be placed on an enemy: Place 1 additional mutation on that enemy.

all_card.name: 可怕的修格斯
all_card.text: 反擊。交兵。 可怕的修格斯每有1個突變標記，獲得+1傷害。 強制 - 在可怕的修格斯攻擊時：在其上面放置1個資源，作為一個突變標記。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 修格斯. 突變
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. Warring. Horrific Shoggoth gets +1 damage for each mutation on it. Forced - When Horrific Shoggoth attacks: Place 1 resource on it, as a mutation.

Aloof. Retaliate. Warring. Spawn - Shrine of Magh'an Ark'at. Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 resource on Bringer of Paradise, as a mutation. Then, if there are 3 or more mutations on it, remove 2 of them and place 2 doom on the green agenda.
all_card.name: 乐园使者
all_card.text: 冷漠。反击。交兵。 生成 - 梅根-阿卡特圣地。 强制 - 一轮结束时：在乐园使者上放置1个资源，作为突变。然后，如果其上有3个或更多突变，移除其中2个，并在绿色密谋上放置2个毁灭标记。

all_card.name: 樂園引領者
all_card.text: 冷漠。反擊。交兵。 生成 - 梅根-阿卡特聖地。 強制 - 當本輪結束時：在樂園引領者上放置1個資源，作為一個突變標記。然後，如果此處有至少3個突變標記，移除其中2個並且在綠色密謀上放置2個毀滅標記。
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Retaliate. Warring. Spawn - Shrine of Magh'an Ark'at. Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 resource on Bringer of Paradise, as a mutation. Then, if there are 3 or more mutations on it, remove 2 of them and place 2 doom on the green agenda.

all_card.name: 窮追猛打
all_card.text: 顯現 - 在攻擊值最高的[[突變]]敵人上放置1個資源，作為一個突變標記。該敵人準備並移動(每次移動1個地點)，直到其到達你所在地點並與你交戰。然後，它攻擊你。如果場上沒有[[突變]]敵人，窮追猛打獲得湧動。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Place 1 resource on the [[Mutated]] enemy with the highest fight, as a mutation. That enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, and engages you. Then, it attacks you. If no [[Mutated]] enemies are in play, Hunt Down gains surge.

all_card.back_flavor: 數不盡的敵軍全都傾洩到地球上來，勢不可擋地淹沒你四周，你在恐懼和痛苦之中大聲呼喊。你感到脆弱、無助、絕望。你一點一點地被吞噬，然而意識卻依然存在。
all_card.name: 艾澤爾-贊-雷茲爾出現
all_card.text: 每個紅色敵人失去冷漠、失去交兵，獲得獵手。 目標 - 如果艾澤爾-贊-雷茲爾被擊敗，(→結局2)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The full magnitude of the boundless horde is unleashed upon Earth. You shout in horror and agony as the overwhelming swarm surrounds you. Vulnerable, helpless, and hopeless. Bit by bit, you are devoured, and yet, your consciousness remains.
all_card.real_text: Each red enemy loses aloof, loses warring, and gains hunter. Objective - If Ezel-zen-rezl is defeated, (→R2).

all_card.name: 艾澤爾-贊-雷茲爾
all_card.text: *艾澤爾-贊-雷茲爾的總生命值為7[per_investigator]。 獵手。龐大。 強制 - 在神話階段結束時：艾澤爾-贊-雷茲爾所在地點的每位調查員選擇自己的1張手牌和自己控制的1張支援卡，將其正面朝下放到一張[[昆蟲]]敵人底下，作為蜂擁卡牌。
all_card.real_text: *Ezel-zen-rezl has a global health pool of 7 [per_investigator]. Hunter. Massive. Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Each investigator at Ezel-zen-rezl's location chooses both a card from their hand and an asset they control and places them facedown underneath an [[Insect]] enemy as swarm cards.

all_card.name: 嗡鳴蟲群
all_card.text: 獵手。蜂擁6。 強制 - 在嗡鳴蟲群入場後：每位調查員選擇自己的1張手牌，將其正面朝下放到一張[[昆蟲]]敵人底下，作為蜂擁卡牌。 強制 - 在嗡鳴蟲群攻擊時：其不造成傷害和恐懼，而是改為造成其中一項。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 昆蟲. 僕從. 精英
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Swarming 6. Forced - After Droning Horde enters play: Each investigator chooses a card from their hand and places it facedown underneath an [[Insect]] enemy as a swarm card. Forced - When Droning Horde attacks: It deals either its damage or its horror, instead of both.

all_card.real_flavor: The irritating, incessant buzzing of the swarm can be heard from miles away.
all_card.real_text: Swarming 2. Warring. Spawn - Burning Pit. Forced - When Trylogog attacks: It deals either its damage or its horror, instead of both.
all_card.name: 三重蝗
all_card.text: 蜂拥2。交兵。 生成 - 火坑。 强制 - 三重蝗攻击时：其改为造成伤害或恐惧中的一项，而非两项。

all_card.flavor: 數英里外都能聽見蟲群不停歇的惱人嗡嗡聲。
all_card.name: 三重蝗
all_card.text: 蜂擁2。交兵。 生成 - 火坑。 強制 - 在三重蝗攻擊時：其不造成傷害和恐懼，而是改為造成其中一項。
all_card.real_flavor: The irritating, incessant buzzing of the swarm can be heard from miles away.
all_card.real_text: Swarming 2. Warring. Spawn - Burning Pit. Forced - When Trylogog attacks: It deals either its damage or its horror, instead of both.

all_card.name: 原形驚變
all_card.text: 顯現 - 將你控制的1張支援卡正面朝下放到一個[[昆蟲]]敵人底下，作為一張蜂擁卡牌。如果場上沒有[[昆蟲]]敵人，查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出並生成1張三重蝗。混洗遭遇牌堆。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Place an asset you control facedown underneath an [[Insect]] enemy as a swarm card. If no [[Insect]] is in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Trylogog and spawn it. Shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 外域披風
all_card.text:
使用(4充能)。
[reaction]在一個非[[精英]]敵人將要與你交戰時，花費1充能：改為消耗該敵人。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遺物. 服裝
all_card.real_text:
Uses (4 charges).
[reaction] When a non-[[Elite]] enemy would engage you, spend 1 charge: Exhaust that enemy instead.

all_card.name: 口袋次元门
all_card.text: 快速。 強制 - 在口袋次元門入場後：把你的調查員迷你卡放在口袋次元門上，然後立即結束你的回合。只要你的調查員迷你卡在口袋次元門上，你不位於任何地點，並且敵人生成時不能與你交戰。當你的回合開始時，丟棄口袋次元門並移動到任意一個已揭示的地點。
all_card.real_text: Fast. Forced - After Pocket Portal enters play: Place your investigator mini-card onto Pocket Portal and immediately end your turn. While your mini-card is on Pocket Portal, you are not at any location and enemies cannot spawn engaged with you. At the start of your turn, discard Pocket Portal and move to any revealed location.

all_card.name: 恐怖终结
all_card.text:
使用(3充能)。
[action]花費1充能：選擇以下一項：
- 將你所在地點的1個非[[精英]]敵人放到遭遇牌堆頂上。
- 查看遭遇牌堆頂的5張卡牌。丟棄其中2張，然後將其餘以任意順序放回該牌堆頂上。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Choose one -
- Place a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location on top of the encounter deck.
- Look at the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. Discard 2 of them and return the rest to the top, in any order.

all_card.name: 阿卡特之剑
all_card.text: [free]消耗阿卡特之劍並花費1個資源：在阿卡特之劍上放置1個資源(從供應堆)。 [action]：攻擊。阿卡特之劍上每有1個資源，這次攻擊你+1[combat]。如果你成功，移除阿卡特之劍上的最多3個資源，以對受到攻擊的敵人額外造成對應數量的傷害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遺物. 武器. 近戰
all_card.real_text: [fast] Exhaust Blade of Ark'at and spend 1 resource: Place 1 resource on Blade of Ark'at (from the token pool). [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for each resource on Blade of Ark'at. If you succeed, remove up to 3 resources from Blade of Ark'at to deal that much additional damage to the attacked enemy.

all_card.name: 附魔頭骨
all_card.text:
[free]消耗附魔頭骨：將你牌堆頂上的一張卡牌正面朝下放到附魔頭骨底下。
[free]：附魔頭骨底下每有1張卡牌，這次技能檢定你+1技能值。然後隨機丟棄附魔頭骨底下的1張卡牌。(每回合限制一次。)
all_card.real_text:
[fast] Exhaust Enchanted Skull: Place the top card of your deck facedown underneath Enchanted Skull.
[fast]: You get +1 to this skill test for each card underneath Enchanted Skull. Then discard 1 card from underneath Enchanted Skull, at random. (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.name: 子弹带
all_card.text:
你拥有额外2个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[武器]]支援。
如果你的[[武器]]支援总计占用至少2个手部槽位，你得到+1[willpower]。
all_card.real_text:
You have two additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Weapon]] assets.
While you have [[Weapon]] assets held in 2 or more hand slots, you get +1 [willpower].

all_card.name: 金属棍棒
all_card.text: [action]：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]。如果你对与另一位调查员交战的敌人执行本次攻击，且你检定成功，本次攻击造成+1伤害。如果你检定失败，则你不造成伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 近战
all_card.real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you perform this attack against an enemy engaged with another investigator, you deal +1 damage for this attack if you succeed, and no damage if you fail.

all_card.name: 荒唐的素描像
all_card.text:
你的地点有线索才能打出。
抽取3张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Draw 3 cards.

all_card.name: 奇怪的溶液
all_card.text:
研究完成。使用(3补给)。
[action]花费1补给并横置奇怪的溶液：选择你所在地点的一位调查员获得2资源并抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
Researched. Uses (3 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Strange Solution: Choose an investigator at your location to gain 2 resources and draw 1 card.

all_card.flavor: 这可能并不合法，但却能办成事。
all_card.name: 走私品
all_card.text:
选择你所在地点一位调查员控制的一个支援并选择一项：
- 在该支援上放置2子弹或补给并抽取1张卡牌。
- 将该支援上的子弹或补给标记数量翻倍。
all_card.real_flavor: It may not be legal, but it gets the job done
all_card.real_text:
Choose an asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Either (choose one):
- Place 2 ammo or supply tokens on that asset and draw 1 card.
- Double the number of ammo or supply tokens on that asset.

all_card.name: 逃跑本能
all_card.text:
快速。在一个敌人将要进入你的地点时打出。
立刻移动到一个连接地点。(该敌人依然进入你先前地点。)
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy enters your location.
Immediately move to a connecting location. (The enemy still enters your previous location.)

all_card.name: 礼寻术
all_card.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次检定得到+2[willpower]。如果检定成功，你发现所在地点额外1个线索。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，本次检定结算后，失去所有剩余的行动，立即结束你的回合。
all_card.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. You get +2 [willpower] for this test. If you succeed you discover 1 additional clue at this location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, after this test resolves lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.

all_card.flavor:
虚幻带来现实
黑暗带来光明
死亡带来永恒
all_card.name: 净心术
all_card.text:
使用(4充能)。
[action]花费1充能：治愈你所在地点的调查员总计2点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor:
From the unreal lead me to the real
From the darkness lead me to the light
From the dead lead me to the immortal
all_card.real_text:
Uses (4 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Heal 2 horror from among investigators at your location.

all_card.name: 哎呀！
all_card.text:
快速。在你攻击一个敌人时技能检定失败，并且低于难度3点及以内后打出。
对你所在地点的任意一个敌人造成本次攻击的伤害。如果你对与另一位调查员交战的敌人执行本次攻击，本次攻击不对该调查员造成伤害。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 3 or less while attacking an enemy.
Deal this attack's damage to any enemy at your location. If the attacked enemy is engaged with another investigator, this attack deals no damage to that investigator.

all_card.name: 随机应变
all_card.text:
只能投入你正在执行，且难度高于你基础技能值的技能检定。
随机应变得到+X[wild]。X为本次检定难度和你基础技能值的差值(最多+3[wild])。
all_card.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing, and only if the difficulty of that test is higher than your base skill value.
Rise to the Occasion gets +X [wild] icons, where X is the difference between your base skill and this test's difficulty (to a maximum of +3 [wild] icons).

all_card.name: 穿越门扉
all_card.text: 显现 - 抽取你牌库顶的牌。如果该卡牌不是弱点，将其从游戏中移除。然后，查找你的牌库、弃牌堆、手牌和所有游戏区域，找到所有你拥有的同名卡牌，将这些卡牌也从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Draw the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, remove that card from the game. Then, search your deck, discard pile, hand, and all play areas for each other copy of that card you own, and remove them from the game, as well.

all_card.back_text: - 在奥恩图书馆和沃伦天文台之间随机选择1张。将所选地点与其余起始地点一同放置入场。将其他地点从游戏中移除。 - 如果你已经完成重返百赌百胜，从找出的遭遇组中找出1张被奴役的保安，将其生成在管理大楼。
all_card.name: 重返课外活动
all_card.text: 遵循敦威治遗产的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返课外活动找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text: - Randomly choose between Orne Library and Warren Observatory. Put the chosen location into play, along with the rest of the starting locations. Remove the other location from the game. - If you have completed Return to The House Always Wins, search the encounter sets for 1 copy of Enthralled Security Guard, and spawn it at the Administration Building.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Dunwich Legacy Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Extracurricular Activities shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: 杰拉尔德·沃伦天文台是米斯卡塔尼克大学校园里新建的建筑，坐落在克兰山顶上，俯瞰整个阿卡姆城。天文台采用的是最进流行的新艺术风格，与校园里的其它建筑截然不同。
all_card.flavor: 你步行穿过天文台崭新的走廊时，心中好奇地想着，不知道这里顶尖的天文仪器能否解答有关宇宙的问题，还是说只会带来更多疑问。
all_card.name: 沃伦天文台
all_card.text: 强制 - 你在沃伦天文台发现至少1个线索后：每发现1个线索，弃掉你牌库顶3张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The latest addition to the Miskatonic University campus is the Gerald Warren Astronomical Observatory, which sits high atop Crane Hill and overlooks all of Arkham. Built in the latest Art Nouveau style, the observatory stands out distinctly from the rest of the buildings of the university.
all_card.real_flavor: As you traverse the observatory's new halls, you wonder whether its state-of-the-art astronomical equipment will offer answers about the universe or will only raise more questions.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at Warren Observatory: Discard 3 cards from the top of your deck for each clue just discovered.

all_card.name: 被奴役的保安
all_card.text: 猎手。反击。 强制 - 被奴役的保安攻击你后：弃掉你牌库顶2张卡牌。 强制 - 被奴役的保安被躲避后：其被击败。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After Enthralled Security Guard attacks you: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck. Forced - After Enthralled Security Guard is evaded: It is defeated.

all_card.back_text:
- 将俱乐部舞台放在一边，位于场外。
- 随机从2个俱乐部大厅地点中选择1个。将所选地点与其余起始地点一同放置入场。将其他版本的俱乐部大厅地点从游戏中移除。
all_card.name: 重返百赌百胜
all_card.text: 遵循敦威治遗产的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返百赌百胜找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- Set the Clover Club Stage aside, out of play.
- Choose one of the two Clover Club Lounge locations at random. Put the chosen location into play along with the rest of the starting locations. Remove the other version of Clover Club Lounge from the game.
all_card.real_name: Return to The House Always Wins
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Dunwich Legacy Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The House Always Win shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: 舒适的真皮沙发、气派的红木家具与琳琅满目的艺术藏品，这些都在诱惑着那些赌徒们，给他们一个黄梁美梦。
all_card.name: 俱乐部大厅
all_card.text: 强制 - 俱乐部大厅被揭示后：将放在一边的俱乐部舞台放置入场。 当前场景为场景1时，俱乐部大厅获得：“[action]：查看你牌库顶的1张卡牌。如果是[[盟友]]支援，你可以将其放置入场。否则，抽取该卡牌。(每轮仅限一次。)”
all_card.real_back_flavor: Comfortable leather couches, mahogany furniture, and an array of beautiful art greets gamblers, tempting them into the life of the would-be affluent.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Clover Club Lounge is revealed: Put the set-aside Clover Club Stage into play. While it is Act 1, Clover Club Lounge gains: "[action]: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is an [[Ally]] asset, you may put it into play. Otherwise, draw it. (Limit once per round.)"

all_card.back_flavor: 随着你走近俱乐部休息区旁的舞台，台上的伤情女歌手和乐队那醉人旋律愈发清晰。黑帮分子与商务打扮的人在乐声中低声交谈，整夜勾兑着他们的交易，任凭夜色沉浮。
all_card.back_text: 俱乐部舞台与俱乐部酒吧连接。
all_card.name: 俱乐部舞台
all_card.text:
俱乐部舞台与俱乐部酒吧连接。
当前场景为场景1时，俱乐部舞台获得：“[action]花费1资源：将该资源放置在俱乐部舞台上。
[free]如果俱乐部舞台上有1[per_investigator]个资源：从供应堆获得1[per_investigator]个线索。(每场游戏团队仅限一次。)”
all_card.real_back_flavor: The mesmerizing melody of a torch singer and her band grows louder as you approach the stage near the club's lounge. Mobsters and business-types chatter quietly over the music, wheeling and dealing the night away.
all_card.real_back_text: Clover Club Bar is connected to Clover Club Stage.
all_card.real_text:
Clover Club Bar is connected to Clover Club Stage.
While it is Act 1, Clover Club Stage gains: "[action] Spend 1 resource: Place that resource on Clover Club Stage.
[fast] If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on Clover Club Stage: Gain 1 [per_investigator] clues from the token pool. (Group limit once per game.)"

all_card.flavor: “你以为能糊弄得了我们？嗯？”
all_card.name: 骗术穿帮
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 - 每位“作弊”的玩家失去2资源并受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: "Think you can pull one over us, eh?"
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Each player who has "cheated" must lose 2 resources and take 1 damage.

all_card.name: 提高赌注
all_card.text: 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 记住你“作弊”了。 - 失去5资源。 - 将提高赌注放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。其获得：“你所在地点每个[[罪犯]]敌人失去冷漠。如果当前场景为场景2或3，你所在地点每个[[罪犯]]敌人+1攻击并+1躲避。”
all_card.real_text: Revelation - You must (choose one): - Remember that you have "cheated." - Lose 5 resources. - Put Raise the Stakes into play in your threat area. It gains: "Each [[Criminal]] enemy at your location loses aloof. If it is Act 2 or 3, each [[Criminal]] enemy engaged with you gets +1 fight and +1 evade."

all_card.back_text:
- 创建“展厅牌库”前，将2张新版展厅地点加入原版6张展厅地点。将展厅(禁止入内)放在一边，随机将2张展厅地点从游戏中移除。然后，按照常规设置创建展厅牌库。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “调查员结算密谋1b或密谋2b的文本时，密谋牌库下一张密谋卡上的强制能力视为生效。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返博物馆之夜
all_card.text: 遵循敦威治遗产的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返博物馆之夜找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- Before creating the "Exhibit Deck," add the 2 new Exhibit Hall locations to the original 6 Exhibit Hall locations. Set Exhibit Hall (Restricted Hall) aside and randomly remove 2 Exhibit Hall locations from the game. Then, continue creating the Exhibit Deck as normal.
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rule applies: "While an investigator is resolving the text on agenda 1b and agenda 2b, the Forced ability on the next agenda in the agenda deck is considered to be active." Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Dunwich Legacy Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Miskatonic Museum shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor:
这些迷人的展品其实是什么？
它们是否也藏着邪恶的秘密？
all_card.flavor: 长廊两侧盔甲森然林列，墙壁上悬挂着各式兵器与刑具。在此处……你最好当心脚步。
all_card.name: 展厅
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你调查本地点时技能检定失败后：受到1点伤害。
all_card.traits: 米斯卡塔尼克. 展览
all_card.real_back_flavor:
What alluring artifacts are displayed inside?
Do they, too, hold a sinister secret?
all_card.real_flavor: Rows of armor line the hall, while instruments of war and torture hang from the walls. You should watch your step in here…
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating this location: Take 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor:
这些迷人的展品其实是什么？
它们是否也藏着邪恶的秘密？
all_card.name: 展厅
all_card.text: [action][action]：从供应堆获得2个线索。然后，如果追猎恐魔在场，在暗影之子上放置1资源。否则，查找遭遇牌库、弃牌堆和混沌，找出追猎恐魔并将其生成在博物馆大厅。混洗遭遇牌库。
all_card.traits: 米斯卡塔尼克. 展览
all_card.real_back_flavor:
What alluring artifacts are displayed inside?
Do they, too, hold a sinister secret?
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Gain 2 clues (from the token bank). Then, if Hunting Horror is in play, place 1 resource on Shadow-spawned. Otherwise, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and the void for Hunting Horror and spawn it in the Museum Halls. Shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 黑暗指令
all_card.text: 显现 - 将黑暗指令附属到追猎恐魔，即使其不在场上。如果追猎恐魔进入混沌，黑暗指令依然保留附属。 强制 - 在追猎恐魔攻击调查员时：该调查员必须受到额外1点伤害和额外1点恐惧。治愈追猎恐魔2点伤害。弃掉黑暗指令。(每次攻击最多一次。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Dark Bidding to Hunting Horror, even if it is out of play. Dark Bidding remains attached to Hunting Horror if it enters the void. Forced - When Hunting Horror attacks an investigator: That investigator must take 1 additional damage and 1 additional horror. Heal 2 damage from Hunting Horror. Discard Dark Bidding. (Max once per attack.)

all_card.flavor: 下方一片漆黑，足以遮天蔽日的振翅军团，乘着呼啸的狂风向北席卷而去，虚空中回荡着不见来源的狞笑……<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 混沌夜色
all_card.text: 显现 - 在暗影之子上放置1个资源，即使其不在场上。
all_card.real_flavor: All was blackness beneath as the fluttering legions surged northward amidst rushing winds and invisible laughter in the aether… - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Place 1 resource on Shadow-spawned, even if it is out of play.

all_card.back_text:
- 将密谋1a——“现实的裂口”从游戏中移除，用新的密谋0a——“烟雾缭绕”和新的密谋1a——“现实的裂口(版本二)”替换。(在创建密谋牌库时，应将密谋0a放在牌库顶上)。
- 在随机选择6张车厢地点放置入场时，将本扩展的2张新版车厢地点也加入该遭遇组，改为从10张卡牌中随机选择6张。
- 在随机选择1张车头地点放置入场时，将本扩展的1张新版车头地点也加入该遭遇组，改为从4张卡牌中随机选择1张。
- 将火车机修工剧情支援放在一边，位于场外。
all_card.name: 重返疯狂列车
all_card.text: 遵循敦威治遗产的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返疯狂列车找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- Remove Agenda 1a - "A Tear in Reality," from the game and replace it with the new Agenda 0a - "Where There's Smoke" and the new agenda 1a - "A Tear in Reality (v.II)." (When you construct the agenda deck, agenda 0a should be on top.)
- When choosing 6 Train Car locations to put into play at random, include the 2 new Train Car locations in this encounter set, for a total of 10 possible cards.
- When choosing an Engine Car location to put into play at random, include the new Engine Car location in this encounter set, for a total of 4 possible cards.
Set the Engineer story asset aside, out of play.
all_card.real_name: Return to The Essex County Express
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Dunwich Legacy Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Essex County Express shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.flavor: 伴随着刺耳的噪音，前往敦威治的列车突然停了下来。你看向窗外，发现天空中有一个巨大的裂口，就好像一块布被撕了个口子。裂口中，一头带翼的凶兽挣脱而出，发出凄厉的尖啸，直扑列车而来。
all_card.name: 烟雾缭绕
all_card.real_flavor: As the train to Dunwich comes to a jarring stop, you look out the window behind you and see an immense tear in the sky, like a rip in a piece of cloth. From this tear, a winged beast emerges. It lets out a painful screech and descends upon the train.

all_card.name: 列车主宰
all_card.text: 生成 - 最左边的地点。 猎手。庞大。 强制 - 在列车主宰被击败时：将其附属到当前密谋。在你推进被附属的密谋后，抽取列车主宰。 强制 - 在列车主宰所在地点离场时：不弃掉列车主宰，改为将其向右移动一个地点。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Leftmost location. Hunter. Massive. Forced - When The Conductor is defeated: Attach it to the current agenda. After you advance the attached agenda, draw The Conductor. Forced - When The Conductor's location leaves play: Instead of discarding The Conductor, move it one location to the right.

all_card.back_flavor: 最后一节车厢扭离了车身。你惊恐地发现车厢脱离铁轨，被上方的大门吞没。
all_card.back_text: 将最左边的地点从游戏中移除(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其放入胜利区)。该地点的每位调查员被击败。弃掉该地点的所有敌人和支援。 弃掉调查员控制的所有线索。
all_card.flavor: 随着那头凶兽的出现，裂口的吸力渐渐增大。怪力拉扯着列车最后几节车厢，扯落的时候发出的声响叫人胆战心惊。车厢向上飞入空中的裂口。附近的乘客惊慌失措，还有人躲在位置上瑟瑟发抖，更有一位长者吓得昏了过去。
all_card.name: 现实的裂口(版本二)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The rearmost car of the train detaches as it is pulled backward. To your horror, it rises off the tracks and is consumed by the gate above you.
all_card.real_back_text:
Remove the leftmost location from the game (or place it in the victory display if it has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at that location is defeated. Each enemy and asset at that location is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.
all_card.real_flavor: The force of the gate grows with the presence of the winged beast. Several of the rearmost train cars are pulled backward, and there is a dreadful metallic crunch as they are detached. The train cars topple upward and into the rift in the sky. Nearby passengers are panicking, others are cowering in their seats, and one elderly man has fainted in fear.

all_card.back_text:
车头与其左边的地点连接。
你不能进入车头，除非其左边地点的所有线索都已发现。
all_card.name: 车头
all_card.text: 车头与其左边的地点连接。 车头不能被调查。 强制 - 你揭示车头后：将放在一边的火车机修工放置入场，放到车头。
all_card.real_back_text:
Engine Car is connected to the location to the left of it.
You cannot enter Engine Car unless all of the clues on the location to its left have been discovered.
all_card.real_text: Engine Car is connected to the location to the left of it. Engine Car cannot be investigated. Forced - After you reveal Engine Car: Put the set-aside Engineer into play at the Engine Car.

all_card.back_text:
车厢与其左边和右边的地点连接。
你不能进入车厢，除非其左边地点的所有线索都已发现。
all_card.name: 货车
all_card.text: 货车与其左边和右边的地点连接。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：位于货车的每位调查员必须检定[agility](1)。检定失败的每位调查员必须再次检定[agility](1)。第二次检定失败的调查员被吸入空中旋涡，其被击败。
all_card.real_back_text:
Train Car is connected to the locations to the left and right of it.
You cannot enter Train Car unless all of the clues on the location to its left have been discovered.
all_card.real_text: Freight Car is connected to the locations to the left and right of it. Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator on the Freight Car must test [agility] (1). Each investigator who fails must test [agility] (1) again. Each investigator who fails this second test is pulled into the vortex above and is defeated.

all_card.back_text:
车厢与其左边和右边的地点连接。
你不能进入车厢，除非其左边地点的所有线索都已发现。
all_card.name: 行李车厢
all_card.text:
行李车厢与其左边和右边的地点连接。
行李车厢不能被调查。
[action]选择1张手牌弃掉：发现行李车厢的1个线索。
all_card.real_back_text:
Train Car is connected to the locations to the left and right of it.
You cannot enter Train Car unless all of the clues on the location to its left have been discovered.
all_card.real_text:
Baggage Car is connected to the locations to the left and right of it.
Baggage Car cannot be investigated.
[action] Choose and discard a card from your hand: Discover 1 clue in the Baggage Car.

all_card.name: 火车机修工
all_card.text: [action]如果火车机修工为重整状态：谈判。检定[willpower]或[intellect](4)。如果你检定成功，控制火车机修工。如果你已经控制火车机修工，改为发现你所在地点的1个线索。位于火车机修工所在地点的每位调查员都可以执行本行动。 强制 - 在火车机修工将要被弃掉时：改为治愈其所有伤害和恐惧，失去对其的控制并将其横置。
all_card.real_text: [action] If Engineer is ready: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, take control of Engineer. If you already control Engineer, discover 1 clue from your location instead. Any investigator at Engineer's location may trigger this action. Forced - When Engineer would be discarded: Instead, heal all damage and horror from it, lose control of it, and exhaust it.

all_card.back_text: - 将新的地点加入血色祭坛遭遇组原版的地点中。每种地点从3张中随机选择2张，将这些地点从游戏中移除。然后，随机从剩余的6张地点中选择1张，将其从游戏中移除。将剩余地点放置入场。 - 在将遭遇卡牌放置在地点底下时，不要包含内奥米的打手遭遇组中的6张卡牌。 - 检查剧本日志。如果调查员和欧巴尼恩帮有隙：将放在一边的1张受雇枪手生成在没有连接到公共空地的地点。将放在一边的其余受雇枪手洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.name: 重返血色祭坛
all_card.text: 遵循敦威治遗产的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返血色祭坛找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将所有受雇枪手放在一边，位于场外。 - 将原版的公共空地地点从游戏中移除，用新版的公共空地(腐朽沉默)地点替换。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text: - Add the new locations to the original locations from the Blood on the Altar encounter set. Remove 1 of the 3 copies of each of these locations from the game at random. Then, choose 1 of the 6 remaining locations at random and remove it from the game as well. Put the remaining locations into play. - When placing encounter cards underneath locations, do not include the 6 cards from the Naomi's Crew encounter set. - Check Campaign Log. If the O'Bannion gang has a bone to pick with the investigators: Spawn one set-aside Hired Gun at one of the locations not connected to Village Commons. Shuffle the other set-aside Hired Gun into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_name: Return to Blood on the Altar
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Dunwich Legacy Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Blood on the Altar shown here. - Set each copy of Hired Gun aside, out of play. - Remove the original Village Commons location from the game and replace it with the new Village Commons (Silent Decay). (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: ……大块的霉菌和数个世纪的腐败，让人很难忽略村里街上依稀的有害臭气。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 公共空地
all_card.text: 在公共空地的调查员不能执行抽取和资源行动。 [action]：撤退。“这简直是自杀！我们晚上最好还是找个地方躲起来。”
all_card.real_back_flavor:
…it is hard to prevent the impression of a faint, malign odour about the village street, as of the massed mould and decay of centuries.
-H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text: Each investigator at Village Commons cannot take draw or resource actions. [action]: Resign. "This is suicide! We're better off hiding out the night."

all_card.back_flavor: 行人并不敢穿过桥上的阴暗走道，可是除此之外别无他法。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 毕晓普河
all_card.text: 强制 - 你揭示毕晓普河后：检定[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。 [free] 如果此处没有线索：抽取毕晓普河底下的遭遇卡牌。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor:
One dreads to trust the tenebrous tunnel of the bridge, yet there is no way to avoid it.
-H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Bishop's Brook: Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 2 damage. [fast] If there are no clues here: Draw the encounter card underneath Bishop's Brook. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 凑近之后，看到大部分房屋已经废弃，坍圮成墟，实在叫人心神难安……<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 火灾废墟
all_card.text: 强制 - 在调查火灾废墟技能检定成功后：受到1点伤害。 [free] 如果此处没有线索：抽取火灾废墟底下的遭遇卡牌。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor:
It is not reassuring to see, on a closer glance, that most of the houses are deserted and falling to ruin…
-H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you successfully investigate Burned Ruins: Take 1 damage. [fast] If there are no clues here: Draw the encounter card underneath Burned Ruins. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 奥斯本杂货店里一片沉默，弥漫着恐惧的气息，他们立刻意识到某些可怕的事情已经发生了……<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 奥斯本杂货店
all_card.text: 强制 - 你揭示奥斯本杂货店后：获得2资源。 [free] 如果此处没有线索：抽取奥斯本杂货店底下的遭遇卡牌。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor:
From the air of hushed fright at Osborn’s store they knew something hideous had happened…
-H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Osborn's General Store: Gain 2 resources. [fast] If there are no clues here: Draw the encounter card underneath Osborn's General Store. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: “不到两周前，咱就在自家房子后面的山丘中清楚地听到邪恶力量的对话，回响着咯咯声、滚动声、呻吟声、尖啸声以及嘶嘶声，肯定不是这个世界能长出来的东西……”<cite>H.P. 洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 自治教堂
all_card.text: 强制 - 你揭示自治教堂后：查找遭遇牌库和弃牌堆，找出一张绑架！诡计并将其抽取。混洗遭遇牌库。 [free]如果此处没有线索：抽取自治教堂底下的遭遇卡牌。(团队每场游戏仅限一次)
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"I my self did not more than a Fortnight ago catch a very plain Discourse of evill Powers in the Hill behind my House; wherein there were a Rattling and Rolling, Groaning, Screeching, and Hissing, such as no Things of this Earth cou’d raise up…"
-H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Congregational Church: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Kidnapped! and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck. [fast] If there are no clues here: Draw the encounter card underneath Congregational Church. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 即便是当地人都会避开这座半淹的小屋。
all_card.name: 芦苇屋
all_card.text:
你位于芦苇屋时，不能打出支援。
[free]如果此处没有线索：抽取芦苇屋底下的遭遇卡牌。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Even the locals stay away from this half-sunken hovel.
all_card.real_text:
While you are in the House in the Reeds, you cannot play assets.
[fast] If there are no clues here: Draw the encounter card underneath House in the Reeds. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 这儿天花板都塌了，墙壁给老鼠打得千疮百孔，根本不能算房子，更别说学校了。
all_card.name: 学校
all_card.text: 强制 - 你发现本地点的线索后：查找遭遇牌库和弃牌堆，找出一张百口之物的仆人并将其抽取。混洗遭遇牌库。 [free]如果此处没有线索：抽取学校底下的遭遇卡牌。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: With its crumbling rooftop and rat-infested walls, this is hardly even a house, let alone a schoolhouse.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discover a clue from this location: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Servant of Many Mouths and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck. [fast] If there are no clues here: Draw the encounter card underneath Schoolhouse. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor: “欧巴尼恩帮向你致意。”
all_card.name: 受雇枪手
all_card.text: 每位[[罪犯]]敌人(包括受雇枪手)获得：“猎手。猎物 - 资源最多。” 每张紧追不舍诡计获得险境和涌动。
all_card.traits: 类人. 罪犯. 犯罪团伙
all_card.real_flavor: "The O'Bannions send their regards."
all_card.real_text: Each [[Criminal]] enemy (including Hired Gun) gains: "Hunter. Prey - Most resources." Each copy of Hunted Down gains peril and surge.

all_card.back_text:
将原版的4张犹格·索托斯之子从游戏中移除，用重返无人知晓遭遇组中4张新的犹格·索托斯之子替换。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “如果有犹格·索托斯之子将被放置入场，随机从放在一边的犹格·索托斯之子中选择并放置入场。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返无人知晓
all_card.text: 遵循敦威治遗产的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返无人知晓找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- Remove 4 copies of Brood of Yog-Sothoth from the original scenario and replace them with the 4 new versions of Brood of Yog-Sothoth from the Return to Undimensioned and Unseen encounter set.
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rule applies: "If a Brood of Yog-Sothoth would be put into play, it is chosen at random from among the set-aside versions of Brood of Yog-Sothoth." Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Dunwich Legacy Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Undimensioned and Unseen shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.name: 犹格·索托斯之子
all_card.text: 庞大。 犹格·索托斯之子得到+1[per_investigator]生命值，且不能因深奥的咒文以外的能力被伤害或攻击。 强制 - 犹格·索托斯之子每轮第一次移动后，如果其未交战：其立即再次向一个随机地点移动。
all_card.real_text: Massive. Brood of Yog-Sothoth gets +1 [per_investigator] health and cannot be damaged or attacked except using the ability on Esoteric Formula. Forced - After Brood of Yog-Sothoth moves for the first time each round, if it is unengaged: It immediately moves again toward a random location.

all_card.name: 犹格·索托斯之子
all_card.text:
庞大。
犹格·索托斯之子得到+2[per_investigator]生命值，且不能因深奥的咒文以外的能力被伤害或攻击。
all_card.real_text:
Massive.
Brood of Yog-Sothoth gets +2 [per_investigator] health and cannot be damaged or attacked except using the ability on Esoteric Formula.

all_card.name: 犹格·索托斯之子
all_card.text:
庞大。反击。
犹格·索托斯之子得到+1[per_investigator]生命值，且不能因深奥的咒文以外的能力被伤害或攻击。
all_card.real_text:
Massive. Retaliate.
Brood of Yog-Sothoth gets +1 [per_investigator] health and cannot be damaged or attacked except using the ability on Esoteric Formula.

all_card.name: 犹格·索托斯之子
all_card.text: 庞大。 犹格·索托斯之子得到+1[per_investigator]生命值，且不能因深奥的咒文以外的能力被伤害或攻击。 强制 - 犹格·索托斯之子进入你所在地点后，或你进入犹格·索托斯之子所在地点后：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Massive. Retaliate. Brood of Yog-Sothoth gets +1 [per_investigator] health and cannot be damaged or attacked except using the ability on Esoteric Formula. Forced - After Brood of Yog-Sothoth enters your location, or vice versa: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 不可察觉的生物
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 - 附属到场上一个未附属不可察觉的生物的犹格·索托斯之子敌人上。移除该敌人上的1个线索。 被附属的敌人获得[[精英]]。
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Attach to a Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemy in play without a copy of Imperceptible Creature attached. Remove 1 clue from that enemy. Attached enemy gains [[Elite]].

all_card.back_text: - 将原版的山脚和上山道路，用新的山脚(蜿蜒曲折)和上山道路(蜿蜒曲折)替换。 - 将新的分岔路和迷幻小路加入原版分岔路和迷幻小路中。然后，随机将1张分岔路和1张迷幻小路从游戏中移除。(与常规设置相比，每种地点你会分别多移除1张) - 检查剧本日志。如果调查员有内奥米罩着：不从剧本手册第1部分的效果获得线索，改为调查员队长可以选择一位调查员将放在一边的内奥米·欧巴尼恩加入其牌组。该卡牌不计入该调查员的卡牌张数。
all_card.name: 重返毁灭之地
all_card.text: 遵循敦威治遗产的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返毁灭之地找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将内奥米·欧巴尼恩放在一边，位于场外。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text: - Replace the original Base of the Hill and Ascending Path with the new Base of the Hill (Warped and Twisted) and Ascending Path (Warped and Twisted). - Add the new Diverging Path and Altered Path to the original Diverging Paths and Altered Paths. Then, randomly remove 1 of each from the game. (You will remove an additional copy of each during standard setup.) - Check Campaign Log. If Naomi has your back: Instead of gaining clues from the token bank via the effect from Part 1 in the Campaign Guide, the lead investigator may choose an investigator to add the set-aside Naomi O'Bannion to his or her deck. This card does not count toward that investigator's deck size.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Dunwich Legacy Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Where Doom Awaits shown here. - Set Naomi O'Bannion aside, out of play. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: 哨兵山长长的山坡在你面前，一路通往犬牙交错的山顶边缘。
all_card.name: 山脚
all_card.text: 山脚与每个分岔路连接。 强制 - 你在山脚发现至少1个线索后：花费这些线索并随机将等量放在一边的分叉路地点放置入场。 [action]：撤退。“叫我来可不是干这个的！”
all_card.real_back_flavor: The long slope of Sentinel Hill rises before you, cresting in the jagged edges of Sentinel Peak.
all_card.real_text: Base of the Hill is connected to each copy of Diverging Path. Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues from Base of the Hill: Spend those clues and put that many random set-aside Diverging Path locations into play. [action]: Resign. "This is more than I signed up for!"

all_card.back_flavor: 就在你试图沿路上山的时候，你发现自己不知为何竟在无尽地兜圈子。你每次停下来确认自己的方位，却又发现自己回到了山脚。
all_card.back_text: 通往山上更远地方的道路挡住了。你不能移动进入上山道路。
all_card.name: 上山道路
all_card.text: 上山道路与每个迷幻小路连接。 强制 - 你在上山道路发现了至少1个线索后：花费这些线索并随机将等量放在一边的迷幻小路放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When you try to follow the path leading farther up Sentinel Hill, you somehow end up walking in a perpetual loop. Each time you stop to get your bearings, you find yourself back at the base of the hill again.
all_card.real_back_text: The path leading farther up the hill is masked. You cannot move into Ascending Path.
all_card.real_text: Ascending Path is connected to each copy of Altered Path. Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues from Ascending Path: Spend those clues and put that many random set-aside Altered Path locations into play.

all_card.back_flavor: 地下践踏的痕迹一路通往哨兵山周围的树林深处。
all_card.flavor:
曾经肯定有人到过这里，
但是没留下任何有用的东西……
all_card.name: 废弃营地
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你揭示废弃营地后：你本轮每执行了一个行动，失去2资源(如可能，包括本行动)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A path off the beaten trail leads deeper into the woods surrounding Sentinel Hill.
all_card.real_flavor:
Someone was definitely here,
but there's nothing of any use left…
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Abandoned Camp: Lose 2 resources for each action you have performed this round (including this one, if applicable).

all_card.back_flavor: 你沿着道路继续前进，但一阵寒意却爬上脊背，前方的路线受到一股奇异的奥术力量干扰。
all_card.flavor: 怎会深不见底……
all_card.name: 无底湖泊
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你揭示无底湖泊后：如果你剩余至少2个行动，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.traits: 敦威治. 树林. 幻境
all_card.real_back_flavor: A shiver courses up your spine as you step forth onto the path, its route touched by a bizarre arcane power.
all_card.real_flavor: There has to be a bottom…
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Fathomless Lake: If you have 2 or more actions remaining, place 1 doom on the current agenda.

all_card.name: 内奥米·欧巴尼恩
all_card.text:
你得到+1[intellent]和+1[combat]。
[reaction]在你所在地点的一位调查员的[intellent]或[combat]检定中，揭示1个非[atuo_fail]的混乱标记时，横置内奥米·欧巴尼恩：取消该混乱标记并揭示一个新的混乱标记。本次检定的剩余时间里，如果再次揭示被取消的混乱标记，取消该标记并揭示一个新的混乱标记。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 罪犯. 犯罪团伙
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [combat].
[reaction] When an investigator at your location reveals a non-[auto_fail] chaos token during an [intellect] or [combat] test, exhaust Naomi O'Bannion: Cancel that chaos token and reveal a new chaos token. For the remainder of this test, if another copy of the canceled chaos token is revealed, cancel it and reveal a new chaos token.

all_card.back_text: - 检查剧本日志。如果仪式已完成：用本遭遇组新的场景2a——“超越领域(版本二)”替换场景2a——“超越领域”。 - 用本遭遇组新的密谋3a——“突破(版本二)”替换密谋3a——“突破”。 - 将单面的彼端领域地点放置入场，并将犹格·索托斯生成在该地点。
all_card.name: 重返迷失时空
all_card.text: 遵循敦威治遗产的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返迷失时空找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将赛斯·毕晓普(犹格·索托斯的奴仆)放在一边，位于场外。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text: - Check Campaign Log. If the Ritual was completed: Replace Act 2a - "Into the Beyond" with the new Act 2a - "Into the Beyond (v. II)" included in this encounter set. - Replace Agenda 3a - "Breaking Through" with the new Agenda 3a - "Breaking Through (v. II)" included in this encounter set. - Put the single-sided Realms Beyond location into play and spawn Yog-Sothoth there.
all_card.real_name: Return to Lost in Time and Space
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Dunwich Legacy Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Lost in Time and Space shown here. - Set Seth Bishop (Thrall of Yog-Sothoth) aside, out of play. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_text: 显现 - 将犹格·索托斯移动到宇宙的边缘(如果宇宙的边缘不在场上，改为将其移动到另一个次元)。将彼端领域从游戏中移除，推进到密谋4a。结算此能力时，忽略彼端领域的文本。
all_card.flavor: 在这个歪曲的次元中，无论你到了哪里，远远地总有一个影子阴魂不散。一开始只是个圆形，仿佛一轮长着无数蠕动触手的黑月。但你渐渐看出它越来越大……
all_card.name: 突破(版本二)
all_card.text: 强制 - 你由于遭遇卡牌的效果移动到一个地点后：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_name: The Key and the Gate (v. II)
all_card.real_back_text: Revelation - Move Yog-Sothoth to The Edge of the Universe (or Another Dimension if The Edge of the Universe is not in play). Remove Realms Beyond from the game and advance to agenda 4a. Ignore the text on Realms Beyond while resolving this ability.
all_card.real_flavor: Throughout this warped dimension, no matter where you travel, there is a haunting shape in the distance. At first, it appears as a disc, like a black moon with many wriggling arms. But as time passes, you can tell it is growing larger and larger…
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you are moved to a location by an encounter card effect: Take 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor:
你抵达了一片致密的混沌，你突然意识到，这里就是一切现实世界的起源，或许也是现实世界的终焉。在混沌的中心，你看到一条裂缝，正在不断地扩张。你向缝隙中看去，竟然看到了哨兵峰。
就在此时，从缝隙另一头的黑暗中，一个声音喊道：“愚蠢的人。”你一直追寻着的那道光芒突然消失在黑暗中。转瞬过后，赛斯·毕晓普那张扭曲变形的脸突然出现。它的皮肤上出现异常的变化。赛斯瞪大了眼睛，眼神里充满了邪恶，喊道：“愚蠢的人！现在我就是他的容器！远古的智慧为我所得！赶紧滚出去……不然就死在这儿！”他那畸形躯体受了操纵，一瘸一拐地向前走来，伴随着疯狂的笑声。
你必须想办法将裂缝永远关闭，但在那之前，你得先解决赛斯——或者说，解决掉这个曾是赛斯的怪物。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的赛斯·毕晓普(犹格·索托斯的奴仆)生成在宇宙的边缘。
all_card.flavor: 你继续跟着这缕微光，但一路上经过的地方危机重重，要追上可不是件容易的事情。
all_card.name: 超越领域(版本二)
all_card.text: [action]：弃掉遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。选择以此效果弃掉的一个地点并结算其“显现”能力。 目标 - 如果调查员进入宇宙的边缘，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You reach an impossibly dense pitch-black void, and realize that this place is where all of reality - all that is and all that ever will be - ends. In its center, you see a minuscule rift, suspended just out of reach. Somehow, you've reached the other side of the gateway above Sentinel Hill.
Just then, a voice from the darkness beyond calls to you. "Git out." The wisp of light you've been following flits into the darkness. Moments later, the warped, twisted face of Seth Bishop emerges. His skin crawls with an unnatural mutation. His eyes are wide, filled with a wicked malice. "Git out! I am his vessel now! I'ave the knowledge of the elders! Now, leave… or die!" He cackles madly as his enthralled, misshapen body limps forward
You must find a way to close the rift for good, but first you must deal with Seth - that is, with the creature he has become.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Seth Bishop (Thrall of Yog-Sothoth) enemy at The Edge of the Universe.
all_card.real_flavor: You continue to follow the wisp of light, though the treacherous landscape makes it a difficult quarry to chase.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Choose a location discarded by this effect and resolve its 'revelation' ability. Objective - If an investigator enters The Edge of the Universe, advance.

all_card.name: 赛斯·毕晓普
all_card.text: 反击。 强制 - 在敌军阶段中赛斯·毕晓普攻击你时：在本次攻击后你移动到另一个次元，或本次攻击造成+2伤害。 强制 - 在犹格·索托斯进入赛斯·毕晓普所在地点(反之亦然)后：赛斯被完全吞噬了。将赛斯·毕晓普从游戏中移除。治愈犹格·索托斯的6点伤害。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 异形. 精英
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. Forced - When Seth Bishop attacks you during the enemy phase: Either move to Another Dimension after this attack, or Seth Bishop deals +2 damage for this attack. Forced - After Yog-Sothoth enters Seth Bishop's location (or vice versa): Seth is devoured whole. Remove Seth Bishop from the game. Heal 6 damage from Yog-Sothoth.

all_card.name: 彼端领域
all_card.text: 犹格·索托斯不能受到玩家卡牌效果的影响，不能受到伤害，不能离开彼端领域。 作为你离开彼端领域的额外费用，检定[willpower]或[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，取消移动的效果。 强制 - 在一个强制效果将要使调查员或敌人移动到另一个次元时：改为移动到彼端领域。不能被取消。
all_card.real_text: Yog-Sothoth is immune to player card effects, cannot take damage, and cannot leave Realms Beyond. As an additional cost for you to leave Realms Beyond, test [willpower] or [agility] (3). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move. Forced - When a forced effect would move an investigator or enemy to Another Dimension: Move them here instead. Cannot be canceled.

all_card.name: 难以理解的阶梯
all_card.text: 显现 - 将难以理解的阶梯放置入场并弃掉你牌库顶3张卡牌。 强制 - 在你离开难以理解的阶梯后：你必须受到2点恐惧，或将难以理解的阶梯弃掉。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Indecipherable Stairs into play and discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Forced - After you leave Indecipherable Stairs: You must either take 2 horror, or discard Indecipherable Stairs.

all_card.name: 高耸辉地
all_card.text: 显现 - 将高耸辉地放置入场，在其上放置1个毁灭标记或受到2点伤害。 强制 - 你在本地点检定失败后：你必须将高耸辉地的一个线索翻至毁灭标记面，或将高耸辉地弃掉。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Towering Luminosity into play and either place 1 doom on it or take 2 damage. Forced - After you fail a test while at this location: You must either flip 1 clue on Towering Luminosity to its doom side, or discard Towering Luminosity.

all_card.name: 不稳定的漩涡
all_card.text: 显现 - 将不稳定的漩涡放置入场并弃掉一张空间裂缝，如可能。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时，如果你在不稳定的漩涡：你必须抽取遭遇牌库顶的牌，或将不稳定的漩涡洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Unstable Vortex into play and discard 1 copy of Tear Through Space, if able. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are at Unstable Vortex: You must either draw the top card of the encounter deck, or shuffle Unstable Vortex into the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 萦绕的回忆
all_card.text: 显现 - 你的手牌中每有一张卡牌在弃牌堆有同名卡牌，受到1点恐惧(最多3点恐惧)。如果没有因本效果受到恐惧，弃掉你牌库顶3张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - For each card in your hand, if there is a copy of that card in your discard pile, take 1 horror (to a maximum of 3 horror). If you take no horror from this effect, discard the top 3 cards of your deck.

all_card.name: 恶意欢迎
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 选择以下两种行动(调查、攻击、躲避、移动或打出)。直到本轮结束，每位调查员不能执行选择的行动。如果这不是本阶段抽出的第一张恶意欢迎，改为选择三种行动。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Choose two of the following actions (investigate, fight, evade, move, or play). For the remainder of the round, each investigator cannot perform each chosen action. If this is not the first copy of A Baleful Welcome drawn this phase, choose three of those actions instead.

all_card.name: 无限门廊
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 作为移动进入或离开被附属地点的额外费用，弃掉你牌库顶1张卡牌。如果被弃掉的卡牌是弱点，将其抽取。否则，你的手牌或游戏区域内每有1张被弃掉的卡牌的同名卡牌，你必须受到1点恐惧或弃掉该牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. As an additional cost to move into or out of attached location, discard the top card of your deck. If the discarded card is a weakness, draw it. Otherwise, for each copy of the discarded card in your hand or play area, you must either take 1 horror or discard that card.

all_card.name: 复苏之邪
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 抽取遭遇牌库顶2张卡牌。 - 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果可以导致当前密谋推进。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Draw the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.

all_card.name: 暗门
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到有最多调查员且没有暗门的地点。 调查员不能离开被附属的地点。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)来搜索通道或[intellent](3)来辨别出路。如果你检定成功，弃掉暗门。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the location with the most investigators, and without a Secret Door attached. Investigators cannot leave this location. [action]: Test [willpower] (3) to search for the passage or [intellect] (3) to discern the way out. If you succeed, discard Secret Door.

all_card.name: 莫测寒冷
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](4)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须从你游戏区域或你手牌中选择并弃掉1张卡牌，或受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). For each point you fail by, you must either choose and discard 1 card from your play area or from your hand, or take 1 damage.

all_card.name: 压抑浓雾
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限1张。 强制 - 在本地点的调查员抽取任意张卡牌后：该调查员必须检定[willpower](3)。如果检定失败，该调查员选择并弃掉等量的卡牌。 [action][action]：弃掉压抑浓雾。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. Forced - After an investigator at this location draws 1 or more cards, that investigator must test [willpower] (3). If that investigator fails, he or she chooses and discards an equal number of cards. [action][action]: Discard Oppressive Mists.

all_card.name: 暴力命令
all_card.text: 显现 - 将暴力命令放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 [action]：对你所在地点的一位调查员造成2点伤害，弃掉暴力命令。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Violent Commands into play in your threat area. [action]: Deal 2 damage to an investigator at your location and discard Violent Commands. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 魔掌
all_card.text: 显现 - 将魔掌放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 [free]如果魔掌在你的威胁区，在你回合期间，受到2点伤害并弃掉魔掌：你本回合可以进行额外一次行动。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Idle Hands into play in your threat area. [fast] If Idle Hands is in your threat area, during your turn, take 2 damage and discard Idle Hands: You may take an additional action this turn. Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 知识渴求
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果你没有线索，知识渴求获得涌动。否则，检定[intellect](X)。其中X为你拥有的线索数量(最多为5)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须受到1点恐惧，或将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If you have no clues, Need for Knowledge gains surge. Otherwise, test [intellect] (X), where X equals the number of clues you have (to a maximum of 5). For each point you fail by, you must either take 1 horror or place 1 of your clues on your location.

all_card.name: 潜伏者之仆
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：潜伏者之仆所在地点的每位调查员弃掉其牌库顶1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Each investigator at Vassal of the Lurker's location discards 1 card from the top of his or her deck.

all_card.name: 惊悚协议
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你可以抽取1张卡牌。你可以从手中选择并弃掉最多2张卡牌。检定[willpower](X)。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。其中X为本次检定开始时你的手牌数量。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You may draw 1 card. You may choose and discard up to 2 cards from your hand. Test [willpower] (X). If you fail, take 2 horror. X equals the number of cards in your hand when this test begins.

all_card.name: 体能训练
all_card.text:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。
all_card.real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.

all_card.name: 炸药爆破
all_card.text: 选择你所在地点或一个连接地点。对所选地点的每个敌人和每位调查员各造成3点伤害。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
all_card.real_text: Choose either your location or a connecting location. Deal 3 damage to each enemy and to each investigator at the chosen location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

all_card.name: 超感知
all_card.text:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[intellect]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。
all_card.real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

all_card.name: 屏障
all_card.text: 附属到你所在地点。 非[[精英]]敌人不能移动进入或生成在附属地点。非[[精英]]敌人生成在附属地点时，改为将其生成在一个连接地点。 强制 - 在一位调查员离开附属地点时：弃掉屏障。
all_card.real_text: Attach to your location. Non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot move into or spawn at attached location. Each time a non-[[Elite]] enemy would spawn at attached location, spawn it at a connecting location instead, if able. Forced - When an investigator leaves attached location: Discard Barricade.

all_card.name: 沉重打击
all_card.text:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。
all_card.real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

all_card.flavor: “我又赢咯！抱歉，甜心，你只是今晚运气有点差。”
all_card.name: 百战百胜
all_card.text: 获得10资源。
all_card.real_flavor: "I win again! Sorry sugar, it’s just not your night."
all_card.real_text: Gain 10 resources.

all_card.name: 神秘研究
all_card.text:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[intellect]。
all_card.real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.

all_card.name: 记忆抹消
all_card.text:
快速。在一个阶段开始后打出。
选择你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。将所选敌人的印刷文本框视为如同空白(除[[特性]]外)，所选敌人得到-1伤害值和-1恐惧值，直到本阶段结束。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play after a phase begins.
Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy in your location. Until the end of the phase, reduce the chosen enemy's damage and horror values by 1, and treat its printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

all_card.name: 深挖
all_card.text:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。
