[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

all_card.flavor: 他们说这能给我带来好运。我本来不信。但现在我觉得，要是丢了它，我可真要倒霉了
all_card.name: 幸运兔脚
all_card.text: [reaction]在你技能检定失败后，横置幸运兔脚：查找你牌库顶X张卡牌，找出一张将其抽取，并将剩余卡牌洗入你的牌库。X为你检定失败且低于难度的点数。
all_card.real_flavor: They claimed it would bring me good luck. I wouldn’t say that’s true. But now I feel like it would be even worse luck to get rid of it.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you fail a skill test, exhaust Rabbit's Foot: Search the top X cards of your deck for a card, draw it, and shuffle the remaining cards into your deck. X is the amount you failed by.

all_card.back_text: - 将原版的书房地点从游戏中移除，用新版的书房(异常通道)替换。将书房(异常通道)放置入场。每位调查员从书房(异常通道)开始游戏。 - 将新版的地点——会客厅、卧室和浴室放置入场。 - 将原版的走廊地点从游戏中移除。 - 随机从2张阁楼地点中选择一张，2张地窖地点中选择一张，将这些卡牌放在一边，位于场外。将阁楼和地窖的其他版本从游戏中移除。 - 将每张其他地点放在一边，位于场外。
all_card.name: 重返聚集于此
all_card.text: 遵循狂热之夜的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返聚集于此找出几个新遭遇組，如下所示： - 将场景1a——“被困于此”从游戏中移除，用新版场景1a——“神秘通道”替换。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- Remove the original Study location from the game and replace it with the new Study (Aberrant Gateway). Put the Study (Aberrant Gateway) into play. Each investigator begins play in the Study (Aberrant Gateway).
- Put the new Guest Hall, Bedroom, and Bathroom locations into play.
- Remove the original Hallway location from the game.
- Choose one of the two Attic locations and one of the two Cellar locations at random, and set them aside, out of play. Remove the other versions of Attic and Cellar from the game.
- Set each other location aside, out of play.
all_card.real_text:
Perform the setup as indicated in the Night of the Zealot Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions:
- When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Gathering shown here.
- Remove Act 1a- "Trapped" from the game and replace it with the new Act 1a- "Mysterious Gateway."
(Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor:
你家中的布局与往常截然不同。不知为何，会客厅仿佛如衔尾蛇般首尾相接，将你困于此处，无法进入靠近宅邸前部的主走廊。
你注意到客房与浴室之间的墙壁已经腐烂，还沾染着像是陈旧血迹的污渍。别无他路可走，你只能强行打破这堵腐朽的脆弱墙壁。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的墙上的洞地点放置入场。
选择位于会客厅的一位调查员。将该调查员立即移动到墙上的洞并将其揭示。然后，该调查员必须检定[willpower](4)。其检定失败且每低于难度1点，该调查员必须随机弃掉自己的1张手牌。
all_card.flavor: 当你想要出门做些调查时，书房的门突然从眼前消失，只留下一条奇怪的通道，通往房子的另一侧。肯定有什么原因导致了这一切……
all_card.name: 神秘通道
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有会客厅的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The layout of your home is vastly different from its usual structure. Somehow, your guest hall seems to have looped around on itself, and you are stuck with no way to enter the main hallway near the front of the house.
You notice that the wall between the guest bedroom and the bathroom is rotted and stained with what appears to be old blood. With no other way to proceed, you have no choice but to bust through the weak, rotted wall.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put into play the set-aside Hole in the Wall location.
Choose an investigator in the Guest Hall. The chosen investigator immediately moves into the Hole in the Wall and reveals it. Then, he or she must test [willpower] (4). For each point that investigator fails by, he or she must discard a random card from his or her hand.
all_card.real_flavor: As you leap to investigate, the door to your study vanishes before your eyes, leaving behind a strange gateway to another part of your house. There must be a reason why this is happening…
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in the Guest Hall may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你已经调查阿卡姆发生的怪异事件连续数月了。你的书桌上铺满了新闻报道、警方报告和目击者的陈述。
all_card.flavor: 书房的门消失了，留下一个通往屋内另一处的通道。
all_card.name: 书房
all_card.text: [action][action]：抽取3张卡牌。只有调查员队长可以执行此能力。 强制 - 在有敌人将要生成在不在场上的地点时：将该地点放置入场，并将该敌人生成在该地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You’ve been investigating the strange events occurring in Arkham for several months now. Your desk is covered in newspaper articles, police reports, and witness accounts.
all_card.real_flavor: The door to your study has vanished, leaving in its wake a gateway to another part of your house.
all_card.real_text:
[action][action]: Draw 3 cards. Only the lead investigator can activate this ability.
Forced - When an enemy attempts to spawn at a location that is not in play: Put that location into play and spawn that enemy there.

all_card.back_flavor: 不知怎的，你最终来到了家里一个截然不同的区域。
all_card.flavor: 你是怎么来到这里的……？
all_card.name: 会客厅
all_card.text: 位于本地点的调查员不能进行抽取行动。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Somehow you’ve ended up in a completely different part of your house.
all_card.real_flavor: How did you end up here… ?
all_card.real_text: Investigators in this location cannot take draw actions.

all_card.back_flavor: 你靠近时，一道影子从卧室门下的缝隙掠过。
all_card.flavor: 床单破烂不堪，布料上画着一个怪异的符号。血迹在衣柜门前汇成一滩，你能听见里面传出咀嚼的声响。
all_card.name: 卧室
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你调查卧室时技能检定失败后：从你的手中随机弃掉1张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A shadow dances across the floor beneath the bedroom door as you approach.
all_card.real_flavor: The bedsheets are tattered, and a strange symbol is drawn on the fabric. Blood pools at the foot of the closet door, and you can hear something chewing inside.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating the Bedroom: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 你靠近浴室门时，腐臭而诡异的空气扑面而来，呛得你阵阵作呕。
all_card.flavor: 客房浴室看起来有好几年都没打扫过了。房间深处的浴缸里积满了粘稠的绿色液体，墙面也覆满了霉斑。
all_card.name: 浴室
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你调查浴室时揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[auto_fail]标记后：失去所有剩余的行动并结束你的回合。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you approach the bathroom door, the weight of the putrid, unnatural air causes you to gag.
all_card.real_flavor: The guest bathroom looks as though it hasn't been cleaned in years. A viscous green liquid fills the bathtub in the far corner of the room, and mold has grown across the walls.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [auto_fail] symbol while investigating the Bathroom: Lose all remaining actions and end your turn.

all_card.back_flavor: 我“需要”这个，就像“需要”墙上有个洞一样。
all_card.flavor: 墙壁上溅有淤泥，硬木地板不见了，一条泥土小径取而代之。
all_card.name: 走廊
all_card.text: 强制 - 走廊揭示后：将放在一边的阁楼、地窖和客厅地点放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor: I need this like I need a hole in my wall.
all_card.real_flavor: The walls of your house are splattered with mud, and your hardwood floor is gone, replaced with a dirt path.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal this location: Put the set-aside Attic, Cellar, and Parlor locations into play.

all_card.back_flavor: 当你走近阁楼的阶梯时，一股腐肉的气味扑鼻而来。
all_card.flavor: 一头畸形野兽的血腥死尸挂在天花板垂下的肉钩上，来回摇摆着。血液从死尸上缓慢流出，滴落到一个小木桶之内。让你意外的是，阁楼尽头的一架木梯穿过了房顶，通向更高的地方。
all_card.name: 阁楼
all_card.text: 强制 - 阁楼揭示后：将放在一边的远在房屋之上放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The smell of rotten meat assaults your nostrils as you approach the attic stairs.
all_card.real_flavor: The bloody carcass of some sort of beast swings from a meat hook chained to the ceiling. Blood drains slowly from the carcass, dripping into a small barrel. To your surprise, a wooden ladder at the far end of the attic ascends through your roof, to an even higher area
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal the Attic: Put the set-aside Far Above Your House location into play.

all_card.back_flavor: 你难以相信眼前的景象，阁楼本该是你房子的最高处才对。至少……之前是的。
all_card.flavor: 你爬上梯子，从地面的一个洞口钻出来，却发现自己置身于一片无边无际的墓地中。每一块墓碑上，都刻着一个你家族成员的名字。
all_card.name: 开阔坟场
all_card.text: 强制 - 你揭示开阔坟场后：检定[willpower](4)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，从每位调查员的手中随机弃掉1张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You struggle to believe this is even possible, considering the attic is the highest point in your home. Or at least…was.
all_card.real_flavor: You climb the ladder and emerge from a pit in the ground amidst an endless field of graves. Each bears a branch from your family tree.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Field of Graves: Test [willpower] (4). For each point you fail by, discard 1 card at random from each player's hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 通往地窖的阶梯格外滑溜，结上了一层泛光的薄冰……
all_card.flavor: 你的地窖变成了一座由冰冷的隧道与地穴组成的地下网络。寒气侵入骨髓。这些隧道向地表之下延伸数英里，不断向更深处蔓延。
all_card.name: 地窖
all_card.text: 强制 - 地窖揭示后：将放在一边的远在房屋之下放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The stairs leading down to your cellar are slick, and glisten with a thin layer of ice…
all_card.real_flavor: Your cellar seems to have been replaced with an underground network of icy tunnels and caverns. The tunnels continue for miles, deeper and deeper beneath the surface.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal the Cellar: Put the set-aside Deep Below Your House location into play.

all_card.back_flavor: 隧道向四面八方延伸，长达数英里。无论你看向哪里，都能看到远处有怪异的犬形生物四肢着地快速移动，在阴影间窜来窜去。
all_card.flavor: 这些坑洞似乎是那些生物的巢穴。冰冷刺骨，里面满是人类和其他动物的腐烂残骸。
all_card.name: 食尸鬼洞穴
all_card.text: 强制 - 你揭示食尸鬼洞穴后：检定[agility](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出1张鼠群并将其抽取。混洗遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The tunnels extend for miles in every direction. Everywhere you look, strange canine creatures skitter on all fours in the distance, scrambling from one shadow to the next.
all_card.real_flavor: These pits seem to be the creatures' lairs. They are ice-cold and filled with the decaying remains of humans and other animals.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Ghoul Pits: Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Swarm of Rats and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: 衣柜门后，那怪物刚结束它的餐食。它的食欲永不满足，立刻就把注意力转向了你。
all_card.name: 嗜尸鬼
all_card.text: 生成 - 卧室。 猎手。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 食尸鬼
all_card.real_flavor: Behind the door to your closet, the creature finishes its meal. Its appetite insatiable, it quickly turns its attention to you.
all_card.real_text:
Spawn - Bedroom.
Hunter.

all_card.flavor: 一头狂乱的野兽硬生生撕开了地面，从下方隧道里钻出。它的双眼因饥饿与憎恨而通红。
all_card.name: 深渊食尸鬼
all_card.text: 生成 - 浴室。 反击。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 食尸鬼
all_card.real_flavor: Tearing its way out of the floor, a crazed beast emerges from the tunnels below. Its eyes are red with hunger and hate.
all_card.real_text:
Spawn - Bathroom.
Retaliate.

all_card.flavor: 三印为终焉。
all_card.name: 狂信徒之印
all_card.text: 显现 - 每位拥有3张或更少手牌数量的调查员必须受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。每位拥有4张或更多手牌数量的调查员检定[willpower](2)，检定失败的调查员从手中随机弃掉2张卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: The third seal will be the last.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Each investigator with 3 or fewer cards in hand must take 1 damage and 1 horror. Each investigator with 4 or more cards in hand tests [willpower] (2). Each investigator who fails must discard 2 cards at random from his or her hand.

all_card.back_text: 随机从2张东城区地点选择1张、2张北区地点选择1张、2张河岸城地点选择1张和2张米斯卡塔尼克大学地点选择1张。将所选地点放置入场。将这些地点的其他版本从游戏中移除。 - 在创建“异教徒牌库”时，加入本扩展乌默尔多斯教派遭遇组的3张新卡牌。混洗异教徒牌库，然后从中随机移除3张卡牌，不要查看其内容。(异教徒牌库最后应有5张卡牌。) - 如果你被指示要从遭遇牌库查找一张祭司，改为从遭遇牌库查找一张生命值为1的[[异教徒]]敌人。
all_card.name: 重返午夜假面
all_card.text: 遵循狂热之夜的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返午夜假面找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 随机从2张密谋1a——“猎人还是猎物？”中选择1张来构建密谋牌库，不要查看另一面。将其他版本的密谋1a从游戏中移除。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- Choose one of the two Easttown locations, one of the two Northside locations, one of the two Rivertown locations, and one of the two Miskatonic University locations at random. Put those locations into play. Remove the other versions of Easttown, Northside, Rivertown, and Miskatonic University from the game.
- When creating the "Cultist deck," include the 3 new Cult of Umôrdhoth cards included in this expansion. Shuffle the Cultist deck and remove 3 random cards from it, without looking at them. (You should be left with a 5-card Cultist deck.)
- If you are instructed to search the encounter deck for an Acolyte, search the encounter deck for any 1-health [[Cultist]] enemy, instead.
all_card.real_text:
Perform the setup as indicated in the Night of the Zealot Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions:
- When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to the Midnight Masks shown here.
- Construct the act deck using one of the two copies of Agenda 1a- "Predator or Prey" at random, without looking at their other sides. Remove the other version of Agenda 1a from the game.
(Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.flavor: 丽塔似乎坚信阿卡姆城中正酝酿着一个阴谋。她相信有一个隐秘的异教正服侍着地下洞穴中的食尸鬼，而异教几名重要的成员正散居在阿卡姆城各处。你开始搜寻他们，却不由地感到自己也正在被某个东西追捕。
all_card.name: 猎人还是猎物？
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你不愿冒险多做停留，带着收集的信息去往安全之处。
all_card.real_flavor: Lita seems convinced of a conspiracy within the city of Arkham. She believes that a secret cult serves the ghouls that live in the crypts beneath the city, and that several of the cult’s prominent members are scattered throughout Arkham. As you begin searching for them, you can’t shake the feeling that you, too, are being hunted.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.

all_card.name: 纳罗加斯
all_card.text: 生成 - 与猎物交战。 猎物 - 距离另一个[[异教徒]]敌人最近的调查员。 猎手。 每有一位调查员，纳罗加斯得到+3生命。 纳罗加斯处于重整状态时，其所在地点和连接地点的每位调查员不能与[[异教徒]]敌人谈判。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 异教徒. 精英
all_card.real_text:
Spawn - Engaged with Prey.
Prey - Nearest to another [[Cultist]] enemy.
Hunter.
Narôgath gets +3 health per investigator.
While Narôgath is ready, each investigator at its location or a connecting location cannot Parley with [[Cultist]] enemies.

all_card.back_flavor: 东城区位于米斯卡塔尼克河的北岸，这里是底层人民的居所，还坐落着阿卡姆警察局以及维尔玛小餐馆这样的人气食肆。
all_card.flavor: 你知道恩格尔警长多半不会相信你的说辞，但兴许能说服其他几位警员协助你调查。
all_card.name: 东城区
all_card.text: [action] ：在你控制的一个支援上放置2个补给标记或子弹标记。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Easttown neighborhood, situated on the northern banks of the Miskatonic River, contains lower-class housing, the Arkham Police Station, and popular eateries like Velma’s Diner.
all_card.real_flavor: You doubt that Sheriff Engle will believe your story, but you might be able to convince some of the other officers to assist in your investigation.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Add 2 supply tokens or ammo tokens to an asset you control. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 北区是阿卡姆的商贸区，坐落着大量办公室和工厂，火车站也在这里。
all_card.flavor: 这趟火车在阿卡姆境内有许多停靠站，而通往城外的站点更多。你很想把这一切都抛在身后。
all_card.name: 北区
all_card.text: [action] ：移动到任意一个[[阿卡姆]]地点。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Northside is a commercial district that contains many offices and factories, as well as the train station.
all_card.real_flavor: The train has many stops throughout Arkham, and many more beyond. You are tempted to leave all of this behind.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Move to any [[Arkham]] location. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 米斯卡塔尼克大学是东北地区最富盛名的学府之一。大学图书馆因其神秘学书籍的收藏而闻名于世，由受人尊敬的亨利·阿米蒂奇博士管理维护。
all_card.flavor: 大学博物馆保管着众多来自世界各地的奇珍异宝。
all_card.name: 米斯卡塔尼克大学
all_card.text: [action]受到2点恐惧：从供应堆获得1个线索。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Miskatonic University is one of the most prestigious colleges in the Northeast. The university library is famous for its collection of occult books maintained by the esteemed Dr. Henry Armitage.
all_card.real_flavor: The university's museum holds many peculiar exhibits and ominous relics from expeditions all over the world.
all_card.real_text: [action] Take 2 horror: Gain 1 clue from the token pool. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 米斯卡塔尼克河的两岸排列着诸多码头、仓库，和小店，这片地方叫河岸城真是名副其实。
all_card.flavor: 河边那座孤零零的仓库安静又偏僻：是进行隐秘交易的绝佳场所。
all_card.name: 河岸城
all_card.text: [action]弃掉一张带有X个[willpower]图标的手牌：从场上的一个[[异教徒]]敌人上移除X个毁灭标记。(每场游戏团队仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The banks of the Miskatonic River are lined with docks, warehouses and small shops in a district aptly named Rivertown.
all_card.real_flavor: The lone warehouse next to the river is quiet and secluded: an ideal venue for unsavory dealings.
all_card.real_text: [action] Discard a card with X [willpower] icons: Remove X doom from a [[Cultist]] enemy in play. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor: “乌默尔多斯……乌默尔多斯……乌默尔多斯……”
all_card.name: 假面惊骇
all_card.text: 显现 - 每位拥有2个或更多线索的调查员受到2点恐惧。如果未能造成任何恐惧，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果可以导致当前密谋推进。
all_card.real_flavor: "Umôrdhoth…Umôrdhoth…Umôrdhoth…"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Each investigator with 2 or more clues takes 2 horror. If no horror is dealt by this effect, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.

all_card.name: 重返地底噬魔
all_card.text:
遵循《狂熱之夜》的劇本手冊執行設置，但以下步驟例外：
- 在找出遭遇組的卡牌時，還需要為《重返地底噬魔》找出幾個新遭遇組，如下所示：
- 在隨機選擇4張阿卡姆密林地點放置入場時，將本擴展4張新版的阿卡姆密林地點也加入遭遇組，變為從10張阿卡姆密林地點中隨機選擇4張。
- 在將烏默爾多斯敵人放到一邊後，將本卡牌翻面，疊加到烏默爾多斯。
all_card.real_text:
Perform the setup as indicated in the Night of the Zealot Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions:
- When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Devourer Below shown here.
- When choosing 4 Arkham Woods locations to put into play at random, include the 4 new Arkham Woods locations included in this encounter set, for a total of 10 possibilities.
- After setting the Umôrdhoth enemy aside, flip this card over and attach it to Umôrdhoth.

all_card.name: 凡尘终陨之墟
all_card.text: 凡尘终陨之墟不能离场。 乌默尔多斯得到+X倍调查员人数的生命，得到+X攻击，其中X为本卡牌上的资源数量。 强制 - 在乌默尔多斯入场时，场景牌库每剩余一张场景卡牌，在凡尘终陨之墟上放置1个资源。
all_card.real_text:
Vault of Earthly Demise cannot leave play.
Umôrdhoth gets +X health per investigator and gets +X fight, where X is the number of resources on this card.
Forced - When Umôrdhoth enters play, place 1 resource on this card for each act remaining in the act deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
all_card.flavor: 在寒风中它嘎吱作响，不断扭动，如同有生命一般。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆密林
all_card.text: 强制 - 本地点的调查员结算诡计时技能检定成功后：该诡计卡获得涌动。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Growing up, you were always warned to stay out of the woods at night. Now you know why.
all_card.real_flavor: It seems to groan and twist in the chill wind, as though alive.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After an investigator at this location succeeds at a skill test on a treachery: That treachery gains surge. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
all_card.flavor: 这里曾是热门的钓鱼点，但看起来已经好几年没人来这儿钓鱼了。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆密林
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你调查本地点时，揭示一个混乱标记后：揭示并结算一个额外的混乱标记。(每次检定仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Growing up, you were always warned to stay out of the woods at night. Now you know why.
all_card.real_flavor: This used to be a popular spot for fishing, but it doesn't look like anybody has fished here in years.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag while investigating this location: Reveal and resolve an additional chaos token. (Limit once per test.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
all_card.flavor: 被啃食了一半的动物残骸遍布这片树林，尸臭弥漫在空气中。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆密林
all_card.text: 本地点的每个敌人每次被攻击时受到的伤害不能超过1点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Growing up, you were always warned to stay out of the woods at night. Now you know why.
all_card.real_flavor: The remains of half-eaten animal corpses litter this section of the woods, befouling the air with their stench.
all_card.real_text: Each enemy at this location cannot take more than 1 damage from each attack performed against it.

all_card.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
all_card.flavor: 就算有人激你，你也绝不想走上这座腐朽摇晃的桥。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆密林
all_card.text: 强制 - 你在本地点尝试躲避时，揭示一个混乱标记后：揭示并结算一个额外的混乱标记。(每次检定仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Growing up, you were always warned to stay out of the woods at night. Now you know why.
all_card.real_flavor: Not even on a dare would you attempt to cross this rotted, rickety bridge.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag during an evasion attempt at this location: Reveal and resolve an additional chaos token. (Limit once per test.)

all_card.flavor: 它更偏爱以死者的腐肉为食，但要是饥渴难耐，活物也能将就。
all_card.name: 乌默尔多斯的饥饿
all_card.text: 显现 - 每位调查员必须从手中随机弃掉1张卡牌。没有手牌的调查员阵亡。治愈在场每个敌人1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: It prefers to feast on the rot of the deceased, but when the hunger is overpowering, the living will suffice.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Each investigator must discard 1 card at random from his or her hand. Each investigator who has no cards in his or her hand is killed. Heal 1 damage from each enemy in play.

all_card.flavor: 它保持着一种缩伏的姿态，令人觉得它随时可能抛开手里的猎物，转而扑向更肥美的佳肴。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《皮克曼的模特》</cite>
all_card.name: 食墓鬼
all_card.text: 强制 - 食墓鬼攻击你后：从你的手中随机弃掉1张卡牌。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 食尸鬼
all_card.real_flavor:
Its position was a kind of crouch, and as one looked one felt that at any moment it might drop its present prey and seek a juicier morsel.
-H. P. Lovecraft, “Pickman’s Model”
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Grave-Eater attacks you: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.flavor: 骇人面具之下，潜藏着真正的恐怖。
all_card.name: 乌默尔多斯的祭司
all_card.text: 猎物 - 手牌最少。 与没有手牌的调查员交战时，乌默尔多斯的祭司不能被躲避。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 食尸鬼
all_card.real_flavor: Its dreadful mask conceals the true horror beneath.
all_card.real_text:
Prey - Fewest cards in hand.
While engaged with an investigator with no cards in his or her hand, Acolyte of Umôrdhoth cannot be evaded.

all_card.flavor: 地面覆盖着冰雪，一股刺骨的寒意弥漫在空气中。
all_card.name: 地底深寒
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，从你的手中随机弃掉1张卡牌。每有1张卡牌不能丢弃，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: The ground is covered in ice and frost, and a deep chill courses through the air.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must discard 1 card at random from your hand. For each card you cannot discard, take 1 damage.

all_card.flavor: 安抚好这头野兽，我们就能活下来。等我们死后，它便会以遗骸为盛宴。
all_card.name: 噬魔信徒
all_card.text: 生成 - 最远的无人地点。 强制 - 你生成噬魔信徒后：你必须在噬魔信徒上放置1个毁灭标记，或将你的1个线索放到其所在地点。如果当前密谋不是密谋1，改为两项都执行。
all_card.real_flavor: Placate the beast, and we are allowed to live. When we die, it will feast on our remains.
all_card.real_text:
Spawn - Farthest empty location.
Forced - After you spawn Disciple of the Devourer: You must either place 1 doom on it or place 1 of your clues on its location. If the current agenda is not agenda 1, do both instead.

all_card.name: 掠尸者
all_card.text: 生成 - 最远的无人地点。 强制 - 当神话阶段结束时：在掠尸者上放置1个毁灭标记。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，掠尸者向河岸城或主道路移动一次。如果掠尸者已经位于河岸城或主道路，改为将掠尸者上的所有毁灭标记移动到当前密谋上。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 仆从. 异教徒
all_card.real_text:
Spawn - Farthest empty location.
Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Place 1 doom on Corpse-Taker.
Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Corpse-Taker moves once toward Rivertown or Main Path. If Corpse-Taker is already at Rivertown or Main Path, move all doom from Corpse-Taker to the current agenda, instead.

all_card.name: 乌默尔多斯的面具
all_card.text: 显现 – 附属到最远的[[异教徒]]敌人，并在该敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。如果场上没有[[异教徒]]敌人，查找遭遇牌库及弃牌堆，找出一个[[异教徒]]敌人，将其抽取，并将乌默尔多斯的面具附属到该敌人。混洗遭遇牌库。 附属的敌人得到+2生命。如果被附属的敌人不是独特敌人，其获得冷漠。如果被附属的敌人是独特敌人，其获得反击。
all_card.real_text:
Revelation - Attach to the farthest [[Cultist]] enemy and place 1 doom on that enemy. If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy, draw it, and attach Mask of Umôrdhoth to it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
Attached enemy gets +2 health. If attached enemy is unique, it gains retaliate. If it is non-unique, it gains aloof instead.

all_card.flavor: 他对你这几天的动向似乎关心过头了。
all_card.name: 耶利米·皮尔斯
all_card.text: 生成 - 你的房子。否则，河岸城。 [action] ：谈判。将耶利米·皮尔斯加入胜利区。然后，检定[willpower](4)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记(本效果可以导致当前密谋推进)。
all_card.real_flavor: He seems a little too interested in what you’ve been up to these days.
all_card.real_text:
Spawn - Your House. Otherwise, Rivertown.
[action]: Parley. Add Jeremiah Pierce to the victory display. Then, test [willpower] (4). Place 1 doom on the current agenda for each point you fail by (this can cause the current agenda to advance).

all_card.flavor: 警方把最近这些失踪案件认定为动物袭击。特别是其中一名警察……
all_card.name: 比利·库伯
all_card.text: 生成 - 东城区。 强制 - 比利·库伯所在地点有[[怪物]]敌人被击败后：将比利·库伯加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: The cops have been writing off these disappearances as animal attacks. One cop, in particular…
all_card.real_text:
Spawn - Easttown.
Forced - After a [[Monster]] enemy is defeated at Billy Cooper's location: Add Billy Cooper to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 希尔女士最近总是在阻止历史协会的其他成员研究类似的失踪事件。她在害怕什么？
all_card.name: 阿尔玛·希尔
all_card.text: 生成 - 南区。 [action]：谈判。抽取遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。然后，将阿尔玛·希尔加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: Miss Hill has been preventing other members of the Historical Society from researching similar disappearances. What is she afraid of?
all_card.real_text:
Spawn - Southside.
[action]: Parley. Draw the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Then, add Alma Hill to the victory display.

all_card.name: .32柯尔特手枪
all_card.text: 使用(6子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击造成+1伤害。 [free]花费1资源：将.32柯尔特手枪返回你的手牌。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械
all_card.real_text: Uses (6 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You deal +1 damage for this attack. [fast] Spend 1 resource: Return .32 Colt to your hand.

all_card.name: “吃枪子吧！”
all_card.text: 快速。在你激活[[枪械]]支援上的攻击能力时打出。 你可以花费该支援上的额外1子弹标记。在你为本次攻击揭示混乱标记时，额外揭示1个混乱标记。选择其中一个结算并忽略其余标记。
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play when you activate the Fight ability on a [[Firearm]] asset. Spend 1 additional ammo token from that asset. When you reveal chaos tokens for this attack, reveal 1 additional chaos token. Choose one to resolve and ignore the other.

all_card.flavor: “我是活着的最智慧的人，因为我知道一件事，那就是我知道我一无所知。”<cite>——柏拉图，《理想国》</cite>
all_card.name: 逻辑推理
all_card.text: 你每有1个线索(最多3个)，治愈你所在地点的一位调查员2点恐惧或弃掉你所在地点的一张[[恐怖]]卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor:
"I am the wisest man alive, for I know one thing, and that is that I know nothing."
- Plato, <u>The Republic</u>
all_card.real_text: For each clue you have (to a maximum of 3), either heal 2 horror from an investigator at your location or discard a [[Terror]] card at your location.

all_card.name: 古代雕文
all_card.text: 研究完成。(FAQ v2.0)使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。如果你检定成功，你可以将手牌中一张印刷资源费用不高于X的支援放置入场。其中X为你检定成功且超过难度的点数。
all_card.real_text: Researched. Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. If you succeed, you may put an asset with printed cost of X or lower into play from your hand. X is the amount you succeeded by.

all_card.name: 潜行
all_card.text: [free]在你回合期间，横置潜行：躲避。所选敌人本次躲避尝试得到-2躲避。如果你成功躲避该敌人，与它解除交战但不要横置它。直到你回合结束，该敌人不能与你交战。
all_card.real_text: [fast] During your turn, exhaust Stealth: Evade. The chosen enemy gets -2 evade for this evasion attempt. If you successfully evade the enemy, disengage with it but do not exhaust it. Until the end of your turn, that enemy cannot engage you.

all_card.name: 建议
all_card.text: 使用(3充能)。如果建议没有充能，将其弃掉。 [action]横置建议：躲避。本次躲避尝试将你的[willpower]值加入你的技能值。如果你未超过难度至少2点并成功，从建议移除1充能。
all_card.real_text: Uses (3 charges). If Suggestion has no charges, discard it. [action] Exhaust Suggestion: Evade. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 charge from Suggestion.

all_card.name: 炼金转化
all_card.text:
使用(4充能)。
[action]横置炼金转化，花费1充能：检定[willpower](0)。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，获得1资源(最多4个)。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (4 charges).
[action] Exhaust Alchemical Transmutation, spend 1 charge: Test [willpower] (0). For each point you succeed by, gain 1 resource (to a maximum of 4). If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, take 1 damage.

all_card.name: 灵力风暴
all_card.text: 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。本次攻击你得到+2[willpower]。如果你检定成功，本次攻击不造成标准伤害，改为对受攻击敌人所在地点的每个敌人造成3点伤害(所有额外伤害只对被攻击敌人造成)。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，对受攻击敌人所在地点的每位调查员造成2点伤害。(FAQ v2.0)
all_card.real_text: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [willpower] for this attack. If you succeed, instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 3 damage to each enemy at the attacked enemy's location (any additional damage is dealt to the attacked enemy). If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token is revealed during this attack, deal 2 damage to each investigator at the attacked enemy's location.

all_card.name: 提灯
all_card.text: [action]：调查。本次调查你所在地点的隐藏值-1。 [action]弃掉提灯：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害(或将提灯从游戏中移除，改为造成2点伤害)。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
all_card.real_text: [action]: Investigate. Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation. [action] Discard Lantern: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location (or remove Lantern from the game to deal 2 damage, instead). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

all_card.flavor: 我知道我不应该再挖了，但我就是停不下来。
all_card.name: 挖墓人的铲子
all_card.text: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。 [action]弃掉挖墓人的铲子：发现你所在地点的1个线索(或将挖墓人的铲子从游戏中移除，改为发现2个线索)。
all_card.traits: 道具. 工具. 武器. 近战
all_card.real_flavor: I knew I should have, but I couldn't stop digging.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. [action] Discard Gravedigger's Shovel: Discover 1 clue at your location (or remove Gravedigger's Shovel from the game to discover 2 clues, instead).

all_card.back_flavor: 站在陌生人面前时，你能感觉到他那苍白而没有表情的面具下，他在咧齿狞笑。“人都去哪儿了？”你问道，但他没有作答。“到底怎么回事？”他仍然一语不发，你步步逼近，他步步后退，直到他的后背贴到房间的角落。突然，他的身体溶解成一团银色的雾气漩涡，猛地撞向你，将你掀翻在地，随即盘旋着掠过你身侧，弥散在空气之中。
all_card.back_text: 不弃掉苍白面具下的男子，改为将他移动到前厅。 在混乱袋里加入1个[cultist]标记和1个[tablet]标记。 在后台上放置1点恐惧。直到冒险结束，地点上的恐惧代表蔓延的迷雾，每个带有恐惧的地点获得：“强制 - 在你将要离开本地点时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，你必须取消本次移动的效果，或在完成移动效果后失去所有剩余行动并结束你的回合。” 将本卡牌放在场景牌库旁作为提示，并推进到场景3a。
all_card.flavor: 《黄衣之王》里这个神秘的陌生人可能知道幕间休息时发生了什么。要发掘真相，你必须找到他，和他当面对质。
all_card.name: 陌生人
all_card.text: 目标 - 在苍白面具下的男子将要从场上弃掉时，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you face off with the Stranger, you get the sense that he is grinning beneath his pale, faceless mask. "Where is everyone?" you ask, but he does not respond. "What is going on?" He remains silent and steps back as you approach, until his back is against the corner of the room. Suddenly, his body dissolves into a vortex of silvery mist, which slams into your body and knocks you to the floor before whirling past you and spreading into the air.
all_card.real_back_text: Instead of discarding The Man in the Pallid Mask, move him to the Lobby. Add 1 [cultist] and 1 [tablet] token to the chaos bag. Place 1 horror on Backstage. Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents the creeping mist, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - When you would leave this location: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must either cancel the effects of the move or lose all remaining actions and end your turn after completing the effects of the move." Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.
all_card.real_flavor: The mysterious Stranger from The King in Yellow might know something about what happened during the intermission. You must find and confront him if you are to discover the truth.
all_card.real_text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: “啊，这不是我们最后的客人嘛。”门口的侍者通报说，“迪瓦恩小姐，您的贵客终于到了。”这个女子身着暴露的连衣裙，露出媚艳的笑容。你发誓曾经见过她护身符上的符号。“噢，现在真正的晚宴终于可以开始了。”说着，她就前去招待其他宴会的宾客了。
all_card.back_text:
找出线索最少的[[旁人]]支援(在有至少1个线索的[[旁人]]支援中)。将放在一边的黛安娜·迪瓦恩生成在该支援所在地点。
将遭遇弃牌堆和令人震惊的一幕洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你走近庄园时，才发现有些不对劲。门廊的台阶上拖出了一条血迹，前门也被砸开了。屋内传来微弱的音乐，那扭曲而不和谐的音符刺痛着你的双耳。难道《黄衣之王》的疯狂已经蔓延到了这里？
all_card.name: 宁缺毋迟
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Ah, if it isn't our final guest," the doorman announces. "Miss Devine, your presence here has been long awaited." The woman wears a devilish dress and similar grin. You swear you've seen the symbol on her amulet before. "Well, now the real party can begin," she declares, then heads off to mingle with the other party-goers.
all_card.real_back_text:
Find the [[Bystander]] asset with the fewest clues on it (among [[Bystander]] assets with at least one clue). Spawn the set-aside Dianne Devine asset at that asset's location.
Shuffle Shocking Display into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: As you pull up to the manor, you notice that something is wrong. A trail of blood leads up the porch steps, and the front door is smashed. Muted music comes from within the house, its warped and discordant notes painful to your ears. Has the madness of <u>The King in Yellow</u> already made its way here?

all_card.flavor: "真高興再次見到你。"身穿黃色長裙的女子溫柔而安靜地對另一名賓客說道，就好像多年未見的老友一般。黛安娜的聲音最初很讓人放鬆，但其下似乎潛伏著什麼暗流——一些原始而險惡的東西。"我相信你有好好守住我們的承諾吧？"你沒有聽清回答，但黛安娜的微笑轉變成咧嘴狂笑。她的皮膚開始冒泡沸騰，就像表皮下面有什麼東西藏著，威脅著要逃跑。"噢，這樣嗎？"她直直地轉向你，眼裡閃耀著怒火。"這。樣。嗎。"
all_card.name: 黛安娜·迪瓦恩
all_card.text: 猎物 - 线索最多。 猎手。 黛安娜·迪瓦恩得到+3[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 任意调查员执行谈判行动后：黛安娜·迪瓦恩朝该调查员移动一次。
all_card.real_flavor: “It’s so good to see you again.” The woman in the yellow dress speaks fondly and quietly to one of the other VIPs, like they are old friends just seeing each other for the first time in years. Dianne’s voice is soothing at first, but there lies within it an undercurrent of something else - something primal, something menacing. “I trust you have held fast to our promise?” You don’t catch their reply, but Dianne’s smile spreads into a manic grin. Her skin begins to bubble and boil as though there is something hidden beneath the surface, threatening to escape. “Oh, is that so?” She turns directly toward you, her eyes ablaze with fury. “Is. That. So.”
all_card.real_text:
Each investigator at Dianne Devine's location takes 1 horror.
Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the asset version of Dianne Devine, removing that version from the game.

all_card.name: 疯狂的宾客
all_card.text: 猎手。 [action]：谈判。检定[intellect](4)。如果你检定成功，你设法与其交谈了一小会；自动躲避疯狂的宾客。如果你检定失败，你说的话被当作了耳旁风。
all_card.real_text:
If there are no Party Guests in play, place this card back underneath the scenario reference card and randomly choose a new Sickening Reality card to resolve. Otherwise, read the following:
A chorus of laughter erupts nearby as one of the guests dances to the bizarre music. You head over to discover what is so funny, but what you find is no laughing matter at all. The guest’s dance partner lies sprawled on the floor, limp and bloodied, a gaping, gory hole in their chest. The guest turns to you with a disturbing look in their eye and a wicked grin spreading on their lips.
Choose a Party Guest in play. Each investigator at that Party Guest's location takes 1 damage. Place 1 doom on the current agenda. Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the chosen version of Party Guest, removing that version from the game.
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 附身
