all_card.text:
如果场上没有宴会宾客，将本卡牌放回冒险参考卡牌下方，然后随机选择一张新的令人作呕的现实卡牌结算。否则，阅读下列内容：
在一位宾客随着怪异的音乐起舞时，近旁爆发出哄堂大笑。你走过去想看看是什么这么好笑，但眼前的景象绝非玩笑。那名宾客的舞伴瘫倒在地，四肢无力，浑身是血，胸口有一个血淋淋的大洞。宾客转过身来，望着你的眼神叫人不安，嘴角缓缓咧开一个邪恶的笑容。
选择场上一个宴会宾客。 位于该宴会宾客所在地点的每位调查员受到1点伤害。 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。 将本卡牌翻至敌人面，并将其与所选版本的宴会宾客切换，将该版本从游戏中移除。
all_card.traits: 類人. 怪物. 狂人
all_card.real_text: Hunter. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, you manage to get through to them for just a moment; automatically evade Crazed Guest. If you fail, your words fall on deaf ears.

all_card.name: 黛安娜·迪瓦恩
all_card.text: 位于黛安娜·迪瓦恩所在地点的每位调查员不能发现或控制线索。 强制 - 当敌军阶段开始时：找出线索最少的[[旁人]]支援(在有至少1个线索的[[旁人]]支援中)。如可能，将黛安娜·迪瓦恩移动到该支援所在地点。
all_card.real_text: Each investigator at Dianne Devine's location cannot discover or take control of clues. Forced - At the beginning of the enemy phase: Find the [[Bystander]] asset with the fewest clues on it (among [[Bystander]] assets with at least one clue). Move Dianne Devine to that asset's location, if able.

all_card.name: 宴会宾客
all_card.text: 显现 - 找出线索最多的[[旁人]]支援，将宴会宾客放置入场，放到该支援所在地点。 位于宴会宾客所在地点的调查员不能与[[旁人]]支援谈判。 [action]花费2资源：谈判。将宴会宾客移动到一个连接地点。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Find the [[Bystander]] asset with the most clues on it, and put Party Guest into play at that asset's location. Investigators cannot parley with [[Bystander]] assets at Party Guest's location. [action] Spend 2 resources: Parley. Move Party Guest to a connecting location.

all_card.name: 令人震惊的一幕
all_card.text: 显现 - 结算冒险参考卡牌底下的随机一张令人作呕的现实卡牌。不能被取消。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Randomly resolve one of the Sickening Reality cards underneath the scenario reference card. Cannot be canceled.

all_card.back_text:
- 在将地点放置入场时，将全部3张宁静的走廊与剩余8张历史协会地点一同放置入场。(3张[[地下室]]地点应在3张[[一楼]]地点下方排成一行。) - 将两张誓约看守人敌人放在一边，位于场外。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “强制 - 在调查员推进到场景2或场景3后：将放在一边的一个誓约看守人生成在任意无人历史协会地点。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返往事回声
all_card.text: 遵循卡尔克萨之路的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返往事回声找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 随机选择一张[[地下室]]历史协会地点从游戏中移除，不要查看它的已揭示面。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- When putting locations into play, put all 3 copies of Quiet Halls into play, along with the remaining 8 Historical Society locations. (The 3 [[basement]] locations should be placed to form a bottom row below the 3 [[ground floor]] locations.) - Set both Keeper of the Oath enemies aside, out of play.
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rule applies: "Forced - After the investigators advance to act 2 or act 3: Spawn a set-aside Keeper of the Oath in any empty Historical Society location." Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_name: Return to Echoes of the Past
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Echoes of the Past shown here. - Randomly choose one [[Basement]] Historical Society location and remove it from the game, without looking at its revealed side. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你向下步入协会深处的地下室，脚步声在石地板上空洞地回荡。
all_card.back_text: 宁静的走廊与其他每个[[地下室]]地点连接。
all_card.name: 宁静的走廊
all_card.text: 宁静的走廊与其他每个[[地下室]]地点连接。 [action]如果场上每个地点均已揭示，且场上所有地点上均没有线索：在宁静的走廊上放置1[per_investigator]个线索(从供应堆拿取)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your footsteps echo off the stone floor as you descend into the basement below the manor.
all_card.real_back_text:
Entry Hall is connected to Quiet Halls.
Quiet Halls is connected to each other [[Basement]] location.
all_card.real_text: Entry Hall is connected to Quiet Halls. Quiet Halls is connected to each other [[Basement]] location. [action] If each location in play is revealed and there are no clues on locations in play: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues on Quiet Halls (from the token bank).

all_card.back_flavor: 朴素的木门后是历史协会地下室的某间房间。
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 在敌人生成在本地点时：揭示本地点。
all_card.name: 历史协会
all_card.text: 你有至少1张隐私卡牌在手牌中时，你不能调查本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: An unadorned wooden door leads to one of the basement rooms used by the Historical Society.
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
all_card.real_text: While you have at least 1 hidden card in your hand, you cannot investigate this location.

all_card.back_flavor: 朴素的木门后是历史协会地下室的某间房间。
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 在敌人生成在本地点时：揭示本地点。
all_card.name: 历史协会
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你调查本地点时，如果场上有至少1个[[异教徒]]敌人：本次调查本地点的隐藏值-3。如果揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，将本地点的1个线索移动到离你最远的[[异教徒]]敌人上(在结算检定效果前)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: An unadorned wooden door leads to one of the basement rooms used by the Historical Society.
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you investigate this location, if there is at least 1 [[Cultist]] enemy in play: This location gets -3 shroud for this investigation. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, move 1 clue from this location to the [[Cultist]] enemy farthest from you (before resolving the effects of the test).

all_card.back_flavor: 朴素的木门后是历史协会地下室的某间房间。
all_card.back_text: 强制 - 在敌人生成在本地点时：揭示本地点。
all_card.name: 历史协会
all_card.text: 强制 - 你发现本地点的1个或更多线索后：一次一张，从遭遇牌库顶抽取等量的卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: An unadorned wooden door leads to one of the basement rooms used by the Historical Society.
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
all_card.flavor: 樸素的木門後是歷史協會地下室的某間房間。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: One at a time, draw that many cards from the top of the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 誓约看守人
all_card.text: 当前场景编号大于当前密谋编号时，誓约看守人获得猎手。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：找出每位所在地点与誓约看守人所在地点有相同[[特性]]的调查员。将这些调查员的各1个线索移动到誓约看守人上。
all_card.real_text: While the number of the current act is greater than the number of the current agenda, Keeper of the Oath gains hunter. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Find each investigator whose location shares a [[Trait]] with Keeper of the Oath's location. Move 1 clue from each of those investigators to Keeper of the Oath.

all_card.back_text: - 将疯狂之主敌人和根除疗法诡计卡放在一边，位于场外。 - 在决定使用哪个版本的场景2时，不要遵循原版的执行设置。改为将原版的场景2从游戏中移除，并检查剧本日志。如果你的确信高于(或等于)疑惑，使用新的场景2——真正可怕的人(版本三)。如果你的疑惑高于确信，使用新的场景2——真正可怕的人(版本四)。
all_card.name: 重返邪秽誓约
all_card.text: 遵循卡尔克萨之路的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返邪秽誓约找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text: - Set the Host of Insanity enemy and the Radical Treatment treachery aside, out of play. - When determining which version of act 2 to use, do not follow the original setup instructions. Instead, remove the original versions of act 2 from the game, and check the Campaign Log. If you have more (or equal) Conviction than Doubt, use the new Act 2 - "The Really Bad Ones" (v. III). If you have more Doubt than Conviction, use the new Act 2 - "The Really Bad Ones" (v. IV).
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Unspeakable Oath shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你走进丹尼尔的囚室，发现他蜷缩在房间的一个角落里，一边抽泣，一边摇晃着身子。“不要面具，不要面具……”他反复嘟囔着。你搀扶他起身，问他是否还记得有关《黄衣之王》的事情，但他打断了你。“我早就告诉过你了！”他疯狂地大叫，瞪大的双眼中泛出了黄色的光泽。“你不记得了吗？你上次来这儿的时候？”他的话意义不明。你只不过刚刚才到这儿……不是吗？“不、不、不……”男子结结巴巴地说着，向后摔回房间角落那张肮脏的小床上。“永远不会结束。这一切永远不会结束，除非他不再出现，而只要你们在这里，他就永远不会离开！让我出去！我想要离开——”丹尼尔尖声求救，但唯一回应他的只有突然从他床下出现的生物。在你做出反应前，它的卷须已经裹住了丹尼尔的身体，将他整个吞噬了。他最后的尖叫只化为了那个生物巨大身体里的一声闷响。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的疯狂之主生成在病人拘禁室(丹尼尔的囚室)。将遭遇弃牌堆和场景牌库下的每张敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 丹尼尔和其他一些最危险的病人都被关在地下室的禁闭区里。现在你手握地下室钥匙，可以前去一探究竟了。
all_card.name: 真正可怕的人(版本三)
all_card.text: 忽略[[阿卡姆疯人院]]地点未揭示面上的文字。 目标 - 找到关着丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德的病人拘禁室地点。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When you enter his cell, you find Daniel huddled in a corner of the room, sobbing and rocking back and forth on the ground. “No mask, no mask…” he stammers over and over. You help him to his feet and ask him what he remembers about The King in Yellow, but he interrupts you. “I already told you!” he exclaims frantically, his eyes wide with a yellow glow. “Don’t you remember? The last time you came here?” His words make no sense. You’ve only just arrived here…haven’t you? “No, no, no…” The man stammers, falling backward onto the dirty cot in the corner of his room. “It will never end. It will never end until HE is gone for good, and he will never be gone so long as you are here! Get me out! I want out-” Daniel screams for help, but the only response is the creature that suddenly emerges from beneath his cot. Before you can react, its tendrils have wrapped around his body, devouring him whole. His final screams are muffled by the creature’s enormity.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Host of Insanity at Patient Confinement (Daniel's Cell). Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each enemy beneath the act deck into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: Daniel is somewhere in the secured basement where the most dangerous patients are kept. Now that you have the key, you can explore this area of the asylum.
all_card.real_text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你走进丹尼尔的囚室，发现他坐在椅子上，面对着房间的一个角落。他正在墙上潦草地写着什么，他的表情非常平静。不，并不是平静——是几乎完全没有任何情感。你询问他对黄衣之王的了解，他虽然没有说话，但你注意到他将回答写在了墙上：“我们都知道会有什么下场。”惊愕之下，你检查了房间的其他地方。墙上还有一些类似的语句：“你早已知道誓约。”“代价已经支付。”“通道已开启了一次又一次。”这些看着都没有任何意义，但你的直觉告诉你这些信息中蕴含的更多是真相而不是疯言疯语。你扶起丹尼尔，试着把他带出房间，你希望你能帮他点什么。
all_card.back_text: 选择位于病人拘禁室(丹尼尔的囚室)的一位调查员。将放在一边的丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德卡牌(支援面朝上)放置入场，放到该调查员的控制之下。然后，将放在一边的根除疗法诡计卡附属到丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德。 将遭遇弃牌堆和场景牌库底下的每张敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 丹尼尔和其他一些最危险的病人都被关在地下室的禁闭区里。现在你手握地下室钥匙，可以前去一探究竟了。
all_card.name: 真正可怕的人(版本四)
all_card.text: 忽略[[阿卡姆疯人院]]地点未揭示面上的文字。 目标 - 找到关着丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德的病人拘禁室地点。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When you enter Daniel’s cell, you see him sitting on a chair facing the corner of his room. He is scrawling something on the wall, his expression calm. No, not calm - almost devoid of emotion entirely. You ask him what he knows of The King in Yellow, and though he does not speak, you spot his reply written on the wall: “We both know how this ends.” Dumbfounded, you check the rest of his room. There are similar messages along the wall: “You already know of the oath,” “The price has been paid,” “The path has been opened again and again.” None of it makes any sense, but your instincts warn you there is more truth in these messages than there is lunacy. You help Daniel to his feet and try to usher him out of the room, hoping there is something you can do to help him.
all_card.real_back_text: Choose an investigator at Patient Confinement (Daniel's Cell). Put the set-aside Daniel Chesterfield card (asset side faceup) into play under that investigator's control. Then, attach the set-aside Radical Treatment treachery to Daniel Chesterfield. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each enemy beneath the act deck into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: Daniel is somewhere in the secured basement where the most dangerous patients are kept. Now that you have the key, you can explore this area of the asylum.
all_card.real_text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)

all_card.name: 疯狂之主
all_card.text: 庞大。猎手。 疯狂之主得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 [action]如果你控制黑玛瑙扣环：谈判。你向这个生物展示扣环。它停滞在原地，低语着混乱的祷言。自动躲避疯狂之主。
all_card.real_text: Massive. Hunter. Host of Insanity gets +2 [per_investigator] health. [action] If you control Clasp of Black Onyx: Parley. You reveal the clasp to the creature. It freezes in place, whispering a garbled prayer. Automatically evade Host of Insanity.

all_card.name: 根除疗法
all_card.text: 强制 - 当一轮结束时：丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德的控制者受到2点恐惧。 [action]如果你位于医务室：检定[willpower]或[intellect](6)。如果你检定成功，根除疗法解除附属并将其加入胜利区。如果你控制黑玛瑙扣环，本次检定难度-3。
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the round: Daniel Chesterfield's controller takes 2 horror. [action] If you are at Infirmary: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (6). If you succeed, detach Radical Treatment and add it to the victory display. If you control Clasp of Black Onyx, reduce the difficulty of this test by 3.

all_card.name: 朦胧记忆
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 忘记一位调查员通过一个地点上的能力“记住”的事。(这个条件不再达成)。 - 受到1点恐惧且朦胧记忆获得涌动。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Forget something an investigator has "remembered" from an ability on a location. (It is no longer true.) - Take 1 horror and Clouded Memory gains surge.

all_card.back_text:
……2张圣马丁运河地点中选择1张，2张巴黎圣母院地点中选择1张，2张卢森堡公园地点中选择1张。将所选地点放置入场。将这些地点的其他版本从游戏中移除。 - 将两张影中身形放在一边，位于场外。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “强制 - 在风琴手入场后：将遭遇弃牌堆和放在一边的两张影中身形洗入遭遇牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返真相幻影
all_card.text: 遵循卡尔克萨之路的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返真相幻影找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 随机从2张蒙巴纳斯地点中选择1张，2张大木偶剧场地点中选择1张，2张拉雪兹神父公墓地点中选择1张…… (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
...1 of the 2 Canal Saint-Martin locations, 1 of the 2 Notre-Dame locations, and 1 of the 2 Gardens of Luxembourg locations. Put those locations into play. Remove the other versions of those locations from the game. - Set both copies of Figure in the Shadows aside, out of play.
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rules apply: "Forced - After The Organist enters play: Shuffle both set-aside copies of Figure in the Shadows into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile." Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_name: Return to A Phantom of Truth
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to A Phantom of Truth shown here. - Randomly choose 1 of the 2 Montparnasse locations, 1 of the 2 Grand Guignol locations, 1 of the 2 Père Lachaise Cemetery locations... (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: 这个街区以其咖啡馆和酒吧著称，也是穷困潦倒的艺术家经常光顾的地方。说不定哪一天，这里某个天才艺术家还能名扬四海。但你清楚，大部分只会默默无名。
all_card.name: 蒙巴纳斯
all_card.text: 强制 - 你发现蒙巴纳斯任意数量的线索后：弃掉你至少总计带有等量[willpower]图标的手牌。如果你不能这么做，改为受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: This area is known for its cafés and bars, and is often frequented by starving artists. Perhaps some of these creative types will become famous someday. Most, you assume, will fade into obscurity.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discover any number of clues from Montparnasse: Discard cards from your hand with that many [willpower] icons among them. If you cannot, take 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 大木偶剧场的恐怖剧特别有名，这里的演出生动，有时甚至有违人伦。它坐落在巴黎一条著名的小道上。
all_card.flavor: 似乎最近剧院在上演一出有关疯狂的戏剧。你不禁好奇这里是不是也上演过《黄衣之王》。
all_card.name: 大木偶剧场
all_card.text: [action]花费5资源：在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记，或从当前密谋上移除1个毁灭标记。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Le Théâtre du Grand-Guignol specializes in horror shows of a graphic and sometimes amoral nature. It is among the smallest venues in Paris, and one of the most popular.
all_card.real_flavor: It seems the theatre is performing a show about insanity. You wonder if they have ever performed <u>The King in Yellow</u>.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 5 resources: Either place 1 doom on the current agenda, or remove 1 doom from the current agenda. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 拉雪兹神父公墓是巴黎最大的公墓，同时也是城里第一座公园墓地，这里风景优美，但也阴森恐怖。
all_card.flavor: 石子铺成的小路蜿蜒曲折，连接着成排的墓穴和数不清的陵墓。密集的墓地纵横交错，在死者的包围中，你陷入了淡淡的忧伤。
all_card.name: 拉雪兹神父公墓
all_card.text: 强制 - 在一个敌人移动进入拉雪兹神父公墓后：其得到+1恐惧值，直到本轮结束。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The largest cemetery in Paris, and its first garden cemetery, Père Lachaise is as beautiful as it is haunting.
all_card.real_flavor: Paths of stone wind through rows of graves and countless mausoleums. The dense, twisting cemetery has you trapped in a state of melanchoy, surrounded by death on all sides.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After an enemy moves into Père Lachaise Cemetery: It gets +1 horror value for the remainder of the round.

all_card.back_flavor: 这条地下运河连通了塞纳河与乌尔克运河。一道古老开裂的楼梯通向下面的运河入口。
all_card.name: 圣马丁运河
all_card.text: 你位于圣马丁运河时，你必须用你的[combat]代替你的[agility]，反之亦然。
all_card.real_back_flavor: This underground canal connects the river Seine to the Canal de l’Ourcq. An old, cracked staircase leads down to the canal’s entrance.
all_card.real_text: While you are at Canal Saint-Martin, you must use your [combat] in place of your [agility], and vice versa.

all_card.back_flavor: Notre-Dame de Paris在法语中的意思为“我们巴黎的圣母”，这里是全市最为著名的大教堂，它不仅是这座城市的名片，也是全世界哥特式建筑的标志。彩色的玻璃窗后透出了灯光，你可以听到教堂内有管风琴高声演奏着古怪混乱的旋律。
all_card.name: 巴黎圣母院
all_card.text:
位于巴黎圣母院的每个敌人得到+1攻击与-1躲避。
[reaction]在你成功躲避位于巴黎圣母院的一名敌人且至少超过难度3点后：你本回合可以进行额外1次行动。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The most famous cathedral in all of Paris, and one of the finest examples of gothic architecture in the world, Notre-Dame de Paris - “Our Lady of Paris” - is an icon of the city. Light shines out from its stained glass windows, and you can hear a pipe organ inside blaring a bizarre, chaotic melody.
all_card.real_text:
Each enemy at Notre-Dame gets +1 fight and -1 evade.
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy at Notre-Dame by 3 or more during your turn: You may take an additional action this turn. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 卢森堡宫的公园中散落着数以百计的雕像、纪念碑和喷泉。可惜你来这里是为了躲避夜空中尖叫飞翔着的怪物，要是换一个情况，这里应该是休闲散步的好地方。
all_card.name: 卢森堡公园
all_card.text: 强制 - 你进入卢森堡公园后，如果场上有至少1个[[拜亚基]]敌人：从混乱袋中随机揭示一个标记。如果揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，将场上每个[[拜亚基]]敌人重整并移动到卢森堡公园。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The gardens of Luxembourg Palace contain hundreds of scattered statues, monuments, and fountains. It would make for a relaxing walk if you hadn’t come here to escape the winged creatures that screech and soar in the dark sky overhead.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Gardens of Luxembourg, if there is at least 1 [[Byakhee]] enemy in play: Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, each [[Byakhee]] enemy in play readies and moves to Gardens of Luxembourg.

all_card.name: 影中身形
all_card.text: 显现 - 检查剧本日志。 - 如果你的疑惑高于(或等于)确信，将其朝着远离最近的调查员的方向移动1个地点(如可能，移动到一个没有调查员的地点)。 - 如果你的确信高于疑惑，结算风琴手的猎手关键词。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Check Campaign Log. - If you have more (or equal) Doubt than Conviction, move The Organist 1 location away from the nearest investigator (to a location with no investigators, if possible). - If you have more Conviction than Doubt, resolve The Organist's hunter keyword.

all_card.back_text:
- 接着，随机选择4张地下墓穴地点，并将其从游戏中移除，不要查看。
- 按照常规设置创建地下墓穴剩余部分。
<hr>本场冒险期间，加入以下规则：
“结算尸体寄居者的生成能力时，苍白面具下的男子不视为[[类人]]敌人。
当前场景为场景2时，苍白面具下的男子不能离开暗影坟墓。”
将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返苍白面具
all_card.text: 遵循卡尔克萨之路的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返苍白面具找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 在创建地下墓穴牌库时，首先按照常规设置将暗影坟墓和堵塞通道放在一边。 - 接着，将本遭遇组中4张新的地下墓穴地点与剩余地下墓穴地点放在一起，按照常规设置决定你的起始地点。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- Next, randomly choose 4 Catacombs locations and remove them from the game, without looking at them.
- Build the remainder of the Catacombs deck as normal.
<hr>For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rules apply:
"For the purposes of Corpse Dweller's spawn ability, The Man in the Pallid Mask does not count as a [[Humanoid]] enemy.
While it is act 2, The Man in the Pallid Mask cannot leave the Tomb of Shadows."
Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter set for Return to The Pallid Mask shown here. - When building the Catacombs deck, first set aside the Tomb of Shadows and the Blocked Passage, as normal. - Next, add the 4 new Catacombs locations included in this encounter set with the remaining Catacombs locations, and determine your starting location, as normal. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: 宽敞的走廊两边装饰着大量头骨和尸骨，显得异常恐怖。
all_card.back_text: 作为你进入地下墓穴的额外费用，你所在地点的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.name: 秘密通道
all_card.text: [action]如果你控制黑玛瑙扣环：你将扣环放入头骨的眼窝，通道开启了。揭示秘密通道右方的地下墓穴地点。 强制 - 在秘密通道揭示时：将地下墓穴牌库顶的1张地下墓穴放置入场，放在秘密通道的右方。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Skulls and bones decorate the walls of this wide hallway in a macabre fashion.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter Catacombs, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_text: [action] If you control Clasp of Black Onyx: You place the clasp within the skull's eye socket, and the passage opens. Reveal the Catacombs location to the right of Secret Passage. Forced - When Secret Passage is revealed: Put the topmost Catacombs in the Catacombs deck into play to the right of Secret Passage.

all_card.back_flavor: 寬敞的走廊兩邊裝飾著大量頭骨和屍骨，顯得異常恐怖。
all_card.back_text: 你所在地點的調查員必須以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]線索作為進入地下墓穴的額外費用。
all_card.name: 骸骨堆
all_card.text: 强制 - 在骸骨堆揭示时：将地下墓穴牌库顶的4张地下墓穴放置入场，分别放在白骨迷阵的上方、下方、左方和右方。当本轮结束时，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个畸形骸骨敌人并将其生成在骸骨堆。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Skulls and bones decorate the walls of this wide hallway in a macabre fashion.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter Catacombs, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When Mound of Bones is revealed: Put the top 4 Catacombs in the Catacombs deck into play above, below, to the left, and to the right of Mound of Bones. At the end of the current round, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Malformed Skeleton and spawn it at Mound of Bones.

all_card.back_flavor: 寬敞的走廊兩邊裝飾著大量頭骨和屍骨，顯得異常恐怖。
all_card.back_text: 你所在地點的調查員必須以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]線索作為進入地下墓穴的額外費用。
all_card.name: 研究站点
all_card.text: [reaction]在你成功调查研究站点后：揭示任意一个地下墓穴地点。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。) 强制 - 在研究站点揭示时：将地下墓穴牌库顶的1张地下墓穴放置入场，放在任意一个其他地点的上方、下方或右方。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Skulls and bones decorate the walls of this wide hallway in a macabre fashion.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter Catacombs, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate Research Site: Reveal any Catacombs location. (Group limit once per game.) Forced - When Research Site is revealed: Put the topmost Catacombs in the Catacombs deck into play above, below, or to the right of any other location.

all_card.back_flavor: 寬敞的走廊兩邊裝飾著大量頭骨和屍骨，顯得異常恐怖。
all_card.back_text: 你所在地點的調查員必須以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]線索作為進入地下墓穴的額外費用。
all_card.name: 颅骨之海
all_card.text: 强制 - 在颅骨之海揭示时：将地下墓穴牌库顶的1张地下墓穴放置入场，放在离颅骨之海最远的地点的上方、下方或右方，并在其上放置1点恐惧标记。直到冒险结束，颅骨之海与标记地点互相连接。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Skulls and bones decorate the walls of this wide hallway in a macabre fashion.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter Catacombs, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you end your turn at Sea of Skulls: You must either take 1 direct horror or choose and discard 3 cards from your hand. Forced - When Sea of Skulls is revealed: Put the topmost Catacombs in the Catacombs deck into play above, below, or to the right of the location farthest from Sea of Skulls and mark it with a horror token. For the remainder of the game, Sea of Skulls is connected to the marked location.

all_card.name: 畸形骸骨
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在畸形骸骨将要结算其猎手关键词时：如果其2个地点内没有调查员，不结算其猎手关键词，改为将其移动到离调查员最近的地下墓穴地点。 强制 - 在畸形骸骨攻击你时：它会造成伤害或恐惧，而不是两者同时。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When Malformed Skeleton would resolve its hunter keyword: If there are no investigators within 2 locations of Malformed Skeleton, instead of resolving its hunter keyword, move it to the Catacombs location nearest to an investigator. Forced - When Malformed Skeleton attacks you: It deals either its damage or its horror, instead of both.

all_card.back_text: - 根据已揭示面的遭遇组图标，将回廊和骑士大厅分为两组。一组为原版的回廊和骑士大厅，一组为本扩展的新版本。然后将它们都翻到背面，只能看到黑星升起的遭遇组图标。将这两组牌随机打乱直到你无法分辨它们属于原版或新版。随机选择一组从游戏中移除，另一组在冒险设置时使用。
all_card.name: 重返黑星升起
all_card.text: 遵循卡尔克萨之路的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返黑星升起找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text: - Sort each copy of Cloister and Knight's Hall into two piles, based on the encounter set icon on their reverse side. One pile should consist of the original versions of Cloister and Knight's Hall, the other should consist of the new versions included in this encounter set. Flip each pile over so only the Black Stars Rise encounter set icon is showing. Randomize the two piles so you cannot tell which is which. Choose one pile at random to remove from the game and one pile at random to use throughout this scenario's setup.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Black Stars Rise shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: 回廊上空荡荡的，平时这里只对寺院的僧侣和宗教领袖开放，但眼下修道院里看来空无一人，你没花什么功夫就偷偷溜了进去。
all_card.flavor: 一个僧侣在长廊上孤独地徘徊。嘴里默默念着祷文。他的腰带上挂着一大串铜钥匙。
all_card.name: 回廊
all_card.text: [action]如果回廊没有线索：谈判。检定[willpower]或[intellect](4)。如果你检定成功，记住你“找到了塔楼的钥匙”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The open arcade of the cloister is normally restricted to the monastery’s monks and religious leaders, but with the abbey seemingly abandoned, it takes little effort for you to sneak your way in.
all_card.real_flavor: A lone monk patrols the covered walk, surrounding himself in whispered prayer. A large ringe of brass keys hangs from the sash around his waist.
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Cloister: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, remember that you have "found the tower key."

all_card.back_flavor: 对称的石柱排列得整整齐齐，让这个大厅显得安宁而恬静，与屋外的滔天洪水形成了强烈的对比。
all_card.flavor: 你听到附近的一扇门砰砰作响，有个修道院的僧侣正试图逃离外面的毁灭。“让我进去！”他惊慌失措地喊道。“拜托，我求求你！”
all_card.name: 骑士大厅
all_card.text: [action]如果骑士大厅没有线索：谈判。检定[combat]或[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，记住你“找到了一个向导”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Rows of symmetrical stone pillars give this hall a sense of calm serenity that clashes with the torrent outside.
all_card.real_flavor: You hear pounding on a nearby door, as one of the abbey's monks tries to escape the destruction outside. "Let me in!" he cries, panicked. "Please, I beg you!"
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Knight's Hall: Test [combat] or [agility] (3). If you succeed, remember that you have "found a guide."

all_card.name: 哈斯塔的凝视
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将哈斯塔的凝视秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 有毁灭标记放置到“c”密谋牌库后：受到2点恐惧并从你手牌中弃掉哈斯塔的凝视。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Hastur's Gaze to your hand. Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on the "c" agenda: Take 2 horror and discard Hastur's Gaze from your hand.

all_card.name: 哈斯塔的抓攫
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将哈斯塔的抓攫秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 有毁灭标记放置到“a”密谋牌库后：受到2点伤害并从你手牌中弃掉哈斯塔的抓攫。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Hastur's Grasp to your hand. Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on the "a" agenda: Take 2 damage and discard Hastur's Grasp from your hand.

all_card.back_text:
- 将原版的王之宫殿地点从游戏中移除，使用本扩展新版的王之宫殿(哈斯塔的领域)地点替换，然后按照常规进行地点设置。 - 将以下地点放在一边，位于场外：你的内心深处、王座之间和沃德剧院舞台。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “除非有调查员‘知道了秘密’，否则哈斯塔的生命值不能低于2[per_investigator]点。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返卡城幽影
all_card.text: 遵循卡尔克萨之路的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返卡城幽影找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- Remove the original Palace of the King location from the game and replace it with the new Palace of the King (Hastur's Domain). Proceed with location setup as normal. - Set the following new locations aside, out of play: Recesses of Your Own Mind, The Throne Room, and Stage of the Ward Theatre.
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rules apply: "Hastur's health cannot be reduced to less than 2 [per_investigator] unless any investigator 'knows the secret.'" Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Dim Carcosa shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.flavor:
我祈求上帝詛咒這個作者，就如同這個作者詛咒這個世界，這鴻篇巨制的詛咒是那麼美麗，簡樸得令人害怕，真切得讓人難以抗拒……
– “名譽修復師”，《黃衣之王》，羅伯特·W·錢伯斯著
all_card.name: 王之宮殿
all_card.text: 哈斯塔剩餘生命值多於2[per_investigator]時，王之宮殿不能翻面。
all_card.real_flavor:
I pray God will curse the writer, as the writer has cursed the world with this beautiful, stupendous creation, terrible in its simplicity, irresistible in its truth…
- Robert W. Chambers, “The Repairer of Reputations,” <u>The King in Yellow</u>
all_card.real_text: Palace of the King cannot be flipped over while Hastur has more than 2 [per_investigator] remaining health.

all_card.flavor:
你站在王的宫殿前。哈斯塔无休止的低语充斥着你的头脑，你无法将他荼毒的话语从你脑中赶走。看着眼前壮观而荣耀的宫殿，你意识到了它真正的本质。你知道自己必须要做什么了。
王宫的大门打开了。
all_card.name: 哈斯塔的终局
all_card.text: 检查剧本日志： - 如果在场的哈斯塔版本是哈斯塔(黄衣之王)：将放在一边的你的内心深处地点放置入场。 - 如果在场的哈斯塔版本是哈斯塔(卡尔克萨领主)：将放在一边的王座之间地点放置入场。将哈斯塔移动到王座之间。 - 如果在场的哈斯塔版本是哈斯塔(褴褛之王)：将放在一边的沃德剧院舞台地点放置入场。 将本卡牌翻面。直到游戏结束，它不能再次翻面。
all_card.real_flavor:
You stand before the palace of the King. Hastur’s incessant whispering fills your mind, and you find it difficult to block his poisonous words from your thoughts. Seeing the palace in all its spectacle and glory, you realize its true nature. You know now what you must do.
The doors to the palace open.
all_card.real_text: Check Campaign Log: - If Hastur (The King in Yellow) is the version of Hastur that is in play: Put the set-aside Recesses of Your Own Mind location into play. - If Hastur (Lord of Carcosa) is the version of Hastur that is in play: Put the set-aside The Throne Room location into play. Move Hastur to The Throne Room. - If Hastur (The Tattered King) is the version of Hastur that is in play: Put the set-aside Stage of the Ward Theatre location into play. Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.name: 你的内心深处
all_card.text:
你位于你的内心深处时，将你[willpower]的基础值设为0。
每位位于你的内心深处的调查员视为在不同的你的内心深处，此能力影响玩家卡牌效果或在其他人的技能检定中投入卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
While you are in the Recesses of Your Own Mind, set the base value of your [willpower] to 0.
Each investigator at Recesses of Your Own Mind is considered to be at a different copy of Recesses of Your Own Mind for the purposes of player card effects and committing cards to each other's skill tests.

all_card.flavor: 这一切皆由你所虚构，但这并不意味它不真实。正是创作者的意志赋予了它存在——笔锋划过，墨迹印于纸面。你体内蕴藏着改变自身命运的力量。你，是你自己结局的书写者。
all_card.name: 作者
all_card.text:
记住你“知道了秘密”。
将本卡牌翻面。直到游戏结束，它不能再次翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: You invented all of this, but that does not mean it is not real. It is the will of the Writer that makes it so. The stroke of a pen. The press of ink on paper. You hold within you the power to change your own fate. You are the author of your own demise.
all_card.real_text:
Remember that you "know the secret."
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.name: 王座之间
all_card.text:
哈斯塔不能离开王座之间。
哈斯塔不能被横置。
哈斯塔不能进行趁乱攻击。
all_card.real_text:
Hastur cannot leave The Throne Room.
Hastur cannot be exhausted.
Hastur cannot make attacks of opportunity.

all_card.flavor: 王与王座本是一回事。它既是他的权力之座，也是他的终焉之所。
all_card.name: 实体
all_card.text:
记住你“知道了秘密”。
将本卡牌翻面。直到游戏结束，它不能再次翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: The king and the throne are one and the same. It is his seat of power and his final resting place.
all_card.real_text:
Remember that you "know the secret."
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.name: 沃德剧院舞台
all_card.text:
哈斯塔移动时，如果有调查员位于沃德剧院舞台，哈斯塔所在地点视为与沃德剧院舞台连接。
你位于沃德剧院舞台时，你不能攻击哈斯塔。
all_card.real_text:
While Hastur is moving, if there is an investigator at Stage of the Ward Theatre, Hastur's location is considered to be connected to Stage of the Ward Theatre.
While you are at Stage of the Ward Theatre, you cannot attack Hastur.

all_card.flavor:
观众的掌声如雷鸣般响彻，经久不息。你的心中满溢着澎湃的喜悦和成就感。
演出必须继续。
all_card.name: 妄想
all_card.text:
记住你“知道了秘密”。
将本卡牌翻面。直到游戏结束，它不能再次翻面。
all_card.real_flavor:
The crowd’s applause is thundering. Ceaseless. Your heart is filled with overflowing joy and accomplishment.
The show must go on.
all_card.real_text:
Remember that you "know the secret."
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.name: 哈斯塔的高阶祭司
all_card.text: 生成 - 王之宫殿。 猎物 - 手牌最多。 猎手。 强制 - 在哈斯塔的高阶祭司攻击你时，如果你的手牌中有至少一张恶灵附身：将其揭示。哈斯塔的高阶祭司盛情邀请你加入王的圣列。你被击败且发疯。
all_card.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 精英
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Palace of the King. Prey - Most cards in hand. Hunter. Forced - When High Priest of Hastur attacks you, if you have a copy of Possession in your hand: Reveal it. The high priest welcomes you into the grand company of the King. You are eliminated and driven insane.

all_card.name: 虚妄之邪
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将虚妄之邪秘密加入你的手牌，或在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记并弃掉虚妄之邪(本效果可以导致当前密谋推进)。 强制 - 在你技能检定将要成功并超过难度3点或更多时：改为本次检定自动失败。弃掉你手牌中的虚妄之邪。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - You must either secretly add Delusory Evils to your hand, or place 1 doom on the current agenda and discard Delusory Evils (this effect may cause the current agenda to advance). Forced - When you would succeed at a skill test by 3 or more: You automatically fail, instead. Discard Delusory Evils from your hand.

all_card.name: 渗血墙壁
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](X)，其中X为你所在地点的隐藏值。如果你检定失败，失去1个行动并受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X). X is the shroud value of your location. If you fail, lose 1 action and take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 脆弱思绪
all_card.text: 显现 - 从你手牌中弃掉一定数量的事件卡牌，且这些卡牌上的印刷资源费用总计至少为X，其中X为你所在地点的隐藏值。如果没有因本效果弃掉卡牌，脆弱思绪获得涌动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Discard events from your hand with a total printed resource cost of at least X, where X is the shroud value of your location. If no cards are discarded by this effect, Fragile Thoughts gains surge.

all_card.name: 蛆群
all_card.text:
蛆群所在地点得到+2隐藏值。
蛆群所在地点没有线索时，其获得猎手。
all_card.real_text:
Maggot Swarm's location gets +2 shroud.
While Maggot Swarm is at a location with no clues, it gains hunter.

all_card.name: 猎食的拜亚基
all_card.text: 猎物 - 仅限剩余神智值最低。 猎手。 猎食的拜亚基与剩余神智值在4或以下的调查员交战时，交换猎食的拜亚基的攻击值和躲避值。
all_card.real_text: Prey - Lowest remaining sanity only. Hunter. While engaged with an investigator with remaining sanity 4 or fewer, swap Preying Byakhee's fight and evade values.

all_card.name: 哈斯塔的印记
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 将哈斯塔的印记附属到当前密谋或当前场景。 每个密谋或场景仅限1张。 强制 - 每次一位调查员受到1点或更多恐惧时：其受到额外1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Attach The Sign of Hastur to either the current agenda or the current act. Limit 1 per agenda/act. Forced - Each time an investigator takes 1 or more horror: He or she takes 1 additional horror.

all_card.name: 脑中幻象
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将本卡牌秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 在你的回合结束时，如果你没有在回合期间执行过至少1次打出行动：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌并受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. Forced - When your turn ends, if you did not perform at least 1 play action during your turn: Discard this card from your hand and take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror.

all_card.name: 脑中幻象
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将本卡牌秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 在你的回合结束时，如果你没有在回合期间执行过至少1次资源行动：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌并受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. Forced - When your turn ends, if you did not perform at least 1 resource action during your turn: Discard this card from your hand and take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror.

all_card.name: 脑中幻象
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将本卡牌秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 在你的回合结束时，如果你没有在回合期间执行过至少1次移动行动：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌并受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. Forced - When your turn ends, if you did not perform at least 1 move action during your turn: Discard this card from your hand and take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror.

all_card.name: 脑中幻象
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将本卡牌秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 在你的回合结束时，如果你没有在回合期间执行过至少1次抽取行动：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌并受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. Forced - When your turn ends, if you did not perform at least 1 draw action during your turn: Discard this card from your hand and take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror.

all_card.name: 发狂妄想
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 - 如果你手牌中有1张或更多隐私卡牌，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - If you have 1 or more hidden cards in your hand, take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 特鲁恩布拉之音
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须选择下列一个不同的选项： - 失去2资源。 - 受到1点恐惧。 - 本轮你的下一次技能检定得到-2。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must choose a different option: - Lose 2 resources. - Take 1 horror. - Get -2 to the next skill test you perform this round.

all_card.name: 忧郁
all_card.text: 显现 - 将忧郁放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你每张手牌的资源费用提升1点。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉忧郁。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Melancholy into play in your threat area. Increase the resource cost of each card in your hand by 1. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Melancholy.

all_card.name: 苦痛回响
all_card.text: 显现 - 将苦痛回响放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 在你打出事件时：从混乱袋中随机揭示一个标记。如果揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，取消该事件，受到1点恐惧，然后弃掉苦痛回响。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Painful Reflection into play in your threat area. Forced - When you play an event: Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it is a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token, cancel that event, take 1 horror, and discard Painful Reflection.

all_card.name: 星星·XVII
all_card.text:
你控制的每个有生命值的支援得到+1生命值。
你控制的每个有神智值的支援得到+1神智值。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果星星·XVII在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
all_card.real_text:
Each asset you control with health gets +1 health.
Each asset you control with sanity gets +1 sanity.
[reaction] When the game begins, if The Star • XVII is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

all_card.name: 圣化之镜
all_card.text: 每套牌库仅限一张。 [reaction]在你打出一张舒缓旋律时，将上面的所有的“2”改为“3”，或结算后不弃掉，改为将其洗回你的牌库。 强制 - 在圣化之镜入场后：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出3张舒缓旋律。将其中一张加入你手牌，将其余2张洗入你的牌库。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 密教. 祝福
all_card.real_text: Limit 1 per deck. [reaction] When you play a copy of Soothing Melody: Either change each "2" on it to a "3," or shuffle it into your deck instead of discarding it. Forced - After Hallowed Mirror enters play: Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Soothing Melody. Add 1 to your hand and shuffle the other 2 into your deck.

all_card.name: 世界·XXI
all_card.text:
[free]如果你拥有8张或更多手牌，横置世界·XXI：抽取1张卡牌。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果世界·XXI在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
all_card.real_text:
[fast] If you have 8 or more cards in your hand, exhaust The World • XXI: Draw 1 card.
[reaction] When the game begins, if The World • XXI is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

all_card.name: 密教词典
all_card.text: 每套牌库仅限一张。 [reaction]在你打出一张鲜血仪式时，将上面的所有的“2”改为“3”，或结算后不弃掉，改为将其洗回你的牌库。 强制 - 在密教词典入场后：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出3张鲜血仪式。将其中1张加入你手牌，将其余2张洗入你的牌库。
all_card.traits: 道具. 书籍. 密教
all_card.real_text: Limit 1 per deck. [reaction] When you play a copy of Blood-Rite: Either change each "2" on it to a "3," or shuffle it into your deck instead of discarding it. Forced - After Occult Lexicon enters play: Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Blood-Rite. Add 1 to your hand and shuffle the other 2 into your deck.

all_card.name: 宝剑骑士
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你技能检定将要成功时：你本次技能检定得到技能值+1。你可以弃掉宝剑骑士，改为得到技能值+3。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果宝剑骑士在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] When you would succeed at a skill test: You get +1 skill value for this test. You may discard Knight of Swords to get +3 instead.
[reaction] When the game begins, if Knight of Swords is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

all_card.name: 良好人脉
all_card.text:
每位调查员仅限1张。
[free]横置良好人脉：你每有4资源，你本次技能检定得到技能值+1。
[free]花费2资源：重整良好人脉。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] Exhaust Well Connected: You get +1 skill value for this skill test for every 4 resources you have.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: Ready Well Connected. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.name: 教皇·V
all_card.subname: 真正的导师正等待着你
all_card.text:
你拥有额外1个法术槽位。
你的法术槽位可以携带占用饰品槽位的支援，反之亦然。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果教皇·V在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
all_card.real_text:
You have 1 additional arcane slot.
Your arcane slots can be used to hold cards that take up accessory slots, and vice versa.
[reaction] When the game begins, if The Hierophant • V is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

all_card.name: 魔法手势
all_card.text: 快速。 你拥有额外1个法术槽位，只能用来携带一张[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援。 [reaction]在你执行一个[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援的一个[action]能力后，横置魔法手势：执行你控制的一个不同的[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援上的一个[action]能力(不支付其[action]费用)。
all_card.real_text: Fast. You have 1 additional arcane slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset. [reaction] After you activate an [action] ability on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset, exhaust Sign Magick: Activate an [action] ability on a different [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset you control (without paying its [action] cost).

all_card.name: 权杖九
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你抽取一张非弱点遭遇卡牌时，横置权杖九：取消该卡牌的所有效果并将其洗回遭遇牌库。然后，抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果权杖九在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] When you draw a non-weakness encounter card, exhaust Nine of Rods: Cancel all of that card's effects and shuffle it into the encounter deck. Then, draw another card from the top of the encounter deck.
[reaction] When the game begins, if Nine of Rods is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

all_card.flavor: 只有在你性命受到威胁时，你才会认识到自己能力的极限。
all_card.name: 勇闯火线
all_card.text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
直到你回合结束，将你所有技能的基础值设为5，或将你一项技能的基础值设为7。
all_card.real_flavor: You never really know what you are capable of until something is trying to eat you.
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of your turn, set the base value of each of your skills to 5, or the base value of one of your skills to 7.

all_card.name: 愚者·0
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你打出一张卡牌时，横置愚者·0：该卡牌的费用减1。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果愚者·0在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] When you play a card, exhaust The Fool • 0: Reduce that card's cost by 1.
[reaction] When the game begins, if The Fool • 0 is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

all_card.name: 月之吊坠
all_card.text:
你拥有额外1个塔罗牌槽位。
你手牌中或投入技能检定中的每张非弱点[[塔罗]]支援获得[wild][wild]。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果月之吊坠在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
all_card.real_text:
You have 1 additional tarot slot.
Each non-weakness [[Tarot]] asset in your hand or committed to a skill test gains [wild] [wild].
[reaction] When the game begins, if Moon Pendant is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

all_card.name: 赐福注目
all_card.text:
永久。每位调查员仅限1张。
每场游戏冒险设置前，从塔罗牌库随机抽取3张卡牌并选择其中1张。将其以正位放置在你的面前。其他调查员忽略该卡牌的效果。将其余卡牌混洗回塔罗牌库。
all_card.real_text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per investigator.
Before setting up each game, draw 3 random cards from the tarot deck and choose 1. Place the chosen card in front of you, in the upright position. Each other investigator ignores its effects. Shuffle the rest back into the tarot deck.

all_card.name: 诅咒缠身
all_card.text:
永久。
每场游戏冒险设置前，从塔罗牌库随机抽取1张卡牌，并将其以逆位放置在你的面前。其他调查员忽略该卡牌的效果。
all_card.real_text:
Permanent.
Before setting up each game, draw a random card from the tarot deck and place the chosen card in front of you, in the reverse position. Each other investigator ignores its effects.

all_card.name: 恶魔·XV
all_card.text: 恶魔·XV在你手牌中时，你不能打出其他支援。 如果冒险设置期间你抽取了恶魔·XV作为你起始手牌(不论在重调之前还是之后)，你不能将其替换。其必须留在你的起始手牌中。
all_card.real_text: You cannot play assets other than The Devil • XV while it is in your hand. If The Devil • XV is drawn in your opening hand during setup (before or after taking a mulligan), you cannot replace it. It must stay in your opening hand.

all_card.back_text:
- 将[[幽灵]]版本的酒窖(卡牌 #28)放置入场。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “在结算看守人的攫噬诡计时，幽灵看守人在攻击后不会横置。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返暮色庄园失踪事件
all_card.text: 遵循万象无终的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返暮色庄园失踪事件找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- Put the [[Spectral]] version of the Wine Cellar (card #28) into play.
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rule applies: "While resolving The Watcher's Grasp treachery, The Spectral Watcher does not exhaust after it attacks.". Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_name: Return to Disappearance at the Twilight Estate
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Circle Undone Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Disappearance at the Twilight Estate shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_text: - 在随机选择5张女巫作祟之林地点放置入场时，将本扩展的2张新版女巫作祟之林地点也加入遭遇组，改为从9张女巫作祟之林地点中随机选择5张。 - 将每张新版的阿卡姆密林地点放在一边，位于场外。(如果你有重返狂热之夜，你可以找出重返地底噬魔中的新版阿卡姆密林地点，一同放在一边。) - 在创建场景牌库时，使用两个版本的场景4。在推进到场景4a时，将两张场景卡牌一同放置入场；两张卡牌上的文本均有效。
all_card.name: 重返巫异时刻
all_card.text: 遵循万象无终的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返巫异时刻找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将阿卡姆密林(静谧空地)从游戏中移除。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text: - When choosing 5 Witch-Haunted Woods locations to put into play at random, include the 2 new Witch-Haunted Woods included in this encounter set, for a total of 9 possibilities. - Set each of the new Arkham Woods locations aside, out of play. (You may optionally gather the Arkham Woods locations included in the Return to The Devourer Below and set those aside, as well, if your collection includes them. This encounter set can be found in the Return to the Night of the Zealot expansion.) - When building the act deck, include both versions of act 4. When advancing to act 4a, put both act cards into play; the text on both cards is active.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Circle Undone Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Witching Hour shown here. - Remove Arkham Woods (Quiet Glade) from the game. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor:
那群戴兜帽的人见你既未与她们战斗也未干扰仪式，便收敛了敌意。“他们不是之前那些人——那些擅闯仪式的不速之客，”其中一人说着摘下兜帽，露出一头在火光中熠熠生辉的醒目红发。余烬在她指间飞舞。“那么，你们是否与我们志同道合？”她问道。
“不，伊琳，”女巫首领替你回答了。“他们只是迷途之人。”她以锐利的目光审视着你。“你是怎么到这儿来的？”
你解释自己如何在树林中醒来，如何遭到恐怖生物袭击，又是如何来到这片法阵中心，只为寻求所受磨难背后的真相。
“安妮特，我觉得是有人故意将他们送到这里的。”名叫伊琳的红发女巫低声呢喃，眼中透着困惑。
“我们应该在阵法闭合时完成仪式。树林里可能还有其他人。来吧，姐妹们，让我们继续。”安妮特说道。
all_card.flavor: 这些人聚在一起想做什么？她们是树林骚乱的原因吗？如果真是这样，她们真正的目的又是什么？
all_card.name: 未毁之环
all_card.text:
你面前的地点均相互连接。 目标 -
“也许我们能从她们身上了解更多…”
如果有超过1[per_investigator]个被横置的[[女巫]]敌人在女巫圆环，在女巫圆环的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The hooded figures stand down once they realize you are not fighting them or working to disrupt their ritual. "They are not the ones from before - the interlopers who interfered with our ritual," one of them says, pulling off her hood to reveal striking red hair that glows in the firelight. Embers dance around her fingers. "Are you of the same mind as us, then?" she asks.
"nNo, Erynn," the leader of the coven answers for you. "They are lost." She studies you with harsh eyes. "How came you here?"
You explain how you awoke in the woods, how you were attacked by terrible creatures, and how you came to the center of this circle to discover the truth behind your ordeal.
"Anette, I think someone delivered them here," the red-haired witch named Erynn whispers, mystified.
"We should finish here while the circle remains closed. There may be others in these woods. Come, sisters. Let us continue our work," Anette says.
all_card.real_flavor: For what purpose have these people gathered? Are they the cause of the disturbances in these woods? And if so, what is their true goal?

all_card.text: 地点不能被翻到[[幽灵]]面。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Soft chanting guides you to a gloomy clearing near the abandoned chapel. A circle of witchweed surrounds the clearing, swaying gently in the breeze. At the center of the clearing, a cloaked woman kneels before an unmarked grave, far from the rest of the graveyard. You watch in quiet for a few minutes while the woman sings an old, somber melody. It reminds you somewhat of a child's lullaby, with a dark gravity that betrays its purpose. As soon as the song ends, she turns to face you. You recognize Erynn by her crimson red hair and the dark circles that hang beneath her eyes. "You again." She rises. "Have you come here for answers, as I have?"
all_card.real_back_text:
Spawn 1 set-aside Heretic enemy at each of the following locations: The Gallows, Heretics' Graves, Chapel Attic, and Chapel Crypt. Add 2 [per_investigator] clues to each location.
Put the set-aside Erynn MacAoidh story asset into play at the Haunted Fields, under no player's control.
Each investigator puts into play 1 set-aside Spectral Web asset, under their control.
all_card.real_flavor: You have come to Hangman's Hill to investigate reports over the last few nights of ghost sightings and strange activities in the woods. The witch named Erynn told you to meet her here...but for what purpose?
all_card.real_text: Locations cannot be flipped to their [[Spectral]] side.

all_card.back_flavor:
“我……我不知道该如何理解这一切，”当你还在消化这些发现时，伊琳说道。灵魂确实因雾中那个存在而苏醒，但它似乎……在引导它们。指挥它们。你问伊琳，究竟什么样的存在能做到这种事。
“她曾是我们的一员，我们中最杰出的。或许也是最危险的。”她叹息道。如今一切都有了答案。你知道只有一个女巫能激起如此的敬畏与恐惧：凯夏·梅森。
“现今安妮特正拼命攫取凯夏曾经持有的禁忌知识。这场仪式……我不确定我们是否该继续下去。恐怕我一直以来都是个傻瓜。”她深邃的目光与你相对，眼神坚定不移。“我和你一起去。也许我们携手合作可以阻止这一切。”
all_card.flavor: “我先祖的灵魂无法安息，”伊琳解释道，“但他们掌握的知识至关重要，我不能视而不见。请帮我……向他们请教。”
all_card.name: 追寻彼岸
all_card.text: [reaction]当你将要“驱除”一个幽灵时：你可以改为将其异端者面朝上放在伊琳·麦考伊底下。 [action]如果你位于伊琳·麦考伊所在地点，花费1[per_inverstigator]个线索：谈判。选择她底下一张异端者放在本场景底下。 目标 - 通过将异端者放到本场景底下来帮助伊琳寻找答案。如果本场景底下有3张异端者，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"I...I do not know what to make of this," Erynn says as you ruminate on the discoveries you've made. The spirits were indeed roused by the presence of the creature in the mist, but it almost seemed to be guiding them. Commanding them. You ask Erynn what kind of creature could do such a thing.
"She was one of us, once. The greatest of us. And perhaps the most dangerous." She sighs. It all makes sense now. There is only one witch you know of who would inspire such reverence and such fear: Keziah Mason.
"Now Anette grasps at the forbidden knowledge she once held. This ritual... I am no longer sure we should go through with it. I fear I have been a fool this whole time." Her dark gaze meets yours, unwavering. "Let me come with you. Perhaps together we can put a stop to this."
all_card.real_flavor: "The spirits of my kin are restless," Erynn explains. "But the knowledge they possess is too great to ignore. Please, help me learn from them."
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you would "banish" a ghost: You may instead place it beneath Erynn MacAoidh, Heretic side faceup. [action] If you are at Erynn MacAoidh's location, spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Parley. Choose a Heretic beneath her and place it beneath this act. Objective - Help Erynn find answers by placing Heretics beneath this act. If there are 3 beneath this act, advance.

all_card.name: 绞刑者河
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。“这个好主意是谁想出来的？” 闹鬼 - 从供应堆将1个线索放到绞刑者河上。
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. "Whose bright idea was this, anyway?" Haunted - Place 1 clue from the supply on Hangman's Brook.

all_card.flavor: 這條又窄又淺的小河起源於絞刑者山頂附近的一處天然泉水，給周遭的樹林帶來了靜謐平和的細響。小河從山上蜿蜒流下，向南延伸，形成了阿卡姆住宅區的西側地界。
all_card.name: 絞刑者河
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。"這個好主意是誰想出來的？"
all_card.real_flavor: Originating from a natural spring near the peak of Hangman’s Hill, the narrow, shallow brook fills the surrounding woods with a quiet, peaceful babbling. The brook winds down the hill southward, forming the western border of Arkham's Uptown district.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. "Whose bright idea was this, anyway?"

all_card.name: 异端者
all_card.text: 异端者得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 异端者位于非[[幽灵]]地点时，其获得冷漠且不能被交战也不能受到伤害。 [free]花费1个线索：谈判。查看异端者的另一面(不要结算其文字)。 强制 - 异端者被击败后：将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 灵怪. 女巫. 幽灵. 精英
all_card.real_text: Heretic gets +2 [per_investigator] health. While Heretic is at a non-[[Spectral]] location, it gains aloof and cannot be engaged or damaged. [fast] Spend 1 clue: Parley. Look at Heretic's other side (without resolving its text). Forced - After Heretic is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor: 空气……求求你，我需要空气……
all_card.name: 未了之事
all_card.text:
溺亡的灵魂向你扑来，喉咙里挤出饱含折磨的咯咯声响，湿沉的水草缠结在它发间。
将该卡牌保留在你的威胁区域(以本面朝上)。如果你退场，将其翻面。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：你必须弃掉1张你控制的支援或将本卡牌翻回敌人面。 [action]如果你位于绞刑者河，且其上没有线索：检定任意技能(5)。如果你检定成功，本幽灵被“驱除”(结算以下文本)。
本幽灵被“驱除”之前，请勿阅读下文。
在河岸底部，你找到了亡魂的遗骸。你在溪边挖了一个浅浅的墓穴，将它的遗体安葬其中，它终于得以干燥、安全的长眠了。
将本卡牌加入胜利牌区。
all_card.real_flavor: AIR... PLEASE, I NEED AIR...
all_card.real_text:
The drowned spirit lunges for you, croaking with the garbled sounds of torment. Sodden weeds are tangled through its hair.
Keep this card in your threat area (this side faceup). If you are eliminated, flip it over. Forced - At the end of the round: You must either discard an asset you control or flip this card back to its enemy side. [action] If you are at Hangman's Brook and it has no clues on it: Test a skill of your choice (5). If you succeed, the ghost is "banished" (resolve the text below).
Do not read until this ghost is "banished."
At the bottom of the riverbank, you find the spirit's remains. You dig a shallow grave beside the brook and there you lay its body to rest, dry and safe at long last.
Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 它来了！它来找我们了！
all_card.name: 未了之事
all_card.text:
这个怨灵惊慌失措，目光不断扫视着漆黑的树林，仿佛在寻找某个隐匿的掠食者。是什么能让死者都如此惧怕？
将该卡牌保留在你的威胁区域(以本面朝上)。如果你退场，将其翻面。 强制 - 在敌军阶段开始时：如果幽灵看守人在场，将其重整。 [action]：躲避。仅能对幽灵看守人执行。本次躲避尝试检定你技能值最低的技能。如果你检定成功，本幽灵被“驱除”(结算以下文本)。(作为躲避了幽灵看守人的额外效果。)
本幽灵被“驱除”之前，请勿阅读下文。
你奋力击退了这可怖的幽影，趁此间隙安抚了躁动的魂灵。当它逐渐消散于夜色时，视线却始终紧盯着看守人的身影。
将本卡牌加入胜利牌区。
all_card.real_flavor: IT'S COMING! IT'S COMING FOR US BOTH!
all_card.real_text:
The wraith is in a panic, casting its gaze into the dark woods in search of some enigmatic predator. What could something that is dead possibly fear?
Keep this card in your threat area (this side faceup). If you are eliminated, flip it over. Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: If The Spectral Watcher is in play, ready it. [action]: Evade. Use only on The Spectral Watcher. Use your lowest skill for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, the ghost is "banished" (resolve the text below) (in addition to evading The Spectral Watcher).
Do not read until this ghost is "banished."
You force the spectral horror back, buying enough time to calm the spirit down. As it dissolves into the night, its gaze never wanders from the watcher's form.
Add this card to the victory display.

all_card.name: 独脚金
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 如果调查员抽出了独脚金…… - ……并且是从基础遭遇牌库抽出的，将其洗入幽灵遭遇牌库。 - ……并且是从幽灵遭遇牌库抽出的，结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力两次。你可以使独脚金获得涌动，来将其放到基础遭遇弃牌堆，否则，将其放到幽灵遭遇弃牌堆。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - If Witchweed is drawn... - ...from the standard encounter deck, shuffle it into the spectral encounter deck. - ...from the spectral encounter deck, trigger each haunted ability on your location twice. You may give Witchweed surge to place it in the standard encounter discard pile. Otherwise, place it in the spectral encounter discard pile.

all_card.name: 伊琳·麦考伊
all_card.text:
使用(3秘密)。
你得到+1[willpower]。
[reaction]在你抽取一张非弱点[[诅咒]]或[[力量]]诡计时，花费1秘密并横置伊琳·麦考伊：取消该卡牌的显现效果。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (3 secrets).
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] When you draw a non-weakness [[Curse]] or [[Power]] treachery, spend 1 secret and exhaust Erynn MacAoidh: Cancel that card's revelation effect.

all_card.name: 重返崇高利益
all_card.text: 遵循万象无终的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返崇高利益找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将新版的秘密通道和圣堂门廊地点放在一边，位于场外。 (继续阅读背面。)

all_card.back_flavor: 你登上通往大宅二楼的楼梯时，闻到了蜡烛燃烧的气味。安静得连纸张翻页的细小沙沙声也能听见。
all_card.flavor: 休息室里温暖舒适，而且居然空无一人。这儿肯定还藏着什么……对吧？
all_card.name: 休息室
all_card.text: 强制 - 在休息室揭示后：将放在一边的机密室和藏书室地点放置入场。 [action]休息室的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将放在一边的秘密通道地点放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you approach the staircase leading to the second floor of the mansion, you smell burning candle wax. It is quiet enough that you can hear the gentle crinkling of a page being turned.
all_card.real_flavor: The lounge is warm, cozy, and surprisingly empty. There's got to be something else here...right?
all_card.real_text: Forced - After the Lounge is revealed: Put the set-aside Vault and Library locations into play. [action] Investigators at the Lounge spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Put the set-aside Hidden Passageway location into play.

all_card.back_text: 强制 - 在你进入秘密通道时：检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，有人听见了你移动书架的声音，在最近的[[异教徒]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.name: 遗物储藏室
all_card.text: 如果有调查员控制[skull]钥匙，遗物储藏室和秘社地下墓穴相互连接。 强制 - 在遗物储藏室揭示后：将随机1个放在一边的钥匙放在遗物储藏室上。
all_card.real_back_text: Forced - When you enter Hidden Passageway: Test [agility] (3). If you fail, place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy as they hear you shifting the bookcase.
all_card.real_text: While an investigator controls the [skull] key, Relic Storage is connected to Lodge Catacombs, and vice versa. Forced - After Relic Storage is revealed: Place 1 random set-aside key on it.

all_card.back_flavor: 石拱门后面是一扇没有标识的铁门，以未曾透露的秘密和隐藏的真相嘲弄着你。
all_card.name: 隐秘档案室
all_card.text: [action]：选择卡牌上的一个([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing])钥匙，检定[willpower]或[intellect](8)。场上每有一个[[银暮秘社]]敌人，本次技能检定的难度降低1点。如果你检定成功，将选择的钥匙和另一个在场上或放在一边的([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing])钥匙交换。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Beyond a stone archway lies an unmarked iron door, mocking you with untold secrets and hidden truths.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Choose a ([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing]) key on a card and test [willpower] or [intellect] (8). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in play. If you succeed, swap the chosen key with another key in play or with a set-aside ([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing]) key.
