all_card.back_flavor:
在浓雾中搜索近一个小时过后，你终于抵达了秘社的仪式场所，但这儿已经一片混乱。银暮秘社的成员都披着蓝色和银色的长袍，与女巫战作一团。安妮特注意到你，对你的到来震怒不已。“你！你在这儿干什么？”她呼唤女巫集会：“姐妹们！我们绝对不能让他们插手！”
“不，安妮特，”伊琳回应道，她站到你的身边，“这次你做得太过了。我们必须阻止的人是你。”看着对峙的二人，女巫们不知道该跟随谁，只得退让到一旁。
“你必须完成仪式！”卡尔·桑福德从空地另一头命令你，“这是唯一的办法！”
all_card.back_text:
揭示灵怪陷阱地点。将位于未访之岛地点的每位调查员移动到灵怪陷阱。
将放在一边的安妮特·梅森生成在灵怪陷阱，带有2[per_investigator]点伤害。
all_card.flavor: 你接近了封印仪式的场地。你得点燃火盆才能找到进入的方法。然后只要把看守人引到陷阱，对它施以咒缚。
all_card.name: 迷雾彼端(版本五)
all_card.text: [free]在一个阵法行动期间，花费1个线索：本次技能检定难度降低2点。 目标 - 如果场上每个未访之岛地点均已翻开，且每个此类地点的火盆均已点燃，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
After nearly an hour spent searching through the dense mist, you finally arrive at the Lodge's ritual site to find it in chaos. Members of the Silver Twilight Lodge, in robes of blue and silver, are embroiled in battle with the witches. Anette turns her attention to you, shocked and angered at your arrival. "You! What are you doing here?" She calls to her coven: "Sisters! We must not let them interfere!"
"No, Anette," Erynn replies, standing by your side. "You have gone too far this time. It is you we must stop." Unsure who to follow, the rest of the witches stand down as the two face off.
"You must complete the ritual!" Carl Sanford commands you from across the clearing. "It is the only way!"
all_card.real_back_text:
Reveal The Geist-Trap location. Move each investigator at an Unvisited Isle location to The Geist-Trap.
Spawn the set-aside Anette Mason at The Geist-Trap, with 2 [per_investigator] damage on her.
all_card.real_flavor: You are close to the site of the binding ritual. You must light all the braziers to find the way. Then, all that is left to do is bait the watcher to the trap and bind it there.
all_card.real_text: [fast] During a circle action, spend 1 clue: Reduce the difficulty of this skill test by 2. Objective - If each Unvisited Isle location in play is revealed and the brazier on each of them is lit, advance.

all_card.name: 火盆附魔
all_card.text: 显现 - 将火盆附魔放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁边。 执行地点上的阵法行动期间，每次技能检定难度提升2点。 [action]：阵法。检定你技能值最低的技能+你技能值次低的技能(6)。如果你检定成功，弃掉火盆附魔。如果你检定失败，结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Brazier Enchantment into play next to the agenda deck. Increase the difficulty of each skill test during circle actions on locations by 2. [action]: Circle. Test your lowest skill + your next lowest skill (6). If you succeed, discard Brazier Enchantment. If you fail, resolve each haunted ability on your location.

all_card.back_text: - 对于以下每个地点，从其三个版本中随机选择一张：法兰西山、河岸城、南区、住宅区、南区教堂、商人区。将所选地点从游戏中移除。使用剩余地点如常进行冒险设置。
all_card.name: 重返混沌魔掌
all_card.text: 遵循万象无终的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返混沌魔掌找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text: - Choose at random one of the three copies of each of the following locations: French Hill, Rivertown, Southside, Uptown, South Church, and Merchant District. Remove the chosen locations from the game. Use the rest throughout setup, as normal.
all_card.real_name: Return to In the Clutches of Chaos
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Circle Undone Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to In the Clutches of Chaos shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: 阿卡姆最为富裕，最具历史意义的街区之一，法兰西山有许多废弃的大宅和庄园，个中藏有许多古老的财宝……还有更多的秘密。
all_card.name: 法兰西山
all_card.text: [action]：将法兰西山任意数量的裂口移动到当前场景。然后，检定[willpower](X)，其中X为移动的裂口数量。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: One of the richest and most historical neighborhoods in Arkham, the many decaying mansions and estates of French Hill hold a lot of old wealth... and many more secrets.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Move any number of breaches from French Hill to the current act. Then, test [willpower] (X), where X is the number of breaches moved. For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 在过去的几个礼拜里，河岸城的仓库和码头都笼罩着一重灰雾，让本就安静的街区变得更加空旷、荒凉。
all_card.name: 河岸城
all_card.text: [action]：将河岸城任意数量的裂口移动到当前场景。然后，检定[intellect](X)，其中X为移动的裂口数量+1。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: These past few weeks, the warehouses and docks of Rivertown have been swathed in grey mist, making an already quiet district even more empty and desolate.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Move any number of breaches from Rivertown to the current act. Then, test [intellect] (X), where X is 1 more than the number of breaches moved. For each point you fail by, either take 1 horror or 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 要是不知道，你会以为南区是个鬼城。所有的居民都躲在家里，紧锁家门。你能看到的唯一一盏灯火，似乎来自南边的天主教堂。
all_card.name: 南区
all_card.text: [action]：躲避。可以对场上或遭遇弃牌堆中的敌人执行本能力。如果你检定失败，该敌人攻击你(即使其在场外)。如果你检定成功，不躲避选择的敌人，改为将南区的所有裂口移动到当前场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: If you didn’t know any better, you would think Southside was a ghost town. All of the residents have retreated into their homes and locked their doors. The only light you see seems to be coming from the Catholic church to the south.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Evade. Use this ability on any enemy in play or in the encounter discard pile. If you fail, that enemy attacks you (even if it is not in play). If you succeed, instead of evading the chosen enemy, move all breaches from Southside to the current act.

all_card.back_flavor: 通常这是个治安良好的街区，而今天晚上，住宅区的鹅卵石街道上却呈现出一种截然不同的氛围。薄雾从城镇边界的树林里蔓延开来，越过绞刑者河，沿着大街小巷蠕动。
all_card.name: 住宅区
all_card.text: [action]：将住宅区任意数量的裂口移动到当前场景。然后，检定[agility](X)，其中X为移动的裂口数量。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Typically a safe neighborhood, the cobbled streets of Uptown have taken a very different mood this night. Tendrils of mist reach out from the woods that border the town, stretching over Hangman’s Brook and crawling through the streets.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Move any number of breaches from Uptown to the current act. Then, test [agility] (X), where X is the number of breaches moved. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 这座巨大的罗马式教堂耸立在住宅区，高于其他建筑，阳光会从彩窗照射进来。尽管城里发生了一件件怪事，迈克尔神父还是决定让教堂全天开放，今晚也不例外。
all_card.flavor: 许多惊恐的市民坐在教堂的木质长椅上祈祷，互相窃窃私语。
all_card.name: 南区教堂
all_card.text: [action][action]：将南区教堂的所有裂口移动到当前场景。 [action]：撤退。你趁着夜色隐蔽起来。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The massive Romanesque building towers over the rest of Uptown, light shining from within its stained glass windows. Father Michael has made it a point to keep the church open at all hours, and despite the strange happenings throughout town, tonight is no different.
all_card.real_flavor: Many fearful citizens are seated at the church's wooden pews, praying and whispering amongst themselves.
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Move all breaches from South Church to the current act. [action]: Resign. You hide through the night.

all_card.back_flavor: 商人区是阿卡姆的商业中心，通常一整天都热热闹闹的。但是今晚，码头工人和水手都不见了，这让你感到不安。远远望去，米斯卡塔尼克河漆黑的水面上笼罩着一重雾，似乎形成了一些不自然的形状。
all_card.name: 商人区
all_card.text: [action]：将商人区的1个裂口移动到当前场景。你可以从你控制的支援上花费任意数量的充能、秘密、补给或子弹，移动等量的额外裂口。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The commercial center of Arkham, the Merchant District is usually bustling at all hours. But tonight, the dockhands and sailors have vanished, leaving you with a sense of unease. The mist over the dark waters of the Miskatonic River seems to take unnatural shapes as you watch from afar.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Move 1 breach from Merchant District to the current act. You may spend any number of charges, secrets, supplies, or ammo from any assets you control to move that many additional breaches.

all_card.back_text: - 在创建场景牌库时，使用本遭遇组新版的场景3替换原版的场景3。将原版的场景3从游戏中移除。 - 在创建宇宙时，加入重返黑色王座遭遇组中3张新的宇宙地点。 - 在游戏开始时，调查员们可以从冒险参考卡牌上移除2个资源标记，使每位调查员开始游戏时都有一个夜魇坐骑剧情支援放置在场。将所有剩余的夜魇坐骑从游戏中移除。
all_card.name: 重返黑色王座
all_card.text: 遵循万象无终的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返黑色王座找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text: - When building the act deck, replace the original version of act 3 with the new version included in this encounter set. Remove the original version from the game. - When building the Cosmos, include the 3 new Cosmos locations included in the Return to Before the Black Throne encounter set. - When the game begins, the investigators may remove 2 resources from the scenario reference card to have each investigator begin the game with a Nightgaunt Steed story asset in play. Remove each remaining Nightgaunt Steed from the game.
all_card.real_name: Return to Before the Black Throne
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Circle Undone Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Before the Black Throne shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你站在黑色王座前的悬崖，抬头凝视那名叫阿撒托斯的盲目而沉默的怪物。光是看见它，你的视觉就开始模糊，身体不住地颤抖。单调的笛声如今变得洪亮，让你浑身骨骼颤抖，几乎从身体内部使你呕吐出来。鲜血从你的眼睛与耳朵滴落。要是阿撒托斯苏醒，它将吞噬曾经存在的所有世界。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 - 如果达成下方至少2种情况，你可以前往(→结局2)：你接受了自己的命运、“遗留记忆”下方列有催眠长笛、“遗留记忆”下方列有仪式道具。 - 如果达成下方至少2种情况，你可以前往(→结局3)：你拒绝了自己的命运、“遗留记忆”下方列有残影碎片、“遗留记忆”下方列有一缕鬼灵迷雾。 - 如果“遗留记忆”下方列有怪异咒语和血树雕刻，你可以前往(→结局6)。 - 否则，(→结局4)。
all_card.flavor: 你现在已经很接近了。在你周围的虚空之中，你能感觉到历史长河的翻腾扭曲。这是万事万物的中心——混沌其本身的中心——你的目标与你最终的命运就在面前。
all_card.name: 必竟之事(版本二)
all_card.text: [action]花费X个线索：抽取“宇宙”顶上的X张卡牌。选择其中一张卡牌，按照其“宇宙 -”指示放置入场，并移动到其上。将其余卡牌洗回“宇宙”。 目标 - 如果调查员队长位于黑色王座，且该地点上没有线索，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You stand on a precipice before the Black Throne and gaze up at the blind, voiceless monstrosity that is Azathoth. The mere sight of it causes your vision to blur and your body to shake uncontrollably. The monotonous piping is so loud now, it rattles your bones and causes blood to drip from your eyes and ears. Should Azathoth awaken, it will devour every world that ever was.
all_card.real_back_text: Check the Campaign Log. - If at least two of the following are true, you may proceed to (→R2): You accepted your fate, Mesmerizing Flute is listed under "Mementos Discovered," and Ritual Components is listed under "Mementos Discovered." - If at least two of the following are true, you may proceed to (→R3): You rejected your fate, Scrap of Torn Shadow is listed under "Mementos Discovered," and Wisp of Spectral Mist is listed under "Mementos Discovered." - If Strange Incantation and Bloody Tree Carvings are listed under "Mementos Discovered," you may proceed to (→R6) - Otherwise, (→R4).
all_card.real_flavor: You are close now. You can feel the churning and twisting of aeons in the emptiness around you. Here, in the nucleus of all things - the very center of chaos itself - your objective, and your ultimate fate, lie at hand.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos. Objective - If the lead investigator is a The Black Throne and there are no clues on it, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 群星嘲讽般舞动着，几乎每时每刻都在变换位置，组成象征毁灭的苍白符号。从未见过这个符号也不曾畏惧它的人，可能还会对它感到惊奇；就连以太形成的风呼啸时，也带着来自宇宙之外的缥缈黑暗与孤独。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 梦魇裂口
all_card.text: 宇宙 - 与任意方向连接，但只能放在有虚空格子的位置。将该虚空格子的卡牌从游戏中移除，而非洗回其所有者牌库。然后，将场上和每位调查员手中与该卡牌相同的卡牌弃掉。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The stars danced mockingly, almost shifting now and then to form pale signs of doom that one might wonder one had not seen and feared before; and ever the winds of aether howled of vague blackness and loneliness beyond the cosmos.
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Cosmos - Connect in a direction of your choice, but only onto a spot where an empty space exists. Remove that empty space from the game instead of shuffling it back into its owner's deck. Then, discard each other copy of that card from play and from each investigator's hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 群星嘲讽般舞动着，几乎每时每刻都在变换位置，组成象征毁灭的苍白符号。从未见过这个符号也不曾畏惧它的人，可能还会对它感到惊奇；就连以太形成的风呼啸时，也带着来自宇宙之外的缥缈黑暗与孤独。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 星际深渊
all_card.text: 宇宙 - 与离黑色王座最近的方向连接。(如果黑色王座不在场上，则与任意方向连接。) 你位于星际深渊时，你不能花费线索。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The stars danced mockingly, almost shifting now and then to form pale signs of doom that one might wonder one had not seen and feared before; and ever the winds of aether howled of vague blackness and loneliness beyond the cosmos.
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Cosmos - Connect in the direction nearest to The Black Throne (or any direction if The Black Throne is not in play). While you are at Interstellar Abyss, you cannot spend clues.

all_card.back_flavor: 群星嘲讽般舞动着，几乎每时每刻都在变换位置，组成象征毁灭的苍白符号。从未见过这个符号也不曾畏惧它的人，可能还会对它感到惊奇；就连以太形成的风呼啸时，也带着来自宇宙之外的缥缈黑暗与孤独。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
all_card.name: 曲折深壑
all_card.text: 宇宙 - 与最靠左的已揭示地点的任意方向连接。然后，你可以选择不移动到曲折深壑，改为在阿撒托斯上放置1个毁灭标记。 闹鬼 - 受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The stars danced mockingly, almost shifting now and then to form pale signs of doom that one might wonder one had not seen and feared before; and ever the winds of aether howled of vague blackness and loneliness beyond the cosmos.
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
all_card.real_text: Cosmos - Connect to the leftmost revealed location in a direction of your choice. You may choose not to move to Winding Gulf and instead place 1 doom on Azathoth. Haunted - Take 1 damage and 1 horror.

all_card.name: 夜魇坐骑
all_card.text: 你控制夜魇坐骑时，你可以进入虚空格子，如同其是一个地点。 强制 - 在你进入虚空格子后：夜魇坐骑受到1点直接伤害。 强制 - 如果夜魇坐骑离场，将其从游戏中移除且你移动到最近的已揭示地点。
all_card.real_text: While you control Nightgaunt Steed, you may enter empty space as if it were a location. Forced - After you enter empty space, Nightgaunt Steed takes 1 direct damage. Forced - If Nightgaunt Steed leaves play, remove it from the game and move to the nearest revealed location.

all_card.name: 闯入者！
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。你的威胁区域每有一张非弱点诡计，本次技能检定难度提升1点。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害或2点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each non-weakness treachery in your threat area. If you fail, take 2 damage or 2 horror.

all_card.name: 玷污
all_card.text: 显现 - 将玷污放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 在你的回合期间，你技能检定成功后：本回合你后续进行的所有技能检定难度提升1点。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉玷污。如果你所在地点有处于横置状态的[[女巫]]敌人，本次检定自动成功。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Despoiled into play in your threat area. Forced - After you succeed at a skill test during your turn: Increase the difficulty of each subsequent test you perform this turn by 1. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Despoiled. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.

all_card.name: 恶语中伤
all_card.text: 显现 - 将恶语中伤放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你打出每张卡牌的费用提升1点。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉恶语中伤。如果你所在地点有处于横置状态的[[女巫]]敌人，本次检定自动成功。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Maligned into play in your threat area. Increase the cost of each card you play by 1. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Maligned. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.

all_card.name: 迫近之邪
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须受到1点伤害和1点恐惧，或将迫近之邪放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁边且获得涌动。 如果密谋牌库旁边有3张迫近之邪，弃掉这3张卡牌，推进当前密谋。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either take 1 damage and 1 horror, or put Impending Evils into play next to the agenda deck and it gains surge. If there are 3 copies of Impending Evils next to the agenda deck, discard them and advance the current agenda.

all_card.name: 在劫难逃
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](2)。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。如果你检定成功，将在劫难逃放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁边。 在劫难逃在密谋牌库旁边时，其余每张在劫难逃技能检定难度提升1点，且如果检定失败，造成+1伤害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). If you fail, take 2 damage. If you succeed, put Unavoidable Demise into play next to the agenda deck. While Unavoidable Demise is next to the agenda deck, each other copy of Unavoidable Demise gets +1 difficulty and deals +1 damage if its test is failed.

all_card.name: 愚人的命运
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 如果场上没有其他愚人的命运，将愚人的命运放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。否则，威胁区域有愚人的命运的调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。该卡牌获得险境，其效果不能被取消，且结算其显现效果期间的技能检定不能投入卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there is no other copy of Fate of All Fools in play, put Fate of All Fools into play in your threat area. Otherwise, an investigator with another copy of Fate of All Fools in their threat area draws the top card of the encounter deck. That card gains peril, its effects cannot be canceled, and cards cannot be committed to skill tests while resolving its revelation effect.

all_card.name: 不稳定能量
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 强制 - 在你离开附属的地点时：结算该地点的每个闹鬼能力。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：如果附属的地点上没有调查员，弃掉不稳定能量。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - After you leave attached location: Resolve each haunted ability on it. Forced - At the end of the round: If there are no investigators at attached location, discard Unstable Energies.

all_card.name: 来自彼端
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力(如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，改为每个结算两次)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, resolve each haunted ability on your location (if you fail by 3 or more, resolve each of them twice, instead).

all_card.name: 堕落恶行
all_card.text: 显现 - 将堕落恶行附属到你控制的一个非永久支援上。每个支援仅限1张。 强制 - 在遭遇牌库耗尽时：弃掉附属的支援。 强制 - 在附属的支援离场时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，将堕落恶行附属到你控制的一个不同的非永久支援上。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Vice and Villainy to a non-permanent asset you control. Limit 1 per asset. Forced - When the encounter deck runs out of cards: Discard attached asset. Forced - When attached asset leaves play: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, attach Vice and Villainy to a different non-permanent asset you control.

all_card.name: 不洁之地
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](5)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，弃掉遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。如果本效果弃掉了[[诅咒]]诡计，对你的调查员和你的每个[[盟友]]支援造成1点直接恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (5). For each point you fail by, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If a [[Curse]] treachery is discarded by this effect, deal 1 direct horror to your investigator and to each of your [[Ally]] assets.

all_card.name: 超自然风暴
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](5)。如果你检定失败，从你的场上和/或手中选择并弃掉印刷资源费用总计至少为X的牌，其中X为你失败且低于难度的点数。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (5). If you fail, choose and discard cards from your play area and/or from your hand with a total printed resource cost of at least X, where X is the amount you failed by.

all_card.name: 彼端迷雾
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 所附属地点的隐藏值+1。 强制 - 当一轮结束时，如果附属的地点上没有线索：将彼端迷雾向最近的有1个或更多线索的地点移动一次。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Attached location gets +1 shroud. Forced - At the end of the round, if there are no clues on attached location: Move Mists from Beyond once toward the nearest location with 1 or more clues.

all_card.name: 尖啸女妖
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在你对尖啸女妖造成1点或更多伤害(除[[法术]]或[[遗物]]以外的)时：结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 灵怪. 幽灵
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When you deal 1 or more damage to Screeching Banshee (except from a [[Spell]] or [[Relic]]): Resolve each haunted ability at its location.

all_card.name: 嗜血魂灵
all_card.text: 显现 - 将嗜血魂灵放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你所在地点闹鬼时，作为在技能检定中投入1张或多张卡牌的额外费用，你必须结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉嗜血魂灵。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Bloodthirsty Spirits into play in your threat area. While your location is haunted, as an additional cost for you to commit 1 or more cards to a skill test, you must resolve each haunted ability on your location. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Bloodthirsty Spirits.

all_card.name: 鲜血失色
all_card.text: 作为打出鲜血失色的额外费用，受到2点伤害。 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。本次攻击得到+2[willpower]并造成+2伤害。
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost to play Blood Eclipse, take 2 damage. Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [willpower] and deal +2 damage for this attack.

all_card.name: 求生匕首
all_card.text: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。 [reaction]在敌军阶段期间，在敌人攻击你时(在此次攻击结算前)，横置求生匕首：攻击。本次攻击以刚刚发起攻击的敌人为目标。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 近战
all_card.real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. [reaction] When an enemy attacks you during the enemy phase (before resolving that attack), exhaust Survival Knife: Fight. This attack targets the attacking enemy. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

all_card.flavor:
“你怎么知道我是疯的？”爱丽丝说。“你肯定疯了。”柴郡猫说，“不然你不会到这儿来。”
——路易斯·卡罗尔，《爱丽丝梦游仙境》
all_card.name: 去伪存真
all_card.text: 在你所在地点的调查员控制的支援上放置总计2秘密。(如果你所在地点有线索，改为3秘密。)
all_card.real_flavor:
"How do you know I'm mad?" said Alice. "You must be," said the Cat, "or you wouldn't have come here."
 - Lewis Carroll, <u>Alice's Adventures in Wonderland</u>
all_card.real_text: Place 2 secrets among assets controlled by investigators at your location (3 secrets instead if there is a clue at your location).

all_card.name: 古代巨石
all_card.text:
研究完成。使用(X秘密)。X为“你鉴定了古代巨石”旁括号内的数字。
[reaction]在你抽取任意数量的卡牌时，花费等量的秘密：移动等量的次数。
all_card.real_text:
Researched. Uses (X secrets). X is the number in parentheses next to "you have identified the stone."
[reaction] When you draw any number of cards, spend that many secrets: Move that many times.

all_card.name: 彩饰骷髅
all_card.text: 使用(0充能)。 [reaction]在你所在地点有调查员、[[盟友]]支援或敌人被击败后：在彩饰骷髅上放置1资源(从供应堆拿取)，作为充能。 [action]花费最多3充能：抽取等量的卡牌并获得等量资源。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕
all_card.real_text: Uses (0 charges). [reaction] After an investigator, [[Ally]] asset, or enemy at your location is defeated: Place 1 resource (from the token bank) on Decorated Skull, as a charge. [action] Spend up to 3 charges: Draw that many cards and gain that many resources.

all_card.name: 柯尔特袖珍手枪
all_card.text: 使用(5子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。 强制 - 当一轮结束时，如果你执行过柯尔特袖珍手枪的“[action]”能力：将其弃掉。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法
all_card.real_text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. Forced - At the end of the round, if you triggered Colt Vest Pocket's "[action]" ability: Discard it.

all_card.name: 拉莱耶迷雾
all_card.text: 使用(5充能)。 [action]花费1充能：躲避。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次躲避尝试得到+1[willpower]。如果你检定成功，在躲避所选敌人后，你可以移动到一个连接地点。如果本次躲避尝试期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，从你手牌中选择并弃掉一张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Uses (5 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. You get +1 [willpower] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, after evading the chosen enemy, you may move to a connecting location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, choose and discard a card from your hand.

all_card.name: 钻地魔虫之石
all_card.text: 封印([skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing])。使用(3充能)。如果钻地魔虫之石没有充能，将其返回你的手牌。 强制 - 你在技能检定中揭示[auto_fail]符号后：移除钻地魔虫之石上的1充能。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕
all_card.real_text: Seal ([skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing]). Uses (3 charges). If The Chthonian Stone has no charges, return it to your hand. Forced - After you reveal an [auto_fail] symbol during a skill test: Remove 1 charge from The Chthonian Stone.

all_card.flavor: 我们的命运由自己书写。
all_card.name: 改变命运
all_card.text: 选择并弃掉场上一张没有附属到[[精英]]敌人上的非弱点诡计卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: We make our own fate.
all_card.real_text: Choose and discard from play a non-weakness treachery that is not attached to an [[Elite]] enemy.

deck_options.error: You cannot have assets that take up an ally slot.

all_card.name: 自食其力
all_card.text: 卓越。永久。 你的调查员获得：“牌库构建限制：无占用盟友槽位的支援。” [reaction]在你打出一张[survivor]事件卡牌时，横置自食其力：该事件费用减2。
all_card.real_text: Exceptional. Permanent. Your investigator gains: "Deckbuilding Restrictions: No assets that take up an ally slot." [reaction] When you play a [survivor] event, exhaust On Your Own: Reduce that event's cost by 2.

all_card.name: 背包
all_card.text:
[reaction]在背包入场后：查找你牌库顶的12张卡牌，找出最多3张非弱点[[道具]]或[[供给]]卡牌，正面朝下附属到背包上。混洗你的牌库。
附属到背包的卡牌可以被打出，如同其在你手中。如果没有卡牌附属在背包，弃掉背包。
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] After Backpack enters play: Search the top 12 cards of your deck for up to 3 non-weakness [[Item]] or [[Supply]] cards, and attach them facedown to Backpack. Shuffle your deck.
Cards attached to Backpack may be played as if they were in your hand. If there are no cards attached to Backpack, discard it.

all_card.flavor: “植物！”
all_card.name: 植形异变
all_card.text: 显现 - 将植形异变放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。植形异变上没有伤害时不能离场。 [free]受到1点直接伤害：对植形异变造成1点伤害。 本卡牌由植物学家设计于阿卡姆之夜2018。
all_card.real_flavor: "Plants!"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Dendromorphosis into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play while it has no damage on it. [fast] Take 1 direct damage: Deal 1 damage to Dendromorphosis. Card design by the Botanists at Arkham Nights 2018.

all_card.name: 无法拒绝的提议
all_card.text: 剧本模式专用。 在你成为本弱点的承受者时，获得2经验。 显现 - 失去5资源。如果你不能这么做，将无法拒绝的提议从你的牌库中移除。查找收藏，找出附加条款，并将其放入你的弃牌堆。
all_card.real_text: Campaign Mode only. When you become the bearer of this weakness, gain 2 experience. Revelation - Lose 5 resources. If you cannot, instead remove Offer You Cannot Refuse from your deck, search the collection for Fine Print, and place it in your discard pile.

all_card.flavor: 你猩红的签名正从其表面滴落。
all_card.name: 附加条款
all_card.text: 显现 - 失去7资源。如果你不能这么做，将附加条款从你的牌库中移除。查找收藏，找出出卖灵魂，并将其放入你的弃牌堆。
all_card.real_flavor: Your scarlet signature drips from its surface.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Lose 7 resources. If you cannot, instead remove Fine Print from your deck, search the collection for Sell Your Soul, and place it in your discard pile.

all_card.flavor: 这笔债，终须以某种方式偿还。
all_card.name: 出卖灵魂
all_card.text: 显现 - 失去10资源。如果你不能这么做，你的黑暗恩主将你的意识从躯体中剥离。你发疯。
all_card.real_flavor: One way or another, the debt shall be repaid.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Lose 10 resources. If you cannot, your dark patron tears your consciousness from your body. You are driven insane.

all_card.back_text:
- 在创建探索牌库时，从以下每个地点符号的2张地点中随机选择1张加入：紫色月亮、蓝色三角、红色方形、橙色心形。将其余4张[[丛林]]地点从游戏中移除，不要查看。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。(总计应有5张卡牌。)
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “探险营地的‘检查你的补给品’能力可以在任意地点使用。 强制 - 在一次成功的探索结束后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返荒莽密林
all_card.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返荒莽密林找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- When building the exploration deck, include only 1 of the 2 locations with each of the following connection symbols, chosen at random: Purple Moon, Blue Triangle, Red Square, Orange Heart. Remove the other 4 [[Jungle]] locations from the game wihtout looking at them. Do not include any of the other encounter cards listed in the original setup instructions. (There should be a total of 5 cards.)
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rules apply: "The 'check your supplies' ability on the Expedition Camp can be used from any location. Forced - After a successful exploration ends: Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the exploration deck." Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Untamed Wilds shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_text:
- 在冒险设置前，使用本遭遇组新版的遗迹入口、古代石厅、华美石室和时间石室地点替换原版的。 -在冒险设置前，使用新版的瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)替换原版的瓦卢西亚的预示者。 - 在创建探索牌库时，仅使用封印通道、彩砖石室、古代墓穴、王座大厅、蛇洞、古代石厅和华美石室。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “强制 - 在一次成功的探索结束后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返埃兹特里的覆灭
all_card.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返埃兹特里的覆灭找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 从蛇族遭遇组中找出3张蝮蛇，将它们放在一边，位于场外。 - 在冒险设置前，将原版的坑葬墓室、地下遗迹和秘密通道地点从游戏中移除。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- Before setup, replace the original Entryway, Ancient Hall, Grand Chamber, and Chamber of Time locations with the new versions from this encounter set. - Before setup, replace the original Harbinger of Valusia enemy with the new Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns) - When building the exploration deck, use only Sealed Passage, Mosaic Chamber, Tomb of the Ancients, Throne Room, Snake Pit, Ancient Hall, and Grand Chamber. Do not include any of the other encounter cards listed in the original setup instructions.
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rule apply: "Forced - After a successful exploration ends: Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the exploration deck." Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_name: Return to The Doom of Eztli
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Doom of Eztli shown here. - Gather the 3 Pit Viper cards from the Serpents encounter set and set them aside, out of play. - Before setup, remove the original Burial Pit, Underground Ruins, and Secret Passage locations from the game. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.name: 瓦卢西亚的预示者
all_card.text: 警戒。猎手。反击。 瓦卢西亚的预示者上有5[per_investigator]点或更多伤害时，其得到+2攻击值和-2躲避值。 强制 - 在对本敌人进行的一次成功的攻击或躲避尝试结束后：在该卡牌上放置1资源。然后，如果该卡牌上有2[per_investigator]资源，瓦卢西亚的预示者发出奸险的嘶嘶声并遁去身影。(将该卡牌放在一边，位于场外。该卡牌保留所有伤害标记。)
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 蛇族. 精英
all_card.real_text: Alert. Hunter. Retaliate. While this enemy has 5 [per_investigator] or more damage on it, it gets +2 fight and -2 evade. Forced - After a successful attack or evasion attempt against this enemy ends: Place 1 resource on it. Then, if there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on it, it vanishes with a sinister hiss. (Set it aside, out of play. It keeps all damage tokens.)

all_card.back_flavor: 日落余晖洒在神庙遗迹，所有石块都沐浴在温暖的光辉下.当你踏入漆有颜色的遗迹入口时，丛林的种种声音离你远去。在遗迹入口里，诸多厅室淹没在漆黑之中。
all_card.name: 遗迹入口
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你暂时……逃出来了。 [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有火把：查看探索牌库顶的2张卡牌。弃掉以此效果查看到的1张诡计或敌人卡牌。混洗探索牌库。本能力可以在任意地点使用。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The sun sets over the temple ruins, bathing the stone in warm light. The sounds of the rainforest are distant by the time you cross underneath the painted entryway. Inside, the halls are plunged into darkness.
all_card.flavor: 数百年之前，这座神庙或许就是一座美丽而受人敬畏的精神圣殿，坐落在这片危机四伏的丛林中。
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You've escaped... for now. [action]: Check your supplies. If you have torches: Look at the top 2 cards of the exploration deck. Discard 1 treachery or enemy looked at by this effect. Shuffle the exploration deck. This ability can be used at any location.

all_card.name: 封印通道
all_card.text: [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有埃兹特里之钥：查找探索牌库或所有放在一边的卡牌，找出时间石室并将其放置入场。如果当前场景是场景1a，直接跳至场景2a。在该场景的剩余时间里，封印通道和时间石室连接，反之亦然。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text: [action] Check your supplies. If you have the Key of Eztli: Search the exploration deck and all set-aside cards for Chamber of Time and put it into play. If it is act 1a, skip directly to act 2a. For the remainder of this act, Sealed Passage is connected to Chamber of Time and vice versa. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 彩砖石室
all_card.text: [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有水壶：石室接受你供奉的净水，从在场任意地点上移除1个毁灭标记。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text: [action] Check your supplies. If you have a canteen: The chamber accepts your gift of water. Remove 1 doom from any location in play. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 古代墓穴
all_card.text: [action]：检查你的补给品。如果位于古代墓穴的调查员带有绳索：移动到一个连接次数最多为3的已揭示地点。直到本轮结束，古代墓穴视为和该地点连接，反之亦然。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text: [action] Check your supplies. If an investigator at Tomb of the Ancients has rope: Move to a revealed location up to 3 connections away. Until the end of the round, Tomb of the Ancients is considered to be connected to that location, and vice versa. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.name: 王座大厅
all_card.text:
王座大厅上有毁灭标记时，该地点视为在胜利区中(用以计入复仇点数)。
[action]如果王座大厅上没有线索和毁灭标记：在你的补给品中记录“神秘权杖”。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text:
While Throne Room has doom on it, it is considered to be in the victory display (for the purposes of counting vengeance).
[action] If there are no clues or doom on Throne Room: Record "mysterious scepter" in your supplies. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 蛇洞
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你探索成功并将蛇洞放置入场后，但在移动进入前：将放在一边的1[per_investigator]个蝮蛇敌人生成在蛇洞(最多3个)。检查你的补给品。如果你所在地点的调查员带有双筒望远镜，你可以选择不移动到蛇洞。否则，你必须移动到蛇洞。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you put Snake Pit into play by exploring successfully, but before moving to it: Spawn 1 [per_investigator] set-aside Pit Viper enemies in Snake Pit (to a maximum of 3). Check your supplies. If an investigator at your location has binoculars, you may choose not to move to Snake Pit. Otherwise, you must move to it.

all_card.name: 古代石厅
all_card.text:
古代石厅入场时带有1[per_investigator]个毁灭标记。
[action]：将古代石厅上的1个毁灭标记翻到线索面。
[free]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有指南针，将古代石厅上的1个毁灭标记翻到线索面。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text:
Ancient Hall enters play with 1 [per_investigator] doom on it.
[action]: Flip 1 doom on Ancient Hall to its clue side.
[fast]: Check your supplies. If you have a compass, flip 1 doom on Ancient Hall to its clue side. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.name: 华美石室
all_card.text: [action]检查你的补给品。如果你带有地图且华美石室上没有线索：在本场冒险的剩余时间里(包括结局)，华美石室失去复仇1并获得胜利1。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text: [action] Check your supplies. If you have a map and there are no clues on Grand Chamber: For the remainder of the scenario (and its resolution), Grand Chamber loses Vengeance 1 and gains Victory 1. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor: 这个石室中央的地面雕刻着精细纹路，发出诡异的光芒……
all_card.name: 时间石室
all_card.text: 强制 - 在时间石室入场后：将放在一边的古代遗物支援附属到时间石室上。在时间石室上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_flavor: The floor of this central chamber is intricately carved and glows strangely...
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Chamber of Time enters play: Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages asset to the Chamber of Time. Place 1 doom on Chamber of Time.

all_card.back_text:
- 本遭遇组包含第四套“g/h”场景牌库。按照以下内容调整“g/h”场景牌库。调查员必须选择(以下一项)：
如果你想找到《广告人报》刊登内容的情报来源，将以下场景卡牌从“g/h”场景牌库中移除：寻找意义、2张蔓生庄园和2张自找麻烦中的随机1张。
如果你想找到怪异事件发生的根源，将以下场景卡牌从“g/h”场景牌库中移除：寻找来源、2张自找麻烦和2张蔓生庄园中的随机1张。
all_card.name: 重返命运之线
all_card.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返命运之线找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将薇达·惠茨利剧情支援放在一边，位于场外。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text: - This encounter set contains a fourth "g/h" act deck. Adjust the contents of the "g/h" act deck as follows. The investigators must decide (choose one): If you wish to find the source named in the Advertiser's story, remove the following act cards from the "g/h" deck: Search for the Meaning, both copies of The Overgrown Estate, and 1 of the 2 copies of Seeking Trouble, at random. If you wish to find the root of the problem, remove the following act cards from the "g/h" deck: Search for the Source, both copies of Seeking Trouble, and 1 of the 2 copies of The Overgrown Estate, at random.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Threads of Fate shown here. - Set the Veda Whitsley story asset aside, out of play. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.flavor: 你决定前往马歇尔·黑斯廷斯的庄园，进一步了解《广告人报》文章中提到的怪异事件。或许这一新的事态能为你最近遇到的其他麻烦带来一些线索。
all_card.name: 寻找意义
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在河岸城的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_flavor: You decide to head to the estate of Marshall Hastings to learn more about the strange happenings mentioned in the Advertiser's article. Perhaps this new development can shed light on your other recent troubles.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in Rivertown can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.flavor: 几名护理员和探险队成员瘫倒在周围，身体发僵、昏迷不醒。这里到底发生了什么？
all_card.name: 黑斯廷斯庄园
all_card.text: 显现 - 将黑斯廷斯庄园放置入场。 [action]从你的补给品中划掉药品：发现黑斯廷斯庄园的所有线索。
all_card.real_flavor: Several caretakers and members of the expedition lie paralyzed and comatose nearby. What in the hell happened here?
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put The Hastings Estate into play. [action] Cross medicine off from your supplies: Discover all of the clues on The Hastings Estate.

all_card.flavor: 为了查明这起新事件的真相，你决定追查《广告人报》那篇文章的匿名消息来源。或许前往北区的报社办公室能打探到更多线索——不过为了得到所需情报，恐怕免不了得打点些“好处费”。
all_card.name: 寻找来源
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在北区的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_flavor: In order to get to the bottom of this new development, you decide to search for the anonymous source of the Advertiser's article. Perhaps if you head to its offices in Northside, you can inquire further - although you may have to grease a few palms to get the information you need.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in Northside can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.name: 默尔·加文
all_card.text: 显现 - 将默尔·加文放置入场，放到米斯卡塔尼克大学上。 [action]：谈判。加文先生试图溜走。检定[agility](2)。如果你检定成功，在默尔·加文上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)并将其向远离你的方向移动1个地点。如果你检定失败，将其向远离你的方向移动2个地点。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Merle Garvin into play at Miskatonic University. [action]: Parley. Mr. Garvin tries to give you the slip. Test [agility] (2). If you succeed, place 1 clue on Merle Garvin (from the token pool) and move him 1 location away from you. If you fail, move him 2 locations away from you.

all_card.back_flavor: 你在庄园仔细搜查了一遍，却只找到些《广告人报》文章里早已提过的东西。仿佛你的噩梦成真：那片雨林真的尾随你一路来到了阿卡姆。长久以来的提心吊胆，此刻反倒让你生出一种直面它的释然。就在这时，一阵熟悉的响环声在庄园走廊里回荡。那骇人的声响让你毛骨悚然。这肯定不可能……对吧？
all_card.back_text: 查找收藏，找出瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)并将它生成在黑斯廷斯庄园。按照剧本日志括号内记录的伤害总数，瓦卢西亚的预示者在入场时带有对应数量的伤害。如果你剧本日志里的“伊格之怒”下方的记录次数小于等于5，其入场时处于横置状态。 推进到场景3g——“不可能的追猎”。
all_card.flavor: 当你抵达黑斯廷斯庄园时，发现它的状况比新闻描述的还要糟糕得多。雨林已现身于阿卡姆，几乎完全吞噬了庄园及其周边区域。
all_card.name: 蔓生庄园
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在黑斯廷斯庄园的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You scour the estate for clues but find nothing that wasn't already described in the Advertiser's article. It's like your fears have come to life: the rainforest has indeed followed you all the way here to Arkham. After dreading this for so long, it's almost a relief to finally be able to confront it. Just then, a familiar rattling echoes through the halls of the manor. The dreadful sound makes your skin crawl. Surely, it couldn't be... could it?
all_card.real_back_text: Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns) and spawn it at The Hastings Estate. It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log. If there are 5 or fewer tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play exhausted. Advance to Act 3g - "Impossible Pursuit".
all_card.real_flavor: When you arrive at the Hastings estate, you find it in a much sorrier state than was originally described. The rainforest has come to Arkham, claiming the manor and the surrounding area almost entirely.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators at The Hastings Estate can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.flavor: 你抵達黑斯廷斯莊園時，發現這裡比新聞描述的還要悽慘。雨林已現身於阿卡姆，幾乎吞沒了整片莊園及其週邊地區。
all_card.name: 植物蔓生的莊園
all_card.text: 目標 - 只有在黑斯廷斯莊園的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
all_card.real_flavor: When you arrive at the Hastings estate, you find it in a much sorrier state than was originally described. The rainforest has come to Arkham, claiming the manor and the surrounding area almost entirely.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators at The Hastings Estate can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.name: 克林顿·弗里曼
all_card.text: 显现 - 将克林顿·弗里曼放置入场，放到维尔玛小餐馆上。推进到场景3g——“探寻真相”。 [action]：谈判。检定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，在克林顿·弗里曼上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)并受到1点恐惧。如果你检定失败，每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Clinton Freeman into play at Velma's Diner. Advance to Act 3g - "Discover the Truth." [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, place 1 clue on Clinton Freeman (from the token pool) and take 1 horror. If you fail, take 1 horror for each point you failed by.

all_card.back_flavor: 你终于追上了加文先生，把他逼的无路可逃。他吓坏了——但不是因为你，而是因为别的什么东西。“它来了，”他警告道。“不把我们全弄死它绝不会停。求求你，一定要帮帮我！你得把我藏起来！”你还没来得及问究竟是什么把他吓成这样，一阵熟悉的响环声便已回答了你未说出口的疑问。那骇人的声响让你毛骨悚然。它怎么可能出现在阿卡姆？
all_card.back_text: 查找收藏，找出瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)并将它生成在默尔·加文所在地点。按照剧本日志括号内记录的伤害总数，瓦卢西亚的预示者在入场时带有对应数量的伤害。如果你剧本日志里的“伊格之怒”下方的记录次数小于等于5，其入场时处于横置状态。 推进到场景3g——“不可能的追猎”。
all_card.flavor: 你已查明《广告人报》消息源的身份：一个名叫默尔·加文的男人，他最近刚从一场探险中归来，而这场探险的资助人正是马歇尔·黑斯廷斯。他最后一次被人看见，是在大学图书馆里焦躁地翻找着什么，不过没人知道确切缘由。
all_card.name: 自找麻烦
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果默尔·加文上有1[per_investigator]个线索：你必须移除这些线索并立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When you finally track Mr. Garvin down and corner him, he is absolutely terrified - not of you, but of something else entirely. "It's coming," he warns. "It won't ever stop until all of us are dead. Please, you have to help me! You have to hide me!" Before you can ask what it is that frightens him so, your unspoken question is answered by a familiar rattling. The dreadful sound makes your skin crawl. How could it be here in Arkham?
all_card.real_back_text: Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns) and spawn it at Merle Garvin's location. It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log. If there are 5 or fewer tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play exhausted. Advance to Act 3g - "Impossible Pursuit".
all_card.real_flavor: You've learned the identity of the Advertiser's source: a man named Merle Garvin, who recently returned from an expedition funded by none other than Marshall Hastings. He was last seen anxiously rummaging through the library at the university, though nobody is quite sure why.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Merle Garvin: You must remove them and immediately advance.

all_card.flavor: 你已經得知了報社的情報來源：是個名為摩爾·加文的男子，最近從一場探險歸來，而這場探險的資助人正是馬歇爾·黑斯廷斯。他最近被人目擊到在大學圖書館焦躁地四處翻閱，不過沒人清楚他這麼做的原因。
all_card.name: 尋找麻煩
all_card.text: 目標 - 如果摩爾·加文身上有1[per_investigator]線索：你必須移除這些線索並且立即推進。
all_card.real_flavor: You've learned the identity of the Advertiser's source: a man named Merle Garvin, who recently returned from an expedition funded by none other than Marshall Hastings. He was last seen anxiously rummaging through the library at the university, though nobody is quite sure why.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Merle Garvin: You must remove them and immediately advance.

all_card.name: 装货码头
all_card.text: 显现 - 将装货码头放置入场，其入场时带有4个资源标记。推进到场景3g——“探寻真相”。 装货码头上没有资源时，其上的线索不能以任何方式被发现。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：移除装货码头上的1资源。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Loading Docks into play with 4 resources on it. Advance to Act 3g - "Discover the Truth." While there are no resources on Loading Docks, clues on it cannot be discovered by any means. Forced - At the end of the round: Remove 1 resource from Loading Docks.

all_card.back_text:
如果克林顿·弗里曼在场：
弗里曼先生终于对你吐露了真相：他那场探险的一部分资金出自墨西哥城的一位神秘“慈善家”，对方要求用几件遗物作为回报。出于好奇和担忧，他和他的同伴们主动提出要帮助你查明事件背后的真相。
距离克林顿·弗里曼最近的调查员控制放在一边的薇达·惠茨利。将剩余的“g/h”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
如果装货码头在场：
多亏了加文先生提供的信息，你发现探险队的诸多收获正被运往一个令人意外的目的地：墨西哥城的一位不明收货人。出于对你相助的感激，几位探险队成员主动提出要助你一臂之力。
距离装货码头最近的调查员控制放在一边的薇达·惠茨利。将剩余的“g/h”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 你即将揭开这另一场探险背后的真相。他们究竟在寻找什么，原因又是什么？这一切是否和伊塔卡以及埃兹特里有所关联？
all_card.name: 探寻真相
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果克林顿·弗里曼上有1[per_investigator]个线索：你必须移除这些线索并立即推进。 目标 - 如果装货码头在场且其上没有剩余线索：你必须立即推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If Clinton Freeman is in play:
Mr. Freeman finally reveals to you the truth: that his expedition was partially funded by a mysterious "philanthropist" in Mexico City, in return for several relics. Curious - and worried - he and his partners offer to help you get to the bottom of this.
The investigator nearest to Clinton Freeman takes control of the set-aside Veda Whitsley. Remove the remainder of the "g/h" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If Loading Docks is in play:
Thanks to Mr. Garvin's information, you discover that many of the expedition's finds are heading to a surprising destination: an unspecified recipient in Mexico City. Grateful for your assistance, several members of the expedition offer you their help.
The investigator nearest to the Loading Docks takes control of the set-aside Veda Whitsley. Remove the remainder of the "g/h" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
all_card.real_flavor: You're close to learning the truth behind this other expedition. What were they after, and why? Does this have anything to do with Ichtaca and the Eztli?
all_card.real_text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Clinton Freeman: You must remove them and immediately advance. Objective - If Loading Docks is in play and there are no clues remaining on it: You must immediately advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 那蛇形生物来得突然，去得也快。你仍不确定它是否真的存在过，但至少此刻，你似乎是安全的。出于对你相助的感激，另一支探险队的几位成员主动提出要助你一臂之力。至于他们发现的文物是否与埃兹特里有关，仍有待查证。无论如何，如果这类怪物继续纠缠不休，他们的专业知识无疑能派上用场。
all_card.back_text: 距离瓦卢西亚的预示者最近的调查员控制放在一边的薇达·惠茨利。 将剩余的“g/h”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 你从未想过这生物会一路追踪你到阿卡姆。又或许它只是你臆想的产物。是你脑海中的幽灵。是你潜意识的一块碎片，想要让你远离这场调查。
all_card.name: 不可能的追猎
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果瓦卢西亚的预示者离场，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As quickly as it arrived, the serpent-thing is gone. You're still not sure if it was really there to begin with, but for the moment, it seems you are safe. Grateful for your assistance, several members of the other expedition offer you their help. Whether or not there was a link to the Eztli in the relics they found remains to be seen. Regardless, their expertise will surely be invaluable if creatures like this one continue to haunt your every step.
all_card.real_back_text: The investigator nearest to the Harbinger of Valusia takes control of the set-aside Veda Whitsley. Remove the remainder of the "g/h" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
all_card.real_flavor: You never thought this creature would track you all the way to Arkham. Or perhaps it's just a figment of your imagination. A ghost in your mind. A shard of your subconscious, driving you away from this line of inquiry.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If the Harbinger of Valusia leaves play, advance.

all_card.name: 薇达·惠茨利
all_card.text: [free]横置薇达·惠茨利：查看探索牌库或遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。如果是敌人，你可以对薇达·惠茨利造成1点伤害来将其弃掉。如果是诡计，你可以对薇达·惠茨利造成1点恐惧来将其弃掉。否则，将其放回其牌库顶。
all_card.real_text: [fast] Exhaust Veda Whitsley: Look at the top card of the exploration deck or encounter deck. If it is an enemy, you may deal 1 damage to Veda Whitsley to discard it. If it is a treachery, you may deal 1 horror to Veda Whitsley to discard it. Otherwise, return it to the top of its deck.

all_card.back_text: - 将新的[[现代]]地点加入原版界限彼端的遭遇组中。在每2张同名地点中，随机选择1张从游戏中移除。将剩余地点放置入场。 - 在冒险设置后，查找收藏，找出新版的瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)并将其放在一边，位于场外。在本场冒险期间，如果要将瓦卢西亚的预示者放置入场，使用该版本替代原版。 - 在创建探索牌库时，仅使用12张单面[[古代]]地点。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。
all_card.name: 重返界限彼端
all_card.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返界限彼端找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text: - Add the new [[Present-Day]] locations to the original locations from The Boundary Beyond encounter set. Remove 1 of the 2 copies of each of these locations from the game at random. Put the remaining locations into play. - After setup, search the collection for the new Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns) and set it aside, out of play. If the Harbinger of Valusia would enter play during this scenario, use this version instead of the original one. - When building the exploration deck, use only the 12 single-sided [[Ancient]] locations. Do not include any of the other encounter cards listed in the original setup instructions.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Boundary Beyond shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: 尽管特诺奇蒂特兰主神庙的确切位置仍未得知，但挖掘工作已经开展，以搜寻这片区域曾经存在的多座神庙的遗迹。
all_card.name: 神庙遗迹
all_card.text: [reaction]在你成功调查神庙遗迹后：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Though the exact location of the main temple of Tenochtitlán is not yet known, excavation has begun in search of the ruins of the many temples that once covered this area.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate Temple Ruins: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

all_card.back_flavor: 大都会教堂坐落在索卡洛广场北边，西班牙征服者们在攻陷阿兹特克王朝后建造了这座建筑。在这座教堂的每个钟塔上方，有一缕缕云彩在诡异地打旋。
all_card.name: 大都会教堂
all_card.text: [action]受到1点恐惧：获得2资源。 [action]如果你有至少10点资源：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Catedral Metropolitana, situated on the northern side of the Plaza de la Constitución, was built by conquistadors after the conquest of the Aztec Empire. Cloud wisps swirl eerily over each of the cathedral's bell towers.
all_card.real_text: [action] Take 1 horror: Gain 2 resources. [action] If you have 10 or more resources: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

all_card.back_flavor: 查普尔特佩克公园这个美丽的生态地标是西方最大的城市公园之一。在这里能将全城美景尽收眼底，其建造地在几个世纪之前曾是一处丛林。
all_card.name: 查普尔特佩克公园
all_card.text: 强制 - 你位于查普尔特佩克公园时，[agility]技能检定失败后：受到1点伤害。 [action]：探索。检定[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点在左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: One of the largest city parks in the west, the Bosque de Chapultepec is a beautiful ecological landmark overlooking the city, built in what was once a sacred forest many centuries ago.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail an [agility] test while at Chapultepec Park: Take 1 damage. [action]: Explore. Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

all_card.back_flavor: 墨西哥城中央的主广场就在你眼前，这里曾是特诺奇蒂特兰的仪式中心。银色的闪电出现在上空的重重乌云之中，而你震惊地发现一股鲜血洪潮在广场上漫延。整座城市异常地毫无生机，死气沉沉。
all_card.name: 索卡洛广场
all_card.text: [action]弃掉你技能图标总计至少有4个的手牌：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The main square in central Mexico City, once the ceremonial center of Tenochtitlán, stretches before you. Silver lightning flashes in the storm clouds overhead, and you are shocked to find a tide of blood swelling over the plaza. The entire city is bizarrely devoid of any life.
all_card.real_text: [action] Discard cards with a combined total of at least 4 skill icons from your hand: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

all_card.back_flavor: 一艘小木船撞在运河边上，在潺潺流动的河水上荡漾起水波。旁边的浅水滩头上有一株醒目的松树，在微风中轻轻摇曳。
all_card.name: 霍奇米尔科
all_card.text: [reaction]在你成功在霍奇米尔科攻击或躲避一个敌人后：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A small wooden boat bumps up against the side of the canal, swaying gently in the rippling water. A juniper tree sticks out of the shallow water nearby, bending in the mild breeze.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully fight or evade an enemy at Xochimilco: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

all_card.back_flavor: 尽管科约阿坎区曾经不属于墨西哥城，但它始终是一块历史悠久的地区，其特征是有着诸多狭窄的鹅卵石街道和广场。当你走在这个村落的狭窄小道上时，地面伴有震动，你怀疑还有着更多的未知生命居于地下……
all_card.name: 科约阿坎区
all_card.text: 你位于科约阿坎区时，你控制的卡牌上的伤害/恐惧不能被治愈。 [action]如果你的调查员上总计有至少5点伤害和/或恐惧：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Although not always a part of Mexico City, Coyoacán has always been a historic area, marked by narrow cobblestone streets and plazas. The ground shakes as you walk down one of the village’s many confined paths, and you suspect there is more that lives below the surface...
all_card.real_text: While you are at Coyoacán, damage/horror cannot be healed from cards you control. [action] If you have 5 or more total damage and/or horror on your investigator: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.

all_card.back_text:
- 在创建探索牌库时，从以下每个地点符号的2张地点中随机选择1张加入：紫色月亮、蓝色三角、红色方形、橙色心形。将其余4张[[丛林]]地点从游戏中移除，不要查看。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。(总计应有6张卡牌。)
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “昆扬之口的‘检查你的补给品’能力可以在任意地点使用。 强制 - 在一次成功的探索结束后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返久远腹地，第一部分
all_card.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返久远腹地，第一部分找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将场景1a——“研究图案”从游戏中移除，使用新的场景1a——“熟悉的图案”替代。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- When building the exploration deck, include only 1 of the 2 locations with each of the following connection symbols, chosen at random: Purple Moon, Blue Triangle, Red Square, Orange Heart. Remove the other 4 [[Jungle]] locations from the game without looking at them. Do not include any of the other encounter cards listed in the original setup instructions. (There should be a total of 6 cards.)
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rules apply: "The 'check your supplies' ability on the Mouth of K'n-yan can be used from any location. Forced - After a successful exploration ends: Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the exploration deck." Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_name: Return to Heart of the Elders, Part 1
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Heart of the Elders, Part 1 shown here. - Remove Act 1a - "Search for the Pattern" from the game and replace it with the new Act 1a - "A Familiar Pattern." (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.flavor: 六根石柱围绕着洞穴入口，每根石柱都刻着许多异常的凹槽和象形文字，形成了错综复杂的图案。触摸石柱的时候凹槽上的光芒会变得明亮，而转动石柱时则会使得图案转动并改变。或许这些图案与在丛林其他地方找到的象形文字是对应的？
all_card.name: 熟悉的图案
all_card.text: 目标 - 在调查员拥有所需数量的线索时，必须立即花费线索并推进。
all_card.real_flavor: Six stone pillars surround the entrance to the cavern, each carved with a series of uncanny grooves and hieroglyphs that form an intricate pattern. Touching them causes the grooves to glow brightly, and twisting them causes the patterns to shift and change. Perhaps these patterns match the glyphs found in other regions of the rainforest?
all_card.real_text: Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance.

all_card.name: 羽翼蛇族
all_card.text: 生成 - 昆扬之口。 猎手。庞大。 不能被击败。不能进行趁乱攻击。 强制 - 如果本敌人上有5点或更多伤害，或在一个石柱标记被放置在昆扬之口上后：治愈其所有伤害并将其横置。其在本轮补给阶段期间不重整。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 蛇族. 精英
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Mouth of K'n-yan. Hunter. Massive. Cannot be defeated. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Forced - If there are 5 or more damage on this enemy, or after a pillar token is placed on the Mouth of K'n-yan: Heal all damage from this enemy and exhaust it. It does not ready during the upkeep phase this round.

all_card.name: 鲜翎蛇族
all_card.text: 其中X为昆扬之口上石柱标记的数量。X为3或更高时，鲜翎蛇族获得警戒和猎手。 [action]：躲避。检查你的补给品。如果你带有神秘权杖，你自动躲避鲜翎蛇族，并命令它对其所在地点的另一个敌人造成它的伤害。
all_card.real_text: X is the number of pillar tokens on Mouth of K'n-yan. While X is 3 or higher, Feathered Serpent gains alert and hunter. [action]: Evade. Check your supplies. If you have a mysterious scepter, you automatically evade the serpent and command it to deal its damage to another enemy at its location.

all_card.back_text:
- 在创建探索牌库时，从以下每个地点符号的2张地点中随机选择1张加入：紫色月亮、蓝色三角、红色方形、绿色菱形。将其余4张[[古代]]地点从游戏中移除，不要查看。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。(不计入放在一边的深入幽嘶，总计应有5张卡牌。)
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “昆扬之口的‘检查你的补给品’能力可以在任意地点使用，且该能力既能弃掉诡计，也能弃掉敌人。 强制 - 在一次成功的探索结束后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返久远腹地，第二部分
all_card.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返久远腹地，第二部分找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 在冒险设置后，查找收藏，找出新版的瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)并将其放在一边，位于场外。在本场冒险期间，如果要将瓦卢西亚的预示者放置入场，使用该版本替代原版。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- When building the exploration deck, include only 1 of the 2 locations with each of the following connection symbols, chosen at random: Purple Moon, Blue Triangle, Red Square, Green Diamond. Remove the other 4 [[Ancient]] locations from the game without looking at them. Do not include any of the other encounter cards listed in the original setup instructions. (There should be a total of 5 cards, not counting the set-aside Descent to Yoth.)
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rules apply: "The 'check your supplies' ability on the Mouth of K'n-yan can be used from any location, and it discards enemies as well as treacheries. Forced - After a successful exploration ends: Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the exploration deck." Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_name: Return to Heart of the Elders, Part 2
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Heart of the Elders, Part 2 shown here. - After setup, search the collection for the new Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns) and set it aside, out of play. If the Harbinger of Valusia would enter play during this scenario, use this version instead of the original one. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.name: 昆扬遗迹
all_card.text: [action][action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有指南针，发现昆扬遗迹的2个线索。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.traits: 古代. 洞穴. 遗迹
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Check your supplies. If you have a compass, discover 2 clues on Ruins of K'n-yan. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 地下沼泽
all_card.text: [free]如果地下沼泽上没有线索：检查你的补给品。如果你带有水壶，在本地点上放置1个毁灭标记并在你的补给品中记录“粘液团”。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。) 强制 - 在你调查地下沼泽时，技能检定失败后：检查你的补给品。如果你没有折叠小刀，失去所有剩余行动并结束你的回合。
all_card.real_text: [fast] If there are no clues on Subterranean Swamp: Check your supplies. If you have a canteen, place 1 doom on this location and record "sticky goop" in your supplies. (Group limit once per game.) Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Subterranean Swamp: Check your supplies. If you do not have a pocketknife, lose all remaining actions and end your turn.

all_card.name: 钻地魔虫深渊
all_card.text: 强制 - 在钻地魔虫深渊的最后一个线索被发现后：检查你的补给品。如果本地点没有调查员带有火把，在其上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from Chthonian Depths: Check your supplies. If no investigator at this location has torches, place 1 doom on it.

all_card.name: 险恶坡道
all_card.text: [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有鹤嘴锄，在本场冒险的剩余时间里，险恶坡道的隐藏值降低2点。(团队每场游戏仅限3次。)
all_card.real_text: [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a pickaxe, reduce the shroud value of Treacherous Descent by 2 for the remainder of the scenario. (Group limit 3 times per game.)

all_card.back_text: - 将巨石密库和异星培育所放在一边，位于场外。(这些地点应在场景1b“将所有放在一边的地点放置入场”时放置入场。) - 将场景2a——“禁止通行”从游戏中移除，用新版的场景2a——“自由通行”替换。
all_card.name: 重返天机之城
all_card.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返天机之城找出新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将纳克特廊道(南翼通道)放置入场。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text: - Set Cyclopean Vaults and Alien Conservatory aside, out of play. (These locations should be put into play during act 1b when the remainder of the set-aside locations are put into play.) - Remove Act 2a - "Restricted Access" from the game and replace it with the new Act 2a - "Unrestricted Access."
all_card.real_name: Return to The City of Archives
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The City of Archives shown here. - Put Halls of Pnakotus (Southern Corridors) into play. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.back_flavor: 事实令人难以接受。你的身体从未被带到这里来。你的意识已被转移到这具身体中，属于这群生物的其中一个同胞。在其他的某个地方——在某个时空——这群该死的生物中的一员就居住在你的身体中。
all_card.back_text: 你再也不必执行以下任何任务。但是，你在本场冒险结束之前执行的任务越多，就越容易能转移到你的人类身体中，这项程式失败或产生反作用的几率也更低。但要当心…… 将本场景放到胜利区，本面朝上，作为提醒。 - 有调查员“找到了归位程式”。 - 有调查员“解剖了一个器官”。 - 有调查员“进行了一次会谈”。 - 有调查员“发现了现在的年份”。 - 有调查员“启动了设备”。 - 有调查员控制了看管人。 - 有调查员“阅读了关于地球的知识”。 - 有调查员“看到了熟悉的样本”。
all_card.name: 自由通行
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果以下情况中，有三种情况已发生，你必须推进场景： - 有调查员“找到了归位程式”。 - 有调查员“解剖了一个器官”。 - 有调查员“进行了一次会谈”。 - 有调查员“发现了现在的年份”。 - 有调查员“启动了设备”。 - 有调查员控制了看管人。 - 有调查员“阅读了关于地球的知识”。 - 有调查员“看到了熟悉的样本”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The truth is hard to accept. Your body was never brought to this place. Your mind has been transferred into the body of one of these creatures. Somewhere, in another place - in another time - one of the reviled creatures dwells in your body.
all_card.real_back_text: You no longer have to perform any of the following tasks. However, the more you have performed by the time the scenario ends, the easier the transition to your human body will be, and the less likely the process is to fail or backfire. Be careful... Put this act into play with this side faceup as a reminder. - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian. - An investigator "read about Earth." - An investigator "saw a familiar specimen."
all_card.real_text: Objective - If three of the following are true, you must advance: - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian. - An investigator "read about Earth." - An investigator "saw a familiar specimen."

all_card.back_text: 本地点与纳克特廊道(东翼通道)和纳克特廊道(西翼通道)连接，反之亦然。
all_card.name: 纳克特廊道
all_card.text:
本地点与纳克特廊道(东翼通道)和纳克特廊道(西翼通道)连接，反之亦然。
[free]在你回合期间，选择并弃掉一张手牌：移动到另一个纳克特廊道。(每回合仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_text: This location is connected to Halls of Pnakotus (Eastern Corridors) and Halls of Pnakotus (Western Corridors), and vice versa.
all_card.real_text: This location is connected to Halls of Pnakotus (Eastern Corridors) and Halls of Pnakotus (Western Corridors), and vice versa. [fast] During your turn, choose and discard a card from your hand: Move to another copy of Halls of Pnakotus. (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.back_flavor: 我最终来到一处低矮的圆形地窟，周围环列着拱门——保存得惊人地完好——向各个方向延伸。墙面上，或者说火把照亮的类似墙面的部分，都是密密麻麻象形文字，还刻满了典型的曲线符号——其中一些，是在我那些梦境之后才添上的。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 巨石密库
all_card.text:
[action]：弃掉你所有非弱点手牌。
[action]如果你没有手牌：记住你“阅读了关于地球的知识”。
[action][action]如果你的手牌少于5张：抽取卡牌，直到你有正好5张手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: I came at last to a low, circular crypt with arches - still in a marvellous state of preservation - opening off on every side. The walls, or such parts of them as lay within reach of my torchlight, were densely hieroglyphed and chiselled with typical curvilinear symbols - some added since the period of my dreams. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_text:
[action]: Discard each non-weakness card in your hand.
[action] If you have no cards in your hand: Remember that you "read about Earth."
[action][action] If you have fewer than 5 cards in your hand: Draw cards until you have exactly 5 cards in your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: ……伟大种族本身已近乎全知，继而致力于与其他行星的智慧生命建立意识交换，探索它们的过去与未来。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
all_card.name: 异星培育所
all_card.text:
你位于异星培育所时，你手牌上限减少2张。
[action]：检定[willpower](1)。如果你检定成功，检定[agility](2)。如果你检定成功，检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，记住你“看到了熟悉的样本”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: ...the Great Race itself waxed well-nigh omniscient, and turned to the task of setting up exchanges with the minds of other planets, and of exploring their pasts and futures. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>
all_card.real_text:
While you are in the Alien Conservatory, decrease your maximum hand size by 2.
[action]: Test [willpower] (1). If you succeed, test [agility] (2). If you succeed, test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, remember that you "saw a familiar specimen."

all_card.name: 被奴役的实验体
all_card.text: 生成 - 异星培育所。 冷漠。反击。 如果有调查员“阅读了关于地球的知识”或“看到了熟悉的样本”，被奴役的实验体失去冷漠并获得猎手。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Alien Conservatory. Aloof. Retaliate. If an investigator "read about Earth" or "saw a familiar specimen," Captive Subjects loses aloof and gains hunter.

all_card.back_text:
- 在冒险设置期间创建探索牌库后，将幽嘶险境诡计洗入探索牌库。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “强制 - 在场景1b期间创建新的探索牌库后：查找遭遇牌库、遭遇弃牌堆和所有场外区域，找出幽嘶险境并将其洗入探索牌库。如果查找过遭遇牌库，将其混洗。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返幽嘶深渊
all_card.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返幽嘶深渊找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 在冒险设置后，查找收藏，找出新版的瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)并将其放在一边，位于场外。在本场冒险期间，如果要将瓦卢西亚的预示者放置入场，使用该版本替代原版。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- After building the exploration deck during setup, shuffle the Perils of Yoth treachery into the exploration deck.
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rule applies: "Forced - After a new exploration deck is created during act 1b: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and all out-of-play areas for Perils of Yoth and shuffle it into the exploration deck. Shuffle the encounter deck if it was searched." Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_name: Return to The Depths of Yoth
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Depths of Yoth shown here. - After setup, search the collection for the new Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns) and set it aside, out of play. If the Harbinger of Valusia would enter play during this scenario, use this version instead of the original one. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.name: 幽嘶险境
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 将幽嘶险境放在一边，位于场外。(本次探索失败。) - 将幽嘶险境放在一边，位于场外；受到等于当前深度等级的伤害或恐惧；并继续探索如同你没有抽取幽嘶险境。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Set Perils of Yoth aside, out of play. (This exploration fails.) - Set Perils of Yoth aside, out of play: take horror or damage equal to the current depth level; and continue exploring as if you had not drawn Perils of Yoth.

all_card.back_text:
- 将新的[[破碎]]地点放在一边，位于场外。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “强制 - 在一次成功的探索结束后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返破碎永世
all_card.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返破碎永世找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 在创建探索牌库时，仅使用4张单面[[异界]]地点。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- Set the new [[Shattered]] locations aside, out of play.
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rule applies: "Forced - After a successful exploration ends: Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the exploration deck." Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Shattered Aeons shown here. - When building the exploration deck, use only the 4 single-sided [[Otherworld]] locations. Do not include any of the other encounter cards listed in the original setup instructions. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.name: 塞拉伊诺大图书馆
all_card.text: [reaction]在你移动到塞拉伊诺大图书馆后，在其上放置1个毁灭标记：查看遭遇牌库、探索牌库或任意玩家牌库顶的牌。你可以弃掉该卡牌。
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you move to Great Hall of Celeano, place 1 doom on it: Look at the top card of the encounter deck, the exploration deck, or any player deck. You may discard that card.

all_card.name: 布宜诺斯艾利斯
all_card.text: 布宜诺斯艾利斯上每有1个毁灭标记，其隐藏值-2。 强制 - 当神话阶段结束时：在布宜诺斯艾利斯上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Buenos Aires gets -2 shroud for each doom on it. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Place 1 doom on Buenos Aires.

all_card.name: 极北之地
all_card.text: 强制 - 在极北之地入场后：查找混乱袋，找出[elder_sign]混乱标记并将其封印在此地点上。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Ultima Thule enters play: Search the chaos bag for the [elder_sign] chaos token and seal it on Ultima Thule.

all_card.name: 不可知的过去
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 揭示4个混乱标记。每揭示1个[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。 - 选择并弃掉你的1张手牌，并将不可知的过去洗入探索牌库。不可知的过去如果是从探索牌库抽出的，你不能选择这个选项。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Reveal 4 chaos tokens. For each [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol revealed, take 1 damage and 1 horror. - Choose and discard 1 card from your hand and shuffle Unknowable Past into the exploration deck. You cannot choose this option if Unknowable Past was drawn from the exploration deck.

all_card.back_text:
- 在冒险设置前，使用本遭遇组新版的遗迹入口、古代石厅、华美石室和时间石室地点替换原版的。 - 在冒险设置前，使用新版的瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)替换原版的瓦卢西亚的预示者。 - 在创建探索牌库时，仅使用封印通道、彩砖石室、古代墓穴、王座大厅、蛇洞、古代石厅和华美石室。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “强制 - 在一次成功的探索结束后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
all_card.name: 重返时间倒流
all_card.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返时间倒流找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 从蛇族遭遇组中找出3张蝮蛇，将它们放在一边，位于场外。 - 在冒险设置前，将原版的坑葬墓室、地下遗迹和秘密通道地点从游戏中移除。 (继续阅读背面。)
all_card.real_back_text:
- Beforoe setup, replace the original Entryway, Ancient Hall, Grand Chamber, and Chamber of Time locations with the new versions from this encounter set. - Before setup, replace the original Harbinger of Valusia enemy with the new Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns). - When building the exploration deck, use only Sealed Passage, Mosaic Chamber, Tomb of the Ancients, Throne Room, Snake Pit, Ancient Hall, and Grand Chamber. Do not include any of the other encounter cards listed in the original setup instructions.
For the duration of this scenario, the following additional rule applies: "Forced - After a successful exploration ends: Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the exploration deck." Attach this card to the scenario reference card as a reminder.
all_card.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Turn Back Time shown here. - Gather the 3 Pit Viper cards from the Serpents encounter set and set them aside, out of play. - Before setup, remove the original Burial Pit, Underground Ruins, and Secret Passage locations from the game. (Continued on reverse side.)

all_card.name: 河畔神庙
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你发现河畔神庙任意数量的线索后：检查你的补给品。如果位于河畔神庙的调查员没有粉笔，将等量遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After any number of clues are discovered at Riverside Temple: Check your supplies. If no investigator at Riverside Temple has chalk, shuffle an equal number of cards from the top of the encounter deck into the exploration deck.

all_card.name: 瀑布
all_card.text: [reaction]在你调查瀑布时：检查你的补给品。如果位于瀑布的调查员带有绳索，本次调查瀑布的隐藏值降低3点。 强制 - 在你调查瀑布时，技能检定失败后：随机弃掉你的1张手牌。
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you investigate Waterfall: Check your supplies. If an investigator at Waterfall has rope, reduce Waterfall's shroud by 3 for this investigation. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Waterfall: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.name: 亡者之径
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你在亡者之径调查或探索后：检查你的补给品。如果位于亡者之径的调查员没有双筒望远镜，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you investigate or explore while at Trail of the Dead: Check your supplies. If no investigator at Trail of the Dead has binoculars, take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 云雾林
all_card.text: 强制 - 在云雾林上的敌人将要受到任意数量的伤害时：检查你的补给品。如果位于云雾林的调查员没有火把，取消该伤害。
all_card.real_text: Forced - When an enemy at Cloud Forest would be dealt any amount of damage: Check your supplies. If no investigator at Cloud Forest has torches, cancel that damage.

all_card.name: 兄弟会侍僧
all_card.text: 生成 - 有最多[[异教徒]]敌人的地点。 冷漠。 强制 - 在兄弟会侍僧入场后：在其所在地点的其他每个[[异教徒]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Location with the most [[Cultist]] enemies. Aloof. Forced - After Brotherhood Acolyte enters plaay: Place 1 doom on each other [[Cultist]] enemy at its location.

all_card.name: 被窃取的思维
all_card.text: 生成 - 任意无人地点。 反击。 被窃取的思维上每有一个毁灭标记，其得到+1攻击值。 强制 - 当神话阶段结束时：在被窃取的思维上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Any empty location. Retaliate. Stolen Mind gets +1 fight for each doom on it. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Place 1 doom on Stolen Mind.

all_card.name: 来自另一个时代
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](4)。在场上的[[异教徒]]敌人上放置总计X个毁灭标记，尽可能平均分配。其中X为你检定失败且低于难度的点数。如果你检定失败且场上没有[[异教徒]]敌人，改为查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个[[异教徒]]敌人并将其抽取(混洗遭遇牌库)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (4). Place X doom on [[Cultist]] enemies in play, divided as evenly as possible. X is the amount you failed by. If you fail and there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, instead search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it (shuffle the encounter deck).

all_card.name: 怨愤荒野
all_card.text: 显现 - 受到1点恐惧，并将怨愤荒野附属到最近的且没有附属怨愤荒野的地点。 强制 - 在你在附属的地点探索成功后：将怨愤荒野加入胜利区。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Take 1 horror and attach Resentful Wilds to the nearest location without a copy of Resentful Wilds attached. Forced - After you successfully explore at attached location: Add Resentful Wilds to the victory display.

all_card.name: 最精心的计划
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 失去2个行动。 - 将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Lose 2 actions. - Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the exploration deck.

all_card.name: 融合时间线
all_card.text: 显现 - 弃掉你牌库顶的5张卡牌。对于你的与被弃掉的卡牌名称相同的每张手牌(相同标题)，弃掉该卡牌并失去1个行动。将每张因此效果弃掉的弱点洗回你的牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. For each card in your hand that matches one of the cards (by title), discard that card from your hand and lose 1 action. Shuffle each weakness discarded by this effect into your deck.

all_card.name: 廷达洛斯头犬
all_card.text: 警戒。反击。 强制 - 在廷达洛斯头犬攻击你后：将一张你控制的非剧情支援洗回你的牌库，将该支援卡牌上的所有伤害和恐惧移动到你的调查员上。弃掉廷达洛斯头犬。 强制 - 在敌军阶段结束后：弃掉廷达洛斯头犬。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 异次元. 廷达洛斯
all_card.real_text: Alert. Retaliate. Forced - After Tindalos Alpha attacks you: Shuffle a non-story asset you control into your deck, moving all damage and horror from that asset to your investigator. Discard Tindalos Alpha. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Discard Tindalos Alpha.

all_card.name: 复仇蛇人
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在你抽取复仇蛇人后：抽取胜利区中每张复仇蛇人。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 蛇族
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - After you draw Vengeful Serpent: Draw each Vengeful Serpent in the victory display as well.

all_card.name: 蛇族守卫
all_card.text: 生成 - 最近的有至少1个线索的地点。 冷漠。 蛇族守卫未交战时，其所在地点隐藏值+2。 胜利区内有至少3点复仇点数时，蛇族守卫失去冷漠并获得猎手。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Nearest location with at least 1 clue. Aloof. While Serpent Guardian is unengaged, its location gets +2 shroud. While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, Serpent Guardian loses aloof and gains hunter.

all_card.name: 伊格的怒火
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。胜利区内有每有1点复仇点数，本次检定难度+1。如果你检定失败，将放在一边的一个中毒弱点放置入场，放到你的威胁区域(如果你不能，受到2点伤害)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each vengeance point in the victory display. If you fail, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area (if you cannot, take 2 damage).

all_card.flavor: 他点燃了打火机，内心平静了下来。
all_card.name: “同归于尽！”
all_card.text: 击败与你交战的每个非[[精英]]敌人。你被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
all_card.real_flavor: He flicked open the lighter and made his peace.
all_card.real_text: Each non-[[Elite]] enemy engaged with you is defeated. You are defeated and suffer 1 physical trauma. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

all_card.name: .45自动手枪
all_card.text: 使用(4子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。本次攻击忽略反击关键词。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械
all_card.real_text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. Ignore the retaliate keyword for this attack.

all_card.flavor: “我是活着的最智慧的人，因为我知道一件事，那就是我知道我一无所知。”<cite>——柏拉图，《理想国》</cite>
all_card.name: 逻辑推理
all_card.text:
仅当你至少拥有1个线索才可打出。
选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员治愈2点恐惧或弃掉其威胁区域中的一张[[恐怖]]卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor:
"I am the wisest man alive, for I know one thing, and that is that I know nothing."
- Plato, <u>The Republic</u>
all_card.real_text:
Play only if you have at least 1 clue.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator either heals 2 horror or discards a [[Terror]] card from his or her threat area.

all_card.name: 古代雕文
all_card.text: 研究完成。(FAQ v2.0)使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。你检定成功且每超过难度2点，发现你所在地点的额外1个线索。
all_card.real_text: Researched. Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. For every 2 points you succeed by, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

all_card.name: 古代雕文
all_card.text: 研究完成。(FAQ v2.0)使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。如果你检定成功，你可以自动躲避一个与你交战的敌人。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
all_card.real_text: Researched. Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. If you succeed, you may automatically evade an engaged enemy. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

all_card.flavor: “瞄准眼晴。”他们这么告诉我的。
all_card.name: 暗中偷袭
all_card.text: 攻击。本次攻击将你的[agility]值加入你的技能值。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，自动躲避被攻击敌人。
all_card.real_flavor: "Aim for the eyes," they told me.
all_card.real_text: Fight. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, automatically evade the attacked enemy.

all_card.name: 扒窃
all_card.text:
快速。
[reaction]在你躲避一个敌人后，横置扒窃：抽取1张卡牌或获得1资源。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，改为执行以上两项。
all_card.real_text:
Fast.
[reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Pickpocketing: Draw 1 card or gain 1 resource. If you succeeded by 2 or more, do both instead.

all_card.name: 量子通量
all_card.text: 将你的弃牌堆洗入你的牌库并抽取1张卡牌。将量子通量从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_text: Shuffle your discard pile into your deck and draw 1 card. Remove Quantum Flux from the game.

all_card.name: 重新充能
all_card.text: 选择你所在地点的一位调查员控制的一张[[法术]]或[[遗物]]支援，并从混乱袋随机揭示一个混乱标记。如果你揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，弃掉所选支援。否则，为所选支援增加3充能。
all_card.real_text: Choose a [[Spell]] or [[Relic]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location and reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, discard the chosen asset. Otherwise, add 3 charges to the chosen asset.

all_card.name: 拉布兰奇夫人
all_card.text:
[free]如果你没有手牌，横置拉布兰奇夫人：抽取1张卡牌。
[free]如果你没有资源，横置拉布兰奇夫人：获得1资源。
all_card.real_text:
[fast] If you have no cards in your hand, exhaust Madame Labranche: Draw 1 card.
[fast] If you have no resources, exhaust Madame Labranche: Gain 1 resource.

all_card.name: 诱捕陷阱
all_card.text: 附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限1张。 强制 - 在一个非[[精英]]敌人进入被附属地点后：横置该敌人，它与所有调查员解除交战，井将诱捕陷阱附属到它上。 强制 - 在被附属敌人将要重整时：改为弃掉诱捕陷阱。
all_card.real_text: Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. Forced - After a non-[[Elite]] enemy enters attached location: Exhaust that enemy, disengage it from all investigators, and attach Snare Trap to it. Forced - When attached enemy would ready: Instead, discard Snare Trap.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]：-X。X为场上的毁灭标记总数。 [cultist]：-2。将场上每个未与调查员交战的[[拜亚基]]朝最近的调查员移动一次。 [tablet]：-4。取消投入本次检定的每张技能卡牌上的效果和图标。 [elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，每低于难度1点，失去1资源。
all_card.name: 真相幻影
