all_card.back_flavor: 小鸟唧唧喳喳开始鸣唱。天边渐渐染上了一层橙红色，黑夜中的生物退回了黑暗之中。你把白天大部分时间都用来休息，很快阳光就黯淡了下来。你还没有完全从前一夜中恢复，又迎来了新的一夜。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员和与自己交战的每个敌人解除交战，且可以移动到一个连接地点。将风琴手朝着远离最近的调查员的方向移动1个地点(如可能，移动到一个没有调查员的地点)。
all_card.flavor: 你走出奥赛火车站时，太阳已经沉入了巴黎的地平线下。你不能再浪费时间了。如果奈杰尔·英格兰姆就在巴黎，你必须找到他，逼他为你答疑解惑。
all_card.name: 第一夜
all_card.text: 你的确信高于疑惑时，本密谋获得： “在检查毁灭阈值时，改为从场上毁灭标记总数中减去本密谋以外的其他卡牌上的毁灭标记数，而不是加上。”
all_card.real_back_flavor: Birds start to chirp eagerly. An orange tint slowly spreads across the sky as the creatures of the night shrink back into the darkness. You spend most of the day resting, and the daylight passes quickly with very little to show for it. Before you are able to fully recover from the previous night's events, it is evening once more
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator disengages from each enemy engaged with him or her and may move to a connecting location. Move The Organist 1 location away from the nearest investigator (to a location with no investigators, if possible).
all_card.real_flavor: As you step off the train in Gare d’Orsay, the sun sinks below the Paris skyline. You cannot waste any time. If Nigel Engram is somewhere in Paris, you have to find him and wring the answers from him one way or another.
all_card.real_text: While you have more Conviction than Doubt, this agenda gains: "When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it."

all_card.back_flavor: 太阳终于再次冉冉升起，从东边的地平线探出了头，在街道上投射出长长的影子。前一夜的风波让你筋疲力竭。让你感觉好像连续几周没有睡觉。说不定还真是这样。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员和与自己交战的每个敌人解除交战，且可以移动到一个连接地点。将风琴手朝着远离最近的调查员的方向移动1个地点(如可能，移动到一个没有调查员的地点)。 检查剧本日志。如果“贵宾遇害”下没有乔丹·佩里，查找收藏，找出乔丹·佩里(盛气凌人)并将其生成在蒙巴纳斯。
all_card.flavor: 寒影裹挟着街道，城中又开始骚动起来。你身边危机四伏。而你却无从脱身。它们会跟随你到天涯海角。这个噩梦究竟何时才能结束？
all_card.name: 第二夜
all_card.text: 你的确信高于疑惑时，本密谋获得： “在检查毁灭阈值时，改为从场上毁灭标记总数中减去本密谋以外的其他卡牌上的毁灭标记数，而不是加上。”
all_card.real_back_flavor: To your relief, the sun once again begins to rise, peeking just over the eastern horizon and casting long shadows across the city streets. You are completely exhausted from the night's events. It feels as though you haven't slept in weeks. Perhaps you haven't.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator disengages from each enemy engaged with him or her and may move to a connecting location. Move The Organist 1 location away from the nearest investigator (to a location with no investigators, if possible). Check Campaign Log. If Jordan Perry is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Jordan Perry (An Imposing Presence) and spawn him in Montparnasse.
all_card.real_flavor: The city stirs as cold shadows embrace the streets. There is danger all around you. Danger that you cannot escape. Danger that will follow you to the ends of the earth. When will this waking nightmare end?
all_card.real_text: While you have more Conviction than Doubt, this agenda gains: "When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it."

all_card.back_flavor: 初升的太阳驱散了黑暗。温暖的薄雾弥漫在城中，遮蔽了整片天空。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 - 如果你的疑惑高于(或等于)确信，进入(→结局3)。 - 如果你的确信高于疑惑，推进到场景2b。
all_card.flavor: 这是你在巴黎的第三晚了，你暗自下定决心，这场猫抓老鼠的游戏不能再继续下去了。无论如何，今晚必见分晓。
all_card.name: 第三夜
all_card.text: 你的确信高于疑惑时，本密谋获得： “在检查毁灭阈值时，改为从场上毁灭标记总数中减去本密谋以外的其他卡牌上的毁灭标记数，而不是加上。”
all_card.real_back_flavor: The sun rises, and dispels the darkness. A warm fog envelops the city, blotting out the sky.
all_card.real_back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If you have more (or equal) Doubt than Conviction, proceed to (→R3). - If you have more Conviction than Doubt, advance to act 2b.
all_card.real_flavor: On the evening of your third night in Paris, a desperate resolve stirs within you. This cat and mouse game cannot go on any longer. One way or another, this night will end it.
all_card.real_text: While you have more Conviction than Doubt, this agenda gains: "When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it."

all_card.back_text:
如果你花费线索以推进场景：
你差点撞上一个高高的男子，他漆黑的外套和帽子与他苍白的肤色形成了鲜明的对照。你记得好像在圣巴拿波教堂的窗后见过他的身影。他的风琴演奏始终萦绕在你心头……
将放在一边的风琴手敌人生成在调查员队长所在地点(神秘莫测)面朝上。推进到场景2a“闻风追影”。
否则：
你之前听到的风琴演奏始终萦绕在你的心头。无论你走到哪里，这和弦声在你脑中反复演奏，折磨着你。惊惧之中，你拉住一个过路人询问教堂怎么走。“你说圣巴拿波？”她用厚重的口音答道，“这里没这地方。”
每位调查员受到2点恐惧。 将放在一边的风琴手敌人生成在离所有调查员最远的地点，(神秘莫测)面朝上。推进到场景2a“闻风追影”。
all_card.flavor: 你走出火车站，经过圣巴拿波教堂时，耳旁飘来一阵风琴声。这么晚了还在布道吗？这奔放奇特的和音扣紧了你的心弦，你不禁驻足倾听了片刻才继续上路。巴黎很大，而你手头的线索很少……
all_card.name: 巴黎阴谋(版本一)
all_card.text: 目标 - 花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。 目标 - 当一轮结束时，如果场上有至少3个毁灭标记，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If you spent clues to advance:
You nearly bump into a tall man, his coat and hat as black as his skin is pale. You remember seeing him through the windows of St. Barnabé Church. His organ playing continues to haunt you…
Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the lead investigator's location, (Draped in Mystery) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Pursuing Shadows.
Otherwise:
The organ you heard earlier continues to haunt you. No matter where you are, the torturous chords play over and over in your head. Startled, you ask a passerby about the church. "St. Barnabé?" she replies in a thick accent. "There is no such place."
Each investigator takes 2 horror. Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the location farthest from all investigators, (Draped in Mystery) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Pursuing Shadows.
all_card.real_flavor: You pass the Church of St. Barnabé as you exit the train station and cannot help but overhear the organ playing. Is there a sermon this late in the evening? You marvel at the wild and strange chords for a moment before continuing. Paris is a big city, and you have very few leads…
all_card.real_text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues to advance. Objective - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more doom in play, advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果你花费线索以推进场景：
你之前听到的风琴演奏始终萦绕在你的心头。无论你走到哪里，这和弦声在你脑中反复演奏，折磨着你。你始终感觉有人监视着自己。
将放在一边的风琴手敌人生成在离所有调查员最远的的地点，(藐视绝望)面朝上。推进到场景2a“暗影缠身”。
否则：
你差点撞上一个高高的男子，他漆黑的外套和帽子与他苍白的肤色形成了鲜明的对照。他恶狠狠地看了你一眼，那是你见过最可怕，最致命的眼神。光是看到他就让你浑身发颤，他朝你步步逼近时，暗影都聚集到了他的脚下。
每位调查员受到2点恐惧。 将放在一边的风琴手敌人生成在调查员队长所在地点，(藐视绝望)面朝上。推进到场景2a“暗影缠身”。
all_card.flavor: 你走出火车站，经过圣巴拿波教堂时，耳旁飘来一阵风琴声。这么晚了还在布道吗？这奔放奇特的和音扣紧了你的心弦，你不禁驻足倾听了片刻才继续上路。巴黎很大，而你手头的线索很少……

all_card.real_back_text:
If you spent clues to advance:
The organ you heard earlier continues to haunt you. No matter where you are, the torturous chords play over and over in your head. The sensation that you are being watched tugs at your mind.
Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the location farthest from all investigators, (Hopeless, I Defied Him) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Stalked by Shadows.
Otherwise:
You nearly bump into a tall man, his coat and hat as black as his skin is pale. He gives you a look of hatred, as intense and as deadly as you have ever seen. You recoil at the mere sight of him, and shadows gather around his feet as he marches toward you.
Each investigator takes 2 horror. Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the lead investigator's location, (Hopeless, I Defied Him) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Stalked by Shadows.
all_card.real_flavor: You pass the Church of St. Barnabé as you exit the train station and cannot help but overhear the organ playing. Is there a sermon this late in the evening? You marvel at the wild and strange chords for a moment before continuing. Paris is a big city, and you have very few leads…
all_card.real_text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues to advance. Objective - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more doom in play, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 穿过一扇扇沉重的铁门，你把你的猎物逼到了一条狭窄的林荫道上。这里是一条死胡同——两边都是高大老宅的庭院。你关上身后的大门，转身面对这个神秘人物，正在这时，天色开始破晓。光线刺破天边，你抬起手遮挡了一下灼眼的太阳。而后，就好像被太阳驱散了一般，你追了整整一晚的这个人随着暗影一起消失了。你翻遍庭院寻找这个神秘人，但丝毫找不到他的踪迹。你正准备离开时，看到了一道狭窄陡峭的楼梯，楼梯尽头的红棕色门旁挂着一块牌匾。上面写着：“奈·英格兰姆”。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 - 如果你闯入了一场密会，进入(→结局2)。 - 否则，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 你脑海中回荡着的那道和弦，那个让你既恐惧又好奇的地狱风琴手……这个神秘人物和《黄衣之王》会不会有什么联系？
all_card.name: 闻风追影
all_card.text: [reaction]你成功攻击风琴手后：你所在地点的一位调查员可以将自己的1个线索放置到风琴手上。(团队每轮仅限1[per_investigator]次。) 目标 - 如果风琴手上有3[per_investigator]个线索，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You pursue your quarry through a narrow avenue, passing a set of heavy iron gates. You are in a dead end - a court with tall, old houses on either side. You close the gates behind you and turn back toward the shadowed figure just as day begins to break. Rays of light peek out over the skyline, and you lift your hand to block the gaze of the sun. Then, as though dispersed by the sunlight, the figure you had been chasing folds into the shadows and vanishes. You search the court for the mysterious figure, but there is no sign of him anywhere. Just as you are about to leave, you spot a plaque next to a red-brown door atop a steep, narrow staircase. It reads: "N. Engram."
all_card.real_back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If you intruded on a secret meeting, proceed to (→R2). - Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
all_card.real_flavor: The chords that echo in your mind, the infernal man whose organ-playing intrigues and terrifies you… Perhaps there is a connection between this shadowy presence and <u>The King in Yellow</u>?
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully attack The Organist: An investigator at your location may place 1 of his or her clues on The Organist. (Group limit 1 [per_investigator] times per round.) Objective - If there are 3 [per_investigator] clues on The Organist, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你夺路而逃，回过神来时，已经迷失了方向。你只觉得两只脚不由自主地在飞奔。遒劲有力的翅膀在你头顶拍打着，不明生物的叫嚣催促着你不断往前逃跑。穿过一扇扇沉重的铁门，很快，你就把自己逼到了一条狭窄的林荫道上。这里是一条死胡同——两边都是高大老宅的庭院。你转身朝入口跑去，这时，太阳再一次从巴黎的地平线上升起，让你终于松了一口气。追了你整整一晚的这个人就好像被太阳驱散了一般，随着暗影一起消失了。你正准备离开时，看到了一道狭窄陡峭的楼梯，楼梯尽头的红棕色门旁挂着一块牌匾。上面写着：“奈·英格兰姆”。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 - 如果你闯入了一场密会，进入(→结局2)。 - 否则，进入(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 我知道每次与他见面，都让他离他的目标和我的末日又近了一步。即使是这样，我还是想拯救自己。<cite>——罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“龙之朝廷”，《黄衣之王》</cite>
all_card.name: 暗影缠身
all_card.text: [free]共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记，或自动躲避风琴手。(团队每轮仅限一次。) 目标 - 熬过三个夜晚。(不要推进场景，直到你受到指示。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: You lose track of yourself within the city as you flee for your life. Your feet move of their own accord. The beating of sinewy wings and screeching of creatures above you spurs you onward. Soon you find yourself running down a narrow avenue, passing a set of heavy iron gates. You are in a dead end - a court with tall, old houses on either side. You turn back toward the entrance and breathe a sigh of relief as you see the sun rising once more over the skyline of Paris. As though dispersed by the sunlight, the figure that had been chasing you folds into the shadows and vanishes. Just as you are about to leave, you spot a plaque next to a red-brown door atop a steep, narrow staircase. It reads: "N. Engram."
all_card.real_back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If you intruded on a secret meeting, proceed to (→R2). - Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
all_card.real_flavor:
I knew that every time I met him brought him nearer to the accomplishment of his purpose and my fate. And still I tried to save myself.
-Robert W. Chambers, "In the Court of the Dragon," <u>The King in Yellow</u>
all_card.real_text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Either place 1 doom on the current agenda, or automatically evade The Organist. (Group limit once per round.) Objective - Survive three nights. (Do not advance until you are instructed.)

all_card.back_flavor: 这个街区以其咖啡馆和酒吧著称，也是穷困潦倒的艺术家经常光顾的地方。说不定哪一天，这里某个天才艺术家还能名扬四海。但你清楚，大部分只会默默无名。
all_card.name: 蒙巴纳斯
all_card.text: [free]弃掉你一张手牌：获得与弃掉的卡牌上[willpower]图标数量相等的资源。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: This area is known for its cafés and bars, and is often frequented by starving artists. Perhaps some of these creative types will become famous someday. Most, you assume, will fade into obscurity.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Discard a card from your hand: Gain resources equal to the number of [willpower] icons on the discarded card. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你听人说这个友善的街区充满了活力，但在这里你只感觉到特别孤寂。
all_card.flavor: 冷雨拍打着街面。你经过的每一条小巷也许都藏着见不得人的勾当。
all_card.name: 蒙马特尔
all_card.text: [action]：揭示每位调查员牌库顶1张卡牌。你可以打出一张因本效果揭示的支援(支付其费用)，放到你的控制之下。混洗每位调查员的牌库。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: You’ve heard this district to be vibrant and friendly, but the streets feel unusually lonely to you.
all_card.real_flavor: Cold rain pelts the street. Every alleyway you pass is another hiding place for something sinister.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Reveal the top card of each investigator's deck. You may play an asset revealed by this effect (paying its cost), under your control. Shuffle each investigator's deck. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你听人说这个友善的街区充满了活力，但在这里你只感觉到特别孤寂。
all_card.flavor: 冷雨拍打着街面。你经过的每一条小巷也许都藏着见不得人的勾当。
all_card.name: 蒙马特尔
all_card.text: [action]花费1资源：在你控制的一张卡牌上放置1补给或子弹标记。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: You’ve heard this district to be vibrant and friendly, but the streets feel unusually lonely to you.
all_card.real_flavor: Cold rain pelts the street. Every alleyway you pass is another hiding place for something sinister.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Add 1 supply or ammo token to a card you control. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 大木偶剧场的恐怖剧特别有名，这里的演出生动，有时甚至有违人伦。它坐落在巴黎一条著名的小道上。
all_card.flavor: 似乎最近剧院在上演一出有关疯狂的戏剧。你不禁好奇这里是不是也上演过《黄衣之王》。
all_card.name: 大木偶剧场
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你揭示大木偶剧场后：你必须受到2点恐惧，或将你全部非弱点手牌洗入你的牌库，然后抽取等量的卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Le Théâtre du Grand-Guignol specializes in horror shows of a graphic and sometimes amoral nature. It is among the smallest venues in Paris, and one of the most popular.
all_card.real_flavor: It seems the theatre is performing a show about insanity. You wonder if they have ever performed <u>The King in Yellow</u>.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Grand Guignol: You must either take 2 horror, or shuffle all non-weakness cards from your hand into your deck, then draw an equal number of cards.

all_card.back_flavor: 加尼叶歌剧院主体建筑宏伟华丽，这里是全世界最为知名的剧院之一。你意外地发现大门敞开着，一阵黑暗的迷雾从院内匍匐而出。
all_card.flavor: 宽大的楼梯上拖出了一条血迹。一股阴冷的迷雾笼罩着整个房间。一种莫名的感觉让你坚信这个歌剧院里有某种非人类的存在……
all_card.name: 加尼叶歌剧院
all_card.text: 你调查加尼叶歌剧院时，投入本次技能检定的卡牌上的技能图标数量翻倍。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Palais Garnier is an ornate architectural masterpiece, and one of the most famous opera houses in the world. Strangely, you find the main doors thrown wide open, and a dark mist creeps out from the doorway.
all_card.real_flavor: A trail of blood leads up the grand staircase. Deep, cold mist envelops the room. You get the unmistakable feeling that there is something inhuman in the opera house…
all_card.real_text: While you are investigating Opéra Garnier, double the number of skill icons committed to this skill test.

all_card.back_flavor: 加尼叶歌剧院主体建筑宏伟华丽，这里是全世界最为知名的剧院之一。你意外地发现大门敞开着，一阵黑暗的迷雾从院内匍匐而出。
all_card.flavor: 宽大的楼梯上拖出了一条血迹。一股阴冷的迷雾笼罩着整个房间。一种莫名的感觉让你坚信这个歌剧院里有某种非人类的存在……
all_card.name: 加尼叶歌剧院
all_card.text: 你调查加尼叶歌剧院时，你技能的基础值翻倍。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Palais Garnier is an ornate architectural masterpiece, and one of the most famous opera houses in the world. Strangely, you find the main doors thrown wide open, and a dark mist creeps out from the doorway.
all_card.real_flavor: A trail of blood leads up the grand staircase. Deep, cold mist envelops the room. You get the unmistakable feeling that there is something inhuman in the opera house…
all_card.real_text: While you are investigating Opéra Garnier, double the base value of your skill.

all_card.back_flavor: 这座火车站建于1900年，是世界上第一座仅使用电力火车的车站。
all_card.flavor: 你原以为车站里会熙熙攘攘，但这里却出奇的冷清，只有几个过路人拖着步子在车站里徐徐游荡。
all_card.name: 奥赛火车站
all_card.text: [action]花费1资源：移动到任意一个[[轨道沿线]]地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Built in 1900, this train station was the first urban station in the world to use only electric trains.
all_card.real_flavor: You'd expect the station to be bustling, but it is eerily abandoned, save for a few passengers who wander the station in slow, meandering steps.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Move to any [[Rail]] location.

all_card.back_flavor: 拉雪兹神父公墓是巴黎最大的公墓，同时也是城里第一座公园墓地，这里风景优美，但也阴森恐怖。
all_card.flavor: 石子铺成的小路蜿蜒曲折，连接着成排的墓穴和数不清的陵墓。密集的墓地纵横交错，在死者的包围中，你陷入了淡淡的忧伤。
all_card.name: 拉雪兹神父公墓
all_card.text: 强制 - 你成功调查拉雪兹神父公墓后：你不能离开拉雪兹神父公墓，直到一轮结束。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The largest cemetery in Paris, and its first garden cemetery, Père Lachaise is as beautiful as it is haunting.
all_card.real_flavor: Paths of stone wind through rows of graves and countless mausoleums. The dense, twisting cemetery has you trapped in a state of melancholy, surrounded by death on all sides.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you successfully investigate Père Lachaise Cemetery: You cannot leave Père Lachaise Cemetery until the end of the round.

all_card.back_flavor: 这条地下运河连通了塞纳河与乌尔克运河。一道古老开裂的楼梯通向下面的运河入口。
all_card.name: 圣马丁运河
all_card.text: [reaction]你在圣马丁运河躲避一个敌人后：将该敌人移动到一个连接地点。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: This underground canal connects the river Seine to the Canal de l’Ourcq. An old, cracked staircase leads down to the canal’s entrance.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you evade an enemy at Canal Saint-Martin: Move that enemy to a connecting location. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 近年来这个历史名区已经不再是贵族的专区，但在这里还是能看到许多精工细作的老建筑。
all_card.flavor: 经过这片地区时，你始终感觉有人在监视着你。每次你一抬头，屋顶就有什么东西缩了回去。
all_card.name: 玛黑区
all_card.text: [reaction]在你的回合开始时，如果你在玛黑区：抽取1张卡牌。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: This historic district has recently become less aristocratic, but the old architectural masterwork remains.
all_card.real_flavor: Throughout this region, you cannot shake the feeling that you are being watched. Something along the rooftops ducks just out of sight each time you peer upward.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When your turn begins, if you are in Le Marais: Draw 1 card. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 近年来这个历史名区已经不再是贵族的专区，但在这里还是能看到许多精工细作的老建筑。
all_card.flavor: 经过这片地区时，你始终感觉有人在监视着你。每次你一抬头，屋顶就有什么东西缩了回去。
all_card.name: 玛黑区
all_card.text: 强制 - 你进入玛黑区后：直到本轮结束，你不能离开玛黑区。
all_card.real_back_flavor: This historic district has recently become less aristocratic, but the old architectural masterwork remains.
all_card.real_flavor: Throughout this region, you cannot shake the feeling that you are being watched. Something along the rooftops ducks just out of sight each time you peer upward.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Le Marais: For the remainder of the round, you cannot leave Le Marais.

all_card.back_flavor: Notre-Dame de Paris在法语中的意思为“我们巴黎的圣母”，这里是全市最为著名的大教堂，它不仅是这座城市的名片，也是全世界哥特式建筑的标志。彩色的玻璃窗后透出了灯光，你可以听到教堂内有管风琴高声演奏着古怪混乱的旋律。
all_card.name: 巴黎圣母院
all_card.text:
位于巴黎圣母院的每个敌人得到-1攻击与+1躲避。
[action]：检定[willpower](6)。如果你检定成功，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记，或从当前密谋上移除1个毁灭标记。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The most famous cathedral in all of Paris, and one of the finest examples of gothic architecture in the world, Notre-Dame de Paris - "Our Lady of Paris" - is an icon of the city. Light shines out from its stained glass windows, and you can hear a pipe organ inside blaring a bizarre, chaotic melody.
all_card.real_text:
Each enemy at Notre-Dame gets -1 fight and +1 evade.
[action]: Test [willpower] (6). If you succeed, either place 1 doom on the current agenda, or remove 1 doom from the current agenda. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 卢森堡宫的公园中散落着数以百计的雕像、纪念碑和喷泉。可惜你来这里是为了躲避夜空中尖叫飞翔着的怪物，要是换一个情况，这里应该是休闲散步的好地方。
all_card.name: 卢森堡公园
all_card.text: [[拜亚基]]敌人移动时，如果有调查员位于卢森堡公园，该敌人所在地点视为与卢森堡公园连接。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The gardens of Luxembourg Palace contain hundreds of scattered statues, monuments, and fountains. It would make for a relaxing walk if you hadn’t come here to escape the winged creatures that screech and soar in the dark sky overhead.
all_card.real_text: While a [[Byakhee]] enemy is moving, if there is an investigator at Gardens of Luxembourg, that enemy's location is considered to be connected to Gardens of Luxembourg.

all_card.flavor: ……他那地狱般的双眼暗藏杀机。<cite>——罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“龙之朝廷”，《黄衣之王》</cite>
all_card.name: 风琴手
all_card.text: 猎手。不能受到伤害。 强制 - 风琴手通过猎手关键词移动后，如果其未与调查员交战：再次结算其猎手关键词。本阶段风琴手不能攻击。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.traits: 类人. 化身. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: …the point from which it would strike was his infernal eyes. - Robert W. Chambers, "In the Court of the Dragon," <u>The King in Yellow</u>
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Cannot be damaged. Forced - After The Organist moves from the hunter keyword, if it is unengaged: Resolve its hunter keyword again. The Organist cannot attack this phase. (Limit once per round).

all_card.flavor: 我的双脚几乎已经无法动弹，我只能匍匐前进。<cite>罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“龙之朝廷”，《黄衣之王》</cite>
all_card.name: 风琴手
all_card.text: 冷漠。不能受到伤害。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：如果风琴手未与调查员交战，将其朝着远离最近的调查员的方向移动1个地点(如可能，移动到一个没有调查员的地点)。如果其与调查员交战，改为其与调查员解除交战。
all_card.traits: 类人. 化身. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: I was creeping along, my feet almost refusing to move. - Robert W. Chambers, "In the Court of the Dragon," <u>The King in Yellow</u>
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Cannot be damaged. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: If The Organist is unengaged, move it 1 location away from the nearest investigator (to a location with no investigators, if possible). If it is engaged, disengage it instead.

all_card.flavor: 如果你听到了它皮质的翅膀拍打的声音，那就说明太晚了。
all_card.name: 潜行的拜亚基
all_card.text:
猎手。
潜行的拜亚基处于横置状态时，其得到-3攻击。
all_card.real_flavor: If you can hear the beating of its leathery wings, it’s already too late.
all_card.real_text:
Hunter.
While Stealthy Byakhee is exhausted, it gets -3 fight.

all_card.flavor: 要不是这不详的征兆，这将是一片多么美丽的落日。
all_card.name: 双生太阳
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](4)。如果你检定失败，你必须从当前密谋上移除1个毁灭标记，或每低于难度1点就受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: The implication spoils what would otherwise be a lovely sunset.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (4). If you fail, you must either remove 1 doom from the current agenda, or take 1 horror for each point you failed by.

all_card.name: 致命运数
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌，直到弃掉一个敌人。你必须抽取该敌人，或该敌人攻击你(从遭遇弃牌堆)。如果没有敌人被弃掉，改为受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. You must either draw that enemy, or that enemy attacks you (from the discard pile). If no enemy is discarded, take 1 horror instead.

all_card.name: 折磨和弦
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](5)。如果你检定失败，将折磨和弦放置入场，放到你的威胁区域，且你每低于难度1点，其带有1资源。 每次你打出一张卡牌，提升该卡牌的费用1点并从折磨和弦移除1资源。 如果折磨和弦没有资源，将其弃掉。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). If you fail, put Torturous Chords into play in your threat area, with 1 resource on it for each point you failed by. Each time you play a card, increase the cost of that card by 1 and remove 1 resource from Torturous Chords. If Torturous Chords has no resources, discard it.

all_card.name: 呆若木鸡
all_card.text: 显现 - 将呆若木鸡放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你每轮第一次执行以下行动(移动、攻击、或躲避)之一，须支付额外1个行动。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉呆若木鸡。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Frozen in Fear into play in your threat area. The first time you perform one of the following actions (move, fight, or evade) each round, it costs 1 additional action. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Frozen in Fear.

all_card.name: 失魂落魄
all_card.text: 显现 - 检查剧本日志。 - 如果你的疑惑高于(或等于)确信，检定[intellect](X)，其中X为你的[willpower]。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。 - 如果你的确信高于疑惑，检定[willpower](X)，其中X为你的[intellect]。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Check Campaign Log. - If you have more (or equal) Doubt than Conviction, test [intellect] (X), where X is your [willpower]. If you fail, take 2 damage. - If you have more Conviction than Doubt, test [willpower] (X), where X is your [intellect]. If you fail, take 2 damage.

all_card.name: 追猎行动
all_card.text:
快速。在神话阶段期间你将要抽取一张遭遇卡牌时打出。
改为查找遭遇牌库顶9张卡牌，找出一个敌人，不将该敌人生成在其通常的生成地点，改为生成并与你交战，并混洗遭遇牌库。如果你不能这么做，抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play when you would draw an encounter card during the mythos phase. Instead, search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy, spawn it engaged with you (instead of its normal spawn location), and shuffle the encounter deck. If you cannot, draw the top card of the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 原定计划
all_card.text: 永久。卓越。 [reaction]你抽取起始手牌前：查找你的牌库，找出最多3张不同的[[策略]]和/或[[供给]]事件，并将其正面朝下附属到原定计划。混洗你的牌库。 附属到原定计划的卡牌可以被打出，如同其在你手中。作为打出一张附属卡牌的额外费用，横置原定计划。(FAQ v2.0)
all_card.real_text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
[reaction] Before you draw your opening hand: Search your deck for up to 3 different [[Tactic]] and/or [[Supply]] events, and attach them facedown to Stick to the Plan. Shuffle your deck.
Cards attached to Stick to the Plan may be played as if they were in your hand. As an additional cost to play an attached card, exhaust Stick to the Plan.

all_card.name: 指导
all_card.text: 选择你所在地点的另一位本轮尚未进行其回合的调查员。该调查员可以在本轮自己回合期间进行额外一次行动。
all_card.real_text: Choose another investigator at your location who has yet to take his or her turn this round. That investigator may take an additional action during his or her turn this round.

all_card.name: 奥术洞察
all_card.text:
使用(3充能)。
[free]一位调查员进行自己的回合时，花费1充能：直到本回合结束，你所在地点的隐藏值-2。(每回合仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[fast] While an investigator is taking his or her turn, spend 1 charge: Your location gets -2 shroud until the end of this turn. (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.flavor: “下次让我来开车！”
all_card.name: 侥幸逃脱
all_card.text:
快速。在敌人对你进行趁乱攻击时打出。
取消该次攻击。本回合中你下次执行的技能检定得到技能值+2。
all_card.real_flavor: "Next time, I'm driving!"
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy makes an attack of opportunity against you.
Cancel that attack. You get +2 skill value for the next skill test you perform this turn.

all_card.name: 建议
all_card.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]横置建议：躲避。本次躲避尝试将你的[willpower]值加入你的技能值。如果你未超过难度至少2点并成功，从建议移除1充能。 [reaction]在一个非[[精英]]敌人将要攻击你时，花费1充能：取消该次攻击。
all_card.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Exhaust Suggestion: Evade. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 charge from Suggestion. [reaction] When a non-[[Elite]] enemy would attack you, spend 1 charge: Cancel that attack.

all_card.name: 圣胡伯的钥匙
all_card.text:
你得到+1[willpower]、+1[intellect]和-2神智值。
[reaction]在你将要由于恐惧被击败时，弃掉圣胡伯的钥匙：立刻治愈2点恐惧。
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [willpower], +1 [intellect], and -2 sanity.
[reaction] When you would be defeated by horror, discard St. Hubert's Key: Immediately heal 2 horror.

all_card.name: 守护结界
all_card.text:
快速。在位于任意地点的一位调查员抽取一张非弱点诡计卡牌时打出。
取消该卡牌的显现效果。然后，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at any location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Then, take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 新晋术士
all_card.text: 强制 - 在新晋术士入场后：在上面放置1个毁灭标记或2点恐惧。 [free]横置新晋术士：查找你牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张[[法术]]卡牌并将其抽取。混洗你的牌库。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Arcane Initiate enters play: Place 1 doom or 2 horror on it. [fast] Exhaust Arcane Initiate: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

all_card.name: “放马过来！”
all_card.text:
有敌人与你交战才能投入到技能检定。
每有一个与你交战的敌人，“放马过来！”获得[willpower][combat][agility]。
all_card.real_text:
Commit to a skill test only if you are engaged with an enemy.
For each enemy engaged with you, "Not without a fight!" gains [willpower] [combat] [agility].

all_card.name: 求生高手
all_card.text: 将你弃牌堆中的3张[[天性]]技能返回你的手牌。
all_card.real_text: Return 3 [[Innate]] skills from your discard pile to your hand.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]：-X。X为场上所有密谋上的毁灭标记总数。 [cultist]：揭示另一个标记。如果你所在地点有带有毁灭标记的敌人，改为本次检定自动失败。 [tablet]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，或成功但没有超过难度至少1点，在每个密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。 [elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，查找遭遇牌库及遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张[[拜亚基]]敌人，并将其抽取。
all_card.name: 黑星升起
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]：-X。X为场上毁灭标记最多的密谋上的毁灭标记数。 [cultist]：揭示另一个标记。如果攻击或尝试躲避带有毁灭标记的敌人期间揭示本标记，改为本次技能检定自动失败。 [tablet]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，在每个密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。 [elder_thing]：-2。如果你检定失败，查找遭遇牌库及遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张[[拜亚基]]敌人，并将其抽取。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the total amount of doom on agendas in play.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If there is an enemy with 1 or more doom on it at your location, this test automatically fails instead.
[tablet]: Reveal another token. If you do not succeed by at least 1, place 1 doom on each agenda.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Byakhee]] enemy and draw it.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the highest amount of doom on an agenda in play.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If this token is revealed during an attack or evasion attempt against an enemy with doom on it, this skill test automatically fails instead.
[tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on each agenda.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Byakhee]] enemy and draw it.

all_card.back_flavor: 潮水急剧上涨，飓风和冰雨侵袭着镇子的外城墙。夜幕悄悄降临，而风暴却变得更为凶猛。很快潮水就将淹没整座城镇。

all_card.real_back_flavor: The outer wall of the city defends it from the wrath of the tides, and also from conquering invaders.
all_card.real_flavor: Waves slam against the stone walls, water spraying onto the pathways above. If you don't act quickly, even these stalwart walls won't be able to stop the rising tide.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on the "a" agenda deck: Each investigator at the Outer Wall takes 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 外城墙保护着城市，抵御愤怒的潮水和外来的入侵者。
all_card.flavor: 浪涛撞击着石墙，海水溅上了城墙顶的通道。如果你不赶紧行动，即使这些坚固的城墙也挡不住上涨的潮水。
all_card.name: 外城墙
all_card.text: 当前“c”密谋的毁灭标记数量多于当前“a”密谋的毁灭标记时，投入在外城墙的技能检定的卡牌上的技能图标数量翻倍。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The outer wall of the city defends it from the wrath of the tides, and also from conquering invaders.
all_card.real_flavor: Waves slam against the stone walls, water spraying onto the pathways above. If you don't act quickly, even these stalwart walls won't be able to stop the rising tide.
all_card.real_text: While the current "c" agenda has more doom on it than the current "a" agenda, double the number of skill icons on cards committed to skill tests at the Outer Wall.

all_card.back_flavor: 从外城墙边的北部塔楼，可以俯瞰到城镇的一边和另一边滔天的巨浪。冰冷的雨水下，这条小道上湿滑而危险。
all_card.flavor: 湿滑的石头台阶一路向上，通往修道院。在山巅，漆黑的乌云随时会压垮整个小岛。
all_card.name: 北部塔楼
all_card.text: 强制 - 有毁灭标记放置到“c”密谋牌库后：位于北部塔楼的每位调查员受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The north tower along the outer wall overlooks the town on one side and the tumultuous waters on the other. Freezing rain has made this path slippery and dangerous to follow.
all_card.real_flavor: Wet, stone steps lead higher up the path, toward the abbey. Above, black storm clouds threaten to overtake the island.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on the "c" agenda deck: Each investigator at North Tower takes 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 从外城墙边的北部塔楼，可以俯瞰到城镇的一边和另一边滔天的巨浪。冰冷的雨水下，这条小道上湿滑而危险。
all_card.flavor: 湿滑的石头台阶一路向上，通往修道院。在山巅，漆黑的乌云随时会压垮整个小岛。
all_card.name: 北部塔楼
all_card.text: 当前“a”密谋的毁灭标记数量多于当前“c”密谋的毁灭标记时，在北部塔楼的技能检定难度降低1点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The north tower along the outer wall overlooks the town on one side and the tumultuous waters on the other. Freezing rain has made this path slippery and dangerous to follow.
all_card.real_flavor: Wet, stone steps lead higher up the path, toward the abbey. Above, black storm clouds threaten to overtake the island.
all_card.real_text: While the current "a" agenda has more doom on it than the current "c" agenda, reduce the difficulty of each skill test at North Tower by 1.

all_card.back_flavor: 一道道闪电映衬出山顶修道院的轮廓。一条长长的小道沿着山坡蜿蜒而上。你走进修道院时发现小道分出了几条岔路。
all_card.name: 垮塌的台阶
all_card.text: 强制 - 你进入垮塌的台阶后：你必须失去1个行动，或抽取遭遇弃牌堆最顶上的[[征兆]]诡计。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Bolts of lightning silhouette the abbey above. A path of long, winding steps leads up the hill, branching into multiple routes as you draw nearer to the abbey.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Broken Steps: You must either lose 1 action or draw the topmost [[Omen]] treachery in the encounter discard pile.

all_card.back_flavor: 一道道闪电映衬出山顶修道院的轮廓。一条长长的小道沿着山坡蜿蜒而上。你走进修道院时发现小道分出了几条岔路。
all_card.name: 垮塌的台阶
all_card.text: 强制 - 你进入垮塌的台阶后：你必须弃掉一个你控制的支援，或抽取遭遇弃牌堆最顶上的[[异教徒]]敌人。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Bolts of lightning silhouette the abbey above. A path of long, winding steps leads up the hill, branching into multiple routes as you draw nearer to the abbey.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter Broken Steps: You must either discard an asset you control or draw the topmost [[Cultist]] enemy in the encounter discard pile.

all_card.back_flavor: 你必须找到一条没有被残骸和碎石堵死的小路才能到达修道院。
all_card.back_text: 通往修道院教堂的小道堵死了。作为你进入修道院教堂的额外费用，位于垮塌的台阶的调查员必须共同花费3[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.name: 修道院教堂
all_card.text: 如果场上有2张密谋编号不同的密谋，修道院教堂的隐藏值+2。 强制 - 在修道院教堂揭示时：将放在一边的哥特式唱诗台、骑士大厅、回廊、圣奥伯特礼拜堂和修道院塔楼地点放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You’ll have to find a path not blocked by debris and rubble in order to reach the abbey.
all_card.real_back_text: The path leading to the Abbey Church is blocked. As an additional cost for you to enter the Abbey Church, investigators at Broken Steps must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_text: If there are two agendas in play with different agenda numbers, Abbey Church gets +2 shroud. Forced - When Abbey Church is revealed: Put the set-aside Chœur Gothique, Knight's Hall, Cloister, Chapel of St. Aubert, and Abbey Tower locations into play.

all_card.back_flavor: 地板上一滩长长的血迹缓缓流淌到前面的哥特式唱诗台。
all_card.flavor: 闪电在修道院的窗户后亮起，很快，雷电就用响彻全岛的轰鸣予以回应。
all_card.name: 哥特式唱诗台
all_card.text: [action]在当前“a”密谋上放置1个毁灭标记：治愈2点伤害。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: A long pool of blood spreads slowly across the floor, leading toward the chœur gothique.
all_card.real_flavor: Lightning flashes through the windows of the abbey, thunder quickly answering in a booming voice all around the island.
all_card.real_text: [action] Place 1 doom on the current "a" agenda: Heal 2 damage. (Group limit once per game).

all_card.back_flavor: 地板上一滩长长的血迹缓缓流淌到前面的哥特式唱诗台。
all_card.flavor: 闪电在修道院的窗户后亮起，很快，雷电就用响彻全岛的轰鸣予以回应。
all_card.name: 哥特式唱诗台
all_card.text: [action]在当前“c”密谋上放置1个毁灭标记：治愈2点恐惧。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: A long pool of blood spreads slowly across the floor, leading toward the chœur gothique.
all_card.real_flavor: Lightning flashes through the windows of the abbey, thunder quickly answering in a booming voice all around the island.
all_card.real_text: [action] Place 1 doom on the current "c" agenda: Heal 2 horror. (Group limit once per game).

all_card.back_flavor: 回廊上空荡荡的，平时这里只对寺院的僧侣和宗教领袖开放，但眼下修道院里看来空无一人，你没花什么功夫就偷偷溜了进去。
all_card.flavor: 一个僧侣在长廊上孤独地徘徊。嘴里默默念着祷文。他好像根本没有注意到风暴很快就会把修道院掀个底朝天。
all_card.name: 回廊
all_card.text: [action]如果回廊没有线索：谈判。检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，记住你“找到了一个向导”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The open arcade of the cloister is normally restricted to the monastery’s monks and religious leaders, but with the abbey seemingly abandoned, it takes little effort for you to sneak your way in.
all_card.real_flavor: A lone monk patrols the covered walk, surrounding himself in whispered prayer. He doesn't seem to notice the storm threatening to tear the abbey down.
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Cloister: Parley. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, remember that you have "found a guide."

all_card.back_flavor: 对称的石柱排列得整整齐齐，让这个大厅显得安宁而恬静，与屋外的滔天洪水形成了强烈的对比。
all_card.name: 骑士大厅
all_card.text: [action]如果骑士大厅没有线索：调查。不使用[intellect]，改为使用[agility]调查。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为记住你“找到了塔楼的钥匙”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Rows of symmetrical stone pillars give this hall a sense of calm serenity that clashes with the torrent outside.
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Knight's Hall: Investigate. Investigate using [agility] instead of [intellect]. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, remember that you have "found the tower key."

all_card.back_flavor: 海浪猛烈地冲击着岩石。礼拜堂孤零零地矗立在雨中，在风暴的肆虐中摇摇欲坠。
all_card.back_text: 通往圣奥伯特礼拜堂的路是隐藏的。除非你“找到了一个向导”，否则你不能进入圣奥伯特礼拜堂。
all_card.flavor: 透过脚下的海水，你可以看见卡尔克萨那群扭曲的尖柱。你就快到了——你要做的只是打开这道大门。
all_card.name: 圣奥伯特礼拜堂
all_card.text:
你剩余神智值为3点或更少才可在圣奥伯特礼拜堂发现线索。
[action]：受到最多3点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Waves crash violently upon the rocks. The chapel stands lonely against the rain, barely able to survive the storm’s onslaught.
all_card.real_back_text: The way to the Chapel of St. Aubert is hidden. You cannot enter the Chapel of St. Aubert unless you have "found a guide."
all_card.real_flavor: In the water below, you can see the spires of Carcosa. You are almost there - you need only open the gate.
all_card.real_text:
You can only discover clues in the Chapel of St. Aubert if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity.
[action]: Take up to 3 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 海浪猛烈地冲击着岩石。礼拜堂孤零零地矗立在雨中，在风暴的肆虐中摇摇欲坠。
all_card.back_text: 通往圣奥伯特礼拜堂的路是隐藏的。除非你“找到了一个向导”，否则你不能进入圣奥伯特礼拜堂。
all_card.flavor: 你望向脚下的海水时，可以看见水中的哈斯塔戴着兜帽，若隐若现，向你伸出了手。他的笑声在你脑中不断回荡。
all_card.name: 圣奥伯特礼拜堂
all_card.real_back_flavor: Waves crash violently upon the rocks. The chapel stands lonely against the rain, barely able to survive the storm’s onslaught.
all_card.real_back_text: The way to the Chapel of St. Aubert is hidden. You cannot enter the Chapel of St. Aubert unless you have "found a guide."
all_card.real_flavor: As you peer into the water below, you can see the hooded shape of Hastur looming beyond, hand outstretched. His laughter echoes throughout your mind.

all_card.back_flavor: 黑色的闪电刺破了天空。站在塔顶，你能见到的只有乌云形成的旋涡和呼啸的狂风。
all_card.back_text: 通往修道院塔楼的门上了锁。除非你“找到了塔楼的钥匙”，否则你不能进入修道院塔楼。
all_card.flavor: 透过头顶的旋涡，你可以看见卡尔克萨那群扭曲的尖柱。你就快到了——你要做的只是打开这道大门。
all_card.name: 修道院塔楼
all_card.text:
你没有手牌才可在修道院塔楼发现线索。
[action]：弃掉你最多3张手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Dark lightning crashes throughout the air. Surrounding the top of the tower is a whirlwind of black clouds and bellowing wind.
all_card.real_back_text: The door leading up to the Abbey Tower is locked. You cannot enter the Abbey Tower unless you have "found the tower key."
all_card.real_flavor: In the vortex above, you can see the spires of Carcosa. You are almost there - you need only open the gate.
all_card.real_text:
You can only discover clues in the Abbey Tower if you have no cards in your hand.
[action]: Discard up to 3 cards from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 黑色的闪电刺破了天空。站在塔顶，你能见到的只有乌云形成的旋涡和呼啸的狂风。
all_card.back_text: 通往修道院塔楼的门上了锁。除非你“找到了塔楼的钥匙”，否则你不能进入修道院塔楼。
all_card.flavor: 你望向头顶的旋涡时，可以看见天上的哈斯塔戴着兜帽，若隐若现，向你伸出了手。他的笑声在你脑中不断回荡。
all_card.name: 修道院塔楼
all_card.real_back_flavor: Dark lightning crashes throughout the air. Surrounding the top of the tower is a whirlwind of black clouds and bellowing wind.
all_card.real_back_text: The door leading up to the Abbey Tower is locked. You cannot enter the Abbey Tower unless you have "found the tower key."
all_card.real_flavor: As you peer into the vortex above, you can see the hooded shape of Hastur looming beyond, hand outstretched. His laughter echoes throughout your mind.

all_card.flavor: 每当涨潮时，它们就爬出海中，出来觅食。
all_card.name: 潮汐骇物
all_card.text: 生成 - 晋升之门或圣奥伯特礼拜堂。 猎手。
all_card.real_flavor: When the tide is high, they emerge from the sea to feed.
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Porte de l'Avancée or Chapel of St. Aubert. Hunter.

all_card.name: 裂缝探求者
all_card.text: 强制 - 在裂缝探求者攻击你后：你必须受到额外1点伤害和额外1点恐惧，或在场上每个密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。 [action]在场上每个密谋上放置1个毁灭标记并受到2点恐惧：谈判。弃掉裂缝探求者。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 拜亚基. 异教徒
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Rift Seeker attacks you: You must either take 1 additional damage and 1 additional horror, or place 1 doom on each agenda in play. [action] Place 1 doom on each agenda in play and take 2 horror: Parley. Discard Rift Seeker.

all_card.name: 洪水肆虐
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败： - 如果密谋1a在场，受到1点伤害并失去1个行动。 - 如果密谋2a在场，受到2点伤害并失去2个行动。 - 如果场景3a或密谋3a在场，受到3点伤害并失去3个行动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail: - If agenda 1a is in play, take 1 damage and lose 1 action. - If agenda 2a is in play, take 2 damage and lose 2 actions. - If act 3a or agenda 3a is in play, take 3 damage and lose 3 actions.

all_card.name: 世界融合
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败： - 如果密谋1c在场，受到1点恐惧并弃掉你1张手牌。 - 如果密谋2c在场，受到2点恐惧并弃掉你2张手牌。 - 如果场景3c或密谋3c在场，受到3点恐惧并弃掉你3张手牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail: - If agenda 1c is in play, take 1 horror and discard 1 card from your hand. - If agenda 2c is in play, take 2 horror and discard 2 cards from your hand. - If act 3c or agenda 3c is in play, take 3 horror and discard 3 cards from your hand.

all_card.name: “吃枪子吧！”
all_card.text: 快速。在你激活[[枪械]]支援上的攻击能力时打出。 你可以花费该支援上的额外X子弹标记。在你为本次攻击揭示混乱标记时，额外揭示X个混乱标记。选择其中一个结算并忽略其余标记。
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play when you activate the Fight ability on a [[Firearm]] asset. You may spend X additional ammo tokens from that asset. When you reveal chaos tokens for this attack, reveal X additional chaos tokens. Choose one to resolve and ignore the rest.

all_card.name: 阿登护甲
all_card.text: [reaction]在分配伤害给阿登护甲时，横置阿登护甲：取消该伤害中的1点。
all_card.traits: 道具. 护甲. 遗物
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When damage is assigned to Armor of Ardennes, exhaust Armor of Ardennes: Cancel 1 of that damage.

all_card.name: 遗觉记忆
all_card.text: 将遗觉记忆作为任意调查员弃牌堆中的一张[[洞察]]事件打出(包括其资源费用)。将该事件从游戏中移除。不要弃掉遗觉记忆，改为将其从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_text: Play Eidetic Memory as an exact copy of an [[Insight]] event in any investigator's discard pile (including its resource cost). Remove that event from the game. Remove Eidetic Memory from the game instead of discarding it.

all_card.name: 殚精竭虑
all_card.text:
快速。在任意[free]玩家时间段期间打出。
选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员查找其牌库，找出一张卡牌，将其抽取，并混洗其牌库。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles his or her deck.

all_card.name: 卡戎的银币
all_card.text: 永久。卓越。 在冒险结局期间取得经验值时，如果该次冒险期间你没有被击败，你取得额外2点经验。如果该次冒险期间你被击败，你阵亡。
all_card.real_text: Permanent. Exceptional. When earning experience during the resolution of a scenario, if you were not defeated during that scenario, you earn 2 additional experience. If you were defeated during that scenario, you are killed.

all_card.name: 短管猎枪
all_card.text: 使用(2子弹)。 打出短管猎枪不会触发趁乱攻击。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]并造成+1伤害。如果短管猎枪是本回合入场的，你本次攻击得到额外+1[combat]并造成额外+1伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法
all_card.real_text: Uses (2 ammo). Playing Lupara does not provoke attacks of opportunity. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If Lupara entered play this turn, you get an additional +1 [combat] and deal an additional +1 damage for this attack.

all_card.name: 死里逃生
all_card.text:
快速。在你将要被击败时打出。
和与你交战的每个敌人解除交战，弃掉你威胁区域中的全部卡牌，治愈2点恐惧和2点伤害，并移动到任意一个没有敌人的已揭示地点。如果现在是你的回合，结束你的回合。将死里逃生从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when you would be defeated.
Disengage from each enemy engaged with you, discard all cards in your threat area, heal 2 horror and 2 damage, and move to any revealed location with no enemies. If it is your turn, end your turn. Remove Cheat Death from the game.

all_card.name: 时间曲折
all_card.text: 快速。你所在地点的一位调查员在其回合期间结算完毕一次行动后立刻打出。 撤销该行动(游戏返回到该行动执行之前的状态，但仍然视作你打出了时间曲折，且该卡牌打出的费用不会返还)。(FAQ v1.4)
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play immediately after an investigator at your location finishes resolving an action during his or her turn. Undo that action (return the game state to exactly the way it was before that action was performed, except for the playing of Time Warp and its costs).

all_card.name: 远古印记封印
all_card.text:
本次检定不要从混乱袋中揭示混乱标记。本次检定揭示的混乱标记视为[elder_sign]。
在本次检定结束时，将远古印记封印从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_text:
Do not reveal chaos tokens from the chaos bag for this test. Treat the chaos token revealed for this test as an [elder_sign].
When this test ends, remove Seal of the Elder Sign from the game.

all_card.flavor: 新闻头条里丝毫没有提到你目击的恐怖事件。但讣告栏里的名字却多得让人心中发怵。
all_card.name: 报纸
all_card.text:
你调查时如果没有线索，得到+2[intellect]。
[reaction]在你将要发现你所在地点的至少1个线索时，如果你没有线索：发现你所在地点的额外1个线索。
all_card.real_flavor: There's nothing in the headlines about the horrors you've witnessed. But the obituaries section is disturbingly long.
all_card.real_text:
You get +2 [intellect] while investigating if you have no clues.
[reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues at your location, if you have no clues: Discover an additional clue at your location.

all_card.name: 内讧
all_card.text:
快速。敌军阶段开始后打出。
取消本阶段所有非[[精英]]敌人对你的攻击。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play after the enemy phase begins.
Cancel all attacks made by non-[[Elite]] enemies against you this phase.

all_card.name: 伊苏之匙
all_card.subname: 让暴风雨来得更猛烈些吧
all_card.text: 伊苏之匙上每有一点恐惧，你得到每项技能+1。 强制 - 在任意数量的恐惧将要放置到你身上时：将其中1点恐惧放置到伊苏之匙上。 强制 - 在伊苏之匙离场时：弃掉你牌库顶10张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: You get +1 to each of your skills for each horror on Key of Ys. Forced - When any amount of horror would be placed on you: Place 1 of that horror on Key of Ys. Forced - When Key of Ys leaves play: Discard the top 10 cards of your deck.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]：-X。X为你身上的恐惧数量。 [cultist]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。 [tablet]：-5。如果你检定失败且哈斯塔在场，在你所在地点放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。 [elder_thing]：-5。如果攻击或尝试躲避[[怪物]]或[[古神]]敌人期间揭示本标记，失去1个行动。
all_card.name: 卡城幽影
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]：-2(如果你没有神智值剩余，改为-4)。 [cultist]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧。 [tablet]：-3。如果你检定失败且哈斯塔在场，在你所在地点放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。 [elder_thing]：-3。如果攻击或尝试躲避[[怪物]]或[[古神]]敌人期间揭示本标记，失去1个行动。
all_card.real_back_text: Hard / Expert [skull]: -X. X is the amount of horror on you. [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, take 2 horror. [tablet]: -5. If you fail and Hastur is in play, place 1 clue on your location (from the token bank). [elder_thing]: -5. If this token is revealed during an attack or evasion attempt against a [[Monster]] or [[Ancient One]] enemy, lose 1 action.
all_card.real_text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you have no sanity remaining). [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, take 1 horror. [tablet]: -3. If you fail and Hastur is in play, place 1 clue on your location (from the token bank). [elder_thing]: -3. If this token is revealed during an attack or evasion attempt against a [[Monster]] or [[Ancient One]] enemy, lose 1 action.

all_card.back_flavor: 你转过一个墙角，迎面撞上一个护士，她长着浅棕色的头发，脸廓分明。你告诉她这里怪事频频，病人异常暴力，但她根本听不进去。当你问到丹尼尔时，她告诉你那是王的好友，现在住在宫殿里。
all_card.back_text:
调查员必须决定(选择一项)：
- 任意一位调查员检定[willpower](4)以挣脱幻觉。如果检定成功，推进到密谋2a。如果检定失败，你必须选择另一个尚未选择过的选项。
- 任意一位调查员检定[intellect](4)以回忆起这是你曾经的经历。如果检定成功，推进到密谋2a。如果检定失败，你必须选择另一个尚未选择过的选项。
- 这不可能是真的。这不可能是真的。这不可能是真的。每位调查员受到2点恐惧。推进到密谋2a。
- 调查员们昏倒了，过了一会儿才清醒过来。推进到密谋2a并在该密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.flavor: 而现在，穿越了绵延数个里格的云海，在翻腾的云雾远端，我看见月亮上浪花四溅，而在更远处，卡尔克萨的塔楼从月亮之后缓缓升起。<cite>——罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“龙之朝廷”，《黄衣之王》</cite>
all_card.name: 疯狂漩涡
all_card.text: 哈斯塔不能被击败。 强制 -如果哈斯塔上有至少3[per_investigator]伤害：推进本密谋。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Turning a corner, you nearly bump into a nurse with light brown hair and sharp features. You tell her about the violent patients and the strange things you've seen, but she doesn't listen. When you inquire about Daniel, she informs you that he is a friend of the King and that he resides in the palace.
all_card.real_back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
 - Any investigator tests [willpower] (4) to snap out of it. If successful, advance to agenda 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
 - Any investigator tests [intellect] (4) to remember that you've done this before. If successful, advance to agenda 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
 - This can't be real. This can't be real. This can't be real. Each investigator takes 2 horror. Advance to agenda 2a.
 - The investigators faint and awaken some time later. Advance to agenda 2a and place 1 doom on it.
all_card.real_flavor:
And now, far away, over leagues of tossing cloud-waves, I saw the moon dripping with spray; and beyond, the towers of Carcosa rose behind the moon.
 - Robert W. Chambers, "In the Court of the Dragon," <u>The King in Yellow</u>
all_card.real_text: Hastur cannot be defeated. Forced - If there is at least 3 [per_investigator] damage on Hastur: Advance this agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: “啊，这不是我们最后的客人嘛。”门口的侍者通报说，“迪瓦恩小姐，您的贵客终于到了。”这个生物从宫殿的一边蛇行而来。你发誓曾经见过她护身符上的符号。等等，这不对劲。 “噢，现在真正的晚宴终于可以开始了。”它咆哮道。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的毕宿五的野兽敌人生成在王之宫殿。
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 我也想起了黄衣之王，他那褴褛的披风散射着疯狂的颜色，包裹着他的全身，还有卡西露达的痛哭：“放过我们吧，噢，王啊，放过我们！”<cite>——罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“面具”，《黄衣之王》</cite>
all_card.name: 疯狂沉溺
all_card.text: 哈斯塔得到+1攻击且不能被击败。 强制 - 如果哈斯塔上有至少5[per_investigator]伤害：推进本密谋。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"Ah, if it isn't our final guest," the doorman announces. "Miss Devine, your presence here has been long awaited." The creature slithers up the side of the palace. You swear you've seen the symbol on her amulet before. Wait, that can't be right.
"Well, now the <u>real</u> party can begin," it roars.
all_card.real_back_text:
Spawn the set-aside Beast of Aldebaran enemy at the Palace of the King.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor:
I thought, too, of The King in Yellow wrapt in the fantastic colors of his tattered mantle, and that bitter cry of Cassilda, "Not upon us, oh King, not upon us!"
- Robert W. Chambers, "The Mask," <u>The King in Yellow</u>
all_card.real_text: Hastur gets +1 fight and cannot be defeated. Forced - If there is at least 5 [per_investigator] damage on Hastur: Advance this agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 天空坠落。碎云撒到了大地，天上出现的几十个月亮同时裂成碎片。无数天体碎块砸向地面，侵袭着下方的城市。你头顶上，圣米歇尔山那颠倒的黑色倒影开始下沉。修道院撞上了王的宫殿，乌黑的残骸四下飞散。而你的脑中无时无刻不回荡着哈斯塔狰狞的笑声。一切都结束了。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 - 如果你的确信高于(或等于)疑惑，进入(→结局4)。 - 如果你的疑惑高于确信，进入(→结局5)。
all_card.flavor: ……我忘不了卡尔克萨，忘不了那天上高悬的黑星，忘不了那午后人们的思维拖出的长长暗影，忘不了那哈利湖上西沉的落日，而那苍白面具，则在我的脑中，永远挥之不去。<cite>——罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“名誉修复师”，《黄衣之王》</cite>
all_card.name: 疯狂灭亡
all_card.text: 哈斯塔得到+2攻击。 除非有调查员“知道了秘密”，否则哈斯塔不能被击败。(FAQ v1.3)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The sky falls. Cloud-wisps lash into the earth, and the dozens of moons in the sky shatter. Shards of the cosmic entities above plunge into the ground and assault the city. The dark reflections of Mont Saint-Michel which floats upside down above you starts to descend. They abbey crashes into the king's palace, launching ebony debris in all directions. Hastur's hideous echoing laughter haunts your mind. It is done.
all_card.real_back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If you have more (or equal) Conviction than Doubt, proceed to (→R4). - If you have more Doubt than Conviction, proceed to (→R5).
all_card.real_flavor:
...I cannot forget Carcosa, where black stars hang in the heavens, where the shadows of men’s thoughts lengthen in the afternoon, when the twin suns sink into the Lake of Hali, and my mind will bear forever the memory of the Pallid Mask.
 - Robert W. Chambers, "The Repairer of Reputations," <u>The King in Yellow</u>
all_card.real_text:
Hastur gets +2 fight.
Hastur cannot be defeated unless an investigator "know the secret."

all_card.back_flavor:
一道暗影爬上了你身边的墙壁，你的心一下子跳到了嗓子眼。你一转身，看见一个人影溜出了你的视野。是你产生了幻觉？还是剧院里真的还有别人？
你跟着暗影的方向，转过一个角落。在大厅的尽头，有个人正站着等你：这个男子脸上戴着苍白面具，几周来这个扮演陌生人的男子的脚步声一直萦绕在你的心头。你想起来你曾经来过这里。
此时你身边的剧院开始消融。空中的两个太阳射来耀眼的阳光，刺入你的双眼。“现在你想起来了吗？”他问道。他一转身，消失在太空的尽头，就好像在激你跟上前去。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的苍白面具下的男子敌人生成在王之宫殿。
all_card.flavor: 为了阻止那些想要从星辰之中解放哈斯塔的人，你已经打开了卡尔克萨之路。只有你能阻止这场疯狂！
all_card.name: 失落的卡尔克萨
all_card.text: 目标 - 在调查员搜集的线索总计达到所需数量时，必须立即花费这些线索并推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A shadow creeps along the wall beside you, and your heart leaps into your throat. You turn, and a figure flits away just out of sight. Either your mind is playing tricks on you, or someone else is in the theatre.
You follow the direction of the shadow, rounding a nearby corner. At the far end of the hall, he stands awaiting you: the man who wears the Pallid Mask, the Stranger whose steps you have haunted for so many weeks. You remember that you have been here before.
The theatre dissolves around you. The bright glare of two suns pierce into your eyes from above. "Do you remember now?" he asks. He turns and vanishes into the aether, as if taunting you to follow.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside The Man in the Pallid Mask enemy at the Palace of the King.
all_card.real_flavor: You have opened the path to Carcosa in order to stop those who wish to free Hastur from his prison in the stars. Only you can put an end to this madness!
all_card.real_text: Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance.

all_card.flavor: 现在，终于该去与陌生人正面对质，彻底弄清他的身份和一切真相。
all_card.name: 搜寻陌生人(版本一)
all_card.text: 每位调查员均不能发现线索。 苍白面具下的男子不能被击败。 目标 - 调查员队长位于苍白面具下的男子所在地点时，其可以花费[action][action][action]以推进场景。
all_card.real_flavor: It is time to finally confront the Stranger and learn the truth about his identity, once and for all.
all_card.real_text: Each investigator cannot discover clues. The Man in the Pallid Mask cannot be defeated. Objective - While the lead investigator is at The Man in the Pallid Mask's location, he or she may spend [action][action][action] to advance.

all_card.name: 苍白面具
all_card.text: 显现 - 将苍白面具放置入场，放到调查员队长的控制之下。将苍白面具下的男子从游戏中移除。将放在一边的哈斯塔(褴褛之王)敌人生成在王之宫殿。 苍白面具不能离场。 你得到-2神智值。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put The Pallid Mask into play, under the lead investigator's control. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game. Spawn the set-aside Hastur (The Tattered King) enemy at the Palace of the King. The Pallid Mask cannot leave play. You get -2 sanity.

all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的哈斯塔(黄衣之王)敌人放置入场，放在场景牌库旁。直到冒险结束，哈斯塔视为在场，但不在任何地点上。将苍白面具下的男子从游戏中移除。
all_card.flavor: 现在，终于该去与陌生人正面对质，彻底弄清他的身份和一切真相。
all_card.name: 搜寻陌生人(版本二)
all_card.text: 每位调查员均不能发现线索。 苍白面具下的男子除因其[action]能力外不能被击败。 目标 - 在苍白面具下的男子将要因其[action]能力被击败时，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Hastur (The King in Yellow) enemy into play next to the act deck. For the remainder of the scenario, Hastur is considered to be in play but is not at any location. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game.
all_card.real_flavor: It is time to finally confront the Stranger and learn the truth about his identity, once and for all.
all_card.real_text: Each investigator cannot discover clues. The Man in the Pallid Mask cannot be defeated except by his [action] ability. Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be defeated by his [action] ability, advance.

all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的哈斯塔(卡尔克萨领主)敌人生成在苍白面具下的男子所在地点。将苍白面具下的男子从游戏中移除。
all_card.flavor: 现在，终于该去与陌生人正面对质，彻底弄清他的身份和一切真相。
all_card.name: 搜寻陌生人(版本三)
all_card.text: 每位调查员均不能发现线索。 苍白面具下的男子除因伤害外不能被击败。 目标 - 在苍白面具下的男子将要因伤害被击败时，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Hastur (Lord of Carcosa)enemy at The Man in the Pallid Mask's location. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game.
all_card.real_flavor: It is time to finally confront the Stranger and learn the truth about his identity, once and for all.
all_card.real_text: Each investigator cannot discover clues. The Man in the Pallid Mask cannot be defeated except by damage. Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be defeated by damage, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
无数的哭喊声在你脑中不断回荡。混乱的风琴和弦折磨着你的耳朵。你跪倒在地，鲜血从你眼中滴落。卡尔克萨化成了数以百万的碎片，消逝在宇宙的虚空之中。
剧终谢幕。
all_card.back_text: - 如果击败的是哈斯塔(褴褛之王)版本，进入(→结局1)。 - 如果击败的是哈斯塔(黄衣之王)版本，进入(→结局2)。 - 如果击败的是哈斯塔(卡尔克萨领主)版本，进入(→结局3)。
all_card.flavor: ……我听到黄衣之王在对我的灵魂轻诉：“落在活生生的神祇手中是多么恐怖！”<cite>——罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“龙之朝廷”，《黄衣之王》</cite>
all_card.name: 褴褛之王
all_card.text: [free]如果你所在地点没有线索：将每位调查员的所有线索从游戏中移除。将你所在地点翻面并结算其另一面的文本。 目标 - 如果哈斯塔被击败，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A chorus of cries echoes throughout your mind. Chaotic organ chords torture your ears. You fall to your knees and blood drips from your eyes. The realm of Carcosa shatters into millions of pieces and fades into the empty void of space.
Curtains fall.
all_card.real_back_text: - If Hastur (The Tattered King) was the version of Hastur that was defeated, proceed to (→R1). - If Hastur (The King in Yellow) was the version of Hastur that was defeated, proceed to (→R2). - If Hastur (Lord of Carcosa) was the version of Hastur that was defeated, proceed to (→R3).
all_card.real_flavor:
...I heard the King in Yellow whispering to my soul: "It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God!"
 - Robert W. Chambers, "In the Court of the Dragon," <u>The King in Yellow</u>
all_card.real_text: [fast] If there are no clues on your location: Remove each investigator's clues from the game. Flip your location over and resolve the text on the other side. Objective - If Hastur is defeated, advance.

all_card.flavor: 云浪碎拍湖涯，双日西沉晚霞，暗影渐长，卡尔克萨<cite>——罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，《黄衣之王》</cite>
all_card.name: 哈利湖滨
all_card.real_flavor:
Along the shore the cloud waves break,
The twin suns sink behind the lake,
The shadows lengthen
In Carcosa
 - Robert W. Chambers, <u>The King in Yellow</u>

all_card.flavor: 黑星倒映在水中，它们的歌声中透出诡秘而绝无可能的旋律。然而，你却记得这个曲调。就好像你幼年的回忆涌回了你的脑海。你开始哼唱，随着歌声渐响，水面泛起了层层涟漪。这时你想起了歌词，你与众片黑星一同歌唱，你们的歌声在这扭曲的世界里荡漾。
all_card.name: 毕宿奇歌初响
all_card.text:
对哈斯塔造成1[per_investigator]点伤害，横置他，且他与所有调查员解除交战。
将本卡牌翻面。直到游戏结束，它不能再次翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: Black stars sing in the reflection of the water, their melody impossible and uncanny. Yet somehow, you remember the tune. It is as though your earliest living memory has returned to you. You hum at first, ripples appearing along the water's surface as your volume increases. The lyrics return to you, and you join in the stars' singing, your voice echoing across the twisted realm.
all_card.real_name: Songs That the Hyades Shall Sing
all_card.real_text:
Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur, exhaust him, and disengage him from all investigators.
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.flavor: 无论我放眼何处，到处都是荒凉而孤寂的平原。地面上覆盖着异常高大的枯草，随着秋风瑟瑟作响……<cite>——安布罗斯·比尔斯，《一个卡尔克萨的居民》</cite>
all_card.name: 荒凉平原
all_card.text: 你位于荒凉平原时，你不能打出[[盟友]]支援。
all_card.real_flavor:
On every side of me stretched a bleak and desolate expanse of plain, covered with a tall overgrowth of sere grass, which rustled and whistled in the autumn wind...
 - Ambrose Bierce, "An Inhabitant of Carcosa"
all_card.real_text: While you are at Bleak Plains, you cannot play [[Ally]] assets.

all_card.flavor: 空中的云层突然露出一道缝隙，这是你来到这个怪地以来第一次看见天空。天空染成一片橙红色，看不见一丝黑暗，但黑色的星辰却在你头顶闪耀。如果说地球上的科学在这个世界里也能奏效，那也许你可以画出星图，找到回家的路。你找到一根长长的树枝，开始在沙地上画了起来……
all_card.name: 毕宿五的星辰
all_card.text:
每位调查员治愈3点恐惧。
对场上除哈斯塔外的一个敌人造成4点伤害。
将本卡牌从游戏中移除，并用另一张放在一边的荒凉平原替换它(将本地点上的所有调查员、敌人和附属移动到新的荒凉平原上)。在该荒凉平原上增加线索，直到其拥有的线索数量等于其线索值。
all_card.real_flavor: A sudden rift in the clouds above allows you to see the sky for the first time since arriving in this strange place. The sky is orange-tinted and devoid of darkness, but black stars shine above you. If the workings of Earthly science mean anything in this world, perhaps you can create a map of the stars above to find your way home. You find a long stick and begin to draw in the sand...
all_card.real_text:
Each investigator heals 3 horror.
Deal 4 damage to an enemy in play other than Hastur.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Bleak Plains (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Bleak Plains). Add clues to that copy of Bleak Plains until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.

all_card.flavor: 无论我放眼何处，到处都是荒凉而孤寂的平原。地面上覆盖着异常高大的枯草，随着秋风瑟瑟作响……<cite>——安布罗斯·比尔斯，《一个卡尔克萨的居民》</cite>
all_card.name: 荒涼平原
all_card.text: 你位于荒凉平原时，你不能打出[[盟友]]支援。
all_card.real_flavor:
On every side of me stretched a bleak and desolate expanse of plain, covered with a tall overgrowth of sere grass, which rustled and whistled in the autumn wind...
 - Ambrose Bierce, "An Inhabitant of Carcosa"
all_card.real_text: While you are at Bleak Plains, you cannot play [[Ally]] assets.

all_card.flavor:
这个世界只留下了它曾经模样的残影。在这片一望无际的无尽荒原上，根本看不到《黄衣之王》中提到的恢弘庄严的卡尔克萨。无论你走到哪里，迎接你的只有扭曲的枯树，饥瘦的动物和寸草不生的田野。
你开始寻找造成这种破坏原因的痕迹。在湖的对面，你看见疑似卡尔克萨城内的黑暗而扭曲的建筑物。至少出现了一处能媲美哈斯塔领域的宏大地区。你不禁在想，这两座城市之间是否发生了什么冲突。
all_card.name: 无边的荒凉
all_card.text:
对哈斯塔造成2[per_investigator]点伤害。
将本卡牌翻面。直到游戏结束，它不能再次翻面。
all_card.real_flavor:
This world is but a remnant of what it once was. The grand majesty of Carcosa spoken of in <u>The King in Yellow</u> is lost in this expanse of endless desolation. Dead, twisted trees, starving animals, and barren fields greet you everywhere you turn.
You begin to look for evidence of what might have caused such devastation. Across the lake, you see dark, twisted structures similar to those in Carcosa. At least one appears as large and as grand as Hastur's domain. You wonder if perhaps some kind of conflict took place between the two cities.
all_card.real_text:
Deal 2 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur.
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.flavor: 这些遗迹看起来那么古老，还有这些浮世的残迹和记忆之中的热爱和虔诚，它们都已破败不堪，污迹斑斑……<cite>——安布罗斯·比尔斯，《一个卡尔克萨的居民》</cite>
all_card.name: 卡尔克萨废墟
all_card.text: 强制 - 你发现卡尔克萨废墟最后的线索后：受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor:
So old seemed these relics, these vestiges of vanity and memorials of affection and piety, so battered and worn and stained...
 - Ambrose Bierce, "An Inhabitant of Carcosa"
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discover the last remaining clue on Ruins of Carcosa: Take 1 damage.

all_card.flavor:
你在城市的废墟中遇到了一个男子，他面容憔悴，疲惫不堪。“你好，陌生人。”他说，“我生了病，还迷了路。我恳求您，指引我吧，指引我去卡尔克萨。”你告诉他，你觉得你们现在就在卡尔克萨，他跪倒在地，陷入了绝望：“不……但这不可能！”
男子声带哭腔，咆哮着告诉了你许多有关这座古老而著名城市的往事。虽然他的话对你没有什么意义，但在你内心深处，你开始理解了。
all_card.name: 卡尔克萨的居民
all_card.text:
每位调查员治愈3点恐惧。
将本卡牌从游戏中移除，并用另一张放在一边的卡尔克萨废墟替换它(将本地点上的所有调查员、敌人和附属移动到新的卡尔克萨废墟上)。在该卡尔克萨废墟上增加线索，直到其拥有的线索数量等于其线索值。
all_card.real_flavor:
You encounter a man among the ruins of the city, haggard and tired. "Good stranger," he says, "I am ill and lost. Direct me, I beseech you, to Carcosa." You tell him that you believe you are in the realm of Carcosa right now, and he falls to his knees in despair. "No... But that cannot be!"
The man cries and raves, telling you more of the ancient and famous city. Though his words have little meaning to you, deep within your mind, you begin to understand.
all_card.real_text:
Each investigator heals 3 horror.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Ruins of Carcosa (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Ruins of Carcosa). Add clues to that copy of Ruins of Carcosa until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.

all_card.flavor: 你在探索时发现了一幢古老的建筑，虽然它已摇摇欲坠，但这里却成了你躲避这个世界的旱热与恐怖生物的理想场所。从你来到这片领域以来，你终于能在建筑的荫凉下小憩片刻。安静平和的环境缓解了你疼痛的肌肉和疲惫的头脑。然而你不能久留。
all_card.name: 短暂休憩
all_card.text:

- 选择场上一个敌人。横置该敌人，且它与所有调查员解除交战。

将本卡牌从游戏中移除，并用另一张放在一边的卡尔克萨废墟替换它(将本地点上的所有调查员、敌人和附属移动到新的卡尔克萨废墟上)。在该卡尔克萨废墟上增加线索，直到其拥有的线索数量等于其线索值。
all_card.real_flavor: During your exploration, you find an old, crumbled building that makes for an ideal refuge from this world's dry heat and its horrifying creatures. For the first time since entering this realm, you take a moment to rest in the building's cool shade. The quiet calm soothes your aching muscles and weary mind. But you cannot stay for long.
all_card.real_text:
You must decide (choose one):
 - Choose an enemy in play. Exhaust that enemy and disengage it from all investigators.
 - You heal 5 horror.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Ruins of Carcosa (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Ruins of Carcosa). Add clues to that copy of Ruins of Carcosa until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.

all_card.flavor: 你在城郊找到了一处毁坏的陵墓。陵墓的入口和巴黎的地下墓穴入口有些神似：石头的拱道两旁装饰着白骨和嘲笑着你的颅骨。最后一道拱门上的石头上，铭刻着黄色印记。狭窄拥挤的通道的尽头是一个盖着球形天花板的圆形房间。房间中央躺着一口卵形的石棺，上面没有任何标记，但封口牢固。在好奇心的驱使下，你试图打开棺椁。你耗尽全身力气才挪开了沉重的棺盖，随着砰的一声巨响，棺盖滑落到了地上。你在棺材里看见一张熟悉的脸庞——这个女子身着褴褛的长裙，她的表情既高贵又残酷。
all_card.name: 棺椁
all_card.text:
对哈斯塔造成1[per_investigator]点伤害。
将本卡牌翻面。直到游戏结束，它不能再次翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: In the outskirts of the city, you find a ruined mausoleum. Its entrance is not unlike the entrance to the Catacombs of Paris: archways of stone decorated with bone and mocking skulls. The Yellow Sign is inscribed in the stone above the final archway. The narrow, cluttered passageway leads into a circular chamber with a domed ceiling. In the center of the chamber lies an egg-shaped coffin made of stone, unmarked and firmly sealed. Curious, you attempt to open the coffin. It takes all of your strength to pull the heavy lid off, and it slides to the floor with a resounding thud. Inside, you see a familiar face - a woman in a tattered dress, her countenance noble and grim.
all_card.real_text:
Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur.
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.flavor: 街道扭曲翻腾，看不出一丝逻辑合理的样子。
all_card.name: 幽暗街道
all_card.text: 强制 - 你发现幽暗街道最后的线索后：失去1个行动。
all_card.real_flavor: The streets twist and churn without any semblance of logic or reason.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discover the last remaining clue on Dim Streets: Lose 1 action.

all_card.flavor: 你发现在城中狭窄扭曲的街道上极容易迷路。本应绕回熟悉地方的道路却通往城市新的区域，要沿原路返回是不可能的事情。也许这里的物体不像在地球那样在三维空间存在。传统的地图根本无法绘制出卡尔克萨复杂的格局。你仔细探索着各条街道，费尽心思开始绘制这座城市惊人的地图……
all_card.name: 街道地图
all_card.text:
检定[intellect](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧。无论你检定成功或失败，对哈斯塔造成1[per_investigator]点伤害。
本次检定结束后，将本卡牌翻面。直到游戏结束，它不能再次翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: You find yourself easily lost within the city's narrow, twisting streets. Routes that should lead back to familiar places lead instead to new parts of the city, and retracing your steps is impossible. Perhaps objects here do not exist in three dimensions like they do on Earth. Conventional maps cannot possibly begin to depict the complexity of Carcosa's design. You explore the streets carefully, and begin to puzzle out a shocking map of the city...
all_card.real_text:
Test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur regardless of whether you succeed or fail.
After this test ends, flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.flavor:
你转过一个街角，眼前是一条宽大的街道。街上在以王的名义举行一场盛大的游行。褴褛的黄色旗帜在风中摇摆。
你突然想了起来：你记得戏剧中出现过这一幕。你绞尽脑汁回忆接下来会发生什么事情。游行突然被打断了，游行队伍惨遭攻击……
all_card.name: 皇家游行
all_card.text:
检定[combat](2)。如果你检定成功，横置哈斯塔，且他与所有调查员解除交战。
将本卡牌从游戏中移除，并用另一张放在一边的幽暗街道替换它(将本地点上的所有调查员、敌人和附属移动到新的幽暗街道上)。在该幽暗街道上增加线索，直到其拥有的线索数量等于其线索值。
all_card.real_flavor:
You turn a corner, and before you lies a wide, grand street. A great parade marches by, in honor of the King. Banners of tattered yellow cloth sway in the wind.
Then it strikes you: you remember this scene from the play. You wrack your mind trying to remember what is supposed to happen next. The parade is interrupted and the entourage is attacked...
all_card.real_text:
Test [combat] (2). If you succeed, exhaust Hastur and disengage him from all investigators.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Dim Streets (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Dim Streets). Add clues to that copy of Dim Streets until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.

all_card.flavor: 你经过一道用漆黑的石头搭成的拱门，两边连接着两根尖柱。拱门上铭刻着你从未见过的文字，但不知为何，你却能理解它的含义。你大声朗读出铭文时，石头的传送门开始闪出微光，你瞥见卡尔克萨的另一副光景。鲜活的幻景不断变换，显现出你从未见过的地方。很快，幻象就消失了，你发现自己依旧站在废弃的街道上。
all_card.name: 拱门
all_card.text:
检定[willpower](1)。你检定成功且每高于难度1点，每位调查员治愈1点恐惧。
将本卡牌从游戏中移除，并用另一张放在一边的幽暗街道替换它(将本地点上的所有调查员、敌人和附属移动到新的幽暗街道上)。在该幽暗街道上增加线索，直到其拥有的线索数量等于其线索值。
all_card.real_flavor: You pass under an archway of ebony stone linking two spires. The inscription on the archway is written in a language you have never seen before, but somehow you are able to understand it. When you read the inscription aloud, the portal of stone shimmers, and you see a glimpse into an alternate vision of the city of Carcosa. It is vibrant and mesmerizing, like no place you have ever seen before. The vision dissolves shortly after, and you find yourself back in the ruined streets.
all_card.real_text:
Test [willpower] (1). For each point you succeed by, heal 1 horror.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Dim Streets (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Dim Streets). Add clues to that copy of Dim Streets until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.

all_card.flavor: 不要往上看。
all_card.name: 迪蒙深渊
all_card.text: 你位于迪蒙深渊时，你不能打出快速卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: Don’t look up.
all_card.real_text: While you are at Depths of Demhe, you cannot play fast cards.

all_card.flavor: 这个地方让人完全摸不到头脑。你眼前的楼梯同时向上下两个方向延伸。云端的深处既在沉降起伏，但又纹丝不动。你的身体像是在片片云雾之中飘浮，又似在海底的浪涛下浮游。这些楼梯原来只是你自己的想象。你决定跳下去。
all_card.name: 深渊的高度
all_card.text:
每位调查员治愈5点恐惧。
将本卡牌从游戏中移除，并用另一张放在一边的迪蒙深渊替换它(将本地点上的所有调查员、敌人和附属移动到新的迪蒙深渊上)。在该迪蒙深渊上增加线索，直到其拥有的线索数量等于其线索值。
all_card.real_flavor: Nothing in this realm seems to make sense. The stairs before you both ascend and descend. The cloudy depths sink and rise and sway, and yet remain still. You are floating in a cloud-wisp of mist and swimming under the sunken waves. The stairs are just a part of your imagination. You decide to jump.
all_card.real_text:
Each investigator heals 5 horror.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Depths of Demhe (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Depths of Demhe). Add clues to that copy of Depths of Demhe until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.

all_card.flavor: 你遇到了一组阶梯，看起来就像《黄衣之王》第一幕第四场中出现的宏伟楼梯——就在这组阶梯上，卡西露达第一次见到了陌生人，差一点晕倒摔了下来。一个女人的尖叫粉碎了你的回想，你抬起头来，看见卡西露达正站在楼梯顶端，她看到你的脸，脸上呈现出惊恐的表情。你冲上楼梯，接住了从楼梯上跌下来的她，用手臂抱紧她的身体。但她化成一团云雾，消散在你的身边。
all_card.name: 宫殿阶梯
all_card.text:
对哈斯塔造成1[per_investigator]点伤害，横置他，且他与所有调查员解除交战。
将本卡牌翻面。直到游戏结束，它不能再次翻面。
all_card.real_flavor: You come across a set of steps that look similar to the grand staircase of the palace from Act 1, Scene 4 of <u>The King in Yellow</u> - The very same stairs Cassilda nearly fell down when she fainted upon seeing the Stranger for the very first time. Shattering your reverie is the sound of a woman's gasp, and when you look up, you see Cassilda at the top of the steps, her expression shocked upon seeing your face. You rush up the staircase and catch her as she falls, wrapping your arms around her body. She dissolves into the cloudy mists around you.
all_card.real_text:
Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur, exhaust him, and disengage him from all investigators.
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.flavor: 时间一分一秒地逝去，夜幕降临，但我们仍然在向彼此低声说着黄衣之王和苍白面具。城中雾气缭绕，这时，从雾气中的尖柱上传来了午夜的钟声。<cite>——罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“黄色印记”，《黄衣之王》</cite>
all_card.name: 黑暗尖柱
all_card.real_flavor:
Night fell and the hours dragged on, but still we murmured to each other of the King and the Pallid Mask, and midnight sounded from the misty spires in the fog-wrapped city.
 - Robert W. Chambers, "The Yellow Sign," <u>The King in Yellow</u>

all_card.flavor:
一个女人站在高高的阳台顶端，她黄色的长裙污渍斑驳，褴褛不堪。你高声呼叫她，但她对你却没有任何反应。然后，你突然想起《黄衣之王》中的场景，在那场戏中，一个女人跳下高塔，摔在底下的街道上。
你看见的是过去吗？抑或是未来？
all_card.name: 坠落
all_card.text: 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 你下不了狠心履行你的职责。将本卡牌翻面。 - 你意识到自己的职责，上前一步，把她推了下去。受到2点恐惧并对哈斯塔造成2[per_investigator]点伤害。将本卡牌翻面。直到游戏结束，它不能再次翻面。
all_card.real_flavor:
A woman stands atop a tall balcony, her yellow dress tattered and stained. You call out to her, but she does not respond to anything you say. Then, you suddenly remember a scene from <u>The King in Yellow</u>, in which a woman plunges herself into the streets below.
Are you seeing the past? The future?
all_card.real_text: You must decide (choose one): - You cannot bring yourself to do what must be done. Flip this card back over. - Realizing what you must do, you step forward and push her. Take 2 horror and deal 2 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur. Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

all_card.flavor: 我祈求上帝诅咒这个作者，就如同这个作者诅咒这个世界，这鸿篇巨制的诅咒是那么美丽，简朴得令人害怕，真切得让人难以抗拒……<cite>——罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“名誉修复师”，《黄衣之王》</cite>
all_card.name: 王之宫殿
all_card.text: 除非哈斯塔有至少5[per_investigator]伤害，否则王之宫殿不能翻面。
all_card.real_flavor:
I pray God will curse the writer, as the writer has cursed the world with this beautiful, stupendous creation, terrible in its simplicity, irresistible in its truth...
 - Robert W. Chambers, "The Repairer of Reputations," <u>The King in Yellow</u>
all_card.real_text: Palace of the King cannot be flipped over unless Hastur has at least 5 [per_investigator] damage on him.

all_card.flavor:
你站在王的宫殿前。哈斯塔无休止的低语充斥着你的头脑，你无法将他荼毒的话语从你脑中赶走。看着眼前壮观而荣耀的宫殿，所有的记忆如潮水般涌了回来。
第二幕，陌生人与王。
王宫的大门打开了。
all_card.name: 哈斯塔的末路

记住你“知道了秘密”。
