all_card.back_flavor:
建筑里隐隐约约回荡着听不懂的语言，突然之间，所有的灯泡毫无征兆地同时熄灭了。你点燃了附近的一支蜡烛，继续搜寻。
黑暗包裹了四周，让整栋建筑显出一股异样的感觉。暗影和轮廓在墙壁上舞动，让你警惕地发现之前从未注意到的裂隙。这幢建筑还藏着什么秘密？
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 历史协会安置在一幢乔治王时代的宅邸里，你到达时惊讶地发现宅子的门半掩着。都这个点了，还会有什么人来这里吗？
all_card.name: 埋藏的真相
all_card.text: 跳过神话阶段的“在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记”步骤。(FAQ v1.2) 强制 - 有1点或以上线索放置到场上的敌人后：将这些线索翻至其毁灭标记面。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A phrase in a language you cannot describe whispers through the building, and without warning all of the electric lights shatter at once. You light a nearby candle and continue your search.
The building is quite different once plunged into darkness. Shadows and silhouettes dance along the walls. Crevices you hadn't noticed before draw your wary eye. What other secrets does this building hold?
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: Surprisingly, the front doors of the Historical Society’s Georgian manor are cracked halfway open when you arrive. Who else could be here at this hour?
all_card.real_text: Skip the 'Place 1 doom on the current agenda' step of the Mythos phase. Forced - After 1 or more clues are placed on an enemy in play: Flip those clues to their doom side.

all_card.back_flavor:
宅邸的前门打开，呼啸的寒风将屋外噼啪的雨点卷进屋内，突然，门又砰得一声关上了。你躲起来偷听，思量着这么晚了，是谁还来造访这幢建筑。“不，我发誓，我发誓我不知道门在哪里！”这是一个男子的髙喊，“你要自己找到路，我帮不上你！”他的声音充满了惊恐与无力。
“你说出了誓约。”另一个男子的声音回应道，“你说出了他的名字。”第一个男子结巴起来：“不！不，我不行！我不要！”随后，他的声音扭曲了，慢慢陷入了寂静。你听到楼梯上传来了脚步声——沉重而潮湿。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的附身宣誓者敌人生成在入口大厅。 检查剧本日志。如果“贵宾遇害”下没有塞巴斯蒂安·莫罗，查找收藏，找出塞巴斯蒂安·莫罗(歇斯底里的蛮子)并将其生成在入口大厅。
all_card.flavor: 虽然低语声平息了，但翻箱倒柜的声音却决计错不了。不管那是谁，他们的搜查一定极为仔细……
all_card.name: 洗劫宅邸
all_card.text: 跳过神话阶段的“在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记”步骤。(FAQ v1.2) 强制 - 有1点或以上线索放置到场上的敌人后：将这些线索翻至其毁灭标记面。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The front door of the manor opens, letting in a howl of chill wind and the pitter-patter of soft rain, then it suddenly slams shut. You find a place to hide and eavesdrop, wondering who else might have entered the building this late. "No, I swear, I swear I don't know where the door is!" A man cries out. "You'll have to find the Path on your own, I cannot help you!" He sounds panicked and disorientated.
"You spoke the Oath," a man's voice responds. "You spoke His name." The man stammers. "No! No, I cannot! I will not!" Then, his voice becomes distorted, and he speaks no more. You hear footsteps on the staircase - heavy and wet.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Possessed Oathspeaker enemy at the Entry Hall. Check Campaign Log. If Sebastien Moreau is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Sebastien Moreau (Savage Hysteria) and spawn him in the Entry Hall.
all_card.real_flavor: Though the whispering has ceased, the sounds of rummaging and furniture shifting is unmistakable. Whoever is here, they’re searching just as thoroughly as you are...
all_card.real_text: Skip the 'Place 1 doom on the current agenda' step of the Mythos phase. Forced - After 1 or more clues are placed on an enemy in play: Flip those clues to their doom side.

all_card.back_flavor: 宅邸中间的楼梯上传来一阵急促的脚步声，前门又一次打开了。“你找到了吗？”一个声音压低了问。 “对，我们马上就能启程了，道路即将打开。” 大门关上了，宅邸又恢复到了平时的孤寂与安宁。之后，你在搜寻中再也没有遇上这些神秘的长袍人的踪迹，但有关《黄衣之王》的诸多疑问你也没有找到任何答案……
all_card.flavor: 不管这些人是谁，他们一定和《黄衣之王》背后的阴谋有关。你绝不能让他们找到他们要找的东西！
all_card.name: 不能揭开的秘密
all_card.text: 跳过神话阶段的“在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记”步骤。(FAQ v1.2) 强制 - 有1点或以上线索放置到场上的敌人后：将这些线索翻至其毁灭标记面。
all_card.real_back_flavor: There is a rush of footsteps along the manor's central stairway, and the front door opens once more. "Have you found it?" A muffled voice asks. "Yes. We can embark immediately. The Path will be opened." The door closes, and the manor returns to being quiet and lonely. For the remainder of your search, you find no further traces of the mysterious robed figures, nor do you find any information to answer your many questions about The King in Yellow...
all_card.real_flavor: Whoever these people are, they must be involved with the conspiracy behind The King in Yellow. You can’t let them find whatever it is they’re looking for!
all_card.real_text: Skip the 'Place 1 doom on the current agenda' step of the Mythos phase. Forced - After 1 or more clues are placed on an enemy in play: Flip those clues to their doom side.

all_card.back_flavor: 你找到了协会一个历史学家存档的一份记录，上面记载了围绕阿卡姆早年雪松剧场关门歇业的一系列“恐怖事件”。虽然此处没有明确提到《黄衣之王》，但你相信你已经走上了正轨。 历史学家的这篇笔记并不完整，一张手写的褪色备注被夹在了最后一页日志上。 这件事太过恐怖，不宜公之于众。我把这段记录剩余部分放在了隐藏的图书馆里。这样应该能打消所有刺探的目光，毕竟这桩事件过于危险，不能轻易调查。
all_card.back_text: 在每个已揭示的历史协会地点上放置1[per_investigator]个线索(上限为其本身线索值)。
all_card.flavor: 历史协会里房间众多，每一间都保存着大量记录和文档，也许能有助于你寻找关于《黄衣之王》的答案。这里一定有什么东西能指引你获得真相。
all_card.name: 追寻答案
all_card.real_back_flavor: You find a record kept by one of the society's historians pertaining to the "dreadful events" surrounding the closing of an old theatre in Arkham, the Cedar Playhouse. Though there is no explicit mention of The King in Yellow, you believe you are on the right track. The historian's notes are cut short, and there is a faded, handwritten page clipped to the final entry. This matter is too ghastly for the public eye. I am placing the remainder of this record in the hidden library. All further inquiries should be done away from prying eyes, for this is a dangerous matter, and not one to be researched lightly.
all_card.real_back_text: For each revealed Historical Society location, add 1 [per_investigator] clues to it (to a maximum of its clue value).
all_card.real_flavor: Each of the Historical Society’s many rooms contains records and documents that may aid you in your search for answers about The King in Yellow. There must be something here that can guide you toward the truth.

all_card.back_flavor:
你正在书桌的抽屉里翻找，突然身后传来一个声音，吓了你一大跳。“抱歉！需要帮忙吗？”你看到一个形容消瘦的老人，他戴着厚边框眼镜——无疑是历史协会的一员，你顿时松了一口气。你向他解释说你在寻找这幢宅子里一个隐藏的图书馆，当然你特意隐去了你的理由。
他自我介绍说他是皮博迪先生，是历史协会的馆长。“让我来帮你找吧。”他说，“但等我们进去以后，你要跟我说说清楚。”当然你可不想走到那一步。
all_card.back_text:
在每个已揭示的历史协会地点上放置1[per_investigator]个线索(上限为其本身线索值)。
选择一位调查员控制放在一边的皮博迪先生支援。
将放在一边的隐藏的图书馆地点放置入场。
all_card.flavor: 这幢宅邸内有一个“隐藏的图书馆”，也许你能在其中找到有关《黄衣之王》的更多信息。如果要继续调查，你就必须找到进去的方法。
all_card.name: 昔日恶果
all_card.real_back_flavor:
As you rummage through a desk drawer, you are startled when you hear a voice behind you. "Excuse me! Can I help you?" You are relived to find the voice belonging to a thin, elderly man wearing wide-rimmed glasses - a member of the Historical Society, no doubt. You explain to him that you are searching for a hidden library somewhere in the manor, though you purposely leave out why.
He introduces himself as Mr. Peabody, the Historical Society's curator. "I'll help you find what you are looking for," he explains, "but only if you tell me what this is all about once we get there." You hope it doesn't come to that.
all_card.real_back_text:
For each revealed Historical Society location, add 1 [per_investigator] clues to it (to a maximum of its clue value).
Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Mr. Peabody asset.
Put the set-aside Hidden Library location into play.
all_card.real_flavor: Somewhere in the manor is a "hidden library" where you might be able to find more information about The King in Yellow. You must find the way in if you are to continue your investigation.

all_card.back_flavor: 在隐藏的图书馆里进行研究时，你发现了几条重要线索。之前演出的《黄衣之王》和这次一样，是由法国的一个巡演团出演的。这个剧组里的演职人员的名字你一个也不认识，当然扮演陌生人这一角色的演员也是匿名出演。但看起来历史协会的会员为你做了一些铺垫工作；和这部剧的信息放在一起的还有几张旧报纸。报纸头条包括：雪松剧场因火灾歇业，专家无从解释怪异的洪水等等。在这些文档中间，你还找到一个奇怪的物件——是一个带有异样铭文的黑玛瑙扣环。
all_card.back_text: 调查员必须决定(选择一项)： - 这可是重大发现！我们应该拿走它。(→结局1) - 这只是个无聊的小配饰，而且我们也不应该偷历史协会的东西。把它留下。(→结局2)
all_card.flavor: “这幢建筑年代久远，这里藏着各种秘密通道。”皮博迪先生解释说，“也许哪一条就通往你要找的这间图书馆。”
all_card.name: 誓约
all_card.text: 带有[[通道]]特性的地点互相连接。 目标 - 只有在隐藏的图书馆的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you study the hidden library, you find a few pieces of information that stand out. As with the recent production, the previous performance of The King in Yellow came to Arkham from overseas, and was performed by a French acting troupe. You don't recognize any of the cast members' names, and of course the actor who played the role of the Stranger is anonymous. However, it seems that a member of the Historical Society has done some of your work for you; there are several old newspaper clippings gathered together along with information about the play. Headlines include: Cedar Playhouse Closes Due To Fire, Experts Baffled Over Freak Floods, and the like. Hidden amongst this information, you also find a strange object - A clasp of onyx with an alien inscription.
all_card.real_back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - This is an important discovery! We should take it with us. (→R1). - It's just a silly trinket, and it would be wrong to steal from the Historical Society. Leave it behind. (→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: "This building is very old, and filled with all manner of secret passageways," Mr. Peabody explains. "Perhaps one of them will lead to this library you’re looking for."
all_card.real_text: Locations with the [[Passageway]] trait are connected to one another. Objective - Only investigators in the Hidden Library may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 有无数人拖着残缺的身体和受伤的心灵从战场回到家乡。但马克·哈里根见证的恐怖却是他无法解释的。当他写信回家时，把自己的见闻告诉了他心爱的索菲，她对此深信不疑——残杀人类的不是人类，而是些不明生物。他回家看她时，终于发现为什么她那么相信自己了：这种生物就寄宿在她体内，从内部啃食着她，从她体内破肚而出。在无助和恐惧之下，马克看着那个生物享用完它的美餐，看着索菲尖叫着消失在空气之中。现在所有人都觉得马克·哈里根疯了。也许他是疯了，但他知道那些怪物是真实存在的，除非消灭所有这些怪物，否则他永远不会罢手。

all_card.real_back_flavor: There were plenty who returned from the war broken in body or spirit. But Mark Harrigan had witnessed horrors he could not explain. His beloved Sophie believed him when he wrote her about the things he saw - not the men killing other men, but the other things. The creatures. When he came home and went to visit her, he found the reasons she believed him: she had one of the creatures inside her, eating her from the inside out. As he watched in helpless horror, she faded away into the air, screaming as thing finished its meal. Now everyone thinks Mark Harrigan is crazy. Maybe he's finally lost it, after all. But he knows the monsters are real, and he will not rest until every last one is dead.

all_card.real_flavor: He'd burn the entire town down if necessary, but he wouldn't let those monsters take anyone else.

all_card.back_flavor: 潘明感觉自己从未融入美国。在移居之前，她居住在日本统治下的韩国，那时作为越南人的她生活更为艰难。她始终不忘自己的父母做出了多大牺牲才举家迁来美国，于是她勤奋学习，考取了大学文凭。终于有一天，她父亲结识了一位来自阿卡姆的托马斯先生，对方邀请她来自己公司工作。起初托马斯先生对她非常和善一一但自从他开始阅读《黄衣之王》后，他性情大变。他把书借给潘明，但她看完第一章后就始终不敢继续阅读。三个星期后，人们发现托马斯先生自杀身亡…而真相就隐藏在这本《黄衣之王》中。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Minh never quite felt like she belonged in America. Things were even harder for her family before they moved, being Vietnamese in Korea under Japanese rule. She worked hard to get her college degree, reminding herself that her parents had sacrificed much to come to the States. Finally, her father became acquainted with a man from Arkham, Mr. Thomas, who offered Minh a job at his office. He was kind to her, at first - but then he started reading The King in Yellow, and his demeanor changed completely. He'd lent it to Minh, but she dared not read past the first act. Three weeks later, Mr. Thomas was found dead, having taken his own life... And The King in Yellow is the key to the truth.

all_card.back_flavor: 打小开始，赛菲娜漂亮的画就吸引了许多人的眼球。后来，一位巴黎的艺术收藏家来到塔希提岛，发现了赛菲娜，给了她一份工作，但要求她为他绘制赝品。赛菲娜敏锐的眼光和稳健的巧手让她成为这份工作不二的人选，而她也发现造假工艺比她想象中更能激发她的热情。最近一位腰缠万贯的匿名陌生人给了她一份活，要她重绘出一座奇怪的异星城市的全景图。当她完成最后一笔时，她猛地被拖入了画中的世界。筋疲力竭之下，她昏厥了过去，差一点当场暴毙。她醒来时，已身处自己的画室，这时她知道，一切都是真实的。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Even when she was young, Sefina's alluring paintings drew the eyes of many. When an art collector from Paris visited Tahiti and discovered Sefina, he offered to support her work in exchange for her services creating imitations. Her keen eye and steady hand were perfect for the task, and Sefina found the art of forgery to be more engaging and captivating than she'd imagined. Her most recent work came from an anonymous stranger with deep pockets, who'd tasked her with recreating a panorama of a strange, alien city. When she completed the final stroke, she was sent hurtling into the world of the painting. She only barely survived the ordeal, passing out from exhaustion. When she awoke in her gallery, she knew it had been real.

all_card.back_flavor: 阿喀琦来自尼日利亚，她从小就和他人格格不入。她经常与空气对话，也不和其他孩子一起玩耍，所以村里人觉得她疯了。而村子的先知第一个发现了她的潜力。他相信神灵选中了阿喀琦是需要她去成就大事，于是他教会了她如何发挥潜力与神灵交流。在他的教导下，阿喀琦迅速成长为一名年轻睿智的领袖，不仅她所在的村子，所有她帮助过的社群都对她尊敬有加。现在她要踏上征途，运用她独有的知识去解决那些只有她能解决的非自然问题。

all_card.real_back_flavor: As a young girl in Nigeria, Akachi became used to being set apart. Her habits of chattering away at thin air and secluding herself from other children led her village to believe she was mad. Her village Dibia was the first to see her true potential. He believed Akachi was marked by the spirits for greatness, and he taught her how to commune with them to her advantage. Under his tutelage, Akachi grew into a wise young leader, respected not just in her village, but in every community she aided. Now she meets her destiny head on, seeking out unnatural troubles that only her knowledge can stop.

all_card.back_flavor: 威廉·约里克从没想过要当一个挖墓人。他早年学习演艺，在波士顿当了多年演员，承接所有角色。莎士比亚的剧当然精彩，但是过了那么多年却没有接到几个角色的他也不得不承认舞台不是他的归宿。挖墓是一件沉闷的工作，但死者却是最好的观众，而威廉最喜欢的就是戏剧独白。但当他发现一群堕落的生物在啃食墓地里的尸体时，一切又变得不同了。自从那一晚起，为了保护死者，约里克用尽了各种手段驱赶那些生物。

all_card.real_back_flavor: William Yorick never wanted to be a gravedigger. He had trained to be an actor and had worked for years in Boston, taking whatever parts were available. Shakespeare was the best stuff, of course, but after many years and hardly any roles, he was forced to admit that the stage was not his destiny. Digging graves was tedious work, but the dead made for an excellent audience, and William always did love a soliloquy. The job took a dark turn when he found degenerate creatures eating the dead in their graves. Ever since that night, Yorick has kept the creatures at bay, using whatever means he can to protect the dead.

all_card.back_flavor: 萝拉在全球各地出演剧目时，戏票每每都被抢购一空，但从没有一部剧像《黄衣之王》一般不详而诡异。就连排练期间，戏班子都连遭厄运。一天，与她联袂出演的米里亚姆被人发现浮尸于塞纳河上，她终于崩溃了，提笔写下辞职信，告诉导演下一场就是自己的告别演出。现在她回到自己的家乡阿卡姆，准备最后一次演出，她也希望这一次能永远告别这出可怕的戏剧。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Lola has performed to sold-out houses worldwide, but no play has been as haunting or as odd as The King in Yellow. Even during rehearsals, everything about it brought calamity and dread. When her co-star, Miriam, was found floating dead in the Seine, she decided she'd had enough, and penned a letter to the director explaining that her next performance would be her last. Now she heads home to Arkham for one final show, hoping she can finally be rid of this dreadful play.

If your location has at least 1 horror on it, take 1 horror (from the token pool). If your location has no horror on it, place 1 horror on it instead.

all_card.back_flavor: 突然，一个自然之外的梦魇生物抽动着它畸形的躯体，猛击着舞台，它的触手滑进了两边的走道。它张开大口，大声唱出尖锐刺耳的歌声。这道旋律如此恐怖，把每一个音符都烙进了你的脑海。你感到前额阵阵剧痛，鲜血流出了你的耳朵。
all_card.back_text: 查找全部放在一边的卡牌和胜利区，找出皇家密使敌人，并将其生成在剧院。
all_card.flavor: 剧院安静得有些怪异。老旧的木地板在你脚下吱嘎作响，你探查观众席时小雨不断地拍打着屋顶。座位上躺着更多腐烂的尸体，其余观众也都不见了……
all_card.name: 第三幕
all_card.real_back_flavor: Abruptly, the malformed body of an unnatural nightmare slams onto the stage, its slithering tendrils reaching into the aisles. It opens its maw and lets out a shrill, piercing song. The melody is uncanny; the notes sear into your mind. Pain pounds in your forehead, and blood runs from your ears.
all_card.real_back_text: Search all set-aside cards and the victory display for the Royal Emissary enemy, and spawn it in the Theatre.
all_card.real_flavor: The theatre is eerily silent. The old wooden floor creaks beneath your feet, and a light rain gently patters on the roof as you explore the auditorium. There are more rotting corpses among the seats, and the rest of the crowd has vanished…

all_card.back_flavor: 歌声愈唱愈响，终于完全吞没了你的意识。你倒在地板上，捂住耳朵，但无论怎么紧捂，都丝毫不能减轻这生物可怕的声音。整个世界都在向你紧缩，终于，你在乐曲中听到一个不和谐的乐句：“曲终散场”。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员受到100点恐惧(不能防止)。
all_card.flavor: 这个生物的歌声在剧院的各个大厅之间无情地回荡。旋律不断重复，然而同一个音符却从未出现第二次。
all_card.name: 加演曲目
all_card.text: 强制 - 皇家密使加入胜利区后：移除场上所有的毁灭标记，并将密谋牌库重置到密谋1a。然后，在该密谋上放置3个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The song grows louder and louder, until it drowns out all of your thoughts. You collapse to the floor and cover your ears, but try as you might, you cannot muffle the intensity of the creature's awful voice. The whole world threatens to close around you, until at last you hear a discordant phrase throughout the melody: "EXIT NOW."
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator takes 100 horror (cannot be prevented).
all_card.real_flavor: The creature’s song echoes relentlessly throughout the halls of the theatre. The melody repeats again and again, yet somehow, never the same note twice.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Royal Emissary is added to the victory display: Remove all doom from play and reset the agenda deck to agenda 1a. Then, place 3 doom on that agenda.

all_card.back_flavor:
一道暗影爬上了你身边的墙壁，你的心一下子跳到了嗓子眼。你一转身，看见一个人影溜出了你的视野。是你产生了幻觉？还是剧院里真的还有别人？
你跟着暗影的方向，转过一个角落。在大厅的尽头，有个人正站着等你：这个男子身着优雅的黑色西装，他的脸上罩着一个苍白色的面具。虽然他更换了服饰，但你还是一眼就认出了他就是扮演《黄衣之王》剧中角色——陌生人的演员。他一转身，消失在走廊的尽头，就好像在激你跟上前去。
all_card.back_text: 随机选择一张放在一边的地点。将该地点放置入场，并生成放在一边的苍白面具下的男子敌人(不生成在其通常的生成地点，改为生成在该地点)。 推进到3张场景2a中的随机一张。将剩余2张场景2a从游戏中移除，不要查看其内容。
all_card.flavor: 你掐了一下自己，皮肤红肿发痛，你确定自己没有在做梦。你深吸几口气，静下心来仔细思索。不管发生了什么事，你必须探查剧院，了解事情真相。
all_card.name: 惊醒
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A shadow creeps along the wall beside you, and your heart leaps into your throat. You turn, and a figure flits away just out of sight. Either your mind is playing tricks on you, or someone else is in the theatre.
You follow the direction of the shadow, rounding a nearby corner. At the far end of the hall, he stands awaiting you: a man in an elegant black suit, his face covered by a pale mask. Though his attire has changed, you instantly recognize him as the actor who played the role of the Stranger - one of the characters from <u>The King in Yellow</u>. He turns and disappears through an open doorway, as if taunting you to follow.
all_card.real_back_text: Choose one of the set-aside locations, at random. Put that location into play, and spawn the set-aside The Man in the Pallid Mask enemy at that location (instead of his normal spawn location). Advance to one of the 3 copies of act 2a, at random. Remove the other 2 copies of act 2a from the game without looking at them.
all_card.real_flavor: You pinch yourself to see if you are dreaming, and sure enough, your skin stings and reddens. You take a few deep breaths and try to think rationally. Whatever is going on, you must explore the theatre to learn the truth of the matter.

all_card.back_flavor: 站在陌生人面前时，你能感觉到他那苍白而没有表情的面具下，他在咧齿狞笑。“人都去哪儿了？”你问道，但他没有作答。“到底怎么回事？”他仍然一语不发，你步步逼近，他步步后退，直到他的后背贴到房间的角落。你感觉背后一阵燥热，扭头一看，观众席已经化作一片火海。你再次转过头时，陌生人已经消失了。
all_card.back_text: 不弃掉苍白面具下的男子，改为将他移动到前厅。 在混乱袋里加入2个[cultist]标记。 在剧院上放置1点恐惧。直到冒险结束，地点上的恐惧代表扩散的火焰，每个带有恐惧的地点获得：“强制 - 你进入本地点或在本地点结束回合后：检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害。(每轮仅限一次。)” 将本卡牌放在场景牌库旁作为提示，并推进到场景3a。
all_card.flavor: 《黄衣之王》里这个神秘的陌生人可能知道幕间休息时发生了什么。要发掘真相，你必须找到他，和他当面对质。
all_card.name: 陌生人
all_card.text: 目标 - 在苍白面具下的男子将要从场上弃掉时，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you face off with the Stranger, you get the sense that he is grinning beneath his pale, faceless mask. "Where is everyone?" you ask, but he does not respond. "What is going on?" He remains silent and steps back as you approach, until his back is against the corner of the room. You feel intense heat behind you, and you turn to see flames roaring throughout the auditorium. You turn back to the Stranger, but he is gone.
all_card.real_back_text: Instead of discarding The Man in the Pallid Mask, move him to the Lobby. Add 2 [cultist] tokens to the chaos bag. Place 1 horror on the Theatre. Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents spreading flames, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - After you enter this location or end your turn at this location: Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage. (Limit once per round.)" Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.
all_card.real_flavor: The mysterious Stranger from <u>The King in Yellow</u> might know something about what happened during the intermission. You must find and confront him if you are to discover the truth.
all_card.real_text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
陌生人朝你微微鞠了一躬，打开了一扇之前没有出现过的玻璃门，移步从前厅的正门走了出去。突然你身边爆发出一阵刺耳的杂声，你害怕建筑会随时倒塌。于是你砸开前门赶紧逃走，身后的剧院已化为一片废墟。
逃出了几个街区后，你稍作休息，开始回想你方才目睹的一切……
all_card.back_text: 调查员必须决定(选择一项)： - 我们要去报警，告诉他们这里出了什么事！(→结局1) - 警方不会相信我们的。我们必须自己解决这件奇案。(→结局2)
all_card.flavor: 这个陌生人肯定知道出去的路。你必须紧跟其后！
all_card.name: 谢幕
all_card.text: 苍白面具下的男子不在场时，前厅获得：“[action]：撤退。” 强制 - 当一轮结束时：与带有恐惧的地点连接的地点上如果没有恐惧，在每个此类地点上放置1点恐惧。 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The Stranger gives you a slight bow as he steps through the lobby's front entrance, opening a glass door that was not there a moment before. A sudden cacophony of noise erupts around you, and you fear that the building has only seconds before it is destroyed. You flee, crashing through the front doors and leaving the ruined theatre in your wake. 
Several blocks away, you take a moment to rest and think about what you've witnessed...
all_card.real_back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - We have to warn the police about what's going on! (→R1) - The police won't believe us. We have to solve this mystery on our own. (→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: The Stranger must know the way out. You have to follow him!
all_card.real_text: While The Man in the Pallid Mask is not in play, the Lobby gains: "[action]: Resign." Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 horror on each location with no horror that is connected to a location with horror. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 幕间休息时一定出了什么大事。
all_card.flavor: 用一团乱麻来形容剧院简直太保守了。之前擦得锃亮的墙壁和座椅现在严重开裂，沾满了泥土。幕布破碎烂烂，舞台上拖着陈旧的血污。你不知道哪个更糟：是这股腐烂的气味，还是昏睡过久的烦躁感。
all_card.name: 剧院
all_card.real_back_flavor: Must have been one hell of an intermission.
all_card.real_flavor: To say that the theatre is in disarray would be a profound understatement. The walls and seats, previously polished to a shine, are cracked and caked with dirt. The curtains are tattered, and the set is stained with old blood. You aren't sure what's worse: the smell of rot or the nagging feeling that you've been asleep for a very long time.

all_card.back_flavor: 前方的玻璃门后就是前厅，透过高高的玻璃门，你可以看到这间房间和观众席一般破败不堪。里面《黄衣之王》的海报吸引你前去查看。
all_card.flavor: 不知为何，通向阿卡姆街道的大门不见了，就好像从来没有出现在那里。
all_card.name: 前厅
all_card.text: 强制 - 在前厅揭示时：将放在一边的前厅走廊门口地点中的随机2张放置入场。 [action][action]：抽取3张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Through the tall glass doors leading into the lobby, you can see that this room isn’t nearly as dilapidated as the auditorium. Signs promoting <u>The King in Yellow</u> taunt you from inside.
all_card.real_flavor: The wide doors that led to the streets of Arkham are somehow gone, as if they were never there.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When Lobby is revealed: Put 2 of the set-aside Lobby Doorway locations into play, at random. [action][action]: Draw 3 cards.

all_card.back_flavor: 铺着地毯的楼梯通向楼座。不知为何，狭窄的楼道上有一股热浪冲了下来。
all_card.flavor: 你失望地发现楼座和一楼情况差不多，但你时不时感觉有人在走道上轻轻游走。
all_card.name: 楼座
all_card.text: 强制 - 你执行移动行动从楼座移动到剧院后：受到2点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A carpeted staircase leads up into the balcony. Somehow, a hot draft is blowing down through the steep passageway.
all_card.real_flavor: To your disappointment, the balcony sections are much like the ground floor below, although every now and then you think you spot a figure moving silently in the aisles.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you perform a move action during which you move from the Balcony to the Theatre: Take 2 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 这里的布景和你记忆中的第一幕有些不同，背景上装饰着一道令人不安的落日。
all_card.name: 后台
all_card.text: 强制 - 在后台揭示时：将放在一边的后台走廊门口地点中的随机2张放置入场。 你位于后台时，在计算你的手牌上限的时候，你手牌中每张隐私诡计改为视为3张卡牌而不是1张。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The set is different from what you remember of the play’s first act, decorated with a backdrop of an unsettling sunset.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When Backstage is revealed: Put 2 of the set-aside Backstage Doorway locations into play, at random. While you are at Backstage, each hidden treachery in your hand counts as 3 cards instead of 1 for the purposes of counting your hand size.

all_card.back_flavor: 一道华丽的木门通向剧院的前部区域。
all_card.flavor: 狭窄的楼梯让你有一种幽闭恐惧感，在楼梯顶端你找到了灯光技术员在楼座顶端的小密室。狭小的房间里放满了昂贵的照明器材和几台重型照明灯。
all_card.name: 照明室
all_card.text: 你位于照明室时，你每张手牌的资源费用提升2点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: An ornate wooden door leads into one of the front areas of the theatre.
all_card.real_flavor: At the top of a narrow, claustrophobic staircase, you find the lighting crew's closet-like booth, stationed above the balcony. Expensive lighting equipment and several heavy spotlights dominate the cramped room.
all_card.real_text: While you are in the Lighting Box, increase the resource cost of each card in your hand by 2.

all_card.back_flavor: 一道华丽的木门通向剧院的前部区域。
all_card.flavor: 你走进售票处，雨点不断拍打着你的外衣。你过了好一会儿才想起来你在室内已经买过票了，这时你才意识到不知怎的雨滴穿过了大厅的屋顶。
all_card.name: 售票处
all_card.text: [action]：获得5资源。记住你“从售票处偷窃”。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: An ornate wooden door leads into one of the front areas of the theatre.
all_card.real_flavor: Raindrops pelt your clothing as you step into the box office. It takes you a moment before you remember you purchased your ticket indoors, and you realize it is somehow raining through the roof of the hall.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Gain 5 resources. Remember that you "stole from the box office." (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 一道华丽的木门通向剧院的前部区域。
all_card.flavor: 这间房间本该是给艺人在紧张的演出中休憩放松的地方，但此刻你能想象出在这脏乱的猪圈里休息会是什么样的结果。
all_card.name: 演员休息室
all_card.text: [action]调查。你本次调查得到+3[intellect]。本次技能检定结束后，弃掉你的每张手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: An ornate wooden door leads into one of the front areas of the theatre.
all_card.real_flavor: This green room is supposed to be a relaxing lounge for tense performers, but you imagine anyone trying to find a moment's rest in this cluttered pigsty would come up shortchanged.
all_card.real_text: [action] Investigate. You get +3 [intellect] for this investigation. After this skill test ends, discard each card in your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 一道简单的木门通往剧院的后面，即使是喜欢打探的观众也很少会去到那边。
all_card.flavor: 剧组的化妆室里摆满了各种戏服与配饰，房间最远处挂着一件破破烂烂的黄色长袍，吸引了你的注意力。虽然这件袍子已经破烂不堪，却异常抓人眼球。
all_card.name: 化妆室
all_card.text: [action][action][action]：治愈3点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A simple wooden door leads into the back of the theatre, far from the prying eyes of patrons.
all_card.real_flavor: The cast's dressing room is filled with all manner of costumes and accessories, but it's the tattered yellow robe at the far end of the room that catches your attention. It looks too torn and disheveled to be worn, yet it is enticing all the same.
all_card.real_text: [action][action][action]: Heal 3 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 一道简单的木门通往剧院的后面，即使是喜欢打探的观众也很少会去到那边。
all_card.flavor: 你走进房间，看见破碎的墙纸显露出一个巨大的符号，正静静等待着你。你说不清墙壁是刻意被破坏成这个样子，还是因为建材自然脱落才形成的这个奇怪图案。
all_card.name: 排练厅
all_card.text: 强制 - 你调查排练厅时检定成功且超过难度至少2点后：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A simple wooden door leads into the back of the theatre, far from the prying eyes of patrons.
all_card.real_flavor: As you enter this room, silently confronting you is a giant symbol torn into the wallpaper. You cannot tell whether the wall was deliberately vandalized or the material peeled away in the strange pattern on its own.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you succeed by 2 or more while investigating the Rehearsal Room: Take 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 一道简单的木门通往剧院的后面，即使是喜欢打探的观众也很少会去到那边。
all_card.flavor: 显然舞台底下的道具库已经几个月没人清理了。
all_card.name: 机关室
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你揭示机关室后：查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出1张鼠群并将其放置入场与你交战(如果游戏中有3或4位调查员，改为2张)。如果查找过遭遇牌库，将其混洗。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A simple wooden door leads into the back of the theatre, far from the prying eyes of patrons.
all_card.real_flavor: Clearly, nobody has cleaned out the prop area beneath the stage in months
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal the Trap Room: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Swarm of Rats and put it into play engaged with you (2 copies instead if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game). Shuffle the encounter deck if it is searched.

all_card.flavor: “是时候了。我们都已卸下伪装，而你却没有。”<cite>——罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“面具”，《黄衣之王》</cite>
all_card.name: 苍白面具下的男子
all_card.text: 生成 - 距离所有调查员最远的地点。 冷漠。 [action]：调查。本次调查你所在地点的隐藏值+2。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为击败苍白面具下的男子。
all_card.real_flavor:
"Indeed it’s time. We have all laid aside disguise but you." - Robert W. Chambers, "The Mask,"
The King in Yellow
all_card.real_name: The Man in the Pallid Mask
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Location farthest from all investigators. Aloof. [action]: Investigate. Your location gets +2 shroud for this investigation. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, defeat The Man in the Pallid Mask.

all_card.name: 皇家密使
all_card.text: 猎物 - [willpower]最低。 庞大。猎手。反击。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：位于皇家密使所在地点或连接地点的每位调查员受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Prey - Lowest [willpower]. Massive. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Each investigator at Royal Emissary's location or a connecting location takes 1 horror.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，在场上剩余生命值最高的一个[[附身]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。(FAQ v2.0) [cultist]：-3。将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。 [tablet]：-4。受到1点恐惧。 [elder_thing]：-X。X为你所在地点的隐藏值。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害。
all_card.name: 最后的王者
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，在场上一个[[附身]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。(FAQ v2.0) [cultist]：-2。如果你检定失败，将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。 [tablet]：-4。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧。 [elder_thing]：-X。X为你所在地点的隐藏值。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on the [[Possessed]] enemy in play with the most remaining health.
[cultist]: -3. Place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -4. Take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -X. X is the shroud value of your location. If you fail, take 1 damage.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on a [[Possessed]] enemy in play.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -X. X is the shroud value of your location.

all_card.back_flavor: “啊，这不是我们最后的客人嘛。”门口的侍者通报说，“迪瓦恩小姐，您的贵客终于到了。”这个女子身着暴露的连衣裙，露出媚艳的笑容。你发誓曾经见过她护身符上的符号。“噢，现在真正的晚宴终于可以开始了。”说着，她就前去招待其他宴会的宾客了。
all_card.back_text:
找出线索最少的[[旁人]]支援。将放在一边的黛安娜·迪瓦恩敌人生成在该支援所在地点。
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你走近庄园时，才发现有些不对劲。门廊的台阶上拖出了一条血迹，前门也被砸开了。屋内传来微弱的音乐，那扭曲而不和谐的音符刺痛着你的双耳。难道《黄衣之王》的疯狂已经蔓延到了这里？
all_card.name: 礼节性迟到
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Ah, if it isn't our final guest," the doorman announces. "Miss Devine, your presence here has been long awaited." The woman wears a devilish dress and similar grin. You swear you've seen the symbol on her amulet before. "Well, now the <u>real</u> party can begin," she declares, then heads off to mingle with the other party-goers.
all_card.real_back_text:
Find the [[Bystander]] asset with the fewest clues on it. Spawn the set-aside Dianne Devine enemy at that asset's location.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: As you pull up to the manor, you notice that something is wrong. A trail of blood leads up the porch steps, and the front door is smashed. Muted music comes from within the house, its warped and discordant notes painful to your ears. Has the madness of <u>The King in Yellow</u> already made its way here?

all_card.back_flavor: 这都只发生在你的脑海中。一定是这样。不然怎么解释你身边发生的一切？是你喝多了，是你脑中产生的幻觉。大家都玩得那么尽兴——他们只是想要你加入他们一起。
all_card.flavor: 随着时间推移，这个地方在疯狂中愈陷愈深，在你眼前不断变形……
all_card.name: 可怕的真相
all_card.text: 强制 - 在本密谋将因达到毁灭阈值而推进时：改为移除场上所有毁灭标记，并结算冒险参考卡牌底下的随机一张令人作呕的现实卡牌。如果冒险参考卡牌底下没有卡牌，改为推进到密谋2b。
all_card.real_back_flavor: It's all in your head. It must be. How else could you explain what is going on around you? You've had one too many drinks, and your mind is playing tricks on you. Everybody is having so much fun - all they want is for you to join them.
all_card.real_flavor: More and more, this place continues to fall into madness, transforming before your very eyes…
all_card.real_text: Forced - When this agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold: Instead, remove all doom in play and randomly resolve one of the Sickening Reality cards underneath the scenario reference card. If there are no cards underneath the scenario reference card, advance to agenda 2b instead.

all_card.back_text: 【疯狂】名词，fēng kuáng因精神错乱而举止失常。 - 极其愚蠢的行为。 - 癫狂的状态或混乱的状况。 - 你为什么要看这一面？ - 没有理由要翻到场景1b。 - 请翻回场景1a。
all_card.flavor: 这不是聚会：这是疯人院。但不知为何，宾客们都被骗了，完全注意不到。几乎没有人还能保持理智，在你看来许多人本身就是怪物。也许你可以和他们聊一聊《黄衣之王》。
all_card.name: 发掘真相
all_card.text: 强制 - 在一位调查员退场(撤退或被击败)时：改为将该调查员的每个线索放在本场景上，而不是放在其所在地点。 目标 - 找出尽可能多的线索，然后逃出这个可怕的地方！
all_card.real_back_text: Madness. noun. mad.ness. The state of being mentally ill, especially severely. - Extremely foolish behavior. - A state of frenzied or chaotic activity. - Why are you looking at this side? - There is no reason to flip to Act 1b. - Flip back to Act 1a.
all_card.real_flavor: This isn’t a party: it’s a mad house. But for some reason, the guests are too deluded to notice. Very few of them are sane, and many are themselves horrors to your eye. Perhaps you can talk to them to learn more about <u>The King in Yellow</u>.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When an investigator is eliminated (by defeat or resignation): Place each of that investigator's clues on this act, instead of placing them at his or her location. Objective - Find as many clues as you can, then get out of this awful place!

all_card.flavor: 康斯坦丝大笑起来，她的皮肤开始剥落。鲜血从她撕裂的皮肤上徐徐淌下，随着她的脚步，在地毯上留下一条猩红的血痕。渐渐地，她曝露出了肋骨和器官，但生命却没有丝毫停止的迹象，似乎她完全没有注意到这一点。
all_card.name: 令人作呕的现实
all_card.text:
位于康斯坦丝·杜梅因所在地点的每位调查员受到1点恐惧。
将康斯坦丝·杜梅因上的每个线索移动到她所在地点。
将本卡牌翻至敌人面，并将其与[[旁人]]支援版本的康斯坦丝·杜梅因切换，将该版本从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_flavor: Constance laughs as the skin begins to slough off her body. Blood trickles from her shedding skin, leaving a trail of crimson on the carpet where she walks. One might expect her to cease functioning with her ribs and organs exposed, but she barely seems to notice.
all_card.real_text:
Each investigator at Constance Dumaine's location takes 1 horror.
Move each clue from Constance Dumaine to her location.
Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the [[Bystander]] asset version of Constance Dumaine, removing that version from the game.

all_card.flavor: “怎么了？你玩得不开心吗？”
all_card.name: 康斯坦丝·杜梅因
all_card.text:
猎手。
康斯坦丝·杜梅因处于横置状态时，她得到+3攻击。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 附身. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "What's wrong? Aren't you enjoying yourself?"
all_card.real_text:
Hunter.
While Constance Dumaine is exhausted, she gets +3 fight.

all_card.flavor: 佩里先生又喷出一口烟，他的眼睛烧出了深红色。每次他吐烟时，他的皮肤就开始开裂，慢慢化成了石块。雪茄的烟气从他皮肤的裂缝中渗出，房间内的温度急剧上升。他一把抓住了座椅，扶手在他的握力下碎成了粉末。
all_card.name: 令人作呕的现实
all_card.text:
位于乔丹·佩里所在地点的每位调查员受到1点恐惧。
将乔丹·佩里上的每个线索移动到他所在地点。
将本卡牌翻至敌人面，并将其与[[旁人]]支援版本的乔丹·佩里切换，将该版本从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_flavor: Mr. Perry takes another puff from his cigar, and his eyes burn a deep red hue. As he exhales, his skin begins to crack and hardens into stone. Cigar smoke exudes from the fissures in his skin, and the temperature in the room rises dramatically. He clenches his hand around the chair’s armrest, which crumbles to ash in his awful grasp.
all_card.real_text:
Each investigator at Jordan Perry's location takes 1 horror.
Move each clue from Jordan Perry to his location.
Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the [[Bystander]] asset version of Jordan Perry, removing that version from the game.

all_card.flavor: 雪茄的烟味弥漫着整个屋子，让你不住咳嗽，喘气。
all_card.name: 乔丹·佩里
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 当敌军阶段开始时：治愈乔丹·佩里1点伤害。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 附身. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: Cigar smoke permeates the room, causing you to cough and wheeze.
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - At the beginning of the enemy phase: Heal 1 damage from Jordan Perry.

all_card.flavor: 旁边一位宾客问春子，她穿的衣服是不是自己设计的，她点了点头，摆了个造型准备让他拍照。这个姿势似乎让她看起来变高了，她的脊椎开始生长，向上延展，最后把她的胸腔和下半身撕裂开来。但她却没有痛苦地尖叫，而是对周围投来的目光报以微笑。
all_card.name: 令人作呕的现实
all_card.text:
位于石丸春子所在地点的每位调查员受到1点恐惧。
将石丸春子上的每个线索移动到她所在地点。
将本卡牌翻至敌人面，并将其与[[旁人]]支援版本的石丸春子切换，将该版本从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_flavor: A nearby guest asks Haruko if she designed the dress she is wearing, and she nods and poses for him. As if part of her effort to appear taller, her spine grows and extends upward, separating her torso from the bottom half of her body. Instead of crying out in pain, she smiles at the attention she receives.
all_card.real_text:
Each investigator at Ishimaru Haruko's location takes 1 horror.
Move each clue from Ishimaru Haruko to her location.
Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the [[Bystander]] asset version of Ishimaru Haruko, removing that version from the game.

all_card.flavor: “这套衣服穿在我身上是不是棒极了？”
all_card.name: 石丸春子
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 你通过攻击以外的效果对石丸春子造成伤害后：抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 附身. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "Doesn't this dress look gorgeous on me?"
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - After you deal damage to Ishimaru Haruko by an effect other than an attack: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: 塞巴斯蒂安与另一位宾客的激烈讨论变了味。他大发脾气，不仅举止吓人，连他的身体也开始变形。他的皮肤上萌发出了厚重的毛发和几个肉球，这些增生物往外滴着脓水和血液。他身形扭曲，西装被扯得粉碎，只听见他骨骼劈啪作响，肌肉愈发鼓胀。他现在看起来就像一头野兽。
all_card.name: 令人作呕的现实
all_card.text:
位于塞巴斯蒂安·莫罗所在地点的每位调查员受到1点恐惧。
将塞巴斯蒂安·莫罗上的每个线索移动到他所在地点。
将本卡牌翻至敌人面，并将其与[[旁人]]支援版本的塞巴斯蒂安·莫罗切换，将该版本从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_flavor: Sebastien’s passionate debate with another guest turns ugly. His temper transforms not just his demeanor but his body as well. Thick fur sprouts from his skin, along with several bulbous growths that leak pus and blood. His suit tears as his body distorts, bones snapping and muscles bulging. He is as much beast as he is man.
all_card.real_text:
Each investigator at Sebastien Moreau's location takes 1 horror.
Move each clue from Sebastien Moreau to his location.
Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the [[Bystander]] asset version of Sebastien Moreau, removing that version from the game.

all_card.flavor: “想不想参加我们下一场演出？”
all_card.name: 塞巴斯蒂安·莫罗
all_card.text:
猎手。反击。
塞巴斯蒂安·莫罗的攻击不能被取消。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 附身. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: "Want to be in our next performance?"
all_card.real_text:
Hunter. Retaliate.
Sebastien Moreau's attacks cannot be canceled.

all_card.flavor: “再唱一个！再唱一个！”阿什莉刚刚唱完今晚最后一曲，听众就高喊起来。她向钢琴师点了点头，准备留下来最后再唱一曲。然而接下来的这首歌听起来让人极为痛苦。在不自然的高音下，她曼妙的声音现在变成了尖锐的哀嚎。她的皮肤开始收紧，紧紧包裹在骨骼外面，显得她异常丑陋，而大量虫子开始啃破她的胳膊和肩膀，爬满了她的全身。而听众都沉醉在这最后一曲中。
all_card.name: 令人作呕的现实
all_card.text:
位于阿什莉·克拉克所在地点的每位调查员受到1点恐惧。
将阿什莉·克拉克上的每个线索移动到她所在地点。
将本卡牌翻至敌人面，并将其与[[旁人]]支援版本的阿什莉·克拉克切换，将该版本从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_flavor: "Encore! Encore!" the crowd shouts as Ashleigh finishes her final song of the night. Deciding to stay for one last number, she nods to the pianist. The song that follows is excruciating. Her once-beautiful voice is now a wailing screech with unnatural pitch. Her skin has tightened hideously around her bones, and insects begin to eat their way out of her arms and shoulders, crawling over her body. The crowd is loving this final performance.
all_card.real_text:
Each investigator at Ashleigh Clarke's location takes 1 horror.
Move each clue from Ashleigh Clarke to her location.
Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the [[Bystander]] asset version of Ashleigh Clarke, removing that version from the game

all_card.flavor:
“毕宿奇歌初响，风动褴褛之王，
卡城幽影，歌声渐亡。”
all_card.name: 阿什莉·克拉克
all_card.text:
猎手。
补给阶段期间，位于阿什莉·克拉克所在地点的每位调查员不抽取卡牌。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 附身. 精英
all_card.real_flavor:
"Songs that the Hyades shall sing,
Where flap the tatters of the King,
Must died unheard in Dim Carcosa."
all_card.real_text:
Hunter.
Each investigator at Ashleigh Clarke's location does not draw cards during the upkeep phase.

all_card.back_flavor: 入口大厅的装修极为奢华，在制造出迎宾氛围的同时也显示出庄园主人的无尽财富。“需要我帮您拿外套吗？”你进门时侍者问道。你愣了一会儿才意识到门口的侍者没有双手，只有沾血的残肢。
all_card.name: 门厅
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你已经找到了有关这部剧的宝贵信息，你准备离开并计划下一步行动。(如果每位未被击败的调查员都撤退了，进入剧本手册中“如果未达成任何结局”部分。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The entrance hall is lavishly decorated, displaying the wealth of the manor’s owners while still creating a welcoming atmosphere. "Shall I take your coat?" the doorman asks as you enter. It takes a moment before you realize the doorman has only bloody stumps where he should have hands.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. Having found valuable information about the production, you depart and plan your next move. (If each undefeated investigator has resigned, proceed to "if no resolution was reached" in the Campaign Guide.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你靠近舞厅时，屋内扭曲的音乐越来越响。舞厅里许多客人在跳舞、享用美食，大家玩得都非常尽兴。
all_card.flavor: 屋外一片漆黑，只见一对对黄色的小眼睛饥饿地盯着屋内跳舞的客人。你尽力警告其他宾客，但他们只是礼貌性地报以微笑，闲扯到阿卡姆周围出现的野生动物，随后又回去跳舞了。
all_card.name: 舞厅
all_card.text: [reaction]你在舞厅里执行谈判行动后：获得2资源。(团队每阶段仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The distorted music grows louder as you approach the ballroom. Inside, many of the guests are dancing, eating, and enjoying themselves.
all_card.real_flavor: Narrow yellow eyes watch the dancers hungrily from the darkness outside. When you try to warn the other guests, they smile politely, comment about wild animal sightings around Arkham, and go back to dancing.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you perform a parley action in the Ballroom: Gain 2 resources. (Group limit once per phase.)

all_card.back_flavor: 烟味和闲聊的声音从客厅里飘了出来。你能感觉到门后传来的暖意。
all_card.flavor: 这地方到底有多少壁炉？
all_card.name: 客厅
all_card.text: [reaction]你在客厅里执行谈判行动后：抽取1张卡牌。(团队每阶段仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Cigarette smoke and the sounds of idle chatter drift out of the manor’s living room. You feel warmth behind the door.
all_card.real_flavor: How many fireplaces does this place have?
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you perform a parley action in the Living Room: Draw 1 card. (Group limit once per phase.)

all_card.back_flavor: 庄园的这处角落少人问津，你走近时，远处谈话和音乐声渐渐低了下去。通往画廊的长廊上挂着许多名贵的画作，其中也包括杜梅因夫人自己的作品。
all_card.flavor: 所有的画作和雕像都被人蓄意破坏了，但屋里的宾客还是对展示的艺术品津津乐道。
all_card.name: 画廊
all_card.text: 强制 - 你在画廊结束回合后：检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定失败，将你的1个线索放到画廊。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The sounds of conversation and warped music become muffled as you approach a lonely section of the manor. Leading to the door of the gallery is a long hall adorned with many expensive paintings, including one of Mrs. Dumaine herself.
all_card.real_flavor: Somehow, the guests in the gallery are still interested in the art on display, even though someone has vandalized all of the paintings and statues.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you end your turn at the Gallery: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, place 1 of your clues on the Gallery.

all_card.back_flavor: 你向窗外张望，看到了庄园中央的庭院。你突然感觉自己需要一些新鲜空气。
all_card.flavor: 走出庭院，还没有来得及放松，突然恐惧攫获了你。几十双黄色的眼睛从建筑的屋顶上盯着你，云层间隐约透出它们的身形。
all_card.name: 庭院
all_card.text: 强制 - 你进入庭院后：弃掉遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。如果该卡牌是敌人，将其抽取。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Looking out one of the windows, you spy the courtyard in the center of the manor. You find yourself longing for fresh air.
all_card.real_flavor: What was first a wave of relief upon exiting the manor turns to dread. Dozens of yellow eyes stare at you from the building's rooftops, and shapes loom in the clouds above.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter the Courtyard: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is an enemy, draw it.

all_card.back_flavor: 餐厅飘出一股食物的腐臭味，你差一点就把午饭吐了出来。
all_card.flavor: 你看着宾客们大口大口的吞咽着恶心的晚餐，胃里忍不住地翻腾。
all_card.name: 餐厅
all_card.text: [action]：治愈1点恐惧。然后，从混乱袋中随机揭示一个标记。如果揭示了[skull]或[auto_fail]符号，受到1点恐惧并在餐厅放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The rancid smell of rotten food wafts under the dining room door, and you barely avoid losing your lunch.
all_card.real_flavor: The sight of the guests scarfing down the awful feast, mouthful after mouthful, makes your stomach turn.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Heal 1 horror. Then, reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed, take 1 horror and place 1 doom on the Dining Room.

all_card.flavor: “来一杯香槟如何？”
all_card.name: 康斯坦丝·杜梅因
all_card.text: [action]：谈判。检定[intellect](3)以询问康斯坦丝有关戏剧的事情。如果你检定成功，控制康斯坦丝·杜梅因上的1个线索。 强制 - 在移除康斯坦丝·杜梅因上最后一个线索时：将本卡牌翻面并结算其文本。
all_card.real_flavor: "Can I offer you a glass of champagne?"
all_card.real_text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3) to ask Constance about the play. If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Constance Dumaine. Forced - When the last clue is removed from Constance Dumaine: Flip this card over and resolve its text.

all_card.flavor: 和蔼的女主人很快就谈起了这部剧。“哦，是的，我丈夫和我一起帮助塞巴斯蒂安制作了整部剧。”她解释说，“我开始还有一些迟疑，但那个导演——奈杰尔·英格兰姆先生——天哪，他太有才华了！”她大笑起来，“他是那么古怪！你知道吗，排练还没开始，他就让我们朗诵了某种……我不知道，我想那是某种誓言吧。只是走个程序，我猜。你也知道他们这种才子喜欢愚蠢的仪式。但结束以后，我们都感觉神清气爽！”她微微一笑，眼中燃起了热情，“从那一刻起，我们就再也没有任何迟疑了。《黄衣之王》肯定会成为阿卡姆历史上最成功的演出！”
all_card.name: 英格兰姆的誓约
all_card.text:
记住你“与康斯坦丝进行过会谈”。

all_card.real_flavor: It doesn't take long for the amiable hostess to open up to you about the play. "Oh yes, my husband and I helped Sebastien produce the whole thing," she explains. "I was a little hesitant at first, but that director - Mr. Nigel Engram - my, what a talented man!" She laughs. "He's so very eccentric! Did you know, before rehearsals even began, he had us recite some kind of… Why, I suppose it was an oath of sorts. A formality, I guess. You know creative types and their silly rituals. But afterward, we were filled with so much spirit!" She smiles, zeal in her eyes. "From that moment on, we had no hesitations. <u>The King in Yellow</u> would be the most successful performance in Arkham history!"

all_card.flavor: 起初佩里先生对你的提问漠不关心，但当你表示对他多项投资有兴趣时，他就变得健谈了起来。你获知他过去资助了好几场《黄衣之王》的编排——当然也包括今晚的这场演出。“是导演英格兰姆先生说服我进行投资的。”他解释说，“我第一次遇见他是在巴黎蒙巴纳斯的一间咖啡馆里。名字叫什么来着？”他沉默了一会儿，努力回想当时的情况。“总之，是他说服了我，并不是每一笔投资都需要资本回报的。也许会有人说相信他，我就是个傻瓜，但这个决定我没有后悔。从那时起，我一直在资助他的剧作。”他露出了微笑，停顿了一下，又陷入了回忆。“迷途羔羊，就是那个地方。对，对。多么美妙的一晚。”
all_card.name: 迷途羔羊

all_card.real_flavor: Mr. Perry is indifferent to your questions at first, but he grows more talkative as you express interest in his many investments. You learn that he has financed several productions of <u>The King in Yellow</u> in the past - not just tonight's performance. "It was the director, Mr. Engram, who convinced me to invest," he explains. "The first time I met him was in Paris, at a café in Montparnasse. What was the name?" He ruminates for some time, trying to remember. "Anyway, he convinced me that not every investment is about capital gain. One might consider me a fool to believe him, but I don't regret my decision. I've been financing his productions ever since." He smiles and pauses for some time, lost in memory. "L'agneau Perdu, that was the place. Yes, yes. What a night."

all_card.flavor: 与石丸小姐交谈后，你发现她设计了今晚演出中所有的戏服，但有一件例外。“你说‘陌生人’那个角色……确实很奇特，不是吗？我不知道为什么，英格兰姆先生不许我更换他的行头，一点点也不能动。那个面具也是！”她的语调带着嘲讽。“你知道吗，有一次我发现那演员——我现在都不知道他名字！——我发现他躲在第二幕的背景幕布后画着一个奇怪的图案。你见过的，就是有两个太阳的那个。他恶狠狠地瞪了我一眼，我想我当时跳下舞台就跑了！”你继续追问那个图案长什么样子，她拿起附近的一块餐巾，画了起来。她画出的图案远比你想象中精细：许多同轴的半圆形成的圆环上点缀着奇怪的符文，在中间是一对波浪形的线条。你问她这代表了什么意思，她耸了耸肩：“完全不懂。”
all_card.name: 奇怪图案

all_card.real_flavor: In speaking with Miss Ishimaru, you discover that she designed all of the costumes worn in tonight's performance, save for one. "That 'Stranger' character… Peculiar role, is it not? For whatever reason, Mr. Engram would not allow me to change his outfit, not one bit. And that mask!" She scoffs. "Did you know, one time I found that actor - I don't even know his name! - I found him drawing a strange pattern behind the backdrop for the second act. You know the one, with the two suns. He gave me a terrible stare, and I daresay I jumped right off the stage and ran!" You ask what the pattern looked like, and she finds a nearby napkin and begins to draw. Her re-creation is much more detailed than you expected: rings of concentric semicircles lined with strange runes, and at the center is a pair of wavy lines. You ask her what it means, and she shrugs. "Haven't the slightest clue."

all_card.flavor: 塞巴斯蒂安说起今晚的剧作时，你能感受到他充满了激情。“比去年的还要棒！真的！我见过最棒的一次！”你问起这是不是他第一次参加《黄衣之王》的编排，他摇了摇头表示强烈否定：“不，不，当然不是！我们出演过好多次了。巴黎、佛罗伦萨、纽约——说起来，这部剧在阿卡姆都不是第一次上演！”这个回答让你大吃一惊，于是你继续追问。“哦，好吧，如果你一定要知道，其实之前在阿卡姆的那场和我没有关系。那是几十年前了，那个时候沃德剧院都还没建成。事实上，英格兰姆先生今晚的目标就是让《黄衣之王》的故事收获更多的观众！”
all_card.name: 首场演出

all_card.real_flavor: You can tell Sebastien is a dramatic man from the way he speaks about tonight's production. "Better than last year! Indeed! The best I've ever seen!" You ask him whether this was the first performance of <u>The King in Yellow</u> he'd helped produce, and he shakes his head in vigorous disagreement. "No, no, of course not! We've done many many shows before. Paris, Florence, New York - why, this isn't even the first time the play has been performed in Arkham!" Surprised, you question him further. "Well, alright, if you must know, I had nothing to do with the previous show in Arkham. It was several decades ago, before Ward Theatre was even built. In fact, part of Mr. Engram's goal tonight was to bring the story of <u>The King in Yellow</u> to a wider audience!"

阿什莉歌声优美，让人难以忘怀，你不知不觉被她的旋律迷住了。你不知道为什么这个歌词那么吸引你，但一定有什么原因，让它们深深印在了你的脑海：
“悬城雷云嚣哗，
浪碎鎏金囚枷，
天开路现，
卡尔克萨。

水渗海底流沙，
赤日西枕暗霞，

卡尔克萨。”

all_card.real_flavor:
Ashleigh's song is beautiful and haunting, and you find yourself mesmerized by its melody. You don't know why the lyrics call to you, but for some reason, you cannot get them out of your head.
"Above the city the storm clouds rage,
And waves crash through the gilded cage,
The skies open the Path above to
Lost Carcosa.
Below the earth the salt water seeps,
The shadows fall as the red sun sleeps
The ocean opens the Path below to
Dim Carcosa."

all_card.real_text: Spawn - Revealed location with the most clues. Forced - After Fanatic enters play: Move 1 clue from Fanatic's location to Fanatic. Forced - When you defeat Fanatic: Take control of all of its clues.

all_card.name: 王之特使
all_card.text: 猎物 - 线索最多。 猎手。 强制 - 在王之特使攻击你后：将你的1个线索移动到王之特使上。 强制 - 在你击败王之特使时：控制其所有线索。
all_card.real_text: Prey - Most clues. Hunter. Forced - After Agent of the King attacks you: Move 1 of your clues to Agent of the King. Forced - When you defeat Agent of the King: Take control of all of its clues.

all_card.name: 王之法令
all_card.text: 显现 - 场上每有1个[[异教徒]]敌人，就将该敌人所在地点的1个线索移动到该敌人上。直到一轮结束，对于场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人，该敌人上每有1个线索和/或毁灭标记，就使其得到+1攻击。如果没有因本效果移动的线索，王之法令获得涌动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - For each [[Cultist]] enemy in play, move 1 clue from that enemy's location to that enemy. Until the end of the round, each [[Cultist]] enemy in play gets +1 fight for each clue and/or doom on it. If no clues are moved by this effect, The King's Edict gains surge.

all_card.name: 淤泥与污物
all_card.text: 显现 - 将淤泥与污物放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 每个地点的隐藏值+1。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：弃掉淤泥与污物。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Ooze and Filth into play next to the act deck. Each location gets +1 shroud. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Ooze and Filth.

all_card.flavor: 你的物品突然掉到地上，在你眼前迅速腐蚀，化为一堆废铁。
all_card.name: 锈蚀
all_card.text: 显现 - 从你游戏区域和/或你手牌中弃掉一定数量的[[道具]]支援，且这些卡牌上的印刷资源费用总计至少为X，其中X为你所在地的隐藏值。如果没有因本效果弃掉的卡牌，锈蚀获得涌动。(FAQ v1.2)
all_card.real_flavor: You suddenly drop the object on the ground and watch as it erodes and turns to dust before your eyes.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Discard [[Item]] assets from your play area and/or from your hand with a total printed resource cost of at least X, where X is the shroud value of your location. If no cards are discarded by this effect, Corrosion gains surge.

all_card.flavor: 一大群格格作响的蟑螂铺满了地板，它们所到之处留下了一条棕色的黏液。
all_card.name: 蟑螂群
all_card.text: X为蟑螂群所在地点的隐藏值。
all_card.real_flavor: A mass of skittering roaches completely covers the floor, leaving a trail of sticky brown ooze in its wake.
all_card.real_text: X is the shroud value of Roach Swarm's location.

all_card.name: 印记之痕
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。如果苍白面具下的男子在场，本效果造成的恐惧视为直接恐惧，且本次检定+2难度。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, take 2 horror. If The Man in the Pallid Mask is in play, horror dealt by this effect is considered direct horror, and this test has +2 difficulty.

all_card.name: 苍白面具的呼唤
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果苍白面具下的男子在场，其按玩家顺序攻击场上每位调查员，无论其当前地点。如果苍白面具下的男子不在场，查找其承受者的牌库和弃牌堆，将其找出并抽取，并混洗其承受者的牌库(即使其承受者已退场，依然结算本效果，查找所有场外区域)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If The Man in the Pallid Mask is in play, he attacks each investigator in player order, regardless of his current location. If The Man in the Pallid Mask is not in play, search his bearer's deck and discard pile for him, draw him, and shuffle his bearer's deck (resolve this effect even if his bearer is currently eliminated, searching all out-of-play areas).

all_card.flavor: “安德森对手下确实狠。他平时把朗姆酒都锁起来，还经常天一亮就把我们叫起来。但现在，在这种不毛之地，我就希望他能打头阵。”
all_card.name: 身先士卒
all_card.text: 如果本次技能检定成功，重整你所在地点的一个[[盟友]]支援并治愈其1点伤害或1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: "Anderson's a hard-ass, sure. Always locking up the rum and waking us up at the crack of dawn. But out here in the middle of nowhere, he's definitely the one I want taking point."
all_card.real_text: If this skill test is successful, ready an [[Ally]] asset at your location and heal 1 damage or 1 horror from it.

all_card.name: 单打独斗
all_card.text:
只可作为你的第一个行动打出。
对与你交战的一个敌人造成1点伤害。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
all_card.real_text:
Play only as your first action.
Deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

all_card.name: 急救
all_card.text:
使用(4补给)。如果急救没有补给，将其弃掉。
[action]花费1补给：治愈你所在地点的一位调查员或一个[[盟友]]支援1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (4 supplies). If First Aid has no supplies, discard it.
[action] Spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset in your location.

all_card.name: 重大发现
all_card.text: 如果本次技能检定成功，执行本次检定的调查员查找其牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张卡牌，将其抽取，并混洗其牌库。
all_card.real_text: If this skill test is successful, the investigator performing this test searches the top 3 cards of his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles his or her deck.

all_card.flavor: 你对这座小镇了如指掌。
all_card.name: 捷径
all_card.text: 快速。只能在你回合期间打出。 附属到你所在地点。被附属地点获得：“[free]横置捷径：移动(到一个连接地点)。”位于该地点的所有调查员均可以触发此能力。(FAQ v1.4)
all_card.real_flavor: You know this town like the back of your hand.
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play only during your turn. Attach to your location. Attached location gains: "[fast] Exhaust Shortcut: Move (to a connecting location). Any investigator at this location may trigger this ability."

all_card.flavor: 赤裸裸的炫耀。
all_card.name: “吃我一招！”
all_card.text:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。作为将“吃我一招！”投入技能检定的额外费用，花费最多3资源。
如果你检定成功且超过难度至少1点，获得两倍数量的该资源。
all_card.real_flavor: Show-off.
all_card.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing. As an additional cost to commit "Watch this!" to a skill test, spend up to 3 resources.
If you succeed by 1 or more, gain twice that many resources.

all_card.name: .41短口手枪
all_card.text: 使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少1点，本次攻击造成+1伤害。每回合一次，如果你检定成功且超过难度至少3点，你本回合可以进行额外一次行动。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法
all_card.real_text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed by 1 or more, this attack deals +1 damage. Once per turn, if you succeed by 3 or more, you may take an additional action this turn.

all_card.name: 力量洪流
all_card.text:
作为将力量洪流投入技能检定的额外费用，从你控制的所有支援上花费最多3充能。
每以此方式花费1充能，力量洪流获得[willpower][wild]。
all_card.real_text:
As an additional cost to commit Torrent of Power to a skill test, spend up to 3 charges from among assets you control.
For each charge spent in this way, Torrent of Power gains [willpower] [wild].

all_card.name: 探知术
all_card.text:
使用(3充能)。
[free]横置探知术并花费1充能：查看任意一位调查员的牌库顶或遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。将其以任意顺序放回该牌库顶。如果查看的卡牌中有[[恐怖]]或[[征兆]]卡牌，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[fast] Exhaust Scrying and spend 1 charge: Look at the top 3 cards of any investigator's deck, or the encounter deck. Return them to the top of that deck, in any order. If a [[Terror]] or [[Omen]] card is among the looked-at cards, take 1 horror.

all_card.flavor: “结……结束了吗？”她跪倒在地，双手颤抖不止，“终于结束了吗？”
all_card.name: 中途伏击
all_card.text: 选择你所在地点一个处于横置状态的非[[精英]]敌人并检定[agility](X)，其中X为该敌人的躲避值。如果你检定成功，击败该敌人。
all_card.real_flavor: "Is… is it over?" Her hands shook, and she fell to her knees. "Is it finally over?"
all_card.real_text: Choose an exhausted non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location and test [agility] (X), where X is that enemy's evade value. If you succeed, defeat that enemy.

all_card.name: 不期而遇
all_card.text: 选择任意玩家弃牌堆中的一个印刷资源费用为X的[[盟友]]支援。将该支援放置入场，放到你的控制之下。
all_card.real_text: Choose an [[Ally]] asset with printed resource cost X in any player's discard pile. Put that asset into play under your control.

all_card.flavor: 有备无患，多多益善。
all_card.name: 应急物品
all_card.text: 获得4资源或将4补给标记分配给你所在地点的调查员控制的支援(或以任意方式组合，总计4点)。
all_card.real_flavor: You can never be too prepared.
all_card.real_text: Gain 4 resources or place 4 supply tokens among assets controlled by investigators at your location, or any combination thereof.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]：-X。X为你所在地点到起始地点的地点数量。 [cultist]：-3。如果攻击期间揭示本标记且本次技能检定成功，则本次攻击不造成伤害。 [tablet]：-3。如果你所在地点有[[食尸鬼]]或[[灵怪]]敌人，其重整并攻击你(如果有多个，选择一个)。 [elder_thing]：-4。如果你检定失败，查找遭遇牌库及遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张[[食尸鬼]]或[[灵怪]]敌人，并将其抽取。
all_card.name: 苍白面具
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]：-X。X为你所在地点到起始地点的地点数量(最多为5)。 [cultist]：-2。如果攻击期间揭示本标记且本次技能检定成功，则本次攻击造成的伤害减1。 [tablet]：-2。如果你所在地点有处于重整状态的[[食尸鬼]]或[[灵怪]]敌人，其攻击你(如果有多个，选择一个)。 [elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，查找遭遇牌库及遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张[[食尸鬼]]或[[灵怪]]敌人，并将其抽取。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of locations away from the starting location you are.
[cultist]: -3. If this token is revealed during an attack and this skill test is successful, this attack deals no damage.
[tablet]: -3. If there is a [[Ghoul]] or [[Geist]] enemy at your location, it readies and attacks you (if there is more than one, choose one).
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Ghoul]] or [[Geist]] enemy and draw it.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of locations away from the starting location you are (max 5).
[cultist]: -2. If this token is revealed during an attack, and this skill test is successful, this attack deals 1 less damage.
[tablet]: -2. If there is a ready [[Ghoul]] or [[Geist]] enemy at your location, it attacks you (if there is more than one, choose one).
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Ghoul]] or [[Geist]] enemy and draw it.

all_card.flavor: 地下墓穴内潮湿寒冷的空气穿透你的衣物，冻得你瑟瑟发抖。放眼之处只能看到亡者的尸骨——唯有你一个活人。
all_card.name: 亡者帝国
all_card.text: 每个地点与其相邻的每个地点连接。
all_card.real_flavor: The dank, chill air of the catacombs penetrates your clothes and causes you to shiver. Everywhere you look, the remains of the dead greet you - a grim reminder of your own mortality.
all_card.real_text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.

all_card.name: 死亡鬼灵
all_card.text: 生成 - 起始地点。 猎手。反击。 死亡鬼灵处于横置状态时，每次对其造成的攻击伤害减1。 强制 - 你尝试躲避死亡鬼灵时技能检定失败后：其攻击你。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 灵怪. 精英
all_card.real_text: Spawn - The starting location. Hunter. Retaliate. While Specter of Death is exhausted, it takes 1 less damage from each attack made against it. Forced - After you fail a skill test while attempting to evade Specter of Death: It attacks you.

all_card.back_flavor: 你在探索这可怕的地下墓穴时，感觉到那幽灵般的恶意无时无刻不在滋长。你越走越快，每走几步就要紧张地望向身后。它为什么要追你？它有什么目的？它刺激着你每一处感官。你一个急转弯，看到它无形的黑影瞪着你。你转身就逃，路上你穿过一处狭窄的石头走廊，但你之前未曾察觉此处。在每一处路口，在每一个转角，都有它幽暗的臂膀伸向你，你看见了它无数张在痛苦中变形的脸。你是逃不掉的。在绝望中，你跪倒在地，屈从于你的命运，呆滞地盯着冰冷的地板。你感觉这个东西逼近了你，但你不敢抬头看它。然后你只觉一片漆黑。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 它们包围了你，颅骨中的眼珠闪烁着妖异的颜色。幽灵般的声音在地下墓穴的迷宫中回荡。你感觉到身边的威胁在慢慢迫近。但你看不见它们，它们躲在弥漫于地下墓穴的浓雾之中，它们躲在每一个角落之后……
all_card.name: 亡灵帝国
all_card.text: 每个地点与其相邻的每个地点连接。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The ghostly presence that menaces you grows with each minute you spend exploring these dreadful catacombs. You walk faster, glancing behind you nervously every few steps. Why does it hound you? What is its purpose? It tugs and pulls on the periphery of your senses. You turn a sharp corner and its shapeless umbral form stares back at you. You spin and flee, passing through a narrow stone corridor you do not recognize. At every intersection, every corner, its shadowy arms reach for you, its many faces contorted in agony. You cannot escape. Resigned to your fate, you drop to your knees in hopelessness and stare down at the cold stone floor. You feel the presence approaching you and cannot bear to look up. Everything goes black.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: All around you, the eyes of skulls glow with an otherworldly hue. A ghostly voice echoes throughout the labyrinthine catacombs. You sense a threatening presence looming around you. It is just outside of your vision, past the dim fog that permeates through the catacombs, around every corner…
all_card.real_text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.

all_card.back_flavor: 你沿着一条狭窄的石头拱道，走进一间火光照亮下的圆形房间，一路上成排颅骨把它们的牙齿咬得咔哒直响。陌生人就站在墓室的中央，凝视着火光。摇曳的火焰下，暗影在四周的墙上不断舞动扭曲。陌生人转过身面对着你，他的影子扩散到了整个墙面。他手臂的影子处，触手的形状愈来愈大，把整个墙面都包裹在黑暗之中。他抬起手指向墙壁，就好像要把什么东西指给你看。
all_card.back_text: 生成放在一边的苍白面具下的男子弱点(不生成在其通常的生成地点，改为生成在暗影坟墓)。 检查剧本日志。如果“贵宾遇害”下没有石丸春子，查找收藏，找出石丸春子(皮包骨头)并将其生成在起始地点。
all_card.flavor: 你的身边有一条长长的隧道，穿过一片黑暗，你看见陌生人的身影，他那苍白的面具在烛光下闪动。“等等！”你喊道。他朝你看了一眼，消失在暗影之中。为了找到答案，你不得不继续追踪……
all_card.name: 穿越墓穴
all_card.text: 目标 - 找到苍白面具下的男子。他就在地下墓穴里。(不要推进场景，直到你受到指示。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Rows of skulls chatter their teeth endlessly as you pass through a narrow stone archway, into a round chamber illuminated by firelight. In the center of the tomb stands the Stranger, peering into the blaze. Across the wall, shadows dance and twist with the flickering of the flame. The Stranger turns to face you, and his own shadow spreads across the wall. Where his shadow's arms should be, tentacle shapes emerge, enveloping the walls in darkness. He lifts his hands toward the wall, as if trying to show you something.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside The Man in the Pallid Mask weakness in the Tomb of Shadows (instead of its normal spawn location). Check the Campaign Log. If Ishimaru Haruko is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Ishimaru Haruko (Just Skin and Bones) and spawn her at the starting location.
all_card.real_flavor: At the end of the long tunnel next to you, the Stranger steps through the darkness, his pale mask glinting in the candlelight. "Wait!" you call out. He glances your way before vanishing into the shadows. Once more, you are forced to track him down to find answers…
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find The Man in the Pallid Mask. He is somewhere in the Catacombs. (Do not advance until you are instructed.)

all_card.back_text:
如果苍白面具下的男子被击败：
陌生人单膝跪地，显然受了重伤。愤怒之下，你的拳头绷得惨白，你吼道：“我们知道卡尔克萨和哈斯塔。现在告诉我们怎么阻止这场疯狂！”陌生人把手指埋入冰冷的石头地板中，地下墓穴开始震动起来……
在剧本日志中，记2点确信。 将苍白面具下的男子从游戏中移除。 推进到场景3a“逃出生天”。
如果你花费线索以推进场景：
你发现陌生人没有对你表现出明显的敌意，便开始仔细研究四周和墙壁上奇怪的影子。他从火把中取出了什么东西，暗影再次扭曲舞动起来，显示出一个奇怪的图文……
在剧本日志中，记2点疑惑。 将苍白面具下的男子从游戏中移除。 推进到场景3a“引领道路”。
all_card.flavor: 骨墙上的暗影游走变换，形成几个人体的形态，这恐怖的一幕就像在拙劣地模仿着《黄衣之王》的演出。
all_card.name: 前途受阻
all_card.text: 目标 - “告诉我们怎么阻止通路打开！”如果苍白面具下的男子被击败，推进场景。 目标 - “他想让我们看什么？”在暗影坟墓的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If The Man in the Pallid Mask was defeated:
The Stranger drops to one knee, visibly wounded. Your knuckles whiten with anger, and you shout, "We know about Carcosa and Hastur. Now tell us how to stop this madness!" The Stranger digs his fingers into the cold stone floor, and the catacombs shake…
Mark two Conviction in your Campaign Log. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game. Advance to Act 3a - The Way Out.
If you spent clues to advance:
Recognizing that the Stranger poses no immediate danger to you, you study your surroundings and the strange shadows twist and distort once more, revealing a strange diagram…
Mark two Doubt in your Campaign Log. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game. Advance to Act 3a - Leading the Way.
all_card.real_flavor: The shadows cast along the bone walls shift into the shapes of several figures, acting out a macabre parody of <u>The King in Yellow</u>.
all_card.real_text: Objective - "Tell us how to stop the path from opening!" If The Man in the Pallid Mask is defeated, advance. Objective - "What is he trying to show us?" Investigators in the Tomb of Shadows may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你夺路而逃，墓穴在你身后轰然倒塌。你跟着陌生人的身影，在迷宫般的通道中跟着他的脚步找到了出路。你跨过地下墓穴入口门槛的那一刻，身后的碎石和碎骨奔涌而出。废墟倒塌，在你身后发出震耳欲聋的声响，你转过身去，发现一道由枯骨和岩石堆成的新墙拦在了入口前面。你正准备离开，一个带有奇怪图文的半焦颅骨滚到了你的脚边。陌生人完全消失了。
all_card.flavor: 你身边的洞窟开始摇晃崩塌，枯骨纷纷掉在地上，咯咯作响。陌生人从墓室中央的火焰中抓起一个颅骨，逃走了。
all_card.name: 逃出生天
all_card.text: 强制 - 当一轮结束时，如果地狱之门在场：弃掉离地狱之门最远的地方。将位于该地点的每位调查员和每个敌人移动到一个连接地点，且他们各受到2点伤害。 目标 - 如果每位没有被击败的调查员都在地狱之门，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The catacombs rumble and collapse behind you as you make your escape. You are able to follow the Stranger's shadow, tracing his steps to find your way through the labyrinthine passages. You cross the threshold of the catacombs entrance, a wave of rubble and bone chips following in your wake. The deafening noise of falling debris crashes behind you, and you turn to find the entrance blocked by a newly-formed wall of bone and rock. Just as you are ready to depart, a partially-charred skull bearing a strange diagram rolls to a stop at your feet. There is no sign of the Stranger anywhere.
all_card.real_flavor: Bones rattle to the floor, dislodged by the shaking and crumbling of the caverns around you. The Stranger grabs a skull from within the flames in the center of the chamber and flees.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the round, if The Gate to Hell is in play: Discard the location that is farthest from The Gate to Hell. Move each investigator and enemy that was at that location to a connecting location and deal 2 damage to each of them. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at The Gate to Hell, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
你跟着陌生人在地下通道中迂回前进。终于你走到了一个死胡同——崩塌的骨骼和碎石形成了一道厚得不可思议的墙壁，堵住了前面的隧道。陌生人站到旁边，端起了他从暗影坟墓的火焰中取出的半焦颅骨。“现在呢？”你心头疑云重重。他高举颅骨，地板开始崩塌，露出了底下深不见底的黑坑。随着骨头和碎石从墙上纷纷掉落，坑洞在迅速扩大。陌生人鞠了一躬，往后退了一步，在你想要抓住他之前掉入了坑洞里。“等等！”你喊道，但为时已晚。
坑洞越变越大，很快就会吞没整个地下墓穴，除了跟他跳下坑洞，你别无选择。
all_card.flavor: 墓室墙上的暗影开始合并。奇怪的符文扭曲成一座高塔状的建筑，那尖尖的塔顶直刺天花板。随后陌生人向你招了招手，示意你跟随；很快，他就消失在你身后的石头拱道后。
all_card.name: 引领道路
all_card.text: 忽略堵塞通道上的强制能力。 目标 - 如果每位没有被击败的调查员都在堵塞通道，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Following the Stranger's lead, you take a circuitous route through the underground passageways. Finally you are confronted by a dead end - a tunnel blocked by an impossibly thick wall of collapsed bone and rubble. The Stranger stands nearby, holding the partially-charred skull he pulled from the fire in the Tomb of Shadows. "What now?" you ask, confused. He holds the skull aloft, and the floor begins to collapse into a pit of dark emptiness below. Bones and rubble from the wall fall into the pit, and it grows larger with each moment. The Stranger bows, then falls backwards into the pit before you can grab him. "Wait!" you call out, but it is too late. With the pit growing and threatening to swallow the catacombs entirely, you have no choice but to follow him.
all_card.real_flavor: The shadows along the walls of the tomb begin to coalesce. Strange runic symbols twist into the image of a building with a tall tower, its spire reaching up toward the ceiling. Then the Stranger beckons for you to follow, and disappears through the stone archway behind you.
