[action]如果你所在地点没有敌人，横置达里奥·埃尔阿明：获得2资源。
all_card.real_text:
While you have 10 or more resources, you get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
[action] If there are no enemies at your location, exhaust Dario El-Amin: Gain 2 resources.

all_card.name: 偷袭
all_card.text: 对你所在地点的一个未与你交战的敌人造成2点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy not engaged with you at your location.

all_card.name: 灵力风暴
all_card.text: 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你检定成功，本次攻击不造成标准伤害，改为对被攻击敌人所在地点的每个敌人造成2点伤害(所有额外伤害只对被攻击敌人造成)。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，对被攻击敌人所在地点的每位调查员造成1点伤害。(FAQ v2.0)
all_card.real_text: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. If you succeed, instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 2 damage to each enemy at the attacked enemy's location (any additional damage is dealt to the attacked enemy). If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token is revealed during this attack, deal 1 damage to each investigator at the attacked enemy's location.

all_card.name: 影之书
all_card.text: [action]横置影之书并花费1资源：为你控制的一个[[法术]]支援增加1充能。
all_card.real_text: [action] Exhaust Book of Shadows and spend 1 resource: Add 1 charge to a [[Spell]] asset you control.

all_card.name: 战斗或逃跑
all_card.text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
直到本轮结束，你得到+X[combat]和+X[agility]，其中X为你身上的恐俱数量。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of the round, you get +X [combat] and +X [agility], where X is the amount of horror on you.

all_card.flavor: 无论是否看得到希望，你所能做的只有抵抗。
all_card.name: 意志考验
all_card.text:
快速。在你所在地点的一位调查员抽取一张非弱点诡计卡牌时打出。
取消该卡牌的显现效果。放逐意志考验。
all_card.real_flavor: With or without hope, all you can do is resist.
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Exile A Test of Will.

all_card.flavor: “那可是我最喜欢的帽子！”
all_card.name: 吉人天相
all_card.text:
快速。在你受到伤害和/或恐惧时打出。
取消你刚受到的伤害和/或恐惧中最多10点。放逐吉人天相。
all_card.real_flavor: "That was my favorite hat!"
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when you are dealt damage and/or horror.
Cancel up to 10 damage and/or horror just dealt to you. Exile Devil's Luck.

all_card.flavor: “接线员，麻烦你把电话挂断。”
all_card.name: 施恩求报
all_card.text: 选择一张你控制的[[盟友]]支援并将其返回你的手牌。然后，查找你牌库顶9张卡牌，找出1张[[盟友]]支援并将其打出，其费用减少X点。X为返回你手牌的[[盟友]]支援的费用。混洗你的牌库。
all_card.real_flavor: "Operator, I’m gonna need you to hang up."
all_card.real_text: Choose an [[Ally]] asset you control and return it to your hand. Then, search the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and play it, reducing its cost by X. X is the cost of the [[Ally]] asset returned to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]：揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，从放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人中随机选择一个敌人，并将其放在场景牌库底下，不要查看内容。(每次检定仅限一次。) [cultist]：-X。X为你身上的恐惧数量。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧。 [tablet]：-X。X为你所在地点的基础隐藏值。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧。 [elder_thing]：0。从放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人中随机选择一个敌人，并将其放在场景牌库底下，不要查看内容；或改为本次检定自动失败。
all_card.name: 邪秽誓约
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]：-1。如果你检定失败，从放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人中随机选择一个敌人，并将其放在场景牌库底下，不要查看内容。 [cultist]：-X。X为你身上的恐惧数量。 [tablet]：-X。X为你所在地点的基础隐藏值。 [elder_thing]：0。从放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人中随机选择一个敌人，并将其放在场景牌库底下，不要查看内容；或改为本次检定自动失败。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: Reveal another token. If you fail, randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it. (Limit once per test.)
[cultist]: -X. X is the amount of horror on you. If you fail, take 1 horror.
[tablet]: -X. X is the base shroud value of your location. If you fail, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: 0. Either randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it, or this test automatically fails instead.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1. If you fail, randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it.
[cultist]: -X. X is the amount of horror on you.
[tablet]: -X. X is the base shroud value of your location.
[elder_thing]: 0. Either randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it, or this test automatically fails instead.

all_card.back_flavor: 和病患的交谈比你预期的更加困难。他们警惕地看着你，拒绝回答你的任何问题，你每每靠近时，他们不是往后退却，就是转身逃跑。也许他们不习惯有客来访，也许是你身上的什么造成了他们的恐慌。你在这儿呆得越久，越能注意到他们行为上的变化。一人眼中闪过的黄色光芒吸引了你的注意。他们是被控制了……？
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆和每张放在一边的[[附身]]敌人洗入遭遇牌库。(FAQ v2.0) 调查员队长必须从放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人中随机选择一个敌人，并将其放在场景牌库底下，不要查看内容。
all_card.flavor: 疯人院这一片病房远比你想象中要清净而孤寂。大厅里散发着体臭和化学品的气味。你刚被带进来，身后的门就关上，锁了起来。
all_card.name: 锁闭
all_card.real_back_flavor: Speaking with the patients is proving more difficult than you had assumed. They eye you cautiously and refuse to answer any of your questions, backing away or fleeing if confronted. Either they're not used to guests, or something about you is causing them a considerable amount of distress. Some act like animals back into a corner, and you think at any moment they might strike.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each of the set-aside [[Possessed]] enemies into the encounter deck.
The lead investigator must randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it.
all_card.real_flavor: The patient wing of the asylum is far quieter and lonelier than you had expected. The hall reeks of chemicals and body odor. As soon as you are escorted inside, the doors behind you are closed and locked tight.

all_card.back_flavor: 一股力量在你脑海深处召唤你。“你看到它了吗？”它这么呼唤着。你眼角瞥见一些异状，你转过头，发现放眼之处，触目尽是熟悉的符号在回瞪着你。它蚀刻在门上。它画在墙壁上。它印在病服上。让你无从脱身。
all_card.back_text: 调查员队长必须从放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人中随机选择一个敌人，并将其洗入遭遇牌库，不要查看内容。 检查剧本日志。如果“贵宾遇害”下没有康斯坦丝·杜梅因，查找收藏，找出康斯坦丝·杜梅因(过度社交)并将其生成在花园。
all_card.flavor: 在这个人间地狱里呆得越久，你越想离开。在这里简直度日如年。你甚至害怕在这里停留太久，自己都会变成病人：变成自己的一个躯壳，变得危险而无法控制。
all_card.name: 精神折磨
all_card.real_back_flavor: In the back of your mind, a force beckons. "Have you seen it?" It calls to you. Glimpsing something in your peripheral vision, you turn, and find a familiar symbol peering back at you wherever you look. It is etched upon the doors. Drawn on the walls. Painted on the patients' canvases. You cannot escape it.
all_card.real_back_text: The lead investigator must randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and shuffle it into the encounter deck without looking at it. Check Campaign Log. If Constance Dumaine is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Constance Dumaine (A Little Too Sociable) and spawn her in the Garden.
all_card.real_flavor: The longer you spend in this hellish place, the more you want to leave. Already it has felt like days. You fear that if you are stuck here much longer, you will become like the patients: a husk of your former self, unruly, and dangerous.

all_card.back_flavor:
墙壁在逼近你。你的视线模糊了。尖啸在你耳中回荡。你被紧紧攫获，无法反击。你试图呼救，但没人前来帮你。
你寻找着出路，但却发现戴着苍白面具的陌生人盯着你。他透过每扇窗户，每个角落，每道门后，盯着你。那个面具……那个该死的面具……
还是说……也许戴着面具的就是你自己……？
all_card.back_text: 每位没有撤退的调查员被击败。(如果有调查员撤退，那些调查员可以立即推进到场景4b。)
all_card.flavor: 逃，尽力地逃。
all_card.name: 他的领地
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你将要把一个敌人放到场景牌库底下时：改为将该敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The walls close in. Your vision blurs. There is screeching in your ears. You are grabbed and cannot fight back. You call for help but nobody comes to your aid.
You look for a way to escape, but instead you see the pallid mask of the Stranger staring back at you. Around every corner, behind every door, staring at you through every window. That mask… That damned mask…


Or… Perhaps it is you who wears the mask…?
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated. (If any investigators resigned, those investigators may immediately advance to act 4b.)
all_card.real_flavor:
Flee.
Flee while you still can.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you would place an enemy beneath the act deck: Shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck, instead.

all_card.back_flavor: 你转过一个墙角，迎面撞上一个护士，她长着浅棕色的头发，脸廓分明。你告诉她这里怪事频频，病人异常暴力，但她根本听不进去。当你问到丹尼尔时，她告诉你那是明茨大夫的病人，现在住在地下室禁闭区里。可惜她拒绝让你进入疯人院的那片区域。
all_card.back_text:
调查员必须决定(选择一项)：
- 任意一位调查员检定[combat](4)以威胁她交出钥匙。如果检定成功，推进到场景2a。如果检定失败，你必须选择另一个尚未选择过的选项。
- 任意一位调查员检定[agility](4)以偷她的钥匙。如果检定成功，推进到场景2a。如果检定失败，你必须选择另一个尚未选择过的选项。
- 任意一位调查员检定[intellect](4)以说服她交出钥匙。如果检定成功，推进到场景2a。如果检定失败，你必须选择另一个尚未选择过的选项。
- 你击晕了她，夺走了钥匙。记住你“强行夺走了钥匙”。推进到场景2a。
all_card.flavor: 除了几个病人跟你保持着安全距离外，这里可以交谈的人连一个医生或勤杂工都没有。看起来你只能靠自己去找契斯特菲尔德先生了。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆疯人院
all_card.real_back_flavor: Turning a corner, you nearly bump into a nurse with light brown hair and sharp features. You tell her about the violent patients and the strange things you've seen, but she doesn't listen. When you inquire about Daniel, she informs you that he is a patient of Dr. Mintz and that he resides in the secured basement level. Unfortunately, she refuses to let you into that area of the asylum.
all_card.real_back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
- Any investigator tests [combat] (4) to intimidate her into giving you the keys. If successful, advance to act 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
- Any investigator tests [agility] (4) to steal the keys from her. If successful, advance to act 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
- Any investigator tests [intellect] (4) to persuade her to give you the keys. If successful, advance to act 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
- You knock her over and grab the keys. Remember that "you took the keys by force." Advance to act 2a.
all_card.real_flavor: Aside from the few patients giving you a wide berth, there aren’t any orderlies or doctors around to speak with. Looks like you’ll have to find Mr. Chesterfield on your own.

all_card.back_flavor:
你走进丹尼尔的囚室，发现他蜷缩在房间的一个角落里，一边抽泣，一边摇晃着身子。“不要面具，不要面具……”他反复嘟嚷着。你搀扶他站了起来，尽力安慰他，告诉他，他没有疯——告诉他《黄衣之王》演出后全城出现的怪事又在阿卡姆重演了。“是奈杰尔！”他叫了起来，紧紧抓住了你。“奈杰尔逼我们说出了他的名字……他逼我们发下了誓约，现在他活在我们身体里，控制了我们，你还不懂吗？”他前言不搭后语地说着。“我们说出了他的名字，付出了代价！哈斯塔！哈斯塔！噢，王啊！”
你觉得只要能让他冷静下来，也许就能理解这个状况了，但首先，你必须把他弄出这个疯人院。
all_card.back_text: 选择位于病人拘禁室(丹尼尔的囚室)的一位调查员。将放在一边的丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德卡牌(支援面朝上)放置入场，放到该调查员的控制之下。 将遭遇弃牌堆和场景牌库底下的每张敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 丹尼尔和其他一些最危险的病人都被关在地下室的禁闭区里。现在你手握地下室钥匙，可以前去一探究竟了。
all_card.name: 真正可怕的人(版本一)
all_card.text: 忽略[[阿卡姆疯人院]]地点未揭示面上的文字。 目标 - 找到关着丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德的病人拘禁室地点。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
When you enter his cell, you find Daniel huddled in a corner of the room, sobbing and rocking back and forth on the ground. "No mask, no mask…" he stammers over and over. You help him to his feet and try to console him, telling him that he is not crazy - that strange events have been occurring throughout town ever since <u>The King in Yellow</u> returned to Arkham. "It's Nigel!" he exclaims, gripping you tightly. "Nigel made us speak his name… He made us speak the Oath, and now He lives inside us, controlling us, don't you understand?" he rambles on. "We spoke His name and the price was paid! Hastur! Hastur! O King!"
You believe you might understand more about the situation if you can calm him down, but you'll have to get him out of this asylum if you are to accomplish that.
all_card.real_back_text: Choose an investigator at Patient Confinement (Daniel's Cell). Put the set-aside Daniel Chesterfield card (asset side faceup) into play under that investigator's control. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each enemy beneath the act deck into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: Daniel is somewhere in the secured basement where the most dangerous patients are kept. Now that you have the key, you can explore this area of the asylum.
all_card.real_text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)

all_card.back_flavor:
你走进丹尼尔的囚室，发现他蜷缩在房间的一个角落里，一边抽泣，一边摇晃着身子。“不要面具，不要面具……”他反复嘟囔着。你搀扶他起身，问他是否还记得有关《黄衣之王》的事情，但他打断了你。“不要说出他的名字！”他疯狂地大叫，瞪大的双眼中泛出了黄色的光泽。“奈杰尔逼我们说出了他的名字……他逼我们发下了誓约，现在他活在我们身体里，控制了我们，你还不懂吗？”他前言不搭后语地说着。
这个男子的脸上浮现出疯狂的表情，你警觉地后退了一步。“我们说出了他的名字，付出了代价！哈斯塔！哈斯塔！噢，王啊！——”这时，他在你眼前突然变形。他的骨骼在扭曲下劈啪作响。他的躯体怪异地歪曲着。他额头上刻着的符号开始熊熊燃烧，从他的体内散发出黄色的光芒。他脚力迸发，向你攻来。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德(敌人面朝上)生成在病人拘禁室(丹尼尔的囚室)。
all_card.flavor: 丹尼尔和其他一些最危险的病人都被关在地下室的禁闭区里。现在你手握地下室钥匙，可以前去一探究竟了。
all_card.name: 真正可怕的人(版本二)
all_card.text: 忽略[[阿卡姆疯人院]]地点未揭示面上的文字。 目标 - 找到关着丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德的病人拘禁室地点。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
When you enter his cell, you find Daniel huddled in a corner of the room, sobbing and rocking back and forth on the ground. "No mask, no mask…" he stammers over and over. You help him to his feet and ask him what he remembers about <u>The King in Yellow</u>, but he interrupts you. "Don't speak His name!" he exclaims frantically, his eyes wide with a yellow glow. "Nigel made us speak his name… He made us speak the Oath, and now He lives inside us, controlling us, don't you understand?" he rambles on.
The man approaches wearing a crazed expression, and you take a wary step backward. "We spoke His name and the price was paid! Hastur! Hastur! O King! - " Then, suddenly, he transforms before your very eyes. His bones twist and snap. His body warps grotesquely. The symbol carved into his forehead burns bright, and a yellow glow emanates from within his body. He lunges to attack you.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Daniel Chesterfield (enemy side faceup) at Patient Confinement (Daniel's Cell).
all_card.real_flavor: Daniel is somewhere in the secured basement where the most dangerous patients are kept. Now that you have the key, you can explore this area of the asylum.
all_card.real_text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)

all_card.back_flavor: 一个勤杂工的尖叫响彻了整个大厅。刹那之间，整个病院里警铃大作。护士和守卫冲进疯人院，拼命想要控制住局势。你感觉头晕眼花，就好像吃了一记闷棍。连墙壁都揉作一团，在你眼前扭动。缝隙和角落里突然之间就冒出了一群生物。
all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆和场景牌库底下的每张敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
如果至少3个[[怪物]]敌人因本效果洗入遭遇牌库，[willpower]最低的调查员从遭遇牌库顶开始弃掉卡牌，直到弃掉一个[[怪物]]敌人，并抽取该敌人。
all_card.flavor: 不管有没有带着丹尼尔，你都得尽快逃离这个地方。
all_card.name: 出逃计划
all_card.text: 忽略[[阿卡姆疯人院]]地点未揭示面上的文字。 目标 - 如果调查员达成了以下条件中的4个，你必须推进场景。 - “获知了守卫的巡逻路线。” - “在厨房放了火。” - “煽动病人互相攻击。” - “释放了一个危险的病人。” - “想起了出去的路。” - “分散了守卫的注意力。”
all_card.real_back_flavor: An orderly's scream echoes across the hall. Within moments, an alarm rings loudly throughout the institution. Nurses and guards rush through the asylum in a desperate attempt to control the situation. You feel dazed, and your vision is spotty, as though you've been struck by something heavy. The walls blur together and twist. Creatures begin to emerge out of the crevices and corners that did not exist moments before.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each enemy beneath the act deck into the encounter deck.
If at least 3 [[Monster]] enemies were shuffled into the encounter deck by this effect, the investigator with the lowest [willpower] discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Monster]] enemy is discarded and draws that enemy.
all_card.real_flavor: With or without Daniel, you have to get out of this place as soon as you can.
all_card.real_text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]]locations. Objective - If investigators have performed 4 of the following, you must advance. - "Know the guards' patrols." - "Set a fire in the kitchen." - "Incited a fight amongst the patients." - "Released a dangerous patient." - "Recalled the way out." - "Distracted the guards."

all_card.back_text:
如果“你强行夺走了钥匙”，阅读下列内容：
你正准备逃离时，之前被你攻击的护士发现了你，她身后带着一群守卫：“他们在那儿！快，抓住他们！”。
(→结局2)
否则，阅读下列内容：
守卫忙着管控局势，捆绑院内病人，全然没有注意你的逃离。
(→结局3)
all_card.flavor: 场面陷入一片混乱。
all_card.name: 告别疯人院
all_card.text: 忽略[[阿卡姆疯人院]]地点未揭示面上的文字。 花园获得：“[action]如果花园没有处于重整状态的敌人：撤退。终于，找到出口了！” 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text: If "you took the keys by force," read the following: As you attempt to escape, you are spotted by the nurse you attacked earlier, leading a group of guards. "There they are! Quickly, restrain them!" (→R2) Otherwise, read the following: The guards are too busy controlling the situation and restraining the asylum's patients to notice your escape. (→R3)
all_card.real_flavor: All hell has broken loose.
all_card.real_text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of Arkham Asylum locations. Garden gains: "[action] If there is no ready enemy in the Garden: Resign. Finally, a way out!" Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 明茨大夫关上身后沉重的铁门，接待你时轻松的氛围顿时消失殆尽。室温急剧下降，湿冷的空气中夹杂着一股刺鼻的恶臭。<cite>——马洛里·奥梅拉，《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 他们沿着隔离病区曲折的石头走廊前进时，卡洛琳开始感到不安了。这里看起来非常容易迷路。<cite>——马洛里·奥梅拉，《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》</cite>
all_card.name: 疯人院大厅
all_card.text: [reaction]你击败本地点的一个[[附身]]敌人后：抽取1张卡牌。(FAQ v2.0)
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The pleasant atmosphere of the reception area disappeared as soon as Dr. Mintz shut the thick iron door behind them. The temperature dropped to a clammy chill, and a foul, sharp stench hung in the air.
- Mallory O’Meara, The Investigators of Arkham Horror
all_card.real_flavor:
As they walked through the meandering stone halls of the sanatorium, Carolyn began to feel uneasy. It seemed like it would be very easy to get lost.
- Mallory O'Meara, The Investigators of Arkham Horror
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you defeat a [[Possessed]] enemy at this location: Draw 1 card.

all_card.real_text: Forced - After you end your turn at this location: Take 1 horror and gain 2 resources.

all_card.back_flavor: 食堂尽头狭窄的门上了锁。门后传来的臭味让你感到强烈的不适。
all_card.back_text: 通往厨房的门锁住了。你不能进入厨房。
all_card.flavor: 水槽和操作台上堆满了脏碟子。炉子上正煮着一锅无法辨认的烂泥。
all_card.name: 厨房
all_card.text: [action]如果厨房没有线索：检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定成功，记住你“在厨房放了火”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The narrow door in the back of the mess hall is locked. The scent that strikes you from behind the door is foul and repugnant.
all_card.real_back_text: The door leading into the Kitchen is locked. You cannot enter the Kitchen.
all_card.real_flavor: Dirty dishes fill the sinks and cover the countertops. An unidentifiable sludge boils on the stove.
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on the Kitchen: Test [willpower] (2). If you succeed, remember that you "set a fire in the kitchen."

all_card.back_flavor: 一道敞开的大门通向疯人院的食堂，这里是病人就餐的地方。你没想到这里那么安静——没有拖拽椅子、碗盘相碰或是病人交谈的声音。
all_card.flavor: 成排的桌子上堆满了脏碟子和变质的食物。也许叫这里“屎塘”更为合适。
all_card.name: 食堂
all_card.text: 强制 - 你成功调查食堂后：选择并弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A wide, open doorway leads into the asylum’s mess hall, where patients would have their meals. It’s quieter than you expected - there are no chairs scuffling, dishes clanking, or patients speaking with one another
all_card.real_flavor: Rows of tables are covered in dirty dishes and stale food. You get the feeling they took "mess" too literally here.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you successfully investigate the Mess Hall: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 这扇木门上挂着一块满是划痕的门牌：“医务室”。这里一定是医生照料病人的地方。
all_card.flavor: 我们的方法是经过验证的。
all_card.name: 医务室
all_card.text: [action]：治愈1点伤害并受到1点直接恐惧；或治愈1点恐惧并受到1点直接伤害。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The scratched plaque on this wooden door reads: "Infirmary." This must be where the doctors treat their patients.
all_card.real_flavor: Our methods are proven.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Heal 1 damage and take 1 direct horror, or heal 1 horror and take 1 direct damage. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 新鲜的空气和一种重获自由的幻觉让疯人院的后院成为病人日常聚集的场所。透过窗户上的栏杆，可以看到枯树在风中摇摆。一望无际的灰色天空下，疯人院就如同一座死气沉沉的监狱。
all_card.name: 后院
all_card.text:
你调查后院时，你每有1点恐惧，后院隐藏值+1。
[action]如果后院没有线索，受到1点伤害：记住你“煽动病人互相攻击”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The fresh air and the illusion of freedom makes the asylum’s courtyard a common gathering place for patients. Through the barred windows, dead tree branches sway in the wind. Gray, overcast skies trap the asylum in a dull limbo.
all_card.real_text:
While you are investigating the Yard, it gets +1 shroud for each horror on you.
[action] If there are no clues on Yard, take 1 damage: Remember that you "incited a fight amongst the patients."

all_card.back_flavor: 一座雕像孤零零地看守着花园。寒风将枯叶轻轻吹拂到花园里的路边。
all_card.back_text: 通往花园的门锁住了。你不能进入花园。
all_card.flavor: 两个白衣守卫站在花园大门旁边，时刻警觉着。
all_card.name: 花园
all_card.text: [action]如果花园没有线索：检定[agility](2)。如果你检定成功，记住你“分散了守卫的注意力”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A lone statue stands sentinel over the garden. Cold wind causes dead leaves to roll gently across the garden path.
all_card.real_back_text: The gate leading into the Garden is locked. You cannot enter the Garden.
all_card.real_flavor: Two guards in white uniforms stand by the gate to the garden, keeping watch.
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Garden: Test [agility] (2). If you succeed, remember that you "distracted the guards."

all_card.back_flavor: 黑黝黝的走廊上空气十分潮湿。卡洛琳问：“这里有通道通到地下吗？”海瑟护士点了点头。“这房子可古老得很呐，大夫。”<cite>——马洛里·奥梅拉，《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 通往地下室走廊的门锁住了。你不能进入地下室走廊。
all_card.flavor: 狭窄的石质楼梯下，就是疯人院的地下室。走廊铁门后痛苦的哭喊声听得你心惊肉跳。你无法想象生活在这个地方是什么样。
all_card.name: 地下室走廊
all_card.text: 强制 - 地下室走廊揭示后：将4张放在一边的病人拘禁室地点放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Dank air drifted out of some of the darker hallways. Carolyn asked, "Do some of these passageways lead underground?" Nurse Heather nodded. "It’s a very old building, Doctor."
- Mallory O’Meara, The Investigators of Arkham Horror
all_card.real_back_text: The door leading into the Basement Hall is locked. You cannot enter the Basement Hall.
all_card.real_flavor: A cramped stone staircase leads deep underground, to the basement level of the asylum. Cries and howls of anguish torment you from behind the hall's many iron doors. You can't imagine what it would be like to live your days in this place.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After the Basement Hall is revealed: Put the 4 set-aside Patient Confinement locations into play.

all_card.back_flavor: 沉重的铁门紧闭着，从外面上了锁。门上开了一道小窗，可以让你查看室内情况，可惜窗口卡死了。
all_card.back_text: 作为进入病人拘禁室的额外费用，你必须花费1个线索。
all_card.flavor: 丹尼尔的囚室没有窗户，这里阴冷潮湿。整面墙上都是古怪的涂绘，仔细查看可以发现似乎是摘自《黄衣之王》里的片段。
all_card.name: 病人拘禁室
all_card.text: 强制 - 病人拘禁室揭示后：推进到场景2b。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The heavy metal door is firmly shut and locked from the outside. The thin slit that would allow you to peer inside the cell is stuck.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost to enter Patient Confinement, you must spend 1 clue.
all_card.real_flavor: Daniel's windowless cell is hopelessly dank and grim. The walls are covered in erratic scribbling, which upon further inspection appears to be passages from <u>The King in Yellow</u>.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Patient Confinement is revealed: Advance to act 2b.

all_card.back_flavor: 沉重的铁门紧闭着，从外面上了锁。门上开了一道小窗，可以让你查看室内情况，可惜窗口卡死了。
all_card.back_text: 作为进入病人拘禁室的额外费用，你必须花费1个线索。
all_card.name: 病人拘禁室
all_card.text: [action]：检定[combat](2)以释放这里的病人。如果你检定成功，他像狼一样嚎叫着冲出地下室；记住你“释放了一个危险的病人”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The heavy metal door is firmly shut and locked from the outside. The thin slit that would allow you to peer inside the cell is stuck.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost to enter Patient Confinement, you must spend 1 clue.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [combat] (2) to release the patient here from his bonds. If you succeed, he howls like a wolf and tears off through the basement; remember that you "released a dangerous patient."

all_card.back_flavor: 沉重的铁门紧闭着，从外面上了锁。门上开了一道小窗，可以让你查看室内情况，可惜窗口卡死了。
all_card.back_text: 作为进入病人拘禁室的额外费用，你必须花费1个线索。
all_card.flavor: 一股阴暗的寒意包裹着这间没有窗户的囚室。在这里被关上一天都肯定让人难以忍受，不要说关上几个月了。
all_card.name: 病人拘禁室
all_card.text: [action]：检定[intellect](2)以与这里的病人交谈。如果你检定成功，你终于听懂了她的胡言乱语；记住你“获知了守卫的巡逻路线”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The heavy metal door is firmly shut and locked from the outside. The thin slit that would allow you to peer inside the cell is stuck.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost to enter Patient Confinement, you must spend 1 clue.
all_card.real_flavor: A chill gloom envelops this windowless cell. Being locked in here for a day would be torturous, let alone for months.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to speak to the patient here. If you succeed, you are able to interpret her ravings; remember that you "know the guards' patrols."

all_card.back_flavor: 沉重的铁门紧闭着，从外面上了锁。门上开了一道小窗，可以让你查看室内情况，可惜窗口卡死了。
all_card.back_text: 作为进入病人拘禁室的额外费用，你必须花费1个线索。
all_card.name: 病人拘禁室
all_card.text: [action]：检定[willpower](X)，其中X为你身上的恐惧数量。如果你检定成功，你认出了这间房间；记住你“想起了出去的路”。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The heavy metal door is firmly shut and locked from the outside. The thin slit that would allow you to peer inside the cell is stuck.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost to enter Patient Confinement, you must spend 1 clue.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] (X), where X is the amount of horror on you. If you succeed, you recognize the room; remember that you "recalled the way out."

all_card.name: 丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德
all_card.text: [free]横置丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德：将他的控制权给予你所在地的另一位调查员。 强制 - 在你受到恐惧时，如果这些恐惧中至少有1点没有分配给丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德：受到1点伤害。 强制 - 如果丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德离场：将他从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_subname: He’s Not Doing All Too Well
all_card.real_text: [fast] Exhaust Daniel Chesterfield: Give control of him to another investigator at your location. Forced - When you take horror, if at least 1 of that horror is not assigned to Daniel Chesterfield: Take 1 damage. Forced - If Daniel Chesterfield leaves play: Remove him from the game.

all_card.name: 丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德
all_card.text: 猎物 - [combat]最高。 [action]如果你控制黑玛瑙扣环：谈判。你把扣环拿给丹尼尔看，他蹒跚着退后了几步，瘫倒在地一动不动。将他加入胜利区。
all_card.traits: 类人. 附身. 精英
all_card.real_subname: …Or At Least, What's Left of Him
all_card.real_text: Prey - Highest [combat]. [action] If you control Clasp of Black Onyx: Parley. You show Daniel the clasp, and he staggers backward, collapsing into a motionless husk. Add him to the victory display.

all_card.name: 疯人院暴食怪
all_card.text: 生成 - 地下室走廊。 猎手。 疯人院暴食怪不能进行趁乱攻击，且在其猎手关键词移动的同一阶段期间不能攻击。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Basement Halls. Hunter. Asylum Gorger cannot make attacks of opportunity, and cannot attack during the same phase it moved from its hunter keyword.

all_card.flavor: 没有什么是王和他的邪秽馈赠无法触及的。
all_card.name: 阴魂不散的病人
all_card.text: 生成 - 最近的疯人院大厅。 猎物 - 剩余神智值最高。 强制 - 在你攻击阴魂不散的病人时：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: Sometimes the most terrifying of foes is one’s own mind.
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Nearest Asylum Halls. Prey - Most remaining sanity. Forced - When you attack Haunted Patient: Take 1 horror.

all_card.flavor: “你在干什么？我没有疯！”
all_card.name: 约束衣
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果你的威胁区域没有约束衣，将约束衣放置入场，放到你的威胁区域，作为一个占用1个身体槽位和2个手部槽位的支援。将那些槽位的每个支援返回你的手牌。除非通过以下能力，否则本卡牌不能离场。 [action][action]：弃掉约束衣。
all_card.real_flavor: "What are you doing? I’m not crazy!"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there is no copy of Straitjacket in your threat area, put Straitjacket into play in your threat area as an asset that takes up a body slot and 2 hand slots. Return each asset in those slots to your hand. This card cannot leave play except by the ability below. [action][action]: Discard Straitjacket.

all_card.name: 疯狂礼物
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将疯狂礼物(怜悯)秘密加入你的手牌。 你不能攻击[[附身]]敌人。(FAQ v2.0) [action]：从放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人中随机选择1个敌人，并将其放在场景牌库底下，不要查看内容。从你手牌中弃掉疯狂礼物(怜悯)。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Gift of Madness (Pity) to your hand. You cannot attack [[Possessed]] enemies. [action]: Randomly choose 1 enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it. Discard Gift of Madness (Pity) from your hand.

all_card.name: 疯狂礼物
all_card.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将疯狂礼物(悲惨)秘密加入你的手牌。 你不能触发地点上的[action]能力。 [action]：从放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人中随机选择1个敌人，并将其放在场景牌库底下，不要查看内容。从你手牌中弃掉疯狂礼物(悲惨)。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Gift of Madness (Misery) to your hand. You cannot trigger [action] abilities on locations. [action]: Randomly choose 1 enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it. Discard Gift of Madness (Misery) from your hand.

all_card.name: 危墙迫近

all_card.back_flavor: 对戴克斯特·德雷克而言，童话与神话中的魔法是他毕生的痴迷。一战期间一次偶然发现的旧书页让他意识到魔法或许真的存在。多年后，米斯卡塔尼克大学特藏室里封存的神秘典籍的诱惑，将这位成功的舞台魔术师吸引到了宁静的阿卡姆镇。“伟大的德雷克”和他的助手莫莉·麦克斯韦被一场神秘物品拍卖会引诱至此，却发现自己被来自异界腐化与疫病之力的堕落仆从给盯上了。为了拯救莫莉、阿卡姆，甚至是整个世界免于可怕的畸变，德雷克仅凭机智和快手已经不够了。他必须求助于真正的魔法--哪怕这会危及他的心智、肉体与灵魂。

all_card.real_back_flavor: For Dexter Drake, the magic of fairy tales and myth has been a lifelong fascination. The chance discovery of an old book page during the Great War opened Drake's eyes to the possibility that magic might truly exist. Years later, the promise of arcane tomes locked away in Miskatonic University's special collection draws the successful stage magician to the quiet town of Arkham. Lured to an auction of occult items, "Drake the Great" and his assistant, Molly Maxwell, find themselves targeted by the depraved servants of an otherwordly force of disease and corruption. To save Molly, Arkham, and perhaps the world from a horrific transformation, Drake needs more than his wits and quick hands. He must turn to real magic, even if it risks his mind, body, and spirit.

all_card.real_flavor: "Do you want to see true magic?"

all_card.back_flavor: 小说家歌莉娅·戈德堡一生都被噩梦和末日幻象所困扰。尽管她学会了将恐惧宣泄在纸上，却从未向任何人一一甚至包括同行作家杰米·加尔布雷思——透露过她那些怪诞故事的灵感来源。某天，她眼前浮现出杰米的幻象，他恳求她帮忙完成自己未竟的事业。片刻后，她便得知了杰米的死讯。当歌莉娅翻开杰米未完成的书稿时，故事开始将她吞噬，纸上的文字也逐渐渗入现实。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Nightmares and apocalyptic visions have plagued novelist Gloria Goldberg her entire life. Although she learned to exorcise her terrors onto the page, she has never revealed the inspiration for her weird tales, not even to fellow author Jamie Galbraith. One day, she is struck by a vision of Jamie begging her to help finish what he started. Moments later, she receives word of his sudden death. As Gloria reads Jamie's unfinished book, the story takes hold of her, and the words on the page begin to bleed into reality.

all_card.back_flavor: 珍妮·巴恩斯从未想过自己会这么快就返回美国，更没想过是在这样的情况下。马萨诸塞州的阿卡姆与巴黎相去甚远，但当妹妹的定期来信变得越来越语无伦次、直至彻底中断时，珍妮无法摆脱一种感觉一--她妹妹一定遭遇了什么可怕的事。在珍妮开始寻找妹妹的过程中，她很快意识到，伊莎贝拉并非阿卡姆唯一失踪的女孩。这些失踪案之间有何关联?为什么当地丰收节传单上印着的奖章图案，正是珍妮寄给妹妹的那枚上的面孔?

all_card.real_back_flavor: Jenny Barnes never guessed that she would be returning to America so soon, or under such circumstances. Arkham, Massachusetts, is a far cry from Paris, but when her sister's regular correspondence became increasingly deranged before stopping entirely, Jenny could not shake the feeling that something terrible had happened to her. As Jenny begins the search for her sister, she quickly realizes that Isabelle is not the only girl in Arkham to have gone missing. How might the disappearances be connected? And why do the flyers for the local harvest festival depict the face on a medallion Jenny sent her sister?

Astronomer and Miskatonic University professor Norman Withers had all but given up on regaining his colleagues' esteem when a protege of the renowned Albert Einstein comes to speak on campus. The visiting physicist, with unsettling theories about the curvature of space-time, may hold the key to helping Norman explain the phenomenon of the vanishing stars...

all_card.back_flavor: Marie Lambeau always had a voice to die for. People called her "the Smoky Velvet." They said she was born to sing jazz, that she had the magic touch — and maybe they were right. After all, the songs she heard in her dreams ever since her Grand-Mère passed away were like nothing she'd ever heard before. The vocals sounded like no language spoken on Earth, the notes twisted and warped. Why her Grand-Mère had moved from New Orleans to Arkham, Marie would never know. People used to call her Grand-Mère a witch. Maybe there's more than just jazz in Marie's blood, after all...

all_card.back_flavor: 塞拉斯·马什一生都受着大海的召唤。年少时，他离开笼罩在恐惧阴影下的印斯茅斯老家，在七大洋航行中闯出了自己的名声。但父母离世后，大海的呼唤愈发强烈。塞拉斯总会梦见——尖牙狞笑、带蹼的手伸来、还有深海黑暗中发光的眼睛。家里没人能解释他的梦境，至少，没人愿意解释。所以当绝望的图书管理员阿比盖尔·福尔曼带着自己的疑问找到赛拉斯时，他无法拒绝。她那本古老神秘的典籍《亵渎预言》指向了一场预示世界末日的星象事件，而书页边栏画着的，正是那些在赛拉斯噩梦中纠缠不休的生物……
all_card.back_text: 牌组卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，[[天性]]技能卡牌等级0-2。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：骇变鱼叉、塞拉斯的渔网、海妖之唤、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “出海了就别怕，小子。”

all_card.real_back_flavor: Silas Marsh has always felt called to the sea. As a young lad, he left his family in fear-shadowed Innsmouth and made a name for himself sailing the seven seas. But after the death of his parents, the sea's call has only grown stronger. Silas has dreams - nightmares - of pointed teeth grinning, webbed hands reaching, and eyes glowing in the darkness of the ocean deeps. No one in his family is able to offer an explanation for his dreams, or at least, no one is willing. So when desperate librarian Abigail Foreman comes to Silas with questions of her own, he cannot turn her away. Her ancient and mysterious tome, the <u>Profesiae Profana</u>, points to a stellar event foretelling the end of the world, and painted in its margins are the very same creatures that haunt Silas's nightmares...
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Innate]] skills level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Sea Change Harpoon, Silas's Net, Siren Call, 1 random basic weakness.

all_card.back_flavor: 联邦探员罗兰·班克斯向来循规蹈矩。这是在禁酒令时期的美国，避免陷入政府腐败与利益交换泥潭的唯一办法。但当班克斯在弗吉尼亚偏远地区捣毁了一个不该碰的私酒贩卖组织后，他受到的惩罚是被派往马萨诸塞州阿卡姆附近执行一项离奇任务。自调查伊始便显而易见，阿卡姆这座城市将秘密守得密不透风，若罗兰仍固守标准作业程序，绝无可能侦破此案。然而他那本探员手册里，对那些远古神话与暴怒神祇却只字未提……

all_card.real_back_flavor: Federal Agent Roland Banks has always done things by the book. It was the only way to avoid being dragged into the mire of corruption and quid pro quo that is government in Prohibition America. But when Agent Banks busts the wrong bootlegging operation in backwoods Virginia, his punishment is a bizarre assignment near Arkham, Massachusetts. It is clear from the outset of his investigation that Arkham keeps its secrets close, and Roland isn't going to break open this case if he sticks to SOP. But his agent's handbook has nothing to say regarding ancient myths and wrathful gods...

all_card.real_flavor: Everything by the book: every "i" dotted, every "t" crossed. It has worked, until now.

all_card.back_flavor: 客座心理学家卡罗琳·弗恩的最新病人是约瑟·拉格尔斯，这位女继承人在噩梦中背部会留下形如神秘符文的伤痕。即便对于阿卡姆疗养院这样的机构而言，拉格尔斯小姐的病例也实属罕见。而当她声称在梦中遇见了玛拉基——卡罗琳的前病人，此人因惨遭谋杀而中断治疗——之后，这起病例的走向愈发离奇。卡罗琳试图用催眠疗法治疗约瑟芬的心理创伤时，两人竟一同踏入了约瑟芬口中那个名为“幻梦境”的奇异所在。

all_card.flavor: “心灵本身是脆弱的，但是通过理解，我们就能对它加以保护。”

all_card.real_back_flavor: Visiting psychologist Carolyn Fern's newest patient is Josephine Ruggles, an heiress whose nightmares leave glyph-shaped wounds across her back. Miss Ruggles's case is unusual, even for an institution like Arkham Sanatorium. Her case takes an even stranger turn after she claims to have met Malachi - Carolyn's former patient whose treatment was cut short when he was brutally murdered - in her dreams. When Carolyn uses hypnotherapy to address Josephine's trauma, they find themselves both journeying to a strange place Josephine calls "the Dreamlands."

all_card.back_flavor: 马泰奥·卡斯提尔自从成为神父后，日子一直不好过。近十年来，墨西哥深受动乱与冲突之苦。马泰奥神父一面希望守住自己的信仰，一面为了布道，有时不得不忽视法律，但这并不是马泰奥信仰动摇的主要原因。如他所料，周围发生的凶杀案和绑架案，其动机与政治因素无关。在这场精心酝酿的纷争背后，一个可怕而恐怖的邪教逐渐壮大。马泰奥想知道，仁慈而可亲的上帝怎能容许他那晚所见的事情发生呢？

all_card.real_back_flavor: Mateo Castile's life has not been easy since he became a priest. Recent decades in Mexico have been wracked with instability and conflict. Father Mateo struggled to balance his faith with the pragmatic concerns of preaching when the law told him he must not. But this is not what has assaulted Mateo's faith at its core. The nearby murders and kidnappings were not politically motivated, as he had suspected. A gruesome and horrid cult thrives at the heart of the brewing war. How, Mateo wonders, could a kind and loving God allow what he saw that night to exist?

all_card.back_flavor: “倒霉蛋”本来想做个好人。但有的时候，要对得起自已的良心，就得不干不净。尽管他要钱是为了妈妈的手术，但这些条子可不会管。就在他服刑的第二年，妈妈因病去世。但狱友布拉德·霍林告诉他，还有比死亡更糟糕的事。他每晚都无声地嘴喊“古神”之事，把自己梦到的奇异旅程都告诉“倒莓蛋”。“倒霉蛋”本来没当回事，直到有一晚，他起夜看到了狱友烧成了灰。等到终于出狱的时候，“倒霉蛋”回到了阿卡姆寻求答案。

[elder_thing]: -5. If you fail, "Skids" O'Toole takes 1 horror.

Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 for each clue you have.
[cultist]: -2 (-4 instead if you have 10 or more resources).
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, lose 3 resources.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, "Skids" O'Toole takes 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 已经过去很长时间了，你赌了整夜。精疲力竭的你试图站起来，却一个踉跄，把酒全洒在了同桌一个胡子拉碴的家伙身上。那个魁梧的恶棍缓缓转过身，一脸狞恶地怒视着你，眼神充满鄙夷。他猛地从座位跃起，向你扑来。这下你可闯祸了。这帮黑帮分子肯定会把你扔出去……
all_card.back_text: 每位没有撤退调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。 如果“倒霉蛋”奥图尔已撤退，进入(→结局1)。否则进入(→结局2)。
all_card.flavor: 四叶草俱乐部里挤满了三教九流的黑帮分子和赌徒。想不动声色地大赢一笔，恐怕没你想的那么容易。
all_card.name: 众目睽睽
all_card.text: [action]如果你位于俱乐部卡牌室，花费任意数量的线索：你兑现了筹码，每花费1个线索，获得5资源。 强制 - 如果“倒霉蛋”奥图尔被击败：(→结局2)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: It's getting late, and you've been gambling all night. Exhausted, you try to stand up, but stumble and spill your drink all over a scruffy-looking fellow at your table. Slowly turning to you with a wicked scowl, the husky hoodlum stares at you with contempt. The man leaps out of his seat and lunges at you. Now you've done it. The mobsters are sure to kick you out...
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. If "Skids" O'Toole has resigned, proceed to (→R1). Otherwise, proceed to (→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: The Clover Club is filled with mobsters and gamblers from all walks of life. Winning big without causing alarm may not be as easy as you thought.
all_card.real_text: [action] If you are in the Clover Club Cardroom, spend any number of clues: You cash in your chips. Gain 5 resources for each clue just spent. Forced - If "Skids" O'Toole is defeated: (→R2)

all_card.back_flavor:
被运气和肾上腺素驱使，你赢得有点多，没能保持低调。欧巴尼恩家族的人已经知道你在这儿，并且痛恨自己的钱被“老千”偷走。从月下美人那边传来一声威严的喝令：“奥图尔那个杂种在这儿。分头行动，抓住他！”

听到自己的名字，你浑身一僵，头脑瞬间清醒。或许是时候收手了。原本毫不留意的黑帮分子们此刻纷纷起身，带着狠厉的决心追捕你。你是要在逃离前从正门直面这场麻烦，还是试着去找后门？
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的西尔班·莱利生成在月下美人。
每位调查员各将一张放在一旁的俱乐部保安生成并与自己交战。
all_card.flavor: 你不想惹麻烦，所以最好别主动生事。尽量别太快赌上全部筹码，否则很可能会被轰出去。
all_card.name: 来玩牌吧
all_card.text: 调查员不能撤退。 俱乐部赌场管理员获得冷漠。 强制 - 每当一个[[罪犯]]敌人被击败：在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。 目标 - 一轮结束时，如果有一位调查员拥有至少15资源，你必须推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Fueled by luck and adrenaline, you've wont a bit too much and failed to keep a low profile. The O'Bannions know you're here and despise having their money stolen by "cheaters." A commanding voice from La Bella Luna calls out, "That O'Toole vermin is here. Split up and get him!"
You freeze and your mind clears at the sound of your name. It may be time to stop. Once-oblivious mobsters now rise and pursue you with fierce determination. Do you confront the trouble before escaping out the front, or do you try to find the back door?
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Siobhan Riley enemy in La Bella Luna. Each investigator spawns 1 set-aside Clover Club Bouncer enemy engaged with them.
all_card.real_flavor: You don't want trouble, so it's best not to cause it. Try not to go all in too soon, or you'll likely take the bounce.
all_card.real_text: Investigators cannot resign. Clover Club Pit Boss gains aloof. Forced - After a [[Criminal]] enemy is defeated: Place 1 doom on the agenda. Objective - At the end of the round: If an investigator has 15 or more resources, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你攥着赢来的钱夺门而出，冲过街角。那股肾上腺素的激涌感无与伦比。跑到安全距离后，你清点了手中的钞票。你深吸一口气，如释重负；今晚这一趟大大减轻了你的债务负担。无疑，今夜的经历只会让你的“名声”更响。幸运女神总是站在你这边！
all_card.flavor: 带上你赢的钱就跑！
all_card.name: 紧追不放
all_card.text: 所有[[罪犯]]敌人获得猎手和+1生命。 强制 - 当调查员撤退时，将该调查员拥有的所有资源放在本场景牌上。 目标 - 尽可能多带点资源然后逃跑。当每位未被击败的调查员都撤退了，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You run out the door and sprint around the corner, winnings in hand. The adrenaline rush is like no other. Once at a safe distance, you count your money. You take a deep breath and are relieved; this outing put a big dent in your debts. Surely this night will only add to your reputation. Lady Luck is always on your side!
all_card.real_flavor: Collect your winnings and escape!
all_card.real_text: Each [[Criminal]] enemy gains hunter and gets +1 health. Forced - When an investigator resigns: Place each of that investigator's resources on this act. Objective - Collect as many resources as you can and get out. When each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.name: 西尔班·莱利
all_card.text: 强制 - 当西尔班·莱利与你交战时，你每有5资源，失去1资源。 强制 - 在调查阶段，如果有调查员在西尔班·莱利的所在地点获得1或更多的资源：将其重整，与该调查员交战，并立刻攻击一次。
all_card.traits: 类人. 罪犯. 精英
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Siobhan Riley engages you: For every 5 resources you have, lose 1 resource. Forced - After an investigator at Siobhan Riley's location gains 1 or more resources during the investigation phase: Siobhan Riley readies, engages that investigator, and makes an attack.

all_card.name: 俱乐部保安
all_card.text: 当俱乐部保安与你交战时，你每有5资源，其获得+1攻击和+1躲避。 [action]花费3资源：谈判。检定[intellect](2)。如果你检定成功，与俱乐部保安解除交战，将其横置，且在下一个维持阶段不会重整。
all_card.real_text: When Clover Club Bouncer is engaged with you, it gets +1 fight and +1 evade for every 5 resources you have. [action] Spend 3 resources: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, disengage from Clover Club Bouncer and exhaust it. It does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

all_card.back_flavor: 艾格尼丝·贝克今生可能只是个毕恭毕敬的侍应，但在超越现代世界想象的前生，她可是个强大的女巫。一切都源自她在自家阁楼那堆落满灰的传家宝里发现的奇怪神器一一大概是某种钥匙。她触碰的时候，记忆如潮水般涌来，一同奔流的还有另一个词：“希波利尔”。越是深入幻景和前世的记忆，她的力量也就越强大……但她也就更加害怕。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：25。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，[[法术]]卡牌等级0-3，[[密教]]卡牌等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：希波利尔传家宝、黑暗回忆、1张随机基础弱点。 额外选项：在你升级[[法术]]卡牌时，你可以改为支付较高等级卡牌的全额经验值，并较低等级卡牌保留在你的牌库中(该卡牌不计入你的牌库卡牌张数，或你的牌库中的同名卡牌数量)。
all_card.flavor:
“魔力流淌于我的血液，
穿行于我的血管，
涌动于我的心脏。”
all_card.name: 艾格尼丝·贝克
all_card.text:
作为打出一张[[法术]]事件的额外费用，你可以受到1点伤害。如果你这么做，减少打出该事件的费用2点，并且你可以不将该事件弃掉，改为将其洗回你的牌库。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。你可以治愈1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Agnes Baker may be just an unassuming waitress in this life, but in a previous life, she had been a powerful witch. It began when she found a strange artifact - a key of some kind - in a dusty collection of family belongings in her attic. When she touched it, the memories came flooding back, along with one word: "Hyperborea."
all_card.real_back_text: Deck size: 25. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, [[Spell]] cards level 0-3, [[Occult]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Heirloom of Hyperborea, Dark Memory, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Options: When you upgrade a [[Spell]] card, you may instead pay the full experience cost of the higher level version and leave the lower level version in your deck (it does not count towards your deck size or the number of copies of that card in your deck).
all_card.real_flavor:
"The magic is in my blood.
Coursing through my veins.
Pumping through my heart."
all_card.real_text:
As an additional cost to play a [[Spell]] event, you may take 1 damage. If you do, reduce the cost to play that event by 2, and you may shuffle that event back into your deck instead of discarding it.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may heal 1 damage.

all_card.name: 希波利尔传家宝
all_card.text:
艾格尼丝·贝克牌库专用。进阶。
只有来自玩家卡牌效果的伤害和/或恐惧能被分配到希波利尔传家宝。
[reaction]你打出一张[[法术]]卡牌后：抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:
Agnes Baker deck only. Advanced.
Only damage and/or horror from player card effects can be assigned to Heirloom of Hyperborea.
[reaction] After you play a [[Spell]] card: Draw 1 card.

all_card.name: 黑暗回忆
all_card.text: 进阶。 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致当前密谋推进。 强制 - 如果当你回合结束时，黑暗回忆在你手中：将其揭示并受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Advanced. Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. Forced - If Dark Memory is in your hand at the end of your turn, reveal it and take 2 horror.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为艾格尼丝·贝克控制的回忆数量+1。
[cultist]：-2。重整艾尔佩斯·博丹并结算其巡逻关键词，如果其与调查员交战，立刻攻击一次。
[tablet]：-5。如果你检定失败，且艾尔佩斯·博丹的所在地点有回忆，将该混乱标记放到其所在地点。
[elder_thing]：-8。艾格尼丝·贝克可以受到最多3点伤害，每受到1点，本次技能检定期间你获得+2技能值。
all_card.name: 血海深仇
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为艾格尼丝·贝克控制的回忆数量。
[cultist]：-2。重整艾尔佩斯·博丹并结算其巡逻关键词。
[tablet]：-3。如果你检定失败，且艾尔佩斯·博丹的所在地点有回忆，将该混乱标记放到其所在地点。
[elder_thing]：-6。艾格尼丝·贝克可以受到最多3点伤害，每受到1点，本次技能检定期间你获得+2技能值。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the number of memories Agnes Baker has collected.
[cultist]: -3. Ready Elspeth Baudin and resolve her patrol keyword. If she is engaged with an investigator, she makes an attack.
[tablet]: -5. If you fail and there is a memory at Elspeth Baudin's location, place this token on that location.
[elder_thing]: -8. Agnes Baker may take up to 3 damage to increase your skill value by 2 for each damage taken.

Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of memories Agnes Baker has collected.
[cultist]: -2. Ready Elspeth Baudin and resolve her patrol keyword.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail and there is a memory at Elspeth Baudin's location, place this token on that location.
[elder_thing]: -6. Agnes Baker may take up to 3 damage to increase your skill value by 2 for each damage taken.

all_card.back_flavor: 一道奥术能量的裂响撕裂长空，直扑你与你的同伴而来。刹那间，折磨变得难以承受。痛楚如毒液般在你血脉中分叉窜行，视野后方的一阵闪光令你目眩。紧接着，一切又戛然而止。但似乎缺了什么，有什么东西遗失了。她难道是在试图窃取你的记忆？
all_card.back_text:
艾尔佩斯·博丹依次攻击每位调查员，无论地点(即使其处于横置状态)。
将本密谋翻面。
all_card.name: 希波利尔之血
all_card.text: 强制 - 在敌军阶段结束时，如果艾尔佩斯·博丹处于重整状态且其所在地点有回忆：随机揭示一个混乱标记并将其放在该地点。 强制 - 如果一个没有回忆的地点上有混乱标记：将这些混乱标记放回混乱袋。 强制 - 如果一个地点上的混乱标记的修正值总和达到6或更多(忽略+/-号，[elder_sign]和[auto_fail]视为-6。)：将这些混乱标记放回混乱袋，艾尔佩斯·博丹收集该回忆。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A crackle of arcane power lashes throughout the sky, seeking out you and your companions. For a brief moment, the torment is unbearable. The pain forks through your body like poison in your veins. A flash of light in the back of your vision blinds you. Then, just as suddenly, it is over. But there is something missing. Something lost. Is she trying to steal your memories?
all_card.real_back_text: Elspeth Baudin attacks each investigator in player order, regardless of their current location (even if she is exhausted). Flip this agenda back over.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Elspeth Baudin is ready and there is a memory at her location: Reveal a random token from the chaos bag and place it on that location. Forced - If there are 1 or more chaos tokens on a location without a memory: Return them to the chaos bag. Forced - If there are chaos tokens on a location with a memory that have a combined value of 6 or more (ignoring +/- and treating each [auto_fail] and [elder_sign] as a -6): Return them to the chaos bag, and Elspeth Baudin collects that memory.

all_card.back_text:
如果艾格尼丝·贝克的回忆多于艾尔佩斯·博丹：
艾尔佩斯倒在你面前，痛苦在她体内奔窜。“动手啊，来个了结吧。”她齿间嘶嘶作响，沸腾的恨意凝成瞪视你的目光。奥术能量在你手中噼啪作响。她是你的敌人，你的战利品。她的生命，她的记忆，尽在你掌握之中。你应取回理应属于你的一切。
(→结局1)。
如果艾尔佩斯·博丹的回忆多于艾格尼丝·贝克：
你双膝跪地，被剧痛压倒。艾尔佩斯俯视着你，双手跃动着奥术能量的电弧。“你太软弱了，”她嘲弄道，“你配不上这份力量。但我……”她咧嘴一笑，“我会比你强得多。”
(→结局2)。
all_card.flavor: 你必须在艾尔佩斯之前收集到丢失的回忆！
all_card.name: 搜集回忆之路
all_card.text: [free]位于艾格尼丝·贝克所在地点的调查员共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索：艾格尼丝·贝克收集该地点的回忆。 强制 - 如果艾格尼丝·贝克被击败：(→结局2)。 目标 - 收集比艾尔佩斯更多的回忆。如果场上9个回忆全部被收集(被任意一方)，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If Agnes collected more memories than Elspeth:
Elspeth falls before you, pain coursing through her body. "Go on, then. Finish it," she hisses through her teeth, glaring up at you with seething hatred. Arcane power crackles in your hand. She is your enemy. Your conquest. Her life, her memories, they are in your hands. You should take what is rightfully yours.
(→R1)
If Elspeth collected more memories than Agnes:
You fall to your knees, overcome by pain. Elspeth looms over you, her hands crackling with arcane energy. "You are weak," she taunts. "You are not deserving of this power. But I..." she grins. "I will be so much better."
(→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: You must recover the lost memories of your previous life before Elspeth does!
all_card.real_text: [fast] Investigators at Agnes Baker's location spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Agnes Baker collects the memory at her location. Forced - If Agnes Baker is defeated, proceed to (→R2). Objective - Collect more memories than Elspeth. If all 9 memories have been collected (by either party), advance.

all_card.name: 艾尔佩斯·博丹
all_card.text: 警戒。巡逻(最近的有回忆的地点)。反击。 艾尔佩斯·博丹不能被自动躲避，其每收集一个回忆，获得-1攻击和-1躲避。 强制 - 如果艾尔佩斯·博丹将要被击败：改为治愈其所有伤害，然后将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。
all_card.traits: 类人. 法师. 精英
all_card.real_text: Alert. Patrol (nearest location with at least 1 memory). Retaliate. Elspeth Baudin cannot be automatically evaded and gets -1 fight and -1 evade for each memory she has collected. Forced - When Elspeth Baudin would be defeated: Instead, heal all damage from her, flip her over, and resolve the text on her other side.

all_card.flavor: 你的魔法与艾尔佩斯的力量在夜空中轰然对撞，迸发出刺目的光芒。一阵如异界警笛般尖啸的爆鸣——仿佛在召唤审判的降临——令你与艾尔佩斯双双跪倒在地。她痛苦地蜷缩着，指甲深深掐入太阳穴。你释放出自己的力量，攫住她的记忆，用尽全力拉扯剥离。
all_card.name: 凯旋与征服
all_card.text:
艾格尼丝·贝克必须决定(选择一项)：
- 艾格尼丝·贝克收集艾尔佩斯·博丹的1个回忆。
- 艾格尼丝·贝克从供应堆获得2[per_investigator]个线索。
然后将此牌翻面，处于横置且未交战状态。
all_card.real_flavor: Light crashes against the night sky as your magic and Elspeth's intersect. A blaring peal - like an otherworldly siren, calling for judgment - sends you and Elspeth both to your knees. She reels in pain, digging her nails into her temples. You reach out with your power, grasp at her memories, and pull with all your strength.
all_card.real_text:
Agnes Baker must decide (choose one):
- Agnes Baker collects 1 memory from Elspeth Baudin.
- Agnes Baker gains 2 [per_investigator] clues from the token bank.
Then, flip this card over, exhausted and unengaged.

all_card.back_flavor: 遵照流程和规则往往让罗兰感到放心。身为联邦探员，罗兰的手册在任何情况下都能派上用场，这真是令他宽慰。但最近，他的联邦探员手册在任务里完全派不上用场。无论多么努力，罗兰也找不到哪里提及了遭遇奇怪生物、时空之门，和魔法咒文的对策。要不是亲眼所见，他自己也绝不会相信……他的上峰也是绝不会明白的。罗兰知道，这次他可得靠自己了。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-3，[[洞察]]卡牌等级0-3，[[策略]]卡牌等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：罗兰的.38特制手枪、掩盖罪证、1张随机基础弱点。 额外经验值：剧本开始时你有额外5点经验值(这不影响你在单场冒险模式必须拿取的弱点数量)。
all_card.flavor: “如果我惹事生非，警长，那是因为已有是非。”
all_card.name: 罗兰·班克斯
all_card.text: 牌库构建时，选择3张不同的指令支援加入你的牌库。 [free]：将一张指令翻至反面(忽略其永久关键词)。(每场游戏仅限一次。) [elder_sign]效果：+2。选择一张指令支援。本轮你可以忽略其守则能力。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Roland had always taken comfort in procedure and rules. As an agent in the Bureau, he was relieved to have guidelines to follow in any given situation. But lately, his Federal Agent's Handbook had been entirely unhelpful given the cases he'd been assigned. Try as he might, Roland could find no mention of what to do when confronted with strange creatures, gates through time and space, or magic spells. If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, he would never have believed it... and there's no way his superiors would understand.

all_card.back_flavor:
“证据还不够，”你的上司斥责道，“抱歉，但这些材料在我看来太过牵强，难以取信。如果连我都无法相信，法庭更不会采信。说真的，邪教？活人献祭？”

你咬紧牙关，一掌拍在积攒成堆的文件与证据上。所有线索都在这儿了，你坚持道。
“已经几周了，你手里根本没有实质性的案件，只有一堆间接的胡说八道，”他搪塞着，“况且，格雷先生是本社区的支柱。你竟用这些指控来诋毁他……”他话音里那丝对你的轻蔑出卖了他。难道他收了格雷的好处？还是更糟？无论如何，继续争辩显然毫无意义。你深知此时不宜声张。若想在阿卡姆有所作为，就必须保持低调，按自己的方式行事。
all_card.back_text: 从胜利区移除一个[[异教徒]]敌人(如果可能，优先选择格雷先生)。 (→结局2)。
all_card.flavor: 你的上级正施压让你放弃调查。毫无疑问，这背后是格雷先生的影响力在作祟。与此同时，他和他的爪牙正用尽一切手段，企图悄无声息地将你从这场博弈中永久抹除。
all_card.name: 最后期限
all_card.text: 强制 - 当[[异教徒]]敌人将要被击败时：改为治愈其伤害直到剩余1点生命。 强制 - 如果罗兰·班克斯被击败：(→结局2)。 [action]：撤退。你不想错过最后期限，草草结案。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"It's not enough," your superior scolds you. "I'm sorry, but it's just too contrived for me to believe. And if I don't believe it, the courts won't, either. I mean, honestly. Cults? Human sacrifices?"
You grit your teeth and slam your hand down on the myriad documents and evidence you've collected. It's all there, you insist.
"It's been weeks and you don't have a real case here. Just a lot of circumstantial mumbo-jumbo," he deflects. "And besides, Mr. Grey is a cornerstone of this community. That you would disparage him with these accusations..." The hint of derision towards you in his voice gives him away. Is he on Grey's payroll? Or worse? Either way, it's clear arguing won't get you anywhere. You know better than to make a fuss. You'll have to keep your head down and do things your own way if you want to make a difference in Arkham.
all_card.real_back_text: Remove a [[Cultist]] enemy in the victory display from the game (Mr. Grey, if able). (→R1).
all_card.real_flavor: Your superiors are pressuring you to drop your investigation. Mr. Grey's influence, no doubt. Meanwhile, he and his lackies are doing everything in their power to quietly remove you from the equation, once and for all.

all_card.back_flavor:
格雷先生在牢房里来回踱步，隔着铁栏怒视着你。“你会后悔的，班克斯探员，”他嘶吼道，“等这事了结，你会跪下来求我宽恕。”
你礼貌地提醒格雷先生，威胁联邦探员是重罪。
“这世上还有比你这种人更可怕的东西值得畏惧。”他答道，随后颓然瘫倒在牢房角落，一副败溃之态。
真凶已锒铛入狱，但你仍不清楚他协助那些谋杀案共犯的真实目的。究竟是什么，能驱使一个人夺走如此多的生命？你尚不知晓——但你决心查明真相。
all_card.flavor: 要将献祭仪式背后的真凶绳之以法，唯有依靠证据，通过法庭的审判。你必须光明正大地完成这一切。

all_card.real_back_flavor:
Mr. Grey paces the length of his cell, glaring at you from behind the bars. "You're going to regret this, Agent Banks," he snarls. "You'll be begging for my mercy when this is over."
You politely remind Mr. Grey that threatening a federal agent is a felony.
"There are worse things to be afraid of than the likes of you," he replies, before slumping into the corner of his cell, defeated.
The true culprit is behind bars, but you still don't know what his real purpose was in aiding the conspirators behind the murders. What could possibly compel one to take the lives of so many? You don't know - but you intend to find out.
all_card.real_flavor: Taking down the culprits behind the sacrifices can only be done with proof, in a court of law. You'll have to do this fair and square.

If 10 [[Cultist]] enemies are in the victory display, advance.

all_card.real_back_flavor: The soloist haunts your steps, ever present and always playing that maddening song. You feel the musical notes take root in your mind, threatening to pull you out of the theatre and into another world, one you think you've visited before...
all_card.real_back_text:
Place 1 resource on the scenario reference card, as a measure. Then if there are 5 or more measures, each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
Otherwise, each investigator must test [willpower](3). Each investigator who fails takes 1 horror and sets aside 1 non-permanent, non-weakness asset they control. Then, shuffle each asset set aside by this effect into the Props deck. If all investigators fail this test, remove 1[per_investigator] damage from Sinister Soloist.
Place clues on each revealed location, up to its clue value.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Reset this agenda to agenda 1a.
all_card.real_flavor: The theatre is closed and quiet, as it has been since those days during the phantom production of The King in Yellow. As you take in your surroundings, you hear it again - the haunting violin. Someone is here, and they are keeping the memory of that production alive.

Automatically evade Sinister Soloist. Treat Sinister Soloist's text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]) for the remainder of the round.

all_card.real_back_flavor: The soloist crumples before you, collapsing to the floor in a puff of acrid, black smoke and glowing embers, reeking of rosin. Your skin burns and your eyes water, forcing you to turn away. Coughing and waving your arms to clear the air, the smoke eventually dissipates. The soloist is nowhere to be seen. The theatre is quiet once again, as is your mind. Whatever unresolved business this stage held seems to be finished now. You turn and head back to the lobby, ready to put the Ward Theatre behind you for good.
all_card.real_flavor: The soloist stands on stage, their gangly arms moving with mechanical precision as they play the violin. Their face is shrouded in shadow, but their song follows you throughout the theatre.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Investigators at the same [[Private]] location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Parley. Reveal the top 3 cards of the Props deck and choose an investigator to draw 1 of them. Shuffle the remaining cards together and place them on the bottom of the Props deck. Objective - When Sinister Soloist is in the victory display, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 每每灾祸来临，雷克斯·墨菲总是首当其冲。只要和雷克斯待上一天，哪怕是最坚定的无神论者都会坚信，这个男人一定是被诅咒了。每次一有好报道的苗头，事情就开始不对劲了。印斯茅斯的记录和照片一起都吹到了海里。在敦威治的时候，他刚要报警，路上的踪迹就被雨水冲得一干二净。这糟糕的运气已经不止一次让他直面可怕的野兽和密教的阴谋。为了活下去，雷克斯不得不拥有一颗好奇善问的心，让自己赶在下一场灾祸的前头。

all_card.real_back_flavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong, like that business in Innsmouth with the photographs that blew out to sea. His terrible fortune has more than once exposed him to gruesome beasts and occult conspiracies. To survive, Rex has developed an inquisitive mind, keeping one step ahead of the next disaster.

all_card.back_flavor: 你跟著輕柔的吟誦聲來到廢棄教堂附近的陰暗空地。空地的周圍長著一圈獨腳金，隨風輕輕搖曳。空地中央有一名披著斗篷的女子，跪在一個沒有標記的墳墓前，與其他的墓地相隔甚遠。你靜靜地觀察了幾分鐘，那個女人唱著一首古老陰鬱的旋律。它聽起來像是孩子的搖籃曲——舒緩，但又帶著一種格格不入的沉重黑暗。歌曲一結束，女子的斗篷就消融在薄霧中，接著她消失在一陣暗影的漩渦裡。
all_card.back_text:
如果是因为完成目标而推进：
“坚持住！” 让稳住身形说道。他双眼翻白，随即瘫倒在你怀中，浑身颤抖。四周的灵能似乎随之凝滞了。
将所有饥饿之魂置入胜利区，(→结局1)。
否则：
“太多了！”让尖叫着，双手捂住血流不止的双耳。一阵刺耳的哭号声席卷过狂风呼啸的山丘，回荡在你们逃离现场的途中。
彼端内每有一个异端者，吉姆·卡尔弗承受1点精神创伤(最少受到1点)。其余未离场的调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。(→结局2)。
all_card.flavor: 如果你帮助灵魂，它们也会帮助你。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Soft chanting guides you to a gloomy clearing near the abandoned chapel. A circle of witchweed surrounds the clearing, swaying gently in the breeze. At the center of the clearing, a cloaked woman kneels in front of an unmarked grave, far from the remainder of the graveyard. You watch in quiet for a few minutes while the woman sings an old, somber melody. It reminds you somewhat of a child's lullaby - soothing, but with a dark gravity that betrays its purpose. As soon as the song ends, the woman's cloak dissolves into mist, and she vanishes in a swirl of shadows.
all_card.real_back_text:
If this act advanced via its objective:
“Wait,” says Jean, steadying himself. His eyes roll back in his head and he collapses into your arms, shaking. The spiritual energy around you seems to still.
Find each Ravenous Spirit in play and place it in the victory display. (→R1)
Otherwise:
“It’s too much!” Jean screams as he holds his hands to his bleeding ears. A cacophanous cry echoes across the wind-swept hill as you both flee the scene.
Jim Culver suffers 1 mental trauma for each Heretic enemy still in The Beyond (to a minimum of 1 mental trauma). Each other investigator who was not eliminated is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. (→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: If you help these ghosts, they'll help you.

all_card.back_flavor: “灰堆”皮特一路流浪，晚上走到哪里就睡在哪里：田野间，火车上，运气好的话则是谷仓里。他身边睡着自己忠实的猎犬——杜克，另一边则是自己的旧吉他。皮特睡着的时候，有时会做梦。他梦到恶灵萦绕、饱受折磨的地方，梦到可怕的怪物。每每醒来之时，他知道有人需要帮助，因为他的梦境绝非虚假。他不知道自己凭着机智已经走了多久，但他确定只要有人需要帮助，任何地方都无法弗届。只要皮特还能对别人施以援手，他就会一直流浪下去。

all_card.real_back_flavor: At night, "Ashcan" Pete sleeps wherever his travels take him: in a field, on a train, or maybe, if he’s lucky, in a barn. He bunks with his loyal hound dog, Duke, on one side and his beat-up guitar on the other. And sometimes when Pete sleeps, he dreams. He dreams of haunted, tortured places and of horrible creatures. When he wakes up, he knows that someone needs his help, because his dreams are true. He could not say how long he has been on the road, living by his wits, but he can say for certain no place is too far to go to help someone in need. And as long as Pete can help people, he is not likely to stop wandering any time soon.

all_card.back_flavor: 珍妮·巴恩斯把自己的青春韶光都花在了追求物质享受、珍馐佳肴和新近时尚上。但自从她收到姐妹伊莎贝拉的来信之后，一切都变了。伊莎贝拉在信中坦露，神秘力量合起伙儿来对付她，她害怕自己就要沦入某种神秘力量的魔爪。这是珍妮从挚爱的姐妹那里收到的最后一封信。于是她回到了美国，追踪调查自己能发现的任何密教行迹。她已证明自己绝非温室里的花朵，一碰就枯，而是一位百发百中的神枪手，一位勇敢无畏、绝顶聪明、挺身面向未知的调查员。找不到伊莎贝拉失踪的原因，珍妮的搜寻就绝不停止。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Jenny Barnes has spent the majority of her young life in pursuit of creature comforts, fine dining, and the latest fashions. That all changed when she received a letter from her sister, Isabelle. In this letter, Isabelle confessed that mysterious forces were aligning against her and that she feared she may fall victim to some paranormal threat. It was the last letter Jenny received from her beloved sister. Jenny has since returned to the States to track down and investigate all occult occurrences she can find. Hardly a wilting flower, she has proven herself a crack shot as well as a fearless and clever investigator of the unknown. Until Isabelle's disappearance is explained, Jenny will never relent in her search.

all_card.back_flavor: 在六岁那一晚，佐伊听到了上帝对她说话，她由此得知自己与众不同……就是在那一晚，大火夺走了她的父母。上帝告诉佐伊，已经在茫茫众生之中选中了她作为自己的使徒。她将保护无辜、惩处奸恶。自那以后，每次她身陷困局，主都会及时出现，指引她、抚慰她。佐伊现在穿行于各个城市之间，以主厨为业。不上班的时候，她就遵循主的声音，穿行于暗夜。只要发现奸恶，她必予以痛击，毫不心软，亦无犹豫。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Zoey had known that she was special ever since God spoke to her one night when she was six years old... the night that terrible fire took away her parents. He told her that He had chosen her from among all the people of the world to be His agent. She would protect the innocent and punish the wicked. Since then, He comes to her in times of trouble, offering guidance and comfort. Zoey now travels from city to city, taking work as a chef to support herself. When she isn’t working, she stalks the night, guided by the Lord’s voice. Wherever she finds wickedness, she strikes it down without remorse or hesitation.

all_card.back_flavor: 黛西是米斯卡塔尼克大学里受人尊敬的图书馆员，她一直都觉得自己生命里最重要的就是书。恐怖、暴力、惊俱，这些日常生活中嫌恶的东西，她在书里倒是看得津津有味。她随即一头陷进了约翰·迪伊翻译的《死灵之书》。这是亵渎、污秽，毛骨悚然、难以置信。但根据自己对神秘事物和密教主题的研究，黛西知道，这本书里事实大于虚构。她开始好奇，在奥恩图书馆的限制区里，还藏着什么其他秘密……

all_card.real_back_flavor: As a respected librarian at Miskatonic University, Daisy had always felt that books were the most important thing in her life. She explored in fiction what she abhorred in life: horror, violence, fear. Then, she stumbled across the John Dee translation of the Necronomicon. It was blasphemous, unholy, and too awful to be read. But given her studies in obscure and occult subjects, Daisy knew there was more truth than fiction within the book's pages. She began to wonder what other secrets the restricted collection of the Orne Library held...

all_card.text: 进阶。 显现 - 将死灵之书放置入场，放到你的威胁区域，带有3点恐惧。死灵之书上有恐惧时不能离场。其在场时，将你揭示的混乱标记上的每个[elder_sign]视为[cultist]、[tablet]和[elder_thing](结算所有三个标记)。 [action]：将死灵之书的1点恐惧移动到黛西·沃克上。然后，如果死灵之书没有恐惧，将其弃掉。
all_card.real_text: Advanced. Revelation - Put this card into play in your threat area, with 3 horror on it. It cannot leave play while it has 1 or more horror on it. While it is in play, treat each [elder_sign] you reveal on a chaos token as a [cultist], [tablet], and [elder_thing] (resolve all three). [action]: Move 1 horror from this card to Daisy Walker. Then, if The Necronomicon has no horror on it, discard it.

all_card.back_text:

all_card.back_flavor: 一股巨大的旋风伴随着雷鸣般的声音从《死灵之书》中迸发，将书页的龙卷抛向天空。一道不祥的阴影笼罩了整个校园，随即在随之而来的风暴中遁逃。当一切平息后，那本魔法书哐当一声掉落在地，能量尽失。它先前所蕴含的存在如今已荡然无存。在你手中，它只余一片空洞。
all_card.flavor: 无论何种实体已从《死灵之书》中被释放，它都如致命的阴影般在校园中蔓延。你必须在它变得过于强大而无法遏制之前，将其阻止。
all_card.name: 凡人求索
all_card.text:
亨利·阿米蒂奇博士不占用盟友槽位并获得“ 你拥有额外2个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[书籍]]支援。”
“爵士”马利根获得：“[action]：移动到最多3个距离以内的[[米斯卡塔尼克]]地点。”
all_card.real_back_flavor: A tremendous whirlwind and a thunderous voice erupts from the Necronomicon, sending a tornado of pages into the sky. A sinister shadow looms over the entire campus, then escapes through the ensuing tempest. When it is done, the grimoire clatters to the floor, devoid of energy. Whatever presence it held before is now gone. It feels somehow empty in your hands.
all_card.real_flavor: Whatever entity has been unleashed from within the Necronomicon, it is spreading across the campus like a deadly shadow. You must put a stop to it before it grows too powerful to be contained.
all_card.real_text:
Dr. Henry Armitage does not take up an ally slot and gains: "You have 2 additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Tome]] assets."
"Jazz" Mulligan gains: "[action]: Move to a [[Miskatonic]] location up to 3 connections away."

all_card.back_flavor: 你站在奥恩图书馆的禁区内，四周环绕着成卷古老而离经叛道的典籍。你所寻得的咒文或许足以驱散那个实体——亦或将其重新封印回它诞生的《死灵之书》中。你的声音随着咒文的重复逐渐升至顶点。阴影在房间里蔓延爬行，墙壁与天花板开始扭曲。书页在暴烈的狂风中翻飞，你每一根发丝都被卷入空中。万物都在随之而来的混沌中被席卷而去，宛若一支湿润的画笔亲吻着现实的画布。
all_card.flavor: 写了封印这东西的方法的书籍肯定散落在校园四周……
all_card.name: 快速阅读
all_card.text: 忽略所有地点上的目标。 [free]如果你是黛西·沃克，你所在地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将此地点下方的一张玩家卡洗入你的牌库。 目标 - 在一切都太迟了之前驱除死书之灵！
all_card.real_back_flavor: You stand in the restricted section of the Orne Library, surrounded by volumes of ancient, heretical texts. The incantations you have found may prove to be enough to dispel the entity - or perhaps bind it back within the Necronomicon from whence it came. Your voice rises to a crescendo as you repeat the words. Shadows crawl across the room. The walls and ceiling bend. Pages flutter in the tempestuous gale. Every fiber of your hair is whisked into the air. All is swept away in the ensuing chaos, like a wet paintbrush kissing the canvas of reality.
all_card.real_flavor: The way to seal this being away must be recorded in one of the many tomes around campus...
all_card.real_text: Ignore all Objectives on locations. [fast] If you are Daisy Walker, investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Shuffle 1 facedown player card beneath this location into your deck. Objective - Find a way to banish the Namer of the Dead before it is too late.

all_card.name: 死书之灵
all_card.text: 猎手。 猎物 - 仅限黛西·沃克。 强制 - 如果死书之灵将要被击败：改为治愈其所有伤害，将其横置并移动到奥恩图书馆。 [action]如果你是黛西·沃克且你控制了至少4本非弱点[[书籍]]支援：谈判。检定[willpower](18)。你每控制一本非弱点[[书籍]]支援，本次检定难度降低2。如果你成功，推进场景。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 灵怪. 精英
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Prey - Daisy Walker only. Forced - When Namer of the Dead would be defeated: Instead, fully heal it, exhaust it, and move it to Orne Library. [action] If you are Daisy Walker and you control at least 4 non-weakness [[Tome]] assets: Parley. Test [willpower] (18). This test gets -2 difficulty for each [[Tome]] asset you control. If you succeed, advance the act.

all_card.back_flavor: 年轻的杰克跟随他父亲一起考古探险，环游世界。而如今他已是遍历全球的寻宝猎人，同时也是一个出色的考古学家，“蒙特雷”跟随他父亲的脚步，保护者古代文明和失落文化的宝藏。但当蒙特雷发现了一个带有熟悉符号的银色吊坠后，他决定去探索自己的过去。很多年前，他的父亲被杀害了，额头带有同样的符号。自此之后，那个画面一直出现在蒙特雷的梦境里。他已经快接近真相了。在找出杀害他父亲的凶手前，他是不会停下脚步的……无论付出多少代价。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡片张数：30。 牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-3，[[守护]]和[[遗物]]卡牌等级0-4，中立卡牌等级0-5，其他探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0最多5张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：可靠的长鞭、被埋葬的秘密、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “你管这个叫考古？”
all_card.name: 蒙特雷·杰克
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你发现你所在地点的最后一个线索后：查找你牌库顶的X张卡牌，找出一张[[守护]]或[[遗物]]支援并将其打出，其费用减少X点。X为你所在地点的印刷隐藏值。混洗你的牌库。(每轮仅限一次。)
    [elder_sign]效果：+1。你每控制一张[[守护]]支援和一张[[遗物]]支援，获得1资源。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Young Jack traveled the world with his father’s archaeological expeditions. Now a globe-trotting treasure hunter and an accomplished archaeologist in his own right, “Monterey” follows in his father’s footsteps, securing the treasures of ancient civilizations and lost cultures. But after discovering a silver pendant with a familiar symbol on it, Monterey must explore his own past. Years ago, his father was found murdered with the very same sigil carved onto his forehead. The image has haunted Monterey’s dreams ever since. But he’s getting close. He won’t stop until he solves the mystery of his father’s murder... no matter what it takes.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-3, [[Charm]] and [[Relic]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Trusty Bullwhip, Buried Secrets, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "You call this archaeology?"
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] After you discover the last clue at your location: Search the top X cards of your deck for a [[Charm]] or [[Relic]] asset and play it, reducing its cost by X. X is the printed shroud of your location. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Gain 1 resource for each [[Charm]] asset and each [[Relic]] asset you control.

all_card.name: 可靠的长鞭
all_card.text: 快速。雷蒙特·杰克牌库专用。进阶。 [action]：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[agility]。本次攻击你得到+2技能值。如果本次攻击成功，你可以横置可靠的长鞭，以使本次攻击造成+1伤害并自动躲避受到攻击的敌人。
all_card.real_text: Fast. Monterey Jack deck only. Advanced. [action]: Fight. This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]. You get +2 skill value for this attack. If this attack succeeds, you may exhaust Trusty Bullwhip to deal +1 damage for this attack and automatically evade the attacked enemy.

all_card.name: 被埋葬的秘密
all_card.text: 进阶。 显现 - 将被埋葬的秘密放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 如果你所在的地点能够被调查，除冒险卡牌效果外，你不能移动。 [action][action]：调查。如果你成功，不发现线索，改为弃掉被埋葬的秘密。
all_card.real_text: Advanced. Revelation - Put Buried Secrets into play in your threat area. If your location can be investigated, you cannot move except by scenario card effects. [action][action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, discard Buried Secrets.

困难/专家

all_card.flavor: You've made your way to the Eztli ruins in search of ancient artifacts.
all_card.name: 别的东西苏醒了……
all_card.text: *本密谋得到+1[per_investigator]毁灭阈值。 强制 - 本密谋推进时：不要从场上的地点移除毁灭标记。 强制 - 一位调查员被击败时：该调查员将其控制的每个[[古代]]剧情支援混洗入探索牌库。
all_card.real_flavor: You've made your way to the Eztli ruins in search of ancient artifacts.
all_card.real_text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from locations in play. Forced - When an investigator is defeated: That investigator shuffles each [[Ancient]] story asset they control into the exploration deck.

all_card.name: 坑洞原住民
all_card.text: 猎手。反击。生成 - 与蒙特雷·杰克交战。 坑洞居住者获得+1[per_investigator]生命，且胜利区每有1点复仇，获得+1攻击(最多+3攻击)。 强制 - 当坑洞居住者对你造成伤害时，检查你的补给品：如果你未带有挎包，将你控制的每个[[古代]]支援洗入探索牌库。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Spawn - Engaged with Monterey Jack. Dweller in the Pit gets +1 [per_investigator] health and +1 fight for each vengeance point in the victory display (max +3 fight). Forced - After Dweller in the Pit deals damage to you, check your supplies: If you do not have the satchel, shuffle each [[Ancient]] asset you control into the exploration deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 持续的嘶嘶声在遗迹中回荡。蛇群与类人的蛇形生物向你围拢，呲着毒牙，高举利刃。深入这片遗迹已被证明过于危险，无法继续。你将仅有的几件找回的器物掷向追兵，转身朝来路逃去。至少，你以为那是来时的方向……
all_card.back_text: 每位未离场的调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 隧道的黑暗中，那生物拖着爬行类般的嘶嘶声笨重地向前逼近。
all_card.name: 遗物守卫
all_card.text: *本密谋得到+1[per_investigator]毁灭阀值。 强制 - 当调查员被击败时：将其控制的每个[[古代]]支援洗入探索牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The constant hissing echoes throughout the ruin. Snakes and serpentine humanoids close in on you, fangs beared and blades raised. Delving into these ruins has proved too dangerous to continue. You throw what few objects you had recovered at your pursuers, and then turn to flee back the way you came. At least, you think it was the way you came...
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator who has not been eliminated is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: From the darkness of the tunnel before you, the creature lumbers forward with a reptilian hiss.
all_card.real_text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When an investigator is defeated: That investigator shuffles each [[Ancient]] story asset they control into the exploration deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 你谨慎地踏入内室——一个已被封存不知多少岁月的房间。正当你环视铺满地板与墙壁的各种标记时，身后传来石头摩擦的声响。你猛转过身，只见秘道正在滑闭。随着一声闷响，它彻底合拢，只留下一面无痕的墙壁。你被困住了！
all_card.back_text:
将所有未交战的[[精英]]敌人移动到内部密室。
将以下卡牌洗入探索牌库：每张[[古代]]故事支援，放在一边的复仇往昔诡计，每张场上的单面地点，以及数量与胜利区复仇点数量相等的伊格之子(最多3张)。
在所有地点上放置1[per_investigator]个线索(不超过其线索上限)。
all_card.flavor: 你穿行在遗迹狭窄的廊道中，感到脚下传来深沉的震动。
all_card.name: 崩塌的遗迹
all_card.text: [action]如果你所在地点没有线索：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。 目标 - 如果每位调查员均位于内部密室，则可以共同花费所需的线索推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You cautiously step into the inner chamber, a room that has been sealed away for untold ages. As you look around at the various markings covering the floor and walls, you hear the grinding of stone on stone behind you. You wheel about to see the secret passage sliding closed. With a resounding thud, it slams shut, leaving only an unmarked wall in its place. You’re trapped!
all_card.real_back_text:
Move each unengaged [[Elite]] enemy directly to Inner Chamber.
Shuffle each of the following cards into the exploration deck: Each of the set-aside [[Ancient]] story assets, the set-aside Vengeant Past treachery, each single-sided location in play, and 1 copy of the set-aside Brood of Yig enemy for each vengeance point in the victory display.
Place 1 [per_investigator] clues on each revealed location (up to a maximum of its clue threshold).
all_card.real_flavor: As you traverse the tight corridors of the ruin, you feel a deep rumbling beneath your feet.
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - When each surviving investigator is at Inner Chamber, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 终于，你找到了一条可以将那些黑暗和怪物留在身后的出路。
all_card.name: 逃出生天
all_card.text: [action]如果你所在地点没有线索：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。 目标 - 带上尽可能多的[[古代]]遗物！如果每位存活的调查员都撤退，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: At long last, you have found your way back to the entrance of the tomb and have left the creatures in the darkness behind you.
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Get out with as many [[Ancient]] relics as you can! If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.name: 秘密通道
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果秘密通道与你的所在地点相连，则将本卡牌和放在一旁的内部密室放置入场。否则将此牌洗回探索牌库。 [reaction]当你进入秘密通道时，检查你的补给品：如果你带有指南针，发现秘密通道的1个线索。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If Secret Passage is connected to your location, put it and the set-aside Inner Chamber into play. Otherwise, shuffle it into the exploration deck. Forced - After you enter Secret Passage: Check your supplies. If you have the compass, discover 1 clue from Secret Passage.

all_card.back_flavor: 这间中央密室的雕花地板泛着诡异的微光，墙壁与地面遍布着昔日激烈打斗留下的划痕与凹坑。
all_card.name: 内部密室
all_card.text: [action]花费X个线索：揭示探索牌库顶的X张牌。抽取其中一张非地点卡牌然后检查你的补给品：如果你带有粉笔，则可以再抽取一张非地点卡牌。将其余卡牌洗回探索牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The floor of this central chamber is intricately carved and glows strangely. The walls and floor are scuffed with signs of some past struggle.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend X clues: Reveal the top X cards of the exploration deck. Draw 1 non-location card revealed in this way and check your supplies. If you have chalk, you may choose 1 additional non-location card revealed and draw it. Shuffle the remaining cards into the exploration deck.

all_card.flavor: 摇摇欲坠的走廊如同在激你往更深处探索……
all_card.name: 古代石厅
all_card.text: 强制 - 当毁灭标记被放置在古代石厅上时：将遭遇牌库顶的牌洗入探索牌库。位于该地点的调查员可以花费3资源来取消该效果。
all_card.real_flavor: The crumbling hall dares you to venture deeper.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After doom is placed on Ancient Hall: Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the exploration deck. Any investigator at Ancient Hall may spend 3 resources to cancel this effect.

all_card.name: 翡翠鳄鱼
all_card.text: 显现 - 将玉石鳄鱼置于你的控制之下。然后你必须受到2点伤害或在你的所在地点放置1个毁灭标记。 强制 -当你撤退时：将玉石鳄鱼加入胜利区。

all_card.back_flavor: 温蒂还小的时候，妈妈常让她玩自己的项链。妈妈会讲她的故事，温蒂则转着项链，看它闪闪发光。然后，话就说到爸爸在海上失踪，妈妈也开始行为古怪，在房子里用粉笔画满了反常的符号。妈妈被带到了疯人院，温蒂则去了孤儿院。但妈妈在被带走前，把项链留给了温蒂，说是能“保护她”。温蒂在孤儿院里待了几年，然后溜了出来，她决定能靠自己活得更好。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Mama used to let Wendy play with her necklace when she was small. Mama would tell her stories, and Wendy would spin the necklace and watch as it glittered. Then, word came that her father had been lost at sea, and Mama started acting strange, drawing unusual symbols in chalk all over the house. They took Mama to the asylum, and Wendy went to the orphanage. Before they took her away, Mama gave her the necklace, to "protect her." Wendy stayed in the orphanage for several years before running away, deciding that she could take better care of herself on her own.

all_card.back_flavor: 你早已习惯被人拒绝和排斥，但不知为何，此地的居民对你刨根问底的抵触情绪远超预期。最后与你交谈的那人浑身鱼腥味，皮肤苍白病态，脖颈上还有诡异的隆起褶皱。紧接着，你发现自己无论走到哪儿都被尾随，而那群跟踪者看来绝非善类。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的愤怒暴民以横置状态生成在印斯茅斯广场。
在场上所有[[嫌犯]]和[[窝点]]卡牌上各放置1[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.flavor: 你刚一来到印斯茅斯，就立刻开始询问当地人，寻找你爸爸的踪迹，又或者这个照片的所在地点，亦或是这个落下照片的德比帽男人。
all_card.name: 新来的女孩
all_card.text: 强制 - 在本密谋将因达到毁灭阈值而推进时：改为移除场上所有毁灭标记并将随机一张放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人洗入迹象牌堆。然后如果没有[[怪物]]敌人被放在一边，推进密谋。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You’re used to people turning you down and pushing you away, but for some reason, the locals here are even more upset at your prying questions than you could have expected. The last person you speak to is a man who reeks of fish, with pale, sickly skin and strange ridges across his neck. Next thing you know, you are being followed everywhere you go, and the lot of them don’t look all too friendly.
all_card.real_back_text:
Spawn the set-aside Angry Mob enemy at Innsmouth Square, exhausted.
Place 1 [per_investigator] clues on each [[Suspect]] enemy and [[Hideout]] location in play.
all_card.real_flavor: You arrive in Innsmouth and immediately set to work asking the townspeople if they’ve seen your Dad, the place in the photograph, or the man in the derby who dropped off the photo.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When this agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold: Instead, remove all doom in play and shuffle a random set-aside [[Monster]] enemy into the [[Leads]] deck. Then, if there are no set-aside [[Monster]] enemies, advance to agenda 1b.

all_card.back_flavor: 你躲在一堆散发酸臭的垃圾后面，听着搜寻你的暴民们沉重而不懈的脚步声在四周擂响。你不明白他们为何追捕你——你不过问了些问题！——但显然此地已不可久留。在阿卡姆，像你这样的街头流浪儿根本无人注目。此刻，你忽然但愿这里也是如此。
all_card.flavor: 你逗留得越久，追问得越多，危险就越是如影随形。当地人对你投来愤怒与猜疑的目光，更糟糕的是：长着翅膀的怪异生物在屋顶徘徊，伺机寻找猎物……
all_card.name: 线索渐消
all_card.text:
愤怒暴民不能被击败。
[reaction]当温蒂·亚当斯躲避愤怒暴民后：其发现该敌人所在地点的1个线索。
所有[[嫌犯]]敌人失去冷漠，且入场时额外带有1[per_investigator]个线索。
所有[[窝点]]地点获得+1[per_investigator]个线索数量。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You hide behind a sour-smelling pile of trash and wait for the pounding of heavy steps as the mob searches relentlessly for you. You don’t know why they’re after you—you were only asking questions!—but it’s clear you can’t stay here any longer. In Arkham, everyone’s gaze passes right over street urchins like you. Suddenly, you wish that were the case here, too.
all_card.real_flavor: The longer you stick around and the more questions you ask, the more danger seeks you out. The locals eye you with anger and suspicion, and worse: strange winged creatures prowl about the rooftops, searching for prey...
all_card.real_text:
Angry Mob cannot be defeated.
[reaction] After Wendy Adams evades Angry Mob: She may discover 1 clue from its location.
Each [[Suspect]] enemy loses aloof and enters play with +1 [per_investigator] clues.
Each [[Hideout]] location gets +1 [per_investigator] clue value.

all_card.back_flavor:
没用的。爸爸或许确实来过印斯茅斯，可他早就离开了。而镇民们似乎对任何打听他消息的人都充满敌意。他们可能知道些什么却不愿透露，也可能只是在守护其他不相干的秘密。无论如何，继续留在这里已经不安全了。

但就在你准备放弃、动身返回巴士站赶回阿卡姆时，你瞥见了一个穿着熟悉装束的男人：一件长羊毛外套，头戴一顶棕色德比帽。
all_card.flavor: 说这个地方比阿卡姆不友善，还是太高看它了。
all_card.name: 寻找爸爸
all_card.text: 除非使用神秘相片，否则[[嫌犯]]和[[窝点]]卡牌不能进入胜利区。 强制 - 如果场上没有[[嫌犯]]或[[窝点]]卡牌：温蒂·亚当斯必须依次抽取迹象牌库顶的卡牌，直到抽取了一张[[嫌犯]]或[[窝点]]卡牌。 目标 - 使用神秘相片将卡牌置入胜利区。迹象牌库剩余的卡牌越少越好，如果它为空，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
It’s no use. Maybe Dad was in Innsmouth at some point, but he’s long gone now. And the townsfolk here don’t seem too keen on anybody asking about him. Might be they know more than they’re letting on, or it might just be they’re protecting other, unrelated secrets. Either way, it’s no longer safe to stick around.
But just as you are ready to give up and head back to the bus stop to return to Arkham, you spot a man in a familiar outfit: a long wool coat and a brown derby.
all_card.real_flavor: To say that this town is less friendly than even Arkham would be an understatement.
