Objective – Search for Dad using Mysterious Photo. The fewer cards that remain in the Leads deck, the better. If it is empty, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 安德烈13岁的时候，父母讨到了足够的钱给他买一张区巴黎中心剧院的电影票。这种艺术形式折服了安德烈，他很快醉心于银幕，不知疲倦地工作，就为实现自己的好莱坞梦。就在好莱坞拍摄《宇宙之旅》的时候，安德烈经历了无法解释、天翻地覆的事情。现实和幻想的界限已在他脑海中模糊。这时候同行朋友贝琪·巴克斯特建议他换换环境。在贝琪的推荐下，安德烈收拾行装，搬到了马萨诸塞州的小镇阿卡姆。他太需要休息了。

all_card.flavor: “全世界都是我的舞台。”

all_card.real_back_flavor: When André turned 13, his parents scrounged up just enough money to buy him a ticket to the Central Paris Theatre. Enamored by the art form, André quickly became obsessed with the silver screen, working tirelessly to act his way to Hollywood. There, while filming A Cosmic Journey, he experienced inexplicable and world-altering happenings. As the lines between reality and fantasy began to blur in his mind, his peer and friend, Betsy Baxter, suggested a change of scenery. At her recommendation, André packed up and moved to the small town of Arkham, Massachusetts for a much-needed break.

all_card.back_flavor: 卡洛琳·弗恩多年来一直倾听病人描绘梦境，其中有一些栩栩如生，就像真实的记忆。但她没想到自己有朝一日也会有这种体验。梦境中有地表之下的黑暗洞窟，阴影中爬行的古怪生物，还有千丝万缕闪闪发亮的蛛网。是意识在让她回想起过去见证的往昔吗?还是她去过的地方?或者，是在警告她有危险的、异界的，甚至灾祸的事情就要降临?

all_card.real_back_flavor: Carolyn Fern has listened to her patients share their dreams for years, many so vivid they seem like actual memories. But she never expected to experience such things herself. Visions of dark caves deep beneath the surface of the world, of alien creatures creeping in the shadows, and of thousands of strands of glistening spiderwebs. Is her mind trying to remind her of something she witnessed in her past? A place she went? Or is it trying to warn her of something dangerous, something otherworldly, or even something catastrophic still to come?
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Experimental Psychology, Unbroken Web, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "Our dreams are a window into the hidden truths of not just our minds, but of the universe."

all_card.back_flavor: 沃尔特斯教授本来热衷于神秘与晦涩的事物，但是在多年之后他发现，自己积累的关于古语言、亵渎古物和怪异仪式的知识，对于解决当代危机至关重要。他既是一位狂热收藏家，热衷于收集史前曾出现的东西；他又是一口知识的源泉，了解那些最初的、崇拜上亿年前的恐怖神明的宗教。任然在世并且没有陷入疯狂的人当中，没有谁能比哈维更了解神秘事物。当有超自然事件发生，沃尔特斯教授就会用他大量的资源和经验来担起责任。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡片张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：知识宝库、该死的好奇心、1张随机基础弱点。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Professor Walters began as a devotee of the archaic and obscure, but over the years he has discovered that his knowledge of ancient languages, profane relics, and strange rituals is vital to addressing dangers in the modern day. He is both an avid collector of prehistoric ephemera and a fount of knowledge regarding the bizarre primordial religions that worshipped nightmarish gods eons ago. There is perhaps no sane person alive who knows more about the occult than Harvey. When a supernatural event occurs, Professor Walters brings his considerable resources and experience to bear.

all_card.flavor: 无知是福，但你无福消受。

all_card.real_flavor: Ignorance is a bliss you cannot afford.
all_card.real_text: Draw 1 card. Shuffle any number of non-weakness cards from your hand into your deck. Then, draw that many cards.

all_card.text:

all_card.real_text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[action] Spend 1 secret: Choose a revealed location up to 3 connections away from your location. Move to that location.

all_card.text:
你控制[[书籍]][或[[遗物]]支援时，你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。

all_card.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克
all_card.real_text:
While you control a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset, you get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].

获得3资源(如果你手牌中有至少10张其他卡牌，改为4资源)。
[reaction]在你于自己回合抽取神秘笔迹后：将其打出。
all_card.real_flavor: "...these are few as compared with those in the languages I cannot understand." - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Statement of Randolph Carter"
all_card.real_text:
Gain 3 resources (4 resources instead if you have 10 or more other cards in hand).
[reaction] After you draw Cryptic Writings during your turn: Play it.

好吧，那我们还在等什么？”

Fast. Play during your turn.
Until the end of the round, add your [intellect] to your [combat] and [agility]. Draw 1 card.

all_card.flavor:
有人不惜一切代价也要知道真相。
但有些真相比利刃更伤人。

all_card.real_flavor: Some people need to know the truth at any cost. Some truths can cut like knives.

all_card.flavor: 终于，我找到了！

每次技能检定最多投入1张。

Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card (2 cards instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).

研究完成。
[action][action][action][action]横置禁忌之书：将你所在地点的一张玩家卡上的1点伤害移动到你所在地点的一个敌人上。你每有4张手牌，本能力费用减1行动(最低减至[action])。

Researched.

all_card.flavor: 超越时间的任何一刻。超越空间的任何一隅。超越现实的曲折蜿蜒。

all_card.real_text: Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. You have 2 additional ally slots, which can only be used to hold [[Miskatonic]] assets. Forced - When you take damage or horror: No more than 1 of that damage/horror can be assigned to a [[Miskatonic]] asset.

all_card.name: 死灵之书
all_card.subname: 波得鲁斯·德·达西亚译本
all_card.text:
使用(6资源)。每套牌库仅限1张。
[free]花费1秘密：你本次技能检定的技能值+2。
[free]花费2秘密：抽取2张卡牌。
[free]花费3秘密：发现任意地点的1个线索。
[free]花费4秘密：对与你交战的一个敌人造成3点伤害。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (6 secrets). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast] Spend 1 secret: You get +2 skill value for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 2 secrets: Draw 2 cards.
[fast] Spend 3 secrets: Discover 1 clue at any location.
[fast] Spend 4 secrets: Deal 3 damage to an enemy engaged with you.

all_card.back_flavor: 鲜血。火焰。毁灭。每个晚上，杰奎琳的梦里总是充满了还未发生的情景。一开始，她认为这些梦是一种可怕的诅咒。但是，当她开始控制自己的灵视,仔细观察梦中的事件时,她现在明白这不是诅咒，而是一种召唤。世界将会陷入长达千年、难以言名的混沌，而这预兆只有她一个人得知。她梦境的预示从未出错，但不能让这夜夜萦绕的噩梦成为现实。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡片张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：命运决定者、黑暗未来、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “未来是可以改写的。”
all_card.name: 杰奎琳·法恩
all_card.text:
[reaction]在你所在地点的一位调查员将要揭示任意数量的混乱标记时：额外揭示2个标记。从揭示的标记选择并取消2个非[auto_fail]标记，或者取消1个[auto_fail]标记。(每轮仅限一次。)
    [elder_sign]效果：+1。如果本效果被取消或忽略，抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Blood. Fire. Destruction. Every night, Jacqueline's dreams are filled with things that have not yet come to pass. At first, she thought of these dreams as a terrible curse. However, as she began to control her visions and observe the events within in greater detail, she now understands they are no curse, but a calling. The world is about to be plunged into a thousand years of indescribable chaos, and only she knows the warning signs. Her dreams have never been wrong, but she cannot let the nightmares that haunt them become a reality.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Arbiter of Fates, Dark Future, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: "The future can be rewritten."
all_card.real_text:
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would reveal any number of chaos tokens: Reveal 2 additional tokens. Of the revealed tokens, choose and cancel 2 non-[auto_fail] tokens, or 1 [auto_fail] token. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If this effect is canceled or ignored, draw 1 card.

all_card.flavor: 我能看见命运之线，知道它们何时会断裂。

Jacqueline Fine deck only.

Forced - At the end of your turn: Reveal 5 random tokens from the chaos bag. If an [elder_sign] symbol is revealed, discard Dark Future.

all_card.name: 虚无主义
all_card.text: 显现 - 将虚无主义放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 在你揭示、取消或忽略一个[auto_fail]标记后：受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。 [action][action]:弃掉虚无主义。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Nihilism into play in your threat area. Forced - After you reveal, cancel, or ignore an [auto_fail] token: Take 1 damage and 1 horror. [action][action]: Discard Nihilism.

all_card.flavor: 蜡滴奇光，火舞如生。

all_card.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the evaded enemy. If an [elder_sign], "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 1 resource.

all_card.flavor: “汝全然不配，但从现在开始，吾将侍奉汝。”

all_card.text: 你拥有额外1个法术槽位，只可以用来携带[[法术]]支援。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 生物. 召唤
all_card.real_flavor: "Thou art wholly unworthy. But I shall serve thee for now."
all_card.real_text: You have 1 additional arcane slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Spell]] asset.

all_card.text:
你得到+1[willpower]。

all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [willpower].

all_card.flavor: 黑暗是身外的深渊，光明是内心的深渊。

all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you play a [[Spell]] card, exhaust Robes of Endless Night: Reduce the cost of that card by 1.

all_card.flavor:
跨维度的旅行存在着风险，这他很清楚。
但谁能抗拒那超越时空的疆域呢？
all_card.name: 星界旅行

all_card.name: 催眠术

快速。在一个敌人攻击你所在地点的一位调查员时打出。
取消该次攻击。然后，从混乱袋随机揭示一个标记。如果该标记有[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，对该敌人造成其自身的伤害。

all_card.real_flavor: The secrets were written in the stars.

all_card.back_flavor: 玛丽发现祖母黑暗污秽的血魔法传承之后，她尽了最大的努力去无视。还是在阿卡姆烟雾缭绕的酒吧、人挤人的俱乐部里唱歌更简单，也安全得多。但现在大环境不好啊。顾客越来越少，老主顾脾气也越来越坏，于是玛丽开始接受祖母的力量，控制观众，让吵闹的闭嘴，诱使有钱的慷慨解囊。这份危险的力量她越用越频繁，甚至觉得没有就不行。这股新发现的力量想必不会有什么代价吧。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入牌库卡牌张数)：[祖母的护符]、[故土呼召]、1张随机基础弱点。

all_card.text:

[elder_sign]效果：+0。如果你检定成功，治愈1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When Marie discovered her Grand-Mère's dark and sordid legacy of blood magic, she did her best to ignore it. It was much easier to just sing in the smoky lounges and packed nightclubs of Arkham, and far less dangerous. But then times got tough. As crowds thinned and patrons grew surly, Marie found herself embracing her Grand-Mère's powers to sway her audience, quieting the rowdy ones and enticing the wealthier amongst them to open their wallets. Relying on her dangerous powers increasingly often, Marie felt they were becoming a necessary tool to get through the day. Surely there would be no cost for this newfound power... right?
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Grand-Mère's Charm, Called to Guinée, 1 random basic weakness.

all_card.back_flavor: 米格尔完全没想到自己会理一片牧场。离开了故土阿根廷之后，他不知疲倦地工作，就为了攒钱把丈夫吉列尔莫和女儿阿多尼亚也接来阿卡姆。只是他的工作有了麻烦。晚上有东西在猎杀牲畜，只留下了残尸。更奇怪的是，这东西杀害牲畜并非是为了掠食。米格尔可不只有反击的本领。他会追踪这个神秘的猎手，案入当地树林，一劳永逸也将其捕获。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入牌库卡牌张数)：[米格尔的背包]、[猫科混种]、1张随机基础弱点。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Miguel never thought he'd find himself managing a stockyard. Having left his native Argentina, he has worked tirelessly to save up enough money to bring his husband Guillermo and their daughter Adonia to Arkham. But now his business is at risk; something has been killing the livestock at night, leaving mutilated corpses in its wake. Stranger still, it's not even killing them for food. But Miguel is more than capable of fighting back: he has tracked this mysterious predator into the local woods, intent on catching it once and for all.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Miguel's Knapsack, Feline Hybrid, 1 random basic weakness.

all_card.back_flavor: 前途无量的拳击手纳撒尼尔·曹，曾有人以重金邀请他参加一场拳赛。争夺冠军，那时他以为自己终于要成功了。但纳撒尼尔的经纪人竟是臭名昭著的欧巴尼恩帮成员，他常常逼迫纳撒尼尔在拳击台上假装倒下，捏造赛果。他出言拒绝，导致自己的哥哥兰道尔出了“意外”。这群黑帮匪徒每晚都危害着阿卡姆市民的安全，纳撒尼尔再也无法容忍他们的所为。现在他将自己的拳头用在正途，在街道上巡逻，保护他人不受伤害。但他很快就发现，阿卡姆的阴影之下危机四伏，不仅仅是黑帮……

all_card.real_back_flavor: When up-and-coming boxer Nathaniel Cho was offered lots of dough for a title fight, he thought he'd finally hit the big time. But his promoter turned out to be part of the notorious O'Bannion gang, and Nathaniel was pressured to fix fights by taking a dive every now and then. His refusal led to his brother Randall's "accident." Nathaniel is rightly fed up with the mobsters endangering Arkham's citizens on a nightly basis. Now he puts his fists to better use, patrolling the streets and defending others from harm. But he's about to find out there are much more dangerous things that lurk in the shadows of Arkham than simple gangsters...

all_card.back_flavor: 自打斯特拉在阿卡姆邮局当差以来，她很清楚两件事。第一，她的父母错将她叫做儿子，还给她起了一个男孩儿名字。第二是，在深夜里——国王港悬崖上的小屋曾低声念出了她的真名——她为自己挑选的名字：“斯特拉。”斯特拉每周六天不论天气如何都会派送邮件，这不是一件易事，但她只要想到自己在维系人们之间的联系，便对这份工作满怀热忱。随后她就开始翻找信件。每次她派送到最后，包里总会多出来一个信封。信封上的收件人一直是她，盖有国王港的邮戳。信封里只有一封信，信上是打印的一个词：“斯特拉。”

all_card.real_back_flavor: Before Stella began working for the postal service in Arkham, she knew two things with certainty. First, her parents made a mistake when they called her their son and gave her a boy's name. Second, the house on the cliff in Kingsport whispered her true name - the name she chose for herself - late at night: "Stella." Delivering the mail six days a week in all kinds of weather wasn't an easy job, but Stella loved knowing that she was helping people connect with one another. Then she started finding the letters. At the end of her route, there was always one extra envelope in her bag. It was always addressed to her. It was always postmarked from Kingsport. And it always contained a letter with one typed word: "Stella."

all_card.back_flavor: 托米还在波士顿警局的时候，并不相信真的有怪物这回事。等被借调到了沉睡的河畔小镇阿卡姆，他才明白自己大错特错。虽然已经过去将近一年了，托米还是会被叫“新人”，但他坚信自己执勤时见过的怪事比任何同事都多。现在托米正努力工作，想要跟局里其他人证明自己不是笑料，与此同时还是抵御阿卡姆一半的怪物。而且他也认识到，并非所有的怪物都有獠牙和触手。

all_card.real_back_flavor: While he was working with the Boston Police Department, Tommy thought there was no such thing as real monsters. When he got loaned out to the sleepy river town of Arkham, he learned he couldn't have been more wrong. That was almost a year ago at this point, and despite still being "the new guy," he's pretty sure he's seen far more out on the beat than anyone else on the force. Now he's working hard to prove he's not a laughingstock to the rest of the police department, all while facing off against half the monsters of Arkham. And he's learned that not all monsters have fangs and tentacles.

all_card.back_flavor: 温妮弗雷德——她父亲叫她温特尔，朋友们都叫她温妮——在就读的保留地学校里，她是最聪明的孩子之一。但是，她做事不顾后果，不将权威放在眼中，常常因此陷入麻烦。有一天，她从一个农夫的车库里发现了一架陈旧的双翼飞机,决定“把它开上天兜一圈”，她的人生轨迹从此彻底改变。曾是一战飞行员的飞机主人被温妮的天赋所折服，主动提出要将自己的所有技艺传授给她。现在，温妮在全国各地巡回表演，炫耀自己的技术，大家都知道她是个“无所畏惧的女人”。但她的无畏在一场表演当中受到了挑战，她发现了一种自己差点没法描述的生物：它有着皮质的翅膀和一双鼓着脓泡的眼睛。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Winifred - Weethao as her parents know her, Wini to her friends - was one of the smartest kids in her reservation school. However, her reckless attitude and lack of respect for authority meant she often got herself into trouble. The course of her life changed forever when she found an old biplane in a farmer's garage and decided to "take it out for a spin." The owner, a former pilot in the Great War, was awestruck by her natural talent and offered to teach her what he knew. Now Wini is known as the "woman without fear," showing off her skills in barnstormers all across the country. That nickname would be tested when, during one of her shows, she spotted a creature she could scarcely describe: a thing with leathery wings and a single, mutated, pus-filled eye.

all_card.text: 躲避。在本次行动开始时，获得2资源。
all_card.real_flavor: Being told not to do something was generally Winifred's cue to proceed as planned.
all_card.real_text: Evade. When this action begins, gain 2 resources.

all_card.name: 身手矫健
all_card.text: 本次技能检定成功且每超过难度1点，在本次检定结算后你可以立即移动到一个连接地点(最多移动3次)。
all_card.real_text: For each point this skill test succeeds by, after it resolves, you may immediately move to a connecting location (to a maximum of 3 times).

all_card.flavor:
“你是个疯子，温妮！”
“我知道！这难道不是一件好事吗？”
all_card.name: 虎口拔牙
all_card.text: 在你将虎口拔牙投入到一次技能检定后，从你的牌库顶弃牌，直到弃掉一张能够投入到本次检定的[rogue]技能。将其投入。将本次效果弃掉的所有弱点洗回你的牌库。
all_card.real_flavor:
"You're a maniac, Wini!"
"I know! Isn't it wonderful?"
all_card.real_text: After you commit Daredevil to a skill test, discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard a [rogue] skill you can commit to this test. Commit it. Shuffle each weakness that was discarded by this effect back into your deck.

all_card.name: 机会主义者
all_card.text:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。
如果你检定成功且超过难度至少3点，在本次检定后不将机会主义者弃掉，改为将其返回你的手牌。
all_card.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
If you succeed by 3 or more, return Opportunist to your hand after this test instead of discarding it.

all_card.name: 酒胆
all_card.text:
使用(4补给)。
[action]花费1补给：选择你所在地点的一位调查员，治愈其1点恐惧。然后，该调查员检定[willpower](2)。如果检定成功，其抽取1张卡牌。如果检定失败，其额外治愈1点恐惧并随机弃掉自己1张手牌。
all_card.real_text:
Uses (4 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Choose an investigator at your location to heal 1 horror. Then, that investigator tests [willpower] (2). If the test succeeds, they draw 1 card. If the test fails, they heal 1 additional horror and discard 1 card at random from their hand.

all_card.name: 毛瑟C96手枪

all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

all_card.flavor:
“麦克格林，你想让我们两个都送命吗？”
“这次不会了，伙计。这次不会了。”
all_card.name: 艺高胆大

本次检定你得到+3技能值。抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor:
"McGlen, are you tryin' to get us both killed?"

all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when you would succeed at a skill test.
You get +3 skill value for this test. Draw 1 card.

all_card.flavor: “瞄准眼睛。”他们这么告诉我的。

all_card.real_flavor: "Aim for the eyes," they told me.
all_card.real_text: Fight. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this attack. If you succeed by 1 or more, automatically evade the attacked enemy. If you succeed by 3 or more, return Cheap Shot to your hand at the end of your turn.

all_card.name: 悄然遁去

all_card.real_text: Evade. Add your [intellect] to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed by 1 or more and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], it does not ready during the next upkeep phase. If you succeed by 3 or more, return Slip Away to your hand at the end of your turn.

all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 1 or more, exhaust Lucky Cigarette Case: Search the top X cards of your deck for a card, draw it, and shuffle the remaining cards into your deck. X is the amount you succeeded by.

all_card.real_text: Investigate. This investigation uses [agility] instead of [intellect]. If you succeed, discover 2 additional clues at your location. If you succeed by 2 or more, return Pilfer to your hand at the end of your turn.

all_card.name: 学人精
all_card.text: 在你将学人精投入到技能检定后，在另一位调查员的弃牌堆中查找一张你能够投入到本次检定中的技能卡，并将其投入。在本次检定结束后，将该卡放到其所有者的牌库底部。
all_card.real_text: After you commit Copycat to a skill test, search the discard pile of another investigator for a skill you can commit to this test, and commit it. After this test ends, place that card on the bottom of its owner's deck.

all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

all_card.back_flavor: 一根木质横梁吱嘎一声正砸在你头上。这一下差点把你砸昏过去。矿井深外的岩穴也是一阵震颤。
all_card.back_text:
对每位调查员造成2点伤害，对其控制的每个[[盟友]]支援造成1点直接伤害。
揭示控制站地点，将每位幸存的调查员移动至该地点。
每位调查员失去其所有线索。
推进场景。
all_card.flavor: 老矿井里有一条陈旧的铁道，四处堆满了废弃的机械。下面的岩石间藏着什么秘密？
all_card.name: 地下勘察
all_card.text: 强制 - 在本密谋推进时：将上面所有的毁灭标记移动到下一个密谋。 [action]抽取遭遇牌库顶一张卡牌：将1资源从你的地点移动到冒险参考卡牌，作为废料。如果刚刚抽取的遭遇卡牌是[[力量]]诡计，获得5资源。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A wooden beam buckes with a sharp crack, coming down on your skull. The impact of the blow nearly knocks you out. Further tremors rock the cave from deeper within the mine.
all_card.real_back_text:
Deal 2 damage to each investigator and 1 direct damage to each [[Ally] asset they control.
Reveal the Control Station location and move each surviving investigator to it.
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Advance the act.
all_card.real_flavor: The old mine is full of dilapidated machinery and an old rail track. What secrets are written in rock below?
all_card.real_text: Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda. [action] Draw the top card of the encounter deck: Move 1 resource from your location to the scenario reference card, as a scrap. If the enconter card just drawn was a [[Power]] treachery, gain 5 resources.

all_card.back_flavor:
矿车后的隧道一路垮塌，露出了一个岩穴，里面全是发光的紫水晶。矿车撞上巨石，把你一头甩进了黑暗。隧道里颤动不止，你手脚并用，在洞穴之间向前，害怕自己要是困在这里，不知道会发生什么。你跃过一具腐败的尸体，它的下巴都已经松垮。看到这幅景象，你差点吐了，随即被一块石头绊倒，摔到了脑袋。
你醒来后已经过了好几个小时，脑子里嗡嗡的。你在眩晕中游荡向前，最后终于捕捉到一丝新鲜的空气，跟着它走出了矿井。
all_card.back_text: 每位幸存的调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤或1点精神创伤。
all_card.flavor: 你知道北岬矿井为什么会荒废了。因为隧道里徘徊着畸变的怪物和发疯的矿工，正饥渴地寻找下一顿美餐。
all_card.name: 危险之旅
all_card.text:
不能滑动及交换有剧情支援的地点。
每个敌人获得猎手关键词，且在敌军阶段期间，额外结算其猎手关键词一次。
在敌人移动时，将每个相邻地点视为与其地点连接。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The tunnel collapses behind the mine cart to expose a cavern filled with glowing violet crystals. The cart crashes into a boulder to send you flying headlong into the dark. As more tremors rock the tunnel, you scramble to keep ahead of the cave-in, terrified of what might happen if you are trapped here. As you sprint past a rotten, slack-jawed corpse, you almost gag from the stench, then trip on a fallen rock and hit your head.
You wake up hours later, head pounding, and wonder in a daze until you catch the scent of fresh air and follow it out of the mine.
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical or 1 mental trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: You now know why North Point Mine was abandoned. Writhing abominations and frenzied miners prowl the tunnels, hungry for their next meal.
all_card.real_text:
Locations with a story asset on them cannot be slid or swapped.
Each enemy gains the hunter keyword and resolves its hunter keyword an additional time during the enemy phase.
When an enemy moves, each adjacent location is considered to be connected to its location.

all_card.back_flavor: 顶上掉下一串岩石，差点就砸中你了。更多的岩石己经松动，迫使你往更深处前行。
all_card.back_text: 将每个[[洞穴]]地点从游戏中移除(弃掉这些地点的所有敌人、标记和附属)。如果瑞玟·霍桑在场且不由调查员控制，将其从游戏中移除。 每位调查员失去其线索至只剩2个。 如果是密谋1a，直接推进到密谋2a(不结算密谋1b)。 你先前搜寻的补给将帮你前行。将冒险参考卡牌翻至另一面，将上面所有的废料移至另一面，作为道岔。 阅读冒险幕间故事:塌方(第10页)。
all_card.flavor: 你意识到空气中可怕的嗡鸣是来自震颤的水晶。有哪里不对头，但你说不出是什么……
all_card.name: 深入矿井
all_card.text: 目标 - 当一轮结束时：如果每位幸存的调查员都位于控制站，推进。(提示：赶在密谋推进前到达控制站！)
all_card.real_back_flavor: A chunk of rock falls from the ceiling, narrowly missing you. More rocks come loose, forcing you deeper.
all_card.real_back_text: Remove each [[Cave]] location from the game (discarding all enemies, tokens, and attachments at those locations). If River Hawthorne is in play but not under control of any investigator, remove them from the game. Each investigator loses all but 2 of their clues. If it is agenda 1a, advance the agenda directly to agenda 2a (do not resolve agenda 1b). Your search for supplies will help you navigate whatever is ahead. Flip the scenario reference card over to its other side, moving all scraps on it to that side, as switches. Read Scenario interlude: The Cave-In (page 10).
all_card.real_flavor: You realize the eerie hum in the air comes from vibrating crystal formations. Something feels strange, though you cannot say what...
all_card.real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, if each surviving investigator is at Control Station, advance. (Hint: Get to the Control Station before the agenda advances!)

all_card.back_flavor: 你按下刹车，轨道上火花四溅，矿车速度变缓，最终停了下来。
all_card.back_text: 检查以下各项： - 如果调查员控制了席米恩·阿特伍德，(→结局1)。 - 如果调查员控制了莉亚·阿特伍德，(→结局2)。 - 如果席米恩·阿特伍德放在一边，或仍在场且不由调查员控制，(→结局3)。 - 如果莉亚·阿特伍德放在一边，或仍在场且不由调查员控制，(→结局4)。 - 如果均非上述情况，(→结局5)。
all_card.flavor: 要想逃出北岬矿井，就必须穿过轨道重重的隧道迷宫。
all_card.name: 地下迷宫
all_card.text: [free]在你的回合期间，共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将一个地点滑动到一个相邻空格，或交换2个相邻地点。 [action]花费1[per_investigator]资源：将一个已揭示地点滑动到一个相邻空格。(团队每轮仅限一次。) [action]如果棱柱碎片剧情支援在你的地点：控制它。 目标 - 到达轨道出口！在矿车进入轨道出口时，立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Sparks fly off the tracks as you pump the cart brakes until you slow to a stop.
all_card.real_back_text: Check the following: - If an investigator controls Simeon Atwood, (→R1). - If an investigator controls Leah Atwood, (→R2). - If Simeon Atwood is set aside or still in play and not under the control of an investigator, (→R3). - If Leah Atwood is set aside or still in play and not under the control of an investigator, (→R4). - If none of the above is true, (→R5).
all_card.real_flavor: The only way out of North Point Mine is through the maze of rail tunnels.
all_card.real_text: [fast] During your turn, spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Either slide a location into an empty adjacent space, or swap 2 adjacent locations. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Slide a revealed location into an empty adjacent space. (Group limit once per round.) [action] If the Prismatic Shard story asset is at your location: Take control of it. Objective - Get to the Rail Exit! When the Mine Card enters Rail Exit, immediately advance.

all_card.name: 矿车
all_card.text: 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：移动矿车一次。如果矿车脱轨，每位调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。 [reaction]在矿车移动时，花费1道岔：取消该移动，或移动额外一次。(团队每阶段仅限两次。)
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move Mine Cart once. If it moves off the rail line, each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. [reaction] When Mine Cart moves, spend 1 switch: Either cancel the move, or move an additional time. (Group limit twice per phase.)

all_card.back_flavor: 里面的灯亮着。之前是谁来了？
all_card.back_text: 作为进入控制站的额外费用，相邻地点的调查员必须共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.flavor: 控制站后面堆满了放久的炸药和火药。
all_card.name: 控制站
all_card.text: [free]在你回合期间：交换2个相邻的[[轨道沿线]]地点。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The lantern in the shed is lit. Who was here before you?
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost to enter Control Station, investigators at an adjacent location must spend 2[per_investigator] clues, as a group.

all_card.text: 用下列标记单独创建一个袋子：[cultist]、[tablet]和[elder_thing]。(如果你没有第二个袋子，你可以用杯子、碗，或其他不透明容器代替。)这个袋子就是猎杀袋，这些标记就是猎杀标记，而不是混乱标记。 然后，根据当前天数，在猎杀袋中加入下列标记： - 第一天： 将[cultist]、[cultist]加入猎杀袋。 - 第二天： 将[cultist]加入猎杀袋。 - 第三天： 不作变化。 有些能力会指示调查员进行猎杀检定。猎杀检定可能会让庄园活过来，追猎调查员。要结算一次猎杀检定，从猎杀袋中随机揭示一个标记，结算该标记在本卡牌另一面上所指示的效果。 将本卡牌翻面，放在冒险参考卡牌旁。
all_card.real_text: Create a separate bag consisting of the following tokens: [cultist], [tablet], and [elder_thing]. (If you do not have a second bag, you can use a cup, bowl, or other opaque container.) This is the predation bag, and these are predation tokens. They are not chaos tokens. Then, add the following tokens to the predation bag based on the current day: - Day 1: Add [cultist], [cultist] to the predation bag. - Day 2: Add [cultist] to the predation bag. - Day 3: No change is made. Some abilities will instruct investigators to make a predation test. A predation test may cause the house to come alive and prey on the investigators. To resolve a predation test, reveal a random token from the predation bag and resolve the effects for that token as indicated on the other side of this card. Flip this card over and place it next to the scenario reference card.

all_card.back_flavor:
你听到木头的吱嘎声，转身回头朝向你过来的走廊。一切似乎都和刚才一样，但你总感觉有什么地方微微不同。你不再屏气，继续调查，只发现房间里的家具各自归位，仿佛孩子们玩的抢椅子游戏。一根黏糊的触手缩回了木头之间的缝隙。
汉洛克庄园的谣言只有一半是对的。墙里确实有什么东西活着。但它远比你想的更糟。
all_card.back_text:

找到放在一边的猎杀之屋剧情卡牌，结算其文本。
all_card.flavor: 你一踏进这座老宅，一股恶臭就扑面而来。你随即有了一种受到监视的紧张感觉。空气太安静了。对一座废弃的老宅来说，家具和地板上居然都没有灰尘，实在令人不安。如果这里已经好几年没人住了，为什么样样东西都像是才动过？
all_card.name: 吊诡的靜默
all_card.real_back_flavor:
At the sound of creaking wood, you spin to face the hall you came from. Everything looks as it was, and yet you cannot shake the feeling that things are subtly different. Letting out a held breath, you resume your investigation, only to find the furniture in your room settling into place, like children playing a game of musical chairs. A slimy tentacle retreats between a gap in the wood.
The rumors regarding Hemlock House were only half right. There is something living within its walls. But it is something far worse than you could have imagined.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle each copy of the set-aside Out of the Walls and Pulled In treacheries into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
Find the unsealed [[Dormant]] location nearest to the most investigators. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.
Find the set-aside The Predatory House story card and resolve its text.
all_card.real_flavor: Your first steps into the old manor come with a fetid odor and an intense feeling of being watched. The air is too still, and for an abandoned house, there is an unsettling lack of dust on the furniture and floors. If nobody has lived here for years, then why does it feel like everything has moved recently?

all_card.back_flavor: 房子吱嘎呻吟，仿佛还在调整身体。你余光已经看到了：地板像水面一样泛起涟漪，就像是吱吱嘎嘎的老木板下面有东西在动。
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。找到离最多调查员最近的未封印的[[沉寂]]地点。将该地点翻至敌人-地点面。
all_card.flavor: 住在这座荒废老宅的可不是老鼠或者什么林地生物。有什么邪恶的东西正寄居在汉洛克庄园里。它在地板里掘洞，在墙中翻滚，用无形的饥渴眼睛望着你。
all_card.name: 庄园动了(版本一)
all_card.text: 强制 - 在神话阶段结束时：进行一次猎杀检定。 [free]将你的1[per_investigator]个线索放在你的地点，或移除你地点的一个封印：将其重整并翻面。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The house groans and creaks, as though it is still settling. Movement stirs in the corner of your eye: the floor itself ripples like water as something moves beneath the creaking old boards.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the unsealed [[Dormant]] location nearest to the most investigators. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.
all_card.real_flavor: It is no mere infestation of rats or woodland creatures that haunts this decrepit manor. Something vile lives in Hemlock House. It burrows through the floor, writhes within its walls, and watches you with invisible, hungry eyes.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Make a predation test. [fast] Either place 1 [per_investigator] of your clues on your location or remove a seal from it: Ready it and flip it over.

all_card.back_flavor: 狂乱的雨滴倾泄在屋顶上。黑云笼罩了外面的天空，只有间或几道远方的闪电才带来一点光亮。在雷霆稍歇、窗外倾盆大雨的间隙，你听到低沉的吱嘎呻吟，顿时感觉毛骨悚然。恰在此时，亮光灌满屋内，房顶上回响起轰隆的破裂声。木头烧焦的气味沿着走道传了下来。闪电击中了房子！
all_card.back_text:

all_card.flavor: 住在这座荒废老宅的可不是老鼠或者什么林地生物。有什么邪恶的东西正寄居在汉洛克庄园里。它在地板里掘洞，在墙中翻滚，用无形的饥渴眼睛望着你。

all_card.text: 强制 - 在神话阶段结束时：进行一次猎杀检定。 [free]将你的1[per_investigator]个线索放在你的地点，或移除你地点的一个封印：将其重整并翻面。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Tumultuous rain pelts the roof of the house. The sky outside is swathed in dark clouds, illuminated only by brief flashes of light in the distance. Your skin crawls as the groans and creaks are muffled by the roar of thunder and the downpour crashing against the windows. Just then, bright light floods the room, and a resounding crack booms from the top floor of the house. The smell of burning wood drifts down into the halls. Lightning has struck the house!
all_card.real_back_text:
Find the unsealed [[Dormant]] location nearest to the most investigators. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.
Attach a set-aside Fire! treachery to the leftmost location on the highest floor. Shuffle each other copy of Fire! into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: It is no mere infestation of rats or woodland creatures that haunts this decrepit manor. Something vile lives in Hemlock House. It burrows through the floor, writhes within its walls, and watches you with invisible, hungry eyes.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Make a predation test. [fast] Either place 1 [per_investigator] of your clues on your location or remove a seal from it: Ready it and flip it over.

all_card.back_flavor:
你周围的墙壁压了过来，木头吱嘎碎裂。家具翻倒，露出这头生物更多蜿蜓的触手。天花板下降、变形、扭曲，而就在这时，触手缠住了你的四肢，将你砸在地上。这是活着的器官，有规律的搏动；是正在饕餮的巨胃。木材、填料和石膏将你包围。房子的轰隆隆逐渐消解为低沉的磨牙声。
你感到自己涌起一阵肾上腺素，奋力挣脱了这个东西的抓攫。你脑子里嗡嗡的，猛地推开屋门逃了出去。它在你背后关上，像一张饥饿的巨口。
all_card.back_text: 每位尚未撤退的幸存调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。
all_card.flavor: 不管是这栋房子活了，还是墙里的生物已经完全包围了它。你现在只希望要么清理所有的房间，把这里变成一堆瓦砾；要么赶紧逃出去，确保没人再敢冒险靠近。
all_card.name: 墙壁活了
all_card.text: 强制 - 在神话阶段结束时：进行一次猎杀检定。 [free]将你的1[per_investigator]个线索放在你的地点，或移除你地点的一个封印：将其重整并翻面。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Wood cracks and splinters as the walls press in around you. Furniture topples, making way for more of the creature's slithering tentacles. They wrap around your limbs and pin you to the floor as the ceiling descends, warped and contorted. It is a pulsating organ, a stomach devouring its meal. Wood, caulk, and plaster enclose you as the house's rumblings dissolve into muffled gnashing.
Your senses are flooded with a surge of adrenaline, and you shake out of the thing's grip. Head pounding, you sprint out of the house as its doors slam open and shut like hungry mouths.
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: Either the house is alive, or the creature within its walls has grown to encompass it entirely. Your only hope now is to either secure all of the rooms, turn this place into rubble, or flee and make sure nobody ever ventures near this place ever again.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Make a predation test. [fast] Either place 1 [per_investigator] of your clues on your location or remove a seal from it: Ready it and flip it over.

all_card.back_text:
如果场上的封印数多于胜利区的敌人-地点：
你尝试压制这诡异的生物，却似乎激怒了它。烦人的尖叫让地基都在摇晃，底下有什么可怕的东西传来恶臭，灌满了空气。
将放在一边的失形地窖敌人-地点放置入场，位于地窖层，尽可能靠近中间一列。 推进到放在一边的场景2a“庄园之心”并将场景2a“对抗庄园”从游戏中移除。
如果胜利区的敌人-地点多于场上的封印数：
另一个房间也要垮塌，房子的地基已经在摇晃。要是你拆了这栋房子，里面畸变的怪物肯定也活不长。
推进到放在一边的场景2a“对抗庄园”并将场景2a“庄园之心”从游戏中移除。
all_card.name: 诡异住户
all_card.text: 不能发现没有调查员的地点的线索。 [action]如果你的地点未封印且为[[沉寂]]，该地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：在上面放置1资源，作为一个封印。 目标 - 当一轮结束时：如果总计有7个地点被封印和/或在胜利区，推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If there are more seals in play than enemy-locations in the victory display:
Your efforts to suppress the strange infestation seem to have angered it. A noisome screech shakes the foundation of the house, and the air floods with a fetid stench of something awful down below.
Put the set-aside Shapeless Cellar enemy-location into play on the Cellar Floor, as close to the middle column as possible. Advance to the set-aside act 2a "The Heart of the House" and remove act 2a "Against the House" from the game.
If there are more enemy-locations in the victory display than seals in play:
The foundations of the house shake as another room threatens to collapse. If you bring this house down, the abomination that lives inside it won't survive long.
Advance to the set-aside act 2a "Against the House" and remove act 2a "The Heart of the House" from the game.
all_card.real_text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. [action] If your location is unsealed and [[Dormant]], investigators at that location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource on it, as a seal. Objective - At the end of the round, if a total of 7 locations are sealed and/or in the victory display, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 汉洛克庄园的最后一点残余也变成了废墟和瓦砾，而你及时逃了出来。透过尘土和烟雾，你看到这头怪物残存的触手缩回了地基，从地底逃跑了。无论它是什么，现在都不在了。
all_card.flavor: 封印这头生物根本解决不了任何问题。无论是什么怪物占据了汉洛克庄园，都必须彻底摧毁。
all_card.name: 对抗庄园
all_card.text: 不能发现没有调查员的地点的线索。 目标 - 拆了这座庄园！如果场上没有地点，立即推进(这发生在调查员因不在地点而将要被击败之前)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You escape just in time as the last remnant of Hemlock House collapses into rubble and ruin. Through the cloud of dirt and dust, you watch as the creature's remaining tentacles slither into its foundations and retreat underground. Whatever it was, it is gone now.
all_card.real_back_name: Fall of the House of Hemlock
all_card.real_flavor: Sealing this creature away won't solve anything. Whatever sort of monster has taken over Hemlock House, it needs to be destroyed.
all_card.real_text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. Objective - Bring this house down! If no locations are in play, immediately advance (this occurs before investigators would be defeated by not being at a location).

all_card.back_flavor: 庄园颤动着，然后静止了。你封上了这头生物从庄园墙壁间钻出来的裂缝和角落，看来这已经足以迫使它撤退，或者沉寂一段时间。希望它不会再出现了。与此同时，汉洛克家族的遗产保住了。也许假以时日，他们可以找到办法彻底消灭这头生物。
all_card.back_text: 将每个敌人-地点翻至地点面。在每个未封印的[[沉寂]]地点上放置1资源，作为封印。 (→结局1)(第18页)。
all_card.flavor: 你要是想永远封印这座庄园，就必须深入下面骇人的埋骨地。
all_card.name: 庄园之心

all_card.real_back_flavor: The house shudders, then stills. Sealing off the crevices and nooks where the creature was breaching through the house's walls seems to have forced it to retreat, or perhaps lay dormant for a while. Hopefully it won't resurface, but in the meantime, the legacy of the Hemlock family still stands. Maybe in time, they can find a way to exterminate the creature for good.
all_card.real_back_text: Flip each enemy-location to its location side. Place 1 resource, as a seal, on each unsealed [[Dormant]] location. (→R1) (page 18).

all_card.text: 显现 - 如果场上没有敌人-地点，拖离正道获得涌动。否则，检定[combat](4)。如果你检定失败，选择最近的敌人-地点并移动(一次一个地点)到它。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少4点，所选的敌人-地点攻击你。
all_card.real_flavor: You should really watch where you step.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no enemy-locations in play, Pulled In gains surge. Otherwise, test [combat] (4). If you fail, choose the nearest enemy-location and move (one location at a time) to it. If you failed by 4 or more, the chosen enemy-location attacks you.

all_card.name: 失形地窖
all_card.text: 庞大。反击。不能进行趁乱攻击。 失形地窖不能被封印，也不能被翻面。 强制 - 在你调查失形地窖时，技能检定失败后：失形地窖攻击你。 强制 - 如果失形地窖没有线索：将其加入胜利区。
all_card.traits: 房间. 怪物. 精英
all_card.real_text: Massive. Retaliate. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Shapeless Cellar cannot be sealed or flipped. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Shapeless Cellar: Shapeless Cellar attacks you. Forced - If there are no clues on Shapeless Cellar: Add it to the victory display.

all_card.name: 小西尔维
all_card.text: [reaction]在小西尔维从你的手牌或牌库被弃掉时：将其打出(支付其费用)。 [reaction]在冒险卡牌效果将要从你手牌或牌库弃掉一张卡牌时，横置小西尔维：改为将该卡牌放到你的牌库顶。
all_card.traits: 道具. 守护. 诅咒萦绕
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When Little Sylvie is discarded from your hand or deck: Play it (paying its cost). [reaction] When a scenario card effect would discard a card from your hand or deck, exhaust Little Sylvie: Place that card on top of your deck, instead.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为场上和胜利区中[[昆虫]]敌人的数量。
[cultist]：-3。如果你检定成功，你可以将胜利区的一个非[[精英]]敌人混洗入遭遇牌库。
[tablet]：-5。重整最近的[[昆虫]]敌人。它移动并攻击，如同此刻是敌军阶段。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你在[[巢穴]]地点，你自动失败。
all_card.name: 寂靜荒野
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为场上和胜利区中[[昆虫]]敌人数量的一半(向上取整)。
[cultist]：-1。你可以将胜利区的一个非[[精英]]敌人混洗入遭遇牌库。
[tablet]：-3。如果你检定失败，选择你所在地点的一个[[昆虫]]敌人。它与你交战并立即进行一次攻击。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你在[[巢穴]]地点，再揭示一个标记。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X the number of [[Insect]] enemies in play and in the victory display.
[cultist]: -3. If you succeed, you may shuffle a non-[[Elite]] enemy in the victory display into the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -5. Ready the nearest [[Insect]] enemy. It moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you are at a [[Lair]] location, you automatically fail.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of [[Insect]] enemies in play and in the victory display (rounded up).
[cultist]: -1. You may shuffle a non-[[Elite]] enemy in the victory display into the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, choose an [[Insect]] enemy at your location. It engages you and makes an immediate attack.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you are at a [[Lair]] location, reveal another token.

all_card.back_flavor: 地下深处传来一降刺鼻的臭气。几百条腿抽动的声音顿时响起，一只巨大的昆虫从地底钻出。它半透明的皮肤让人恶心，背上软绵绵地挂着一对枯萎的黑色翅膀。这怪物无情的珠状眼睛瞪着你，挥舞起触须，它已经注意到你了。
all_card.back_text:
从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌，直到弃掉一个[[昆虫]]敌人。调查员队长抽取该敌人。
将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 干旱的地表寂静无声。醉人的微光笼罩了一切。
all_card.name: 不安的宁静
all_card.text: 强制 - 在毁灭标记放置到本密谋时，如果族群虫后敌人放在一边：从混乱袋中揭示标记，数量等于胜利区中[[昆虫]]敌人的数量。如果揭示了[skull]或[auto_fail]标记，生成放在一边的族群虫后敌人。
all_card.real_back_flavor: An acrid stench wafts from somewhere deep below. The skittering of hundreds of legs fills the air before a monstrous insect emerges from underground. It has sickly, translucent skin and a pair of shriveled black wings that hang limply over its back. The creature stares at you with unfeeling beady eyes, waving its antennae to announce your presence.
all_card.real_back_text:
Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an [[Insect]] enemy is discarded. The lead investigator draws that enemy.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: The dry landscape is perfectly still. A beguiling glow hangs over everything.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if the Brood Queen enemy is set aside: Reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the number of [[Insect]] enemies in the victory display. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] token is revealed, spawn the set-aside Brood Queen enemy.

all_card.back_flavor:
虫群战士蜂拥而来，挡住你所有的退路。其中一个将口器扎进你的身体，精准得有如机械。你感到疼痛，然后是麻木，最后什么也感觉不到，昏过去了。
你几个小时后醒来，发现自已身处干燥的洞穴，被埋在盐里。你头昏脑胀，拖着步子离开这“免子洞”，来到外面干燥的荒野。你的伤口一侧渗出薄膜似的蓝色毒物，但看起来死不了人……
all_card.back_text: 每位没有退场的调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 昆虫来来回回，警惕你的出现。
all_card.name: 荒芜(版本一)
all_card.text: 每个[[昆虫]]敌人失去冷漠。 强制 - 在毁灭标记放置到本密谋时，如果族群虫后敌人放在一边：从混乱袋中揭示标记，数量等于胜利区中[[昆虫]]敌人的数量。如果揭示了有符号的标记，生成放在一边的族群虫后敌人。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A swarm of insect soldiers descends upon you, blocking any escape. One of them buries its proboscis in your torso with near-mechanical efficiency. You feel pain, then numbness, then nothing as you pass out.
You come to hours later, covered in salt, in a dry cavern. Head pounding, you stagger out of the warrens into the arid heath. The wound in your side oozes a filmy blue poison, but it doesn't seem to be fatal...
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator who has not been eliminated is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: The insects scurry to and fro, alarmed by your presence.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Insect]] enemy loses aloof. Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if the Brood Queen enemy is set aside: Reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the number of [[Insect]] enemies in the victory display. If a token with a symbol is revealed, spawn the set-aside Brood Queen enemy.

all_card.back_flavor:
虫群蜂拥而来，挡住你所有的退路。其中一个带着机械般的精准将口器扎进你的身体。刺痛遍布你的全身，接着是一阵麻木。乳白色的昆虫抽回黑色的口器，上面还滴着蓝色的液体，而你的意识已经开始涣散。昏厥也是一种仁慈。
你几个小时后醒来，发现自己身处干燥的地下厅室，被埋在盐里。你头昏脑胀，拖着步子离开这“免子洞”，来到外面干燥的荒野。你的伤口一侧渗出薄膜似的蓝色毒物，但看起来死不了人……
all_card.back_text: 每位没有退场的调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 昆虫来来回回，警惕你的出现。
all_card.name: 荒芜(版本二)
all_card.text: 每个[[昆虫]]敌人失去冷漠和巡逻，并获得猎手。 强制 - 在毁灭标记放置到本密谋时，如果族群虫后敌人放在一边：从混乱袋中揭示标记，数量等于胜利区中[[昆虫]]敌人的数量。如果揭示了有符号的标记，生成放在一边的族群虫后敌人。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A swarm of insects descends upon you, blocking any escape. One of them darts forward with almost mechanical efficiency, burying a proboscis in your torso. Sharp pain spasms through your body, followed by numbness. The milky white insect retracts a black proboscis dripping blue fluid as your vision begins to swim. Passing out is a mercy.
You come to hours later, covered in salt, in a dry chamber underground. Head pounding, you stagger out of the warrens into the arid heath. The wound in your side oozes a filmy blue poison, but it doesn't seem to be fatal...
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator who has not been eliminated is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: The insects scurry to and fro, alarmed by your presence.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Insect]] enemy loses aloof and patrol and gains hunter. Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if the Brood Queen enemy is set aside: Reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the number of [[Insect]] enemies in the victory display. If a token with a symbol is revealed, spawn the set-aside Brood Queen enemy.

all_card.back_flavor: 你在珀尔庄园的废墟中找到了苏珊·珀尔的日记。里面详细记述了探索山脊下隧道的历程。这些隧道结构颇似迷宫，所以被称作“免子洞”。也许珀尔家有些人就消失在了周围的隧道里，可是为什么呢？你决心调查一番。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的岩间恐怖遭遇组的三张地点随机放置入场，未揭示面朝上，与三张起始地点相邻，如剧本手册20页所示。 拿取剩余的放在一边的地点(盐厅、幼虫隧道和水晶温床)，以及遭遇牌库顶的3张卡牌。将其混洗，随机在每个地点底下正面朝下分发1张。
all_card.flavor: 珀尔山上的遗产对当地人而言可是一桩大事。珀尔一家也是汉洛克和阿特伍德一样的当地望族，但整个家族却在1906年的一场奇异事故中完全消失。这里到底发生了什么？
all_card.name: 失落的遗产
all_card.text: 目标 - 在一轮结束时，位于珀尔庄园废墟地点的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Amongst the ruins of the Pearl Estate, you find Susan Pearl's diary. It details attempts to explore tunnels beneath the ridge. They were called "The Warrens" due to their mazelike structure. Perhaps some of the Pearl family disappeared in the surrounding tunnels, but why? You resolve to investigate.
all_card.real_back_text: Randomly put the three set-aside locations from the Horrors in the Rock encounter set into play, unrevealed, adjacent to the three starting locations as explained on page 20 of the Campaign Guide. Take the remaining set-aside locations (Salt Chamber, Larval Tunnel, and Crystal Nursery) along with the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Shuffle them together and randomly deal 1 card facedown beneath each location.
all_card.real_flavor: The legacy of Pearl Ridge is a story of note amongst the locals. The Pearls were a prominent family like the Hemlocks and Atwoods, but the family vanished in a curious incident back in 1906. What could have happened here?
all_card.real_text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators at the Pearl Estate Ruins may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 腐败的臭气和怪异生物的信息素混合出一种独特又恶心的气味。你从洞穴里出来，放下了尸骸，你觉得这肯定是珀尔家族最后的成员了。他们晶体化的诡异增生上酸性物质的残留灼伤了你的皮肤。这些尸体看上去就十分痛苦，脸上都是僵住的苦难。尸体周围弥漫着一种气氛，似乎有什么无形又沉重的存在，尽管现在并没有东西在动，也没有微风或尘土。只有空气中的什么东西在动。你感到一阵深入骨髓的疲惫。
all_card.back_text: 检查胜利区中水晶残散的数量。 - 如果有正好3张水晶残骸，(→结局1)(第22页)。 - 否则，(→结局2)(第22页)。
all_card.flavor: “兔子洞”看来就是珀尔家族最后的安息之地了。研究他们的遗存或许能启发你这里到底发生了什么。
all_card.name: 搜寻荒野
all_card.text: [action]如果你所在地点没有线索：抽取你地点底下，最顶上的卡牌。 [free]你所在地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：查看你地点底下，最顶上的卡牌。你可以将该卡牌放置到那堆卡牌最底下。 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退，且胜利区有至少1张水晶残骸，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The scent of decay and the strange creatures' pheromones mix to create a uniquely awful musk. Emerging from the caverns, you lay down the last member of what you assume must be the Pearl family. The acidic residue from their strange, crystalline growths burns your skin. The bodies are painful to look at, their faces frozen in silent agony. Some invisible, heavy presence fills the air above the corpses, although there is no motion, no breeze or dust. Only a movement of something in the air. You feel a deep, bone-aching weariness.
all_card.real_back_text: Check the number of Crystal Remains in the victory display. - If there are exactly 3 Crystal Remains, (→R1) (page 22). - Otherwise, (→R2) (page 22).
all_card.real_flavor: The Warrens are likely the final resting place of the Pearl family. Studying their remains may shed light on what really happened here.
all_card.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Draw the top card beneath your location. [fast] Investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the top card beneath your location. You may place that card on the bottom of its stack. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned and there are 1 or more Crystal Remains in the victory display, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 一度生机勃勃的果园现在看起来更像是一座精心打造的玻璃艺术展览馆。苹果树已经结晶，折射出变换多端的图案。
all_card.flavor: 周围的世界正在改变。我真诚地认为，是为了更好的世界。<cite>来自苏珊·珀尔的个人日记</cite>
all_card.name: 水晶果园
all_card.text: [action]在水晶果园的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将一张你控制的水晶残骸加入胜利区。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A once-living orchard looks more like a delicate glasswork gallery. The apple trees have crystallized and reflect the light in shifting patterns.
all_card.real_flavor: The world is changing around us. I think, truly, for the better. - from the personal diary of Susan Pearl
all_card.real_text: [action] Investigators at Crystal Grove spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Add a Crystal Remains you control to the victory display.

all_card.back_flavor: 一度辉煌的庄园，现在只剩下摇摇欲坠的残墟还留在悬崖的边缘。破败的房顶看着就像拼凑起来的空洞。
all_card.flavor: 先前的果园和农地经年累月无人打理，已经化为齑粉。不过将近二十年过去，自然还是没有夺回这座奢华的庄园。
all_card.name: 珀尔庄园废墟
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你将荒野抛在身后。将所有你控制的水晶残骸加入胜利区。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The wreck of a once-great house stands precariously on the edge of a cliff. The decaying roofs look like an empty patchwork.
all_card.real_flavor: The former orchard and farm has turned to powder from years of neglect. Nearly two decades have passed, yet nature has not reclaimed the opulent estate.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You leave the heath behind. Add all Crystal Remains you control to the victory display.

all_card.back_flavor: 无穷无尽的灰烬掩盖了一切生命迹象。
all_card.flavor: 这层柔软的灰烬让穿行陡峭的地形变得非常危险。
all_card.name: 惨白斜坡
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你揭示惨白斜坡时：检定[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The endless stretch of ash appears to be completely devoid of life.
all_card.real_flavor: The soft ash makes navigating the steep terrain especially treacherous.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you reveal Ashen Slope: Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 2 damage.

all_card.name: 盐厅
all_card.text: 显现 - 将盐厅放置入场，与抽取它的地点相邻([codex]Ω)(第21页)。 [action]在盐厅的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：抽取盐厅底下一堆卡牌中最顶上的一张。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Salt Chamber into play adjacent to the location from which it was drawn ([codex] Ω) (page 21). [action] Investigators at Salt Chamber spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the top card of the stack beneath Salt Chamber. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.name: 幼虫隧道
all_card.text: 显现 - 将幼虫隧道放置入场，与抽取它的地点相邻。查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张无彩幼虫敌人并将其生成在本地点([codex]Ψ)(第21页)。 [reaction]你成功躲避位于幼虫隧道的敌人后：抽取本地点底下一堆卡牌中最顶上的一张。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Larval Tunnel into play adjacent to the location from which it was drawn. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Colorless Larva and spawn it at this location ([codex] Ψ) (page 21). [reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy at Larval Tunnel: Draw the top card of the stack beneath this location. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.name: 水晶温床
all_card.text: 显现 - 将水晶温床放置入场，与抽取它的地点相邻([codex]Ф)(第21页)。 [reaction]你在水晶温床结束自己回合后，受到1点直接恐惧：抽取水晶温床底下一堆卡牌中最顶上的一张。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.traits: 洞穴. 巢穴. 枯疫
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Crystal Nursery into play adjacent to the location from which it was drawn ([codex] Ф) (page 21). [reaction] After you end your turn in Crystal Nursery, take 1 direct horror: Draw the top card of the stack beneath Crystal Nursery. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.name: 号令共振
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，如可能，选择下列一个不同的选项： - 受到1点伤害。 - 随机弃掉你1张手牌。 - 最近的[[昆虫]]敌人重整、移动(每次一个地点)，直到它抵达你的地点，与你交战，并立即进行一次攻击。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, choose a different option from the following, if able: - Take 1 damage. - Discard 1 card at random from your hand. - The nearest [[Insect]] enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.

all_card.flavor: 这些蚂蚁真的能筑丘成山。
all_card.name: 保卫虫巢
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](2)。场上每有一个[[巢穴]]地点，此次检定的难度提高1点。如果你检定失败，在最近的[[昆虫]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。(如果你不能这么做，改为受到2点恐惧。)
all_card.real_flavor: These ants can literally make mountains out of molehills.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 1 for each [[Lair]] location in play. If you fail, place 1 doom on the nearest [[Insect]] enemy. (If you cannot, take 2 horror instead.)

all_card.flavor: 幼虫眼中流出苍白的液体，仿佛眼泪。
all_card.name: 无彩幼虫
all_card.text: 冷漠。 强制 - 无彩幼虫攻击后：击败它。
all_card.traits: 生物. 昆虫. 突变
all_card.real_flavor: The pale fluid dripping from the larva's eyes almost resemble tears.
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Forced - After Colorless Larva attacks: Defeat it.

all_card.flavor: “这些生物有8-12英尺长。翅膀退化。完全目盲。毒液如火烧般灼人。”<cite>罗莎·马奎兹博士，米斯卡塔尼克勘察队，1926年</cite>
all_card.name: 族群兵虫
all_card.text:
冷漠。巡逻(有线索的[[洞穴]]地点)。
族群兵虫为重整状态时，其地点得到+2隐藏值。
all_card.traits: 生物. 昆虫. 突变
all_card.real_flavor: "The creatures were 8-12 feet long. Vestigial wings. Completely blind. Their venom burned like fire." - Dr. Rosa Marquez, Miskatonic Survey, 1926
all_card.real_text:
Aloof. Patrol ([[Cave]] location with clues).
While Brood Soldier is ready, its location gets +2 shroud.

all_card.name: 族群虫后

all_card.back_flavor: 隧道的岩壁间回响起一阵轰隆吱嘎的响动。旁边的潮池里钻出一只巨大的螃蟹状生物，在空中挥舞着自己的触角，好像是在找你。这东西十几条腿动起来快得惊人，壳上覆盖着尖利的藤壶、一串串巨藻和腐败的海草。无论这是什么东西，它都散发出你今生闻过最难以忍受的臭气。
all_card.back_text: 将一张放在一边的虾类混种敌人生成在离最多调查员最近的[[海岸]]地点，(在光中)面朝上。 在[[黑暗]]地点的每位调查员必须随机弃掉其1张手牌。 在密谋2a上放置毁灭标记，数量等于当前天数。
all_card.flavor: 海浪拍打着边岸，就要将通往潮水岩穴的脚印全部扫除。你捕捉到隧道深处露出一丝最最微弱的幽暗蓝光。
all_card.name: 深入洞穴
all_card.text: [[黑暗]]地点的卡牌使用(黑夜[night])效果。所有其他地点的卡牌使用(白日[day])效果。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A whirring, chittering sound echoes off the tunnel walls. A large, crab-like creature emerges from a nearby tidal pool, antennae swaying in the air as if searching for you. The thing moves surprisingly fast on dozens of legs, and its carapace is covered in sharp barnacles and strings of kelp and rotten seaweed. Whatever it is, it emits the most awful, rotten stench you have ever smelled.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn one of the set-aside Crustacean Hybrid enemies at the [[Coastal]] location nearest to the most investigators, (In the Light) side faceup. Each investigator at a [[Dark]] location must discard 1 card at random from their hand. Place doom on agenda 2a equal to the current day number.
all_card.real_flavor: Waves crash on the shoreline, threatening to wipe out a set of footprints that lead into the tidal caverns. You catch the faintest glimpse of a dim, blue glow deep within the tunnels.
all_card.real_text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.

all_card.back_flavor:
你发现自己被十几个咔哒作响的影子包围，身处黑暗之中。更吓人的还是微微发光的苔藓，已经遍布潮水洞穴光滑的岩壁和顶端。生物和变换的苔藓不断逼近，令人窒息，你失去平衡，落入厚厚的苔藓层中。你凑近之后发现苔藓中细小的花苞和多刺的增生悸动着转向你，就像一百张小嘴。
你觉得自己的肢体已经麻木，就在这时，有双手将你拉了出来。海伦·彼得斯将你全身拖出了洞穴，一边还在不停地咒骂。
all_card.back_text: 每位尚未撤退的幸存调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。
all_card.flavor: 岩壁上都是活生生的真菌增生，搅动着，变换着，而且似乎都在跟着你。
all_card.name: 黑暗围拢
all_card.text: [[黑暗]]地点的卡牌使用(黑夜[night])效果。所有其他地点的卡牌使用(白日[day])效果。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You find yourself surrounded in the dark by dozens of shadowy forms, clacking and chittering. More unsettling still is the soft glowing moss that spreads across the slick walls and ceiling of the tidal cave. As the creatures and shifting moss press in, suffocatingly close, you lose your balance and fall into a thick carpet of moss. Up close, you see small buds and spiny growths in the moss that palpitate and turn toward you like a hundred tiny mouths.
As you feel your limbs go numb, a pair of hands pulls you from the moss. Helen Peters drags you bodily out of the cave, cursing under her breath.
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: The cavern walls are alive with churning, shifting fungal growths. And they seem to be following you.
all_card.real_text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.

all_card.back_flavor:
“她还活着。但我怀疑布鲁斯不在了。”海伦一手攥着磨损的狗链说到。你跟着她沿着一串足迹深入黑暗。岩穴里盖着一层真菌，等眼睛适应了它们黯淡的生物光，你发现足迹本身居然也有微光。
“这条路。做好准备，什么都有可能发生。”海伦说道。你镇定心神，跟在她身边。前面骇人的怪声告诉你，这里不止有你们……
all_card.back_text:
选择一个[[海岸]]地点(如可能，选择没有调查员的地点)。将放在一边的真菌洞穴地点放置入场，与所选地点相邻。
将岩穴牌库顶的卡牌放置入场，与真菌洞穴相邻。重复此过程，直到真菌洞穴和四个地点连接，或岩穴牌库为空。
all_card.flavor: 伊丽莎白·彼得斯追着家里的狗，在海边的洞穴里走丢了。海伦决心要找她回来。
all_card.name: 失踪的姐妹
all_card.text: 强制 - 在发现了[[洞穴]]地点最后的线索后：将岩穴牌库顶的卡牌放置入场，与该地点相邻。 目标 - 找到伊丽莎白·彼得斯！如果调查员“找到了磨损的狗链”并“发现了一串足迹”，立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"She's alive. Though I doubt Bruce is," Helen says, gripping the torn dog leash in one hand. You follow her as she tracks a set of footprints deeper into the darkness. As your eyes readjust to the low light, you notice the footprints glow with the leavings of the bioluminescent fungus covering the cavern floors.
"It's this way. Be ready for anything," Helen says. You steel yourself and keep step beside her. Ahead, an unsettling click and whir tell you that you are far from alone...
all_card.real_back_text:
Choose a [[Coastal]] location (with no investigators, if able). Put the set-aside Fungal Cave location into play adjacent to the chosen location.
Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play, adjacent to the Fungal Cave. Repeat this until the Fungal Cave is connected to four locations, or the Caverns deck is empty.
all_card.real_flavor: Elizabeth Peters has gone missing in these coastal caves, chasing after the family dog. Helen is determined to get her back.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from a [[Cave]] location: Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play adjacent to that location. Objective - Find Elizabeth Peters! If the investigators "found a torn dog leash" and "found a set of footprints," immediately advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
“海伦！”伊丽莎白绝望锐利的尖叫划破了沉默。一个圆圆脸蛋的年轻女人破衣烂衫地从黑暗中跌跌撞撞出来，抱住了她的姐姐。但她们的重聚没多久就被一阵骇人的尖叫打断了。一只有房子那么巨大的甲壳类动物向前突进，举起的螯子吓人不轻。这东西亮闪闪滑溜溜的躯体在岩穴的苔藓中闪着绿蓝色的光，散发出腐败贝类的味道。
“你还能走吗？”海伦问妹妹道。丽姿摇了摇头。大怪物越来越近，你跟她们喊道快跑。海伦纠结了一下，随即点头谢过你，扛起妹妹走了。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的鳖类混种生成在真菌洞穴。 将海伦·彼得斯从游戏中移除。如果希奥·彼得斯由任意调查员控制，([codex]Σ)(第25页)。
all_card.flavor: 丽姿发光的足迹通向岩穴深处不为人知的洞室。你经过一番探索，终于知道要怎么把带着闪光苔藓的饕餮巨怪从黑暗里引到光明的地方。
all_card.name: 追踪
all_card.text: [action]花费1[per_investigator]个线索并选择一个连接的[[黑暗]]地点的一个敌人：将该敌人移动到你的地点。 目标 - 在有调查员进入真菌洞穴时，立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"Helen!" Elizabeth's shrill, desperate cry cuts through the silence. A young woman with a round face and torn clothes hobbles out of the darkness to embrace her sister. As the pair embrace, their reunion is cut short by a fearsome screech. A massive crustacean the size of a house advances, pincers raised threateningly. The thing's slick, shining form is illuminated in green and blue by the cavern moss, and it emits a smell like rotten shellfish.
"Can you walk?" Helen asks her sister. Lizzie shakes her head. As the massive creature comes closer, you tell the pair to run. Helen looks torn for a moment, then nods in thanks before carrying her sister away.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Limulus Hybrid at the Fungal Cave. Remove Helen Peters from the game. If Theo Peters is under the control of any investigator, ([codex] Σ) (page 25).
all_card.real_flavor: Lizzie's glowing footprints lead to an unexplored chamber deep in the caverns. Through your exploration, you now know how to lure the ravenous creatures with glowing moss out of the darkness and into the light.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - When an investigator enters Fungal Cave, immediately advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 高耸的畸形怪物晃动扭曲，它庞大的身体在濒死的痛苦中颤栗不止。终于，那怪物不动了。它的眼睛和甲壳里渗出一层朦胧的蓝色液体，闻起来更胜腐鱼。你捂住口鼻，冲回了阿克望。
all_card.flavor: 洞穴深处钻出来的畸变怪物在隧道里一路跟着你。你只能希望自己为海伦和她的妹妹争取了足够的时间逃跑。
all_card.name: 直面甲壳
all_card.text: [action]花费1[per_investigator]个线索并选择一个连接的[[黑暗]]地点的一个敌人：将该敌人移动到你的地点。 目标 - 如果鳖类混种被击败，立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The towering abomination thrashes and squirms, its massive bulk shuddering in violent death throes. At long last, the monstrosity goes still. A filmy blue fluid leaks from its eyes and carapace, smelling like more awful, rotten shellfish. Covering your nose and mouth, you head back to Akwan.
all_card.real_flavor: The abomination from the depths of the caves stalks you through the tunnels. You can only hope you can buy Helen and her sister enough time to escape.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - If Limulus Hybrid is defeated, immediately advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 阿克望这个小渔村静静地坐落在毒堇岛北边岩石嶙峋的海岸。有几个人在村庄的步道上游荡。
all_card.name: 阿克望
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你放弃了搜寻。 如果是第一日或第二日，阿克望获得：“[action]：谈判。你在村民中问了一圈岩石洞窟的事情。查看岩穴牌库顶3张卡牌。将其以任意顺序放回岩穴牌库顶。”
all_card.real_back_flavor: The fishing village of Akwan sits quietly in a rocky bay on the northern shores of Hemlock Isle. A few people mill around on the village's boardwalks.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You give up the search. If it is Day 1 or Day 2, Akwan gains: "[action]: Parley. You ask around the village about the coastal caves. Look at the top 3 cards of the Caverns deck. Return them to the top of the Caverns deck in any order."

all_card.back_flavor: 下行许久之后，我发现岔路和地洞从未知的黢黑阴暗之处通向这座阴森神秘的深井。<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《魔节》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 墙上和天顶上挂着十几具狞笑的颅骨和伸出的臂骨。
all_card.name: 悬墓
all_card.text: [action]受到1点恐惧：你翻遍墙上盖着的骸骨丛生的苔藓。将岩穴牌库顶的卡牌放置入场，与本地点相邻。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor:
After more aeons of descent I saw some side passages or burrows leading from unknown recesses of blackness to this shaft of nighted mystery
 - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Festival"
all_card.real_flavor: Dozens of grinning skulls and reaching skeletal arms hang down from the walls and ceiling.

all_card.back_flavor: 一阵刺耳的吼叫在沼地回响，眼前浮动的景象泛起涟漪。你感到脚底一阵颤动，刚一扑到安全的地方，一只可怕的怪物就从地下猛地钻了出来。它一排排针尖样的细牙咬住了你刚刚还在的地方，眼睛转过来饥渴地寻找着你，可怕极了。
all_card.back_text: 将中央地点翻至[[沉没]]面，弃掉其所有标记和玩家卡牌附属。将放在一边的深沼之物敌人生成在此。
all_card.flavor: 光芒摇曳，景象浮动。沼地里满是鲜艳的花，也满是油光泛亮的透明倒影。
all_card.name: 地表下沉
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你逃出了沼地。 强制 - 在你的回合结束时，如果你在[[沼地]]地点：在你的地点放置1个伤害标记，作为渗坑(如果游戏中只有1或2位调查员，改为2个渗坑)。 强制 - 如果一个地点上有3个或更多渗坑：将其所有的渗坑移除，并将其翻面。
all_card.real_back_flavor: An ear-splitting roar resounds through the bog, followed by several ripples that roll through the floating landscape. You feel a low tremble below you, and dive to safety just before a horrible monstrosity erupts from below. Rows of thin, needle-sharp teeth gnash at the air where you just were, and ghastly stalks on eyes turn to regard you with hunger.
all_card.real_back_text: Flip the center location to its [[Sunken]] side, discarding all tokens and player card attachments. Spawn the set-aside Thing in the Depths enemy at it.
all_card.real_flavor: Light tremors ripple through the floating landscape. The bog is a fecund jungle of bright flowers and glassy, oily reflections.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You flee the bog. Forced – When your turn ends, if you are at a [[Bog]] location: Place 1 damage on your location, as a sinkhole (2 sinkholes instead if there are 1 or 2 investigators in the game). Forced – If a location has 3 or more sinkholes on it: Remove all sinkholes from it and flip it over.

all_card.back_flavor: 你刚躲开一只触手的抓攫，就又有两根卷须缠住了你的腿和脖子。臭气熏天的怪物钻到了你身下，滴着脓水，张开了大嘴。你拼命挣脱，从缠着你的触须上撕下了苔样的组织。突然一朵银花将这怪物吸引了过去。它放下你，去追逐新的猎物。你冲到岸边，在路旁昏死过去。
all_card.back_text: 幸存的每位调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 沼地翻腾起惊涛骇浪！
all_card.name: 沼地之物
all_card.text: 强制 在你的回合结束时，如果你在[[沼地]]地点：在你的地点放置1个伤害标记，作为渗坑(如果游戏中只有1或2位调查员，改为2个渗坑)。 强制 - 如果一个地点上有3个或更多渗坑：将其所有的渗坑移除，并将其翻面。 目标 - 如果深沼之物被击败，(→结局4)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As your sidestep to avoid a grasping tendril, two more wrap around your legs and neck. The noisome monstrosity emerges below you, slick with ichor, and opens its wide-angled mouth. You thrash wildly, and tear at the mossy tissue gathered around the tendrils holding you. A sudden movement of a silvery blossom turns the creature's attention away from you, and it drops you to follow its new prey. You spring back to the shoreline and collapse in a dead faint at the edge of the road.
all_card.real_back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: The bog rocks with towering waves!
all_card.real_text: Forced – When your turn ends, if you are at a [[Bog]] location: Place 1 damage on your location, as a sinkhole (2 sinkholes instead if there are 1 or 2 investigators in the game). Forced – If a location has 3 or more sinkholes on it: Remove all sinkholes from it and flip it over. Objective – If the Thing in the Depths is defeated, (→R4).

all_card.back_flavor: 你来到了沼地东北岸一个静静的圆池旁。野花堆上有一株银色的碱性花朵，很像将马奎兹博士吸引到毒堇岛的样本。你靠近的时候，花朵肿胀释放了一团孢子，然后又合上了。孢子有着芬芳的味道，仿佛丁香，但时间越久就越发苦涩。长花的土堆突然动了。一颗巨大的爬行类脑袋从水里钻出来，机灵的眼睛望着你，随即迅速游走了。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的鳄龟混种敌人生成在北岸地点。选择一个与鳄龟混种所在地点相邻的地点，在该地点生成1个放在一边的攫噬触须敌人。
将放在一边的其他每张攫噬触须敌人与遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 吸引马奎兹博士至此的样本可能就发源于沼地。你就是来干这个活的。
all_card.name: 植物勘察
all_card.text: 目标 - 当一轮结束时，在北岸地点的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。(参见剧本手册第28页的地点摆放示意图来确定北岸地点的位置。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: You come to a round still pond on the northeastern shore of the bog. Atop a mound of wildflowers is a silvery alkaloid blossom very much like the sample that drew Dr. Marquez to Hemlock Isle. When you approach, the blossom swells to release a cloud of spores, then closes. The scent of the spores is pleasant, almost like cloves, but grows bitter the longer it lingers. Suddenly the mound of flowers moves. A large reptilian head rises out of the water and looks at you with intelligent eyes before swiftly swimming away.
all_card.real_back_text:
Spawn the set-aside Chelydran Hybrid enemy at the North Shore location. Choose a location adjacent to Chelydran Hybrid's location and spawn 1 of the set-aside Grasping Tendril enemies at that location.
Shuffle each other set-aside Grasping Tendril enemy into the encounter deck along with the discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: The bog is supposedly the origin of the sample that drew Dr. Marquez to the island in the first place. You have your work cut out for you.
all_card.real_text: Objective – At the end of the round, investigators at the North Shore location may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. (See the Location Placement diagram on page 28 of the campaign guide for the North Short location.)

all_card.back_text:
你把这个爬行类动物逼到闪亮的池子里，它沉到泥浆下面，已经筋疲力尽。它咀嚼起一团花朵，你画了几张草图，记录下它正在发芽的甲壳。它背上的碱性花朵似乎在搏动。你取出剪子，打算采集样本。
如果是第一日，阅读下列内容。否则，(→结局1)。
“停下！”马奎兹博士叫道，“这花是寄生的。它现在已经是这生物构造的一部分了。不知道嵌得有多深。”她指着花朵粗壮的根茎：里面搏动着白色的粘液，仿佛脉搏。“如果花死了，宿主也会死的。”
(→结局2)(第30页)。
all_card.flavor: 那个大块头长着花像乌龟一样的生物正在移动。兴许你能将它赶到安全的地方。
all_card.name: 绝世发现
all_card.text: [free]在鳄龟混种所在地点的某个相邻地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：在本轮剩余时间内，将鳄龟混种的巡逻地点改成该地点。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：鳄龟混种所在地点每有一个重整状态的[[异形]]敌人，鳄龟混种受到1点伤害。 目标 - 当一轮结束时：如果鳄龟混种在起始地点，立即推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
You corner the reptilian creature in a shining pool, where it sinks into the mud, clearly exhausted. As it starts munching on a tangle of flowers, you take several sketches and notes of the thing's sprouting shell. The alkaloid blossom on its back seems to pulse. Producing a pair of shears, you prepare to take a sample.
If it is Day 1, read the following. Otherwise, (→R1).
"Stop!" Dr. Marquez shouts. "That flower is parasitic. It is now part of the creature's anatomy. There's no telling how deeply it's embedded." She points to the flower's thick translucent stem: vicious white fluid pumps through it like an artery. "If the flower dies, its host dies too."
(→R2) (page 30).
all_card.real_flavor: The large flowering turtle-like creature is on the move. Perhaps you can herd it to safety.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Investigators at a single location adjacent to Chelydran Hybrid's location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: For the remainder of the round, change Chelydran Hybrid's patrol location to that location. Forced – At the end of the enemy phase: Chelydran Hybrid takes 1 damage for each ready [[Abomination]] enemy at its location. Objective – At the end of the round, if the Chelydran Hybrid is at the Starting Location, immediately advance.

all_card.name: 廊桥
all_card.text: 强制 - 你调查廊桥时，揭示带有符号的标记后：抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: The pungent flowers small like honey and musk.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal a token with a symbol while investigating Covered Bridge: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: 平静的涟漪隐藏了深处邪恶的东西。
all_card.name: 开阔水域
all_card.text: 强制 - 你移动进入本地点后：抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: The calm ripples hide something sinister deep below.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you move into this location: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 深沼之物
all_card.text: 逃逸。猎手。庞大。反击。 深沼之物得到+5[per_investigator]生命值且不能进行趁乱攻击。 深沼之物移动时，其地点视为与每个[[沉没]]地点连接。 强制 - 深沼之物在[[沼地]]地点攻击后：治愈其2点伤害。
all_card.traits: 异形. 植物. 突变. 精英
all_card.real_text: Elusive. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Thing in the Depths gets +5 [per_investigator] health and cannot make attacks of opportunity. While Thing in the Depths is moving, its location is considered to be connected to each [[Sunken]] location. Forced – After Thing in the Depths attacks at a [[Bog]] location: Heal 2 damage from it.

all_card.name: 鳄龟混种
all_card.text: 冷漠。逃逸。巡逻(最近的无人地点)。 如果鳄龟混种所在地点有重整状态的[[异形]]敌人，或如果鳄龟混种与调查员交战，它不能移动。 强制 - 如果本敌人被击败，(→结局3)。
all_card.traits: 生物. 植物. 突变. 精英
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Elusive. Patrol (nearest empty location). Chelydran Hybrid cannot move if a ready [[Abomination]] enemy is at its location, or if it is engaged with an investigator. Forced – If this enemy is defeated, (→R3).

all_card.flavor: 说实话，无论底下那东西是什么，我们也就能想到“之物”来形容了。<cite>罗莎·马奎兹博士，米斯卡塔尼克勘察队，1926年。</cite>
all_card.name: 攫噬触须
all_card.text: 涌动。(黑夜[night])冷漠。 生成 - 鳄龟混种所在地点。 X为当前天数。
all_card.traits: 异形. 植物. 突变
all_card.real_flavor: Truthfully, 'Thing' was the best thing we could come up with to describe whatever was down there. – Dr. Rosa Marquez, Miskatonic Survey, 1926
all_card.real_text: Surge. (Night [night]) Aloof. Spawn - Chelydran Hybrid's location. X is the current day number.

all_card.flavor: 骇人的震颤之后是一群受惊的林中动物正在狂奔。
all_card.name: 地层扰动
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect]或[agility](4)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须受到1点伤害，或在最近的[[沼地]]地点放置1个伤害标记，作为渗坑。
all_card.real_flavor: The awful tremors are followed by a stampede of terrified forest creatures.
all_card.real_text: Revelation – Test [intellect] or [agility] (4). For each point you fail by, you must either take 1 damage or place 1 damage on the nearest [[Bog]] location, as a sinkhole.

all_card.name: 泥泞下沉
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果你位于…… -……[[沉没]]地点，受到1点直接伤害，并对你控制的每个[[盟友]]支援造成1点直接伤害。 -……[[沼地]]地点，在你的地点放置1个伤害标记，作为渗坑。
all_card.real_text: Revelation – If you are at a... - ...[[Sunken]] location, take 1 direct damage and deal 1 direct damage to each [[Ally]] asset you control. - ...[[Bog]] location, place 1 damage on your location, as a sinkhole.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为当前黑暗等级的两倍。
[cultist]：-3。如果你检定成功，治愈你调查员的1点伤害。
[tablet]：-4。找出躲避值最高且处于追击中的敌人。将它生成在你的地点。
[elder_thing]：-5。受到1点恐惧。
all_card.name: 扭曲空洞
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为当前的黑暗等级。
[cultist]：-1。治愈你调查员的1点伤害。
[tablet]：-3。如果你检定失败，找出躲避值最高且处于追击中的敌人。将它生成在你的地点。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is twice the current darkness level.
[cultist]: -3. If you succeed, heal 1 damage from your investigator.
[tablet]: -4. Find the enemy in pursuit with the highest evade. Spawn it at your location.
[elder_thing]: -5. Take 1 horror.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the current darkness level.
[cultist]: -1. Heal 1 damage from your investigator.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, find the enemy in pursuit with the highest evade. Spawn it at your location.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, take 1 horror.

all_card.back_text:
增加1资源到当前黑暗等级。如果当前黑暗等级为6+，并且你以剧本模式进行游戏，每位幸存的调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
否则，按照以下步骤执行：
- 将每个在[[黑暗]]地点且不与调查员交战的敌人放置到追击区域。
- 将所有未揭示的[[黑暗]]地点与树林牌库顶2张卡牌一同混洗，放置在树林牌库顶。将所有已揭示的无人[[黑暗]]地点翻至未揭示面，弃掉其所有标记。
- 从树林牌库顶将地点放置到每个有调查员的地点的上、下、左、右。
- 带有山谷提灯的调查员检定(willpower)(X)，其中X等于当前黑暗等级。如果该调查员检定失败，必须选择一个处于追击中的敌人，将其生成并与自己交战。
将本卡牌翻回密谋1a。
all_card.flavor: 寂静的森林中混杂着饥饿的生物发出的声响，还有来来回回梭巡不止的阴影。
all_card.name: 黑暗渐深
all_card.text: 强制 - 在地点揭示后：从树林牌库顶将地点放置到该地点的上、下、左、右。 强制 - 在调查阶段结束时：每位在[[黑暗]]地点的调查员必须抽取躲避值最高且处于追击中的敌人，或受到1点恐惧(不能被取消)。
all_card.real_back_text:
Add 1 resource to the current darkness level. If the current darkness level is 6+ and you are playing in Campaign Mode, each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
Otherwise, perform the following:
- Put each enemy at a [[Dark]] location and not engaged with an investigator into the pursuit area.
- Shuffle each unrevealed [[Dark]] location along with the top 2 cards of the Woods deck and place them on top of the Woods deck. Flip each revealed empty [[Dark]] location to its unrevealed side, discarding all tokens.
- Put locations from the top of the Woods deck into play above, below, to the left, and to the right of each location with an investigator.
- The investigator with the Vale Lantern tests [willpower] (X), where X is the current darkness level. If they fail, they must choose an enemy in the pursuit area to spawn engaged with them.
Flip this card back to agenda 1a.
all_card.real_flavor: The silent woods thrum with the sounds of hungry creatures and stalking shadows.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After a location is revealed: Put locations from the top of the Woods deck into play above, below, to the left, and to the right of that location. Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Each investigator at a [[Dark]] location must either draw an enemy in pursuit with the highest evade or take 1 horror (cannot be canceled).

all_card.flavor: 森林里肯定藏着伯蒂的踪迹或者线索。你只能祈祷自己没有太迟。
all_card.name: 冥思苦想
all_card.text: 每个没有生成指示的敌人获得“生成 - 在从遭遇牌库抽取本敌人时：将本敌人放置到追击区域。” 目标 - 当一轮结束时，如果所有调查员都在同一个[[巢穴]]地点，则可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_flavor: There must be some trace or clue of Bertie in these woods. You only hope you aren't already too late.
all_card.real_text: Each enemy without spawn instructions gains "Spawn - When this enemy is drawn from the encounter deck: Put this enemy in the pursuit area." Objective - At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same [[Lair]] location, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.name: 类熊混种
all_card.text: 生成 - ([codex]Σ)(第37页)。 猎手。反击。 类熊混种得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 在类熊混种将要被击败时，如果是场景2：不将其放入胜利区，改为治愈其全部伤害并放置到追击区域。
all_card.traits: 生物. 怪物. 突变. 精英
all_card.real_text: Spawn - ([codex] Σ) (page 37). Hunter. Retaliate. Ursine Hybrid gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When Ursine Hybrid would be defeated, if it is act 2: Heal all damage from it and put it in the pursuit area instead of the victory display.

all_card.back_flavor: “退后！”一个熟悉的声音紧张地叫道。松果从你耳边掠过。伯蒂在一棵大树树干的空洞中向外张望。“是你！”他激动地喊道，“我还以为我完了——但你来了！”他瞪大了眼睛，因为此时又一个熟悉的声音响彻空洞。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的伯蒂·马斯格雷夫剧情支援放置入场，置于任意调查员控制下。将每个未与调查员交战的敌人放置到追击区域。将除扭曲空洞之外的所有地点混洗入树林牌库，按照第36页的示意图放置入场。
查找所有的场上和场外区域，找出类熊混种敌人，治愈其全部伤害，并将其生成在扭曲空洞。将场景和密谋牌库推进到“回到山谷！”特殊密谋，将当前密谋的所有毁灭标记移动到“回到山谷！”。它既是当前场景也是当前密谋。
all_card.flavor: 你追随伯蒂的踪迹深入森林，四周的树木将你包围。
all_card.name: 伯蒂在哪儿？
all_card.text: [free]花费1个线索：查看一个相邻地点的已揭示面。 目标 - 找到伯蒂·马斯格雷夫。他迷失在森冷深处！(不要推进场景，直到你受到指示。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Stay back!" squeaks a familiar voice. A pinecone whizzes past your ear. Bertie peers out from a hollow in the massive trunk. "It's you!" he chirps excitedly. "I thought I was done for - but here you are!" His eyes go wide as a familiar wheezing roar echoes through the hollow.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put the set-aside Bertie Musgrave story asset into play under the control of any investigator. Put each unengaged enemy in the pursuit area. Shuffle each other location except for The Twisted Hollow location into the Woods deck and put them into play according to the diagram on page 36.
Search all in- and out-of-play areas for the Ursine Hybrid enemy, heal all damage from it, and spawn it at The Twisted Hollow. Advance the act and agenda deck to the "Back to the Vale!" special agenda, moving all doom from the current agenda to it. It is both the current act and the current agenda.
all_card.real_flavor: The trees close in as you follow Bertie's trail deeper into the forest.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Spend 1 clue: Look at the revealed side of an adjacent location. Objective - Find Bertie Musgrave. He is lost deep in the forest! (Do not advance until you are instructed.)

all_card.back_flavor: 森林围拢，空气里全是巨口滴涎、利牙咬切的声音。灌木中传来可怕的嚎叫，熟悉的气喘吁吁和刺耳的咳声都预示着巨熊逼近。
all_card.back_text: 增加1资源到当前黑暗等级。如果当前黑暗等级为6+，每位幸存的调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤(→结局2)(第38页)。 否则，按玩家顺序，每位玩家必须选择一个在追击区域中的敌人，将其生成在最近的[[黑暗]]地点。如果其不能这么做，则必须从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌，直到弃掉一个敌人，将其生成在最近的[[黑暗]]地点。 将本卡牌翻面。
all_card.flavor: 你带着伯蒂，必须找一条路回到毒堇谷。
all_card.name: 回到山谷
all_card.text: [free]横置山谷提灯或共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：查看一个相邻地点的已揭示面。你可以移动到该地点。 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退，(→结局1)(第38页)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The forest closes in and the sound of slavering jaws and gnashing fangs fills the air. A sickly howl calls out from the underbrush and the familiar sound of a wheezing, hacking cough telegraphs the bear's approach.
all_card.real_back_text: Add 1 resource to the current darkness level. If the current darkness level is 6, each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma (→R2) (page 38. Otherwise, in player order, each player must choose an enemy in the pursuit area and spawn it at the nearest [[Dark]] location. If they cannot, they must discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded and spawn it at the nearest [[Dark]] location. Flip this card.
all_card.real_flavor: With Bertie in tow, you must find your way back to Hemlock Vale.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Either exhaust the Vale Lantern or spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the revealed side of an adjacent location. You may move to that location. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, (→R1) (page 38).

all_card.name: 山谷提灯
all_card.text: 山谷提灯所在地点和每个连接地点失去[[黑暗]]特性。 [reaction]在你的地点的调查员移动进入并揭示[[森林]]地点时，横置山谷提灯：该调查员忽略该地点的强制效果。 强制 - 在山谷提灯将要离场时：改为将其翻面并放置在最近的地点。
all_card.traits: 道具. 工具. 点燃. 福祉
all_card.real_text: Vale Lantern's location and each connecting location lose the [[Dark]] trait. [reaction] When an investigator at your location moves into and reveals a [[Forest]] location, exhaust Vale Lantern: They ignore that location's forced effect(s). Forced - When Vale Lantern would leave play: Flip it over and place it at the nearest location, instead.

all_card.name: 山谷提灯
all_card.text: [action]：控制山谷提灯，然后将其翻面。山谷提灯所在地点的任意调查员均可以触发此能力。 强制 - 在山谷提灯将要离场时：改为将其放置在最近的地点。
all_card.traits: 道具. 工具. 熄灭. 福祉
all_card.real_text: [action]: Take control of Vale Lantern, then flip it over. Any investigator at Vale Lantern's location may trigger this ability. Forced - When Vale Lantern would leave play: Place it at the nearest location, instead.

all_card.name: 山谷提灯
all_card.text: 山谷提灯所在地点失去[[黑暗]]特性。 [action]横置山谷提灯：查看一个连接地点的已揭示面。你可以移动到该地点，忽略其强制效果。 强制 - 在山谷提灯将要离场时：改为将其翻面并放置在最近的地点。
all_card.traits: 道具. 工具. 点燃
all_card.real_text: Vale Lantern's location loses the [[Dark]] trait. [action] Exhaust Vale Lantern: Look at the revealed side of a connecting location. You may move to that location, ignoring its forced effect(s). Forced - When Vale Lantern would leave play: Flip it over and place it at the nearest location, instead.

all_card.name: 山谷提灯
all_card.text: [free]：控制山谷提灯，然后将其翻面。山谷提灯所在地点的任意调查员均可以触发此能力。 强制 - 在山谷提灯将要离场时：改为将其放置在最近的地点。
all_card.traits: 道具. 工具. 熄灭
all_card.real_text: [fast]: Take control of Vale Lantern, then flip it over. Any investigator at Vale Lantern's location may trigger this ability. Forced - When Vale Lantern would leave play: Place it at the nearest location, instead.

all_card.back_flavor: 这里的树木太过茂密，树干太过巨大，一点也不像新英格兰健康的木材。树木之间的小径铺满了柔软潮湿的苔藓，纠缠着经年累月的腐化物，实在是太安静了。<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《星之彩》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 似乎所有的植被、青草、树叶和花朵之类的东西都清清楚楚带着昏暗的光……<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《星之彩》</cite>
all_card.name: 荧光草地
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。“伯蒂肯定没事！” [action]：治愈1点恐惧。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The trees grew too thickly, and their trunks were too big for any healthy New England wood. There was too much silence in the dim alleys between them, and the floor was too soft with the dank moss and mattings of infinite years of decay.
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Colour Out of Space"
all_card.real_flavor:
A dim though distinct luminosity seemed to inhere in all the vegetation, grass, leaves, and blossoms alike...
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Colour Out of Space"
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. "I'm sure Bertie's fine!" [action]: Heal 1 horror. (Limit once per round.)
