all_card.text:
标记效果
忽略标记效果的敌人不触发标记的强制能力。 资源强制 - 在敌人将要通过关键词移动，且其所在地点和要移动进入的地点之间有1个或更多屏障时：移除这些屏障中的一个。取消该移动的效果。 恐惧强制 - 在敌人进入有诱饵的地点时：移除该诱饵。对该敌人造成1点伤害，使其与所有调查员解除交战，并将其横置。该敌人本轮剩余时间内不能重整。 伤害强制 - 在敌人进入有陷阱的地点时：移除该陷阱。对该敌人造成2点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Token Effects Enemies that ignore a token's effects do not trigger its Forced abilities. Resource Forced - When an enemy would move via a keyword and 1 or more barriers are between its location and the location it is moving to: Remove one of those barriers. Cancel the effects of the move. Horror Forced - When an enemy enters a location with a decoy: Remove the decoy. Deal 1 damage to that enemy, disengage it from each investigator, and exhaust it. That enemy cannot ready for the remainder of the round. Damage Forced - When an enemy enters a location with a trap: Remove the trap. Deal 2 damage to that enemy.

all_card.back_flavor: 黎明的第一抹阳光冲破了红紫的天空，盖过了群星。正当你面对即将到来的黎明，支离破碎的尸体堆上有个倒下的怪物又站了起来，向你冲来。你没时间反应了！
all_card.back_text: 调查员队长必须决定(选择一项)： - 每位未被击败的调查员承受1点精神创伤。 - 选择一位由调查员控制的居民。这位居民向前挡在了你和怪物的中间，牺牲了自己。在剧本日志中，将选中居民的名字划掉。在该位居民的备注部分，记录[居民名字]为调查员牺牲自己。 推进场景。
all_card.flavor: 你唯一的希望就是坚持到黎明。
all_card.name: 猛攻

all_card.real_back_flavor: The first rays of dawn send streaks of violet and crimson across the sky, blotting out the stars. As you face the oncoming dawn, a fallen monstrosity rises from a heap of mangled corpses to charge toward you. You barely have time to react!
all_card.real_back_text: The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - Each undefeated investigator suffers 1 mental trauma. - Choose a resident under an investigator's control. That resident steps between you and the monstrosity, sacrificing themselves. In the Campaign Log, cross out the chosen resident's name. In that Resident's notes, record [name] sacrificed themselves for the investigators. Advance the act.
all_card.real_flavor: Your only hope is to last until dawn.
all_card.real_text: When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it. all_card.back_text:
如果病俘上的伤害少于等于4点：
尽管怪物的猛攻看似无穷无尽，实际受到伤害的病俘并不算多。你仔细检查农庄内部的惨状，有些病俘手捂着脸哭泣，其他则怨恨地望着你。你要如何说服他们相信自己的生命值得拯救？
(→结局1)(第50页)。
否则：
农场已经成了埋尸地，遍布血污和脏器。面对猛攻的时候，许多病俘逃跑了、尖叫着，落入怪物的虎口。晨光映出的景象在你梦中逡巡不去。
(→结局2)(第50页)。
all_card.flavor: 你必须保护病俘！

all_card.real_back_name: By the Skin of Your Skin
all_card.real_back_text:
If 4 or fewer damage is on The Captives:
Despite the seemingly endless onslaught, relatively few of the captives were harmed. As you survey the wrecked interior of the farmhouse, some captives weep into their hands, and others look at you accusingly. How can you convince them that their lives were worth saving?
(→R1) (page 50).
Otherwise:
The farm is a charnel house of gore and viscera. When confronted with the onslaught, many of the captives ran, screaming, into the jaws of the monstrosities. The morning light illuminates a scene that will haunt your dreams.
(→R2) (page 50).
all_card.real_flavor: You must protect the captives!

all_card.name: 病俘
all_card.text: 敌军阶段期间，农庄每个处于重整状态且未与调查员交战的敌人会攻击病俘，如同与其交战。以此方式对病俘造成的恐惧改为造成伤害。 强制 - 在病俘剧情支援被击败时：(→结局3)(第50页)。
all_card.real_text: During the enemy phase, each ready, unengaged enemy at The Farmhouse attacks as though it were engaged with The Captives. Horror dealt to The Captives in this way is dealt as damage instead. Forced - When The Captives story asset is defeated: (→R3) (page 50).

all_card.real_text: Your first action each round does not provoke attacks of opportunity. [action] Exhaust Ajax: Move. Either move twice, or choose any [[Field]] location and move to it. [action] If Ajax is at your location: Take control of him. Any player at Ajax's location may trigger this ability.

all_card.name: 无尽夜晚
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 移除密谋上的1个毁灭标记。 - 对病俘剧情支援造成2点伤害。 - 受到3点直接伤害和3点直接恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Remove 1 doom from the agenda. - Deal 2 damage to The Captives story asset. - Take 3 direct damage and 3 direct horror.

all_card.name: 入侵
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](X)。X为场上毁灭标记数量的一半(向上取整)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，选择一个离农庄最近的不同的[[突变]]敌人，将其重整。每个所选敌人移动、交战并攻击，如同是敌军阶段。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (X). X is half the number of doom in play (rounded up). For each point you fail by, choose a different [[Mutated]] enemy nearest to The Farmhouse and ready it. Each chosen enemy moves, engages, and attacks as if it were the enemy phase.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为场上[[色彩]]敌人的数量。
[cultist]：-6。随机弃掉你1张手牌。
[tablet]：-8。你可以在你的调查员卡牌上放置1个毁灭标记，以将本标记的修正值改为视作-3。
[elder_thing]：-5。如果是对宇宙密使的攻击或躲避尝试，改为你自动失败。
all_card.name: 山谷的命运
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为当前场景编号+1。
[cultist]：-4。如果你检定失败，随机弃掉你1张手牌。
[tablet]：-5。你可以在你的调查员卡牌上放置1个毁灭标记，以将本标记的修正值改为视作0。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果是对宇宙密使的攻击或躲避尝试，再揭示一个标记。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of [[Colour]] enemies in play.
[cultist]: -6. Discard 1 card at random from your hand.
[tablet]: -8. You may place 1 doom on your investigator card to treat this token's modifier as -3, instead.
[elder_thing]: -5. If this is a fight or evasion attempt against Cosmic Emissary, you automatically fail instead.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the current act number.
[cultist]: -4. If you fail, discard 1 card at random from your hand.
[tablet]: -5. You may place 1 doom on your investigator card to treat this token's modifier as 0, instead.
[elder_thing]: -2. If this is a fight or evasion attempt against Cosmic Emissary, reveal another token.

all_card.back_flavor: 你感到脑子里有什么在低语，说着一种咔哒呼啦的古怪语言，还伴有诡异抑扬的乐声。但听起来又是那么熟悉。翻滚的云雾中显出一个身影向你而来。你的意识开始涣散，你忍不住大笑，你究竟忘了什么？那也不重要了。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员检定[willpower]或[intellect](4)。对于检定失败的调查员，每低于难度1点，其必须受到1点恐惧，或将其牌库顶的卡牌洗入深渊。
all_card.flavor: 漩涡一样的气体中闪烁着一个灰白的身影。
all_card.name: 寂灭
all_card.text: 如果你单次查看宇宙密使敌人超过15秒，你发疯。 强制 - 在你将要从遭遇牌库抽取卡牌时：改为从深渊底揭示卡牌，直到揭示了有遭遇卡牌牌背的卡牌，抽取该卡牌(揭示的其他卡牌全部放回深渊顶)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You feel whispers in your head, speaking an alien language of clicks and whirs and strange, lilting music. It sounds familiar. A vague shape emerges from the roiling mist and reaches out to you. As you feel your mind begin to empty, you can't help but laugh. What was it that you forgot, exactly? It must not matter.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator tests [willpower] or [intellect] (4). For each point they fail by, they must either take 1 horror or shuffle the top card of their deck into The Abyss.
all_card.real_flavor: A hoary shape flickers in spiraling gas.
all_card.real_text: If you look at the Cosmic Emissary enemy for more than 15 seconds at a time, you are driven insane. Forced - When you would draw 1 or more cards from the encounter deck: Instead, reveal cards from the bottom of The Abyss until a card with an encounter card back is revealed and draw it (all other revealed cards are placed on top of The Abyss).

all_card.back_flavor: 毒液从地上升腾，汇聚骇人的形体。你看到眼前出现了一个参差的晶状形体，一阵眩晕，向前栽倒。你呼吸着身边的毒气，觉得自己越来越虚弱。你的生命和勇气都被抽走了。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员检定[combat]或[agility](4)。对于检定失败的调查员，每低于难度1点，其必须受到1点伤害，或将其牌库顶的卡牌混洗入深渊。
all_card.flavor: 噩梦的身影在雾中聚拢。
all_card.name: 危险瘴气
all_card.text: 如果你单次查看宇宙密使敌人超过15秒，你发疯。 强制 - 在你将要从遭遇牌库抽取卡牌时：改为从深渊底揭示卡牌，直到揭示了有遭遇卡牌牌背的卡牌，抽取该卡牌(揭示的其他卡牌全部放回深渊顶)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Vapors rise from the ground, coalescing into harsh, corporeal shapes. A jagged, crystalline form juts out of the ground as you stumble forward in a daze. The longer you breathe the poisonous gas around you, the weaker you feel. Your life and vigor are being drained away.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator tests [combat] or [agility] (4). For each point they fail by, they must either take 1 damage or shuffle the top card of their deck into The Abyss.
all_card.real_flavor: Nightmarish shapes coalesce in the mist.
all_card.real_text: If you look at the Cosmic Emissary enemy for more than 15 seconds at a time, you are driven insane. Forced - When you would draw 1 or more cards from the encounter deck: Instead, reveal cards from the bottom of The Abyss until a card with an encounter card back is revealed and draw it (all other revealed cards are placed on top of The Abyss).

all_card.back_flavor:
起伏的空气停住了，化为千万个面庞、身影、形体。你肺里的空气都被抽走，你竭力呼吸，却发现自己被抽到了光柱里。光辉升入夜空，如同逆向的流星，将你周围的一切都化为尘土。树木枯萎消散，逃跑的野生动物都变成了骸骨和灰烬。你的身体已经升华，和毒堇岛上万事万物一起，升入了夺目的明光。
你终于知道了自己在永恒中的位置。
all_card.back_text: 毒堇岛的一切都被伟大升格变形。每位调查员被星之彩吞噬(它们都阵亡)。
all_card.flavor: 你眼中的景象像碎掉的玻璃一样折射四散。
all_card.name: 往升
all_card.text: 如果你单次查看宇宙密使敌人超过15秒，你发疯。 强制 - 在你将要从遭遇牌库抽取卡牌时：改为从深渊底揭示卡牌，直到揭示了有遭遇卡牌牌背的卡牌，抽取该卡牌(揭示的其他卡牌全部放回深渊顶)。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The rippling air stops, then churns into myriad faces, shapes, and forms. You struggle to breathe as the air is sucked out of your lungs and drawn into a pillar of light. The brilliance ascends into the night sky like a falling star in reverse, reducing everything around you to dust. Trees wither and desiccate, and fleeing wildlife are turned to bone and ash. Your body sublimates, rising into the blinding brilliance along with everything else on Hemlock Isle.
You have learned your place in infinity.
all_card.real_back_text: All of Hemlock Isle has been transfigured in the great ascendance. Each investigator is devoured by the Colour Out of Space (they are killed).
all_card.real_flavor: Your vision refracts like broken glass.
all_card.real_text: If you look at the Cosmic Emissary enemy for more than 15 seconds at a time, you are driven insane. Forced - When you would draw 1 or more cards from the encounter deck: Instead, reveal cards from the bottom of The Abyss until a card with an encounter card back is revealed and draw it (all other revealed cards are placed on top of The Abyss).

all_card.back_flavor: 你恢复了知觉，抬头看到了高高的星空和血月。也许你还能找到回地面的路。

all_card.back_flavor: 你站在马奎兹博士身边，脚下脱水的尸体已经堆成了山丘。深渊依然在你们头顶的寒风中闪烁。光辉勃发炫目，朦胧的人形身影朝你而来。“这可不妙。我们得阻止它。喂它点不能‘消化’的东西。”马奎兹博士严肃地说道。她交给你一个小包，里面装满了勘察笔记和样本：“我希望你拿着这个。”你问她为何。“得有人告诉阿米蒂奇教授这里的事情……”她眯起眼睛凝视闪烁的虹光，“……这里的星之彩。”
all_card.back_text: 调查员必须决定(选择一项)： - 让马奎兹博士执行她的计划(→结局1)(第66页)。 - 自己动手(→结局2)(第67页)。(只有有调查员控制了棱柱碎片剧情支援，你才可以选择此项。)
all_card.flavor: 马奎兹博士需要你的帮助才能拯救山谷！
all_card.name: 山谷的命运(版本一)
all_card.text: [reaction]你在自己回合期间在[[巢穴]]地点技能检定成功后：你检定成功且每超过难度1点，揭示深渊底的一张卡牌。抽取所有以此效果揭示的单面敌人。将揭示的其他每张卡牌从游戏中移除。 [free]花费1个线索：你本次技能检定得到技能值+2。 目标 - 当一轮结束时，如果所有幸存的调查员都在深渊，调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You stand next to Dr. Marquez at the base of a mound of desiccated bodies. Above, the Abyss flickers in the still, cold air. A hazy humanoid shape reaches toward you as the brilliance flares again, blindingly bright. "It's no good. We need to disrupt it. Feed it something it can't 'digest,'" Dr. Marquez says soberly. She hands you her satchel filled with survey notes and samples. "I want you to have this." You ask why. "Someone needs to tell Dr. Armitage the story of this..." her eyes narrow, staring up at the flickering iridescence. "...this colour out of space."
all_card.real_back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - Let Dr. Marquez carry out her plan (→R1) (page 66). - Do it ourselves (→R2) (page 67). (You may only choose this if an investigator controls Prismatic Shard story asset.)
all_card.real_flavor: Dr. Marquez needs your help to save the Vale!
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test at a [[Lair]] location during your turn: Reveal cards from the bottom of The Abyss for each point you succeed by. Draw each single-sided enemy card revealed by this effect. Remove each other revealed card from the game. [fast] Spend 1 clue: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. Objective - At the end of the round, if each surviving investigator is at The Abyss, investigators may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: “快上车！”车上的居民朝一群晕头转向的当地人招手。剩下的幸存者蜂拥向卡车和风吹雨打的自行车，一路向南边蜿蜒的道路而去。你经过废弃的港口时，村子中央射出纯粹的光柱，周围环绕着黏糊糊油腻腻的云雾。幸存者一行刚刚躲进南方的灯塔，一阵热浪就以飓风般的力量席卷了整座岛屿。
all_card.flavor: 你得跟狂乱的居民讲讲道理……或者打醒他们。
all_card.name: 山谷的命运(版本二)
all_card.text: [action]选择并弃掉你1张手牌：谈判。检定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，抽取你地点底下敌人面朝上的[[居民]]卡牌。你可以花费1[per_investigator]个线索以使其以横置状态放置入场。 目标 - 如果地点底下及场上都没有[[居民]]敌人，调查员可以共同花费所需的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Get in the truck!" A resident waves a crowd of dazed locals onto the vehicle. The remaining survivors pile into trucks and weather-beaten bikes and drive down the winding southern road. As you pass the dilapidated harbor, a pillar of pure light shoots up from the village center followed by an oily, viscous cloud. The train of survivors have just taken refuge in the southern lighthouse when a shockwave of hot air tears across the island with a hurricane force.
all_card.real_flavor: You'll have to either talk sense into the frenzied residents... or knock it out of them.
all_card.real_text: [action] Choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, draw the [[Resident]] card beneath your location, enemy side faceup. You may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues to put it into play exhausted. Objective - If no [[Resident]] enemies are beneath locations or in play, you may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
焰火射入空中，毒堇谷被烈烙吞没。毁灭的大火吞噬了乡野，但更夺目的还是飞旋的亮光和巨大的爆裂。红、黄、蓝三色的焰火砰砰地直插云霄，在夜空中炸响。
你和马奎兹博士跟剩下寥寥无几的幸存者一起，躲在了南边海岸一座摇摇晃晃的灯塔里。你透过烟熏火燎的窗子，看到烈焰包围的村子中央有一条细细的灰光射出，随即消散。一点小小的磷光跌入烈火，像一颗坠星。
all_card.flavor: 你要想阻止这一切，唯一的希望就是烧掉这座该死的岛，岛上的一切。
all_card.name: 山谷的命运(版本三)
all_card.text: [action]花费X[per_investigator]个线索：在你的地点放置X资源，作为引线(你可以花费5资源，或弃掉一个你控制的[[道具]]支援，以放置额外1引线)。 [action]如果你的地点的引线数量大于等于其隐藏值，移除其所有引线：抽取1张放在一边的“着火了！”诡计。(团队每个地点仅限一次。) 目标 - 在一轮结束时，如果场上有5张“着火了！”，立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Fireworks shoot up into the sky as Hemlock Vale is consumed in the blaze. The whizzing lights and loud crackles almost distract from the devastating inferno as it devours the landscape. Poms of red, yellow, and blue fireworks launch into the air to explode in the night sky.
You and Dr. Marquez join the few remaining survivors on a trek to the island's southern reach to take refuge in a crumbling lighthouse. As you watch the inferno from a smudged window, a thread of thin, gray light shoots up from the village center, then winks out. A small, phosphorescent light plummets back into the blaze like a fallen star.
all_card.real_flavor: Your only hope of stopping this thing is to burn this accursed island. All of it.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend X [per_investigator] clues: Place X resources on your location, as kindling (you may spend 5 resources or discard an [[Item]] asset you control to place 1 additional kindling). [action] If your location has kindling on it equal to or greater than its shroud value, remove all kindling from it: Draw 1 set-aside Fire! treachery. (Group limit once per location.) Objective - When the round ends, if there are 5 copies of Fire! in play, immediately advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
你带着为数不多的幸存者钻进希奥天蓝色的卡车，马奎兹博士就跟在后面。当地人尖叫着指引方向，让你住南开，沿着蜿蜒的小路到岛的最南端去。你们这一小群人个个因为肾上腺素激增而颤抖，都躲进了摇摇晃晃的灯塔。
你踏进灯塔前，回头看了一眼，眼前所见却让你永生难忘。山谷中射出纯粹的光柱，周围是黏糊糊油膩腻的云雾。强力的冲击撕扯了岛屿，你被迫跪下，精疲力竭，仿佛自己经历的年岁都在这一刻被偷走了。炫目的光芒刺穿了平流层，射入星空，这一幕震慑得你动弹不得。
all_card.flavor: 你必须逃出生天！
all_card.name: 山谷的命运(版本四)
all_card.text: [action]如果达成下列至少5项(调查员找到了汽油、调查员找到了希奥的卡车、前路已通、勘察笔记已找回、伯蒂逃走、 已找到样本)：撤退。你逃出了山谷。 目标 - 逃命！如果所有未被击败的调查员都已撤退，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
With Dr. Marquez in tow, you gather the few survivors that remain and pile into Theo's sky blue truck. The locals shout directions as you drive south down a winding road to the southernmost point of the island. Shaking from the adrenaline, your small band of survivors takes refuge in the crumbling lighthouse.
Before you enter, you turn to see a sight you will never forget. A pillar of pure light shoots up from the Vale, drawing the oily viscous cloud in its wake. A shockwave tears across the island, and you fall to your knees, exhausted, as though years of your life were stolen from you in a single moment. You are transfixed by the dazzling light as it launches up through the stratosphere and into space.
all_card.real_flavor: You must escape with your lives!
all_card.real_text: [action] If at least 5 of the following are true (the investigators found gas, the investigators found Theo's truck, the road is clear, the survey notes were recovered, Bertie is fleeing, the samples were found): Resign. You flee the Vale. Objective - Escape with your lives! If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.real_back_flavor: I was the sun, I was the shining sun in that perfect day, illuminating and whole and full and everyone laid in the tall grass and we prepared for the great ascension and she spoke and told us who we would become who we truly were...

all_card.real_back_flavor: I was the sun, I was the shining sun in that perfect day, illuminating and whole and full and everyone laid in the tall grass and we prepared for the great ascension and she spoke and told us who we would become who we truly were...

all_card.real_text: Mirror Nest is connected to the location in the clockwise and counter-clockwise directions. Forced - When you end your turn at this location: Discard 1 card at random from your hand. [action] Spend 7 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Search The Abyss for a card and draw it. (Group limit once per act.)

all_card.name: 深渊
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你进入深渊时，如果深渊中有卡牌：你阵亡。 敌军阶段期间，每个在深渊的[[破碎]]敌人失去冷漠。 深渊必须一直盖在深渊牌库顶。
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you enter The Abyss, if there are cards in The Abyss: You are killed. During the enemy phase, each [[Shattered]] enemy at The Abyss loses aloof. The Abyss always covers the top of The Abyss deck.

all_card.name: 深渊
all_card.text: 这张卡牌必须一直盖在深渊顶。 卡牌总是从深渊底抽取、揭示。在弃掉非弱点遭遇卡牌时，总是将其放在深渊顶。 强制 - 在你从深渊抽取卡牌时，如果该卡牌是…… - ……诡计或敌人：将其抽取。 - ……[[居民]]卡牌：将其翻至敌人面，该卡牌获得“显现 - 本敌人攻击你(不与你交战)。弃掉本敌人。” - ……玩家卡牌：将其加入所有者的手牌。 - ……地点：将其放置入场，未揭示面朝上，与最近的镜巢相邻(如可能，与尚未和[[洞穴]]地点连接的最近的镜巢相邻)。本场冒险剩余时间内，这两个地点互相连接。 - ……任意调查员“真正的”调查员卡牌：其所有者治愈全部的伤害和恐惧，并控制该卡牌。然后，该调查员将其破碎自我调查员卡牌翻至旧时记忆面，放置入场，由自己控制。
all_card.real_text: This card must always cover the top of The Abyss. Cards are always drawn and revealed from the bottom of The Abyss. When a non-weakness encounter card is discarded, it is always placed on top of The Abyss. Forced - When you draw a card from The Abyss, if that card is ... - ...a treachery or an enemy: Draw it. - ...a [[Resident]] card: Flip it to its enemy side. It gains "Revelation - This enemy attacks you (without engaging you). Discard this enemy." - ...a player card: Add it to its owner's hand. - ...a location: Put it into play, unrevealed, adjacent to the nearest Mirror Nest (that is not already connected to a [[Cave]] location, if able). For the remainder of this scenario, the two locations are connected to one another. - ...any investigator's "true" investigator card: Its owner heals all damage and horror and takes control of it. Then, they flip their Shattered Self investigator card to its Old Memory side and put it into play under their control.

all_card.name: 水晶仿体
all_card.text: 逃逸。猎手。 你攻击或躲避本敌人时，X为你的手牌数。否则，X为6。 强制 - 水晶仿体攻击你后：随机弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_text: Elusive. Hunter. While you are fighting or evading this enemy, X is the number of cards in your hand. Otherwise, X is 6. Forced - After Crystal Mimic attacks you: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.name: 升华
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定失败，你必须决定(选择一项)： - 你检定失败且每低于难度1点，选择你1张手牌放到深渊顶。 - 最近的宇宙密使敌人攻击你(即便它不在你的地点)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, you must decide (choose one): - For each point you fail by, choose 1 card in your hand to place on top of The Abyss. - The nearest Cosmic Emissary enemy attacks you (even if it is not at your location).

all_card.name: 碎裂
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，你必须决定(选择一项)： - 选择你游戏区域内印刷费用最高的支援，将其放到深渊顶。 - 最近的宇宙密使敌人攻击你(即便它不在你的地点)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, you must decide (choose one): - Choose the asset in your play area with the highest printed cost and place it on top of The Abyss. - The nearest Cosmic Emissary enemy attacks you (even if it is not at your location).

all_card.flavor:
“要寻真心/枯疫中请/
众人降临/至纯光明。”<cite>《彼岸之地》，狂喜之歌第235号</cite>
all_card.name: 狂喜
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](4)。你必须受到2点恐惧，或将一个你控制的非剧情支援放到深渊顶。如果你检定失败，执行两者。
all_card.real_flavor:
"There is a heart / Within the blight /
We'll all go down / To purest light."
 - "The Lands Beyond", Songs of Bliss no. 235
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (4). You must either take 2 horror, or place a non-story asset you control on top of The Abyss. If you fail, do both.

all_card.back_text: 森林的晚上好热闹。 生灵众多真奇妙，有大也有小。
all_card.name: 第一日
all_card.text: 新的朋友已来到，毒堇谷的欢迎不得了。
all_card.real_back_text: In which the forest comes alive with many creatures, great and small.
all_card.real_text: In which we welcome new friends to Hemlock Vale.

all_card.flavor: “大多数生物的外形和移动都异于寻常……”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《星之彩》</cite>
all_card.name: 虫群
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，必须失去1资源或受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor:
"Most of the creatures seemed not quite usual in their aspects and motions..."
 - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Colour Out of Space"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 resource or take 1 damage.

all_card.back_text: 宇宙何等广袤，我们位置已知晓。
all_card.name: 第二日
all_card.text: 大雨倾盆当头浇，盛宴还得准备好。
all_card.real_back_text: In which we remember our place in the cosmos.
all_card.real_text: In which we prepare for the Feast under a blanket of rain.

all_card.flavor: “……大雨如注，目不可视，不得不找一个躲避的地方。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《潜伏的恐惧》</cite>
all_card.name: 大雨倾盆
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须失去1个行动，或将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。
all_card.real_flavor:
"...there descended such a blinding sheet of torrential rain that shelter became imperative."
 - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Lurking Fear"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 action or place 1 of your clues on your location.

all_card.back_text: 摆脱现世的囚牢， 迎接无穷的怀抱。
all_card.name: 第三日
all_card.text: 盛宴终于来到，我们欢笑， 共庆新面貌。
all_card.real_back_text: In which we take our place in infinity.
all_card.real_text: In which we celebrate the joy of transfiguration.

all_card.flavor: 吾为眼全尽之眼
all_card.name: 异界幻象
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果你所在地点有[[色彩]]敌人，本次检定难度+2。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须受到1点恐惧，或弃掉你随机1张手牌。
all_card.real_flavor: I am the eyes I am all eyes that see
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). This test gets +2 difficulty if there is a [[Colour]] enemy at your location. For each point you fail by, you must either take 1 horror or discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 伯蒂气喘吁吁地跑了过来。“马奎兹博士要你马上过去。”他上气不接下气地打断了你刚才正在进行的对话，“相信我，你去晚了她可不会高兴。”
all_card.back_text: 所有调查员撤退(→结局1)(第9页)。
all_card.flavor: 米斯卡塔尼克勘察队待在毒堇谷里为今天的探险做准备。当地居民越信任你，你就越能理解毒堇谷的本性。
all_card.name: 欢迎来到毒堇谷！
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你抽取弱点时：取消其显现效果，将其弃掉。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Bertie approaches, absolutely winded. "Dr. Marquez requests your immediate presence," he huffs, butting into your conversation. "And believe me, she will not like it if you're late at all."
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator resigns (→R1) (page 9).
all_card.real_flavor: The Miskatonic Survey is staying in Hemlock Vale and making preparations for today's expedition. The more the locals trust you, the better you will understand the nature of Hemlock Isle.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you draw a weakness: cancel its revelation effect and discard it.

all_card.back_text:
如果你在进行“欢迎来到毒堇谷！”前奏时或之后翻面本场景，阅读以下内容：
空气中的甜腻和晃动的色彩压得你喘不过气。你的脉搏一阵加速，手臂上起了鸡皮疙瘩。皮肤也一阵刺痛，仿佛有什么看不见的东西正在拂过。你并非孤身一人，你从来都不是。但和你在一起的人就是你，和你，和你，和你和你和和和和 你发现自己盯着一碧如洗的天空，昏头转向，沉迷在一片困惑之中。
你(且只有你)取得1点奖励经验值。(不要花费，直到剧本手册有所指示。)
all_card.flavor: 整个村子都喜气洋洋！孩子们戴着动物面具在路边玩耍，其他人则忙着把鲜艳扎眼的花朵挂在屋檐和篱笆上。
all_card.name: 第一日黎明
all_card.text: 调查员不能受到伤害/恐惧，也不能被击败。 目标 - 和当地人交上朋友，为你的第一次勘察做好准备！(有关前奏的更多信息，参见剧本手册第6页。)
all_card.real_back_text:
If you flipped this act while or after playing the Dawn of the First Day prelude, read the following:
The sweetness of the air and the vibrant colors are overwhelming. Your pulse is electric as gooseflesh creeps up your arm and your skin prickles, almost as if under an invisible caress. You are not alone, you never were alone, but the one who is with you is you, and you, and you, and you, and you and you and and and and You catch yourself staring up at the glassy sky, bewildered and drunk with wonder.
You (and only you) earn 1 bonus experience. (do not spend it until instructed.)
all_card.real_flavor: The village brims with excitement! Children play along the roadside wearing animal masks, while others hang gaudy flowers on eaves and along fences.
all_card.real_text: Investigators cannot take damage/horror or be defeated. Objective - Befriend the locals and prepare for the first survey! (Refer to the rules on page 6 for more information on preludes)

all_card.back_flavor: 你又回到了旅舍。奥姆斯德夫人摆出了丰富的一餐：热腾腾的玉米面包，上面还涂了黄油；有你拳头大的烤萝卜；还有油滴滴的灰蛋。你没有吃自己那份，而是小口啃起了干粮，肚子咕咕叫抗议起来。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志： - 如果伯蒂获救，(→结局1)(第42页)。 - 否则，(→结局2)(第42页)。
all_card.flavor: 头顶响起了雷，吓人的云看着就要下雨了。当地人都忙着做准备。
all_card.name: 乌云
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你抽取弱点时：取消其显现效果，将其弃掉。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You reconvene back the boarding house. Ms. Olmstead lays out a spread of warm buttered cornbread, roasted radishes the size of your fist, and a pile of grey oily eggs. Your stomach growls as you nibble on some of your field rations rather than partake.
all_card.real_back_text: Check the campaign log: If Bertie was rescued, (→R1) (page 42). Otherwise, (→R2) (page 42).
all_card.real_flavor: Dreary clouds threaten rain as thunder rumbles overhead. Locals bustle about making preparations.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you draw a weakness: cancel its revelation effect and discard it.

all_card.back_text:
如果你在进行“第二个黎明”前奏时或之后翻面本场景，阅读以下内容：
你正在村子里走着，突然一阵头晕目眩，脚下打滑，不得不伸出手来撑着身子。你在一堆镜子的边角上割破了手掌，痛叫出声。就在这时，天上下起了瓢泼大雨。
([codex]17)(第42页)。
all_card.flavor: 尽管天气不佳，村子里还是喜气洋洋，决心做好准备。
all_card.name: 第二个黎明
all_card.text: 调查员不能受到伤害/恐惧，也不能被击败。 目标 - 跟当地人聊聊，再多了解一些毒堇岛！
all_card.real_back_text:
If you flipped this act while or after playing the Dawn of the Second Day prelude, read the following:
As you walk through the village, a wave of dizziness washes over you and you stumble forward, putting your hand out to steady yourself. You cut your palm on the corner of a stack of mirrors and cry out in pain as thick, heavy raindrops begin to fall.
([codex] 17) (page 42).
all_card.real_flavor: The village continues preparations with cheery resolve, despite the dour weather.
all_card.real_text: Investigators cannot take damage/horror or be defeated. Objective - Talk to the locals and learn more about Hemlock Isle!

all_card.name: 毒堇诅咒
all_card.subname: 无尽饥饿/回声悠悠/凋零血肉/多节增生
all_card.text: 本技能的图标不加入你的技能值，改为减去。 如果本次技能检定失败，弃掉你手里的每张卡牌。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时，如果毒堇诅咒在你手中：随机弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_text: This skill's icons subtract from your skill value instead of adding to it. If this skill test fails, discard each card in your hand. Forced - At the end of your turn, if The Hemlock Curse is in your hand: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.back_text:
检查剧本日志。如果伯蒂见证了显灵：
你正在旅舍跟马奎兹博士商量，伯蒂过来的时候眼神里透着狂热，他居然还穿着山谷的白金色长袍。“我决定今天参加盛宴了——一整天。我明白这样有损我的评定，但是……”马奎兹博士还没来得及骂他，这小伙子就已经穿过一群舞者溜了。
(→结局2)(第54页)。
否则：
你正在旅舍跟马奎兹博士商量，伯蒂朝你们走了过来，看上去挺高兴。“我知道毒堇岛一点内情，这里的食物链一团乱。猎手被猎物捕食了————太有想象力了，不是吗？这种狂乱是由食物或者水里的什么东西引起的——其实这整场庆典都是某种狂乱。”他指着疯狂的人影和跳舞的孩子说道。
(→结局1)(第54页)。
all_card.flavor: 山谷里的人跳起舞来简直有一种躁狂的能量。空气中满是骚乱的音乐和甜腻的香水味。
all_card.name: 爱意满满
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你抽取弱点时：取消其显现效果，将其弃掉。
all_card.real_back_text:
Check the Campaign Log. If Bertie had an epiphany:
You reconvene with Dr. Marquez at the Boarding House. Bertie approaches you with a manic gleam in his eye, wearing the white-gold cloak of the Vale. "I've decided to join the Feast today - for the whole day. I understand this may put my grant in jeopardy but -" Before Dr. Marquez can chastise him, the young man scampers off past a throng of dancers.
(→R2) (page 54).
Otherwise:
You reconvene with Dr. Marquez at the Boarding House. Bertie approaches you and the professor with obvious excitement. "I've had a revelation about Hemlock Isle. The food chain is chaos. Predators predated by prey - poetic, isn't it? Something in the food or water induces a frenzy - in fact, this entire celebration is kind of frenzy," he gestures to the giddy figures and dancing children.
(→R1) (page 54).
all_card.real_flavor: The people of the Vale dance with an almost manic energy. Riotous music and a sweet perfume scent hang in the air.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you draw a weakness: Cancel its revelation effect and discard it.

all_card.back_text:
如果你在进行“最后一个黎明”前奏时或之后翻面本场景，阅读以下内容：
你说不出你怎么知道你为什么在这儿你在这儿是为了看看为了见见为了知道为了感知为了感受为了理解为了在心里放下宇宙的真相就是你不过是无穷明光中的一粒尘土任何一点气流都能让你旋飞湮灭任何一点动作都能让你不复存在若是如此为何你还要找寻明光为何你要长久地凝视群星耀眼炫目的光明
你必须承受1点精神创伤，或者查找收藏，随机找出一张基础[[疯狂]]弱点，并加入自己牌库。这张卡牌不计入你的牌库卡牌张数。你取得2点奖励经验值。
all_card.flavor: 所有的事物都蒙上了一层美丽的光芒，照映了你周围的空气。
all_card.name: 最后一个黎明
all_card.text: 目标 - 跟当地人聊聊，享受盛宴。
all_card.real_back_text:
If you flipped this act while or after playing the Dawn of the Final Day prelude, read the following:
you cannot say why but you know why you are here you are here to watch to see to know to perceive to feel to understand to hold in your heart the truth of the cosmos which is that you are but a mote of dust in the brilliant light of infinity and that a single puff of air will send you spiraling into oblivion a single moment and you will cease to be if you even ever were why did you look into the brilliance why did you stare so long at the shining blinding brightness of the stars
You must either suffer 1 mental trauma or search the collection for a random basic [[Madness]] weakness and add it to your deck. It does not count toward your deck size. You earn 2 bonus experience.
all_card.real_flavor: A beautiful sheen hangs over everything, shimmering in the air around you.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Talk to the locals and prepare yourself for the Feast.

all_card.back_flavor: 巨像周围的空气中漂浮着孢子，点亮了镜子，让整场节日沐浴在幻境之光中。你呼吸之间，觉得嘴里和喉咙里充满了轻轻的刺痛。你昏过去之前，还记得最后的声响就是轻快的长笛和手鼓声。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤或1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 狂欢的赴宴之人跟着刺耳的音乐共舞，其他人则在一盘盘油腻的食物旁大口饕餮。游客和当地人都笑得要死，剩下人则用手抠着自己的眼睛。他们个个都戴着愉快的大笑。
all_card.name: 围坐桌边
all_card.text: 目标 - 直面蕾切尔嬷嬷！如果蕾切尔嬷嬷被击败：(→结局1)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Glowing spores hang in the air around the effigy, lighting up the mirrors and bathing the festival in a faerie glow. You breathe in and feel your mouth and throat buzz with a light, tingling sensation. The last thing you hear as you pass out is the sound of lilting flutes and tambourines.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental or 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: Revelers dance to raucous music while others gorge themselves on rank platters of oily food. Visitors and locals alike collapse in fits of laughter while others claw at their eyes. Each of them wear a wild, gleeful smile.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Confront Mother Rachel! If Mother Rachel is defeated: (→R1).

all_card.back_flavor:
“很好。”蕾切尔嬷嬷对你说道。头顶的天空光线四溢，最后一位山谷的居民也忠顺地来到了桌边自己的位置。有人带着怨恨的表情望着你，自然是觉得被你背叛。你正上前揣测自己该坐在桌边哪里，蕾切尔嬷嬷上来挡住了你。
“你的位置不是跟我们在一起。你是荣誉贵客。”她笑道。你感到后脑勺一下重击，然后就什么也感受不到了。
all_card.back_text: 所有调查员撤退。
all_card.flavor: 你要把蕾切尔嬷嬷的“羊群”赶到他们桌边的位置上，无论他们愿不愿意。
all_card.name: 待宰羔羊
all_card.text: 你不能触发[codex]抄本条目。 [reaction]你成功躲避[[居民]]敌人，且超过难度至少2点后：将其加入胜利区。 目标 - 如果有1[per_investigator]+1张[[居民]]卡牌在胜利区，(→结局3)(第60页)。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"Well done," Mother Rachel says to you. Lights dance in the sky overhead as the last of the Vale residents are led dutifully to their place at the table. Some look at you with rueful expressions, rightfully betrayed. As you move to assume your place at the table, Mother Rachel steps in your way.
"It is not your place to sit with us. You are our guest of honor," she smiles. You feel a sharp blow to the back of your head, and then nothing.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator resigns.
all_card.real_flavor: You must gather Mother Rachel's flock, willing or not, to their place at the table.
all_card.real_text: You cannot trigger [codex] codex entries. [reaction] After you evade a [[Resident]] enemy by 2 or more: Add them to the victory display. Objective - If 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] [[Resident]] cards are in the victory display, (→R3) (page 60).

[reaction] After you successfully evade a [[Shattered]] enemy at The Crossroads by 3 or more, if the current act is Fate of the Vale (v.IV): Remember that "the road is clear."

all_card.flavor: 这教堂就像童话故事里出来的一样。
all_card.name: 毒堇教堂
all_card.text: [action]：你走向山丘顶端掩埋在植被之下的教堂([codex]11)。 [action]：查找你牌库顶9张卡牌，找出一张[[法术]]卡牌并将其抽取。混洗你的牌库。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: The chapel looks like something out of a storybook.
all_card.real_text: [action]: You approach the overgrown chapel at the top of the hill ([codex] 11). [action]: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] card and draw it. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 毒堇教堂
all_card.text: 强制 - 在毒堇教堂上最后的线索被发现后：在场上每个地点放置1个线索。(每场游戏最多一次。) [action]：治愈1点恐惧。将你弃牌堆中一张[[法术]]卡牌返回你的手牌。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from Hemlock Chapel: Place 1 clue on each location in play. (Max once per game.) [action]: Heal 1 horror. Return a [[Spell]] card from your discard pile to your hand. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor: 清晨的微风给山谷带来了鲁冰花、紫菀、欧蓍和草甸的清新气味。
all_card.name: 老磨坊
all_card.text: [reaction]你发现老磨坊的线索后：([codex]12)。
all_card.real_flavor: The morning breeze carries the fresh scent of lupines, asters, yarrow, and meadowsweet into the Vale.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you discover a clue at The Old Mill: ([codex] 12).

all_card.name: 老磨坊
all_card.text: [action]：检定[agility](8)。如果你检定成功，治愈2点伤害(如果你检定失败，你可以花费2[per_investigator]个线索以改为自动成功)。然后，如果当前场景为山谷的命运(版本四)，记住“已找到样本”。
all_card.real_text: [action]: Test [agility] (8). If you succeed, heal 2 damage (if you fail you may spend 2 [per_investigator] clues to automatically succeed instead). Then, if the current act is Fate of the Vale (v.IV), remember that "the samples were found."

all_card.flavor: 老宅阴森的正面还透露着过去的辉煌。当地人似乎都绕着这儿走。
all_card.name: 阿特伍德宅
all_card.text: [action]：你接近了这座老宅([codex]13)。
all_card.real_flavor: The dour façade of the old house carries a hint of its former glory. The locals seem to avoid the property.
all_card.real_text: [action]: You approach the old homestead ([codex] 13).

all_card.name: 阿特伍德宅
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你调查阿特伍德宅时，技能检定失败后：受到1点恐惧。 [action]：检定[willpower](8)。如果你检定成功，治愈2点恐惧(如果你检定失败，你可以花费2[per_investigator]个线索以改为自动成功)。然后，如果当前场景为山谷的命运(版本四)，记住“勘察笔记已找回”。
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating The Atwood House: Take 1 horror. [action]: Test [willpower] (8). If you succeed, heal 2 horror (if you fail, you may spend 2 [per_investigator] clues to automatically succeed instead). Then, if the current act is Fate of the Vale (v.IV), remember that "the survey notes were recovered."

all_card.flavor: 杂货店里一阵熙熙攘攘，当地人和游客都在为即将到来的盛宴准备东西。
all_card.name: 泰德杂货店
all_card.text: [action]：谈判。你跟当地人讨价还价，一边聊了起来。([codex]14)。
all_card.real_flavor: The general store is abustle with locals and visitors buying up supplies for the coming Feast.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Parley. You haggle for goods and chat with the locals ([codex] 14).

all_card.flavor: 商店里传出一阵腐败的恶臭。
all_card.name: 泰德杂货店
all_card.text:
泰德杂货店的敌人得到+1攻击值。
[reaction]在一个引线放置到本地点后：额外放置1个引线。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: A putrid stench wafts out of the emporium.
all_card.real_text:
Enemies at Tad's General Store get +1 fight.
[reaction] After a kindling is placed on this location: Place 1 additional kindling. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.flavor: 学校旁有几条路通往毒堇岛南端。
all_card.name: 山谷学校
all_card.text: [action]：你在学校的图书馆里仔细翻阅([codex]15)。 [action]：查找你的牌库，找出一张[[书籍]]支援并将其抽取。混洗你的牌库。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: Several roads lead past the schoolhouse toward Hemlock Isle's southern point.
all_card.real_text: [action]: You peruse the school library ([codex] 15). [action]: Search your deck for a [[Tome]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor: 学校旁有萤火虫飞舞。
all_card.name: 山谷学校
all_card.text:
山谷学校的敌人得到+1躲避值。
[action]：检定[willpower]或[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，治愈本地点的一位调查员或一个[[盟友]]支援1点伤害或1点恐惧。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_flavor: Fireflies dance in the air around the schoolhouse.
all_card.real_text:
Enemies at Vale Schoolhouse get +1 evade.
[action]: Test [willpower] or [agility] (3). If you succeed, heal 1 damage or 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at this location. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.flavor: 这幢长屋大概有谷仓大，举办了山谷中许多聚餐、舞会和社区活动。
all_card.name: 集会厅
all_card.text: [action]：你在村子的社群大厅里仔细检查，想找出当地是怎么和外面互通有无的([codex]16)。
all_card.real_flavor: The long barn-sized building is host to many dinners, dances, and community events in the Vale.
all_card.real_text: [action]: You inspect the communal hall and check out the local delivery service ([codex] 16).

all_card.name: 集会厅
all_card.text:
敌人移动时，其所在地点视为与集会厅连接。
[action]：检定[intellect](3)，然后检定[combat](2)，然后检定[agility](1)。如果你这些检定都成功，获得5资源。然后，如果当前场景为山谷的命运(版本四)，记住“调查员找到了希奥的卡车”。
all_card.real_text:
While an enemy is moving, its location is considered to be connected to The Commons.
[action]: Test [intellect] (3), then [combat] (2), then [agility] (1). If you succeed at each of these tests, gain 5 resources. Then, if the current act is Fate of the Vale (v.IV), remember that "the investigators found Theo's truck."

all_card.flavor: 这块石头已经磨平了。
all_card.name: 忘忧石
all_card.text:
快速。
[reaction]在冒险卡牌效果从你手中弃掉忘忧石时：抽取3张卡牌。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
all_card.traits: 道具. 守护. 祝福
all_card.real_flavor: The stone is worn and smooth.
all_card.real_text:
Fast.
[reaction] When a scenario card effect discards Worry Rock from your hand: Draw 3 cards. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor: 一个传统的阿本拿基部落娃娃，样子很像蕾切尔嬷嬷。
all_card.name: 玉米壳娃娃
all_card.text:
快速。使用(3祝愿)。
[reaction]在你的地点揭示[skull]或[tablet]标记时，花费1祝愿并横置玉米壳娃娃：改为将该标记视为[cultist]标记。
all_card.real_flavor: A traditional Abenaki doll made to look like Mother Rachel.
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Uses (3 wishes).
[reaction] When a [skull] or [tablet] token is revealed at your location, spend 1 wish and exhaust Corn Husk Doll: Treat that token as a [cultist] token instead.

all_card.name: 珀尔日记
all_card.text: (白日[day])你得到+1[intellect]。(黑夜[night])你得到+1[willpower]。 [reaction]你所在地点的调查员从遭遇牌库抽取[[枯疫]]或[[力量]]卡牌后，横置珀尔日记：该调查员抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: (Day [day]) You get +1 [intellect]. (Night [night]) You get +1 [willpower]. [reaction] After an investigator at your location draws a [[Blight]] or [[Power]] card from the encounter deck, exhaust The Pearl Diary: That investigator draws 1 card.

all_card.back_flavor: 下行许久之后，我发现岔路和地洞从未知的黢黑阴暗之处通向这座阴森神秘的深井。<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《魔节》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 这条道路看起来足够安全了……是吗？
all_card.name: 干燥地洞
all_card.text: (白日[day])[free]：移动(至一个连接地点)。(团队每轮仅限一次。) (黑夜[night])强制 - 你在干燥地洞结束回合后：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
After more aeons of descent I saw some side passages or burrows leading from unknown recesses of blackness to this shaft of nighted mystery.
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Festival"
all_card.real_flavor: The open paths seem safe enough... but are they?
all_card.real_text: (Day [day]) [fast] : Move (to a connecting location). (Group limit once per round.) (Night [night]) Forced - After you end your turn in Dry Burrow: Take 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 下行许久之后，我发现岔路和地洞从未知的黢黑阴暗之处通向这座阴森神秘的深井。<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《魔节》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 岩柱参差不齐，四周氤氲着红色的毒气。
all_card.name: 碱性柱丛
all_card.text: 强制 - 你揭示碱性柱丛后：你必须受到1点直接恐惧，或随机弃掉你2张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
After more aeons of descent I saw some side passages or burrows leading from unknown recesses of blackness to this shaft of nighted mystery.
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Festival"
all_card.real_flavor: The rock formations resemble a jagged grove, wreathed in poisonous red gas.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Alkaline Forest: You must either take 1 direct horror, or discard 2 cards at random from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 下行许久之后，我发现岔路和地洞从未知的黢黑阴暗之处通向这座阴森神秘的深井。<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《魔节》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 镜样的墙壁倒映出你破碎的面庞。
all_card.name: 虹彩通道
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你调查虹彩通道时，技能检定失败后：选择并弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
After more aeons of descent I saw some side passages or burrows leading from unknown recesses of blackness to this shaft of nighted mystery.
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Festival"
all_card.real_flavor: The mirror-like walls reflect your fractured face.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Iridescent Passage: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 下行许久之后，我发现岔路和地洞从未知的黢黑阴暗之处通向这座阴森神秘的深井。<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《魔节》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 厚实有力的根须扼住了周遭的隧道。
all_card.name: 蔓生隧道
all_card.text: 蔓生隧道有线索时，你必须花费额外1个行动以移动离开蔓生隧道。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
After more aeons of descent I saw some side passages or burrows leading from unknown recesses of blackness to this shaft of nighted mystery.
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Festival"
all_card.real_flavor: Thick sinewy roots choke the surrounding tunnels.
all_card.real_text: While Overgrown Tunnel has clues on it, you must spend 1 additional action to move out of Overgrown Tunnel.

all_card.back_flavor: 下行许久之后，我发现岔路和地洞从未知的黢黑阴暗之处通向这座阴森神秘的深井。<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《魔节》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 这里的柱列很像鲨鱼的层层利齿，也和利齿一样尖锐。
all_card.name: 矿物隧道
all_card.text: 你调查矿物隧道时，你每有一张手牌，矿物隧道得到+1隐藏值(简单/普通难度最多+6)。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
After more aeons of descent I saw some side passages or burrows leading from unknown recesses of blackness to this shaft of nighted mystery.
 - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Festival"
all_card.real_flavor: The formations resemble a shark's many-rowed teeth, and are just as sharp.
all_card.real_text: While you are investigating Mineral Tunnel, it gets +1 shroud for each card in your hand (max +6 shroud on Easy/Standard difficulty).

all_card.name: 水晶寄生虫
all_card.text: 猎手。反击。 (白日[day])强制 - 水晶寄生虫攻击后：治愈其2点伤害。 (黑夜[night])水晶寄生虫上每有2点伤害，其得到+2攻击值和+1伤害值。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 昆虫. 枯疫
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. (Day [day]) Forced - After Crystal Parasite attacks: Heal 2 damage from it. (Night [night]) Crystal Parasite gets +2 fight and +1 damage value for every 2 damage on it.

all_card.name: 着彩枯疫
all_card.text: 显现 - 将着彩枯疫放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。每位调查员仅限1张。 强制 - 在你从自己牌库抽取卡牌后：放置1资源在着彩枯疫上，作为光辉。 强制 - 如果着彩枯疫上有总计6光辉：将放在一边的一张水晶寄生虫放置入场，放在你的地点。将着彩枯疫从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Chroma Blight into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - After you draw 1 or more cards from your deck: Place 1 resource on Chroma Blight, as brilliance. Forced - If there is a total of 6 brilliance on Chroma Blight: Put a set-aside copy of Crystal Parasite into play at your location. Remove Chroma Blight from the game.

all_card.name: 钙化
all_card.text: 显现 - 将钙化放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。每位调查员仅限1张。 强制 - 在每轮你第一次移动时：受到1点直接伤害。 [action]：检定[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉钙化。(你可以受到1点直接伤害以使本次检定自动成功。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Calcification into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - The first time you move each round: Take 1 direct damage. [action]: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Calcification. (You may take 1 direct damage for this test to automatically succeed.)

all_card.name: 瘴气之影
all_card.text: 冷漠。猎手。(黑夜[night])逃逸。 除因[[法术]]、[[遗物]]、[[科学]]和遭遇卡牌外，不能受到伤害。 强制 - 在你位于瘴气之影的地点弃掉手牌时，如果它为重整状态：它与你交战并立即进行一次攻击。
all_card.real_text: Aloof. Hunter. (Night [night]) Elusive. Cannot be damaged except by [[Spell]], [[Relic]], [[Science]], or encounter cards. Forced - When you discard 1 or more cards from hand at Miasmatic Shadow's location, if it is ready: It engages you and makes an immediate attack.

all_card.name: 异星低语
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须(选择一项)： - 受到1点伤害，只能分配给你控制的支援。 - 受到1点恐惧，只能分配给你控制的支援。 - 随机弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must (choose one): - Take 1 damage, which can only be assigned to an asset you control. - Take 1 horror, which can only be assigned to an asset you control. - Discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.flavor: 皮肤上爆出多瘤鳞状的肿胀，像鳞片，又像发育不全的指甲。
all_card.name: 诡异突变
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](5)。你每有1点恐惧，本次检定难度降低1点。如果你检定失败，你必须受到2点恐惧或随机弃掉你2张手牌。
all_card.real_flavor: Knotty, scaly growths erupt on the skin, resembling scales or vestigial fingernails.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each horror on you. If you fail, you must either take 2 horror, or discard 2 cards at random from your hand.

all_card.name: 真菌感染
all_card.text: 显现 - 将真菌感染附属到一张你控制的没有附属真菌感染的[[道具]]支援。如果你不能这么做，真菌感染获得涌动。 将所附属支援的文本框视为如同空白(除[[特性]]外)。 [action]：检定[combat](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉真菌感染。否则，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Fungal Rot to an [[Item]] asset you control without Fungal Rot attached. If you cannot, Fungal Rot gains surge. Treat attached asset's text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]). [action]: Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, discard Fungal Rot. Otherwise, take 1 damage.

all_card.flavor: 这伤口不会自己愈合，还发出一股刺鼻的化学味道。
all_card.name: 衰弱
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[combat](5)。你每有1点伤害，本次检定难度降低1点。如果你检定失败，你必须受到2点伤害，或选择并弃掉你手牌中印刷费用最高的卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: The sores won't heal on their own, and emit a sharp chemical scent.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [combat] (5). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each damage on you. If you fail, you must either take 2 damage, or choose the card with the highest printed cost in your hand and discard it.

all_card.name: 脱水
all_card.text: 显现 - 将脱水放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 作为调查员打出卡牌的额外费用，该调查员必须受到1点伤害。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从场上弃掉1张脱水。(每轮最多一次。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Desiccation into play next to the agenda deck. As an additional cost for an investigator to play a card, they must take 1 damage. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Desiccation from play. (Max once per round.)

all_card.name: 至高光彩
all_card.text: (白日[day])显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。如果你有至少5张手牌，此次检定的难度提高2点。如果你检定失败，选择并弃掉你2张卡牌。 (黑夜[night])显现 - 随机弃掉你1张手牌。检定[willpower](X)。X等于该卡牌的印刷费用。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: (Day [day]) Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 2 if you have 5 or more cards in hand. If you fail, choose and discard 2 cards from your hand. (Night [night]) Revelation - Discard 1 card at random from your hand. Test [willpower] (X). X is that card's printed cost. If you fail, take 2 horror.

all_card.flavor: 你在帷幕彼端看到了谁？
all_card.name: 摄魂微光
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 - 将摄魂微光放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。每位调查员仅限1张。 强制 - 如果你没有手牌：受到5点恐惧并弃掉摄魂微光。
all_card.real_flavor: Who do you see beyond the veil?
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Put Captivating Gleam into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - If you have no cards in hand: Take 5 horror and discard Captivating Gleam.

all_card.name: 毒花
all_card.text: 反击。 (白日[day])毒花每有一个疯长，其得到+1生命值和+1伤害值。 (黑夜[night])毒花上每有一个疯长，其得到+1攻击值和+1伤害值。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：在毒花上放置1资源，作为疯长。
all_card.traits: 生物. 植物. 突变
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. (Day [day]) Poisonblossom gets +1 health and +1 damage value for each overgrowth on it. (Night [night]) Poisonblossom gets +1 fight and +1 damage value for each overgrowth on it. Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 resource on Poisonblossom, as overgrowth.

all_card.flavor: 别想摸它。
all_card.name: 森林看护者
all_card.text: 冷漠。(黑夜[night])逃逸。 生成 - 任意地点(如可能，生成在无人地点)。 强制 - 森林看守者入场后：在其上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.traits: 生物. 植物. 突变
all_card.real_flavor: Don't even try to pet it.

all_card.back_flavor: 威尔森向来得意自己能找到合适的家伙对付手上的活。管子漏了？有扳手。大树倒了？有手锯。要内部翻新了？快掏出大锤。但近来他在阿卡姆内外的活儿却变得怪起来了。吱吱嘎嘎的地板怎么就变成了迷宫般的隧道。破碎的屋顶居然不是向内垮塌，而是往外炸开。解决问题是威尔森的工作，可问题要是牵扯上诡奇骇人的怪物和难以解释的异象……好吧，该开动脑筋，想想手上这些东西还能做点什么了。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Wilson takes pride in always having the right tool for the job. Leaky plumbing? Pipe wrench. Fallen tree? Hand saw. Interior remodeling? Sledgehammer. But recently his jobs in and around Arkham have taken on a certain strangeness. Creaky floorboards give way to labyrinthine tunnels. A broken roof shows signs of bursting outward instead of collapsing inward. It's Wilson's job to fix problems, and when those problems involve bizarre and horrifying creatures and unexplained phenomena, well, then it's time to get creative with what he's got.

all_card.back_flavor: 凯特·温斯罗普在米大科学大楼的地下室里潜心研究已有数年。为了推进自己的研究，她拒绝了许多其他的项目，哪怕因此错失基金援助与学术声誉也在所不惜。她的心无旁骛最终有了回报，发明出了磁通量稳定器：这件设备威力无穷，可以传输一种全新形态的能量。但研究进展的代价也是不菲：这件惊世发明的第一次成功实验，就夺走了凯特亦师亦友的杨教授的性命。打那以后，凯特就开始不知疲惫地研究这种奇异的电流，期望能找到方法回退实验的效果。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Kate Winthrop has spent years researching in the basement of Miskatonic University's science building, passing up funding and academic prestige in pursuit of progress. Her single-minded focus finally paid off with the invention of the Flux Stabilizer: a powerful device capable of channeling a new form of energy. However, the price of progress is steep. The first successful test of this groundbreaking invention took the life of her friend and mentor Professor Young. Since then, Kate has worked tirelessly to understand these alien currents, in hopes that she find a way to reverse their effects.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, [[Science]] cards level 0-4, [[Insight]] cards level 0-1, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Flux Stabilizer, Failed Experiment, 1 random basic weakness.

all_card.back_flavor: 亚历山德拉的生活无忧无虑，纸醉金迷。她穿行于纽约富丽堂皇的赌场和印度王公的豪宴，无不泰然处之。从马拉喀什到芝加哥，女爵尝过所有的珍馐佳酿，无论哪位贵妇她也都没落下。但王室头衔不过是个幌子，亚历山德拉运用自己光鲜的外表，幕后却在剽窃画廊、银行，也偷走了愚蠢富人的口袋和心。她的伶牙俐齿招惹了不少麻烦，却也总能安然脱身。眼下这趟新活跟神神秘秘的萨马科纳有关。亚历山德拉为此来到了马萨诸塞州的阿卡姆。女爵发现这里除了颟顸的有钱人，还有什么正在潜伏。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Alessandra's life of carefree luxury enables her to hop from a stately gala in New York City to a banquet with the Maharaja of India with ease. The Countess has sampled every dish, drink, and dame from Marrakesh to Chicago. The regal title is just an act, however: behind the scenes, Alessandra uses her cover to pilfer from art galleries, banks, and the hearts and pocketbooks of the rich and frivolous. Her silver tongue has gotten her into and out of plenty of trouble. A new job with the shadowy Zamacona brought Alessandra to Arkham, Massachusetts, where the Countess learned that more lurks beyond the suggestible rich and frivolous excess than she previously thought.

all_card.back_flavor: 阿卡姆历史协会人人都认得琥珀的爽朗笑声。他说的那些鬼故事也是深入人心，这些故事既有他幼时在东京城外家中的妖怪，也有在阿卡姆树林中游荡的奇异生物。这位神神叨叨的民俗学者告诉大家，他要出版一本记录这些现象实质的编年史，这无疑将是他最伟大的作品。但只有等他回到家里，和自己的伙伴加布里埃尔共处，琥珀才听见了亡魂的哭喊——这个亡魂也曾缠着他父亲不放。他不禁害怕起来，这本“最伟大的作品”是否还能让自己有一宿安眠。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Everyone in the Arkham Historical Society recognizes Kōhaku's booming laughter, and the haunting tales he tells of both the yōkai from his childhood home outside Tokyo and the strange creatures that haunt the Arkham Woods. The eccentric folklorist tells everyone that the chronicling and publication of these phenomena's existence will be his greatest work. It is only when he is home with his partner Gabriel that he hears the cries of the same spirit who haunted his father, and fears that his "greatest work" will never allow him a night's sleep.

all_card.back_flavor: 长在庄稼地里的汉克·萨姆森不管爹娘安排了什么活儿都尽力去办，就连照顾弟弟妹妹也不例外。爹爹要带汉克去看城里畜牧场有什么奇怪的动物。汉克虽然觉得不舒服，但还是去了。爹爹告诉他要等，他也就等了。一旦爹爹没有回来，汉克就去找。爹爹教过他家人就是一切，你可不能把家人扔下。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Growing up on a farm, Hank Samson did all the chores Ma and Pa told him to do, including taking care of his brothers and sisters. When Pa showed him the strange animals in the city stockyard, Hank felt uneasy, but he did as he was told. When Pa told him to wait, he waited. And when Pa didn't come back, Hank went to find him. Pa taught him that family is everything, and you don't just leave family behind.

快速。你所在地点的技能检定期间揭示了[bless]标记后打出。
查找你的绑定卡牌，找出转瞬为神，并将其放置入场。在上面放置最多X个资源，作为祝愿(最多为揭示的[bless]标记数量)。将奇迹祝愿从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play after 1 or more [bless] tokens are revealed during a skill test at your location.
Search your bonded cards for Evanescent Ascension and put it into play. Place up to X resources on it, as wishes (to a maximum of the number of [bless] tokens revealed). Remove Miracle Wish from the game.

all_card.name: 转瞬为神
all_card.text: 绑定(奇迹祝愿)。如果转瞬为神没有祝愿，将其放在一边，位于场外。 [reaction]在你地点的调查员技能检定将要失败时，花费1祝愿并横置转瞬为神：结算该调查员的[elder_sign]效果(本次检定期间揭示的所有其他标记也要结算)。
all_card.traits: 仪式. 契约. 祝福
all_card.real_text: Bonded (Miracle Wish). If Evanescent Ascension has no wishes, set it aside, out of play. [reaction] When an investigator at your location would fail a skill test, spend 1 wish and exhaust Evanescent Ascension: Resolve that investigator's [elder_sign] effect (in addition to all other tokens revealed during this test).

all_card.name: 化学品套装
all_card.text: [action]横置化学品套装：调查。如果你…… - ……检定失败且低于难度正好2点，弃掉化学品套装。 - ……检定成功且等于难度，获得2资源。 - ……检定成功且超过难度正好2点，抽取1张卡牌。 - ……检定成功且超过难度正好4点，发现你所在地点额外1个线索。
all_card.traits: 道具. 工具. 科学
all_card.real_text: [action] Exhaust Chemistry Set: Investigate. If you... - ...fail by exactly 2, discard Chemistry Set. - ...succeed by exactly 0, gain 2 resources. - ...succeed by exactly 2, draw 1 card. - ...succeed by exactly 4, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

all_card.name: 查尔斯·威斯特三世博士
all_card.text:
你拥有额外1个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[工具]]支援。
[reaction]在你成功调查，且超过难度正好1点或3点后，横置查尔斯·威斯特三世博士：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_text:
You have 1 additional hand slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Tool]] asset.
[reaction] After you successfully investigate by exactly 1 or 3, exhaust Dr. Charles West III: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.

all_card.name: 显微镜
all_card.text: [reaction]你所在地点的敌人被成功躲避或击败后，横置显微镜：在显微镜上放置1资源，作为证据。 [action][action]：调查。显微镜上每有1证据，你本次调查得到+1[intellect](最多+3[intellect])。如果你检定成功，你可以花费最多2证据，以额外发现你的地点同等数量的线索。
all_card.traits: 道具. 工具. 科学
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After an enemy at your location is successfully evaded or defeated, exhaust Microscope: Place 1 resource on Microscope, as evidence. [action][action]: Investigate. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation for each evidence on Microscope (max +3 [intellect]). If you succeed, you may spend up to 2 evidence to discover that many additional clues at your location.

all_card.name: 鼠面具
all_card.text:
每位调查员仅限1张[[面具]]。
使用(2贡品)。你揭示地点或将新的地点放置入场后，补满其中的1个贡品。
[free]花费1贡品：你本次技能检定得到+2[willpower]或+2[intellect]。(每次检定仅限一次。)
all_card.traits: 道具. 守护. 面具
all_card.real_text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you reveal a location or put a new location into play.
[fast] Spend 1 offering: You get +2 [willpower] or +2 [intellect] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

all_card.name: 饥饿霉菌
all_card.text:
每套牌库仅限1张。
[action]：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出诡异疯长，并将其加入你的手牌。
[action]如果饥饿霉菌上有至少3个生长：将每个生长移动到你的资源池，作为资源。在剧本日志中，记录下“你识别了新的物种。”
all_card.traits: 生物. 怪物. 植物. 科学
all_card.real_text:
Limit 1 per deck.
[action]: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand.
[action] If Ravenous Myconid has 3 or more growth on it: Move each growth to your resource pool, as resources. Record in your Campaign Log that "you have classified a new species."

all_card.name: 诡异疯长
all_card.text: 绑定(饥饿霉菌)。 调查。本次检定结算后，你检定成功且每超过难度1点，在饥饿霉菌上放置1资源，作为生长。将诡异疯长放在一旁，位于场外。如果你检定失败，将诡异疯长返回你的手牌。
all_card.real_text: Bonded (Ravenous Myconid). Investigate. After this test resolves, place 1 resource on Ravenous Myconid, as growth, for each point you succeed by. Set Uncanny Growth aside, out of play. If you fail, return Uncanny Growth to your hand.

all_card.flavor:
“他会往死去的生物血管里注射一种溶剂，如果尸体还够新鲜，就会作出奇怪的反应。”
——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《赫伯特·威斯特——复活死者之人》
all_card.name: 控制变量
all_card.text:
快速。有调查员在你地点的技能检定期间揭示了[curse]标记后打出。
发现你所在地点的1个线索。
all_card.traits: 洞察. 科学. 诅咒萦绕
all_card.real_flavor: "There was a solution which he injected into the veins of dead things, and if they were fresh enough they responded in strange ways." -H.P. Lovecraft, Herbert West - Reanimator
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play after an investigator reveals a [curse] token during a skill test at your location.
Discover 1 clue at your location.

all_card.name: 冲刺实验
all_card.text: 作为打出冲刺实验的额外费用，花费一个行动。 调查。按照隐藏值升序依次调查你所在地点和每个连接地点一次，直到你调查失败或成功调查了每个符合条件的地点。
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost to play Testing Sprint, spend an action. Investigate. One at a time, investigate your location and each connecting location once each in ascending order of shroud, until you either fail to investigate or successfully investigate each eligible location.

all_card.flavor: 真相往往就在眼皮子底下。
all_card.name: 刨根问底
all_card.text: 作为打出刨根问底的额外费用，花费一个行动。 你所在地点的调查员抽取总计5张卡牌(由你决定每位调查员各抽取几张卡牌)
all_card.real_flavor: The truth is often hidden in plain sight.
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost to play Thorough Inquiry, spend an action. Investigators at your location draw a combined total of 5 cards (you decide how many cards each investigator draws).

all_card.flavor: “孩子，你……你真是大大超出我的意料。”
all_card.name: “用书砸它！”
all_card.text: 攻击。选择一个你控制的[[书籍]]支援。你本次攻击得到+X[combat]，其中X为该支援的印刷费用。如果你检定成功，你可以自动躲避被攻击的敌人，或者你可以在攻击结束后结算所选支援上的一个[action]或[free]能力(忽略其[action]费用，如有)。
all_card.real_flavor: "Kid, you... you took that a lot more literally than I expected you to."
all_card.real_text: Fight. Choose a [[Tome]] asset you control. You get +X [combat] for this attack, where X is that asset's printed cost. If you succeed, you may either automatically evade the attacked enemy, or after the attack ends, you may resolve an [action] or [fast] ability on the chosen asset (ignoring its [action] cost, if any).

all_card.flavor: “我说‘别碰它’，不是‘变膨大’！”
all_card.name: 原形惊变
all_card.text: 躲避。你本次躲避尝试可以不使用[agility]，改为使用[intellect]。如果你检定成功，且该敌人非[[精英]]，将原形惊变附属到该敌人。 所附属敌人获得：“庞大。不能移动。 [reaction]你躲避本敌人后：发现其所在地点的1个线索。(每轮仅限一次。)”。
all_card.real_flavor: "I said 'blow it up,' not '<u>blow</u> it up!"
all_card.real_text: Evade. You may use [intellect] instead of [agility] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], attach Transmogrify to it. Attached enemy gains: "Massive. Cannot move. [reaction] After you evade this enemy: Discover 1 clue at its location. (Limit once per round.)"

all_card.flavor: 每一分研究经费都花在刀刃上。
all_card.name: 资金充裕
all_card.text: 你控制[[科学]]或[[工具]]支援时，资金充裕获得[wild](你控制至少3个[[科学]]和/或[[工具]]支援时，资金充裕改为获得[wild][wild])。
all_card.real_flavor: Every cent of that research grant counts.
all_card.real_text: While you control a [[Science]] or [[Tool]] asset, Well-Funded gains [wild] (while you control 3 or more [[Science]] and/or [[Tool]] assets, Well-Funded gains [wild] [wild], instead).

all_card.flavor: “帮这个忙可比教学生几何轻松多了。”
all_card.name: 加布里埃尔·卡里洛
all_card.text:
你得到+1[intellect]。
[reaction]当你回合开始时，在混乱袋中加入1个[curse]标记：抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 学者. 诅咒萦绕
all_card.real_flavor: "Helping you is easier than teaching my students geometry."
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] At the start of your turn, add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag: Draw 1 card.

all_card.flavor: 一个小口子就会决定生死。
all_card.name: 手法稳当
all_card.text:
每位调查员仅限1张。
[reaction]在你技能检定将要成功时，横置手法稳当：你成功且超过难度的点数多1点或少1点。如果你检定成功且超过难度正好2点，治愈1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: A nick can be the difference between life and death.
all_card.real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] When you would succeed at a skill test, exhaust Steady-Handed: You either succeed by 1 more or 1 less. If you succeeded by exactly 2, heal 1 horror.

all_card.flavor: “我保证没什么好怕的！”
all_card.name: 精准调配
all_card.text:
附属到你控制的[[工具]]或[[科学]]支援。每个支援仅限1张。
[reaction]所附属支援横置后，横置精准调配：重整所附属的支援。
all_card.real_flavor: "I assure you there's nothing to fear!"
all_card.real_text:
Attach to a [[Tool]] or [[Science]] asset you control. Limit 1 per asset.
[reaction] After attached asset exhausts, exhaust Fine Tuning: Ready attached asset.

all_card.flavor: 传言大学里上一位颅相学教授的教职生涯长到离谱。
all_card.name: 绝密手段
all_card.text: 本次技能检定结束后，执行检定的调查员检定成功且每超出难度1点，或者检定失败且每低于难度1点，就在混乱袋中加入1个[curse]标记。
all_card.real_flavor: Rumor has it the university's last phrenology professor enjoyed an unnaturally long tenure.
all_card.real_text: After this skill test ends, add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag for each point the performing investigator either succeeded or failed by.

all_card.name: 棱相眼镜
all_card.text: [action]在混乱袋中加入1个[curse]标记：调查。你本次调查得到技能值+2。如果本次调查期间揭示了[curse]标记，你可以横置棱相眼镜以发现你所在地点的额外1个线索。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕
all_card.real_text: [action] Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag: Investigate. You get +2 skill value for this investigation. If a [curse] token is revealed during this investigation, you may exhaust Prismatic Spectacles to discover 1 additional clue at your location.

all_card.flavor: “这向来不顶用，赫伯特。”
all_card.name: 云山雾罩
all_card.text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个敌人。检定 [intellect](X)，其中X为所选敌人的躲避值。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点的2个线索。然后，如果所选敌人为非[[精英]]，自动躲避该敌人。其在下一个补给阶段期间不重整。
all_card.real_flavor: "It'll never work, Herbert."
all_card.real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's evade value. If you succeed, discover 2 clues at your location. Then, if the chosen enemy is non-[[Elite]], automatically evade it. It does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

You get +2 [intellect] for this investigation for each evidence on Microscope (max +6 [intellect]). If you succeed, you may spend up to 3 evidence to discover that many additional clues at your location.

[reaction]在调查员抽取非弱点诡计卡牌时，如果该调查员所在地点的隐藏值不大于饥饿霉菌上的生长数：取消该诡计的效果并将其弃掉。移除饥饿霉菌上所有的生长。

[reaction] When an investigator draws a non-weakness treachery card, if their locations shroud is equal to or less than Ravenous Myconid's growth: Cancel that treachery's effects and discard it. Remove all growth from Ravenous Myconid.

[free]选择你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人，该敌人的剩余生命值不能大于饥饿霉菌上的生长数：击败该敌人。移除饥饿霉菌上所有的生长。
all_card.real_text:

[fast] Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location with equal or fewer remaining health than the amount of growth on Ravenous Myconid: Defeat that enemy. Remove all growth from Ravenous Myconid.

[fast] Remove all growth from Ravenous Myconid: Either heal that much damage/horror from Ravenous Myconid, or move that much damage/horror from investigators or [[Ally]] assets at your location to Ravenous Myconid.

all_card.name: “咪咪”比安卡
all_card.text: 每套牌库仅限1张。使用(10资源)。 [action]横置“咪咪”比安卡：谈判。将X资源从“咪咪”比安卡移动到你的资源池。X不能大于5。检定[agility](X)。如果你检定失败，记住“你欠比安卡X资源。”然后，查找你的绑定卡牌，找出“咪咪”比安卡敌人并将她生成在你的地点。将本卡牌从游戏中移除。

Test [agility] (X). If you fail, remember "you owe Bianca X resources." Then, search your bonded cards for the Bianca "Die Katz" enemy and spawn her at your location. Remove this card from the game.

all_card.name: “咪咪”比安卡
all_card.text: 绑定(“咪咪”比安卡)。猎手。 猎物 - 仅对承受者。 [action]如果“你欠比安卡X资源”，花费X资源：谈判。将“咪咪”比安卡加入胜利区。 强制 - 在“咪咪”比安卡离场(除因上述能力外)时：将她混洗入你的牌库。
all_card.traits: 类人. 罪犯. 社会名流

all_card.text: 使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击可以不使用[combat]，改为使用[agility]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。 [reaction]你与敌人谈判时技能检定失败后：将不列颠斗牛犬左轮手枪从你的手牌放置入场。

all_card.back_flavor:
“等一下！来看下这个！”当你在雪地中艰难前行时，另一名队员喊道。你返回看看他们发现了什么——雪地上有另一组脚印，但是更小，而且是畸形的。这几乎不可能。
“到底是什么鬼东西留下了这些脚印？”团队中的一人问道。你目瞪口呆地站着。在这片冰冻荒原上，几乎没有野生动物存在。而且你从没见过有什么动物是这种脚印。你甚至无法想像这是什么生物。
但很快你就不用纠结这是什么东西的脚印了。 一道身影从喷发的雪中出现，扭曲变形，就像泼洒在现实画布上的墨点。 它发出一种奇怪的、有些熟悉的叫声，但被呼啸的狂风吞没了：“——哩！——哩！”然后，它以惊人的速度向你冲来。
