all_card.flavor: 这和你想像中第一次进入南极荒野不太一样。随着时间推移，刺骨的寒冷和鞭挞着你的冰冷寒风会让情况越来越糟。
all_card.name: 冷遇
all_card.text: 强制 - 调查员第一次进入一个地点后：将放在一边的地点中，所有与该地点相连的地点放置入场。(参考剧本手册中的地图摆放)。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
"Hold on! Come see this!" one of the other team members shouts as you trudge ahead through the snow. You turn back and examine what they have found - a second set of tracks in the snow, but smaller, misshapen. Almost impossibly so.
"What in the hell could have made these tracks?" one of your party asks. You stand dumbfounded. Very little wildlife exists out here in the frozen wastes. And these tracks match nothing you've ever seen before. Nothing you can even imagine.
You don't have to question what could make such tracks for long. A shape emerges from the erupting snow, twisted and deformed, like a splotch of ink spilled upon the canvas of reality. It makes a strange, almost familiar cry that is eaten by the howling wind: "-li! -li!" Then, with terrifying speed, it rushes toward you.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn a set-aside Skittering Nonsense at the lead investigator's location. Shuffle the remainder of the set-aside Skittering Nonsense enemies and the set-aside Creatures in the Ice encounter set into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: This isn't exactly how you imagined your first foray into the Antarctic wilds. The stinging cold and lashing, frozen winds will only get worse over time.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)

all_card.back_flavor:
这些东西，这些存在，它们不是野兽，甚至也不像戴尔和丹佛斯上次探险中遭遇的外星生物。你甚至不确定它们是不是实体。它们没有形状，由几乎像原生质一样的物质组成，当受到伤害或你逃脱它们的控制时，就会重新渗入冰雪之中。考虑到这些实体的存在，以及南极严酷致命的环境，你明白，如果找不到庇护所，你将无法熬过夜晚。
就在你思考下一步该怎么做的时候，你脚下的冰面开始剧烈震动，轰隆隆的巨响，发出可怕的呻吟。“地震？”团队中有人沙哑着嗓子问。
“不，这不可能。”另一人回答。你的眼神也充满畏惧。会不会也是那种……东西？
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的星之恐怖敌人生成在已揭示的庇护值最高的地点。
all_card.flavor: 有什么东西潜伏在冰雪之下。那是你从没见过也没听过的，甚至在威廉·戴尔那可怕的报告中也未提及丝毫的东西。那是……非现实的东西。
all_card.name: 深入白雪
all_card.text: 强制 - 调查员第一次进入一个地点后：将放在一边的地点中，所有与该地点相连的地点放置入场。(参考剧本手册中的地图摆放)。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
These things, these manifestations, they're not beasts or even alien creatures like those Dyer and Danforth encountered in their last expedition. You're not even sure they are entities at all. They have no shape, consisting of an almost proto-plasmic substance that seeps back into the ice when harmed or whenever you escape their clutches. Given the persistence of these entities and the inclement, deadly conditions of Antarctica, you know you won't survive the night without finding shelter.
Just as you are pondering what your next move should be, the ice beneath you rumbles with tremendous force, letting out a terrifying groan. "An earthquake?" one of your party asks over the raucous noise.
"No, that's impossible," another replies. You share a dreadful glance. Could it be one of those...things?
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy at the revealed location with the highest shelter value.
all_card.real_flavor: Something dwells beneath the ice. Something you've never seen or heard of before, not even in William Dyer's horrifying report. Something...unreal.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你无法再继续了。虽然不是很理想，但你只能将就着使用你找到的庇护地了。你只希望这里足够让你的团队避免冻死……或更糟的情况。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员(包括已退场的)将忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的1张卡牌混洗入自己的牌库。 选择场上一个没有线索的地点。每位没有被击败的调查员移动到该地点并立即撤退。该地点的庇护值越高越好。如果调查员无法选择此类地点，则必须无视任何条件移动至坠机点并立即撤退(然后，结算场景1a上的目标)。
all_card.flavor: 太阳低悬于天空，但从不落下。你们团队经过漫长而艰苦的一天，已经筋疲力尽了。虽然天空永远不会陷入黑夜，但你知道被迫扎营只是早晚的事。
all_card.name: 没时间了
all_card.text: 强制 - 调查员第一次进入一个地点后：将放在一边的地点中，所有与该地点相连的地点放置入场。(参考剧本手册中的地图摆放)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You can go on no longer. It's not ideal, but you'll have to make do with the shelter you've found. You only hope that it's enough to keep your party from freezing... or worse.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator, including those who are eliminated, shuffles the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck. Choose a location in play with no clues on it. Each undefeated investigator moves to that location and immediately resigns. The higher that location's shelter value, the better. If the investigators cannot choose such a location, they must move to the Crash Site and immediately resign, even if they otherwise could not. (Then, resolve the [[Objective]] on act 1a.)
all_card.real_flavor: The sun hangs low in the sky, but never sets. Your party is exhausted from the long, arduous day. Though the sky is never plunged into the dark of night, you know it's only a matter of time before you are forced to make camp.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)

all_card.back_flavor: 你经历苦难，现在筋疲力尽、惊恐不已。你决定这里是扎营过夜的好地方。也许明天你能从这地狱般的旅程中挖掘一些学术价值，但现在这些事情根本微不足道。你满脑子只想着活下去。
all_card.flavor: 你得找到回营地的路，而且要尽快……不然你就只能在野外暂且扎营。
all_card.name: 寻找扎营点
all_card.text: [action]如果所有调查员都在同一地点，且该地点上没有线索：撤退。你扎起了营。所有调查员撤退。 目标 - 找到安全的地方扎营。如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退了，推进场景。他们撤退的地点的庇护值越高越好。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Exhausted and terrified by your ordeal, you decide this is as good a place as any to make camp for the night. Perhaps tomorrow you can salvage some kind of academic value out of this hellish journey, but for now such things seem trivial. Survival is the only thing on your mind.
all_card.real_flavor: You're going to have to find a way back to camp, and soon...or you'll have to make due camping in the wilds.
all_card.real_text: [action] If each investigator is at the same location and that location has no clues on it: Resign. You set up camp. Each investigator resigns. Objective - Find somewhere safe to set up camp. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance. The higher the shelter value of the location they resigned at, the better.

all_card.name: 星之恐怖
all_card.text:
猎手。 庞大。
星之恐怖得到+3[per_investigator]生命值。
星之恐怖处于重整状态时，调查员不能在星之恐怖所在地点撤退，或发现星之恐怖所在地点的线索。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 幻灵. 精英
all_card.real_text:
Hunter. Massive.
Terror of the Stars gets +3 [per_investigator] health.
While Terror of the Stars is ready, investigators cannot resign at its location or discover clues at its location.

all_card.back_flavor: 当你穿越冰川荒野时，你偶然发现一组脚印，朝着远离营地的方向延伸。你停下来作进一步调查。这些足迹是你失踪的一名队员留下的吗？还是什么……更可怕的东西？
all_card.back_text: 选择在一个地点底下的一张正面朝下的遭遇卡牌。查看该卡牌正面(不要结算其文字)。然后将其正面朝下放回该地点底下。
all_card.flavor: 你团队中几个人在晚上神秘消失。没有任何挣扎的迹象，你只能认为他们是自愿离开的……但是为什么？
all_card.name: 狂风呼啸
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you journey through the glacial wilds, you stumble across a set of tracks in the snow leading farther from camp. You pause and investigate further. Were these tracks made by one of your missing team members? Or by something more...monstrous?
all_card.real_back_text: Choose a facedown encounter card beneath a location. Look at the other side of that card (without resolving its text). Then return it facedown beneath that location.
all_card.real_flavor: Several of your party have mysteriously vanished in the night. Without a sign of any struggle, you can only assume they left of their own accord...but why?

all_card.back_flavor: 当你穿越冰川荒野时，你偶然发现一组脚印，朝着远离营地的方向延伸。你停下来作进一步调查。这些足迹是你失踪的一名队员留下的吗？还是什么……更可怕的东西？
all_card.back_text: 选择在一个地点底下的一张正面朝下的遭遇卡牌。查看该卡牌正面(不要结算其文字)。然后将其正面朝下放回该地点底下。
all_card.flavor: 低垂的太阳照亮了南极的夜晚。天空乌云密布，预示着一场冰雪风暴即将来临。
all_card.name: 寒冷夜晚
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you journey through the glacial wilds, you stumble across a set of tracks in the snow leading farther from camp. You pause and investigate further. Were these tracks made by one of your missing team members? Or by something more...monstrous?
all_card.real_back_text: Choose a facedown encounter card beneath a location. Look at the other side of that card (without resolving its text). Then return it facedown beneath that location.
all_card.real_flavor: The low-hanging sun dimly illuminates the Antarctic night. Gray clouds cover the sky, threatening an icy storm.

all_card.back_flavor:
夜幕退散，风暴肆虐。凛冽的寒风和密集的大雪让你的任务失去了成功的可能。在这种情况下你永远也找不到剩下的团队成员，而即使你找到了……
一股强烈的内疚和绝望涌上你的喉咙。在这场风暴中，没有补给和庇护所，活下来是不可能的。你只能在双方的性命之间做取舍，这项决定会成为你一辈子的心理负担。当然，前提是你这辈子不会过几天就到头。
all_card.back_text: 剩下的每位调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。 (→结局1)
all_card.flavor: 风暴越来越近，而随着它在天空中逼近，那该死的声音又回来了。它萦绕着你，钻进你的思想。是它造成了这场闹剧吗？还有这场疯狂？
all_card.name: 疯狂与死亡
all_card.real_back_flavor:
As the night ends, the storm arrives in its full ferocity. Raging, icy winds and dense snowfall make your task impossible. You'll never find the remaining team members in these conditions, and even if you did...
A hard lump of guilt and despair forms in your throat. There's no way they would survive in this storm, not without supplies or shelter. That you are forced to choose between your life and theirs is a burden you will surely carry with you for the rest of your life. And you'll be lucky if that's more than a couple of days.
all_card.real_back_text: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. (→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: The storm grows closer, and with it looming in the sky, that damnable sound returns. It haunts you with its presence, worming its way into your mind. Is it the cause of this folly? This madness?

all_card.back_flavor: 随着夜晚临近结束，风暴接近得越来越迅速了。很快，天气就会变得非常恶劣，你们将无法继续搜寻。如果还有人在外面，你怀疑他们是否还能活下来——当然，如果你也继续待在庇护所外面，那你也是一样的下场。你返回营地，你的心被沉重的罪恶感压迫着，而你的思想被你身体里那不断滋长的污秽声音所腐化。
all_card.flavor: 你开始寻找失踪的队员，希望在黎明前找到他们……
all_card.name: 失踪队员
all_card.text: [free]你所在地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：抽取你所在地点底下的遭遇卡牌。 [action]如果你位于营地：撤退。你回来渡过夜晚。 目标 - 找到尽可能多的失踪探险队成员(将其加入胜利区)，然后在黎明到来前回到营地。如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退了，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: With night coming to a close, the storm approaches faster and faster. Soon, the weather will be too deadly for your search to continue. If anyone is still out there, you doubt they'll survive - and neither will you if you remain unsheltered any longer. You return to your camp, your heart heavy with guilt and and your mind addled by that foul noise that festers within.
all_card.real_flavor: You set out to search for the missing team members, hoping to find them before daybreak...
all_card.real_text: [fast] Investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the encounter card beneath your location. [action] If you are at camp: Resign. You turn in for the night. Objective - Find as many missing expedition members as you can by adding them to the victory display, then head back to camp before daybreak. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.flavor: 这里除了冰雪以外什么都没有，也没有任何失踪队员的迹象。你垂头丧气地回了头。你在这找不到任何人。
all_card.name: 死路
all_card.text:
从混乱袋里移除1个[frost]标记。
将本剧情卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: There is nothing here but ice and snow, and no sign of any missing team members. Frustrated, you turn back. You won't find anyone here.
all_card.real_text:
Remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag.
Add this story card to the victory display.

all_card.flavor:
当你穿越冰川荒野时，有东西在你脚下搅动，隆隆作响。这些生物就是从那里来的吗？从冰雪深处？
一个严峻的想法掠过你的脑海。如果你是对的，那不管你在哪里，都逃不出这些存在的魔爪。也许这跟你失踪的同伴有关系，尽管这里没有他们的踪迹。
all_card.name: 冰上裂缝
all_card.text:
查找你的牌库，找出一张忒咳哩-哩并将其放到忒咳哩-哩牌库底，不要结算它。混洗你的牌库。
将本剧情卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor:
As you traverse the glacial wilds, something rumbles and churns beneath your feet. Is that where these creatures are coming from? In the depths of the ice?
A somber thought crosses your mind. If you are right, such entities could exert their vile influence no matter where you stand. Perhaps this has something to do with your missing companions after all, though there are no signs of them here.
all_card.real_text:
Search your deck for a copy of Tekeli-li and place it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 你偶然发现了一个失踪同伴的迹象，是厚重毛皮大衣上撕下的碎片和一副护目镜，被遗弃在这里，半埋在雪中。仔细检查护目镜，你发现一些可怕的事情——一种你无论如何也认不出的黑色粘稠物质。
all_card.name: 忧心弃物
all_card.text:
查找你牌库顶的9张卡牌，找出其中所有忒咳哩-哩，并将这些卡牌都放在忒咳哩-哩牌库底，不要结算它们。混洗你的牌库。
将本剧情卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: You come across evidence of one of your lost companions, abandoned and half-buried in snow - torn scraps from a heavy fur coat and a pair of goggles. Examining the goggles closely yields a terrifying discovery - a dark, sticky substance that you cannot, for the life of you, identify.
all_card.real_text:
Search the top 9 cards of your deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and place each one you find on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.

all_card.flavor:
足迹持续了一段，然后莫名其妙地消失在雪地中。没有任何挣扎的迹象，也没有任何其他痕迹可以表明他们可能去了哪里。难道是狂风将足迹掩埋了吗？但如果是这样，为什么你能这么轻易的追踪到之前的脚印呢？
你转身想检查一路跟来的脚印，却发现它们也消失了。
all_card.name: 消失的足迹
all_card.text:
从混乱袋里移除1个[frost]标记。
将本剧情卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor:
The tracks continue for some time before vanishing, bafflingly, into the snow. There's no sign of any struggle, nor are there any other tracks that might indicate where they could have gone. Could the winds have covered the tracks? And if so, why were you able to follow the rest of the footprints so easily?
But when you turn back to examine the prints you first followed, they too are gone.
all_card.real_text:
Remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag.
Add this story card to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 你跟着一组脚印进入了一个在冰川峭壁上凿出的小洞穴，而看到眼前的景象，你的胃痉挛起来。一名失踪队员躺在坑洞尽头，衣服被撕开了。一道利落的切口从他的胸口切开到腹部，他的內脏被小心地取走了。你努力不让自己呕吐。谁会做出这样的事？
all_card.name: 被剖开的探险家
all_card.text:
查找你的牌库，找出一张忒咳哩-哩并将其放到忒咳哩-哩牌库底，不要结算它。混洗你的牌库。
将本剧情卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: You follow a set of tracks into a small cavern carved into a glacial wall, and your stomach lurches at the sight before you. One of your missing team members lies in a crumpled heap at the end of the hollow, his clothing torn open. A clean vertical incision has bisected his torso open from his sternum to his belly, and his entrails have been carefully removed. You struggle not to retch. Who could have possibly done such a thing?
all_card.real_text:
Search your deck for a copy of Tekeli-li and place it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 你正在逃离一个由千变万化的软泥组成的生物时，突然停了下来，脚下的冰面上布满了裂缝。你大气不敢出一口。再走一步，你就可能万劫不复，或者小命得救。在你身后，那个实体渐渐靠近你，伸出既不完全是固体也不完全是液体的手臂。你想试试运气，决定孤注一掷，猛击身后的冰面并逃到一边。正如你所希望的，冰面足够薄从而裂开，那生物掉进裂缝，去往深处。你松了一口气，还好下去的不是自己。
all_card.name: 深层邪恶
all_card.text:
从场上弃掉一个没有[[精英]]特性的[[幻灵]]敌人。
将本剧情卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: You are fleeing from a creature made of kaleidoscopic ooze when you suddenly freeze in place, a web of cracks reaching out across the ice beneath your boots. Your breath catches in your throat. Another step could spell your doom or save your life. Behind you, the entity gains on you, reaching out with arms that are not quite solid or liquid. Feeling lucky, you decide to roll the dice, striking the ground behind you and fleeing to the side. Just as you hoped, the ice is thin enough to splinter open, and the creature tumbles down through the crack, into the icy depths. You breathe a sigh of relief, thankful you did not share a similar fate.
all_card.real_text:
Discard an [[Eidolon]] enemy that does not have the [[Elite]] trait from play.
Add this story card to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 你跟着雪地上的一组脚印，希望它们能指引你找到失踪同伴的任何迹象。遗憾的是，你找到的迹象并不是你想要的那种。在脚印的尽头，你发现一个覆盖着新鲜冻血的破冰锥。令你惊恐的是，旁边放着一个人类的眼珠，把雪染成了红色。你的脊梁上冒出寒气，忍不住打了个寒颤。究竟是什么迫使一个人做出这种事情？
all_card.name: 血腥证据
all_card.text:
查找你牌库顶的9张卡牌，找出其中所有忒咳哩-哩，并将这些卡牌都放在忒咳哩-哩牌库底，不要结算它们。混洗你的牌库。
将本剧情卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: You follow a set of footprints through the snow, hoping they will lead you to a sign, any sign, of your lost companions. Sadly, the evidence you discover is not the kind you were hoping to find. Where the prints end, you find an ice pick covered in freshly frozen blood. To your horror, a human eye lies nearby, staining the snow red. A shudder creeps up your spine. What on Earth could compel somebody to do such a thing?
all_card.real_text:
Search the top 9 cards of your deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and place each one you find on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 让你松一口气的是，你遇到了一名失踪的队员——但已经面目全非了。对方目光呆滞，神情茫然。一种浑浊、粘稠的物质从这名队员的脸上滴下来，落到下面的冰面上。当你最终准备接近，对方擦拭着脸上奇怪、墨黑的瘴气，脸颊都染成了黑色。“我在……做什么？”那人问道。
all_card.name: 心中的疯狂
all_card.text:
选择场上一个没有[[精英]]特性的[[附身]]敌人。控制该敌人上所有毁灭标记，并将其翻到线索面。弃掉选择的敌人。
将本剧情卡牌加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: To your relief, you come across one of your missing team members - but they are not themself. Their eyes glazed over, their expression dazed and lost. A murky, slimy substance drips from their face and trickles onto the ice below. When you finally manage to get through to them, they wipe the strange, inky miasma from their face, staining their cheeks black. "What...was I doing?" they ask.
all_card.real_text:
Choose a [[Possessed]] enemy in play that does not have the [[Elite]] trait. Take control of each doom on that enemy, flipping them to their clue sides. Discard the chosen enemy.

all_card.back_flavor: 这地方并非表里如一。你感觉好像你侵入了一个古老而可怕的地方，现在它的愤怒正在你周围爆发。
all_card.back_text:
调查员队长必须决定(选择一项)：
- 在混乱袋里加入1个[frost]标记。
- 以玩家顺序，每位调查员将忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的2张卡牌混洗入自己的牌库(每位不能这么做的调查员改为受到1点伤害和1点恐惧)。
all_card.flavor: 冰下有东西在搅动。从裂缝里冒出邪恶的酸水，散发着刺鼻的腐臭气味。
all_card.name: 邪灵现身
all_card.text: 强制 - 在本密谋将要推进时，如果在渗出梦魇底下有正面朝下的卡牌：不推进密谋，改为从场上移除2个毁灭标记，并找到其底下正面朝下卡牌最多的渗出梦魇。随机选择其底下的1张卡牌，并生成在其所在地点。
all_card.real_back_flavor: This place is not what it seems. You feel as though you have trespassed somewhere ancient and terrible, and now its wrath is erupting all around you.
all_card.real_back_text:
The lead investigator must decide (choose one):
- Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag.
- In player order, each investigator shuffles the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck (each investigator who cannot takes 1 damage and 1 horror instead).
all_card.real_flavor: Something stirs beneath the ice. Through the cracks, a vile ichor bubbles forth, its odor pungent and rancid.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When this agenda would advance, if there is at least 1 facedown card beneath a Seeping Nightmare: Instead of advancing this agenda, remove 2 doom from play and find the Seeping Nightmare with the most facedown cards beneath it. Choose one of the cards beneath it at random and spawn it at its location.

all_card.back_flavor:
你唯一的警告就是你脚前的冰面上出现了薄薄一层裂缝，然后你周围突然爆发出雾气和墨般的瘴气。这股力量将你击倒在地。你绝望地在冰冷的冰面上爬行，瘴气向你袭来。一种难以理解的声音像一阵狂暴的旋风一样，震耳欲聋。然后是一声雷鸣般的巨响，你就掉下去了——不，是沿着冰面滑向下面冰冷的海水。
你还有意识简直是个奇迹。就在你掉下去之前，你鼓起所有的力量抓住了冰架。你终于爬上边缘，惊慌失措地瞥了一眼地平线，但没有任何瘴气或薄雾的迹象。冰架上的裂缝在你面前延伸数百英尺，将你与追捕者分开。你不知不觉地就逃了出来……尽管那次濒死体验你很长时间都忘不了。
all_card.back_text: 剩下的每位调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 强烈的地震已达到高潮。现在起的每一秒，你都觉得整个冰架可能崩塌，把你扔进冰冷的海洋——或者更糟，如果你关于这些生物来自地下的推论是正确的话。
all_card.name: 冰雪深处
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Your only warning is a thin web of cracks that tears through the ice before your feet, and then a sudden explosion of mist and ink-like miasma erupts around you. The force slams you to the ground. You crawl desperately along the freezing-cold ice as the miasma reaches for you. An incomprehensible sound, like the rushing of a furious whirlwind, fills your ears. Then a thunderous crack, and you are falling - no, sliding - down along the ice toward the freezing cold waters below.
It is a wonder you are even still conscious. You summon all of your strength and cling to the ice shelf just before you plummet below. You finally haul yourself back over the edge, casting a panicked glance at the horizon, but there is no sign of any miasma or mist. The crack in the ice shelf extends for hundreds of feet in front of you, separating you from your pursuers. Somehow, you've unwittingly escaped...although you won't be forgetting that near-death experience anytime soon.
all_card.real_back_text: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: The violent quakes have risen to a crescendo. Any second now, you feel as though the entire ice shelf could collapse, spilling you into the frigid ocean - or worse, if your theory about the underground source of these creatures is correct.

all_card.back_text:
如果场上没有[[幻灵]]敌人：
最后的可怕生物倒下了，它瘴气似的身体立刻融化成墨状的五彩液体，然后消散成一缕缕形状诡异的灰色雾气。然后，一切归于沉寂。
(→结局1)
如果调查员通过撤退来推进场景：
你沿着一条简易小路穿过冰架的锯齿状裂缝，进入大陆深处，走向山脉。你不知道这些生物是否会跟随人类的足迹——或者它们是否需要人类的足迹来追赶你——但无论如何，你都要花时间来掩盖它们。希望有了这条你找到的捷径，你会变安全些……
(→结局2)
all_card.flavor: 你的营地被发现了，现在在冰雪中徘徊的怪物正向你的位置聚集。你只有两条路可以逃离这个噩梦：要么战斗，要么逃跑。
all_card.name: 陷入围攻！
all_card.text: 每个[[幻灵]]敌人获得胜利0。 营地获得：“[action]你所在地点的调查员共同花费4个线索：撤退。” 目标 - 如果场上没有[[幻灵]]敌人，推进场景。 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退了，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_text:
If there are no [[Eidolon]] enemies in play:
The last of the nightmarish creatures falls, its miasmatic body at once dissolving into inky, prismatic liquid and dissipating into wisps of gray mist filled with screaming shapes. Then, silence.
(→R1)
If the investigators advanced by resigning:
You follow a makeshift path through a jagged split in the ice shelf, making your way deeper into the mainland, toward the mountains. You don't know if these creatures can follow human tracks - or indeed if they need tracks at all in order to pursue you - but you take the time to cover them, regardless. Hopefully, with this shortcut you've found, you'll be safe...
(→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: Your camp has been discovered, and now the monsters prowling about the ice and snow are converging on your position. You have only two ways out of this nightmare: you must fight, or you must flee.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Eidolon]] enemy gains Victory 0. The camp gains: "[action] Investigators at your location spend 4 clues, as a group: Resign." Objective - If there are no [[Eidolon]] enemies in play, advance. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
你开始理解了。尽管可能是梦，但这个地方就像思想的中枢——笼罩于瘴气之中，思想是实体的地方。在这里，疯狂也会具象化。
当你在思考，这恐怖迷宫中可能存在的深层真相时，一扇门恰好出现在你视线的边缘：正是通过那扇门你才被关在这鬼地方。
也许这里还有更多的谜团有待探索，但现在，你已经看得够多了。你打开了门……

all_card.real_back_flavor:
Understanding sets in. Dream though it may be, this place is like a nexus of minds - a place within the miasma where thought is material. Where madness is embodied.
As you ponder the deeper truths that might have taken shape in this maze of horrors, a door appears just in the periphery of your sight: the same door you once used to trap yourself in this hellish place.
Perhaps there are more mysteries to discover here, but for now, you've seen enough. You open the door...

Enigmatic glyphs wind around its frame, their meaning inscrutable. You step forward, place your hand upon the stone, and to your surprise, the door cracks open with an immense rumble. A layer of thick, prismatic miasma drips from the doorway as you peer inside. Thum-thum. Thum-thum. Thum-thum. The beating is tremendous. Something quivers and throbs on the other side, something hideous and enormous, like a beating heart. Thum-thum. Thum-thum. Thum-thum. The heart of the mountain. The heart of the mirage. Then the door slams open, tendrils of ichor slap around your wrists, and you are dragged, screaming, through the door-

“放松。我可不是独自一人。”伊里亚回答道，他戴着手套的手轻轻地抚摸着安雨的脖子。
医师翻了个白眼离开了，但高田抱着双臂，依然留在那里。“在我们出发之前还有很多事情要做，你知道的吧。”她说。

高田点头。“是的。我也感觉到了。”

Eliyah and his companion, Anyu, shimmer into view along the outskirts of the camp. "Where have you been?" Takada says, also appearing before your very eyes.
"It is foolish to venture out alone," Dr. Sinha joins in the scolding.
"Relax. I wasn't alone," Eliyah replies, his gloved hand gently petting Anyu's neck.
The physician rolls her eyes and departs, but Takada remains, folding her arms across her chest. "There is still a lot to do before we head out, you know," she states.
Eliyah sighs and nods. "I know. Just...anxious. Something about this place..." he trails off.
Takada nods. "Yes. I feel it, too."

埃尔斯沃思出现在闪烁的幻光中，凝视着栏杆外冰冷的蓝色海洋。
“很美，不是吗？”他说。
曲奇和克莱普尔出现在旁边，他们中间还有几箱补给品。“那你想知道什么事情更美吗？”曲奇大喊着。“比如你现在就来搭把手。埃尔斯沃思，你能不能动一下，过来帮帮忙？”
探险家轻轻叹了口气，点了点头，接过克莱普尔手中的东西，向旁边点了下头，让克莱普尔休息一下。克莱普尔给了他一个温柔的、会心的微笑。

Cookie and Claypool appear nearby, carrying several crates of supplies between them. "Y'know what would be beautiful?" Cookie hollers. "If maybe yeh helped out a lil' bit. Think yeh might get off yer ass for a minute 'n pitch in, Ellsworth?"
The explorer nods with a soft sigh and takes the weight from Claypool's hands, nodding aside for him to take a break. Claypool gives him a gentle, knowing smile.

all_card.flavor:
三个人影在昏暗的礼堂里互相交错，闪着微光出现在你的视线中。“教授。”你听到肯斯勒博士的声音，她的轮廓变得清晰起来。戴尔教授和他的学生紧接着出现了。“我真的希望你能考虑我的建议。”她继续说。如果她真的如她所言那么在乎，至少从她的语气完全听不出来。
作为回应，戴尔只是瞥了丹佛斯一眼，丹佛斯似乎正盯着她身后——远处，非常远。
“好吧。不论如何……”她调整了一下眼镜，走进了贴着她名字的门。
戴尔摇摇头，叹了口气，但是丹佛斯打破了沉默。“我……我认为我们应该去。”

Three figures shimmer into view as they cross one another in the darkened halls. "Professor," you hear Dr. Kensler's voice acknowledge, and her outline becomes defined. Professor Dyer and his protégé appear next. "I do hope you'll consider my proposal," she continues. If she truly cared one way or the other, her tone of voice surely does not reveal it.
In response, Dyer simply glances at Danforth, who appears to be staring behind her - far, far behind her. "Well. In any event..." she adjusts her glasses, and enters the door labeled with her name.
Dyer shakes his head with a sigh, but Danforth is the one who breaks the silence. "I...I think we should go."

all_card.real_flavor: "You really think I can't navigate a simple maze?" Ellsworth chuckles. He looks several years younger and wears a proper tuxedo instead of his comfortable jacket and trousers. The figure he speaks to stands just out of view, a dark silhouette with a muffled, indistinct voice. "Fine," the explorer replies with a roll of his eyes. He hands the figure his champagne glass and loosens his tie. "But when I get back, you are going to tell me what this is really all about."

all_card.flavor:
当伊里亚出现在你的视线中时，你惊讶地发现他身边没有一直陪伴着他的伙伴安雨。他握着一个陌生女子的手，她有着灿烂红宝石般颜色的卷发。当老旧的火车驶近时，这对年轻的恋人互相凝视着对方的眼睛。“你预计你要去多久？”
“我……我也不清楚。”他坦白，“这是一次漫长的旅程。阿拉斯加真是个大地方。”
“所以，这就是永别了吧。”女子说道。她擦去眼中愤怒的泪水。“你会写信给我吗？”
“我尽力，但是……”他把目光移开。
“好吧，好吧。”她说道，表示明白。火车进站了，刺耳的汽笛声盖过了他们说的话。“你……大傻瓜。”她踮起脚，亲吻了他的脸颊。“你是个大傻瓜，伊里亚。”
“我……我知道。”他回答，“我知道的。”

all_card.real_flavor:
When Eliyah materializes into view, you are stunned to see him without his steadfast companion, Anyu. He holds an unfamiliar woman's hands, her wavy hair the color of a brilliant ruby. The two young lovers stare into one another's eyes as the old train approaches. "How long do you think you will be gone?"
"I...I'm not sure," he confesses. "It is a lengthy journey. Alaska is a hell of a big place."
"So, this is goodbye, then," the woman says. She wipes angry tears from her eyes. "Will you write?"
"I'll try, but..." he glances away.
"Right, right," she says, understanding. The train pulls into the station, its piercing squeal muffling their words. "You...fool." She leans up and kisses his cheek. "You are a fool, Eliyah."
"I...I know," he replies. "I know."

all_card.flavor:
“这该死的试飞！”曲奇的喊声盖过了呼啸的疾风。他俩在高田的一架飞机上——这一定是发生在你们出发前往那些山峰之前，她完成第一架飞机的工作后，紧接着发生的事情。
“习惯一下吧！”高田坐在飞行员的座位上高喊。“我们在空中，任何时候天气都会很恶劣。不过别担心，她撑得住。”你看到冷酷的副驾驶在强忍着笑。“你很享受，是吧？”高田调侃道。
“啥呀？”曲奇撒謊着，“只是时间长有点无聊罢了。”

all_card.real_flavor:
"Hell of a test run!" Cookie yells over the roar of the rushing wind. The two of them are up in one of Takada's aeroplanes - this must have happened just after she completed work on the first plane, before the lot of you set off toward the peaks, and the events that ensued.
"Get used to it!" Takada shouts from the pilot's seat. "Weather's gonna be rough anytime we're in the air. Don't worry though, she'll hold." You see the grim copilot hold back a smile. "You're enjoying this, aren't you?" Takada chimes.
"Naw," Cookie lies. "Just been a while, is all."
all_card.real_text: Choose one: - Follow Takada's memories. Put the set-aside Airfield location into play. - Follow Cookie's memories. Put the set-aside Ottoman Front location into play. Flip this card back over.

all_card.flavor:
“这些是莱克营地失踪的雪橇。”戴尔教授边说着边闪着光出现在视线中。听起来他并没有特别惊讶——似乎他们已经预见了这种可能性。
丹佛斯已经走到第一辆雪橇前面，检查雪橇里的东西。“这是燃油炉、燃料，还有他们所有的研究仪器……”他声音越来越小。“天哪，这是什么臭味？”他朝最远的那架雪橇走去，捆在货物上的油布奇怪地鼓起。
“丹佛斯，别——”戴尔喊着，但已经太迟了。丹佛斯刚把油布拿开，就摇摇晃晃地后退了几步，捂住了嘴和鼻子。油布下面冻着一位年轻探险家和他的一只雪橇犬的尸体。
“格德尼。”戴尔低语

all_card.real_flavor:
These are the sledges missing from Lake's camp," Professor Dyer remarks, shimmering into view. He doesn't sound particularly surprised - it seems they must have accounted for this possibility.
Danforth is already at the first of the sledges, examining its contents. "Here's the gasoline stove, the fuel, all of their research instruments..." he trails off. "God, what is that awful stench?" He motions toward the farthest sledge, the tarpaulin strapped around its cargo bulging oddly.
"Danforth, don't-" Dyer calls out, but it's too late. The moment Danforth removes the tarpaulin, he staggers backward, covering his mouth and nose. Frozen and preserved beneath the tarpaulin are the corpses of a young explorer and one of his sled dogs.
"Gedney," Dyer whispers.
all_card.real_text:

all_card.flavor:
“谢谢你……邀请我来这里，辛哈医生。”肯斯勒博士轻声说着，她的轮廓闪烁着出现在视线中。她和辛哈医生坐在几乎空无一人的剧院里。灯光昏暗，帷幕揭起，但演出还没有开始。
“当然。还有叫我玛拉就行。”
肯斯勒畏缩了一下，然后清了清嗓子。“那你可以叫我艾米。”
“我已经这么做啦。”医师回复着，她们面前的荧幕开始变亮。

all_card.real_flavor:
"Thank you for...for inviting me here, Dr. Sinha," Dr. Kensler says quietly, her outline shimmering into view. She and Dr. Sinha sit next to one another in the almost-empty theatre. The lights are dim and the curtain drawn, but the show has not yet begun.
"Of course. And just Mala is fine."
Kensler flinches and clears her throat. "Then call me Amy."
"I already do," the physician replies as the screen in front of them kindles to life.

all_card.flavor:
克莱普尔抬头凝视着遗迹，眼中闪烁着惊奇的光芒。“太了不起了，是不是，威廉？”在他身后，戴尔教授在幻景中出现了。他们两人都至少年轻十岁，也许更多。你注意到克莱普尔没有称呼教授的头衔。
“奇妙而神秘。”戴尔回答，“没有人知道这里的真正用途。也许以后也不会有人知道。”
“但这就是我们这么做的原因，对吧？”克莱普尔笑着说，“为了了解真相。”
戴尔回头看了一眼那个年轻人，他的眼角拉出忧虑的皱纹。“是的。”他低语道，“真相。”

all_card.real_flavor:
Claypool stares up at the ruins with a twinkle of wonder in his eyes. "Marvelous, isn't it, William?" Behind him, Professor Dyer materializes within the mirage. Both of them are at least a decade younger, perhaps more. You note Claypool did not address the professor by his title.
"Marvelous and mysterious," Dyer replies. "Nobody knows the true purpose of this site. Perhaps nobody ever will."
"But that's why we do this, right?" Claypool says with a grin. "To learn the truth."
Dyer glances back at the youth, lines of worry pulling at his eyes. "Yes," he whispers, "the truth."

all_card.flavor: 一个十几岁的女孩闪烁着出现在视线中。你认出高田栗色的眼睛和纤细的直发。她的脸颊被泪水和雨水弄脏了。当那架摇摇晃晃的老旧飞机起飞时，她挥着手。你并不认识这种设计——这一定是十多年前的事了。“别担心，孩子。”她旁边的男人抓住她的肩膀鼓励她。“他很快就会回来的。”他安慰她说，他的声音温柔而富有同情心，“你就等着吧。”

all_card.real_flavor: A teenage girl shimmers into view. You recognize Takada's chestnut eyes and thin, straight hair. Her cheeks are stained with tears and rain. She waves as the old, rickety aeroplane takes off. You don't recognize the design - this must have been over a decade ago. "Don't worry, kiddo." The man next to her grips her shoulder encouragingly. "He'll be back soon," he reassures her, his voice soft with compassion. "You'll see."

all_card.flavor: 伊里亚蜷缩在一棵树旁坐着，一阵大雪在他的周围落下。安雨在他的臂弯里呜咽着。鲜血浸湿了他的手套，他紧紧地抱着狗，狗的皮毛都被染成了红色。“我知道，小姑娘。”他念叨着，“我知道，我知道。我们……我们会没事的。你和我都会没事的，小姑娘。安雨，对吧？那是你的名字吗？”大狗抬头看着他的眼睛。“我们会没事的，安雨。我向你保证。”

all_card.real_flavor: Eliyah sits huddled up against a tree, a torrent of snow falling around him. In his arms, Anyu whines. Blood soaks his gloves, staining the dog's fur red as he holds her tight. "I know, girl," he chants, "I know, I know. We...we are going to be okay. You and me, girl. Anyu, right? That was your name?" The dog peers up into his eyes. "We will be okay, Anyu. I promise you."

all_card.flavor: 丹佛斯尖叫着把被子扔到一边。汗水浸透了他的前额，从他的脸颊上滴下来。“这只是个梦。”他低语着，“只是个梦，只是个梦。”他从床上倒了下来，用手帕轻轻擦了擦脑袋，然后走到旁边的窗口向外张望。他看到另一边的影子，吓得向后一跳，撞上对面的墙。“不……不！”

all_card.real_flavor: Danforth screams and throws his covers aside. Sweat drenches his forehead and drips down his cheeks. "Just a dream," he whispers. "Just a dream, just a dream." He collapses from his bed, dabs his head with a handkerchief, and wanders over to the nearby window to peer outside. The shape he sees on the other side causes him to leap back in fear, crashing into the opposite wall. "No...no!"

all_card.flavor:
戴尔使劲捏着那个男子的手，脸上洋溢着笑容。“你不知道这对我有多重要。”他大声说道，“这将是一次意义深远的旅程。对我们所有人来说都是。”
你认出了和他说话的那个人——已故的莱克教授，他是和戴尔一起去南极冒险并再也没有回来的众多人员之一。
“是的，威廉。”莱克回答道，他的眼睛里流淌着可怕的黑色脓液。“这次探险将改变一切。”

Dyer shakes the man's hand vigorously, a smile beaming across his face. "You have no idea how much this means to me," he exclaims. "This will be a journey of profound importance. For all of us."
You recognize the man he speaks to - it is the late Professor Lake, one of many who ventured with Dyer to Antarctica and never returned.
"Yes, William," Lake replies, his eyes dribbling over with terrible black ichor. "This expedition will change everything."

all_card.flavor:
年轻的辛哈医生出现在床边，她的脸因悲伤而扭曲。你从未见过她如此伤心。一名护士把手放在辛哈医生的手上安慰她，但她把手挥开了。“不要。”她哽咽着尖叫。
“你已经做到最好了，医生。”护士说。
“不，我永远都应该做得更好。” 辛哈医生喊道，“我们本可以更聪明！更快！”她想握拳，但双手却颤抖起来。黑色瘴气从她的指缝间渗出。“我们——我——这是我的错。都是我的错。”

all_card.real_flavor: A young Dr. Sinha appears by the bedside, her face contorted with grief. You have never seen her so stricken. A nurse places a hand on top of Dr. Sinha's in consolation, but she bats it away. "Don't," she barks, choking back a sob. "There is nothing more you could have done, Doctor," the nurse says. "There is always more that can be done," Dr. Sinha shouts. "We could have been smarter! Faster!" Her hands shake as she tries to make a fist. Black miasma seeps from between her knuckles. "We - I - this is my fault. All my fault."

all_card.flavor: 肯斯勒博士坐在办公桌前，努力将精神集中在工作上。各种各样的文件整齐地堆放在她的周围，书架上整齐有序，就跟你认为教授应该的样子一样。但她写的日记却凌乱不堪。她用手梳理头发，解开马尾辫。“不，不，不……”她喃喃地说着，从书上撕下一张紙。你在她生气地合上日记时注意到一张作为书签的照片夹在书页之间。她打开一个抽屜，把那张皱巴巴的紙扔了进去，全然不在乎抽屉里正冒着瘴气泡，还有从里面散发出来的腐烂的灰色烟雾……

all_card.real_flavor: Dr. Kensler sits at her desk, struggling to focus on her work. Various papers sit in neat piles around her, and the bookshelf is perfectly ordered, just as you would expect from the professor. But the journal she writes in is cluttered and unkempt. She runs her hand through her hair, undoing her ponytail. "No, no, no..." she mutters, ripping a piece of paper from the book. You spot a photograph serving as a bookmark, keeping her page as she shuts the journal angrily. She opens one of her desk drawers and throws the crumpled paper inside, barely noticing the way the drawer bubbles over with miasma, and the putrid gray mist emanating from within...

all_card.flavor:
在战爭的喧闹声——枪声和迫击炮声震得大地都为之摇动——之中，曲奇缓慢而有条不紊地重新装填好步枪。“弗雷德里克斯中士！”一个声音喊道。他的同伴俯身穿过壕沟，附近的另一次爆炸扬起了泥水。“德国人昨晚突破阵线了。他们在周围打转。我们必须离开这里！”
曲奇在他的步枪末端绑上了刺刀。“中尉下命令了吗？”他问道。
“威廉斯中尉死了。”士兵回答，声音里透着恐惧，“长官……现在由您指挥。”

all_card.real_flavor:
Through the din of war - a hail of gunfire and mortars so loud it shakes the earth - Cookie reloads his rifle, slowly and methodically. "Sergeant Fredericks!" a voice calls out to him. His companion ducks through the trench as another nearby explosion kicks up a spray of mud. "Germans broke the line last night. They're circling around. We have to get out of here!"
Cookie affixes a bayonet to the end of his rifle. "Did the lieutenant give the order?" he asks.
"Lieutenant Williams is dead," the soldier replies, the fear in his voice palpable. "Sir...you're in charge."

all_card.flavor:
“根据因纽特人的传说，这块巨石在人类出现在地球上之前就已经矗立在这里了。”年轻的艾弗里一边沿着它的表面研究符文语言，一边敘述道。“我不懂这些文字，但它毫无疑问是古代的。不过，这还不是最奇怪的部分。”
“那什么是呢？”另一名探险家一边问，一边拉下兜帽，以便更好地欣赏这座高耸的建筑。
“你自己看吧。”克莱普尔说着，展开一张地图，把它放在光滑的石头上。地图表面绘有许多圆环和线条，描绘了不同的天气模式。“这东西……像是避雷针。”

"I don't know about any of that, but it is definitely ancient. That's not even the weirdest part, though."
"What is?" one of the other explorers asks, pulling his hood down to get a better view of the towering structure.
"See for yourself," Claypool says, unfolding a map and placing it against the smooth stone. Drawn over the map's surface are many rings and lines depicting various weather patterns. "This thing...is like a lightning rod."

And nobody ever believed me when I told them about the creature that attacked us. They turned me into a pariah. I thought...maybe I was crazy, after all." He shudders as he recalls the shape the mirage took. "But now I know. What attacked us that day was real."

all_card.flavor: “我永远忘不了那一天，我第一个病人去世的那天。”当幻景消失时，她交叉双臂。她的眼睛疲倦而疲惫。“他们告诉你，即使是最优秀的人也会遇到这种情况，但即便如此，我们也从来没有准备好。我还没有蠢到发誓再也不会失去另一个病人。我知道那只是幻想。”她会意地瞥了你一眼。“相反，我只是发誓再也不对他人倾注感情。所以不要因为我疏远你而难过。这是为了我自己。所以如果——当——我失去你时，我也不会迷失，我自己。”

"They tell you it happens to even the best of us, but even so, we are never prepared. I was not foolish enough to vow that I would never lose another one. I knew that was a fantasy." She glances at you knowingly. "Instead, I simply vowed never to get attached. So do not be upset at my distance. It is for my own sake. So if - when - I lose you, I am not lost, myself."

all_card.text: 警戒。 猎物 - 拥有艾弗里·克莱普尔的调查员。 [action]在混乱袋里加入1个[frost]标记：谈判。对本敌人造成4点伤害。 强制 - 在本敌人被击败时：将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 幻灵. 精英
all_card.real_text: Alert. Prey - Investigator with Avery Claypool. [action] Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag: Parley. Deal 4 damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

all_card.flavor:
“从那以后，就没有回头路了。”真正的克莱普尔解释说，“可以说，我们打开了潘朵拉之盒。我再也不能逃避现实了。世上存在我们无法理解的力量。科学无法解释的东西。就像我无法解释那石头对那个地区的气象影响一样，我也无法解释在我们发现后袭击我们的风暴的性质。”
你询问克莱普尔，那天和他在一起的另一个人发生了什么。他咬着牙，摇着头。
all_card.name: 可怕发现之记忆
all_card.text: 在剧本日志中，记录下克莱普尔直面他內心的恶魔。在探险队部分他的名字旁画一个勾。 从现在起，每当一场冒险期间包括艾弗里·克莱普尔或其被使用，不使用探险队遭遇组中的版本，改为使用放在一边的[[坚毅]]版本。如果他当前在场上，现在就将他切换为该版本。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。 调查员可以推进当前场景或继续游戏。
all_card.real_flavor:
"After that, there was no going back," the real Claypool explains. "We had opened Pandora's box, so to speak. I could no longer bury my head in the sand. There are forces out there beyond our comprehension. Things that science cannot explain. Just as I could not explain that stone's meteorological impact on the region. Nor could I explain the nature of the storm that hit us after we uncovered it."
You ask Claypool what happened to the other man who was with him that day. He grinds his teeth and shakes his head.
all_card.real_text: In your Campaign Log, record Claypool has confronted his demons. Draw a checkmark next to his name in the Expedition Team section. From now on, whenever Avery Claypool is included or used during a scenario, use the set-aside [[Resolute]] version instead of the version from the Expedition Team encounter set. If he is currently in play, switch him with that version now. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.

all_card.flavor: “我……我记得这个。”真正的埃尔斯沃思盯着自己的记忆说，“这就是为什么我想成为一名探险家的原因。为了发现这样的东西。古代秘密，天知道是被什么东西留下来的。但我发现得越多，我就越觉得，不去探索地球的某些地方会更好。也许这一切都是像我这样的人的错，我们这些拒绝让历史被尘封的人。我们都是傲慢的傻瓜。”
all_card.name: 翻译异星文字之记忆
all_card.text: 在剧本日志中，记录下埃尔斯沃思直面他內心的恶魔。在探险队部分他的名字旁画一个勾。 从现在起，每当一场冒险期间包括罗尔德·埃尔斯沃思或其被使用，不使用探险队遭遇组中的版本，改为使用放在一边的[[坚毅]]版本。如果他当前在场上，现在就将他切换为该版本。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。 调查员可以推进当前场景或继续游戏。
all_card.real_flavor: "I...I remember this," the real Ellsworth says, staring at his own memory. "This is what made me want to become an explorer. To discover things like this. Ancient secrets, left behind by God knows what. But the more I discover, the more I think that perhaps there are parts of the Earth better left alone. Perhaps all of this is the fault of people like me, who refuse to let history lie. Arrogant fools, the lot of us."

all_card.flavor: 肯斯勒博士——真正的那位——冷眼看着你。“你不该接触这段记忆。”她警告着，“不过我想你和我一样，对当前处境也没有什么决定权。”你不禁好奇，什么样的学术工作会让像她这样的人感到不安，所以你向她发问。“这不是学术性质的。”她坦白道，一边漫不经心地抚摸着她的办公桌，然后从日记里抽出照片，私下里检查它。“我从来都不擅长……表达自己內心的想法。”她说着，照片在她手中慢慢消失，幻景中的其他东西也一同消失了。“走吧。我不想再待在这里了。”她说着。

all_card.real_flavor: Dr. Kensler - the real one - eyes you coldly. "This memory is not for you," she warns. "Though I suppose you have no more control over this than I do." You cannot help but be a little curious what kind of academic work would rattle somebody like her, so you ask. "It was not academic in nature," she confesses, running her hand idly along the vision of her office desk, before pulling the photograph out from inside the journal and examining it in private. "I was never very skilled in expressing myself in...matters of the heart," she says, and the photograph fades in her hands, along with the rest of the mirage. "Come along. I do not wish to remain here any longer," she states.

all_card.back_flavor: 山腰裂开，雪花喷了出来。一股凌乱的冰屑风暴从山腹中爆发。在其之后，野兽出现了：一团迷雾旋风；令人难忘的异形身影；可怕的臭气。它惊悚的眼神死死盯着你们，带着一缕瘴气向你袭来。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的星之恐怖敌人放置入场，位于高度最高的，有调查员的地点。所有位于该地点的调查员各自失去其对所有[[探险]]支援的控制权，并将那些支援放在自己所处的地点。 阅读剧本手册中的冒险幕间故事：悲剧袭来。
all_card.flavor: 你来到了险恶山脉的山麓下。山顶的奇异洞穴和奇怪构造亟待探索。
all_card.name: 失落山峰
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你移动到一个地点后：将你所有线索放回供应堆。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The mountainside splits and erupts with snow. A storm of jagged ice shards bursts forth from the womb of the mountain. Behind it, the beast emerges: a whirlwind of mist; haunting, alien shapes; hideous effluvia. It sets its terrible gaze on your party and reaches for you with a tendril of miasma.
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy into play at the highest level location with one or more investigators. Each investigator at that location loses control of all [[Expedition]] assets and places them at their location. Read Scenario Interlude: Tragedy Strikes in the Campaign Guide.
all_card.real_flavor: You arrive at the foothills of the menacing mountain. The strange caves and odd formations at the mountain's summit beg to be explored.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you move to a location: Return all of your clues to the token pool.

all_card.back_flavor: 雪下得如此之大，目的地已从你的视野中消失，你同伴的呼喊也无法越过咆哮的狂风传入你耳中。你走的每一步都让你喘不过气来。这里的空气太稀薄了，你还能呼吸已经是个奇迹。你抬头望着头顶上投下的白茫茫的无尽之网。也许你从来没有接近过山顶——就像这个鬼地方的一切，不过是另一种障眼法。
all_card.back_text: 如果有调查员已经撤退，进入(→结局1)。 否则，进入(→结局2)。
all_card.flavor: 曾经的小雪变成了狂风暴雪。如果你不能尽快越过山峰，你就得被迫寻找避难所……或者永远变成山坡上一具冻僵的尸体。
all_card.name: 恐怖降临
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你移动到一个地点后：将你所有线索放回供应堆。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The snowfall is so thick now that you can no longer see your destination, nor can you hear your companions' shouts over the howling wind. Every step takes the breath out of you. The air is so thin up here, it is a wonder you even have any breath to spare. You glance up at the blanket of white cast in an endless net overhead. Perhaps you were never close to the summit - just another trick of the eye, like everything else in this godforsaken place.
all_card.real_back_text: If one or more investigators have resigned, proceed to (→R1). Otherwise, proceed to (→R2).
all_card.real_flavor: The once-flurrying snow has become a tempest of wind and heavy snowfall. If you don't make it across the peaks soon, you'll be forced to take shelter...or spend the rest of eternity as a frozen corpse along the mountainside.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you move to a location: Return all of your clues to the token pool.

all_card.back_flavor: 经过漫长而艰难的登山之旅，你已经到达了失落山峰。你希望一路上承受的痛苦和恐惧都已拋诸于脑后，但你恐怕它会继续折磨着你……永不间断。
all_card.flavor: 你带着尽可能多的探险装备，必须爬上险峻的山坡去解开另一边的秘密。
all_card.name: 登上高峰
all_card.text: [action]：控制你所在地点的一个[[探险]]支援。 目标 - 到达山顶。如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退了，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: After a long and arduous journey up the mountainside, you've reached the forbidden peaks. You hope the pain and horror you've suffered along the way is behind you, but you fear that it will persist...and become relentless.
all_card.real_flavor: Carrying as much expedition gear as you can, you must climb the imposing mountainside to unlock the secrets that lie on the other side.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Take control of an [[Expedition]] asset at your location. Objective - Get to the top of the mountain. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 城市的城墙偷偷呼唤着你，这是人类耳朵听不懂的空灵歌曲，但不知怎么的，却还是那么熟悉。你尽全力让声音不进入脑海，假装这只是你的想像，但你的所有同伴并非都能成功……
all_card.back_text: 阅读剧本手册中的冒险幕间故事：凝视疯狂。
all_card.flavor: 古老而神秘的城市在你面前隐现，里面有着怎样的秘密——和恐怖——在等待着你呢？
all_card.name: 恐惧潜伏
all_card.text:
[free]在你回合期间，花费1个线索：查看你所在行或列的一个城市景观的已揭示面。(每轮仅限一次。)
[free]在你回合期间，花费3个线索：移动到你所在行或列的任意地点。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The walls of the city call to you in surreptitious whispers, ethereal songs indecipherable to human ears, and yet somehow familiar all the same. You try your best to shut them out, to make believe it is just your imagination, but not all of your companions are as successful...
all_card.real_back_text: Read Scenario Interlude: Gaze into Madness in the Campaign Log.
all_card.real_flavor: The hidden alien city looms before you, ancient and enigmatic. What secrets - and terrors - lie in wait within?
all_card.real_text:
[fast] During your turn, spend 1 clue: Look at the revealed side of a City Landscape in your column or row. (Limit once per round.)
[fast] During your turn, spend 3 clues: Move to any location in your column or row. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor:
你的想法变得错综复杂，恐惧、担心和怀疑交织在一起。危险潜伏在这个令人厌恶的地方每一个角落，但最危险的是，你越来越觉得你不应该呆在这里——你应该逃离这个地方，永远不要回来。
当外面的天气变坏时，你躲在这座城市高楼中相对安全的一个地方。现在已经太迟了，没法回营地了。你唯一的希望是在这个城市中避难，祈祷你的存在不会被仍然徘徊在它的街道和古老大厅里的居民注意到。
all_card.flavor: 在黑暗的冰层下，城市更多部分都被困在那里，冰封于时间的长河中。这只是冰山一角……
all_card.name: 自下而来的毁灭
all_card.text:
[free]在你回合期间，花费1个线索：查看你所在行或列的一个城市景观的已揭示面。(每轮仅限一次。)
[free]在你回合期间，花费3个线索：移动到你所在行或列的任意地点。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Your thoughts become convoluted, a tangle of fear, worry, and doubt. Danger lurks around every corner of this abominable place, but most dangerous of all is the growing feeling that you should not be here - that you should flee from this place and never return.
As the weather outside turns foul, you hole up in the relative safety of one of the city's towering structures. It is too late to return to camp. Your only hope is to take shelter within the alien city, hoping your presence goes unnoticed by the denizens that still prowl through its streets and ancient halls.
all_card.real_flavor: Below the darkened ice, more of the city lies trapped, encased and frozen in time. This is but the tip of the iceberg...

[fast] During your turn, spend 3 clues: Move to any location in your column or row. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor:
你的发现简直太疯狂了，让人难以置信。根据城里的壁画和记录，“古老者”是来自繁星的旅者。早在人类出现之前，它们就在地球上殖民，定居范围非常宽广。在最高山脉下的地下城市深处，它们创造了怪异生物——“修格斯”——作为它们的仆人。但修格斯反抗了它们，它们的文明很快就崩溃了……
突然，远处传来声音阻止了你和其他探险者的脚步：一种低沉的咆哮声，似乎来自下面远处的某个地方。你不敢想像是什么样的怪物会发出如此可怕的声音。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的修格斯遭遇组和遭遇弃牌库混洗入遭遇牌库。 你知道去地下城市的通路。揭示隐秘隧道。 将放在一边的星之恐怖敌人放置入场，位于隐秘隧道，处于横置状态。
all_card.flavor: 这是一生难得的发现。戴尔的报告是真的——全部內容都是。你必须探索这个异星文明，以便了解更多……
all_card.name: 错综复杂之城(版本一)
all_card.text: [action]花费2个[elder_thing]钥匙：请记住队伍“研究了古老者的历史”。 [action]花费2个[tablet]钥匙：请记住队伍“了解了修格斯的起源”。 目标 - 如果队伍“研究了古老者的历史”且“了解了修格斯的起源”，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
What you have found is almost too wild to believe. According to the murals and records within the city, the "Elder Things" were travelers from the stars. They colonized the Earth long before the time of humanity, settling far and wide. And deep in the undercity beneath the tallest mountain, they created monstrous creatures - "Shoggoths" - to be their servants. But the Shoggoths rebelled against them and soon their civilization collapsed...
Suddenly, a distant noise stops you and the other explorers in their tracks: a deep, bellowing roar that seems to come from somewhere far below. You dare not ponder what kind of monstrosity could have made such a hideous sound.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Shoggoths encounter set and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. You know the route into the undercity. Reveal the Hidden Tunnel. Put the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy into play at the Hidden Tunnel, exhausted.
all_card.real_flavor: This is the discovery of a lifetime. Dyer's report was true - all of it. You must explore this alien civilization in order to learn more...
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend two [elder_thing] keys: Remember that the team "studied the history of the Elder Things." [action] Spend two [tablet] keys: Remember that the team "discerned the origin of the Shoggoths." Objective - If the team has "studied the history of the Elder Things" and "discerned the origin of the Shoggoths," advance.

all_card.real_flavor: Somewhere in this sprawling web of icy streets and cyclopean structures lies an ancient gateway leading to the undercity beneath the great mountain. You'll have to find it if you wish to learn more...

all_card.name: 星之恐怖
all_card.text:
猎手。庞大。
星之恐怖得到+3[per_investigator]生命值。
星之恐怖处于重整状态时，位于星之恐怖所在地点的调查员不能花费或控制钥匙。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 幻灵. 精英
all_card.real_text:
Hunter. Massive.
Terror of the Stars gets +3 [per_investigator] health.
While Terror of the Stars is ready, investigators at its location cannot spend or take control of keys.

all_card.name: 和蔼的古老者
all_card.text: 生成 - 任意无人地点。 和蔼的古老者入场带有1个毁灭标记。 强制 - 在和蔼的古老者被击败时：在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。 [action]：谈判。检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，将和蔼的古老者从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Any empty location. Benign Elder Thing enters play with 1 doom on it. Forced - When Benign Elder Thing is defeated: Place 1 doom on the agenda. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, remove Benign Elder Thing from the game.

all_card.name: 复苏的古老者
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在本敌人与你交战时：将你控制的一个钥匙放到本敌人上。在本敌人离场时，将该钥匙放在本敌人所在地点。 强制 - 在本敌人所在地点的一位调查员控制一个钥匙时：本敌人重整，与该调查员交战，并攻击该调查员。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When this enemy engages you: Place a key you control on it. When it leaves play, place that key on its location. Forced - When an investigator at this enemy's location takes control of a key: This enemy readies, engages, and attacks them.

all_card.name: 真相开端
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。本次检定难度值增加你所在地点和你控制的钥匙数之和。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧(如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，改为3点恐惧)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 1 for each key on your location or under your control. If you fail, take 2 horror (3 horror instead if you fail by 3 or more).

all_card.name: 崩塌废墟
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。本次检定期间，如果你揭示了一个与你所在地点上的钥匙或者你所在地点一位调查员控制的钥匙一致的混乱标记，你自动失败。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). During this test, if you reveal a chaos token that matches a key on your location or under the control of an investigator at your location, you automatically fail. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.

all_card.name: 冻伤
all_card.text: 显现 - 将冻伤放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 冻伤可被治愈，如同是你身上的1点伤害(如果它被治愈，将其弃掉)。 强制 - 你在技能检定期间揭示[frost]混乱标记时：你必须受到1点伤害或本次检定自动失败。(每次检定仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Frostbitten into play in your threat area. Frostbitten can be healed as if it were a single point of damage on you (if it is healed, discard it). Forced - When you reveal a [frost] token during a skill test: You must either take 1 damage or you automatically fail this test. (Limit once per test.)

all_card.name: 附身
all_card.text: 显现 - 将附身放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 附身可被治愈，如同是你身上的1点恐惧(如果它被治愈，将其弃掉)。 强制 - 你在技能检定期间揭示[frost]混乱标记时：你必须受到1点恐惧或本次检定自动失败。(每次检定仅限一次。)
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Possessed into play in your threat area. Possessed can be healed as if it were a single point of horror on you (if it is healed, discard it). Forced - When you reveal a [frost] token during a skill test: You must either take 1 horror or you automatically fail this test. (Limit once per test.)

all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if there is an [[Ancient One]] enemy at your location).
[cultist]: -1. If there is a seal at your location, or if your location is a Mist-Pylon, treat this token as a [frost] token in addition to its modifier.
[tablet]: -3. Draw the top card of the Tekeli-li deck.
[elder_thing]: -5. If you fail by 3 or more, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This can cause the current agenda to advance.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if there is an [[Ancient One]] enemy at your location).
[cultist]: -1. If there is a seal at your location, or if your location is a Mist-Pylon, treat this token as a [frost] token, instead.

all_card.back_flavor: ——黑色深坑——洞穴边——原初修格斯——没有窗户的五维实体——无名圆柱——古老灯塔——原始白色胶状物——翅膀——黑暗中的眼睛——登月梯——起源——永恒——不朽——
all_card.back_text: 一堵翻滾的瘴气之墙挡住了古老的大门，调查员和敌人不能进入伊夸之门。伊夸之门不能拥有附属。
all_card.name: 伊夸之门
all_card.text: [action]：将你控制的一个激活的封印放在伊夸之门上。 [action]：撤退。你撤退了，希望你已经做了足够的工作，能够把大门彼端的东西封印起来(如果你控制着1个或更多封印，你保留它们的控制权)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: -the black pit - the carven rim - the proto-shoggoths - the windowless solids with five dimensions - the nameless cylinder - the elder pharos - the primal white jelly - the wings - the eyes in darkness - the moon-ladder - the original - the eternal - the undying-
all_card.real_back_text: A wall of churning miasma blocks the ancient gateway. Investigators and enemies cannot enter The Gate of Y'quaa. The Gate of Y'quaa cannot have attachments.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Place an activated seal you control on The Gate of Y'quaa. [action]: Resign. You retreat, hoping you've done enough to seal away whatever lies beyond the gate. (If you control 1 or more seals, you retain control of them.)

all_card.back_flavor: “其他的孔洞无疑是与过去的机械设备有关——如供暖、照明等——这在许多雕画中都有所暗示。天花板一般都很平实，但有时也会镶嵌上绿色的皂石或其他瓷砖，而现在大多已经脱落了。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.name: 地热口
all_card.text: [action]如果你控制[seal_a]封印：检定[combat](3)。如果你检定成功，位于地热口的调查员可以共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索，来激活[seal_a]封印。然后，从混乱袋里移除1个[frost]标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Other apertures were undoubtedly connected with bygone mechanical facilities - heating, lighting, and the like - of a sort suggested in many of the carvings. Ceilings tended to be plain, but had sometimes been inlaid with green soapstone or other tiles, mostly fallen now." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

all_card.real_back_flavor: "Other apertures were undoubtedly connected with bygone mechanical facilities - heating, lighting, and the like - of a sort suggested in many of the carvings. Ceilings tended to be plain, but had sometimes been inlaid with green soapstone or other tiles, mostly fallen now." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
all_card.real_text: [action] If you control the [seal_e] seal, investigators at Hall of the Sunless Sea spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and discard 2 [per_investigator] cards from their hands, as a group: Activate the [seal_e] seal.

all_card.back_flavor: “其他的孔洞无疑是与过去的机械设备有关——如供暖、照明等——这在许多雕画中都有所暗示。天花板一般都很平实，但有时也会镶嵌上绿色的皂石或其他瓷砖，而现在大多已经脱落了。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.name: 水下扩张区
all_card.text: 在水下扩张区的每次技能检定期间，将揭示的第一个[frost]标记的修正值改为视为-3，而不是-1。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Other apertures were undoubtedly connected with bygone mechanical facilities - heating, lighting, and the like - of a sort suggested in many of the carvings. Ceilings tended to be plain, but had sometimes been inlaid with green soapstone or other tiles, mostly fallen now." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
all_card.real_text: Treat the modifier of the first [frost] token revealed during each skill test at Subnautical Sprawl as -3 instead of -1. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: “其他的孔洞无疑是与过去的机械设备有关——如供暖、照明等——这在许多雕画中都有所暗示。天花板一般都很平实，但有时也会镶嵌上绿色的皂石或其他瓷砖，而现在大多已经脱落了。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.name: 拱形走廊
all_card.text: [free]：选择另一个拱形走廊并检定[agility](X)。X为本地点到该拱形走廊所需移动次数。如果你检定成功，移动到该地点。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Other apertures were undoubtedly connected with bygone mechanical facilities - heating, lighting, and the like - of a sort suggested in many of the carvings. Ceilings tended to be plain, but had sometimes been inlaid with green soapstone or other tiles, mostly fallen now." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
all_card.real_text: [fast]: Choose another Vaulted Corridor and test [agility] (X). X is the number of locations away that Vaulted Corridor is from this one. If you succeed, move there. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.flavor: “这个地方那纯粹到令人震惊的古老和致命的荒涼足以压倒几乎所有敏感的人……”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.name: 原始恐怖
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。你所在地点到伊夸之门每需移动一次，本次检定得到+1难度。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: "The sheer appalling antiquity and lethal desolation of the place were enough to overwhelm almost any sensitive person..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each location away from The Gate of Y'quaa you are. If you fail, take 2 horror.

all_card.flavor: “在恐龙时代繁育和居住在这个可怕的砖石建筑里的东西并不是真正的恐龙，而是更可怕的东西。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.name: 地球根源
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](2)。你所在地点到伊夸之门每需移动一次，本次检定得到+1难度。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: "The things once rearing and dwelling in this frightful masonry in the age of dinosaurs were not indeed dinosaurs, but far worse." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each location away from The Gate of Y'quaa you are. If you fail, take 2 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 一种黑暗、原始的能量从墙壁中渗出，正是在这末日之旅中缠绕着你前进路程上每一步的瘴气。你停下脚步，开始后退。你已经见识过它会变成什么样的可怕形状，它所能唤起的那些记忆——不论肮脏还是美好的。但并不是每个人都能看到幻景的真实面目……
all_card.back_text: 阅读剧本手册中的冒险幕间故事：最后一根稻草。
all_card.flavor: 五道黑暗的通路从大门向外延伸，穿过冰封的洞穴和光滑的黑石拱廊。寂静的恐怖遍布这古老沉寂的建筑。
all_card.name: 跳动的心脏
all_card.text: 强制 - 如果在同一地点有至少2个由调查员控制的激活的封印：储存在封印內的潜在能量聚合在一起，随后的连锁反应引发静电爆炸，摧毁了地球上的所有生命。(→结局3)
all_card.real_back_flavor: A dark, primordial energy seeps forth from the walls, the very same miasma that has haunted your every step throughout this doomed journey. You freeze in your tracks and back away. You've seen the kinds of hideous shapes it can take. The kinds of memories it conjures- foul and fair alike. But not everyone sees the mirage for what it truly is...
all_card.real_back_text: Read Scenario Interlude: The Final Straw in the Campaign Guide.
all_card.real_flavor: Five darkened paths lead away from the gateway, through icy caverns and down vaulted corridors of smooth black stone. Quiet dread fills the ancient, dormant structure.
all_card.real_text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)

all_card.back_flavor: 封印中跳动着危险的静电能量，明亮的蓝色光芒照亮了整个冰冷的房间。你尽力控制所有封印的力量，同时快速移动，想要把它们放在正确的地方。
all_card.back_text:
检查由每位调查员控制的封印(如果有封印不是由调查员控制的，跳过它)。
控制[seal_a]封印的调查员受到1点伤害(如果封印是激活的，改为2点)。
控制[seal_b]封印的调查员随机弃掉2张手牌(如果封印是激活的，改为4张)。
控制[seal_c]封印的调查员受到1点恐惧(如果封印是激活的，改为2点)。
控制[seal_d]封印的调查员失去1个行动(如果封印是激活的，改为2个)。
控制[seal_e]封印的调查员失去3资源(如果封印是激活的，改为6资源)。
all_card.flavor: 怪异的低语和滴下的墨状瘴气弥漫在曾经寂静的废墟上。有东西从墙里向你伸出。它正呼唤着你。
all_card.name: 瘴气的召唤
all_card.text: 强制 - 如果在同一地点有至少2个由调查员控制的激活的封印：储存在封印內的潜在能量聚合在一起，随后的连锁反应引发静电爆炸，摧毁了地球上的所有生命。(→结局3)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The seals pulse with dangerous electrostatic energy, filling the icy chambers with bright blue light. You struggle to contain the power within each seal as you move quickly to put them in their proper place.
all_card.real_back_text:
Check the seals controlled by each investigator (if a seal is not controlled by an investigator, skip it).
The investigator who controls the [seal_a] seal takes 1 damage (2 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_b] seal discards 2 random cards from their hand (4 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_c] seal takes 1 horror (2 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_d] seal loses 1 action (2 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_e] seal loses 3 resources (6 instead if the seal is activated).
all_card.real_flavor: Eldritch whispers and the dribbling of inky miasma permeates the once-silent ruins. Something is reaching out to you from within its walls. Calling to you.
all_card.real_text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)

all_card.back_flavor: 在你成功找到并放置所有五个封印之前，巨大的噪音响彻洞穴般的大厅，五彩的墨状瘴气开始从墙壁和天花板的每一寸渗透出来。大量蠕动的脓水和飘来的黑雾挡住了每一条路，除了你来的那条。你向大门口逃去，试图逃跑或找到另一条路前进，但当你到达大门时，已经太迟了。
all_card.back_text: 剩余的每位调查员被击败，且必须承受1点精神创伤，或者将忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的3张卡牌混洗入各自的牌库。
all_card.flavor: 大门骚动着。无论墙里有什么在召唤你，它都能听到你说的每一个字，你的每一步。它知道你的存在，你的希望，你的恐惧。而且它渴望自由。
all_card.name: 疯狂的召唤
all_card.text: 强制 - 如果在同一地点有至少2个由调查员控制的激活的封印：储存在封印內的潜在能量聚合在一起，随后的连锁反应引发静电爆炸，摧毁了地球上的所有生命。(→结局3)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Before you can find and place all five seals, a tremendous noise fills the cavernous halls of the facility, and inky, prismatic miasma begins to seep from every inch of the walls and ceiling. Waves of creeping ichor and wafting black mist block every route but the one from which you came. You flee back to the gateway to escape or find another path forward, but by the time you reach the massive door, it is too late.
all_card.real_back_text: Each remaining investigator is defeated and must either suffer 1 mental trauma or shuffle the top 3 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck.
all_card.real_flavor: The gateway stirs. Whatever is calling to you from within these walls, it hears your every word, your every footstep. It knows of your presence, of your hopes, of your fears. And it yearns to be free.
all_card.real_text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)

all_card.back_flavor: 一旦你将封印放对位置，随着咔嗒一声，它就锁在了门上。储存在封印内的能量顺着管道和凹槽延伸，照亮了整个房间，发出一种怪异的光芒。也许如果你能激活并放置剩下的四个封印，你就能阻止这场疯狂。
all_card.back_text: 检查刚刚放置的是哪个封印(不要移除它)。 如果是[seal_a]封印，放置该封印的调查员治愈1点伤害。 如果是[seal_b]封印，放置该封印的调查员抽取2张卡牌。 如果是[seal_c]封印，放置该封印的调查员治愈1点恐惧。 如果是[seal_d]封印，放置该封印的调查员本回合可以执行额外一个行动。 如果是[seal_e]封印，放置该封印的调查员获得3资源。
all_card.flavor: 为了找到能安装在这个奇怪大门上的设备，你决定探索这片远古建筑群的其余部分。
all_card.name: 蛰伏
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果一个激活的封印被放到伊夸之门上，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As soon as you set the seal into place, it locks into the door with an audible click. The energy stored within the seal reaches out, coursing through channels and grooves along the doorway, and lighting the entire chamber with an eerie glow. Perhaps if you can activate and place the remaining four seals, you can put a stop to this madness.
all_card.real_back_text: Check which seal was just placed (do not remove it). If it was the [seal_a] seal, the investigator who placed it heals 1 damage. If it was the [seal_b] seal, the investigator who placed it draws 2 cards. If it was the [seal_c] seal, the investigator who placed it heals 1 horror. If it was the [seal_d] seal, the investigator who placed it may take an additional action this turn. If it was the [seal_e] seal, the investigator who placed it gains 3 resources.
all_card.real_flavor: You have decided to explore the rest of this antediluvian complex in order to find the devices that fit this strange doorway.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If an activated seal is placed on The Gate of Y'quaa, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 最后的封印归位。随着一阵嗡嗡声，能量流过整个设施。嵌在天花板上的小球体开始一个接一个地亮起来。你意识到这个圣所比你想像的要先进得多。
all_card.flavor: 放置了五个封印中的第一个后，设施中的某种奇怪力量被唤醒了。你相信如果你能找到并激活剩下的封印，它们将有助于控制潜伏在这扇门彼端的东西……
all_card.name: 巨大封印
all_card.text: 目标 - 在里面的东西逃离前，在伊夸之门上放置尽可能多的激活的封印。如果放置了所有五个封印，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The final seal locks into place. With a hum, power flows through the facility. Small orbs embedded in the ceiling begin to light, one by one. The realization dawns on you that this sanctuary is far more advanced than you could have ever imagined.
all_card.real_flavor: Placing the first of the five seals has awoken a strange power within the facility. You believe if you can find and activate the remaining seals, they will aid in containing the thing that dwells on the other side of this gate...
all_card.real_text: Objective - Place as many activated seals as you can on The Gate of Y'quaa before whatever is inside escapes. If all five seals have been placed, advance.

all_card.name: 原生质团
all_card.text: 猎手。 生成 - 最外的环形上距离你最远的地点。 猎物 - 仅对拥有封印的最近调查员。 强制 - 在敌军阶段结束时，如果一位调查员控制着激活的封印：重整原生质团并再结算一次敌军阶段(其结算其猎手关键词并再次攻击)。(每阶段限一次)(FAQ v2.1)
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Spawn - Location farthest from you on the outer ring. Prey - Nearest investigator with a seal only. Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if an investigator controls an activated seal: Protoplasmic Mass readies and resolves the enemy phase again (it resolves its hunter keyword and attacks a second time). (Limit once per phase.)

all_card.name: 静电释放
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 - 每位与一个封印在同一地点的调查员受到1点恐惧，如果该封印是激活的，再受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Each investigator at the same location as a seal takes 1 horror, and 1 damage if that seal is activated

all_card.back_flavor: 从地球最核心的无名深渊中，瘴气的真实形态出现了。那是一种无形，由旋转的雾和腐烂脓液构成的生物，它在尖叫、低语、爬行、飞舞。它穿过墙壁，从冰中渗出；它无处不在；它就是一切。
all_card.back_text:
在离一位调查员最近的迷雾高塔生成1张放在一边的无名疯狂敌人。
检查剧本日志。如果你尚未明了幻景的真相：
你呆呆地望着这千变万化的可怕幻景。空气中闪烁着梦幻般的光芒，噩梦和记忆在无尽地交织着。一看到它你就不由自主跪了下来。这是终极真相。现实曾是幻景。
每位调查员查找自己牌库，找出其中所有忒咳哩-哩，并依次按随机顺序抽取这些卡牌，且不要将它们放在忒咳哩-哩牌库底。在结算完所有这些卡牌后，将它们各自混洗入承受者的牌库。
all_card.flavor: 瘴气已经完全吞噬了设施的这一部分。墙壁和天花板上滴落着色彩不断变化的软泥，极地迷雾在大厅里盘旋，空气闪烁着虚幻的微光。这是什么样的力量？而你又能怎样毁掉它？
all_card.name: 封印减弱
all_card.real_back_flavor: From the nameless depths at the very core of the Earth, the miasma's true form emerges. It is a shapeless thing, a creature of whirling mist and putrid ichor that screams and whispers and crawls and flies. It seeps through the walls and up from the ice; it is everywhere; it is everything.
all_card.real_back_text:
Spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness enemy at the Mist-Pylon nearest to an investigator.
Check the Campaign Log. If the truth of the mirage eludes you:
You stare, dumbstruck, at the hideous phantasmagoria. The air shimmers with a dreamlike quality about its damnable form, an endless weave of intermingled nightmare and memory. The very sight of it drives you to your knees. It is the final truth. Reality was the mirage.
Each investigator searches their deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and draws them one at a time in a random order, without placing them on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. After resolving all of them, shuffle each of them back into their bearer's deck.
all_card.real_flavor: Miasma has completely consumed this part of the facility. The walls and ceiling drip with polychromatic ooze, polar mist swirls through the halls, and the air shimmers with the insubstantial quality of a mirage. What manner of power is this? And how can you possibly hope to destroy it?

all_card.back_flavor: 已经太迟了。你没能控制住在山脉底下的生物。你现在唯一能做事情的就是逃命。
all_card.back_text:
每有一个被摧毁的迷雾高塔，将3张无名疯狂放在一边。
每位调查员失去其所有线索。
将除了伊夸之门外的所有地点从游戏中移除。调查员和无名疯狂不会被本效果击败。弃掉这些地点上的所有其他卡牌。
将4张放在一边的巨大坡道地点放置入场，在伊夸之门右边排成一条直线。将放在一边的隐密隧道地点放置入场，位于最右边的巨大坡道右边。将所有调查员和剩余的所有无名疯狂放置入场，位于最左边的巨大坡道。
将场景牌库从游戏中移除，并推进至放在一边的最终幻景。它既是当前场景也是当前密谋。
all_card.flavor: 忒咳哩-哩！忒咳哩-哩！忒咳哩-哩！忒咳哩-哩！忒咳哩-哩！忒咳哩-哩！忒咳哩-哩！忒咳哩-哩！忒咳哩-哩！
all_card.name: 无名存在
all_card.text: 强制 - 在至少1个毁灭标记将要被放置入场时，如果仍然有放在一边的无名疯狂：改为在一个没有无名疯狂敌人，但连接地点有该敌人的，离调查员最近的地点生成1张放在一边的无名疯狂。 目标 -当一轮结束时，如果所有15张无名疯狂都在场上，且并非所有迷雾高塔都被摧毁，推进本密谋。
all_card.real_back_flavor: It is too late. You cannot contain the creature that dwells beneath the mountain. All you can hope to do now is escape with your lives.
all_card.real_back_text:
For each Mist-Pylon that is collapsed, set 3 copies of The Nameless Madness aside.
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Remove each location except The Gate of Y'quaa from the game. Investigators and copies of The Nameless Madness are not defeated by this effect. All other cards at these locations are discarded.
Put the 4 set-aside Titanic Ramp locations into play in a straight line to the right of The Gate of Y'quaa. Put the set-aside Hidden Tunnel location into play to the right of the rightmost Titanic Ramp. Place each investigator and each remaining copy of The Nameless Madness in play at the leftmost Titanic Ramp.
Remove the act deck from the game and advance to the set-aside The Final Mirage. It is both the current act and the current agenda.
all_card.real_flavor: Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li!
all_card.real_text: Forced - When 1 or more doom would be put into play, if there are any copies of The Nameless Madness still set aside: Instead, spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness at the location nearest to an investigator without a copy of that enemy that is connected to a location with a copy of that enemy. Objective - At the end of the round, if all 15 copies of The Nameless Madness are in play and not every Mist-Pylon is collapsed, advance this agenda.

all_card.back_flavor: 整座设施都在摇晃。没有高塔为建筑供能，居住在里面的无名存在重获自由——但它时日无多，当然你也一样。山脉呻吟着，颤抖着，好像要在你周围倒塌。
all_card.back_text:
将除了3张以外的其他所有无名疯狂放在一边。
每位调查员失去其所有线索。
将除了伊夸之门外的所有地点从游戏中移除。调查员和无名疯狂不会被本效果击败。弃掉这些地点上的所有其他卡牌。
将4张放在一边的巨大坡道地点放置入场，在伊夸之门右边排成一条直线。将放在一边的隐密隧道地点放置入场，位于最右边的巨大坡道右边。将所有调查员和剩余的所有无名疯狂放置入场，位于最左边的巨大坡道。
将密谋牌库从游戏中移除，并推进至放在一边的最终幻景。它既是当前场景也是当前密谋。
all_card.flavor: 五座高塔共同支撑着这座设施。你唯一的希望就是摧毁它们——还有其他的一切。
all_card.name: 摧毁高塔
all_card.text: 每个已揭示的迷雾高塔可以被攻击，如同它是敌人。它的攻击值等于它的隐藏值，它的生命值等于它的线索值。它没有剩余生命值时，它被摧毁(它依然保持在场上)。 [reaction]在你发现迷雾高塔上的1个或更多线索时，花费那些线索：对该迷雾高塔造成该数量的伤害。 目标 - 当一轮结束时，如果所有迷雾高塔都被摧毁，推进本场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The facility shakes to its very core. Without the Mist-Pylons powering the structure, the nameless entity that resides within is free - and its days are numbered, as are yours. The mountain groans and trembles, threatening to collapse all around you.
all_card.real_back_text:
Set all but 3 copies of The Nameless Madness aside.
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Remove each location except The Gate of Y'quaa from the game. Investigators and copies of The Nameless Madness are not defeated by this effect. All other cards at those locations are discarded.
Put the 4 set-aside Titanic Ramp locations into play in a straight line to the right of The Gate of Y'quaa. Put the set-aside Hidden Tunnel location into play to the right of the rightmost Titanic Ramp. Place each investigator and each remaining copy of The Nameless Madness in play at the leftmost Titanic Ramp.
Remove the agenda deck from the game and advance to the set-aside The Final Mirage. It is both the current act and the current agenda.
all_card.real_flavor: Five pylons hold this facility together. Your only hope is to destroy them - and everything else.
all_card.real_text: Each revealed Mist-Pylon can be attacked as if it were an enemy. Its fight value is equal to its shroud value and its health is equal to its clue value. While it has no health remaining, it is collapsed (it remains in play). [reaction] When you discover 1 or more clues at a Mist-Pylon, spend those clues: Deal that much damage to that Mist-Pylon. Objective - At the end of the round, if each Mist-Pylon is collapsed, advance this act.

all_card.back_flavor: “在这整个奇观中，始终遍布着某种暗示，暗示着惊人的秘密和潜在的启示：仿佛这些荒涼的、噩梦般的尖顶标志着一个可怕大门旁的高塔……”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 作为你进入迷雾高塔的额外费用，你所在地点的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.name: 迷雾高塔
all_card.text: [free]如果你控制[seal_a]封印，且其是激活的：你释放了封印的力量。将[seal_a]封印放在本迷雾高塔上。直到本场游戏结束，每当你对迷雾高塔造成伤害，额外造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "In the whole spectacle there was a persistent, pervasive hint of stupendous secrecy and potential revelation; as if these stark, nightmare spires marked the pylons of a frightful gateway..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter Mist-Pylon, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_text: [fast] If you control the [seal_a] seal, and it is activated: You unleash the seal's power. Place the [seal_a] seal on this Mist-Pylon. For the remainder of the game, each time you deal damage to a Mist-Pylon, deal 1 additional damage.

all_card.name: 无名疯狂
all_card.text: 警戒。庞大。反击。 无名疯狂不能受到伤害。 强制 - 你成功躲避或攻击无名疯狂后：你每超过难度1点，横置最近的一个重整状态的无名疯狂。
all_card.traits: 古神. 幻灵. 精英
all_card.real_text: Alert. Massive. Retaliate. The Nameless Madness cannot take damage. Forced - After you successfully evade or attack The Nameless Madness: For each point you succeeded by, exhaust the nearest ready copy of The Nameless Madness.

all_card.name: 解开封印的幻影
all_card.text: 生成 - 最近的未被摧毁的迷雾高塔(如果场上没有，则为你所在地点)。 解开封印的幻影处于重整状态且位于一个迷雾高塔时，不能对该迷雾高塔造成伤害。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果解开封印的幻影处于重整状态：将其朝最近的未被摧毁的迷雾高塔移动一次。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 幻灵. 修格斯
all_card.real_text: Spawn - The nearest Mist-Pylon that is not collapsed (or your location, if there are none in play). While Unsealed Phantasm is ready and at a Mist-Pylon, damage cannot be dealt to that Mist-Pylon. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Unsealed Phantasm is ready: Move it once toward the Mist-Pylon nearest to it that is not collapsed.

all_card.back_flavor: 你从隧道里出来，阳光从远处锯齿状的山顶后面探出头，使你目眩。在你身后，那存在也猛冲向出口。你做好面对终结的准备，雾墙、瘴气和疯狂感觉就像一列火车迎面而来。
all_card.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 - 如果所有5个迷雾高塔都被摧毁，且肯斯勒博士有一个计划，进入(→结局1)。 - 如果所有5个迷雾高塔都被摧毁，且你尚未明了幻景的真相，进入(→结局2)。 - 否则，进入(→结局3)。
all_card.name: 最终幻景
all_card.text: 无名疯狂获得猎手。 强制 - 在至少1个毁灭标记将要被放置入场时：改为在最左边的调查员所在地点生成一张放在一边的无名疯狂敌人。 目标 - 跑。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You emerge from the tunnel, daylight blinding you as the sun peeks out from behind the jagged mountaintops in the distance. Behind you, the entity rushes toward the exit. You prepare yourself for the end, the wall of mist, miasma, and madness feeling much like an oncoming train.
all_card.real_back_text: Check the Campaign Log. - If all 5 Mist-Pylons were collapsed and Dr. Kensler has a plan, proceed to (→R1). - If all 5 Mist-Pylons were collapsed and the truth of the mirage eludes you, proceed to (→R2). - Otherwise, proceed to (→R3).
all_card.real_text: The Nameless Madness gains hunter. Forced - When 1 or more doom would be put into play: Instead, spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness at the leftmost investigator's location. Objective - Run.

all_card.back_flavor: “在我们回城路上，沿着被冰淹没的巨石走廊来到那空旷的巨大圆形遗迹，然后沿着古老的螺旋坡道疯狂而机械地往上冲，朝向外面那有着空气和日光的正常世界。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 巨大坡道与其左边和右边的地点连接。
all_card.name: 巨大坡道
all_card.text:
巨大坡道与其左边和右边的地点连接。
作为离开巨大坡道的额外费用，检定[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，取消本次移动的效果。位于你所在地点或相邻地点的任意调查员，可以花费1个线索来使你本次检定自动成功。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "...over our former trail back to the city, along ice-sunken megalithic corridors to the great open circle, and up that archaic spiral ramp in a frenzied automatic plunge for the sane outer air and light of day." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
all_card.real_back_text: Titanic Ramp is connected to the locations to its left and right.
all_card.real_text:
Titanic Ramp is connected to the locations to its left and right.
As an additional cost for you to leave Titanic Ramp, test [agility] (4). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move. Any investigator at your location or a connecting location may spend 1 clue to have you automatically succeed at this test.

Titanic Ramp is connected to the locations to its left and right.
As an additional cost for you to leave Titanic Ramp, test [agility] (3). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move. Any investigator at your location or a connecting location may spend 1 clue to have you automatically succeed at this test.

all_card.back_flavor: “在我们回城路上，沿着被冰淹没的巨石走廊来到那空旷的巨大圆形遗迹，然后沿着古老的螺旋坡道疯狂而机械地往上冲，朝向外面那有着空气和日光的正常世界。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 巨大坡道与其左边和右边的地点连接。
all_card.name: 巨大坡道
all_card.text:
巨大坡道与其左边和右边的地点连接。
作为离开巨大坡道的额外费用，检定[agility](2)。如果你检定失败，取消本次移动的效果。位于你所在地点或相邻地点的任意调查员，可以花费1个线索来使你本次检定自动成功。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "...over our former trail back to the city, along ice-sunken megalithic corridors to the great open circle, and up that archaic spiral ramp in a frenzied automatic plunge for the sane outer air and light of day." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

Titanic Ramp is connected to the locations to its left and right.
As an additional cost for you to leave Titanic Ramp, test [agility] (2). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move. Any investigator at your location or a connecting location may spend 1 clue to have you automatically succeed at this test.

all_card.text:
巨大坡道与其左边和右边的地点连接。
作为离开巨大坡道的额外费用，检定[agility](1)。如果你检定失败，取消本次移动的效果。位于你所在地点或相邻地点的任意调查员，可以花费1个线索来使你本次检定自动成功。
