all_card.real_text:
Titanic Ramp is connected to the locations to its left and right.
As an additional cost for you to leave Titanic Ramp, test [agility] (1). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move. Any investigator at your location or a connecting location may spend 1 clue to have you automatically succeed at this test.

all_card.back_flavor: “谢天谢地，我们没有放慢脚步。卷曲的雾又浓了起来，正加速向我们涌来；而在我们后面的那些迷路的企鹅开始尖叫……”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 隐密隧道与其左边的地点连接。
all_card.flavor: “……就算是对遗迹倒塌的恐惧，也不能停下我们奔向有着太阳和天空的正常世界的脚步。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.name: 隐密隧道
all_card.text: 隐密隧道与其左边的地点连接。 目标 - 如果每位没有被击败的调查员都在隐秘隧道，推进场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: "Thank heaven we did not slacken our run. The curling mist had thickened again, and was driving ahead with increased speed; whilst the straying penguins in our rear were squawking and screaming..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
all_card.real_back_text: Hidden Tunnel is connected to the location to its left.
all_card.real_flavor: "...not even the fear of collapse could make us pause before reaching the normal outer realm of sun and sky." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
all_card.real_text: Hidden Tunnel is connected to the location to its left. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at the Hidden Tunnel, advance the act.

all_card.name: 原初恶魔
all_card.text: 猎手。反击。 强制 - 在你对原初恶魔造成任意数量的伤害时：将忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的1张卡牌混洗入你的牌库，不要查看內容(如果你不能这么做，原初恶魔攻击你)。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - When you deal any amount of damage to Primordial Evil: Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (if you cannot, Primordial Evil attacks you).

all_card.name: 潜藏的疯狂
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](4)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，将忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的1张卡牌混洗入你的牌库，不要查看內容(每有1张卡牌不能混洗入你的牌库，受到1点恐惧)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). For each point you fail by, shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (for each card you cannot shuffle, take 1 horror).

all_card.name: 实体疯狂
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在实体疯狂攻击你时：将忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的2张卡牌混洗入你的牌库，不要查看內容(每有1张卡牌不能混洗入你的牌库，实体疯狂该次攻击造成+1伤害和+1恐惧)。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When Manifestation of Madness attacks you: Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at them (for each card you cannot shuffle, Manifestation of Madness deals +1 damage and +1 horror for this attack).

all_card.name: 冰川幻影
all_card.text: 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果冰川幻影处于重整状态：将其向调查员最多的地点移动一次。按玩家顺序，每位在冰川幻影所在地点或连接地点的调查员，将忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的1张卡牌混洗入自己的牌库，不要查看內容(每位不能这么做的调查员受到1点恐惧)。
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Glacial Phantasm is ready: Move it once toward the location with the most investigators. In player order, each investigator at Glacial Phantasm's location or a connecting location shuffles the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck without looking at it (each investigator who cannot takes 1 horror).

all_card.name: 同源迷雾
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到最近且没有附属同源迷雾的地点。 强制 - 你在附属地点时，在忒咳哩-哩牌库的卡牌将要混洗入你的牌库时：改为抽取那些卡牌，不要将它们放在忒咳哩-哩牌库底，改为放在你的牌库底。当一轮结束时弃掉同源迷雾。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Kindred Mist attached. Forced - When 1 or more cards from the Tekeli-li deck would be shuffled into your deck while you are at attached location: Draw them instead, placing them on the bottom of your deck instead of the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. Discard Kindred Mist at the end of this round.

all_card.name: 南极寒风
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到最近且没有附属南极寒风的地点。 位于附属地点的调查员不能打出卡牌，或从自己的牌库抽取卡牌。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：弃掉南极寒风。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Antarctic Wind attached. Investigators at attached location cannot play cards or draw cards from their deck. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Antarctic Wind.

all_card.name: 雪盲危机
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 位于附属地点的每位调查员得到-1[willpower]、-1 [intellect]、-1 [combat]、-1 [agility]。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：弃掉雪盲危机。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Each investigator at attached location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility]. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Whiteout.

all_card.name: 极地旋涡
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 强制 - 你在附属地点结束你的回合时：你控制的每张有生命值的卡牌(包括你的调查员)受到1点直接伤害。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：弃掉极地旋涡
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - When you end your turn at attached location: Each card you control with health (including your investigator) takes 1 direct damage. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Polar Vortex.

all_card.flavor: “古老者的生活，不论是在海底，还是一部分迁移到陆地上之后，都足以出好几本书了。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.name: 古老者清道夫
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在古老者清道夫攻击你后：弃掉你牌库顶3张卡牌。抽取所有以此方式弃掉的弱点。
all_card.real_flavor: "Of the life of the Old Ones, both under the sea and after part of them migrated to land, volumes could be written." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - After Elder Thing Scavenger attacks you: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Draw each weakness discarded this way.

all_card.name: 古老者守卫
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在你对古老者守卫造成伤害时：每造成1点伤害，弃掉你牌库顶的1张卡牌。抽取所有以此方式弃掉的弱点。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When you deal damage to Guardian Elder Thing: For each point of damage dealt, discard the top card of your deck. Draw each weakness discarded this way.

all_card.name: 古老者崛起
all_card.text: 显现 - 找出遭遇弃牌堆最顶部的一张[[古老者]]敌人，并将其生成，与你交战。当前与你交战的每个[[古老者]]敌人得到+1攻击和+1躲避，直到一轮结束。如果古老者崛起没有放置敌人入场，其获得涌动。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Find the topmost [[Elder Thing]] enemy in the encounter discard pile and spawn it engaged with you. Each [[Elder Thing]] enemy currently engaged with you gets +1 fight and +1 evade until the end of the round. If Rise of the Elder Things put no enemies into play, it gains surge.

all_card.flavor: 一失足……
all_card.name: 冰缝
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。本次检定期间每揭示一个[frost]标记，受到1点伤害。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: One false step...
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each [frost] token revealed during this test, take 1 damage. If you fail, take 2 damage.

all_card.name: 穿越冰雪
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到最近且没有附属穿越冰雪的地点。 作为进入或离开附属地点(除因冒险卡牌效果外)的额外费用，检定[agility](2)。如果你检定失败，取消本次移动的效果，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧，并弃掉穿越冰雪。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Through the Ice attached. As an additional cost for you to enter or leave attached location (except by a scenario card effect), test [agility] (2). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move, take 1 damage and 1 horror, and discard Through the Ice.

all_card.name: 迷失的研究员
all_card.text: 生成 - 任意地点(如可能，则生成在无人地点)。 迷失的研究员入场时，带有1个毁灭标记。 强制 - 在迷失的研究员被击败时：将其上的所有毁灭标记移动到其所在地点。 [action]：谈判。检定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，控制迷失的研究员上的1个毁灭标记并将其翻至线索面。然后，如果迷失的研究员上没有毁灭标记，将其弃掉。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Any location (empty, if able). Lost Researcher enters play with 1 doom on it. Forced - When Lost Researcher is defeated: Move each doom on it to its location. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, take control of 1 doom on Lost Researcher and flip it to its clue side. Then, if there is no doom on Lost Researcher, discard it.

all_card.name: 狂乱的探险家
all_card.text: 狂乱的探险家入场时，带有1个毁灭标记。 强制 - 在狂乱的探险家被击败时：将其上的所有毁灭标记移动到其所在地点。 [reaction]在你成功躲避狂乱的探险家，且超过难度至少2点后：控制狂乱的探险家上的1个毁灭标记并将其翻至线索面。然后，如果狂乱的探险家上没有毁灭标记，将其弃掉。
all_card.real_text: Frenzied Explorer enters play with 1 doom on it. Forced - When Frenzied Explorer is defeated: Move each doom on it to its location. [reaction] After you successfully evade Frenzied Explorer by 2 or more: Take control of 1 doom on Frenzied Explorer and flip it to its clue side. Then, if there is no doom on Frenzied Explorer, discard it.

all_card.name: 身陷疯狂
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到最近的[[附身]]敌人，并在该敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。如果场上没有[[附身]]敌人，查找遭遇牌库及弃牌堆，从中找出并抽取一个[[附身]]敌人，并将身陷疯狂附属到该敌人(混洗遭遇牌库)。 与该敌人进行的攻击、躲避或谈判的难度增加1。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest [[Possessed]] enemy and place 1 doom on that enemy. If there are no [[Possessed]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Possessed]] enemy, draw it, and attach Abandoned to Madness to it (shuffle the encounter deck). Increase the difficulty to fight, evade, or parley with attached enemy by 1.

all_card.name: 渎神幻象
all_card.text: 显现 - 将忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的1张卡牌混洗入你的牌库，不要查看內容。然后，将渎神幻象放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你抽取的每张忒咳哩-哩弱点的效果额外结算一次。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉渎神幻象。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it. Then, put Blasphemous Visions into play in your threat area. Resolve the effects of each Tekeli-li weakness you draw an additional time. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Blasphemous Visions.

all_card.name: 窥看不可说之事
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 抽取忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的1张卡牌(并结算其效果)。不要将其放到忒咳哩-哩牌库底，改为混洗入任意一位调查员的牌库。如果没有以此效果抽取忒咳哩-哩弱点，窥看不可说之事获得涌动。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Draw the top card of the Tekeli-li deck (and resolve its effects). Shuffle it into any investigator's deck instead of placing it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. If no Tekeli-li weakness is drawn by this effect, Glimpse the Unspeakable gains surge.

all_card.name: 噩梦烟气
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须(选择以下一项)： - 失去2个行动。 - 将忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的2张卡牌混洗入你的牌库，不要查看內容。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Lose 2 actions. - Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at them.

all_card.name: 瘴气折磨
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 如果你控制伙伴支援，将其横置，并将瘴气折磨附属到该支援。否则，瘴气折磨获得涌动。 被附属的支援不能重整。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：被附属的支援受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。 [action]：检定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉瘴气折磨。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If you control a partner asset, exhaust them and attach Miasmatic Torment to them. Otherwise, Miasmatic Torment gains surge. Attached asset cannot ready. Forced - At the end of your turn: Attached asset takes 1 damage or 1 horror. [action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, discard Miasmatic Torment.

all_card.name: 朦胧瘴气
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 强制 - 你在附属地点结束你的回合时：你控制的每张有神智值的卡牌(包括你的调查员)受到1点直接恐惧。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：弃掉朦胧瘴气。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - When you end your turn at attached location: Each card you control with sanity (including your investigator) takes 1 direct horror. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Nebulous Miasma.

all_card.flavor: “……那只是一只企鹅——是一种未知的巨型白化种，比帝企鹅中已知最大的还要大，而其白化的外观和无目的的眼睛非常怪异。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.name: 巨型白化企鹅
all_card.text:
冷漠。
作为进入或离开本敌人所在地点的额外费用，你必须花费1个行动。
all_card.real_flavor: "...it was only a penguin - albeit of a huge, unknown species larger than the greatest of the known king penguins, and monstrous in its combined albinism and virtual eyelessness." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
all_card.real_text:
Aloof.
As an additional cost for you to enter or leave this enemy's location, you must spend 1 action.

all_card.name: 呜啊！呜啊！呜啊！
all_card.text: 显现 - 找到离你最远的巨型白化企鹅敌人。你必须将其移动到你所在地点，或在其上放置1个毁灭标记。如果场上没有巨型白化企鹅敌人，查找遭遇牌库及弃牌堆，从中找出并抽取一个巨型白化企鹅，并混洗遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Find the Giant Albino Penguin enemy farthest from you. You must either move it to your location or place 1 doom on it. If there are no Giant Albino Penguins in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Giant Albino Penguin, draw it, and shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: “……修格斯与其作为，不该被任何人目睹，也不该被任何生物记述。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.name: 失落的修格斯
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制 - 失落的修格斯与你交战后：抽取忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的1张卡牌(如果你不能这么做，失落的修格斯攻击你)。
all_card.real_flavor: "...shoggoths and their work ought not to be seen by human beings or portrayed by any beings." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - After Forgotten Shoggoth engages you: Draw the top card of the Tekeli-li deck (if you cannot, Forgotten Shoggoth attacks you).

all_card.name: 狂暴的修格斯
all_card.text: 猎手。 庞大。 狂暴的修格斯得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：对狂暴的修格斯所在地点的每位调查员和每个非[[修格斯]]敌人造成2点伤害。这些调查员各自抽取忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的1张卡牌。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 修格斯. 精英
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Massive. Rampaging Shoggoth gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Deal 2 damage to each investigator and non-[[Shoggoth]] enemy at Rampaging Shoggoth's location. Each of those investigators draws the top card of the Tekeli-li deck.

all_card.name: 极地幻景
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到最近的有线索且没有附属极地幻景的地点。 强制 - 你发现附属地点的线索，或控制附属地点的线索后：弃掉你手中所有非弱点卡牌。弃掉极地幻景。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location with at least 1 clue, and without a copy of Polar Mirage attached. Forced - After you discover or take control of 1 or more clues at attached location: Discard each non-weakness card in your hand. Discard Polar Mirage.

all_card.flavor: “这种磷光生物提供的光线非常有效，毫无疑问，此处缺失的如同外界夜晚的极光的问题被它弥补了。”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》</cite>
all_card.name: 黑暗极光
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。本次检定期间每揭示一个[frost]标记，受到1点恐惧。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: "The phosphorescent organisms supplied light with vast effectiveness, and doubtless atoned for the loss of the familiar polar auroras of the outer-world night." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

all_card.back_flavor: 丹妮拉一直认为她拥有美好的生活。她有一个可爱的、热闹的家庭。她有一份自力更生的稳定工作。她有足够的钱花在跑车、漂亮女孩儿和自己的摩托车加百列上。但之后她的哥哥拉蒙遇上了一些麻烦。母亲警告过她要小心，黑暗将会接踵而至。丹妮拉在门后放了一杯水——母亲小时候教导她，说这样能抓住恶灵。当丹妮拉醒来，发现瓶子碎了，她便决定去找到毛病的源头，然后将其修正，一如既往。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡片张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0，求生者卡牌([survivor])等级1-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，其他求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0最多5张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：机修工的扳手、黑帮暴徒、1张随机基础弱点。

[elder_sign]效果：+1。如果你本轮被敌人攻击过，改为自动成功。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Daniela always figured she had a good life. She had a loving, boisterous family. She had a steady job that used her brains and her hands. She had enough money to spend on fast cars, pretty girls, and her motorcycle, Gabriel. Then her brother, Ramon, got caught up in some trouble. Her mother warned her to be careful, that darkness lay ahead. Daniela set a glass of water behind the door for her mother's sake, to catch evil spirits - just as she'd been taught as a child. When Daniela awoke to find it shattered, she was determined to figure out what happened and fix it. Just like she always did.

Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Mechanic's Wrench, Mob Goons, 1 random basic weakness.

all_card.back_flavor: 星星里藏有很多秘密，诺曼从不会忽略秘密。当六颗星星从天上消失时，诺曼简直无法接受——尽管他的同事告诉他那一切都是他的想象。他为此花费了好几年，还差点葬送职业生涯，但终于从一本古籍里找到了答案。它描述了星星以及它们消失的顺序，包括确切的日期和时间。书中说这是万物终结的一个信号。它预示了一只庞大的野兽将会撕碎人类所创造的一切。诺曼不知道该怎么做来阻止野兽摧毁世界，但如果星星知道答案，他将会找到答案。

all_card.real_back_flavor: The stars hold many secrets, and Norman was never one to ignore a mystery. So when six stars vanished from the sky, he simply couldn't let it go - not even when his colleagues told him he was just imaginging things. It took him years, and the near-death of his career, but he eventually found his answers in an ancient tome. It described the stars, and the sequence in which they would vanish, down to the very date and time. It was a sign, the book said, of the end of everything. It was the harbinger of a great beast that would tear asunder all that man had wrought. Norman isn't sure what he can do to stop the beast from destroying the world, but if the stars hold the answer, then he will find it.

all_card.back_flavor: 年轻的杰克跟随他父亲一起考古探险，环游世界。而如今他已是遍历全球的寻宝猎人，同时也是一个出色的考古学家，“蒙特雷”跟随他父亲的脚步，保护着古代文明和失落文化的宝藏。但当蒙特雷发现了一个带有熟悉符号的银色吊坠后，他决定去探索自己的过去。很多年前，他的父亲被杀害了，额头带有同样的符号。自此之后，那个画面一直出现在蒙特雷的梦境里。他已经快接近真相了。在找出杀害他父亲的凶手前，他是不会停下脚步的……无论付出多少代价。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Young Jack traveled the world with his father's archaeological expeditions. Now a globe-trotting treasure hunter and an accomplished archaeologist in his own right, "Monterey" follows in his father's footsteps, securing the treasures of ancient civilizations and lost cultures. But after discovering a silver pendant with a familiar symbol on it, Monterey must explore his own past. Years ago, his father was found murdered with the very same sigil carved in his forehead. The image has haunted Monterey's dreams ever since. But he's getting close. He won't stop until he solves the mystery of his father's murder... no matter what it takes.

all_card.back_flavor: 鲍勃认为，推销员的成功取决于坚持不懈。你只需要一遍又一遍地告知别人他们想要的是什么。最近，鲍勃拥有了几枚“被诅咒”的金币，他希望自己一向声名在外的坚持能够发现金币的起源与出现的原因。如果他不出差错的话，这将是一大成就。也许干完这票，他终于能退休，买下自己一直想要的那艘船，在热带天堂钓鱼度过余生。也许到最后，鲍勃会发现那些闪闪发光的其实并不是黄金。

all_card.real_back_flavor: According to Bob, the secret to success as a salesman is persistence. People just need to be told what it is that they want. Repeatedly. Recently, Bob came into possession of a handful of "cursed" golden coins, and he hopes the same persistence he so famously advocates will help him to uncover their origin and purpose. If he plays his cards right, maybe this will be his big score. Maybe he'll finally be able to retire and buy that boat he's had his eye on and spend the rest of his days fishing in a tropical paradise. Or maybe Bob will finally come to see all that glitters is not gold.

all_card.real_flavor: You slide your feet into position, take a deep breath, and center yourself. They are many, but you are one.

all_card.flavor: 熟练操控，这就是延长的双手。
all_card.name: 蝴蝶对剑
all_card.text: [action]：攻击。本次攻击你得到+1[combat]。本次攻击后，你可以横置蝴蝶对剑再次进行攻击，这次攻击将你的[agility]加入你的技能值。这次攻击造成+1伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 近战
all_card.real_flavor: In a practiced grip, they are an extension of the empty hand.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. After this attack, you may exhaust Butterfly Swords to fight again, adding your [agility] to your skill value for that attack. That attack deals +1 damage.

all_card.name: 闪躲
all_card.text:
快速。在一个敌人攻击你所在地点的一位调查员时打出。
取消该次攻击。然后，检定[agility](1)。如果你成功，对该敌人造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack. Then, test [agility] (1). If you succeed, deal 1 damage to that enemy.

all_card.name: 战斗训练
all_card.text:
快速。[[沉稳]]卡牌场上仅限1张。
你得到+1[combat]和+1[agility]。
非直接伤害/恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给战斗训练。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]或+1[agility]。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
You get +1 [combat] and +1 [agility].
Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Combat Training before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] or +1 [agility] for this skill test.

all_card.name: 追猎行动
all_card.text: 快速。在神话阶段期间你将抽取遭遇卡牌时打出。 改为从遭遇牌库中查找一个敌人，将其生成并与你交战(而非在本来的位置生成它)，将追猎行动附属到该敌人上，并混洗遭遇牌库。 [reaction]在你击败被附属的敌人时：获得3资源。
all_card.real_text: Fast. Play when you would draw an encounter card during the mythos phase. Instead, search the encounter deck for an enemy, spawn it engaged with you (instead of its normal spawn location), attach On the Hunt to it, and shuffle the encounter deck. [reaction] When you defeat attached enemy: Gain 3 resources.

all_card.flavor: 廷达洛斯之牙不会放过任何猎物。
all_card.name: 提尔斯哈之牙
all_card.text: 攻击。选择任何已揭示地点的一个敌人作为本次攻击的目标。在结算本次攻击前，你可以移动到该敌人的地点。本次攻击你的[combat]加上你的[agility]。本次攻击造成+3伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: The fangs of Tindalos reach any prey.
all_card.real_text: Fight. Choose an enemy at any revealed location as the target for this attack. Before resolving this attack, you may move to that enemy's location. Add your [agility] to your [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +3 damage.

all_card.name: 蝴蝶对剑
all_card.text: [action]：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]。本次攻击后，你可以再次攻击，这次攻击将你的[agility]加入你的技能值。如果两次攻击都成功，你可以横置蝴蝶对剑，使第二次攻击造成+1伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 近战
all_card.real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. After this attack, you may fight again, adding your [agility] to your skill value for that attack. If both attacks are successful, you may exhaust Butterfly Swords to have the second attack deal +1 damage.

all_card.name: 强制学习

永久。每套牌库仅限1张。当构建牌库时购买。
你的牌库卡牌张数+15。
补给阶段期间，不抽取一张卡牌，改为抽取两张并弃掉其中一张。
all_card.real_text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation.
Increase your deck size by 15.
During each upkeep phase, instead of drawing 1 card, draw 2 cards and discard 1 of them.

all_card.name: 耶利米·科尔比
all_card.text:
你得到+1[intellect]。
[reaction]在耶利米·科尔比入场后，选择“偶数”或“奇数”：揭示你牌库顶的5张卡牌。抽取每张费用符合你选择的卡牌。将剩下的卡牌洗入你的牌库。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克. 旅人
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After Jeremiah Kirby enters play, choose "even" or "odd:" Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Draw each card with a cost that matches the chosen option. Shuffle the remaining cards into your deck.

all_card.name: 通路档案
all_card.text:
每套牌库仅限1张。作为打出本支援的额外费用，在4个不同地点放置1个资源，作为灵脉。
[reaction]在你成功调查了一个带有灵脉的地点后，横置本支援：将该灵脉移动至本支援上。然后，如果本卡牌上有4个灵脉，将其弃掉，拿取本卡牌的灵脉作为资源，并在剧本日志里记录“你已经确认了前行道路”。
all_card.traits: 道具. 书籍. 密教
all_card.real_text:
Limit 1 per deck. As an additional cost to play this asset, place 1 resource on 4 different locations, as leylines.
[reaction] After you successfully investigate a location with a leyline, exhaust this asset: Move that leyline onto this asset. Then, if there are 4 leylines on it, discard it, take its leylines as resources, and record in your Campaign Log that "you have identified the gateway."

all_card.name: 繁星密语
all_card.text:
快速。只可在你的回合期间打出。
弃掉你牌库顶的1张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一张弱点，将它重新洗回你的牌库。否则在你回合剩余时间内，该卡牌在你的弃牌堆时，将它投入到你执行的每个符合条件的技能检定中。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discard the top card of your deck. If that card is a weakness, shuffle it back into your deck. Otherwise, for the remainder of your turn, while that card is in your discard pile, commit it to each eligible skill test you perform.

all_card.name: 登山靴
all_card.text:
每位调查员仅限1张[[鞋子]]。
你得到+1[agility]。
[reaction]你所在地点的最后一个线索被发现后，横置登山靴：移动到一个至少有1个线索，或未揭示的连接地点。
all_card.traits: 道具. 服装. 鞋子
all_card.real_text:
Limit 1 [[Footwear]] per investigator.
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After the last clue is discovered from your location, exhaust Hiking Boots: Move to a connecting location with at least 1 clue, or to a connecting unrevealed location.

all_card.flavor: 心之所向才是真正的旅途。
all_card.name: 加入马队

快速。只可在你的回合期间打出。你每控制一张不同职阶的卡牌，本卡牌的费用减1。
移动到任意一个已揭示的地点。
all_card.real_flavor: The true journey is the one we take in our minds.
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn. Reduce the cost of this card by 1 for each different class among cards you control.
Move to any revealed location.

all_card.flavor: 不拍到相片里就没有人会相信你。见鬼，他们可能还是会不相信你。
all_card.name: 地区勘测
all_card.text: 地区探测在你手中或投入到技能检定中时，其获得等于你[agility]的[intellect]图标，以及等于你[intellect]的[agility]图标。
all_card.real_flavor: They won't believe you if you don't capture it on film. Hell, they probably still won't believe you.
all_card.real_text: While Survey the Area is in your hand or committed to a skill test, it gains [intellect] icons equal to your [agility], and [agility] icons equal to your [intellect].

all_card.name: 医学教科书
all_card.text: [action]：选择你所在地点的一位调查员并检定[intellect](2)。如果你成功，治愈该调查员1点伤害(如果你成功并超过难度至少2点，改为治愈2点伤害)。如果你失败，你必须横置医学教科书或对该调查员造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: [action]: Choose an investigator at your location and test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, heal 1 damage from that investigator (2 damage instead if you succeed by 2 or more). If you fail, you must either exhaust Medical Texts or deal 1 damage to that investigator.

all_card.name: 发掘古物
all_card.text: 调查。选择你手中最多2张[seeker]支援。本次技能检定难度等于所选支援费用之和。如果你成功，将所选支援依次放置入场。通过本能力每放置入场一张[[遗物]]支援，抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Investigate. Choose up to 2 [seeker] assets in your hand. The difficulty of this skill test is equal to the combined cost of the chosen assets. If you succeed, put the chosen assets into play, one at a time. For each [[Relic]] asset put into play by this ability, draw 1 card.

非直接伤害/恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给科学理论。

Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Scientific Theory before it can be assigned to your investigator card.

[action]：选择一位调查员和一个在已揭示地点且带有灵脉的敌人。该调查员移动到该地点。你可以移除该灵脉来对该敌人造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Move 1 leyline from this asset to a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
[action]: Choose an investigator, and an enemy with a leyline at a revealed location. That investigator moves to that location. You may remove the leyline to deal 1 damage to that enemy.

[action]：选择一位调查员和一个带有灵脉的已揭示地点。该调查员移动到该地点。你可以移除该灵脉来让该调查员执行一次调查行动。
all_card.real_text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Move 1 leyline from this asset to a revealed location.
[action]: Choose an investigator and a revealed location with a leyline. That investigator moves to that location. You may remove the leyline to have them take an investigate action.

研究完成。使用(4灵脉)。每套牌库仅限1张。

[action]：选择一位与带有灵脉的敌人交战的调查员。该调查员与带有灵脉的一个敌人解除交战，并移动至一个连接地点。你可以移除该灵脉来自动躲避该敌人。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
all_card.real_text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Move 1 leyline from this asset to a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
[action]: Choose an investigator engaged with an enemy with a leyline. That investigator disengages from that enemy and moves to a connecting location. You may remove the leyline to automatically evade that enemy. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

all_card.name: 通路档案
all_card.text:
研究完成。使用(4灵脉)。每套牌库仅限1张。
[free]：从本支援上移动1灵脉到一位调查员上。
[action]：选择一位带有灵脉的调查员。该调查员抽取1张卡牌并治愈1点伤害或恐惧。你可以移除该灵脉来使该调查员改为抽取2张卡牌并治愈2点伤害或恐惧。
all_card.real_text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Move 1 leyline from this asset to an investigator.
[action]: Choose an investigator with a leyline. That investigator draws 1 card and heals 1 damage or 1 horror. You may remove the leyline to have them instead draw 2 cards and heal 2 damage or 2 horror.

all_card.name: 亵渎预言
all_card.text:
你不在坐标点时，你得到+1[intellect]和+1[agility]，并且你可以忽略趁乱攻击。
[reaction]在亵渎预言入场后：选择一个已揭示地点。该地点是“坐标点”，直到亵渎预言离场。
[action]：移动任意一位调查员至坐标点。
all_card.traits: 道具. 遗物. 书籍
all_card.real_text:
While you are not at the locus, you get +1 [intellect], +1 [agility], and you may ignore attacks of opportunity.
[reaction] After Prophesiae Profana enters play: Choose a revealed location. That location is "the locus" until Prophesiae Profana leaves play.
[action]: Move any investigator to the locus.

all_card.name: 地下支持

永久。每套牌库仅限1张。当构建牌库时购买。
你的牌库中每张非弱点、非署名卡牌最多只能有一张(以卡牌名称区别)。
你的牌库卡牌张数减5。
all_card.real_text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation.
Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of each non-weakness, non-signature card (by title).
Reduce your deck size by 5.

all_card.flavor:
“……一种无形的气息抗拒着我，并让我远离这些古老而凶险的秘密，这些秘密不应为人所知，也未曾有人所知。”
——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《无名之城》
all_card.name: 提前侦察
all_card.text: 移动。移动最多3次。该移动期间敌人不会与你交战。
all_card.real_flavor: "... a viewless aura repelled me and bade me retreat from antique and sinister secrets that no man should see, and no man else had ever dared to see." - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Nameless City"
all_card.real_text: Move. Move up to 3 times. Enemies do not engage you during this movement.

all_card.name: 21点
all_card.text:
依次随机揭示任意个混乱标记，直到你自己选择停下。[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]视作5；[auto_fail]视作10；
[elder_sign]可视作1或11。如果这些标记的总和(忽略+/-)是……
- ……18或更少，获得4资源。
- ……19，获得5资源。
- ……20，获得6资源。
- ……21，获得9资源。
all_card.real_text:
One at a time, reveal random tokens from the chaos bag until you choose to stop. Treat each [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] as a 5; the [auto_fail] as a 10; and the [elder_sign] as either a 1 or an 11. If the combined value of those tokens (ignoring +/-) is...
- ...18 or less, gain 4 resources.
- ...19, gain 5 resources.
- ...20, gain 6 resources.
- ...21, gain 9 resources.

all_card.name: 反间谍活动
all_card.text:
快速。在你抽取一张非弱点的诡计时打出。
取消该卡牌的显现效果并抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
[reaction]在你打出反间谍活动时，提升其费用2点：将“遭遇牌库”换成“你的牌库”。
[reaction]在你打出反间谍活动时，提升其费用2点：将“你”换成“任意调查员”。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery.
Cancel that card's revelation effect and draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[reaction] When you play Counterespionage, increase its cost by 2: Change "the encounter deck" to "your deck".
[reaction] When you play Counterespionage, increase its cost by 2: Change "you" to "any investigator".

all_card.flavor: 要是有什么事是你不该做的，那它当然不会合法。
all_card.name: 欺骗制度

你每控制一张不同职阶的卡牌，获得1资源。
all_card.real_flavor: If you weren't supposed to do it, it wouldn't be legal.
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Gain 1 resource for each different class among cards you control.

all_card.flavor: “真的嘛？现在要跟我讨价还价了？”
all_card.name: 不当交易
all_card.text: 揭示你手中的一张[[道具]]支援。你所在地点的另一位调查员可以打出该支援，如同其是自己手牌。如果该调查员选择打出，你抽取一张卡牌并获得该支援印刷费用的资源。
all_card.real_flavor: "Really? You're going to haggle with me now?"
all_card.real_text: Reveal an [[Item]] asset in your hand. Another investigator at your location may play that asset as if it were in their hand. If they do, draw 1 card and gain resources equal to that asset's printed cost.

all_card.flavor: 五十分的运气，一百分的实力。
all_card.name: 行业专家
all_card.text: 行业专家获得等于你最低技能值的[wild]图标(除正在检定的技能外)。
all_card.real_flavor: Fifty percent luck, a hundred percent skill.
all_card.real_text: Savant gains [wild] icons equal to your lowest skill other than the skill being tested.

all_card.text: 卓越。使用(0充能)。 强制 - 在你的回合开始后：在此放置1充能，或拿取此处所有充能作为资源。然后，如果它恰好拥有…… - 1充能，下次技能检定中你得到技能值+3。 - 2充能，你可以移动最多2次。 - 3充能，你本回合可以进行1次额外行动。
all_card.real_text: Exceptional. Uses (0 charges). Forced - After your turn begins: Either place 1 charge here, or take all charges here, as resources. Then, if it has exactly... - 1 charge, you get +3 skill value for your next skill test. - 2 charges, you may move up to 2 times. - 3 charges, you may take an additional action this turn.

all_card.name: 金钱万能
all_card.text:
快速。在任意地点一位调查员发动技能检定时打出。
本次检定不是其标识的技能类型([willpower]、[intellect]、[combat]或[agility])，而是改为资源技能检定。执行检定的调查员的基础技能值等于你资源池内资源数的一半(向下取整)。抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_text:

Instead of the skill type indicated for this test ([willpower], [intellect], [combat], or [agility]), this is a resource skill test. The performing investigator's base skill value for this test is equal to half the number of resources in your resource pool (rounded down). Draw 1 card.

从任意位调查员的牌库顶依次揭示卡牌，直到正好揭示5张卡牌。将这些卡牌放在一边，位于场外。这些卡牌放在一边时，任意调查员可以将其打出，如同是自己手牌。当下个调查阶段开始时，将这些卡牌中仍放在一边的洗回其所有者的牌库。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play at the start of the investigation phase.
One at a time, reveal cards from the top of any investigator deck(s) until exactly 5 cards have been revealed. Set those cards aside, out of play. While set aside, any investigator may play any of those cards as if they were in their hand. At the start of the next investigation phase, shuffle each of those cards still set aside into its owner's deck.

all_card.name: 刚毅果敢

快速。[[沉稳]]卡牌场上仅限1张。
你得到+1[willpower]和+1[agility]。
非直接伤害/恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给刚毅果敢。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]或+1[agility]。

Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Moxie before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] or +1 [agility] for this skill test.

卓越。
你拥有……(时)
- ……10+资源，你得到+1生命和+1神智。
- ……15+资源，在你回合期间你可以额外执行一次行动。
- ……20+资源，你得到每项技能值+1。

Exceptional.
While you have...

- ...15+ resources, you may take one additional action during your turn.

all_card.back_flavor: 夜鹰汇集在敦威治的屋顶，发出欢呼的尖叫。敦威治人相信，夜鹰的到来，就预示着某人命不久矣。它们是在等候你的死亡？还是哪里的受害者吗？
all_card.back_text: 如果有至少3个潜在牺牲，随机选择一个放到密谍牌库底下，不要查看。
all_card.flavor: 敦威治并不欢迎你。近来一连串的失踪案，让本就冷漠的村民更是变本加厉。大多数人都向你投来怀疑的目光，愿意帮助你调查的人寥寥无几。要是你不快点找到失踪村民身在何处，天知道将会发生什么……
all_card.name: 奇怪的失踪案
all_card.real_back_flavor: Whippoorwills gather along the gambrel roofs of Dunwich and begin to shriek in jubilation. The people of Dunwich believe that the presence of whippoorwills foreshadows somebody’s imminent death. Do they long for your death? Or is the victim someone else?
all_card.real_back_text: If there are 3 or more potential sacrifices, choose one of them at random and place it underneath the agenda deck, without looking at it.
all_card.real_flavor: Your welcome in Dunwich has been cold. A string of disappearances has left the already aloof townsfolk on edge. Most of them look at you with distrust, and few are willing to help in your investigation. Who knows what will happen if you don’t find the location of the missing townsfolk soon...

all_card.back_flavor: 夜色愈深，聚集在敦威治的夜鹰也就越多。你早就听说这里的村民非常迷信，他们都被夜鹰吓坏了。家家户户都对你锁上了大门，你发现自己在敦威治的街道上孤立无援。
all_card.back_text: 如果有至少2个潜在牺牲，随机选择一个放到密谋牌库底下，不要查看。
all_card.flavor: 日暮西垂，惊恐的村民回家锁上了门。你很清楚他们之中许多人知道内情，只是不说。村内的人心本质竟是如此，你不禁觉得腹中一阵恶心。
all_card.name: 他饿了
all_card.real_back_flavor: More whippoorwills flock to Dunwich village as the night progresses. The other townsfolk, notoriously superstitious, are terrified by the birds’ presence. With the doors around you shut and locked, you find yourself alone in the streets of Dunwich.
all_card.real_back_text: If there are 2 or more potential sacrifices, choose one of them at random and place it underneath the agenda deck, without looking at it.
all_card.real_flavor: As the sun sets, the frightened townsfolk retreat into their homes and lock their doors. It is clear to you that many of them know more than they are letting on. A sickening feeling turns over in your stomach as the village’s true nature becomes clear.

all_card.back_flavor: 整夜呱呱叫的夜鹰一同散去了，看来它们对是夜的一切心满意足。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员必须立刻撤退。
all_card.flavor: 整片夜色之中都是夜鹰鸣叫的旋律。要是敦威治村民所信为真，它们的歌声预示着即将到来的死亡……但死的人会是谁呢？
all_card.name: 怪兽的美餐
all_card.real_back_flavor: The whippoorwills that have been cawing through the night scatter in unison, as if they are somehow satisfied with the turn of events.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator must immediately resign.
all_card.real_flavor: The rhythmic screeching of the whippoorwills fills the night. If the superstitions of Dunwich are correct, their song portends impending death... But for whom?

all_card.back_flavor:
你找到了进入隐藏密室的路，你相信失踪的村民就关在那里。但你在此处见到的恐怖景象几乎把你逼疯。房间隐藏的角落里锁着一个不可名状的人脸怪物。你进来的时候，它扭动身子，气喘吁吁，想要挣脱身上的锁链。这怪物身上长满了巨口，张张嘴巴里都带着血和软骨，仿佛有人刚刚喂过。
这怪物用七张嘴发出可怕的嘶吼：“赛……赛……赛斯？”它突然朝你转了过来，像是要抓住你一样。锁链中有几条已经折断。
all_card.back_text:
揭示每个未揭示的地点。
将场上所有线索(包括每位调查员的)移动到隐藏密室。
将放在一边的塞拉斯·毕晓普敌人生咸在隐藏密室。
all_card.flavor: 敦威治村里的失踪案可能和阿卡姆发生的事情有关。你怀疑有什么邪恶的事情正在谋划。你必须找到被抓走的失踪村民，揭开阴谋的真相。
all_card.name: 寻找答案
all_card.text: 目标 - 在有调查员进入隐藏密室时，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You find your way into the hidden chamber where you believe the missing folk are being held, but the horrors that confront you there fray the edges of your sanity. Bound by chains in a secluded corner of the room is an unspeakable creature with the face of a man. It wheezes and wrestles to free itself as it notices your entrance. The many mouths covering the creature’s body are covered in blood and gristles of meat, as though it were feeding recently.
With a hideous croak, the creature speaks with seven mouths."Ss... se... eth...?" Then it lurches forward as though to grab you, and several of its chains snap.
all_card.real_back_text:
Reveal each unrevealed location. 
Move all clues in play (including those on each investigator) to The Hidden Chamber.
Spawn the set-aside Silas Bishop enemy in The Hidden Chamber.
all_card.real_flavor: The disappearances in town may be related to the events in Arkham. You suspect that something awful is afoot. You must find where the missing townsfolk are being held in order to unveil this conspiracy.
all_card.real_text: Objective - When an investigator enters The Hidden Chamber, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你不顾危险和这可怕的怪物，没有将它直接杀死，而是勇敢地在密室中调查。真相验证了你最糟糕的预想。几本“赛斯·毕晓普”所写的日志用骇人听闻的细节描述了喂养这只怪物的过程——开始是番茄，后来是小动物，再之后是牲畜，最后则是“人类牺牲”。但最恶心的是，赛斯居然还用人的名字称呼这个怪物：“塞拉斯”。
all_card.back_text: 如果死灵之书(奥洛斯·沃尔密乌斯译本)在场上：(→结局2)。 否则：(→结局3)。
all_card.flavor: 这凄惨的怪物伸出黏滑的手臂来抓你，万千巨口饥渴地噬咬。杀了它反而是一种仁慈。但也许这怪物身上也能发现点什么……
all_card.name: 野兽的牢笼
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果塞拉斯·毕晓普被击败：(→结局1) 目标 - 如果隐藏密室没有线索，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Despite the danger, you brave the beast's horrifying presence and investigate further before killing it. What you find confirms your worst suspicions. Several journal entries written by a "Seth Bishop" describe the process of feeding the creature in horrifying detail - tomatoes at first, then small game, then cattle, and then finally 'human sacrifices'. But the most disturbing part is that Seth calls the creature by name: 'Silas.'
all_card.real_back_text: If The Necronomicon is in play: (→R2) Otherwise: (→R3)
all_card.real_flavor: The pitiful beast lunges to grab you with slimy arms, its many jaws snapping in hunger. Killing it would be merciful. But perhaps there is something else to discover about this creature…
all_card.real_text: Objective - If Silas Bishop is defeated: (→R1) Objective - If there are no clues in the Hidden Chamber, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: ……大块的霉菌和数个世纪的腐败，让人很难忽略村里街上依稀的有害臭气。<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.flavor: ……零星散布的房屋却出奇得一致：老旧、肮脏、破败不堪。<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 公共空地
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。“这简直是自杀！我们晚上最好还是找个地方躲起来。”
all_card.real_back_flavor:
...it is hard to prevent the impression of a faint, malign odour about the village street, as of the massed mould and decay of centuries.
-H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_flavor:
...the sparsely scattered houses wear a surprisingly uniform aspect of age, squalor, and dilapidation.
-H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text: [action] Resign. "This is suicide! We're better off hiding out the night."

all_card.back_flavor: 在六岁那一晚，佐伊听到了上帝对她说话，她由此得知自己与众不同……就是在那一晚，大火夺走了她的父母。上帝告诉佐伊，已经在茫茫众生之中选中了她作为自己的使徒。她将保护无辜、惩处奸恶。自那以后，每次她身陷困局，主都会及时出现，指引她、抚慰她。佐伊现在穿行于各个城市之间，以主厨为业。不上班的时候，她就遵循主的声音，穿行于暗夜。只要发现奸恶，她必予以痛击，毫不心软，亦无犹豫。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Zoey had known that she was special ever since God spoke to her one night when she was six years old... the night that terrible fire took away her parents. He told her that He had chosen her from among all the people of the world to be His agent. She would protect the innocent and punish the wicked. Since then, He comes to her in times of trouble, offering guidance and comfort. Zoey now travels from city to city, taking work as a chef to support herself. When she isn't working, she stalks the night, guided by the Lord's voice. Wherever she finds wickedness, she strikes it down without remorse or hesitation.

all_card.back_flavor: 每每灾祸来临，雷克斯·墨菲总是首当其冲。只要和雷克斯待上一天，哪怕是最坚定的无神论者都会坚信，这个男人一定是被诅咒了。每次一有好报道的苗头，事情就开始不对劲了。印斯茅斯的记录和照片一起都吹到了海里。在敦威治的时候，他刚要报警，路上的踪迹就被雨水冲得一干二净。这糟糕的运气已经不止一次让他直面可怕的野兽和密教的阴谋。为了活下去，雷克斯不得不拥有一颗好奇善问的心，让自己赶在下一场灾祸的前头。

all_card.real_back_flavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong. That business in Innsmouth with the photographs that had blown out to sea. The tracks in Dunwich that had washed away in the rain just before he'd brought the sheriff. His terrible fortune has more than once exposed him to gruesome beasts and occult conspiracies. To survive, Rex has developed an inquisitive mind, keeping one step ahead of the next disaster.

all_card.back_flavor: 珍妮·巴恩斯把自己的青春韶光都花在了追求物质享受、珍馐佳肴和新近时尚上。但自从她收到姐妹伊莎贝拉的来信之后，一切都变了。伊莎贝拉在信中坦露，神秘力量合起伙儿来对付她，她害怕自己就要沦入某种神秘力量的魔爪。这是珍妮从挚爱的姐妹那里收到的最后一封信。于是她回到了美国，追踪调查自己能发现的任何密教行迹。她已证明自己绝非温室里的花朵，一碰就枯，而是一位百发百中的神枪手，一位勇敢无畏、绝顶聪明、挺身面向未知的调查员。找不到伊莎贝拉失踪的原因，珍妮的搜寻就绝不停止。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Jenny Barnes has spent the majority of her young life in pursuit of creature comforts, fine dining, and the latest fashions. That all changed when she received a letter from her sister, Isabelle. In this letter, Isabelle confessed that mysterious forces were aligning against her and that she feared she may fall victim to some paranormal threat. It was the last letter Jenny received from her beloved sister. Jenny has since returned to the States to track down and investigate all occult occurrences she can find. Hardly a wilting flower, she has proven herself a crack shot as well as a fearless and clever investigator of the unknown. Until Isabelle's disappearance is explained, Jenny will never relent in her search.

all_card.back_flavor: 自打吉姆拿起父亲的小号那天，爵士乐对他来说就只剩下了麻烦。喇叭里面奇怪的雕文看起来像是异界文字，里面吹出的曲调也醇厚而暗黑，仿佛一杯浓咖啡。这把小号给吉姆召来了不少活计，直到寡妇詹金斯听了他的演奏跳起来手舞足蹈——那天恰是寡妇的葬礼。打那以后，吉姆就很难找到活了。他深入学习了更多有关爵士乐的事情——以及墓地食尸鬼在寒秋之夜谈论的东西。近来它们都在谈论“终末”，也就是现有万物和未来一起的终结。最后的狂想曲。其实，吉姆并不太喜欢这个。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Jazz has been nothing but trouble for Jim since the day he picked up his daddy's trumpet. There was something weird and otherworldly about the writing on the inside of the bell, but the tones from it were smooth and dark, like good coffee. That trumpet landed Jim a lot of gigs until the time it made Widow Jenkins get up and dance, the day he played at her funeral. After that, it was kind of hard to find work. Since then, Jim has learned a lot about jazz - and the things the graveyard ghouls talk about on cold autumn nights. Lately, they've been talking about The End, as in the end of everything that is and could be. The Final Rhapsody. The fact is, Jim isn't too keen on that idea.

all_card.back_flavor: “灰堆”皮特一路流浪，晚上走到哪里就睡在哪里：田野间，火车上，运气好的话则是谷仓里。他身边睡着自己忠实的猎犬——杜克，另一边则是自己的旧吉他。皮特睡着的时候，有时会做梦。他梦到恶灵萦绕、饱受折磨的地方，梦到可怕的怪物。每每醒来之时，他知道有人需要帮助，因为他的梦境绝非虚假。他不知道自己凭着机智已经走了多久，但他确定只要有人需要帮助，任何地方都无法弗届。只要皮特还能对别人施以援手，他就会一直流浪下去。

all_card.real_back_flavor: At night, "Ashcan" Pete sleeps wherever his travels take him: in a field, on a train, or maybe, if he's lucky, in a barn. He bunks with his loyal hound dog, Duke, on one side and his beat-up guitar on the other. And sometimes when Pete sleeps, he dreams. He dreams of haunted, tortured places and of horrible creatures. When he wakes up, he knows that someone needs his help, because his dreams are true. He could not say how long he has been on the road, living by his wits, but he can say for certain no place is too far to go to help someone in need. And as long as Pete can help people, he is not likely to stop wandering any time soon.

all_card.name: 亨利·阿米蒂奇博士
all_card.text: [reaction]在你抽取一张非弱点卡牌后，弃掉该卡牌并横置亨利·阿米蒂奇博士：获得3资源。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克
all_card.real_flavor: Armitage knew he would be meddling with terrible powers, yet saw that there was no other way to annul the deeper and more malign meddling which others had done before him. - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you draw a non-weakness card, discard that card and exhaust Dr. Henry Armitage: Gain 3 resources.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-2.如果你检定失败，弃掉你牌库顶5张卡牌。
[cultist]：-1(如果你弃牌堆有至少10张卡牌，改为-5)。
[elder_thing]：-X。弃掉你牌库顶的3张卡牌。X为弃掉卡牌的总印刷费用。
all_card.name: 课外活动
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-1。如果你检定失败，弃掉你牌库顶3张卡牌。
[cultist]：-1(如果你弃牌堆有至少10张卡牌，改为-3)。
[elder_thing]：-X。弃掉你牌库顶的2张卡牌。X为弃掉卡牌的总印刷费用。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2. If you fail, discard the top 5 cards of your deck.
[cultist]: -1 (-5 instead if there are 10 or more cards in your discard pile).
[elder_thing]: -X. Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. X is the total printed cost of those discarded cards.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1. If you fail, discard the top 3 cards of your deck.
[cultist]: -1 (-3 instead if there are 10 or more cards in your discard pile).
[elder_thing]: -X. Discard the top 2 cards of your deck. X is the total printed cost of those discarded cards.

all_card.back_flavor: 校园里死一般寂静。你前行的时候脚边落下了影子，你发誓自己每走一步都有什么东西在跟着。这只是你的想象吗？还是真有谁——或者什么——在跟着你？
all_card.back_text:
每位弃牌堆有至少5张卡牌的调查员受到1点恐惧。每位弃牌堆有至少10张卡牌的调查员改为受到2点恐惧。
如果玩家已完成百赌百胜，直接推进到密谋2b。如果课外活动是本次剧本的第一场冒险，推进到密谋2a。
all_card.flavor: 你来到米大校园寻找沃伦·莱斯教授。现在已是下课时间，校园里弥漫着一股诡异的宁静。
all_card.name: 宁静的走廊
all_card.real_back_flavor: The university is dead silent. The shadows coil about your feet as you walk, and you swear there is something following you with each step you take. Is it just your imagination? Or is there really someone - or something - stalking you?
all_card.real_back_text:
Each investigator with 5 or more cards in his or her discard pile takes 1 horror. Each investigator with 10 or more cards in his or her discard pile takes 2 horror, instead.
If the players have completed The House Always Wins, advance directly to agenda 2b. If Extracurricular Activity is the first scenario in the campaign, advance to agenda 2a.
all_card.real_flavor: You have arrived at the Miskatonic University campus in search of Professor Warren Rice. Classes are over, and a mysterious silence hangs in the air over the quad.

all_card.back_flavor: 校园中回响着惊恐的尖叫，几个学生从学校东侧逃了出来，那里是科学大楼所在之处。这场骚乱会和莱斯教授失踪有关吗？
all_card.back_text:
如果宿舍地点不在场上，将其放置入场。
如果实验体在场，将其朝宿舍移动一个地点。
如果实验体不在场，将其生成在科学大楼。
all_card.flavor: 莱斯教授失踪可不是大学里唯一出的岔子。你不大清楚到底发生了什么，但你开始相信阿米蒂奇找你帮忙真是找对了。
all_card.name: 死寂之夜
all_card.text: 补给阶段期间检查手牌上限时，每位调查员的手牌上限减少3张。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A cry of fear echoes through the campus, and several students flee from the eastern side of the university, where the Science building can be found. Could this commotion be linked to Professor Rice's disappearance?
all_card.real_back_text:
If the Dormitories location is not in play, put it into play.
If The Experiment is in play, move it 1 location toward the Dormitories.
If The Experiment is not in play, spawn it in the Science Building.
all_card.real_flavor: Professor Rice's disappearance isn't the only thing amiss at the university. You're unsure exactly what is going on, but you're starting to believe Armitage was right in asking for your help.
all_card.real_text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 3 while checking his or her hand size during the upkeep phase.

all_card.back_flavor: 你还没来得及行动，就听到了从校园北部传来的尖叫声。你急忙朝声音传来的方向赶去，每一步都感到视线愈发黑暗。突然那怪物进入了你的视野，你感到身体被黑暗占据，一股力量让你失去了意识。你眼前一片漆黑，晕了过去。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员立刻受到3点恐惧。然后，进入(→结局4)。
all_card.flavor: 有头野兽在校园里游荡。尽管不知究竟为何物，它看上去却像是要朝大学宿舍冲去。
all_card.name: 野兽出笼
all_card.text: 强制-在本密谋将因达到毁灭阈值而推进时：改为移除场上所有的毁灭标记，并将实验体朝宿舍移动一个地点。 目标-如果实验体进入宿舍，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Before you are able to act, you hear screaming from the northern side of the campus. You begin to make your way toward the screaming, your vision darkening with each step. As soon as the creature enters sight, you feel the darkness overtake you, and a force pulls you out of your consciousness. Everything goes black, and you pass out.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator immediately takes 3 horror. Then, proceed to (→R4).
all_card.real_flavor: Some kind of wild creature is on the loose. Whatever it is, it appears to be headed toward the university dormitories.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When this agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold: Instead, remove all doom in play and move The Experiment 1 location toward the Dormitories. Objective - If The Experiment enters the Dormitories, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你找不到莱斯教授，但有个学生提起一个怪人进了莱斯的办公室。不巧的是，现在这么晚了，通往教师办公室的大门已经关闭。学生说要是你能找到清洁工工头“爵士”，他或许会放你进去。
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆和放在一边的“爵士”马利根洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 阿米蒂奇有个学生几小时前在人文学大楼见过莱斯教授。
all_card.name: 下班时间
all_card.real_back_flavor: You were unable to find Professor Rice, but one of the students you spoke with mentioned a strange man entering Rice's office. Unfortunately, the door leading to the faculty offices is locked at this late hour. The student says that the head janitor, "Jazz", might be able to let you in, if you can find him.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside "Jazz" Mulligan into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: Professor Rice was last seen several hours ago by one of Armitage's students, in the Humanities building.

all_card.back_flavor:
你让“爵士”相信有事不对劲，莱斯教授可能处于危险之中。他还没有信任到把钥匙直接给你，但他同意和你们一起去。
突然间，你听到科学大楼传来了巨大的声响。一个学生冲了出来。“救救我！”他冲你喊道，“有什么怪物从化学实验室里逃出来了！我没看仔细，但是······”他颤抖着，“我想它朝宿舍去了！你得做点什么！”
all_card.back_text:
如果炼金实验室地点不在场上，将其放置入场。如果你在密谋1或密谋2，将放在一边的实验体生成在炼金实验室。
如果你已完成百赌百胜，将放在一边的炼金试剂放置入场，放在炼金实验室底下。如果课外活动是本次剧本的第一场冒险，改为将放在一边的炼金试剂从游戏中移除。
all_card.flavor: 你很担心莱斯教授的安全，于是去找清洁工工头，他能让你进校园里上锁的地方。
all_card.name: 莱斯的下落
all_card.text: [action]花费1个线索：弃掉遭遇牌库顶5张卡牌(单人游戏则改为弃掉遭遇牌库顶10张卡牌)。 强制-如果你以任何方式弃掉了“爵士”马利根，结算其显现效果。 目标-在你控制“爵士”马利根时，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You convince "Jazz" that something strange is going on, and that Professor Rice may be in danger. He doesn't trust you enough to hand you his keys, but agrees to come with you.
All of a sudden, you hear a crash coming from the Science building, and a student rushes toward you. "Help!" he cries. "There's some kind of animal loose in the chem labs! I only barely caught a glimpse of it, but..." He shudders. "I think it's heading to the dorms! You've got to do something!"
all_card.real_back_text:
If the Alchemy Labs location is not in play, put it into play. If you are at Agenda 1 or 2, spawn The Experiment in the Alchemy Labs.
If you have completed The House Always Wins, put the set-aside Alchemical Concoction into play underneath the Alchemy Labs. If Extracurricular Activity is the first scenario of the campaign, remove the set-aside Alchemical Concoction from the game, instead.
all_card.real_flavor: Concerned for Professor Rice's safety, you seek out the head janitor, who can let you into the locked sections of the campus.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck (top 10 instead if there is only 1 player in the game). Forced - If you discard "Jazz" Mulligan for any reason, resolve his revelation effect. Objective - When you take control of "Jazz" Mulligan, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 怪物受伤倒地，发出一声惨烈的尖叫。尸体冒泡发臭。你刚松了口气，就发现尸体开始溶解，转而觉得恶心。区区几分钟，尸体就完全变成了一团粘性物质，恶臭也已消散。你在怪物尸体的残骸间只能找到一具骨架——看结构像是某种犬类。
all_card.flavor: 留给你反应的时间寥寥无几。你可以警告宿舍里的学生，护送他们到安全地带；或者继续在教师办公室寻找莱斯教授。又或者，兴许你能试着消灭这头威胁校园的怪兽。
all_card.name: 校园安全
all_card.text: 目标-找到并完成另一张遭遇卡牌上的目标。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The monstrous creature lets out a terrible shriek as it succumbs to its wounds and collapses onto the ground. A foul odor emanates from the corpse as its flesh begins to bubble and froth. Your relief turns to disgust as the body begins to shrink and disintegrate. Minutes later, the body has almost entirely evaporated into a sticky mass, and the awful odor has vanished. Inside the remnants of the creature's body, all you can find is a set of bones - the skeletal structure of a canine.
all_card.real_flavor: You have only moments to react. You could warn the students in the dormitories and escort them to safety, or continue your task of searching the faculty offices for Professor Rice. Or, perhaps you could try to slay the beast that threatens the campus.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Find and complete an objective on another encounter card.

all_card.back_flavor: 早冬将道边的大树剥了个精光。冷风拂过空无一人的广场，在光秃秃的树枝上吹着口哨。
all_card.flavor: 在四周的栅栏和铁门围绕之下，你觉得自己在这里不是访客，而是囚徒。
all_card.name: 大学广场
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。“我们到处都找不到莱斯……”你离开了校园，希望阿米蒂奇会原谅你。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A too-early winter has stripped the trees bare. Their dead branches whistle as a sharp, cold wind cuts across the empty quad.
all_card.real_flavor: Surrounded by fences and gates of wrought iron, you can't help but feel as much a prisoner here as a guest.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. "We can't find Rice anywhere..." You leave the campus, hoping Armitage will forgive you.

all_card.back_flavor: 最后一次有人看到莱斯教授，是他在人文学大楼上拉丁语课。大楼的外窗一片朦胧，风吹日晒的窗框里透不出光，你周围的夜色也是一片死寂。
all_card.flavor: 大楼里没有电，整个大厅一片漆黑。并无莱斯教授的踪迹。
all_card.name: 人文学大楼
all_card.text: 强制 - 当你的回合结束时，如果你在人文学大楼：弃掉你牌库顶的X张卡牌，其中X为你的恐惧数。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Professor Rice was last seen in the humanities building, teaching one of his Latin classes. The murky windows of the weatherworn structure emit no light, and the night is silent around you.
all_card.real_flavor: The power is out, plunging the building's halls into heavy darkness. There is no sign of Professor Rice.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are in the Humanities Building: Discard the top X cards of your deck, where X is the amount of horror on you.

all_card.back_flavor: 图书馆里三层楼的灰色花岗岩都已饱受岁月的侵蚀，这里与其说是学习的地方，倒是更像一个存放骸骨的匣子。弧形窗台上石头的滴水兽嘴朝下咆哮，宽阔的石阶顶上，双开大门周围绕着一圈拉丁铭文。
all_card.flavor: 沾满灰尘的书架，灯光昏暗的厅堂，奥恩图书馆就是一座迷宫。
all_card.name: 奥恩图书馆
all_card.text: 你必须花费额外1个行动来调查奥恩图书馆。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Three floors of weathered grey granite, the library looks more like a reliquary than a place of learning. Stone gargoyles snarl down from above arched windows, and Latin script winds around the double doors at the top of a wide set of stone steps.
all_card.real_flavor: The Orne Library is a labyrinth of dusty bookshelves and poorly lit halls.
all_card.real_text: You must spend 1 additional action to investigate the Orne Library.

all_card.back_flavor: 就算是这么晚了，你还能听到学生会里传来模糊的交谈声。也许里面会有学生知道莱斯教授在哪儿。
all_card.name: 学生会
all_card.text: 强制 - 在学生会揭示后：将放在一边的宿舍放置入场。 [action][action]：治愈1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Even at this late hour, you can hear a muffled chatter from inside the student union. Perhaps one of the students will know where Professor Rice is.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Student Union is revealed: Put the set-aside Dormitories into play. [action][action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 通过树木可以看到西面宿舍的红砖……<cite>——格雷厄姆·麦克尼尔，《米斯卡塔尼克的食尸鬼》</cite>
all_card.back_text: 通往宿舍的门锁住了。你不能移动进入宿舍。
all_card.flavor: 就在你探索这栋保存完好的老房子的时候，你发现自己居然想知道这里的床是否舒适……
all_card.name: 宿舍
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果在宿舍的调查员共同花费3[per_investigator]个线索：(→结局2)。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The red brick form of the west dormitory could be seen through the trees...
Graham McNeill, Ghouls of the Miskatonic
all_card.real_back_text: The door leading into the Dormitories is locked. You cannot move into the Dormitories.
all_card.real_flavor: As you explore these old, well-kept buildings, you find yourself wondering whether the beds are comfortable...
all_card.real_text: Objective - If investigators in the Dormitories spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: (→R2)

all_card.back_flavor: 年岁已久的管理大楼外藤蔓爬满了墙壁，宣告着对建筑的占有权。大楼离校园中的其他建筑很远，不是学生们日常忙碌的地方。
all_card.name: 管理大楼
all_card.text: 强制 - 在管理大楼揭示后：将放在一边的教师办公室放置入场。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时，如果你在管理大楼：弃掉你牌库顶1张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Around the aged administration building, creepers of ivy climb from the ground in an effort to claim it. The old hall stands alone in an isolated section of the campus, apart from the day-to-day bustle of students.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Administration Building is revealed: Put the set-aside Faculty Offices into play. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are in the Administration Building: Discard the top card of your deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 你来到管理大楼，通完三楼的阶梯顶上矗立着一扇上锁的门。你透过满是雾气的窗户看到一个影子冲过了走廊。
all_card.back_text: 通往教师办公室的门锁住了。你不能移动进入教师办公室。
all_card.name: 教师办公室
all_card.text: 强制 - 在教师办公室揭示后：查找遭遇牌库和弃牌堆，找出一张[[类人]]敌人并将其生成在此。混洗遭遇牌库。 目标 - 如果在教师办公室的调查员共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索：(→结局1)
all_card.real_back_flavor: You come to a locked door at the top of the stairs leading to the third floor of the administration building. Through its frosted window, you glimpse a shadow darting across the hall.
all_card.real_back_text: The door leading into the Faculty Offices is locked. You cannot move into the Faculty Offices.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Faculty Offices is revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Humanoid]] enemy and spawn it here. Shuffle the encounter deck. Objective - If investigators in the Faculty Offices spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: (→R1)

all_card.back_flavor: 你来到管理大楼，通完三楼的阶梯顶上矗立着一扇上锁的门。你相信自己透过满是雾气的窗户看到一个影子冲过了走廊……又或者那只是你的想象。
all_card.back_text: 通往教师办公室的门锁住了。你不能移动进入教师办公室。
all_card.flavor: 莱斯教授的办公室里并无他的踪迹。你呼喊他的名字，但走廊里传来空洞无果的回响。
all_card.name: 教师办公室
all_card.real_back_flavor: You come to a locked door at the top of the stairs leading to the third floor of the administration building. Through its frosted window, you glimpse a shadow darting across the hall... or maybe it's just your imagination.
all_card.real_back_text: The door leading into the Faculty Offices is locked. You cannot move into the Faculty Offices.
all_card.real_flavor: There is no sign of Professor Rice in his office. You call his name, and it echoes fruitlessly through the hall.

all_card.back_flavor: 科学大楼占据了校园的东边。窗户暗着，只有地下室角落的一扇窗户发出微光。
all_card.flavor: 科学大楼一层的走廊上拖着一条粘液的轨迹，直通往地下室。
all_card.name: 科学大楼
all_card.text: 强制 - 在科学大楼揭示后：将放在一边的炼金实验室放置入场。 强制 - 在你于科学大楼[willpower]检定失败时：受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Science building dominates the eastern side of the campus. Its windows are dark, save for a lone window shining faintly in the corner of the basement.
all_card.real_flavor: A trail of viscous ooze snakes through the halls of the Science building's first floor, leading down into the basement.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After Science Building is revealed: Put the set-aside Alchemy Labs into play. Forced - When you fail a [willpower] test in the Science Building: Take 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 楼下实验室传来了刺鼻的臭气。里面发出的声音打破了走廊的寂静——肯定是火炉。
all_card.back_text: 通往炼金实验室的门锁住了。你不能移动进入炼金实验室。
all_card.flavor: 实验室的架子上放着罕见的混合物和不知所谓的试剂。这里到底在研究哪门子科学？
all_card.name: 炼金实验室
all_card.text: [action]：调查。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为(如可能)拿取本地点底下的炼金试剂。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A pungent stench rises from the laboratory downstairs. The silence of the hall is broken by the unmistakable hiss of a burner.
all_card.real_back_text: The door leading into the Alchemy Labs is locked. You cannot move into the Alchemy Labs.
all_card.real_flavor: Peculiar concoctions and obscure reagents line the shelves of the laboratory. What manner of science is going on down here?
all_card.real_text: [action]: Investigate. If you are successful, instead of discovering clues, take the Alchemical Concoction from underneath this location if able.

all_card.name: 实验体
all_card.text: 庞大。 实验体得到+3[per_investigator]生命值 强制 - 在敌军阶段开始时：重整实验体。 目标 - 如果实验体被击败，推进到场景3b。
all_card.traits: 怪物. 异形. 精英
all_card.real_text: Massive. The Experiment gets +3 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When the enemy phase begins: Ready The Experiment. Objective - If The Experiment is defeated, advance to act 3b.

all_card.name: 炼金试剂
all_card.text: [action]：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[intellect]。如果用于攻击实验体，本次攻击造成+6伤害。如果你检定成功，将炼金试剂从游戏中移除。
all_card.real_text: [action]: Fight. This attack uses [intellect] instead of [combat]. If used to attack The Experiment, this attack deals +6 damage. If you succeed, remove Alchemical Concoction from the game.

all_card.name: “爵士”马利根
all_card.text: 显现 - 将“爵士”马利根放置入场，位于你所在地点。 “爵士”马利根不由调查员控制时，他获得：“[action]：谈判。检定[intellect](3)。如果检定成功，控制‘爵士’马利根。” 你控制“爵士”马利根时，忽略每个未揭示的[[米斯卡塔尼克]]地点的文本。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put "Jazz" Mulligan into play at your location. While "Jazz" Mulligan is not controlled by a player, he gains: "[action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If successful, take control of "Jazz" Mulligan." While you control "Jazz" Mulligan, you ignore the text on each unrevealed [[Miskatonic]] location.

all_card.name: 沃伦·莱斯教授
all_card.text:
你得到+1[intellect]。
[reaction]你发现自己地点最后的线索后，横置沃伦·莱斯教授：抽取一张卡牌。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you discover the last remaining clue in your location, exhaust Professor Warren Rice: Draw 1 card.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-3。你可以花费3资源将本标记改为视作0。
[cultist]：-3。如果你检定失败，弃掉3资源。
[tablet]：-2。弃掉3资源
all_card.name: 百赌百胜
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-2。你可以花费2资源将本标记改为视作0。
[cultist]：-3。如果你检定成功，获得3资源。
[tablet]：-2。如果你检定失败，弃掉3资源
