all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -2. You may spend 2 resources to treat this token as a 0, instead.
[cultist]: -3. If you succeed, gain 3 resources.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, discard 3 resources.

all_card.back_flavor: 你的盘问引起了几个人的注意——他们看上去是雇来的打手。“佛朗西斯不想被打扰。”其中一个说道，“我们建议你自己走，不然就是我们让你走。”
all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
如果玩家已完成课外活动，直接推进到密谋2b。如果百赌百胜是本次剧本的第一场冒险，推进到密谋2a。
all_card.flavor: 你来到四叶草俱乐部寻找摩尔根博士。夜色已深，俱乐部里一片熙熙攘攘，挤满了客人。他们有的想要放松，有的想喝一杯，还有的想玩笔大的。看起来这儿不会有什么危险。
all_card.name: 四叶草俱乐部
all_card.text: 每个[[罪犯]]敌人获得冷漠。 强制 - 如果调查员对[[罪犯]]敌人造成伤害：立即推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your questioning has drawn the attention of several men - hired thugs, by the look of them. "Francis doesn't want to be bothered," one of them says. "We suggest you leave the premises before we force you to leave."
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If the players have completed Extracurricular Activity, advance directly to agenda 2b. If The House Always Wins is the first scenario in the campaign, advance to agenda 2a.
all_card.real_flavor: You have entered the Clover Club Casino in search of Dr. Morgan. The club is bustling at this late hour, filled with patrons looking to relax and drink, or make it big. You don't appear to be in much danger.
all_card.real_text: Each [[Criminal]] enemy gains Aloof. Forced - If an investigator deals damage to a [[Criminal]] enemy: Immediately advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你听到门外什么地方传来了破裂声，还有大厅里痛苦的尖叫。可怕的异形怪物从俱乐部的入口冲了进来，撞到楼梯井上，还把一些像是黑帮成员和赌场宾客的人撞倒了。
all_card.back_text: 从放在一边的丑陋异形遭遇组中随机生成一个敌人，放置在俱乐部大厅。将遭遇组的剩余卡牌、放在一边的恐惧打击遭遇组与遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。 将月下美人的所有调查员和未与调查员交战的敌人移动到俱乐部大厅。将月下美人从游戏中移除。
all_card.flavor: 其他客人看起来并不在意这些打手，你周围已经围上了一群人。你意识到自己就要被痛打一顿了。
all_card.name: 地下打手
all_card.real_back_flavor: You hear a crash from somewhere outside and screams of pain in the lounge. A terrible monstrosity smashes through the entrance to the club, crushing the stairwell and knocking over gangsters and patrons alike.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn a random enemy from the set-aside Hideous Abominations encounter set in Clover Club Lounge. Shuffle the rest of that encounter set, the set-aside Striking Fear encounter set, and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Move all investigators and unengaged enemies from La Bella Luna to the Clover Club Lounge. Remove La Bella Luna from the game.
all_card.real_flavor: Most of the other patrons seem oblivious to the mobsters and goons closing in around you. But you recognize this for what it really is - you're about to get roughed up.

all_card.back_flavor: 那个怪物还在俱乐部里横冲直撞，整个建筑不停地震动摇晃着。你想要从门口逃出去，但俱乐部坍塌的废墟还是无情地将你掩埋。
all_card.flavor: 奇异的畸形生物在混乱中攻击俱乐部里的所有人。血液四处喷洒，尖叫声此起彼伏。
all_card.name: 混乱俱乐部
all_card.text: 强制 - 当敌军阶段开始时：弃掉和[[异形]]敌人在同一个地点的每个[[罪犯]]敌人。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As the strange abominations continue to rampage through the club, the building's foundations shake and tremble. You flee toward the exit, but you are caught in the collapsing rubble as the club is destroyed.
all_card.real_flavor: Amidst the chaos and confusion, the strange abominations attack everyone in the club. Screams echo through the halls as the blood begins to spray.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Discard each [[Criminal]] enemy in the same location as an [[Abomination]] enemy.

all_card.back_flavor: 你和几个赌徒还有侍者谈了谈，看起来摩尔根博士现在运气正旺。但他没有将赢来的筹码换钱走人，还想双倍下注。最后一次有人看到他，是走进了卡牌室后面有特别安保的走廊。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的黑暗走廊放置入场。
如果是密谋1，从遭遇牌库顶弃牌，直到弃掉一张[[罪犯]]敌人，并将该敌人生成在黑暗走廊。
all_card.flavor: 你得找到摩尔根博士。俱乐部里人山人海，兴许有人知道他在哪里。
all_card.name: 歪打正着
all_card.text: [reaction]在你揭示一个混乱标记时：你可以将该标记视作混乱袋里的任意其他标记。如果你这么做，请记住你“作弊”了(团队每轮仅限一次)。 目标 - 调查员在收集的线索总计达到所需数量时，必须立即花费这些线索并推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: After speaking to a number of gamblers and servers, it seems as though Dr. Morgan has had quite the run lately. Instead of cashing out his winnings, he was convinced to double down. He was last seen entering the guarded hall near the back of the cardroom.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put the set-aside Darkened Hall into play.
If it is Agenda 1, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Criminal]] enemy is discarded, and spawn that enemy in the Darkened Hall.
all_card.real_flavor: You need to find Dr. Morgan. The club is packed; perhaps somebody knows where he is.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you reveal a chaos token: You may treat that token as if it were any other token in the chaos bag. If you do, remember that you have "cheated." (Group limit once per round.) Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance.

all_card.back_text:
如果玩家没有完成课外活动：
你在一间VIP房里发现了正在赌博的摩尔根博士……但是他似乎正与两具行尸走肉打牌，他瞪大瞳孔，精神涣散。他似乎停不下笑，也忍不住和其他“牌手”谈天说地。
将放在一边的佛朗西斯·摩尔根博士放置入场，放到VIP区。推进至场景3a“孤注一掷”。
如果玩家已完成课外活动：
VIP房间里全是不幸客人血淋淋的扭曲尸体。但这里却没有任何摩尔根博士的踪迹。你听到俱乐部的主要区域传来尖叫和开火的声音。
将放在一边的彼得·克劳佛放置入场，放到俱乐部酒吧。查找遭遇牌库(或场外区域)，找出一个[[异形]]敌人，并将其生成在俱乐部酒吧。推进到场景3a“收牌认输”。
all_card.flavor: 摩尔根博士正在俱乐部私人区的某个地方，只有VIP和俱乐部经理才能进入。要是你想找到他，要么偷偷溜进去，要么就得杀出一条路来。
all_card.name: 赌场骗局
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有在VIP区的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
If the players have not yet completed Extracurricular Activity:
You find Dr. Morgan gambling in one of the VIP rooms... but he appears to be playing cards with two unconscious bodies, his pupils dilated as though in a trance. He can't seem to stop laughing, smiling, and chatting with the other "players."
Put the set-aside Dr. Morgan into play in the VIP Area. Advance to Act 3a - "All In."
If the players have completed Extracurricular Activity:
The VIP rooms are filled with the mangled and bloody bodies of unfortunate patrons. There doesn't appear to be any trace of Dr. Morgan. You hear screaming and gunfire from the main area of the club.
Put the set-aside Peter Clover into play in the Clover Club Bar. Search the encounter deck (or out of play) for an [[Abomination]] enemy, and spawn it in the Clover Club Bar. Advance to Act 3a - "Fold."
all_card.real_flavor: Dr. Morgan is somewhere in the private section of the club, where only VIPs and the club's managers are allowed. If you are to find him, you're going to have to sneak or even fight your way in.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in the VIP Area may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你逃出了俱乐部，尽力装作无关路人，这时有几辆车在街边停下。里面走出几个面容严肃的男女，冲向餐厅入口，控制住了局面。其中有一个人和你对上了眼神，他手里还握着.38手枪，但谢天谢地，他把注意力转回了自己一伙人身上，跟着他们进了俱乐部。你松了一口气……
all_card.back_text: - 如果控制佛朗西斯·摩尔根博士的调查员撤退，(→结局2) - 否则，(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: 现在不管有没有摩尔根博士，你都得逃出这儿。而且要快。
all_card.name: 孤注一掷
all_card.text: 佛朗西斯·摩尔根博士不由调查员控制时，他获得“[action]：谈判。检定[willpower](3)以摇醒摩尔根博士。如果你检定成功，从供应堆将1线索放到佛朗西斯·摩尔根博士上。如果佛朗西斯·摩尔根博士上有1[per_investigator]个线索，控制他。” 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You escape the club, doing your best to look inconspicuous as several cars pull up near the street. A handful of grim-faced men and women exit, running toward the restaurant's entrance to take control of the situation. One of them catches your eye, his hand on the grip of his .38, but thankfully he turns his attention back to the rest of his crew and follows them into the club. You breathe a sigh of relief...
all_card.real_back_text: - If an investigator resigned with Dr. Francis Morgan under his or her control, (→R2) - Otherwise, (→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: With or without Dr. Morgan, you have to get out of here. Fast.
all_card.real_text: While Dr. Morgan is not controlled by a player, he gains "[action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) to shake Dr. Morgan out of his daze. If you succeed, place 1 clue from the token bank on him. If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Dr. Morgan, take control of him." Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你逃到了阿卡姆的大街上，雨后的道路很滑。
all_card.back_text: - 如果控制彼得·克劳佛的调查员撤退，(→结局3) - 否则，(→结局1)。
all_card.flavor: “谁能带我离开这鬼地方，我请他喝酒！”一个男人在吧台那儿大喊道。
all_card.name: 收牌认输
all_card.text: 彼得·克劳佛不由调查员控制时，他获得“[action]：谈判。检定[willpower](3)以说服彼得跟着你。如果你检定成功，从供应堆将1线索放到彼得·克劳佛上。如果彼得·克劳佛上有1[per_investigator]个线索，控制他。” 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You make your way toward the rain-slicked streets of Arkham.
all_card.real_back_text: - If an investigator resigned with Peter Clover under his or her control, (→R3) - Otherwise, (→R1)
all_card.real_flavor: "Free drinks for whoever gets me the hell out of here!" A man exclaims from the bar.
all_card.real_text: While Peter Clover is not controlled by a player, he gains "[action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) to convince Peter to follow you. If you succeed, place 1 clue from the token bank on him. If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Peter Clover, take control of him." Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 月下美人这地方可是“功能不少”。
all_card.flavor: 这里音乐烂俗，菜品还只有通心粉。就这么掩盖地下酒吧的实质，实在是没什么创意。
all_card.name: 月下美人
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。真是一团稀巴烂。
all_card.real_back_flavor: La Bella Luna was a "multi-purpose" establishment.
all_card.real_flavor: The music is cliché and they only serve spaghetti. As far as covers for underground speakeasies go, it's not particularly creative.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. This was a bust.

all_card.back_flavor: 舒适的真皮沙发、红木家具，还有精致的艺术陈列，都在诱惑赌徒，给他们一个黄梁美梦。
all_card.name: 俱乐部大厅
all_card.text: 场景1时，俱乐部大厅获得：“[action]弃掉你手中一个盟友支援：从供应堆获得2个线索。(每场游戏仅限一次。)”
all_card.real_back_flavor: Comfortable leather couches, mahogany furniture, and an array of beautiful art greets gamblers, tempting them into the life of the would-be affluent.
all_card.real_text:
While it is Act 1, Clover Club Lounge gains:
"[action] Discard an [[Ally]] asset from your hand: Gain 2 clues from the token pool. (Limit once per game.)"

all_card.back_flavor: 吧台后的架子上全是各种禁酒：便宜的麦芽酒、私酿、昂贵的瓶装葡萄酒，还有陈年威士忌。要是你有几个小时的空闲时间……
all_card.name: 俱乐部酒吧
all_card.text: 场景1时，俱乐部酒吧获得：“[action]花费2资源：从供应堆获得2个线索并抽取2张卡牌。请记住你‘喝了一杯’。(每场游戏仅限一次。)”
all_card.real_back_flavor: The shelves behind the bar sag beneath the weight of all manner of bootlegged drinks: cheap ales, moonshine, expensive bottles of wine, aged whiskey. If only you had a couple hours to kill...
all_card.real_text:
While it is Act 1, Clover Club Bar gains:
"[action] Spend 2 resources: Gain 2 clues from the token pool and draw 2 cards. Remember that you have 'had a drink.' (Limit once per game.)"

all_card.back_flavor: 你走向卡牌室，这儿一片喧嚣，满是筹码撞击的咔哒声、洗牌发出的刷刷声，以及人们狂喜或沮丧的叫喊声。这么吵的环境你几乎无法思考。
all_card.name: 俱乐部卡牌室
all_card.text:
场景1时，俱乐部卡牌室获得：“[action]花费2资源：随机揭示一个混乱标记。
如果是[elder_sign]符号，从供应堆获得2线索和2资源。
如果是偶数，从供应堆获得2个线索。
如果是奇数，或者[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，无事发生。”
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you approach the cardroom, the clinking of poker chips and the shuffling of cards is punctuated by shouts of revelry and frustration. Your thoughts are nearly drowned out by the racket.
all_card.real_text:
While it is Act 1, Clover Club Cardroom gains:
"[action] Spend 2 resources: Reveal a random chaos token.
If it is a [elder_sign] symbol, gain 2 clues and 2 resources from the token bank.
If it is an even number, gain 2 clues from the token bank.
If it is an odd number or a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, nothing happens."

all_card.back_flavor: 俱乐部隐蔽的角落里有一扇沉重的橡木门。你打开门走了进去，顿时空气变得沉重，卡牌室的嘈杂声在你身后消逝了。
all_card.flavor: 门在你背后重重关上，你周围突然一片死寂。俱乐部里的这块地方既没有人，也缺乏光亮和色彩。不知怎的，一尘不染的地板和墙壁看上去并不温馨，反倒十分邪恶。
all_card.name: 黑暗走廊
all_card.text: 强制 - 在黑暗走廊揭示时：将放在一边的3张走廊后门地点放置入场。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A heavy oak door stands in a secluded corner of the club. As you approach it, the air grows heavy and the clamor of the cardroom fades behind you.
all_card.real_flavor: The door slams shut behind you, and you stand in sudden silence. This area of the club is lonesome and devoid of warmth and color. Somehow, the spotless floor and walls seem more sinister than inviting.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When Darkened Hall is revealed: Put into play the 3 set-aside Back Hall Doorway locations.

all_card.back_flavor: 你走进四叶草俱乐部后面一扇没有标记的门。
all_card.flavor: 异国艺术和古玩装点着彼得·克劳佛的私人画廊。晚风轻拂，把屋内账目磨损的书页吹得沙沙作响。
all_card.name: 画廊
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你调查画廊时技能检定失败后：失去2资源。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You approach an unmarked door toward the back of the Clover Club.
all_card.real_flavor: Exotic art and antiques adorn the walls of Peter Clover's private gallery. An evening breeze rustles the worn pages of a ledger back and forth.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating the Art Gallery: Lose 2 resources.

all_card.back_flavor: 你走进四叶草俱乐部后面一扇没有标记的门。
all_card.flavor: 血腥的铁锈味刺激着你的感官。地板上满是碎玻璃和家具的碎片。摩尔根博士在哪儿呢？
all_card.name: VIP区
all_card.text: 你在VIP区时，你在补给阶段期间不能抽取卡牌或获得资源。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You approach an unmarked door toward the back of the Clover Club.
all_card.real_flavor: The coppery smell of blood assaults your senses. The floor is littered with broken glass, and the upholstery has been torn to shreds. Where is Dr. Morgan?
all_card.real_text: While you are in the VIP Area, you cannot draw cards or gain resources during the upkeep phase.

all_card.back_flavor: 你走进四叶草俱乐部后面一扇没有标记的门。
all_card.flavor: 又陡又窄的阶梯通往第二扇没有标记的门。你惊讶地发现这里直通月下美人后面的小巷。看来这儿就是他们走私“货”的地方。
all_card.name: 后巷
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。我们能从这儿出去！
all_card.real_back_flavor: You approach an unmarked door toward the back of the Clover Club.
all_card.real_flavor: A steep, narrow staircase ascends to a second unmarked door. To your surprise, it leads into a back alley behind La Bella Luna. This must be where they smuggle in their "goods."
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. We can get out this way!

all_card.name: 俱乐部赌场管理员
all_card.text: 猎物 - [intellect]最高。 猎手。 强制 - 俱乐部赌场管理员所在地点的调查员获得任意数量的线索后：俱乐部赌场管理员重整并与该调查员交战，并立刻进行一次攻击。
all_card.traits: 类人. 罪犯. 精英
all_card.real_text: Prey - Highest [intellect]. Hunter. Forced - After an investigator at Clover Club Pit Boss's location gains any number of clues: Clover Club Pit Boss readies, engages that investigator, and makes an immediate attack.

all_card.name: 彼得·克劳佛
all_card.text: 强制 - 当敌军阶段开始时，如果没有调查员控制彼得·克劳佛：对他造成1点伤害。 [free]横置彼得·克劳佛：自动躲避你所在地点的一个[[罪犯]]敌人。 译注：克劳佛(Clover)，即四叶草之意。
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase, if no investigator controls Peter Clover: Deal 1 damage to him. [fast] Exhaust Peter Clover: Automatically evade a [[Criminal]] enemy in your location.

all_card.name: 佛朗西斯·摩尔根博士
all_card.text:
你得到+1[combat]。
[reaction]你击败一个敌人后 ，横置佛朗西斯·摩尔根博士：抽取1张卡牌 。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [combat].
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy, exhaust Dr. Francis Morgan: Draw 1 card.

all_card.flavor: 一股不太愉悦的燥热充满你的身体，你傻傻地看着空酒杯。
all_card.name: 酒里有毒
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 - 每位“喝了一杯”的玩家失去1个行动。
all_card.real_flavor: An unpleasant warmth fills your body, and you sluggishly look at your empty glass.
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Each player who has "had a drink" loses 1 action.

all_card.flavor: 许多双眼睛盯着你，注视你的一举一动。
all_card.name: 引起怀疑
all_card.text: 显现 - 在你所在地点的每个[[罪犯]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。如果未因本效果放置毁灭标记，失去2资源。
all_card.real_flavor: Eyes are all around you, watching your every move.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on each [[Criminal]] enemy at your location. If no doom was placed by this effect, lose 2 resources.

all_card.flavor: 这些幻景是将来真事，还是仅仅一种可能？又或者，是已经发生的恐怖？
all_card.name: 穿越时间的幻觉
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](5)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，弃掉你牌库顶的1张卡牌。
all_card.real_flavor: Are these visions of things to be, or things as they might be? Or could these horrors have already happened?
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, discard the top card of your deck.

all_card.name: 帷幕彼端
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 - 如果你的威胁区域没有帷幕彼端，将帷幕彼端放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 如果你的牌库没有卡牌：受到10点伤害并弃掉帷幕彼端。
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Put Beyond the Veil into play in your threat area if there is no copy of Beyond the Veil in your threat area. Forced - If your deck has no cards in it: Take 10 damage and discard Beyond the Veil.

all_card.name: 亚弗戈蒙之光
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须将亚弗戈蒙之光附属到当前密谋或当前场景。 每张密谋／场景仅限1张。将所有伤害视为直接伤害，将所有恐惧视为直接恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must attach Light of Aforgomon to either the current agenda or the current act. Limit 1 per agenda/act. Treat all damage as direct damage and all horror as direct horror.

all_card.flavor: 邪恶已占据心志，将其变成了没有灵魂的傀儡。
all_card.name: 奴仆
all_card.text: 生成 - 线索最多的地点。 反击。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 异形
all_card.real_flavor: A malevolence has overtaken their minds, turning them into soulless puppets.
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Location with the most clues. Retaliate.

all_card.name: 犹格·索托斯的法师
all_card.text: 猎物 - 手牌最少。 猎手。 强制 - 与其交战的调查员在抽取一张[[巫术]]或[[契约]]卡牌时：犹格·索托斯的法师攻击该调查员。
all_card.real_text: Prey - Least cards in hand. Hunter. Forced - When the engaged investigator draws a [[Hex]] or [[Pact]] card: Wizard of Yog-Sothoth attacks that investigator.

all_card.name: 不洁之地
all_card.text: 显现 - 将不洁之地放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你不能打出[[盟友]]支援。将你控制的每个[[盟友]]支援的印刷文本框视为如同空白。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉不洁之地。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Unhallowed Country into play in your threat area. You cannot play [[Ally]] assets. Treat the printed text box of each [[Ally]] asset you control as if it were blank. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Unhallowed Country.

all_card.name: 忍气吞声
all_card.text: 显现 - 将忍气吞声附属到你所在地点。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：附属地点的每位调查员受到1点恐俱。 强制 - 在密谋推进时：弃掉忍气吞声。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Sordid and Silent to your location. Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator at attached location takes 1 horror. Forced - When the agenda advances: Discard Sordid and Silent.

all_card.flavor: 有人赌咒发誓说这些鸟都是来接引亡魂的，在枝头等着将死之人……<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 夜鹰
all_card.text:
冷漠。猎手。
夜鹰所在地点的每位调查员得到-1[willpower]、-1[intellect]、-1[combat]和-1[agility]。
all_card.real_flavor: "It is vowed that the birds are psychopomps lying in wait for the souls of the dying..." <cite>H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"</cite>
all_card.real_text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Each investigator at Whippoorwill's location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility].

all_card.flavor: 要是抓住了离体的灵魂，它们就会立即振羽飞走，同时发出魔鬼般的笑声……<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 渴望死亡
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。你每有1点伤害，本次技能检定难度提升1点。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: "If they can catch the fleeing soul when it leaves the body, they instantly flutter away chittering in daemonic laughter..." <cite>H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"</cite>
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase this skill test's difficulty by 1 for each damage on you. If you fail, take 2 horror.

all_card.name: 厄运连连
all_card.text: 显现 - 将厄运连连放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你在技能检定期间得到-1技能值。 强制 - 你检定成功且超过难度1点或更多后：弃掉厄运连连。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Cursed Luck into play in your threat area. You get -1 skill value during skill tests. Forced - After you succeed at a skill test by 1 or more: Discard Cursed Luck.

all_card.name: 扭转命运
all_card.text: 显现 - 从混乱袋中随机揭示1个标记。 如果你揭示了[elder_sign]符号或正值，无事发生。 如果你揭示了其他数值，受到1点伤害。 如果你揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [elder_sign] symbol or positive number, nothing happens. If you reveal any other number, take 1 damage. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, take 2 horror.

all_card.name: 鸟之奴仆
all_card.text: 猎物 - [intellect]最低。 猎手。 用[[远程]]、[[枪械]]或[[法术]]支援攻击鸟之奴仆时，其得到-3攻击值。
all_card.traits: 生物. 怪物. 异形
all_card.real_text: Prey - Lowest [intellect]. Hunter. While Avian Thrall is being attacked using a [[Ranged]], [[Firearm]], or [[Spell]] asset, it gets -3 fight.

all_card.flavor: 哪种狼会有这么多牙齿？
all_card.name: 狼之奴仆
all_card.text: 生成 - 离你最远的地点。 猎物 - [agility]最低。 猎手。反击。
all_card.traits: 生物. 怪物. 异形
all_card.real_flavor: What manner of wolf has that many teeth?
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Farthest location from you. Prey - Lowest [agility]. Hunter. Retaliate.

all_card.name: 变异野兽
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果场上没有[[异形]]敌人，变异野兽获得涌动。否则，选择一个[[异形]]敌人。治愈该敌人的所有伤害，并将变异野兽附属到该敌人。 强制 - 在你进入附属敌人所在地点(或附属敌人进入你所在地点)时：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Abomination]] enemies in play, Altered Beast gains surge. Otherwise, choose an [[Abomination]] enemy. Heal all damage from that enemy and attached Altered Beast to it. Forced - When you enter attached enemy's location (or vice-versa): Take 1 horror.

all_card.flavor: “我们在这儿有麻烦了？”
all_card.name: 欧巴尼恩暴徒
all_card.text: 欧巴尼恩暴徒与你交战时，你不能获得资源。
all_card.traits: 类人. 罪犯. 犯罪团伙
all_card.real_flavor: "Are we going to have a problem here?"
all_card.real_text: While O'Bannion's Thug is engaged with you, you cannot gain resources.

all_card.flavor: “老兄，要是不想吃一脚、吃枪子儿，那就最好快滚。”
all_card.name: 匪徒
all_card.text: 反击。 强制 - 在匪徒攻击你后：失去1资源。
all_card.traits: 类人. 罪犯. 犯罪团伙
all_card.real_flavor: "You better scram, pal, unless you're hungry for boot leather and lead."
all_card.real_text: Retaliate. Forced - After Mobster attacks you: Lose 1 resource.

all_card.name: 紧追不舍
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果场上没有未与调查员交战的[[罪犯]]敌人，紧追不舍获得涌动。如果场上有未与调查员交战的[[罪犯]]敌人，这些敌人各朝你移动1个地点。每个以此效果与你交战的[[罪犯]]敌人立刻进行一次攻击。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no unengaged [[Criminal]] enemies in play, Hunted Down gains surge. If there are 1 or more unengaged [[Criminal]] enemies in play, each of them moves 1 location toward you. Each [[Criminal]] enemy that engages you as a result of this effect makes an immediate attack.

all_card.name: 异界放逐
all_card.text: 显现 - 选择你控制的一个非剧情支援，将其混洗入你的牌库，并从你的牌库顶弃掉3张卡牌。如果弃掉了该支援的同名卡牌，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Choose and shuffle a non-story asset you control into your deck and discard the top 3 cards of your deck. If a copy of that asset is discarded, take 2 horror.

all_card.name: 世外诡影
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 选择以下一种卡牌类型(支援、事件，或技能)。每位玩家必须弃掉手牌中所选类型的每张卡牌。如果这不是本阶段抽出的第一张世外诡影，改为选择两种卡牌类型。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Choose one of the following cardtypes (asset, event, or skill). Each player must discard each card in his or her hand that is of the chosen cardtype. If this is not the first copy of Terror from Beyond drawn this phase, choose two cardtypes instead.

all_card.name: 奥术屏障
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 作为移动进入或离开附属地点的额外费用，检定[willpower](4)。如果检定成功，弃掉奥术屏障。否则，你必须取消该次移动的效果，或者弃掉你牌库顶5张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. As an additional cost to move into or out of attached location, test [willpower] (4). If successful, discard Arcane Barrier. Otherwise, you must either cancel the effects of the move or discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

all_card.name: 球之群
all_card.text: 猎物 - [willpower]最低。 猎手。 强制 - 你使用[[近战]]卡牌对“球之群”执行攻击后：弃掉该卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Prey - Lowest [willpower]. Hunter. Forced - After you perform an attack against the Conglomeration of Spheres using a [[Melee]] card: Discard that card.

all_card.name: 门阈潜伏者之仆
all_card.text: 猎物 - [agility]最低。 猎手。 强制 - 在门阈潜伏者之仆攻击你时：弃掉你牌库顶2张卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Prey - Lowest [agility]. Hunter. Forced - When Servant of the Lurker attacks you: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

all_card.flavor: 随着一阵阵令人作呕的响声，他不停打击那个怪物……直到它再也无法动弹。
all_card.name: 致命打击
all_card.text: 如果攻击期间本次技能检定成功，则本次攻击造成+1伤害(如果检定成功且超过难度2点或更多，则改为造成+2伤害)。
all_card.real_flavor: With a sickening smack, he struck the abomination over and over…until at last, it stopped moving.
all_card.real_text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage (+2 damage instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).

all_card.name: 屠怪勇士
all_card.text: 攻击。如果本次攻击对一个非[[精英]]敌人检定成功，击败该敌人。
all_card.real_text: Fight. If this attack succeeds against a non-[[Elite]] enemy, defeat that enemy.

all_card.name: 闪电枪
all_card.text: 使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+5[combat]。本次攻击造成+2伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械
all_card.real_text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +5 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +2 damage.

all_card.name: 威廉·T·马尔森博士
all_card.text: [reaction]在你从遭遇牌库抽取一张遭遇卡牌时，横置威廉·T·马尔森博士并将你的一个线索放在你的地点：取消该卡牌的抽取，并将其混洗回遭遇牌库。然后，从遭遇牌库顶抽取一张新卡牌。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When you draw an encounter card from the encounter deck, exhaust Dr. William T. Maleson and place 1 of your clues on your location: Cancel the drawing of that card and shuffle it back into the encounter deck. Then, draw a new card from the top of the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 揭开现实的面纱
all_card.text: 调查。本次技能检定的难度等于场上已揭示地点中最高的隐藏值。如果你检定成功，发现场上每个已揭示地点各1个线索。
all_card.real_text: Investigate. The difficulty of this skill test is equal to the highest shroud value among revealed locations in play. If you succeed, discover 1 clue from each revealed location in play.

all_card.name: 芝加哥机关枪
all_card.text: 使用(4子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你在执行本次攻击时，可以花费任意数量的额外行动。本次攻击每花费一个行动，你得到+2[combat](包括本能力的[action]费用)。本次攻击造成+2伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法
all_card.real_text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You may spend any number of additional actions when you perform this attack. You get +2 [combat] for this attack for each action being spent (including this ability's [action] cost). This attack deals +2 damage.

all_card.name: 黄金怀表
all_card.text:
卓越。
[reaction]在一个阶段开始时，将黄金怀表从游戏中移除：跳过该阶段。
[reaction]在一个阶段结束后，将黄金怀表从游戏中移除：重复该阶段。
all_card.real_text:
Exceptional.
[reaction] When a phase begins, remove The Gold Pocket Watch from the game: Skip this phase.
[reaction] After a phase ends, remove The Gold Pocket Watch from the game: Repeat that phase.

all_card.name: 皱缩术
all_card.text: 使用(4充能)。 [action]花费1充能：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次攻击得到+3[willpower]并造成+2伤害。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +3 [willpower] and deal +2 damage for this attack. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, take 2 horror.

all_card.name: 守护结界
all_card.text:
快速。在你抽取一张非弱点的遭遇卡牌时打出。
取消该卡牌的所有效果并将其弃掉。然后，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness encounter card. 
Cancel all of that card's effects and discard it. Then, take 1 horror.

all_card.flavor: “不要害怕你所看到的。害怕你看不到的。”
all_card.name: 安奎娜
all_card.text: [reaction]在敌人攻击你时，横置安奎娜并对她造成1点恐惧：改为对你所在地点的任意一个敌人造成该敌人的伤害。(你依然受到此次攻击的恐惧。)
all_card.real_flavor:
"Do not be frightened by what you see.
Be frightened by what you cannot see."
all_card.real_text: [reaction] When an enemy attacks you, exhaust Aquinnah and deal 1 horror to her: Deal that enemy's damage to any enemy at your location, instead. (You still take horror dealt by the attack.)

all_card.name: 反复尝试
all_card.text: [reaction]在技能检定失败后，如果有投入到该检定的技能卡牌归你所有，横置反复尝试：将这些技能卡牌中的一张返回你的手牌。
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After a skill test is failed, if a skill card you own is committed to that test, exhaust Try and Try Again: Return that skill card to your hand.

all_card.name: 戴红手套的男子
all_card.text: 快速。 [reaction]在戴红手套的男子入场后：选择你两项技能。戴红手套的男子在场上时，将每项所选技能的基础值提升为6。 强制 - 当神话阶段结束时：弃掉戴红手套的男子。
all_card.real_text: Fast. [reaction] After The Red-Gloved Man enters play: Choose two of your skills. While The Red-Gloved Man is in play, raise the base value of each of those skills to 6. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Discard The Red-Gloved Man.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull] ：场上每有一个[[异次元]]地点，-1。
[cultist] ：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败，本次技能检定后，弃掉遭遇牌库顶的卡牌，直到弃掉一个地点。将该地点放置入场并移动至此。
[tablet] ：-5。如果犹格·索托斯在场上，它本次技能检定后攻击你。
[elder_thing] ：-X，X为你所在地点隐藏值的两倍。如果你检定失败且你在[[异次元]]地点，将其弃掉。
all_card.name: 迷失时空
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull] ：场上每有一个[[异次元]]地点，-1 (最多-5)。
[cultist] ：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败，本次技能检定后，弃掉遭遇牌库顶的卡牌，直到弃掉一个地点。将该地点放置入场并移动至此。
[tablet] ：-3。如果犹格·索托斯在场上，它本次技能检定后攻击你。
[elder_thing] ：-X，X为你所在地点的隐藏值。如果你检定失败且你在[[异次元]]地点，将其弃掉。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -1 for each [[Extradimensional]] location in play.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. After this skill test, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a location is discarded. Put that location into play and move there.
[tablet]: -5. If Yog-Sothoth is in play, it attacks you after this skill test.
[elder_thing]: -X. X is twice the shroud value of your location. If you fail and your location is [[Extradimensional]], discard it.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 for each [[Extradimensional]] location in play (max -5).
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, after this skill test, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a location is discarded. Put that location into play and move there.
[tablet]: -3. If Yog-Sothoth is in play, it attacks you after this skill test.
[elder_thing]: -X. X is the shroud value of your location. If you fail and your location is [[Extradimensional]], discard it.

all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。然后，弃掉遭遇牌库顶上的卡牌，直到弃掉一个地点。调查员队长结算该地点的“显现”效果。
检查剧本日志。如果调查员未能成功解救学生，阅读下列内容：
你面前出现了一只巨大的犬形生物，看似陌生，又似曾相识。这头怪物向你冲来，你想将它挡开，却惊讶地发现它径直穿过了你，冲向先前还不在你身后的建筑：米大的德比楼。这头怪物冲进了前门，你听到里面传来惊恐的叫喊，随后就是骨头扭断的嘎吱声和痛苦的尖嚎。
每位调查员无论其地点都受到1点恐惧。
all_card.flavor: 声与色的道路向各个方向伸至永恒，周遭是不可思议的建筑和疯狂生长的异星生物。事物的轮廓犬牙交错、变幻不止，你感到自己的皮肤仿佛也要翻出。
all_card.name: 一生万物
all_card.text: 强制 - 你由于遭遇卡牌的效果移动到一个地点后：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Then, discard cards from the top until a location is discarded. The lead investigator resolves that location's 'revelation' effect. Check Campaign Log. If the investigators failed to save the students, read the following: "A huge canine creature, alien to your eyes and yet familiar, appears before you. The creature rushes forward, and you prepare to fend it off, but to your surprise it runs through you, towards a building that wasn't behind you moments before: Derby Hall from the Miskatonic University. The creature bursts through the building's front door and you hear screams of panic from inside, followed by the crunch of snapping bones and cries of pain." Each investigator takes 1 horror, regardless of their location.
all_card.real_flavor: Pathways of sound and color extend for an eternity in all directions, dotted with impossible architecture, and overgrown with alien wildlife. The lines between objects are jagged and shifting, and your skin feels as if it were inside out.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you are moved to a location by an encounter card effect: Take 1 horror.

all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。然后，弃掉遭遇牌库顶上的卡牌，直到弃掉一个地点。调查员队长结算该地点的“显现”效果。
检查剧本日志。如果“献给犹格·索托斯的牺牲”下记录了名字，阅读下列内容：
你听到有熟悉的声音在呼唤，你走进了一幢奇形怪状、难以言喻的碎石建筑。“不，别！”那声音叫道。你冲下狭窄陡峭的楼梯，往那个声音冲去。你冲到楼梯底，发现自己身处敦威治的密室。你看到自己没能拯救的人镣铐加身、遍体鳞伤、浑身是血。一只长着人脸的怪物则在啃食地上的尸体。尸体翻过来面朝着你，你心中涌起一阵锐利的痛苦。
每位调查员检定[willpower](X)，X为“献给犹格·索托斯的牺牲”下记录的名字数量。调查员检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害。
all_card.flavor: 你穿越这片领域的时候，不时能瞥见现实——那都是过去记忆的一幕幕，方才几日发生的场景居多，但有时是一些你压根不记得曾经发生过的事……
all_card.name: 过去，现在 ，将来
all_card.text: 强制 - 你由于遭遇卡牌的效果移动到一个地点后：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Then, discard cards from the top until a location is discarded. The lead investigator resolves that location's 'revelation' effect. Check Campaign Log. If at least one name is recorded under "Sacrificed to Yog-Sothoth," read the following: "You hear a familiar voice calling out to you, and you enter an impossibly shaped building of cracked stone. "No… don't!" the voice cries. You rush toward the voice, down a set of steep, narrow stairs. Upon reaching the bottom, you find yourself in the hidden chamber from Dunwich. Bound by shackles, you see those you failed to save, bloodied and maimed. A creature with a man's face feeds from a corpse on the ground. The head of the corpse turns to face you, and a sharp pain stabs your heart." Each investigator tests [willpower] (X), where X is the number of names recorded under "Sacrificed to Yog-Sothoth." For each point an investigator fails by, that investigator takes 1 damage.
all_card.real_flavor: As you cross this realm, you catch occasional glimpses of reality - scenes from old memories, more recent visions from the past few days, and sometimes even events that you do not remember ever happening…
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you are moved to a location by an encounter card effect: Take 1 horror.

all_card.back_text: 显现 - 将放在一边的犹格·索托斯敌人生成在宇宙的边缘。如果宇宙的边缘不在场上，改为将其生成在另一个次元。推进到密谋4a。
all_card.flavor: 在这个歪曲的次元中，无论你到了哪里，远远地总有一个影子阴魂不散。一开始只是个圆形，仿佛一轮长着无数蠕动触手的黑月。但你渐渐看出它越来越大……
all_card.name: 突破
all_card.text: 强制 - 你由于遭遇卡牌的效果移动到一个地点后：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_text: Revelation - Spawn the set-aside Yog-Sothoth enemy at The Edge of the Universe. If The Edge of the Universe is not in play, spawn it in Another Dimension, instead. Advance to agenda 4a.
all_card.real_flavor: Throughout this warped dimension, no matter where you travel, there is a haunting shape in the distance. At first, it appears as a disc, like a black moon with many wriggling arms. But as time passes, you can tell it is growing larger and larger…
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you are moved to a location by an encounter card effect: Take 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 那异界的骇物伸出触手，找寻你来到此间的裂隙，把整片领域都碾在自己的抓攫之下。
all_card.back_text: 犹格·索托斯无论其当前地点，按玩家顺序攻击场上每位调查员。然后，将本密谋翻回“a”面。
all_card.flavor: 远方的身影摧毁了这个次元的屏障，其万千臂膀盖住了你所见的一切。它看上去像是一滩长满眼睛和巨口的粘泥。在这巨物的庞然巨形面前，你觉得自己仿佛虫豸一般微不足道。
all_card.name: 万物归一
all_card.text: 强制 - 你由于遭遇卡牌的效果移动到一个地点后：受到1点恐惧。 强制 - 如果犹格·索托斯被击败，(→结局3)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Seeking the rift from which you entered this dimension, the extradimensional horror lashes out, crushing entire realms within its grasp.
all_card.real_back_text: In player order, Yog-Sothoth attacks each investigator in play, regardless of Yog-Sothoth's current location. Then, flip this agenda back to its "a" side.
all_card.real_flavor: The shape in the distance smashes through the barriers of this dimension, its many arms reaching to envelop everything you see. Its body is like an ooze, covered in eyes and mouths. You feel insignificant, like a bug, next to the creature’s terrifying grandeur.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you are moved by an encounter card effect: Take 1 horror. Forced - If Yog-Sothoth is defeated, (→R3).

all_card.back_flavor: 远方闪烁着光芒，你赶过去调查。这缕微光飘离你而去，浮现在此界诡奇的门扉，冲上螺旋楼梯，穿越了你先前不敢跨足的屏障。你知道孤身找到连接点的可能微乎其微，于是跟着光芒，指望它能将你引去正确的方向。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的宇宙的边缘地点放置入场。
all_card.flavor: 无论如何，你都要找到穿越这片奇异领域的路，发现老沃特雷书里描述的连接点。
all_card.name: 世界之外
all_card.text: [action]：弃掉遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。选择以此效果弃掉的一个地点并结算其“显现”能力。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A light shimmers in the distance, and you head toward it to investigate. The wispy light drifts away from you, floating through the realm's strange gateways, ascending looping staircases, and crossing through barriers you dared not cross earlier. With little chance of finding the nexus on your own, you follow the light, hoping it is guiding you in the right direction.
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside The Edge of the Universe location into play.
all_card.real_flavor: Somehow, you must find your way across this alien landscape in order to find the nexus that was described in Old Whateley’s tome.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Choose a location discarded by this effect and resolve its 'revelation' ability.

all_card.back_flavor: 你到了一片致密的虚空之中，这里的黑暗浓厚得不可思议。你意识到这里是一切现实——如今与将来的一切现实——终结之所。你在中央恰好无法触及的地方发现了一道微小的裂隙。透过裂隙，你惊讶地发现自己居然看到了哨兵峰。不知怎的，你已然抵达缝隙的另一侧。现在必须找到办法将其永远关闭。
all_card.flavor: 你继续跟着这缕微光，但一路上经过的地方危机重重，要追上可不是件容易的事情。
all_card.name: 超越领域
all_card.text: [action]：弃掉遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。选择以此效果弃掉的一个地点并结算其“显现”能力。 目标 - 如果调查员进入宇宙的边缘，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You reach an impossibly dense pitch-black void, and realize that this place is where all of reality - all that is and all that ever will be - ends. In its center, you see a minuscule rift, suspended just out of reach. When you peer through the tear, you are surprised to see the peak of Sentinel Hill. Somehow, you've reached the other side of the rift. Now you must find a way to close it for good.
all_card.real_flavor: You continue to follow the wisp of light, though the treacherous landscape makes it a difficult quarry to chase.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Choose a location discarded by this effect and resolve its 'revelation' ability. Objective - If an investigator enters The Edge of the Universe, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你精疲力尽，根本不知道该怎么关闭裂缝。它太远了，你所做的一切都无济于事。也没有任何事物能帮你远离脑海里渗入的异星话语。就在这时，你听到脑海里回荡着一个熟悉的声音，你不由自主地重复道：“Claude ostium…”你先是低语，词句从你舌尖自己蹦了出去。你闭上眼睛，集中精神，脑中的回声越来越响。念完的时候，你睁开双眼，所见唯有墨黑的深渊，而裂缝已然消失。
all_card.back_text:
将宇宙的边缘从游戏中移除。
将放在一边的时间缝隙地点放置入场。


译注：Claude ostium为拉丁文，意为“关上大门”。
all_card.flavor: 地上的异界之石刻写着某种封印。你甫一接近，脑海里就有一个声音诉说着异星的语言。
all_card.name: 关闭裂缝
all_card.text: [action]：弃掉遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。选择以此效果弃掉的一个地点并结算其“显现”能力。 目标 - 只有宇宙的边缘的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You are utterly exhausted, with no idea as to what can be done to close the rift. It is too distant to touch, and nothing you do has any effect. There is nothing here to guide you apart from the unearthly words that are seeping into your mind. Just then, you hear a familiar voice within the echoing chorus, and feel yourself compelled to repeat it. "Claude ostium…" You whisper at first, the words on the tip of your tongue. You close your eyes to concentrate, and the echo grows louder. When it ends and you open your eyes, you face nothing but an inky abyss, and the tear has vanished.
all_card.real_back_text:
Remove the Edge of the Universe from the game.
Put the set-aside Tear Through Time location into play.
all_card.real_flavor: The unearthly stones on the ground are inscribed with some sort of seal. Approaching them causes a voice to enter your mind, speaking in an alien tongue.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Choose a location discarded by this effect and resolve its 'revelation' ability. Objective - Only investigators at The Edge of the Universe may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你发现了一条看似熟悉的通路，跟了上去。尽管你已经完成了任务，但你关闭裂隙的时候却明白自己可能永远也无法回去了。你害怕自己将永远纠缠于此，策步向前，穿过拱门，通往蔓生的长廊。潮湿的木门后是绵绵细雨的黑夜。水泥路、碎石路，然后是大理石路、铁板路和草地。这片草地漫长得犹如虚幻，但你还是竭力穿过，又跨越浓密的树林，最终实在精疲力尽。你已经花光了所有的力气，再也不能前行半步。你放弃了。
all_card.flavor: 原本能清楚逃离这个次元的道路已经不再，你得另寻他途。
all_card.name: 寻找新的道路
all_card.text: [action]：弃掉遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。选择以此效果弃掉的一个地点并结算其“显现”能力。 目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You discover a path that looks somewhat familiar and follow it. Even though your task is complete, you now understand that in closing the tear, you may never make it home. The fear of being lost here forever spurs you onward, through an archway leading into an overgrown corridor. A damp wooden door leads you out into a pocket of thin rain and dark sky. Cement turns to gravel, then marble, then steel, then grass. You cross impossibly long meadows and make your way through dense woods before fatigue finally sets in. Drained of all energy, you cannot go on any further. Your body gives out.
all_card.real_flavor: With no clear way out of this dimension, you seek another path.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Choose a location discarded by this effect and resolve its 'revelation' ability. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 周围旋转的色彩和诡谲的角度让你目瞪口呆。真是疯了。
all_card.name: 另一个次元
all_card.text: 强制 - 在一个地点离场时：将该地点的每位调查员和每个未交战的敌人移动到另一个次元。不能取消。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You gape in disbelief at the swirling colors and alien angles surrounding you. This is true madness.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When a location leaves play: Move each investigator and unengaged enemy at that location to Another Dimension. Cannot be canceled.

all_card.back_flavor: 你怎么也无法料到会瞧见这样的景象。很美，但也很骇人。
all_card.back_text: 你必须有至少2个线索才能移动到宇宙的边缘。
all_card.name: 宇宙的边缘
all_card.text:
你必须有至少2个线索才能移动到宇宙的边缘。
宇宙的边缘的调查员在补给阶段期间不能抽取卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Nothing could have possibly prepared you for this.
It is beautiful and terrible to behold.
all_card.real_back_text: You must have at least 2 clues in order to move to The Edge of the Universe.
all_card.real_text:
You must have at least 2 clues in order to move to The Edge of the Universe.
Investigators at The Edge of the Universe cannot draw cards during the upkeep phase.

all_card.back_flavor: 现在、过去、不可能的将来……你看见了所有，它也看见了你。
all_card.name: 时间缝隙
all_card.text: [action] 花费2个线索：撤退。你找到了一条新路，希望能返回安全之处。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
What is, what was, what will never be…
you see it all, and it sees you.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 2 clues: Resign. You find a new path and hope that it leads back to safety.

all_card.name: 犹格·索托斯
all_card.text:
庞大。猎手。反击。
犹格·索托斯得到+6[per_investigator]生命。
犹格·索托斯不能被躲避，不能进行趁乱攻击。
[reaction] 在犹格·索托斯攻击你时：你可以不受到最多X点恐惧，改为从自己牌库顶弃掉最多X张卡牌。然后，如果你的牌库没有卡牌，你发疯。
all_card.real_text:
Massive. Hunter. Retaliate.
Yog-Sothoth gets +6 [per_investigator] health.
Yog-Sothoth cannot be evaded and cannot make attacks of opportunity.
[reaction] When Yog-Sothoth attacks you: Instead of taking up to X horror, you may discard the top X cards from your deck. Then, if you have no cards in your deck, you are driven insane.

all_card.name: 空间裂缝
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现 - 将空间裂缝放置入场。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：在空间裂缝上放置1个毁灭标记，或将空间裂缝弃掉。
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Put Tear Through Space into play. Forced - At the end of the round: Either place 1 doom on Tear Through Space, or discard it.

all_card.name: 菱柱瀑布
all_card.text: 显现 - 将菱柱瀑布放置入场，并随机弃掉你一张手牌。 强制 - 在菱柱瀑布上最后的线索移除后：弃掉菱柱瀑布。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Prismatic Cascade into play and discard a random card from your hand. Forced - After the last clue on Prismatic Cascade is removed: Discard Prismatic Cascade.

all_card.name: 无尽之桥
all_card.text: 显现 - 将无尽之桥放置入场并失去2资源。 强制 - 在调查员离开无尽之桥后：在无尽之桥上放置1个毁灭标记，或将无尽之桥弃掉。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Endless Bridge into play and lose 2 resources. Forced - After an investigator leaves Endless Bridge: Either place 1 doom on Endless Bridge, or discard it.

all_card.name: 伊哈格尔的阶梯
all_card.text: 显现 - 将伊哈格尔的阶梯放置入场。然后，抽取你弃牌堆最顶上的[[疯狂]]卡牌。 强制 - 在你将要离开伊哈格尔的阶梯时：检定 [willpower] (2)。如果你检定失败，不移动到你原本的目的地，改为将伊哈格尔的阶梯混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Steps of Y'hagharl into play. Then, draw the topmost [[Madness]] card in your discard pile. Forced - When you would leave Steps of Y'hagharl: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, shuffle Steps of Y'hagharl into the encounter deck instead of moving to your original destination.

all_card.name: 次元之门
all_card.text: 显现 - 将次元之门放置入场。然后，抽取遭遇弃牌堆最顶上的[[巫术]]卡牌。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时，如果你在次元之门：你必须花费2资源或将次元之门混洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Dimensional Doorway into play. Then, draw the topmost [[Hex]] card in the encounter discard pile. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are at Dimensional Doorway: You must either spend 2 resources or shuffle Dimensional Doorway into the encounter deck.

all_card.name: 星际旅行者
all_card.text: 生成 - 任意[[异次元]]地点。 猎手。 强制 - 在星际旅行者进入一个地点时：将该地点的1个线索标记翻至毁灭面，并放在星际旅行者上；如果该地点没有线索，则在星际旅行者上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Any [[Extradimensional]] location. Hunter. Forced - When Interstellar Traveler enters a location: Flip 1 clue on that location to its doom side and place it on Interstellar Traveler, or place 1 doom on Interstellar Traveler if there are no clues on that location.

all_card.name: 伊斯寻星者
all_card.text: 生成 - 另一个次元。 反击。 强制 - 在伊斯寻星者攻击一位弃牌堆有至少10张卡的调查员时：在伊斯寻星者上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Another Dimension. Retaliate. Forced - When Yithian Starseeker attacks an investigator with more than 10 cards in his or her discard pile: Place 1 doom on Yithian Starseeker.

all_card.flavor: 你周围的世界仿佛要自我折叠、弯折、扭曲、倾斜。
all_card.name: 现实崩塌
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果你在[[异次元]]地点，将其弃掉并受到1点伤害。否则，受到2点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: The world around you appears to be folding in on itself, warping, twisting, bending.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If you are at an [[Extradimensional]] location, discard it and take 1 damage. Otherwise, take 2 damage.

all_card.name: 虫洞
all_card.text: 显现 - 从遭遇牌库顶弃牌，直到弃掉一个地点。结算该地点的“显现”能力，然后移动到该地点。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a location is discarded. Resolve that location's 'revelation' ability, then move to that location.

all_card.name: 辽阔无边
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果场上没有[[异次元]]地点，辽阔无边获得涌动。否则，检定[willpower](X)，其中X为场上[[异次元]]地点数(最多为5)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Extradimensional]] locations in play, Vast Expanse gains surge. Otherwise, test [willpower] (X), where X is the number of [[Extradimensional]] locations in play (max 5). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 子弹带
all_card.text: 你拥有额外1个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[武器]]支援。
all_card.real_text: You have 1 additional hand slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Weapon]] asset.

all_card.flavor: 这无法轻易击倒我们！
all_card.name: 团结一致
all_card.text: 选择你所在地点的另一位调查员。你和该调查员都抽取2张卡牌并获得2资源。
all_card.real_flavor: They won't take us down that easily!
all_card.real_text: Choose another investigator at your location. Both you and that investigator draw 2 cards and gain 2 resources.

all_card.name: 艺术生
all_card.text: [reaction]在艺术生入场后：发现你所在地点的1个线索。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After Art Student enters play: Discover 1 clue at your location.

all_card.flavor: 我知道我看过这个符号。我必须赶在一切太迟之前警告其他人！
all_card.name: 推理
all_card.text: 如果调查一个地点时本技能检定成功，额外发现该地点的1个线索(如果检定成功且超过难度2点或更多，则改为额外2个线索)。
all_card.real_flavor: I knew I had seen this symbol before. I must warn the others before it is too late!
all_card.real_text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location (2 additional clues instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).

all_card.flavor: 半途而废可能不会赢，但也很少死。
all_card.name: “我要走了！”
all_card.text: 场上有冒险卡带有“撤退”能力才能打出。 撤退。你逃出了这个鬼地方。
all_card.real_flavor: Quitters may never win, but they also rarely die.
all_card.real_text: Play only if there is a scenario card with a 'resign' ability in play. Resign. You get the hell out of here.

all_card.name: 弹簧刀
all_card.text: 快速。 [action]：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，本次攻击造成+1伤害。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 近战. 违法
all_card.real_text: Fast. [action] Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, this attack deals +1 damage.

all_card.name: 催眠术
all_card.text:
快速。在一个敌人攻击你所在地点的一位调查员时打出。
取消该次攻击。然后，从混乱袋中随机揭示一个标记。如果该标记有[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，对该敌人造成其自身的伤害。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack. Then, reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it has a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, deal the attacking enemy's damage to itself.

all_card.name: 皱缩术
all_card.text: 使用(4充能)。 [action]花费1充能：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次攻击得到+2[willpower]并造成+1伤害。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action] Spend one charge: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, take 1 horror.

all_card.flavor: 头条里并未刊登你所见证的恐怖。但讣告栏里的名字却多得吓人。
all_card.name: 报纸
all_card.text: 你调查时如果没有线索，得到+2[intellect]。
all_card.real_flavor: There's nothing in the headlines about the horrors you've witnessed. But the obituaries section is disturbingly long.
all_card.real_text: You get +2 [intellect] while investigating if you have no clues.

all_card.name: 诱敌深入
all_card.text: 附属到你所在地点。 敌军阶段期间，所有要移动的敌人不照常移动，而是改为沿着最短路径，朝附属地点移动。 强制 - 附属在地点时，当一轮结束时：弃掉诱敌深入。
all_card.real_text: Attach to your location. During the enemy phase, each enemy that moves does so along the shortest path toward the attached location, instead of to where it would normally move. Forced - While attached, at the end of the round: Discard Lure.

all_card.flavor: 翻石破砖苦，殚精竭虑忙。旧宝传千古，妙手一扫光。
all_card.name: 宝物猎人
all_card.text:
永久。
你拥有额外1个饰品槽位。
all_card.real_flavor: No stone unturned, no ancient treasure left behind.
all_card.real_text:
Permanent.
You have 1 additional accessory slot.

all_card.flavor: 魅力光芒万丈，全城为之闪亮。
all_card.name: 魅力超凡
all_card.text:
永久。
你拥有额外1个盟友槽位。
all_card.real_flavor: When you turn on the charm, it could light the entire town.
all_card.real_text:
Permanent.
You have 1 additional ally slot.

all_card.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为当前密谋编号+1。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败且是你的回合，失去所有剩余行动并立刻结束你的回合。
[tablet]：-4。场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人增加1个毁灭标记。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，每低于难度1点，选择并弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.name: 疯狂列车
all_card.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为当前密谋编号。
[cultist]：-1。如果你检定失败且是你的回合，失去所有剩余行动并立刻结束你的回合。
[tablet]：-2。在最近的一个[[异教徒]]敌人上增加1个毁灭标记。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，选择并弃掉你1张手牌。

Hard / Expert

Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the current Agenda #.
[cultist]: -1. If you fail and it is your turn, lose all remaining actions and end your turn immediately.
[tablet]: -2. Add 1 doom token to the nearest Cultist enemy.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, choose and discard a card from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 最后一节车厢扭离了车身。你惊恐地发现车厢脱离铁轨，被上方的大门吞没。
all_card.back_text: 将最左边的地点从游戏中移除(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其放入胜利区)。该地点的每位调查员被击败。弃掉该地点的所有敌人和支援。 弃掉调查员控制的所有线索。
all_card.flavor: 伴随着刺耳的噪音，前往敦威治的列车突然停了下来。你看向窗外，发现天空中有一个巨大的裂口，就好像一块布被撕了个口子。怪力拉扯着列车最后几节车厢，扯落的时候发出的声响叫人胆战心惊。车厢向上飞入空中的裂口。附近的乘客惊慌失措，还有人躲在位置上瑟瑟发抖，更有一位长者吓得昏了过去。
all_card.name: 现实的裂口
all_card.real_back_flavor: The rearmost car of the train detaches as it is pulled backwards. To your horror, it rises off the tracks and is consumed by the gate above you.
all_card.real_back_text:
Remove the leftmost location from the game (or place it in the victory display if it has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at that location is defeated. Each enemy and asset at that location is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.
all_card.real_flavor: As the train to Dunwich comes to a jarring stop, you look out the window behind you and see an immense tear in the sky, like a rip in a piece of cloth. Several of the rearmost train cars are pulled backwards, and there is a dreadful metallic crunch as they are detached. The train cars topple upwards and into the rift in the sky. Nearby passengers are panicking, others are cowering in their seats, and one elderly man has fainted in fear.

all_card.back_flavor: 又一节车厢被蛮力扯下，一路冲向裂缝，一位中年男子用指尖扒住边缘，吊在空中。一转眼整座车厢都被吞没，男子宁可松手也不愿被推入虚空。他开始下落，但裂缝的力量还是抓住了他，将他吞没。
all_card.back_text: 将最左边的地点从游戏中移除(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其放入胜利区)。该地点的每位调查员被击败。弃掉该地点的所有敌人和支援。 弃掉调查员控制的所有线索。
all_card.flavor: 裂缝渐渐变大，你能感到火车尾部被拉扯晃动。更多的乘客意识到自己身处怎样的危局，混乱爆发，让眼下的情况雪上加霜。有些乘客开始寻找可以躲藏的地方，其他的则在车厢之间惊恐奔走。
all_card.name: 裂缝扩张
all_card.real_back_flavor: The next train car is ripped backwards with violent force. A middle-aged man hangs from his fingertips as the car flies unhindered toward the rift. In moments, the car is consumed whole, and the man lets go rather than be pulled into the void. He starts to fall, but is caught by the rift's force and pulled inside it anyway.
all_card.real_back_text:
Remove the leftmost location from the game (or place it in the victory display if it has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at that location is defeated. Each enemy and asset at that location is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.
all_card.real_flavor: The tear grows larger, and you can feel the rearmost car of the train shaking as it is pulled backwards. The situation threatens to erupt into chaos as more passengers realize the danger they are in. Some passengers are looking for places to hide, while others are running about the compartments in terror.

all_card.back_flavor: 一股强大的热流划过火车车体，将最靠近裂缝的两节车厢切开，干净利落得就像小刀切开黄油。车厢被吸离往上，飞向门中。车上传来一声可怕的尖响，只是在你听来那更像是蒸汽管道破裂的嘶鸣。
all_card.back_text: 将最左边的两个地点从游戏中移除(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其放入胜利区)。这些地点的每位调查员被击败。弃掉这些地点的所有敌人和支援。 弃掉调查员控制的所有线索。
all_card.flavor: 天空中的裂缝越来越强大，整辆列车都在沿着铁轨后退。列车后部的车厢剧烈晃动，裂缝的怪力要将其从火车上扯下。你必须赶紧逃出去！
all_card.name: 后退
all_card.real_back_flavor: Two of the train cars closest to the gate are severed from the rest of the train by a sheet of impossibly hot steam, which slices through metal like a knife through butter. The cars are sucked upwards and fly into the gate. Something above the train lets out a terrible screech, though to your ears it is like the shrill sound of a broken steam pipe.
all_card.real_back_text:
Remove each of the two leftmost locations from the game (or place it in the victory display if either one has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at those locations is defeated. Each enemy and asset at those locations is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.
all_card.real_flavor: The pull of the rift in the sky seems to grow stronger, and the entire train begins to roll backwards along the tracks. The rearmost cars of the train begin to rattle, the force of the rift threatening to detach them. You must get out of these cars as fast as you can!

all_card.back_flavor: 灼热的蒸汽包裹着最后两节车厢，车体也开始熔化。金属歪裂，里面的乘客发出痛苦的尖叫。车厢连同铁轨和桥身一起都被扯裂卷起，远远地甩在了你身后。
all_card.back_text: 将最左边的两个地点从游戏中移除(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其放入胜利区)。这些地点的每位调查员被击败。弃掉这些地点的所有敌人和支援。 弃掉调查员控制的所有线索。
all_card.flavor: 天上裂缝的力量愈发强大。你身后桥边的土石飞离地面，树木连根拔起，都吸进了裂缝。你车厢中一位年轻的乘客撞上了窗子，尖叫道：“我们得从这儿出去！”他从窗子一跃而出，还没落到下面的河里，一只飞快的生物就伸出利爪将其抓住，带出了视线之外。那怪物只留下一道蒸汽。
all_card.name: 淹没
all_card.real_back_flavor: The two rearmost train cars begin to melt as they are filled with superheated steam. The metal warps, and the passengers inside scream in agony. The cars are ripped from the train tracks along with rail slats and chunks of the bridge behind you.
all_card.real_back_text:
Remove each of the two leftmost locations from the game (or place it in the victory display if either one has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at those locations is defeated. Each enemy and asset at those locations is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.
all_card.real_flavor: The gate crackles with power as its strength increases. Dirt and rocks from the edge of the bridge behind you are torn from the ground and trees are uprooted, pulled in by the gate. One younger passenger smashes the window of your car and shouts, “We gotta get outta here!” He leaps out of the window, but before he lands in the river below, he is snatched in the talons of a swift flying creature, and carried out of sight. A trail of steam is left in the creature’s wake.

all_card.back_flavor: 整座桥在裂缝巨口的强大力量之下断裂了。但火车剩下的部分却没有掉进河里，而是直直吸上了空中的裂缝。你被吸入裂缝的时候，发出了惊恐的尖叫，紧紧抓住了最后一根稻草。最后你只觉得眼前一黑。
all_card.back_text: 每位幸存的调查员立刻被击败，并承受1点精神创伤。(→结局2)
all_card.flavor: 天上的裂缝歪折震动，已完全扭曲，其规模之大，形态的错乱变形，好像就要爆炸一般。
all_card.name: 时间耗尽
all_card.real_back_flavor: The entire bridge cracks under the pressure of the gate, and breaks apart. Instead of plummeting into the river, the remaining train cars are pulled into the sky, toward the rift. You hang on for dear life and scream in horror as you are pulled into the gate. Then, everything goes black.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator is immediately defeated and takes 1 mental trauma. (→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: The rift in the sky twists and shakes, completely distorted. Its size is now massive, its shape warping and shifting, as if it is about to explode.

all_card.back_text:
进入车头的调查员(大声)阅读下列内容：
一辆装满煤的推车摇摇晃晃，挡住了你去车头的路。你极力咽下自己的恐惧，从附近的窗子爬上车顶，穿越煤车。车子还在后退，让你站不稳脚跟。就在你接近的时候，天上俯冲下来一只长着翅膀的怪物，它的身体完全是滚烫涌动的蒸汽。
你必须决定 (选择一项)： - 检定 [agility] (3) 以尝试躲避这怪物。如果你检定失败，你滑得太远，拼尽全力才抓住了火车的边缘，命悬一线。尽管你成功爬了上去，但这种体验还是叫人心惊胆战。你承受1点精神创伤。 - 检定 [willpower] (3) 以尝试忍受这怪物的高温。如果你检定失败，怪物飞过的时候灼痛了你。你承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 列车停在了米斯卡塔尼克河的桥上，跳河逃跑或许可行，但你并不想冒这种风险。你最好还是尽快赶往车头，让火车重新跑起来。
all_card.name: 大家快跑！
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果有调查员进入车头，立刻推进。
all_card.back_flavor: 一輛載滿煤炭的小車擋在前往引擎室的路上。你咽了一口水，嘗試讓自己冷靜下來。然後打開窗，試圖從車頂移動到引擎室中。車廂依然在搖晃，這令你難以站穩腳步。當你靠近時，一個帶著翅膀的怪物在你上空盤旋，它的身體是由蒸氣構成的。
all_card.real_back_text:
The investigator entering the Engine Car reads the following (out loud):
A tender car filled with coal blocks your way to the engine cab. Swallowing your fear, you climb out of the nearby window and clamber onto the roof of the train, making your way across the tender car. The steady backward motion of the train makes it difficult for you to keep your footing. As you get close, a winged creature swoops down from above, its body composed of piping hot steam.
You must decide (choose one): - Test [agility] (3) to attempt to dodge the creature. If you fail, you leap too far and barely grip the side of the train, hanging on for dear life. Although you manage to pull yourself up, the experience is terrifying. You suffer 1 mental trauma. - Test [combat] (3) to attempt to endure the creature's extreme heat. If you fail, the creature flies through you and the heat burns you. You suffer 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: The train has stopped on a bridge high above the Miskatonic River - you might be able to survive the fall, but you don’t like your chances. Your best bet is to make your way to the engine car as fast as you can and get the train running again.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If an investigator enters the Engine Car, immediately advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 引擎又重获新生，开始运作。你拿着铲子，不断为锅炉加煤。看到火车在铁轨上又动了起来，你终于松了一口气。
all_card.flavor: 你成功抵达了车头，现在你得重新启动引擎，才能逃离天上巨口的抓攫！
all_card.name: 发动引擎！
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果车头没有线索，立刻推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The engine roars to life and kicks into motion. You shovel coal into the engine's firebox and are relieved to see that the train is moving forward along the tracks once again.
all_card.real_flavor: You’ve managed to make it to the engine cab, but now you have to get the engine started again so you can outrun the pulling force of the gate!
all_card.real_text: Objective - If there are no clues in the Engine Car, immediately advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 在博物馆大厅的阴影之中，一个可怕的生物正扭动着身体，它如同蟒蛇一般细长，还有着一对巨大的黑皮翅膀。

如果追猎恐魔在场上，在上面增加1个毁灭标记。

all_card.flavor: 阿米蒂奇博士把拉丁文版本的《死灵之书》给了他的同事——米斯卡塔尼克博物馆的馆长，哈罗德·维尔斯特。你担心有人盯上了这本书，于是去博物馆把它拿回来。
all_card.name: 禁止通行

all_card.real_back_flavor: From the shadows of the museum halls, a terrible creature slithers forth, long and serpentine, and propelled by black leathery wings.

If Hunting Horror is not in play, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and the void for Hunting Horror and spawn it in Museum Halls, if able. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: Dr. Armitage has given the university’s Latin translation of The Necronomicon to his associate, Harold Walsted, the curator of the Miskatonic University Museum. Worried that someone might still be after the book, you have gone to the museum to recover it.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When Hunting Horror enters play: Attach the set-aside copy of Shadow-spawned to it, or add 1 resource to Shadow-spawned if it is already attached.

all_card.back_flavor: 那怪物在博物馆里追逐着你，绝不会放慢步伐。

如果追猎恐魔在场上，在上面增加1个毁灭标记。
如果追猎恐魔不在场上，查找遭遇牌库、弃牌堆和混沌，找出追猎恐魔并将其生成在博物馆大厅(如可能)。将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 博物馆中的阴影愈发浓重了。阴影增长扭曲，预示着可怕的怪物正从你意识不到的地方矫捷跃过……
all_card.name: 浓厚之影
all_card.text: 强制 - 在追猎恐魔入场时：将放在一边的暗影之子附属到追猎恐魔上，如果暗影之子已经附属，则在上面增加1资源。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The creature does not relent, pursuing you throughout the museum.
all_card.real_back_text:
If Hunting Horror is in play, add 1 doom to it.
If Hunting Horror is not in play, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and the void for Hunting Horror and spawn it in Museum Halls, if able. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: The shadows in the museum grow and become darker. As the shadows lengthen and shift, they begin to suggest the sinewy body of an uncanny creature darting at the periphery of your awareness...
all_card.real_text: Forced - When Hunting Horror enters play: Attach the set-aside copy of Shadow-spawned to it, or add 1 resource to Shadow-spawned if it is already attached.

all_card.back_flavor: 你没有办法击败博物馆里的怪物，只能逃走。每一条走廊的阴影中都能看到那可怕的蛇身蜿蜓游动，博物馆大厅因其存在变得更为黑暗。你终于抵达大门的时候，它堵住了去路，尖锐可怕的牙齿向你袭来。千钧一发之际，你竭力逃出了建筑，保住了性命，但是那怪物的毒液给你留下的伤口永远无法痊愈。
all_card.back_text: 每位没有撤退的调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 伴随着时间的流逝，博物馆中的怪物变得愈发巨大，也更加可怖。这头可怕的怪兽在阴影之间游弋，每一个角落都可能是它的藏身之地。
all_card.name: 无处不在
all_card.text: 强制 - 在追猎恐魔入场时：将放在一边的暗影之子附属到追猎恐魔上，如果暗影之子已经附属，则在上面增加1资源。
all_card.real_back_flavor: With no way of defeating the creature in the museum, you flee. In every shadow of every corridor, the serpentine horror’s slithering body can be seen, the museum halls growing darker with the creature’s presence. As you reach the entrance, it blocks the doorway and attacks you with its terrible fangs. You barely manage to escape the building with your life, though the effects of the creature’s venom will scar you forever.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: The creature in the museum grows larger and more terrifying with each passing moment. Its body slithers from shadow to shadow, every corner of every room a potential hiding place for the hideous beast.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When Hunting Horror enters play: Attach the set-aside copy of Shadow-spawned to it, or add 1 resource to Shadow-spawned if it is already attached.

all_card.back_text:
如果调查员花费线索来推进场景：
你找到了靠近保安的那扇窗户，用力地敲了敲，吸引他的注意。他吓得跳了起来，打开了窗子。“你想干什么？”他怯生生地问道。你向他解释了情况，告诉他博物馆很危险。他小心翼翼地打开了博物馆的前门，摇头叹息道：“我本来今天都不用上班的……”
选择一位调查员控制放在一边的亚当·林奇。揭示博物馆大厅。推进到场景2a——“博物馆之夜”。
如果调查员成功执行博物馆大厅的[action]能力以推进：
你用尽力气打开了博物馆的门，发出了巨大的噪音。保安看到你闯进来，吓得尖叫了一声，逃进了博物馆深处。
通往博物馆大厅的门打开了。揭示博物馆大厅。推进到场景2a——“强行闯入”。
all_card.flavor: 不巧的是，这么晚了，博物馆的门已锁。透过正面的窗子，你看到博物馆的保安，他对周围的一切浑然不觉。也许你能找到办法吸引他的注意，说服他让你进去。
all_card.name: 寻找入口
all_card.real_back_text:
If you spent clues to advance:
You find the window nearest to the guard and tap it loud enough to get his attention. He gives a startled jump, then shifts open the window. “What do you want?” he asks timidly. You explain the situation to him and tell him he is in grave danger. He warily opens the front door to the Museum, shaking his head. “I wasn’t even supposed to be here today...”
Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Adam Lynch asset. Reveal the Museum Halls. Advance to Act 2a - "Night at the Museum."
If you successfully performed the [action] ability on the Museum Halls to advance:
With great strength, you break down the door to the Museum, making considerable noise as you do. The security guard sees you enter, cries out in fear, and rushes toward the back of the museum.
The door leading into the Museum Halls is broken. Reveal the Museum Halls. Advance to Act 2a - "Breaking and Entering."
all_card.real_flavor: Unfortunately, the entrance to the Museum is kept locked at this late hour. A security guard is visible through the building’s front windows, oblivious to his surroundings. Perhaps you can find a way to get his attention and convince him to let you in.

all_card.back_flavor: 你踏入禁区的时候，看到馆长倒在血泊之中。五脏六腑散了一地。你胃里翻江倒海，拼命抗住想吐的感觉。无论谁是罪魁祸首，都肯定还在附近。
all_card.back_text: 查找遭遇牌库、弃牌堆、混沌和所有游戏区域，找出追猎恐魔，将其以重整状态放置在展厅(禁止入内)。推进到场景3a。
all_card.flavor: 《死灵之书》就放在禁区里，博物馆深处的某个地方。亚当好像有点迷路，这栋老房子里只要一有声，他就吓得蹦一下。“我是上周才来的。”他解释道，“你说的麻烦到底是什么啊？”但你现在没心情详细解释。
all_card.name: 博物馆之夜
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果有调查员进入展厅(禁止入内)，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When you enter the restricted hall, you find the curator of the museum lying in a pool of blood, his intestines strewn about in a grotesque display. Your stomach turns over and you resist the urge to vomit. Whatever did this, it’s still nearby...
all_card.real_back_text: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, the void, and all play areas for Hunting Horror, and place it in the Exhibit Hall (Restricted Hall), ready. Advance to Act 3a.
all_card.real_flavor: The Necronomicon is being kept in a Restricted Hall somewhere in the museum. Adam barely knows his way around, and gives a startled jump at every creak of the old building. "I just started here last week," he explains. "What sort of trouble did you say was going on?" You haven’t the heart to give him the full story.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If an investigator enters the Exhibit Hall (Restricted Hall), advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你踏入禁区的时候，发现馆长抓着一尊精美的石刻，仿佛握着长棍，西服上沾满了血，一脸惊恐。你之前看到的保安倒在血泊之中。五脏六腑散了一地。你胃里翻江倒海，拼命抗住想吐的感觉。“我试着阻止，但……”馆长的声音又轻又颤。无论谁是罪魁祸首，都肯定还在附近……
all_card.back_text:
选择一位调查员控制放在一边的哈罗德·维尔斯特支援。
查找遭遇牌库、弃牌堆、混沌和所有游戏区域，找出追猎恐魔，将其以重整状态放置在展厅(禁止入内)。
推进到场景3a。
all_card.flavor: 《死灵之书》就放在禁区里，博物馆深处的某个地方。
all_card.name: 强行闯入
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果有调查员进入展厅(禁止入内)，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When you enter the Restricted Hall, you find the curator of the museum clutching an ornate statue as if it were a club, his suit stained with blood, a panicked expression on his face. The security guard you saw earlier lies in a pool of blood nearby, his intestines strewn about in a grotesque display. Your stomach turns and you resist the urge to vomit. "I tried to stop it, but..." the curator says quietly, his voice quivering. Whatever did this, it’s still nearby...
all_card.real_back_text: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Harold Walsted asset. Search the encounter deck, discard pile, the void, and all play areas for Hunting Horror, and place it in the Exhibit Hall (Restricted Hall), ready. Advance to Act 3a.
all_card.real_flavor: The Necronomicon is being kept in a Restricted Hall somewhere in the museum.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If an investigator enters the Exhibit Hall (Restricted Hall), advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
你终于找到了锁着《死灵之书》的柜子。
这本超过八百页厚的典籍写满了各式各样的死亡意象、公式、法术、预言，以及关于彼端空间生物的描述。
毫无疑问，这本书非常危险……但其中的秘密也非常有用。
all_card.back_text: 调查员必须决定(选择一项)： - “这东西留着太危险。我们必须摧毁它。”(→结局1)。 - “这东西太珍贵，可不能毁了。我们应该妥善保管。”(→结局2)。
all_card.flavor: 这里某个地方放着奥洛斯·沃尔密乌斯翻译的拉丁文版本的《死灵之书》。你必须赶紧找到，溜之大吉！
all_card.name: 查找古书
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果展厅(禁止入内)上没有线索，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
At last, you find the locked case containing the Necronomicon.
The tome, over eight hundred pages in length, is filled with all manner of macabre imagery, formulae, spells, prophecies, and descriptions of creatures from beyond the threshold of space.
Without a doubt, it is a dangerous book... But its secrets could be very useful.
all_card.real_back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - It's too dangerous to keep around. We must destroy it. (→R1) - It's too valuable to destroy. We must keep it safe.(→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: Somewhere in this area is Olaus Wormius’s Latin translation of the Necronomicon. You must find it and escape while you can!
all_card.real_text: Objective - If there are no clues remaining in the Exhibit Hall (Restricted Hall), advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 米斯卡塔尼克博物馆恢弘壮观，馆藏丰富，里面都是大学资助的探险队发现的古物。无论是异国文物、珍品，还是艺术品，收藏都很可观，吸引了全国的游客。
all_card.flavor: 你走近博物馆的时候，拉紧了外套，抵御冬风。满月在楼上洒下一阵洁白而不祥的月光。
all_card.name: 博物馆大门
all_card.text: 位于博物馆大门的调查员不能获得资源。 [action]：撤退。“呃。一本书能有多重要呢，是吧？”
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Miskatonic Museum is an opulent and stately building, supported by expeditions funded by the university. Its sizable collection of exotic artifacts, curios, and art has drawn visitors from all over the country.
all_card.real_flavor: As you approach the museum, you draw your coat tighter around your body to keep the wintry air away. The full moon drapes the building in ominous bright moonlight.
all_card.real_text: Investigators at the Museum Entrance cannot gain resources. [action] Resign. "Eh. How important can a book really be, anyway?"

all_card.back_text:
通往博物馆大厅的门锁住了。你不能移动进入博物馆大厅。
博物馆大门获得：“[action]：检定[combat](5)以尝试打开博物馆的大门。如果你检定成功，立刻推进到场景1b。”
all_card.name: 博物馆大厅
all_card.text:
博物馆大厅与每个展厅连接。
[action]在博物馆大厅的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将展厅牌库顶的卡牌以未揭示面放置入场。
all_card.real_back_text:
The entrance to the Museum Halls is locked. You cannot move into the Museum Halls.
Museum Entrance gains: "[action]: Test [combat] (5) to attempt to break down the door to the Museum. If you are successful, immediately advance to Act 1b."
all_card.real_text:
Museum Halls is connected to each copy of Exhibit Hall.
[action] Investigators in the Museum Halls spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Put the top card of the Exhibit deck into play, unrevealed.

all_card.back_flavor: 门旁一块铭牌写着：“保安”。门半开着，你闻到里面传来血的味道。
all_card.flavor: 定是有人急匆匆地离开了保安室。附近的桌子下洒着鲜血。所幸这儿还是有一些你能用上的东西。
all_card.name: 保安室
all_card.text: [action][action]：查找你牌库顶的6张卡牌，找出1张卡牌并将其加入你的手牌。将其余卡牌洗回你的牌库。(每回合仅限一次)
all_card.real_back_flavor: A plaque next to this doorway reads: "Security." The door is ajar, and inside you catch the scent of blood.
all_card.real_flavor: Somebody must have left the security office in a hurry. Blood stains the floor under the desk nearby. Thankfully, there are some useful supplies here you may be able to use.
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a card and add it to your hand. Shuffle the rest back into your deck. (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.back_flavor: 门旁一块铭牌写着：“保安”。门半开着，你闻到里面传来血的味道。

all_card.real_flavor: Somebody must have left the security office in a hurry. Blood stains the floor under the desk nearby. There are some maps of the Museum in here, as well.
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Look at the revealed side of an Exhibit Hall in play, or the top card of the Exhibit deck. (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.back_flavor: 坚固的木门旁铭牌写着：“行政管理处”。门外的走廊上挂着一排历任馆长的画像，都标有其名称和就任时间。兴许是你的错觉，但最近几任馆长看起来尤其烦恼。
all_card.flavor: 办公室整理得井井有条，架子上的书都按字母顺序排好，张张桌子上的表格也都分门别类。附近的椅子上放着一件外套，看来这么晚还在博物馆里工作的不只是保安。
all_card.name: 管理办公室
all_card.text: 你的资源不多于4时，不能调查管理办公室。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A sturdy wooden door with a plaque next to it reads: "Administration." In the hall outside the doorway, you see a row of paintings depicting the museum’s many curators through the years, each adorned with their name and years of employment. Perhaps it’s just your imagination, but they look more distressed in recent years.
all_card.real_flavor: This office is meticulously organized, from the books in alphabetical order on the shelves to the stacks of forms organized by category on each desk. A coat is draped over one of the nearby chairs; perhaps somebody other than the security guard is still here at this late hour.
all_card.real_text: You cannot investigate Administration Office while you have 4 or fewer resources.

all_card.flavor: ……这蛇状的生物头颅怪异地扭曲，巨大带爪的附肢前所未见……<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特&奥古斯特·德雷斯，《门阈潜伏者》</cite>
all_card.name: 暗影潜随
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果追猎恐魔在场上，其重整，与你交战，并攻击你所在地点的每位调查员。否则，暗影潜随获得涌动。
all_card.real_flavor:
...viperine creatures, which had curiously distorted heads, and grotesquely great clawed appendages...
-H.P. Lovecraft & August Derleth, The Lurker at the Threshold
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If Hunting Horror is in play, it readies, engages you, and attacks each investigator at your location. Otherwise, Stalked in the Dark gains surge.

all_card.name: 通往异界的道路
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果追猎恐魔位于你所在地点，本次检定+2难度。如果你检定失败，你必须(选择一项)：弃掉你牌库顶5张卡牌，或受到1点直接伤害并对你每个[[盟友]]支援造成1点伤害。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). This test has +2 difficulty if Hunting Horror is at your location. If you fail you must either (choose one): discard the top 5 cards of your deck, or take 1 direct damage and deal 1 damage to each of your [[Ally]] assets.

all_card.flavor: 是你来看展，还是展在看你？
all_card.name: 短暂的展览
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定失败，每低于难度1点，失去1个行动。
all_card.real_flavor: Are you watching the exhibits, or are the exhibits watching you?
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). If you fail, lose 1 action for each point you failed by.

all_card.name: 尾随之蛇
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果追猎恐魔在场上，为其增加1个毁灭标记。如果追猎恐魔不在场上，查找遭遇牌库、弃牌堆和混沌，找出追猎恐魔并将其生成在你所在地点，与你交战。混洗遭遇牌库。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If Hunting Horror is in play, add 1 doom to it. If Hunting Horror is not in play, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and the void for Hunting Horror and spawn it at your location, engaged with you. Shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: 只是一次小小的激励，但你确实需要。
all_card.name: “如果它会流血……”
all_card.text:
快速。在你击败一个[[怪物]]敌人后打出。
你所在地点的每位调查员治愈等于该敌人恐惧值的恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: It's a small comfort, but you'll take it.
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play after you defeat a [[Monster]] enemy.
Each investigator at your location heals horror equal to that enemy's horror value.

all_card.name: 春田M1903
all_card.text: 使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+3[combat]并造成+2伤害。不能用于攻击与你交战的敌人。
all_card.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械
all_card.real_text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +3 [combat] and deal +2 damage for this attack. Cannot be used to attack enemies engaged with you.

all_card.flavor: 欲学必先问万事。
all_card.name: 追根究底
all_card.text: 你的地点有线索才能投入到技能检定。
all_card.real_flavor: If we wish to learn, we must first question everything we know.
all_card.real_text: Commit to a skill test only if there is a clue at your location.

all_card.name: 暴露弱点
all_card.text:
快速。在任意[free]玩家时间段期间打出。
选择你所在地点的一个敌人。检定[intellect](X)，其中X等于该敌人的攻击值。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，本阶段对该敌人下次执行的攻击中，该敌人的攻击值降低1点。
all_card.real_text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Choose an enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. For each point you succeed by, reduce that enemy's fight value by 1 for the next attack performed against it this phase.

all_card.name: 思维敏捷
all_card.text: 如果本次技能检定成功且超过难度2点或更多，在其结算后，你可以立即进行一个行动，如同在你的回合(该行动不计入你每回合可以进行的行动数)。
all_card.real_text: If this skill test is successful by 2 or more, after it resolves, you may immediately take an action as if it were your turn (this action does not count toward the number of actions you can take each turn).

all_card.name: 幸运骰子
all_card.text:
卓越。
[reaction]在你揭示一个非[auto_fail]混乱标记时，花费2资源：忽略该混乱标记，并揭示另一个混乱标记以结算。如果新揭示的标记有[auto_fail]符号，将幸运骰子从游戏中移除(不能忽略/取消)。
all_card.real_text:
Exceptional.
[reaction] When you reveal a non-[auto_fail] chaos token, spend 2 resources: Ignore that chaos token and reveal another one to resolve. If that token has a [auto_fail] symbol, remove Lucky Dice from the game (cannot be ignored/canceled).

all_card.name: 机会主义者
all_card.text:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。
如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，在本次检定后不将机会主义者弃掉，改为将其返回你的手牌。
all_card.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
If you succeed by 2 or more, return Opportunist to your hand after this test instead of discarding it.

all_card.name: 艾丽莎·格雷厄姆

你得到+1[intellect]。
[free]横置艾丽莎·格雷厄姆：查看遭遇牌库或任意玩家牌库顶的卡牌。然后你可以在艾丽莎·格雷厄姆上增加1个毁灭标记，以将查看的卡牌放到其牌库底。
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[fast] Exhaust Alyssa Graham: Look at the top card of either the encounter deck or any player deck. You may then add 1 doom to Alyssa Graham to place the looked-at card on the bottom of its deck.

all_card.name: 礼寻术
all_card.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次检定得到+2[willpower]。如果检定成功，你发现所在地点额外2个线索。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，本次检定结算后，失去所有剩余的行动，立即结束你的回合。
all_card.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. You get +2 [willpower] for this test. If successful, you discover 2 additional clues at this location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, after this test resolves lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.

all_card.name: 黑马
all_card.text:
每位调查员仅限1张。
在补给阶段期间，你可以选择不获得资源。
你资源池没有资源时，你得到+1[willpower]、+1[intellect]、+1[combat]和+1[agility]。
all_card.real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
During the upkeep phase, you may choose to not gain resources.
While you have no resources in your resource pool, you get +1 [willpower], +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility].

all_card.name: 求生本能
all_card.text: 如果尝试躲避期间本次技能检定成功，躲避的调查员可以立即躲避与其交战的每个其他敌人，并可以移动到一个连接地点。
all_card.real_text: If this test is successful during an evasion attempt, the evading investigator may immediately evade each other enemy engaged with him or her, and may move to a connecting location.

困难/专家
[skull] ：场上每有一个犹格·索托斯之子，-2。

简单/普通

[skull]: -1 for each Brood of Yog-Sothoth in play.
