all_card.back_flavor:
敦威治郊外风吹雨打的小路上驶过一辆小货车，司机——乔·奥斯本停下车，但没有关引擎，他透过碎裂的车窗朝你们喊道：“它去了埃里克的农场！那儿几乎全毁了。可怜的亨利和玛莎……”
你问奥斯本埃里克家的田地在哪里，你明白自己最深的恐惧已然成真。最近这样的攻击说明，正在肆虐的怪物肯定不止一只。
all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
如可能，将1张放在一边的犹格·索托斯之子敌人生成在一个随机地点。
all_card.flavor: 据称威胁村民恐慌的是村郊肆虐的可怕存在。更可怕的是，这些怪物肉眼是看不见的。
all_card.name: 横冲直撞
all_card.text: 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：将每个犹格·索托斯之子敌人朝一个随机地点移动一次。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
An old pickup truck rolls to a stop along the weathered trails of Dunwich. The driver - Joe Osborn - calls out to you through a shattered driver-side window, the truck's engine still running. "IT's over at the Ericks' farm!" he shouts. "Done blasted their place apart. Poor Henry and Martha..."
You ask Osborn for the location of the Ericks' homestead, and it confirms your worst fear. For that attack to have occurred recently, there must be more of the monsters on the loose.
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Spawn 1 of the set-aside Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemies at a random location, if able.
all_card.real_flavor: Reports of terrifying entities wreaking havoc across the countryside have caused the citizens of Dunwich to panic. Worse, the creatures seem to be invisible to the naked eye.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move each Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemy once toward a random location.

all_card.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
如果有放在一边的犹格·索托斯之子，调查员队长(大声)阅读下列内容：
阴冷的云在头顶聚集，狂风暴雨倾泻下来，像厚重的毯包裹住整个村郊。你看着雨越下越大，只好去附近一个半毁的棚屋中躲避。天空中闪电划过，在短暂的光亮中，你好像在雨中看到了什么东西的轮廓。突然间，远处的树枝自己折断了。倏尔一股强大的力量向你的藏身之处袭来。
如可能，将1张放在一边的犹格·索托斯之子敌人生或在调查员队长所在地点。然后，该地点的每位调查员检定[agility](4)。新生成的犹格·索托斯之子对每位本次检定失败的调查员进行一次攻击。
all_card.flavor: 冷泉幽谷偶尔吹出的冷风，为夜晚沉闷的空气带来一股难以言喻的恶臭……但所寻的恐怖并未出现。无论谷地中藏着的是什么，它都在等候时机，而阿米蒂奇则告诫同事，在黑夜攻击这怪物不啻自杀。<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 等待时机
all_card.text: 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：将每个犹格·索托斯之子敌人朝一个随机地点移动一次。
all_card.real_back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If there is a set-aside Brood of Yog-Sothoth, the lead investigator reads the following (out loud):
Bleak storm clouds churn overhead and a blanket of rain pelts the countryside. As the downpour grows in intensity, you take refuge in a half-ruined shack nearby. There is a flash of lightning, and in the brief illumination, you spot the outline of something large in the rain. Without warning, the distant trees bend, though nothing seems to be bending them. Moments later, a force with the strength of a truck crashes into your refuge.
Spawn 1 of the set-aside Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemies at the lead investigator's location, if able. Then, each investigator at that location tests [agility] (4). The newly spawned Brood of Yog-Sothoth makes an attack against each investigator who fails this skill test.
all_card.real_flavor:
Once in a while a wind, sweeping up out of Cold Spring Glen, would bring a touch of ineffable foetor to the heavy night air... But the looked-for terror did not appear. Whatever was down there in the glen was biding its time, and Armitage told his colleagues it would be suicidal to try to attack it in the dark.
-H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move each Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemy once toward a random location.

all_card.back_flavor: 村郊一阵猛烈的摇晃，你压根儿分不清这是因为你狩猎的怪物，还是山体的震颤。很快，你沿着山丘找到了更多怪物的踪迹：碾过的灌木、折断的树枝，这段痕迹长达三十英尺。战斗令你疲惫不堪，夜色渐渐昏暗，你决定前往安全的地方，不再追踪这些可怕的痕迹。
all_card.flavor: 这东西虽然肉眼看不见，却足足有一幢屋子那么大，还犯下了恶魔的所有暴力罪行，要追踪它可不是开玩笑的。<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 恐惧爆发
all_card.text: 每个[[异形]]敌人得到+1攻击和+1躲避。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：将每个犹格·索托斯之子敌人朝一个随机地点移动一次。
all_card.real_back_flavor: There is a monstrous rumbling throughout the countryside, though it is impossible to tell whether its source is the creatures you hunt or the very mountains themselves. Soon after, you find more of the creatures' tracks leading up toward the hills: a thirty-foot path of crushed underbrush and trees snapped like twigs. Exhausted from battle, and with night fast approaching, you decide to head to safety rather than follow these hellish tracks.
all_card.real_flavor:
It was no joke tracking down something as big as a house that one could not see, but that had all the vicious malevolence of a daemon.
-H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text: Each [[Abomination]] enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move each Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemy once toward a random location.

all_card.back_text:
检查剧本日志。如果亨利·阿米蒂奇博士在敦威治遗产中幸存：
“那儿！”阿米蒂奇松了口气，草草记下了咒文最后的段落。“我已经译出了最后的部分。”他颤抖着将手稿交给你，这些词句唤醒了他之前与怪物大战的记忆。“我真希望这是我最后一次不得不读这玩意儿了。”他坦言道，“但要是我们什么都不做，那结果可能会糟得多得多。”
每位调查员将1张放在一边的深奥的咒文放置入场。
如果亨利·阿米蒂奇博士记录在“献给犹格·索托斯的牺牲”下方：
上次肆虐敦威治的怪物就是阿米蒂奇消灭的。借助沃特雷老宅里找到的信息，你终于可以将博士之前用到的咒文转写完毕。但这番努力花了你好几个小时的时间。
每位调查员将1张放在一边的深奥的咒文放置入场。 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.flavor: 传统武器伤害不了在敦威治村肆虐的怪物。只有吟诵特定的咒语才能击败它们。你必须先去威尔伯·沃特雷老宅的废墟中找到异界手稿的末章。
all_card.name: 古阿拉伯手稿
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有沃特雷家的废墟中的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_text:
Check Campaign Log. If Dr. Armitage survived The Dunwich Legacy:
"There!" Armitage sighs a breath of relief, jotting down the last phrases of the formula. "I have translated the last of it." He shudders as he hands you the script, the words conjuring forth memories of his battle with the creature. "I hope this is the last time I'll have to read it," he admits. "But if we do nothing, the end result will be much, much worse."
Each investigator puts into play 1 set-aside Esoteric Formula. If Dr. Armitage is listed under "Sacrificed to Yog-Sothoth":
Using the information contained within the ruins of the Whateley homestead, you are able to transcribe the remainder of the formula previously used by Dr. Armitage to destroy the beast that plagued Dunwich. However, the endeavor sets you back several hours.
Each investigator puts into play 1 set-aside Esoteric Formula. Place 1 doom on the current agenda.
all_card.real_flavor: The monsters tearing through Dunwich county are immune to traditional weapons. Only by reciting a particular incantation can the creatures be defeated. First you must search the ruins of Wilbur Whateley’s home in order to find the final sections of the otherworldly script.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators at Whateley Ruins may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你念完咒文，可憎的怪物咆哮着发出非人的声音。它扭曲崩裂，发出与英语迥异的嘶哑声。叫喊声消失之际，怪物的肢体也皱缩，很快就完全消失了。只剩下恶臭和植被上可怕的痕迹标志着怪物曾经存在过。
all_card.flavor: 现在咒文在手，你终于可以消灭这群在敦威治横行的怪物……只要你能活下去。
all_card.name: 消灭他们！
all_card.text: 目标 - 尽可能击败最多的犹格·索托斯之子！如果没有犹格·索托斯之子在场上或放在一边，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you complete the incantation, the foul creature cries out with a raucous, inhuman voice. It rumbles and cracks, the syllables of its croaking far from English. As its cry plays out, the creature shrinks upon itself, and then, with little warning, it is gone. All that remains is a foul stench and a repulsive mark that mars the vegetation where the beast once stood.
all_card.real_flavor: With the formula in hand, you finally have the means to destroy the creatures wreaking havoc in Dunwich... but only if you can survive long enough.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Defeat as many Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemies as you can. If there are no copies of Brood of Yog-Sothoth in play or set aside, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 要是能远离这片地方，沿着山脚的小路，穿越平坦的乡野，重回艾斯伯里峰，那真是能松口气了。待时过境迁，旅人或许会知道，原来自己曾经到过敦威治。<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 敦威治村
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你躲避这些怪物。 [free]：你借了几头猎犬，通过气味追踪怪物。敦威治村的调查员可以将自己的1个线索放置到场上任意一个[[异形]]敌人上。(团队每场游戏仅限一次)
all_card.real_back_flavor:
It is always a relief to get clear of the place, and to follow the narrow road around the base of the hills and across the level country beyond till it rejoins the Aylesbury pike. Afterward one sometimes learns that one has been through Dunwich.
-H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You hide from the rampaging creatures. [fast]: You borrow some hounds to track the creatures by scent. An investigator in Dunwich Village may place 1 of his or her clues on any [[Abomination]] enemy in play. (Group limit once per game).

all_card.back_flavor: 要是能远离这片地方，沿着山脚的小路，穿越平坦的乡野，重回艾斯伯里峰，那真是能松口气了。待时过境迁，旅人或许会知道，原来自己曾经到过敦威治。<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.flavor: 要是你足够勇敢，能够直面怪物，那就敲响教堂的钟声，把它们吸引到村子里。

all_card.real_back_flavor:
It is always a relief to get clear of the place, and to follow the narrow road around the base of the hills and across the level country beyond till it rejoins the Aylesbury pike. Afterward one sometimes learns that one has been through Dunwich.
-H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_flavor: Ringing the church bell may draw the monsters toward the village, if you are brave enough to face them.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You hide from the rampaging creatures. [action]: Move a Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemy once toward Dunwich Village.

all_card.back_flavor:
就在你探查哨兵山周遭道路的时候，山顶的吟唱越来越响，已非此界能容。树林间传来阵阵回响，仿佛有无形的气流在其中激荡。
世界已经开始变动。草木如茶中的砂糖一般融解。你面前的现实已然割裂，露出广阔无垠的天空。你骇恐万分，却也被这种奇景吸引，为之惊叹。奥术力量扭曲了，渗透到你身边，大地都发生了奇异的变动。
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
all_card.flavor: 你接近哨兵山的时候，听到远古的拉丁咒文响彻夜空。是时候出手了。要是你不能阻止敦威治的法师，谁知道他们会把什么样的恐怖放到世界上？
all_card.name: 呼唤远古之神
all_card.real_back_flavor:
As you explore the paths surrounding Sentinel Hill, the chanting at the hilltop rises to a crescendo and takes an otherworldly quality, reverberating through the trees as if carried by unseen currents.
The world begins to change. The grass and trees dissolve like sugar in a cup of tea. A vast endless sky slices through the reality you see before you, and you feel drawn to it, terrified and awestruck. The arcane power becomes distorted and seeps around you, creating strange alterations in the land.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
all_card.real_flavor: As you approach Sentinel Hill, you hear ancient Latin rites bellowed across the night. The time for action has come. If you cannot stop the sorcerers in Dunwich, who knows what terrors they might unleash upon the world?

all_card.back_flavor:
哨兵山的吟唱达到了高潮，天空中撕开了裂缝，排开云层，甚至就连空气也为之破裂。
你看到裂缝中涌出了难以名状的实体——那球体、千眼、千口、粘泥。巨物的形体渗出天空，浸渗盖住了大地。一群法师呼喊着它的名字：“咿呀！咿呀！犹格·索托斯！咿呀！咿呀！犹格·索托斯！”
但他们还没来得及继续欢呼的吟唱，就被不断膨胀的巨形扼住，再无声息。
你惊恐地发现这巨物的膨胀毫无休止。
all_card.flavor: 旧日支配者曾存，旧日支配者仍在，而旧日支配者永在——不在吾等所知空间，而在诸界之间。彼行安定，彼行元初，无维无形。犹格·索托斯知门。犹格·索托斯即门。犹格·索托斯即钥，即门之看守者。过去、现在、未来，皆在犹格·索托斯之中。他知旧日支配者曾于何处破入，亦知旧日支配者将于何处再次破入。他知彼等曾践踏何处，亦知彼等将践踏何处——更知彼时无人曾见彼等。
all_card.name: 呼唤力量
all_card.real_back_flavor:
The chanting reaches its climax, and at the summit of Sentinel Hill, a tear opens across the fabric of the sky, parting the clouds and slicing through the very air itself.
You watch as an indescribable entity - spheres, eyes, mouths, ooze - pours out of the rift. The sorcerers call its name as its form seeps into the sky, spreading forth above the earth."Ia! Ia! Yog-Sothoth! Ia! Ia! Yog-Sothoth!"
Before their jubilant chant can continue, they are smothered by the growing mass, and are heard no more.
To your horror, the expansion of the mass does not cease.
all_card.real_flavor: The Old Ones were, the Old Ones are, and the Old Ones shall be. Not in the spaces we know, but between them, They walk serene and primal, undimensioned and to us unseen. Yog-Sothoth knows the gate. Yog-Sothoth is the gate. Yog-Sothoth is the key and guardian of the gate. Past, present, future, all are one in Yog-Sothoth. He knows where the Old Ones broke through of old, and where They shall break through again. He knows where They have trod earth’s fields, and where They still tread them, and why no one can behold Them

all_card.back_flavor:
你在哨兵山下树木成荫的道路搜寻之时，发现了惊人的一幕。一片隐蔽的空地中躺着一群死羊，鲜血淋漓的尸体精心摆成了奇怪的图形。你屏住呼吸，忍受死亡的臭气，跨过支离破碎的羊尸，来到诡异阵型的中央。
羊群之中横陈着一具人尸。在他的额头中央，严实地按入了一颗透明的宝石。此人瞪大双眼，表情扭曲出一幅可怕的景象，仿佛在祈求你赐予慈悲。尽管已知绝无可能，但你还是检查了一下脉搏。你刚一碰到他皮肤，他额前的宝石就分解消失，而周围的树木似乎敞开了道路。
all_card.back_text:
移除场上每个地点的所有线索。
遮挡通往山上道路的奥术能量散去了。揭示山上道路。
all_card.flavor: 空气中满溢的奥术能量不断震动，冻得你骨头生寒。这股能量在你面前冲毁的道路旋转，渗进几条岔路消失了。
all_card.name: 通往山顶的道路
all_card.text: 目标 - 调查员在收集的线索总计达到所需数量时，必须立即花费这些线索并推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
During your search through the wooded paths around the base of Sentinel Hill, you come across a startling sight. A herd of sheep lays dead upon the ground in a secluded clearing, their bloodied carcasses placed in a strange but careful pattern. Holding your nose against the stench of death, you step over mangled sheep on your way to the center of the odd formation.
In the center of the sheep lies the corpse of a man. A clear jewel has been firmly pressed into his forehead, caving in the front of his skull. His eyes are wide, his face contorted in a vision of fear, as if beseeching you for mercy. Though you know better, you check for a pulse. As you touch the man's skin, the jewel in his forehead dissolves, and the woods around you seem to clear.
all_card.real_back_text: Remove all clues from each location in play. The arcane presence masking the path further up the hill has faded. Reveal Ascending Path.
all_card.real_flavor: A vibrant arcane energy fills the air with a bone-rattling chill. The energy swirls along the crushed trail before you, and seeps down several other paths before disappearing.
all_card.real_text: Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 就在接近哨兵山顶的时候，你遇上了敦威治的几个村民。他们组成圆阵，位于中央的男子吟唱着拉丁文，而其他人顺从地低下了头。“赛斯·毕晓普？”你疑惑地发问。中央的男子回应地抬头看向你，证实了你的怀疑。你祈求男子停止这疯狂的举动，但他并不答复。你拿出在赛拉斯尸体上发现的银色星座挂坠，亮给赛斯看。“我们在你的兄弟那儿只找到了这个。”你顶着咆哮的寒风怒吼，“这就是你给自己安排的命运吗？你想让我们都这样？”你把挂坠扔在地上。一看到挂坠，赛斯大吃一惊，瞪大眼睛，跌跌撞撞地向后摔去，绊倒在自己的咒文上。他摔倒的时候，身后的祭坛洞开，石头里涌出一阵能量涡流，旋转成一道敞开的大门，将他完全吞没。你勉强站住脚跟，紧紧抓牢一块周围的石头，才挡住了大门的拉力。
all_card.back_text: 从游戏中移除放在一边的赛斯·毕晓普敌人。
all_card.flavor: 你往山上走去，周围的环境变得越来越怪异，仿佛异界一般。奥术能量越来越强，空气中劈啪作响，你甚至能感到能量在皮肤上爬。
all_card.name: 登山路途(版本一)
all_card.text: 线索不能放置在非[[幻境]]地点。 目标 - 在有调查员进入哨兵峰时，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Approaching the peak of Sentinel Hill, you are confronted by several citizens of Dunwich. The man in the center of their circle chants in Latin while the others bow their heads in reverence. "Seth Bishop?" you ask presumptively. The man in the center raises his gaze in response, confirming your suspicions. You plead with the man to stop this madness, but he doesn't respond. You draw forth the silver constellation pendant you'd found on Silas's body and present it to Seth. "This is all we found of your brother," you shout over the howling wind. "Is this the fate you want for yourself? For all of us?" You throw the pendant onto the ground. Staggered by the sight of it, he stumbles backwards and trips over his incantation, eyes widened. As he falls, the altar behind him splits open, and a torrent of energy pours from the stone, swirling into an open gate that swallows the man whole. You barely manage to dig your heels in and grab hold of a nearby rock to resist the pull of the gate.
all_card.real_back_text: Remove the set-aside Seth Bishop enemy from the game.
all_card.real_flavor: As you ascend the hill, the environment around you grows increasingly strange and otherworldly. The arcane energy feels even stronger here, crackling in the air and crawling on your skin.
all_card.real_text: Clues cannot be placed on non-[[Altered]] locations. Objective - When an investigator enters Sentinel Peak, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 就在接近哨兵山顶的时候，你遇上了敦威治的几个村民。他们组成圆阵，位于中央的男子发出疯狂的大笑。你从先前村民的描述中认出了这个男子——那正是赛斯·毕晓普。在他身后，还有几个男女也顺从地用拉丁文低头咏唱。“我们成功了！”他大笑道，“我们做到了老沃特雷没有完成的！”你恶心地望着赛斯双眼放空，不住抽搐，好像在阅读什么旁人不可见的东西。“我看到了……我终于看到了！”他将双手举向天空，身后祭坛的基石突然炸裂。一股能量从中涌出，在空气中涌合成一个敞开的传送门。赛斯紧紧抓住一块巨石，防止自己被吸进去，但周遭几人惊得措手不及，被拉了进去。你勉强站住脚跟，紧紧抓牢一块周围的石头，才挡住了大门的拉力。赛斯站了起来，一脸骄傲的神情。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的赛斯·毕晓普敌人放置入场，位于哨兵峰。
all_card.flavor: 你往山上走去，周围的环境变得越来越怪异，仿佛异界一般。奥术能量越来越强，空气中劈啪作响，你甚至能感到能量在皮肤上爬。
all_card.name: 登山路途(版本二)
all_card.text: 线索不能放置在非[[幻境]]地点。 目标 - 在有调查员进入哨兵峰时，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Approaching the peak of Sentinel Hill, you are confronted by several citizens of Dunwich. The man in the center of their circle lets out a crazed laugh. You recognize the man - Seth Bishop - from the description given to you by the townsfolk earlier. Behind him, several other men and women bow their heads in reverence, chanting in Latin. "We've done it!" he cackles. "We've accomplished what Old Whateley and 'is git couldn't!" You watch in revulsion as his eyes glaze over and twitch, as though he were reading something invisible. "I can see now… I can finally see!" He raises his hands to the sky and the headstone of the altar behind him splits open. A torrent of energy pours out of the stone, coalescing into the form of an open gate. Seth holds onto the stone in front of him to prevent himself from being sucked into the gate, but several of the others are startled and pulled through it. You barely manage to dig your heels in and grab hold of a nearby rock in time to resist the pull of the gate. Seth rises to his feet, wearing an expression of pride.
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Seth Bishop enemy into play at Sentinel Peak.
all_card.real_flavor: As you ascend the hill, the environment around you grows increasingly strange and otherworldly. The arcane energy feels even stronger here, crackling in the air and crawling on your skin.
all_card.real_text: Clues cannot be placed on non-[[Altered]] locations. Objective - When an investigator enters Sentinel Peak, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 就在接近哨兵山顶的时候，你遇上了敦威治的几个村民。他们组成圆阵，位于中央的男子绝望地试图完成拉丁文的咏唱。“这不起作用，赛斯！”其中一个男子叫道，“我们该做些什么？”中央的男子停下咏唱，掏出一柄手工刀。“父神需求鲜血的牺牲。”他扭曲出疯狂的表情。你还没来得及反应，他就把刀子刺进了自己的左腕，痛苦地跪在地上。身后祭坛的基石突然炸裂。一股能量从中涌出，在空气中涌合成一个敞开的传送门。赛斯紧紧抓住一块巨石，防止自己被吸进去，但周遭几人惊得措手不及，被拉了进去。你勉强站住脚跟，紧紧抓牢一块周围的石头，才挡住了大门的拉力。赛斯站了起来，身受重伤，但依然活着。他痛苦的脸上露出骄傲的神情。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的赛斯·毕晓普放置入场，位于哨兵峰，带有1[per_investigator]伤害。
all_card.flavor: 你往山上走去，周围的环境变得越来越怪异，仿佛异界一般。奥术能量越来越强，空气中劈啪作响，你甚至能感到能量在皮肤上爬。
all_card.name: 登山路途(版本三)
all_card.text: 线索不能放置在非[[幻境]]地点。 目标 - 在有调查员进入哨兵峰时，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Approaching the peak of Sentinel Hill, you are confronted by several citizens of Dunwich. The man in the center of their circle is desperately trying to complete a Latin incantation. "It's not working, Seth!" one of the other men cries out. "What're we gonna do?" The man in the center stops his chant and pulls out a cobbler's knife. "The father demands a blood sacrifice," he declares, and his face twists into a crazed expression. Before you can react, he slits his left wrist with the knife, dropping to his knees in agony. The headstone of the altar behind him splits open. A torrent of energy pours out of the stone, coalescing into the form of an open gate. Seth holds onto the stone in front of him to prevent himself from being sucked into the gate, but several of the others are startled and pulled through it. You barely manage to dig your heels in and grab hold of a nearby rock in time to resist the pull of the gate. Seth rises, wounded but alive. An expression of pride spreads across his pained face.
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Seth Bishop enemy into play at Sentinel Peak, with 1 [per_investigator] damage on him.
all_card.real_flavor: As you ascend the hill, the environment around you grows increasingly strange and otherworldly. The arcane energy feels even stronger here, crackling in the air and crawling on your skin.
all_card.real_text: Clues cannot be placed on non-[[Altered]] locations. Objective - When an investigator enters Sentinel Peak, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你并不知道如何关闭面前漩流的大门。每过一刻，其中的力量都更为强大。你忧心忡忡，不知道这群法师到底从彼界唤来了怎样的存在。你争分夺秒，查找石头祭坛上打开的典籍，迫切地想要找到答案。
all_card.flavor: 在山顶祭坛的基石废墟之中，强劲的能量打开了漩涡般的传送门。飓风般的力 量从门中涌出，折断了树木，把无数碎片卷入其中。巨大的呼啸声充斥了你的耳朵，盖过了一切声响。不管怎样，你都必须找到关门的方法。
all_card.name: 大门打开
all_card.text: 目标 - 只有哨兵峰的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You don't know how to close the swirling gate before you, and with each passing moment, the force from within it grows in strength. You fear that whatever entity the sorcerers have summoned from beyond approaches. With no time to spare, you turn to the open tome on the stone altar, desperate for answers.
all_card.real_flavor: From the ruins of the headstone on the altar at the hill’s peak, a gateway of churning vibrant energy has appeared. A force like a hurricane erupts from the gate, bending trees and pulling debris into it. The howling of the gale drowns out all other sound. Somehow, you must find a way to close the gate.
all_card.real_text: Objective - Only investigators at Sentinel Peak may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 哨兵山长长的山坡在你面前，一路通往犬牙交错的山顶边缘。
all_card.name: 山脚
all_card.text: 山脚与每个分岔路连接。 [action]：调查。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为将随机一张放在一边的分岔路放置入场。(每轮仅限一次。) [action]：撤退。“叫我来可不是干这个的！”
all_card.real_back_flavor: The long slope of Sentinel Hill rises before you, cresting in the jagged edges of Sentinel Peak.
all_card.real_text: Base of the Hill is connected to each copy of Diverging Path. [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, put a random set-aside Diverging Path into play. (Limit once per round.) [action]: Resign. "This is more than I signed up for!"

all_card.back_flavor: 就在你试图沿路上山的时候，你发现自己不知为何竟在无尽地兜圈子。你每次停下来确认自己的方位，却又发现自己回到了山脚。
all_card.back_text: 通往山上更远地方的道路挡住了。你不能移动进入上山道路。
all_card.name: 上山道路
all_card.text: 上山道路与每个迷幻小路连接。 [action]：调查。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为将随机一张放在一边的迷幻小路放置入场。(每轮仅限一次。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: When you try to follow the path leading further up Sentinel Hill, you somehow end up walking in a perpetual loop. Each time you stop to find your bearings, you find yourself back at the base of the hill again.
all_card.real_back_text: The path leading further up the hill is masked. You cannot move into Ascending Path.
all_card.real_text: Ascending Path is connected to each copy of Altered Path. [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, put a random set-aside Altered Path into play. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 一道奥术之墙挡住了前往更远处山峰的道路。
all_card.back_text: 作为移动进入哨兵峰的额外费用，调查员必须共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.flavor: 沃特雷一家就是在这里点燃可憎的篝火，吟诵他们奸邪的仪式……<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 哨兵峰
all_card.text: 强制 - 在本地点的调查员抽取一张[[巫术]]卡牌时：该调查员受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: An arcane wall blocks the path further up the hill, leading towards the peak.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost to move to Sentinel Peak, the investigators must spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group
all_card.real_flavor:
It is here that the Whateleys used to build their hellish fires and chant their hellish rituals…
-H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text: Forced - When an investigator at this location draws a [[Hex]] card: That investigator takes 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 地下践踏的痕迹一路通往哨兵山周围的树林深处。
all_card.name: 屠杀之森
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你揭示屠杀之森后：如果你没有行动剩余，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A path off the beaten trail leads deeper into the woods surrounding Sentinel Hill
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Slaughtered Woods: Take 2 horror if you have no actions remaining.

all_card.back_flavor: 地下践踏的痕迹一路通往哨兵山周围的树林深处。
all_card.flavor: 四下寂静无声。没有树叶沙沙，没有鸟鸣啾啾，甚至连风声都听不到。
all_card.name: 诡异空地
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你揭示诡异空地后：你每剩余一个行动，弃掉你牌库顶2张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A path off the beaten trail leads deeper into the woods surrounding Sentinel Hill

all_card.back_flavor: 遵照流程和规则往往让罗兰感到放心。身为联邦探员，罗兰的手册在任何情况下都能派上用场，这真是令他宽慰。但最近，他的联邦探员手册在任务里完全派不上用场。无论多么努力，罗兰也找不到哪里提及了遭遇奇怪生物、时空之门，和魔法咒文的对策。要不是亲眼所见，他自己也绝不会相信……他的上峰也是绝不会明白的。罗兰知道，这次他可得靠自己了。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Roland had always taken comfort in procedure and rules. As an agent in the Bureau, he was relieved to have guidelines to follow in any given situation. But lately, his Federal Agent's Handbook had been entirely unhelpful given the cases he'd been assigned. Try as he might, Roland could find no mention of what to do when confronted with strange creatures, gates through time and space, or magic spells. If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, he would never have believed it... and there's no way his superiors would understand. Roland knew he would have to handle this one himself.

all_card.back_flavor: 黛西是米斯卡塔尼克大学里受人尊敬的图书馆员，她一直都觉得自己生命里最重要的就是书。恐怖、暴力、惊俱，这些日常生活中嫌恶的东西，她在书里倒是看得津津有味。她随即一头陷进了约翰·迪伊翻译的《死灵之书》。这是亵渎、污秽，毛骨悚然、难以置信。但根据自己对神秘事物和密教主题的研究，黛西知道，这本书里事实大于虚构。她开始好奇，在奥恩图书馆的限制区里，还藏着什么其他秘密……

all_card.real_back_flavor: As a respected librarian at Miskatonic University, Daisy had always felt that books were the most important thing in her life. She explored in fiction what she abhorred in life: horror, violence, fear. Then, she stumbled across the John Dee translation of the Necronomicon. It was blasphemous, unholy, and too awful to be read. But given her studies in obscure and occult subjects, Daisy knew there was more truth than fiction within the book's pages. She began to wonder what other secrets the restricted collection of the Orne Library held...

all_card.back_flavor: “倒霉蛋”本来想做个好人。但有的时候，要对得起自己的良心，就得不干不净。尽管他要钱是为了妈妈的手术，但这些条子可不会管。就在他服刑的第二年，妈妈因病去世。但狱友布拉德·霍林告诉他，还有比死亡更糟糕的事。他每晚都无声地嘶喊“古神”之事，把自己梦到的奇异旅程都告诉“倒霉蛋”。“倒霉蛋”本来没当回事，直到有一晚，他起夜看到了狱友烧成了灰。等到终于出狱的时候，“倒霉蛋”回到了阿卡姆寻求答案。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Skids hadn't planned on a life of crime. But sometimes doing the right thing means getting your hands dirty. The cops didn't care that Skids needed the money for his mother's operation. His mother died of her illness during the second year of his sentence. His cellmate, Brad Hollins, told him there were worse fates than death. He ranted and raved in a quiet voice every evening about the "Old Ones" and told Skids about bizarre adventures he'd had while dreaming. Skids didn't give it much thought until the night he woke to the sight of his cellmate bursting into flames. When Skids was finally released, he returned to Arkham, looking for answers.

all_card.back_flavor: 艾格尼丝·贝克今生可能只是个毕恭毕敬的侍应，但在超越现代世界想象的前生，她可是个强大的女巫。一切都源自她在自家阁楼那堆落满灰的传家宝里发现的奇怪神器一一大概是某种钥匙。她触碰的时候，记忆如潮水般涌来，一同奔流的还有另一个词：“希波利尔”。越是深入幻景和前世的记忆，她的力量也就越强大……但她也就更加害怕。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Agnes Baker may be just an unassuming waitress in this life, but in a previous life, in a time and age undreamed of in the modern world, she had been a powerful witch. It began when she found a strange artifact - a key of some kind - in a dusty collection of family belongings in her attic. When she touched it, the memories came flooding back, along with one word: "Hyperborea." The more she delved into the visions and memories of her former life, the stronger her powers grew... and the more frightened she became.

all_card.back_flavor: 温蒂还小的时候，妈妈常让她玩自己的项链。妈妈会讲她的故事，温蒂则转着项链，看它闪闪发光。然后，话就说到爸爸在海上失踪，妈妈也开始行为古怪，在房子里用粉笔画满了反常的符号。妈妈被带到了疯人院，温蒂则去了孤儿院。但妈妈在被带走前，把项链留给了温蒂，说是能“保护她”。温蒂在孤儿院里待了几年，然后溜了出来，她决定能靠自己活得更好。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Mama used to let Wendy play with her necklace when she was small. Mama would tell her stories, and Wendy would spin the necklace and watch as it glittered. Then, word came that her father had been lost at sea, and Mama started acting strange, drawing unusual symbols in chalk all over the house. They took Mama to the asylum, and Wendy went to the orphanage. Before they took her away, Mama gave her the necklace, to "protect her." Wendy stayed in the orphanage for several years before running away, deciding that she could take better care of herself on her own.

all_card.back_flavor: 丹妮拉辛勤工作，就为了在机修的行当里闯出点名堂。她刚还清新修理厂的贷款，毁灭阿卡姆的滔天洪水就来了，让她的整个生意真的泡了汤。她没有失落，而是和往常一样卷起袖子继续干。现在她还加班负责调试肉类加工厂的机器。但她开始听说滨水区发生了奇怪的事情：本地人失踪、鲜血淋漓的尸体，还有传言说黑影在晚上游走于街巷。丹妮拉清楚的很，不能把这些怪事当作偶然。不管是什么，她都要做好准备。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，生存者卡牌([survivor])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入牌库卡牌张数)：[丹妮拉的扳手]、[身临危境]、1张随机基础弱点。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Daniela worked hard to make a name for herself as a mechanic. She'd only just paid off her new garage when Arkham was devastated by a cataclysmic flood, sending her business quite literally underwater. Rather than mope, she rolled up her sleeves, like always, and got back to work. Now she works an extra shift tuning up engines at the new meat-packing factories. But she's started to hear talk about strange things going on in the waterfront district: locals gone missing; corpses drained of blood; and rumors of a shadowy figure that stalks the alleys at night. Daniela knows better than to dismiss these strange happenings as mere circumstance. Whatever it is, she intends to be ready.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Daniela's Wrench, In Harm's Way, 1 random basic weakness.

all_card.back_flavor: 说起异常诡怪的事情，乔·戴蒙德比大多数人都有经验。他有着敏锐的直觉，遇上最离奇的事情也能一探到底，这很大程度上是因为他愿意为了获得真相用尽一切手段。但最近几周，即便是乔也不堪重负，难以应付工作。他的桌子堆满了谋杀案的照片和失踪案的报道，桩桩件件都骇人听闻：各行各业居然都有人不留一丝踪迹就消失了。乔不知道这些事件之间有什么联系，但他绝不会冷落这些案子。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Joe Diamond has more experience with supernatural nonsense than most. He has developed a keen intuition and a knack for getting to the bottom of even the most uncanny occurrences, helped in no small part by his willingness to get his hands dirty. But in recent weeks, even Joe has been hard-pressed to stay on top of his work. His desk is flooded with photos of grisly murders and reports of disappearances: people from all walks of life vanishing without a trace. Joe isn't sure how each of these events is connected, but he's not about to let the case go cold.

all_card.real_flavor: "I can't stop now. Not when I'm so close to the truth."

all_card.back_flavor: 特里希·斯卡波罗曾经是黑室的间谍，这段危险又刺激的经历让她十分享受。她对诡计并不陌生，但怎么也没想到新主任接管组织的时候，自己会成为一场阴谋的中心。她手上的任务越来越枯燥，后来还被强烈暗示该“为自己休息休息”。特里希怀疑主任的动机，深入调查黑室的记录，发现腐败一直蔓延到高层的证据——还有传言说背后在操纵一切的，是一个叫红色同志会的组织。现在的特里希遭人陷害，背负泄漏敏感信息的罪名。她不得不出逃在外，想办法洗刷自己的冤屈。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Trish Scarborough enjoyed an exciting and dangerous career as a spy for the Black Chamber. She's no stranger to subterfuge, but never expected to be at the center of her own conspiracy when a new director arrived to run the organization. After a series of increasingly menial missions, she was strongly encouraged to "take time for herself." Suspicious of her director's motives, she dug into the Chamber's records and discovered evidence of corruption going all the way to the top - rumors of an organization known as the Red Coterie working behind the scenes. Framed for leaking sensitive information, she's now on the run and driven to restore her good name.

all_card.back_flavor: 大战期间，戴克斯特·德雷克找到了危险又神秘的《死灵之书》残页，从此他不遗余力，想要找到、翻译更多的内容。起初，他是为了封印这本书中的邪恶。然而，学会“真正”魔法的诱惑驱动了戴克斯特的好奇心，让他开始更深入地阅读书中亵渎的文字。戴克斯特确信自己可以解密其中的文本：战争考验了他的勇气，舞台锻炼了他的机智。但真正的魔法，是有代价的。戴克斯特能否掌握这份奥秘，还是会被其掌握？

all_card.real_back_flavor: After finding scraps of the dangerous and mysterious Necronomicon while fighting in the Great War, Dexter Drake wasted no small effort in hunting down and translating more pages. At first, his goal was to keep its evil contained. However, Dexter's curiosity drove him to delve deeper into the profane text, tempted by the promise of "true" magic. Dexter is sure he has what it takes to decode the text: he proved his courage in the war and his resourcefulness on stage. But true magic comes at a cost. Will Dexter prove his mastery over the arcane, or will the arcane overpower him?

all_card.back_flavor: 伊莎贝拉·巴恩斯觉得自己打记事起就一直在逃亡。终于，她从奥姆斯德一家的魔爪中逃了出来，这群教徒把她当作某个黑暗扭曲仪式的“最后一块碎片”。她自己都不知道身上有什么特殊之处吸引了他们。但现在，多亏了姐姐珍妮，伊莎贝拉自由了。但自由代价不菲。姐姐付出了一切才换回伊莎贝拉。为此，她要让奥姆斯德一家——以及所有欺压弱者及无辜者的人——血债血偿。在拿起姐姐的.45双枪后，伊莎贝拉终于可以回头迎击追来的敌人了。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Isabelle Barnes has been on the run for as long as she can remember. She finally escaped from the Olmsteads, a family cult who thought of her as the "final piece" for some dark and twisted ritual. She doesn't know what made her so special to the cult. But now, thanks to her sister Jenny, Isabelle is finally free. But freedom comes at a cost. Her sister gave everything to get Isabelle back, and for that, Isabelle intends to make the Olmsteads - and all those who prey on the weak and innocent - pay in blood. Armed with her lost sister's twin .45s, Isabelle can finally turn to face her pursuers head on.

all_card.name: 有烟处……
all_card.text: 目标-当一轮结束时，调查员可以共同花费所需的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You find your friend's satchel, scorched with a stylized emblem of an open palm. Wherever your friend is, you imagine they didn't go willingly. As you turn to leave, you are confronted by a masked figure wreathed in flame. As the room erupts into flames around you, they let out a chilling wail.
all_card.real_back_text:
Discard each enemy in play.
Put the set-aside Dormitories and Miskatonic Quad locations into play. Spawn the set-aside Servant of Flame enemy at the Dormitories.
Attach 1 set-aside copy of Fire! to Your Friend's Room. Place each other set-aside copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile.
all_card.real_flavor: You are searching the dormitories for any sign of your friend.
all_card.real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你冲出宿舍，在清朗的秋夜中感觉肺都要炸开了。回过头，已经没有追兵的身影。你想起朋友打算咨询米大图书馆的负责人，亨利·阿米蒂奇博士。他或许能帮助你理清发生了什么。
all_card.back_text: 查找所有场上和场外区域，找出[烈焰仆从]敌人，治愈其所有伤害，将其放在一边，位于场外。 弃掉场上的所有敌人。 弃掉[朋友的房间]的所有标记和附属并将其从游戏中移除。将剩下每张放在一边的地点（[奥恩图书馆]，[科技馆]，[沃伦天文台]）放置入场。
all_card.flavor: 你和出口之间挡着一个燃烧的幽影，你必须逃出宿舍！
all_card.name: 逃出宿舍
all_card.text: 目标-如果每位未被击败的调查员都在[大学广场]，推进。（提示：有的时候走为上计！）
all_card.real_back_flavor: You emerge from the dormitories, lungs bursting, into the crisp autumn evening. Looking behind, there is no trace of your pursuer. You remember your friend planned to consult Miskatonic University's head librarian, Dr. Henry Armitage. He may be able to help you understand what is going on.
all_card.real_back_text: Search all in-play and all out-of-play areas for the Servant of Flame, heal all damage from them, and set them aside, out of play. Discard each enemy in play. Discard all tokens and attachments from Your Friend's Room and remove it from the game. Put each remaining set-aside location (Orne Library, Science Hall, Warren Observatory) into play.
all_card.real_flavor: A burning apparition stands between you and the exit. You must escape the dormitories!
all_card.real_text: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at Miskatonic Quad, advance. (Hint: Somcetimes it's better to run than to fight!)

all_card.back_flavor:
你发现阿米蒂奇博士困守在奥恩图书馆的讲堂里。
“校园里近来有人行事故怪，你的朋友也是。但这些事情都不是最紧急的。现在我们要直面你的追兵，阻止此人烧毁整个校园！”阿米蒂奇博士说道。
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的[亨利·阿米蒂奇]剧情支援放置入场，位于任意调查员的控制之下。他在本场冒险期间不占据盟友槽位。 将放在一边的[烈焰仆从]敌人放置入场，位于[大学广场]。在[大学广场]上放置3[per_investigator]个线索。 调查员队长必须查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出1[per_investigator]张[着火了！]并将其抽取。（如果查找过遭遇牌库，将其混洗）
all_card.flavor: 你的朋友提过要去拜访图书馆的负责人，亨利·阿米蒂奇博士。周围奇怪的身影越来越多，你必须穿过校园找到他的下落。
all_card.name: 寻找阿米蒂奇博士
all_card.text: 目标-当一轮结束时，位于[奥恩图书馆]的调查员可以共同花费所需的线索以推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You find Dr. Armitage barricaded in one of Orne Library's lecture halls.
"Some on campus have been acting strange lately, your friend among them. But all of that can wait. We must confront your pursuer and stop them before the entire campus burns!" Dr. Armitage says.
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Dr. Henry Armitage story asset into play under any investigator's control. He does not take up an ally slot during this scenario. Put the set-aside Servant of Flame enemy into play at Miskatonic Quad. Place 3 [per_investigator] clues on Miskatonic Quad. The lead investigator must search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 [per_investigator] copies of Fire! and draw them. (Shuffle the encounter deck if it was searched.)
all_card.real_flavor: Your friend had mentioned visiting the head librarian, Dr. Henry Armitage. With more and more strange figures arriving, you must scour the campus for his whereabouts.
all_card.real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators at Orne Library may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你那噩梦般的追兵到退一步，双手抱头，仿佛要把面具扯下来。远方的警报声越来越响。你转身，一大群惊慌失措的学生跑过身边。等你再把注意力转回燃烧的敌人，却发现对方已经消失无踪。
all_card.flavor: 你绝不容许那个火爆的家伙伤害更多无辜！借由阿米蒂奇博士的帮助，或许你就能阻止此人。
all_card.name: 炽热辉煌
all_card.text: [free]共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1[per_investigator]点伤害。 [action]：撤退。你掏出了燃烧的校园。（这不会引起趁乱攻击） 目标-如果[烈焰仆从]被击败：推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your nightmarish pursuer reels back, clutching both hands to their head, as if trying to pry their mask off. The sound of sirens in the distance grows louder. You turn to see a gaggle of terrified students rush past you. When you turn your attention back to your flaming nemesis, they have vanished into thin air.
all_card.real_flavor: Your fiery nemesis can't be allowed to hurt more innocents! With Dr. Armitage's help, perhaps you can stop them.
all_card.real_text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to an enemy at your location. [action]: Resign. You flee the burning campus. (This does not provoke attacks of opportunity.) Objective - If the Servant of Flame is defeated: Advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 朋友的房间一团糟。但这到底是因为屋主心烦意乱，还是因为这里发生过一场打斗？
all_card.flavor: 宿舍里很快就到处是烟。
all_card.name: 朋友的房间
all_card.text: [action]：交战。选择连接地点的一个敌人。该敌人移动到本地点并于你交战。本行动不会引起趁乱攻击。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your friend's room is in utter disarray. But are these signs of a weary mind, or of some kind of struggle?
all_card.real_flavor: The dorm is quickly filling with smoke.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Engage. Choose an enemy at a connecting location. That enemy moves to this location and engages you. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

all_card.name: *烈焰仆从
all_card.text: 猎手。猎物([agility]最低)。反击。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Prey (lowest [agility]). Retaliate.

all_card.name: *亨利·阿米蒂奇博士
all_card.text:
你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
你每回合执行的第一个行动不会引起趁乱攻击。
all_card.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克.
all_card.real_flavor: "I've seen more than my share of strange occurrences."
all_card.real_text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
The first action you perform each round does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

all_card.back_flavor: 广场位于米大正中心，连接着校园各处。
all_card.name: 大学广场
all_card.text: [free]如果游戏中正好有1或2位调查员，在你的回合期间：移动至一个连接地点。（团队每轮仅限一次）
all_card.traits: 米斯卡塔尼克. 中心.
all_card.real_back_flavor: The quad is the central crossroads of Miskatonic University.
all_card.real_text: [fast] During your turn, if there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game: Move to a connecting location. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 最近翻修过的宿舍有了很多值得夸耀的现代顶尖便利设施，比如空调，抽水马桶和共享冰箱。
all_card.flavor: 大学宿舍里绝不会无聊。
all_card.name: 宿舍
all_card.text: [action]：治愈1点伤害和1点恐惧。（每场游戏仅限一次）
all_card.real_back_flavor: Recently renovated, the dormitories boast some of the best modern conveniences, including air conditioning, flush toilets, and a communal ice box.
all_card.real_flavor: There's never a dull moment in the university dorms.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 西部纪念科技馆建立在校园北部的举措令很多人摸不着头脑。但学生们还是非常乐于见到现代的设备和顶尖的科技仪器。
all_card.flavor: 学生们从来不确定每天会在显微镜下发现什么。
all_card.name: 科技馆
all_card.text: 强制-你发现科技馆的线索后：选择并弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The construction of the West Memorial Science Hall at the northern end of campus is confusing, to say the least. However, students nevertheless are more than happy for the modern facilities and state-of-the-art science equipment.
all_card.real_flavor: The students are never exactly sure what will be under the microscope each day.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at Science Hall: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.

all_card.back_flavor: 蒂林哈斯特产业的一笔捐款让大学得以重建著名的天文台，规模更胜往昔。
all_card.flavor: 迄今为止，米斯卡塔尼克的天文学家已经发现至少有15个独立的天体从北半球的天空消失。
all_card.name: 沃伦天文台
all_card.text: [reaction]你发现本地点的线索后：抽取1张卡牌。（每轮仅限一次）
all_card.real_back_flavor: A generous grant from Tillinghast Endeavors has allowed the university to bring the storied observatory back, bigger and better than ever.
all_card.real_flavor: To date, Miskatonic astronomers have identified at least 15 separate stars that appear to have gone missing from the Northern Hemisphere.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 在洪水之后，为了做好一切防范手段，奥恩图书馆的管理员清空了底下的档案，并正在为图书馆增设防水措施。
all_card.flavor: 学生报告说无人的档案馆在晚上传来了奇怪的声响……
all_card.name: 奥恩图书馆
all_card.text: [action][action]：抽取3张卡牌。（每场游戏仅限一次）
all_card.real_back_flavor: To take every precaution since the flood, the Orne librarians have cleared out the basement archives and worked to waterproof the building.
all_card.real_flavor: Students have reported strange sounds coming from the empty archives at night...
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Draw 3 cards. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor:
“火与刀，影与血。洪流之后，女王复生。”
<cite>《灰烬法典》，卷十九</cite>
all_card.name: 烈焰领唱
all_card.text: 反击。
all_card.real_flavor:
"By flame and blade, in shade and blood
Our queen reborn after the flood."
-Edict of Ash, Vol XIX
all_card.real_text: Retaliate.

all_card.name: 地狱猎犬
all_card.text: 猎手。 强制-[地狱猎犬]在敌军阶段期间攻击你后：选择并弃掉1张你控制的支援。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Forced - After Hellhound attacks you during the enemy phase: Choose and discard 1 asset you control.

all_card.flavor: 他们总是在错误时间出现在错误的地点。
all_card.name: 旁人
all_card.text: 厄运降临。（在本敌人被击败时，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致当前密谋推进）
all_card.real_flavor: They're always in the exact wrong place at the exact wrong time.
all_card.real_text: Doomed. (When this enemy is defeated, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.)

all_card.name: 宇宙恶魔
all_card.text: 险境。 显现-你必须（选择一项）： -在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致密谋推进。 -受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧。[宇宙恶魔]获得涌动。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the agenda to advance. - Take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror. Cosmic Evils gains surge.

all_card.name: 不可说的真相
all_card.text: 显现-将[不可说的真相]放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。每位调查员仅限1张。 强制-你发现线索后：受到1点恐惧。 [action][action]：弃掉[不可说的真相]。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Unspeakable Truths into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues: Take 1 horror. [action][action]: Discard Unspeakable Truths.

all_card.flavor: 都说好奇心杀死猫，那它也会杀死你吗？
all_card.name: 禁忌秘密
all_card.text: 显现-如果你没有线索，[禁忌秘密]获得涌动。否则，检定[intellect](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须将你的1个线索放到你所在地点，或受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: They say curiosity killed the cat. But will it kill you, too?
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If you have no clues, Forbidden Secrets gains surge. Otherwise, test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either place 1 of your clues on your location, or take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 超维幻想
all_card.text: 显现-检定[willpower]或[intellect](X)，其中X为你的手牌数。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害并随机弃掉你1张手牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] or [intellect] (X), where X is the number of cards in your hand. If you fail, take 1 damage and discard 1 card at random from your hand.

all_card.flavor:
“神助入梦者，它们疯狂的幻觉映示着水晶峡湾下的死亡之眼！”
<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《犹格斯星的真菌》</cite>
all_card.name: 狂野冲动
all_card.text: 显现-检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须随机弃掉你1张手牌，或失去1资源。
all_card.real_flavor: "God help the dreamer whose mad visions shew Those did eyes set in crystal gulfs below!" -H.P. Lovecraft, "Fungi from Yuggoth"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either discard 1 card at random from your hand, or lose 1 resource.

all_card.name: 着火了！
all_card.text: 显现-将[着火了！]附属到最近且没有附属[着火了！]的地点。 强制-在调查阶段结束时：本地点每张有生命值的非[[精英]]卡牌受到1点直接伤害。 [action]：检定[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉[着火了！]。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Fire! to the nearest location without Fire! attached. Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Each non-[[Elite]] card with health at this location takes 1 direct damage. [action]: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Fire!

all_card.flavor: 有烟处必有火。
all_card.name: 有毒烟雾
all_card.text: 显现-检定[willpower]或[agility](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: Where there's smoke, there's almost definitely fire.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] or [agility] (3). Take 1 damage for each point you fail by.

all_card.name: 突变！
all_card.text: 显现-检定[willpower](2)。如果你所在地点有敌人，本次检定难度+2。如果你检定失败，你必须受到2点伤害，或你所在地点的每位调查员受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +2 difficulty if there is an enemy at your location. If you fail, you must either take 2 damage, or each investigator at your location takes 1 horror.

all_card.name: 突变实验体
all_card.text: 强制-在本敌人被击败时：其所在地点的每位调查员受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_text: Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Each investigator at its location takes 1 horror.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]-X。X为胜利区和场景底下[[精英]]敌人的总数量+2。 [cultist]-3。如果检定的对象为[[精英]]敌人，再揭示一个标记。 [tablet]-4。如果你检定失败，将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。 [elder_thing]你每控制1个线索，-2。
all_card.name: 迷烟重重
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]-X。X为胜利区和场景底下[[精英]]敌人的数量。 [cultist]-1。如果检定的对象为[[精英]]敌人，再揭示一个标记。 [tablet]-3。如果你检定失败，将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。 [elder_thing]你每控制1个线索，-1。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull] -X. X is 2 more than the total number of [[Elite]] enemies in the victory display and under the act.
[cultist] -3. If this is a test targeting an [[Elite]] enemy, reveal another token.
[tablet] -4. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[elder_thing] -2 for each clue you control.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] -X. X is the total number of [[Elite]] enemies in the victory display and under the act.
[cultist] -1. If this is a test targeting an [[Elite]] enemy, reveal another token.
[tablet] -3. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[elder_thing] -1 for each clue you control.

all_card.back_flavor: 你极力忽视的瘙痒越来越无法忍受。你拉开袖子，发现一块灰皮正在剥落。你小心翼翼地刮开死皮，露出一块光滑的疤，仿佛是有人在你身上卡了烙印。疤的样子像是一只手，中间嵌着一颗张开的眼。你摸了摸，只觉得温暖，又有点头重脚轻，跟喝醉了似的。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员依次抽取1张放在一边的[俄洛寇斯印记]弱点。每位调查员现在拥有该弱点。（将该卡牌加入该调查员的牌库，忽略牌库构建限制。这张卡牌不计入该调查员的牌库卡牌张数）
all_card.flavor: 阿卡姆街上全是翻唱的雾霾。几个本地人说是西边的山烧起来了。尽管秋天天气凉爽，夜幕降临的时候街道上还是温暖得不寻常。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆热火朝天
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你启程返回，带着目前为止的发现前去和阿米蒂奇博士一起探讨你朋友的下落。
all_card.real_back_flavor: An itch you've done your best to ignore becomes unbearable. Pulling back your sleeve reveals a patch of peeling gray skin. Gingerly, you scratch the dead skin to reveal a smooth scar, almost as though you were branded. The scar resembles a hand with an unblinking eye inset into it. Touching it gives you a warm, heady feeling, like being drunk.
all_card.real_back_text: One at a time, each investigator draws 1 copy of the set-aside Mark of Elokoss weakness. Each investigator is now the bearer of that weakness. (Add that card to that investigator's deck, ignoring deckbuilding restrictions. It does not count toward that investigator's deck size.)
all_card.real_flavor: An unnatural haze fills the streets of Arkham. Some of the locals say the hills west of Arkham are burning. Despite the cool autumn weather, the city streets feel unnaturally warm as evening falls.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You return to compare notes with Dr. Armitage on your friend's whereabouts.

all_card.back_flavor: 你看了看表，发现时间已经过了11点半。你咒骂着叫了辆车，往东城区而去。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员立即撤退。
all_card.flavor: 湿漉漉的人行道上升腾起蒸汽，仿佛下面的地面真的在烧。
all_card.name: 邪恶渐起
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你启程返回，带着目前为止的发现前去和阿米蒂奇博士一起探讨你朋友的下落。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You check your watch and realize it is already half past 11. Cursing, you hail a cab to make your way to Easttown.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator immediately resigns.
all_card.real_flavor: Steam rises off of the wet pavement, as though the ground beneath it were actually burning.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You return to compare notes with Dr. Armitage on your friend's whereabouts.

all_card.back_flavor: 你调查的结果耐人寻味。现在你和阿米蒂奇博士应该有足够的线索，能找到你朋友的下落可。你叫了辆车，回东城区讨论自己的发现。
all_card.flavor: 你必须找到朋友清单上嫌犯的下落。
all_card.name: 烈焰预言
all_card.text: [action]共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索：抽取你地点底下正面朝下的卡牌。 目标-如果胜利区和/或场景底下有总计6个[[精英]]敌人，推进。 （提示：用武力击败嫌犯，或者结算其抄本条目，都可以推进你的调查！）
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your search has turned up some interesting results. With all that you've learned, you and Dr. Armitage should have enough clues to find your friend's whereabouts. You hail a cab back to Easttown to discuss your findings.
all_card.real_flavor: You must find the whereabouts of the suspects on your friend's list.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the facedown card beneath your location. Objective - If there are a total of 6 [[Elite]] enemies in the victory display and/or under the act, advance. (Hint: Either defeat the suspects by force or resolve their codex entries to generate leads for your investigation!)

all_card.name: 俄洛寇斯印记
all_card.text: 显现-将[俄洛寇斯印记]放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。 强制-在你的回合结束时：受到1点伤害。如可能，将该伤害分配给你控制的支援。 [action][action]：弃掉[俄洛寇斯印记]。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Mark of Elokoss into play in your threat area. Forced - When your turn ends: Take 1 damage. Assign that damage to an asset you control, if able. [action][action]: Discard Mark of Elokoss.

all_card.name: *烈焰仆从
all_card.text: 逃逸。猎手。反击。 强制-在[烈焰仆从]被击败时：([codex]Ф)
all_card.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 精英.

all_card.real_text: Aloof. (This enemy does not automatically engage investigators at its location.) [reaction] After you successfully investigate David Renfield's location: ([codex] 1).

Decrease the difficulty for this test by 1 for each damage on Sgt. Earl Monroe. If you succeed, ([codex] 4).

all_card.real_text: Aloof. (This enemy does not automatically engage investigators at its location.) [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more at Margaret Liu's location: ([codex] 6).

all_card.back_flavor: 商业区是座不夜城。这里是阿卡姆最繁忙的城区，有着崭新华丽的剧场、酒店、高楼大厦，还有马萨诸塞州最好的餐厅（至少他们自己是这么说的）。
all_card.flavor: 要从阿卡姆第一银行贷到款还是很简单的，但别忘了看看细则……
all_card.name: 商业区
all_card.text: [reaction]你发现本地点的线索后：获得1资源。
all_card.real_back_flavor: There's never a quiet night in Downtown. Arkham's busiest district is home to glamorous new theaters, hotels, high-rises, and the finest dining in all of Massachusetts (or so they say).
all_card.real_flavor: It's fairly easy to take out a loan from the First Bank of Arkham, but don't forget to read the fine print...
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Gain 1 resource.

all_card.back_flavor: 商业区是座不夜城。这里是阿卡姆最繁忙的城区，有着崭新华丽的剧场、酒店、高楼大厦，还有马萨诸塞州最好的餐厅（至少他们自己是这么说的）。
all_card.flavor: 当然，没人会提到疗养院。
all_card.name: 商业区
all_card.text: [reaction]你发现本地点的线索后：治愈本地点的一位调查员或一个[[盟友]]支援1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: There's never a quiet night in Downtown. Arkham's busiest district is home to glamorous new theaters, hotels, high-rises, and the finest dining in all of Massachusetts (or so they say).
all_card.real_flavor: Of course, nobody mentions the sanatorium.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at this location.

all_card.back_flavor: 阿卡姆最新的街区满是时髦的商店。摇摆的爵士乐，学生和外来居民的人数也在不断增长。
all_card.flavor: 阿卡姆唯一的医院，病人总是人满为患，护士总是不堪重负。
all_card.name: 住宅区
all_card.text: [action]：治愈本地点的调查员和/或[[盟友]]支援总计最多2点伤害。（每场游戏仅限一次）
all_card.real_back_flavor: The newest district in Arkham is filled with fashionable shops, swinging jazz music, and a growing population of students and young newcomers.
all_card.real_flavor: Arkham's only hospital is flush with patients and put-upon nurses.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Heal up to 2 damage from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at this location. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 阿卡姆最新的街区满是时髦的商店。摇摆的爵士乐，学生和外来居民的人数也在不断增长。
all_card.flavor:
“欢迎来魔术古玩商店见识真正的魔法。舞台魔术师恕不接待。”
<cite>当地广告</cite>
all_card.name: 住宅区
all_card.text: [action]：查找你牌库顶的9张卡牌，找出一张[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援，将其加入你的手牌。混洗你的牌库。如果没有卡牌以此方式加入你的手牌，抽取1张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The newest district in Arkham is filled with fashionable shops, swinging jazz music, and a growing population of students and young newcomers.
all_card.real_flavor:
"Come to Ye Olde Magick Shoppe to discover the wonders of REAL magic. Stage magicians will not be served."
-Local Advertisement
all_card.real_text: [action]: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. If no card was added in this way, draw 1 card.

all_card.back_flavor: 北区是工业区，现代工厂拔地而起，移民工人的廉价住房如雨后春笋。这里还有最近重建的阿卡姆报社。
all_card.name: 北区
all_card.text: [action]花费5资源：发现任意已揭示的[[阿卡姆]]地点的1个现实。（每轮仅限1次）
all_card.real_back_flavor: Northside is an industrial hub, boasting modern factories, cheap housing for migrant workers, and the newly restored Arkham Advertiser.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 5 resources: Discover 1 clue from any revealed [[Arkham]] location. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 东城区在阿卡姆的历史作为有就，但一点也没有衰败。希伯特路边酒馆和维尔玛小餐馆都是人们常去的地方，哪怕是新来的也觉得这里充满吸引力。
all_card.name: 东城区
all_card.text: [reaction]你发现[东城区]最后的线索：查找你的牌库，找出一张[[盟友]]支援并将其打出（支付其费用）。混洗你的牌库。（每场游戏仅限一次）
all_card.real_back_flavor: The oldest district in Arkham, Easttown hasn't aged well. While Hibb's Roadhouse and Velma's Diner are well-frequented establishments, newcomers find very little else inviting.
all_card.real_text: [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Easttown: Search your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and play it (paying its cost). Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 洪水之后，商人区成了阿卡姆商业和发展的焦点。这里每天都见证者越来越多的建筑、工人和产业兴起。
all_card.name: 商人区
all_card.text: [free]如果游戏中正好有1或2位调查员，在你的回合期间：移动至一个连接地点。（每轮仅限一次）
all_card.real_back_flavor: Since the flood, the Merchant District has become a focal point for business and development in Arkham. Each day seems to bring in more and more construction, workers, and industry.
all_card.real_text: [fast] During your turn, if there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game: Move to a connecting location. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 先前的河岸城街道被永久淹没，成了一片鬼镇。只有厚重混凝土地基的阴沉工程，还屹立在洪水浸过的棚户区中。
all_card.flavor: 要是不想在齐腰深的水里硬蹚过去，就得雇当地人的船捎一程。
all_card.name: 滨水区
all_card.text: 作为调查[滨水区]的额外费用，你必须花费1个行动。
all_card.real_back_flavor: With its streets perpetually flooded, the former Rivertown district is a ghost town. Only dour factories, with their heavy cement foundations, are able to stand among the waterlogged shanties.
all_card.real_flavor: Anyone who doesn't want to walk in waist-high water needs to hitch a ride from one of the locals.
all_card.real_text: As an additional cost to investigate Waterfront District, you must spend 1 action.

all_card.back_flavor: 南区位于法兰西山南麓，兴许是阿卡姆最宁静、最有魅力的区域。
all_card.name: 南区
all_card.text: [action][action]：本地点的调查员抽取总计3张卡牌，由这些调查员选择分配。（团队每轮仅限一次）
all_card.real_back_flavor: Situated on the southern slope of French Hill, Southside is perhaps the most welcoming and quiet of Arkham's districts.
all_card.real_text: [action][action]: Investigators at this location draw a combined total of 3 cards, divided as they choose. (Group limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 古老世家逐渐凋零，法兰西山的大宅也就随之变得年久失修。
all_card.name: 法兰西山
all_card.text: [action]选择并弃掉你1张手牌：在你控制的一个支援上放置1充能或1秘密。（每轮仅限一次）
all_card.real_back_flavor: The stately homes of French Hill have fallen into disrepair as the old families slowly die out.
all_card.real_text: [action] Choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Place 1 charge or secret on an asset you control. (Limit once per round.)

all_card.back_flavor: 阿卡姆的米斯卡塔尼克大学经常成为流言蜚语的源头。大学的封闭档案是各方关注的焦点，好奇的教职工的各种发现也常常成为校园中的热门话题。
all_card.name: 米斯卡塔尼克大学
all_card.text: 强制-在调查阶段结束时：对米斯卡塔尼克大学的每张有生命值的玩家卡牌造成1点直接伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Arkham's own Miskatonic University is often a source of rumors and gossip. The university's restricted archives are a subject of great interest, and the campus is often awash with chatter about the strange findings of its curious faculty.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Deal 1 direct damage to each player card with health at Miskatonic University.

all_card.back_flavor: 阿卡姆的米斯卡塔尼克大学经常成为流言蜚语的源头。大学的封闭档案是各方关注的焦点，好奇的教职工的各种发现也常常成为校园中的热门话题。
all_card.name: 米斯卡塔尼克大学
all_card.text: [action]：从你弃牌堆打出一张[[书籍]]或[[法术]]支援，其费用减2。（每场游戏仅限一次）
all_card.real_back_flavor: Arkham's own Miskatonic University is often a source of rumors and gossip. The university's restricted archives are a subject of great interest, and the campus is often awash with chatter about the strange findings of its curious faculty.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Play a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset from your discard pile, reducing its cost by 2. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.name: 奥术锁
all_card.text: 显现-将[奥术锁]附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限1张。 作为进入或离开所附属地点的额外费用，你必须花费1个行动。 [action]：检定[willpower]或[intellect](4)。如果你检定成功，弃掉[奥术锁]。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Arcane Lock to your location. Limit 1 per location. As an additional cost to enter or leave attached location, you must spend 1 action. [action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, discard Arcane Lock.

all_card.flavor:
“……大雨如注，目不可视，不得不找一个对比的地方。”
<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《潜伏的恐惧》</cite>
all_card.name: 大雨倾盆
all_card.text: 显现-检定[agility](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须失去1个行动，或将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。
all_card.real_flavor: "... there descended such a blinding sheet of torrential rain that shelter became imperative." -H.P. Lovecraft, "The Lurking Fear"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 action or place 1 of your clues on your location.

all_card.name: 暴洪骤来
all_card.text: 显现-将[暴洪骤来]附属到你所在地点。 附属地点的隐藏值+4。 强制-在一轮结束时：弃掉[暴洪骤来]。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach Flash Flood to your location. Attached location gets +4 shroud. Forced - When the round ends: Discard Flash Flood.

all_card.flavor: 至少你试着保持低调。
all_card.name: 疑窦丛生
all_card.text: 显现-在最近的没有毁灭标记的敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。如果未因本效果放置毁灭标记。[疑窦丛生]获得涌动。
all_card.real_flavor: At least you tried to keep a low profile.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the nearest enemy with no doom on it. If no doom was placed by this effect, Raising Suspicions gains surge.

all_card.name: 障眼诱饵
all_card.text: 显现-检定[intellect](2)。如果你控制至少2个线索，本次检定难度+2.如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧并将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (2). This test gets +2 difficulty if you control 2 or more clues. If you fail, take 1 horror and place 1 of your clues on your location.

all_card.flavor:
“……一群已经驯服、经过训练的有翼混生种正有节奏地扑打着翅膀。正常的眼睛无法把握它们的形象，健全的头脑无法记忆它们的全貌。”
<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《魔节》</cite>
all_card.name: 蝙蝠恐魔
all_card.text: 逃逸。猎手。
all_card.real_flavor: "...there flopped rhythmically a horde of tame, trained, hybrid winged things that no sound eye could ever wholly grasp, or sound brain ever wholly remember." -H.P. Lovecraft, "The Festival"
all_card.real_text: Elusive. Hunter.

all_card.name: 空中追击
all_card.text: 涌动。 显现-最近的非[[精英]]敌人向你的地点移动一次。如果其与调查员交战，其立即进行一次攻击。
all_card.real_text: Surge. Revelation - The nearest non-[[Elite]] enemy moves once toward your location. If it engages an investigator, it makes an immediate attack.

all_card.name: 独行无赖
all_card.text: 猎手。猎物（资源最多）。反击。 强制-[独行无赖]与你交战后：失去1资源。如果你不能这么做，本敌人攻击你。
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Prey (most resources). Retaliate. Forced - After Rogue Gangster engages you: Lose 1 resource. If you cannot, this enemy attacks you.

all_card.flavor: “趴下！”
all_card.name: 交火
all_card.text: 显现-检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，你所在地点的每位调查员受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: "Get down!"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, each investigator at your location takes 1 damage.

all_card.flavor: 有人赌咒发誓说这些鸟都是来接引亡魂的，在枝头等着将死之人……<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 夜鹰
all_card.text:
冷漠。猎手。
夜鹰所在地点的每位调查员得到-1[willpower]、-1[intellect]、-1[combat]和-1[agility]。
all_card.real_flavor: "It is vowed that the birds are psychopomps lying in wait for the souls of the dying..." -H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Each investigator at Whippoorwill's location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility].

all_card.flavor: 要是抓住了离体的灵魂，它们就会立即振羽飞走，同时发出魔鬼般的笑声……<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特《敦威治恐怖事件》</cite>
all_card.name: 渴望死亡
all_card.text: 显现-检定[willpower](2)。你每有1点伤害，本次技能检定难度提升1点。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: "If they can catch the fleeing soul when it leaves the body, they instantly flutter away chittering in daemonic laughter." -H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase this skill test's difficulty by 1 for each damage on you. If you fail, take 2 horror.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]-X。X为场上[着火了！]诡计数量的两倍。 [cultist]-3。如果本次检定是以[[异教徒]]敌人为对象的攻击或躲避，再揭示一个标记。 [tablet]-4。如果你在[[仪式地]]地点，改为你自动失败。 [elder_thing]-5。如果你检定失败，抽取遭遇弃牌堆最顶部的一张[着火了！]。
all_card.name: 灰烬女王
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]-X。X为场上[着火了！]诡计的数量。 [cultist]-2。如果本次检定是以[[异教徒]]敌人为对象的攻击或躲避，再揭示一个标记。 [tablet]-2(如果你位于[[仪式地]]地点，改为-4)。 [elder_thing]-3。如果你检定失败，抽取遭遇弃牌堆最顶部的一张[着火了！]。

all_card.back_text:
如果是场景1： 饥渴的烈火遍布隧道，底下的吟唱震耳欲聋。你太慢了，没能阻止召唤。 揭示[地下水库]，将[俄洛寇斯]生成在此，（烈焰主母）面朝上。以特殊密谋3a：[灰烬同炮会]替代当前场景与密谋。它既是当前场景也是当前密谋。
否则： 远古的灰烬女王发出可怕的嚎叫，苏醒了。 将[俄洛寇斯]翻至（烈焰主母）面，保留她所有的伤害和附属。 以特殊密谋3a：[灰烬同炮会]替代当前场景与密谋。它既是当前场景也是当前密谋。
all_card.flavor: 空气中全是毒烟，令人窒息。吟唱的声音也越来越响。
all_card.name: 重生
all_card.text: 所在地点附属了[着火了！]的每个敌人不能受到伤害。
all_card.real_back_text:
If it is act 1:
Hungry flames spread through the tunnels, and the chants below intensify. You were too late to stop the summoning.
Reveal Underground Cistern and spawn Elokoss at it, (Mother of Flame) side faceup. Replace the current act and agenda with special agenda 3a: Brethren of Ash. It is both the current act and the current agenda.
Otherwise:
The ancient queen of ash awakens with a horrific wail.
Flip Elokoss to her (Mother of Flame) side, keeping all damage and attachments on her. Replace the current act and agenda with special agenda 3a: Brethren of Ash. It is both the current act and the current agenda.
all_card.real_flavor: The air is choked with noxious smoke as the sounds of chanting grow louder.
all_card.real_text: Each enemy at a location with a copy of Fire! attached cannot be damaged.

all_card.back_flavor: 先是一只长满节疤，爪子一样的手抓住了你，接着又是十几只将你围抱。碰着的地方火烧一样痛。俄洛寇斯的腹部张开骇人的尖牙利口，你失声尖叫。 别担心，她只是想赐予你荣耀。一个熟悉的声音说到。 你回头一看，发现了你的朋友，和灰烬同炮会的其他人一样，穿着黑红两色的长袍。你的朋友朝你狞笑，燃烧的巨口中火舌腾起，将你裹住。你被拉入俄洛寇斯腹中白热的炼狱，你所听到的最后一句话，是你朋友——和整个教派——在吟唱抑扬顿挫，全无调性的颂歌，歌颂你的重生。
all_card.back_text: 每位调查员阵亡。
all_card.name: 灰烬同炮会
all_card.text: 强制-在毁灭标记要放到卡牌上时：改为每位调查员受到1点直接伤害。 强制-如果剩余的每位调查员被击败：推进。 目标-如果[俄洛寇斯]被击败，（结局1）(第13页)。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
A knotted, claw-like hand grabs your arm as dozens more wrap around you, embracing you. The touch burns. You scream as a horrifying, toothy maw opens in Elokoss' belly.
"Don't worry. She only wants to honor you," says a familiar voice.
You look behind you to see your friend wearing the same black and red robes as the rest of the Brethren of Ash. They grin at you as tongues of flame billow out from the burning maw, enveloping you in a cocoon of fire. The last thing you hear as you are pulled into the white-hot inferno in Elokoss' chest is your friend - along with the rest of the cult - singing a lilting, off-key hymn for your rebirth.
all_card.real_back_text: Each investigator is killed.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When doom would be placed on a card: Each investigator takes 1 direct damage, instead. Forced - If each remaining investigator is defeated: Advance. Objective - If Elokoss is defeated, (→R1) (page 13).

all_card.back_flavor: 你循着吟唱声穿过迷宫，来到一座已经干涸的水库。几十个穿着长袍的身影跪在燃烧的桦树前，吟唱着。你的朋友就在其中。你必须阻止他们把自己献祭给俄洛寇斯！
all_card.back_text: 将放在一边的[俄洛寇斯]敌人生成在[地下水库]，（余烬黯淡）面朝上。 位于[地下水库]的调查员抽取一张放在一边的[着火了！]诡计。 将其他所有的[着火了！]和放在一边的[女王的骑士]敌人与[烈焰仆从]敌人一同，混洗入遭遇牌库。 将放在一边的[水闸控制台]地点放置入场。
all_card.flavor: 灰烬同炮会可能在任何地方。要是想拯救自己的朋友，就得彻底搜查阿卡姆的下水道，找到教派举行仪式的地点。
all_card.name: 搜查下水道
all_card.text: 目标-在有调查员进入[地下水库]时，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The chanting leads you through a labyrinth of tunnels to a dry cistern. Several dozen robed figures kneel before a burning birch tree, chanting. Your friend is among them. You must stop them before they sacrifice themselves for Elokoss!
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Elokoss enemy at Underground Cistern, (Faint Embers) side faceup. The investigator at Underground Cistern draws one of the set-aside Fire! treacheries. Shuffle each other copy of Fire! into the encounter deck, along with the set-aside Queen's Knight and Herald of Flame enemies. Put the set-aside Sluice Control location into play.
all_card.real_flavor: The Brethren of Ash could be anywhere. You must search the sewers for the cult's ritual site if you hope to save your friend.
all_card.real_text: Objective - When an investigator enters Underground Cistern, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你把教派的燃烧桦树砍成了柴薪，顿时一阵诡异的嚎叫响彻四周。你充耳不闻，继续攻击，一下下精准的打击彻底摧毁着远古的恶魔。终于，同袍会女神的昔日肖像化为了碎屑。
all_card.flavor: 你必须不惜一切代价阻止仪式。你可以在下水道中寻找阻止仪式的方法，也可以拼尽全力把他们的亵渎神像砍成柴薪！
all_card.name: 阻止仪式
all_card.text: [free]共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：弃掉你所在地点的一张[着火了！]。 强制-在一轮结束时：每个[[异教徒]]敌人朝[地下水库]移动一次。 目标-如果[俄洛寇斯]被击败，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: As you chop the burning tree to tinder, an unearthly howl fills the room. Ignoring it, you continue your attack, placing well-timed strike after well-timed strike to destroy the ancient evil. Eventually, the former effigy of the Brethren's goddess lies in pieces.
all_card.real_flavor: You must stop the rite at any cost. You could scour the cistern for a means to stop the cult, or you could try to chop their profane idol to tinder!
all_card.real_text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Discard a copy of Fire! at your location. Forced - When the round ends: Each [[Cultist]] enemy moves once toward Underground Cistern. Objective - If Elokoss is defeated, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 隧道中传来奇怪的吟唱，暗示着教派的老巢就在此处。
all_card.back_text: 作为进入[地下水库]的额外费用，调查员必须共同花费3[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.name: 地下水库
all_card.text: 强制-如果[地下水库]上没有线索：在其上放置线索（从供应堆拿取），直至其线索等于其线索值。 强制-在调查阶段结束时：弃掉本地点每个重整状态的非[[精英]]的[[异教徒]]敌人。每以此方式弃掉一个敌人，在密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Strange chants echo through the tunnels, hinting at the location of the cult's lair.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost to enter Underground Cistern, investigators must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_text: Forced - If there are no clues on Underground Cistern: Place clues (from the token pool) on it up to its clue value. Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Discard each ready non-[[Elite]] [[Cultist]] enemy at this location. Place 1 doom on the agenda for each enemy discarded in this way.

all_card.back_flavor: 一条狭窄的通道从水库通往一到锁着门。水闸的大门已经几年没打开过了，但它能产生的水流还是足够扫清下水道里的一切——也包括你。
all_card.back_text: 作为进入[地下水库]的额外费用，调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。
all_card.flavor: 是时候做个英雄了。
all_card.name: 水闸控制台
all_card.text: [action]：“不惜一切代价阻止他们！”你试着打开水闸的阀门。检定[agility]或[combat](5)。如果你检定成功，每个敌人都被击败，每位没有撤退的调查员阵亡(结局3)(第14页)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A narrow passage leads out of the cistern up to a locked door. Although the sluice gate hasn't been opened in years, the ensuing flood might be enough to wipe out everything in the sewers - including you.
all_card.real_back_text: As an additional cost to enter Sluice Control, investigators must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
all_card.real_flavor: There's no better time to be a hero.
all_card.real_text: [action]: "Stop them at all costs!" You try to open the sluice valve. Test [agility] or [combat] (5). If you succeed, each enemy is defeated and each investigator who has not resigned is killed (→R3) (page 14)
