Otherwise, you cannot play or commit cards of that type (asset, event, or skill) this round. [action][action]: Discard Languor.

all_card.name: 不谐
all_card.text: 显现-检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，失去一个行动并选择一个卡牌种类（支援，事件或技能）。弃掉你手牌中所有所选种类的非弱点卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, lose 1 action and choose a cardtype (asset, event, or skill). Discard all non-weakness cards of the chosen type from your hand.

all_card.name: 折磨
all_card.text: 险境。 显现-检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，指定一个卡牌种类（支援，事件或技能）。每位调查员从手牌中弃掉1张指定种类的卡牌。
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, name a cardtype (asset, event, or skill). Each investigator discards 1 card of the named type from their hand.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull] -2。如果你检定失败，在本次技能检定后，查找遭遇牌库及弃牌堆，找出一个[[食尸鬼]]敌人，将其抽取。混洗遭遇牌库。 [cultist] 揭示另一个标记。如果你检定失败，受到2点恐惧。 [tablet] -4。如果你所在地点有[[食尸鬼]]敌人，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.name: 聚集于此
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull] -X。X为位于你所在地点的[[食尸鬼]]敌人的数量。 [cultist] -1。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧。 [tablet] -2。如果你所在地点有[[食尸鬼]]敌人，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull] -2. If you fail, after this skill test, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Ghoul]] enemy, and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
[cultist] Reveal another token. If you fail, take 2 horror.
[tablet] -4. If there is a [[Ghoul]] enemy at your location, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] -X. X is the number of [[Ghoul]] enemies at your location.
[cultist] -1. If you fail, take 1 horror.
[tablet] -2. If there is a [[Ghoul]] enemy at your location, take 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 你的房屋在你眼前持续变换着模样。墙壁已腐败，不少房间的地板化作了泥土。虽然时不时能认出自宅的痕迹，你仍感觉自己仿佛被传送到了截然不同的处所。
all_card.back_text: 调查员队长必须决定(选择一项)：每位调查员随机从其手中弃掉一张卡牌，或者调查员队长受到2点恐惧。
all_card.flavor: 夜色已深。你埋头书房，研究最近在本地区发生的数起血腥失踪案件。数个小时过去了，突然从走廊另一头的客厅里传来怪异的吟唱。于此同时，你听见泥土的搅动声，仿佛有东西在地板之下挖掘。
all_card.name: 到底发生了什么？！
all_card.real_back_flavor: Your house continues to change before your very eyes. The walls have decayed, and the ground in many rooms has turned to dirt. It is almost as if you have been transported somewhere else entirely, although every now and again you recognize elements of your former home.
all_card.real_back_text: The lead investigator must decide (choose one): Either each investigator discards 1 card at random from his or her hand, or the lead investigator takes 2 horror.
all_card.real_flavor: It is late at night. You are holed up in your study, researching the bloody disappearances that have been taking place in the region. A few hours into your research, you hear the sound of strange chanting coming from your parlor, down the hall. At the same time, you hear dirt churning, as if something were digging beneath the floor.

all_card.back_flavor: 这头野兽依稀还有点人形，却长着蹄子和一副犬类的面孔。它正撕裂你面前的地面。你看见自家地板下出现了错综而旷阔的隧道。恶魔般的嚎叫声从地下岩洞的深处传来。
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。从遭遇牌库顶开始弃掉卡牌，直到弃掉一个[[食尸鬼]]敌人。调查员队长抽取该敌人。
all_card.flavor: 你身前的地板崩陷，错综而旷阔的隧道网络映入眼帘，直通地底幽深处。诸多诡异生物的身影在隧道中迅速穿行，寻找上来的路。你可不想呆在这儿等着它们……
all_card.name: 食尸鬼崛起
all_card.real_back_flavor: A feral beast, roughly humanoid with a canine cast and hooves for feet, tears through the ground in front of you. Below the floor, you can see vast tunnels beneath your house. Fiendish howling echoes from deep within the underground caverns.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Ghoul]] enemy is discarded. The lead investigator draws that enemy.
all_card.real_flavor: The floor beneath you is giving way, and you see a vast network of tunnels, twisting into the darkness below. Shapes and silhouettes of strange creatures move swiftly through the tunnels, trying to find a way up. You probably don't want to be here when they do...

all_card.back_flavor: 地面开始颤动，你看见利爪从泥土中伸出。在你周围，数个诡异生物正拼命地掘土而出。慌忙四顾，你发现破土而出的怪物已将你包围。你惊恐不已，极尽所能夺路而逃。
all_card.back_text: - 如果调查员处于场景1或场景2，他们被困于屋内，被食尸鬼的利爪撕碎。(→结局3) - 如果调查员处于场景3，他们侥幸逃脱，而食尸鬼四处肆虐。每位没有撤退的调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
all_card.flavor: 从屋外传来一声疯狂的嚎叫，吸引了所有怪物的注意力。他们匆忙逃离屋子，一路破门而出，利爪撕裂挡路的一切。
all_card.name: 他们爬出來了！
all_card.text: 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：每个未与调查员交战的[[食尸鬼]]敌人向客厅移动一个地点。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：走廊或客厅中每有1个[[食尸鬼]]敌人，在本密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The ground begins to shake and you can see claws rising up from the dirt as uncanny creatures desperately try to claw their way out of the ground all around you. Everywhere you turn, you see monsters rising from the earth. Terrified, you flee as fast as you can.
all_card.real_back_text: - If the investigators are at Act 1 or 2, they are trapped inside the house as the ghouls tear them apart. (→R3) - If the investigators are at Act 3, they barely escape with their lives, allowing the ghouls to run rampant. Each investigator that has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
all_card.real_flavor: You hear a crazed howl outside, and suddenly all the creatures turn their attention to that sound. They rush to escape the house, breaking down doors and clawing at everything in their way.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Each unengaged [[Ghoul]] enemy moves 1 location towards the Parlor. Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 doom on this agenda for each [[Ghoul]] enemy in the Hallway or Parlor.

all_card.back_flavor:
你发现新近购置的地毯边缘破败不堪，沾满泥土。你感到困惑，移开了上面的家具，掀开地毯。让你大吃一惊的是，你居然在地毯下找到了离开书房的门。你缓慢转动把手，门扉弹起，显露出下方竟是你家的走廊。
你跳下门道，落在松软的泥土上。头顶上，通向书房的门嘎然关闭。一股木材燃烧的气味充斥着狭窄的走廊，混杂着腐烂与腐败的气息。
all_card.back_text:
将放在一边的走廊、地窖、阁楼和客厅放置入场。
弃掉书房的所有敌人。
将所有调查员放到走廊。
将书房从游戏中移除。
all_card.flavor: 你快步上前调查，只见书房的门在眼前消失，留下一道厚实的墙壁。你被困在了书房之中，必须另寻出路。
all_card.name: 被困于此
all_card.real_back_flavor:
You notice that the edges of your newly purchased rug are tattered and mud-stained. Finding this odd, you shift the furniture aside and pull back the rug. To your surprise, you see the door leading out of your study. You slowly turn the knob, and the door swings open, revealing your hallway below.
You jump through the doorway, landing on your feet on soft dirt. The door to the study slams shut above you. The smell of burning wood fills the narrow hall, intermingled with the scent of rot and decay.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put into play the set-aside Hallway, Cellar, Attic, and Parlor.
Discard each enemy in the Study.
Place each investigator in the Hallway.
Remove the Study from the game.
all_card.real_flavor: As you leap to investigate, the door to your study vanishes before your eyes, leaving behind only solid wall. You're trapped inside your study until you can find another way out.

all_card.back_flavor: 你用在阁楼找到的木桶从地窖内装来冰雪，朝着屏障抛洒过去。屏障吞噬了冰雪，发出一阵震动和闪光，然后便在嘶嘶声中逐渐消失。
all_card.back_text:
阻挡前往客厅道路的屏障消失了。揭示客厅。
将放在一边的丽塔·钱德勒放置入场，放到客厅。将放在一边的食尸鬼祭司生成在走廊。
all_card.flavor: 一道发光的屏障阻挡了前往客厅的路。你试图靠近，但强烈的高温将你逼退。你抓起一把泥土朝屏障扔了过去。泥土瞬间烧成灰烬，让你胆战心惊。也许地窖或者阁楼有什么东西可以帮你。
all_card.name: 灼热屏障
all_card.text: 目标 - 在一轮结束时，走廊内的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索，以推进当前场景。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Using the barrel from the attic, you carry ice and snow from the cellar and hurl it at the barrier. The barrier sparks and shudders as it consumes the ice, then hisses and fades out of existence.
all_card.real_back_text:
The barrier blocking passage into the parlor has vanished. Reveal the Parlor.
Put the set-aside Lita Chantler into play in the Parlor.
Spawn the set-aside Ghoul Priest in the Hallway.
all_card.real_flavor: A glowing barrier blocks the path to your parlor. As you move toward it, intense heat forces you to back away. Picking up a handful of dirt, you toss it as the barrier and watch in horror as the dirt incinerates. Perhaps there's something in the cellar or attic that can help.
all_card.real_text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators in the hallway may, as a group, spend the requisite number of clues to advance.

all_card.back_flavor:
身着长袍的怪物倒下了，恶魔般的兽群重新钻回了地下，屋内的喧嚣也宣告停歇。你客厅中的陌生人并未因此而放松。
“你们破坏了我困住食尸鬼的封印。”她举起手中的火炬，“现在必须采取更直接的措施。让我们彻底烧毁这座地狱坑洞！”
all_card.back_text: 调查员队长必须决定(选择一项)： - 这房子从来也没什么家的感觉。我们烧了它吧！(→结局1) - 这座“地狱坑洞”可是我家！我们绝不能烧毁它！(→结局2)
all_card.flavor: 你的客厅里站着一名女子，她手持火炬，眼中泛着恨意的光。“你对我的屏障做了什么？”她暴怒地吼叫着。你还没来得及回答，一声阴森的嚎叫从背后传来。一只穿着长袍、戴着鹿头骨面具的怪物撕裂了墙壁，径直朝你而来。
all_card.name: 瞧瞧你们做的好事！
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果食尸鬼祭司被击败，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor:
When the robed creature falls, the fiendish swarm burrows back into the ground and the chaos of the house quiets. But the stranger in your parlor chamber doesn't seem relieved.
"You broke my seal that was set to trap the ghouls within." She raises her torch. "Now, we must take more direct measures and burn this hell-pit to the ground!"
all_card.real_back_text: The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - It was never much of a home. Burn it down! (→R1) - This hell-pit is my home! No way are we burning it! (→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: A woman with a torch stands in your parlor, a glimmer of hatred in her eyes. "What have you done to my barrier?" she screams, furious. Before you can enter, a ghastly wail sounds behind you, and a creature wearing robes and a deer skull mask tears through the wall, advancing toward you.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If the Ghoul Priest is Defeated, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你对近来阿卡姆发生的诸多怪异事件已持续调查了好几天。你的书桌上铺满了新闻报道、警方报告和目击者的陈述。
all_card.flavor: 书房的门消失了。
all_card.name: 书房
all_card.real_back_flavor: You've been investigating the strange events occurring in Arkham for several days now. Your deck in covered in newspaper articles, police reports, and witness accounts.
all_card.real_flavor: The door to your study has vanished.

all_card.back_flavor: 你落在走廊的地面上，一阵恐慌与错乱向你袭来。乾坤颠倒，天旋地转。
all_card.flavor: 墙壁上溅有淤泥，硬木地板不见了，一条泥土小径取而代之。
all_card.name: 走廊
all_card.real_back_flavor: A moment of panic and disorientation strikes as you land upon the floor of the hallway. The world spins, as if turned on its head.
all_card.real_flavor: The walls of your house are splattered with mud, and your hardwood floor is gone, replaced with a dirt path.

all_card.back_flavor: 当你走近阁楼的阶梯时，一股腐肉的气味扑鼻而来。
all_card.flavor: 一头畸形野兽的血腥死尸挂在天花板垂下的肉钩上，来回摇摆着。血液从死尸上缓慢流出，滴落到一个小木桶之内。
all_card.name: 阁楼
all_card.text: 强制 - 你进入阁楼后：受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The smell of rotten meat assaults your nostrils as you approach the attic stairs.
all_card.real_flavor: The bloody carcass of a malformed beast swings from a meat hook chained to the ceiling. Blood drains slowly from the carcass, dripping into a small barrel.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter the Attic: Take 1 horror.

all_card.back_flavor: 通往地窖的阶梯格外滑溜，结上了一层泛光的薄冰……
all_card.flavor: 你的地窖变成了一座由冰冷的隧道与地穴组成的地下网络。寒气侵入骨髓。
all_card.name: 地窖
all_card.text: 强制 - 你进入地窖后：受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The stairs leading down to your cellar are slick, and they glisten with a thin layer of ice...
all_card.real_flavor: Your cellar seems to have been replaced with an underground network of icy tunnels and caverns. The cold chills you to the bone.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter the Cellar: Take 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 你不确定如果强行越过这奇怪的屏障会发生什么，但根据它散发出的高温，你确信自己并不想尝试。
all_card.back_text: 进入客厅的门被一道泛着幽暗光芒的神秘屏障挡住了。你不能移动到客厅。
all_card.name: 客厅
all_card.text: [action] 撤退。“我再也受不了了！”惊恐中，你从前门夺路而逃。 没有玩家控制丽塔·钱德勒时，她获得：“[action]：谈判。检定[intellect](4)。如果你检定成功，控制丽塔·钱德勒。”
all_card.real_back_flavor: You're unsure what would happen if you tried to cross the threshold of the strange barrier, but based on its extreme heat, you sure as hell don't want to try.
all_card.real_back_text: The entrance to the Parlor is blocked by a darkly glowing unfathomable barrier. You cannot move into the Parlor.
all_card.real_text: [action] Resign. "This is too much for me!" You run out the front door, fleeing in panic. While Lita Chantler is not controlled by a player, she gains: "[action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, take control of Lita Chantler."

all_card.flavor: 一个穿着红色长袍、头戴骨制面具的人形。它发出呓语与低吼，并跳上前来攻击。
all_card.name: 食尸鬼祭司
all_card.text: 猎物 - [combat]最高。 猎手。反击。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 食尸鬼. 精英
all_card.real_flavor: A figure in red robes wearing a bone mask. It gibbers and snarls before leaping to attack.
all_card.real_text: Prey - Highest [combat]. Hunter. Retaliate.

all_card.name: 丽塔·钱德勒
all_card.text:
你控制丽塔·钱德勒时，她获得：
“每位在你所在地点的调查员得到+1[combat]。
[reaction]在一位你所在地点的调查员成功攻击一个[[怪物]]敌人时：该调查员造成+1伤害。”
all_card.real_text:
While you control Lita Chantler, she gains:
"Each investigator at your location gets +1 [combat].
[reaction] When an investigator at your location successfully attacks a [[Monster]] enemy: That investigator deals +1 damage."

all_card.flavor: 一只可怖的怪物正在啃食阁楼上的腐烂死尸。
all_card.name: 食肉者
all_card.text: 生成 - 阁楼。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 食尸鬼
all_card.real_flavor: A monstrous creature feeds from the rotting carcass in the attic.
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Attic.

all_card.flavor: 房屋下的隧道中，一只硕大的野兽破冰而出。它全身覆盖着一层厚实的冰霜，呼出的热气在严寒中清晰可见。
all_card.name: 冰封食尸鬼
all_card.text: 生成 - 地窖。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 食尸鬼
all_card.real_flavor: Inside the tunnels beneath the house, a massive beast tears its way out of the ice. It is covered in a think layer of frost, its breath visible in the bitter cold.
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Cellar.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]：-X。X为场上的毁灭标记总数。 [cultist]：-2。在每个[[异教徒]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。如果场上没有[[异教徒]]敌人，揭示另一个标记。 [tablet]：-4。如果你检定失败，将你所有的线索放到你所在地点。
all_card.name: 午夜假面
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]：-X为场上毁灭标记最多的[[异教徒]]敌人上的毁灭标记数。 [cultist]：-2。在最近的一个[[异教徒]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。 [tablet]：-3。如果你检定失败，将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the total number of doom in play.
[cultist]: -2. Place 1 doom on each [[Cultist]] enemy in play. If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, reveal another token.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, place all your clues on your location.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the highest number of doom on a [[Cultist]] enemy in play.
[cultist]: -2. Place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.

all_card.flavor: 丽塔似乎坚信阿卡姆城中正酝酿着一个阴谋。她相信有一个隐秘的异教正服侍着地下洞穴中的食尸鬼，而异教几名重要的成员正散居在阿卡姆城各处。你开始搜寻他们，却不由地感到自己也正在被某个东西追捕。
all_card.name: 猎人还是猎物？
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你不愿冒险多做停留，带着收集的信息去往安全之处。
all_card.real_flavor: Lita seems convinced of a conspiracy within the city of Arkham. She believes that a secret cult serves the ghouls that live in the crypts beneath the city, and that several of the cult's prominent members are scattered throughout Arkham. As you begin searching for them, you can't shake the feeling that you, too, are being hunted.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.

all_card.name: 假面猎手
all_card.text: 生成 - 与猎物交战。 猎物 - 线索最多。 猎手。 每有一位调查员，假面猎手得到+2生命。 你与假面猎手交战时，不能发现或花费线索。
all_card.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 精英
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Engaged with Prey. Prey - Most clues. Hunter. The Masked Hunter gets +2 health per investigator. While you are engaged with The Masked Hunter, you cannot discover or spend clues.

all_card.back_flavor: 十二声钟鸣响彻阿卡姆。午夜已至。没有时间继续在城中调查了：你没能找到所有的异教徒，你必须依照现有信息开展行动。
all_card.flavor: 你们的调查在继续，而时间一分一秒地逝去。
all_card.name: 时间飞逝
all_card.text: [action]：撤退。你不愿冒险多做停留，带着收集的信息去往安全之处。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Twelve bells ring out across the town. It is midnight. There is no time left to investigate the city; you must act based on the information you've collected from the cultists you've found.
all_card.real_flavor: The minutes pass quickly as your investigation continues.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.

all_card.back_flavor: 你们成功地揭露了阿卡姆城中所有异教高级成员的身份。那名在城中各处潜随你的男子已献身邪恶，而墓地管理员赫尔曼也同样如此。但其他人似乎是被迫帮助异教。殓葬师露丝被告知，如果她不向食尸鬼提供新鲜的尸体，她的家人将遭杀害。谢天谢地，你设法帮她安全逃离了医院。你说服了彼得教授，使他明白和异教的牵连恶多于善。维多利亚对于密教器物的痴迷令她深陷于邪教的罗网。你在疯人院遇到德鲁的时候，他攻击了你——但他这么做是因为把你也误当成了异教的一员。随着你们对密谋的深入探索，事情变得越发明了：它摧毁了许多人的生活。
all_card.flavor: 你只有这一个晚上来寻找异教成员并揭露他们的计划。你找到并盘问的异教成员越多越好。
all_card.name: 揭露阴谋
all_card.text: [action]：调查员共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索：抽取异教徒牌库顶的卡牌。 目标 - 找到尽可能多的独特[[异教徒]]敌人并将其加入胜利区。如果胜利区中有6个独特[[异教徒]]敌人，推进。(注：并不是全部6人都在异教徒牌库中。)
all_card.real_back_flavor: You've successfully uncovered the identities of all of the cult's high-ranking members within Arkham. The man who had stalked you throughout the city was dedicated in his conviction, as was Herman, the undertaker of the graveyard. Others seemed to have been coerced to aid the cult. Ruth, the mortician, had been told that her family would be killed if she did not supply the ghouls with fresh corpses. Thankfully, you managed to help her escape the hospital safely. Peter, the professor, had to be convinced that his involvement with the cult would do more harm than good. Victoria's obsession with occult artifacts had landed her deep within the cult's web. When you confronted Drew in the asylum, he attacked you - but interestingly, he did so because he thought you were part of the cult. The deeper you delve into this conspiracy, the clearer it becomes that many lives have been ruined by it.
all_card.real_flavor: You have one night to find the members of this cult and unveil their plan. The more members of the cult you can find and interrogate before midnight, the better.
all_card.real_text: [action] The investigators spend 2 clues per investigator, as a group: Draw the top card of the Cultist deck. Objective - Find as many unique [[Cultist]] enemies as you can and add them to the victory display. If there are 6 unique [[Cultist]] enemies in the victory display, advance. (Note: Not all 6 of them are in the Cultist deck.)

all_card.back_flavor: 即使发生了这一切，你仍然无法亲手摧毁自己的家。
all_card.flavor: 你对回家还是有点胆战心惊。
all_card.name: 你的房子
all_card.text: 强制 - 在食尸鬼祭司生成时：改为将其生成在此处，而非通常地点。 [action]：抽取1张卡牌并获得1资源。(每回合仅限一次)。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Despite what happened, you just couldn't bring yourself to destroy your home.
all_card.real_flavor: You still feel uneasy about going back.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When the Ghoul Priest spawns: Spawn it here instead of at its normal location. [action]: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource. (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.back_flavor: 米斯卡塔尼克河的两岸排列着诸多码头、仓库，和小店，这片地方叫河岸城真是名副其实。
all_card.flavor: 今晚，米斯卡塔尼克河的水面有些异样。泛起的涟漪和涌出的气泡暗示着水下有东西在移动。
all_card.name: 河岸城
all_card.real_back_flavor: The banks of the Miskatonic River are lined with docks, warehouses and small shops in a district aptly named Rivertown.
all_card.real_flavor: There is something unsettling about the water of the Miskatonic River tonight. It ripples and bubbles as though something is moving beneath the surface.

all_card.back_flavor: 南区的街道旁满是复斜屋顶的中产之家。这片街区以其文化和社会地标而闻名，其中包括南区教堂、老马旅社和历史协会。
all_card.flavor: 历史协会坐落在一座乔治亚风格的豪宅内。该豪宅以其私人图书馆闻名，里面的本地记录、地图，以及来自阿卡姆的过去的工艺品无不暗示着不应被打扰的秘密。
all_card.name: 南区
all_card.text: [action]：抽取3张卡牌。(每场游戏仅限一次)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Middle-class houses with gambrel roofs crowd together between the streets of Southside. The neighborhood is known for its cultural and social landmarks, such as South Church, Ma's Boarding House, and the Historical Society.
all_card.real_flavor: The Georgian manor housing the Historical Society is well known for its private library, where local records, maps, and artifacts from Arkham's past hint at secrets better left alone.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Draw 3 cards. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 南区的街道旁满是复斜屋顶的中产之家。这片街区以其文化和社会地标而闻名，其中包括南区教堂、老马旅社和历史协会。
all_card.flavor: 老马旅社以其廉价客房和“周一神秘肉”而闻名。从早到晚，各色人等在这里来来往往。
all_card.name: 南区
all_card.text: [action]：查找你的牌库，找出一张[[盟友]]支援并将其加入你的手牌。混洗你的牌库。(每场游戏仅限一次)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Middle-class houses with gambrel roofs crowd together between the streets of Southside. The neighborhood is known for its cultural and social landmarks, such as South Church, Ma's Boarding House, and the Historical Society.
all_card.real_flavor: Ma's is famous for its cheap rooms and Mystery Meat Mondays. A motley variety of characters can be found coming and going at all times of day.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Search your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 圣玛丽医院是阿卡姆唯一的医院，24小时接待室整夜忙碌。由于近来发生的事件，莫蒂莫尔医生和莎隆护士近期的工作格外紧张。
all_card.flavor: 在圣玛丽医院久留有利于恢复身体健康，但对于精神的影响就不得而知了。
all_card.name: 圣玛丽医院
all_card.text: [action]：治愈3点伤害。(每场游戏仅限一次)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Arkham's only hospital, St. Mary's has a twenty-four-hour receiving room and is busy at all hours of the night. Doctor Mortimore and Nurse Sharon have been particularly stressed lately, thanks in part to recent events.
all_card.real_flavor: An extended stay at St. Mary's can do wonders for the body, but its effect on one's psyche is unclear.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Heal 3 damage. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 米斯卡塔尼克大学是东北地区最富盛名的学府之一。大学图书馆因其神秘学书籍的收藏而闻名于世，由受人尊敬的亨利·阿米蒂奇博士管理维护。
all_card.flavor: 校园安静而孤寂。有几座建筑不会上锁，学生与教师在其中工作到深夜。
all_card.name: 米斯卡塔尼克大学
all_card.text: [action]：查找你牌库顶的6张卡牌，找出1张[[书籍]]或者[[法术]]卡牌，将其加入你的手牌。混洗你的牌库。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Miskatonic University is one of the most prestigious colleges in the Northeast. The university library is famous for its collection of occult books maintained by the esteemed Dr. Henry Armitage.
all_card.real_flavor: The campus is quiet and lonely. Several of the buildings have been left unlocked for students and faculty working late into the night.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

all_card.back_flavor: 阿卡姆城的商业区坐落着大量政府建筑，包括市政厅在内。阿卡姆第一银行、独立广场、阿卡姆疯人院也位于这个区域。这里是最为繁忙的城区。
all_card.flavor: 我们将这称作一笔“贷款”。
all_card.name: 商业区
all_card.text: [action]：获得3资源。(每场游戏仅限一次)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Downtown area of Arkham is filled with government buildings, including City Hall. The First Bank of Arkham, Independence Square, and Arkham Asylum can also be found in this area. It is the busiest district in the city.
all_card.real_flavor: We'll call this a "loan."
all_card.real_text: [action]: Gain 3 resources. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 阿卡姆城的商业区坐落着大量政府建筑，包括市政厅在内。阿卡姆第一银行、独立广场、阿卡姆疯人院也位于这个区域。这里是最为繁忙的城区。
all_card.flavor: 这里是心智的避难所，还是灵魂的牢笼？
all_card.name: 商业区
all_card.text: [action]：治愈3点恐惧。(每场游戏仅限一次)
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Downtown area of Arkham is filled with government buildings, including City Hall. The First Bank of Arkham, Independence Square, and Arkham Asylum can also be found in this area. It is the busiest district in the city.
all_card.real_flavor: A refuge for the mind, or a prison for the soul?
all_card.real_text: [action]: Heal 3 horror. (Limit once per game.)

all_card.back_flavor: 东城区位于米斯卡塔尼克河的北岸，这里是底层人民的居所，还坐落着阿卡姆警察局以及维尔玛小餐馆这样的人气食肆。
all_card.name: 东城区
all_card.text: 你位于东城区时，你打出每张[[盟友]]支援的费用-2。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The Easttown neighborhood, situated on the northern banks of the Miskatonic River, contains lower-class housing, the Arkham Police Station, and popular eateries like Velma's Diner.
all_card.real_text: While you are in Easttown, reduce the cost of each [[Ally]] asset you play by 2.

all_card.back_flavor: 墓地坐落在法兰西山的山脚下。部分墓碑可以追溯至17世纪。第一批殖民者在那时踏上了阿卡姆的大地。鉴于在你家中发生的一切，你不太乐意前往那里。
all_card.name: 墓地
all_card.text: 强制 - 你进入墓地后：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，你必须受到2点恐惧或移动到河岸城。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The graveyard lies at the foot of French Hill. Some of the headstones date back to the seventeenth century, when the earliest colonists came to Arkham. Considering what happened in your house, you're not completely keen on heading there.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter the Graveyard: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 horror or move to Rivertown.

all_card.back_flavor: 北区是阿卡姆的商贸区，坐落着大量办公室和工厂，火车站也在这里。
all_card.flavor: 在北区，一点小钱就能让人无所不言。
all_card.name: 北区
all_card.text: [action] 花费5资源：从供应堆获得2个线索。(每场游戏团队仅限一次)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Northside is a commercial district that contains many offices and factories, as well as the train station.
all_card.real_flavor: In Northside, nothing gets people talking faster than a piece of dough.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 5 resources: Gain 2 clues from the token pool. (Group limit once per game.)

all_card.flavor: 一个鬼魅般的人影在雨中跟踪你。你回头注视它，却突然头痛欲裂，视线模糊。
all_card.name: 追猎鬼影
all_card.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须(选择以下一项)：花费1个线索或受到2点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: A shadowy figure follows you in the rain. When you look back, your head pounds in agony and your vision blurs.
all_card.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): Spend 1 clue or take 2 damage.

all_card.name: 错误指示
all_card.text: 显现 - 如果你没有线索，错误指示获得涌动。如果你有至少1个线索，检定[intellect](4)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - If you have no clues, False Lead gains surge. If you have 1 or more clues, test [intellect] (4). For each point you fail by, place 1 of your clues on your location.

all_card.flavor: 德鲁是一名阿卡姆疯人院的长期病患。有传闻说他在数年前因食人而被锁了起来。他被认为极度危险。
all_card.name: “狼人”德鲁
all_card.text: 生成 - 商业区。 强制 - 在“狼人”德鲁攻击时：治愈他1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: Drew is a longtime patient at Arkham Asylum. Rumor has it he was locked up for committing cannibalism several years ago. He is considered extremely dangerous.
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Downtown. Forced - When "Wolf-Man" Drew attacks: Heal 1 damage from him.

all_card.flavor: 当地墓地的管理员一直在陵墓之下挖掘奇怪的隧道……他的目的是什么？
all_card.name: 赫尔曼·柯林斯
all_card.text: 生成 - 墓地。 [action] 从你的手中选择并弃掉4张卡牌：谈判。将赫尔曼·柯林斯加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: The undertaker in the local graveyard has been digging strange tunnels underneath the mausoleum... but for what purpose?
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Graveyard. [action] Choose and discard 4 cards from your hand: Parley. Add Herman Collins to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 这位神秘学教授一直在阅读关于食人禁忌的怪异书籍。或许他知晓一些我们所不知道的事情？
all_card.name: 彼得·沃伦
all_card.text: 生成 - 米斯卡塔尼克大学。 [action] 花费2个线索：谈判。将彼得·沃伦加入胜利区。
all_card.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 米斯卡塔尼克
all_card.real_flavor: A professor of the occult has been seen reading strange books that relate to cannibalism. Maybe he knows something we don't?
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Miskatonic University. [action] Spend 2 clues: Parley. Add Peter Warren to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 奥利弗·托马斯，珍品店的店主，告知你们，一名新顾客对一副神秘的面具格外感兴趣……
all_card.name: 维多利亚·德佛罗
all_card.text: 生成 - 北区。 [action] 花费5资源：谈判。将维多利亚·德佛罗加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: Oliver Thomas, the proprietor of the Curiositie Shoppe, has informed you that a new client has taken a keen interest in a mysterious mask...
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Northside. [action] Spend 5 resources: Parley. Add Victoria Devereux to the victory display.

all_card.flavor: 停尸房的尸体常常不翼而飞。或许圣玛丽医院的殓葬师与此事有关。
all_card.name: 露丝·特纳
all_card.text: 生成 - 圣玛丽医院。 强制 - 躲避露丝·特纳后：将她加入胜利区。
all_card.real_flavor: Bodies from the morgue have mysteriously gone missing. Perhaps the mortician in St. Mary's had something to do with these disappearances.
all_card.real_text: Spawn - St. Mary's Hospital. Forced - After Ruth Turner is evaded: Add her to the victory display.

all_card.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]：-3。如果你检定失败，在本次技能检定后，查找遭遇牌库及弃牌堆，找出一个[[怪物]]敌人，将其抽取。混洗遭遇牌库。 [cultist]：-4。在最近的一个敌人上放置2个毁灭标记。 [tablet]：-5。如果你所在地点有[[怪物]]敌人，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。 [elder_thing]：-7.如果场上有[[古神]]敌人，揭示另一个标记。
all_card.name: 地底噬魔
all_card.text: 简单/普通 [skull]：-X。X为位于场上[[怪物]]敌人的数量。 [cultist]：-2。在最近的一个敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。 [tablet]：-3。如果你所在地点有[[怪物]]敌人，受到1点伤害。 [elder_thing]：-5。如果场上有[[古神]]敌人，揭示另一个标记。
all_card.real_back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -3. If you fail, after this skill test, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Monster]] enemy, and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
[cultist]: -4. Place 2 doom on the nearest enemy.
[tablet]: -5. If there is a [[Monster]] enemy at your location, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -7. If there is an [[Ancient One]] enemy in play, reveal another token.
all_card.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of [[Monster]] enemies in play.
[cultist]: -2. Place 1 doom on the nearest enemy.
[tablet]: -3. If there is a [[Monster]] enemy at your location, take 1 damage.
[elder_thing]: -5. If there is an [[Ancient One]] enemy in play, reveal another token.

all_card.back_flavor:
一种尖啸般的嚎叫声在林中回荡。恐怖的声音从密林深处回应着呼唤，绝非人类，却如犬吠，甚至清晰可辨，重复着同一个名字：
“乌默尔多斯……乌默尔多斯……乌默尔多斯……”
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库，并从遭遇牌库顶弃牌，直到弃掉1个[[怪物]]敌人。在主道路生成该敌人。然后，在该敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.flavor: 通过审问阿卡姆城中参与阴谋的异教成员，你得知异教徒即将进行一种复仇仪式，以报复有人摧毁了他们主人的巢穴。你跨入阿卡姆郊外的密林，试图阻止他们。一种死寂笼罩着树林，寒冷异常。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆密林
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Throughout the woods, a shrieking cry echoes. From somewhere deeper in the forest, a score of hideous voices answer the call, inhuman as the baying of hounds and yet articulate, repeating a singular name:
"Umôrdhoth... Umôrdhoth... Umôrdhoth..."
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until a [[Monster]] enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy in the Main Path. Then, place 1 doom on that enemy.
all_card.real_flavor: After interrogating members of the conspiracy within Arkham, you have learned that they are performing a rite of vengeance in response to the destruction of one of their master's lairs. You have entered the woods outside Arkham to try and stop them. The woods seem unnaturally cold, and filled with a deathly silence.

all_card.back_flavor: 黑暗之物已靠近，无形的重压袭来，你不由地跪倒在地。某种可怕的力量正要侵入你的心智与灵魂。强烈的感官灼烧你全身，你的喉咙紧锁，双眼湿润。
all_card.back_text: 以玩家顺序，每位调查员必须检定[willpower](6)。每位检定失败的调查员必须查找收藏，随机找出1张基础[[疯狂]]弱点，并加入自己手牌。
all_card.flavor:
“乌默尔多斯……乌默尔多斯……乌默尔多斯……”
吟唱声越发响亮，在夜间寒冷的空气中回荡。夜空中仅有的些许云朵都聚集在了阿卡姆密林的上空，遮盖了群星的微光。
all_card.name: 仪式开始
all_card.text: 每个敌人得到+1攻击与+1躲避。
all_card.real_back_flavor: A dark presence approaches, and you are assaulted by invisible pressures that bring you to your knees. A terrible force threatens to invade your mind and soul. Your throat clenches and your eyes water as the sensation burns through you.
all_card.real_back_text: In player order, each investigator must test [willpower] (6). Each investigator who fails must search his or her collection for a random basic [[Madness]] weakness and add it to his or her hand.
all_card.real_flavor:
"Umôrdhoth... Umôrdhoth... Umôrdhoth..."
The chanting builds in intensity, echoing into the cold air of the night. The sparse clouds in the sky coalesce above the Arkham woods, blotting out the faint light of the stars.
all_card.real_text: Each enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade.

all_card.back_text: 显现 - 以地底噬魔替代当前场景与密谋。本卡牌既是当前场景也是当前密谋。 目标 - 如果乌默尔多斯被击败，(→结局2)。
all_card.flavor: 仪式接近尾声，世界已开始变化。空气越发凛冽，整个森林覆盖上了白霜。树木反常地弯曲着，影子伸展出诡异的形状。
all_card.name: 复仇开始
all_card.text: 强制 - 在本密谋推进时： - 如果调查员处于场景1，将放在一边的仪式地放置入场，在该地点生成放在一边的乌默尔多斯。 - 如果调查员处于场景2或3，弃掉仪式地上的所有敌人，在该地点生成放在一边的乌默尔多斯。
all_card.real_back_text: Revelation - Replace the current Act and Agenda with The Devourer Below. This card is both the current Act and the current Agenda. Objective - If Umôrdhoth is defeated, (→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: The world begins to shift and change as the ritual nears its conclusion. The air grows chilly, and the entire forest is covered in a layer of rime. The trees bend unnaturally, and their shadows lengthen into weird shape.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When this agenda advances: - If the investigators are at Act 1, put the set-aside Ritual Site into play and spawn the set-aside Umôrdhoth there. - If the investigators are at Act 2 or 3, discard all enemies at the Ritual Site and spawn the set-aside Umôrdhoth there.

all_card.back_flavor:
你在森林各处发现了四散的图像和神秘印记一一刻在树皮上、凿在石面上、滴落在地上的血迹里。尽管这些文字无法解读，你发现它们大多面向南边。你顺着这些符号逶迤前行，终于在森林中最为黑暗寒冷的区域找到一处洞穴。
你正欲前行，鬼魅般的人影由树后窜出，挡住了通向洞穴的路。
all_card.back_text:
如果仪式地不在场上，将放在一边的仪式地放置入场。
查找收藏，找出每个记录在剧本日志中“未落网的异教徒”一栏的敌人，并将其生成在主道路。
all_card.flavor: 收集的信息指引你来到阿卡姆城南边的密林中，你相信召唤某种名为“乌默尔多斯”的怪物的仪式将在这里进行。你坚定决心，踏入密林更深处，希望能找到进行仪式的场所。
all_card.name: 顺藤摸瓜
all_card.real_back_flavor:
Scattered throughout the forest you've seen glyphs and arcane sigils in various places - etched into the bark of trees, carved upon the faces of stones, and dripped in blood upon the ground. Though you cannot decipher these glyphs, you notice that most of them tend to face south. Following these signs leads you by twists and turns toward a cave in the darkest and coldest part of the forest.
As you advance, shadowy figures emerge from the trees, blocking the only path to the cave.
all_card.real_back_text:
Put the set-aside Ritual Site into play if it is not already in play.
Search the collection for each enemy recorded in your Campaign Log under "Cultists Who Got Away," and spawn those enemies at the Main Path.
all_card.real_flavor: The evidence you've gathered has led you to the woods south of Arkham, where you believe a ritual to summon a being called "Umôrdhoth" is about to take place. Steeling your resolve, you set forth deeper into the woods, hoping to find the site of this ritual.

all_card.back_flavor: 当你步入洞穴，空气变得寒冷，一股刺鼻的血腥与腐烂的气味直冲你的鼻腔。
all_card.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。从遭遇牌库顶弃牌，直到弃掉1个敌人(如果有3位或以上玩家进行游戏，则改为2个敌人)。将每个被弃掉的敌人生成在仪式地。
all_card.flavor: 剩余的异教徒跟随你进入了密林，试图阻止你，眼下他们阻挡了你前进的道路。他们不祥的身姿矗立在悬垂的树木下，仿佛黑夜无声的哨兵。要想到达仪式场所，你必须击败他们，或从他们身边潜遁而过。
all_card.name: 深入黑暗
all_card.text: 目标 - 如果有调查员进入仪式地，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When you enter the cave, the air grows cold, and your nostrils are assaulted by the pungent smell of blood and rot.
all_card.real_back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until 1 enemy is discarded (2 enemies instead if there are 3 or more players in the game). Spawn each discarded enemy at the Ritual Site.
all_card.real_flavor: The remaining cultists have followed you into the woods to try to stop you, and now they block the path to your objective. They stand ominously beneath the overhanging trees, silent sentinels in the night. You must defeat them or sneak past if you are to gain access to the site of their ritual.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If an investigator enters the Ritual Site, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 你不惧反常的寒冷，迂回着穿越过奥秘符号组成的网络，终于跨入了圆阵之中。你踏灭了地上的标记，用尘土将其掩埋，破坏了光滑石块精心摆成的图案。一声尖锐的响声刺入你的耳膜，空气突然变暖，周遭的世界扭曲着变回了常态。
all_card.flavor: 异教徒进行仪式的场所是一处大型岩洞，藏在密林的黑暗角落。在洞穴的中央，石块与奥秘符文标记着烛火围成的圆形召唤阵。
all_card.name: 阻止计划
all_card.text: [action]花费1个线索：检定[willpower](3)或[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，在本场景上放置1个线索。 目标 - 如果本场景的线索数量等于调查员人数的2倍，推进。
all_card.real_back_flavor: You brave the unnatural chill and weave through arcane symbols, crossing the threshold of the circle. You smother the markings on the ground, covering them with dirt, breaking apart the carefully constructed pattern of smooth rocks. A shrill noise pierces your ears as the air grows suddenly warmer, and the world distorts around you, settling into normality.
all_card.real_flavor: The site of the cult's ritual is inside a large cavern in a dark corner of the woods. In the center of the chamber is a candlelit circle marked by rocks and arcane runes.
all_card.real_text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Test [willpower] (3) or [agility] (3). If you succeed, place 1 clue on this Act. Objective - If there are 2 clues per investigator on this Act, advance.

all_card.back_flavor: 绞刑者河隔开了住宅区与阿卡姆南方的密林。过了小桥，你沿着主道路前往森林深处。
all_card.name: 主道路
all_card.text: 主道路与其他每个[[树林]]地点连接。 [action]：撤退。“我们根本无法阻止他们！”你逃出了密林，将阿卡姆留给了它凄惨的命运。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Hangman's Brook separates Uptown from the woods south of Arkham. Passing over the small bridge, you follow the main path deeper into the trees.
all_card.real_text: The Main Path is connected to each other [[Woods]] location. [action]: Resign. "There's nothing we can do to stop them!" You flee from the woods, leaving Arkham to its grisly fate.

all_card.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
all_card.flavor: 自从殖民者第一次进入本地区，整整两个世纪以来，这片空地一直被当作黑暗仪式的场所。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆密林
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你进入本地点后：检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Growing up, you were always warned to stay out of the woods at night. Now you know why.
all_card.real_flavor: This clearing has been the site of dark rites since colonists first came to the area over two centuries ago.
all_card.real_text: Forced - After you enter this location: Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, take 1 horror and 1 damage.

all_card.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
all_card.flavor: 林中道路扭曲旋转，仿佛如活物一般。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆密林
all_card.text: 强制 - 在你离开本地点时：检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定失败，取消本次移动的效果。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Growing up, you were always warned to stay out of the woods at night. Now you know why.
all_card.real_flavor: This path seems to twist and turn upon itself, almost as if it were alive.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When you move out of this location: Test [intellect] (3). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move.

all_card.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
all_card.flavor: 一座爬满藤曼的屋子坐落在小道的边缘。屋内的墙壁和地板上血迹斑斑，散布着尘土、淤泥与被遗弃的骸骨。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆密林
all_card.text: 在本地点调查改为使用[willpower]，而非尝试调查原本指示的技能。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Growing up, you were always warned to stay out of the woods at night. Now you know why.
all_card.real_flavor: A house at the edge of the trail, covered in vines. Inside, the walls and floors are bloodstained and littered with dirt, mud, and discarded bones.
all_card.real_text: This location is investigated using [willpower] instead of the skill indicated by the investigation attempt.

all_card.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
all_card.flavor: 你在附近一块高地之上遥望到异教徒活动的痕迹。要去到那块高地的顶端，你将不得不攀崖而上。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆密林
all_card.text: 在本地点调查改为使用[agility]，而非尝试调查原本指示的技能。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Growing up, you were always warned to stay out of the woods at night. Now you know why.
all_card.real_flavor: Atop a nearby plateau, you can see signs of cultist activity. You will have to climb the cliff in order to reach the top.
all_card.real_text: This location is investigated using [agility] instead of the skill indicated by the investigation attempt.

all_card.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
all_card.flavor: 一条殖民地时期的古老马道，十数载未被使用，早已是杂草丛生。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆密林
all_card.text: 在本地点调查改为使用[combat]，而非尝试调查原本指示的技能。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Growing up, you were always warned to stay out of the woods at night. Now you know why.
all_card.real_flavor: An old horse trail in colonial days, this overgrown path hasn't been used in over a decade.
all_card.real_text: This location is investigated using [combat] instead of the skill indicated by the investigation attempt.

all_card.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
all_card.flavor: 若非这些妖魔鬼怪，这将是处野餐胜地。
all_card.name: 阿卡姆密林
all_card.text: [action]：治愈1点伤害或1点恐惧。(每回合仅限一次)
all_card.real_back_flavor: Growing up, you were always warned to stay out of the woods at night. Now you know why.
all_card.real_flavor: This would be a nice picnic spot, if it weren't for all the monsters.
all_card.real_text: [action]: Heal 1 damage or heal 1 horror. (Limit once per turn.)

all_card.back_flavor: 一座寒冷黑暗洞穴的中央穴室，昏暗的烛光照亮了装点洞穴的奥秘标记。
all_card.flavor: 墙上符文闪烁，若隐若现，空气中凝结着死亡的气息。
all_card.name: 仪式地
all_card.text: 强制 - 当一轮结束时，如果仪式地上的线索数量少于调查员人数的2倍：在仪式地上增加线索，直到其数量等于调查员人数的2倍。
all_card.real_back_flavor: The large central chamber of a cold, dark cavern, adorned with arcane markings and dimly lit by candlelight.
all_card.real_flavor: The sigils on the wall begin to flicker in and out of focus, and the air grows heavy with the smell of death.
all_card.real_text: Forced - At the end of the round, if there are fewer than 2 clues per investigator on Ritual Site: Add clues to it until it has 2 clues per investigator on it.

all_card.name: 乌默尔多斯
all_card.text: 猎手。庞大。 乌默尔多斯得到+4[per_investigator]生命。 强制 - 当每位调查员的回合结束时：重整乌默尔多斯. [action]如果你控制丽塔·钱德勒：“这都是她的错！”你将丽塔抛向乌默尔多斯，希望它能饶了你一命。(→结局3)
all_card.real_text: Hunter. Massive. Umôrdhoth gets +4 health per investigator. Forced - At the end of each investigator's turn: Ready Umôrdhoth. [action] If you control Lita Chantler: "It's only after her!" You throw Lita to Umôrdhoth in order to spare your lives. (→R3)

all_card.flavor: 致命的寒意包围着你，试图吸走你的生命力。
all_card.name: 乌默尔多斯的愤怒
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](5)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须(选择一项)：选择并弃掉你手中1张卡牌，或者受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: A deathly chill from below engulfs you, attempting to suck your life force away.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, you must either (choose one): Choose and discard a card from your hand, or take 1 damage and 1 horror.

all_card.flavor: 残酷的鼠群波浪般前进，翻卷着利爪，尖牙与斑驳的皮毛。
all_card.name: 鼠群
all_card.text: 猎手。
all_card.real_flavor: A horde of cruel rats skitters forth in an undulating wave of claws, teeth, and mottled fur.
all_card.real_text: Hunter.

all_card.flavor: 这是一只硕大而无名的渎神之物。它那血红的眼睛怒目圆睁，骨瘦如柴的双爪上提着的东西曾是活人。它啃噬着头颅，如同一个蚕食棉花糖的孩童。<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《皮克曼的模特》</cite>
all_card.name: 食尸鬼爪牙
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 食尸鬼
all_card.real_flavor: It was a colossal and nameless blasphemy with glaring red eyes, and it held in bony claws a thing that had been a man, gnawing at the head as a child nibbles at a stick of candy. <cite>H. P. Lovecraft, "Pickman's Model"</cite>

all_card.flavor: 这怪物的模样使人不禁自问：我们为活而吃，还是为吃而活？
all_card.name: 饥饿的食尸鬼
all_card.text: 猎物 - 剩余生命值最低。
all_card.traits: 类人. 怪物. 食尸鬼
all_card.real_flavor: The sight of the thing raised the question: Do we eat to live, or do we live to eat?
all_card.real_text: Prey - Lowest remaining health.

all_card.flavor: 腐烂的手臂从地下伸出，抓握你的脚踝。
all_card.name: 攫噬之手
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害。
all_card.real_flavor: Decaying hands rise up from below and grasp and claw at your ankles.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.

all_card.flavor: 鲜血淋漓的一幕让你恶心不已。你庆幸这受害者不是自己。
all_card.name: 腐烂的尸体
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧。
all_card.real_flavor: A sickening display of gore causes you to retch. You're glad this wasn't you.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.

all_card.name: 呆若木鸡
all_card.text: 显现 - 将呆若木鸡放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你每轮第一次执行以下行动(移动、攻击、或躲避)之一，须支付额外1个行动。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉呆若木鸡。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Frozen in Fear into play in your threat area. The first time you perform one of the following actions (move, fight, or evade) each round, it costs 1 additional action. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Frozen in Fear.

all_card.name: 刺耳之声
all_card.text: 显现 - 将刺耳之声放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你不能打出支援或事件。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：弃掉刺耳之声。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Dissonant Voices into play in your threat area. You cannot play assets or events. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Dissonant Voices.

all_card.flavor: 黑暗势力向你涌来。如果你不尽快行动，一个可怕的阴谋将会得逞。
all_card.name: 远古恶魔
all_card.text: 显现 - 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果可以导致当前密谋推进。
all_card.real_flavor: Dark forces stir against you. If you do not act quickly, a sinister plot will be fulfilled.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.

all_card.flavor: 反常的寒冷要冻住你的灵魂。
all_card.name: 地窖寒风
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定失败，选择并弃掉1个你控制的支援(如果你不能，则改为受到2点伤害)。
all_card.real_flavor: The supernatural cold threatens to freeze your soul.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, choose and discard 1 asset you control (if you cannot, take 2 damage instead).

all_card.name: 朦胧之雾
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限1张。 所附属地点的隐藏值+2。 强制 - 所附属地点被成功调查后：弃掉朦胧之雾。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. Attached location gets +2 shroud. Forced - After attached location is successfully investigated: Discard Obscuring Fog.

all_card.flavor: 这不过是微不足道的祭品。
all_card.name: 祭司
all_card.text: 生成 - 任意无人地点。 强制 - 在祭司入场后：在祭司上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_flavor: It was only a small sacrifice.
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Any empty location. Forced - After Acolyte enters play: Place 1 doom on it.

all_card.name: 密会巫师
all_card.text: 生成 - 任意无人地点。 反击。 强制 - 当神话阶段结束时：在密会巫师上放置1个毁灭标记。
all_card.real_text: Spawn - Any empty location. Retaliate. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Place 1 doom on Wizard of the Order.

all_card.name: 神秘咏唱
all_card.text: 显现 - 在最近的一个[[异教徒]]敌人上放置2个毁灭标记。如果场上没有[[异教徒]]敌人，查找遭遇牌库及弃牌堆，从中找出并抽取一个[[异教徒]]敌人(混洗遭遇牌库)。
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Place 2 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy. If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.

all_card.flavor: ……它们没有可以微笑的面孔，在本该是脸的位置只有一片空白，意味深长。<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特</cite>
all_card.name: 狩猎中的夜魇
all_card.text:
猎手。
调查员尝试躲避狩猎中的夜魇时，揭示的每个混乱标记的负值修正翻倍。
all_card.real_flavor: ... they had no faces at all to smile with, but only a suggestive blankness where a face ought to be. <cite>H. P. Lovecraft</cite>
all_card.real_text:
Hunter.
While attempting to evade Hunting Nightgaunt, double the negative modifier of each revealed chaos token.

all_card.flavor: 一只夜魇俯冲下来，用它利爪般的手抓住了你，将你带入夜空。
all_card.name: 乘着黑暗之翼
all_card.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。然后，与每个和你交战的非[[夜魇]]敌人解除交战，并移动到一个[[中心]]地点。
all_card.real_flavor: A nightgaunt swoops down from the sky and grabs you with its clawed hands, carrying you off into the night.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 1 horror and 1 damage. Then, disengage with each non-[[Nightgaunt]] enemy engaged with you and move to a [[Central]] location.

all_card.name: 上锁的门
all_card.text: 显现 - 附属到线索最多且没有附属上锁的门的地点。 附属的地点不能被调查。 [action]：检定[combat](4)以破门而入或[agility](4)以撬开门锁。如果你检定成功，弃掉上锁的门.
all_card.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the location in play with the most clues, and without a Locked Door attached. The attached location cannot be investigated. [action]: Test [combat] (4) to break down the door or [agility] (4) to pick the lock. If you succeed, discard Locked Door.

all_card.name: 尖叫的拜亚基
all_card.text: 猎物 - 剩余神智值最低。 猎手。 与剩余神智值在4或以下的调查员交战时，尖叫的拜亚基得到+1攻击和+1躲避。

all_card.back_flavor: 遵照流程和规则往往让罗兰感到放心。身为联邦探员，罗兰的手册在任何情况下都能派上用场，这真是令他宽慰。但最近，他的联邦探员手册在任务里完全派不上用场。无论多么努力，罗兰也找不到哪里提及了遭遇奇怪生物、时空之门，和魔法咒文的对策。要不是亲眼所见，他自己也绝不会相信……他的上峰也是绝不会明白的。罗兰知道，这次他可得靠自己了。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Roland had always taken comfort in procedure and rules. As an agent in the Bureau, he was relieved to have guidelines to follow in any given situation. But lately, his Federal Agent's Handbook had been entirely unhelpful given the cases he'd been assigned. Try as he might, Roland could find no mention of what to do when confronted with strange creatures, gates through time and space, or magic spells. If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, he would never have believed it... and there's no way his superiors would understand. Roland knew he would have to handle this one himself.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Roland's .38 Special, Cover Up, 1 random basic weakness.
all_card.real_flavor: Everything by the book: every "i" dotted, every "t" crossed. It had worked, until now.
all_card.real_text:

all_card.back_flavor: 黛西是米斯卡塔尼克大学里受人尊敬的图书馆员，她一直都觉得自己生命里最重要的就是书。恐怖、暴力、惊俱，这些日常生活中嫌恶的东西，她在书里倒是看得津津有味。她随即一头陷进了约翰·迪伊翻译的《死灵之书》。这是亵渎、污秽，毛骨悚然、难以置信。但根据自己对神秘事物和密教主题的研究，黛西知道，这本书里事实大于虚构。她开始好奇，在奥恩图书馆的限制区里，还藏着什么其他秘密……
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：黛西的手提包、死灵之书：约翰·迪伊译本、1张随机基础弱点。
all_card.flavor: “我知道有些书强大无比，甚至能改写现实。”

all_card.real_back_flavor: As a respected librarian at Miskatonic University, Daisy had always felt that books were the most important thing in her life. She explored in fiction what she abhorred in life: horror, violence, fear. Then, she stumbled across the John Dee translation of the Necronomicon. It was blasphemous, unholy, and too awful to be read. But given her studies in obscure and occult subjects, Daisy knew there was more truth than fiction within the book's pages. She began to wonder what other secrets the restricted collection of the Orne Library held...

all_card.real_flavor: "I know of books so powerful, they can rewrite reality."

all_card.back_flavor: “倒霉蛋”本来想做个好人。但有的时候，要对得起自己的良心，就得不干不净。尽管他要钱是为了妈妈的手术，但这些条子可不会管。就在他服刑的第二年，妈妈因病去世。但狱友布拉德·霍林告诉他，还有比死亡更糟糕的事。他每晚都无声地嘶喊“古神”之事，把自己梦到的奇异旅程都告诉“倒霉蛋”。“倒霉蛋”本来没当回事，直到有一晚，他起夜看到了狱友烧成了灰。等到终于出狱的时候，“倒霉蛋”回到了阿卡姆寻求答案。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Skids hadn't planned on a life of crime. But sometimes doing the right thing means getting your hands dirty. The cops didn't care that Skids needed the money for his mother's operation. His mother died of her illness during the second year of his sentence. His cellmate, Brad Hollins, told him there were worse fates than death. He ranted and raved in a quiet voice every evening about the "Old Ones" and told Skids about bizarre adventures he'd had while dreaming. Skids didn't give it much thought until the night he woke to the sight of his cellmate bursting into flames. When Skids was finally released, he returned to Arkham, looking for answers.

all_card.back_flavor: 艾格尼丝·贝克今生可能只是个毕恭毕敬的侍应，但在超越现代世界想象的前生，她可是个强大的女巫。一切都源自她在自家阁楼那堆落满灰的传家宝里发现的奇怪神器一一大概是某种钥匙。她触碰的时候，记忆如潮水般涌来，一同奔流的还有另一个词：“希波利尔”。越是深入幻景和前世的记忆，她的力量也就越强大……但她也就更加害怕。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Agnes Baker may be just an unassuming waitress in this life, but in a previous life, in a time and age undreamed of in the modern world, she had been a powerful witch. It began when she found a strange artifact - a key of some kind - in a dusty collection of family belongings in her attic. When she touched it, the memories came flooding back, along with one word: "Hyperborea." The more she delved into the visions and memories of her former life, the stronger her powers grew... and the more frightened she became.

all_card.real_flavor: "I remember another life, one of sorcery and conquest."

all_card.back_flavor: 温蒂还小的时候，妈妈常让她玩自己的项链。妈妈会讲她的故事，温蒂则转着项链，看它闪闪发光。然后，话就说到爸爸在海上失踪，妈妈也开始行为古怪，在房子里用粉笔画满了反常的符号。妈妈被带到了疯人院，温蒂则去了孤儿院。但妈妈在被带走前，把项链留给了温蒂，说是能“保护她”。温蒂在孤儿院里待了几年，然后溜了出来，她决定能靠自己活得更好。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Mama used to let Wendy play with her necklace when she was small. Mama would tell her stories, and Wendy would spin the necklace and watch as it glittered. Then, word came that her father had been lost at sea, and Mama started acting strange, drawing unusual symbols in chalk all over the house. They took Mama to the asylum, and Wendy went to the orphanage. Before they took her away, Mama gave her the necklace, to "protect her." Wendy stayed in the orphanage for several years before running away, deciding that she could take better care of herself on her own.

If there are no [[Civilian]] enemies in play, the lead investigator draws 1 of the set-aside Waterfront Civilian enemies. Ready Julia Stern. She moves once toward the nearest [[Civilian]] enemy.
all_card.real_flavor: Julia Stern is hiding somewhere in the Waterfront District. You'll need to look around and see if you can find the monster's lair before she emerges to kill again.
all_card.real_text: Forced - When the enemy phase ends: If Julia Stern is at a [[Lair]] location, flip her facedown (discarding all tokens and attachments on her) and place her beneath that location, along with the top card of the encounter deck. Otherwise, if Julia Stern is ready, she moves once toward the nearest [[Lair]] location.

all_card.real_back_flavor: The sun mercifully begins to rise from the Eastern horizon, setting the Miskatonic ablaze with its shimmering reflection.
all_card.real_back_text:
Heal all damage from Julia Stern. For every 2 damage healed this way (rounded down), place 1 damage on the scenario reference card.
Shuffle the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and Julia Stern together. Place these cards facedown, at random, beneath each [[Lair]] location, distributed as evenly as possible.
One at a time, each investigator draws 1 of the set-aside Waterfront Civilian enemies, until no such enemies remain set-aside.
all_card.real_flavor: The light of the full moon casts stark shadows on the streets of Arkham, creating dark corners and shrouded alleys too dim to see into clearly. The light of the streetlamps doesn't seem to reach as far as it should. The sound of someone—or something—scrabbling up the wall of a nearby building sets you on edge. But you know you only have so much time to find Julia, so you steel yourself against the night.
all_card.name: 第一夜

Move all damage from the scenario reference card to Julia Stern.

all_card.real_flavor: You're running out of time. If you want to put an end to the threat of Julia Stern, you'll need to act fast.

all_card.real_back_flavor: The Miskatonic river burns with bright orange light as the sun rises in the east. The night melts away, and slowly the streets come alive again as the people of the Waterfront District begin the day anew. Too much time has passed, and Julia Stern has escaped. You can only hope that Detective Reynolds has produced some results in his own investigation.
all_card.real_flavor: With every corner you turn, you expect to find another bloody victim of Julia's predatory machinations. The night is mostly quiet, but the sound of a distant scream or the scraping of claws on cobblestone are constant reminders that monsters hide in every shadow.

all_card.real_back_flavor: Julia emerges from hiding with a blood-curdling shriek. She swipes her clawed hands with reckless abandon, glaring around with monstrous eyes, looking for her next victim.
all_card.real_back_text: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues (from the token pool) on each revealed location without victory X, up to that location's clue threshold.
all_card.real_flavor: The creature has gone into hiding. You'll need to find her lair and draw it out.

all_card.real_back_text:
If Julia Stern is not in the victory display:
Julia proves to be a difficult target to pin down. Even when you think you have her, you are surprised to find that she is quick to slip away into the shadows once more.
Reset the act deck to Act 1a. If Julia Stern is in the victory display:
After hours—days—of struggling, you finally bring Julia down. She lies in a crumpled heap on the cobblestones, her breathing ragged as she barely clings to consciousness.
The investigators must decide (choose one): - "There might still be hope for her." (→R1) - "We need to put an end to this monster." (→R2)
all_card.real_flavor: Julia Stern is on the loose, and it is clear she is no longer human. She stalks the streets of Arkham looking for victims. You'll need to work fast and slow her down to stop her from killing again.

all_card.real_back_flavor: You feel like you're starting to get somewhere with this investigation, avoiding the nosy workers while poking around the building. It doesn't take too long, however, before you feel a firm hand on your shoulder. "Something I can help you with?" A voice asks. You turn to see a dark-haired man, mustachioed and square-jawed, looking at you with suspicion.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Javier Rivera enemy engaged with the investigator with the most clues.
all_card.real_flavor: You find your way into the meat packing facility through the back entrance, coming in through the loading dock. You provide vague answers to workers who question your presence, just enough of an excuse to get them out of your hair for the moment. You're sure it's only a matter of time before someone with authority comes to demand answers, so you'll need to investigate the factory as best, and as fast, as you can.
all_card.name: 白日喧嚣

all_card.real_back_flavor: You feel like you're starting to get somewhere with this investigation, moving carefully through the factory to avoid causing too much of a disturbance. Every sound you make seems to echo deafeningly through the darkness. Your quiet investigation is brought to a halt, however, when the sound of a heavy, metal door being thrown open shatters the silence. You see a hulking monster, its form so large that you can hardly believe it was once a human, shambling through the factory floor. It has heard you, and it is coming for you.
all_card.real_back_text: Spawn the set-aside Night Watchman enemy at the Factory Floor nearest the most investigators.
all_card.real_flavor: You find your way into the meat packing facility through the back entrance, coming in through the loading dock. After you break in through the locked door, you find the warehouse to be quiet and dark. Silvery moonlight streams in from the high windows to illuminate parts of the factory floor, but you can't shake the feeling that something is hiding in the shadows, watching you.
all_card.name: 黑夜寂静

all_card.real_back_flavor: The factory proves more difficult to navigate, and the cult's activities better hidden, than you had expected. It seems like you spend hours inside the factory, but every place you search and every document you read only deepens the mystery, or leads you astray. To make matters worse, the cult has been dogging your heels this entire time, and it would seem that they are only growing in number. You decide to try for the exit, but are soon overwhelmed by robed acolytes, grappling your arms, removing your weapons, and dragging you into the tunnels below the facility.
all_card.real_flavor: The more time you spend in the facility, the more you believe that there is a sinister secret lurking in every dark corner or behind every locked door. You've met some resistance so far, and it would've been wise to turn back, but you can't put aside the feeling that if you don't get to the bottom of this, then Julia Stern will only have been the first victim of whatever is going on.
all_card.name: 掘入更深(版本一)

all_card.real_back_flavor: Your search of the factory floor and offices has proven thorough, and you are about to leave empty-handed when you spot something you had missed before: a square hatch in the floor of the basement storage. The hatch is flush with the surrounding surface, blending in to the rest of the floor in the darkness; you would have missed it entirely, had it not been for the streak of dried blood that was smeared across the floor, only to be cut off at the seam of the hatch. You're not about to leave the factory without checking every potential spot for cult activity. With little effort, you're able to lift the hatch up and open, and stare down into the darkness below.

all_card.real_flavor: The New Horizons facility is one of the more recently constructed buildings in Arkham. The clean windows and crisp brick facade present a welcoming exterior, but your instincts tell you that not all is as it seems.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, (→R1). Objective - At the end of the round, investigators at Storage may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
all_card.name: 前往新视野

all_card.real_back_flavor:
Thanks to everything you've found in the tunnels below the facility, you are finally able to put together a fairly complete picture of what is happening.
The cult appears to be conducting experiments on people using containers of blood from... something. What, exactly, you cannot be certain. Some of these people seem to be workers from the facility, while some seem to be cultists. And, through these experiments, people have been turned into blood-thirsty predators of the night. At the head of it all, the name on many of the memos and correspondence you've found is one Howard Wilkes. It would seem you've found what you came for.
There still is the matter of where all this blood is coming from. If you could find this creature they are harvesting it from, you might be able to put a stop to this operation before you confront Mr. Wilkes.
all_card.real_back_text: Put the set-aside Descending Tunnel location into play.
all_card.real_flavor: The tunnels below the New Horizons facility are dark, mostly dirt and stone. The only light is the occasional dim glow of candles or a lone electric lantern. You must be on the right track.
all_card.real_text: Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, (→R1). Objective - At the end of the round, if there are exactly 2 clues on this act, advance.
all_card.name: 寻觅答案

all_card.real_back_flavor: The beast lunges toward you, maw of countless bloody fangs opened wide, ready to devour you whole. In mere moments before you meet your demise, you land the killing blow, sending the great monster reeling backwards. With a remorseful whine of pain, the creature collapses to the floor of the cavern, bleeding from its many wounds. You watch just long enough to be sure it won't rise again, and then you pick yourself up and begin heading to the exit. You want to put as much distance between you and this facility as you can.
all_card.real_flavor: There is only one place you haven't yet investigated in the tunnels. The path winds ever downward, and you can feel a breeze and hear the trickle of water. It seems it leads to a great chamber of some sort. Whatever is down there, it must be the source of all of this tainted blood.

all_card.real_back_flavor: Just as the staff are serving dessert, there's the sound of shattering glass from the kitchen. The people in the dining hall pause in a tense moment of silence, until one guest rises from his chair. "Sounds like Howard is having his own party," the man says with a smirk. He moves towards the door to the kitchen just as a fanged monster leaps through, bringing him to the ground. The other guests scream in terror, and the party plunges into bloody chaos.

If Julia Stern is set-aside, spawn her at Dining Hall (otherwise, spawn 1 of the set-aside Spawn of Zburamoarte enemies instead).
Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and all in-play areas for 1 [[Civilian]] enemy and add that enemy to the victory display (2 [[Civilian]] enemies instead if playing on Hard or Expert difficulty).
Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 [per_investigator] [[Civilian]] enemies. Spawn each of these enemies at a different location (with no investigators, if able).
all_card.real_flavor: You've arrived at the party in the middle of dinner, with most of the guests in the dining hall. You can feel eyes on you, even when other guests aren't looking your way...

all_card.real_back_flavor: The once immaculate penthouse has become a chaotic blood bath as the monsters indulge in the frightened and confused party guests. To your horror, the bodies that line the floor don't remain motionless for long...

Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each remaining set-aside Child of Blood enemy into the encounter deck.

all_card.real_back_flavor: Peering inside the master bedroom, you see the room is in a concerning state—the bed is a mess, pictures hang awkwardly from the walls, and what's worse, the floor is slick with freshly spilled blood. The doors to the balcony hang open. Your eyes finally adjust to the darkness in time to see a tall silhouette rush towards you.

After a long and bloody struggle, you manage to put Howard Wilkes down for good. You hope that this nightmare will finally be fully behind you.
(→R1) If this act advanced because each surviving investigator has resigned:
You manage to escape from the party with your life. You can only hope you've saved enough of the guests and delayed Howard's plans long enough to make a difference.
(→R2)

all_card.back_flavor: 每每灾祸来临，雷克斯·墨菲总是首当其冲。只要和雷克斯待上一天，哪怕是最坚定的无神论者都会坚信，这个男人一定是被诅咒了。每次一有好报道的苗头，事情就开始不对劲了。印斯茅斯的记录和照片一起都吹到了海里。在敦威治的时候，他刚要报警，路上的踪迹就被雨水冲得一干二净。这糟糕的运气已经不止一次让他直面可怕的野兽和密教的阴谋。为了活下去，雷克斯不得不拥有一颗好奇善问的心，让自己赶在下一场灾祸的前头。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，所有其他职阶的卡牌([guardian]、[rogue]、[mystic]和/或[survivor])等级0最多5张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：寻找真相、雷克斯的诅咒、1张随机基础弱点。 牌库构建限制：无[[幸运]]卡牌。
all_card.flavor: “这次，什么都不能阻止我发现真相。”

all_card.real_back_flavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong. That business in Innsmouth with the photographs that had blown out to sea. The tracks in Dunwich that had washed away in the rain just before he'd brought the sheriff. His terrible fortune has more than once exposed him to gruesome beasts and occult conspiracies. To survive, Rex has developed an inquisitive mind, keeping one step ahead of the next disaster.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Search for the Truth, Rex's Curse, 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Fortune]] cards.

all_card.back_flavor: 每每灾祸来临，雷克斯·墨菲总是首当其冲。只要和雷克斯待上一天，哪怕是最坚定的无神论者都会坚信，这个男人一定是被诅咒了。每次一有好报道的苗头，事情就开始不对劲了。印斯茅斯的记录和照片一起都吹到了海里。在敦威治的时候，他刚要报警，路上的踪迹就被雨水冲得一干二净。这糟糕的运气已经不止一次让他直面可怕的野兽和密教的阴谋。为了活下去，雷克斯不得不拥有一颗好奇善问的心，让自己赶在下一场灾祸的前头。

all_card.real_back_flavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong. That business in Innsmouth with the photographs that had blown out to sea. The tracks in Dunwich that had washed away in the rain just before he'd brought the sheriff. His terrible fortune has more than once exposed him to gruesome beasts and occult conspiracies. To survive, Rex has developed an inquisitive mind, keeping one step ahead of the next disaster.

all_card.back_flavor: 每每灾祸来临，雷克斯·墨菲总是首当其冲。只要和雷克斯待上一天，哪怕是最坚定的无神论者都会坚信，这个男人一定是被诅咒了。每次一有好报道的苗头，事情就开始不对劲了。印斯茅斯的记录和照片一起都吹到了海里。在敦威治的时候，他刚要报警，路上的踪迹就被雨水冲得一干二净。这糟糕的运气已经不止一次让他直面可怕的野兽和密教的阴谋。为了活下去，雷克斯不得不拥有一颗好奇善问的心，让自己赶在下一场灾祸的前头。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，所有其他职阶的卡牌([guardian]、[rogue]、[mystic]和/或[survivor])等级0最多5张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：寻找真相、雷克斯的诅咒、1张随机基础弱点。 牌库构建限制：无[[幸运]]卡牌。
all_card.flavor: “这次，什么都不能阻止我发现真相。”
all_card.name: 雷克斯·墨菲

[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以改为选择本次技能检定自动失败，以抽取3张卡牌。
all_card.real_back_flavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong. That business in Innsmouth with the photographs that had blown out to sea. The tracks in Dunwich that had washed away in the rain just before he'd brought the sheriff. His terrible fortune has more than once exposed him to gruesome beasts and occult conspiracies. To survive, Rex has developed an inquisitive mind, keeping one step ahead of the next disaster.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Search for the Truth, Rex's Curse, 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Fortune]] cards.

all_card.back_flavor: 每每灾祸来临，雷克斯·墨菲总是首当其冲。只要和雷克斯待上一天，哪怕是最坚定的无神论者都会坚信，这个男人一定是被诅咒了。每次一有好报道的苗头，事情就开始不对劲了。印斯茅斯的记录和照片一起都吹到了海里。在敦威治的时候，他刚要报警，路上的踪迹就被雨水冲得一干二净。这糟糕的运气已经不止一次让他直面可怕的野兽和密教的阴谋。为了活下去，雷克斯不得不拥有一颗好奇善问的心，让自己赶在下一场灾祸的前头。

all_card.real_back_flavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong. That business in Innsmouth with the photographs that had blown out to sea. The tracks in Dunwich that had washed away in the rain just before he'd brought the sheriff. all_card.back_flavor: 萝拉在全球各地出演剧目时，戏票每每都被抢购一空，但从没有一部剧像《黄衣之王》一般不详而诡异。就连排练期间，戏班子都连遭厄运。一天，与她联袂出演的米里亚姆被人发现浮尸于塞纳河上，她终于崩溃了，提笔写下辞职信，告诉导演下一场就是自己的告别演出。现在她回到自己的家乡阿卡姆，准备最后一次演出，她也希望这一次能永远告别这出可怕的戏剧。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Lola has performed to sold-out houses worldwide, but no play has been as haunting or as odd as The King in Yellow. Even during rehearsals, everything about it brought calamity and dread. When her co-star, Miriam, was found floating dead in the Seine, she decided she'd had enough, and penned a letter to the director explaining that her next performance would be her last. all_card.back_flavor: 曼蒂打从小时候开始，睡不着就会看书。许多夜晚都是如此度过的。她过目不忘，擅长联系事物找出真相，因此她得到了米斯卡塔尼克大学的一份宝贵工作——研究员。她曾花上数小时翻阅那些古老的禁书，细细阅读书中的亵渎内容。在阅读过程中，她发现字里行间在有规律地暗示着一场大乱即将来临。她是不是得了妄想症？还是说真有一场灾难或是动乱将要发生？

all_card.real_back_flavor: Ever since she was a child, Mandy would read whenever she could not sleep. Such has been the case on many nights. all_card.back_flavor: 特里希向来文武双全，她坚定不移，追求卓越，无所畏惧，敢打敢拼，让她屡屡马到成功。鉴于她智体皆优的毕业记录，人人都指望她再干一番大事业。但特里希却去了一家商业密码公司。她的工作实在平平，旁人最初的惊讶也都消磨，一度被寄予重望的特里希·斯卡波罗已经泯然众人。但这却很适合特里希，也让旁人更难发现真相：她日常的工作不过是一种伪装，真实身份却是黑室这一官方译码特工组织的间谍。
all_card.back_text: 牌组卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-2。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：潜于阴影、影子特工、1张随机基础弱点。

变异。
[reaction]你在有敌人的地点发现线索后：发现该地点的额外1个线索，或者如果该敌人非[[精英]]，自动躲避该敌人(每轮限制一次)。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。如果是调查检定，你可以选择任一已揭示地点；改为如同你正在该地点调查。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Trish had always excelled in both body and mind, her unwavering focus on excellence and her fearless disposition a winning combination. Given her stellar academic and athletic records, everyone expected to see her become something great. Instead, Trish took a job at a commercial code company. The initial shock of her humble work eventually wore off, and the exceptional Trish Scarborough faded into obscurity. This suited Trish just fine, as it made it harder for anyone to realize the truth: her job was a cover for her true work as a spy with the Black Chamber, the Bureau's code-breaking agency.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): In the Shadows, Shadow Agents, 1 random basic weakness.

all_card.back_flavor: 曼蒂打从小时候开始，睡不着就会看书。许多夜晚都是如此度过的。她过目不忘，擅长联系事物找出真相，因此她得到了米斯卡塔尼克大学的一份宝贵工作——研究员。她曾花上数小时翻阅那些古老的禁书，细细阅读书中的亵渎内容。在阅读过程中，她发现字里行间在有规律地暗示着一场大乱即将来临。她是不是得了妄想症？还是说真有一场灾难或是动乱将要发生？

all_card.real_back_flavor: Ever since she was a child, Mandy would read whenever she could not sleep. Such has been the case on many nights. Her remarkable memory and ability to correlate facts have landed her a highly valued job as a researcher for Miskatonic University. She has spent hours poring over the profane pages of ancient, forbidden texts. In doing so, she has discovered a pattern indicating an impending catacylsm. Has paranoia finally caught up to her? Or is a disaster of truly epic proportions on the horizon?

all_card.back_flavor: 特里希向来文武双全，她坚定不移，追求卓越，无所畏惧，敢打敢拼，让她屡屡马到成功。鉴于她智体皆优的毕业记录，人人都指望她再干一番大事业。但特里希却去了一家商业密码公司。她的工作实在平平，旁人最初的惊讶也都消磨，一度被寄予重望的特里希·斯卡波罗已经泯然众人。但这却很适合特里希，也让旁人更难发现真相：她日常的工作不过是一种伪装，真实身份却是黑室这一官方译码特工组织的间谍。
all_card.back_text: 牌组卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-2。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：潜于阴影、影子特工、1张随机基础弱点。

[elder_sign]效果：+2。如果是调查检定，你可以选择任一已揭示地点；改为如同你正在该地点调查。
all_card.real_back_flavor: Trish had always excelled in both body and mind, her unwavering focus on excellence and her fearless disposition a winning combination. Given her stellar academic and athletic records, everyone expected to see her become something great. Instead, Trish took a job at a commercial code company. The initial shock of her humble work eventually wore off, and the exceptional Trish Scarborough faded into obscurity. This suited Trish just fine, as it made it harder for anyone to realize the truth: her job was a cover for her true work as a spy with the Black Chamber, the Bureau's code-breaking agency.

all_card.back_flavor: 每每灾祸来临，雷克斯·墨菲总是首当其冲。只要和雷克斯待上一天，哪怕是最坚定的无神论者都会坚信，这个男人一定是被诅咒了。每次一有好报道的苗头，事情就开始不对劲了。印斯茅斯的记录和照片一起都吹到了海里。在敦威治的时候，他刚要报警，路上的踪迹就被雨水冲得一干二净。这糟糕的运气已经不止一次让他直面可怕的野兽和密教的阴谋。为了活下去，雷克斯不得不拥有一颗好奇善问的心，让自己赶在下一场灾祸的前头。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，所有其他职阶的卡牌([guardian]、[rogue]、[mystic]和/或[survivor])等级0最多5张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：寻找真相、雷克斯的诅咒、1张随机基础弱点。 牌库构建限制：无[[幸运]]卡牌。
all_card.flavor: “这次，什么都不能阻止我发现真相。”

all_card.real_back_flavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong. That business in Innsmouth with the photographs that had blown out to sea. The tracks in Dunwich that had washed away in the rain just before he'd brought the sheriff. His terrible fortune has more than once exposed him to gruesome beasts and occult conspiracies. To survive, Rex has developed an inquisitive mind, keeping one step ahead of the next disaster.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Search for the Truth, Rex's Curse, 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Fortune]] cards.
all_card.real_flavor: "This time, nothing will stop me from getting at the truth!"

all_card.back_flavor: 萝拉在全球各地出演剧目时，戏票每每都被抢购一空，但从没有一部剧像《黄衣之王》一般不详而诡异。就连排练期间，戏班子都连遭厄运。一天，与她联袂出演的米里亚姆被人发现浮尸于塞纳河上，她终于崩溃了，提笔写下辞职信，告诉导演下一场就是自己的告别演出。现在她回到自己的家乡阿卡姆，准备最后一次演出，她也希望这一次能永远告别这出可怕的戏剧。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Lola has performed to sold-out houses worldwide, but no play has been as haunting or as odd as The King in Yellow. Even during rehearsals, everything about it brought calamity and dread. When her co-star, Miriam, was found floating dead in the Seine, she decided she'd had enough, and penned a letter to the director explaining that her next performance would be her last. Now she heads home to Arkham for one final show, hoping she can finally be rid of this dreadful play.

all_card.back_flavor: 曼蒂打从小时候开始，睡不着就会看书。许多夜晚都是如此度过的。她过目不忘，擅长联系事物找出真相，因此她得到了米斯卡塔尼克大学的一份宝贵工作——研究员。她曾花上数小时翻阅那些古老的禁书，细细阅读书中的亵渎内容。在阅读过程中，她发现字里行间在有规律地暗示着一场大乱即将来临。她是不是得了妄想症？还是说真有一场灾难或是动乱将要发生？

Or is a disaster of truly epic proportions on the horizon?

all_card.back_flavor: 特里希向来文武双全，她坚定不移，追求卓越，无所畏惧，敢打敢拼，让她屡屡马到成功。鉴于她智体皆优的毕业记录，人人都指望她再干一番大事业。但特里希却去了一家商业密码公司。她的工作实在平平，旁人最初的惊讶也都消磨，一度被寄予重望的特里希·斯卡波罗已经泯然众人。但这却很适合特里希，也让旁人更难发现真相：她日常的工作不过是一种伪装，真实身份却是黑室这一官方译码特工组织的间谍。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Trish had always excelled in both body and mind, her unwavering focus on excellence and her fearless disposition a winning combination. Given her stellar academic and athletic records, everyone expected to see her become something great. Instead, Trish took a job at a commercial code company. The initial shock of her humble work eventually wore off, and the exceptional Trish Scarborough faded into obscurity. This suited Trish just fine, as it made it harder for anyone to realize the truth: her job was a cover for her true work as a spy with the Black Chamber, the Bureau's code-breaking agency.

all_card.back_flavor: 每每灾祸来临，雷克斯·墨菲总是首当其冲。只要和雷克斯待上一天，哪怕是最坚定的无神论者都会坚信，这个男人一定是被诅咒了。每次一有好报道的苗头，事情就开始不对劲了。印斯茅斯的记录和照片一起都吹到了海里。在敦威治的时候，他刚要报警，路上的踪迹就被雨水冲得一干二净。这糟糕的运气已经不止一次让他直面可怕的野兽和密教的阴谋。为了活下去，雷克斯不得不拥有一颗好奇善问的心，让自己赶在下一场灾祸的前头。

all_card.real_back_flavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong. That business in Innsmouth with the photographs that had blown out to sea. The tracks in Dunwich that had washed away in the rain just before he'd brought the sheriff. all_card.back_flavor: 萝拉在全球各地出演剧目时，戏票每每都被抢购一空，但从没有一部剧像《黄衣之王》一般不详而诡异。就连排练期间，戏班子都连遭厄运。一天，与她联袂出演的米里亚姆被人发现浮尸于塞纳河上，她终于崩溃了，提笔写下辞职信，告诉导演下一场就是自己的告别演出。现在她回到自己的家乡阿卡姆，准备最后一次演出，她也希望这一次能永远告别这出可怕的戏剧。
all_card.back_text: 变异。 卡牌张数：35。 牌组构建选项：求生者、守卫者、探求者、流浪者和潜修者卡([survivor]、[guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic])等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：2张即兴表演、2张身分危机、1张随机基础弱点。 其它需求：你的牌组必须包含3个不同职阶([survivor]、[guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic])，每个职阶至少7张卡牌。 额外设置：在你抽取起始手牌后：选择一个角色([survivor]、[guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic]或中立)。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Lola has performed to sold-out houses worldwide, but no play has been as haunting or as odd as The King in Yellow. Even during rehearsals, everything about it brought calamity and dread. When her co-star, Miriam, was found floating dead in the Seine, she decided she'd had enough, and penned a letter to the director explaining that her next performance would be her last. Now she heads home to Arkham for one final show, hoping she can finally be rid of this dreadful play.

all_card.back_flavor: 曼蒂打从小时候开始，睡不着就会看书。许多夜晚都是如此度过的。她过目不忘，擅长联系事物找出真相，因此她得到了米斯卡塔尼克大学的一份宝贵工作——研究员。她曾花上数小时翻阅那些古老的禁书，细细阅读书中的亵渎内容。在阅读过程中，她发现字里行间在有规律地暗示着一场大乱即将来临。她是不是得了妄想症？还是说真有一场灾难或是动乱将要发生？

all_card.real_back_flavor: Ever since she was a child, Mandy would read whenever she could not sleep. Such has been the case on many nights. Her remarkable memory and ability to correlate facts have landed her a highly valued job as a researcher for Miskatonic University. She has spent hours poring over the profane pages of ancient, forbidden texts. In doing so, she has discovered a pattern indicating an impending catacylsm. Has paranoia finally caught up to her? Or is a disaster of truly epic proportions on the horizon?

all_card.back_flavor: 特里希向来文武双全，她坚定不移，追求卓越，无所畏惧，敢打敢拼，让她屡屡马到成功。鉴于她智体皆优的毕业记录，人人都指望她再干一番大事业。但特里希却去了一家商业密码公司。她的工作实在平平，旁人最初的惊讶也都消磨，一度被寄予重望的特里希·斯卡波罗已经泯然众人。但这却很适合特里希，也让旁人更难发现真相：她日常的工作不过是一种伪装，真实身份却是黑室这一官方译码特工组织的间谍。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Trish had always excelled in both body and mind, her unwavering focus on excellence and her fearless disposition a winning combination. Given her stellar academic and athletic records, everyone expected to see her become something great. Instead, Trish took a job at a commercial code company. The initial shock of her humble work eventually wore off, and the exceptional Trish Scarborough faded into obscurity. This suited Trish just fine, as it made it harder for anyone to realize the truth: her job was a cover for her true work as a spy with the Black Chamber, the Bureau's code-breaking agency.

all_card.back_flavor: 每每灾祸来临，雷克斯·墨菲总是首当其冲。只要和雷克斯待上一天，哪怕是最坚定的无神论者都会坚信，这个男人一定是被诅咒了。每次一有好报道的苗头，事情就开始不对劲了。印斯茅斯的记录和照片一起都吹到了海里。在敦威治的时候，他刚要报警，路上的踪迹就被雨水冲得一干二净。这糟糕的运气已经不止一次让他直面可怕的野兽和密教的阴谋。为了活下去，雷克斯不得不拥有一颗好奇善问的心，让自己赶在下一场灾祸的前头。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，所有其他职阶的卡牌([guardian]、[rogue]、[mystic]和/或[survivor])等级0最多5张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：寻找真相、雷克斯的诅咒、1张随机基础弱点。 牌库构建限制：无[[幸运]]卡牌。
all_card.flavor: “这次，什么都不能阻止我发现真相。”

all_card.real_back_flavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong. That business in Innsmouth with the photographs that had blown out to sea. The tracks in Dunwich that had washed away in the rain just before he'd brought the sheriff. His terrible fortune has more than once exposed him to gruesome beasts and occult conspiracies. To survive, Rex has developed an inquisitive mind, keeping one step ahead of the next disaster.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Search for the Truth, Rex's Curse, 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Fortune]] cards.

all_card.back_flavor: 萝拉在全球各地出演剧目时，戏票每每都被抢购一空，但从没有一部剧像《黄衣之王》一般不详而诡异。就连排练期间，戏班子都连遭厄运。一天，与她联袂出演的米里亚姆被人发现浮尸于塞纳河上，她终于崩溃了，提笔写下辞职信，告诉导演下一场就是自己的告别演出。现在她回到自己的家乡阿卡姆，准备最后一次演出，她也希望这一次能永远告别这出可怕的戏剧。
