all_card.real_back_flavor: Lola has performed to sold-out houses worldwide, but no play has been as haunting or as odd as The King in Yellow. Even during rehearsals, everything about it brought calamity and dread. When her co-star, Miriam, was found floating dead in the Seine, she decided she'd had enough, and penned a letter to the director explaining that her next performance would be her last. Now she heads home to Arkham for one final show, hoping she can finally be rid of this dreadful play.

all_card.back_flavor: 曼蒂打从小时候开始，睡不着就会看书。许多夜晚都是如此度过的。她过目不忘，擅长联系事物找出真相，因此她得到了米斯卡塔尼克大学的一份宝贵工作——研究员。她曾花上数小时翻阅那些古老的禁书，细细阅读书中的亵渎内容。在阅读过程中，她发现字里行间在有规律地暗示着一场大乱即将来临。她是不是得了妄想症？还是说真有一场灾难或是动乱将要发生？

Her remarkable memory and ability to correlate facts have landed her a highly valued job as a researcher for Miskatonic University. She has spent hours poring over the profane pages of ancient, forbidden texts. In doing so, she has discovered a pattern indicating an impending catacylsm. Has paranoia finally caught up to her? Or is a disaster of truly epic proportions on the horizon?

all_card.back_flavor: 每每灾祸来临，雷克斯·墨菲总是首当其冲。只要和雷克斯待上一天，哪怕是最坚定的无神论者都会坚信，这个男人一定是被诅咒了。每次一有好报道的苗头，事情就开始不对劲了。印斯茅斯的记录和照片一起都吹到了海里。在敦威治的时候，他刚要报警，路上的踪迹就被雨水冲得一干二净。这糟糕的运气已经不止一次让他直面可怕的野兽和密教的阴谋。为了活下去，雷克斯不得不拥有一颗好奇善问的心，让自己赶在下一场灾祸的前头。
all_card.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，所有其他职阶的卡牌([guardian]、[rogue]、[mystic]和/或[survivor])等级0最多5张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：寻找真相、雷克斯的诅咒、1张随机基础弱点。 牌库构建限制：无[[幸运]]卡牌。
all_card.flavor: “这次，什么都不能阻止我发现真相。”

all_card.real_back_flavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong. That business in Innsmouth with the photographs that had blown out to sea. The tracks in Dunwich that had washed away in the rain just before he'd brought the sheriff. His terrible fortune has more than once exposed him to gruesome beasts and occult conspiracies. To survive, Rex has developed an inquisitive mind, keeping one step ahead of the next disaster.
all_card.real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Search for the Truth, Rex's Curse, 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Fortune]] cards.
all_card.real_flavor: "This time, nothing will stop me from getting at the truth!"

all_card.back_flavor: 萝拉在全球各地出演剧目时，戏票每每都被抢购一空，但从没有一部剧像《黄衣之王》一般不详而诡异。就连排练期间，戏班子都连遭厄运。一天，与她联袂出演的米里亚姆被人发现浮尸于塞纳河上，她终于崩溃了，提笔写下辞职信，告诉导演下一场就是自己的告别演出。现在她回到自己的家乡阿卡姆，准备最后一次演出，她也希望这一次能永远告别这出可怕的戏剧。
all_card.back_text: 变异。 卡牌张数：35。 牌组构建选项：求生者、守卫者、探求者、流浪者和潜修者卡([survivor]、[guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic])等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：2张即兴表演、2张身分危机、1张随机基础弱点。 其它需求：你的牌组必须包含3个不同职阶([survivor]、[guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic])，每个职阶至少7张卡牌。 额外设置：在你抽取起始手牌后：选择一个角色([survivor]、[guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic]或中立)。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Lola has performed to sold-out houses worldwide, but no play has been as haunting or as odd as The King in Yellow. Even during rehearsals, everything about it brought calamity and dread. When her co-star, Miriam, was found floating dead in the Seine, she decided she'd had enough, and penned a letter to the director explaining that her next performance would be her last. Now she heads home to Arkham for one final show, hoping she can finally be rid of this dreadful play.

all_card.back_flavor: 曼蒂打从小时候开始，睡不着就会看书。许多夜晚都是如此度过的。她过目不忘，擅长联系事物找出真相，因此她得到了米斯卡塔尼克大学的一份宝贵工作——研究员。她曾花上数小时翻阅那些古老的禁书，细细阅读书中的亵渎内容。在阅读过程中，她发现字里行间在有规律地暗示着一场大乱即将来临。她是不是得了妄想症？还是说真有一场灾难或是动乱将要发生？

all_card.real_back_flavor: Ever since she was a child, Mandy would read whenever she could not sleep. Such has been the case on many nights. Her remarkable memory and ability to correlate facts have landed her a highly valued job as a researcher for Miskatonic University. She has spent hours poring over the profane pages of ancient, forbidden texts. In doing so, she has discovered a pattern indicating an impending catacylsm. Has paranoia finally caught up to her? Or is a disaster of truly epic proportions on the horizon?

all_card.back_flavor: 特里希向来文武双全，她坚定不移，追求卓越，无所畏惧，敢打敢拼，让她屡屡马到成功。鉴于她智体皆优的毕业记录，人人都指望她再干一番大事业。但特里希却去了一家商业密码公司。她的工作实在平平，旁人最初的惊讶也都消磨，一度被寄予重望的特里希·斯卡波罗已经泯然众人。但这却很适合特里希，也让旁人更难发现真相：她日常的工作不过是一种伪装，真实身份却是黑室这一官方译码特工组织的间谍。

all_card.real_back_flavor: Trish had always excelled in both body and mind, her unwavering focus on excellence and her fearless disposition a winning combination. Given her stellar academic and athletic records, everyone expected to see her become something great. Instead, Trish took a job at a commercial code company. The initial shock of her humble work eventually wore off, and the exceptional Trish Scarborough faded into obscurity. This suited Trish just fine, as it made it harder for anyone to realize the truth: her job was a cover for her true work as a spy with the Black Chamber, the Bureau's code-breaking agency.
